fresh_translation: At the beginning, God made heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: In the beginning God made the heaven and the earth.

fresh_translation: Now the earth was unseen and unformed, darkness was over the abyss, and the Spirit of God moved over the water.
brenton_translation: But the earth was unsightly and unfurnished, and darkness was over the deep, and the Spirit of God moved over the water.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let light come to be.' And light came to be.
brenton_translation: And God said, Let there be light, and there was light.

fresh_translation: And God saw the light, that it was good. And God separated the light from the darkness.
brenton_translation: And God saw the light that it was good, and God divided between the light and the darkness.

fresh_translation: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And evening came, and morning came: day one.
brenton_translation: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night, and there was evening and there was morning, the first day.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let a firm span come to be in the middle of the water, and let it divide water from water.' And it came to be so.
brenton_translation: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the water, and let it be a division between water and water, and it was so.

fresh_translation: And God made the firm span, and God separated the water below the firm span from the water above the firm span.
brenton_translation: And God made the firmament, and God divided between the water which was under the firmament and the water which was above the firmament.

fresh_translation: And God called the firm span Heaven. And God saw that it was good. And evening came, and morning came: second day.
brenton_translation: And God called the firmament Heaven, and God saw that it was good, and there was evening and there was morning, the second day.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let the water below Heaven be gathered into one gathering, and let the dry land appear.' And it came to be so. And the water below Heaven was gathered into collections, and the dry land appeared.
brenton_translation: And God said, Let the water which is under the heaven be collected into one place, and let the dry land appear, and it was so. And the water which was under the heaven was collected into its places, and the dry land appeared.

fresh_translation: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathered waters he called Seas. And God saw that it was good.
brenton_translation: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gatherings of the waters he called Seas, and God saw that it was good.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let the earth sprout seed-bearing grass and herb according to kind and likeness, and fruit-bearing trees making fruit with their seed in them according to kind upon the earth.' And it came to be so.
brenton_translation: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the herb of grass bearing seed according to its kind and according to its likeness, and the fruit-tree bearing fruit whose seed is in it, according to its kind on the earth, and it was so.

fresh_translation: And the earth brought forth seed-bearing grass and herb according to kind and likeness, and fruit-bearing trees making fruit with their seed in them according to kind upon the earth. And God saw that it was good.
brenton_translation: And the earth brought forth the herb of grass bearing seed according to its kind and according to its likeness, and the fruit tree bearing fruit whose seed is in it, according to its kind on the earth, and God saw that it was good.

fresh_translation: And evening came, and morning came: third day.
brenton_translation: And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let light-bearers come to be in the firm span of Heaven for shining on the earth, to divide day from night. And let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and for years.'
brenton_translation: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth, to divide between day and night, and let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and for years.

fresh_translation: And let them be for shining in the firm span of Heaven so as to shine on the earth. And it came to be so.
brenton_translation: And let them be for light in the firmament of the heaven, so as to shine upon the earth, and it was so.

fresh_translation: And God made the two great light-bearers, the greater light-bearer for the dominion of the day and the lesser light-bearer for the dominion of the night, and the stars.
brenton_translation: And God made the two great lights, the greater light for regulating the day and the lesser light for regulating the night, the stars also.

fresh_translation: And God placed them in the firm span of Heaven so as to shine on the earth.
brenton_translation: And God placed them in the firmament of the heaven, so as to shine upon the earth,

fresh_translation: And they were to rule day and night and to divide light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.
brenton_translation: and to regulate day and night, and to divide between the light and the darkness. And God saw that it was good.

fresh_translation: And evening came, and morning came: fourth day.
brenton_translation: And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let the waters bring forth swarming living creatures and winged birds flying over the earth across the firm span of Heaven.' And it came to be so.
brenton_translation: And God said, Let the waters bring forth reptiles having life, and winged creatures flying above the earth in the firmament of heaven, and it was so.

fresh_translation: And God made the great sea-creatures and every living creature among the swarming things that the waters brought forth according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to kind. And God saw that they were good.
brenton_translation: And God made great whales, and every living reptile, which the waters brought forth according to their kinds, and every creature that flies with wings according to its kind, and God saw that they were good.

fresh_translation: And God blessed them, saying, 'Increase and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth.'
brenton_translation: And God blessed them, saying, Increase and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let the creatures that fly be multiplied on the earth.

fresh_translation: And evening came, and morning came: fifth day.
brenton_translation: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to kind: four-footed animals and creeping things and wild beasts of the earth according to kind.' And it came to be so.
brenton_translation: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature according to its kind, quadrupeds and reptiles and wild beasts of the earth according to their kind, and it was so.

fresh_translation: And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to kind, and the livestock according to their kind, and every creeping thing of the earth according to its kind. And God saw that they were good.
brenton_translation: And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to their kind, and cattle according to their kind, and all the reptiles of the earth according to their kind, and God saw that they were good.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Let us make humankind according to our image and according to likeness, and let them rule the fish of the sea and the birds of Heaven and the livestock and all the earth and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.'
brenton_translation: And God said, Let us make man according to our image and likeness, and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the flying creatures of heaven, and over the cattle and all the earth, and over all the reptiles that creep on the earth.

fresh_translation: And God made humankind; according to God's image he made humankind. Male and female he made them.
brenton_translation: And God made man, according to the image of God he made him, male and female he made them.

fresh_translation: And God blessed them, saying, 'Increase and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it, and rule the fish of the sea and the birds of Heaven and all the livestock and all the earth and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.'
brenton_translation: And God blessed them, saying, Increase and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it, and have dominion over the fish of the seas and flying creatures of heaven, and all the cattle and all the earth, and all the reptiles that creep on the earth.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Look, I have given you every seed-bearing plant that sows seed on all the earth, and every tree that has in itself fruit with seed for sowing. It will be food for you.'
brenton_translation: And God said, Behold I have given to you every seed-bearing herb sowing seed which is upon all the earth, and every tree which has in itself the fruit of seed that is sown, to you it shall be for food.

fresh_translation: And to every wild beast of the earth and every bird of Heaven and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, everything that has in itself living breath, I have given every green plant for food. And it came to be so.
brenton_translation: And to all the wild beasts of the earth, and to all the flying creatures of heaven, and to every reptile creeping on the earth, which has in itself the breath of life, even every green plant for food; and it was so.

fresh_translation: And God saw all that he had made, and look, it was very good. And evening came, and morning came: sixth day.
brenton_translation: And God saw all the things that he had made, and, behold, they were very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

fresh_translation: And Heaven and Earth were completed, and all their ordered array.
brenton_translation: And the heavens and the earth were finished, and the whole world of them.

fresh_translation: And God completed his works, the works he had made, on the sixth day, and he rested on the seventh day from all his works that he had made.
brenton_translation: And God finished on the sixth day his works which he made, and he ceased on the seventh day from all his works which he made.

fresh_translation: And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all his works, the works God had begun to make.
brenton_translation: And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it he ceased from all his works which God began to do.

fresh_translation: This is the book of the origin of Heaven and Earth, when they came to be, on the day the Lord God made Heaven and Earth.
brenton_translation: This is the book of the generation of heaven and earth, when they were made, in the day in which the Lord God made the heaven and the earth,

fresh_translation: And every green thing of the field was there before it came to be on the earth, and every grass of the field before it sprang up; for God had not rained on the earth, and there was no human to work it.
brenton_translation: and every herb of the field before it was on the earth, and all the grass of the field before it sprang up, for God had not rained on the earth, and there was not a man to cultivate it.

fresh_translation: But a spring was rising from the earth and watering the whole face of the ground.
brenton_translation: But there rose a fountain out of the earth, and watered the whole face of the earth.

fresh_translation: And God formed the human from dust of the earth and breathed into his face the breath of life, and the human became a living soul.
brenton_translation: And God formed the man of dust of the earth, and breathed upon his face the breath of life, and the man became a living soul.

fresh_translation: And God planted a garden in Eden toward the east, and he placed there the human whom he formed.
brenton_translation: And God planted a garden eastward in Edem, and placed there the man whom he had formed.

fresh_translation: And God still caused every tree to spring up from the earth, beautiful to look at and good for food, and the tree of life in the middle of the garden, and the tree of knowing good and evil.
brenton_translation: And God made to spring up also out of the earth every tree beautiful to the eye and good for food, and the tree of life in the midst of the garden, and the tree of learning the knowledge of good and evil.

fresh_translation: But a river goes out from Eden to water the garden; from there it is divided into four heads.
brenton_translation: And a river proceeds out of Edem to water the garden, thence it divides itself into four heads.

fresh_translation: The name of the first is Pishon; this is the one that circles all the land of Havilah, where the gold is.
brenton_translation: The name of the one, Phisom, this it is which encircles the whole land of Evilat, where there is gold.

fresh_translation: And the gold of that land is good; and there too are the carbuncle and the green stone.
brenton_translation: And the gold of that land is good, there also is carbuncle and emerald.

fresh_translation: And the name of the second river is Gihon; this is the one that circles all the land of Ethiopia.
brenton_translation: And the name of the second river is Geon, this it is which encircles the whole land of Ethiopia.

fresh_translation: And the third river is Tigris; this is the one that goes opposite the Assyrians. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
brenton_translation: And the third river is Tigris, this is that which flows forth over against the Assyrians. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God took the human whom he had formed and placed him in the garden of delight, to work it and to keep it.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God took the man whom he had formed, and placed him in the garden of Delight, to cultivate and keep it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God commanded Adam, saying that from every tree in the garden he might surely eat,
brenton_translation: And the Lord God gave a charge to Adam, saying, Of every tree which is in the garden thou mayest freely eat,

fresh_translation: but from the tree of knowing good and evil, he was not to eat from it; on the day he ate from it, he would certainly die.
brenton_translation: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil—of it ye shall not eat, but in whatsoever day ye eat of it, ye shall surely die.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said, 'It is not good for the human to be alone. Let us make for him a helper corresponding to him.'
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone, let us make for him a help suitable to him.

fresh_translation: And God still formed from the earth all the beasts of the field and all the birds of Heaven, and brought them to Adam to see what he would call them. And whatever Adam called each living creature, that was its name.
brenton_translation: And God formed yet farther out of the earth all the wild beasts of the field, and all the birds of the sky, and he brought them to Adam, to see what he would call them, and whatever Adam called any living creature, that was the name of it.

fresh_translation: And Adam gave names to all the livestock and to all the birds of Heaven and to all the beasts of the field. But for Adam no helper like him was found.
brenton_translation: And Adam gave names to all the cattle and to all the birds of the sky, and to all the wild beasts of the field, but for Adam there was not found a help like to himself.

fresh_translation: And God cast an ecstasy on Adam, and he slept; and he took one of his sides and filled flesh in its place.
brenton_translation: And God brought a trance upon Adam, and he slept, and he took one of his ribs, and filled up the flesh instead thereof.

fresh_translation: And God built the side that he had taken from Adam into a woman and brought her to Adam.
brenton_translation: And God formed the rib which he took from Adam into a woman, and brought her to Adam.

fresh_translation: And Adam said, 'This now is bone from my bones and flesh from my flesh. She shall be called woman, because she was taken from her man.'
brenton_translation: And Adam said, This now is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called woman, because she was taken out of her husband.

fresh_translation: Because of this, a man will leave his father and his mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother and shall cleave to his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

fresh_translation: And the two were naked, Adam and his wife, and they were not ashamed.
brenton_translation: And the two were naked, both Adam and his wife, and were not ashamed.

fresh_translation: Now the serpent was the most shrewd of all the beasts on the earth that the Lord God had made. And the serpent said to the woman, 'Why is it that God said, "You shall not eat from every tree of the garden"?'
brenton_translation: Now the serpent was the most crafty of all the brutes on the earth, which the Lord God made, and the serpent said to the woman, Wherefore has God said, Eat not of every tree of the garden?

fresh_translation: And the woman said to the serpent that they would eat from the fruit of the trees of the garden,
brenton_translation: And the woman said to the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden,

fresh_translation: but from the fruit of the tree that is in the middle of the garden, God had said they should not eat from it, nor indeed touch it, lest they die.
brenton_translation: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

fresh_translation: And the serpent said to the woman that they would certainly not die.
brenton_translation: And the serpent said to the woman, Ye shall not surely die.

fresh_translation: For God knew that on the day you eat from it, your eyes will be opened and you will be like gods, knowing good and evil.'
brenton_translation: For God knew that in whatever day ye should eat of it your eyes would be opened, and ye would be as gods, knowing good and evil.

fresh_translation: And the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes to look at, and that it was beautiful for understanding. And taking from its fruit, she ate; and she gave also to her husband with her, and they ate.
brenton_translation: And the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes to look upon and beautiful to contemplate, and having taken of its fruit she ate, and she gave to her husband also with her, and they ate.

fresh_translation: And the eyes of the two were opened, and they knew that they were naked, and they sewed fig leaves together and made loincloths for themselves.
brenton_translation: And the eyes of both were opened, and they perceived that they were naked, and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons to go round them.

fresh_translation: And they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden at evening, and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the face of the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
brenton_translation: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the afternoon; and both Adam and his wife hid themselves from the face of the Lord God in the midst of the trees of the garden.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God called Adam and said to him, 'Adam, where are you?'
brenton_translation: And the Lord God called Adam and said to him, Adam, where art thou?

fresh_translation: And he said to him, 'I heard your sound as you were walking in the garden, and I was afraid because I am naked, and I hid myself.'
brenton_translation: And he said to him, I heard thy voice as thou walkedst in the garden, and I feared because I was naked and I hid myself.

fresh_translation: And God said to him, 'Who told you that you are naked, unless you have eaten from the tree from which alone I commanded you not to eat?'
brenton_translation: And God said to him, Who told thee that thou wast naked, unless thou hast eaten of the tree concerning which I charged thee of it alone not to eat?

fresh_translation: And Adam said, 'The woman whom you gave with me, she gave me from the tree, and I ate.'
brenton_translation: And Adam said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me—she gave me of the tree and I ate.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to the woman, 'What is this you have done?' And the woman said, 'The serpent deceived me, and I ate.'
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to the woman, Why hast thou done this? And the woman said, The serpent deceived me and I ate.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to the serpent that because you did this, you are cursed above all livestock and above all the beasts on the earth. On your chest and your belly you will go, and earth you will eat all the days of your life.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to the serpent, Because thou hast done this thou art cursed above all cattle and all the brutes of the earth, on thy breast and belly thou shalt go, and thou shalt eat earth all the days of thy life.

fresh_translation: And he would put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will watch your head, and you will watch his heel.
brenton_translation: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman and between thy seed and her seed, he shall watch against thy head, and thou shalt watch against his heel.

fresh_translation: And to the woman he said that multiplying he would multiply your pains and your groaning. In pains you will bear children, and your turning will be toward your husband, and he will rule over you.
brenton_translation: And to the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy pains and thy groanings; in pain thou shalt bring forth children, and thy submission shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

fresh_translation: And to Adam he said that because you listened to the voice of your wife and ate from the tree from which alone he commanded you not to eat, the ground is cursed in your labors. In pains you will eat from it all the days of your life.
brenton_translation: And to Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened to the voice of thy wife, and eaten of the tree concerning which I charged thee of it only not to eat—of that thou hast eaten, cursed is the ground in thy labours, in pain shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life.

fresh_translation: It will bring forth thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the grass of the field.
brenton_translation: Thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to thee, and thou shalt eat the herb of the field.

fresh_translation: By the sweat of your face you will eat your bread, until you return to the earth from which you were taken; because earth you are, and to earth you will depart.
brenton_translation: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat thy bread until thou return to the earth out of which thou wast taken, for earth thou art and to earth thou shalt return.

fresh_translation: And Adam called the name of his wife Life, because she is the mother of all the living.
brenton_translation: And Adam called the name of his wife Life, because she was the mother of all living.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God made skin tunics for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God made for Adam and his wife garments of skin, and clothed them.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'Look, Adam has become like one of us, to know good and evil. And now, lest perhaps he stretch out his hand and take from the tree of life and eat and live forever.'
brenton_translation: And God said, Behold, Adam is become as one of us, to know good and evil, and now lest at any time he stretch forth his hand, and take of the tree of life and eat, and so he shall live for ever—

fresh_translation: And the Lord God sent him out from the garden of delight to work the earth from which he had been taken.
brenton_translation: So the Lord God sent him forth out of the garden of Delight to cultivate the ground out of which he was taken.

fresh_translation: And he cast Adam out and settled him opposite the garden of delight, and he stationed the Cherubim and the flaming turning sword to guard the way of the tree of life.
brenton_translation: And he cast out Adam and caused him to dwell over against the garden of Delight, and stationed the cherubs and the fiery sword that turns about to keep the way of the tree of life.

fresh_translation: And Adam knew Eve his wife, and having conceived she bore Cain and said, 'I have acquired a man through God.'
brenton_translation: And Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and brought forth Cain and said, I have gained a man through God.

fresh_translation: And she added to bear his brother Abel. And Abel became a shepherd of sheep, but Cain was working the earth.
brenton_translation: And she again bore his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after days that Cain brought from the fruits of the earth a sacrifice to the Lord,
brenton_translation: And it was so after some time that Cain brought of the fruits of the earth a sacrifice to the Lord.

fresh_translation: and Abel, he too brought from the firstborn of his sheep and from their fat portions. And God looked upon Abel and upon his gifts,
brenton_translation: And Abel also brought of the firstborn of his sheep and of his fatlings, and God looked upon Abel and his gifts,

fresh_translation: but upon Cain and upon his sacrifices he gave no heed. And Cain was greatly grieved, and his face fell.
brenton_translation: but Cain and his sacrifices he regarded not, and Cain was exceedingly sorrowful and his countenance fell.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to Cain, 'Why did you become deeply grieved, and why did your face fall?'
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to Cain, Why art thou become very sorrowful and why is thy countenance fallen?

fresh_translation: 'If you offered rightly, but did not divide rightly, did you not sin? Be still. Toward you is its turning, and you shall rule it.'
brenton_translation: Hast thou not sinned if thou hast brought it rightly, but not rightly divided it? be still, to thee shall be his submission, and thou shalt rule over him.

fresh_translation: And Cain said to Abel his brother, 'Let us go through into the field.' And it came to be while they were in the field that Cain rose against Abel his brother and killed him.
brenton_translation: And Cain said to Abel his brother, Let us go out into the plain; and it came to pass that when they were in the plain Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to Cain, 'Where is Abel your brother?' And he said, 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? and he said, I know not, am I my brother's keeper?

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, 'What have you done? A voice of your brother's blood cries out to me from the earth.'
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood cries to me out of the ground.

fresh_translation: And now cursed are you from the earth, which opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.
brenton_translation: And now thou art cursed from the earth which has opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand.

fresh_translation: When you work the earth, it shall not continue to give you its strength. Groaning and trembling you shall be on the earth.
brenton_translation: When thou tillest the earth, then it shall not continue to give its strength to thee: thou shalt be groaning and trembling on the earth.

fresh_translation: And Cain said to the Lord God, 'Greater is my charge than for me to be forgiven.'
brenton_translation: And Cain said to the Lord God, My crime is too great for me to be forgiven.

fresh_translation: If you cast me out today from the face of the earth and I am hidden from your face, then I shall be groaning and trembling on the earth, and everyone finding me will kill me.'
brenton_translation: If thou castest me out this day from the face of the earth, and I shall be hidden from thy presence, and I shall be groaning and trembling upon the earth, then it will be that any one that finds me shall slay me.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to him, 'Not so. Everyone who kills Cain will pay sevenfold.' And the Lord God set a sign for Cain, so that none finding him should kill him.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to him, Not so, any one that slays Cain shall suffer seven-fold vengeance; and the Lord God set a mark upon Cain that no one that found him might slay him.

fresh_translation: And Cain went out from the face of God and lived in the land of Naid opposite Eden.
brenton_translation: So Cain went forth from the presence of God and dwelt in the land of Nod over against Edem.

fresh_translation: And Cain knew his wife, and having conceived she bore Enoch. And he was building a city, and he named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
brenton_translation: And Cain knew his wife, and having conceived she bore Enoch; and he built a city; and he named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

fresh_translation: And to Enoch was born Gaidad, and Gaidad begot Maleleel, and Maleleel begot Methusala, and Methusala begot Lamech.
brenton_translation: And to Enoch was born Gaidad; and Gaidad begot Maleleel; and Maleleel begot Mathusala; and Mathusala begot Lamech.

fresh_translation: And Lamech took two wives for himself, the name of one Ada and the name of the second Sella.
brenton_translation: And Lamech took to himself two wives; the name of the one was Ada, and the name of the second Sella.

fresh_translation: And Ada bore Iobel. He was father of those dwelling in tents, herders of livestock.
brenton_translation: And Ada bore Jobel; he was the father of those that dwell in tents, feeding cattle.

fresh_translation: And the name of his brother was Ioubal. He was the one who introduced harp and lyre.
brenton_translation: And the name of his brother was Jubal; he it was who invented the psaltery and harp.

fresh_translation: And Sella also bore Thobel, and he was a hammering smith of bronze and iron. And the sister of Thobel was Noema.
brenton_translation: And Sella also bore Thobel; he was a smith, a manufacturer both of brass and iron; and the sister of Thobel was Noëma.

fresh_translation: And Lamech said to his wives, 'Ada and Sella, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, listen to my words. For I killed a man for a wound to me, and a young man for a welt to me.'
brenton_translation: And Lamech said to his wives, Ada and Sella, Hear my voice, ye wives of Lamech, consider my words, because I have slain a man to my sorrow and a youth to my grief.

fresh_translation: Because Cain has been avenged sevenfold, but Lamech seventy times seven.'
brenton_translation: Because vengeance has been exacted seven times on Cain's behalf, on Lamech's it shall be seventy times seven.

fresh_translation: And Adam knew Eve his wife, and having conceived she bore a son, and named his name Seth, saying, 'For God raised up for me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain killed.'
brenton_translation: And Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and called his name Seth, saying, For God has raised up to me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

fresh_translation: And to Seth there came a son, and he named his name Enos. This one hoped to call on the name of the Lord God.
brenton_translation: And Seth had a son, and he called his name Enos: he hoped to call on the name of the Lord God.

fresh_translation: This is the book of the origin of humans. On the day God made Adam, according to the image of God he made him.
brenton_translation: This is the genealogy of men in the day in which God made Adam; in the image of God he made him:

fresh_translation: Male and female he made them, and he blessed them, and he called their name Adam on the day he made them.
brenton_translation: male and female he made them, and blessed them; and he called his name Adam, in the day in which he made them.

fresh_translation: And Adam lived two hundred and thirty years, and begot according to his form and according to his image, and he named his name Seth.
brenton_translation: And Adam lived two hundred and thirty years, and begot a son after his own form, and after his own image, and he called his name Seth.

fresh_translation: And the days of Adam, which he lived after begetting Seth, were seven hundred years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And the days of Adam, which he lived after his begetting Seth, were seven hundred years; and he begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Adam, which he lived, were nine hundred and thirty years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Adam which he lived were nine hundred and thirty years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Seth lived two hundred and five years and begot Enos.
brenton_translation: Now Seth lived two hundred and five years, and begot Enos.

fresh_translation: And Seth lived after begetting Enos seven hundred and seven years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Seth lived after his begetting Enos, seven hundred and seven years, and he begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Enos lived one hundred and ninety years and begot Cainan.
brenton_translation: And Enos lived an hundred and ninety years, and begot Cainan.

fresh_translation: And Enos lived after begetting Cainan seven hundred and fifteen years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Enos lived after his begetting Cainan, seven hundred and fifteen years, and he begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Cainan lived one hundred and seventy years and begot Maleleel.
brenton_translation: And Cainan lived an hundred and seventy years, and he begot Maleleel.

fresh_translation: And Cainan lived after begetting Maleleel seven hundred and forty years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Cainan lived after his begetting Maleleel, seven hundred and forty years, and he begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Maleleel lived one hundred and sixty-five years and begot Jared.
brenton_translation: And Maleleel lived an hundred and sixty and five years, and he begot Jared.

fresh_translation: And Maleleel lived after begetting Jared seven hundred and thirty years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Maleleel lived after his begetting Jared, seven hundred and thirty years, and he begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Maleleel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Maleleel were eight hundred and ninety and five years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years and begot Enoch.
brenton_translation: And Jared lived an hundred and sixty and two years, and begot Enoch:

fresh_translation: And Jared lived after begetting Enoch eight hundred years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: and Jared lived after his begetting Enoch, eight hundred years, and he begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty and two years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Enoch lived one hundred and sixty-five years and begot Methusala.
brenton_translation: And Enoch lived an hundred and sixty and five years, and begat Mathusala.

fresh_translation: And Enoch pleased God after begetting Methusala two hundred years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Enoch was well-pleasing to God after his begetting Mathusala, two hundred years, and he begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty and five years.

fresh_translation: And Enoch pleased God, and he was not found, because God transferred him.
brenton_translation: And Enoch was well-pleasing to God, and was not found, because God translated him.

fresh_translation: And Methusala lived one hundred and sixty-seven years and begot Lamech.
brenton_translation: And Mathusala lived an hundred and sixty and seven years, and begot Lamech.

fresh_translation: And Methusala lived after begetting Lamech eight hundred and two years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Mathusala lived after his begetting Lamech eight hundred and two years, and begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Methusala, which he lived, were nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Mathusala which he lived, were nine hundred and sixty and nine years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-eight years and begot a son.
brenton_translation: And Lamech lived an hundred and eighty and eight years, and begot a son.

fresh_translation: And he named his name Noah, saying, 'This one will give us rest from our works and from the pains of our hands and from the earth, which the Lord God cursed.'
brenton_translation: And he called his name Noe, saying, This one will cause us to cease from our works, and from the toils of our hands, and from the earth, which the Lord God has cursed.

fresh_translation: And Lamech lived after begetting Noah five hundred and sixty-five years, and he begot sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Lamech lived after his begetting Noe, five hundred and sixty and five years, and begot sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and fifty-three years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and fifty-three years, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Noah was five hundred years old, and he begot three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
brenton_translation: And Noe was five hundred years old, and he begot three sons, Sem, Cham, and Japheth.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when humans began to become many on the earth, and daughters were born to them,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when men began to be numerous upon the earth, and daughters were born to them,

fresh_translation: that the sons of God, seeing the daughters of humans that they are beautiful, took wives for themselves from all whom they chose.
brenton_translation: that the sons of God having seen the daughters of men that they were beautiful, took to themselves wives of all whom they chose.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said, 'My spirit shall certainly not remain in these humans forever, because they are flesh, but their days shall be one hundred and twenty years.'
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said, My Spirit shall certainly not remain among these men for ever, because they are flesh, but their days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

fresh_translation: Now giants were on the earth in those days, and after that, whenever the sons of God were going in to the daughters of humans, they were bearing to them. Those were the giants from of old, the men of renown.
brenton_translation: Now the giants were upon the earth in those days; and after that when the sons of God were wont to go in to the daughters of men, they bore children to them, those were the giants of old, the men of renown.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God, seeing that the evils of humans were multiplied on the earth, and that each one was carefully thinking in his heart upon evil things all the days,
brenton_translation: And the Lord God having seen that the wicked actions of men were multiplied upon the earth, and that every one in his heart was intently brooding over evil continually,

fresh_translation: considered that he had made the human on the earth, and he thought it through.
brenton_translation: then God laid it to heart that he had made man upon the earth, and he pondered it deeply.

fresh_translation: And God said, 'I will wipe away the human whom I made from the face of the earth, from human to cattle and from creeping things to birds of heaven, because I regret that I made them.'
brenton_translation: And God said, I will blot out man whom I have made from the face of the earth, even man with cattle, and reptiles with flying creatures of the sky, for I am grieved that I have made them.

fresh_translation: But Noah found favor before the Lord God.
brenton_translation: But Noe found grace before the Lord God.

fresh_translation: Now these are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, complete in his generation. Noah was well-pleasing to God.
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Noe. Noe was a just man; being perfect in his generation, Noe was well-pleasing to God.

fresh_translation: And Noah begot three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
brenton_translation: And Noe begot three sons, Sem, Cham, Japheth.

fresh_translation: And the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with injustice.
brenton_translation: But the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with iniquity.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God saw the earth, and it was corrupted, because all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God saw the earth, and it was corrupted; because all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to Noah, 'The end of every human has come before me, because the earth is filled with injustice from them, and look, I am destroying them and the earth.'
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to Noe, A period of all men is come before me; because the earth has been filled with iniquity by them, and, behold, I destroy them and the earth.

fresh_translation: 'So make for yourself an ark from squared timbers. You shall make nesting compartments in the ark, and you shall pitch it inside and outside with pitch.'
brenton_translation: Make therefore for thyself an ark of square timber; thou shalt make the ark in compartments, and thou shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

fresh_translation: And this is how you shall make the ark: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, and the width fifty cubits, and the height thirty cubits.
brenton_translation: And thus shalt thou make the ark; three hundred cubits the length of the ark, and fifty cubits the breadth, and thirty cubits the height of it.

fresh_translation: You shall make the ark converging together, and you shall finish it to one cubit above. And the door of the ark you shall make from the side. Lower, second, and third stories you shall make it.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt narrow the ark in making it, and in a cubit above thou shalt finish it, and the door of the ark thou shalt make on the side; with lower, second, and third stories thou shalt make it.

fresh_translation: And I, look, am bringing the flood, water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which is breath of life under heaven. And whatever is on the earth will die.
brenton_translation: And behold I bring a flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life under heaven, and whatsoever things are upon the earth shall die.

fresh_translation: And I will establish my covenant with you, and you shall enter into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and the wives of your sons with you.
brenton_translation: And I will establish my covenant with thee, and thou shalt enter into the ark, and thy sons and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

fresh_translation: And from all the cattle and from all the creeping things and from all the wild beasts and from all flesh, two by two from all you shall bring into the ark, so that you may feed them with yourself. Male and female they shall be.
brenton_translation: And of all cattle and of all reptiles and of all wild beasts, even of all flesh, thou shalt bring by pairs of all, into the ark, that thou mayest feed them with thyself: male and female they shall be.

fresh_translation: From all the birds, the flying ones according to kind, and from all the cattle according to kind, and from all the creeping things creeping on the earth according to kind, two by two from all shall come in to you, to be fed with you, male and female.
brenton_translation: Of all winged birds after their kind, and of all cattle after their kind, and of all reptiles creeping upon the earth after their kind, pairs of all shall come in to thee, male and female to be fed with thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall take for yourself from all the foods that you eat, and gather it to yourself, and it shall be for you and for them to eat.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take to thyself of all kinds of food which ye eat, and thou shalt gather them to thyself, and it shall be for thee and them to eat.

fresh_translation: And Noah did all that the Lord God commanded him; thus he did it.
brenton_translation: And Noe did all things whatever the Lord God commanded him, so did he.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to Noah, Enter, you and all your house, into the ark, because I have seen you righteous before me in this generation.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to Noe, Enter thou and all thy family into the ark, for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

fresh_translation: And from the clean cattle bring in to yourself seven by seven, male and female, but from the cattle that are not clean, two by two, male and female,
brenton_translation: And of the clean cattle take in to thee sevens, male and female, and of the unclean cattle pairs male and female.

fresh_translation: and from the clean birds of heaven seven by seven, male and female, and from all the birds not clean, two by two, male and female, to keep seed alive over all the earth.
brenton_translation: And of clean flying creatures of the sky sevens, male and female, and of all unclean flying creatures pairs, male and female, to maintain seed on all the earth.

fresh_translation: For still seven days, and I am bringing rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe out every rising thing that I made from the face of all the earth.
brenton_translation: For yet seven days having passed I bring rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will blot out every offspring which I have made from the face of all the earth.

fresh_translation: And Noah did all that the Lord God commanded him.
brenton_translation: And Noe did all things whatever the Lord God commanded him.

fresh_translation: And Noah was six hundred years old, and the flood of water came upon the earth.
brenton_translation: And Noe was six hundred years old when the flood of water was upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And Noah entered, and his sons and his wife and the wives of his sons with him, into the ark because of the floodwater.
brenton_translation: And then went in Noe and his sons and his wife, and his sons' wives with him into the ark, because of the water of the flood.

fresh_translation: And from the clean birds and from the birds not clean and from the clean cattle and from the cattle not clean and from all the creeping things on the earth,
brenton_translation: And of clean flying creatures and of unclean flying creatures, and of clean cattle and of unclean cattle, and of all things that creep upon the earth,

fresh_translation: two by two entered to Noah into the ark, male and female, just as God commanded Noah.
brenton_translation: pairs went in to Noe into the ark, male and female, as God commanded Noe.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after the seven days that the water of the flood came upon the earth.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the seven days that the water of the flood came upon the earth.

fresh_translation: In the six-hundredth year in the life of Noah, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, on that day all the springs of the abyss burst open, and the floodgates of heaven were opened.
brenton_translation: In the six hundredth year of the life of Noe, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, on this day all the fountains of the abyss were broken up, and the flood-gates of heaven were opened.

fresh_translation: And rain came upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
brenton_translation: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

fresh_translation: On that day Noah entered, Shem, Ham, Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons with him, into the ark,
brenton_translation: On that very day entered Noe, Sem, Cham, Japheth, the sons of Noe, and the wife of Noe, and the three wives of his sons with him into the ark.

fresh_translation: and every wild beast according to kind, and all the cattle according to kind, and every creeping thing moving on the earth according to kind, and every bird according to its kind,
brenton_translation: And all the wild beasts after their kind, and all cattle after their kind, and every reptile moving itself on the earth after its kind, and every flying bird after its kind,

fresh_translation: entered to Noah into the ark, two by two, male and female, from all flesh in which is spirit of life.
brenton_translation: went in to Noe into the ark, pairs, male and female of all flesh in which is the breath of life.

fresh_translation: And those entering, male and female from all flesh, entered just as God commanded Noah. And the Lord God shut the ark outside him.
brenton_translation: And they that entered went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded Noe, and the Lord God shut the ark outside of him.

fresh_translation: And the flood came forty days and forty nights upon the earth, and the water multiplied and lifted the ark, and it was raised from the earth.
brenton_translation: And the flood was upon the earth forty days and forty nights, and the water abounded greatly and bore up the ark, and it was lifted on high from off the earth.

fresh_translation: And the water prevailed and multiplied greatly upon the earth, and the ark was borne along upon the water.
brenton_translation: And the water prevailed and abounded exceedingly upon the earth, and the ark was borne upon the water.

fresh_translation: And the water prevailed very, very greatly upon the earth and covered all the high mountains that were under heaven.
brenton_translation: And the water prevailed exceedingly upon the earth, and covered all the high mountains which were under heaven.

fresh_translation: Fifteen cubits above, the water rose and covered all the high mountains.
brenton_translation: Fifteen cubits upwards was the water raised, and it covered all the high mountains.

fresh_translation: And all flesh moving on the earth died: birds and cattle and wild beasts and every creeping thing moving on the earth, and every human.
brenton_translation: And there died all flesh that moved upon the earth, of flying creatures and cattle, and of wild beasts, and every reptile moving upon the earth, and every man.

fresh_translation: And everything having breath of life, and everything that was on the dry land, died.
brenton_translation: And all things which have the breath of life, and whatever was on the dry land, died.

fresh_translation: And he wiped out every rising thing that was on the face of the earth, from human to cattle and creeping things and birds of heaven, and they were wiped from the earth. And Noah alone was left, and those with him in the ark.
brenton_translation: And God blotted out every offspring which was upon the face of the earth, both man and beast, and reptiles, and birds of the sky, and they were blotted out from the earth, and Noe was left alone, and those with him in the ark.

fresh_translation: And the water was raised over the earth one hundred and fifty days.
brenton_translation: And the water was raised over the earth an hundred and fifty days.

fresh_translation: And God remembered Noah and all the wild beasts and all the cattle and all the birds and all the creeping things that creep, as many as were with him in the ark, and God brought a wind upon the earth, and the water subsided.
brenton_translation: And God remembered Noe, and all the wild beasts, and all the cattle, and all the birds, and all the reptiles that creep, as many as were with him in the ark, and God brought a wind upon the earth, and the water stayed.

fresh_translation: And the springs of the abyss and the floodgates of heaven were covered over, and the rain from heaven was held back.
brenton_translation: And the fountains of the deep were closed up, and the flood-gates of heaven, and the rain from heaven was withheld.

fresh_translation: And the water kept withdrawing, going away from the earth, and the water diminished after one hundred and fifty days.
brenton_translation: And the water subsided, and went off the earth, and after an hundred and fifty days the water was diminished, and the ark rested in the seventh month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.

fresh_translation: And the ark came to rest in the seventh month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.
brenton_translation: And the water continued to decrease until the tenth month.

fresh_translation: And the water kept diminishing until the tenth month, and in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.
brenton_translation: And in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the heads of the mountains were seen.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after forty days that Noah opened the window of the ark that he made, and he sent out the raven to see whether the water had subsided.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after forty days Noe opened the window of the ark which he had made.

fresh_translation: And having gone out, it did not return until the water dried from the earth.
brenton_translation: And he sent forth a raven; and it went forth and returned not until the water was dried from off the earth.

fresh_translation: And he sent the dove after it, to see whether the water had subsided from the earth.
brenton_translation: And he sent a dove after it to see if the water had ceased from off the earth.

fresh_translation: And the dove, not finding rest for its feet, returned to him into the ark, because water was on all the face of the earth. And stretching out his hand, he took it and brought it in to himself into the ark.
brenton_translation: And the dove not having found rest for her feet, returned to him into the ark, because the water was on all the face of the earth, and he stretched out his hand and took her, and brought her to himself into the ark.

fresh_translation: And waiting still another seven days, again he sent out the dove from the ark.
brenton_translation: And having waited yet seven other days, he again sent forth the dove from the ark.

fresh_translation: And toward evening the dove returned to him, and had an olive-leaf fragment in its mouth. And Noah knew that the water had subsided from the earth.
brenton_translation: And the dove returned to him in the evening, and had a leaf of olive, a sprig in her mouth; and Noe knew that the water had ceased from off the earth.

fresh_translation: And waiting still another seven days, again he sent out the dove, and it did not add to return to him any longer.
brenton_translation: And having waited yet seven other days, he again sent forth the dove, and she did not return to him again any more.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the six-hundred-and-first year in the life of Noah, in the first month, on the first of the month, the water failed from the earth. And Noah uncovered the roof of the ark that he made and saw that the water had failed from the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year of the life of Noe, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the water subsided from off the earth, and Noe opened the covering of the ark which he had made, and he saw that the water had subsided from the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth dried.
brenton_translation: And in the second month the earth was dried, on the twenty-seventh day of the month.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to Noah, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord God spoke to Noe, saying,

fresh_translation: Come out from the ark, you and your wife and your sons and the wives of your sons with you,
brenton_translation: Come out from the ark, thou and thy wife and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

fresh_translation: and all the wild beasts that are with you, and all flesh from birds to cattle, and every creeping thing moving on the earth, bring out with yourself. And increase and multiply upon the earth.
brenton_translation: And all the wild beasts as many as are with thee, and all flesh both of birds and beasts, and every reptile moving upon the earth, bring forth with thee: and increase ye and multiply upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And Noah came out, and his wife and his sons and the wives of his sons with him.
brenton_translation: And Noe came forth, and his wife and his sons, and his sons' wives with him.

fresh_translation: And every wild beast and every cattle and every bird and every creeping thing moving on the earth according to their kind came out from the ark.
brenton_translation: And all the wild beasts and all the cattle and every bird, and every reptile creeping upon the earth after their kind, came forth out of the ark.

fresh_translation: And Noah built an altar to the Lord, and took from all the clean cattle and from all the clean birds and offered up whole-burnt offerings on the altar.
brenton_translation: And Noe built an altar to the Lord, and took of all clean beasts, and of all clean birds, and offered a whole burnt-offering upon the altar.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God smelled an aroma of sweet fragrance, and the Lord God said, having considered, Let me not continue any longer to curse the earth because of the works of humans, because the mind of the human lies carefully upon evil things from his youth. Therefore I will not continue any longer to strike all living flesh, as I have done.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God smelled a smell of sweetness, and the Lord God having considered, said, I will not any more curse the earth, because of the works of men, because the imagination of man is intently bent upon evil things from his youth, I will not therefore any more smite all living flesh as I have done.

fresh_translation: All the days of the earth, seed and harvest, cold and heat, summer and spring, day and night shall not cease.
brenton_translation: All the days of the earth, seed and harvest, cold and heat, summer and spring, shall not cease by day or night.

fresh_translation: And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, Increase and multiply and fill the earth and rule over it.
brenton_translation: And God blessed Noe and his sons, and said to them, Increase and multiply, and fill the earth and have dominion over it.

fresh_translation: And your dread and your fear shall be upon all the wild beasts of the earth, upon all the birds of heaven and upon all the moving things on the earth and upon all the fish of the sea. Into your hands I have given them.
brenton_translation: And the dread and the fear of you shall be upon all the wild beasts of the earth, on all the birds of the sky, and on all things moving upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea, I have placed them under your power.

fresh_translation: And every creeping thing that is living shall be for you as food. As green herbs I have given you all things.
brenton_translation: And every reptile which is living shall be to you for meat, I have given all things to you as the green herbs.

fresh_translation: Only flesh with blood of life in it you shall not eat.
brenton_translation: But flesh with blood of life ye shall not eat.

fresh_translation: And indeed your blood of your lives I will seek out from the hand of all the wild beasts, and from the hand of a human, from the hand of a brother, I will seek out the life of the human.
brenton_translation: For your blood of your lives will I require at the hand of all wild beasts, and I will require the life of man at the hand of his brother man.

fresh_translation: The one pouring out human blood, in return for that blood his own shall be poured out, because in the image of God I made the human.
brenton_translation: He that sheds man's blood, instead of that blood shall his own be shed, for in the image of God I made man.

fresh_translation: But you, increase and multiply and fill the earth and rule over it.
brenton_translation: But do ye increase and multiply, and fill the earth, and have dominion over it.

fresh_translation: And God said to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
brenton_translation: And God spoke to Noe, and to his sons with him, saying,

fresh_translation: And look, I am establishing my covenant with you and with your seed after you,
brenton_translation: And behold I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you,

fresh_translation: and with every living life with you, from birds and from cattle and with all the wild beasts of the earth, as many as are with you, from all that came out of the ark.
brenton_translation: and with every living creature with you, of birds and of beasts, and with all the wild beasts of the earth, as many as are with you, of all that come out of the ark.

fresh_translation: And I will establish my covenant with you, and all flesh shall not die any longer from the water of the flood, and there shall no longer be a flood of water to destroy all the earth.
brenton_translation: And I will establish my covenant with you and all flesh shall not any more die by the water of the flood, and there shall no more be a flood of water to destroy all the earth.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God said to Noah, This is the sign of the covenant that I give between me and you and between every living life that is with you for everlasting generations:
brenton_translation: And the Lord God said to Noe, This is the sign of the covenant which I set between me and you, and between every living creature which is with you for perpetual generations.

fresh_translation: I place my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a sign of covenant between me and the earth.
brenton_translation: I set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a sign of covenant between me and the earth.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when I cloud the earth with clouds, my bow shall be seen in the cloud,
brenton_translation: And it shall be when I gather clouds upon the earth, that my bow shall be seen in the cloud.

fresh_translation: and I will remember my covenant that is between me and you and between every living life in all flesh, and the water shall no longer become a flood so as to wipe out all flesh.
brenton_translation: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you, and between every living soul in all flesh, and there shall no longer be water for a deluge, so as to blot out all flesh.

fresh_translation: And my bow shall be in the cloud, and I will see it to remember the everlasting covenant between me and the earth and between living life in all flesh that is on the earth.
brenton_translation: And my bow shall be in the cloud, and I will look to remember the everlasting covenant between me and the earth, and between every living soul in all flesh, which is upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And God said to Noah, This is the sign of the covenant that I established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.
brenton_translation: And God said to Noe, This is the sign of the covenant, which I have made between me and all flesh, which is upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, Japheth. Now Ham was father of Canaan.
brenton_translation: Now the sons of Noe which came out of the ark, were Sem, Cham, Japheth. And Cham was father of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: These three are sons of Noah. From these the whole earth was scattered abroad.
brenton_translation: These three are the sons of Noe, of these were men scattered over all the earth.

fresh_translation: And Noah, a man, began to be a farmer of the earth and planted a vineyard.
brenton_translation: And Noe began to be a husbandman, and he planted a vineyard.

fresh_translation: And he drank from the wine and became drunk and was stripped naked in his house.
brenton_translation: And he drank of the wine, and was drunk, and was naked in his house.

fresh_translation: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and going out announced it to his two brothers outside.
brenton_translation: And Cham the father of Chanaan saw the nakedness of his father, and he went out and told his two brothers without.

fresh_translation: And taking the garment, Shem and Japheth placed it on their two backs and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father. And their face was backward, and they did not see the nakedness of their father.
brenton_translation: And Sem and Japheth having taken a garment, put it on both their backs and went backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their face was backward, and they saw not the nakedness of their father.

fresh_translation: And Noah sobered up from the wine and knew what his younger son did to him,
brenton_translation: And Noe recovered from the wine, and knew all that his younger son had done to him.

fresh_translation: and said, Cursed be Canaan. A house-servant slave shall he be to his brothers.
brenton_translation: And he said, Cursed be the servant Chanaan, a slave shall he be to his brethren.

fresh_translation: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Shem, and Canaan shall be his house-servant slave.
brenton_translation: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Sem, and Chanaan shall be his bond-servant.

fresh_translation: May God widen Japheth, and let him dwell in the houses of Shem, and let Canaan become his servant.
brenton_translation: May God make room for Japheth, and let him dwell in the habitations of Sem, and let Chanaan be his servant.

fresh_translation: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
brenton_translation: And Noe lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years, and he died.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Noe were nine hundred and fifty years, and he died.

fresh_translation: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.
brenton_translation: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noe, Sem, Cham, Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.

fresh_translation: Sons of Japheth: Gamer and Magog and Madai and Jovan and Elisa and Thobel and Mosoch and Thiras.
brenton_translation: The sons of Japheth, Gamer, and Magog, and Madoi, and Jovan, and Elisa, and Thobel, and Mosoch, and Thiras.

fresh_translation: And sons of Gamer: Aschanaz and Riphath and Thorgama.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Gamer, Aschanaz, and Riphath, and Thorgama.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jovan: Elisa and Tharsis, Kittians, Rhodians.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jovan, Elisa, and Tharseis, Cetians, Rhodians.

fresh_translation: From these the islands of the nations were marked off in their land, each according to tongue, in their tribes and in their nations.
brenton_translation: From these were the islands of the Gentiles divided in their land, each according to his tongue, in their tribes and in their nations.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ham: Chous and Mesrain, Phoud and Canaan.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Cham, Chus, and Mesrain, Phud, and Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And sons of Chous: Saba and Evila and Sabatha and Regma and Sabathaca. And sons of Regma: Saba and Dadan.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Chus, Saba, and Evila, and Sabatha, and Rhegma, and Sabathaca. And the sons of Rhegma, Saba, and Dadan.

fresh_translation: And Chous begot Nebrod. He began to be a giant upon the earth.
brenton_translation: And Chus begot Nebrod: he began to be a giant upon the earth.

fresh_translation: He was a giant hunter before the Lord God. Therefore they will say, Like Nebrod, a giant hunter before the Lord.
brenton_translation: He was a giant hunter before the Lord God; therefore they say, As Nebrod the giant hunter before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the beginning of his kingdom came to be Babylon and Orech and Archad and Chalanne in the land of Sennaar.
brenton_translation: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Orech, and Archad, and Chalanne, in the land of Senaar.

fresh_translation: From that land Asshur went out and built Nineveh and Rooboth-city and Chalach,
brenton_translation: Out of that land came Assur, and built Ninevi, and the city Rhooboth, and Chalach,

fresh_translation: and Dase between Nineveh and between Chalach. This is the great city.
brenton_translation: and Dase between Ninevi and Chalach: this is the great city.

fresh_translation: And Mesrain begot the Loudieim and the Enemetieim and the Labieim and the Nephthalieim and the Pathrosonieim,
brenton_translation: And Mesrain begot the Ludiim, and the Nephthalim, and the Enemetiim, and the Labiim,

fresh_translation: and the Chasloniem, from where the Phylistieim came out, and the Caphtorieim.
brenton_translation: and the Patrosoniim, and the Chasmoniim (whence came forth Phylistiim) and the Gaphthoriim.

fresh_translation: And Canaan begot Sidon his firstborn,
brenton_translation: And Chanaan begot Sidon his first-born, and the Chettite,

fresh_translation: and the Hettite and the Jebusite and the Amorrite and the Gergesite and the Evite and the Aroukite,
brenton_translation: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

fresh_translation: and the Asennaite and the Aradian and the Samaraian and the Amathi.
brenton_translation: and the Evite, and the Arukite, and the Asennite,

fresh_translation: And after this the tribes of the Canaanites were scattered.
brenton_translation: and the Aradian, and the Samarean, and the Amathite; and after this the tribes of the Chananites were dispersed.

fresh_translation: And the borders of the Canaanites came to be from Sidon until one comes to Gerara and Gaza, until one comes as far as Sodom and Gomorrah, Adama and Seboim, as far as Dasa.
brenton_translation: And the boundaries of the Chananites were from Sidon till one comes to Gerara and Gaza, till one comes to Sodom and Gomorrha, Adama and Seboim, as far as Dasa.

fresh_translation: These are sons of Ham, in their tribes, according to their tongues, in their lands and in their nations.
brenton_translation: These were the sons of Cham in their tribes according to their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

fresh_translation: And to Shem, to him also, father of all the sons of Eber, brother of Japheth the greater, sons were born.
brenton_translation: And to Sem himself also were children born, the father of all the sons of Heber, the brother of Japheth the elder.

fresh_translation: Sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arphaxad and Loud and Aram and Cainan.
brenton_translation: Sons of Sem, Elam, and Assur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Cainan.

fresh_translation: And sons of Aram: Ouz and Oul and Gather and Mosoch.
brenton_translation: And sons of Aram, Uz, and Ul, and Gater, and Mosoch.

fresh_translation: And Arphaxad begot Cainan, and Cainan begot Sala, and Sala begot Eber.
brenton_translation: And Arphaxad begot Cainan, and Cainan begot Sala. And Sala begot Heber.

fresh_translation: And to Eber two sons were born. The name of one was Phaleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother was Jektan.
brenton_translation: And to Heber were born two sons, the name of the one, Phaleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother Jektan.

fresh_translation: And Jektan begot Elmodad and Saleth and Sarmoth and Jarach and Odorra and Aibel and Decla,
brenton_translation: And Jektan begot Elmodad, and Saleth, and Sarmoth, and Jarach,

fresh_translation: and Eual and Abimael and Saba,
brenton_translation: and Odorrha, and Aibel, and Decla,

fresh_translation: and Oupheir and Eveila and Jobab.
brenton_translation: and Eval, and Abimael, and Saba,

fresh_translation: All these were sons of Jektan.
brenton_translation: and Uphir, and Evila, and Jobab, all these were the sons of Jektan.

fresh_translation: And their dwelling came to be from Masse, until one comes to Saphira, a mountain of the east.
brenton_translation: And their dwelling was from Masse, till one comes to Saphera, a mountain of the east.

fresh_translation: These are sons of Shem, in their tribes, according to their tongues, in their lands and in their nations.
brenton_translation: These were the sons of Sem in their tribes, according to their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

fresh_translation: These are the tribes of the sons of Noah according to their generations, according to their nations. From these the islands of the nations were scattered over the earth after the flood.
brenton_translation: These are the tribes of the sons of Noe, according to their generations, according to their nations: of them were the islands of the Gentiles scattered over the earth after the flood.

fresh_translation: And all the earth was one lip, and one voice for all.
brenton_translation: And all the earth was one lip, and there was one language to all.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when they moved from the east, they found a plain in the land of Sennaar and lived there.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as they moved from the east, they found a plain in the land of Senaar, and they dwelt there.

fresh_translation: And a person said to his neighbor, Come, let us make bricks and bake them with fire. And the brick became stone for them, and bitumen was clay for them.
brenton_translation: And a man said to his neighbour, Come, let us make bricks and bake them with fire. And the brick was to them for stone, and their mortar was bitumen.

fresh_translation: And they said, Come, let us build for ourselves a city and a tower whose top will be as far as heaven, and let us make a name for ourselves before we are scattered over the face of all the earth.
brenton_translation: And they said, Come, let us build to ourselves a city and tower, whose top shall be to heaven, and let us make to ourselves a name, before we are scattered abroad upon the face of all the earth.

fresh_translation: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men built.
brenton_translation: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the sons of men built.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, Look, one race and one lip for all, and this they have begun to do, and now nothing will fail from them, whatever they may set themselves to do.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, Behold, there is one race, and one lip of all, and they have begun to do this, and now nothing shall fail from them of all that they may have undertaken to do.

fresh_translation: Come, and having come down, let us confuse their tongue there, so that each may not hear the voice of his neighbor.
brenton_translation: Come, and having gone down let us there confound their tongue, that they may not understand each the voice of his neighbour.

fresh_translation: And the Lord scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city and the tower.
brenton_translation: And the Lord scattered them thence over the face of all the earth, and they left off building the city and the tower.

fresh_translation: Because of this its name was called Confusion, because there the Lord confused the lips of all the earth, and from there the Lord scattered them over the face of all the earth.
brenton_translation: On this account its name was called Confusion, because there the Lord confounded the languages of all the earth, and thence the Lord scattered them upon the face of all the earth.

fresh_translation: And these are the generations of Shem. And Shem was one hundred years old when he begot Arphaxad, in the second year after the flood.
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Sem: and Sem was a hundred years old when he begot Arphaxad, the second year after the flood.

fresh_translation: And Shem lived after begetting Arphaxad five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
brenton_translation: And Sem lived, after he had begotten Arphaxad, five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.

fresh_translation: And Arphaxad lived one hundred and thirty-five years and begot Cainan.
brenton_translation: And Arphaxad lived a hundred and thirty-five years, and begot Cainan.

fresh_translation: And Arphaxad lived after begetting Cainan four hundred years, and begot sons and daughters, and died. And Cainan lived one hundred and thirty years and begot Sala. And Cainan lived after begetting Sala three hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
brenton_translation: And Arphaxad lived after he had begotten Cainan, four hundred years, and begot sons and daughters, and died. And Cainan lived a hundred and thirty years and begot Sala; and Cainan lived after he had begotten Sala, three hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.

fresh_translation: And Sala lived one hundred and thirty years and begot Eber.
brenton_translation: And Sala lived an hundred and thirty years, and begot Heber.

fresh_translation: And Sala lived after begetting Eber three hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
brenton_translation: And Sala lived after he had begotten Heber, three hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.

fresh_translation: And Eber lived one hundred and thirty-four years and begot Phaleg.
brenton_translation: And Heber lived an hundred and thirty-four years, and begot Phaleg.

fresh_translation: And Eber lived after begetting Phaleg two hundred and seventy years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
