brenton_translation: And Heber lived after he had begotten Phaleg two hundred and seventy years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.

fresh_translation: And Phaleg lived one hundred and thirty years and begot Ragau.
brenton_translation: And Phaleg lived an hundred and thirty years, and begot Ragau.

fresh_translation: And Phaleg lived after begetting Ragau two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
brenton_translation: And Phaleg lived after he had begotten Ragau, two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.

fresh_translation: And Ragau lived one hundred and thirty-two years and begot Serouch.
brenton_translation: And Ragau lived an hundred thirty and two years, and begot Seruch.

fresh_translation: And Ragau lived after begetting Serouch two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
brenton_translation: And Ragau lived after he had begotten Seruch, two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.

fresh_translation: And Serouch lived one hundred and thirty years and begot Nachor.
brenton_translation: And Seruch lived a hundred and thirty years, and begot Nachor.

fresh_translation: And Serouch lived after begetting Nachor two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
brenton_translation: And Seruch lived after he had begotten Nachor, two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.

fresh_translation: And Nachor lived one hundred and seventy-nine years and begot Thara.
brenton_translation: And Nachor lived a hundred and seventy-nine years, and begot Tharrha.

fresh_translation: And Nachor lived after begetting Thara one hundred and twenty-five years, and begot sons and daughters, and died.
brenton_translation: And Nachor lived after he had begotten Tharrha, an hundred and twenty-five years, and begot sons and daughters, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Thara lived seventy years and begot Abram and Nachor and Arran.
brenton_translation: And Tharrha lived seventy years, and begot Abram, and Nachor, and Arrhan.

fresh_translation: These are the generations of Thara. Thara begot Abram and Nachor and Arran, and Arran begot Lot.
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Tharrha. Tharrha begot Abram and Nachor, and Arrhan; and Arrhan begot Lot.

fresh_translation: And Arran died before Thara his father in the land where he was born, in the country of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: And Arrhan died in the presence of Tharrha his father, in the land in which he was born, in the country of the Chaldees.

fresh_translation: And Abram and Nachor took wives for themselves. The name of Abram's wife was Sara, and the name of Nachor's wife was Melcha, daughter of Arran, father of Melcha and father of Jescha.
brenton_translation: And Abram and Nachor took to themselves wives, the name of the wife of Abram was Sara, and the name of the wife of Nachor, Malcha, daughter of Arrhan, and he was the father of Malcha, the father of Jescha.

fresh_translation: And Sara was barren and was not bearing children.
brenton_translation: And Sara was barren, and did not bear children.

fresh_translation: And Thara took Abram his son and Lot son of Arran, son of his son, and Sara his daughter-in-law, wife of Abram his son, and brought them out from the country of the Chaldeans to go into the land of Canaan. And they came as far as Charran, and he lived there.
brenton_translation: And Tharrha took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Arrhan, the son of his son, and Sara his daughter-in-law, the wife of Abram his son, and led them forth out of the land of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Chanaan, and they came as far as Charrhan, and he dwelt there.

fresh_translation: And all the days of Thara in the land of Charran were two hundred and five years, and Thara died in Charran.
brenton_translation: And all the days of Tharrha in the land of Charrhan were two hundred and five years, and Tharrha died in Charrhan.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Abram, Go out from your land and from your kin and from your father's house, and come into the land that I will show you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Abram, Go forth out of thy land and out of thy kindred, and out of the house of thy father, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

fresh_translation: And I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you and magnify your name, and you shall be blessed.
brenton_translation: And I will make thee a great nation, and I will bless thee and magnify thy name, and thou shalt be blessed.

fresh_translation: And I will bless those blessing you, and those cursing you I will curse. And in you all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed.
brenton_translation: And I will bless those that bless thee, and curse those that curse thee, and in thee shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed.

fresh_translation: And Abram went, just as the Lord spoke to him, and Lot went away with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he went out from Charran.
brenton_translation: And Abram went as the Lord spoke to him, and Lot departed with him, and Abram was seventy-five years old, when he went out of Charrhan.

fresh_translation: And Abram took Sarai his wife and Lot the son of his brother and all their possessions, as many as they had acquired, and every person whom they had acquired in Charran, and they went out to go into the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: And Abram took Sara his wife, and Lot the son of his brother, and all their possessions, as many as they had got, and every soul which they had got in Charrhan, and they went forth to go into the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And Abram passed through the land through its length as far as the place Sychem, to the high oak. And the Canaanites then inhabited the land.
brenton_translation: And Abram traversed the land lengthwise as far as the place Sychem, to the high oak, and the Chananites then inhabited the land.

fresh_translation: And the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, To your seed I will give this land. And Abram built there an altar to the Lord who had appeared to him.
brenton_translation: And the Lord appeared to Abram, and said to him, I will give this land to thy seed. And Abram built an altar there to the Lord, who appeared to him.

fresh_translation: And he departed from there to the mountain east of Bethel and pitched his tent there, Bethel toward the sea and Aggai toward the east. And he built there an altar to the Lord and called on the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he departed thence to the mountain eastward of Bæthel, and there he pitched his tent in Bæthel near the sea, and Aggai toward the east, and there he built an altar to the Lord, and called on the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Abram set out, and going on, camped in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And Abram departed and went and encamped in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And a famine came upon the land, and Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, because the famine grew strong upon the land.
brenton_translation: And there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there, because the famine prevailed in the land.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Abram drew near to enter Egypt, Abram said to Sarai his wife, I know that you are a woman beautiful in face.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Abram drew nigh to enter into Egypt, Abram said to Sara his wife, I know that thou art a fair woman.

fresh_translation: Then it will be, when the Egyptians see you, they will say, This is his wife. And they will kill me, but preserve you.
brenton_translation: It shall come to pass then that when the Egyptians shall see thee, they shall say, This is his wife, and they shall slay me, but they shall save thee alive.

fresh_translation: Say then, I am his sister, so that it may go well for me because of you, and my life will keep living because of you.
brenton_translation: Say, therefore, I am his sister, that it may be well with me on account of thee, and my soul shall live because of thee.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw his wife, that she was very beautiful.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Abram entered into Egypt—the Egyptians having seen his wife that she was very beautiful—

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh's rulers saw her and praised her to Pharaoh, and they brought her into Pharaoh's house.
brenton_translation: that the princes of Pharao saw her, and praised her to Pharao and brought her into the house of Pharao.

fresh_translation: And they treated Abram well because of her, and he came to have sheep and calves and donkeys and male-servants and female-servants and mules and camels.
brenton_translation: And they treated Abram well on her account, and he had sheep, and calves, and asses, and men-servants, and women-servants, and mules, and camels.

fresh_translation: And God afflicted Pharaoh with great and grievous afflictions, and his house, because of Sarai Abram's wife.
brenton_translation: And God afflicted Pharao with great and severe afflictions, and his house, because of Sara, Abram's wife.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What is this you have done to me, that you did not report to me that she is your wife?
brenton_translation: And Pharao having called Abram, said, What is this thou hast done to me, that thou didst not tell me that she was thy wife?

fresh_translation: Why did you say, She is my sister? And I took her for myself as a wife. And now look, your wife before you. Take her and hurry away.
brenton_translation: Wherefore didst thou say, She is my sister? and I took her for a wife to myself; and now, behold, thy wife is before thee, take her and go quickly away.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh instructed men concerning Abram to send him on, and his wife, and all that was his.
brenton_translation: And Pharao gave charge to men concerning Abram, to join in sending him forward, and his wife, and all that he had.

fresh_translation: And Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that was his and Lot with him, into the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And Abram was very rich in livestock and silver and gold.
brenton_translation: And Abram was very rich in cattle, and silver, and gold.

fresh_translation: And he went to the place from which he had come into the wilderness as far as Bethel, as far as the place where his tent had been before, between Bethel and Aggai,
brenton_translation: And he went to the place whence he came, into the wilderness as far as Bæthel, as far as the place where his tent was before, between Bæthel and Aggai,

fresh_translation: to the place of the altar that he had made there at the beginning. And Abram called on the name of the Lord there.
brenton_translation: to the place of the altar, which he built there at first, and Abram there called on the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Lot, who was traveling with Abram, had sheep and oxen and tents.
brenton_translation: And Lot who went out with Abram had sheep, and oxen, and tents.

fresh_translation: And the land had no room for them to live together, because their possessions were many, and the land had no room for them to live together.
brenton_translation: And the land was not large enough for them to live together, because their possessions were great; and the land was not large enough for them to live together.

fresh_translation: And a conflict arose between the shepherds of Abram's livestock and the shepherds of Lot's livestock. And the Canaanites and the Perizzites then inhabited the land.
brenton_translation: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle, and the herdmen of Lot's cattle, and the Chananites and the Pherezites then inhabited the land.

fresh_translation: And Abram said to Lot, Let there not be a conflict between me and you and between my shepherds and your shepherds, because we are human brothers.
brenton_translation: And Abram said to Lot, Let there not be a strife between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen, for we are brethren.

fresh_translation: Look, is not all the land before you? Separate yourself from me. If you go left, I will go right. If you go right, I will go left.
brenton_translation: Lo! is not the whole land before thee? Separate thyself from me; if thou goest to the left, I will go to the right, and if thou goest to the right, I will go to the left.

fresh_translation: And Lot lifted up his eyes and saw all the region around the Jordan, that all of it was watered before God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of God and like the land of Egypt, as far as one comes to Zoar.
brenton_translation: And Lot having lifted up his eyes, observed all the country round about Jordan, that it was all watered, before God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrha, as the garden of the Lord, and as the land of Egypt, until thou come to Zogora.

fresh_translation: And Lot chose for himself all the region around the Jordan, and Lot set out from the east, and they were separated, each from his brother.
brenton_translation: And Lot chose for himself all the country round Jordan, and Lot went from the east, and they were separated each from his brother. And Abram dwelt in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, but Lot dwelt in a city of the surrounding region and pitched tents in Sodom.
brenton_translation: And Lot dwelt in a city of the neighbouring people, and pitched his tent in Sodom.

fresh_translation: Now the people in Sodom were wicked and sinful before God exceedingly.
brenton_translation: But the men of Sodom were evil, and exceedingly sinful before God.

fresh_translation: And God said to Abram after Lot had separated from him, Lift up your eyes and see from the place where you are now, toward north and south and east and sea.
brenton_translation: And God said to Abram after Lot was separated from him, Look up with thine eyes, and behold from the place where thou now art northward and southward, and eastward and seaward;

fresh_translation: Because all the land that you see, I will give it to you and to your seed forever.
brenton_translation: for all the land which thou seest, I will give it to thee and to thy seed for ever.

fresh_translation: And I will make your seed like the sand of the earth. If anyone can number the sand of the earth, then your seed also shall be numbered.
brenton_translation: And I will make thy seed like the dust of the earth; if any one is able to number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed be numbered.

fresh_translation: Rise, go through the land into its length and into its breadth, because I will give it to you and to your seed forever.
brenton_translation: Arise and traverse the land, both in the length of it and in the breadth; for to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

fresh_translation: And Abram, having moved his tent, came and dwelt by the oak of Mamre, which was in Hebron, and built there an altar to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Abram having removed his tent, came and dwelt by the oak of Mambre, which was in Chebrom, and he there built an altar to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the reign of Amarphal king of Sennaar, and Arioch king of Ellasar, Chodollogomor king of Elam, and Thargal king of nations,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the reign of Amarphal king of Sennaar, and Arioch king of Ellasar, that Chodollogomor king of Elam, and Thargal king of nations,

fresh_translation: they made war with Balla king of Sodom and with Barsa king of Gomorrah and with Sennaar king of Adama and with Symobor king of Seboim and king of Balak, this is Segor.
brenton_translation: made war with Balla king of Sodom, and with Barsa king of Gomorrha, and with Sennaar, king of Adama, and with Symobor king of Seboim and the king of Balac, this is Segor.

fresh_translation: All these joined together at the salt valley. This is the Salt Sea.
brenton_translation: All these met with one consent at the salt valley; this is now the sea of salt.

fresh_translation: For twelve years they served Chodollogomor, but in the thirteenth year they revolted.
brenton_translation: Twelve years they served Chodollogomor, and the thirteenth year they revolted.

fresh_translation: And in the fourteenth year Chodollogomor came, and the kings with him, and they cut down the giants in Astaroth and Karnaim, and strong nations with them, and the Ommaeans in the city Save,
brenton_translation: And in the fourteenth year came Chodollogomor, and the kings with him, and cut to pieces the giants in Astaroth, and Carnain, and strong nations with them, and the Ommæans in the city Save.

fresh_translation: and the Chorraeans in the mountains of Seir, as far as the terebinth of Pharan, which is in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And the Chorrhæans in the mountains of Seir, to the turpentine tree of Pharan, which is in the desert.

fresh_translation: And having turned back they came to the spring of judgment, this is Kades, and they cut down all the rulers of Amalek and the Amorites dwelling in Asasonthamar.
brenton_translation: And having turned back they came to the well of judgment; this is Cades, and they cut in pieces all the princes of Amalec, and the Amorites dwelling in Asasonthamar.

fresh_translation: And the king of Sodom went out, and the king of Gomorrah and king of Adama and king of Seboim and king of Balak, this is Segor, and they drew up against them for war in the salt valley,
brenton_translation: And the king of Sodom went out, and the king of Gomorrha, and king of Adama, and king of Seboim, and king of Balac, this is Segor, and they set themselves in array against them for war in the salt valley,

fresh_translation: against Chodollogomor king of Elam and Thargal king of nations and Amarphal king of Sennaar and Arioch king of Ellasar, four kings against the five.
brenton_translation: against Chodollogomor king of Elam, and Thargal king of nations, and Amarphal king of Sennaar, and Arioch king of Ellasar, the four kings against the five.

fresh_translation: Now the salt valley had wells of asphalt. And the king of Sodom fled, and the king of Gomorrah, and they fell there. But those left behind fled into the mountain country.
brenton_translation: Now the salt valley consists of slime-pits. And the king of Sodom fled and the king of Gomorrha, and they fell in there: and they that were left fled to the mountain country.

fresh_translation: And they took all the cavalry of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their provisions, and went away.
brenton_translation: And they took all the cavalry of Sodom and Gomorrha, and all their provisions, and departed.

fresh_translation: And they took Lot also, the son of Abram's brother, and his baggage, and went away, for he was dwelling in Sodom.
brenton_translation: And they took also Lot the son of Abram's brother, and his baggage, and departed, for he dwelt in Sodom.

fresh_translation: And one of those rescued came and reported to Abram the Hebrew. He was dwelling by the oak of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eschol and brother of Aunan, who were Abram's allies.
brenton_translation: And one of them that had been rescued came and told Abram the Hebrew; and he dwelt by the oak of Mamre the Amorite the brother of Eschol, and the brother of Aunan, who were confederates with Abram.

fresh_translation: And Abram, hearing that Lot his nephew had been taken captive, numbered his own home-born ones, three hundred eighteen, and pursued after them as far as Dan.
brenton_translation: And Abram having heard that Lot his nephew had been taken captive, numbered his own home-born servants three hundred and eighteen, and pursued after them to Dan.

fresh_translation: And he fell upon them by night, he and his servants, and struck them and pursued them as far as Choba, which is left of Damascus.
brenton_translation: And he came upon them by night, he and his servants, and he smote them and pursued them as far as Choba, which is on the left of Damascus.

fresh_translation: And he brought back all the cavalry of Sodom, and he brought back Lot his nephew and all his possessions and the women and the people.
brenton_translation: And he recovered all the cavalry of Sodom, and he recovered Lot his nephew, and all his possessions, and the women and the people.

fresh_translation: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after he returned from the slaughter of Chodollogomor and the kings with him, to the valley of Saby. This was the plain of the kings.
brenton_translation: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after he returned from the slaughter of Chodollogomor, and the kings with him, to the valley of Saby; this was the plain of the kings.

fresh_translation: And Melchisedec king of Salem brought out loaves and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
brenton_translation: And Melchisedec king of Salem brought forth loaves and wine, and he was the priest of the most high God.

fresh_translation: And he blessed Abram and said, Blessed be Abram by God Most High, who created heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: And he blessed Abram, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, who made heaven and earth,

fresh_translation: And blessed be God Most High, who delivered your enemies under your hand. And Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
brenton_translation: and blessed be the most high God who delivered thine enemies into thy power. And Abram gave him the tithe of all.

fresh_translation: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the men, but take the cavalry for yourself.
brenton_translation: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the men, and take the horses to thyself.

fresh_translation: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I will stretch out my hand to the Lord, God Most High, who created heaven and earth,
brenton_translation: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I will stretch out my hand to the Lord the most high God, who made the heaven and the earth,

fresh_translation: that I will not take anything from all that is yours, from a cord to a sandal-thong, so that you may not say, I made Abram rich.
brenton_translation: that I will not take from all thy goods from a string to a shoe-latchet, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich.

fresh_translation: Except what the young men have eaten and the share of the men who went with me, Eschol, Aunan, Mamre. Let these take a share.
brenton_translation: Except what things the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men that went with me, Eschol, Aunan, Mambre, these shall take a portion.

fresh_translation: After these words the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Do not fear, Abram. I shield you. Your reward shall be very great.
brenton_translation: And after these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram, I shield thee, thy reward shall be very great.

fresh_translation: And Abram said, Master Lord, what will you give me? I am being dismissed childless. And the son of Masek of my home-born household, this is Damascus Eliezer.
brenton_translation: And Abram said, Master and Lord, what wilt thou give me? whereas I am departing without a child, but the son of Masek my home-born female slave, this Eliezer of Damascus is mine heir.

fresh_translation: And Abram said, Since you have not given me seed, my home-born one will inherit for me.
brenton_translation: And Abram said, I am grieved since thou hast given me no seed, but my home-born servant shall succeed me.

fresh_translation: And immediately a voice of the Lord came to him, saying, This one shall not inherit you, but the one coming out from you, this one shall inherit you.
brenton_translation: And immediately there was a voice of the Lord to him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come out of thee shall be thine heir.

fresh_translation: And he brought him outside and said to him, Look up now to heaven and count the stars, if you can fully number them. And he said, So shall your seed be.
brenton_translation: And he brought him out and said to him, Look up now to heaven, and count the stars, if thou shalt be able to number them fully, and he said, Thus shall thy seed be.

fresh_translation: And Abram believed God, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness.
brenton_translation: And Abram believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, I am God who brought you out from the land of the Chaldeans, so as to give you this land to inherit.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, I am God that brought thee out of the land of the Chaldeans, so as to give thee this land to inherit.

fresh_translation: And he said, Master Lord, by what shall I know that I will inherit it?
brenton_translation: And he said, Master and Lord, how shall I know that I shall inherit it?

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Take for me a heifer in her third year and a she-goat in her third year and a ram in his third year and a turtledove and a pigeon.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Take for me an heifer in her third year, and a she-goat in her third year, and a ram in his third year, and a dove and a pigeon.

fresh_translation: So he took all these for him and divided them in the middle and placed them opposite each other. But the birds he did not divide.
brenton_translation: So he took to him all these, and divided them in the midst, and set them opposite to each other, but the birds he did not divide.

fresh_translation: And birds came down on the bodies, on their cut pieces, and Abram sat with them.
brenton_translation: And birds came down upon the bodies, even upon the divided parts of them, and Abram sat down by them.

fresh_translation: And about sunset a trance fell upon Abram, and look, a great dark fear falls upon him.
brenton_translation: And about sunset a trance fell upon Abram, and lo! a great gloomy terror falls upon him.

fresh_translation: And it was said to Abram, Knowing you shall know that your seed will be a foreigner in a land not its own, and they will enslave them and afflict them and humble them four hundred years.
brenton_translation: And it was said to Abram, Thou shalt surely know that thy seed shall be a sojourner in a land not their own, and they shall enslave them, and afflict them, and humble them four hundred years.

fresh_translation: But the nation to which they will serve, I will judge. And after these things they will come out here with much baggage.
brenton_translation: And the nation whomsoever they shall serve I will judge; and after this, they shall come forth hither with much property.

fresh_translation: But you shall depart to your fathers in peace, nourished in good old age.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt depart to thy fathers in peace, nourished in a good old age.

fresh_translation: And in the fourth generation they will return here, for the sins of the Amorites have not yet been filled up until now.
brenton_translation: And in the fourth generation they shall return hither, for the sins of the Amorites are not yet filled up, even until now.

fresh_translation: And when the sun had gone down, flame came to be, and look, a smoking furnace and lamps of fire, which passed between these divided pieces.
brenton_translation: And when the sun was about to set, there was a flame, and behold a smoking furnace and lamps of fire, which passed between these divided pieces.

fresh_translation: In that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, To your seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt as far as the great river, the Euphrates river,
brenton_translation: In that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, To thy seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river Euphrates.

fresh_translation: the Kenites and the Kenezites and the Kedmoneans,
brenton_translation: The Kenites, and the Kenezites, and the Kedmoneans,

fresh_translation: and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Rephaim,
brenton_translation: and the Chettites, and the Pherezites, and the Raphaim,

fresh_translation: and the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Hivites and the Gergesites and the Jebusites.
brenton_translation: and the Amorites, and the Chananites, and the Evites, and the Gergesites, and the Jebusites.

fresh_translation: Now Sarai Abram's wife was not bearing to him. She had an Egyptian servant-girl whose name was Hagar.
brenton_translation: And Sara the wife of Abram bore him no children; and she had an Egyptian maid, whose name was Agar.

fresh_translation: And Sarai said to Abram, Look, the Lord has shut me up from not bearing. Go in then to my servant-girl, so that I may get children through her. And Abram listened to Sarai's voice.
brenton_translation: And Sara said to Abram, Behold, the Lord has restrained me from bearing, go therefore in to my maid, that I may get children for myself through her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sara.

fresh_translation: And Sarai, Abram's wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her own servant-girl, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband as a wife for him.
brenton_translation: So Sara the wife of Abram having taken Agar the Egyptian her handmaid, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Chanaan, gave her to Abram her husband as a wife to him.

fresh_translation: And he went in to Hagar, and she conceived. And she saw that she was pregnant, and her mistress was dishonored before her.
brenton_translation: And he went in to Agar, and she conceived, and saw that she was with child, and her mistress was dishonoured before her.

fresh_translation: And Sarai said to Abram, I am being wronged because of you. I gave my servant-girl into your bosom, and when she saw that she was pregnant, I was dishonored before her. God judge between me and you.
brenton_translation: And Sara said to Abram, I am injured by thee; I gave my handmaid into thy bosom, and when I saw that she was with child, I was dishonoured before her. The Lord judge between me and thee.

fresh_translation: And Abram said to Sarai, Look, your servant-girl is in your hands. Use her as may seem good to you. And Sarai mistreated her, and she fled from her face.
brenton_translation: And Abram said to Sara, Behold thy handmaid is in thy hands, use her as it may seem good to thee. And Sara afflicted her, and she fled from her face.

fresh_translation: And an angel of the Lord found her by the spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur.
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord found her by the fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Sur.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Hagar, Sarai's servant-girl, where are you coming from and where are you going? And she said, I am running away from the face of Sarai my mistress.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Agar, Sara's maid, whence comest thou, and whither goest thou? and she said, I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sara.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Return to your mistress and humble yourself under her hands.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Multiplying I will multiply your seed, and it will not be numbered because of the multitude.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, I will surely multiply thy seed, and it shall not be numbered for multitude.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Look, you are pregnant and will bear a son, and you shall call his name Ishmael, because the Lord has hearkened to your humiliation.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ismael, for the Lord hath hearkened to thy humiliation.

fresh_translation: This one shall be a wild man. His hands against all, and all hands against him, and before the face of all his brothers he shall dwell.
brenton_translation: He shall be a wild man, his hands against all, and the hands of all against him, and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

fresh_translation: And Hagar called the name of the Lord who was speaking to her, You are God who saw me, because she said, For I have even here seen the one who appeared to me.
brenton_translation: And she called the name of the Lord God who spoke to her, Thou art God who seest me; for she said, For I have openly seen him that appeared to me.

fresh_translation: Because of this she called the well, The well of the one whom I saw before me. Look, it is between Kadesh and Barad.
brenton_translation: Therefore she called the well, The well of him whom I have openly seen; behold it is between Cades and Barad.

fresh_translation: And Hagar bore a son to Abram, and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore to him, Ishmael.
brenton_translation: And Agar bore a son to Abram; and Abram called the name of his son which Agar bore to him, Ismael.

fresh_translation: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
brenton_translation: And Abram was eighty-six years old, when Agar bore Ismael to Abram.

fresh_translation: And Abram became ninety-nine years old, and the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, I am your God. Be well-pleasing before me and become blameless.
brenton_translation: And Abram was ninety-nine years old, and the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, I am thy God, be well-pleasing before me, and be blameless.

fresh_translation: And I will place my covenant between me and you and will multiply you exceedingly.
brenton_translation: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee, and I will multiply thee exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And Abram fell upon his face, and God spoke to him, saying,
brenton_translation: And Abram fell upon his face, and God spoke to him, saying,

fresh_translation: And I, look, my covenant is with you, and you shall be father of a multitude of nations,
brenton_translation: And I, behold! my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of a multitude of nations.

fresh_translation: And your name shall no longer be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, because I have made you father of many nations.
brenton_translation: And thy name shall no more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraam, for I have made thee a father of many nations.

fresh_translation: And I will increase you very exceedingly and make you into nations, and kings shall come out from you.
brenton_translation: And I will increase thee very exceedingly, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

fresh_translation: And I will establish my covenant between me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations, as an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your seed after you.
brenton_translation: And I will establish my covenant between thee and thy seed after thee, to their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be thy God, and the God of thy seed after thee.

fresh_translation: And I will give to you and to your seed after you the land that you are living as a foreigner in, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession, and I will be God to them.
brenton_translation: And I will give to thee and to thy seed after thee the land wherein thou sojournest, even all the land of Chanaan for an everlasting possession, and I will be to them a God.

fresh_translation: And God said to Abraham, And you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your seed after you throughout their generations.
brenton_translation: And God said to Abraam, Thou also shalt fully keep my covenant, thou and thy seed after thee for their generations.

fresh_translation: And this is the covenant which you shall keep, between me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations: every male among you shall be circumcised.
brenton_translation: And this is the covenant which thou shalt fully keep between me and you, and between thy seed after thee for their generations; every male of you shall be circumcised.

fresh_translation: And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be for a sign of covenant between me and you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be for a sign of a covenant between me and you.

fresh_translation: And a child of eight days shall be circumcised by you, every male throughout your generations, the home-born and the silver-bought, from every son of a foreigner who is not of your seed.
brenton_translation: And the child of eight days old shall be circumcised by you, every male throughout your generations, and the servant born in the house and he that is bought with money, of every son of a stranger, who is not of thy seed.

fresh_translation: By circumcision the home-born of your house and the one bought with silver shall be circumcised, and my covenant shall be on your flesh as an everlasting covenant.
brenton_translation: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with money shall be surely circumcised, and my covenant shall be on your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

fresh_translation: And the uncircumcised male, who will not circumcise the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day, that life shall be utterly destroyed from its kind, because he has scattered my covenant.
brenton_translation: And the uncircumcised male, who shall not be circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from its family, for he has broken my covenant.

fresh_translation: And God said to Abraham, Sarai your wife, her name shall not be called Sarai, but Sarah shall be her name.
brenton_translation: And God said to Abraam, Sara thy wife—her name shall not be called Sara, Sarrha shall be her name.

fresh_translation: And I will bless her, and I will give you a child from her. And I will bless him, and he shall become nations, and kings of nations shall come from him.
brenton_translation: And I will bless her, and give thee a son of her, and I will bless him, and he shall become nations, and kings of nations shall be of him.

fresh_translation: And Abraham fell upon his face and laughed, and said in his mind, Shall a son be born to one who is a hundred years old? And shall Sarah, being ninety years old, bear?
brenton_translation: And Abraam fell upon his face, and laughed; and spoke in his heart, saying, Shall there be a child to one who is a hundred years old, and shall Sarrha who is ninety years old, bear?

fresh_translation: And Abraham said to God, Let this Ishmael live before you.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said to God, Let this Ismael live before thee.

fresh_translation: And God said to Abraham, Yes. Look, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac. And I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant, to be God to him and to his seed after him.
brenton_translation: And God said to Abraam, Yea, behold, Sarrha thy wife shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name Isaac; and I will establish my covenant with him, for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to him and to his seed after him.

fresh_translation: And concerning Ishmael, look, I have heard you. And look, I have blessed him and will increase him and multiply him exceedingly. He shall beget twelve nations, and I will make him into a great nation.
brenton_translation: And concerning Ismael, behold, I have heard thee, and, behold, I have blessed him, and will increase him and multiply him exceedingly; twelve nations shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

fresh_translation: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this time in the next year.
brenton_translation: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarrha shall bear to thee at this time, in the next year.

fresh_translation: He finished speaking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
brenton_translation: And he left off speaking with him, and God went up from Abraam.

fresh_translation: And Abraham took Ishmael his son and all his home-born ones and all those bought with silver and every male of the men in Abraham's house, and circumcised their foreskins in the time of that very day, just as God spoke to him.
brenton_translation: And Abraam took Ismael his son, and all his home-born servants, and all those bought with money, and every male of the men in the house of Abraam, and he circumcised their foreskins in the time of that day, according as God spoke to him.

fresh_translation: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.
brenton_translation: And Abraam was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

fresh_translation: Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.
brenton_translation: And Ismael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

fresh_translation: At the time of that day Abraham was circumcised, and Ishmael his son,
brenton_translation: And at the period of that day, Abraam was circumcised, and Ismael his son,

fresh_translation: and all the men of his house, the home-born and the silver-bought from foreign nations, he circumcised them.
brenton_translation: and all the men of his house, both those born in the house, and those bought with money of foreign nations.

fresh_translation: And God appeared to him by the oak of Mamre, as he sat at the door of his tent at midday.
brenton_translation: And God appeared to him by the oak of Mambre, as he sat by the door of his tent at noon.

fresh_translation: Looking up with his eyes he saw, and look, three men stood over him. And seeing, he ran to meet them from the door of his tent and bowed to the ground.
brenton_translation: And he lifted up his eyes and beheld, and lo! three men stood before him; and having seen them he ran to meet them from the door of his tent, and did obeisance to the ground.

fresh_translation: And he said, Lord, if I have found favor before you, do not pass by your servant.
brenton_translation: And he said, Lord, if indeed I have found grace in thy sight, pass not by thy servant.

fresh_translation: Let water be taken, and let them wash your feet, and cool yourselves under the tree.
brenton_translation: Let water now be brought, and let them wash your feet, and do ye refresh yourselves under the tree.

fresh_translation: And I will take bread, and you shall eat, and after this you shall go on your way, because for this reason you turned aside to your servant. And they said, Do so, just as you have said.
brenton_translation: And I will bring bread, and ye shall eat, and after this ye shall depart on your journey, on account of which refreshment ye have turned aside to your servant. And he said, So do, as thou hast said.

fresh_translation: And Abraham hurried to the tent to Sarah and said to her, Hurry and knead three measures of fine flour and make hearth-cakes.
brenton_translation: And Abraam hasted to the tent to Sarrha, and said to her, Hasten, and knead three measures of fine flour, and make cakes.

fresh_translation: And Abraham ran to the cattle and took a tender and good calf and gave it to the servant-boy, and he hurried to prepare it.
brenton_translation: And Abraam ran to the kine, and took a young calf, tender and good, and gave it to his servant, and he hasted to dress it.

fresh_translation: And he took butter and milk and the calf that he had prepared and set it before them, and they ate. But he stood by them under the tree.
brenton_translation: And he took butter and milk, and the calf which he had dressed; and he set them before them, and they did eat, and he stood by them under the tree.

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Where is Sarah your wife? And answering he said, Look, in the tent.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Where is Sarrha thy wife? And he answered and said, Behold! in the tent.

fresh_translation: And he said, Returning I will come to you at this season in due time, and Sarah your wife shall have a son. Sarah heard at the door of the tent, being behind him.
brenton_translation: And he said, I will return and come to thee according to this period seasonably, and Sarrha thy wife shall have a son; and Sarrha heard at the door of the tent, being behind him.

fresh_translation: And Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in days, and the things of women had ceased to be with Sarah.
brenton_translation: And Abraam and Sarrha were old, advanced in days, and the custom of women ceased with Sarrha.

fresh_translation: And Sarah laughed in herself, saying, It has not happened to me until now, and my lord is old.
brenton_translation: And Sarrha laughed in herself, saying, The thing has not as yet happened to me, even until now, and my lord is old.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Abraham, Why is it that Sarah laughed in herself, saying, Shall I truly bear? But I have grown old.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Abraam, Why is it that Sarrha has laughed in herself, saying, Shall I then indeed bear? but I am grown old.

fresh_translation: Shall any word be impossible with God? At this season I will return to you in due time, and Sarah shall have a son.
brenton_translation: Shall anything be impossible with the Lord? At this time I will return to thee seasonably, and Sarrha shall have a son.

fresh_translation: And Sarah denied, saying, I did not laugh, for she was afraid. And he said to her, No, but you did laugh.
brenton_translation: But Sarrha denied, saying, I did not laugh, for she was afraid. And he said to her, Nay, but thou didst laugh.

fresh_translation: And the men, rising from there, looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah. But Abraham went with them, sending them on.
brenton_translation: And the men having risen up from thence looked towards Sodom and Gomorrha. And Abraam went with them, attending them on their journey.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham my servant what I am doing?
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraam my servant what things I intend to do?

fresh_translation: And Abraham indeed shall become a great and numerous nation, and in him all the nations of the earth shall be blessed.
brenton_translation: But Abraam shall become a great and populous nation, and in him shall all the nations of the earth be blest.

fresh_translation: For I know that he will direct his sons and his household after him, and they will keep the ways of the Lord, to do righteousness and judgment, so that the Lord may bring upon Abraham all that he spoke to him.
brenton_translation: For I know that he will order his sons, and his house after him, and they will keep the ways of the Lord, to do justice and judgment, that the Lord may bring upon Abraam all things whatsoever he has spoken to him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, The outcry of Sodom and Gomorrah has been multiplied toward me, and their sins are very great.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, The cry of Sodom and Gomorrha has been increased towards me, and their sins are very great.

fresh_translation: So coming down I will see whether they are carried out according to their outcry that comes to me. But if not, so that I may know.
brenton_translation: I will therefore go down and see, if they completely correspond with the cry which comes to me, and if not, that I may know.

fresh_translation: And the men, turning from there, came to Sodom. But Abraham was still standing before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the men having departed thence, came to Sodom; and Abraam was still standing before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Abraham, drawing near, said, Will you sweep away righteous with ungodly, and shall the righteous be like the ungodly?
brenton_translation: And Abraam drew nigh and said, Wouldest thou destroy the righteous with the wicked, and shall the righteous be as the wicked?

fresh_translation: If there are fifty righteous in the city, will you destroy them? Will you not let the whole place go because of the fifty righteous, if they are in it?
brenton_translation: Should there be fifty righteous in the city, wilt thou destroy them? wilt thou not spare the whole place for the sake of the fifty righteous, if they be in it?

fresh_translation: By no means will you do according to this word, to kill righteous with ungodly, and the righteous shall be like the ungodly. By no means. The one judging all the earth, will you not do judgment?
brenton_translation: By no means shalt thou do as this thing is so as to destroy the righteous with the wicked, so the righteous shall be as the wicked: by no means. Thou that judgest the whole earth, shalt thou not do right?

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, If there are fifty righteous in Sodom in the city, I will spare the whole city and all the place because of them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, If there should be in Sodom fifty righteous in the city, I will spare the whole city, and the whole place for their sakes.

fresh_translation: And Abraham answered and said, Now I have begun to speak to my Lord, and I am earth and ashes.
brenton_translation: And Abraam answered and said, Now I have begun to speak to my Lord, and I am earth and ashes.

fresh_translation: But if the fifty righteous are lessened to forty-five, will you destroy the whole city because of the five? And he said, I will certainly not destroy it if I find forty-five there.
brenton_translation: But if the fifty righteous should be diminished to forty-five, wilt thou destroy the whole city because of the five wanting? And he said, I will not destroy it, if I should find there forty-five.

fresh_translation: And he added still to speak to him and said, But if forty are found there? And he said, I will certainly not destroy it because of the forty.
brenton_translation: And he continued to speak to him still, and said, But if there should be found there forty? And he said, I will not destroy it for the forty's sake.

fresh_translation: And he said, Let it not be so, Lord, if I speak. But if thirty are found there? And he said, I will certainly not destroy it because of the thirty.
brenton_translation: And he said, Will there be anything against me, Lord, if I shall speak? but if there be found there thirty? And he said, I will not destroy it for the thirty's sake.

fresh_translation: And he said, Since I have it to speak to the Lord, but if twenty are found there? And he said, I will certainly not destroy it if I find twenty there.
brenton_translation: And he said, Since I am able to speak to the Lord, what if there should be found there twenty? And he said, I will not destroy it, if I should find there twenty.

fresh_translation: And he said, Let it not be so, Lord, if I speak still once more. But if ten are found there? And he said, I will certainly not destroy it because of the ten.
brenton_translation: And he said, Will there be anything against me, Lord, if I speak yet once? but if there should be found there ten? And he said, I will not destroy it for the ten's sake.

fresh_translation: And the Lord departed when he ceased speaking with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
brenton_translation: And the Lord departed, when he left off speaking to Abraam, and Abraam returned to his place.

fresh_translation: And the two angels came to Sodom at evening. And Lot was sitting by the gate of Sodom. Seeing them, Lot rose to meet them and bowed with his face to the ground.
brenton_translation: And the two angels came to Sodom at evening. And Lot sat by the gate of Sodom, and Lot having seen them, rose up to meet them, and he worshipped with his face to the ground, and said,

fresh_translation: And he said, Look, lords, turn aside into the house of your servant and lodge and wash your feet, and rising early you shall go on your way. And they said, No, but we will lodge in the square.
brenton_translation: Lo! my lords, turn aside to the house of your servant, and rest from your journey, and wash your feet, and having risen early in the morning ye shall depart on your journey. And they said, Nay, but we will lodge in the street.

fresh_translation: And he pressed them, and they turned aside to him and entered into his house. And he made a feast for them, and baked unleavened bread for them, and they ate.
brenton_translation: And he constrained them, and they turned aside to him, and they entered into his house, and he made a feast for them, and baked unleavened cakes for them, and they did eat.

fresh_translation: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the Sodomites, surrounded the house, from young man to old man, all the people together.
brenton_translation: But before they went to sleep, the men of the city, the Sodomites, compassed the house, both young and old, all the people together.

fresh_translation: And they called out to Lot and said to him, Where are the men who entered to you tonight? Bring them out to us, so that we may be with them.
brenton_translation: And they called out Lot, and said to him, Where are the men that went in to thee this night? bring them out to us that we may be with them.

fresh_translation: And Lot went out to them to the porch, and he shut the door after him.
brenton_translation: And Lot went out to them to the porch, and he shut the door after him,

fresh_translation: And he said to them, By no means, brothers, do not act wickedly.
brenton_translation: and said to them, By no means, brethren, do not act villanously.

fresh_translation: Look, I have two daughters who have not known a man. I will bring them out to you, and use them as may please you. Only do no wrong to these men, because for this reason they entered under the shelter of my roof-beams.
brenton_translation: But I have two daughters, who have not known a man. I will bring them out to you, and do ye use them as it may please you, only do not injury to these men, to avoid which they came under the shelter of my roof.

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Stand back there. You came in to live as a foreigner; do you also mean to judge? Now we will mistreat you more than them. And they pressed the man Lot very hard, and they drew near to break the door.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, Stand back there, thou camest in to sojourn, was it also to judge? Now then we would harm thee more than them. And they pressed hard on the man, even Lot, and they drew nigh to break the door.

fresh_translation: And the men stretched out their hands and drew Lot into the house to themselves, and they shut the door of the house.
brenton_translation: And the men stretched forth their hands and drew Lot in to them into the house, and shut the door of the house.

fresh_translation: And the men at the door of the house they struck with blindness, from small to great, and they were worn out seeking the door.
brenton_translation: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, and they were wearied with seeking the door.

fresh_translation: And the men said to Lot, Do you have here sons-in-law or sons or daughters? Or if anyone else is yours in the city, bring them out from this place.
brenton_translation: And the men said to Lot, Hast thou here sons-in-law, or sons or daughters, or if thou hast any other friend in the city, bring them out of this place.

fresh_translation: Because we are destroying this place, because their outcry has been lifted up before the Lord, and the Lord has sent us to wipe it out.
brenton_translation: For we are going to destroy this place; for their cry has been raised up before the Lord, and the Lord has sent us to destroy it.

fresh_translation: And Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, those who had taken his daughters, and said, Rise and go out from this place, because the Lord is wiping out the city. But he seemed to be joking before his sons-in-law.
brenton_translation: And Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law who had married his daughters, and said, Rise up, and depart out of this place, for the Lord is about to destroy the city; but he seemed to be speaking absurdly before his sons-in-law.

fresh_translation: When dawn was coming, the angels urged Lot, saying, Rise, take your wife and your two daughters whom you have, and go out, lest you too be destroyed with the lawless acts of the city.
brenton_translation: But when it was morning, the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise and take thy wife, and thy two daughters whom thou hast, and go forth; lest thou also be destroyed with the iniquities of the city.

fresh_translation: And they were troubled, and the angels took hold of his hand and the hand of his wife and the hands of his two daughters, because the Lord spared him.
brenton_translation: And they were troubled, and the angels laid hold on his hand, and the hand of his wife, and the hands of his two daughters, in that the Lord spared him.

fresh_translation: And it happened when they brought them outside that they said, Save your own life by all means. Do not look around to what is behind, and do not stand in all the surrounding region. Escape to the mountain, lest perhaps you be taken together with them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when they brought them out, that they said, Save thine own life by all means; look not round to that which is behind, nor stay in all the country round about, escape to the mountain, lest perhaps thou be overtaken together with them.

fresh_translation: And Lot said to them, I beg, lord,
brenton_translation: And Lot said to them, I pray, Lord,

fresh_translation: Since your servant has found mercy before you, and you have magnified your righteousness, what you are doing toward me to keep my life alive, I will not be able to escape to the mountain, lest perhaps the evils overtake me and I die.
brenton_translation: since thy servant has found mercy before thee, and thou hast magnified thy righteousness, in what thou doest towards me that my soul may live,—but I shall not be able to escape to the mountain, lest perhaps the calamity overtake me and I die.

fresh_translation: Look, this city is near for me to flee there, and it is small, and there I shall be preserved. Is it not small? And my life shall live because of you.
brenton_translation: Behold this city is near for me to escape thither, which is a small one, and there shall I be preserved, is it not little? and my soul shall live because of thee.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Look, I have shown regard for you also in this matter, that I should not overthrow the city about which you spoke.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Behold, I have had respect to thee also about this thing, that I should not overthrow the city about which thou hast spoken.

fresh_translation: Hasten then to be saved there, for I will not be able to do anything until you come there. Because of this he called the name of that city Segor.
brenton_translation: Hasten therefore to escape thither, for I shall not be able to do anything until thou art come thither; therefore he called the name of that city, Segor.

fresh_translation: The sun came out upon the earth, and Lot entered into Segor.
brenton_translation: The sun was risen upon the earth, when Lot entered into Segor.

fresh_translation: And the Lord rained upon Sodom and Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the Lord out of heaven.
brenton_translation: And the Lord rained on Sodom and Gomorrha brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven.

fresh_translation: And he overthrew these cities and all the surrounding region and all dwelling in the cities and the things springing up from the earth.
brenton_translation: And he overthrew these cities, and all the country round about, and all that dwelt in the cities, and the plants springing out of the ground.

fresh_translation: And his wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
brenton_translation: And his wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

fresh_translation: And Abraham rose early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Abraam rose up early to go to the place, where he had stood before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah and toward the surrounding region and saw, and look, flame went up from the earth like the vapor of a furnace.
brenton_translation: And he looked towards Sodom and Gomorrha, and towards the surrounding country, and saw, and behold a flame went up from the earth, as the smoke of a furnace.

fresh_translation: And it happened when God destroyed all the cities of the surrounding region, God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out from the midst of the overthrow, when the Lord overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass that when God destroyed all the cities of the region round about, God remembered Abraam, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when the Lord overthrew those cities in which Lot dwelt.

fresh_translation: And Lot went up from Segor and dwelt in the mountain, he and his two daughters with him, for he feared to dwell in Segor. And he dwelt in the cave, he and his two daughters with him.
brenton_translation: And Lot went up out of Segor, and dwelt in the mountain, he and his two daughters with him, for he feared to dwell in Segor; and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters with him.

fresh_translation: And the elder said to the younger, Our father is old, and no one is on the earth who will come in to us, as is fitting for all the earth.
brenton_translation: And the elder said to the younger, Our father is old, and there is no one on the earth who shall come in to us, as it is fit in all the earth.

fresh_translation: Come and let us make our father drink wine, and let us sleep with him, and let us raise up seed from our father.
brenton_translation: Come and let us make our father drink wine, and let us sleep with him, and let us raise up seed from our father.

fresh_translation: And they made their father drink wine in that night, and the elder went in and lay with her father in that night, and he did not know when she lay down or when she rose up.
brenton_translation: So they made their father drink wine in that night, and the elder went in and lay with her father that night, and he knew not when he slept and when he rose up.

fresh_translation: And it happened on the next day that the elder said to the younger, Look, I slept yesterday with our father. Let us make him drink wine in this night also, and going in you sleep with him, and let us raise up seed from our father.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the elder said to the younger, Behold, I slept yesternight with our father, let us make him drink wine in this night also, and do thou go in and sleep with him, and let us raise up seed of our father.

fresh_translation: And they made their father drink wine in that night also, and the younger went in and slept with her father, and he did not know when she lay down nor when she arose.
brenton_translation: So they made their father drink wine in that night also, and the younger went in and slept with her father, and he knew not when he slept, nor when he arose.

fresh_translation: And the two daughters of Lot conceived by their father.
brenton_translation: And the two daughters of Lot conceived by their father.

fresh_translation: And the elder bore a son and called his name Moab, saying, From my father. This one is father of the Moabites to the present day.
brenton_translation: And the elder bore a son, and called his name Moab, saying, He is of my father. This is the father of the Moabites to this present day.

fresh_translation: And the younger also bore a son and called his name Amman, saying, Son of my family. This one is father of the Ammanites to the present day.
brenton_translation: And the younger also bore a son, and called his name Amman, saying, The son of my family. This is the father of the Ammanites to this present day.

fresh_translation: And Abraham moved from there toward the south land and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and lived as a foreigner in Gerara.
brenton_translation: And Abraam removed thence to the southern country, and dwelt between Cades and Sur, and sojourned in Gerara.

fresh_translation: And Abraham said concerning Sarah his wife, She is my sister. For he feared to say, She is my wife, lest perhaps the men of the city kill him because of her. And Abimelech king of Gerara sent and took Sarah.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said concerning Sarrha his wife, She is my sister, for he feared to say, She is my wife, lest at any time the men of the city should kill him for her sake. So Abimelech king of Gerara sent and took Sarrha.

fresh_translation: And God came to Abimelech in sleep by night and said, Look, you are dying because of the woman whom you have taken, but she has lived with a husband.
brenton_translation: And God came to Abimelech by night in sleep, and said, Behold, thou diest for the woman, whom thou hast taken, whereas she has lived with a husband.

fresh_translation: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he said, Lord, will you destroy an ignorant and righteous nation?
brenton_translation: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he said, Lord, wilt thou destroy an ignorantly sinning and just nation?

fresh_translation: Did he not himself say to me, She is my sister? And did she not say to me, He is my brother? In a pure heart and in the righteousness of my hands I did this.
brenton_translation: Said he not to me, She is my sister, and said she not to me, He is my brother? with a pure heart and in the righteousness of my hands have I done this.

fresh_translation: And God said to him in sleep, Yes, I knew that you did this in a pure heart, and I spared you so that you should not sin against me. Because of this I did not permit you to touch her.
brenton_translation: And God said to him in sleep, Yea, I knew that thou didst this with a pure heart, and I spared thee, so that thou shouldest not sin against me, therefore I suffered thee not to touch her.

fresh_translation: But now return the woman to the man, because he is a prophet and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, know that you shall die, you and all that is yours.
brenton_translation: But now return the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live; but if thou restore her not, know that thou shalt die and all thine.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech rose early in the morning and called all his servants and spoke all these words into their ears, and all the men feared exceedingly.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and he spoke all these words in their ears, and all the men feared exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, What is this you have done to us? Did we sin against you, that you brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin? A deed that no one should do, you have done to me.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech called Abraam and said to him, What is this that thou hast done to us? Have we sinned against thee, that thou hast brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin? Thou hast done to me a deed, which no one ought to do.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What did you see, that you did this?
brenton_translation: And Abimelech said to Abraam, What hast thou seen in me that thou hast done this?

fresh_translation: And Abraham said, For I said, Surely there is no reverence for God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said, Why I said, Surely there is not the worship of God in this place, and they will slay me because of my wife.

fresh_translation: And indeed she truly is my sister by my father, but not by my mother, and she became my wife.
brenton_translation: For truly she is my sister by my father, but not by my mother, and she became my wife.

fresh_translation: And it happened when God brought me out from my father's house, that I said to her, This righteousness you shall do for me: in every place where we enter there, say of me, He is my brother.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when God brought me forth out of the house of my father, that I said to her, This righteousness thou shalt perform to me, in every place into which we may enter, say of me, He is my brother.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech took a thousand didrachmas and sheep and calves and male-servants and female-servants and gave them to Abraham, and returned Sarah his wife to him.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech took a thousand pieces of silver, and sheep, and calves, and servants, and maid-servants, and gave them to Abraam, and he returned him Sarrha his wife.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech said to Abraham, Look, my land before you. Wherever it pleases you, dwell.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech said to Abraam, Behold, my land is before thee, dwell wheresoever it may please thee.

fresh_translation: And to Sarah he said, Look, I have given a thousand didrachmas to your brother. These shall be to you for the honor of your face and to all the women with you. And speak truth in all things.
brenton_translation: And to Sarrha he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver, those shall be to thee for the price of thy countenance, and to all the women with thee, and speak the truth in all things.

fresh_translation: And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his female-servants, and they bore children.
brenton_translation: And Abraam prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his women servants, and they bore children.

fresh_translation: Because in closing the Lord had closed from outside every womb in Abimelech's house, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
brenton_translation: Because the Lord had fast closed from without every womb in the house of Abimelech, because of Sarrha Abraam's wife.

fresh_translation: And the Lord visited Sarah, just as he said, and the Lord did for Sarah just as he spoke,
brenton_translation: And the Lord visited Sarrha, as he said, and the Lord did to Sarrha, as he spoke.

fresh_translation: and conceiving, she bore to Abraham a son in old age, at the appointed time, just as the Lord spoke to him.
brenton_translation: And she conceived and bore to Abraam a son in old age, at the set time according as the Lord spoke to him.

fresh_translation: And Abraham called the name of his son who came to be for him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
brenton_translation: And Abraam called the name of his son that was born to him, whom Sarrha bore to him, Isaac.

fresh_translation: And Abraham circumcised Isaac on the eighth day, just as God commanded him.
brenton_translation: And Abraam circumcised Isaac on the eighth day, as God commanded him.

fresh_translation: And Abraham was one hundred years old when Isaac his son came to be for him.
brenton_translation: And Abraam was a hundred years old when Isaac his son was born to him.

fresh_translation: And Sarah said, The Lord made laughter for me, for whoever hears will rejoice with me.
brenton_translation: And Sarrha said, The Lord has made laughter for me, for whoever shall hear shall rejoice with me.

fresh_translation: And she said, Who will report to Abraham that Sarah nurses a child? For I bore a son in my old age.
brenton_translation: And she said, Who shall say to Abraam that Sarrha suckles a child? for I have born a child in my old age.

fresh_translation: And the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham made a great feast on the day Isaac his son was weaned.
brenton_translation: And the child grew and was weaned, and Abraam made a great feast the day that his son Isaac was weaned.

fresh_translation: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, who had come to be for Abraham, playing with Isaac her son.
brenton_translation: And Sarrha having seen the son of Agar the Egyptian who was born to Abraam, sporting with Isaac her son,

fresh_translation: And she said to Abraham, Cast out this servant-girl and her son, for the son of this servant-girl shall certainly not inherit with my son Isaac.
brenton_translation: then she said to Abraam, Cast out this bondwoman and her son, for the son of this bondwoman shall not inherit with my son Isaac.

fresh_translation: But the word appeared very hard before Abraham concerning his son.
brenton_translation: But the word appeared very hard before Abraam concerning his son.

fresh_translation: And God said to Abraham, Let it not be hard before you concerning the child and concerning the servant-girl. In all that Sarah says to you, hear her voice, because in Isaac seed shall be called for you.
brenton_translation: But God said to Abraam, Let it not be hard before thee concerning the child, and concerning the bondwoman; in all things whatsoever Sarrha shall say to thee, hear her voice, for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

fresh_translation: And I will make the son of this servant-girl into a great nation also, because he is your seed.
brenton_translation: And moreover I will make the son of this bondwoman a great nation, because he is thy seed.

fresh_translation: And Abraham rose early in the morning and took loaves and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar, and set the child on her shoulders, and sent her away. And departing, she wandered by the wilderness near the well of the oath.
brenton_translation: And Abraam rose up in the morning and took loaves and a skin of water, and gave them to Agar, and he put the child on her shoulder, and sent her away, and she having departed wandered in the wilderness near the well of the oath.

fresh_translation: And the water failed from the skin, and she threw the child under one fir tree.
brenton_translation: And the water failed out of the skin, and she cast the child under a fir tree.

fresh_translation: And departing she sat opposite him at a distance, about a bow-shot, for she said, I certainly shall not see the death of my child. And she sat opposite him, and the child cried out and wept.
brenton_translation: And she departed and sat down opposite him at a distance, as it were a bow-shot, for she said, Surely I cannot see the death of my child: and she sat opposite him, and the child cried aloud and wept.

fresh_translation: And God heard the voice of the child from the place where he was, and an angel of God called Hagar out of heaven and said to her, What is it, Hagar? Do not fear, for God has heard the voice of the child from the place where he is.
brenton_translation: And God heard the voice of the child from the place where he was, and an angel of God called Agar out of heaven, and said to her, What is it, Agar? fear not, for God has heard the voice of the child from the place where he is.

fresh_translation: Rise and take the child and hold him in your hand, for I will make him into a great nation.
brenton_translation: Rise up, and take the child, and hold him in thine hand, for I will make him a great nation.

fresh_translation: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of living water and went and filled the skin with water and gave the child drink.
brenton_translation: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of springing water; and she went and filled the skin with water, and gave the child drink.

fresh_translation: And God was with the child, and he grew. And he dwelt in the wilderness and became an archer.
brenton_translation: And God was with the child, and he grew and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

fresh_translation: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Pharan, and his mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And he dwelt in the wilderness, and his mother took him a wife out of Pharan of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And it happened at that time that Abimelech and Ochozath his marriage-companion and Phichol the commander-in-chief of his force said to Abraham, saying, God is with you in all that you may do.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at that time that Abimelech spoke, and Ochozath his friend, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, to Abraam, saying, God is with thee in all things, whatsoever thou mayest do.

fresh_translation: Now then swear to me by God that you will not wrong me, nor my seed, nor my name, but according to the righteousness that I did with you, you shall do with me and with the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.
brenton_translation: Now therefore swear to me by God that thou wilt not injure me, nor my seed, nor my name, but according to the righteousness which I have performed with thee thou shalt deal with me, and with the land in which thou hast sojourned.

fresh_translation: And Abraham said, I will swear.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said, I will swear.

fresh_translation: And Abraham reproved Abimelech concerning the wells of water, which Abimelech's servants took away.
brenton_translation: And Abraam reproved Abimelech because of the wells of water, which the servants of Abimelech took away.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech said to him, I did not know who did this thing to you, nor did you report it to me, nor did I hear it except today.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech said to him, I know not who has done this thing to thee, neither didst thou tell it me, neither heard I it but only to-day.

fresh_translation: And Abraham took sheep and calves and gave them to Abimelech, and the two made a covenant.
brenton_translation: And Abraam took sheep and calves, and gave them to Abimelech, and both made a covenant.

fresh_translation: And Abraham set seven ewe-lambs of the flock by themselves.
brenton_translation: And Abraam set seven ewe-lambs by themselves.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What are these seven ewe-lambs of the flock that you set by themselves?
brenton_translation: And Abimelech said to Abraam, What are these seven ewe-lambs which thou hast set alone?

fresh_translation: And Abraham said, You shall receive the seven ewe-lambs from me, so that they may be for me as a witness that I dug this well.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said, Thou shalt receive the seven ewe-lambs of me, that they may be for me as a witness, that I dug this well.

fresh_translation: Because of this he named the name of that place, Well of Oath, because there both of them swore.
brenton_translation: Therefore he named the name of that place, The Well of the Oath, for there they both swore.

fresh_translation: And they made a covenant at the well of the oath. And Abimelech rose, and Ochozath his marriage-companion, and Phichol the commander-in-chief of his force, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.
brenton_translation: And they made a covenant at the well of the oath. And there rose up Abimelech, Ochozath his friend, and Phichol the commander-in-chief of his army, and they returned to the land of the Phylistines.

fresh_translation: And Abraham planted a field at the well of the oath and called there on the name of the Lord, Everlasting God.
brenton_translation: And Abraam planted a field at the well of the oath, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.
