fresh_translation: And Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
brenton_translation: And Abraam sojourned in the land of the Phylistines many days.

fresh_translation: And it happened after these words that God tested Abraham and said to him, Abraham, Abraham. And he said, Look, I am here.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after these things that God tempted Abraam, and said to him, Abraam, Abraam; and he said, Lo! I am here.

fresh_translation: And he said, Take your beloved son, whom you loved, Isaac, and go into the high land and bring him up there as a whole-burnt offering on one of the mountains that I will tell you.
brenton_translation: And he said, Take thy son, the beloved one, whom thou hast loved—Isaac, and go into the high land, and offer him there for a whole-burnt-offering on one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

fresh_translation: And Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took with himself two servants and Isaac his son, and splitting wood for a whole-burnt offering, he rose and went and came to the place that God told him, on the third day.
brenton_translation: And Abraam rose up in the morning and saddled his ass, and he took with him two servants, and Isaac his son, and having split wood for a whole-burnt-offering, he arose and departed, and came to the place of which God spoke to him,

fresh_translation: And Abraham, looking up with his eyes, saw the place from afar.
brenton_translation: on the third day; and Abraam having lifted up his eyes, saw the place afar off.

fresh_translation: And Abraham said to his servants, Sit here with the donkey, and I and the young one will go through as far as there, and having worshiped we will return to you.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said to his servants, Sit ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will proceed thus far, and having worshipped we will return to you.

fresh_translation: And Abraham took the wood of the whole-burnt offering and laid it upon Isaac his son. And he took in his hands also the fire and the knife, and the two went together.
brenton_translation: And Abraam took the wood of the whole-burnt-offering, and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took into his hands both the fire and the knife, and the two went together.

fresh_translation: And Isaac said to Abraham his father, Father. And he said, What is it, child? And he said, Look, the fire and the wood. Where is the sheep for a whole-burnt offering?
brenton_translation: And Isaac said to Abraam his father, Father. And he said, What is it, son? And he said, Behold the fire and the wood, where is the sheep for a whole-burnt-offering?

fresh_translation: And Abraham said, God will see for himself a sheep for a whole-burnt offering, child. And both went on together.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said, God will provide himself a sheep for a whole-burnt-offering, my son. And both having gone together,

fresh_translation: And they came to the place that God told him. And Abraham built there the altar and placed the wood, and having bound together Isaac his son, he laid him on the altar upon the wood.
brenton_translation: came to the place which God spoke of to him; and there Abraam built the altar, and laid the wood on it, and having bound the feet of Isaac his son together, he laid him on the altar upon the wood.

fresh_translation: And Abraham stretched out his hand to take the knife to slay his son.
brenton_translation: And Abraam stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay his son.

fresh_translation: And an angel of the Lord called him from heaven and said, Abraham, Abraham. And he said, Look, I am here.
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord called him out of heaven, and said, Abraam, Abraam. And he said, Behold, I am here.

fresh_translation: And he said, Do not lay your hand on the child, and do nothing to him, for now I know that you fear God, and for my sake you did not spare your beloved son.
brenton_translation: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the child, neither do anything to him, for now I know that thou fearest God, and for my sake thou hast not spared thy beloved son.

fresh_translation: And Abraham, looking up with his eyes, saw, and look, one ram caught in a plant of Sabek by the horns. And Abraham went and took the ram and brought it up as a whole-burnt offering instead of Isaac his son.
brenton_translation: And Abraam lifted up his eyes and beheld, and lo! a ram caught by his horns in a plant of Sabec; and Abraam went and took the ram, and offered him up for a whole-burnt-offering in the place of Isaac his son.

fresh_translation: And Abraham called the name of that place, The Lord saw, so that they may say today, On the mountain the Lord was seen.
brenton_translation: And Abraam called the name of that place, The Lord hath seen; that they might say to-day, In the mount the Lord was seen.

fresh_translation: And an angel of the Lord called Abraham a second time from heaven, saying,
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord called Abraam the second time out of heaven,

fresh_translation: By myself I have sworn, says the Lord, because you did this thing, and for my sake did not spare your beloved son,
brenton_translation: saying, I have sworn by myself, says the Lord, because thou hast done this thing, and on my account hast not spared thy beloved son,

fresh_translation: Surely in blessing I will bless you, and in multiplying I will multiply your seed, like the stars of heaven and like the sand beside the shore of the sea, and your seed shall inherit the cities of the adversaries.
brenton_translation: surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand which is by the shore of the sea, and thy seed shall inherit the cities of their enemies.

fresh_translation: And in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you hearkened to my voice.
brenton_translation: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed, because thou hast hearkened to my voice.

fresh_translation: And Abraham returned to his servants, and rising they went together to the well of the oath. And Abraham dwelt at the well of the oath.
brenton_translation: And Abraam returned to his servants, and they arose and went together to the well of the oath; and Abraam dwelt at the well of the oath.

fresh_translation: And it happened after these words that it was reported to Abraham, saying, Look, Milcha also has borne sons to Nachor your brother,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after these things, that it was reported to Abraam, saying, Behold, Melcha herself too has born sons to Nachor thy brother,

fresh_translation: Uz the firstborn and Baux his brother and Kamouel father of the Syrians
brenton_translation: Uz the first-born, and Baux his brother, and Camuel the father of the Syrians, and Chazad, and

fresh_translation: and Chazad and Azau and Phaldes and Jeldaph and Bathouel.
brenton_translation: Azav and Phaldes, and Jeldaph, and Bathuel, and Bathuel begot Rebecca;

fresh_translation: And Bathouel begot Rebecca. These are eight sons whom Milcha bore to Nachor the brother of Abraham.
brenton_translation: these are eight sons, which Melcha bore to Nachor the brother of Abraam.

fresh_translation: And his concubine, whose name was Rheuma, also bore Tabek and Taam and Tochos and Mocha.
brenton_translation: And his concubine whose name was Rheuma, she also bore Tabec, and Taam, and Tochos, and Mocha.

fresh_translation: And Sarah's life was one hundred twenty-seven years.
brenton_translation: And the life of Sarrha was an hundred and twenty-seven years.

fresh_translation: And Sarah died in the city of Arbok, which is in the hollow (this is Hebron) in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to lament Sarah and to mourn.
brenton_translation: And Sarrha died in the city of Arboc, which is in the valley, this is Chebron in the land of Chanaan; and Abraam came to lament for Sarrha and to mourn.

fresh_translation: And Abraham rose up from his dead and Abraham said to the sons of Heth, saying,
brenton_translation: And Abraam stood up from before his dead; and Abraam spoke to the sons of Chet, saying,

fresh_translation: I am a sojourner and a temporary resident among you. So give me a burial holding among you, and I will bury my dead away from me.
brenton_translation: I am a sojourner and a stranger among you, give me therefore possession of a burying-place among you, and I will bury my dead away from me.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying, No, lord.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Chet answered to Abraam, saying, Not so, Sir,

fresh_translation: Hear us. You are a king from God among us. In our choice tombs bury your dead, for none of us will withhold his tomb from you, so that you may bury your dead there.
brenton_translation: but hear us; thou art in the midst of us a king from God; bury thy dead in our choice sepulchres, for not one of us will by any means withhold his sepulchre from thee, so that thou shouldest not bury thy dead there.

fresh_translation: And Abraham rose and bowed to the people of the land, to the sons of Heth,
brenton_translation: And Abraam rose up and did obeisance to the people of the land, to the sons of Chet.

fresh_translation: and Abraham spoke to them, saying, If it is in your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me and speak on my behalf to Ephron son of Saar,
brenton_translation: And Abraam spoke to them, saying, If ye have it in your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hearken to me, and speak for me to Ephron the son of Saar.

fresh_translation: and let him give me the double cave, which belongs to him, which is in part of his field. Let him give it to me among you for full silver as a burial holding.
brenton_translation: And let him give me the double cave which he has, which is in a part of his field, let him give it me for the money it is worth for possession of a burying-place among you.

fresh_translation: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the sons of Heth. And Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham, speaking in the hearing of the sons of Heth and of all who entered into the city, saying,
brenton_translation: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the children of Chet, and Ephron the Chettite answered Abraam and spoke in the hearing of the sons of Chet, and of all who entered the city, saying,

fresh_translation: Listen, lord, and hear me. I give you the field and the cave in it. Before all my fellow-citizens I have given it to you. Bury your dead.
brenton_translation: Attend to me, my lord, and hear me, I give to thee the field and the cave which is in it; I have given it thee before all my countrymen; bury thy dead.

fresh_translation: And Abraham bowed before the people of the land,
brenton_translation: And Abraam did obeisance before the people of the land.

fresh_translation: and said to Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, Since you are for me, hear me. Take the silver for the field from me, and I will bury my dead there.
brenton_translation: And he said in the ears of Ephron before the people of the land, Since thou art on my side, hear me; take the price of the field from me, and I will bury my dead there.

fresh_translation: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying,
brenton_translation: But Ephron answered Abraam, saying,

fresh_translation: No, lord, I have indeed heard. Land worth four hundred silver didrachms - but what is that between me and you? So bury your dead.
brenton_translation: Nay, my lord, I have heard indeed, the land is worth four hundred silver didrachms, but what can this be between me and thee? nay, do thou bury thy dead.

fresh_translation: And Abraham listened to Ephron, and Abraham weighed out to Ephron the silver that he had spoken in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred silver didrachms, merchant-approved.
brenton_translation: And Abraam hearkened to Ephron, and Abraam rendered to Ephron the money, which he mentioned in the ears of the sons of Chet, four hundred didrachms of silver approved with merchants.

fresh_translation: And the field of Ephron, which was at the double cave, which is opposite Mamre, the field and the cave in it, and every tree that was in the field, and everything that was within all its borders round about, was established
brenton_translation: And the field of Ephron, which was in Double Cave, which is opposite Mambre, the field and the cave, which was in it, and every tree which was in the field, and whatever is in its borders round about, were made sure

fresh_translation: to Abraham as a holding, before the sons of Heth and all who entered into the city.
brenton_translation: to Abraam for a possession, before the sons of Chet, and all that entered into the city.

fresh_translation: After this Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field at the double place, which is opposite Mamre (this is Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: After this Abraam buried Sarrha his wife in the Double Cave of the field, which is opposite Mambre, this is Chebron in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And the field and the cave in it were confirmed to Abraham as a burial holding from the sons of Heth.
brenton_translation: So the field and the cave which was in it were made sure to Abraam for possession of a burying place, by the sons of Chet.

fresh_translation: And Abraham was old, far advanced in days, and the Lord had blessed Abraham in everything.
brenton_translation: And Abraam was old, advanced in days, and the Lord blessed Abraam in all things.

fresh_translation: And Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, the ruler of all that was his, Put your hand under my thigh,
brenton_translation: And Abraam said to his servant the elder of his house, who had rule over all his possessions, Put thy hand under my thigh,

fresh_translation: and I will bind you by oath by the Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son Isaac from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell,
brenton_translation: and I will adjure thee by the Lord the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou take not a wife for my son Isaac from the daughters of the Chananites, with whom I dwell, in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: but you shall go instead to my land, where I was born, and to my tribe, and take a wife from there for my son Isaac.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt go instead to my country, where I was born, and to my tribe, and thou shalt take from thence a wife for my son Isaac.

fresh_translation: And the servant said to him, Suppose the woman is not willing to come back with me to this land. Shall I return your son to the land from which you came out?
brenton_translation: And the servant said to him, Shall I carry back thy son to the land whence thou camest forth, if haply the woman should not be willing to return with me to this land?

fresh_translation: And Abraham said to him, Beware for yourself that you do not return my son there.
brenton_translation: And Abraam said to him, Take heed to thyself that thou carry not my son back thither.

fresh_translation: The Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, who took me from my father's house and from the land where I was born, who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, To you and to your seed I will give this land - he himself will send his angel ahead of you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
brenton_translation: The Lord the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, who took me out of my father's house, and out of the land whence I sprang, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, I will give this land to thee and to thy seed, he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife to my son from thence.

fresh_translation: But if the woman is not willing to come with you into this land, you shall be clear from my oath. Only do not return my son there.
brenton_translation: And if the woman should not be willing to come with thee into this land, thou shalt be clear from my oath, only carry not my son thither again.

fresh_translation: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his lord and swore to him concerning this matter.
brenton_translation: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraam, and swore to him concerning this matter.

fresh_translation: And the servant took ten camels from the camels of his lord, and from all the good things of his lord with him. And he rose and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
brenton_translation: And the servant took ten camels of his master's camels, and he took of all the goods of his master with him, and he arose and went into Mesopotamia to the city of Nachor.

fresh_translation: And he made the camels lie down outside the city beside the water well toward evening, at the time when the women who draw water go out.
brenton_translation: And he rested his camels without the city by the well of water towards evening, when damsels go forth to draw water.

fresh_translation: And he said, Lord, God of my lord Abraham, prosper things before me today and show mercy toward my lord Abraham.
brenton_translation: And he said, O Lord God of my master Abraam, prosper my way before me to day, and deal mercifully with my master Abraam.

fresh_translation: Look, I am standing at the spring of water, and the daughters of those inhabiting the city are coming out to draw water,
brenton_translation: Lo! I stand by the well of water, and the daughters of them that inhabit the city come forth to draw water.

fresh_translation: and let it be that the virgin to whom I say, Lower your water jar so that I may drink, and she says to me, Drink, and I will water your camels until they stop drinking - this is the one you prepared for your servant Isaac, and by this I will know that you have done mercy with my lord Abraham.
brenton_translation: And it shall be, the virgin to whomsoever I shall say, Incline thy water-pot, that I may drink, and she shall say, Drink thou, and I will give thy camels drink, until they shall have done drinking—even this one thou hast prepared for thy servant Isaac, and hereby shall I know that thou hast dealt mercifully with my master Abraam.

fresh_translation: And it happened before he finished speaking in his mind, that at once Rebekah came out, born to Bethuel son of Milcah wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, having her water jar on her shoulders.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass before he had done speaking in his mind, that behold, Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, the wife of Nachor, and the same the brother of Abraam, came forth, having a water-pot on her shoulders.

fresh_translation: And the virgin was very beautiful in appearance. She was a virgin; a man had not known her. And she went down to the spring, filled her water jar, and came up.
brenton_translation: And the virgin was very beautiful in appearance, she was a virgin, a man had not known her; and she went down to the well, and filled her water-pot, and came up.

fresh_translation: And the servant ran to meet her and said, Give me a little water to drink from your jar.
brenton_translation: And the servant ran up to meet her, and said, Give me a little water to drink out of thy pitcher;

fresh_translation: And she said, Drink, lord. And she hurried and lowered the jar onto her arm and gave him drink until he stopped drinking.
brenton_translation: and she said, Drink, Sir; and she hasted, and let down the pitcher upon her arm, and gave him to drink, till he ceased drinking.

fresh_translation: And she said, I will draw for your camels too, until they all drink.
brenton_translation: And she said, I will also draw water for thy camels, till they shall all have drunk.

fresh_translation: And she hurried and emptied the water jar into the trough and ran back to the well to draw again and drew for all the camels.
brenton_translation: And she hasted, and emptied the water-pot into the trough, and ran to the well to draw again, and drew water for all the camels.

fresh_translation: And the man was closely observing her and kept silent, to know whether the Lord had prospered his way or not.
brenton_translation: And the man took great notice of her, and remained silent to know whether the Lord had made his way prosperous or not.

fresh_translation: And it happened when all the camels stopped drinking, the man took golden earrings, a drachm in weight each, and two bracelets for her hands, their weight ten gold pieces.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when all the camels ceased drinking, that the man took golden ear-rings, each of a drachm weight, and he put two bracelets on her hands, their weight was ten pieces of gold.

fresh_translation: And he asked her and said, Whose daughter are you? Tell me whether there is room at your father's house for us to lodge.
brenton_translation: And he asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? Tell me if there is room for us to lodge with thy father.

fresh_translation: And she said to him, I am daughter of Bethuel, son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.
brenton_translation: And she said to him, I am the daughter of Bathuel the son of Melcha, whom she bore to Nachor.

fresh_translation: And she said to him, We have both much straw and fodder with us, and room to lodge.
brenton_translation: And she said to him, We have both straw and much provender, and a place for resting.

fresh_translation: And the man, being well pleased, bowed to the Lord and said,
brenton_translation: And the man being well pleased, worshipped the Lord,

fresh_translation: Blessed be the Lord, the God of my lord Abraham, who has not withheld his righteousness and his truth from my lord. And the Lord guided me well to the house of my lord's brother.
brenton_translation: and said, Blessed be the Lord the God of my master Abraam, who has not suffered his righteousness to fail, nor his truth from my master, and the Lord has brought me prosperously to the house of the brother of my lord.

fresh_translation: And the girl ran and reported to her mother's house according to these words.
brenton_translation: And the damsel ran and reported to the house of her mother according to these words.

fresh_translation: Now Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban. And Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
brenton_translation: And Rebecca had a brother whose name was Laban; and Laban ran out to meet the man, to the well.

fresh_translation: And it happened when he saw the earrings and the bracelets on his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister saying, Thus the man spoke to me, that he came to the man standing by the camels at the spring.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he saw the ear-rings and the bracelets on the hands of his sister, and when he heard the words of Rebecca his sister, saying, Thus the man spoke to me, that he went to the man, as he stood by the camels at the well.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Come in, blessed of the Lord. Why do you stand outside? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Come in hither, thou blessed of the Lord, why standest thou without, whereas I have prepared the house and a place for the camels?

fresh_translation: And the man entered the house and unloaded the camels and gave straw and fodder to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men with him.
brenton_translation: And the man entered into the house, and unloaded the camels, and gave the camels straw and provender, and water to wash his feet, and the feet of the men that were with him.

fresh_translation: And he set loaves before them to eat. But he said, I will certainly not eat until I speak my words. And they said, Speak.
brenton_translation: And he set before them loaves to eat; but he said, I will not eat, until I have told my errand. And he said, Speak on.

fresh_translation: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
brenton_translation: And he said, I am a servant of Abraam;

fresh_translation: And the Lord greatly blessed my lord, and he was exalted. And he gave him sheep and calves and silver and gold and male servants and female servants and camels and donkeys.
brenton_translation: and the Lord has blessed my master greatly, and he is exalted, and he has given him sheep, and calves, and silver, and gold, servants and servant-maids, camels, and asses.

fresh_translation: And Sarah, my lord's wife, bore one son to my lord after he had grown old, and he gave him all that he had.
brenton_translation: And Sarrha my master's wife bore one son to my master after he had grown old; and he gave him whatever he had.

fresh_translation: And my lord made me swear, saying, You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whose land I sojourn,
brenton_translation: And my master caused me to swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Chananites, among whom I sojourn in their land.

fresh_translation: but you shall go instead to my father's house and to my tribe and take a wife for my son from there.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt go to the house of my father, and to my tribe, and thou shalt take thence a wife for my son.

fresh_translation: And I said to my lord, Suppose the woman will not come with me.
brenton_translation: And I said to my master, Haply the woman will not go with me.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, The Lord God, before whom I have been well-pleasing, will himself send out his angel with you and prosper your way, and you shall take a wife for my son from my tribe and from my father's house.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, The Lord God to whom I have been acceptable in his presence, himself shall send out his angel with thee, and shall prosper thy journey, and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my tribe, and of the house of my father.

fresh_translation: Then you shall be innocent of my curse, for whenever you come to my tribe and they do not give to you, you shall be innocent of my oath.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou be clear from my curse, for whensoever thou shalt have come to my tribe, and they shall not give her to thee, then shalt thou be clear from my oath.

fresh_translation: And when I came today to the spring I said, Lord, God of my lord Abraham, if you are prospering the way on which I am now going,
brenton_translation: And having come this day to the well, I said, Lord God of my master Abraam, if thou prosperest my journey on which I am now going,

fresh_translation: look, I am standing at the spring of water, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water. And let it be that the virgin to whom I say, Give me a little water from your jar to drink,
brenton_translation: behold, I stand by the well of water, and the daughters of the men of the city come forth to draw water, and it shall be that the damsel to whom I shall say, Give me a little water to drink out of thy pitcher,

fresh_translation: and she says to me, Drink yourself, and I will draw water for your camels too - this is the woman whom the Lord prepared for his own servant Isaac, and by this I will know that you have done mercy with my lord Abraham.
brenton_translation: and she shall say to me, Both drink thou, and I will draw water for thy camels, this shall be the wife whom the Lord has prepared for his own servant Isaac; and hereby shall I know that thou hast wrought mercy with my master Abraam.

fresh_translation: And it happened before I finished speaking in my mind, at once Rebekah came out having the water jar on her shoulders, and she went down to the spring and drew water. And I said to her, Give me drink.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass before I had done speaking in my mind, straightway Rebecca came forth, having her pitcher on her shoulders; and she went down to the well, and drew water; and I said to her, Give me to drink.

fresh_translation: And she hurried and lowered the water jar from herself onto her arm and said, Drink, and I will water your camels too. And I drank, and she watered the camels too.
brenton_translation: And she hasted and let down her pitcher on her arm from her head, and said, Drink thou, and I will give thy camels drink; and I drank, and she gave the camels drink.

fresh_translation: And I asked her and said, Whose daughter are you? Tell me. And she said, I am daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him. And I put the earrings on her and the bracelets around her hands.
brenton_translation: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me; and she said, I am daughter of Bathuel the son of Nachor, whom Melcha bore to him; and I put on her the ear-rings, and the bracelets on her hands.

fresh_translation: And being well pleased I bowed to the Lord and blessed the Lord, the God of my lord Abraham, who prospered me on a true way to take the daughter of my lord's brother for his son.
brenton_translation: And being well-pleased I worshipped the Lord, and I blessed the Lord the God of my master Abraam, who has prospered me in a true way, so that I should take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.

fresh_translation: So now, if you are doing mercy and righteousness toward my lord, tell me. But if not, tell me, so that I may turn to the right or to the left.
brenton_translation: If then ye will deal mercifully and justly with my lord, tell me, and if not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand or to the left.

fresh_translation: And Laban and Bethuel answered and said, This command has gone out from the Lord. So we will not be able to speak against you evil or good.
brenton_translation: And Laban and Bathuel answered and said, This matter has come forth from the Lord, we shall not be able to answer thee bad or good.

fresh_translation: Look, Rebekah is before you. Take her and go quickly, and let her be wife to your lord's son, just as the Lord spoke.
brenton_translation: Behold, Rebecca is before thee, take her and go away, and let her be wife to the son of thy master, as the Lord has said.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Abraham's servant heard these words, he bowed to the ground to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the servant of Abraam heard these words, he bowed himself to the Lord down to the earth.

fresh_translation: And the servant brought out silver vessels and gold vessels and clothing and gave them to Rebekah, and he gave gifts to her brother and to her mother.
brenton_translation: And the servant having brought forth jewels of silver and gold and raiment, gave them to Rebecca, and gave gifts to her brother, and to her mother.

fresh_translation: And he and the men with him ate and drank and slept. And rising in the morning, he said, Send me away, so that I may go to my lord.
brenton_translation: And both he and the men with him ate and drank and went to sleep. And he arose in the morning and said, Send me away, that I may go to my master.

fresh_translation: But her brothers and her mother said, Let the virgin remain with us about ten days, and after that she will depart.
brenton_translation: And her brethren and her mother said, Let the virgin remain with us about ten days, and after that she shall depart.

fresh_translation: But he said to them, Do not hold me back, for the Lord prospered my way for me. Send me away, so that I may go to my lord.
brenton_translation: But he said to them, Hinder me not, for the Lord has prospered my journey for me; send me away, that I may depart to my master.

fresh_translation: And they said, Let us call the girl and ask from her mouth.
brenton_translation: And they said, Let us call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

fresh_translation: And they called Rebekah and said to her, Will you go with this man? And she said, I will go.
brenton_translation: And they called Rebecca, and said to her, Wilt thou go with this man? and she said, I will go.

fresh_translation: And they sent away Rebekah their sister and what belonged to her, and Abraham's servant and those with him.
brenton_translation: So they sent forth Rebecca their sister, and her goods, and the servant of Abraam, and his attendants.

fresh_translation: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, You are our sister. Become into thousands of myriads, and let your seed inherit the cities of the adversaries.
brenton_translation: And they blessed Rebecca, and said to her, Thou art our sister; become thou thousands of myriads, and let thy seed possess the cities of their enemies.

fresh_translation: And Rebekah rose up and her maidens, and they mounted the camels and went with the man. And the servant, taking Rebekah, went away.
brenton_translation: And Rebecca rose up and her maidens, and they mounted the camels and went with the man; and the servant having taken up Rebecca, departed.

fresh_translation: And Isaac was traveling through the wilderness by the well of the vision, and he was dwelling in the land toward the south.
brenton_translation: And Isaac went through the wilderness to the well of the vision, and he dwelt in the land toward the south.

fresh_translation: And Isaac went out to muse in the field toward evening, and lifting up his eyes he saw camels coming.
brenton_translation: And Isaac went forth into the plain toward evening to meditate; and having lifted up his eyes, he saw camels coming.

fresh_translation: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes and saw Isaac and sprang down from the camel.
brenton_translation: And Rebecca lifted up her eyes, and saw Isaac; and she alighted briskly from the camel,

fresh_translation: And she said to the servant, Who is that man there walking in the field to meet us? And the servant said, This is my lord. And she took the veil and covered herself.
brenton_translation: and said to the servant, Who is that man that walks in the plain to meet us? And the servant said, This is my master; and she took her veil and covered herself.

fresh_translation: And the servant recounted to Isaac all the things that he had done.
brenton_translation: And the servant told Isaac all that he had done.

fresh_translation: And Isaac went into the house of his mother and took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her. And Isaac was comforted concerning Sarah his mother.
brenton_translation: And Isaac went into the house of his mother, and took Rebecca, and she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted for Sarrha his mother.

fresh_translation: And Abraham took another wife, whose name was Ketturah.
brenton_translation: And Abraam again took a wife, whose name was Chettura.

fresh_translation: And she bore to him Zombran and Jezan and Madal and Madiam and Jesbok and Soie.
brenton_translation: And she bore to him Zombran, and Jezan, and Madal, and Madiam, and Jesboc, and Soie.

fresh_translation: And Jezan begot Thaiman and Saba and Dedan. And sons of Dedan became Ragouel and Nabdeel and Assourieim and Latousieim and Laomeim.
brenton_translation: And Jezan begot Saba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were the Assurians and the Latusians, and Laomim.

fresh_translation: And sons of Madiam were Gephar and Apher and Enoch and Abeira and Eldaga. All these were sons of Ketturah.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Madiam were Gephar and Aphir, and Enoch, and Abeida, and Eldaga; all these were sons of Chettura.

fresh_translation: And Abraham gave all his possessions to Isaac his son,
brenton_translation: But Abraam gave all his possessions to Isaac his son.

fresh_translation: but to the sons of his concubines Abraham gave gifts and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he was still alive, eastward into the eastern land.
brenton_translation: But to the sons of his concubines Abraam gave gifts, and he sent them away from his son Isaac, while he was yet living, to the east into the country of the east.

fresh_translation: And these were the years of the days of Abraham's life, as many as he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
brenton_translation: And these were the years of the days of the life of Abraam as many as he lived, a hundred and seventy-five years.

fresh_translation: And Abraham came to his end and died in a good old age, old and full of days, and was added to his people.
brenton_translation: And Abraam failing died in a good old age, an old man and full of days, and was added to his people.

fresh_translation: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the double cave, in the field of Ephron son of Saar the Hittite, which is opposite Mamre,
brenton_translation: And Isaac and Ismael his sons buried him in the double cave, in the field of Ephron the son of Saar the Chettite, which is over against Mambre:

fresh_translation: the field and the cave that Abraham acquired from the sons of Heth. There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife.
brenton_translation: even the field and the cave which Abraam bought of the sons of Chet; there they buried Abraam and Sarrha his wife.

fresh_translation: And it happened after Abraham died, God blessed Isaac his son. And Isaac dwelt by the well of the vision.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after Abraam was dead, that God blessed Isaac his son, and Isaac dwelt by the well of the vision.

fresh_translation: And these are the generations of Ishmael son of Abraham, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's servant-girl, bore to Abraham.
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Ismael the son of Abraam, whom Agar the Egyptian the hand-maid of Sarrha bore to Abraam.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of Ishmael's sons according to the names of their generations: firstborn of Ishmael, Nabaioth, and Kedar and Nabdeel and Massam
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the sons of Ismael, according to the names of their generations. The firstborn of Ismael, Nabaioth, and Kedar, and Nabdeel, and Massam,

fresh_translation: and Masma and Douma and Masse
brenton_translation: and Masma, and Duma, and Masse,

fresh_translation: and Choddan and Thaiman and Jetour and Naphes and Kedma.
brenton_translation: and Choddan, and Thæman, and Jetur, and Naphes, and Kedma.

fresh_translation: These are Ishmael's sons, and these are their names in their tents and in their settlements, twelve rulers according to their nations.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Ismael, and these are their names in their tents and in their dwellings, twelve princes according to their nations.

fresh_translation: And these are the years of Ishmael's life: one hundred thirty-seven years. And coming to his end he died and was added to his people.
brenton_translation: And these are the years of the life of Ismael, a hundred and thirty-seven years; and he failed and died, and was added to his fathers.

fresh_translation: And he dwelt from Evilat to Sour, which is opposite Egypt, until one comes to the Assyrians. He dwelt in the presence of all his brothers.
brenton_translation: And he dwelt from Evilat to Sur, which is opposite Egypt, until one comes to the Assyrians; he dwelt in the presence of all his brethren.

fresh_translation: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son.
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Isaac the son of Abraam.

fresh_translation: Abraham begot Isaac. And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel the Syrian from Mesopotamian Syria, sister of Laban the Syrian, as wife for himself.
brenton_translation: Abraam begot Isaac. And Isaac was forty years old when he took to wife Rebecca, daughter of Bathuel the Syrian, out of Syrian Mesopotamia, sister of Laban the Syrian.

fresh_translation: And Isaac was praying to the Lord concerning Rebekah his wife, because she was barren. And God heard him, and Rebekah his wife conceived in her womb.
brenton_translation: And Isaac prayed the Lord concerning Rebecca his wife, because she was barren; and the Lord heard him, and his wife Rebecca conceived in her womb.

fresh_translation: And the children were leaping in her. And she said, If it is going to be like this for me, why is this happening to me? And she went to inquire from the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the babes leaped within her; and she said, If it will be so with me, why is this to me? And she went to enquire of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to her, Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples will be separated from your belly. And one people will excel the other, and the greater will serve the lesser.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to her, There are two nations in thy womb, and two peoples shall be separated from thy belly, and one people shall excel the other, and the elder shall serve the younger.

fresh_translation: And the days were fulfilled for her to give birth, and she had twins in her womb.
brenton_translation: And the days were fulfilled that she should be delivered, and she had twins in her womb.

fresh_translation: And the first came out reddish, all hairy like a hide, and she called his name Esau.
brenton_translation: And the first came out red, hairy all over like a skin; and she called his name Esau.

fresh_translation: And after this his brother came out, and his hand was gripping Esau's heel, and he called his name Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah bore them.
brenton_translation: And after this came forth his brother, and his hand took hold of the heel of Esau; and she called his name Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when Rebecca bore them.

fresh_translation: And the young men grew, and Esau was a man skilled in hunting, a country man, but Jacob was a straightforward man, dwelling at home.
brenton_translation: And the lads grew, and Esau was a man skilled in hunting, dwelling in the country, and Jacob a simple man, dwelling in a house.

fresh_translation: And Isaac loved Esau, because his hunting was food for him, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Isaac loved Esau, because his venison was his food, but Rebecca loved Jacob.

fresh_translation: And Jacob cooked stew, and Esau came from the plain exhausted,
brenton_translation: And Jacob cooked pottage, and Esau came from the plain, fainting.

fresh_translation: and Esau said to Jacob, Feed me from this red stew, because I am exhausted. Therefore his name was called Edom.
brenton_translation: And Esau said to Jacob, Let me taste of that red pottage, because I am fainting; therefore his name was called Edom.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to Esau, Give over to me today your firstborn rights.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to Esau, Sell me this day thy birthright.

fresh_translation: And Esau said, Look, I am going to die, and why are these firstborn rights to me?
brenton_translation: And Esau said, Behold, I am going to die, and for what good does this birthright belong to me?

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to him, Swear to me today. And he swore to him, and Esau sold the firstborn rights to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to him, Swear to me this day; and he swore to him; and Esau sold his birthright to Jacob.

fresh_translation: And Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew, and he ate and drank and rose and went away. And Esau made light of the firstborn rights.
brenton_translation: And Jacob gave bread to Esau, and pottage of lentiles; and he ate and drank, and he arose and departed; so Esau slighted his birthright.

fresh_translation: And there came a famine on the land besides the earlier famine that happened in Abraham's time. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerara.
brenton_translation: And there was a famine in the land, besides the former famine, which was in the time of Abraam; and Isaac went to Abimelech the king of the Phylistines to Gerara.

fresh_translation: And the Lord appeared to him and said, Do not go down to Egypt, but dwell in the land that I tell you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord appeared to him and said, Go not down to Egypt, but dwell in the land, which I shall tell thee of.

fresh_translation: And sojourn in this land, and I will be with you and bless you, for to you and to your seed I will give all this land, and I will establish my oath that I swore to Abraham your father.
brenton_translation: And sojourn in this land; and I will be with thee, and bless thee, for I will give to thee and to thy seed all this land; and I will establish my oath which I swore to thy father Abraam.

fresh_translation: And I will multiply your seed like the stars of heaven and give all this land to your seed, and in your seed all the nations of the earth will be blessed,
brenton_translation: And I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven; and I will give to thy seed all this land, and all the nations of the earth shall be blest in thy seed.

fresh_translation: because Abraham your father heard my voice and kept my charges and my commandments and my ordinances and my statutes.
brenton_translation: Because Abraam thy father hearkened to my voice, and kept my injunctions, and my commandments, and my ordinances, and my statutes.

fresh_translation: And Isaac dwelt in Gerara.
brenton_translation: And Isaac dwelt in Gerara.

fresh_translation: And the men of the place asked about Rebekah his wife, and he said, She is my sister, for he feared to say, She is my wife, lest the men of the place kill him because of Rebekah, because she was beautiful in appearance.
brenton_translation: And the men of the place questioned him concerning Rebecca his wife, and he said, She is my sister, for he feared to say, She is my wife, lest at any time the men of the place should slay him because of Rebecca, because she was fair.

fresh_translation: And it happened after a long time there, Abimelech king of Gerara leaned through the window and saw Isaac sporting with Rebekah his wife.
brenton_translation: And he remained there a long time, and Abimelech the king of Gerara leaned to look through the window, and saw Isaac sporting with Rebecca his wife.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech called Isaac and said to him, So then is she your wife? Why did you say, She is my sister? And Isaac said to him, Because I said, Lest I die because of her.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said to him, Is she then thy wife? why hast thou said, She is my sister? And Isaac said to him, I did so, for I said, Lest at any time I die on her account.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech said to him, What is this you did to us? One of my people might almost have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us in ignorance.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech said to him, Why hast thou done this to us? one of my kindred within a little had lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought a sin of ignorance upon us.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, Everyone touching this man or his wife will be liable to death.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, Every man that touches this man and his wife shall be liable to death.

fresh_translation: And Isaac sowed in that land and found in that year hundredfold barley. And the Lord blessed him.
brenton_translation: And Isaac sowed in that land, and he found in that year barley an hundred-fold, and the Lord blessed him.

fresh_translation: And the man was exalted, and going forward he became greater until he became very great.
brenton_translation: And the man was exalted, and advancing he increased, till he became very great.

fresh_translation: And he had flocks of sheep and herds of cattle and many farms. And the Philistines envied him,
brenton_translation: And he had cattle of sheep, and cattle of oxen, and many tilled lands, and the Phylistines envied him.

fresh_translation: and all the wells that his father's servants dug in his father's time, the Philistines stopped them up and filled them with earth.
brenton_translation: And all the wells which the servants of his father had dug in the time of his father, the Phylistines stopped them, and filled them with earth.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go away from us, because you have become much stronger than we are.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Depart from us, for thou art become much mightier than we.

fresh_translation: And Isaac went away from there and camped in the valley of Gerar and dwelt there.
brenton_translation: And Isaac departed thence, and rested in the valley of Gerara, and dwelt there.

fresh_translation: And Isaac dug again the wells of water that his father Abraham's servants dug and the Philistines stopped up after Abraham his father died. And he called them by the names his father had named them.
brenton_translation: And Isaac dug again the wells of water, which the servants of his father Abraam had dug, and the Phylistines had stopped them, after the death of his father Abraam; and he gave them names, according to the names by which his father named them.

fresh_translation: And Isaac's servants dug in the valley of Gerar and found there a well of living water.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Isaac dug in the valley of Gerara, and they found there a well of living water.

fresh_translation: And the shepherds of Gerar fought with Isaac's shepherds, saying the water was theirs. And he called the name of the well Injustice, because they wronged him.
brenton_translation: And the shepherds of Gerara strove with the shepherds of Isaac, saying that the water was theirs; and they called the name of the well, Injury, for they injured him.

fresh_translation: And moving on from there, he dug another well, and they were quarreling over that one too. And he named it Enmity.
brenton_translation: And having departed thence he dug another well, and they strove also for that; and he named the name of it, Enmity.

fresh_translation: And moving on from there, he dug another well, and they did not fight over it. And he named it Broad Space, saying, Because now the Lord made room for us and increased us on the earth.
brenton_translation: And he departed thence and dug another well; and they did not strive about that; and he named the name of it, Room, saying, Because now the Lord has made room for us, and has increased us upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And he went up from there to the Well of Oath.
brenton_translation: And he went up thence to the well of the oath.

fresh_translation: And the Lord appeared to him in that night and said, I am the God of Abraham your father. Do not fear, for I am with you, and I will bless you and multiply your seed because of Abraham your father.
brenton_translation: And the Lord appeared to him in that night, and said, I am the God of Abraam thy father; fear not, for I am with thee, and I will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for the sake of Abraam thy father.

fresh_translation: And he built there an altar and called on the name of the Lord and pitched his tent there. And Isaac's servants dug a well there in the valley of Gerar.
brenton_translation: And he built there an altar, and called on the name of the Lord, and there he pitched his tent, and there the servants of Isaac dug a well in the valley of Gerara.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ochozath his marriage-companion and Phichol the commander-in-chief of his force.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech came to him from Gerara, and so did Ochozath his friend, and Phichol the commander-in-chief of his army.

fresh_translation: And Isaac said to them, Why did you come to me? You hated me and sent me away from you.
brenton_translation: And Isaac said to them, Wherefore have ye come to me? whereas ye hated me, and sent me away from you.

fresh_translation: And they said, Seeing, we have seen that the Lord was with you, and we said, Let there be an oath-curse between us and you, and we will make a covenant with you,
brenton_translation: And they said, We have surely seen that the Lord was with thee, and we said, Let there be an oath between us and thee, and we will make a covenant with thee,

fresh_translation: that you not do us evil, since we did not abhor you and in the way we treated you well and sent you away with peace. And now you are blessed by the Lord.
brenton_translation: that thou shalt do no wrong by us, as we have not abhorred thee, and according as we have treated thee well, and have sent thee forth peaceably; and now thou art blessed of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
brenton_translation: And he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

fresh_translation: And rising in the morning, each swore to his neighbor, and Isaac sent them away, and they went away from him in safety.
brenton_translation: And they arose in the morning, and swore each to his neighbour; and Isaac sent them forth, and they departed from him in safety.

fresh_translation: And it happened in that day Isaac's servants came and reported to him about the well that they dug, and they said, We did not find water.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in that day, that the servants of Isaac came and told him of the well which they had dug; and they said, We have not found water.

fresh_translation: And he called it Oath. Therefore he called the name of that city Well of Oath until this day.
brenton_translation: And he called it, Oath: therefore he called the name of that city, the Well of Oath, until this day.

fresh_translation: And Esau was forty years old and took Judith, daughter of Beoch the Hittite, and Basemath, daughter of Helon the Hittite, as wives.
brenton_translation: And Esau was forty years old; and he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beoch the Chettite, and Basemath, daughter of Helon the Chettite.

fresh_translation: And they were contentious toward Isaac and Rebekah.
brenton_translation: And they were provoking to Isaac and Rebecca.

fresh_translation: And it happened after Isaac had grown old and his eyes had become dim for seeing, that he called Esau his older son and said to him, My son. And he said, Look, I am here.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after Isaac was old, that his eyes were dimmed so that he could not see; and he called Esau, his elder son, and said to him, My son; and he said, Behold, I am here.

fresh_translation: And he said, Look, I have grown old and do not know the day of my death.
brenton_translation: And he said, Behold, I am grown old, and know not the day of my death.

fresh_translation: Now then take your gear, both quiver and bow, and go out into the plain and hunt game for me,
brenton_translation: Now then take thy weapons, both thy quiver and thy bow, and go into the plain, and get me venison,

fresh_translation: and make me dishes, as I love, and bring them to me so that I may eat, so that my soul may bless you before I die.
brenton_translation: and make me meats, as I like them, and bring them to me that I may eat, that my soul may bless thee, before I die.

fresh_translation: Now Rebekah heard Isaac speaking to Esau his son. And Esau went into the plain to hunt game for his father.
brenton_translation: And Rebecca heard Isaac speaking to Esau his son; and Esau went to the plain to procure venison for his father.

fresh_translation: And Rebekah said to Jacob her son, the lesser one, Look, I heard your father speaking to Esau your brother, saying,
brenton_translation: And Rebecca said to Jacob her younger son, Behold, I heard thy father speaking to Esau thy brother, saying,

fresh_translation: Bring me game and make me dishes so that I may eat and bless you before the Lord before I die.
brenton_translation: Bring me venison, and prepare me meats, that I may eat and bless thee before the Lord before I die.

fresh_translation: Now then, my son, hear me, as I command you.
brenton_translation: Now then, my son, hearken to me, as I command thee.

fresh_translation: And go to the flock and take from there two tender good kids for me, and I will make them dishes for your father as he loves,
brenton_translation: And go to the cattle and take for me thence two kids, tender and good, and I will make them meats for thy father, as he likes.

fresh_translation: and you shall bring them to your father and he will eat, so that your father may bless you before he dies.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt bring them in to thy father, and he shall eat, that thy father may bless thee before he dies.

fresh_translation: But Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Esau my brother is a hairy man, but I am a smooth man.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to his mother Rebecca, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I a smooth man.

fresh_translation: Perhaps my father will feel me and I shall be before him as one mocking him, and I will bring a curse upon myself and not a blessing.
brenton_translation: Peradventure my father may feel me, and I shall be before him as one ill-intentioned, and I shall bring upon me a curse, and not a blessing.

fresh_translation: But his mother said to him, Let your curse be on me, child. Only hear my voice, and go bring them to me.
brenton_translation: And his mother said to him, On me be thy curse, son; only hearken to my voice, and go and bring them me.

fresh_translation: So he went and took them and brought them to his mother, and his mother made dishes as his father loved them.
brenton_translation: So he went and took and brought them to his mother; and his mother made meats, as his father liked them.

fresh_translation: And Rebekah took the fine robe of Esau her older son, which was with her in the house, and put it on Jacob her younger son,
brenton_translation: And Rebecca having taken the fine raiment of her elder son Esau which was with her in the house, put it on Jacob her younger son.

fresh_translation: and she put the skins of the kids on his arms and on the bare parts of his neck,
brenton_translation: And she put on his arms the skins of the kids, and on the bare parts of his neck.

fresh_translation: and gave the dishes and the loaves she made into Jacob her son's hands.
brenton_translation: And she gave the meats, and the loaves which she had prepared, into the hands of Jacob her son.

fresh_translation: And he brought them in to his father. And he said, Father. And he said, Look, I am here. Who are you, child?
brenton_translation: And he brought them to his father, and said, Father; and he said, Behold I am here; who art thou, son?

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to his father, I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Rise, sit, and eat of my game, so that your soul may bless me.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to his father, I, Esau thy first-born, have done as thou toldest me; rise, sit, and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

fresh_translation: And Isaac said to his son, What is this that you found so quickly, child? And he said, What the Lord your God handed over before me.
brenton_translation: And Isaac said to his son, What is this which thou hast quickly found? And he said, That which the Lord thy God presented before me.

fresh_translation: And Isaac said to Jacob, Come near to me and I will feel you, child, whether you are my son Esau or not.
brenton_translation: And Isaac said to Jacob, Draw nigh to me, and I will feel thee, son, if thou art my son Esau or not.

fresh_translation: And Jacob came near to Isaac his father, and he felt him and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are Esau's hands.
brenton_translation: And Jacob drew nigh to his father Isaac, and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

fresh_translation: And he did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like the hands of his brother Esau. And he blessed him,
brenton_translation: And he knew him not, for his hands were as the hands of his brother Esau, hairy; and he blessed him,

fresh_translation: and said, Are you my son Esau? And he said, I am.
brenton_translation: and he said, Art thou my son Esau? and he said, I am.

fresh_translation: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of your game, child, so that my soul may bless you. And he brought it near to him, and he ate. And he brought him wine, and he drank.
brenton_translation: And he said, Bring hither, and I will eat of thy venison, son, that my soul may bless thee; and he brought it near to him, and he ate, and he brought him wine, and he drank.

fresh_translation: And Isaac his father said to him, Come near to me and kiss me, child.
brenton_translation: And Isaac his father said to him, Draw nigh to me, and kiss me, son.

fresh_translation: And he came near and kissed him, and he smelled the smell of his clothes and blessed him and said, Look, the smell of my son is like the smell of a full field that the Lord blessed.
brenton_translation: And he drew nigh and kissed him, and smelled the smell of his garments, and blessed him, and said, Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of an abundant field, which the Lord has blessed.

fresh_translation: And may God give you from the dew of heaven and from the fatness of the earth and abundance of grain and wine.
brenton_translation: And may God give thee of the dew of heaven, and of the fatness of the earth, and abundance of corn and wine.

fresh_translation: And let nations serve you, and let rulers bow down to you. And become lord of your brother, and the sons of your father shall bow to you. Cursed be the one cursing you, and blessed be the one blessing you.
brenton_translation: And let nations serve thee, and princes bow down to thee, and be thou lord of thy brother, and the sons of thy father shall do thee reverence; accursed is he that curses thee, and blessed is he that blesses thee.

fresh_translation: And it happened after Isaac finished blessing Jacob his son, indeed it happened just as Jacob went out from before Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came from the hunt.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after Isaac had ceased blessing his son Jacob, it even came to pass, just when Jacob had gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

fresh_translation: And he too made dishes and brought them to his father. And he said to his father, Let my father arise and eat of his son's game, so that your soul may bless me.
brenton_translation: And he also had made meats and brought them to his father; and he said to his father, Let my father arise and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

fresh_translation: And Isaac his father said to him, Who are you? And he said, I am your firstborn son Esau.
brenton_translation: And Isaac his father said to him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy first-born son Esau.

fresh_translation: And Isaac was overcome with a very great astonishment and said, Who then was the one who hunted game for me and brought it to me? And I ate from everything before you came, and I blessed him, and blessed he shall be.
brenton_translation: And Isaac was amazed with very great amazement, and said, Who then is it that has procured venison for me and brought it to me? and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and I have blessed him, and he shall be blessed.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Esau heard the words of Isaac his father, he cried out with a great and very bitter cry and said, Bless me too, father.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Esau heard the words of his father Isaac, he cried out with a great and very bitter cry, and said, Bless, I pray thee, me also, father.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Your brother came with deceit and took your blessing.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Thy brother has come with subtlety, and taken thy blessing.

fresh_translation: And he said, Rightly was his name called Jacob, for now this second time he has tripped me by the heel. He took my firstborn rights, and now he has taken my blessing. And Esau said to his father, Did you not leave a blessing for me, father?
brenton_translation: And he said, Rightly was his name called Jacob, for lo! this second time has he supplanted me; he has both taken my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing; and Esau said to his father, Hast thou not left a blessing for me, father?

fresh_translation: But Isaac answered and said to Esau, If I made him your lord and made all his brothers his servants, and I strengthened him with grain and wine, what then shall I do for you, child?
brenton_translation: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, If I have made him thy lord, and have made all his brethren his servants, and have strengthened him with corn and wine, what then shall I do for thee, son?

fresh_translation: But Esau said to his father, Do you have only one blessing, father? Bless me too, father. And Isaac was pierced, and Esau cried aloud and wept.
brenton_translation: And Esau said to his father, Hast thou only one blessing, father? Bless, I pray thee, me also, father. And Isaac being troubled, Esau cried aloud and wept.

fresh_translation: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Look, your dwelling shall be from the fatness of the earth and from the dew of heaven above.
brenton_translation: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above.

fresh_translation: And you shall live by your sword and serve your brother. But when you break away, then you will loosen his yoke from your neck.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt live by thy sword, and shalt serve thy brother; and there shall be a time when thou shalt break and loosen his yoke from off thy neck.

fresh_translation: And Esau kept anger against Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. And Esau said in his mind, Let the days of mourning for my father draw near, so that I may kill Jacob my brother.
brenton_translation: And Esau was angry with Jacob because of the blessing, with which his father blessed him; and Esau said in his mind, Let the days of my father's mourning draw nigh, that I may slay my brother Jacob.

fresh_translation: And the words of Esau her older son were reported to Rebekah, and she sent and called Jacob her younger son and said to him, Look, Esau your brother is threatening you, intending to kill you.
brenton_translation: And the words of Esau her elder son were reported to Rebecca, and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, Behold, Esau thy brother threatens thee to kill thee.

fresh_translation: Now then, child, hear my voice and rise, flee to Mesopotamia to Laban my brother in Harran.
brenton_translation: Now then, my son, hear my voice, and rise and depart quickly into Mesopotamia to Laban my brother into Charran.

fresh_translation: And dwell with him some days,
brenton_translation: And dwell with him certain days, until thy brother's anger

fresh_translation: until the anger and wrath of your brother turn away from you and he forget what you did to him. Then I will send and bring you back from there, lest I be bereaved of both of you in one day.
brenton_translation: and rage depart from thee, and he forget what thou hast done to him; and I will send and fetch thee thence, lest at any time I should be bereaved of you both in one day.

fresh_translation: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of the sons of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife from the daughters of this land, why should I go on living?
brenton_translation: And Rebecca said to Isaac, I am weary of my life, because of the daughters of the sons of Chet; if Jacob shall take a wife of the daughters of this land, wherefore should I live?

fresh_translation: And Isaac, calling Jacob to him, blessed him and charged him, saying, You shall not take a wife from the daughters of the Canaanites.
brenton_translation: And Isaac having called for Jacob, blessed him, and charged him, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of the Chananites.

fresh_translation: Rise and flee to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel the father of your mother, and take for yourself a wife from there, from the daughters of Laban your mother's brother.
brenton_translation: Rise and depart quickly into Mesopotamia, to the house of Bathuel the father of thy mother, and take to thyself thence a wife of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

fresh_translation: And may my God bless you and increase you and multiply you, and you shall become gatherings of nations.
brenton_translation: And may my God bless thee, and increase thee, and multiply thee, and thou shalt become gatherings of nations.

fresh_translation: And may he give to you the blessing of Abraham my father, to you and to your seed after you, to inherit the land of your sojourning, which God gave to Abraham.
brenton_translation: And may he give thee the blessing of my father Abraam, even to thee and to thy seed after thee, to inherit the land of thy sojourning, which God gave to Abraam.

fresh_translation: And Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Mesopotamia to Laban son of Bethuel the Syrian, brother of Rebekah, mother of Jacob and Esau.
brenton_translation: So Isaac sent away Jacob, and he went into Mesopotamia to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebecca the mother of Jacob and Esau.

fresh_translation: And Esau saw that Isaac blessed Jacob and sent him away to Mesopotamia of Syria to take a wife for himself from there when he blessed him, and that he charged him, saying, You shall not take a wife from the daughters of the Canaanites,
brenton_translation: And Esau saw that Isaac blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Mesopotamia of Syria as he blessed him, to take to himself a wife thence, and that he charged him, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of the Chananites;

fresh_translation: and that Jacob heard his father and mother and went to Mesopotamia of Syria.
brenton_translation: and that Jacob hearkened to his father and his mother, and went to Mesopotamia of Syria.

fresh_translation: And Esau also saw that the daughters of Canaan were evil in the sight of Isaac his father,
brenton_translation: And Esau also having seen that the daughters of Chanaan were evil before his father Isaac,

fresh_translation: and Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahaleth daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, sister of Nabeoth, as wife in addition to his wives.
brenton_translation: Esau went to Ismael, and took Maeleth the daughter of Ismael, the son of Abraam, the sister of Nabeoth, a wife in addition to his other wives.

fresh_translation: And Jacob went out from the Well of Oath and went to Harran.
brenton_translation: And Jacob went forth from the well of the oath, and departed into Charrhan.

fresh_translation: And he came upon a place and slept there, for the sun had gone down. And he took one of the stones of the place and put it by his head and slept in that place.
brenton_translation: And came to a certain place and slept there, for the sun had gone down; and he took one of the stones of the place, and put it at his head, and lay down to sleep in that place,

fresh_translation: And he dreamed, and look, a ladder stood fixed in the earth, and its top reached to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
brenton_translation: and dreamed, and behold a ladder fixed on the earth, whose top reached to heaven, and the angels of God ascended and descended on it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord stood fixed on it and said, I am the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac. Do not fear. The land on which you are sleeping, to you I will give it and to your seed.
brenton_translation: And the Lord stood upon it, and said, I am the God of thy father Abraam, and the God of Isaac; fear not, the land on which thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.

fresh_translation: And your seed shall be like the sand of the earth, and it shall spread out to the sea and to the south and to the north and to the east, and in you and in your seed all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed.
brenton_translation: And thy seed shall be as the sand of the earth; and it shall spread abroad to the sea, and the south, and the north, and to the east; and in thee and in thy seed shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed.

fresh_translation: And look, I am with you, guarding you on every road where you may go, and I will bring you back to this land, because I will certainly not leave you until I do all that I spoke to you.
brenton_translation: And behold I am with thee to preserve thee continually in all the way wherein thou shalt go; and I will bring thee back to this land; for I will not desert thee, until I have done all that I have said to thee.

fresh_translation: And Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, Surely the Lord is in this place, and I did not know it.
brenton_translation: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and said, The Lord is in this place, and I knew it not.

fresh_translation: And he was afraid and said, How fearsome this place is. This is nothing other than God's house, and this is heaven's gate.
brenton_translation: And he was afraid, and said, How fearful is this place! this is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

fresh_translation: And Jacob rose early in the morning and took the stone he had placed there by his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on its top.
brenton_translation: And Jacob rose up in the morning, and took the stone he had laid there by his head, and he set it up as a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.

fresh_translation: And he called the name of that place House of God, but Ulam-luz was the name of the city before.
brenton_translation: And he called the name of that place, the House of God; and the name of the city before was Ulam-luz.

fresh_translation: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If the Lord God is with me and guards me on this road on which I am going and gives me bread to eat and clothing to wear,
brenton_translation: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If the Lord God will be with me, and guard me throughout on this journey, on which I am going, and give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

fresh_translation: and brings me back with safety to my father's house, then the Lord shall be God to me,
brenton_translation: and bring me back in safety to the house of my father, then shall the Lord be for a God to me.

fresh_translation: and this stone that I set up as a pillar shall be God's house, and from everything you give me, I will tithe a tenth of it to you.
brenton_translation: And this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be to me a house of God; and of all whatsoever thou shalt give me, I will tithe a tenth for thee.

fresh_translation: And Jacob, lifting up his feet, went to the eastern land, to Laban son of Bethuel the Syrian, brother of Rebekah, mother of Jacob and Esau.
brenton_translation: And Jacob started and went to the land of the east to Laban, the son of Bathuel the Syrian, and the brother of Rebecca, mother of Jacob and Esau.

fresh_translation: And he sees, and look, a well in the plain, and three flocks of sheep were lying there by it, for from that well they watered the flocks, and a great stone was on the mouth of the well,
brenton_translation: And he looks, and behold! a well in the plain; and there were there three flocks of sheep resting at it, for out of that well they watered the flocks, but there was a great stone at the mouth of the well.

fresh_translation: and all the flocks were gathered there, and they would roll away the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep and set the stone back on the mouth of the well in its place.
brenton_translation: And there were all the flocks gathered, and they used to roll away the stone from the mouth of the well, and water the flocks, and set the stone again in its place on the mouth of the well.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to them, Brothers, where are you from? And they said, We are from Harran.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to them, Brethren, whence are ye? and they said, We are of Charrhan.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Do you know Laban son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Know ye Laban, the son of Nachor? and they said, We do know him.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Is he well? And they said, He is well. And look, Rachel his daughter was coming with the sheep.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Is he well? And they said, He is well. And behold Rachel his daughter came with the sheep.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said, It is still much day, not yet time for the livestock to be gathered. Water the sheep, then go and pasture them.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said, It is yet high day, it is not yet time that the flocks be gathered together; water ye the flocks, and depart and feed them.

fresh_translation: But they said, We cannot until all the shepherds are gathered and they roll the stone away from the mouth of the well, then we water the sheep.
brenton_translation: And they said, We shall not be able, until all the shepherds be gathered together, and they shall roll away the stone from the mouth of the well, then we will water the flocks.

fresh_translation: While he was still speaking with them, look, Rachel daughter of Laban was coming with her father's sheep, for she was shepherding her father's sheep.
brenton_translation: While he was yet speaking to them, behold, Rachel the daughter of Laban came with her father's sheep, for she fed the sheep of her father.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Jacob saw Rachel daughter of Laban, brother of his mother, and the sheep of Laban, brother of his mother, Jacob came near and rolled the stone from the mouth of the well and watered the sheep of Laban, brother of his mother.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother's brother, that Jacob came and rolled away the stone from the mouth of the well, and watered the sheep of Laban, his mother's brother.

fresh_translation: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and crying out with his voice, he wept.
brenton_translation: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and cried with a loud voice and wept.

fresh_translation: And Jacob reported to Rachel that he was brother to her father and that he was son of Rebekah. And she ran and reported to her father according to these words.
brenton_translation: And he told Rachel that he was the near relative of her father, and the son of Rebecca; and she ran and reported to her father according to these words.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Laban heard the name of Jacob, son of his sister, he ran to meet him and embraced him and kissed him and brought him into his house. And Jacob recounted to Laban all these matters.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Laban heard the name of Jacob, his sister's son, he ran to meet him, and embraced and kissed him, and brought him into his house; and he told Laban all these sayings.

fresh_translation: And Laban said to him, You are from my bones and from my flesh. And he was with him a month of days.
brenton_translation: And Laban said to him, Thou art of my bones and of my flesh; and he was with him a full month.

fresh_translation: And Laban said to Jacob, Because you are my brother, will you serve me for nothing? Tell me, what shall your wages be?
brenton_translation: And Laban said to Jacob, Surely thou shalt not serve me for nothing, because thou art my brother; tell me what thy reward is to be.
