fresh_translation: And we said, We will not be able to go down. But if our younger brother goes down with us, we will go down, for we will not be able to see the man's face if our younger brother is not with us.
brenton_translation: And we said, We shall not be able to go down; but if our younger brother go down with us, we will go down; for we shall not be able to see the man's face, our younger brother not being with us.

fresh_translation: And your servant our father said to us, You know that my wife bore me two sons.
brenton_translation: And thy servant our father said to us, Ye know that my wife bore me two sons;

fresh_translation: And the one went out from me, and you said, He has become eaten by beasts, and I have not seen him until now.
brenton_translation: and one is departed from me; and ye said that he was devoured of wild beasts, and I have not seen him until now.

fresh_translation: If then you take this one also from my face, and some harm happens to him on the road, you will bring my old age down with sorrow into Hades.
brenton_translation: If then ye take this one also from my presence, and an affliction happen to him by the way, then shall ye bring down my old age with sorrow to the grave.

fresh_translation: Now then, if I go in to your servant my father and the child is not with us, and his soul hangs from this child's soul,
brenton_translation: Now then, if I should go in to thy servant, and our father, and the boy should not be with us, (and his life depends on this lad's life)—

fresh_translation: then it will happen that when he sees that the child is not with us, he will die, and your servants will bring down the old age of your servant our father with sorrow into Hades.
brenton_translation: it shall even come to pass, when he sees the boy is not with us, that he will die, and thy servants will bring down the old age of thy servant, and our father, with sorrow to the grave.

fresh_translation: For your servant has taken the child as a pledge from the father, saying, If I do not bring him to you and set him before you, I shall be guilty before my father all my days.
brenton_translation: For thy servant has received the boy in charge from his father, saying, If I bring him not to thee, and place him before thee, I shall be guilty towards my father for ever.

fresh_translation: Now then, let me remain as a servant to my lord in place of the child, but let the child go up with his brothers.
brenton_translation: Now then I will remain a servant with thee instead of the lad, a domestic of my lord; but let the lad go up with his brethren.

fresh_translation: For how shall I go up to my father if the child is not with us? Lest I see the evils that will find my father.
brenton_translation: For how shall I go up to my father, the lad not being with us? lest I behold the evils which will befal my father.

fresh_translation: And Joseph was not able to hold out before all those standing by him, but said, Send everyone away from me. And no one stood with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
brenton_translation: And Joseph could not refrain himself when all were standing by him, but said, Dismiss all from me; and no one stood near Joseph, when he made himself known to his brethren.

fresh_translation: And he lifted up his voice with weeping. And all the Egyptians heard, and it became heard in Pharaoh's house.
brenton_translation: And he uttered his voice with weeping; and all the Egyptians heard, and it was reported to the house of Pharao.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to his brothers, I am Joseph. Does my father still live? And his brothers were not able to answer him, for they were troubled.
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him, for they were troubled.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to his brothers, Come near to me, and they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to his brethren, Draw nigh to me; and they drew nigh; and he said, I am your brother Joseph, whom ye sold into Egypt.

fresh_translation: And now do not be grieved, nor let it seem hard to you, because you sold me here. For God sent me before you for life.
brenton_translation: Now then be not grieved, and let it not seem hard to you that ye sold me hither, for God sent me before you for life.

fresh_translation: For this is the second year of famine upon the land, and there are still five years in which there will be neither plowing nor harvest.
brenton_translation: For this second year there is famine on the earth, and there are yet five years remaining, in which there is to be neither ploughing, nor mowing.

fresh_translation: For God sent me before you to leave for you a remnant on the earth and to preserve for you a great remnant.
brenton_translation: For God sent me before you, that there might be left to you a remnant upon the earth, even to nourish a great remnant of you.

fresh_translation: And now it was not you who sent me here, but God, and he made me as a father to Pharaoh and lord of all his house and ruler of all the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: Now then ye did not send me hither, but God; and he hath made me as a father of Pharao, and lord of all his house, and ruler of all the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: Hurry then and go up to my father and say to him, Thus says your son Joseph: God made me lord of all the land of Egypt. Come down to me, and do not remain.
brenton_translation: Hasten, therefore, and go up to my father, and say to him, These things saith thy son Joseph; God has made me lord of all the land of Egypt; come down therefore to me, and tarry not.

fresh_translation: And you will dwell in the land of Gesem of Arabia, and you will be near me, you and your sons and the sons of your sons, your sheep and your cattle and all that is yours,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Gesem of Arabia; and thou shalt be near me, thou and thy sons, and thy sons' sons, thy sheep and thine oxen, and whatsoever things are thine.

fresh_translation: and I will nourish you there, for there are still five years of famine, lest you and your sons and all your possessions be destroyed.
brenton_translation: And I will nourish thee there: for the famine is yet for five years; lest thou be consumed, and thy sons, and all thy possessions.

fresh_translation: Look, your eyes see, and the eyes of Benjamin my brother see, that my mouth is the one speaking to you.
brenton_translation: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

fresh_translation: Then tell my father all my glory in Egypt and all that you have seen, and hurry and bring my father down here.
brenton_translation: Report, therefore, to my father all my glory in Egypt, and all things that ye have seen, and make haste and bring down my father hither.

fresh_translation: And falling on the neck of Benjamin his brother, he wept over him, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
brenton_translation: And he fell on his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept on him; and Benjamin wept on his neck.

fresh_translation: And kissing all his brothers, he wept over them, and after this his brothers spoke to him.
brenton_translation: And he kissed all his brethren, and wept on them; and after these things his brethren spoke to him.

fresh_translation: And the report was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brothers have come. And Pharaoh and his household rejoiced.
brenton_translation: And the report was carried into the house of Pharao, saying, Joseph's brethren are come; and Pharao was glad, and his household.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Tell your brothers, Do this: fill your beasts and go to the land of Canaan,
brenton_translation: And Pharao said to Joseph, Say to thy brethren, Do this; fill your waggons, and depart into the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: and take your father and your possessions and come to me, and I will give you from all the good things of Egypt, and you will eat the marrow of the land.
brenton_translation: And take up your father, and your possessions, and come to me; and I will give you of all the goods of Egypt, and ye shall eat the marrow of the land.

fresh_translation: And you, command this: take carts for them out of the land of Egypt for your little ones and your wives. And taking your father, come.
brenton_translation: And do thou charge them thus; that they should take for them waggons out of the land of Egypt, for your little ones, and for your wives; and take up your father, and come.

fresh_translation: And do not spare your eyes for your goods, for all the good things of Egypt will be yours.
brenton_translation: And be not sparing in regard to your property, for all the good of Egypt shall be yours.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them carts according to Pharaoh's word and gave them provisions for the road,
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel did so; and Joseph gave to them waggons, according to the words spoken by king Pharao; and he gave them provision for the journey.

fresh_translation: and to all he gave two garments apiece, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred gold pieces and five changing garments,
brenton_translation: And he gave to them all two sets of raiment apiece; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of gold, and five changes of raiment.

fresh_translation: and to his father he sent likewise: ten donkeys carrying from all the good things of Egypt, and ten she-donkeys carrying bread for his father for the journey.
brenton_translation: And to his father he sent presents at the same rate, and ten asses, bearing some of all the good things of Egypt, and ten mules, bearing bread for his father for the journey.

fresh_translation: And he sent away his brothers, and they went. And he said to them, Do not be angry on the road.
brenton_translation: And he sent away his brethren, and they went; and he said to them, Be not angry by the way.

fresh_translation: And they went up out of Egypt and came to the land of Canaan to Jacob their father,
brenton_translation: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Chanaan, to Jacob their father.

fresh_translation: and they reported to him, saying, Your son Joseph lives, and he rules all the land of Egypt. And Jacob was stunned in mind, for he did not believe them.
brenton_translation: And they reported to him, saying, Thy son Joseph is living, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt; and Jacob was amazed, for he did not believe them.

fresh_translation: And they told him all the words of Joseph that he had spoken to them. And when he saw the carts that Joseph had sent to take him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.
brenton_translation: But they spoke to him all the words uttered by Joseph, whatsoever he said to them; and having seen the chariots which Joseph sent to take him up, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.

fresh_translation: And Israel said, It is a great thing for me if Joseph my son still lives. I will go and see him before I die.
brenton_translation: And Israel said, It is a great thing for me if Joseph my son is yet alive, I will go and see him before I die.

fresh_translation: And Israel departed, he and all that was his, and came to the Well of the Oath and offered sacrifice to the God of his father Isaac.
brenton_translation: And Israel departed, he and all that he had, and came to the well of the oath; and he offered sacrifice to the God of his father Isaac.

fresh_translation: And God spoke to Israel in a vision of the night, saying, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, What is it?
brenton_translation: And God spoke to Israel in a night vision, saying, Jacob, Jacob; and he said, What is it?

fresh_translation: And he says to him, I am the God of your fathers. Do not fear to go down into Egypt, for I will make you there into a great nation,
brenton_translation: And he says to him, I am the God of thy fathers; fear not to go down into Egypt, for I will make thee there a great nation.

fresh_translation: and I will go down with you into Egypt, and I will bring you up at the end, and Joseph will place his hands on your eyes.
brenton_translation: And I will go down with thee into Egypt, and I will bring thee up at the end; and Joseph shall put his hands on thine eyes.

fresh_translation: And Jacob rose from the Well of the Oath, and the sons of Israel took up their father and their households and their wives on the carts that Joseph sent to take him,
brenton_translation: And Jacob rose up from the well of the oath; and the sons of Israel took up their father, and the baggage, and their wives on the waggons, which Joseph sent to take them.

fresh_translation: and taking up their possessions and all the property that they had acquired in the land of Canaan, they entered into Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him,
brenton_translation: And they took up their goods, and all their property, which they had gotten in the land of Chanaan; they came into the land of Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him.

fresh_translation: sons and sons of his sons with him, daughters and daughters of his daughters. And he brought all his seed into Egypt.
brenton_translation: The sons, and the sons of his sons with him; his daughters, and the daughters of his daughters; and he brought all his seed into Egypt.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of the sons of Israel who entered into Egypt along with Jacob their father: Jacob and his sons. The firstborn of Jacob was Reuben.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the sons of Israel that went into Egypt with their father Jacob—Jacob and his sons. The first-born of Jacob, Ruben.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben: Enoch and Phallus, Asron and Charmi.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben; Enoch, and Phallus, Asron, and Charmi.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Aod and Jachin and Saar and Saul, son of the Canaanite woman.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Symeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Aod, and Achin, and Saar, and Saul, the son of a Chananitish woman.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Levi: Gerson, Caath and Merari.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Levi; Gerson, Cath, and Merari.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Judah: Er and Aunan and Selom and Phares and Zara. And Er and Aunan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Phares became Esron and Jemuel.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Judas; Er, and Aunan, and Selom, and Phares, and Zara: and Er and Aunan died in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Issachar: Thola and Phua and Iasub and Zambram.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Phares were Esron, and Jemuel. And the sons of Issachar; Thola, and Phua, and Asum, and Sambran.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered and Allon and Achoel.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Zabulun, Sered, and Allon, and Achoel.

fresh_translation: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Mesopotamia of Syria, and Dinah his daughter. All the souls, sons and daughters, were thirty-three.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Lea, which she bore to Jacob in Mesopotamia of Syria, and Dina his daughter; all the souls, sons and daughters, thirty-three.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Gad: Saphon and Angis and Saunis and Thasoban and Aedeis and Aroedeis and Areeleis.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Gad; Saphon, and Angis, and Sannis, and Thasoban, and Aedis, and Aroedis, and Areelis.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Asher: Jemna, Jessua and Jeoul and Baria and Sara their sister. And the sons of Baria: Chobor and Melchiil.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Aser; Jemna, Jessua, and Jeul, and Baria, and Sara their sister. And the sons of Baria; Chobor, and Melchiil.

fresh_translation: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, who bore these to Jacob, sixteen souls.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Zelpha, which Laban gave to his daughter Lea, who bore these to Jacob, sixteen souls.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Rachel, the wife of Jacob; Joseph, and Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And sons were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt, whom Aseneth daughter of Petephres priest of Heliopolis bore to him, Manasseh and Ephraim. And there were sons of Manasseh, whom the Syrian concubine bore to him, Machir. And Machir begot Galaad. And the sons of Ephraim, brother of Manasseh, were Sutalaam and Taam. And the sons of Sutalaam were Edem.
brenton_translation: And there were sons born to Joseph in the land of Egypt, whom Aseneth, the daughter of Petephres, priest of Heliopolis, bore to him, even Manasses and Ephraim. And there were sons born to Manasses, which the Syrian concubine bore to him, even Machir. And Machir begot Galaad. And the sons of Ephraim, the brother of Manasses; Sutalaam, and Taam. And the sons of Sutalaam; Edom.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin: Bala and Chobor and Asbel. And there became sons of Bala: Gera and Noeman and Anchis and Ros and Mamphim and Ophimin. And Gera begot Arad.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Benjamin; Bala, and Bochor, and Asbel. And the sons of Bala were Gera, and Noeman, and Anchis, and Ros, and Mamphim. And Gera begot Arad.

fresh_translation: These are the sons of Rachel, whom she bore to Jacob. All the souls were eighteen.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Rachel, which she bore to Jacob; all the souls eighteen.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Dan: Asom.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Dan; Asom.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Naphtali: Asiel and Gouni and Issaar and Syllim.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Nephthalim; Asiel, and Goni, and Issaar, and Sollem.

fresh_translation: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, who bore these to Jacob. All the souls were seven.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Balla, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel, who bore these to Jacob; all the souls, seven.

fresh_translation: And all the souls that entered with Jacob into Egypt, those who came out of his loins, apart from the wives of Jacob's sons, all the souls were sixty-six.
brenton_translation: And all the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, who came out of his loins, besides the wives of the sons of Jacob, even all the souls were sixty-six.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Joseph born to him in the land of Egypt were nine souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob that entered into Egypt with Jacob were seventy-five souls.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in the land of Egypt, were nine souls; all the souls of the house of Jacob who came with Joseph into Egypt, were seventy-five souls.

fresh_translation: And he sent Judah before him to Joseph to meet him at the city of Heroes, into the land of Ramesses.
brenton_translation: And he sent Judas before him to Joseph, to meet him to the city of Heroes, into the land of Ramesses.

fresh_translation: And Joseph, yoking his chariots, went up to meet Israel his father at the city of Heroes, and appearing to him, he fell on his neck and wept with abundant weeping.
brenton_translation: And Joseph having made ready his chariots, went up to meet Israel his father, at the city of Heroes; and having appeared to him, fell on his neck, and wept with abundant weeping.

fresh_translation: And Israel said to Joseph, From now on I will die, since I have seen your face, because you still live.
brenton_translation: And Israel said to Joseph, After this I will gladly die, since I have seen thy face, for thou art yet living.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to his brothers, I will go up and report to Pharaoh, and I will say to him, My brothers and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to his brethren, I will go up and tell Pharao, and will say to him, My brethren, and my father's house, who were in the land of Chanaan, are come to me.

fresh_translation: And the men are shepherds, for they were men who bred cattle, and they have brought their cattle and their oxen and all that is theirs.
brenton_translation: And the men are shepherds; for they have been feeders of cattle, and they have brought with them their cattle, and their kine, and all their property.

fresh_translation: If then Pharaoh calls you and says to you, What is your work?
brenton_translation: If then Pharao call you, and say to you, What is your occupation?

fresh_translation: you will say, Your servants are breeders of cattle from childhood until now, both we and our fathers, so that you may dwell in the land of Gesem of Arabia, for every shepherd of sheep is an abomination to the Egyptians.
brenton_translation: Ye shall say, We thy servants are herdsmen from our youth until now, both we and our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Gesem of Arabia, for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.

fresh_translation: And Joseph came and reported to Pharaoh, saying, My father and my brothers and their cattle and their oxen and all that is theirs have come out of the land of Canaan, and look, they are in the land of Gesem.
brenton_translation: And Joseph came and told Pharao, saying, My father, and my brethren, and their cattle, and their oxen, and all their possessions, are come out of the land of Chanaan, and, behold, they are in the land of Gesem.

fresh_translation: And from his brothers he took five men and set them before Pharaoh.
brenton_translation: And he took of his brethren five men, and set them before Pharao.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh said to Joseph's brothers, What is your work? And they said to Pharaoh, Your servants are shepherds of sheep, both we and our fathers.
brenton_translation: And Pharao said to the brethren of Joseph, What is your occupation? and they said to Pharao, Thy servants are shepherds, both we and our fathers.

fresh_translation: And they said to Pharaoh, We have come to sojourn in the land, for there is no pasture for the flocks of your servants, because the famine prevailed in the land of Canaan. Now then, let your servants dwell in the land of Gesem.
brenton_translation: And they said to Pharao, We are come to sojourn in the land, for there is no pasture for the flocks of thy servants, for the famine has prevailed in the land of Chanaan; now then, we will dwell in the land of Gesem. And Pharao said to Joseph, Let them dwell in the land of Gesem; and if thou knowest that there are among them able men, make them overseers of my cattle. So Jacob and his sons came into Egypt, to Joseph; and Pharao, king of Egypt, heard of it.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Let them dwell in the land of Gesem. And if you know that there are able men among them, appoint them rulers over my cattle. And Jacob and his sons came into Egypt to Joseph, and Pharaoh king of Egypt heard.
brenton_translation: And Pharao spoke to Joseph, saying, Thy father, and thy brethren, are come to thee.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Your father and your brothers have come to you. Look, the land of Egypt is before you. In the best land settle your father and your brothers.
brenton_translation: Behold, the land of Egypt is before thee; settle thy father and thy brethren in the best land.

fresh_translation: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father and set him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
brenton_translation: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharao; and Jacob blessed Pharao.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, How many are the years of the days of your life?
brenton_translation: And Pharao said to Jacob, How many are the years of the days of thy life?

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, The days of the years of my life in which I sojourn are one hundred thirty years. Few and evil have become the days of the years of my life, and they have not reached the days of the years of the life of my fathers, in which days they sojourned.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to Pharao, The days of the years of my life, wherein I sojourn, are a hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, they have not attained to the days of the life of my fathers, in which days they sojourned.

fresh_translation: And Jacob, having blessed Pharaoh, went out from him.
brenton_translation: And Jacob blessed Pharao, and departed from him.

fresh_translation: And Joseph settled his father and his brothers and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best land, in the land of Ramesses, just as Pharaoh commanded.
brenton_translation: And Joseph settled his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best land, in the land of Ramesses, as Pharao commanded.

fresh_translation: And Joseph measured out grain to his father and his brothers and to all the house of his father according to persons.
brenton_translation: And Joseph gave provision to his father, and his brethren, and to all the house of his father, corn for each person.

fresh_translation: And there was no grain in all the land, for the famine prevailed greatly. And the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan failed because of the famine.
brenton_translation: And there was no corn in all the land, for the famine prevailed greatly; and the land of Egypt, and the land of Chanaan, fainted for the famine.

fresh_translation: And Joseph gathered all the money found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan for the grain that they were buying, and he measured out grain to them. And Joseph brought all the money into Pharaoh's house.
brenton_translation: And Joseph gathered all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and the land of Chanaan, in return for the corn which they bought, and he distributed corn to them; and Joseph brought all the money into the house of Pharao.

fresh_translation: And all the money failed out of the land of Egypt and out of the land of Canaan. And all the Egyptians came to Joseph, saying, Give us bread, and why should we die before you? For our money has failed.
brenton_translation: And all the money failed out of the land of Egypt, and out of the land of Chanaan; and all the Egyptians came to Joseph, saying, Give us bread, and why do we die in thy presence? for our money is spent.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to them, Bring your livestock, and I will give you bread in exchange for your livestock, if your money has failed.
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to them, Bring your cattle, and I will give you bread for your cattle, if your money is spent.

fresh_translation: And they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses and in exchange for the sheep and in exchange for the oxen and in exchange for the donkeys. And he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock in that year.
brenton_translation: And they brought their cattle to Joseph; and Joseph gave them bread in return for their horses, and for their sheep, and for their oxen, and for their asses; and Joseph maintained them with bread for all their cattle in that year.

fresh_translation: And that year ended, and they came to him in the second year and said to him, Let us not be wiped out before our lord. For if our money has failed and our possessions and livestock belong to you, our lord, nothing is left for us before our lord except our own bodies and our land.
brenton_translation: And that year passed, and they came to him in the second year, and said to him, Must we then be consumed from before our lord? for if our money has failed, and our possessions, and our cattle, brought to thee our lord, and there has not been left to us before our lord more than our own bodies and our land, we are indeed destitute.

fresh_translation: So then, let us not die before you and let not the land be made desolate. Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give seed, so that we may sow and live and not die, and the land will not be made desolate.
brenton_translation: In order, then, that we die not before thee, and the land be made desolate, buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharao: give seed that we may sow, and live and not die, so our land shall not be made desolate.

fresh_translation: And Joseph bought all the land of the Egyptians for Pharaoh, for the Egyptians sold their land to Pharaoh, because the famine prevailed against them, and the land became Pharaoh's.
brenton_translation: And Joseph bought all the land of the Egyptians, for Pharao; for the Egyptians sold their land to Pharao; for the famine prevailed against them, and the land became Pharao's.

fresh_translation: And he enslaved the people to him as servants from one border of Egypt to the other.
brenton_translation: And he brought the people into bondage to him, for servants, from one extremity of Egypt to the other,

fresh_translation: Only the land of the priests Joseph did not buy, for Pharaoh gave a fixed allowance to the priests, and they ate the allowance that Pharaoh gave them. Because of this they did not sell their land.
brenton_translation: except only the land of the priests; Joseph bought not this, for Pharao gave a portion in the way of gift to the priests; and they ate their portion which Pharao gave them; therefore they sold not their land.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to all the Egyptians, Look, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Take seed for yourselves and sow the land,
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to all the Egyptians, Behold, I have bought you and your land this day for Pharao; take seed for you, and sow the land.

fresh_translation: and its produce will come, and you will give the fifth part to Pharaoh, and the four parts will be for you yourselves, for seed for the land and for food for you and all those in your houses.
brenton_translation: And there shall be the fruits of it; and ye shall give the fifth part to Pharao, and the four remaining parts shall be for yourselves, for seed for the earth, and for food for you, and all that are in your houses.

fresh_translation: And they said, You have saved us. We have found favor before our lord, and we will be servants to Pharaoh.
brenton_translation: And they said, Thou hast saved us; we have found favour before our lord, and we will be servants to Pharao.

fresh_translation: And Joseph set it for them as an ordinance until this day on the land of Egypt, reserving a fifth part for Pharaoh, except only the land of the priests, which did not belong to Pharaoh.
brenton_translation: And Joseph appointed it to them for an ordinance until this day; to reserve a fifth part for Pharao, on the land of Egypt, except only the land of the priests, that was not Pharao's.

fresh_translation: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, on the land of Gesem, and they gained an inheritance on it and increased and multiplied greatly.
brenton_translation: And Israel dwelt in Egypt, in the land of Gesem, and they gained an inheritance upon it; and they increased and multiplied very greatly.

fresh_translation: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and the days of Jacob, the years of his life, became one hundred forty-seven years.
brenton_translation: And Jacob survived seventeen years in the land of Egypt; and Jacob's days of the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven years.

fresh_translation: And the days of Israel drew near for him to die, and he called his son Joseph and said to him, If I have found favor before you, put your hand under my thigh, and you will do mercy and truth toward me so as not to bury me in Egypt,
brenton_translation: And the days of Israel drew nigh for him to die: and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, If I have found favour before thee, put thy hand under my thigh, and thou shalt execute mercy and truth toward me, so as not to bury me in Egypt.

fresh_translation: but I will sleep with my fathers, and you will carry me up out of Egypt and bury me in their tomb. And he said, I will do according to your word.
brenton_translation: But I will sleep with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me up out of Egypt, and bury me in their sepulchre. And he said, I will do according to thy word.

fresh_translation: And he said, Swear to me. And he swore to him. And Israel bowed upon the top of his staff.
brenton_translation: And he said, Swear to me; and he swore to him. And Israel did reverence, leaning on the top of his staff.

fresh_translation: And it happened after these matters, it was reported to Joseph that your father is ill. And taking his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, he came to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after these things, that it was reported to Joseph, Behold, thy father is ill; and, having taken his two sons, Manasse and Ephraim, he came to Jacob.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Jacob, saying, Look, your son Joseph is coming to you. And Israel, strengthening himself, sat upon the bed.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to Jacob, saying, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh to thee; and Israel having strengthened himself, sat upon the bed.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to Joseph, My God appeared to me in Luza in the land of Canaan and blessed me
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to Joseph, My God appeared to me in Luza, in the land of Chanaan, and blessed me,

fresh_translation: and said to me, Look, I will increase you and multiply you and make you into gatherings of nations, and I will give this land to you and to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.
brenton_translation: and said to me, Behold, I will increase thee, and multiply thee, and will make of thee multitudes of nations; and I will give this land to thee, and to thy seed after thee, for an everlasting possession.

fresh_translation: Now then, your two sons born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt are mine. Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine as Reuben and Simeon are.
brenton_translation: Now then thy two sons, who were born to thee in the land of Egypt, before I came to thee into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasse, as Ruben and Symeon they shall be mine.

fresh_translation: And the offspring that you beget after these will be under the name of their brothers. They will be called after their brothers' inheritances.
brenton_translation: And the children which thou shalt beget hereafter, shall be in the name of their brethren; they shall be named after their inheritances.

fresh_translation: And as for me, when I was coming from Mesopotamia of Syria, Rachel your mother died in the land of Canaan as I drew near toward the racecourse of Chabratha of the land so as to come to Ephratha, and I buried her on the road of the racecourse. This is Bethlehem.
brenton_translation: And as for me, when I came out of Mesopotamia of Syria, Rachel, thy mother, died in the land of Chanaan, as I drew nigh to the horse-course of Chabratha of the land of Chanaan, so as to come to Ephratha; and I buried her in the road of the course; this is Bethlehem.

fresh_translation: And when Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he said, Who are these to you?
brenton_translation: And when Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he said, Who are these to thee?

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God gave me here. And Jacob said, Bring them to me, so that I may bless them.
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God gave me here; and Jacob said, Bring me them, that I may bless them.

fresh_translation: Now the eyes of Israel were dim from old age, and he was not able to see. And Joseph brought them near to him, and he kissed them and embraced them.
brenton_translation: Now the eyes of Israel were dim through age, and he could not see; and he brought them near to him, and he kissed them, and embraced them.

fresh_translation: And Israel said to Joseph, Look, I was not deprived even of your face, and look, God also showed me your seed.
brenton_translation: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I have not been deprived of seeing thy face, and lo! God has showed me thy seed also.

fresh_translation: And Joseph brought them out from his knees, and they bowed to him with face to the ground.
brenton_translation: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and they did reverence to him, with their face to the ground.

fresh_translation: And Joseph took his two sons, Ephraim in his right hand on Israel's left, and Manasseh in his left hand on Israel's right, and brought them near to him.
brenton_translation: And Joseph took his two sons, both Ephraim in his right hand, but on the left of Israel, and Manasse on his left hand, but on the right of Israel, and brought them near to him.

fresh_translation: And Israel, stretching out his right hand, laid it on Ephraim's head, though he was the younger, and his left on Manasseh's head, crossing his hands.
brenton_translation: But Israel having stretched out his right hand, laid it on the head of Ephraim, and he was the younger; and his left hand on the head of Manasse, guiding his hands crosswise.

fresh_translation: And he blessed them and said, The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac were well-pleasing, the God who feeds me from youth until this day,
brenton_translation: And he blessed them and said, The God in whose sight my fathers were well pleasing, even Abraam and Isaac, the God who continues to feed me from my youth until this day;

fresh_translation: the angel who rescues me from all evils, may he bless these boys. And let my name be called on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and let them be multiplied into a great multitude on the earth.
brenton_translation: the angel who delivers me from all evils, bless these boys, and my name shall be called upon them, and the name of my fathers, Abraam and Isaac; and let them be increased to a great multitude on the earth.

fresh_translation: And Joseph, seeing that his father laid his right hand on Ephraim's head, it seemed grievous to him, and Joseph took hold of his father's hand to remove it from Ephraim's head onto Manasseh's head.
brenton_translation: And Joseph having seen that his father put his right hand on the head of Ephraim—it seemed grievous to him; and Joseph took hold of the hand of his father, to remove it from the head of Ephraim to the head of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, father, for this one is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, father; for this is the first-born; lay thy right-hand upon his head.

fresh_translation: And he would not, but said, I know, child, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be exalted. But his younger brother will be greater than he, and his seed will become a multitude of nations.
brenton_translation: And he would not, but said, I know it, son, I know it; he also shall be a people, and he shall be exalted, but his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

fresh_translation: And he blessed them in that day, saying, In you Israel will be blessed, saying, God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh. And he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
brenton_translation: And he blessed them in that day, saying, In you shall Israel be blessed, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and Manasse; and he set Ephraim before Manasse.

fresh_translation: And Israel said to Joseph, Look, I am dying, and God will be with you and return you to the land of your fathers.
brenton_translation: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I die; and God shall be with you, and restore you to the land of your fathers.

fresh_translation: And I give to you Sikima, a chosen portion above your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amorites with my sword and my bow.
brenton_translation: And I give to thee Sicima, a select portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorites with my sword and bow.

fresh_translation: And Jacob called his sons and said to them, Gather yourselves, so that I may tell you what will meet you in the last days.
brenton_translation: And Jacob called his sons, and said to them, Assemble yourselves, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in the last days.

fresh_translation: Gather yourselves and hear me, sons of Jacob. Hear Israel your father.
brenton_translation: Gather yourselves together, and hear me, sons of Jacob; hear Israel, hear your father.

fresh_translation: Reuben, my firstborn, you are my strength and the beginning of my children, hard to bear and hard, self-willed.
brenton_translation: Ruben, thou art my first-born, thou my strength, and the first of my children, hard to be endured, hard and self-willed.

fresh_translation: You were insolent like water; do not boil over, for you went up to your father's bed. Then you defiled the couch where you went up.
brenton_translation: Thou wast insolent like water, burst not forth with violence, for thou wentest up to the bed of thy father; then thou defiledst the couch, whereupon thou wentest up.

fresh_translation: Simeon and Levi are brothers. They accomplished injustice from their own choosing.
brenton_translation: Symeon and Levi, brethren, accomplished the injustice of their cutting off.

fresh_translation: Let not my soul come into their counsel, and let not my inward parts lean upon their conspiracy, because in their wrath they killed men, and in their desire they hamstrung a bull.
brenton_translation: Let not my soul come into their counsel, and let not mine inward parts contend in their conspiracy, for in their wrath they slew men, and in their passion they houghed a bull.

fresh_translation: Cursed be their wrath, because it was self-willed, and their anger, because it grew hard. I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.
brenton_translation: Cursed be their wrath, for it was wilful, and their anger, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

fresh_translation: Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hands will be on the back of your enemies. Your father's sons will bow to you.
brenton_translation: Juda, thy brethren have praised thee, and thy hands shall be on the back of thine enemies; thy father's sons shall do thee reverence.

fresh_translation: Judah is a lion's cub. From a shoot, my son, you went up. Having lain down, you slept as a lion and as a cub. Who will rouse him?
brenton_translation: Juda is a lion's whelp: from the tender plant, my son, thou art gone up, having couched thou liest as a lion, and as a whelp; who shall stir him up?

fresh_translation: A ruler will not fail from Judah, nor a leader from his loins, until the things stored up for him come, and he is the expectation of nations.
brenton_translation: A ruler shall not fail from Juda, nor a prince from his loins, until there come the things stored up for him; and he is the expectation of nations.

fresh_translation: Binding his foal to the vine and the foal of his donkey to the tendril, he will wash his robe in wine and his garment in the blood of the grape.
brenton_translation: Binding his foal to the vine, and the foal of his ass to the branch of it, he shall wash his robe in wine, and his garment in the blood of the grape.

fresh_translation: His eyes are gladdening from wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
brenton_translation: His eyes shall be more cheering than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.

fresh_translation: Zebulun will dwell by the sea, and he will be by a harbor of ships, and he will stretch out as far as Sidon.
brenton_translation: Zabulon shall dwell on the coast, and he shall be by a haven of ships, and shall extend to Sidon.

fresh_translation: Issachar desired the good, resting between the allotments.
brenton_translation: Issachar has desired that which is good; resting between the inheritances.

fresh_translation: And seeing that the rest was good and the land rich, he put his shoulder to labor and became a farmer.
brenton_translation: And having seen the resting place that it was good, and the land that it was fertile, he subjected his shoulder to labour, and became a husbandman.

fresh_translation: Dan will judge his people, as one tribe too in Israel.
brenton_translation: Dan shall judge his people, as one tribe too in Israel.

fresh_translation: And let Dan become a serpent on the road, sitting by the path, biting the horse's heel, and the rider will fall backward,
brenton_translation: And let Dan be a serpent in the way, besetting the path, biting the heel of the horse (and the rider shall fall backward),

fresh_translation: waiting for the salvation of the Lord.
brenton_translation: waiting for the salvation of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Gad, a raiding troop will raid him, but he will raid it at heel.
brenton_translation: Gad, a plundering troop shall plunder him; but he shall plunder him, pursuing him closely.

fresh_translation: Asher, his bread is rich, and he will give delicacies to rulers.
brenton_translation: Aser, his bread shall be fat; and he shall yield dainties to princes.

fresh_translation: Naphtali is a released stem, bestowing beauty in its fruit.
brenton_translation: Nephthalim is a spreading stem, bestowing beauty on its fruit.

fresh_translation: Joseph is a son increased, my increased and envied son, my youngest son. Return to me.
brenton_translation: Joseph is a son increased; my dearly loved son is increased; my youngest son, turn to me.

fresh_translation: Against him, taking evil counsel, they reviled him, and lords of arrows pressed hard upon him.
brenton_translation: Against whom men taking evil counsel reproached him, and the archers pressed hard upon him.

fresh_translation: But their bows were shattered with strength, and the sinews of their arms were loosened by the hand of the Mighty One of Jacob. From there is the one who strengthened Israel, from the God of your father,
brenton_translation: But their bow and arrows were mightily consumed, and the sinews of their arms were slackened by the hand of the mighty one of Jacob; thence is he that strengthened Israel from the God of thy father;

fresh_translation: and my God helped you and blessed you with blessing of heaven from above and blessing of earth possessing all things, because of blessing of breasts and womb,
brenton_translation: and my God helped thee, and he blessed thee with the blessing of heaven from above, and the blessing of the earth possessing all things, because of the blessing of the breasts and of the womb,

fresh_translation: the blessings of your father and mother prevailed above the blessings of abiding mountains and the blessings of everlasting hills. They will be on Joseph's head and on the crown of the one who led his brothers.
brenton_translation: the blessings of thy father and thy mother—it has prevailed above the blessing of the lasting mountains, and beyond the blessings of the everlasting hills; they shall be upon the head of Joseph, and upon the head of the brothers of whom he took the lead.

fresh_translation: Benjamin is a ravening wolf. In the morning he will still eat, and toward evening he gives food.
brenton_translation: Benjamin, as a ravening wolf, shall eat still in the morning, and at evening he gives food.

fresh_translation: All these are the twelve sons of Jacob. And these are the things their father spoke to them, and he blessed them. He blessed each according to his blessing.
brenton_translation: All these are the twelve sons of Jacob; and their father spoke these words to them, and he blessed them; he blessed each of them according to his blessing.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, I am being added to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
brenton_translation: And he said to them, I am added to my people; ye shall bury me with my fathers in the cave, which is in the field of Ephron the Chettite,

fresh_translation: in the double cave opposite Mambre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham acquired from Ephron the Hittite as a possession for a tomb,
brenton_translation: in the double cave which is opposite Mambre, in the land of Chanaan, the cave which Abraam bought of Ephron the Chettite, for a possession of a sepulchre.

fresh_translation: there they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife, there they buried Isaac and Rebecca his wife, there I buried Leah,
brenton_translation: There they buried Abraam and Sarrha his wife; there they buried Isaac, and Rebecca his wife; there they buried Lea;

fresh_translation: in the purchase of the field and of the cave that is in it, from the sons of Heth.
brenton_translation: in the portion of the field, and of the cave that was in it, purchased of the sons of Chet.

fresh_translation: And Jacob ceased commanding his sons, and lifting his feet onto the bed, he failed and was added to his people.
brenton_translation: And Jacob ceased giving charges to his sons; and having lifted up his feet on the bed, he died, and was gathered to his people.

fresh_translation: And Joseph, falling on his father's face, wept over him and kissed him.
brenton_translation: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept on him, and kissed him.

fresh_translation: And Joseph commanded his servants the embalmers to embalm his father, and the embalmers embalmed Israel.
brenton_translation: And Joseph commanded his servants the embalmers to embalm his father; and the embalmers embalmed Israel.

fresh_translation: And they completed forty days for him, for so the days of embalming are counted. And Egypt mourned for him seventy days.
brenton_translation: And they fulfilled forty days for him, for so are the days of embalming numbered; and Egypt mourned for him seventy days.

fresh_translation: And when the days of mourning passed, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh's nobles, saying, If I have found favor before you, speak concerning me into Pharaoh's ears, saying,
brenton_translation: And when the days of mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the princes of Pharao, saying, If I have found favour in your sight, speak concerning me in the ears of Pharao, saying,

fresh_translation: My father adjured me, saying, In the tomb that I dug for myself in the land of Canaan, there you will bury me. Now then I will go up and bury my father, and I will return again.
brenton_translation: My father adjured me, saying, In the sepulchre which I dug for myself in the land of Chanaan, there thou shalt bury me; now then I will go up and bury my father, and return again.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Go up and bury your father, just as he caused you to swear.
brenton_translation: And Pharao said to Joseph, Go up, bury thy father, as he constrained thee to swear.

fresh_translation: And Joseph went up to bury his father, and all Pharaoh's servants went up with him, and the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
brenton_translation: So Joseph went up to bury his father; and all the servants of Pharao went up with him, and the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: and all the household of Joseph, and his brothers, and all his father's house, and his kin. But they left behind the sheep and the oxen in the land of Gesem.
brenton_translation: And all the household of Joseph, and his brethren, and all the house of his father, and his kindred; and they left behind the sheep and the oxen in the land of Gesem.

fresh_translation: And chariots and horsemen also went up with him, and the company became very great.
brenton_translation: And there went up with him also chariots and horsemen; and there was a very great company.

fresh_translation: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and they bewailed him with a great and very strong lamentation. And he made mourning for his father seven days.
brenton_translation: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan; and they bewailed him with a great and very sore lamentation; and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

fresh_translation: And the inhabitants of the land of Canaan saw the mourning at the threshing-floor of Atad and said, This is a great mourning for the Egyptians. Because of this he called its name Mourning of Egypt, which is beyond the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And the inhabitants of the land of Chanaan saw the mourning at the floor of Atad, and said, This is a great mourning to the Egyptians; therefore he called its name, The mourning of Egypt, which is beyond Jordan.

fresh_translation: And his sons did so for him.
brenton_translation: And thus his sons did to him.

fresh_translation: And his sons carried him up into the land of Canaan and buried him in the double cave, which Abraham acquired as a possession for a tomb from Ephrom the Hittite, before Mambre.
brenton_translation: So his sons carried him up into the land of Chanaan, and buried him in the double cave, which cave Abraam bought for possession of a burying place, of Ephrom the Chettite, before Mambre.

fresh_translation: And Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers and those who went up with him to bury his father.
brenton_translation: And Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brethren, and those that had gone up with him to bury his father.

fresh_translation: And Joseph's brothers, seeing that their father had died, said, Perhaps Joseph will remember evil against us and repay us with repayment for all the evils that we showed against him.
brenton_translation: And when the brethren of Joseph saw that their father was dead, they said, Let us take heed, lest at any time Joseph remember evil against us, and recompense to us all the evils which we have done against him.

fresh_translation: And coming to Joseph they said, Your father adjured before his death, saying,
brenton_translation: And they came to Joseph, and said, Thy father adjured us before his death, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus you will say to Joseph, Forgive them their injustice and their sin, because they showed evil to you. And now accept the injustice of the servants of the God of your father. And Joseph wept while they spoke to him.
brenton_translation: Thus say ye to Joseph, Forgive them their injustice and their sin, forasmuch as they have done thee evil; and now pardon the injustice of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept while they spoke to him.

fresh_translation: And they came to him and said, Here we are, your suppliants.
brenton_translation: And they came to him and said, We, these persons, are thy servants.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to them, Do not fear, for I am God's.
brenton_translation: And Joseph said to them, Fear not, for I am God's.

fresh_translation: You planned against me for evil, but God planned concerning me for good, so that it might happen as today and much people might be fed.
brenton_translation: Ye took counsel against me for evil, but God took counsel for me for good, that the matter might be as it is to-day, and much people might be fed.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Do not fear. I will nourish you and your households. And he comforted them and spoke to their heart.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Fear not, I will maintain you, and your families: and he comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

fresh_translation: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his brothers and all the household of his father, and Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
brenton_translation: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his brethren, and all the family of his father; and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.

fresh_translation: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children to the third generation, and the sons of Machir son of Manasseh were born upon Joseph's thighs.
brenton_translation: And Joseph saw the children of Ephraim to the third generation; and the sons of Machir the son of Manasse were borne on the sides of Joseph.

fresh_translation: And Joseph said to his brothers, saying, I am dying. But with visitation God will visit you and bring you up out of this land to the land that God swore to our fathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Joseph spoke to his brethren, saying, I die, and God will surely visit you, and will bring you out of this land to the land concerning which God sware to our fathers, Abraam, Isaac, and Jacob.

fresh_translation: And Joseph adjured the sons of Israel, saying, In the visitation with which God will visit you, then you will carry up my bones from here with you.
brenton_translation: And Joseph adjured the sons of Israel, saying, At the visitation with which God shall visit you, then ye shall carry up my bones hence with you.

fresh_translation: And Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they prepared him and put him in the coffin in Egypt.
brenton_translation: And Joseph died, aged an hundred and ten years; and they prepared his corpse, and put him in a coffin in Egypt.

fresh_translation: These are the names of the sons of Israel who entered into Egypt with Jacob their father; each entered with his whole household.
brenton_translation: These are the names of the sons of Israel that came into Egypt together with Jacob their father; they came in each with their whole family.

fresh_translation: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah,
brenton_translation: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Judas,

fresh_translation: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
brenton_translation: Issachar, Zabulon, Benjamin,

fresh_translation: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
brenton_translation: Dan and Nephthalim, Gad and Aser.

fresh_translation: But Joseph was in Egypt. And all the persons from Jacob were seventy-five.
brenton_translation: But Joseph was in Egypt. And all the souls born of Jacob were seventy-five.

fresh_translation: And Joseph died, and all his brothers, and all that generation.
brenton_translation: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

fresh_translation: But the sons of Israel increased and multiplied and became numerous, and they grew exceedingly, exceedingly strong; and the land multiplied them.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel increased and multiplied, and became numerous and grew exceedingly strong, and the land multiplied them.

fresh_translation: Then another king arose over Egypt who did not know Joseph.
brenton_translation: And there arose up another king over Egypt, who knew not Joseph.

fresh_translation: And he said to his people, 'Look, the race of the sons of Israel is a great multitude and stronger than we are.'
brenton_translation: And he said to his nation, Behold, the race of the children of Israel is a great multitude, and is stronger than we:

fresh_translation: Come then, let us deal shrewdly with them, lest they multiply, and whenever war comes upon us, they too will be added to our enemies and fight against us and depart from the land.
brenton_translation: come then, let us deal craftily with them, lest at any time they be increased, and whensoever war shall happen to us, these also shall be added to our enemies, and having prevailed against us in war, they will depart out of the land.

fresh_translation: So he set over them overseers of labor to afflict them in their labors; and they built fortified cities for Pharaoh: Pithom, Ramesses, and On, which is Heliopolis.
brenton_translation: And he set over them task-masters, who should afflict them in their works; and they built strong cities for Pharao, both Pitho, and Ramesses, and On, which is Heliopolis.

fresh_translation: But as much as they humbled them, so much more they became many and grew exceedingly, exceedingly strong, and the Egyptians were disgusted by the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: But as they humbled them, by so much they multiplied, and grew exceedingly strong; and the Egyptians greatly abhorred the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Egyptians oppressed the sons of Israel by force.
brenton_translation: And the Egyptians tyrannised over the children of Israel by force.

fresh_translation: And they made their life bitter with hard labors, in clay and in brick-making and in every field-labor, according to all the work by which they enslaved them with violence.
brenton_translation: And they embittered their life by hard labours, in the clay and in brick-making, and all the works in the plains, according to all the works, wherein they caused them to serve with violence.

fresh_translation: And the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives; the name of the one was Sepphora, and the name of the second, Phua.
brenton_translation: And the king of the Egyptians spoke to the midwives of the Hebrews; the name of the one was, Sepphora; and the name of the second, Phua.

fresh_translation: And he said, 'When you serve as midwives for the Hebrew women and they are at the time of giving birth, if it is a male, kill it; but if a female, keep it alive.'
brenton_translation: And he said, When ye do the office of midwives to the Hebrew women, and they are about to be delivered, if it be a male, kill it; but if a female, save it.

fresh_translation: But the midwives feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt ordered them, and they kept the male children alive.
brenton_translation: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt appointed them; and they saved the male children alive.

fresh_translation: So the king of Egypt called the midwives and said to them, 'Why have you done this thing and kept the male children alive?'
brenton_translation: And the king of Egypt called the midwives, and said to them, Why is it that ye have done this thing, and saved the male children alive?

fresh_translation: And the midwives said to Pharaoh, 'The Hebrew women are not like the women of Egypt, for before the midwives can go in to them, they give birth.'
brenton_translation: And the midwives said to Pharao, The Hebrew women are not as the women of Egypt, for they are delivered before the midwives go in to them. So they bore children.

fresh_translation: And God did well to the midwives, and the people multiplied and grew very strong.
brenton_translation: And God did well to the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very strong.

fresh_translation: And because the midwives feared God, they established households for themselves.
brenton_translation: And as the midwives feared God, they established for themselves families.

fresh_translation: Then Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, 'Every male that is born to the Hebrews, throw it into the river; but keep every female alive.'
brenton_translation: And Pharao charged all his people, saying, Whatever male child shall be born to the Hebrews, cast into the river; and every female, save it alive.

fresh_translation: Now a certain man from the tribe of Levi went and took one of the daughters of Levi.
brenton_translation: And there was a certain man of the tribe of Levi, who took to wife one of the daughters of Levi.

fresh_translation: And she conceived and bore a male child, and seeing that he was beautiful, they hid him three months.
brenton_translation: And she conceived, and bore a male child; and having seen that he was fair, they hid him three months.

fresh_translation: But when they could no longer hide him, his mother took for him a basket and coated it with bitumen and pitch, and she put the child into it and set it in the reeds by the river.
brenton_translation: And when they could no longer hide him, his mother took for him an ark, and besmeared it with bitumen, and cast the child into it, and put it in the ooze by the river.

fresh_translation: And his sister kept watch from a distance to learn what would happen to him.
brenton_translation: And his sister was watching from a distance, to learn what would happen to him.

fresh_translation: Then Pharaoh's daughter came down to bathe at the river, and her young women were walking along beside the river. Seeing the basket in the reeds, she sent her maid and took it.
brenton_translation: And the daughter of Pharao came down to the river to bathe; and her maids walked by the river's side, and having seen the ark in the ooze, she sent her maid, and took it up.

fresh_translation: And when she opened it, she sees a child crying in the basket. And Pharaoh's daughter had compassion on him and said, 'This is one of the Hebrews' children.'
brenton_translation: And having opened it, she sees the babe weeping in the ark: and the daughter of Pharao had compassion on it, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.

fresh_translation: Then his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter, 'Do you want me to call a nursing woman from the Hebrews, and she will nurse the child for you?'
brenton_translation: And his sister said to the daughter of Pharao, Wilt thou that I call to thee a nurse of the Hebrews, and shall she suckle the child for thee?

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, 'Go.' So the young woman went and called the child's mother.
brenton_translation: And the daughter of Pharao said, Go: and the young woman went, and called the mother of the child.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, 'Keep this child for me and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.' So the woman took the child and nursed him.
brenton_translation: And the daughter of Pharao said to her, Take care of this child, and suckle it for me, and I will give thee the wages; and the woman took the child, and suckled it.

fresh_translation: And when the child grew strong, she brought him to Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses, saying, 'For I drew him out of the water.'
brenton_translation: And when the boy was grown, she brought him to the daughter of Pharao, and he became her son; and she called his name, Moses, saying, I took him out of the water.

fresh_translation: Now in those many days, when Moses had grown great, he went out to his brothers, the sons of Israel. And observing their hardship, he saw an Egyptian striking a certain Hebrew, one of his own brothers from the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in that length of time, that Moses having grown, went out to his brethren the sons of Israel: and having noticed their distress, he sees an Egyptian smiting a certain Hebrew of his brethren the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And looking this way and that way, he saw no one, so he struck the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
brenton_translation: And having looked round this way and that way, he sees no one; and he smote the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

fresh_translation: And going out on the second day, he saw two Hebrew men fighting, and he says to the one doing wrong, 'Why are you striking your neighbor?'
brenton_translation: And having gone out the second day he sees two Hebrew men fighting; and he says to the injurer, Wherefore smitest thou thy neighbour?

fresh_translation: But he said, 'Who made you ruler and judge over us? Do you mean to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?' Then Moses became afraid and said, 'So then this matter has become known.'
brenton_translation: And he said, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us? wilt thou slay me as thou yesterday slewest the Egyptian? Then Moses was alarmed, and said, If it be thus, this matter has become known.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh heard this matter and sought to kill Moses. But Moses withdrew from Pharaoh's face and lived in the land of Midian. And when he came into the land of Midian, he sat by the well.
brenton_translation: And Pharao heard this matter, and sought to slay Moses; and Moses departed from the presence of Pharao, and dwelt in the land of Madiam; and having come into the land of Madiam, he sat on the well.

fresh_translation: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, tending the flock of their father Jothor. And when they came, they drew water until they filled the troughs to water the flock of their father Jothor.
brenton_translation: And the priest of Madiam had seven daughters, feeding the flock of their father Jothor; and they came and drew water until they filled their pitchers, to water the flock of their father Jothor.

fresh_translation: But when the shepherds came, they drove them away. Then Moses rose and rescued them, and he drew water for them and watered their flock.
brenton_translation: And the shepherds came, and were driving them away; and Moses rose up and rescued them, and drew water for them, and watered their sheep.

fresh_translation: Then they came to Raguel their father, and he said to them, 'Why have you come so quickly today?'
brenton_translation: And they came to Raguel their father; and he said to them, Why have ye come so quickly to-day?

fresh_translation: And they said, 'An Egyptian man rescued us from the shepherds, and he also drew water for us and watered our flock.'
brenton_translation: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us from the shepherds, and drew water for us and watered our sheep.

fresh_translation: And he said to his daughters, 'Then where is he? And why have you left the man like this? Call him then, so that he may eat bread.'
brenton_translation: And he said to his daughters, And where is he? and why have ye left the man? call him therefore, that he may eat bread.

fresh_translation: And Moses settled with the man, and he gave Sepphora his daughter to Moses as a wife.
brenton_translation: And Moses was established with the man, and he gave Sepphora his daughter to Moses to wife.

fresh_translation: And the woman conceived and bore a son, and Moses called his name Gersam, saying, 'Because I am a sojourner in a foreign land.'
brenton_translation: And the woman conceived and bore a son, and Moses called his name Gersam, saying, I am a sojourner in a strange land.

fresh_translation: Now after those many days the king of Egypt died, and the sons of Israel groaned from the labors and cried out, and their cry went up to God from the labors.
brenton_translation: And in those days after a length of time, the king of Egypt died; and the children of Israel groaned because of their tasks, and cried, and their cry because of their tasks went up to God.

fresh_translation: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.
brenton_translation: And God heard their groanings, and God remembered his covenant made with Abraam and Isaac and Jacob.

fresh_translation: And God saw the sons of Israel and was made known to them.
brenton_translation: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and was made known to them.

fresh_translation: Now Moses was shepherding the flock of Jothor his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock into the wilderness and came to Mount Horeb.
brenton_translation: And Moses was feeding the flock of Jothor his father-in-law, the priest of Madiam; and he brought the sheep nigh to the wilderness, and came to the mount of Choreb.

fresh_translation: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the bush. And he saw that the bush burned with fire, but the bush was not being consumed.
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord appeared to him in flaming fire out of the bush, and he sees that the bush burns with fire,—but the bush was not consumed.

fresh_translation: And Moses said, 'I will go over now and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned up.'
brenton_translation: And Moses said, I will go near and see this great sight, why the bush is not consumed.

fresh_translation: And when the Lord saw that he was coming near to see, the Lord called to him from the bush, saying, 'Moses, Moses.' And he said, 'What is it?'
brenton_translation: And when the Lord saw that he drew nigh to see, the Lord called him out of the bush, saying, Moses, Moses; and he said, What is it?

fresh_translation: And he said, 'Do not come near here. Untie your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you stand is holy ground.'
brenton_translation: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: loose thy sandals from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, 'I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob.' Then Moses turned away his face, for he feared to gaze before God.
brenton_translation: And he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraam, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob; and Moses turned away his face, for he was afraid to gaze at God.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, 'I have surely seen the affliction of my people in Egypt, and I have heard their cry from the taskmasters, for I know their pain.'
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and I have heard their cry caused by their task-masters; for I know their affliction.

fresh_translation: And I have come down to take them out from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them out of that land into a good and broad land, into a land flowing with milk and honey, into the place of the Canaanites and Hittites and Amorites and Perizzites and Girgashites and Hivites and Jebusites.
brenton_translation: And I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them out of that land, and to bring them into a good and wide land, into a land flowing with milk and honey, into the place of the Chananites, and the Chettites, and Amorites, and Pherezites, and Gergesites, and Evites, and Jebusites.

fresh_translation: And now, look, the cry of the sons of Israel has come to me, and I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come to me, and I have seen the affliction with which the Egyptians afflict them.

fresh_translation: And now come, I will send you to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and you shall bring out my people, the sons of Israel, from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And now come, I will send thee to Pharao king of Egypt, and thou shalt bring out my people the children of Israel from the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to God, 'Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh king of Egypt and that I should bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt?'
brenton_translation: And Moses said to God, Who am I, that I should go to Pharao king of Egypt, and that I should bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt?

fresh_translation: And God said to Moses, saying, 'For I will be with you, and this will be the sign for you that I am the one sending you: when you bring out my people from Egypt, you will serve God on this mountain.'
brenton_translation: And God spoke to Moses, saying, I will be with thee, and this shall be the sign to thee that I shall send thee forth,—when thou bringest out my people out of Egypt, then ye shall serve God in this mountain.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to God, 'Look, I will come to the sons of Israel and say to them, The God of your fathers has sent me to you. And they will ask me, What is his name? What should I say to them?'
brenton_translation: And Moses said to God, Behold, I shall go forth to the children of Israel, and shall say to them, The God of our fathers has sent me to you; and they will ask me, What is his name? What shall I say to them?

fresh_translation: And God said to Moses, 'I am the One who is.' And he said, 'Thus shall you say to the sons of Israel: The One who is has sent me to you.'
brenton_translation: And God spoke to Moses, saying, I am THE BEING; and he said, Thus shall ye say to the children of Israel, THE BEING has sent me to you.

fresh_translation: And God said again to Moses, 'Thus shall you say to the sons of Israel: The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you. This is my eternal name and my memorial from generation to generation.'
brenton_translation: And God said again to Moses, Thus shalt thou say to the sons of Israel, The Lord God of our fathers, the God of Abraam, and God of Isaac, and God of Jacob, has sent me to you: this is my name for ever, and my memorial to generations of generations.

fresh_translation: Go then, gather the elders of the sons of Israel and say to them, 'The Lord, the God of your fathers, has appeared to me, the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, saying, I have surely visited you and the things that have happened to you in Egypt.'
brenton_translation: Go then and gather the elders of the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, The Lord God of our fathers has appeared to me, the God of Abraam, and God of Isaac, and God of Jacob, saying, I have surely looked upon you, and upon all the things which have happened to you in Egypt.

fresh_translation: And I said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of the Egyptians into the land of the Canaanites and Hittites and Amorites and Perizzites and Girgashites and Hivites and Jebusites, into a land flowing with milk and honey.
brenton_translation: And he said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of the Egyptians to the land of the Chananites and the Chettites, and Amorites and Pherezites, and Gergesites, and Evites, and Jebusites, to a land flowing with milk and honey.

fresh_translation: And they will listen to your voice, and you and the elders of Israel shall go in to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and you shall say to him, 'The God of the Hebrews has summoned us. Let us go then a journey of three days into the wilderness so that we may sacrifice to our God.'
brenton_translation: And they shall hearken to thy voice, and thou and the elders of Israel shall go in to Pharao king of Egypt, and thou shalt say to him, The God of the Hebrews has called us; we will go then a journey of three days into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to our God.

fresh_translation: But I know that Pharaoh king of Egypt will not let you go, except under a mighty hand.
brenton_translation: But I know that Pharao king of Egypt will not let you go, save with a mighty hand;

fresh_translation: And stretching out my hand, I will strike the Egyptians with all my wonders that I will do among them, and after these things he will send you out.
brenton_translation: and I will stretch out my hand, and smite the Egyptians with all my wonders, which I shall work among them, and after that he will send you forth.

fresh_translation: And I will give favor to this people before the Egyptians, and when you depart, you will not depart empty.
brenton_translation: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, and whenever ye shall escape, ye shall not depart empty.

fresh_translation: Each woman shall ask from her neighbor and her fellow-dweller articles of silver and gold and clothing, and you shall put them on your sons and on your daughters, and you shall plunder the Egyptians.
brenton_translation: But every woman shall ask of her neighbour and fellow lodger, articles of gold and silver, and apparel; and ye shall put them upon your sons and upon your daughters,—and spoil ye the Egyptians.

fresh_translation: And Moses answered and said, 'What if they do not believe me or listen to my voice? For they will say, God has not appeared to you. What shall I say to them?'
