brenton_translation: his master shall bring him to the judgment-seat of God, and then shall he bring him to the door,—to the door-post, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him for ever.

fresh_translation: If someone sells his own daughter as a household servant, she shall not go out as the female servants go out.
brenton_translation: And if any one sell his daughter as a domestic, she shall not depart as the maid-servants depart.

fresh_translation: If she does not please her master, to whom she had been promised, he shall let her be redeemed. He has no authority to sell her to a foreign nation, because he has broken faith with her.
brenton_translation: If she be not pleasing to her master, after she has betrothed herself to him, he shall let her go free; but he is not at liberty to sell her to a foreign nation, because he has trifled with her.

fresh_translation: But if he promises her to his son, he shall treat her according to the right of daughters.
brenton_translation: And if he should have betrothed her to his son, he shall do to her according to the right of daughters.

fresh_translation: But if he takes another woman for himself, he shall not deprive her of what is needed, or of clothing, or of her companionship.
brenton_translation: And if he take another to himself, he shall not deprive her of necessaries and her apparel, and her companionship with him.

fresh_translation: But if he does not do these three things for her, she shall go out free, without money.
brenton_translation: And if he will not do these three things to her, she shall go out free without money.

fresh_translation: If someone strikes a person and he dies, let him certainly be put to death.
brenton_translation: And if any man smite another and he die, let him be certainly put to death.

fresh_translation: But if he did not do it willingly, and God delivered him into his hands, I will give you a place where the killer may flee.
brenton_translation: But as for him that did it not willingly, but God delivered him into his hands, I will give thee a place whither the slayer may flee.

fresh_translation: But if someone attacks his neighbor to kill him with deceit, and he flees to my altar, you shall take him from there to put him to death.
brenton_translation: And if any one lie in wait for his neighbour to slay him by craft, and he go for refuge, thou shalt take him from my altar to put him to death.

fresh_translation: Whoever strikes his father or his mother, let him certainly be put to death.
brenton_translation: Whoever smites his father or his mother, let him be certainly put to death.

fresh_translation: Whoever reviles his father or his mother shall surely die.
brenton_translation: He that reviles his father or his mother shall surely die.

fresh_translation: Whoever steals one of the sons of Israel, and after overpowering him sells him, and he is found in his hand, let him certainly be put to death.
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall steal one of the children of Israel, and prevail over him and sell him, and he be found with him, let him certainly die.

fresh_translation: If two men revile each other and one strikes his neighbor with a stone or with his fist and he does not die but is laid in bed,
brenton_translation: And if two men revile each other and smite the one the other with a stone or his fist, and he die not, but be laid upon his bed;

fresh_translation: if the man rises and walks about outside on his staff, the one who struck him shall be clear. Yet he shall pay for his idleness and for his healing.
brenton_translation: if the man arise and walk abroad on his staff, he that smote him shall be clear; only he shall pay for his loss of time, and for his healing.

fresh_translation: If someone strikes his male servant or his female servant with a rod and the servant dies under his hands, let justice be exacted.
brenton_translation: And if a man smite his man-servant or his maid-servant, with a rod, and the party die under his hands, he shall be surely punished.

fresh_translation: But if the servant lives a day or two, he shall not be avenged, for he is his money.
brenton_translation: But if the servant continue to live a day or two, let not the master be punished; for he is his money.

fresh_translation: If two men fight and strike a pregnant woman, and her child comes out not yet formed, he shall pay a penalty according as the woman's husband lays upon him. He shall pay with assessment.
brenton_translation: And if two men strive and smite a woman with child, and her child be born imperfectly formed, he shall be forced to pay a penalty: as the woman's husband may lay upon him, he shall pay with a valuation.

fresh_translation: But if it is formed, he shall give life for life,
brenton_translation: But if it be perfectly formed, he shall give life for life,

fresh_translation: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
brenton_translation: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

fresh_translation: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
brenton_translation: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

fresh_translation: If someone strikes the eye of his servant or the eye of his female servant and blinds it, he shall send them out free for their eye.
brenton_translation: And if one smite the eye of his man-servant, or the eye of his maid-servant, and put it out, he shall let them go free for their eye's sake.

fresh_translation: And if he knocks out the tooth of his servant or the tooth of his female servant, he shall send them out free for their tooth.
brenton_translation: And if he should smite out the tooth of his man-servant, or the tooth of his maid-servant, he shall send them away free for their tooth's sake.

fresh_translation: If a bull gores a man or a woman and they die, the bull shall be stoned with stones, and its flesh shall not be eaten. But the bull's owner shall be clear.
brenton_translation: And if a bull gore a man or woman and they die, the bull shall be stoned with stones, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall be clear.

fresh_translation: But if the bull has been a gorer since yesterday and the third day, and they have testified to its owner and he has not confined it, and it kills a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also die.
brenton_translation: But if the bull should have been given to goring in former time, and men should have told his owner, and he have not removed him, but he should have slain a man or woman, the bull shall be stoned, and his owner shall die also.

fresh_translation: But if a ransom is laid upon him, he shall give a ransom for his life, whatever they lay upon him.
brenton_translation: And if a ransom should be imposed on him, he shall pay for the ransom of his soul as much as they shall lay upon him.

fresh_translation: If it gores a son or a daughter, they shall do to him according to this ordinance.
brenton_translation: And if the bull gore a son or daughter, let them do to him according to this ordinance.

fresh_translation: But if the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, he shall give thirty silver didrachms to their master, and the bull shall be stoned.
brenton_translation: And if the bull gore a man-servant or maid-servant, he shall pay to their master thirty silver didrachms, and the bull shall be stoned.

fresh_translation: If someone opens a pit or quarries a pit and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls in there,
brenton_translation: And if any one open a pit or dig a cavity in stone, and cover it not, and an ox or an ass fall in there,

fresh_translation: the owner of the pit shall make compensation. He shall give silver to their owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
brenton_translation: the owner of the pit shall make compensation; he shall give money to their owner, and the dead shall be his own.

fresh_translation: If one person's bull gores the bull of his neighbor and it dies, they shall sell the living bull and divide its silver, and they shall divide the dead one.
brenton_translation: And if any man's bull gore the bull of his neighbour, and it die, they shall sell the living bull and divide the money, and they shall divide the dead bull.

fresh_translation: But if it is known that the bull has been a gorer since yesterday and the third day, and testimony had been made to its owner, and he did not confine it, he shall repay bull for bull, and the dead one shall be his.
brenton_translation: But if the bull be known to have been given to goring in time past, and they have testified to his owner, and he have not removed him, he shall repay bull for bull, but the dead shall be his own.

fresh_translation: If someone steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it, he shall repay five oxen for the ox and four sheep for the sheep.
brenton_translation: And if one steal an ox or a sheep, and kill it or sell it, he shall pay five calves for a calf, and four sheep for a sheep.

fresh_translation: If the thief is found in the breach and is struck and dies, there is no bloodguilt for him.
brenton_translation: And if the thief be found in the breach made by himself and be smitten and die, there shall not be blood shed for him.

fresh_translation: But if the sun rises on him, there is guilt. He shall die in return. But if he has nothing, let him be sold for what was stolen.
brenton_translation: But if the sun be risen upon him, he is guilty, he shall die instead; and if a thief have nothing, let him be sold in compensation for what he has stolen.

fresh_translation: If the stolen thing is found alive in his hand, whether donkey or sheep, he shall repay them double.
brenton_translation: And if the thing stolen be left and be in his hand alive, whether ox or sheep, he shall restore them two-fold.

fresh_translation: If someone lets a field or vineyard be grazed and lets his beast graze another field, he shall repay from his own field according to its produce. But if it grazes the whole field, he shall repay the best of his own field and the best of his vineyard.
brenton_translation: And if any one should feed down a field or a vineyard, and should send in his beast to feed down another field, he shall make compensation of his own field according to his produce; and if he shall have fed down the whole field, he shall pay for compensation the best of his own field and the best of his vineyard.

fresh_translation: If fire goes out and finds thorns and sets aflame a threshing floor or sheaves or a field, the one who kindled the fire shall make repayment.
brenton_translation: And if fire have gone forth and caught thorns, and should also set on fire threshing-floors or ears of corn or a field, he that kindled the fire shall make compensation.

fresh_translation: If someone gives his neighbor silver or goods to keep, and it is stolen from the man's house, if the thief is found, he shall repay double.
brenton_translation: And if any one give to his neighbour money or goods to keep, and they be stolen out of the man's house, if the thief be found, he shall repay double.

fresh_translation: But if the thief is not found, the master of the house shall come before God and swear that he has surely not acted wickedly against any part of his neighbor's deposit.
brenton_translation: But if the thief be not found, the master of the house shall come forward before God, and shall swear that surely he has not wrought wickedly in regard of any part of his neighbour's deposit,

fresh_translation: In every matter of wrongdoing, concerning an ox and a beast of burden and a sheep and a garment and every alleged loss, whatever it may be, the judgment of both shall come before God, and the one convicted through God shall repay double to his neighbor.
brenton_translation: according to every injury alleged, both concerning a calf, and an ass, and a sheep, and a garment, and every alleged loss, whatsoever in fact it may be,—the judgment of both shall proceed before God, and he that is convicted by God shall repay to his neighbour double.

fresh_translation: If someone gives his neighbor a beast of burden or an ox or a sheep or any livestock to keep, and it is injured or dies or is taken captive, and no one knows,
brenton_translation: And if any one give to his neighbour to keep a calf or sheep or any beast, and it be wounded or die or be taken, and no one know,

fresh_translation: an oath of God shall be between both of them, that he surely has not acted wickedly against any part of his neighbor's deposit. So its owner shall accept it, and he shall not repay.
brenton_translation: an oath of God shall be between both, each swearing that he has surely not at all been guilty in the matter of his neighbour's deposit; and so his master shall hold him guiltless, and he shall not make compensation.

fresh_translation: But if it is stolen from him, he shall repay its owner.
brenton_translation: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make compensation to the owner.

fresh_translation: But if it becomes beast-torn, he shall bring it as evidence of the prey, and he shall not repay.
brenton_translation: And if it be seized of beasts, he shall bring him to witness the prey, and he shall not make compensation.

fresh_translation: If someone borrows from his neighbor, and it is injured or dies or is taken captive, and its owner is not with it, he shall repay.
brenton_translation: And if any one borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be wounded or die or be carried away, and the owner of it be not with it, he shall make compensation.

fresh_translation: But if the owner is with it, he shall not repay. But if it is hired, it shall stand for its hire.
brenton_translation: But if the owner be with it, he shall not make compensation: but if it be a hired thing, there shall be a compensation to him instead of his hire.

fresh_translation: If someone entices an unbetrothed virgin and lies with her, he shall surely pay the bride-price and take her as wife for himself.
brenton_translation: And if any one deceive a virgin that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her for a wife to himself.

fresh_translation: But if her father utterly refuses and does not wish to give her to him as wife, he shall pay silver to her father according to the bride-price of virgins.
brenton_translation: And if her father positively refuse, and will not consent to give her to him for a wife, he shall pay compensation to her father according to the amount of the dowry of virgins.

fresh_translation: You shall not preserve sorcerers alive.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not save the lives of sorcerers.

fresh_translation: Everyone who lies with an animal, you shall certainly put them to death.
brenton_translation: Every one that lies with a beast ye shall surely put to death.

fresh_translation: The one sacrificing to gods shall be destroyed by death, except to the Lord alone.
brenton_translation: He that sacrifices to any gods but to the Lord alone, shall be destroyed by death.

fresh_translation: You shall not mistreat a newcomer, nor oppress him, for you were newcomers in the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not hurt a stranger, nor afflict him; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: You shall mistreat no widow or orphan.
brenton_translation: Ye shall hurt no widow or orphan.

fresh_translation: But if by evil-treatment you mistreat them, and crying out they cry to me, I will surely hear their voice.
brenton_translation: And if ye should afflict them by ill-treatment, and they should cry aloud to me, I will surely hear their voice.

fresh_translation: And I will become angry with wrath and kill you with the sword, and your wives shall be widows and your children orphans.
brenton_translation: And I will be very angry, and will slay you with the sword, and your wives shall be widows and your children orphans.

fresh_translation: If you lend silver to your poor brother beside you, you shall not press him hard, nor lay interest upon him.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest lend money to thy poor brother who is by thee, thou shalt not be hard upon him, thou shalt not exact usury of him.

fresh_translation: If you take your neighbor's garment as a pledge, you shall give it back to him before sunset.
brenton_translation: And if thou take thy neighbour's garment for a pledge, thou shalt restore it to him before sunset.

fresh_translation: For this alone is his covering; this is the garment of his nakedness. In what shall he sleep? So if he cries out to me, I will hear him, for I am merciful.
brenton_translation: For this is his clothing, this is the only covering of his nakedness; wherein shall he sleep? If then he shall cry to me, I will hearken to him, for I am merciful.

fresh_translation: You shall not revile gods, and you shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor speak ill of the ruler of thy people.

fresh_translation: You shall not delay the firstfruits of your threshing floor and your winepress. You shall give me the firstborn of your sons.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not keep back the first-fruits of thy threshing floor and press. The first-born of thy sons thou shalt give to me.

fresh_translation: So you shall do with your ox and your sheep and your beast of burden. Seven days it shall be under its mother, and on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
brenton_translation: So shalt thou do with thy calf and thy sheep and thine ass; seven days shall it be under the mother, and the eighth day thou shalt give it to me.

fresh_translation: And you shall be holy men to me, and you shall not eat flesh torn by beasts; you shall throw it to the dog.
brenton_translation: And ye shall be holy men to me; and ye shall not eat flesh taken of beasts, ye shall cast it to the dog.

fresh_translation: You shall not accept a vain report. You shall not join with the unjust to become an unjust witness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not receive a vain report: thou shalt not agree with the unjust man to become an unjust witness.

fresh_translation: You shall not be with the many for evil. You shall not side with a crowd to turn aside with the many so as to bend justice.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not associate with the multitude for evil; thou shalt not join thyself with a multitude to turn aside with the majority so as to shut out judgment.

fresh_translation: And you shall not spare a poor man in judgment.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not spare a poor man in judgment.

fresh_translation: If you meet your enemy's ox or his beast of burden wandering, you shall surely turn it back and return it to him.
brenton_translation: And if thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt turn them back and restore them to him.

fresh_translation: If you see your enemy's beast of burden fallen under its load, you shall not pass it by, but you shall help raise it with him.
brenton_translation: And if thou see thine enemy's ass fallen under its burden, thou shalt not pass by it, but shalt help to raise it with him.

fresh_translation: You shall not pervert the judgment of a poor man in his case.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not wrest the sentence of the poor in his judgment.

fresh_translation: Keep far from every unjust word. You shall not kill the innocent and the righteous, and you shall not justify the ungodly for gifts.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt abstain from every unjust thing: thou shalt not slay the innocent and just, and thou shalt not justify the wicked for gifts.

fresh_translation: You shall not take gifts, for gifts blind the eyes of those who see and destroy just words.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not receive gifts; for gifts blind the eyes of the seeing, and corrupt just words.

fresh_translation: You shall not oppress a newcomer, for you know the soul of the newcomer, because you were newcomers in the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not afflict a stranger, for ye know the heart of a stranger; for ye were yourselves strangers in the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: Six years you shall sow your land and gather its produce.
brenton_translation: Six years thou shalt sow thy land, and gather in the fruits of it.

fresh_translation: But in the seventh you shall make a release and let it rest, and the poor of your nation shall eat, and what they leave the wild beasts shall eat. So you shall do with your vineyard and your oliveyard.
brenton_translation: But in the seventh year thou shalt let it rest, and leave it, and the poor of thy nation shall feed; and the wild beasts of the field shall eat that which remains: thus shalt thou do to thy vineyard and to thine oliveyard.

fresh_translation: Six days you shall do your works, but on the seventh day there shall be rest, so that your ox and your beast of burden may rest, and the son of your female servant and the newcomer may be refreshed.
brenton_translation: Six days shalt thou do thy works, and on the seventh day there shall be rest, that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and that the son of thy maid-servant and the stranger may be refreshed.

fresh_translation: Guard all that I have said to you, and you shall not mention the name of other gods, nor shall it be heard from your mouth.
brenton_translation: Observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you; and ye shall make no mention of the name of other gods, neither shall they be heard out of your mouth.

fresh_translation: Three times of the year celebrate a feast to me.
brenton_translation: Keep ye a feast to me three times in the year.

fresh_translation: Keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I commanded you, at the time of the month of new grain, for in it you came out from Egypt. You shall not appear before me empty.
brenton_translation: Take heed to keep the feast of unleavened bread: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread, as I charged thee at the season of the month of new corn, for in it thou camest out of Egypt: thou shalt not appear before me empty.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep the feast of harvest of the first produce of your labors, whatever you sow in your field, and the feast of completion at the going out of the year, in the gathering of your labors from your field.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt keep the feast of the harvest of first-fruits of thy labours, whatsoever thou shalt have sown in thy field, and the feast of completion at the end of the year in the gathering in of thy fruits out of thy field.

fresh_translation: Three times of the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: For when I cast out nations from before you and widen your borders, you shall not sacrifice the blood of my sacrifice with leaven, nor shall the fat of my feast lie down until morning.
brenton_translation: For when I shall have cast out the nations from before thee, and shall have widened thy borders, thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven, neither must the fat of my feast abide till the morning.

fresh_translation: You shall bring the firstfruits of the first produce of your land into the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother's milk.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt bring the first-offerings of the first-fruits of thy land into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a lamb in its mother's milk.

fresh_translation: And behold, I send my angel before your face to keep you on the way, so that he may bring you into the land that I have prepared for you.
brenton_translation: And, behold, I send my angel before thy face, that he may keep thee in the way, that he may bring thee into the land which I have prepared for thee.

fresh_translation: Pay attention to yourself and listen to him, and do not disobey him, for he will never yield to you, because my name is upon him.
brenton_translation: Take heed to thyself and hearken to him, and disobey him not; for he will not give way to thee, for my name is on him.

fresh_translation: If you truly hear my voice and do all that I command you and keep my covenant, you shall be for me a people of special possession out of all nations, for all the earth is mine. And you shall be for me a royal priesthood and a holy nation. These are the words you shall speak to the sons of Israel. If you truly hear my voice and do all that I say to you, I will be hostile to your enemies and oppose those who oppose you.
brenton_translation: If ye will indeed hear my voice, and if thou wilt do all the things I shall charge thee with, and keep my covenant, ye shall be to me a peculiar people above all nations, for the whole earth is mine; and ye shall be to me a royal priesthood, and a holy nation: these words shall ye speak to the children of Israel, If ye shall indeed hear my voice, and do all the things I shall tell thee, I will be an enemy to thine enemies, and an adversary to thine adversaries.

fresh_translation: For my angel shall go leading you and bring you to the Amorite and Hittite and Perizzite and Canaanite and Girgashite and Hivite and Jebusite, and I will wipe them out.
brenton_translation: For my angel shall go as thy leader, and shall bring thee to the Amorite, and Chettite, and Pherezite, and Chananite, and Gergesite, and Evite, and Jebusite, and I will destroy them.

fresh_translation: You shall not worship their gods, nor serve them. You shall not do according to their works, but by pulling down you shall pull down, and by breaking you shall break their pillars.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not worship their gods, nor serve them: thou shalt not do according to their works, but shalt utterly destroy them, and break to pieces their pillars.

fresh_translation: And you shall serve the Lord your God, and I will bless your bread and your wine and your water, and I will turn sickness away from you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt serve the Lord thy God, and I will bless thy bread and thy wine and thy water, and I will turn away sickness from you.

fresh_translation: None shall be barren or sterile in your land. I will fill up the number of your days.
brenton_translation: There shall not be on thy land one that is impotent or barren. I will surely fulfil the number of thy days.

fresh_translation: And I will send fear ahead of you and throw into confusion all the nations among whom you enter, and I will make all your adversaries flee.
brenton_translation: And I will send terror before thee, and I will strike with amazement all the nations to which thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies to flee.

fresh_translation: And I will send hornets ahead of you, and they shall drive out the Amorites and the Hivites and the Canaanites and the Hittites from before you.
brenton_translation: And I will send hornets before thee, and thou shalt cast out the Amorites and the Evites, and the Chananites and the Chettites from thee.

fresh_translation: I will not drive them out in one year, lest the land become desolate and the beasts of the earth multiply against you.
brenton_translation: I will not cast them out in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the beasts of the field multiply against thee.

fresh_translation: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you increase and inherit the land.
brenton_translation: By little and little I will cast them out from before thee, until thou shalt be increased and inherit the earth.

fresh_translation: And I will set your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the great river Euphrates. And I will give the inhabitants of the land into your hands, and I will drive them out from before you.
brenton_translation: And I will set thy borders from the Red Sea, to the sea of the Phylistines, and from the wilderness to the great river Euphrates; and I will give into your hand those that dwell in the land, and will cast them out from thee.

fresh_translation: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt make no covenant with them and their gods.

fresh_translation: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me. For if you serve their gods, these will be a stumbling block to you.
brenton_translation: And they shall not dwell in thy land, lest they cause thee to sin against me; for if thou shouldest serve their gods, these will be an offence to thee.

fresh_translation: And to Moses he said, "Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron and Nadab and Abihu and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship from far off."
brenton_translation: And to Moses he said, Go up to the Lord, thou and Aaron and Nadab and Abiud, and seventy of the elders of Israel: and they shall worship the Lord from a distance.

fresh_translation: And Moses alone shall come near to God. But they shall not come near, and the people shall not come up with them.
brenton_translation: And Moses alone shall draw nigh to God; and they shall not draw nigh, and the people shall not come up with them.

fresh_translation: And Moses went in and related to the people all the words of God and the ordinances. And all the people answered with one voice, saying, "All the words that the Lord has spoken we will do and we will hear."
brenton_translation: And Moses went in and related to the people all the words of God and the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, saying, All the words which the Lord has spoken, we will do and be obedient.

fresh_translation: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord. Rising early in the morning, Moses built an altar under the mountain, and twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the mountain, and set up twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he sent the young men of the sons of Israel, and they offered whole burnt offerings and sacrificed calves as offerings of salvation to God.
brenton_translation: And he sent forth the young men of the children of Israel, and they offered whole burnt-offerings, and they sacrificed young calves as a peace-offering to God.

fresh_translation: And Moses took half the blood and poured it into bowls, and half the blood he poured out upon the altar.
brenton_translation: And Moses took half the blood and poured it into bowls, and half the blood he poured out upon the altar.

fresh_translation: And taking the book of the covenant, he read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do and we will hear."
brenton_translation: And he took the book of the covenant and read it in the ears of the people, and they said, All things whatsoever the Lord has spoken we will do and hearken therein.

fresh_translation: And Moses took the blood and splashed it on the people and said, "Behold, the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you concerning all these words."
brenton_translation: And Moses took the blood and sprinkled it upon the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has made with you concerning all these words.

fresh_translation: Then Moses and Aaron and Nadab and Abihu and seventy from the council of Israel went up.
brenton_translation: And Moses went up, and Aaron, and Nadab and Abiud, and seventy of the elders of Israel.

fresh_translation: And they saw the place where the God of Israel had stood. And under his feet was like work of sapphire brick, and like the appearance of the firmament of heaven in purity.
brenton_translation: And they saw the place where the God of Israel stood; and under his feet was as it were a work of sapphire slabs, and as it were the appearance of the firmament of heaven in its purity.

fresh_translation: And of the chosen ones of Israel not even one was missing. And they appeared in the place of God, and they ate and drank.
brenton_translation: And of the chosen ones of Israel there was not even one missing, and they appeared in the place of God, and did eat and drink.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain and stay there, and I will give you the stone tablets, the law and the commandments that I wrote to give them law."
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Come up to me into the mountain, and be there; and I will give thee the tables of stone, the law and the commandments, which I have written to give them laws.

fresh_translation: And Moses rose, and Joshua who stood beside him, and they went up into the mountain of God.
brenton_translation: And Moses rose up and Joshua his attendant, and they went up into the mount of God.

fresh_translation: And to the elders they said, "Stay still there until we return to you. And look, Aaron and Hur are with you. If any matter of judgment happens to anyone, let them go to them."
brenton_translation: And to the elders they said, Rest there till we return to you; and behold, Aaron and Or are with you: if any man have a cause to be tried, let them go to them.

fresh_translation: And Moses and Joshua went up into the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
brenton_translation: And Moses and Joshua went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

fresh_translation: And the glory of God came down upon Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day the Lord called Moses from the midst of the cloud.
brenton_translation: And the glory of God came down upon the mount Sina, and the cloud covered it six days; and the Lord called Moses on the seventh day out of the midst of the cloud.

fresh_translation: And the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like burning fire on the top of the mountain before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the appearance of the glory of the Lord was as burning fire on the top of the mountain, before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mountain. And he was there on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
brenton_translation: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and went up to the mountain, and was there in the mountain forty days and forty nights.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: "Tell the sons of Israel to take contributions for me. From everyone whose heart deems it good, you shall take my contributions."
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and take first-fruits of all, who may be disposed in their heart to give; and ye shall take my first-fruits.

fresh_translation: And this is the contribution that you shall take from them: gold and silver and bronze,
brenton_translation: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold and silver and brass,

fresh_translation: and blue and purple and doubled scarlet and spun fine linen and goat hair,
brenton_translation: and blue, and purple, and double scarlet, and fine spun linen, and goats' hair,

fresh_translation: and rams' skins dyed red and blue skins and incorruptible wood,
brenton_translation: and rams' skins dyed red, and blue skins, and incorruptible wood,

fresh_translation: and sardius stones and stones for engraving, for the ephod and the robe.
brenton_translation: and sardius stones, and stones for the carved work of the breast-plate, and the full-length robe.

fresh_translation: And you shall make me a holy place, and I will be seen among you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make me a sanctuary, and I will appear among you.

fresh_translation: And you shall make them for me according to all that I show you on the mountain: the pattern of the tent and the pattern of all its furnishings. So you shall make them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for me according to all things which I shew thee in the mountain; even the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all its furniture: so shalt thou make it.

fresh_translation: And you shall make an ark of testimony of incorruptible wood: two and a half cubits its length, one and a half cubits its breadth, and one and a half cubits its height.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the ark of testimony of incorruptible wood; the length of two cubits and a half, and the breadth of a cubit and a half, and the height of a cubit and a half.

fresh_translation: And you shall overlay it with pure gold. Inside and outside you shall overlay it, and you shall make for it twisted golden moldings all around.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt gild it with pure gold, thou shalt gild it within and without; and thou shalt make for it golden wreaths twisted round about.

fresh_translation: And you shall cast for it four golden rings and place them on its four sides, two rings on one side and two rings on the second side.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt cast for it four golden rings, and shalt put them on the four sides; two rings on the one side, and two rings on the other side.

fresh_translation: And you shall make carrying-poles of incorruptible wood and overlay them with gold.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make staves of incorruptible wood, and shalt gild them with gold.

fresh_translation: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark by them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark with them.

fresh_translation: The poles shall stay fixed in the rings of the ark.
brenton_translation: The staves shall remain fixed in the rings of the ark.

fresh_translation: And you shall put into the ark the testimonies that I shall give you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimonies which I shall give thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a propitiatory lid of pure gold: two and a half cubits its length, and one and a half cubits its breadth.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a propitiatory, a lid of pure gold; the length of two cubits and a half, and the breadth of a cubit and a half.

fresh_translation: And you shall make two cherubim of beaten gold, and you shall place them on both ends of the propitiatory.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make two cherubs graven in gold, and thou shalt put them on both sides of the propitiatory.

fresh_translation: One cherub shall be made on this end and one cherub on the second end of the propitiatory. You shall make the two cherubim on the two ends.
brenton_translation: They shall be made, one cherub on this side, and another cherub on the other side of the propitiatory; and thou shalt make the two cherubs on the two sides.

fresh_translation: And the cherubim shall be stretching out their wings above, overshadowing the propitiatory with their wings, and their faces shall be toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the propitiatory.
brenton_translation: The cherubs shall stretch forth their wings above, overshadowing the propitiatory with their wings; and their faces shall be toward each other, the faces of the cherubs shall be toward the propitiatory.

fresh_translation: And you shall place the propitiatory on top of the ark, and into the ark you shall put the testimonies that I shall give you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt set the propitiatory on the ark above, and thou shalt put into the ark the testimonies which I shall give thee.

fresh_translation: And I will make myself known to you there, and I will speak to you from above the propitiatory, from between the two cherubim that are on the ark of testimony, according to all that I shall command you for the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And I will make myself known to thee from thence, and I will speak to thee above the propitiatory between the two cherubs, which are upon the ark of testimony, even in all things which I shall charge thee concerning the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a table of pure gold: two cubits its length, one cubit its breadth, and one and a half cubits its height.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a golden table of pure gold, in length two cubits, and in breadth a cubit, and in height a cubit and a half.

fresh_translation: And you shall make for it twisted golden moldings all around.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for it golden wreaths twisted round about, and thou shalt make for it a crown of an hand-breadth round about.

fresh_translation: And you shall make for it a rim a handbreadth around it, and you shall make a twisted molding around the rim.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a twisted wreath for the crown round about.

fresh_translation: And you shall make four golden rings and place the rings on the four parts of its feet.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make four golden rings; and thou shalt put the four rings upon the four parts of its feet under the crown.

fresh_translation: The rings shall be under the rim, as holders for the carrying-poles, so that the table may be carried by them.
brenton_translation: And the rings shall be for bearings for the staves, that they may bear the table with them.

fresh_translation: And you shall make the poles of incorruptible wood and overlay them with pure gold, and the table shall be carried by them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the staves of incorruptible wood, and thou shalt gild them with pure gold; and the table shall be borne with them.

fresh_translation: And you shall make its dishes and censers and libation bowls and cups with which you shall pour offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make its dishes and its censers, and its bowls, and its cups, with which thou shalt offer drink-offerings: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

fresh_translation: And you shall set on the table loaves before my face continually.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me continually.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a lampstand of pure gold. Beaten work shall you make the lampstand: its shaft and its branches, its bowls and knobs and lilies shall be from it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold; thou shalt make the candlestick of graven work: its stem and its branches, and its bowls and its knops and its lilies shall be of one piece.

fresh_translation: Six branches shall come out from its sides: three branches of the lampstand from one side and three branches of the lampstand from the second side.
brenton_translation: And six branches proceeding sideways, three branches of the candlestick from one side of it, and three branches of the candlestick from the other side.

fresh_translation: Three almond-shaped bowls on one branch, with knob and lily. So also on the six branches that come out from the lampstand.
brenton_translation: And three bowls fashioned like almonds, on each branch a knop and a lily; so to the six branches proceeding from the candlestick,

fresh_translation: And on the lampstand four almond-shaped bowls, with its knobs and its lilies.
brenton_translation: and in the candlestick four bowls fashioned like almonds, in each branch knops and the flowers of the same.

fresh_translation: A knob under two branches from it, and a knob under four branches from it, so also for the six branches that come out from the lampstand.
brenton_translation: A knop under two branches out of it, and a knop under four branches out of it; so to the six branches proceeding from the candlestick; and in the candlestick four bowls fashioned like almonds.

fresh_translation: Their knobs and their branches shall be from it. All shall be one beaten piece of pure gold.
brenton_translation: Let the knops and the branches be of one piece, altogether graven of one piece of pure gold.

fresh_translation: And you shall make its seven lamps. And you shall set up the lamps, and they shall shine from the one front.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make its seven lamps: and thou shalt set on it the lamps, and they shall shine from one front.

fresh_translation: And you shall make its snuffers and its trays of pure gold.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make its funnel and its snuff-dishes of pure gold.

fresh_translation: All these utensils shall be one talent of pure gold.
brenton_translation: All these articles shall be a talent of pure gold.

fresh_translation: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
brenton_translation: See, thou shalt make them according to the pattern shewed thee in the mount.

fresh_translation: And the tent you shall make with ten curtains of woven fine linen and blue and purple and spun scarlet. You shall make them with cherubim, woven work.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the tabernacle, ten curtains of fine linen spun, and blue and purple, and scarlet spun with cherubs; thou shalt make them with work of a weaver.

fresh_translation: The length of one curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits. One measure shall belong to all the curtains.
brenton_translation: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and one curtain shall be the breadth of four cubits: there shall be the same measure to all the curtains.

fresh_translation: Five curtains shall be joined one to another, and five curtains shall be held together one to another.
brenton_translation: And the five curtains shall be joined one to another, and the other five curtains shall be closely connected the one with the other.

fresh_translation: And you shall make blue loops on the edge of one curtain on one side for the coupling, and so you shall make on the edge of the outer curtain for the second coupling.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for them loops of blue on the edge of one curtain, on one side for the coupling, and so shalt thou make on the edge of the outer curtain for the second coupling.

fresh_translation: Fifty loops you shall make on the one curtain, and fifty loops on the part of the curtain at the coupling of the second, matching one another.
brenton_translation: Fifty loops shalt thou make for one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make on the part of the curtain answering to the coupling of the second, opposite each other, corresponding to each other at each point.

fresh_translation: And you shall make fifty gold clasps and join the curtains one to another with the clasps, and the tent shall be one.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make fifty golden rings; and thou shalt join the curtains to each other with the rings, and it shall be one tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And you shall make goat-hair coverings as a covering over the tent. Eleven coverings you shall make.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for a covering of the tabernacle skins with the hair on, thou shalt make them eleven skins.

fresh_translation: The length of one covering shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one covering four cubits. One measure shall belong to the eleven coverings.
brenton_translation: The length of one skin thirty cubits, and the breadth of one skin four cubits: there shall be the same measure to the eleven skins.

fresh_translation: And you shall join the five coverings together and the six coverings together, and you shall fold the sixth covering over at the front of the tent.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt join the five skins together, and the six skins together; and thou shalt double the sixth skin in front of the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one covering that is in the middle at the joining, and fifty loops on the edge of the second covering that joins it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the border of one skin, which is in the midst for the joinings; and thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the second skin that joins it.

fresh_translation: And you shall make fifty bronze clasps, and you shall join the clasps through the loops and join the coverings, and it shall be one.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make fifty brazen rings; and thou shalt join the rings by the loops, and thou shalt join the skins, and they shall be one.

fresh_translation: And the extra part in the coverings of the tent, the half-covering that remains, you shall let hang over the back of the tent.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt fix at the end that which is over in the skins of the tabernacle; the half of the skin that is left shalt thou fold over, according to the overplus of the skins of the tabernacle; thou shalt fold it over behind the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: A cubit on this side and a cubit on that side, from the excess in the length of the tent coverings, shall hang over the sides of the tent on this side and that side to cover it.
brenton_translation: A cubit on this side, and a cubit on that side of that which remains of the skins, of the length of the skins of the tabernacle: it shall be folding over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and that side, that it may cover it.

fresh_translation: And you shall make for the tent a covering of red-dyed rams' skins, and coverings of blue skins above.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for a covering of the tabernacle rams' skins dyed red, and blue skins as coverings above.

fresh_translation: And you shall make uprights for the tent of incorruptible wood.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the posts of the tabernacle of incorruptible wood.

fresh_translation: Ten cubits shall you make one upright, and one and a half cubits the breadth of one upright.
brenton_translation: Of ten cubits shalt thou make one post, and the breadth of one post of a cubit and a half.

fresh_translation: Two tenons for each upright, corresponding one to another. So you shall do for all the uprights of the tent.
brenton_translation: Two joints shalt thou make in one post, answering the one to the other: so shalt thou do to all the posts of the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And you shall make the uprights for the tent, twenty uprights on the side toward the north.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make posts to the tabernacle, twenty posts on the north side.

fresh_translation: And you shall make forty silver bases for the twenty uprights, two bases for one upright on its two sides and two bases for the next upright on its two sides.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make to the twenty posts forty silver sockets; two sockets to one post on both its sides, and two sockets to the other post on both its sides.

fresh_translation: And on the second side, the side toward the south, twenty uprights.
brenton_translation: And for the next side, toward the south, twenty posts,

fresh_translation: And their forty silver bases, two bases for one upright on its two sides and two bases for the next upright on its two sides.
brenton_translation: and their forty silver sockets: two sockets to one post on both its sides, and two sockets to the other post on both its sides.

fresh_translation: And at the back of the tent, at the side toward the sea, you shall make six uprights.
brenton_translation: And on the back of the tabernacle at the part which is toward the west thou shalt make six posts.

fresh_translation: And you shall make two uprights for the corners of the tent at the back.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make two posts on the corners of the tabernacle behind.

fresh_translation: And they shall be equal below, and together they shall be equal up to the tops for one joining. So you shall make them for both, for the two corners.
brenton_translation: And it shall be equal below, they shall be equal toward the same part from the heads to one joining; so shalt thou make to both the two corners, let them be equal.

fresh_translation: And there shall be eight uprights, and their silver bases sixteen: two bases for one upright on its two sides and two bases for the next upright.
brenton_translation: And there shall be eight posts, and their sixteen silver sockets; two sockets to one post on both its sides, and two sockets to the other post.

fresh_translation: And you shall make bars of incorruptible wood, five for the uprights on one side of the tent,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make bars of incorruptible wood; five to one post on one side of the tabernacle,

fresh_translation: and five bars for the uprights on the second side of the tent, and five bars for the hindmost uprights on the side of the tent toward the sea.
brenton_translation: and five bars to one post on the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars to the hinder posts, on the side of the tabernacle toward the sea.

fresh_translation: And the middle bar, in the midst of the uprights, shall pass through from one side to the other.
brenton_translation: And let the bar in the middle between the posts go through from the one side to the other side.

fresh_translation: And you shall overlay the uprights with gold, and you shall make gold rings into which you shall bring in the bars, and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt gild the posts with gold; and thou shalt make golden rings, into which thou shalt introduce the bars, and thou shalt gild the bars with gold.

fresh_translation: And you shall set up the tent according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shewed thee in the mount.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a curtain of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen. You shall make it with cherubim, woven work.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet woven, and fine linen spun: thou shalt make it cherubs in woven work.

fresh_translation: And you shall place it on four incorruptible posts overlaid with gold, their capitals gold, and their four bases silver.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt set it upon four posts of incorruptible wood overlaid with gold; and their tops shall be gold, and their four sockets shall be of silver.

fresh_translation: And you shall put the curtain on the posts, and within the curtain you shall bring in there the ark of testimony. And the curtain shall divide for you between the Holy Place and the Holy of Holies.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put the veil on the posts, and thou shalt carry in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony; and the veil shall make a separation for you between the holy and the holy of holies.

fresh_translation: And with the curtain you shall cover the ark of testimony in the Holy of Holies.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt screen with the veil the ark of the testimony in the holy of holies.

fresh_translation: And you shall place the table outside the curtain, and the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the tent. And you shall put the table on the north side of the tent.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt set the table outside the veil, and the candlestick opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle; and thou shalt put the table on the north side of the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, embroidered work.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a screen for the door of the tabernacle of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet and fine linen spun, the work of the embroiderer.

fresh_translation: And you shall make for the screen five posts and overlay them with gold, and their capitals gold, and you shall cast for them five bronze bases.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for the veil five posts, and thou shalt gild them with gold; and their chapiters shall be gold; and thou shalt cast for them five brazen sockets.

fresh_translation: And you shall make the altar of incorruptible wood, five cubits its length and five cubits its breadth. The altar shall be square, and its height three cubits.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make an altar of incorruptible wood, of five cubits in the length, and five cubits in the breadth; the altar shall be square, and the height of it shall be of three cubits.

fresh_translation: And you shall make the horns upon its four corners. The horns shall be from it, and you shall cover them with bronze.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the horns on the four corners; the horns shall be of the same piece, and thou shalt overlay them with brass.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a rim for the altar, and its pans and its bowls and its flesh-hooks and its fire-pan. All its utensils you shall make of bronze.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a rim for the altar; and its covering and its cups, and its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pan, and all its vessels shalt thou make of brass.

fresh_translation: And you shall make for it a bronze grate of net-work, and you shall make for the grate four bronze rings on its four sides.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for it a brazen grate with net-work; and thou shalt make for the grate four brazen rings under the four sides.

fresh_translation: And you shall set them under the grate of the altar below, and the grate shall reach to the middle of the altar.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put them below under the grate of the altar, and the grate shall extend to the middle of the altar.

fresh_translation: And you shall make poles for the altar of incorruptible wood, and you shall overlay them with bronze.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for the altar staves of incorruptible wood, and thou shalt overlay them with brass.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring the poles into the rings, and the poles shall be on the sides of the altar when it is carried.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings; and let the staves be on the sides of the altar to carry it.

fresh_translation: Hollow, of boards, you shall make it. According to what was shown you on the mountain, so you shall make it.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt make it hollow with boards: according to what was shewed thee in the mount, so thou shalt make it.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a court for the tent. On the side toward the south wind, hangings of woven fine linen, one hundred cubits long for one side.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a court for the tabernacle, curtains of the court of fine linen spun on the south side, the length of a hundred cubits for one side.

fresh_translation: And their pillars twenty, and their twenty bronze bases, and their hooks and fastenings of silver.
brenton_translation: And their pillars twenty, and twenty brazen sockets for them, and their rings and their clasps of silver.

fresh_translation: So also for the side toward the east wind, hangings one hundred cubits long, and their pillars twenty, and their twenty bronze bases, and the hooks and fastenings of the pillars silver-covered.
brenton_translation: Thus shall there be to the side toward the north curtains of a hundred cubits in length; and their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty of brass, and the rings and the clasps of the pillars, and their sockets overlaid with silver.

fresh_translation: And on the breadth of the court toward the sea, hangings fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their bases ten.
brenton_translation: And in the breadth of the tabernacle toward the west curtains of fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their sockets ten.

fresh_translation: And on the breadth of the court toward the south, hangings fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their bases ten.
brenton_translation: And in the breadth of the tabernacle toward the south, curtains of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

fresh_translation: And the hangings shall be fifteen cubits high on one side, their pillars three and their bases three.
brenton_translation: And the height of the curtains shall be of fifteen cubits for the one side of the gate; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

fresh_translation: And for the second side, fifteen cubits the height of the hangings, their pillars three and their bases three.
brenton_translation: And for the second side the height of the curtains shall be of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

fresh_translation: And for the gate of the court, a screen twenty cubits long, of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, worked by an embroiderer, their pillars four and their bases four.
brenton_translation: And a veil for the door of the court, the height of it of twenty cubits of blue linen, and of purple, and spun scarlet, and of fine linen spun with the art of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

fresh_translation: All the pillars of the court all around silver-covered, their capitals silver, and their bases bronze.
brenton_translation: All the pillars of the court round about overlaid with silver, and their chapiters silver and their brass sockets.

fresh_translation: And the length of the court shall be one hundred by one hundred, and the breadth fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of woven fine linen, and their bases bronze.
brenton_translation: And the length of the court shall be a hundred cubits on each side, and the breadth fifty on each side, and the height five cubits of fine linen spun, and their sockets of brass.

fresh_translation: And all the furnishing and all the implements and the pegs of the court shall be bronze.
brenton_translation: And all the furniture and all the instruments and the pins of the court shall be of brass.

fresh_translation: And you shall charge the sons of Israel, and let them bring you pure beaten olive oil for the light, that a lamp may burn continually.
brenton_translation: And do thou charge the children of Israel, and let them take for thee refined pure olive-oil beaten to burn for light, that a lamp may burn continually

fresh_translation: In the tent of testimony, outside the curtain that is over the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening until morning before the Lord. This is an everlasting ordinance throughout your generations from the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: in the tabernacle of the testimony, without the veil that is before the ark of the covenant, shall Aaron and his sons burn it from evening until morning, before the Lord: it is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And you, bring near to yourself Aaron your brother and his sons with him from among the sons of Israel to serve as priests to me: Aaron and Nadab and Abihu and Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
brenton_translation: And do thou take to thyself both Aaron thy brother, and his sons, even them of the children of Israel; so that Aaron, and Nadab and Abiud, and Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron, may minister to me.

fresh_translation: And you shall make holy apparel for Aaron your brother, for honor and glory.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make holy apparel for Aaron thy brother, for honour and glory.

fresh_translation: And you shall speak to all the wise in mind, whom I have filled with a spirit of perception, and they shall make Aaron's holy apparel for the sanctuary, in which he shall serve as priest to me.
brenton_translation: And speak thou to all those who are wise in understanding, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom and perception; and they shall make the holy apparel of Aaron for the sanctuary, in which apparel he shall minister to me as priest.

fresh_translation: And these are the garments they shall make: the breastpiece and the ephod and the robe and the fringed tunic and the turban and the sash. And they shall make holy garments for Aaron and his sons to serve as priests to me.
brenton_translation: And these are the garments which they shall make: the breast-plate, and the shoulder-piece, and the full-length robe, and the tunic with a fringe, and the tire, and the girdle; and they shall make holy garments for Aaron and his sons to minister to me as priests.

fresh_translation: And they shall take the gold and the blue and the purple and the scarlet and the fine linen.
brenton_translation: And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

fresh_translation: And they shall make the ephod of woven fine linen, work of an embroiderer.
brenton_translation: And they shall make the shoulder-piece of fine linen spun, the woven work of the embroiderer.

fresh_translation: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joined together, fastened on the two sides.
brenton_translation: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joined together, fastened on the two sides.

fresh_translation: And the woven band of the shoulder-pieces that is upon it shall be of one piece with it, of gold and blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen.
brenton_translation: And the woven work of the shoulder-pieces which is upon it, shall be of one piece according to the work, of pure gold and blue and purple, and spun scarlet and fine twined linen.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the two emerald stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take the two stones, the stones of emerald, and thou shalt grave on them the names of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: six names on one stone and the remaining six names on the second stone, according to their births.
brenton_translation: Six names on the first stone, and the other six names on the second stone, according to their births.

fresh_translation: As a stonecutter engraves a seal, so you shall engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: It shall be the work of the stone-engraver's art; as the graving of a seal thou shalt engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And you shall place the two stones on the shoulders of the ephod. They are memorial stones for the sons of Israel. And Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel before the Lord on his two shoulders as a memorial concerning them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put the two stones on the shoulders of the shoulder-piece: they are memorial-stones for the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel before the Lord on his two shoulders, a memorial for them.

fresh_translation: And you shall make settings of pure gold,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make circlets of pure gold;

fresh_translation: and two braided cords of pure gold, mixed in floral work, woven. And you shall place the woven cords on the settings by their shoulder-pieces at the front.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt make two fringes of pure gold, variegated with flowers, wreathen work; and thou shalt put the wreathen fringes on the circlets, fastening them on their shoulder-pieces in front.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a breastpiece of judgments, embroidered work. According to the pattern of the ephod you shall make it, of gold and blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the oracle of judgment, the work of the embroiderer: in keeping with the ephod, thou shalt make it of gold, and blue and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen spun.

fresh_translation: It shall be square and doubled, a span its length and a span its breadth.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt make it square: it shall be double; of a span the length of it, and of a span the breadth.

fresh_translation: And you shall weave into it a setting of four rows of stones. The first row: sardius, topaz, emerald.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt interweave with it a texture of four rows of stone; there shall be a row of stones, a sardius, a topaz, an emerald, the first row.

fresh_translation: And the second row: carbuncle, sapphire, jasper.
brenton_translation: And the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a jasper.

fresh_translation: And the third row: ligure, agate, amethyst.
brenton_translation: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, an amethyst:

fresh_translation: And the fourth row: chrysolite, beryl, onyx, encircled and bound in gold according to their row.
brenton_translation: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, and a beryl, and an onyx stone, set round with gold, bound together with gold: let them be according to their row.

fresh_translation: And the stones shall correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve according to their names, engravings of seals, each according to its name for the twelve tribes.
brenton_translation: And let the stones of the names of the children of Israel be twelve according to their names, engravings as of seals: let them be for the twelve tribes each according to the name.

fresh_translation: And you shall make on the breastpiece braided cords, chainwork of pure gold.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make on the oracle woven fringes, a chain-work of pure gold.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel on the breastpiece of judgments upon his chest when he goes into the holy place, as a memorial before God.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall take the names of the children of Israel, on the oracle of judgment on his breast; a memorial before God for him as he goes into the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: And you shall put on the breastpiece of judgments the Disclosure and the Truth, and it shall be on Aaron's chest when he goes into the holy place before the Lord. And Aaron shall bear the judgments of the sons of Israel upon his chest before the Lord continually.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt put the two circlets on both the shoulders of the ephod in front. And thou shalt put the Manifestation and the Truth on the oracle of judgment; and it shall be on the breast of Aaron, when he goes into the holy place before the Lord; and Aaron shall bear the judgments of the children of Israel on his breast before the Lord continually.

fresh_translation: And you shall make the robe under the ephod all blue.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the full-length tunic all of blue.

fresh_translation: And its opening shall be in the middle, with a woven border all around the opening, joined from the same work so that it may not tear.
brenton_translation: And the opening of it shall be in the middle having a fringe round about the opening, the work of the weaver, woven together in the joining of the same piece that it might not be rent.

fresh_translation: And on the hem of the robe below you shall make pomegranates like blossoming pomegranate fruit, of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, on the hem of the robe all around; and golden pomegranates and bells all around between them.
brenton_translation: And under the fringe of the robe below thou shalt make as it were pomegranates of a flowering pomegranate tree, of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen spun, under the fringe of the robe round about: golden pomegranates of the same shape, and bells round about between these.

fresh_translation: A golden bell beside a pomegranate, and blossom-work on the hem of the robe all around.
brenton_translation: A bell by the side of a golden pomegranate, and flower-work on the fringe of the robe round about.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall wear it when he ministers, and its sound shall be heard when he goes into the holy place before the Lord and when he comes out, so that he may not die.
brenton_translation: And the sound of Aaron shall be audible when he ministers, as he goes into the sanctuary before the Lord, and as he goes out, that he die not.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a pure gold plate, and engrave on it like the engraving of a seal, "Holiness of the Lord."
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and thou shalt grave on it as the graving of a signet, Holiness of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall place it on a blue cord, and it shall be on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put it on the spun blue cloth, and it shall be on the mitre: it shall be in the front of the mitre.

fresh_translation: And it shall be on Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear away the sins of the holy things, whatever holy gifts the sons of Israel sanctify. And it shall be on Aaron's forehead continually, acceptable for them before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it shall be on the forehead of Aaron; and Aaron shall bear away the sins of their holy things, all that the children of Israel shall sanctify of every gift of their holy things, and it shall be on the forehead of Aaron continually acceptable for them before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the fringes of the tunics shall be of fine linen, and you shall make a fine linen turban, and you shall make a sash, work of an embroiderer.
brenton_translation: And the fringes of the garments shall be of fine linen; and thou shalt make a tire of fine linen, and thou shalt make a girdle, the work of the embroiderer.

fresh_translation: And for Aaron's sons you shall make tunics and sashes, and you shall make turbans for them, for honor and glory.
brenton_translation: And for the sons of Aaron thou shalt make tunics and girdles, and thou shalt make for them tires for honour and glory.

fresh_translation: And you shall clothe Aaron your brother and his sons with him, and you shall anoint them and fill their hands and sanctify them, that they may serve as priests to me.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put them on Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, and thou shalt anoint them and fill their hands: and thou shalt sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office.

fresh_translation: And you shall make for them linen undergarments to cover the nakedness of their flesh; they shall reach from loins to thighs.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make for them linen drawers to cover the nakedness of their flesh; they shall reach from the loins to the thighs.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall wear them, and his sons, whenever they enter the tent of testimony or approach the altar to minister in the holy place, so that they may not bring sin upon themselves and die. An everlasting statute for him and for his seed after him.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall have them, and his sons, whenever they enter into the tabernacle of witness, or when they shall advance to the altar of the sanctuary to minister, so they shall not bring sin upon themselves, lest they die: it is a perpetual statute for him, and for his seed after him.

fresh_translation: And these are the things that you shall do for them to sanctify them, so that they may serve as priests to me: take one young bull from the herd and two flawless rams,
brenton_translation: And these are the things which thou shalt do to them: thou shalt sanctify them, so that they shall serve me in the priesthood; and thou shalt take one young calf from the herd, and two unblemished rams;

fresh_translation: and unleavened loaves kneaded with oil and unleavened cakes anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.
brenton_translation: and unleavened loaves kneaded with oil, and unleavened cakes anointed with oil: thou shalt make them of fine flour of wheat.

fresh_translation: And you shall put them on one basket, and you shall bring them on the basket, and the young bull and the two rams.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put them on one basket, and thou shalt offer them on the basket, and the young calf and the two rams.

fresh_translation: And Aaron and his sons you shall bring to the doors of the tent of testimony, and you shall wash them with water.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons to the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, and thou shalt wash them with water.

fresh_translation: And taking the garments, you shall clothe Aaron your brother with the tunic and the robe and the ephod and the breastpiece, and you shall fasten the breastpiece to the ephod for him.
brenton_translation: And having taken the garments, thou shalt put on Aaron thy brother both the full-length robe and the ephod and the oracle; and thou shalt join for him the oracle to the ephod.

fresh_translation: And you shall put the turban on his head, and you shall put the holy plate on the turban.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put the mitre on his head; and thou shalt put the plate, even the Holiness, on the mitre.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his head and anoint him.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take of the anointing oil, and thou shalt pour it on his head, and shalt anoint him,

fresh_translation: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt bring his sons, and put garments on them.

fresh_translation: And you shall gird them with sashes and put the turbans on them, and they shall have a priesthood for me forever. And you shall fill the hands of Aaron and the hands of his sons.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt gird them with the girdles, and put the tires upon them, and they shall have a priestly office to me for ever; and thou shalt fill the hands of Aaron and the hands of his sons.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring the young bull to the doors of the tent of testimony, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the young bull before the Lord by the doors of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt bring the calf to the door of the tabernacle of witness; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the calf, before the Lord, by the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And you shall slaughter the young bull before the Lord by the doors of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt slay the calf before the Lord, by the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And you shall take some of the blood of the young bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and all the rest of the blood you shall pour out beside the base of the altar.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take of the blood of the calf, and put it on the horns of the altar with thy finger, but all the rest of the blood thou shalt pour out at the foot of the altar.

fresh_translation: And you shall take all the fat on the belly and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat on them, and you shall place them on the altar.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take all the fat that is on the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and shalt put them upon the altar.

fresh_translation: But the flesh of the young bull and its skin and its dung you shall burn with fire outside the camp, for it is a sin offering.
brenton_translation: But the flesh of the calf, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp; for it is an offering on account of sin.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

fresh_translation: And you shall slaughter it and, taking the blood, pour it around the altar.
