brenton_translation: And thou shalt kill it, and take the blood and pour it on the altar round about.

fresh_translation: And you shall divide the ram by its limbs, and you shall wash the inward parts and the feet with water, and place them upon the divided pieces with the head.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt divide the ram by his several limbs, and thou shalt wash the inward parts and the feet with water, and thou shalt put them on the divided parts with the head.

fresh_translation: And you shall offer up the whole ram on the altar. It is a whole burnt offering to the Lord, a smell of sweet fragrance, an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt offer the whole ram on the altar, a whole burnt-offering to the Lord for a sweet-smelling savour: it is an offering of incense to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

fresh_translation: And you shall slaughter it and take some of its blood and place it on the tip of Aaron's right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot, and on the right earlobes of his sons and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the great toes of their right feet.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt kill it, and take of the blood of it, and put it on the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot, and on the tips of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the great toes of their right feet.

fresh_translation: And you shall take some of the blood from the altar and some of the anointing oil, and you shall sprinkle it on Aaron and on his garment and on his sons and on the garments of his sons with him, and he shall be sanctified, and his garment, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him. And the blood of the ram you shall pour around the altar.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take of the blood from the altar, and of the anointing oil; and thou shalt sprinkle it upon Aaron and on his garments, and on his sons and on his sons' garments with him; and he shall be sanctified and his apparel, and his sons and his sons' apparel with him: but the blood of the ram thou shalt pour round about upon the altar.

fresh_translation: And you shall take from the ram its fat and the fat covering the belly and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat on them and the right arm, for this is an ordination.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take from the ram its fat, both the fat that covers the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder, for this is a consecration.

fresh_translation: And one loaf of oil bread and one cake from the basket of unleavened bread set before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And one cake made with oil, and one cake from the basket of unleavened bread set forth before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall place all these on the hands of Aaron and on the hands of his sons, and you shall separate them as a separated offering before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put them all on the hands of Aaron, and on the hands of his sons, and thou shalt separate them as a separate offering before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall take them from their hands and offer them on the altar upon the whole burnt offering, as a smell of sweet fragrance before the Lord. It is an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take them from their hands, and shalt offer them up on the altar of whole burnt-offering for a sweet-smelling savour before the Lord: it is an offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the breast from the ram of ordination that belongs to Aaron, and you shall separate it as a separated offering before the Lord, and it shall be your portion.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take the breast from the ram of consecration which is Aaron's, and thou shalt separate it as a separate offering before the Lord, and it shall be to thee for a portion.

fresh_translation: And you shall sanctify the breast of the separated offering and the arm of the removal offering, that which was separated and that which was removed from the ram of ordination, from Aaron and from his sons.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt sanctify the separated breast and the shoulder of removal which has been separated, and which has been removed from the ram of consecration, of the portion of Aaron and of that of his sons.

fresh_translation: And it shall be for Aaron and for his sons an everlasting statute from the sons of Israel. For this is a removal offering, and it shall be a removal offering from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of salvation of the sons of Israel, a removal offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it shall be a perpetual statute of the children of Israel to Aaron and his sons, for this is a separate offering; and it shall be a special offering from the children of Israel, from the peace-offerings of the children of Israel, a special offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the holy garments that are Aaron's shall belong to his sons after him, that they may be anointed in them and their hands filled in them.
brenton_translation: And the apparel of the sanctuary which is Aaron's shall be his sons' after him, for them to be anointed in them, and to fill their hands.

fresh_translation: Seven days the priest who succeeds him from among his sons, who enters the tent of testimony to minister in the holy place, shall wear them.
brenton_translation: The priest his successor from among his sons who shall go into the tabernacle of witness to minister in the holies, shall put them on seven days.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take the ram of consecration, and thou shalt boil the flesh in the holy place.

fresh_translation: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread in the basket by the doors of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the loaves in the basket, by the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: They shall eat those things by which they were sanctified, to fill their hands, to sanctify them. But an outsider shall not eat of them, for they are holy.
brenton_translation: They shall eat the offerings with which they were sanctified to fill their hands, to sanctify them; and a stranger shall not eat of them, for they are holy.

fresh_translation: If any of the flesh of the sacrifice of ordination or of the bread remains until morning, you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, for it is holy.
brenton_translation: And if aught be left of the flesh of the sacrifice of consecration and of the loaves until the morning, thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, for it is a holy thing.

fresh_translation: And thus you shall do for Aaron and for his sons according to all that I commanded you. Seven days you shall fill their hands.
brenton_translation: And thus shalt thou do for Aaron and for his sons according to all things that I have commanded thee; seven days shalt thou fill their hands.

fresh_translation: And you shall offer the young bull of the sin offering on the day of purification, and you shall purify the altar when you sanctify it upon it, and you shall anoint it so as to sanctify it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt sacrifice the calf of the sin-offering on the day of purification, and thou shalt purify the altar when thou dost perform consecration upon it, and thou shalt anoint it so as to sanctify it.

fresh_translation: Seven days you shall purify the altar and sanctify it, and the altar shall be most holy. Everyone touching the altar shall be sanctified.
brenton_translation: Seven days shalt thou purify the altar and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy, every one that touches the altar shall be hallowed.

fresh_translation: And these are the things that you shall offer upon the altar: two year-old flawless lambs each day upon the altar continually, a continual offering.
brenton_translation: And these are the offerings which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two unblemished lambs of a year old daily on the altar continually, a constant offering.

fresh_translation: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer at evening.
brenton_translation: One lamb thou shalt offer in the morning, and the second lamb thou shalt offer in the evening.

fresh_translation: And with the one lamb, a tenth of fine flour kneaded in a quarter-hin of beaten oil, and a drink offering, a quarter-hin of wine.
brenton_translation: And a tenth measure of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil, and a drink-offering the fourth part of a hin of wine for one lamb.

fresh_translation: And the second lamb you shall offer at evening. According to the morning sacrifice and according to its drink offering you shall offer it, as a smell of sweet fragrance, an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt offer the second lamb in the evening, after the manner of the morning-offering, and according to the drink-offering of the morning lamb; thou shalt offer it an offering to the Lord for a sweet-smelling savour,

fresh_translation: A continual sacrifice throughout your generations at the doors of the tent of testimony before the Lord, where I will make myself known to you there so as to speak to you.
brenton_translation: a perpetual sacrifice throughout your generations, at the door of the tabernacle of witness before the Lord; wherein I will be known to thee from thence, so as to speak to thee.

fresh_translation: And there I will appoint things for the sons of Israel, and I will be sanctified in my glory.
brenton_translation: And I will there give orders to the children of Israel, and I will be sanctified in my glory.

fresh_translation: And I will sanctify the tent of testimony and the altar, and Aaron and his sons I will sanctify to serve as priests to me.
brenton_translation: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of testimony and the altar, and I will sanctify Aaron and his sons, to minister as priests to me.

fresh_translation: And I will be called upon among the sons of Israel, and I will be their God.
brenton_translation: And I will be called upon among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

fresh_translation: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt to be called upon by them and to be their God.
brenton_translation: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, to be called upon by them, and to be their God.

fresh_translation: And you shall make an altar of incense of incorruptible wood, and you shall make it
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the altar of incense of incorruptible wood.

fresh_translation: one cubit its length and one cubit its breadth. It shall be square, and its height two cubits. Its horns shall be from it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make it a cubit in length, and a cubit in breadth: it shall be square; and the height of it shall be of two cubits, its horns shall be of the same piece.

fresh_translation: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, its top and its walls all around and its horns, and you shall make for it a twisted golden border all around.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt gild its grate with pure gold, and its sides round about, and its horns; and thou shalt make for it a wreathen border of gold round-about.

fresh_translation: And you shall make two rings of pure gold under its twisted border. On its two sides you shall make them at the two corners, and they shall be holders for the poles, to carry it by them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make under its wreathen border two rings of pure gold; thou shalt make it to the two corners on the two sides, and they shall be bearings for the staves, so as to bear it with them.

fresh_translation: And you shall make poles of incorruptible wood and overlay them with gold.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make the staves of incorruptible wood, and shalt gild them with gold.

fresh_translation: And you shall place it opposite the curtain that is over the ark of testimonies, where I will make myself known to you there.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt set it before the veil that is over the ark of the testimonies, wherein I will make myself known to thee from thence.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall burn on it compounded fine incense every morning. When he trims the lamps, he shall burn incense on it.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall burn upon it fine compound incense every morning; whensoever he trims the lamps he shall burn incense upon it.

fresh_translation: And when Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn incense on it, a continual incense before the Lord throughout their generations.
brenton_translation: And when Aaron lights the lamps in the evening, he shall burn incense upon it; a constant incense-offering always before the Lord for their generations.

fresh_translation: And you shall not offer on it different incense, or an offering, or a sacrifice, and you shall not pour a drink offering on it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not offer strange incense upon it, nor an offering made by fire, nor a sacrifice; and thou shalt not pour a drink-offering upon it.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall make atonement upon its horns once each year. From the blood of purification for sins, from the atonement, once each year he shall cleanse it throughout their generations. It is Holy of Holies to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And once in the year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns, he shall purge it with the blood of purification for their generations: it is most holy to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: If you take the numbering of the sons of Israel at their visitation, each shall give a ransom for his life to the Lord, and there shall be no plague among them at their visitation.
brenton_translation: If thou take account of the children of Israel in the surveying of them, and they shall give every one a ransom for his soul to the Lord, then there shall not be among them a destruction in the visiting of them.

fresh_translation: And this is what they shall give, all who pass through the visitation: half the didrachm, according to the didrachm of the sanctuary. Twenty obols to the didrachm. But the half-didrachm is an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And this is what they shall give, as many as pass the survey, half a didrachm which is according to the didrachm of the sanctuary: twenty oboli go to the didrachm, but the half of the didrachm is the offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: Everyone who passes through the visitation, from twenty years old and above, shall give the offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Every one that passes the survey from twenty years old and upwards shall give the offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: The rich shall not add and the poor shall not lessen from the half-didrachm in giving the offering to the Lord, to make atonement for your lives.
brenton_translation: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than the half didrachm in giving the offering to the Lord, to make atonement for your souls.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the silver of the offering from the sons of Israel and give it for the work of the tent of testimony, and it shall be a memorial before the Lord for the sons of Israel, to make atonement for your lives.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take the money of the offering from the children of Israel, and shalt give it for the service of the tabernacle of testimony; and it shall be to the children of Israel a memorial before the Lord, to make atonement for your souls.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Make a bronze laver and a bronze base for it for washing, and you shall place it between the tent of testimony and the altar, and you shall pour water into it.
brenton_translation: Make a brazen laver, and a brazen base for it, for washing; and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of witness and the altar, and thou shalt pour forth water into it.

fresh_translation: And Aaron and his sons shall wash from it their hands and feet with water.
brenton_translation: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet with water from it.

fresh_translation: When they enter into the tent of testimony, they shall wash with water and not die; or when they approach the altar to minister and offer the whole burnt offerings to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Whensoever they shall go into the tabernacle of witness, they shall wash themselves with water, so they shall not die, whensoever they advance to the altar to do service and to offer the whole burnt-offerings to the Lord.

fresh_translation: They shall wash their hands and feet with water when they enter into the tent of testimony, so that they may not die. And it shall be an everlasting statute for them, for him and for his generations after him.
brenton_translation: They shall wash their hands and feet with water, whensoever they shall go into the tabernacle of witness; they shall wash themselves with water, that they die not; and it shall be for them a perpetual statute, for him and his posterity after him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: And you, take sweet spices: five hundred shekels of choice-flowing myrrh, and half that amount, two hundred fifty of sweet cinnamon, and two hundred fifty of sweet calamus,
brenton_translation: Do thou also take sweet herbs, the flower of choice myrrh five hundred shekels, and the half of this two hundred and fifty shekels of sweet-smelling cinnamon, and two hundred and fifty shekels of sweet-smelling calamus,

fresh_translation: and five hundred shekels of cassia by the sanctuary shekel, and a hin of olive oil.
brenton_translation: and of cassia five hundred shekels of the sanctuary, and a hin of olive oil.

fresh_translation: And you shall make it holy anointing oil, perfumed ointment, work of a perfumer. It shall be holy anointing oil.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt make it a holy anointing oil, a perfumed ointment tempered by the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

fresh_translation: And you shall anoint with it the tent of testimony and the ark of testimony,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt anoint with it the tabernacle of witness, and the ark of the tabernacle of witness,

fresh_translation: and the lampstand and all its utensils and the altar of incense,
brenton_translation: and all its furniture, and the candlestick and all its furniture, and the altar of incense,

fresh_translation: and the altar of whole burnt offerings and all its utensils and the table and all its utensils and the laver and its base.
brenton_translation: and the altar of whole burnt-offerings and all its furniture, and the table and all its furniture, and the laver.

fresh_translation: And you shall sanctify them, and they shall be Holy of Holies. Everyone touching them shall be sanctified.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt sanctify them, and they shall be most holy: every one that touches them shall be hallowed.

fresh_translation: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and sanctify them to serve as priests to me.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them that they may minister to me as priests.

fresh_translation: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, "This shall be holy oil of anointing for you throughout your generations.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, This shall be to you a holy anointing oil throughout your generations.

fresh_translation: It shall not be poured on human flesh, and according to this composition you shall not make any for yourselves in the same way. It is holy, and it shall be holiness for you.
brenton_translation: On man's flesh it shall not be poured, and ye shall not make any for yourselves according to this composition: it is holy, and shall be holiness to you.

fresh_translation: Whoever makes any like it, and whoever gives some of it to an outsider, shall be destroyed from his people."
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall make it in like manner, and whosoever shall give of it to a stranger, shall be destroyed from among his people.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take for yourself sweet spices: stacte, onycha, sweet galbanum, and pure frankincense. There shall be equal amounts of each.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Take for thyself sweet herbs, stacte, onycha, sweet galbanum, and transparent frankincense; there shall be an equal weight of each.

fresh_translation: And they shall make from it incense, perfumed compound, work of a perfumer, mixed, pure, holy.
brenton_translation: And they shall make with it perfumed incense, tempered with the art of a perfumer, a pure holy work.

fresh_translation: And you shall beat some of it very fine and place it before the testimonies in the tent of testimony, where I will make myself known to you there. It shall be Holy of Holies for you.
brenton_translation: And of these thou shalt beat some small, and thou shalt put it before the testimonies in the tabernacle of testimony, whence I will make myself known to thee: it shall be to you a most holy incense.

fresh_translation: And incense according to this composition you shall not make for yourselves. It shall be a holy thing for you to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not make any for yourselves according to this composition; it shall be to you a holy thing for the Lord.

fresh_translation: Whoever makes any like it to smell it shall perish from his people."
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall make any in like manner, so as to smell it, shall perish from his people.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: "Look, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have called by name Beseleel the son of Urias the son of Or, of the tribe of Juda.

fresh_translation: And I have filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding and knowledge in every work,
brenton_translation: And I have filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom, and understanding, and knowledge, to invent in every work,

fresh_translation: to devise and design, to work gold and silver and bronze, and blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen,
brenton_translation: and to frame works, to labour in gold, and silver, and brass, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet,

fresh_translation: and in stone-cutting and woodwork, to work in every task.
brenton_translation: and works in stone, and for artificers' work in wood, to work at all works.

fresh_translation: And I, behold, have appointed with him Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And to everyone wise in heart I have given understanding, and they shall make all that I commanded you:
brenton_translation: And I have appointed him and Eliab the son of Achisamach of the tribe of Dan, and to every one understanding in heart I have given understanding; and they shall make all things as many as I have appointed thee,—

fresh_translation: the tent of testimony and the ark of the covenant and the propitiatory upon it and the furnishings of the tent,
brenton_translation: the tabernacle of witness, and the ark of the covenant, and the propitiatory that is upon it, and the furniture of the tabernacle,

fresh_translation: and the altars and the table and all its utensils and the pure lampstand and all its utensils,
brenton_translation: and the altars, and the table and all its furniture,

fresh_translation: and the laver and its base,
brenton_translation: and the pure candlestick and all its furniture, and the laver and its base,

fresh_translation: and the ministering garments of Aaron and the garments of his sons to serve as priests to me,
brenton_translation: and Aaron's robes of ministry, and the robes of his sons to minister to me as priests,

fresh_translation: and the anointing oil and the compounded incense of the holy place. According to all that I commanded you, they shall make them."
brenton_translation: and the anointing oil and the compound incense of the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded thee shall they make them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: "And you, command the sons of Israel, saying, See that you keep my Sabbaths, for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
brenton_translation: Do thou also charge the children of Israel, saying, Take heed and keep my sabbaths; for they are a sign with me and among you throughout your generations, that ye may know that I am the Lord that sanctifies you.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep the Sabbaths, because this is holy to the Lord for you. The one profaning it shall certainly be put to death. Everyone who does work on it, that life shall be destroyed from the midst of his people.
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep the sabbaths, because this is holy to the Lord for you; he that profanes it shall surely be put to death: every one who shall do a work on it, that soul shall be destroyed from the midst of his people.

fresh_translation: Six days you shall do works, but on the seventh day is Sabbath rest, holy to the Lord. Everyone who does work on the seventh day shall certainly be put to death.
brenton_translation: Six days thou shalt do works, but the seventh day is the sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord; every one who shall do a work on the seventh day shall be put to death.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbaths, to do them throughout their generations, an everlasting covenant.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel shall keep the sabbaths, to observe them throughout their generations.

fresh_translation: Between me and the sons of Israel it is an everlasting sign, because in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he ceased and rested."
brenton_translation: It is a perpetual covenant with me and the children of Israel, it is a perpetual sign with me; for in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth, and on the seventh day he ceased, and rested.

fresh_translation: And when he finished speaking to him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of testimony, stone tablets written with the finger of God.
brenton_translation: And he gave to Moses when he left off speaking to him in mount Sina the two tables of testimony, tables of stone written upon with the finger of God.

fresh_translation: And when the people saw that Moses had delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered against Aaron and said to him, "Rise up and make gods for us who will go before us. For as for this Moses, the man who brought us up from Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him."
brenton_translation: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people combined against Aaron, and said to him, Arise and make us gods who shall go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us forth out of the land of Egypt—we do not know what is become of him.

fresh_translation: And Aaron said to them, "Strip off the gold earrings in the ears of your wives and daughters and bring them to me."
brenton_translation: And Aaron says to them, Take off the golden ear-rings which are in the ears of your wives and daughters, and bring them to me.

fresh_translation: And all the people stripped off the gold earrings in their ears and brought them to Aaron.
brenton_translation: And all the people took off the golden ear-rings that were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

fresh_translation: And he took them from their hands and formed them with the graving tool and made them a molten calf. And he said, "These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from Egypt."
brenton_translation: And he received them at their hands, and formed them with a graving tool; and he made them a molten calf, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And Aaron, seeing, built an altar before it, and Aaron proclaimed, saying, "Tomorrow is a feast of the Lord."
brenton_translation: And Aaron having seen it built an altar before it, and Aaron made proclamation saying, To-morrow is a feast of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And rising early the next day, he offered whole burnt offerings and brought sacrifices of salvation. And the people sat down to eat and drink and rose up to play.
brenton_translation: And having risen early on the morrow, he offered whole burnt-offerings, and offered a peace-offering; and the people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Go, hurry down from here, for your people whom you brought up from Egypt have acted lawlessly.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Go quickly, descend hence, for thy people whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt have transgressed;

fresh_translation: They have quickly turned aside from the way that I commanded them. They have made for themselves a calf and have worshiped it and sacrificed to it and said, 'These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from Egypt.'"
brenton_translation: they have quickly gone out of the way which thou commandedst; they have made for themselves a calf, and worshipped it, and sacrificed to it, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And now let me alone, and in anger I will destroy them, and I will make you a great nation.
brenton_translation: And now let me alone, and I will be very angry with them and consume them, and I will make thee a great nation.

fresh_translation: And Moses entreated before the Lord God and said, "Why, Lord, does angry wrath burn against your people whom you brought out from Egypt with great strength and with your high arm?
brenton_translation: And Moses prayed before the Lord God, and said, Wherefore, O Lord, art thou very angry with thy people, whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt with great strength, and with thy high arm?

fresh_translation: Let not the Egyptians ever say, 'He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them in the mountains and consume them from the earth.' Stop from the anger of your wrath and be merciful concerning the evil of your people.
brenton_translation: Take heed lest at any time the Egyptians speak, saying, With evil intent he brought them out to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from off the earth; cease from thy wrathful anger, and be merciful to the sin of thy people,

fresh_translation: Remember Abraham and Isaac and Jacob your servants, to whom you swore by yourself and spoke to them, saying, 'I will greatly multiply your seed like the stars of heaven in multitude, and all this land that I said I would give to your seed, and they shall possess it forever.'"
brenton_translation: remembering Abraam and Isaac and Jacob thy servants, to whom thou hast sworn by thyself, and hast spoken to them, saying, I will greatly multiply your seed as the stars of heaven for multitude, and all this land which thou spokest of to give to them, so that they shall possess it for ever.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was propitiated concerning the evil that he had said he would do to his people.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was prevailed upon to preserve his people.

fresh_translation: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, and the two tablets of testimony were in his hands, stone tablets inscribed on both their sides, written on this side and that side.
brenton_translation: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, and the two tables of testimony were in his hands, tables of stone written on both their sides: they were written within and without.

fresh_translation: And the tablets were God's work, and the writing was God's writing, engraved upon the tablets.
brenton_translation: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing the writing of God written on the tables.

fresh_translation: And Joshua, hearing the voice of the people crying out, said to Moses, "A sound of war is in the camp."
brenton_translation: And Joshua having heard the voice of the people crying, says to Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

fresh_translation: And he said, "It is not the sound of those shouting in strength, nor the sound of those shouting in rout, but the sound of those striking up wine-song that I hear."
brenton_translation: And Moses says, It is not the voice of them that begin the battle, nor the voice of them that begin the cry of defeat, but the voice of them that begin the banquet of wine do I hear.

fresh_translation: And when he drew near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dances. And Moses, burning with anger, threw the two tablets from his hands and shattered them at the foot of the mountain.
brenton_translation: And when he drew nigh to the camp, he sees the calf and the dances; and Moses being very angry cast the two tables out of his hands, and broke them to pieces under the mountain.

fresh_translation: And taking the calf that they had made, he burned it in fire and ground it fine and scattered it on the water and made the sons of Israel drink it.
brenton_translation: And having taken the calf which they made, he consumed it with fire, and ground it very small, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel to drink it.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to Aaron, "What did this people do to you that you brought a great sin upon them?"
brenton_translation: And Moses said to Aaron, What has this people done to thee, that thou hast brought upon them a great sin?

fresh_translation: And Aaron said to Moses, "Do not be angry, my lord. You know the rush of this people.
brenton_translation: And Aaron said to Moses, Be not angry, my lord, for thou knowest the impetuosity of this people.

fresh_translation: For they say to me, 'Make gods for us who will go before us. For as for this Moses, the man who brought us up from Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.'
brenton_translation: For they say to me, Make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this man Moses, who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what is become of him.

fresh_translation: And I said to them, 'Whoever has gold ornaments, strip them off.' And they gave them to me, and I threw them into the fire, and out came this calf."
brenton_translation: And I said to them, If any one has golden ornaments, take them off; and they gave them me, and I cast them into the fire, and there came out this calf.

fresh_translation: And Moses, seeing that the people were scattered, for Aaron had scattered them into mockery for their enemies,
brenton_translation: And when Moses saw that the people was scattered,—for Aaron had scattered them so as to be a rejoicing to their enemies,—

fresh_translation: stood at the gate of the camp and said, "Who is for the Lord? Let him come to me." Then all the sons of Levi gathered to him.
brenton_translation: then stood Moses at the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come to me. Then all the sons of Levi came to him.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Let each put his sword upon his thigh and go through and return from gate to gate through the camp, and let each kill his brother and each his neighbor and each his nearest one."
brenton_translation: And he says to them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every one his sword on his thigh, and go through and return from gate to gate through the camp, and slay every one his brother, and every one his neighbour, and every one him that is nearest to him.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Levi did as Moses spoke to them, and about three thousand men from the people fell that day.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Levi did as Moses spoke to them, and there fell of the people in that day to the number of three thousand men.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to them, "You have filled your hands today to the Lord, each one against his son or his brother, so that blessing may be given upon you."
brenton_translation: And Moses said to them, Ye have filled your hands this day to the Lord each one on his son or on his brother, so that blessing should be given to you.

fresh_translation: And it came about on the next day that Moses said to the people, "You have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to God, so that I may make atonement for your sin."
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the morrow had begun, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin; and now I will go up to God, that I may make atonement for your sin.

fresh_translation: And Moses returned to the Lord and said, "I beg, Lord, this people has sinned a great sin, and they made for themselves gods of gold.
brenton_translation: And Moses returned to the Lord and said, I pray, O Lord, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made for themselves golden gods.

fresh_translation: And now, if indeed you forgive their sin, forgive. But if not, blot me out from your book that you wrote."
brenton_translation: And now if thou wilt forgive their sin, forgive it; and if not, blot me out of thy book, which thou hast written.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "Whoever has sinned before me, him I will blot out from my book.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, If any one has sinned against me, I will blot them out of my book.

fresh_translation: And now go, descend, and lead this people to the place of which I spoke to you. Behold, my angel goes before your face. But in the day when I visit, I will bring their sin upon them."
brenton_translation: And now go, descend, and lead this people into the place of which I spoke to thee: behold, my angel shall go before thy face; and in the day when I shall visit I will bring upon them their sin.

fresh_translation: And the Lord struck the people because of the making of the calf that Aaron made.
brenton_translation: And the Lord smote the people for the making of the calf, which Aaron made.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go, go up from here, you and your people whom you brought out of Egypt, to the land that I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, saying, 'To your seed I will give it.'
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Go forward, go up hence, thou and thy people, whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, into the land which I swore to Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob, saying, I will give it to your seed.

fresh_translation: And I will send my angel with you and drive out the Amorite and Hittite and Perizzite and Girgashite and Hivite and Jebusite.
brenton_translation: And I will send at the same time my angel before thy face, and he shall cast out the Amorite and the Chettite, and the Pherezite and Gergesite, and Evite, and Jebusite, and Chananite.

fresh_translation: And I will bring you into a land flowing with milk and honey, but I will certainly not go up with you, because you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way."
brenton_translation: And I will bring thee into a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up with thee, because thou art a stiff-necked people, lest I consume thee by the way.

fresh_translation: And when the people heard this evil word, they mourned in mourning clothes.
brenton_translation: And the people having heard this grievous saying, mourned in mourning apparel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to the sons of Israel, "You are a stiff-necked people. See that I do not bring another plague upon you and consume you. Now then strip off your glorious garments and ornaments, and I will show you what I will do to you."
brenton_translation: For the Lord said to the children of Israel, Ye are a stiff-necked people; take heed lest I bring on you another plague, and destroy you: now then put off your glorious apparel, and your ornaments, and I will shew thee what I will do to thee.

fresh_translation: So the sons of Israel stripped off their ornaments and their array from Mount Horeb onward.
brenton_translation: So the sons of Israel took off their ornaments and their array at the mount of Choreb.

fresh_translation: And Moses took his tent and pitched it outside the camp, far from the camp, and it was called Tent of Testimony. And everyone seeking the Lord went out to the tent outside the camp.
brenton_translation: And Moses took his tabernacle and pitched it without the camp, at a distance from the camp; and it was called the Tabernacle of Testimony: and it came to pass that every one that sought the Lord went forth to the tabernacle which was without the camp.

fresh_translation: And whenever Moses went into the tent outside the camp, all the people stood watching, each at the door of his tent, and they gazed after Moses until he entered the tent.
brenton_translation: And whenever Moses went into the tabernacle without the camp, all the people stood every one watching by the doors of his tent; and when Moses departed, they took notice until he entered into the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And when Moses entered the tent, the pillar of the cloud came down and stood at the door of the tent, and he spoke with Moses.
brenton_translation: And when Moses entered into the tabernacle, the pillar of the cloud descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and God talked to Moses.

fresh_translation: And all the people saw the pillar of the cloud standing at the door of the tent, and all the people stood and worshiped, each from the door of his tent.
brenton_translation: And all the people saw the pillar of the cloud standing by the door of the tabernacle, and all the people stood and worshipped every one at the door of his tent.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as if one would speak to his own friend. And he would return to the camp. But his servant Joshua son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as if one should speak to his friend; and he retired into the camp: but his servant Joshua the son of Naue, a young man, departed not forth from the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to the Lord, "See, you say to me, 'Lead up this people,' but you have not made clear to me whom you will send with me. Yet you have said to me, 'I know you above all, and you have favor with me.'
brenton_translation: And Moses said to the Lord, Lo! thou sayest to me, Lead on this people; but thou hast not shewed me whom thou wilt send with me, but thou hast said to me, I know thee above all, and thou hast favour with me.

fresh_translation: If then I have found favor before you, reveal yourself to me plainly, that I may see you, so that I may continue finding favor before you, and so that I may know that this great nation is your people."
brenton_translation: If then I have found favour in thy sight, reveal thyself to me, that I may evidently see thee; that I may find favour in thy sight, and that I may know that this great nation is thy people.

fresh_translation: And he said, "I myself will go before you and give you rest."
brenton_translation: And he says, I myself will go before thee, and give thee rest.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, "If you yourself do not go with us, do not lead me up from here.
brenton_translation: And he says to him, If thou go not up with us thyself, bring me not up hence.

fresh_translation: For how shall it truly become known that both I and your people have found favor with you, except when you go with us? Then both I and your people will be glorified beyond all the nations that are on the earth."
brenton_translation: And how shall it be surely known, that both I and this people have found favour with thee, except only if thou go with us? So both I and thy people shall be glorified beyond all the nations, as many as are upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "I will also do this word that you have spoken, for you have found favor before me, and I know you above all."
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, I will also do for thee this thing, which thou hast spoken; for thou hast found grace before me, and I know thee above all.

fresh_translation: And he said, "Show me your own glory."
brenton_translation: And Moses says, Manifest thyself to me.

fresh_translation: And he said, "I will pass before you in my glory, and I will call on my name, 'Lord,' before you. And I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will pity whom I pity."
brenton_translation: And God said, I will pass by before thee with my glory, and I will call by my name, the Lord, before thee; and I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and will have pity on whom I will have pity.

fresh_translation: And he said, "You cannot see my face, for no human shall see my face and live."
brenton_translation: And God said, Thou shalt not be able to see my face; for no man shall see my face, and live.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, "Behold, a place is beside me. Stand upon the rock.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, Behold, there is a place by me: thou shalt stand upon the rock;

fresh_translation: And when my glory passes by, I will put you in a hollow of the rock and cover you with my hand until I pass by.
brenton_translation: and when my glory shall pass by, then I will put thee into a hole of the rock; and I will cover thee over with my hand, until I shall have passed by.

fresh_translation: And I will remove my hand, and then you shall see my back, but my face shall not be seen by you."
brenton_translation: And I will remove my hand, and then shalt thou see my back parts; but my face shall not appear to thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "Hew for yourself two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me on the mountain, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you shattered.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Hew for thyself two tables of stone, as also the first were, and come up to me to the mountain; and I will write upon the tables the words, which were on the first tables, which thou brokest.

fresh_translation: And be ready for the morning, and you shall come up to Mount Sinai and stand there for me on the top of the mountain.
brenton_translation: And be ready by the morning, and thou shalt go up to the mount Sina, and shalt stand there for me on the top of the mountain.

fresh_translation: And let no one come up with you, nor be seen on all the mountain, and let not the sheep and the oxen graze near that mountain."
brenton_translation: And let no one go up with thee, nor be seen in all the mountain; and let not the sheep and oxen feed near that mountain.

fresh_translation: And he hewed two stone tablets like the first. And Moses, rising early, went up to Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had appointed him, and Moses took the two stone tablets.
brenton_translation: And Moses hewed two tables of stone, as also the first were; and Moses having arisen early, went up to the mount Sina, as the Lord appointed him; and Moses took the two tables of stone.

fresh_translation: And the Lord came down in a cloud and stood with him there and called on the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the Lord descended in a cloud, and stood near him there, and called by the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord passed before his face and proclaimed, "The Lord God, compassionate and merciful, slow to anger and very merciful and true,
brenton_translation: And the Lord passed by before his face, and proclaimed, The Lord God, pitiful and merciful, longsuffering and very compassionate, and true,

fresh_translation: keeping righteousness and showing mercy to thousands, taking away lawlessness and unrighteousness and sins, and he will not clear the guilty, bringing fathers' lawlessness upon children and upon children's children, to the third and fourth generation."
brenton_translation: and keeping justice and mercy for thousands, taking away iniquity, and unrighteousness, and sins; and he will not clear the guilty; bringing the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and to the children's children, to the third and fourth generation.

fresh_translation: And Moses hurried, bowed to the earth, and worshiped.
brenton_translation: And Moses hasted, and bowed to the earth and worshipped;

fresh_translation: And he said, "If I have found favor before you, let my Lord go with us, for the people is stiff-necked, and you will take away our sins and our lawlessnesses, and we will be yours."
brenton_translation: and said, If I have found grace before thee, let my Lord go with us; for the people is stiff-necked: and thou shalt take away our sins and our iniquities, and we will be thine.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I establish a covenant for you. Before all your people I will do glorious things that have not been done in all the earth or in any nation, and all the people among whom you are shall see the works of the Lord, because the things that I will do for you are wonderful.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, I establish a covenant for thee in the presence of all thy people; I will do glorious things, which have not been done in all the earth, or in any nation; and all the people among whom thou art shall see the works of the Lord, that they are wonderful, which I will do for thee.

fresh_translation: Pay attention to all that I command you. Behold, I drive out before you the Amorite and Canaanite and Hittite and Perizzite and Hivite and Girgashite and Jebusite.
brenton_translation: Do thou take heed to all things whatsoever I command thee: behold, I cast out before your face the Amorite and the Chananite and the Pherezite, and the Chettite, and Evite, and Gergesite and Jebusite:

fresh_translation: Pay attention to yourself, lest you make a covenant with those settled on the land into which you are entering, lest it become a stumbling block among you.
brenton_translation: take heed to thyself, lest at any time thou make a covenant with the dwellers on the land, into which thou art entering, lest it be to thee a stumbling-block among you.

fresh_translation: You shall tear down their altars and break in pieces their pillars and cut down their groves, and the carved images of their gods you shall burn with fire.
brenton_translation: Ye shall destroy their altars, and break in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their groves, and the graven images of their gods ye shall burn with fire.

fresh_translation: For you shall certainly not worship another god, for the Lord God, Jealous is his name; he is a jealous God.
brenton_translation: For ye shall not worship strange gods, for the Lord God, a jealous name, is a jealous God;

fresh_translation: Lest you make a covenant with those settled on the land, and they prostitute themselves after their gods and sacrifice to their gods and invite you and you eat from their sacrifices,
brenton_translation: lest at any time thou make a covenant with the dwellers on the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and they call thee, and thou shouldest eat of their feasts,

fresh_translation: and you take some of their daughters for your sons and give some of your daughters to their sons, and your daughters prostitute themselves after their gods and make your sons prostitute themselves after their gods.
brenton_translation: and thou shouldest take of their daughters to thy sons, and thou shouldest give of thy daughters to their sons; and thy daughters should go a whoring after their gods, and thy sons should go a whoring after their gods.

fresh_translation: And you shall not make molten gods for yourself.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not make to thyself molten gods.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of new grain, for in the month of new grain you came out from Egypt.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, as I have charged thee, at the season in the month of new corn; for in the month of new corn thou camest out from Egypt.

fresh_translation: Everything opening the womb is mine, every male firstborn of ox and every firstborn of sheep.
brenton_translation: The males are mine, everything that opens the womb; every first-born of oxen, and every first-born of sheep.

fresh_translation: And the firstborn of a beast of burden you shall redeem with a sheep. And if you do not redeem it, you shall pay a price. Every firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. You shall not appear before me empty.
brenton_translation: And the first-born of an ass thou shalt redeem with a sheep, and if thou wilt not redeem it thou shalt pay a price: every first-born of thy sons shalt thou redeem: thou shalt not appear before me empty.

fresh_translation: Six days you shall work, and on the seventh you shall rest; in seedtime and harvest you shall rest.
brenton_translation: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: there shall be rest in seed-time and harvest.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep for me the feast of weeks, the first of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering in the middle of the year.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt keep to me the feast of weeks, the beginning of wheat-harvest; and the feast of ingathering in the middle of the year.

fresh_translation: Three times in the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: Three times in the year shall every male of thine appear before the Lord the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: For when I cast out the nations before your face and enlarge your borders, no one shall desire your land when you go up to appear before the Lord your God three times in the year.
brenton_translation: For when I shall have cast out the nations before thy face, and shall have enlarged thy coasts, no one shall desire thy land, whenever thou mayest go up to appear before the Lord thy God, three times in the year.

fresh_translation: You shall not slaughter the blood of my offerings with leaven, and the sacrifice of Passover shall not lie down until morning.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifices with leaven, neither shall the sacrifices of the feast of the passover remain till the morning.

fresh_translation: The first produce of your land you shall place in the house of the Lord your God. You shall not offer a lamb in its mother's milk.
brenton_translation: The first-fruits of thy land shalt thou put into the house of the Lord thy God: thou shalt not boil a lamb in his mother's milk.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, "Write these words for yourself, for on these words I have established a covenant with you and with Israel."
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Write these words for thyself, for on these words I have established a covenant with thee and with Israel.

fresh_translation: And Moses was there before the Lord forty days and forty nights. He did not eat bread and did not drink water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten sayings.
brenton_translation: And Moses was there before the Lord forty days, and forty nights; he did not eat bread, and he did not drink water; and he wrote upon the tables these words of the covenant, the ten sayings.

fresh_translation: And when Moses came down from the mountain, the two tablets were in Moses' hands. And as he came down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the appearance of the skin of his face had been glorified when God spoke with him.
brenton_translation: And when Moses went down from the mountain, there were the two tables in the hands of Moses,—as then he went down from the mountain, Moses knew not that the appearance of the skin of his face was glorified, when God spoke to him.

fresh_translation: And Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and the appearance of the skin of his face had been glorified, and they feared to come near him.
brenton_translation: And Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and the appearance of the skin of his face was made glorious, and they feared to approach him.

fresh_translation: And Moses called them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation turned back to him, and Moses spoke to them.
brenton_translation: And Moses called them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the synagogue turned towards him, and Moses spoke to them.

fresh_translation: And after these things all the sons of Israel came near to him, and he commanded them all that the Lord had spoken to him on Mount Sinai.
brenton_translation: And afterwards all the children of Israel came to him, and he commanded them all things, whatsoever the Lord had commanded him in the mount of Sina.

fresh_translation: And when he ceased speaking to them, he put a veil on his face.
brenton_translation: And when he ceased speaking to them, he put a veil on his face.

fresh_translation: Whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out, and coming out he spoke to all the sons of Israel whatever the Lord had commanded him.
brenton_translation: And whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak to him, he took off the veil till he went out, and he went forth and spoke to all the children of Israel whatsoever the Lord commanded him.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel saw the face of Moses, that it had been glorified, and Moses put the veil on his face until he went in to speak with him.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that it was glorified; and Moses put the veil over his face, till he went in to speak with him.

fresh_translation: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the sons of Israel and said to them, "These are the words that the Lord spoke, to do them.
brenton_translation: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said, These are the words which the Lord has spoken for you to do them.

fresh_translation: Six days you shall do works, but on the seventh day there shall be rest, holy Sabbath rest to the Lord. Everyone doing work on it shall die.
brenton_translation: Six days shalt thou perform works, but on the seventh day shall be rest—a holy sabbath—a rest for the Lord: every one that does work on it, let him die.

fresh_translation: You shall not burn fire in any of your dwellings on the day of the Sabbaths. I am the Lord."
brenton_translation: Ye shall not burn a fire in any of your dwellings on the sabbath-day; I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "This is the word that the Lord commanded, saying,
brenton_translation: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord has appointed you, saying,

fresh_translation: Take from yourselves a contribution to the Lord. Everyone accepting it in heart shall bring the Lord's first-contributions: gold, silver, bronze,
brenton_translation: Take of yourselves an offering for the Lord: every one that engages in his heart shall bring the first-fruits to the Lord; gold, silver, brass,

fresh_translation: blue, purple, doubled scarlet spun, woven fine linen, and goat hair,
brenton_translation: blue, purple, double scarlet spun, and fine linen spun, and goats' hair,

fresh_translation: and rams' skins dyed red and blue skins and incorruptible wood,
brenton_translation: and rams' skins dyed red, and skins dyed blue, and incorruptible wood,

fresh_translation: and sardius stones and stones for engraving, for the ephod and the robe.
brenton_translation: and sardine stones, and stones for engraving for the shoulder-piece and full-length robe.

fresh_translation: And every wise-hearted person among you, let him come and make all that the Lord has commanded:
brenton_translation: And every man that is wise in heart among you, let him come and work all things whatsoever the Lord has commanded.

fresh_translation: the tent and the hangings and the coverings and the rings and the bars and the posts,
brenton_translation: The tabernacle, and the cords, and the coverings, and the rings, and the bars, and the posts,

fresh_translation: and the ark of testimony and its poles and its propitiatory and the curtain,
brenton_translation: and the ark of the testimony, and its staves, and its propitiatory, and the veil,

fresh_translation: and the table and all its utensils,
brenton_translation: and the table and all its furniture,

fresh_translation: and the lampstand of light and all its utensils,
brenton_translation: and the candlestick for the light and all its furniture,

fresh_translation: and the altar and all its utensils,
brenton_translation: and the altar and all its furniture;

fresh_translation: and the holy garments of Aaron the priest and the garments in which they shall minister, and the tunics for Aaron's sons for the priesthood, and the anointing oil and the compounded incense."
brenton_translation: and the holy garments of Aaron the priest, and the garments in which they shall do service; and the garments of priesthood for the sons of Aaron and the anointing oil, and the compound incense.

fresh_translation: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel went out from Moses.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation of the children of Israel went out from Moses. And they brought, they whose heart prompted them, and they to whomsoever it seemed good in their mind, each an offering:

fresh_translation: And each one whose heart brought him, and each one to whom it seemed good in soul, brought the Lord's contribution for all the works of the tent of testimony and for all its services and for all the holy garments.
brenton_translation: and they brought an offering to the Lord for all the works of the tabernacle of witness, and all its services, and for all the robes of the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: And the men brought from among the women—everyone to whom it seemed good in mind—they brought seals and earrings and rings and necklaces and bracelets, every gold vessel. And all who brought gold contributions to the Lord brought them.
brenton_translation: And the men, even every one to whom it seemed good in his heart, brought from the women, even brought seals and ear-rings, and finger-rings, and necklaces, and bracelets, every article of gold.

fresh_translation: And everyone with whom fine linen and blue skins and red-dyed rams' skins were found, brought them.
brenton_translation: And all as many as brought ornaments of gold to the Lord, and with whomsoever fine linen was found; and they brought skins dyed blue, and rams' skins dyed red.

fresh_translation: And everyone offering a silver or bronze contribution brought the Lord's contributions, and those with whom incorruptible wood was found for all the works of preparation brought it.
brenton_translation: And every one that offered an offering brought silver and brass, the offerings to the Lord; and they with whom was found incorruptible wood; and they brought offerings for all the works of the preparation.

fresh_translation: And every woman wise in mind spun with her hands and brought what was spun: the blue and the purple and the scarlet and the fine linen.
brenton_translation: And every woman skilled in her heart to spin with her hands, brought spun articles, the blue, and purple, and scarlet and fine linen.

fresh_translation: And all the women whose mind moved them in wisdom spun the goat hair.
brenton_translation: And all the women to whom it seemed good in their heart in their wisdom, spun the goats' hair.

fresh_translation: And the rulers brought the sardius stones and the stones of filling for the ephod and for the breastpiece,
brenton_translation: And the rulers brought the emerald stones, and the stones for setting in the ephod, and the oracle,

fresh_translation: and the spices and the oil of anointing and the compounded incense.
brenton_translation: and the compounds both for the anointing oil, and the composition of the incense.

fresh_translation: Every man and woman whose mind moved them to come in and do all the works that the Lord had commanded to be done through Moses—the sons of Israel brought a contribution to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And every man and woman whose mind inclined them to come in and do all the works as many as the Lord appointed them to do by Moses—they the children of Israel brought an offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to the sons of Israel, "Look, God has called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
brenton_translation: And Moses said to the children of Israel, Behold, God has called by name Beseleel the son of Urias the son of Or, of the tribe of Juda,

fresh_translation: and has filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding and knowledge of all things,
brenton_translation: and has filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding, and knowledge of all things,

fresh_translation: to devise skillfully in all works of craftsmanship, to make gold and silver and bronze,
brenton_translation: to labour skilfully in all works of cunning workmanship, to form the gold and the silver and the brass,

fresh_translation: and to cut stone and work wood and do every work of wisdom.
brenton_translation: and to work in stone, and to fashion the wood, and to work in every work of wisdom.

fresh_translation: And he gave improvement in understanding in his mind, both to him and to Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
brenton_translation: And God gave improvement in understanding both to him, and to Eliab the son of Achisamach of the tribe of Dan.

fresh_translation: He filled them with wisdom, understanding, and insight to understand and do all the works of the holy place, and to weave woven and variegated work with the scarlet and fine linen, to do every work of craftsmanship and embroidery."
brenton_translation: And God filled them with wisdom, understanding and perception, to understand to work all the works of the sanctuary, and to weave the woven and embroidered work with scarlet and fine linen, to do all work of curious workmanship and embroidery.

fresh_translation: And Bezalel and Oholiab and every wise-hearted one to whom wisdom and knowledge were given, to understand how to do all the works of the holy duties, did all that the Lord commanded.
brenton_translation: And Beseleel wrought, and Eliab and every one wise in understanding, to whom was given wisdom and knowledge, to understand to do all the works according to the holy offices, according to all things which the Lord appointed.

fresh_translation: And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and all those having wisdom, to whom God gave knowledge in heart, and all who willingly wanted to come near to the works to perform them.
brenton_translation: And Moses called Beseleel and Eliab, and all that had wisdom, to whom God gave knowledge in their heart, and all who were freely willing to come forward to the works, to perform them.

fresh_translation: And they received from Moses all the contributions that the sons of Israel had brought for all the works of the holy place to do them. And they were still receiving what was brought by those bringing it each morning.
brenton_translation: And they received from Moses all the offerings, which the children of Israel brought for all the works of the sanctuary to do them; and they continued to receive the gifts brought, from those who brought them in the morning.

fresh_translation: And all the wise men doing the works of the holy place came, each from his own work that he was doing,
brenton_translation: And there came all the wise men who wrought the works of the sanctuary, each according to his own work, which they wrought.

fresh_translation: and they said to Moses, "The people are bringing more than enough for the works that the Lord commanded to be done."
brenton_translation: And one said to Moses, The people bring an abundance too great in proportion to all the works which the Lord has appointed them to do.

fresh_translation: And Moses commanded, and proclamation was made in the camp, saying, "Let neither man nor woman work any longer for the first-contributions of the holy place." So the people were restrained from bringing more.
brenton_translation: And Moses commanded, and proclaimed in the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman any longer labour for the offerings of the sanctuary; and the people were restrained from bringing any more.

fresh_translation: And the works they had were sufficient for the making, and there was some left over.
brenton_translation: And they had materials sufficient for making the furniture, and they left some besides.

fresh_translation: And every wise one among those working made the holy garments that belong to Aaron the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And every wise one among those that wrought made the robes of the holy places, which belong to Aaron the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And they made the ephod of gold and blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen.
brenton_translation: And he made the ephod of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.

fresh_translation: And the plates of gold were cut into threads, so that they might be woven with the blue and the purple and the spun scarlet and the woven fine linen, a woven work.
brenton_translation: And the plates were divided, the threads of gold, so as to interweave with the blue and purple, and with the spun scarlet, and the fine linen twined, they made it a woven work;

fresh_translation: They made shoulder-pieces joined from both sides.
brenton_translation: shoulder-pieces joined from both sides, a work woven by mutual twisting of the parts into one another.

fresh_translation: A woven work intertwined into one another they made from the same material, of gold and blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: They made it of the same material according to the making of it, of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined, as the Lord commanded Moses;

fresh_translation: And they made the two emerald stones clasped and encircled in gold, engraved and carved like the carving of a seal, with the names of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: and they made the two emerald stones clasped together and set in gold, graven and cut after the cutting of a seal with the names of the children of Israel;

fresh_translation: And he placed them on the shoulders of the ephod, as memorial stones of the sons of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: and he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, as stones of memorial of the children of Israel, as the Lord appointed Moses.

fresh_translation: And they made the breastpiece, embroidered work, according to the work of the ephod, of gold and blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen.
brenton_translation: And they made the oracle, a work woven with embroidery, according to the work of the ephod, of gold, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.

fresh_translation: They made the breastpiece square and doubled, a span its length and a span its breadth, doubled.
brenton_translation: They made the oracle square and double, the length of a span, and the breadth of a span,—double.

fresh_translation: And a setting of four rows of stones was woven into it: sardius and topaz and emerald, the first row.
brenton_translation: And there was interwoven with it a woven work of four rows of stones, a series of stones, the first row, a sardius and topaz and emerald;

fresh_translation: And the second row: carbuncle and sapphire and jasper.
brenton_translation: and the second row, a carbuncle and sapphire and jasper;

fresh_translation: And the third row: ligure and agate and amethyst.
brenton_translation: and the third row, a ligure and agate and amethyst;

fresh_translation: And the fourth row: chrysolite and beryl and onyx, encircled with gold and bound in gold.
brenton_translation: and the fourth row a chrysolite and beryl and onyx set round about with gold, and fastened with gold.

fresh_translation: And the stones were twelve according to the names of the sons of Israel, engraved like seals, each with its own name for the twelve tribes.
brenton_translation: And the stones were twelve according to the names of the children of Israel, graven according to their names like seals, each according to his own name for the twelve tribes.

fresh_translation: And they made on the breastpiece braided cords, woven chainwork of pure gold.
brenton_translation: And they made on the oracle turned wreaths, wreathen work, of pure gold,

fresh_translation: And they made two gold settings and two gold rings and placed the two gold rings on both ends of the breastpiece.
brenton_translation: and they made two golden circlets and two golden rings. And they put the two golden rings on both the upper corners of the oracle;

fresh_translation: And they placed the gold woven cords on the rings at both sides of the breastpiece.
brenton_translation: and they put the golden wreaths on the rings on both sides of the oracle,

fresh_translation: And the two woven cords they set into the two couplings, and they placed them on the two settings, and they placed them on the shoulders of the ephod opposite each other at the front.
brenton_translation: and the two wreaths into the two couplings. And they put them on the two circlets, and they put them on the shoulders of the ephod opposite each other in front.

fresh_translation: And they made two gold rings and placed them on the two wings at the edge of the breastpiece, on the inner edge of the back of the ephod.
brenton_translation: And they made two golden rings, and put them on the two projections on the top of the oracle, and on the top of the hinder part of the ephod within.

fresh_translation: And they made two gold rings and placed them on both shoulders of the ephod beneath it, at the front, by the joining above the woven band of the ephod.
brenton_translation: And they made two golden rings, and put them on both the shoulders of the ephod under it, in front by the coupling above the connexion of the ephod.

fresh_translation: And he fastened the breastpiece from its rings to the rings of the ephod, joined with blue woven cord to the woven band of the ephod, so that the breastpiece might not loosen from the ephod, as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he fastened the oracle by the rings that were on it to the rings of the ephod, which were fastened with a string of blue, joined together with the woven work of the ephod; that the oracle should not be loosed from the ephod, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And they made the robe under the ephod, woven work, all blue.
brenton_translation: And they made the tunic under the ephod, woven work, all of blue.

fresh_translation: And the opening of the robe in the middle was woven close together, with a border around the opening, not to be torn.
brenton_translation: And the opening of the tunic in the midst woven closely together, the opening having a fringe round about, that it might not be rent.

fresh_translation: And on the hem of the robe below they made pomegranates like blossoming pomegranate fruit, of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen.
brenton_translation: And they made on the border of the tunic below pomegranates as of a flowering pomegranate tree, of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined.

fresh_translation: And they made gold bells and placed the bells on the hem of the robe all around between the pomegranates,
brenton_translation: And they made golden bells, and put the bells on the border of the tunic round about between the pomegranates:

fresh_translation: a gold bell and a pomegranate on the hem of the robe all around, for ministering, as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: a golden bell and a pomegranate on the border of the tunic round about, for the ministration, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And they made woven fine linen tunics for Aaron and his sons,
brenton_translation: And they made vestments of fine linen, a woven work, for Aaron and his sons,

fresh_translation: and the turbans of fine linen and the headdress of fine linen and the undergarments of woven fine linen,
brenton_translation: and the tires of fine linen, and the mitre of fine linen, and the drawers of fine linen twined;

fresh_translation: and their sashes of fine linen and blue and purple and spun scarlet, embroidered work, as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: and their girdles of fine linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet spun, the work of an embroiderer, according as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And they made the gold plate, the separated thing of the holy place, of pure gold, and wrote on it engraved letters like the engraving of a seal: "Holiness to the Lord."
brenton_translation: And they made the golden plate, a dedicated thing of the sanctuary, of pure gold; and he wrote upon it graven letters as of a seal, Holiness to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they placed on it a blue cord so that it would be on the turban above, as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And they put it on the border of blue, so that it should be on the mitre above, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And they made ten curtains for the tent.
brenton_translation: And they made ten curtains for the tabernacle;

fresh_translation: The length of one curtain was twenty-eight cubits; one measure belonged to all of them, and the breadth of one curtain was four cubits.
brenton_translation: of eight and twenty cubits the length of one curtain: the same measure was to all, and the breadth of one curtain was of four cubits.

fresh_translation: And they made the curtain of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, woven work with cherubim.
brenton_translation: And they made the veil of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined, the woven work with cherubs.
