brenton_translation: And the priest shall offer the whole-burnt-offering, and the sacrifice upon the altar before the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be cleansed.

fresh_translation: But if he is poor and his hand cannot find enough, he shall take one lamb for the thing in which he trespassed, as a contribution to make atonement for him, and one tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for sacrifice, and one cup of oil,
brenton_translation: And if he should be poor, and cannot afford so much, he shall take one lamb for his transgression for a separate-offering, so as to make propitiation for him, and a tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a sacrifice, and one cup of oil,

fresh_translation: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whatever his hand can find, and one shall be for sin and one for whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, as he can afford; and the one shall be for a sin-offering, and the other for a whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the tent of testimony, before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring them on the eighth day, to purify him, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of witness before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall take the lamb for trespass and the cup of oil and present them before the Lord as a presentation.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass-offering, and the cup of oil, and place them for a set-offering before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he shall slaughter the lamb for trespass, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the thing for trespass and place it on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed and on the tip of his right hand and on the tip of his right foot.
brenton_translation: And he shall slay the lamb of the trespass-offering; and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and put it on the tip of the right ear of him that is under purification, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

fresh_translation: And some of the oil the priest shall pour on the priest's left hand.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall pour of the oil on his own left hand.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall sprinkle with the finger of his right hand some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall place some of the oil on his hand on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed and on the tip of his right hand and on the tip of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the thing for trespass.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall put of the oil that is on his hand on the tip of the right ear of him that is under purification, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass-offering.

fresh_translation: And what remains of the oil on the priest's hand the priest shall place on the head of the one cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And that which is left of the oil which is on the hand of the priest he shall put on the head of him that is purged, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he shall make one of the turtledoves or of the young pigeons, whatever his hand can find,
brenton_translation: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves or of the young pigeons, as he can afford it,

fresh_translation: the one for sin and the one for whole burnt offering with the sacrifice, and the priest shall make atonement before the Lord for the one being cleansed.
brenton_translation: the one for a sin-offering, the other for a whole-burnt-offering with the meat-offering, and the priest shall make an atonement before the Lord for him that is under purification.

fresh_translation: This is the law for the one in whom is the mark of skin-disease, and whose hand does not find enough for his cleansing.
brenton_translation: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, and who cannot afford the offerings for his purification.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

fresh_translation: When you enter into the land of the Canaanites, which I give you for a possession, and I place a mark of skin-disease in the houses of the land of your possession,
brenton_translation: Whensoever ye shall enter into the land of the Chananites, which I give you for a possession, and I shall put the plague of leprosy in the houses of the land of your possession;

fresh_translation: then the one whose house it is shall come and report to the priest, saying, Something like a mark has appeared to me in the house.
brenton_translation: then the owner of the house shall come and report to the priest, saying, I have seen as it were a plague in the house.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall command them to empty the house before the priest goes in to inspect the mark, so that everything in the house may not become unclean. And after this the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall give orders to remove the furniture of the house, before the priest comes in to see the plague, and thus none of the things in the house shall become unclean; and afterwards the priest shall go in to examine the house.

fresh_translation: And he shall inspect the mark, and if the mark on the walls of the house has greenish or reddish hollows, and their appearance is deeper than the walls,
brenton_translation: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house, he will see greenish or reddish cavities, and the appearance of them will be beneath the surface of the walls.

fresh_translation: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and the priest shall isolate the house seven days.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall come out of the house to the door of the house, and the priest shall separate the house seven days.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall return on the seventh day and inspect, and if the mark has spread in the walls of the house,
brenton_translation: And the priest shall return on the seventh day and view the house; and, behold, if the plague is spread in the walls of the house,

fresh_translation: then the priest shall command, and they shall remove the stones in which the mark is and throw them outside the city into an unclean place.
brenton_translation: then the priest shall give orders, and they shall take away the stones in which the plague is, and shall cast them out of the city into an unclean place.

fresh_translation: And they shall scrape the house inside all around, and they shall pour out the dust that they scraped outside the city into an unclean place.
brenton_translation: And they shall scrape the house within round about, and shall pour out the dust scraped off outside the city into an unclean place.

fresh_translation: And they shall take other stones, scraped, and put them in place of the stones, and they shall take other plaster and plaster the house.
brenton_translation: And they shall take other scraped stones, and put them in the place of the former stones, and they shall take other plaster and plaster the house.

fresh_translation: But if the mark comes again and springs up in the house after they remove the stones and after the house is scraped and after it is plastered,
brenton_translation: And if the plague should return again, and break out in the house after they have taken away the stones and after the house is scraped, and after it has been plastered,

fresh_translation: then the priest shall go in and inspect. If the mark has spread in the house, it is persistent skin-disease in the house. It is unclean.
brenton_translation: then the priest shall go in and see if the plague is spread in the house: it is a confirmed leprosy in the house, it is unclean.

fresh_translation: And they shall pull down the house, and its timbers and its stones, and all its dust they shall carry outside the city into an unclean place.
brenton_translation: And they shall take down the house, and its timbers and its stones, and they shall carry out all the mortar without the city into an unclean place.

fresh_translation: And the one entering into the house all the days during which it is isolated shall be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And he that goes into the house at any time, during its separation, shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And the one sleeping in the house shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening, and the one eating in the house shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And he that sleeps in the house shall wash his garments, and be unclean until evening; and he that eats in the house shall wash his garments, and be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: But if the priest does come and inspect, and if the mark has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the mark is healed.
brenton_translation: And if the priest shall arrive and enter and see, and behold the plague be not at all spread in the house after the house has been plastered, then the priest shall declare the house clean, because the plague is healed.

fresh_translation: And he shall take to purify the house two living clean birds and cedar wood and spun scarlet and hyssop.
brenton_translation: And he shall take to purify the house two clean living birds, and cedar wood, and spun scarlet, and hyssop.

fresh_translation: And he shall slaughter the one bird in an earthen vessel over living water.
brenton_translation: And he shall slay one bird in an earthen vessel over running water.

fresh_translation: And he shall take the cedar wood and the spun scarlet and the hyssop and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird over living water, and with them he shall sprinkle the house seven times.
brenton_translation: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the spun scarlet, and the hyssop, and the living bird; and shall dip it into the blood of the bird slain over running water, and with them he shall sprinkle the house seven times.

fresh_translation: And he shall purify the house with the blood of the bird and with the living water and with the living bird and with the cedar wood and with the hyssop and with the spun scarlet.
brenton_translation: And he shall purify the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the spun scarlet.

fresh_translation: And he shall release the living bird outside the city into the open field, and shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
brenton_translation: And he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the field, and shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.

fresh_translation: This is the law for every mark of skin-disease and scaly patch,
brenton_translation: This is the law concerning every plague of leprosy and scurf,

fresh_translation: and for skin-disease of garment and house,
brenton_translation: and of the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

fresh_translation: and for swelling and mark and bright spot,
brenton_translation: and of a sore, and of a clear spot, and of a shining one,

fresh_translation: to explain the day when it is unclean and the day when it is clean. This is the law of skin-disease.
brenton_translation: and of declaring in what day it is unclean, and in what day it shall be purged: this is the law of the leprosy.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whatever man shall have an issue out of his body, his issue is unclean.

fresh_translation: And this is the law of his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with the discharge or his body is stopped up from the discharge, this is his uncleanness. All the days of the discharge of his body, or if his body is stopped up by the discharge, this is his uncleanness.
brenton_translation: And this is the law of his uncleanness; whoever has a gonorrhœa out of his body, this is his uncleanness in him by reason of the issue, by which his body is affected through the issue: all the days of the issue of his body, by which his body is affected through the issue, there is his uncleanness.

fresh_translation: Every bed on which the one with discharge lies is unclean, and every vessel on which the one with discharge sits shall be unclean.
brenton_translation: Every bed on which he that has the issue shall happen to lie, is unclean; and every seat on which he that has the issue may happen to sit, shall be unclean.

fresh_translation: And the person who touches his bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And the man who shall touch his bed, shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean till evening.

fresh_translation: And the one sitting on the vessel on which the one with discharge sat shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And whosoever sits on the seat on which he that has the issue may have sat, shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And the one touching the flesh of the one with discharge shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And he that touches the skin of him that has the issue, shall wash his garments and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean till evening.

fresh_translation: And if the one with discharge spits on the clean person, he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And if he that has the issue should spit upon one that is clean, that person shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And every saddle of a donkey on which the one with discharge rides shall be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And every ass's saddle, on which the man with the issue shall have mounted, shall be unclean till evening.

fresh_translation: And everyone touching whatever is under him shall be unclean until evening, and the one carrying those things shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And every one that touches whatsoever shall have been under him shall be unclean until evening; and he that takes them up shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And whomever the one with discharge touches, if he has not washed his hands in water, he shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And whomsoever he that has the issue shall touch, if he have not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And an earthen vessel that the one with discharge touches shall be broken, and a wooden vessel shall be washed with water and shall be clean.
brenton_translation: And the earthen vessel which he that has the issue shall happen to touch, shall be broken; and a wooden vessel shall be washed with water, and shall be clean.

fresh_translation: And if the one with discharge is cleansed from his discharge, then he shall count seven days for his cleansing and wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be clean.
brenton_translation: And if he that has the issue should be cleansed of his issue, then shall he number to himself seven days for his purification; and he shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and shall be clean.

fresh_translation: And on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them before the Lord to the doors of the tent of testimony and give them to the priest.
brenton_translation: And on the eighth day he shall take to himself two turtle-doves or two young pigeons, and he shall bring them before the Lord to the doors of the tabernacle of witness, and shall give them to the priest.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall make them, one for sin and one for whole burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord from his discharge.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall offer them one for a sin-offering, and the other for a whole-burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord for his issue.

fresh_translation: And a man from whom an emission of seed goes out shall bathe all his body in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And the man whose seed of copulation shall happen to go forth from him, shall then wash his whole body, and shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And every garment and every skin on which there is an emission of seed shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And every garment, and every skin on which there shall be the seed of copulation shall both be washed with water, and be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And if a woman lies with a man in an emission of seed, they shall bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And a woman, if a man shall lie with her with seed of copulation—they shall both bathe themselves in water and shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And if a woman has a flow of blood, her flow being in her body, she shall be in her separation seven days. Everyone touching her shall be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And the woman whosoever shall have an issue of blood, when her issue shall be in her body, shall be seven days in her separation; every one that touches her shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And everything on which she lies during her separation shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
brenton_translation: And every thing whereon she shall lie in her separation, shall be unclean; and whatever she shall sit upon, shall be unclean.

fresh_translation: And everyone touching her bed shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And whosoever shall touch her bed shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And everyone touching any vessel on which she sits shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And every one that touches any vessel on which she shall sit, shall wash his garments and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

fresh_translation: And if it is on the bed or on the vessel on which she sat, when he touches it he shall be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: And whether it be while she is on her bed, or on a seat which she may happen to sit upon when he touches her, he shall be unclean till evening.

fresh_translation: And if anyone lies with her and her uncleanness comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
brenton_translation: And if any one shall lie with her, and her uncleanness be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he shall have lain shall be unclean.

fresh_translation: And if a woman has a flow of blood for many days, not at the time of her separation, or if she flows after her separation, all the days of the flow of her uncleanness, just as in the days of her separation, she shall be unclean.
brenton_translation: And if a woman have an issue of blood many days, not in the time of her separation; if the blood should also flow after her separation, all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

fresh_translation: And every bed on which she lies during all the days of her flow shall be to her like the bed of her separation, and every vessel on which she sits shall be unclean like the uncleanness of her separation.
brenton_translation: And every bed on which she shall lie all the days of her flux shall be to her as the bed of her separation, and every seat whereon she shall sit shall be unclean according to the uncleanness of her separation.

fresh_translation: Everyone touching her shall be unclean, and he shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be unclean until evening.
brenton_translation: Every one that touches it shall be unclean; and he shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean till evening.

fresh_translation: But if she is cleansed from her flow, then she shall count seven days for herself, and after this she shall be clean.
brenton_translation: But if she shall be cleansed from her flux, then she shall number to herself seven days, and afterwards she shall be esteemed clean.

fresh_translation: And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And on the eighth day she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and shall bring them to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall make the one for sin and the one for whole burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord from the flow of her uncleanness.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a whole-burnt-offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord for her unclean flux.

fresh_translation: And you shall make the sons of Israel cautious from their uncleannesses, and they shall not die because of their uncleannesses by defiling my tent that is among them.
brenton_translation: And ye shall cause the children of Israel to beware of their uncleannesses; so they shall not die for their uncleanness, in polluting my tabernacle that is among them.

fresh_translation: This is the law of the one with discharge, and of the one from whom an emission of seed goes out so as to become unclean by it,
brenton_translation: This is the law of the man who has an issue, and if one discharge seed of copulation, so that he should be polluted by it.

fresh_translation: and of the woman flowing in her separation, and of the one with discharge in his flow, for the male and for the female, and for the man who lies with a separated woman.
brenton_translation: And this is the law for her that has the issue of blood in her separation, and as to the person who has an issue of seed, in his issue: it is a law for the male and the female, and for the man who shall have lain with her that is set apart.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses after the two sons of Aaron died when they brought foreign fire before the Lord, and they died.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses after the two sons of Aaron died in bringing strange fire before the Lord, so they died.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Speak to Aaron your brother, and let him not enter at every time into the holy place within the veil, before the propitiatory that is upon the ark of testimony, so that he may not die, for in a cloud I will be seen upon the propitiatory.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Speak to Aaron thy brother, and let him not come in at all times into the holy place within the veil before the propitiatory, which is upon the ark of the testimony, and he shall not die; for I will appear in a cloud on the propitiatory.

fresh_translation: Thus Aaron shall enter into the holy place: with a calf from the cattle for sin and a ram for whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: Thus shall Aaron enter into the holy place; with a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and having a ram for a whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And he shall put on the holy linen tunic, and linen undergarments shall be upon his flesh, and he shall gird himself with a linen sash, and shall put on a linen turban. They are holy garments. And he shall bathe all his body in water and put them on.
brenton_translation: And he shall put on the consecrated linen tunic, and he shall have on his flesh the linen drawers, and shall gird himself with a linen girdle, and shall put on the linen cap, they are holy garments; and he shall bathe all his body in water, and shall put them on.

fresh_translation: And from the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two he-goats from the goats for sin and one ram for whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin-offering, and one lamb for a whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his own sin and make atonement for himself and for his house.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his own sin-offering, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house.

fresh_translation: And he shall take the two he-goats and set them before the Lord by the door of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And he shall take the two goats, and place them before the Lord by the door of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two he-goats, one lot for the Lord and one lot for the sending-away goat.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats, one lot for the Lord, and the other for the scape-goat.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall bring the he-goat on which the lot for the Lord fell and shall offer it for sin.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot for the Lord fell, and shall offer him for a sin-offering.

fresh_translation: But the he-goat on which the lot of the sending-away goat fell, he shall set alive before the Lord, to make atonement over it, so as to send it away in the sending-away, into the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And the goat upon which the lot of the scape-goat came, he shall present alive before the Lord, to make atonement upon him, so as to send him away as a scape-goat, and he shall send him into the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his own sin, for himself and his house alone, and make atonement for himself and for his house, and he shall slaughter the calf for his own sin.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his sin, and he shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and he shall kill the calf for his sin-offering.

fresh_translation: And he shall take the firepan full of coals of fire from the altar before the Lord, and he shall fill his hands with fine blended incense and bring it within the veil.
brenton_translation: And he shall take his censer full of coals of fire off the altar, which is before the Lord; and he shall fill his hands with fine compound incense, and shall bring it within the veil.

fresh_translation: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, and the vapor of the incense shall cover the propitiatory that is over the testimonies, so that he may not die.
brenton_translation: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, and the smoke of the incense shall cover the mercy-seat over the tables of testimony, and he shall not die.

fresh_translation: And he shall take some of the blood of the calf and sprinkle it with his finger on the propitiatory eastward, and before the propitiatory he shall sprinkle from the blood with his finger seven times.
brenton_translation: And he shall take of the blood of the calf, and sprinkle with his finger on the mercy-seat eastward: before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle seven times of the blood with his finger.

fresh_translation: And he shall slaughter the he-goat for sin, the one for the people, before the Lord, and he shall bring some of its blood within the veil and do with its blood just as he did with the blood of the calf, and he shall sprinkle its blood upon the propitiatory and before the propitiatory.
brenton_translation: And he shall kill the goat for the sin-offering that is for the people, before the Lord; and he shall bring in of its blood within the veil, and shall do with its blood as he did with the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle its blood on the mercy-seat, in front of the mercy-seat.

fresh_translation: And he shall make atonement for the holy place from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel and from their wrongdoings concerning all their sins. And thus he shall do for the tent of testimony that is pitched among them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
brenton_translation: And he shall make atonement for the sanctuary on account of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and for their trespasses in the matter of all their sins; and thus shall he do to the tabernacle of witness established among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

fresh_translation: And no person shall be in the tent of testimony when he enters to make atonement in the holy place until he comes out, and he shall make atonement for himself and for his house and for all the congregation of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of witness, when he goes in to make atonement in the holy place, until he shall have come out; and he shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and for all the congregation of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he shall go out to the altar that is before the Lord and make atonement on it, and he shall take some of the blood of the calf and some of the blood of the he-goat and place it on the horns of the altar all around.
brenton_translation: And he shall come forth to the altar that is before the Lord, and he shall make atonement upon it; and he shall take of the blood of the calf, and of the blood of the goat, and shall put it on the horns of the altar round about.

fresh_translation: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times and cleanse it and sanctify it from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood upon it seven times with his finger, and shall purge it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And when he finishes making atonement for the holy place and the tent of testimony and the altar and purifying concerning the priests, he shall bring near the live he-goat.
brenton_translation: And he shall finish making atonement for the sanctuary and for the tabernacle of witness, and for the altar; and he shall make a cleansing for the priests, and he shall bring the living goat;

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall lay his hands on the head of the live he-goat and confess over it all the lawless deeds of the sons of Israel and all their wrongdoings and all their sins, and he shall place them on the head of the live he-goat and send it away by the hand of a ready man into the wilderness.
brenton_translation: and Aaron shall lay his hands on the head of the live goat, and he shall declare over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their unrighteousnesses, and all their sins; and he shall lay them upon the head of the live goat, and shall send him by the hand of a ready man into the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And the he-goat shall take their wrongdoings upon itself into an untrodden land, and he shall send the he-goat away into the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And the goat shall bear their unrighteousnesses upon him into a desert land; and Aaron shall send away the goat into the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And Aaron shall enter into the tent of testimony and take off the linen garment that he put on when entering into the holy place and lay it there.
brenton_translation: And Aaron shall enter into the tabernacle of witness, and shall put off the linen garment, which he had put on, as he entered into the holy place, and shall lay it by there.

fresh_translation: And he shall bathe his body in water in a holy place and put on his garment, and going out he shall make his whole burnt offering and the whole burnt offering of the people, and he shall make atonement for himself and for his house and for the people, as also for the priests.
brenton_translation: And he shall bathe his body in water in the holy place, and shall put on his raiment, and shall go out and offer the whole-burnt-offering for himself and the whole-burnt-offering for the people: and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and for the people, as for the priests.

fresh_translation: And the fat for the things concerning sins he shall offer on the altar.
brenton_translation: And he shall offer the fat for the sin-offering on the altar.

fresh_translation: And the one sending away the he-goat that has been set apart for release shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and after this shall enter into the camp.
brenton_translation: And he that sends forth the goat that has been set apart to be let go, shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards shall enter into the camp.

fresh_translation: And the calf for sin and the he-goat for sin, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, they shall carry outside the camp and burn them with fire, their skins and their flesh and their dung.
brenton_translation: And the calf for the sin-offering, and the goat for the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, they shall carry forth out of the camp, and burn them with fire, even their skins and their flesh and their dung.

fresh_translation: And the one burning them shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and after this shall enter into the camp.
brenton_translation: And he that burns them shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards he shall enter into the camp.

fresh_translation: And this shall be an everlasting statute for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall humble your lives and do no work, whether the native or the newcomer who dwells among you.
brenton_translation: And this shall be a perpetual statute for you; in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall humble your souls, and shall do no work, the native and the stranger who abides among you.

fresh_translation: For on this day he shall make atonement for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord, and you shall be cleansed.
brenton_translation: For in this day he shall make an atonement for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord, and ye shall be purged.

fresh_translation: It shall be a sabbath of sabbaths, a rest for you, and you shall humble your lives. It is an everlasting statute.
brenton_translation: This shall be to you a most holy sabbath, a rest, and ye shall humble your souls; it is a perpetual ordinance.

fresh_translation: And the priest whom they anoint and whose hands they consecrate to serve as priest after his father shall make atonement, and he shall put on the holy linen garment.
brenton_translation: The priest whomsoever they shall anoint shall make atonement, and whomsoever they shall consecrate to exercise the priestly office after his father; and he shall put on the linen robe, the holy garment.

fresh_translation: And he shall make atonement for the holy of the holy place, and for the tent of testimony, and he shall make atonement for the altar, and for the priests and for all the congregation he shall make atonement.
brenton_translation: And he shall make atonement for the most holy place, and the tabernacle of witness; and he shall make atonement for the altar, and for the priests; and he shall make atonement for all the congregation.

fresh_translation: And this shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the sons of Israel from all their sins once in the year. It shall be done just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And this shall be to you a perpetual statute to make atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins: it shall be done once in the year, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them, This is the word that the Lord commanded, saying,
brenton_translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, This is the word which the Lord has commanded, saying,

fresh_translation: Any man of the sons of Israel or of the newcomers dwelling among you who slaughters a calf or a sheep or a goat in the camp, or who slaughters it outside the camp,
brenton_translation: Every man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers abiding among you, who shall kill a calf, or a sheep, or a goat in the camp, or who shall kill it out of the camp,

fresh_translation: and does not bring it to the door of the tent of testimony so as to make it a whole burnt offering or an offering of salvation to the Lord, accepted as an aroma of sweet fragrance, and whoever slaughters it outside and does not bring it to the door of the tent of testimony so as not to bring a gift to the Lord before the Lord's tent, blood shall be reckoned to that man. He has shed blood. That person shall be cut off from his people.
brenton_translation: and shall not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of witness, so as to sacrifice it for a whole-burnt-offering or peace-offering to the Lord to be acceptable for a sweet-smelling savour: and whosoever shall slay it without, and shall not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of witness, so as to offer it as a gift to the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord; blood shall be imputed to that man, he has shed blood; that soul shall be cut off from his people.

fresh_translation: So that the sons of Israel may bring their sacrifices that they slaughter in the open fields, and bring them to the Lord at the doors of the tent of testimony, to the priest, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of salvation to the Lord.
brenton_translation: That the children of Israel may offer their sacrifices, all that they shall slay in the fields, and bring them to the Lord unto the doors of the tabernacle of witness to the priest, and they shall sacrifice them as a peace-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall pour the blood on the altar all around before the Lord by the doors of the tent of testimony, and shall offer the fat as an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall pour the blood on the altar round about before the Lord by the doors of the tabernacle of witness, and shall offer the fat for a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they shall no longer sacrifice their sacrifices to vain things, after which they prostitute themselves. This shall be an everlasting statute for you throughout your generations.
brenton_translation: And they shall no longer offer their sacrifices to vain gods after which they go a whoring; it shall be a perpetual statute to you for your generations.

fresh_translation: And you shall say to them, Any man of the sons of Israel or of the newcomer sons dwelling among you who makes a whole burnt offering or sacrifice,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to them, Whatever man of the children of Israel, or of the sons of the proselytes abiding among you, shall offer a whole-burnt-offering or a sacrifice,

fresh_translation: and does not bring it to the door of the tent of testimony to make it for the Lord, that man shall be cut off from his people.
brenton_translation: and shall not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of witness to sacrifice it to the Lord, that man shall be destroyed from among his people.

fresh_translation: And any man of the sons of Israel or of the newcomers dwelling among you who eats any blood, I will set my face against the person who eats the blood and will destroy him from his people.
brenton_translation: And whatever man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers abiding among you, shall eat any blood, I will even set my face against that soul that eats blood, and will destroy it from its people.

fresh_translation: For the life of all flesh is its blood, and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your lives, for its blood shall make atonement in place of the life.
brenton_translation: For the life of flesh is its blood, and I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for its blood shall make atonement for the soul.

fresh_translation: Because of this I said to the sons of Israel, No person among you shall eat blood, and the newcomer dwelling among you shall not eat blood.
brenton_translation: Therefore I said to the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, and the stranger that abides among you shall not eat blood.

fresh_translation: And any man of the sons of Israel or of the newcomers dwelling among you who hunts game, wild animal or bird that may be eaten, shall pour out the blood and cover it with earth.
brenton_translation: And whatever man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers abiding among you shall take any animal in hunting, beast, or bird, which is eaten, then shall he pour out the blood, and cover it in the dust.

fresh_translation: For the life of all flesh is its blood, and I said to the sons of Israel, You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, because the life of all flesh is its blood. Everyone eating it shall be cut off.
brenton_translation: For the blood of all flesh is its life; and I said to the children of Israel, Ye shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood: every one that eats it shall be destroyed.

fresh_translation: And every person who eats something dead of itself or torn by beasts, whether among the natives or among the newcomers, shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening, and then shall be clean.
brenton_translation: And every soul which eats that which has died of itself, or is taken of beasts, either among the natives or among the strangers, shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean until evening: then shall he be clean.

fresh_translation: But if he does not wash his garments and does not bathe his body in water, then he shall bear his lawlessness.
brenton_translation: But if he do not wash his garments, and do not bathe his body in water, then shall he bear his iniquity.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: According to the practices of the land of Egypt, in which you dwelt, you shall not do, and according to the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you, there you shall not do, and in their ordinances you shall not walk.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not do according to the devices of Egypt, in which ye dwelt: and according to the devices of the land of Chanaan, into which I bring you, ye shall not do; and ye shall not walk in their ordinances.

fresh_translation: You shall do my judgments, and you shall keep my commands to walk in them. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Ye shall observe my judgments, and shall keep my ordinances, and shall walk in them: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep all my commands and all my judgments and do them, which when a person does, he shall live in them. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: So ye shall keep all my ordinances, and all my judgments, and do them; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: Any man to anyone of his own flesh shall not come near to uncover nakedness. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: No man shall draw nigh to any of his near kindred to uncover their nakedness; I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your father and the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover, for she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, for she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your father's wife you shall not uncover. It is your father's nakedness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's wife; it is thy father's nakedness.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your sister, from your father or from your mother, homeborn or born outside, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
brenton_translation: The nakedness of thy sister by thy father or by thy mother, born at home or abroad, their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter you shall not uncover their nakedness, because it is your own nakedness.
brenton_translation: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or thy daughter's daughter, their nakedness thou shalt not uncover; because it is thy nakedness.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of the daughter of your father's wife you shall not uncover. She is your sister by the same father. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of the daughter of thy father's wife; she is thy sister by the same father: thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your father's sister you shall not uncover, for she is your father's close kin.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister, for she is near akin to thy father.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your mother's sister you shall not uncover, for she is your mother's close kin.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, for she is near akin to thy mother.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your father's brother you shall not uncover, and you shall not go in to his wife, for she is your relative.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, and thou shalt not go in to his wife; for she is thy relation.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your daughter-in-law you shall not uncover, for she is your son's wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law, for she is thy son's wife, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of your brother's wife you shall not uncover. It is your brother's nakedness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

fresh_translation: The nakedness of a woman and her daughter you shall not uncover. The daughter of her son and the daughter of her daughter you shall not take to uncover their nakedness, for they are your own kin. It is impiety.
brenton_translation: The nakedness of a woman and her daughter shalt thou not uncover; her son's daughter, and her daughter's daughter, shalt thou not take, to uncover their nakedness, for they are thy kinswomen: it is impiety.

fresh_translation: A woman in addition to her sister you shall not take as a rival, to uncover her nakedness over against her while she is still alive.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not take a wife in addition to her sister, as a rival, to uncover her nakedness in opposition to her, while she is yet living.

fresh_translation: And to a woman in the separation of her uncleanness you shall not come near to uncover her nakedness.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not go in to a woman under separation for her uncleanness, to uncover her nakedness.

fresh_translation: And with your neighbor's wife you shall not give the bed of your seed, to defile yourself with her.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not lie with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

fresh_translation: And from your seed you shall not give to serve a ruler, and you shall not profane my holy name. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not give of thy seed to serve a ruler; and thou shalt not profane my holy name; I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And with a male you shall not lie the bed of a woman, for it is an abomination.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not lie with a man as with a woman, for it is an abomination.

fresh_translation: And with any four-footed animal you shall not give your bed for seed, to defile yourself with it, and a woman shall not stand before any four-footed animal to mate with it, for it is foulness.
brenton_translation: Neither shalt thou lie with any quadruped for copulation, to be polluted with it: neither shall a woman present herself before any quadruped to have connexion with it; for it is an abomination.

fresh_translation: Do not defile yourselves in all these things, for in all these things the nations are defiled, whom I am sending out from before you.
brenton_translation: Do not defile yourselves with any of these things; for in all these things the nations are defiled, which I drive out before you,

fresh_translation: And the land was defiled, and I repaid their wrongdoing upon them because of it, and the land was aggrieved with those dwelling upon it.
brenton_translation: and the land is polluted; and I have recompensed their iniquity to them because of it, and the land is aggrieved with them that dwell upon it.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep all my statutes and all my commands, and you shall do none of all these abominations, whether the native or the newcomer joined among you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and ye shall do none of these abominations; neither the native, nor the stranger that joins himself with you:

fresh_translation: For all these abominations the people of the land did, those who were before you, and the land was defiled.
brenton_translation: (for all these abominations the men of the land did who were before you, and the land was defiled,)

fresh_translation: And let not the land be aggrieved with you when you defile it, just as it was aggrieved with the nations before you.
brenton_translation: and lest the land be aggrieved with you in your polluting it, as it was aggrieved with the nations before you.

fresh_translation: For everyone who does any of all these abominations, the persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people.
brenton_translation: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, the souls that do them shall be destroyed from among their people.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep my commands, so as not to do any of the abominable statutes that came before you, and you shall not be defiled by them, because I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep mine ordinances, that ye may not do any of the abominable practices, which have taken place before your time: and ye shall not be polluted in them; for I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the congregation of the sons of Israel and say to them, You shall be holy, because I, the Lord your God, am holy.
brenton_translation: Speak to the congregation of the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Ye shall be holy; for I the Lord your God am holy.

fresh_translation: Each of you shall fear his father and his mother, and you shall keep my sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Let every one of you reverence his father and his mother; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall not follow idols, and molten gods you shall not make for yourselves. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not follow idols, and ye shall not make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And if you sacrifice a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
brenton_translation: And if ye will sacrifice a peace-offering to the Lord, ye shall offer it acceptable from yourselves.

fresh_translation: On the day when you sacrifice it, it shall be eaten, and on the next day, and if anything is left until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
brenton_translation: In what day soever ye shall sacrifice it, it shall be eaten; and on the following day, and if any of it should be left till the third day, it shall be thoroughly burnt with fire.

fresh_translation: But if it is indeed eaten on the third day, it is unfit. It shall not be accepted.
brenton_translation: And if it should be at all eaten on the third day, it is unfit for sacrifice: it shall not be accepted.

fresh_translation: And the one eating it shall bear sin, because he profaned the holy things of the Lord, and the persons eating it shall be cut off from their people.
brenton_translation: And he that eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy things of the Lord; and the souls that eat it shall be destroyed from among their people.

fresh_translation: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not finish reaping the harvest of your field, and the fallen things of your harvest you shall not gather.
brenton_translation: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, ye shall not complete the reaping of your field with exactness, and thou shalt not gather that which falls from thy reaping.

fresh_translation: And your vineyard you shall not glean over, nor the grapes of your vineyard shall you gather. For the poor and the newcomer you shall leave them. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not go over the gathering of thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the remaining grapes of thy vineyard: thou shalt leave them for the poor and the stranger: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall not steal. You shall not lie. No one shall inform falsely against his neighbor.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not steal, ye shall not lie, neither shall one bear false witness as an informer against his neighbour.

fresh_translation: And you shall not swear by my name in injustice, and you shall not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not swear unjustly by my name, and ye shall not profane the holy name of your God: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall not wrong your neighbor, and you shall not rob, and the wage of the hired laborer shall not sleep with you until morning.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not injure thy neighbour, neither do thou rob him, neither shall the wages of thy hireling remain with thee until the morning.

fresh_translation: You shall not speak evil to the deaf, and before the blind you shall not put a stumbling block, and you shall fear the Lord your God. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not revile the deaf, neither shalt thou put a stumbling-block in the way of the blind; and thou shalt fear the Lord thy God: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not take the face of the poor, nor marvel at the face of the powerful. In righteousness you shall judge your neighbor.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not act unjustly in judgment: thou shalt not accept the person of the poor, nor admire the person of the mighty; with justice shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

fresh_translation: You shall not go with deceit among your people. You shall not rise up against the blood of your neighbor. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not walk deceitfully among thy people; thou shalt not rise up against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall not hate your brother in your mind. With reproof you shall reprove your neighbor, and you shall not take sin because of him.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, so thou shalt not bear sin on his account.

fresh_translation: And your hand shall not avenge, and you shall not be angry with the sons of your people, and you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thy hand shall not avenge thee; and thou shalt not be angry with the children of thy people; and thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself; I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: You shall keep my law. Your cattle you shall not breed with a different kind, and your vineyard you shall not sow with mixed seed, and a garment woven from two kinds, counterfeit cloth, you shall not put on yourself.
brenton_translation: Ye shall observe my law: thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with one of a different kind, and thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with diverse seed; and thou shalt not put upon thyself a mingled garment woven of two materials.

fresh_translation: And if a man lies with a woman with the bed of seed, and she is a female servant reserved for a man, and she has not been redeemed with a ransom, nor has freedom been given to her, there shall be oversight for them. They shall not die, because she has not been freed.
brenton_translation: And if any one lie carnally with a woman, and she should be a home-servant kept for a man, and she has not been ransomed, and her freedom has not been given to her, they shall be visited with punishment; but they shall not die, because she was not set at liberty.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring his trespass to the Lord at the door of the tent of testimony, a ram of trespass.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring for his trespass to the Lord to the door of the tabernacle of witness, a ram for a trespass-offering.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of trespass before the Lord for the sin that he sinned, and the sin that he sinned shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering, before the Lord, for the sin which he sinned; and the sin which he sinned shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: And when you enter into the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and you plant every edible tree, then you shall purge away its uncleanness. Its fruit shall be uncleansed to you for three years. It shall not be eaten.
brenton_translation: And whenever ye shall enter into the land which the Lord your God gives you, and shall plant any fruit-tree, then shall ye purge away its uncleanness; its fruit shall be three years uncleansed to you, it shall not be eaten.

fresh_translation: And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, praiseworthy to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, a subject of praise to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And in the fifth year you shall eat the fruit, as an addition of its produce for you. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And in the fifth year ye shall eat the fruit, its produce is an increase to you. I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall not eat upon the mountains, and you shall not practice augury, nor observe birds for omens.
brenton_translation: Eat not on the mountains, nor shall ye employ auguries, nor divine by inspection of birds.

fresh_translation: You shall not make a rounded trimming from the hair of your head, nor destroy the appearance of your beard.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not make a round cutting of the hair of your head, nor disfigure your beard.

fresh_translation: And cuttings for a dead person you shall not make in your body, and tattooed writings you shall not make on yourselves. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not make cuttings in your body for a dead body, and ye shall not inscribe on yourselves any marks. I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall not profane your daughter by prostituting her, and the land shall not prostitute itself, and the land shall not be filled with lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not profane thy daughter to prostitute her; so the land shall not go a whoring, and the land be filled with iniquity.

fresh_translation: You shall keep my sabbaths, and from my holy things you shall stand in fear. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuaries: I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: You shall not follow ventriloquists, and to enchanters you shall not cling, to be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not attend to those who have in them divining spirits, nor attach yourselves to enchanters, to pollute yourselves with them: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: Before gray hair you shall rise, and you shall honor the face of the elder, and you shall fear your God. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And if a newcomer comes to you in your land, you shall not oppress him.
brenton_translation: And if there should come to you a stranger in your land, ye shall not afflict him.

fresh_translation: Like the native among you shall be the newcomer who comes to you, and you shall love him as yourself, because you became newcomers in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: The stranger that comes to you shall be among you as the native, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: You shall do no injustice in judgment, in measures and in weights and in scales.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not act unrighteously in judgment, in measures and weights and scales.

fresh_translation: Just scales and just weights and a just liquid-measure shall be for you. I am the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: There shall be among you just balances and just weights and a just liquid measure. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep all my law and all my commands and do them. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep all my law and all my ordinances, and ye shall do them: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Israel you shall say: If any of the sons of Israel or of the newcomer newcomers in Israel gives of his seed to a ruler, he shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone him with stones.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt also say to the children of Israel, If there shall be any of the children of Israel, or of those who have become proselytes in Israel, who shall give of his seed to Moloch, let him be surely put to death; the nation upon the land shall stone him with stones.

fresh_translation: And I will set my face against that man and destroy him from his people, because he gave of his seed to a ruler so as to defile my holy things and profane the name of those sanctified to me.
brenton_translation: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from his people, because he has given of his seed to Moloch, to defile my sanctuary, and profane the name of them that are consecrated to me.

fresh_translation: But if the natives of the land by overlooking overlook that man with their eyes when he gives of his seed to a ruler, so as not to put him to death,
brenton_translation: And if the natives of the land should in anywise overlook that man in giving of his seed to Moloch, so as not to put him to death;

fresh_translation: then I will set my face against that man and against his kin, and I will destroy him and all who are of one mind with him, so that he prostitutes himself to the rulers, from their people.
brenton_translation: then will I set my face against that man and his family, and I will destroy him, and all who have been of one mind with him, so that he should go a whoring to the princes, from their people.

fresh_translation: And the person who follows ventriloquists or enchanters so as to prostitute himself after them, I will set my face against that person and destroy him from his people.
brenton_translation: And the soul that shall follow those who have in them divining spirits, or enchanters, so as to go a whoring after them; I will set my face against that soul, and will destroy it from among its people.

fresh_translation: And you shall be holy, because I, the Lord your God, am holy.
brenton_translation: And ye shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep my commands and do them. I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall observe my ordinances, and do them: I am the Lord that sanctifies you.

fresh_translation: Every man who speaks evil of his father or of his mother shall surely be put to death. He spoke evil of his father or his mother. He shall be guilty.
brenton_translation: Every man who shall speak evil of his father or of his mother, let him die the death; has he spoken evil of his father or his mother? he shall be guilty.

fresh_translation: Any man who commits adultery with the wife of a man, or who commits adultery with the wife of his neighbor, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
brenton_translation: Whatever man shall commit adultery with the wife of a man, or whoever shall commit adultery with the wife of his neighbour, let them die the death, the adulterer and the adulteress.

fresh_translation: And if anyone lies with his father's wife, he has uncovered his father's nakedness. Both shall surely be put to death. They are guilty.
brenton_translation: And if any one should lie with his father's wife, he has uncovered his father's nakedness: let them both die the death, they are guilty.

fresh_translation: And if anyone lies with his daughter-in-law, both shall surely be put to death, for they have acted impiously. They are guilty.
brenton_translation: And if any one should lie with his daughter-in-law, let them both be put to death; for they have wrought impiety, they are guilty.

fresh_translation: And whoever lies with a male the bed of a woman, both have done an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. They are guilty.
brenton_translation: And whoever shall lie with a male as with a woman, they have both wrought abomination; let them die the death, they are guilty.

fresh_translation: Whoever takes a woman and her mother, it is lawlessness. They shall burn him and them with fire, and there shall not be lawlessness among you.
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall take a woman and her mother, it is iniquity: they shall burn him and them with fire; so there shall not be iniquity among you.

fresh_translation: And whoever gives his bed to a four-footed animal shall surely be put to death, and you shall kill the four-footed animal.
brenton_translation: And whosoever shall lie with a beast, let him die the death; and ye shall kill the beast.

fresh_translation: And if a woman comes near to any beast to mate with it, you shall kill the woman and the beast. They shall surely be put to death. They are guilty.
brenton_translation: And whatever woman shall approach any beast, so as to have connexion with it, ye shall kill the woman and the beast: let them die the death, they are guilty.

fresh_translation: Whoever takes his sister by his father or by his mother and sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness, it is a reproach. They shall be cut off before the sons of their family. He uncovered his sister's nakedness. They shall bear sin.
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall take his sister by his father or by his mother, and shall see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness, it is a reproach: they shall be destroyed before the children of their family; he has uncovered his sister's nakedness, they shall bear their sin.

fresh_translation: And a man who lies with a woman under separation and uncovers her nakedness, he has uncovered her fountain and she has uncovered the flow of her blood. Both shall be cut off from among their family.
brenton_translation: And whatever man shall lie with a woman that is set apart for a flux, and shall uncover her nakedness, he has uncovered her fountain, and she has uncovered the flux of her blood: they shall both be destroyed from among their generation.

fresh_translation: And the nakedness of your father's sister and your mother's sister you shall not uncover, for he has uncovered close kin. They shall bear sin.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister, or of the sister of thy mother; for that man has uncovered the nakedness of one near akin: they shall bear their iniquity.

fresh_translation: Whoever lies with his relative, he has uncovered the nakedness of his kin. They shall die childless.
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall lie with his near kinswoman, has uncovered the nakedness of one near akin to him: they shall die childless.

fresh_translation: Whoever takes his brother's wife, it is uncleanness. He has uncovered his brother's nakedness. They shall die childless.
brenton_translation: Whoever shall take his brother's wife, it is uncleanness; he has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall die childless.

fresh_translation: And keep all my commands and all my judgments and do them, and let not the land into which I am bringing you there to dwell on it be aggrieved with you.
brenton_translation: And keep ye all my ordinances, and my judgments; and ye shall do them, and the land shall not be aggrieved with you, into which I bring you to dwell upon it.

fresh_translation: And do not walk in the statutes of the nations that I am sending away from before you, because they did all these things and I abhorred them.
brenton_translation: And walk ye not in the customs of the nations which I drive out from before you; for they have done all these things, and I have abhorred them:

fresh_translation: And I said to you, You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you for a possession, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the Lord your God, who separated you from all the nations.
brenton_translation: and I said to you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you for a possession, even a land flowing with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God, who have separated you from all people.

fresh_translation: And you shall distinguish between the clean animals and the unclean animals and between the clean birds and the unclean birds, and you shall not make your lives abominable among the animals and among the birds and among all the creeping things of the earth, which I set apart for you in uncleanness.
brenton_translation: And ye shall make a distinction between the clean and the unclean cattle, and between clean and unclean birds; and ye shall not defile your souls with cattle, or with birds, or with any creeping things of the earth, which I have separated for you by reason of uncleanness.

fresh_translation: And you shall be holy to me, because I, the Lord your God, am holy, who separated you from all the nations to be mine.
brenton_translation: And ye shall be holy to me; because I the Lord your God am holy, who separated you from all nations, to be mine.

fresh_translation: And if a man or a woman among them becomes a ventriloquist or an enchanter, both shall surely be put to death. Stone them with stones. They are guilty.
brenton_translation: And as for a man or woman whosoever of them shall have in them a divining spirit, or be an enchanter, let them both die the death: ye shall stone them with stones, they are guilty.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, saying, Speak to the priests, sons of Aaron, and you shall say to them: For a dead person they shall not defile themselves among their people,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Speak to the priests the sons of Aaron, and thou shalt tell them that they shall not defile themselves in their nation for the dead,

fresh_translation: except for close kin nearest to them: for father and mother and sons and daughters and brother,
brenton_translation: but they may mourn for a relative who is very near to them, for a father and mother, and sons and daughters, for a brother,

fresh_translation: and for a virgin sister near to him, not given to a man; for these he shall defile himself.
brenton_translation: and for a virgin sister that is near to one, that is not espoused to a man; for these one shall defile himself.

fresh_translation: He shall not defile himself suddenly among his people so as to profane himself.
brenton_translation: He shall not defile himself suddenly among his people to profane himself.

fresh_translation: They shall not shave a bald patch on their head for a dead one, and they shall not shave the face of the beard, and on their flesh they shall not cut cuttings.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not shave your head for the dead with a baldness on the top; and they shall not shave their beard, neither shall they make gashes on their flesh.

fresh_translation: They shall be holy to their God, and they shall not profane the name of their God, because they offer the sacrifices of the Lord, gifts of their God, and they shall be holy.
brenton_translation: They shall be holy to their God, and they shall not profane the name of their God; for they offer the sacrifices of the Lord as the gifts of their God, and they shall be holy.

fresh_translation: A prostitute and a profaned woman they shall not take, and a woman cast out from her husband they shall not take, because he is holy to the Lord his God.
brenton_translation: They shall not take a woman who is a harlot and profaned, or a woman put away from her husband; for he is holy to the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And you shall sanctify him, because he offers the gifts of the Lord your God. He shall be holy, because I, the Lord who sanctifies them, am holy.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt hallow him; he offers the gifts of the Lord your God: he shall be holy, for I the Lord that sanctify them am holy.

fresh_translation: And if the daughter of a priestly man profanes herself by whoring, she profanes her father's name. She shall be burned with fire.
brenton_translation: And if the daughter of a priest should be profaned to go a whoring, she profanes the name of her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

fresh_translation: And the great priest from among his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil has been poured and who has been completed to put on the garments, shall not unbind his head-covering, and shall not tear his garments.
brenton_translation: And the priest that is chief among his brethren, the oil having been poured upon the head of the anointed one, and he having been consecrated to put on the garments, shall not take the mitre off his head, and shall not rend his garments:

fresh_translation: And he shall not enter upon any dead person. For his father or his mother he shall not defile himself.
brenton_translation: neither shall he go in to any dead body, neither shall he defile himself for his father or his mother.

fresh_translation: And he shall not go out from the holy things, and he shall not profane the sanctuary of his God, because the holy anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he shall not go forth out of the sanctuary, and he shall not profane the sanctuary of his God, because the holy anointing oil of God is upon him: I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: This man shall take a virgin woman from his own kindred.
brenton_translation: He shall take for a wife a virgin of his own tribe.

fresh_translation: But a widow and a cast-out woman and a profaned woman and a prostitute, these he shall not take. Rather, he shall take as wife a virgin from his own people.
brenton_translation: But a widow, or one that is put away, or profaned, or a harlot, these he shall not take; but he shall take for a wife a virgin of his own people.

fresh_translation: And he shall not profane his seed among his people. I am the Lord who sanctifies him.
brenton_translation: And he shall not profane his seed among his people: I am the Lord that sanctifies him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to Aaron: A man from your seed throughout your generations, if a blemish is in him, shall not approach to offer the gifts of his God.
brenton_translation: Say to Aaron, A man of thy tribe throughout your generations, who shall have a blemish on him, shall not draw nigh to offer the gifts of his God.

fresh_translation: Every man in whom there is a blemish shall not approach: a lame or blind man, or one disfigured in face or cut in ear,
brenton_translation: No man who has a blemish on him shall draw nigh; a man lame, blind, with his nose disfigured, or his ears cut,

fresh_translation: or a man who has a fracture of hand or a fracture of foot,
brenton_translation: a man who has a broken hand or a broken foot,

fresh_translation: or hunchbacked or stunted, or a man with a blemish in his eyes, or one who has itching scabs or ringworm, or one with a single testicle.
brenton_translation: or hump-backed, or blear-eyed, or that has lost his eye-lashes, or a man who has a malignant ulcer, or tetter, or one that has lost a testicle.

fresh_translation: Any man in whom there is a blemish, from the seed of Aaron the priest, shall not come near to offer the sacrifices to your God. Because a blemish is in him, he shall not approach to offer the gifts of his God.
brenton_translation: Whoever of the seed of Aaron the priest has a blemish on him, shall not draw nigh to offer sacrifices to thy God, because he has a blemish on him; he shall not draw nigh to offer the gifts of God.

fresh_translation: He may eat the gifts of God, the holy of holies and the holy things.
brenton_translation: The gifts of God are most holy, and he shall eat of the holy things.

fresh_translation: Only he shall not approach the curtain, and he shall not come near the altar, because he has a blemish, and he shall not profane the holy place of his God, because I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
