fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, saying,

fresh_translation: Treat the Midianites as enemies and strike them,
brenton_translation: Plague the Madianites as enemies, and smite them,

fresh_translation: because they act as enemies toward you in the deceit with which they deceive you over Peor and over Chasbi daughter of the chief of Midian, their sister, the one struck down on the day of the plague over Peor.
brenton_translation: for they are enemies to you by the treachery wherein they ensnare you through Phogor, and through Chasbi their sister, daughter of a prince of Madiam, who was smitten in the day of the plague because of Phogor.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after the plague, and the Lord spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spoke to Moses and Eleazar the priest, saying,

fresh_translation: Take the sum of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their ancestral houses, everyone who goes out to array for battle in Israel.
brenton_translation: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, according to the houses of their lineage, every one that goes forth to battle in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
brenton_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke in Araboth of Moab at the Jordan by Jericho, saying,

fresh_translation: From twenty years old and upward, just as the Lord commanded Moses. And these are the sons of Israel who came out of Egypt:
brenton_translation: This is the numbering from twenty years old and upward as the Lord commanded Moses. And the sons of Israel that came out of Egypt are as follows:

fresh_translation: Reuben, Israels firstborn. And the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochite; of Phallu, the clan of the Phalluite.
brenton_translation: Ruben was the first-born of Israel: and the sons of Ruben, Enoch, and the family of Enoch; to Phallu belongs the family of the Phalluites.

fresh_translation: Of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronite; of Carmi, the clan of the Carmite.
brenton_translation: To Asron, the family of Asroni: to Charmi, the family of Charmi.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Reuben, and their enrollment became forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Ruben; and their numbering was forty-three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Phallu: Eliab.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Phallu were Eliab,—

fresh_translation: And the sons of Eliab: Namuel and Dathan and Abiram. These are the called men of the congregation, the ones who rose up against Moses and Aaron in the congregation of Korah, in the uprising against the Lord.
brenton_translation: and the sons of Eliab, Namuel, and Dathan, and Abiron: these are renowned men of the congregation; these are they that rose up against Moses and Aaron in the gathering of Core, in the rebellion against the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the earth, opening its mouth, swallowed them and Korah in the death of his congregation, when the fire devoured the two hundred fifty, and they became a sign.
brenton_translation: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up them and Core, when their assembly perished, when the fire devoured the two hundred and fifty, and they were made a sign.

fresh_translation: But the sons of Korah did not die.
brenton_translation: But the sons of Core died not.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Symeon, the clan of the sons of Symeon: of Namuel, the clan of the Namuelite; of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminite; of Jachin, the clan of the Jachinite.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Symeon:—the family of the sons of Symeon: to Namuel, belonged the family of the Namuelites; to Jamin the family of the Jaminites; to Jachin the family of the Jachinites.

fresh_translation: Of Zarah, the clan of the Zarahite; of Saul, the clan of the Saulite.
brenton_translation: To Zara the family of the Zaraites; to Saul the family of the Saulites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Symeon from their enrollment, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Symeon according to their numbering, two and twenty thousand and two hundred.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Judah were Er and Onan, and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Juda, Er and Aunan; and Er and Aunan died in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Judah came to be by their clans: of Shelah, the clan of the Shelanite; of Pharez, the clan of the Pharezite; of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahite.
brenton_translation: And these were the sons of Juda, according to their families: to Selom belonged the family of the Selonites; to Phares, the family of the Pharesites; to Zara, the family of the Zaraites.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Pharez: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronite; of Jamoun, the clan of the Jamounite.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Phares were, to Asron, the family of the Asronites; to Jamun, the family of the Jamunites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Judah by their enrollment, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Juda according to their numbering, seventy-six thousand and five hundred.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Issachar by their clans: of Thola, the clan of the Tholaite; of Phua, the clan of the Phuaite.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Issachar according to their families: to Thola, the family of the Tholaites; to Phua, the family of the Phuaites.

fresh_translation: Of Jashub, the clan of the Jashubite; of Samaran, the clan of the Samaranite.
brenton_translation: To Jasub, the family of the Jasubites; to Samram, the family of the Samramites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Issachar by their enrollment, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Issachar according to their numbering, sixty-four thousand and four hundred.

fresh_translation: The sons of Zebulun by their clans: of Sared, the clan of the Saredite; of Allon, the clan of the Allonite; of Allel, the clan of the Allelite.
brenton_translation: The sons of Zabulon according to their families: to Sared, the family of the Saredites; to Allon, the family of the Allonites; to Allel, the family of the Allelites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Zebulun by their enrollment, sixty thousand five hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Zabulon according to their numbering, sixty thousand and five hundred.

fresh_translation: The sons of Gad by their clans: of Saphon, the clan of the Saphonite; of Angi, the clan of the Angite; of Suni, the clan of the Sunite.
brenton_translation: The sons of Gad according to their families: to Saphon, the family of the Saphonites; to Angi, the family of the Angites; to Suni, the family of the Sunites;

fresh_translation: Of Azeni, the clan of the Azenite; of Addi, the clan of the Addite.
brenton_translation: to Azeni, the family of the Azenites; to Addi, the family of the Addites:

fresh_translation: Of Aroadi, the clan of the Aroadite; of Ariel, the clan of the Arielite.
brenton_translation: to Aroadi, the family of the Aroadites; to Ariel, the family of the Arielites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of the sons of Gad by their enrollment, forty thousand five hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of the children of Gad according to their numbering, forty-four thousand and five hundred.

fresh_translation: The sons of Asher by their clans: of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminite; of Jesui, the clan of the Jesuite; of Bari, the clan of the Bariite.
brenton_translation: The sons of Aser according to their families; to Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; to Jesu, the family of the Jesusites; to Baria, the family of the Bariaites.

fresh_translation: Of Chober, the clan of the Choberite; of Melchiel, the clan of the Melchielite.
brenton_translation: To Chober, the family of the Choberites; to Melchiel, the family of the Melchielites.

fresh_translation: And the name of Ashers daughter was Sara.
brenton_translation: And the name of the daughter of Aser, Sara.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Asher by their enrollment, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Aser according to their numbering, forty-three thousand and four hundred.

fresh_translation: The sons of Joseph by their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.
brenton_translation: The sons of Joseph according to their families, Manasse and Ephraim.

fresh_translation: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the clan of the Machirite. And Machir begot Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadite.
brenton_translation: The sons of Manasse. To Machir the family of the Machirites; and Machir begot Galaad: to Galaad, the family of the Galaadites.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Gilead: of Achiezer, the clan of the Achiezerite; of Cheleg, the clan of the Chelegite.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Galaad; to Achiezer, the family of the Achiezerites; to Cheleg, the family of the Chelegites.

fresh_translation: Of Esriel, the clan of the Esrielite; of Sychem, the clan of the Sychemite.
brenton_translation: To Esriel, the family of the Esrielites; to Sychem, the family of the Sychemites.

fresh_translation: Of Symaer, the clan of the Symaerite; and of Opher, the clan of the Opherite.
brenton_translation: To Symaer, the family of the Symaerites; and to Opher, the family of the Opherites.

fresh_translation: And to Salpaad son of Opher there were no sons, but daughters. And these are the names of the daughters of Salpaad: Mala and Noua and Egla and Melcha and Thersa.
brenton_translation: And to Salpaad the son of Opher there were no sons, but daughters: and these were the names of the daughters of Salpaad; Mala, and Nua, and Egla, and Melcha, and Thersa.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Manasseh by their enrollment, fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Manasse according to their numbering, fifty-two thousand and seven hundred.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Ephraim: of Suthala, the clan of the Suthalaite; of Tanach, the clan of the Tanachite.
brenton_translation: And these are the children of Ephraim; to Suthala, the family of the Suthalanites; to Tanach, the family of the Tanachites.

fresh_translation: These are the sons of Suthala: of Eden, the clan of the Edenite.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Suthala; to Eden, the family of the Edenites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Ephraim by their enrollment, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the clans of the sons of Joseph by their clans.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Ephraim according to their numbering, thirty-two thousand and five hundred: these are the families of the children of Joseph according to their families.

fresh_translation: The sons of Benjamin by their clans: of Bale, the clan of the Baleite; of Asyber, the clan of the Asyberite; of Jachiran, the clan of the Jachiranite.
brenton_translation: The sons of Benjamin according to their families; to Bale, the family of the Balites; to Asyber, the family of the Asyberites; to Jachiran, the family of the Jachiranites.

fresh_translation: Of Sophan, the clan of the Sophanite.
brenton_translation: To Sophan, the family of the Sophanites.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Bale came to be Adar and Noeman: of Adar, the clan of the Adarite; of Noeman, the clan of the Noemanite.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Bale were Adar and Noeman; to Adar, the family of the Adarites; and to Noeman, the family of the Noemanites.

fresh_translation: These are the sons of Benjamin by their clans, by their enrollment, forty-five thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Benjamin by their families according to their numbering, thirty-five thousand and five hundred.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Dan by their clans: of Sami, the clan of the Samite. These are the clans of Dan by their clans.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Dan according to their families; to Same, the family of the Sameites; these are the families of Dan according to their families.

fresh_translation: All the clans of Sami by their enrollment were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
brenton_translation: All the families of Samei according to their numbering, sixty-four thousand and four hundred.

fresh_translation: The sons of Naphtali by their clans: of Asiel, the clan of the Asielite; of Gauni, the clan of the Gaunite.
brenton_translation: The sons of Nephthali according to their families; to Asiel, the family of the Asielites; to Gauni, the family of the Gaunites.

fresh_translation: Of Jeser, the clan of the Jeserite; of Sellem, the clan of the Sellemite.
brenton_translation: To Jeser, the family of the Jeserites; to Sellem, the family of the Sellemites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of Naphtali by their enrollment, forty-five thousand four hundred.
brenton_translation: These are the families of Nephthali, according to their numbering, forty thousand and three hundred.

fresh_translation: This is the enrollment of the sons of Israel: six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
brenton_translation: This is the numbering of the children of Israel, six hundred and one thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: To these the land shall be divided for inheritance by number of names.
brenton_translation: To these the land shall be divided, so that they may inherit according to the number of the names.

fresh_translation: To the more you shall increase the inheritance, and to the fewer you shall lessen the inheritance. To each one according to those who were enrolled shall their inheritance be given.
brenton_translation: To the greater number thou shalt give the greater inheritance, and to the less number thou shalt give the less inheritance: to each one, as they have been numbered, shall their inheritance be given.

fresh_translation: The land shall be divided by lots. By the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
brenton_translation: The land shall be divided to the names by lot, they shall inherit according to the tribes of their families.

fresh_translation: Out of the lot you shall divide their inheritance between many and few.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt divide their inheritance by lot between the many and the few.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Levi by their clans: of Gedson, the clan of the Gedsonite; of Kaath, the clan of the Kaathite; of Merari, the clan of the Merarite.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Levi according to their families; to Gedson, the family of the Gedsonites; to Caath, the family of the Caathites; to Merari, the family of the Merarites.

fresh_translation: These are the clans of the sons of Levi: the clan of the Lobenite, the clan of the Chebronite, the clan of Kore, and the clan of Mousi. And Kaath begot Amram.
brenton_translation: These are the families of the sons of Levi; the family of the Lobenites, the family of the Chebronites, the family of the Coreites, and the family of the Musites; and Caath begot Amram.

fresh_translation: And the name of his wife was Jochabed, daughter of Levi, who bore these to Levi in Egypt, and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister.
brenton_translation: And the name of his wife was Jochabed, daughter of Levi, who bore these to Levi in Egypt, and she bore to Amram, Aaron and Moses, and Mariam their sister.

fresh_translation: And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abioud and Eleazar and Ithamar.
brenton_translation: And to Aaron were born both Nadab and Abiud, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.

fresh_translation: And Nadab and Abioud died when they brought strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
brenton_translation: And Nadab and Abiud died when they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sina.

brenton_translation: And there were according to their numbering, twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because they have no inheritance in the midst of the children of Israel.

brenton_translation: And this is the numbering of Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in Araboth of Moab, at Jordan by Jericho.

brenton_translation: And among these there was not a man numbered by Moses and Aaron, whom, even the children of Israel, they numbered in the wilderness of Sinai.

brenton_translation: And the daughters of Salpaad the son of Opher, the son of Galaad, the son of Machir, of the tribe of Manasse, of the sons of Joseph, came near; and these were their names, Maala, and Nua, and Egla, and Melcha, and Thersa;

Let not the name of our father be blotted out of the midst of his people, because he has no son: give us an inheritance in the midst of our father's brethren.

brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

brenton_translation: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying,

brenton_translation: If a man die, and have no son, ye shall assign his inheritance to his daughter.

fresh_translation: And if he has no daughter, you shall give his inheritance to his brother.
brenton_translation: And if he have no daughter, ye shall give his inheritance to his brother.

fresh_translation: And if he has no brothers, you shall give his inheritance to the brother of his father.
brenton_translation: And if he have no brethren, ye shall give his inheritance to his father's brother.

fresh_translation: And if there are no brothers of his father, you shall give his inheritance to his nearest kinsman from his tribe, and he shall inherit what is his. And this shall be for the sons of Israel an ordinance of judgment, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And if there be no brethren of his father, ye shall give the inheritance to his nearest relation of his tribe, to inherit his possessions; and this shall be to the children of Israel an ordinance of judgment, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Go up into this mountain across here, Mount Nabau, and see the land of Canaan that I give to the sons of Israel as a possession.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Go up to the mountain that is in the country beyond Jordan, this mount Nabau, and behold the land Chanaan, which I give to the sons of Israel for a possession.

fresh_translation: And you shall see it, and you too shall be added to your people, just as Aaron your brother was added on Mount Hor.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt see it, and thou also shalt be added to thy people, as Aaron thy brother was added to them in mount Or:

fresh_translation: Because you transgressed my word in the wilderness of Sin when the congregation fell against me. To sanctify me, you did not sanctify me over the water before them. This is the water of reviling at Kadesh in the wilderness of Sin.
brenton_translation: because ye transgressed my commandment in the wilderness of Sin, when the congregation resisted and refused to sanctify me; ye sanctified me not at the water before them. This is the water of Strife in Cades in the wilderness of Sin.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to the Lord,
brenton_translation: And Moses said to the Lord,

fresh_translation: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits and of all flesh, appoint a man over this congregation,
brenton_translation: Let the Lord God of spirits and of all flesh look out for a man over this congregation,

fresh_translation: one who shall go out before their face and one who shall come in before their face, and one who shall bring them out and one who shall bring them in, and the congregation of the Lord shall not be like sheep that have no shepherd.
brenton_translation: who shall go out before them, and who shall come in before them, and who shall lead them out, and who shall bring them in; so the congregation of the Lord shall not be as sheep without a shepherd.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Take to yourself Joshua son of Nun, a man who has spirit in himself, and you shall lay your hands upon him.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Take to thyself Joshua the son of Naue, a man who has the Spirit in him, and thou shalt lay thy hands upon him.

fresh_translation: And you shall set him before Eleazar the priest and command him before the whole congregation, and command concerning him before them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt set him before Eleazar the priest, and thou shalt give him a charge before all the congregation, and thou shalt give a charge concerning him before them.

fresh_translation: And you shall give some of your glory upon him, so that the sons of Israel may hear him.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put of thy glory upon him, that the children of Israel may hearken to him.

fresh_translation: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, and they shall inquire for him the judgment of the Disclosures before the Lord. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and the sons of Israel together and the whole congregation.
brenton_translation: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, and they shall ask of him before the Lord the judgment of the Urim: they shall go forth at his word, and at his word they shall come in, he and the children of Israel with one accord, and all the congregation.

fresh_translation: And Moses did just as the Lord commanded him, and taking Joshua he set him before Eleazar the priest and before the whole congregation.
brenton_translation: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation.

fresh_translation: And he laid his hands upon him and appointed him, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he laid his hands on him, and appointed him as the Lord ordered Moses.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Command the sons of Israel and say to them, saying: My gifts, my offerings, my fruit-gifts for an aroma of sweet fragrance, you shall keep to offer to me at my feasts.
brenton_translation: Charge the children of Israel, and thou shalt speak to them, saying, Ye shall observe to offer to me in my feasts my gifts, my presents, my burnt-offerings for a sweet-smelling savour.

fresh_translation: And you shall say to them, These are the fruit-gifts that you shall bring near to the Lord: two one-year lambs without blemish each day for a continual whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to them, These are the burnt-offerings, all that ye shall bring to the Lord; two lambs of a year old without blemish daily, for a whole-burnt offering perpetually.

fresh_translation: The one lamb you shall do in the morning, and the second lamb you shall do at evening.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt offer one lamb in the morning, and thou shalt offer the second lamb towards evening.

fresh_translation: And you shall make a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice kneaded in oil, a fourth of a hin.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt offer the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat-offering, mingled with oil, with the fourth part of a hin.

fresh_translation: It is a continual whole burnt offering made on Mount Sinai for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: It is a perpetual whole-burnt-offering, a sacrifice offered in the mount of Sina for a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And its libation, a fourth of a hin for the one lamb. In the holy place you shall pour out a libation of strong drink to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And its drink-offering, the fourth part of a hin to each lamb; in the holy place shalt thou pour strong drink as a drink-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the second lamb you shall do at evening. According to its sacrifice and according to its libation you shall do it for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the second lamb thou shalt offer toward evening; thou shalt offer it according to its meat-offering and according to its drink-offering for a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And on the day of the Sabbaths you shall bring two one-year lambs without blemish and two tenths of fine flour kneaded in oil for a sacrifice and a libation.
brenton_translation: And on the sabbath-day ye shall offer two lambs of a year old without blemish, and two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering, and a drink-offering.

fresh_translation: A whole burnt offering of Sabbaths on the Sabbaths, besides the continual whole burnt offering and its libation.
brenton_translation: It is a whole-burnt-offering of the sabbaths on the sabbath days, besides the continued whole-burnt-offering, and its drink offering.

fresh_translation: And at the new moons you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord: two young bulls from the cattle and one ram, seven one-year lambs without blemish,
brenton_translation: And at the new moons ye shall bring a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord, two calves of the herd, and one ram, seven lambs of a year old without blemish.

fresh_translation: three tenths of fine flour kneaded in oil for the one bull and two tenths of fine flour kneaded in oil for the one ram,
brenton_translation: Three tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil for one calf, and two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil for one ram.

fresh_translation: a tenth of fine flour kneaded in oil for the one lamb, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance, a fruit-gift to the Lord.
brenton_translation: A tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for each lamb, as a meat-offering, a sweet-smelling savour, a burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And their libation shall be half a hin for the one bull and a third of a hin for the one ram and a fourth of a hin of wine for the one lamb. This is the whole burnt offering of month by month throughout the months of the year.
brenton_translation: Their drink-offering shall be the half of a hin for one calf; and the third of a hin for one ram; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for one lamb: this is the whole-burnt-offering monthly throughout the months of the year.

fresh_translation: And one kid from the goats for a sin offering to the Lord; besides the continual whole burnt offering it shall be made, and its libation.
brenton_translation: And he shall offer one kid of the goats for a sin-offering to the Lord; it shall be offered beside the continual whole-burnt-offering and its drink-offering.

fresh_translation: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, Passover to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the passover to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this month, a feast. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
brenton_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a feast; seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.

fresh_translation: And the first day shall be a called holy day for you. You shall do no service-work.
brenton_translation: And the first day shall be to you a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring whole burnt offerings, fruit-gifts to the Lord: two young bulls from the cattle, one ram, seven one-year lambs. They shall be without blemish for you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall bring whole-burnt-offerings, a sacrifice to the Lord, two calves of the herd, one ram, seven lambs of a year old; they shall be to you without blemish.

fresh_translation: And their sacrifice shall be fine flour kneaded in oil, three tenths for the one bull and two tenths for the one ram.
brenton_translation: And their meat-offering shall be fine flour mingled with oil; three tenth deals for one calf, and two tenth deals for one ram.

fresh_translation: A tenth by a tenth you shall do for the one lamb, for the seven lambs.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt offer a tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs.

fresh_translation: And one kid from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt offer one kid of the goats for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.

fresh_translation: Besides the continual morning whole burnt offering, which is a continual whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: Beside the perpetual whole-burnt-offering in the morning, which is a whole-burnt-sacrifice for a continuance,

fresh_translation: So shall you do these things day by day for the seven days, a gift, a fruit-gift for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord. Besides the continual whole burnt offering you shall do it and its libation.
brenton_translation: these shall ye thus offer daily for seven days, a gift, a sacrifice for a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord; beside the continual whole-burnt-offering, thou shalt offer its drink-offering.

fresh_translation: And the seventh day shall be a called holy day for you. You shall do no service-work on it.
brenton_translation: And the seventh day shall be to you a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work in it.

fresh_translation: And on the day of the new things, when you offer a new sacrifice to the Lord in the Feast of Weeks, it shall be a called holy day for you. You shall do no service-work.
brenton_translation: And on the day of the new corn, when ye shall offer a new sacrifice at the festival of weeks to the Lord, there shall be to you a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work,

fresh_translation: And you shall bring whole burnt offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord: two young bulls from the cattle, one ram, seven one-year lambs without blemish,
brenton_translation: and ye shall bring whole-burnt-offerings for a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord, two calves of the herd, one ram, seven lambs without blemish.

fresh_translation: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, it shall be a called holy day for you. You shall do no service-work. It shall be a day of signal for you.
brenton_translation: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be to you a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work: it shall be to you a day of blowing the trumpets.

fresh_translation: And you shall make whole burnt offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord: one bull from the cattle, one ram, seven one-year lambs without blemish,
brenton_translation: And ye shall offer whole-burnt-offerings for a sweet savour to the Lord, one calf of the herd, one ram, seven lambs of a year old without blemish.

brenton_translation: Beside the whole-burnt-offerings for the new moon, and their meat-offerings, and their drink-offerings, and their perpetual whole-burnt-offering; and their meat-offerings and their drink-offerings according to their ordinance for a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And on the tenth of this month, it shall be a called holy day for you, and you shall afflict your souls, and you shall do no work.

fresh_translation: And you shall offer whole burnt offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance, fruit-gifts to the Lord: one bull from the cattle, one ram, seven one-year lambs. They shall be without blemish for you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall bring near whole-burnt-offerings for a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord; burnt-sacrifices to the Lord, one calf of the herd, one ram, seven lambs of a year old; they shall be to you without blemish.

brenton_translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you; beside the sin-offering for atonement, and the continual whole-burnt-offering, its meat-offering, and its drink-offering according to its ordinance for a smell of sweet savour, a burnt-sacrifice to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month it shall be a called holy day for you. You shall do no service-work, and you shall celebrate it as a feast to the Lord seven days.
brenton_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work; and ye shall keep it a feast to the Lord seven days.

brenton_translation: And ye shall bring near whole-burnt-offerings, a sacrifice for a smell of sweet savour to the Lord, on the first day thirteen calves of the herd, two rams, fourteen lambs of a year old; they shall be without blemish.

brenton_translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering; beside the continual whole-burnt-offering: there shall be their meat-offerings and their drink-offerings.

brenton_translation: And on the second day twelve calves, two rams, fourteen lambs of a year old without blemish.

brenton_translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering; beside the continual whole-burnt-offering; there shall be their meat-offerings and their drink-offerings.

brenton_translation: On the sixth day eight calves, two rams, fourteen lambs of a year old without blemish.

brenton_translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering; beside the perpetual whole-burnt-offering; there shall be their meat-offerings and their drink-offerings.

brenton_translation: And ye shall offer whole-burnt-offerings as sacrifices to the Lord, one calf, one ram, seven lambs of a year old without spot.

brenton_translation: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.

brenton_translation: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord has commanded.

fresh_translation: Man by man, whoever vows a vow to the Lord or swears an oath or binds himself with a binding over his life, he shall not profane his word. Everything that goes out from his mouth he shall do.
brenton_translation: Whatsoever man shall vow a vow to the Lord, or swear an oath, or bind himself with an obligation upon his soul, he shall not break his word; all that shall come out of his mouth he shall do.

fresh_translation: But if a woman vows a vow to the Lord or binds a binding in the house of her father in her youth,
brenton_translation: And if a woman shall vow a vow to the Lord, or bind herself with an obligation in her youth in her father's house; and her father should hear her vows and her obligations, wherewith she has bound her soul, and her father should hold his peace at her, then all her vows shall stand,

fresh_translation: and her father hears her vows and her bindings which she bound against her life and her father keeps silent to her, then all her vows shall stand, and all the bindings which she bound against her life shall remain for her.
brenton_translation: and all the obligations with which she has bound her soul, shall remain to her.

fresh_translation: But if her father by refusal refuses her on the day he hears all her vows and the bindings which she bound against her life, they shall not stand, and the Lord will clear her, because her father refused her.
brenton_translation: But if her father straitly forbid her in the day in which he shall hear all her vows and her obligations, which she has contracted upon her soul, they shall not stand; and the Lord shall hold her guiltless, because her father forbade her.

fresh_translation: And if, having become, she becomes to a man, and her vows are upon her according to the utterance of her lips, which she bound against her life,
brenton_translation: But if she should be indeed married, and her vows be upon her according to the utterance of her lips, in respect of the obligations which she has contracted upon her soul;

fresh_translation: and her husband hears and keeps silent to her on the day he hears, then all her vows shall stand, and her bindings which she bound against her life shall stand.
brenton_translation: and her husband should hear, and hold his peace at her in the day in which he should hear, then thus shall all her vows be binding, and her obligations, which she has contracted upon her soul shall stand.

fresh_translation: But if her husband by refusal refuses her on the day he hears, all her vows and her bindings which she bound against her life shall not remain, because her husband refused them from her, and the Lord will clear her.
brenton_translation: But if her husband should straitly forbid her in the day in which he should hear her, none of her vows or obligations which she has contracted upon her soul shall stand, because her husband has disallowed her, and the Lord shall hold her guiltless.

fresh_translation: And the vow of a widow or of one cast out, whatever she vows against her life, shall remain for her.
brenton_translation: And the vow of a widow and of her that is put away, whatsoever she shall bind upon her soul, shall stand to her.

fresh_translation: But if in the house of her husband her vow or the binding against her life is with an oath,
brenton_translation: And if her vow be made in the house of her husband, or the obligation upon her soul with an oath,

fresh_translation: and her husband hears and keeps silent to her and does not refuse her, then all her vows shall stand, and all her bindings which she bound against her life shall stand against her.
brenton_translation: and her husband should hear, and hold his peace at her, and not disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and all the obligations which she contracted against her soul, shall stand against her.

fresh_translation: But if her husband removes them when he hears, everything that has gone out from her lips according to her vows and according to the bindings against her life shall not remain for her. Her husband removed them, and the Lord will clear her.
brenton_translation: But if her husband should utterly cancel the vow in the day in which he shall hear it, none of the things which shall proceed out of her lips in her vows, and in the obligations contracted upon her soul, shall stand to her; her husband has cancelled them, and the Lord shall hold her guiltless.

fresh_translation: Every vow and every binding oath to afflict a life, her husband shall establish it for her, and her husband shall remove it.
brenton_translation: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband shall confirm it to her, or her husband shall cancel it.

fresh_translation: But if her husband keeps silent to her day after day, he shall establish all her vows and the bindings upon her. He shall establish them for her, because he kept silent to her on the day he heard.
brenton_translation: But if he be wholly silent at her from day to day, then shall he bind upon her all her vows; and he shall confirm to her the obligations which she has bound upon herself, because he held his peace at her in the day in which he heard her.

fresh_translation: But if he removes them after the day he heard, he shall bear his sin.
brenton_translation: And if her husband should in any wise cancel them after the day in which he heard them, then he shall bear his iniquity.

fresh_translation: These are the ordinances that the Lord commanded Moses between a man and his wife and between a father and daughter in youth in the house of her father.
brenton_translation: These are the ordinances which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and daughter in her youth in the house of her father.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Avenge the vengeance of the sons of Israel on the Midianites, and at the end you shall be added to your people.
brenton_translation: Avenge the wrongs of the children of Israel on the Madianites, and afterwards thou shalt be added to thy people.

fresh_translation: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm men from among you to array for battle before the Lord against Midian, to return vengeance from the Lord upon Midian.
brenton_translation: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm some of you, and set yourselves in array before the Lord against Madian, to inflict vengeance on Madian from the Lord.

fresh_translation: A thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe, from all the tribes of Israel, send out to array for battle.
brenton_translation: Send a thousand of each tribe from all the tribes of the children of Israel to set themselves in array.

fresh_translation: And they were counted from the thousands of Israel, a thousand from a tribe, twelve thousand armed for battle.
brenton_translation: And they numbered of the thousands of Israel a thousand of each tribe, twelve thousands; these were armed for war.

fresh_translation: And Moses sent them, a thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe, with their force, and Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, and the holy vessels and the trumpets of the signals in their hands.
brenton_translation: And Moses sent them away a thousand of every tribe with their forces, and Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest: and the holy instruments, and the signal trumpets were in their hands.

fresh_translation: And they arrayed against Midian just as the Lord commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
brenton_translation: And they set themselves in array against Madian, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew every male.

fresh_translation: And the kings of Midian they killed along with their wounded: Evin and Sour and Rokom and Our and Robok, five kings of Midian. And Balaam son of Beor they killed with sword along with their wounded.
brenton_translation: And they slew the kings of Madian together with their slain subjects; even Evi and Rocon, and Sur, and Ur, and Roboc, five kings of Madian; and they slew with the sword Balaam the son of Beor with their other slain.

fresh_translation: And they plundered the women of Midian and their baggage and their cattle and all their possessions and all their force they plundered.
brenton_translation: And they made a prey of the women of Madian, and their store, and their cattle, and all their possessions: and they spoiled their forces.

fresh_translation: And all their cities in their dwellings and their camps they burned with fire.
brenton_translation: And they burnt with fire all their cities in the places of their habitation, and they burnt their villages with fire.

fresh_translation: And they took all the plunder and all their spoils, from human to beast.
brenton_translation: And they took all their plunder, and all their spoils, both man and beast.

fresh_translation: And they brought to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to all the sons of Israel the captivity and the spoils and the plunder to the camp in the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
brenton_translation: And they brought to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, and to all the children of Israel, the captives, and the spoils, and the plunder, to the camp to Araboth Moab, which is at Jordan by Jericho.

fresh_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
brenton_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the rulers of the synagogue went forth out of the camp to meet them.

fresh_translation: And Moses was angry with the overseers of the force, the chiliarchs and centurions coming from the battle line of the war.
brenton_translation: And Moses was angry with the captains of the host, the heads of thousands and the heads of hundreds who came from the battle-array.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to them, Why have you kept every female alive?
brenton_translation: And Moses said to them, Why have ye saved every female alive?

fresh_translation: For these became for the sons of Israel, according to the word of Balaam, a cause to depart and despise the word of the Lord for the sake of Peor, and the plague came in the congregation of the Lord.
brenton_translation: For they were the occasion to the children of Israel by the word of Balaam of their revolting and despising the word of the Lord, because of Phogor; and there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And now kill every male among all the company, and every woman who has known the bed of a male kill.
brenton_translation: Now then slay every male in all the spoil, slay every woman, who has known the lying with man.

fresh_translation: But every company of women who has not known the bed of a male keep alive for yourselves.
brenton_translation: And as for all the captivity of women, who have not known the lying with man, save ye them alive.

fresh_translation: And you camp outside the camp seven days, every one who killed and every one touching the wounded. He shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
brenton_translation: And ye shall encamp outside the great camp seven days; every one who has slain and who touches a dead body, shall be purified on the third day, and ye and your captivity shall purify yourselves on the seventh day.

fresh_translation: And every garment and every leather vessel and every work of goats hair and every wooden vessel you shall cleanse.
brenton_translation: And ye shall purify every garment and every leathern utensil, and all furniture of goat skin, and every wooden vessel.

fresh_translation: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the force who had come from the battle line of the war, This is the ordinance of the law that the Lord commanded Moses:
brenton_translation: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the host that came from the battle-array, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord has commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: Except the gold and the silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin,
brenton_translation: Beside the gold, and the silver, and the brass, and the iron, and lead, and tin,

fresh_translation: every thing that goes through fire shall be purified, but it shall be purified by the water of purification. And everything that does not pass through fire shall go through water.
brenton_translation: every thing that shall pass through the fire shall so be clean, nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of sanctification; and whatsoever will not pass through the fire shall pass through water.

fresh_translation: And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day and you shall be clean, and after these things you shall enter into the camp.
brenton_translation: And on the seventh day ye shall wash your garments, and be clean; and afterwards ye shall come into the camp.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Take the total of the spoil of the captivity, from human to beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the leaders of the ancestral houses of the congregation.
brenton_translation: Take the sum of the spoils of the captivity both of man and beast, thou and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the families of the congregation.

fresh_translation: And divide the spoils between the warriors who went out into battle and the whole congregation.
brenton_translation: And ye shall divide the spoils between the warriors that went out to battle, and the whole congregation.

fresh_translation: And remove a tax for the Lord from the warriors who went out into battle, one soul out of five hundred, from the humans and from the cattle and from the oxen and from the sheep and from the goats.
brenton_translation: And ye shall take a tribute for the Lord from the warriors that went out to battle; one soul out of five hundred, from the men, and from the cattle, even from the oxen, and from the sheep, and from the asses; and ye shall take from their half.

fresh_translation: And from their half you shall take and give to Eleazar the priest the firstfruits of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt give them to Eleazar the priest as the first-fruits of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And from the half of the sons of Israel you shall take one out of fifty, from the humans and from the oxen and from the sheep and from the donkeys and from all the cattle, and you shall give them to the Levites who keep the charges in the tent of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And from the half belonging to the children of Israel thou shalt take one in fifty from the men, and from the oxen, and from the sheep, and from the asses, and from all the cattle; and thou shalt give them to the Levites that keep the charges in the tabernacle of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And the excess of plunder that the fighting men plundered from the sheep was six hundred seventy-five thousand.
brenton_translation: And that which remained of the spoil which the warriors took, was—of the sheep, six hundred and seventy-five thousand:

fresh_translation: And cattle, seventy-two thousand.
brenton_translation: and oxen, seventy-two thousand:

fresh_translation: And donkeys, sixty-one thousand.
brenton_translation: and asses, sixty-one thousand.

fresh_translation: And human souls from the women who had not known the bed of a male, all the souls, thirty-two thousand.
brenton_translation: And persons of women who had not known lying with man, all the souls, thirty-two thousand.

fresh_translation: And the half, the share of those who went out to war, from the number of the sheep, was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred.
brenton_translation: And the half, even the portion of them that went out to war, from the number of the sheep, was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand and five hundred.

fresh_translation: And the tax to the Lord from the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
brenton_translation: And the tribute to the Lord from the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five.

fresh_translation: And cattle, thirty-six thousand, and the tax to the Lord, seventy-two.
brenton_translation: And the oxen, six and thirty thousand, and the tribute to the Lord, seventy-two.

fresh_translation: And donkeys, thirty thousand five hundred, and the tax to the Lord, sixty-one.
brenton_translation: And asses, thirty thousand and five hundred, and the tribute to the Lord, sixty-one:

fresh_translation: And human souls, sixteen thousand, and their tax to the Lord, thirty-two souls.
brenton_translation: and the persons, sixteen thousand, and the tribute of them to the Lord, thirty-two souls.

fresh_translation: And Moses gave the tax to the Lord, the removed offering of God, to Eleazar the priest, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And Moses gave the tribute to the Lord, the heave-offering of God, to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses;

fresh_translation: From the half of the sons of Israel, which Moses divided off from the fighting men,
brenton_translation: from the half belonging to the children of Israel, whom Moses separated from the men of war.

fresh_translation: and the half of the congregation was, from the sheep, three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred,
brenton_translation: And the half taken from the sheep, belonging to the congregation, was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand and five hundred.

fresh_translation: and cattle, thirty-six thousand,
brenton_translation: And the oxen, thirty-six thousand;

fresh_translation: donkeys, thirty thousand five hundred,
brenton_translation: asses, thirty thousand and five hundred;

fresh_translation: and human souls, sixteen thousand.
brenton_translation: and persons, sixteen thousand.

fresh_translation: And Moses took from the half of the sons of Israel one out of fifty, from the humans and from the cattle, and gave them to the Levites who keep the charges of the tent of the Lord, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And Moses took of the half belonging to the children of Israel the fiftieth part, of men and of cattle, and he gave them to the Levites who keep the charges of the tabernacle of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And all those appointed over the thousands of the force, the chiliarchs and centurions, came near to Moses
brenton_translation: And all those who were appointed to be officers of thousands of the host, captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, approached Moses, and said to Moses,

fresh_translation: and said to Moses, Your servants have taken the total of the fighting men from among us, and not even one is missing from them.
brenton_translation: Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war with us, and not one is missing.

fresh_translation: And we have brought the gift to the Lord, each man what he found, a gold article, chain and bracelet and ring and armlet and clasped ornament, to make atonement for us before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And we have brought our gift to the Lord, every man who has found an article of gold, whether an armlet, or a chain, or a ring, or a bracelet, or a clasp for hair, to make atonement for us before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, every worked article.
brenton_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, even every wrought article.

fresh_translation: And all the gold, the removed offering that they removed for the Lord, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels from the chiliarchs and from the centurions.
brenton_translation: And all the wrought gold, even the offering that they offered to the Lord, was sixteen thousand and seven hundred and fifty shekels from the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds.

fresh_translation: And the fighting men had each plundered for himself.
brenton_translation: For the men of war took plunder every one for himself.

fresh_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the chiliarchs and from the centurions and brought it into the tent of testimony, a memorial of the sons of Israel before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and brought the vessels into the tabernacle of witness, a memorial of the children of Israel before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And cattle in great multitude belonged to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad, very many, and they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and the place was a place for cattle.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ruben and the children of Gad had a multitude of cattle, very great; and they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Galaad; and the place was a place for cattle:

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad came and said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
brenton_translation: and the children of Ruben and the children of Gad came, and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

fresh_translation: Ataroth and Dibon and Jazer and Nambram and Heshbon and Elealeh and Sebama and Nabau and Baian,
brenton_translation: Ataroth, and Dæbon, and Jazer, and Namra, and Esebon, and Eleale, and Sebama, and Nabau, and Bæan,

fresh_translation: the land that the Lord handed over before the sons of Israel, is cattle-land, and your servants have cattle.
brenton_translation: the land which the Lord has delivered up before the children of Israel, is pasture land, and thy servants have cattle.

fresh_translation: And they said, If we have found favor before you, let this land be given to your servants as a possession, and do not carry us across the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And they said, If we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession, and do not cause us to pass over Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, Shall your brothers go to war and you sit here?
brenton_translation: And Moses said to the sons of Gad and the sons of Ruben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

fresh_translation: And why do you twist the minds of the sons of Israel, so that they do not cross into the land that the Lord gives them?
brenton_translation: And why do ye pervert the minds of the children of Israel, that they should not cross over into the land, which the Lord gives them?

fresh_translation: Did not your fathers do thus when I sent them from Kadesh-Barnea to look upon the land?
brenton_translation: Did not your fathers thus, when I sent them from Cades Barne to spy out the land?

fresh_translation: And they went up to the Ravine of Cluster and looked upon the land, and turned away the heart of the sons of Israel so that they did not enter into the land that the Lord gave them.
brenton_translation: and they went up to the valley of the cluster, and spied the land, and turned aside the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land, which the Lord gave them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was enraged in anger on that day and swore, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry in that day, and sware, saying,

fresh_translation: If these men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, who know evil and good, shall see the land that I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, because they did not follow after me—
brenton_translation: Surely these men who came up out of Egypt from twenty years old and upward, who know good and evil, shall not see the land which I sware to give to Abraam and Isaac and Jacob, for they have not closely followed after me:

fresh_translation: except Caleb son of Jephunneh, the separated one, and Joshua son of Nun, because he followed after the Lord.
brenton_translation: save Caleb the son of Jephonne, who was set apart, and Joshua the son of Naue, for they closely followed after the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was enraged in anger against Israel and drove them round in the wilderness forty years until all the generation doing evil before the Lord was consumed.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel; and for forty years he caused them to wander in the wilderness, until all the generation which did evil in the sight of the Lord was extinct.

fresh_translation: Behold, you rose up in place of your fathers, a twisted growth of sinful men, to add yet more to the fury of the Lords anger against Israel.
brenton_translation: Behold, ye are risen up in the room of your fathers, a combination of sinful men, to increase yet farther the fierce wrath of the Lord against Israel.

fresh_translation: For you will turn away from him, to add yet again to leave him in the wilderness, and you will do lawlessness against all this congregation.
brenton_translation: For ye will turn away from him to desert him yet once more in the wilderness, and ye will sin against this whole congregation.

fresh_translation: And they came near to him and said, Let us build sheepfolds here for our cattle and cities for our baggage.
brenton_translation: And they came to him, and said, We will build here folds for our cattle, and cities for our possessions;

fresh_translation: But we, armed for a guard, will go first before the sons of Israel until we bring them to their place, and our baggage will dwell in fortified cities because of those dwelling in the land.
brenton_translation: and we will arm ourselves and go as an advanced guard before the children of Israel, until we shall have brought them into their place; and our possessions shall remain in walled cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

fresh_translation: We shall certainly not turn back to our houses until the sons of Israel are apportioned, each one into his inheritance.
brenton_translation: We will not return to our houses till the children of Israel shall have been distributed, each to his own inheritance.

fresh_translation: And we shall no longer inherit with them from beyond the Jordan and further on, because our allotments are here beyond the Jordan to the east.
brenton_translation: And we will not any longer inherit with them from the other side of Jordan and onwards, because we have our full inheritance on the side beyond Jordan eastward.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to them, If you do this thing, if you arm yourselves before the Lord for war,
brenton_translation: And Moses said to them, If ye will do according to these words, if ye will arm yourselves before the Lord for battle,

fresh_translation: and every armed man of yours crosses the Jordan before the Lord until his enemy is crushed from before him,
brenton_translation: and every one of you will pass over Jordan fully armed before the Lord, until his enemy be destroyed from before his face,

fresh_translation: and the land is subdued before the Lord, and afterward you turn back, then you shall be innocent before the Lord and from Israel, and this land shall be for you as a possession before the Lord.
brenton_translation: and the land shall be subdued before the Lord, then afterwards ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and as regards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before the Lord.

fresh_translation: But if you do not do thus, you will sin before the Lord, and you shall know your sin when evils overtake you.
brenton_translation: But if ye will not do so, ye will sin against the Lord; and ye shall know your sin, when afflictions shall come upon you.

fresh_translation: And you shall build cities for your baggage and sheepfolds for your cattle, and what goes out from your mouth you shall do.
brenton_translation: And ye shall build for yourselves cities for your store, and folds for your cattle; and ye shall do that which proceeds out of your mouth.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad said to Moses, saying, Your servants will do just as our lord commands.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben and the sons of Gad spoke to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as our lord commands.

fresh_translation: Our baggage and our wives and all our cattle will be in the cities of Gilead.
brenton_translation: Our store, and our wives, and all our cattle shall be in the cities of Galaad.

fresh_translation: But your servants will cross over, all armed and drawn up before the Lord for battle, as our lord says.
brenton_translation: But thy servants will go over all armed and set in order before the Lord to battle, as our lord says.

fresh_translation: And Moses appointed over them Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and the leaders of the ancestral houses of the tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Moses appointed to them for judges Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Naue, and the chiefs of the families of the tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Moses said to them, If the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad cross the Jordan with you, every armed man for war before the Lord, and you subdue the land before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
brenton_translation: And Moses said to them, If the sons of Ruben and the sons of Gad will pass over Jordan with you, every one armed for war before the Lord, and ye shall subdue the land before you, then ye shall give to them the land of Galaad for a possession.

fresh_translation: But if they do not cross armed with you before the Lord into war, then you shall bring their baggage and their wives and their cattle across ahead of you into the land of Canaan, and they shall inherit along with you in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: But if they will not pass over armed with you to war before the Lord, then shall ye cause to pass over their possessions and their wives and their cattle before you into the land of Chanaan, and they shall inherit with you in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad answered, saying, Whatever the Lord says to his servants, so we will do.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben and the sons of Gad answered, saying, Whatsoever the Lord says to his servants, that will we do.

fresh_translation: We will cross armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, and give us the possession beyond the Jordan.
brenton_translation: We will go over armed before the Lord into the land of Chanaan, and ye shall give us our inheritance beyond Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Moses gave to them—to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, sons of Joseph—the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land and its cities with its borders, the cities of the land around.
brenton_translation: And Moses gave to them, even to the sons of Gad and the sons of Ruben, and to the half tribe of Manasse of the sons of Joseph, the kingdom of Seon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Basan, the land and its cities with its coasts, the cities of the land round about.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Gad built Dæbon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

fresh_translation: and Sophar and Jazer and fortified them,
brenton_translation: and Sophar, and Jazer, and they set them up,

fresh_translation: and Nambran and Baitharan, fortified cities, and sheepfolds.
brenton_translation: and Namram, and Bætharan, strong cities, and folds for sheep.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and Kariathaim,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben built Esebon, and Eleale, and Kariatham,

fresh_translation: and Beelmeon, surrounded with walls, and Sebama, and they renamed by their names the names of the cities that they built.
brenton_translation: and Beelmeon, surrounded with walls, and Sebama; and they called the names of the cities which they built, after their own names.

fresh_translation: And a son of Machir son of Manasseh went into Gilead and took it and destroyed the Amorite dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: And a son of Machir the son of Manasse went to Galaad, and took it, and destroyed the Amorite who dwelt in it.

fresh_translation: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and he dwelt there.
brenton_translation: And Moses gave Galaad to Machir the son of Manasse, and he dwelt there.

fresh_translation: And Jair the Manassite went and took their camps and named them Jairs Camps.
brenton_translation: And Jair the son of Manasse went and took their villages, and called them the villages of Jair.

fresh_translation: And Nabau went and took Kenaath and its villages and named them Naboth after his name.
brenton_translation: And Nabau went and took Caath and her villages, and called them Naboth after his name.

fresh_translation: And these are the stages of the sons of Israel as they went out from the land of Egypt with their forces by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
brenton_translation: And these are the stages of the children of Israel, as they went out from the land of Egypt with their host by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

fresh_translation: And Moses wrote down their departures and their stages by word of the Lord. And these are the stages of their journey.
brenton_translation: And Moses wrote their removals and their stages, by the word of the Lord: and these are the stages of their journeying.

fresh_translation: They set out from Ramesse in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after Passover. The sons of Israel went out with uplifted hand before all the Egyptians,
brenton_translation: They departed from Ramesses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the passover the children of Israel went forth with a high hand before all the Egyptians.

fresh_translation: while the Egyptians were burying from among them all the dead whom the Lord had struck, every firstborn in the land of Egypt. And on their gods the Lord executed vengeance.
brenton_translation: And the Egyptians buried those that died of them, even all that the Lord smote, every first-born in the land of Egypt; also the Lord executed vengeance on their gods.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel set out from Ramesse and camped in Sokchoth.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel departed from Ramesses, and encamped in Socchoth:

fresh_translation: And they set out from Sokchoth and camped in Bouthan, which is some part of the wilderness.
brenton_translation: and they departed from Socchoth and encamped in Buthan, which is a part of the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Bouthan and camped at the mouth of Eiroth, which is opposite Beelsepphon, and camped opposite Magdolus.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Buthan and encamped at the mouth of Iroth, which is opposite Beel-sepphon, and encamped opposite Magdol.

fresh_translation: And they set out from opposite Eiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and they went a road of three days through the wilderness, they themselves, and camped in Pikriai.
brenton_translation: And they departed from before Iroth, and crossed the middle of the sea into the wilderness; and they went a journey of three days through the wilderness, and encamped in Picriæ.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Pikriai and came to Ailim, and in Ailim were twelve springs of waters and seventy trunks of palms, and they camped there by the water.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Picriæ, and came to Ælim; and in Ælim were twelve fountains of water, and seventy palm-trees, and they encamped there by the water.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Ailim and camped by the Red Sea.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Ælim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

fresh_translation: And they set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
brenton_translation: And they departed from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

fresh_translation: And they set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped in Raphaka.
brenton_translation: And they departed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Raphaca.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Raphaka and camped in Ailous.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Raphaca, and encamped in Ælus.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Ailous and camped in Raphidin, and there was no water for the people to drink there.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Ælus, and encamped in Raphidin; and there was no water there for the people to drink.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Raphidin and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Raphidin, and encamped in the wilderness of Sina.

fresh_translation: And they set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at the Tombs of Desire.
brenton_translation: And they departed from the wilderness of Sina, and encamped at the Graves of Lust.

fresh_translation: And they set out from the Tombs of Desire and camped in Aseroth.
brenton_translation: And they departed from the Graves of Lust, and encamped in Aseroth.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Aseroth and camped in Rathama.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Aseroth, and encamped in Rathama.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Rathama and camped in Remmon-Phares.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Rathama, and encamped in Remmon Phares.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Remmon-Phares and camped in Lemona.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Remmon Phares, and encamped in Lebona.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Lemona and camped at Dessa.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Lebona, and encamped in Ressan.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Dessa and camped at Makellath.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Ressan, and encamped in Makellath.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Makellath and camped at Sapher.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Makellath, and encamped in Saphar.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Sapher and camped at Charadath.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Saphar, and encamped in Charadath.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Charadath and camped at Makeloth.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Charadath, and encamped in Makeloth.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Makeloth and camped at Kataath.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Makeloth, and encamped in Kataath.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Kataath and camped at Tarath.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Kataath, and encamped in Tarath.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Tarath and camped at Matekka.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Tarath, and encamped in Mathecca.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Matekka and camped at Selmona.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Mathecca, and encamped in Selmona.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Selmona and camped at Massourouth.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Selmona, and encamped in Masuruth.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Massourouth and camped at Banaia.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Masuruth, and encamped in Banæa.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Banaia and camped at Mount Gadgad.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Banæa, and encamped in the mountain Gadgad.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Mount Gadgad and camped at Etebatha.
brenton_translation: And they departed from the mountain Gadgad, and encamped in Etebatha.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Etebatha and camped at Ebrona.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Etebatha, and encamped in Ebrona.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Ebrona and camped at Gesiongaber.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Ebrona, and encamped in Gesion Gaber.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Gesiongaber and camped in the wilderness of Sin, and they set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped in the wilderness of Paran; this is Kadesh.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Gesion Gaber, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin; and they departed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in the wilderness of Pharan; this is Cades.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, near the land of Edom.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Cades, and encamped in mount Or near the land of Edom.

fresh_translation: And Aaron the priest went up by command of the Lord and died there, in the fortieth year of the departure of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
brenton_translation: And Aaron the priest went up by the command of the Lord, and died there in the fortieth year of the departure of the children of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

fresh_translation: And Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.
brenton_translation: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old, when he died in mount Or.

fresh_translation: And the Canaanite king of Arad heard, and he himself dwelt in the land of Canaan, when the sons of Israel were entering.
brenton_translation: And Arad the Chananitish king (he too dwelt in the land of Chanaan) having heard when the children of Israel were entering the land—

fresh_translation: And they set out from Mount Hor and camped at Selmona.
brenton_translation: then they departed from mount Or, and encamped in Selmona.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Selmona and camped at Phino.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Selmona, and encamped in Phino.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Phino and camped at Oboth.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Phino, and encamped in Oboth.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Oboth and camped in Gai-beyond on the borders of Moab.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Oboth, and encamped in Gai, on the other side Jordan on the borders of Moab.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Gai and camped at Dibon-Gad.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Gai, and encamped in Dæbon Gad.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Dibon-Gad and camped in Gelmon-Deblathaim.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Dæbon Gad, and encamped in Gelmon Deblathaim.

fresh_translation: And they set out from Gelmon-Deblathaim and camped at the mountains of Abarim opposite Nabau.
brenton_translation: And they departed from Gelmon Deblathaim, and encamped on the mountains of Abarim, over against Nabau.

fresh_translation: And they set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped west of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
brenton_translation: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped on the west of Moab, at Jordan by Jericho.

fresh_translation: And they camped by the Jordan, from Aisimoth to Belsattim, west of Moab.
brenton_translation: And they encamped by Jordan between Æsimoth, as far as Belsa to the west of Moab.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses west of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses at the west of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, You are crossing the Jordan into the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Ye are to pass over Jordan into the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And you shall destroy all the inhabitants in the land from before you, and you shall remove their watch-posts, and all their molten idols you shall destroy them, and all their pillars you shall remove.
brenton_translation: And ye shall destroy all that dwell in the land before your face, and ye shall abolish their high places, and all their molten images ye shall destroy, and ye shall demolish all their pillars.

fresh_translation: And you shall destroy all those inhabiting the land and dwell in it, for I have given you their land by lot.
brenton_translation: And ye shall destroy all the inhabitants of the land, and ye shall dwell in it, for I have given their land to you for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: And you shall take possession of their land by lot according to your tribes. To the greater you shall increase their possession, and to the fewer you shall lessen their possession. Wherever his lot comes out, there it shall be his. According to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.
brenton_translation: And ye shall inherit their land according to your tribes; to the greater number ye shall give the larger possession, and to the smaller ye shall give the less possession; to whatsoever part a man's name shall go forth by lot, there shall be his property: ye shall inherit according to the tribes of your families.
