fresh_translation: But if you do not destroy the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you leave from them shall be spikes in your eyes and darts in your sides, and they shall be hostile over the land on which you dwell.
brenton_translation: But if ye will not destroy the dwellers in the land from before you, then it shall come to pass that whomsoever of them ye shall leave shall be thorns in your eyes, and darts in your sides, and they shall be enemies to you on the land on which ye shall dwell;

fresh_translation: And it shall be, just as I determined to do to them, I will do to you.
brenton_translation: and it shall come to pass that as I had determined to do to them, so I will do to you.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Command the sons of Israel and say to them, You are entering into the land of Canaan. This shall be for you as an inheritance, the land of Canaan with its borders.
brenton_translation: Charge the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Ye are entering into the land of Chanaan: it shall be to you for an inheritance, the land of Chanaan with its boundaries.

fresh_translation: And for you the south side shall be from the wilderness of Sin up to Edom, and for you the southern borders shall be from the side of the Salt Sea eastward.
brenton_translation: And your southern side shall be from the wilderness of Sin to the border of Edom, and your border southward shall extend on the side of the salt sea eastward.

fresh_translation: And the borders shall turn for you from the south to the ascent of Akrabin and shall pass Sena, and its exit shall be south of Kadesh-Barnea and shall go out to the camp of Arad and shall pass Asemona.
brenton_translation: And your border shall go round you from the south to the ascent of Acrabin, and shall proceed by Ennac, and the going forth of it shall be southward to Cades Barne, and it shall go forth to the village of Arad, and shall proceed by Asemona.

fresh_translation: And the borders shall turn from Asemona to the Torrent of Egypt, and its exit shall be the sea.
brenton_translation: And the border shall compass from Asemona to the river of Egypt, and the sea shall be the termination.

fresh_translation: And your sea border shall be the Great Sea; it shall mark the boundary. This shall be for you the sea border.
brenton_translation: And ye shall have your border on the west, the great sea shall be the boundary: this shall be to you the border on the west.

fresh_translation: And this shall be the border for you to the north. From the Great Sea you shall measure for yourselves by Mount Hor.
brenton_translation: And this shall be your northern border; from the great sea ye shall measure to yourselves, by the side of the mountain.

fresh_translation: And from Mount Hor you shall measure for yourselves entering into Emath, and its exit shall be the borders of Sarada.
brenton_translation: And ye shall measure to yourselves the mountain from mount Hor at the entering in to Emath, and the termination of it shall be the coasts of Saradac.

fresh_translation: And the borders shall go out to Dephrōn, and its exit shall be Asernain. This shall be for you the northern border.
brenton_translation: And the border shall go out to Dephrona, and its termination shall be at Arsenain; this shall be your border from the north.

fresh_translation: And you shall measure for yourselves the eastern border from Asernain to Sephama.
brenton_translation: And ye shall measure to yourselves the eastern border from Arsenain to Sepphamar.

fresh_translation: And the border shall go down from Sepham to Arbela eastward by the springs, and the border shall go down to Bela on the slope of the Sea of Chenereth eastward.
brenton_translation: And the border shall go down from Sepphamar to Bela eastward to the fountains, and the border shall go down from Bela behind the sea Chenereth eastward.

fresh_translation: And the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its exit shall be the Salt Sea. This shall be for you the land and its borders all around.
brenton_translation: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the termination shall be the salt sea; this shall be your land and its borders round about.

fresh_translation: And Moses commanded the sons of Israel, saying, This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded Moses to give it to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe of Manasseh,
brenton_translation: And Moses charged the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, even as the Lord commanded us to give it to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasse.

fresh_translation: because the tribe of the sons of Reuben and the tribe of the sons of Gad by their ancestral houses and the half-tribe of Manasseh received their allotments.
brenton_translation: For the tribe of the children of Ruben, and the tribe of the children of Gad have received their inheritance according to their families; and the half-tribe of Manasse have received their inheritances.

fresh_translation: Two tribes and a half-tribe received their allotments beyond the Jordan at Jericho, from the south eastward.
brenton_translation: Two tribes and half a tribe have received their inheritance beyond Jordan by Jericho from the south eastwards.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: These are the names of the men who shall allot the land to you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
brenton_translation: These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for an inheritance; Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Naue.

fresh_translation: And one leader from each tribe you shall take to allot the land for you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall take one ruler from each tribe to divide the land to you by lot.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of the men: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the men; of the tribe of Juda, Chaleb the son of Jephonne.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of Symeon, Salamiēl son of Emioud.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of Symeon, Salamiel the son of Semiud.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of Benjamin, Eldad son of Chaslōn.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Eldad the son of Chaslon.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of Dan, the leader Bacchir son of Egli.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of Dan the prince was Bacchir the son of Egli.

fresh_translation: From the sons of Joseph, from the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, the leader Aniēl son of Ouphi.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Joseph of the tribe of the sons of Manasse, the prince was Aniel the son of Suphi.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, the leader Kamouēl son of Sabatha.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, the prince was Camuel the son of Sabathan.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of Zebulun, the leader Elisaphan son of Pharnach.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of Zabulon, the prince was Elisaphan the son of Pharnac.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of the sons of Issachar, the leader Phaltiēl son of Oza.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of the sons of Issachar, the prince was Phaltiel the son of Oza.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of the sons of Asher, the leader Achiōr son of Selemi.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of the children of Aser, the prince was Achior the son of Selemi.

fresh_translation: From the tribe of Naphtali, the leader Phadaēl son of Benamioud.
brenton_translation: Of the tribe of Nephthali, the prince was Phadael the son of Jamiud.

fresh_translation: These are the ones whom the Lord commanded to divide the land for the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: These did the Lord command to distribute the inheritances to the children of Israel in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses west of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses to the west of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

fresh_translation: Command the sons of Israel, and they shall give to the Levites from the lots of their possession cities to dwell in, and the outskirts of the cities around them they shall give to the Levites.
brenton_translation: Give orders to the children of Israel, and they shall give to the Levites cities to dwell in from the lot of their possession, and they shall give to the Levites the suburbs of the cities round about them.

fresh_translation: And the cities shall be for them to dwell in, and their separated lands shall be for their cattle and for all their four-footed animals.
brenton_translation: And the cities shall be for them to dwell in, and their enclosures shall be for their cattle and all their beasts.

fresh_translation: And the surrounding lands of the cities that you shall give to the Levites, from the wall of the city and outward, shall be two thousand cubits all around.
brenton_translation: And the suburbs of the cities which ye shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outwards two thousand cubits round about.

fresh_translation: And you shall measure outside the city the east side two thousand cubits and the south side two thousand cubits and the west side two thousand cubits and the north side two thousand cubits, and the city shall be in the middle of this. These shall be for you the adjoining lands of the cities.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt measure outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and your city shall be in the midst of this, and the suburbs of the cities as described.

fresh_translation: And the cities that you shall give to the Levites, the six cities of refuges, which you shall give for the slayer to flee there, and besides these, forty-two cities.
brenton_translation: And ye shall give the cities to the Levites, the six cities of refuge which ye shall give for the slayer to flee thither, and in addition to these, forty-two cities.

fresh_translation: All the cities that you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities, these and their outskirts.
brenton_translation: Ye shall give to the Levites in all forty-eight cities, them and their suburbs.

fresh_translation: And the cities that you shall give from the possession of the sons of Israel, from the greater share many, and from the smaller share fewer. Each according to his inheritance that they will inherit, they shall give from their cities to the Levites.
brenton_translation: And as for the cities which ye shall give out of the possession of the children of Israel, from those that have much ye shall give much, and from those that have less ye shall give less: they shall give of their cities to the Levites each one according to his inheritance which they shall inherit.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, You are crossing the Jordan into the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Ye are to cross over Jordan into the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And you shall designate cities for yourselves. They shall be refuges for you, for the slayer to flee there, everyone who struck down a soul unintentionally.
brenton_translation: And ye shall appoint to yourselves cities: they shall be to you cities of refuge for the slayer to flee to, every one who has killed another unintentionally.

fresh_translation: And the cities shall be refuges for you from the avenger of blood, and the slayer shall certainly not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
brenton_translation: And the cities shall be to you places of refuge from the avenger of blood, and the slayer shall not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

fresh_translation: And the cities that you shall give, the six cities, shall be refuges for you.
brenton_translation: And the cities which ye shall assign, even the six cities, shall be places of refuge for you.

fresh_translation: Three cities you shall give beyond the Jordan, and three cities you shall give in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: Ye shall assign three cities on the other side of Jordan, and ye shall assign three cities in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: The refuge shall be for the sons of Israel and for the proselyte and for the resident among you. These cities shall be a refuge, for everyone striking a soul unintentionally to flee there.
brenton_translation: It shall be a place of refuge for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for him that sojourns among you; these cities shall be for a place of refuge, for every one to flee thither who has killed a man unintentionally.

fresh_translation: But if he strikes him with an iron tool and he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
brenton_translation: And if he should smite him with an iron instrument, and the man should die, he is a murderer; let the murderer by all means be put to death.

fresh_translation: And if with a stone in the hand by which one may die he strikes him and he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
brenton_translation: And if he should smite him with a stone thrown from his hand, whereby a man may die, and he thus die, he is a murderer; let the murderer by all means be put to death.

fresh_translation: And if with a wooden tool in the hand by which one may die he strikes him and he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
brenton_translation: And if he should smite him with an instrument of wood from his hand, whereby he may die, and he thus die, he is a murderer; let the murderer by all means be put to death.

fresh_translation: The avenger of blood, this one shall kill the murderer. When he meets him, this one shall kill him.
brenton_translation: The avenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: whensoever he shall meet him he shall slay him.

fresh_translation: And if through enmity he pushes him, or throws any object upon him from ambush, and he dies,
brenton_translation: And if he should thrust him through enmity, or cast any thing upon him from an ambuscade, and the man should die,

fresh_translation: or in anger strikes him with the hand and he dies, the one striking shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall kill the murderer when he meets him.
brenton_translation: or if he have smitten him with his hand through anger, and the man should die, let the man that smote him be put to death by all means, he is a murderer: let the murderer by all means be put to death: the avenger of blood shall slay the murderer when he meets him.

fresh_translation: But if suddenly, not through enmity, he pushes him, or throws any object upon him not from ambush,
brenton_translation: But if he should thrust him suddenly, not through enmity, or cast any thing upon him, not from an ambuscade,

fresh_translation: or with any stone by which one may die, not knowing, it falls on him and he dies, while he was not his enemy nor seeking to do him harm,
brenton_translation: or smite him with any stone, whereby a man may die, unawares, and it should fall upon him, and he should die, but he was not his enemy, nor sought to hurt him;

fresh_translation: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these judgments.
brenton_translation: then the assembly shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood, according to these judgments.

fresh_translation: And the congregation shall rescue the slayer from the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge where he fled, and he shall dwell there until the great priest dies, the one whom they anointed with the holy oil.
brenton_translation: And the congregation shall rescue the slayer from the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, whither he fled for refuge; and he shall dwell there till the death of the high-priest, whom they anointed with the holy oil.

fresh_translation: But if the slayer goes out beyond the bounds of the city where he fled there,
brenton_translation: But if the slayer should in any wise go out beyond the bounds of the city whither he fled for refuge,

fresh_translation: and the avenger of blood finds him outside the bounds of the city of his refuge and the avenger of blood kills the slayer, he is not guilty.
brenton_translation: and the avenger of blood should find him without the bounds of the city of his refuge, and the avenger of blood should kill the slayer, he is not guilty.

fresh_translation: For he shall dwell in the city of refuge until the great priest dies, and after the great priest dies the slayer shall return to the land of his possession.
brenton_translation: For he ought to have remained in the city of refuge till the high-priest died; and after the death of the high-priest the slayer shall return to the land of his possession.

fresh_translation: And these things shall be for you an ordinance of judgment throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
brenton_translation: And these things shall be to you for an ordinance of judgment throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

fresh_translation: Everyone striking a soul, by witnesses you shall kill the murderer, but one witness shall not testify against a soul for dying.
brenton_translation: Whoever kills a man, thou shalt slay the murderer on the testimony of witnesses; and one witness shall not testify against a soul that he should die.

fresh_translation: And you shall not take ransom for the life of the murderer who is guilty to be taken away, for by death he shall be put to death.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not accept ransoms for life from a murderer who is worthy of death, for he shall be surely put to death.

fresh_translation: You shall not take ransom for fleeing into the city of refuges, for returning to dwell upon the land until the great priest dies.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not accept a ransom to excuse his fleeing to the city of refuge, so that he should again dwell in the land, until the death of the high-priest.

fresh_translation: And you shall certainly not murder the land in which you dwell, for blood murders the land, and the land shall not be atoned for from the blood poured out on it except by the blood of the one pouring it out.
brenton_translation: So shall ye not pollute with murder the land in which ye dwell; for this blood pollutes the land, and the land shall not be purged from the blood shed upon it, but by the blood of him that shed it.

fresh_translation: And you shall not defile the land on which you dwell, upon which I tabernacle among you, for I am the Lord tabernacling in the midst of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not defile the land whereon ye dwell, on which I dwell in the midst of you; for I am the Lord dwelling in the midst of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the leaders of the tribe of the sons of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, from the tribe of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before Eleazar the priest and before the leaders of the ancestral houses of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the heads of the tribe of the sons of Galaad the son of Machir the son of Manasse, of the tribe of the sons of Joseph, drew near, and spoke before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the heads of the houses of the families of the children of Israel:

fresh_translation: And they said to our lord, The Lord commanded to give the land of inheritance by lot to the sons of Israel, and to our lord the Lord commanded to give the inheritance of Salpaad our brother to his daughters.
brenton_translation: and they said, The Lord commanded our lord to render the land of inheritance by lot to the children of Israel; and the Lord appointed our lord to give the inheritance of Salpaad our brother to his daughters.

fresh_translation: And if they become wives to one of the tribes of the sons of Israel, their inheritance will be taken away from the possession of our fathers and added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they become wives, and it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
brenton_translation: And they will become wives in one of the tribes of the children of Israel; so their inheritance shall be taken away from the possession of our fathers, and shall be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which the women shall marry, and shall be taken away from the portion of our inheritance.

fresh_translation: And if the release of the sons of Israel comes, their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they become wives, and their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
brenton_translation: And if there shall be a release of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which the women marry, and their inheritance shall be taken away from the inheritance of our family's tribe.

fresh_translation: And Moses commanded the sons of Israel by command of the Lord, saying, Thus the tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks.
brenton_translation: And Moses charged the children of Israel by the commandment of the Lord, saying, Thus says the tribe of the children of Joseph.

fresh_translation: This is the word that the Lord commanded for the daughters of Salpaad, saying, Let them become wives to whom it is pleasing before them. Only from the clan of their father shall they become wives.
brenton_translation: This is the thing which the Lord has appointed the daughters of Salpaad, saying, Let them marry where they please, only let them marry men of their father's tribe.

fresh_translation: And inheritance shall not be turned around for the sons of Israel from tribe to tribe, because the sons of Israel shall cling each to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
brenton_translation: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel go about from tribe to tribe, for the children of Israel shall steadfastly continue each in the inheritance of his family's tribe.

fresh_translation: And every daughter inheriting inheritance from the tribes of the sons of Israel shall become wife to one from the clan of her father, so that the sons of Israel may inherit each the inheritance of his fathers.
brenton_translation: And whatever daughter is heiress to a property of the tribes of the children of Israel, such women shall be married each to one of her father's tribe, that the sons of Israel may each inherit the property of his father's tribe.

fresh_translation: And a lot shall not be turned from tribe to another tribe, but the sons of Israel shall cling each to his own inheritance.
brenton_translation: And the inheritance shall not go about from one tribe to another, but the children of Israel shall steadfastly continue each in his own inheritance.

fresh_translation: Just as the Lord commanded Moses, so the daughters of Salpaad did.
brenton_translation: As the Lord commanded Moses, so did they to the daughters of Salpaad.

fresh_translation: And Thersa and Egla and Melcha and Noua and Maala, daughters of Salpaad, became wives to their cousins.
brenton_translation: So Thersa, and Egla, and Melcha, and Nua, and Malaa, the daughters of Salpaad, married their cousins;

fresh_translation: From the clan of Manasseh, sons of Joseph, they became wives, and their inheritance remained upon the tribe of the clan of their father.
brenton_translation: they were married to men of the tribe of Manasse of the sons of Joseph; and their inheritance was attached to the tribe of their father's family.

fresh_translation: These are the commands and the ordinances and the judgments that the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses west of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
brenton_translation: These are the commandments, and the ordinances, and the judgments, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, at the west of Moab, at Jordan by Jericho.

fresh_translation: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, toward the west, near the Red Sea, between Pharan and Tophel and Lobon and Aulon and Katakrusea.
brenton_translation: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on this side Jordan in the desert towards the west near the Red Sea, between Pharan Tophol, and Lobon, and Aulon, and the gold works.

fresh_translation: Eleven days from Horeb by the road of Mount Seir to Kadesh-Barnea.
brenton_translation: It is a journey of eleven days from Choreb to mount Seir as far as Cades Barne.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, Moses spoke to all the sons of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded him to them,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to all the children of Israel, according to all things which the Lord commanded him for them:

fresh_translation: after he struck Sihon king of the Amorites who dwelt in Heshbon and Og king of Bashan who dwelt in Astaroth and in Edrain.
brenton_translation: after he had smitten Seon king of the Amorites who dwelt in Esebon, and Og the king of Basan who dwelt in Astaroth and in Edrain;

fresh_translation: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to make this law clear, saying,
brenton_translation: beyond Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

fresh_translation: The Lord our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, Let it be enough for you to dwell on this mountain.
brenton_translation: The Lord your God spoke to us in Choreb, saying, Let it suffice you to have dwelt so long in this mountain.

fresh_translation: Turn and set out, you, and enter into the hill-country of the Amorites and to all the neighbors of the Arabah, into mountain and plain and toward the south and the coastland, the land of the Canaanites and Lebanon, as far as the great river Euphrates.
brenton_translation: Turn ye and depart and enter into the mountain of the Amorites, and go to all that dwell near about Araba, to the mountain and the plain and to the south, and the land of the Chananites near the sea, and Antilibanus, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

fresh_translation: See, I have handed over the land before you. Having entered, inherit the land which I swore to your fathers, to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them.
brenton_translation: Behold, God has delivered the land before you; go in and inherit the land, which I sware to your fathers, Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob, to give it to them and to their seed after them.

fresh_translation: And I said to you at that time, saying, I will not be able to bear you alone.
brenton_translation: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, I shall not be able by myself to bear you.

fresh_translation: The Lord your God multiplied you, and behold, today you are as the stars of heaven in multitude.
brenton_translation: The Lord your God has multiplied you, and, behold, ye are to-day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

fresh_translation: May the Lord, the God of your fathers, add to you, as you are, a thousandfold, and bless you just as he spoke to you.
brenton_translation: The Lord God of your fathers add to you a thousand-fold more than you are, and bless you as he has spoken to you.

fresh_translation: How will I be able alone to bear your toil and your standing and your disputes?
brenton_translation: How shall I alone be able to bear your labour, and your burden, and your gainsayings?

fresh_translation: Give yourselves men wise and understanding and prudent for your tribes, and I will appoint them as leaders over you.
brenton_translation: Take to yourselves wise and understanding and prudent men for your tribes, and I will set your leaders over you.

fresh_translation: And you answered me and said, Good is the word that you spoke to do.
brenton_translation: And ye answered me and said, The thing which thou hast told us is good to do.

fresh_translation: And I took from among you men wise and understanding and prudent, and I appointed them to lead over you as chiliarchs and centurions and leaders of fifty and leaders of ten and record-keepers for your judges.
brenton_translation: So I took of you wise and understanding and prudent men, and I set them to rule over you as rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, and rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens, and officers to your judges.

fresh_translation: And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, Hear between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother and his proselyte.
brenton_translation: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear causes between your brethren, and judge rightly between a man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

fresh_translation: You shall not recognize a face in judgment. By the small and by the great you shall judge. You shall not shrink from a man's face, because the judgment is Gods. And the matter that is hard for you, you shall bring it up to me, and I will hear it.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not have respect to persons in judgment, thou shalt judge small and great equally; thou shalt not shrink from before the person of a man, for the judgment is God's; and whatsoever matter shall be too hard for you, ye shall bring it to me, and I will hear it.

fresh_translation: And I commanded you at that time all the matters that you should do.
brenton_translation: And I charged upon you at that time all the commands which ye shall perform.

fresh_translation: And setting out from Horeb, we went through all that great and fearful wilderness which you saw, by the road of the mountain of the Amorite, just as the Lord our God commanded us, and we came as far as Kadesh-Barnea.
brenton_translation: And we departed from Choreb, and went through all that great wilderness and terrible, which ye saw, by the way of the mountain of the Amorite, as the Lord our God charged us, and we came as far as Cades Barne.

fresh_translation: And I said to you, You have come as far as the mountain of the Amorite, which the Lord our God gives you.
brenton_translation: And I said to you, Ye have come as far as the mountain of the Amorite, which the Lord our God gives to you:

fresh_translation: See, the Lord your God has handed over the land before you. Go up, inherit, just as the Lord the God of your fathers said to you. Do not fear and do not lose heart.
brenton_translation: behold, the Lord your God has delivered to us the land before you: go up and inherit it as the Lord God of your fathers said to you; fear not, neither be afraid.

fresh_translation: And you all came near to me and said, Let us send men before us, and let them explore the land for us and report back to us the answer, the road by which we shall go up in it and the cities into which we shall enter.
brenton_translation: And ye all came to me, and said, Let us send men before us, and let them go up to the land for us; and let them bring back to us a report of the way by which we shall go up, and of the cities into which we shall enter.

fresh_translation: And the word pleased me, and I took from among you twelve men, one man by tribe.
brenton_translation: And the saying pleased me: and I took of you twelve men, one man of a tribe.

fresh_translation: And turning, they went up into the mountain and came as far as the Ravine of Cluster and spied it out.
brenton_translation: And they turned and went up to the mountain, and they came as far as the valley of the cluster, and surveyed it.

fresh_translation: And they took in their hands from the fruit of the land and brought it down to us and said, Good is the land that the Lord our God gives us.
brenton_translation: And they took in their hands of the fruit of the land, and brought it to you, and said, The land is good which the Lord our God gives us.

fresh_translation: But you were not willing to go up, and you disobeyed the word of the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Yet ye would not go up, but rebelled against the words of the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: And you were grumbling in your tents and said, Because the Lord hates us, he brought us out from the land of Egypt to hand us over into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.
brenton_translation: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the Lord hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, to destroy us.

fresh_translation: Where are we going up? Our brothers turned away your heart, saying, The nation is great and many and stronger than we, and the cities great and walled up to heaven, and moreover we saw sons of giants there.
brenton_translation: Whither do we go up? and your brethren drew away your heart, saying, It is a great nation and populous, and mightier than we; and there are cities great and walled up to heaven: moreover we saw there the sons of the giants.

fresh_translation: And I said to you, Do not be terrified, and do not fear them.
brenton_translation: And I said to you, Fear not, neither be ye afraid of them;

fresh_translation: The Lord your God who goes before your face, he himself will fight together with them for you according to all that he did for you in the land of Egypt,
brenton_translation: the Lord your God who goes before your face, he shall fight against them together with you effectually, according to all that he wrought for you in the land of Egypt;

fresh_translation: and in this wilderness which you saw, how the Lord your God carried you as someone would carry his son, throughout all the road that you traveled until you came to this place.
brenton_translation: and in this wilderness which ye saw, by the way of the mountain of the Amorite; how the Lord thy God will bear thee as a nursling, as if any man should nurse his child, through all the way which ye have gone until ye came to this place.

fresh_translation: And in this matter you did not trust the Lord your God,
brenton_translation: And in this matter ye believed not the Lord our God,

fresh_translation: who goes ahead of you on the road, choosing for you a place, leading you in fire by night, showing you the road on which you go, and in cloud by day.
brenton_translation: who goes before you in the way to choose you a place, guiding you in fire by night, shewing you the way by which ye go, and a cloud by day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord heard the voice of your words and, being provoked, swore, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, and being greatly provoked he sware, saying,

fresh_translation: If any of these men shall see this good land that I swore to their fathers—
brenton_translation: Not one of these men shall see this good land, which I sware to their fathers,

fresh_translation: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He shall see it, and to him I will give the land on which he trod and to his sons, because he clung to the things of the Lord.
brenton_translation: except Chaleb the son of Jephonne, he shall see it; and to him I will give the land on which he went up, and to his sons, because he attended to the things of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was angry with me because of you, saying, Neither shall you enter there.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was angry with me for your sake, saying, Neither shalt thou by any means enter therein.

fresh_translation: Joshua son of Nun, the one standing by you, he shall enter there. Strengthen him, because he shall allot it to Israel.
brenton_translation: Joshua the son of Naue, who stands by thee, he shall enter in there; do thou strengthen him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And every young child who today does not know good or evil, these shall enter there, and to these I will give it, and they shall inherit it.
brenton_translation: And every young child who this day knows not good or evil,—they shall enter therein, and to them I will give it, and they shall inherit it.

fresh_translation: And you, having turned, camp yourselves in the wilderness by the road of the Red Sea.
brenton_translation: And ye turned and marched into the wilderness, in the way by the Red Sea.

fresh_translation: And you answered me and said, We sinned before the Lord our God. We ourselves, going up, will wage war according to all that the Lord our God commanded us. And each taking up his weapons of war and gathering yourselves, you were going up into the mountain.
brenton_translation: And ye answered and said, We have sinned before the Lord our God; we will go up and fight according to all that the Lord our God has commanded us: and having taken every one his weapons of war, and being gathered together, ye went up to the mountain.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Tell them, You shall not go up, nor shall you fight, for I am not with you, and you shall not be crushed before your enemies.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Tell them, Ye shall not go up, neither shall ye fight, for I am not with you; thus shall ye not be destroyed before your enemies.

fresh_translation: And I spoke to you, and you did not listen to me, and you transgressed the word of the Lord, and forcing your way, you went up into the mountain.
brenton_translation: And I spoke to you, and ye did not hearken to me; and ye transgressed the commandment of the Lord; and ye forced your way and went up into the mountain.

fresh_translation: And the Amorite who dwelt in that mountain came out to meet you and pursued you as bees might do and were wounding you from Seir to Herma.
brenton_translation: And the Amorite who dwelt in that mountain came out to meet you, and pursued you as bees do, and wounded you from Seir to Herma.

fresh_translation: And sitting down, you were weeping before the Lord, and the Lord did not hear your voice nor pay attention to you.
brenton_translation: And ye sat down and wept before the Lord our God, and the Lord hearkened not to your voice, neither did he take heed to you.

fresh_translation: And you remained in Kadesh many days, however many days you remained.
brenton_translation: And ye dwelt in Cades many days, as many days as ye dwelt there.

fresh_translation: And turning, we set out into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, just as the Lord spoke to me, and we went around Mount Seir many days.
brenton_translation: And we turned and departed into the wilderness, by the way of the Red Sea, as the Lord spoke to me, and we compassed mount Seir many days.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me,
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me,

fresh_translation: Let it be enough for you to go around this mountain. Turn then to the north.
brenton_translation: Ye have compassed this mount long enough; turn therefore toward the north.

fresh_translation: And command the people, saying, You are passing through the borders of your brothers, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir, and they shall fear you and be very wary of you.
brenton_translation: And charge the people, saying, Ye are going through the borders of your brethren the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they shall fear you, and dread you greatly.

fresh_translation: Do not join battle with them, for I shall certainly not give you from their land even a step of foot, because I have given Mount Seir to the sons of Esau as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: Do not engage in war against them, for I will not give you of their land even enough to set your foot upon, for I have given mount Seir to the children of Esau as an inheritance.

fresh_translation: Buy food from them with silver and eat, and water by measure take from them for silver and drink.
brenton_translation: Buy food of them for money and eat, and ye shall receive water of them by measure for money, and drink.

fresh_translation: For the Lord our God blessed you in every work of your hands. Know how you passed through that great and fearful wilderness. Behold, forty years the Lord your God is with you. You lacked no thing.
brenton_translation: For the Lord our God has blessed thee in every work of thy hands. Consider how thou wentest through that great and terrible wilderness: behold, the Lord thy God has been with thee forty years; thou didst not lack any thing.

fresh_translation: And we passed by our brothers, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir, by the road of the Arabah, from Ailon and from Gasiongaber. And turning, we passed by the road of the wilderness of Moab.
brenton_translation: And we passed by our brethren the children of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, by the way of Araba from Ælon and from Gesion Gaber; and we turned and passed by the way of the desert of Moab.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Do not treat the Moabites as enemies, and do not join them in war, for I shall certainly not give you from their land as an inheritance, because I have given Seir to the sons of Lot as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Do not ye quarrel with the Moabites, and do not engage in war with them; for I will not give you of their land for an inheritance, for I have given Aroer to the children of Lot to inherit.

fresh_translation: The Ommin lived on it formerly, a great and many people and mighty, like the Anakim.
brenton_translation: Formerly the Ommin dwelt in it, a great and numerous nation and powerful, like the Enakim.

fresh_translation: These also are counted as Raphain, like the Anakim, and the Moabites call them Ommin.
brenton_translation: These also shall be accounted Raphain like the Enakim; and the Moabites call them Ommin.

fresh_translation: And in Seir the Chorraean dwelt formerly, and the sons of Esau destroyed them and crushed them from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did to the land of his inheritance which the Lord gave them.
brenton_translation: And the Chorrhite dwelt in Seir before, and the sons of Esau destroyed them, and utterly consumed them from before them; and they dwelt in their place, as Israel did to the land of his inheritance, which the Lord gave to them.

fresh_translation: Now then rise and set out, you, and pass through the Ravine of Zaret. And we passed through the Ravine of Zaret.
brenton_translation: Now then, arise ye, said I, and depart, and cross the valley of Zaret.

fresh_translation: And the days that we traveled from Kadesh-Barnea until we passed through the Ravine of Zaret were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of fighting men fell away, dying from the camp, just as God swore to them.
brenton_translation: And the days in which we travelled from Cades Barne till we crossed the valley of Zaret, were thirty and eight years, until the whole generation of the men of war failed, dying out of the camp, as the Lord God sware to them.

fresh_translation: And the hand of God was upon them to consume them from the camp until they fell away.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the Lord was upon them to destroy them out of the midst of the camp, until they were consumed.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, when all the fighting men had fallen away, dying from the midst of the people,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when all the men of war dying out of the midst of the people had fallen,

fresh_translation: the Lord spoke to me, saying,
brenton_translation: that the Lord spoke to me, saying,

fresh_translation: You are passing today the borders of Moab, Seir.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt pass over this day the borders of Moab to Aroer;

fresh_translation: And you will come near to the sons of Ammon. Do not treat them as enemies and do not join them in war, for I shall certainly not give you from the land of the sons of Ammon as an inheritance, because I have given it to the sons of Lot as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: and ye shall draw nigh to the children of Amman: do not quarrel with them, nor wage war with them; for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Amman for an inheritance, because I have given it to the children of Lot for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: It is counted as land of Raphain, for Raphain dwelt on it formerly, and the Ammanites call them Zomzommin,
brenton_translation: It shall be accounted a land of Raphain, for the Raphain dwelt there before, and the Ammanites call them Zochommin.

fresh_translation: a great and many people and stronger than you, like the Anakim. And the Lord destroyed them from before them, and they inherited and dwelt in their place to this day,
brenton_translation: A great nation and populous, and mightier than you, as also the Enakim: yet the Lord destroyed them from before them, and they inherited their land, and they dwelt there instead of them until this day.

fresh_translation: just as they did for the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir, in the way they crushed the Chorraean from before them and inherited and dwelt in their place to this day.
brenton_translation: As they did to the children of Esau that dwell in Seir, even as they destroyed the Chorrhite from before them, and inherited their country, and dwelt therein instead of them until this day.

fresh_translation: And the Euaeans who dwelt in Aseroth as far as Gaza, and the Cappadocians who came out from Cappadocia crushed them and dwelt in their place.
brenton_translation: And the Evites who dwell in Asedoth to Gaza, and the Cappadocians who came out of Cappadocia, destroyed them, and dwelt in their room.

fresh_translation: Now then rise and set out and pass through the Ravine of Arnon. Behold, I have handed into your hands Sihon king of Heshbon the Amorite and his land. Begin to inherit; join battle with him.
brenton_translation: Now then arise and depart, and pass over the valley of Arnon: behold, I have delivered into thy hands Seon the king of Esebon the Amorite, and his land: begin to inherit it: engage in war with him this day.

fresh_translation: On this day begin to give your terror and your fear on the face of all the nations under heaven, who, hearing your name, shall be troubled and shall have birth-pains from before your face.
brenton_translation: Begin to put thy terror and thy fear on the face of all the nations under heaven, who shall be troubled when they have heard thy name, and shall be in anguish before thee.

fresh_translation: And I sent envoys from the wilderness of Kedamoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
brenton_translation: And I sent ambassadors from the wilderness of Kedamoth to Seon king of Esebon with peaceable words, saying,

fresh_translation: I shall pass through your land. By the road I shall pass. I shall not turn aside right or left.
brenton_translation: I will pass through thy land: I will go by the road, I will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

fresh_translation: Food for silver you shall give me and I shall eat, and water for silver you shall give me and I shall drink, except that I shall pass through on foot,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt give me food for money, and I will eat; and thou shalt give me water for money, and I will drink; I will only go through on my feet:

fresh_translation: just as the sons of Esau dwelling in Seir did for me, and the Moabites dwelling in Aroer, until I pass through the Jordan into the land that the Lord our God gives us.
brenton_translation: as the sons of Esau did to me, who dwelt in Seir, and the Moabites who dwelt in Aroer, until I shall have passed Jordan into the land which the Lord our God gives us.

fresh_translation: And Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing to let us pass through him, because the Lord our God hardened his spirit and strengthened his heart, so that he might be handed into your hands, as at this day.
brenton_translation: And Seon king of Esebon would not that we should pass by him, because the Lord our God hardened his spirit, and made his heart stubborn, that he might be delivered into thy hands, as on this day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Behold, I have begun to hand over before your face Sihon king of Heshbon the Amorite and his land. Begin to inherit his land.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Behold, I have begun to deliver before thee Seon the king of Esebon the Amorite, and his land, and do thou begin to inherit his land.

fresh_translation: And Sihon king of Heshbon came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle at Jassa.
brenton_translation: And Seon the king of Esebon came forth to meet us, he and all his people to war at Jassa.

fresh_translation: And the Lord our God handed him over before our face, and we struck him and his sons and all his people.
brenton_translation: And the Lord our God delivered him before our face, and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

fresh_translation: And we seized all his cities at that time and utterly destroyed every city in succession, and their women and their children. We left no living captive.
brenton_translation: And we took possession of all his cities at that time, and we utterly destroyed every city in succession, and their wives, and their children; we left no living prey.

fresh_translation: Except the cattle we plundered and the spoils of the cities we took.
brenton_translation: Only we took the cattle captive, and took the spoil of the cities.

fresh_translation: From Aroer, which is by the lip of the torrent Arnon, and the city that is in the ravine, even to the mountain of Gilead, there was no city that escaped us. The Lord our God handed all of them into our hands.
brenton_translation: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the brook of Arnon, and the city which is in the valley, and as far as the mount of Galaad; there was not a city which escaped us: the Lord our God delivered all of them into our hands.

fresh_translation: Except to the land of the sons of Ammon we did not come near, all adjoining the torrent Jabbok, and the cities in the hill country, just as the Lord our God commanded us.
brenton_translation: Only we did not draw near to the children of Amman, even all the parts bordering on the brook Jaboc, and the cities in the mountain country, as the Lord our God charged us.

fresh_translation: And turning, we went up by the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle at Edrain.
brenton_translation: And we turned and went by the way leading to Basan; and Og the king of Basan came out to meet us, he and all his people, to battle at Edraim.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Do not fear him, because I have handed him over into your hands, and all his people and all his land, and you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites who dwelt in Heshbon.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Fear him not, for I have delivered him, and all his people, and all his land, into thy hands; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst to Seon king of the Amorites who dwelt in Esebon.

fresh_translation: And the Lord our God handed him into our hands, Og king of Bashan and all his people, and we struck him until no seed of his was left.
brenton_translation: And the Lord our God delivered him into our hands, even Og the king of Basan, and all his people; and we smote him until we left none of his seed.

fresh_translation: And we seized all his cities at that time. There was no city that we did not take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
brenton_translation: And we mastered all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we took not from them; sixty cities, all the country round about Argob, belonging to king Og in Basan:

fresh_translation: All the cities were fortified, with high walls, gates, and bars, besides the very many villages of the Pherezites.
brenton_translation: all strong cities, lofty walls, gates and bars; besides the very many cities of the Pherezites.

fresh_translation: We utterly destroyed them, just as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, and we utterly destroyed every city in succession, and the women and the children.
brenton_translation: We utterly destroyed them as we dealt with Seon the king of Esebon, so we utterly destroyed every city in order, and the women and the children,

fresh_translation: And all the cattle and the spoils of the cities we plundered for ourselves.
brenton_translation: and all the cattle; and we took for a prey to ourselves the spoil of the cities.

fresh_translation: And we took at that time the land from the hands of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the torrent Arnon as far as Aermon.
brenton_translation: And we took at that time the land out of the hands of the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond Jordan, extending from the brook of Arnon even unto Aermon.

fresh_translation: The Phoenicians call Aermon Sanior, and the Amorite named it Sanir.
brenton_translation: The Phœnicians call Aermon Sanior, but the Amorite has called it Sanir.

fresh_translation: All the cities of Misor and all Gilead and all Bashan as far as Selcha and Edrain, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
brenton_translation: All the cities of Misor, and all Galaad, and all Basan as far as Elcha and Edraim, cities of the kingdom of Og in Basan.

fresh_translation: For only Og king of Bashan was left from the Raphain. Behold, his bed was an iron bed. Behold, it is in Akra of the sons of Ammon, nine cubits its length and four cubits its width, by a man's cubit.
brenton_translation: For only Og the king of Basan was left of the Raphain: behold, his bed was a bed of iron; behold, it is in the chief city of the children of Ammon; the length of it is nine cubits, and the breadth of it four cubits, according to the cubit of a man.

fresh_translation: And this land we inherited at that time, from Aroer which is on the lip of the torrent Arnon, and half the mountain of Gilead and its cities I gave to Reuben and to Gad.
brenton_translation: And we inherited that land at that time from Aroer, which is by the border of the torrent Arnon, and half the mount of Galaad; and I gave his cities to Ruben and to Gad.

fresh_translation: And the rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh, and all the region of Argob, all that Bashan; that land shall be counted as land of Raphain.
brenton_translation: And the rest of Galaad, and all Basan the kingdom of Og I gave to the half-tribe of Manasse, and all the country round about Argob, all that Basan; it shall be accounted the land of Raphain.

fresh_translation: And Jair son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob up to the borders of the Gergesites and the Maakathites, and he named them after his own name, Bashan: Jair's Camps, to this day.
brenton_translation: And Jair the son of Manasse took all the country round about Argob as far as the borders of Gargasi and Machathi: he called them by his name Basan Thavoth Jair until this day.

fresh_translation: And to Machir I gave Gilead.
brenton_translation: And to Machir I gave Galaad.

fresh_translation: And to Reuben and to Gad I gave from Gilead as far as the torrent Arnon, the middle of the torrent as a border, and as far as Jabbok, the torrent being the border of the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And to Ruben and to Gad I gave the land under Galaad as far as the brook of Arnon, the border between the brook and as far as Jaboc; the brook is the border to the children of Amman.

fresh_translation: And the Arabah and the Jordan as a border, from Machanaereth even to the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under Asedoth of Phasga eastward.
brenton_translation: And Araba and Jordan are the boundary of Machanareth, even to the sea of Araba, the salt sea under Asedoth Phasga eastward.

fresh_translation: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The Lord your God gave you this land as an inheritance. Armed, go before your brothers, the sons of Israel, every mighty man.
brenton_translation: And I charged you at that time, saying, The Lord your God has given you this land by lot; arm yourselves, every one that is powerful, and go before your brethren the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: Only your wives and your children and your cattle—I know that you have many cattle—shall dwell in your cities that I have given you.
brenton_translation: Only your wives and your children and your cattle (I know that ye have much cattle), let them dwell in your cities which I have given you;

fresh_translation: Until the Lord your God gives your brothers rest as also to you, and they too inherit the land that the Lord our God gives them beyond the Jordan. And you shall return, each to his inheritance that I gave you.
brenton_translation: until the Lord your God give your brethren rest, as also he has given to you, and they also shall inherit the land, which the Lord our God gives them on the other side of Jordan; then ye shall return, each one to his inheritance which I have given you.

fresh_translation: And to Joshua I commanded at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all that the Lord our God did to these two kings. So the Lord our God will do to all the kingdoms into which you are crossing there.
brenton_translation: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all things, which the Lord our God did to these two kings: so shall the Lord our God do to all the kingdoms against which thou crossest over thither.

fresh_translation: You shall not fear them, because the Lord our God himself will fight for you.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not be afraid of them, because the Lord our God himself shall fight for you.

fresh_translation: And I pleaded with the Lord at that time, saying,
brenton_translation: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying,

fresh_translation: Lord, Lord, you began to show your servant your strength and your power and your mighty hand and your high arm. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who will do as you did and according to your strength?
brenton_translation: Lord God, thou hast begun to shew to thy servant thy strength, and thy power, and thy mighty hand, and thy high arm: for what God is there in heaven or on the earth, who will do as thou hast done, and according to thy might?

fresh_translation: Crossing over then, I shall see this good land that is beyond the Jordan, this good mountain and Anti-Lebanon.
brenton_translation: I will therefore go over and see this good land that is beyond Jordan, this good mountain and Antilibanus.

fresh_translation: And the Lord overlooked me because of you and did not hear me, and the Lord said to me, Let it be enough for you; do not add to speak this word any more.
brenton_translation: And the Lord because of you did not regard me, and hearkened not to me; and the Lord said to me, Let it suffice thee, speak not of this matter to me any more.

fresh_translation: Go up onto the top of the Hewn Place, and looking up with your eyes toward the sea and north and south and east, see with your eyes, because you shall not cross this Jordan.
brenton_translation: Go up to the top of the quarried rock, and look with thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes, for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

fresh_translation: And command Joshua and strengthen him and encourage him, because he shall cross before this people and he shall allot to them the land that you saw.
brenton_translation: And charge Joshua, and strengthen him, and encourage him; for he shall go before the face of this people, and he shall give them the inheritance of all the land which thou hast seen.

fresh_translation: And we stayed in the valley near the house of Phogor.
brenton_translation: And we abode in the valley near the house of Phogor.

fresh_translation: And now, Israel, hear the ordinances and the judgments that I teach you today to do, so that you may live and multiply and, entering in, inherit the land that the Lord God of your fathers gives you.
brenton_translation: And now, Israel, hear the ordinances and judgments, all that I teach you this day to do: that ye may live, and be multiplied, and that ye may go in and inherit the land, which the Lord God of your fathers gives you.

fresh_translation: You shall not add to the word that I command you, and you shall not take away from it. Keep the commands of the Lord your God that I command you today.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not add to the word which I command you, and ye shall not take from it: keep the commandments of the Lord our God, all that I command you this day.

fresh_translation: Your eyes saw all that the Lord our God did at Baal-Peor, because every man who went after Baal-Peor, the Lord your God crushed him from among you.
brenton_translation: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord our God did in the case of Beel-phegor; for every man that went after Beel-phegor, the Lord your God has utterly destroyed him from among you.

fresh_translation: But you who cling to the Lord your God are all alive today.
brenton_translation: But ye that kept close to the Lord your God are all alive to-day.

fresh_translation: See, I have shown you ordinances and judgments just as the Lord commanded me, so that you may do thus in the land into which you are entering there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have shewn you ordinances and judgments as the Lord commanded me, that ye should do so in the land into which ye go to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep and do them, because this is your wisdom and your understanding before all the nations, whoever hears all these ordinances and says, Behold, this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep and do them: for this is your wisdom and understanding before all nations, as many as shall hear all these ordinances; and they shall say, Behold, this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

fresh_translation: For what great nation has a god drawing near to them as the Lord our God in all the things for which we call on him?
brenton_translation: For what manner of nation is so great, which has God so near to them as the Lord our God is in all things in whatsoever we may call upon him?

fresh_translation: And what great nation has righteous ordinances and judgments according to all this law that I set before you today?
brenton_translation: And what manner of nation is so great, which has righteous ordinances and judgments according to all this law, which I set before you this day?

fresh_translation: Take heed to yourself and guard your soul greatly, lest you forget all the words that your eyes saw and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life, and you shall teach them to your sons and to the sons of your sons:
brenton_translation: Take heed to thyself, and keep thy heart diligently: forget not any of the things, which thine eyes have seen, and let them not depart from thine heart all the days of thy life; and thou shalt teach thy sons and thy sons' sons,

fresh_translation: The day you stood before the Lord your God in Horeb, the day of the assembly, when the Lord said to me, Assemble the people to me, and let them hear my words so that they may learn to fear me all the days they live upon the land and teach their sons.
brenton_translation: even the things that happened in the day in which ye stood before the Lord our God in Choreb in the day of the assembly; for the Lord said to me, Gather the people to me, and let them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days which they live upon the earth, and they shall teach their sons.

fresh_translation: And you came near and stood under the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire up to heaven, darkness, gloom, storm, a great sound.
brenton_translation: And ye drew nigh and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire up to heaven: there was darkness, blackness, and tempest.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to you from the midst of the fire. You heard a voice of words, and you saw no form, only a voice.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to you out of the midst of the fire a voice of words, which ye heard: and ye saw no likeness, only ye heard a voice.

fresh_translation: And he declared to you his covenant that he commanded you to do, the ten words, and he wrote them on two stone tablets.
brenton_translation: And he announced to you his covenant, which he commanded you to keep, even the ten commandments; and he wrote them on two tables of stone.

fresh_translation: And to me the Lord commanded at that time to teach you ordinances and judgments, for you to do them in the land into which you are entering there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: And the Lord commanded me at that time, to teach you ordinances and judgments, that ye should do them on the land, into which ye go to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And guard your souls greatly, because you saw no form on the day the Lord spoke to you in Horeb in the mountain from the midst of the fire,
brenton_translation: And take good heed to your hearts, for ye saw no similitude in the day in which the Lord spoke to you in Choreb in the mountain out of the midst of the fire:

fresh_translation: lest you act lawlessly and make for yourselves a carved image, any likeness, likeness of male or female,
brenton_translation: lest ye transgress, and make to yourselves a carved image, any kind of figure, the likeness of male or female,

fresh_translation: likeness of any beast that is on the earth, likeness of any winged bird that flies under heaven,
brenton_translation: the likeness of any beast of those that are on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird which flies under heaven,

fresh_translation: likeness of any creeping thing that creeps on the earth, likeness of any fish that is in the waters below the earth.
brenton_translation: the likeness of any reptile which creeps on the earth, the likeness of any fish of those which are in the waters under the earth;

fresh_translation: And lest, looking up to heaven and seeing the sun and the moon and the stars and all the order of heaven, you be led astray and bow to them and serve them, things that the Lord your God assigned to all the nations under heaven.
brenton_translation: and lest having looked up to the sky, and having seen the sun and the moon and the stars, and all the heavenly bodies, thou shouldest go astray and worship them, and serve them, which the Lord thy God has distributed to all the nations under heaven.

fresh_translation: But God took you and brought you out from the iron furnace, from Egypt, to be for him an inherited people, as at this day.
brenton_translation: But God took you, and led you forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was angry with me over the things spoken by you and swore that I should not cross this Jordan and should not enter into the land that the Lord God gives you as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God was angry with me for the things said by you, and sware that I should not go over this Jordan, and that I should not enter into the land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: For I am dying in this land and not crossing this Jordan, but you are crossing and inheriting this good land.
brenton_translation: For I am to die in this land, and shall not pass over this Jordan; but ye are to pass over, and shall inherit this good land.

fresh_translation: Watch yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the Lord your God that he covenanted with you, and make for yourselves a carved likeness of anything that the Lord your God commanded you not to make.
brenton_translation: Take heed to yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the Lord our God, which he made with you, and ye transgress, and make to yourselves a graven image of any of the things concerning which the Lord thy God commanded thee.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
brenton_translation: For the Lord thy God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

fresh_translation: But if you beget sons and sons of sons and remain long in the land and act lawlessly and make a carved likeness of anything and do evil before the Lord your God to provoke him,
brenton_translation: And when thou shalt have begotten sons, and shalt have sons' sons, and ye shall have dwelt a long time on the land, and shall have transgressed, and made a graven image of any thing, and shall have done wickedly before the Lord your God to provoke him;

fresh_translation: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that with destruction you shall perish from the land into which you are crossing the Jordan there to inherit it. You shall not remain many days on it, but with crushing you shall be crushed.
brenton_translation: I call heaven and earth this day to witness against you, that ye shall surely perish from off the land, into which ye go across Jordan to inherit it there; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall be utterly cut off.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will scatter you among all the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the nations into which the Lord will bring you there.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall scatter you among all nations, and ye shall be left few in number among all the nations, among which the Lord shall bring you.

fresh_translation: And there you shall serve other gods, works of human hands, wood and stone, which shall not see and shall certainly not hear, neither shall they eat nor smell.
brenton_translation: And ye shall there serve other gods, the works of the hands of men, wood and stones, which cannot see, nor can they hear, nor eat, nor smell.

fresh_translation: And there you shall seek the Lord your God and find him when you seek him out from all your heart and from all your soul in your affliction.
brenton_translation: And there ye shall seek the Lord your God, and ye shall find him whenever ye shall seek him with all your heart, and with all your soul in your affliction.

fresh_translation: And all these words will find you at the last of the days, and you will turn to the Lord your God and listen to his voice.
brenton_translation: And all these things shall come upon thee in the last days, and thou shalt turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt hearken to his voice.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord your God is a compassionate God. He will not forsake you, nor will he surely crush you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers that he swore to them.
brenton_translation: Because the Lord thy God is a God of pity: he will not forsake thee, nor destroy thee; he will not forget the covenant of thy fathers, which the Lord sware to them.

fresh_translation: Ask the earlier days that came before you, from the day God created humankind on the earth, and from one end of heaven to the end of heaven, whether there has happened anything according to this great word or whether anything like it has been heard.
brenton_translation: Ask of the former days which were before thee, from the day when God created man upon the earth, and beginning at the one end of heaven to the other end of heaven, if there has happened any thing like to this great event, if such a thing has been heard:

fresh_translation: Has any nation heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire the way you heard and lived?
brenton_translation: if a nation have heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard and hast lived;

fresh_translation: Has God attempted, entering in, to take for himself a nation from the midst of a nation, by trial and by signs and by wonders and by war and by mighty hand and by high arm and by great sights, according to all that the Lord our God did in Egypt before you while you watched?
brenton_translation: if God has assayed to go and take to himself a nation out of the midst of another nation with trial, and with signs, and with wonders, and with war, and with a mighty hand, and with a high arm, and with great sights, according to all the things which the Lord our God did in Egypt in thy sight.

fresh_translation: So that you might know that the Lord your God, this one is God, and there is no other besides him.
brenton_translation: So that thou shouldest know that the Lord thy God he is God, and there is none beside him.

fresh_translation: From heaven his voice was made heard to discipline you, and on the earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from the midst of the fire.
brenton_translation: His voice was made audible from heaven to instruct thee, and he shewed thee upon the earth his great fire, and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

fresh_translation: Because he loved your fathers and chose their seed after them, you, and he brought you out himself by his great strength from Egypt,
brenton_translation: Because he loved thy fathers, he also chose you their seed after them, and he brought thee himself with his great strength out of Egypt,

fresh_translation: to destroy nations greater and stronger than you from before your face, to bring you in, to give you their land to inherit, as you have today.
brenton_translation: to destroy nations great and stronger than thou before thy face, to bring thee in, to give thee their land to inherit, as thou hast it this day.

fresh_translation: And you shall know today and turn it back to your mind that the Lord your God, this one is God in heaven above and on the earth below, and there is no other besides him.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt know this day, and shalt consider in thine heart, that the Lord thy God he is God in heaven above, and on the earth beneath, and there is none else but he.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep his ordinances and his commands that I command you today, so that it may be well with you and with your sons after you, so that you may be long-lived on the land that the Lord your God gives you all the days.
brenton_translation: And keep ye his commandments, and his ordinances, all that I command you this day; that it may be well with thee, and with thy sons after thee, that ye may be long-lived upon the earth, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for ever.

fresh_translation: Then Moses marked off three cities beyond the Jordan from the rising of the sun,
brenton_translation: Then Moses separated three cities beyond Jordan on the east,

fresh_translation: for the killer to flee there, whoever kills his neighbor not knowing, and this one not hating him before yesterday or the third day, and he shall flee into one of these cities and live:
brenton_translation: that the slayer might flee thither, who should have slain his neighbour unintentionally, and should not have hated him in times past, and he shall flee to one of these cities and live:

fresh_translation: Bosor in the wilderness in the level land for Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead for Gad, and Gaulon in Bashan for Manasseh.
brenton_translation: Bosor in the wilderness, in the plain country of Ruben, and Ramoth in Galaad belonging to Gad, and Gaulon in Basan belonging to Manasse.

fresh_translation: This is the law that Moses set before the sons of Israel,
brenton_translation: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: these are the testimonies and the ordinances and the judgments that Moses spoke to the sons of Israel in the wilderness when they came out from the land of Egypt,
brenton_translation: These are the testimonies, and the ordinances, and the judgments, which Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt:

fresh_translation: beyond the Jordan in the valley near the house of Phogor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites who dwelt in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel struck when they came out from the land of Egypt,
brenton_translation: on the other side of Jordan, in the valley near the house of Phogor, in the land of Seon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Esebon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel smote when they came out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: and they inherited his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
brenton_translation: And they inherited his land, and the land of Og king of Basan, two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond Jordan eastward.

fresh_translation: from Aroer which is on the lip of the torrent Arnon and up to the mountain of Sion, which is Aermon,
brenton_translation: From Aroer, which is on the border of the brook Arnon, even to the mount of Seon, which is Aermon.

fresh_translation: all the Arabah beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise under Asedoth the Hewn Place.
brenton_translation: All Araba beyond Jordan eastward under Asedoth hewn in the rock.

fresh_translation: And Moses called all Israel and said to them, Hear, Israel, the ordinances and the judgments that I speak in your ears today, and you shall learn them and keep to do them.
brenton_translation: And Moses called all Israel, and said to them, Hear, Israel, the ordinances and judgments, all that I speak in your ears this day, and ye shall learn them, and observe to do them.

fresh_translation: The Lord your God covenanted with you in Horeb.
brenton_translation: The Lord your God made a covenant with you in Choreb.

fresh_translation: Not with your fathers did the Lord covenant this covenant, but with you, you here, all alive today.
brenton_translation: The Lord did not make this covenant with your fathers, but with you: ye are all here alive this day.

fresh_translation: Face to face the Lord spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire.
brenton_translation: The Lord spoke to you face to face in the mountain out of the midst of the fire.

fresh_translation: And I was standing between the Lord and you at that time, to report to you the words of the Lord, because you feared before the fire and did not go up onto the mountain, saying:
brenton_translation: And I stood between the Lord and you at that time to report to you the words of the Lord, (because ye were afraid before the fire, and ye went not up to the mountain,) saying,

fresh_translation: I am the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
brenton_translation: I am the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

fresh_translation: There shall not be for you other gods before my face.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt have no other gods before my face.

fresh_translation: You shall not make for yourself an idol, nor any likeness of whatever is in the heaven above and whatever is on the earth below and whatever is in the waters below the earth.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not make to thyself an image, nor likeness of any thing, whatever things are in the heaven above, and whatever are in the earth beneath, and whatever are in the waters under the earth.
