fresh_translation: You shall not bow to them, nor shall you serve them, because I am the Lord your God, a jealous God, repaying fathers sins upon children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not bow down to them, nor shalt thou serve them; for I am the Lord thy God, a jealous God, visiting the sins of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generation to them that hate me,

fresh_translation: and showing mercy to thousands, to those who love me and keep my commands.
brenton_translation: and doing mercifully to thousands of them that love me, and that keep my commandments.

fresh_translation: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, because the Lord shall certainly not clear the one taking his name in vain.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain, for the Lord thy God will certainly not acquit him that takes his name in vain.

fresh_translation: Keep the day of the Sabbaths, to sanctify it, just as the Lord your God commanded you.
brenton_translation: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God commanded thee.

fresh_translation: Six days work, and you shall do all your works.
brenton_translation: Six days thou shalt work, and thou shalt do all thy works;

fresh_translation: But the seventh day is Sabbath to the Lord your God. You shall do no work on it, you and your sons and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, your ox and your beast of burden and every animal of yours, and the proselyte residing among you, so that your male servant and your female servant may rest as you do.
brenton_translation: but on the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: thou shalt do in it no work, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, thine ox, and thine ass, and all thy cattle, and the stranger that sojourns in the midst of thee; that thy man-servant may rest, and thy maid, and thine ox, as well as thou.

fresh_translation: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God brought you out from there with mighty hand and high arm. Therefore the Lord your God commanded you so as to keep the day of the Sabbaths and sanctify it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord thy God brought thee out thence with a mighty hand, and a high arm: therefore the Lord appointed thee to keep the sabbath day and to sanctify it.

fresh_translation: Honor your father and your mother, just as the Lord your God commanded you, so that it may be well with you and so that you may be long-lived on the land that the Lord your God gives you.
brenton_translation: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God commanded thee; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest live long upon the land, which the Lord thy God gives thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not commit adultery.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not commit murder.

fresh_translation: You shall not murder.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

fresh_translation: You shall not steal.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not steal.

fresh_translation: You shall not bear false testimony against your neighbor, a false witness.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

fresh_translation: You shall not desire your neighbor's wife. You shall not desire your neighbor's house, nor his field, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his beast of burden, nor any of his cattle, nor whatever belongs to your neighbor.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife; thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, nor his field, nor his man-servant, nor his maid, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any beast of his, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.

fresh_translation: These words the Lord spoke to all your congregation on the mountain from the midst of the fire, darkness, gloom, storm, a great voice, and he added no more. And he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.
brenton_translation: These words the Lord spoke to all the assembly of you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire—there was darkness, blackness, storm, a loud voice—and he added no more, and he wrote them on two tables of stone, and he gave them to me.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, when you heard the voice from the midst of the fire, and the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, all the leaders of your tribes and your elders,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the fire, for the mountain burned with fire, that ye came to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders:

fresh_translation: and you were saying, Behold, the Lord our God showed us his glory, and his voice we heard from the midst of the fire. On this day we saw that God will speak to a human and he shall live.
brenton_translation: and ye said, Behold, the Lord our God has shewn us his glory, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: this day we have seen that God shall speak to man, and he shall live.

fresh_translation: And now let us not die, because this great fire will consume us. If we add any more to hear the voice of the Lord our God, then we shall die.
brenton_translation: And now let us not die, for this great fire will consume us, if we shall hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, and we shall die.

fresh_translation: For what flesh is there that heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire as we did and shall live?
brenton_translation: For what flesh is there which has heard the voice of the living God, speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have heard, and shall live?

fresh_translation: Come near, you, and hear whatever the Lord our God may say, and you will speak to us all that the Lord our God speaks to you, and we shall hear and do.
brenton_translation: Do thou draw near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say, and thou shalt speak to us all things whatsoever the Lord our God shall speak to thee, and we will hear, and do.

fresh_translation: And the Lord heard the voice of your words while you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me, I heard the voice of the words of this people, whatever they spoke to you. They spoke rightly all that they spoke.
brenton_translation: And the Lord heard the voice of your words as ye spoke to me; and the Lord said to me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, even all things that they have said to thee. They have well said all that they have spoken.

fresh_translation: Who will give that their heart should be thus in them, so as to fear me and keep all my commands all the days, so that it may be well with them and with their sons forever?
brenton_translation: O that there were such a heart in them, that they should fear me and keep my commands always, that it might be well with them and with their sons for ever.

fresh_translation: Go, say to them, Turn back, you, into your houses.
brenton_translation: Go, say to them, Return ye to your houses;

fresh_translation: But you stand here with me, and I will speak to you the commands and the ordinances and the judgments that you shall teach them, and let them do them in the land that I give them as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: but stand thou here with me, and I will tell thee all the commands, and the ordinances, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, and let them do so in the land which I give them for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep to do as the Lord your God commanded you. You shall not turn aside to the right nor to the left.
brenton_translation: And ye shall take heed to do as the Lord thy God commanded thee; ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left,

fresh_translation: In all the road that the Lord your God commanded you to go in it, so that he may give you rest and it may be well with you and you may be long-lived on the land that you shall inherit.
brenton_translation: according to all the way which the Lord thy God commanded thee to walk in it, that he may give thee rest; and that it may be well with thee, and ye may prolong your days on the land which ye shall inherit.

fresh_translation: And these are the commands and the ordinances and the judgments that the Lord our God commanded to teach you, for you to do them in the land into which you are entering there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: And these are the commands, and the ordinances, and the judgments, as many as the Lord our God gave commandment to teach you to do so in the land on which ye enter to inherit it.

fresh_translation: so that you may fear the Lord your God, keeping all his ordinances and his commands that I command you today, you and your sons and the sons of your sons, all the days of your life, so that you may be long-lived.
brenton_translation: That ye may fear the Lord your God, keep ye all his ordinances, and his commandments, which I command thee to-day, thou, and thy sons, and thy sons' sons, all the days of thy life, that ye may live many days.

fresh_translation: And hear, Israel, and keep to do, so that it may be well with you and that you may multiply greatly, just as the Lord, the God of your fathers, spoke, to give you a land flowing with milk and honey.
brenton_translation: Hear, therefore, O Israel, and observe to do them, that it may be well with thee, and that ye may be greatly multiplied, as the Lord God of thy fathers said that he would give thee a land flowing with milk and honey: and these are the ordinances, and the judgments, which the Lord commanded the children of Israel in the wilderness, when they had gone forth from the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And these are the ordinances and the judgments that the Lord commanded the sons of Israel in the wilderness, when they came out from the land of Egypt: Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
brenton_translation: Hear, O Israel, The Lord our God is one Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall love the Lord your God from your whole heart and from your whole soul and from your whole strength.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy mind, and with all thy soul, and all thy strength.

fresh_translation: And these words that I command you today shall be in your heart and in your soul.
brenton_translation: And these words, all that I command thee this day, shall be in thy heart and in thy soul.

fresh_translation: And you shall pass them on to your sons, and you shall speak of them while sitting in the house and while walking on the road and while lying down and while rising up.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt teach them to thy children, and thou shalt speak of them sitting in the house, and walking by the way, and lying down, and rising up.

fresh_translation: And you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and it shall be fixed before your eyes.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt fasten them for a sign upon thy hand, and it shall be immoveable before thine eyes.

fresh_translation: And you shall write them on the doorposts of your houses and your gates.
brenton_translation: And ye shall write them on the lintels of your houses and of your gates.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when the Lord your God brings you into the land that he swore to your fathers, to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, to give you, cities great and good that you did not build,
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware to thy fathers, to Abraam, and to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and beautiful cities which thou didst not build,

fresh_translation: houses full of every good thing that you did not fill, cisterns cut out that you did not cut out, vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant, and when you eat and are filled,
brenton_translation: houses full of all good things which thou didst not fill, wells dug in the rock which thou didst not dig, vineyards and oliveyards which thou didst not plant, then having eaten and been filled,

fresh_translation: watch yourself lest you forget the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
brenton_translation: beware lest thou forget the Lord thy God that brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

fresh_translation: You shall fear the Lord your God, and you shall serve him and cling to him and swear by his name.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve; and thou shalt cleave to him, and by his name thou shalt swear.

fresh_translation: You shall not go after other gods from the gods of the nations around you,
brenton_translation: Go ye not after other gods of the gods of the nations round about you;

fresh_translation: because the Lord your God in your midst is a jealous God, lest the Lord your God in your midst, having become angry in wrath, destroy you from the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: for the Lord thy God in the midst of thee is a jealous God, lest the Lord thy God be very angry with thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: You shall not test the Lord your God in the way you tested him in the Testing.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God, as ye tempted him in the temptation.

fresh_translation: Keeping, you shall keep the commands of the Lord your God, the testimonies and the ordinances that he commanded you.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt by all means keep the commands of the Lord thy God, the testimonies, and the ordinances, which he commanded thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall do what is pleasing and good before the Lord your God, so that it may be well with you and you may enter and inherit the good land that the Lord swore to your fathers,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt do that which is pleasing and good before the Lord thy God, that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and inherit the good land, which the Lord sware to your fathers,

fresh_translation: to drive out all your enemies from before your face, just as he spoke.
brenton_translation: to chase all thine enemies from before thy face, as the Lord said.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when your son asks you tomorrow, saying, What are the testimonies and the ordinances and the judgments that the Lord our God commanded you?
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when thy son shall ask thee at a future time, saying, What are the testimonies, and the ordinances, and the judgments, which the Lord our God has commanded us?

fresh_translation: then you shall say to your son, We were household servants to Pharaoh in the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought us out from there with mighty hand and high arm.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou say to thy son, We were slaves to Pharao in the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought us forth thence with a mighty hand, and with a high arm.

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave signs and wonders, great and grievous, in Egypt, against Pharaoh and against his house, before us.
brenton_translation: And the Lord wrought signs and great and grievous wonders in Egypt, on Pharao and on his house before us.

fresh_translation: And he brought us out from there so that he might bring us in, to give us this land that he swore to give to our fathers.
brenton_translation: And he brought us out thence to give us this land, which he sware to give to our fathers.

fresh_translation: And the Lord commanded us to do all these ordinances, to fear the Lord our God, so that it may be well with us all the days, so that we may live, as also today.
brenton_translation: And the Lord charged us to observe all these ordinances; to fear the Lord our God, that it may be well with us for ever, that we may live, as even to-day.

fresh_translation: And it will be righteousness for us if we keep to do all these commands before the Lord our God, just as the Lord commanded us.
brenton_translation: And there shall be mercy to us, if we take heed to keep all these commands before the Lord our God, as he has commanded us.

fresh_translation: And if the Lord your God brings you into the land into which you are entering there to inherit it, and he removes great nations from before your face, the Hittite and Gergesite and Amorite and Canaanite and Pherezite and Hivite and Jebusite, seven nations many and stronger than you,
brenton_translation: And when the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land, into which thou goest to possess it, and shall remove great nations from before thee, the Chettite, and Gergesite, and Amorite, and Chananite, and Pherezite, and Evite, and Jebusite, seven nations more numerous and stronger than you,

fresh_translation: and the Lord your God gives them into your hands, then you shall strike them. With utter destruction you shall utterly destroy them. You shall not covenant a covenant with them, nor indeed show them mercy.
brenton_translation: and the Lord thy God shall deliver them into thy hands, then thou shalt smite them: thou shalt utterly destroy them: thou shalt not make a covenant with them, neither shall ye pity them:

fresh_translation: And you shall certainly not intermarry with them. Your daughter you shall not give to his son, and his daughter you shall not take for your son,
brenton_translation: neither shall ye contract marriages with them: thou shalt not give thy daughter to his son, and thou shalt not take his daughter to thy son.

fresh_translation: for he will turn your son away from me, and he will serve other gods, and the Lord will be angered in wrath against you and destroy you quickly.
brenton_translation: For he will draw away thy son from me, and he will serve other gods; and the Lord will be very angry with you, and will soon utterly destroy thee.

fresh_translation: But thus you shall do to them: their altars you shall pull down, and their pillars you shall shatter, and their sacred groves you shall cut down, and the carved images of their gods you shall burn with fire.
brenton_translation: But thus shall ye do to them; ye shall destroy their altars, and shall break down their pillars, and shall cut down their groves, and shall burn with fire the graven images of their gods.

fresh_translation: Because you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord your God chose you to be for him a people of special possession beyond all the nations that are on the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: For thou art a holy people to the Lord thy God; and the Lord thy God chose thee to be to him a peculiar people beyond all nations that are upon the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: Not because you are more numerous than all the nations did the Lord choose you and select you, for you are fewer than all the nations,
brenton_translation: It was not because ye are more numerous than all other nations that the Lord preferred you, and the Lord made choice of you: for ye are fewer in number than all other nations.

fresh_translation: but because the Lord loves you and keeps the oath that he swore to your fathers, the Lord brought you out with mighty hand and high arm, and he redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
brenton_translation: But because the Lord loved you, and as keeping the oath which he sware to your fathers, the Lord brought you out with a strong hand, and the Lord redeemed thee from the house of bondage, out of the hand of Pharao king of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And you shall know that the Lord your God, this one is God, faithful God, keeping covenant and mercy with those who love him and with those who keep his commands, to a thousand generations,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt know therefore, that the Lord thy God, he is God, a faithful God, who keeps covenant and mercy for them that love him, and for those that keep his commandments to a thousand generations,

fresh_translation: and repaying those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not delay with those who hate him; he will repay them to their face.
brenton_translation: and who recompenses them that hate him to their face, to destroy them utterly; and will not be slack with them that hate him: he will recompense them to their face.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep these commands and ordinances and judgments that I command you today, to do them.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt keep therefore the commands, and the ordinances, and these judgments, which I command thee this day to do.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when you hear all these ordinances and keep and do them, then the Lord your God will keep for you the covenant and the mercy that he swore to your fathers.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when ye shall have heard these ordinances, and shall have kept and done them, that the Lord thy God shall keep for thee the covenant and the mercy, which he sware to your fathers.

fresh_translation: And he will love you and bless you and multiply you, and he will bless the offspring of your womb and the fruit of your land, your grain and your wine and your oil, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep, on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give you.
brenton_translation: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee; and he will bless the offspring of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep, on the land which the Lord sware to thy fathers to give to thee.

fresh_translation: You shall be blessed beyond all the nations. There shall not be among you one without offspring or barren, nor among your cattle.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt be blessed beyond all nations; there shall not be among you an impotent or barren one, or among thy cattle.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will remove from you every sickness, and all the evil diseases of Egypt that you have seen and all that you have known he will not put on you, but he will put them on all who hate you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall remove from thee all sickness; and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou hast seen, and all that thou hast known, will he lay upon thee; but he will lay them upon all that hate thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall consume all the spoils of the nations that the Lord your God gives you. Your eye shall not spare them, and you shall not serve their gods, because this is a stumbling block to you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt eat all the spoils of the nations which the Lord thy God gives thee; thine eye shall not spare them, and thou shalt not serve their gods; for this is an offence to thee.

fresh_translation: And if you say in your mind, This nation is more numerous than I. How shall I be able to utterly destroy them?
brenton_translation: But if thou shouldest say in thine heart, This nation is greater than I, how shall I be able to destroy them utterly?

fresh_translation: you shall not fear them. In remembrance you shall remember what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all the Egyptians,
brenton_translation: thou shalt not fear them; thou shalt surely remember all that the Lord thy God did to Pharao and to all the Egyptians:

fresh_translation: the great trials that your eyes saw, those signs and great wonders, the mighty hand and the high arm by which the Lord your God brought you out. Thus the Lord our God will do to all the nations whose face you fear.
brenton_translation: the great temptations which thine eyes have seen, those signs and great wonders, the strong hand, and the high arm; how the Lord thy God brought thee forth: so the Lord your God will do to all the nations, whom thou fearest in their presence.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will send the hornets against them until the remnant and those hidden from you are ground away.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall send against them the hornets, until they that are left and they that are hidden from thee be utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: You shall not be broken before their face, because the Lord your God in your midst is a great and mighty God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not be wounded before them, because the Lord thy God in the midst of thee is a great and powerful God.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will consume these nations from before your face little by little. You will not be able to consume them quickly, lest the land become desolate and the wild beasts multiply against you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall consume these nations before thee by little and little: thou shalt not be able to consume them speedily, lest the land become desert, and the wild beasts of the field be multiplied against thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will give them into your hands and destroy them with a great destruction until he utterly destroys them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall deliver them into thy hands, and thou shalt destroy them with a great destruction, until ye shall have utterly destroyed them.

fresh_translation: And he will give their kings into your hands, and their name will perish from that place. No one shall stand against your face until you utterly destroy them.
brenton_translation: And he shall deliver their kings into your hands, and ye shall destroy their name from that place; none shall stand up in opposition before thee, until thou shalt have utterly destroyed them.

fresh_translation: The carved images of their gods you shall burn with fire. You shall not desire the silver or gold from them, nor take it for yourself, lest you stumble because of it, because it is an abomination to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Ye shall burn with fire the graven images of their gods: thou shalt not covet their silver, neither shalt thou take to thyself gold from them, lest thou shouldest offend thereby, because it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And you shall not bring an abomination into your house, and you shall be devoted to destruction like it. With abhorrence you shall abhor it, and with loathing you shall loathe it, because it is devoted to destruction.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not bring an abomination into thine house, so shouldest thou be an accursed thing like it; thou shalt utterly hate it, and altogether abominate it, because it is an accursed thing.

fresh_translation: All the commands that I command you today you shall keep to do, so that you may live and be multiplied and enter and inherit the land that the Lord your God swore to your fathers.
brenton_translation: Ye shall observe to do all the commands which I charge you to-day, that ye may live and be multiplied, and enter in and inherit the land, which the Lord your God sware to give to your fathers.

fresh_translation: And you shall remember all the road that the Lord your God led you in the wilderness, so that he might afflict you and test you, and so that the things in your heart might be known, whether you would keep his commands or not.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee in the wilderness, that he might afflict thee, and try thee, and that the things in thine heart might be made manifest, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments or no.

fresh_translation: And he afflicted you and made you hunger, and he fed you with the manna that your fathers did not know, so that he might tell you that not on bread alone shall a human live, but on every word going out through the mouth of God shall a human live.
brenton_translation: And he afflicted thee and straitened thee with hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thy fathers knew not; that he might teach thee that man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God shall man live.

fresh_translation: Your clothes did not wear out from upon you, and your feet did not become calloused, behold, these forty years.
brenton_translation: Thy garments grew not old from off thee, thy shoes were not worn from off thee, thy feet were not painfully hardened, lo! these forty years.

fresh_translation: And you shall know in your heart that as someone might discipline his son, so the Lord your God will discipline you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt know in thine heart, that as if any man should chasten his son, so the Lord thy God will chasten thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep the commands of the Lord your God, to walk in his ways and fear him.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt keep the commands of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

fresh_translation: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good and rich land, a land of watercourses and springs and depths coming out through plains and through mountains,
brenton_translation: For the Lord thy God will bring thee into a good and extensive land, where there are torrents of waters, and fountains of deep places issuing through the plains and through the mountains:

fresh_translation: a land of wheat and barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey,
brenton_translation: a land of wheat and barley, wherein are vines, figs, pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;

fresh_translation: a land on which you will not eat your bread with poverty, and you shall lack nothing on it, a land whose stones are iron and from whose mountains you shall mine copper.
brenton_translation: a land on which thou shalt not eat thy bread with poverty, and thou shalt not want any thing upon it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of its mountains thou shalt dig brass.

fresh_translation: And you shall eat and be filled and bless the Lord your God for the good land that he gave you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt eat and be filled, and shalt bless the Lord thy God on the good land, which he has given thee.

fresh_translation: Watch yourself lest you forget the Lord your God by not keeping his commands and judgments and ordinances that I command you today,
brenton_translation: Take heed to thyself that thou forget not the Lord thy God, so as not to keep his commands, and his judgments, and ordinances, which I command thee this day:

fresh_translation: lest, having eaten and been filled and built good houses and lived in them,
brenton_translation: lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt in them;

fresh_translation: and your cattle and your sheep have been multiplied to you, and silver and gold have been multiplied to you, and all that belongs to you has been multiplied to you,
brenton_translation: and thy oxen and thy sheep are multiplied to thee, and thy silver and thy gold are multiplied to thee, and all thy possessions are multiplied to thee,

fresh_translation: your heart be lifted up and you forget the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery,
brenton_translation: thou shouldest be exalted in heart, and forget the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage:

fresh_translation: who led you through that great and fearful wilderness where the biting serpent and scorpion were, and thirst where there was no water, who brought out for you a spring of water from sheer rock,
brenton_translation: who brought thee through that great and terrible wilderness, where is the biting serpent, and scorpion, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee a fountain of water out of the flinty rock:

fresh_translation: who fed you with manna in the wilderness that your fathers did not know, so that he might afflict you and test you and do good for you at the end of your days.
brenton_translation: who fed thee with manna in the wilderness, which thou knewest not, and thy fathers knew not; that he might afflict thee, and thoroughly try thee, and do thee good in thy latter days.

fresh_translation: Do not say in your heart, My strength and the power of my hand made for me this great power.
brenton_translation: Lest thou shouldest say in thine heart, My strength, and the power of mine hand have wrought for me this great wealth.

fresh_translation: And you shall remember the Lord your God, because he gives you strength to make power, and so that he may establish his covenant that the Lord swore to your fathers, as today.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, that he gives thee strength to get wealth; even that he may establish his covenant, which the Lord sware to thy fathers, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, if in forgetfulness you forget the Lord your God and go after other gods and serve them and bow to them, I testify to you today, both heaven and earth, that with destruction you shall perish.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and shouldest go after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall surely perish.

fresh_translation: Just as the other nations that the Lord destroys from before your face, so you shall perish, because you did not hear the voice of the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: As also the other nations which the Lord God destroys before your face, so shall ye perish, because ye hearkened not to the voice of the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: Hear, Israel: you are crossing the Jordan today to enter and inherit nations greater and stronger than you, cities great and walled up to heaven,
brenton_translation: Hear, O Israel: Thou goest this day across Jordan to inherit nations greater and stronger than yourselves, cities great and walled up to heaven;

fresh_translation: a people great and many and tall, sons of Anak, whom you know and of whom you heard, Who shall stand against the face of the sons of Anak?
brenton_translation: a people great and many and tall, the sons of Enac, whom thou knowest, and concerning whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Enac?

fresh_translation: And you shall know today that the Lord your God, this one goes before your face. He is a consuming fire. He will utterly destroy them, and he will turn them back from before your face, and you shall destroy them, just as the Lord said to you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt know to-day, that the Lord thy God he shall go before thy face: he is a consuming fire; he shall destroy them, and he shall turn them back before thee, and shall destroy them quickly, as the Lord said to thee.

fresh_translation: Do not say in your heart, when the Lord your God consumes these nations from before your face, saying, Because of my righteousness the Lord brought me in to inherit this good land. Rather, because of the ungodliness of these nations the Lord will utterly destroy them from before your face.
brenton_translation: Speak not in thine heart, when the Lord thy God has destroyed these nations before thy face, saying, For my righteousness the Lord brought me in to inherit this good land.

fresh_translation: Not because of your righteousness or because of the holiness of your heart are you entering to inherit their land, but because of the ungodliness of these nations the Lord will utterly destroy them from before your face, and so that he may establish his covenant that he swore to your fathers, to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob.
brenton_translation: Not for thy righteousness, nor for the holiness of thy heart, dost thou go in to inherit their land, but because of the wickedness of these nations the Lord will destroy them from before thee, and that he may establish the covenant, which the Lord sware to our fathers, to Abraam, and to Isaac, and to Jacob.

fresh_translation: And you shall know today that not because of your righteousness does the Lord your God give you this good land to inherit, because you are a stiff-necked people.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt know to-day, that it is not for thy righteousnesses the Lord thy God gives thee this good land to inherit, for thou art a stiff-necked people.

fresh_translation: Remember, do not forget how much you provoked the Lord your God in the wilderness. From the day you came out from Egypt until you came to this place, you kept being disobedient in the things toward the Lord.
brenton_translation: Remember, forget not, how much thou provokedst the Lord thy God in the wilderness: from the day that ye came forth out of Egypt, even till ye came into this place, ye continued to be disobedient toward the Lord.

fresh_translation: And in Horeb you provoked the Lord, and the Lord became angry with you, to utterly destroy you.
brenton_translation: Also in Choreb ye provoked the Lord, and the Lord was angry with you to destroy you;

fresh_translation: When I went up onto the mountain to take the stone tablets, tablets of the covenant that the Lord covenanted with you, I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights. Bread I did not eat, and water I did not drink.
brenton_translation: when I went up into the mountain to receive the tables of stone, the tables of the covenant, which the Lord made with you, and I was in the mountain forty days and forty nights, I ate no bread and drank no water.

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave me the two stone tablets written by the finger of God, and on them had been written all the words that the Lord spoke to you on the mountain in the day of assembly.
brenton_translation: And the Lord gave me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God, and on them there had been written all the words which the Lord spoke to you in the mountain in the day of the assembly.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, after forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, tablets of the covenant.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two tables of stone, the tables of the covenant.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Rise, go down quickly from here, because your people whom you brought out from the land of Egypt have acted lawlessly. They turned quickly out of the way that I commanded them. They made a molten image for themselves.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Arise, go down quickly from hence, for thy people whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt have transgressed; they have gone aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them, and have made themselves a molten image.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, I have spoken to you once and twice, saying, I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to me, saying, I have spoken to thee once and again, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiff-necked people.

fresh_translation: Let me alone, and I will utterly destroy them and wipe out their name from under heaven, and I will make you into a nation great and strong and much more than this.
brenton_translation: And now suffer me utterly to destroy them, and I will blot out their name from under heaven, and will make of thee a nation great and strong, and more numerous than this.

fresh_translation: And turning, I came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire, and the two tablets were on my two hands.
brenton_translation: And I turned and went down from the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire to heaven; and the two tables of the testimonies were in my two hands.

fresh_translation: And I saw that you had sinned before the Lord your God and made for yourselves a molten image, and you had turned from the way that the Lord commanded you.
brenton_translation: And when I saw that ye had sinned against the Lord your God, and had made to yourselves a molten image, and had gone astray out of the way, which the Lord commanded you to keep;

fresh_translation: And seizing the two tablets, I threw them from my two hands and shattered them before you.
brenton_translation: then I took hold of the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and broke them before you.

fresh_translation: And I pleaded before the Lord the second time, as also the first, forty days and forty nights. Bread I did not eat, and water I did not drink, on account of all your sins that you sinned, doing evil before the Lord your God to provoke him.
brenton_translation: And I made my petition before the Lord as also at the first forty days and forty nights: I ate no bread and drank no water, on account of all your sins which ye sinned in doing evil before the Lord God to provoke him.

fresh_translation: And I was terrified because of the anger and the wrath, because the Lord had been provoked against you, to utterly destroy you. And the Lord heard me at that time also.
brenton_translation: And I was greatly terrified because of the wrath and anger, because the Lord was provoked with you utterly to destroy you; yet the Lord hearkened to me at this time also.

fresh_translation: And against Aaron the Lord was very angry, to utterly destroy him, and I prayed also concerning Aaron at that time.
brenton_translation: And he was angry with Aaron to destroy him utterly, and I prayed for Aaron also at that time.

fresh_translation: And your sin that you made, the calf, I took it and burned it in fire and crushed it, grinding it down thoroughly until it became fine and became like dust, and I threw the dust into the torrent that came down from the mountain.
brenton_translation: And your sin which ye had made, even the calf, I took, and burnt it with fire, and pounded it and ground it down till it became fine; and it became like dust, and I cast the dust into the brook that descended from the mountain.

fresh_translation: And at the Burning and at the Testing and at the Graves of Desire you were provoking the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Also in the burning, and in the temptation, and at the graves of lust, ye provoked the Lord.

fresh_translation: And when the Lord sent you out from Kadesh-Barnea, saying, Go up and inherit the land that I give you, then you disobeyed the word of the Lord your God and did not believe him and did not listen to his voice.
brenton_translation: And when the Lord sent you forth from Cades Barne, saying, Go up and inherit the land which I give to you, then ye disobeyed the word of the Lord your God, and believed him not, and hearkened not to his voice.

fresh_translation: You kept being disobedient in the things toward the Lord from the day he became known to you.
brenton_translation: Ye were disobedient in the things relating to the Lord from the day in which he became known to you.

fresh_translation: And I pleaded before the Lord forty days and forty nights, as many as I pleaded, for the Lord said he would utterly destroy you.
brenton_translation: And I prayed before the Lord forty days and forty nights, the number that I prayed before, for the Lord said that he would utterly destroy you.

fresh_translation: And I prayed to God and said, Lord, Lord, King of the gods, do not utterly destroy your people and your portion, whom you redeemed in your great strength, whom you brought out from the land of Egypt in your great strength and with your mighty hand and high arm.
brenton_translation: And I prayed to God, and said, O Lord, King of gods, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, whom thou didst redeem, whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt with thy great power, and with thy strong hand, and with thy high arm.

fresh_translation: Remember Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, your servants, to whom you swore by yourself. Do not look upon the hardness of this people and their ungodly deeds and their sins,
brenton_translation: Remember Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thyself: look not upon the hardness of heart of this people, and their impieties, and their sins.

fresh_translation: lest those dwelling in the land from which you brought us out there say, Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land that he said to them, and because he hated them, he brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: Lest the inhabitants of the land whence thou broughtest us out speak, saying, Because the Lord could not bring them into the land of which he spoke to them, and because he hated them, has he brought them forth to slay them in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: But they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out from the land of Egypt in your great strength and with your high arm.
brenton_translation: And these are thy people and thy portion, whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt with thy great strength, and with thy mighty hand, and with thy high arm.

fresh_translation: At that time the Lord said to me, Carve for yourself two stone tablets like the first ones, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make for yourself a wooden ark.
brenton_translation: At that time the Lord said to me, Hew for thyself two stone tables as the first, and come up to me into the mountain, and thou shalt make for thyself an ark of wood.

fresh_translation: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets that you shattered, and you shall put them into the ark.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt write upon the tables the words which were on the first tables which thou didst break, and thou shalt put them into the ark.

fresh_translation: And I made an ark from incorruptible woods, and I carved the two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up onto the mountain, and the two tablets were on my hands.
brenton_translation: So I made an ark of boards of incorruptible wood, and I hewed tables of stone like the first, and I went up to the mountain, and the two tables were in my hand.

fresh_translation: And he wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten words that the Lord spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire, and the Lord gave them to me.
brenton_translation: And he wrote upon the tables according to the first writing the ten commandments, which the Lord spoke to you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire, and the Lord gave them to me.

fresh_translation: And turning, I came down from the mountain and put the tablets into the ark that I had made, and they were there, just as the Lord commanded me.
brenton_translation: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and I put the tables into the ark which I had made; and there they were, as the Lord commanded me.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel set out from Beeroth of the sons of Jaakim to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried there, and Eleazar his son served as priest in place of him.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel departed from Beeroth of the sons of Jakim to Misadai: there Aaron died, and there he was buried, and Eleazar his son was priest in his stead.

fresh_translation: From there they set out to Gadgad, and from Gadgad to Etebatha, a land of watercourses.
brenton_translation: Thence they departed to Gadgad; and from Gadgad to Etebatha, a land wherein are torrents of water.

fresh_translation: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord, to minister, and to bless in his name, until this day.
brenton_translation: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand near before the Lord, to minister and bless in his name to this day.

fresh_translation: Because of this the Levites have no portion or inheritance among their brothers; the Lord himself is his inheritance, just as he said to him.
brenton_translation: Therefore the Levites have no part nor inheritance among their brethren; the Lord himself is their inheritance, as he said to them.

fresh_translation: And I stood on the mountain forty days and forty nights, and the Lord heard me at that time also, and the Lord was not willing to utterly destroy you.
brenton_translation: And I remained in the mount forty days and forty nights: and the Lord heard me at that time also, and the Lord would not destroy you.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Go, set out before this people, and let them enter and inherit the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Go, set out before this people, and let them go in and inherit the land, which I sware to their fathers to give to them.

fresh_translation: And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God ask from you except to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways and to love him and to serve the Lord your God from your whole heart and from your whole soul,
brenton_translation: And now, Israel, what does the Lord thy God require of thee, but to fear the Lord thy God, and to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul;

fresh_translation: to keep the commands of the Lord your God and his ordinances that I command you today, so that it may be well with you?
brenton_translation: to keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, and his ordinances, all that I charge thee to-day, that it may be well with thee?

fresh_translation: Behold, to the Lord your God belong the heaven and the heaven of heaven, the earth and all that is in it.
brenton_translation: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens belong to the Lord thy God, the earth and all things that are in it.

fresh_translation: Only your fathers did the Lord choose, to love them, and he chose their seed after them, you, above all the nations, as on this day.
brenton_translation: Only the Lord chose your fathers to love them, and he chose out their seed after them, even you, beyond all nations, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And circumcise your hard-heartedness, and do not harden your neck any longer.
brenton_translation: Therefore ye shall circumcise the hardness of your heart, and ye shall not harden your neck.

fresh_translation: For the Lord your God, this one is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great and mighty and fearful God, who does not show partiality and certainly does not take a gift,
brenton_translation: For the Lord your God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great, and strong, and terrible God, who does not accept persons, nor will he by any means accept a bribe:

fresh_translation: doing justice for the proselyte and the orphan and the widow, and loving the proselyte, to give him bread and clothing.
brenton_translation: executing judgment for the stranger and orphan and widow, and he loves the stranger to give him food and raiment.

fresh_translation: And you shall love the proselyte, because you were proselytes in the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And ye shall love the stranger; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: You shall fear the Lord your God, and you shall serve him and cling to him and swear by his name.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt cleave to him, and shalt swear by his name.

fresh_translation: He is your boast, and he is your God, who did among you these great and glorious things that your eyes saw.
brenton_translation: He is thy boast, and he is thy God, who has wrought in the midst of thee these great and glorious things, which thine eyes have seen.

fresh_translation: With seventy souls your fathers went down into Egypt, but now the Lord your God made you like the stars of heaven in multitude.
brenton_translation: With seventy souls your fathers went down into Egypt; but the Lord thy God has made thee as the stars of heaven in multitude.

fresh_translation: And you shall love the Lord your God and keep his charges and his ordinances and his judgments all the days.
brenton_translation: Therefore thou shalt love the Lord thy God, and shalt observe his appointments, and his ordinances, and his commandments, and his judgments, always.

fresh_translation: And know today that it was not your children who did not know and did not see the discipline of the Lord your God, his greatness and his mighty hand and his high arm,
brenton_translation: And ye shall know this day; for I speak not to your children, who know not and have not seen the discipline of the Lord thy God, and his wonderful works, and his strong hand, and his high arm,

fresh_translation: and his signs and his wonders that he did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to all his land,
brenton_translation: and his miracles, and his wonders, which he wrought in the midst of Egypt on Pharao king of Egypt, and all his land;

fresh_translation: and what he did to the power of the Egyptians, to their chariots and their horsemen, how he flooded the water of the Red Sea over their face while they pursued from behind you, and the Lord destroyed them until this day,
brenton_translation: and what he did to the host of the Egyptians, and to their chariots, and their cavalry, and their host; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overwhelm the face of them as they pursued after you, and the Lord destroyed them until this day;

fresh_translation: and what he did for you in the wilderness until you came to this place,
brenton_translation: and all the things which he did to you in the wilderness until ye came into this place;

fresh_translation: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab son of Reuben, whom the earth, opening its mouth, swallowed, and their households and their tents and all their substance that was with them in the midst of all Israel.
brenton_translation: and all things that he did to Dathan and Abiron the sons of Eliab the son of Ruben, whom the earth opening her mouth swallowed up, and their houses, and their tents, and all their substance that was with them, in the midst of all Israel:

fresh_translation: Because your eyes have seen all the great works of the Lord, all that he did for you today.
brenton_translation: for your eyes have seen all the mighty works of the Lord, which he wrought among you to-day.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep all his commands that I command you today, so that you may live and be multiplied and, entering in, inherit the land into which you are crossing the Jordan there to inherit it,
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep all his commandments, as many as I command thee to-day, that ye may live, and be multiplied, and that ye may go in and inherit the land, into which ye go across Jordan to inherit it:

fresh_translation: so that you may be long-lived on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give to them and to their seed after them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
brenton_translation: that ye may live long upon the land, which the Lord sware to your fathers to give to them, and to their seed after them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

fresh_translation: For the land into which you are entering there to inherit it is not like the land of Egypt from which you came out, where they sow the seed and water it with their feet like a vegetable garden.
brenton_translation: For the land into which thou goest to inherit it, is not as the land of Egypt, whence ye came out, whensoever they sow the seed, and water it with their feet, as a garden of herbs:

fresh_translation: But the land into which you are entering there to inherit it is a mountainous and plain land; from the rain of heaven it drinks water,
brenton_translation: but the land into which thou goest to inherit it, is a land of mountains and plains; it shall drink water of the rain of heaven.

fresh_translation: a land that the Lord your God watches over. The eyes of the Lord your God are always on it, from the beginning of the year until the end of the year.
brenton_translation: A land which the Lord thy God surveys continually, the eyes of the Lord thy God are upon it from the beginning of the year to the end of the year.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, if indeed you listen to all his commands that I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve him from your whole heart and from your whole soul,
brenton_translation: Now if ye will indeed hearken to all the commands which I charge thee this day, to love the Lord thy God, and to serve him with all thy heart, and with all thy soul,

fresh_translation: then he will give rain to your land in its season, early and late, and you shall bring in your grain and your wine and your oil,
brenton_translation: then he shall give to thy land the early and latter rain in its season, and thou shalt bring in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

fresh_translation: and he will give fodder in your fields for your cattle, and you shall eat and be filled.
brenton_translation: And he shall give food in thy fields to thy cattle; and when thou hast eaten and art full,

fresh_translation: Watch yourselves lest your heart turn aside and you transgress and serve other gods and bow to them,
brenton_translation: take heed to thyself that thy heart be not puffed up, and ye transgress, and serve other gods, and worship them:

fresh_translation: and the Lord, angered in wrath against you, shut up the heaven, and there will be no rain and the land will not give its fruit, and you will perish quickly from the good land that the Lord gave you.
brenton_translation: and the Lord be angry with you, and restrain the heaven; and there shall not be rain, and the earth shall not yield its fruit, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land, which the Lord has given you.

fresh_translation: And you shall put these words into your heart and into your soul, and you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be fixed before your eyes.
brenton_translation: And ye shall store these words in your heart and in your soul, and ye shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and it shall be fixed before your eyes.

fresh_translation: And you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them while sitting in the house and while walking on the road and while lying down and while rising up.
brenton_translation: And ye shall teach them to your children, so as to speak about them when thou sittest in the house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou sleepest, and when thou risest up.

fresh_translation: And you shall write them on the doorposts of your houses and your gates,
brenton_translation: And ye shall write them on the lintels of your houses, and on your gates;

fresh_translation: so that your days and the days of your children may be many on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
brenton_translation: that your days may be long, and the days of your children, upon the land which the Lord sware to your fathers to give to them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, if indeed you listen to all these commands that I command you today to do, to love the Lord our God and to walk in all his ways and cling to him,
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass that if ye will indeed hearken to all these commands, which I charge thee to observe this day, to love the Lord our God, and to walk in all his ways, and to cleave close to him;

fresh_translation: then the Lord will cast out all these nations from before your face, and you will inherit nations greater and stronger than you.
brenton_translation: then the Lord shall cast out all these nations before you, and ye shall inherit great nations and stronger than yourselves.

fresh_translation: Every place where the track of your foot treads shall be yours, from the wilderness and Anti-Lebanon, and from the great river, the river Euphrates, and as far as the western sea shall be your boundaries.
brenton_translation: Every place whereon the sole of your foot shall tread shall be yours; from the wilderness and Antilibanus, and from the great river, the river Euphrates, even as far as the west sea shall be your coasts.

fresh_translation: No one shall stand against your face. The Lord your God will put your terror and your fear on the face of all the land on which you step, in the way the Lord spoke to you.
brenton_translation: No one shall stand before you; and the Lord your God will put the fear of you and the dread of you on the face of all the land, on which ye shall tread, as he told you.

fresh_translation: Behold, I set before you today blessing and curse:
brenton_translation: Behold, I set before you this day the blessing and the curse;

fresh_translation: the blessing, if you hear the commands of the Lord your God that I command you today,
brenton_translation: the blessing, if ye hearken to the commands of the Lord your God, all that I command you this day;

fresh_translation: and the curse, if you do not hear the commands of the Lord your God that I command you today and wander from the way that I commanded you, going to serve other gods whom you do not know.
brenton_translation: and the curse, if ye do not hearken to the commands of the Lord our God, as many as I command you this day, and ye wander from the way which I have commanded you, having gone to serve other gods, which ye know not.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when the Lord your God brings you into the land into which you are crossing there to inherit it, then you shall place the blessing on Mount Garizin and the curse on Mount Gaibal.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land into which thou goest over to inherit it, then thou shalt put blessing on mount Garizin, and the curse upon mount Gæbal.

fresh_translation: Behold, are these not beyond the Jordan, behind the road of the sun's setting, in the land of Canaan that lies westward, near Golgol, beside the tall oak?
brenton_translation: Lo! are not these beyond Jordan, behind, westward in the land of Chanaan, which lies westward near Golgol, by the high oak?

fresh_translation: For you are crossing the Jordan, entering to inherit the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance all the days, and you shall inherit it and dwell in it.
brenton_translation: For ye are passing over Jordan, to go in and inherit the land, which the Lord our God gives you to inherit always, and ye shall dwell in it.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep to do all his ordinances and these judgments that I set before you today.
brenton_translation: And ye shall take heed to do all his ordinances, and these judgments, as many as I set before you to-day.

fresh_translation: And these are the ordinances and the judgments that you shall keep to do on the land that the Lord God of your fathers gives you as an inheritance, all the days that you live on the land.
brenton_translation: And these are the ordinances and the judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the Lord God of your fathers gives you for an inheritance, all the days which ye live upon the land.

fresh_translation: With destruction you shall destroy all the places in which those whom you inherit served their gods, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every dense tree.
brenton_translation: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places in which they served their gods, whose land ye inherit, on the high mountains and on the hills, and under the thick tree.

fresh_translation: And you shall dig down their altars and shatter their pillars and cut down their sacred groves, and the carved images of their gods you shall burn with fire, and their name shall perish from that place.
brenton_translation: And ye shall destroy their altars, and break in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their groves, and ye shall burn with fire the graven images of their gods, and ye shall abolish their name out of that place.

fresh_translation: You shall not do thus to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not do so to the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: But only to the place that the Lord your God chooses in one of your tribes, to have his name called there, you shall seek, and you shall go in there.
brenton_translation: But in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose in one of your cities to name his name there, and to be called upon, ye shall even seek him out and go thither.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring there your whole burnt offerings and your sacrifices and your firstfruits and your vows and your freewill offerings and the firstborn of your cattle and your sheep,
brenton_translation: And ye shall carry thither your whole-burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your first-fruits, and your vowed-offerings, and your freewill-offerings, and your offerings of thanksgiving, the first-born of your herds, and of your flocks.

fresh_translation: and you shall eat there before the Lord your God and rejoice in everything to which you put your hand, you and your households, in the way the Lord your God blessed you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall eat there before the Lord your God, and ye shall rejoice in all the things on which ye shall lay your hand, ye and your houses, as the Lord your God has blessed you.

fresh_translation: You shall not do all that we do here today, each one what is pleasing before himself,
brenton_translation: Ye shall not do altogether as we do here to-day, every man that which is pleasing in his own sight.

fresh_translation: for you have not come until now to the rest and to the inheritance that the Lord your God gives you.
brenton_translation: For hitherto ye have not arrived at the rest and the inheritance, which the Lord our God gives you.

fresh_translation: And you shall cross the Jordan and dwell on the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around, and you shall dwell in safety.
brenton_translation: And ye shall go over Jordan, and shall dwell in the land, which the Lord our God takes as an inheritance for you; and he shall give you rest from all your enemies round about, and ye shall dwell safely.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there, there you shall bring everything that I command you today, your whole burnt offerings and your sacrifices and your tithes and the firstfruits of your hands and every choice gift that you vow to your God.
brenton_translation: And there shall be a place which the Lord thy God shall choose for his name to be called there, thither shall ye bring all things that I order you to-day; your whole-burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the first-fruits of your hands, and every choice gift of yours, whatsoever ye shall vow to the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, your male servants and your female servants, and the Levite within your gates, because he has no portion or inheritance with you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God, ye and your sons, and your daughters, and your men-servants and your maid-servants, and the Levite that is at your gates; because he has no portion or inheritance with you.

fresh_translation: Watch yourself lest you bring up your whole burnt offerings in every place that you see,
brenton_translation: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy whole-burnt-offerings in any place which thou shalt see;

fresh_translation: but only at the place that the Lord your God chooses, that one, in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your whole burnt offerings and there you shall do everything that I command you today.
brenton_translation: save in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, in one of thy tribes, there shall ye offer your whole-burnt-offerings, and there shalt thou do all things whatsoever I charge thee this day.

fresh_translation: But according to all your desire, you may slaughter and eat meat according to the blessing of the Lord your God that he gave you in every city. The unclean among you and the clean alike shall eat it, as the gazelle or the deer.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt kill according to all thy desire, and shalt eat flesh according to the blessing of the Lord thy God, which he has given thee in every city; the unclean that is within thee and the clean shall eat it on equal terms, as the doe or the stag.

fresh_translation: Except the blood, you shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
brenton_translation: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it out on the ground as water.

fresh_translation: You shall not be able to eat in your cities the tithe of your grain and your wine and your oil, the firstborn of your cattle and your sheep, and all the vows that you vow and your confessions and the firstfruits of your hands,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not be able to eat in thy cities the tithe of thy corn, and of thy wine, and of thine oil, the first-born of thine herd and of thy flock, and all your vows as many as ye shall have vowed, and your thank-offerings, and the first-fruits of thine hands.

fresh_translation: but only before the Lord your God shall you eat them in the place that the Lord your God chooses for himself, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant and the proselyte in your cities, and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in everything to which you put your hand.
brenton_translation: But before the Lord thy God thou shalt eat it, in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the stranger that is within thy gates; and thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God, on whatsoever thou shalt lay thine hand.

fresh_translation: Watch yourself lest you abandon the Levite for all the time that you live on the land.
brenton_translation: Take heed to thyself that thou do not desert the Levite all the time that thou livest upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And if the Lord your God enlarges your boundaries, just as he spoke to you, and you say, I will eat meat, if your soul desires to eat meat, then by every desire of your soul you may eat meat.
brenton_translation: And if the Lord thy God shall enlarge thy borders, as he said to thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh; if thy soul should desire to eat flesh, thou shalt eat flesh according to all the desire of thy soul.

fresh_translation: And if the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there is farther from you, then you shall slaughter from your cattle and from your sheep that God gave you, in the way I commanded you, and you shall eat in your cities according to the desire of your soul.
brenton_translation: And if the place be far from thee, which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself, that his name be called upon it, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock which God shall have given thee, even as I commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy cities according to the desire of thy soul.

fresh_translation: Just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you shall eat it. The unclean among you and the clean alike shall eat it.
brenton_translation: As the doe and the stag are eaten, so shalt thou eat it; the unclean in thee and the clean shall eat it in like manner.

fresh_translation: Watch strongly that you do not eat blood, because its blood is life. Life shall not be eaten with the flesh.
brenton_translation: Take diligent heed that thou eat no blood, for blood is the life of it; the life shall not be eaten with the flesh.

fresh_translation: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not eat it; ye shall pour it out on the ground as water.

fresh_translation: You shall not eat it, so that it may be well with you and with your sons after you, if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not eat it, that it may be well with thee and with thy sons after thee, if thou shalt do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: Except your holy things that you may have, and your vows, taking them you shall come to the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt take thy holy things, if thou hast any, and thy vowed-offerings, and come to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to have his name named upon it.

fresh_translation: And you shall make your whole burnt offerings: the meat you shall offer on the altar of the Lord your God, and the blood of your sacrifices you shall pour out at the base of the altar of the Lord your God, but the meat you shall eat.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt sacrifice thy whole-burnt-offerings, thou shalt offer the flesh upon the altar of the Lord thy God; but the blood of thy sacrifices thou shalt pour out at the foot of the altar of the Lord thy God, but the flesh thou shalt eat.

fresh_translation: Keep and hear and do all these words that I command you, so that it may be well with you and with your sons forever, if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Beware and hearken, and thou shalt do all the commands which I charge thee, that it may be well with thee and with thy sons for ever, if thou shalt do that which is pleasing and good before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And if the Lord your God utterly destroys the nations into whose land you are entering there to inherit it from before your face, and you fully inherit them and dwell in their land,
brenton_translation: And if the Lord thy God shall utterly destroy the nations, to whom thou goest in thither to inherit their land, from before thee, and thou shalt inherit it, and dwell in their land;

fresh_translation: watch yourself lest you seek to follow after them after they have been destroyed from before your face. You shall certainly not seek their gods, saying, How do these nations act toward their gods? I also will do likewise.
brenton_translation: take heed to thyself that thou seek not to follow them after they are destroyed before thee, saying, How do these nations act towards their gods? I will do likewise.

fresh_translation: You shall not do thus to the Lord your God, for the abominations that the Lord hated they did to their gods, because they burn their sons and their daughters in fire to their gods.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not do so to thy God; for they have sacrificed to their gods the abominations of the Lord which he hates, for they burn their sons and their daughters in fire to their gods.

fresh_translation: Every word that I command you today, this you shall keep to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
brenton_translation: Every word that I command you this day, it shalt thou observe to do: thou shalt not add to it, nor diminish from it.

fresh_translation: And if a prophet arises among you, or one dreaming a dream, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
brenton_translation: And if there arise within thee a prophet, or one who dreams a dream, and he gives thee a sign or a wonder,

fresh_translation: and the sign or wonder comes that he spoke to you, saying, Let us go and serve other gods whom you do not know,
brenton_translation: and the sign or the wonder come to pass which he spoke to thee, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye know not;

fresh_translation: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of the dream, because the Lord your God tests you, to know whether you love the Lord your God from your whole heart and from your whole soul.
brenton_translation: ye shall not hearken to the words of that prophet, or the dreamer of that dream, because the Lord thy God tries you, to know whether ye love your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

fresh_translation: After the Lord your God you shall walk, and him you shall fear, and his commands you shall keep, and his voice you shall hear, and to him you shall be joined.
brenton_translation: Ye shall follow the Lord your God, and fear him, and ye shall hear his voice, and attach yourselves to him.

fresh_translation: And that prophet or that dreamer of the dream shall die, because he spoke to lead you astray from the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt, who redeemed you from slavery, to drive you out of the way that the Lord your God commanded you to walk in it. And you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: And that prophet or that dreamer of a dream, shall die; for he has spoken to make thee err from the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, who redeemed thee from bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the Lord thy God commanded thee to walk in: so shalt thou abolish the evil from among you.

fresh_translation: And if your brother from your father or from your mother or your son or your daughter or the wife in your bosom or the friend equal to your soul secretly urges you, saying, Let us go and serve other gods whom neither you nor your fathers knew,
brenton_translation: And if thy brother by thy father or mother, or thy son, or daughter, or thy wife in thy bosom, or friend who is equal to thine own soul, entreat thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known,

fresh_translation: from the gods of the nations around you, those near you or those far from you, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth,
brenton_translation: of the gods of the nations that are round about you, who are near thee or at a distance from thee, from one end of the earth to the other;

fresh_translation: you shall not agree with him, and you shall not listen to him, and your eye shall not spare him, and you shall not long for him, nor indeed hide him.
brenton_translation: thou shalt not consent to him, neither shalt thou hearken to him; and thine eye shall not spare him, thou shalt feel no regret for him, neither shalt thou at all protect him:

fresh_translation: Reporting, you shall report concerning him. Your hands shall be upon him first to kill him, and the hands of all the people last.
brenton_translation: thou shalt surely report concerning him, and thy hands shall be upon him among the first to slay him, and the hands of all the people at the last.

fresh_translation: And they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, because he sought to turn you away from the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
brenton_translation: And they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, because he sought to draw thee away from the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

fresh_translation: And all Israel, hearing, shall fear, and they shall not add again to do according to this evil word among you.
brenton_translation: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not again do according to this evil thing among you.

fresh_translation: And if you hear in one of your cities that the Lord your God gives you to dwell there, people saying,
brenton_translation: And if in one of thy cities which the Lord God gives thee to dwell therein, thou shalt hear men saying,

fresh_translation: Lawless men have gone out from among you and turned away all those dwelling in their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods whom you did not know,
