brenton_translation: Evil men have gone out from you, and have caused all the inhabitants of their land to fall away, saying, Let us go and worship other gods, whom ye knew not,

fresh_translation: then you shall inquire and search very carefully, and behold, if the matter has clearly become true, that this abomination happened among you,
brenton_translation: then thou shalt enquire and ask, and search diligently, and behold, if the thing is clearly true, and this abomination has taken place among you,

fresh_translation: killing, you shall kill all those dwelling in that city with the slaughter of the sword. With a devoted thing you shall devote it and everything in it.
brenton_translation: thou shalt utterly destroy all the dwellers in that land with the edge of the sword; ye shall solemnly curse it, and all things in it.

fresh_translation: And all its spoils you shall gather into its crossroads, and you shall burn the city with fire and all its spoils publicly before the Lord your God, and it shall be uninhabited forever. It shall not be built again.
brenton_translation: And all its spoils thou shalt gather into its public ways, and thou shalt burn the city with fire, and all its spoils publicly before the Lord thy God; and it shall be uninhabited for ever, it shall not be built again.

fresh_translation: Nothing from the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, so that the Lord may turn from the wrath of his anger and give you mercy and show you mercy and multiply you, in the way the Lord swore to your fathers,
brenton_translation: And there shall nothing of the cursed thing cleave to thy hand, that the Lord may turn from his fierce anger, and shew thee mercy, and pity thee, and multiply thee, as he sware to thy fathers;

fresh_translation: if you hear the voice of the Lord your God, keeping all his commands that I command you today, to do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: if thou wilt hear the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments, all that I charge thee this day, to do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: You are sons of the Lord your God. You shall not gash yourselves, nor put baldness between your eyes for the dead,
brenton_translation: Ye are the children of the Lord your God: ye shall not make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

fresh_translation: because you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord your God chose you to become for him a people of special possession from all the nations on the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: For thou art a holy people to the Lord thy God, and the Lord thy God has chosen thee to be a peculiar people to himself of all the nations on the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: You shall not eat any abomination.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not eat any abominable thing.

fresh_translation: These are the animals that you shall eat: calf from the cattle, lamb from the sheep, and kid from the goats,
brenton_translation: These are the beasts which ye shall eat; the calf of the herd, and lamb of the sheep, and kid of the goats;

fresh_translation: stag and gazelle and buffalo and goat-deer and pygarg and oryx and giraffe.
brenton_translation: the stag, and doe, and pygarg, and wild goat, and camelopard.

fresh_translation: Every animal that parts the hoof and splits the claws in two hoof-parts and brings up cud among the animals, these you shall eat.
brenton_translation: Every beast that divides the hoofs, and makes claws of two divisions, and that chews the cud among beasts, these ye shall eat.

fresh_translation: And these you shall not eat from those that bring up cud and from those that part the hoof and split the claws: the camel and the hare and the hyrax, because they bring up cud but do not part the hoof. These are unclean for you.
brenton_translation: And these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, and of those that divide the hoofs, and make distinct claws; the camel, and the hare, and the rabbit; because they chew the cud, and do not divide the hoof, these are unclean to you.

fresh_translation: And the pig, because it parts the hoof and splits the hoof-claws, but it does not chew the cud, this is unclean for you. From their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch.
brenton_translation: And as for the swine, because he divides the hoof, and makes claws of the hoof, yet he chews not the cud, he is unclean to you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, ye shall not touch their dead bodies.

fresh_translation: And these you shall eat from all that are in the waters: everything that has fins and scales in them you shall eat.
brenton_translation: And these ye shall eat of all that are in the water, ye shall eat all that have fins and scales.

fresh_translation: And everything that does not have fins and scales you shall not eat. They are unclean for you.
brenton_translation: And all that have not fins and scales ye shall not eat; they are unclean to you.

fresh_translation: Every clean bird you shall eat.
brenton_translation: Ye shall eat every clean bird.

fresh_translation: And these are what you shall not eat from them: the eagle and the griffin and the sea-eagle,
brenton_translation: And these of them ye shall not eat; the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the sea-eagle,

fresh_translation: and the vulture and the kite and those like it,
brenton_translation: and the vulture, and the kite and the like to it,

fresh_translation: and every raven and those like it,
and the ostrich and the owl and the gull,
brenton_translation: and the sparrow, and the owl, and the sea-mew,

fresh_translation: and the heron and the swan and the ibis,
brenton_translation: and the heron, and the swan, and the stork,

fresh_translation: and the diver and the hawk and those like it and the hoopoe and the night-raven,
brenton_translation: and the cormorant, and the hawk, and its like, and the hoopoe, and the raven,

fresh_translation: and the pelican and the plover and those like it and the purple bird and the bat.
brenton_translation: and the pelican, and the diver and the like to it, and the red-bill and the bat.

fresh_translation: Every creeping thing of the birds is unclean for you. You shall not eat from them.
brenton_translation: All winged animals that creep are unclean to you; ye shall not eat of them.

fresh_translation: Every clean flying thing you shall eat.
brenton_translation: Ye shall eat every clean bird.

fresh_translation: You shall not eat any carcass. It shall be given to the resident alien in your cities, and he shall eat it, or you may sell it to the foreigner, because you are a holy people to the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother's milk.
brenton_translation: Ye shall eat nothing that dies of itself; it shall be given to the sojourner in thy cities and he shall eat it, or thou shalt sell it to a stranger, because thou art a holy people to the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not boil a lamb in his mother's milk.

fresh_translation: Tithing, you shall tithe all the produce of your seed, the produce of your field, year by year.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt tithe a tenth of all the produce of thy seed, the fruit of thy field year by year.

fresh_translation: And you shall eat it before the Lord your God in the place where the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there. You shall bring the tithes of your grain and your wine and your oil and the firstborn of your cattle and your sheep, so that you may learn to fear the Lord your God all the days.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt eat it in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to have his name called there; ye shall bring the tithe of thy corn and of thy wine, and of thine oil, the first-born of thy herd and of thy flock, that thou mayest learn to fear the Lord thy God always.

fresh_translation: And if the road is too long for you and you are not able to carry them, because the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there is far from you, because the Lord your God will bless you,
brenton_translation: And if the journey be too far for thee, and thou art not able to bring them, because the place is far from thee which the Lord thy God shall choose to have his name called there, because the Lord thy God will bless thee;

fresh_translation: then you shall exchange them for silver and take the silver in your hands and go to the place that the Lord your God chooses, that one,
brenton_translation: then thou shalt sell them for money, and thou shalt take the money in thy hands, and thou shalt go to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose.

fresh_translation: and you shall give the silver for everything your soul desires, for cattle or for sheep, for wine or for strong drink or for anything your soul desires, and you shall eat there before the Lord your God and rejoice, you and your household.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt give the money for whatsoever thy soul shall desire, for oxen or for sheep, or for wine, or thou shalt lay it out on strong drink, or on whatsoever thy soul may desire, and thou shalt eat there before the Lord thy God, and thou shalt rejoice and thy house,

fresh_translation: And the Levite who is in your cities, because he has no portion or inheritance with you,
brenton_translation: and the Levite that is in thy cities, because he has not a portion or inheritance with thee.

fresh_translation: after three years you shall bring out all the tithe of your produce in that year and place it in your cities,
brenton_translation: After three years thou shalt bring out all the tithes of thy fruits, in that year thou shalt lay it up in thy cities.

fresh_translation: and the Levite will come, because he has no portion or inheritance with you, and the proselyte and the orphan and the widow who are in your cities, and they shall eat and be filled, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works that you do.
brenton_translation: And the Levite shall come, because he has no part or lot with thee, and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow which is in thy cities; and they shall eat and be filled, that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all the works which thou shalt do.

fresh_translation: At the end of seven years you shall make a release.
brenton_translation: Every seven years thou shalt make a release.

fresh_translation: And this is the ordinance of the release: you shall release every personal debt that your neighbor owes you, and you shall not demand it from your brother, because a release has been proclaimed to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And this is the ordinance of the release: thou shalt remit every private debt which thy neighbour owes thee, and thou shalt not ask payment of it from thy brother; for it has been called a release to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: From the foreigner you shall demand, but from your brother you shall make a release of your debt.
brenton_translation: Of a stranger thou shalt ask again whatsoever he has of thine, but to thy brother thou shalt remit his debt to thee.

fresh_translation: Because there shall not be one in need among you, because in blessing the Lord your God will bless you in the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance to inherit it,
brenton_translation: For thus there shall not be a poor person in the midst of thee, for the Lord thy God will surely bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God gives thee by inheritance, that thou shouldest inherit it.

fresh_translation: if indeed you listen to the voice of the Lord your God, keeping and doing all these commands that I command you today.
brenton_translation: And if ye shall indeed hearken to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and do all these commandments, as many as I charge thee this day,

fresh_translation: Because the Lord your God blessed you in the way he spoke to you, and you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow, and you shall rule many nations, but they shall not rule you.
brenton_translation: (for the Lord thy God has blessed thee in the way of which he spoke to thee,) then thou shalt lend to many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over thee.

fresh_translation: And if one in need arises among you from your brothers in one of your cities, in the land that the Lord your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor indeed close your hand from your needy brother,
brenton_translation: And if there shall be in the midst of thee a poor man of thy brethren in one of thy cities in the land, which the Lord thy God gives thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, neither shalt thou by any means close up thine hand from thy brother who is in want.

fresh_translation: but opening, you shall open your hands to him. Lending, you shall lend to him as much as he needs, according to what he lacks.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt surely open thine hands to him, and shalt lend to him as much as he wants according to his need.

fresh_translation: Watch yourself lest a hidden matter of lawlessness arise in your heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, draws near, and your eye become evil toward your needy brother and you do not give to him, and he cries out against you to the Lord, and there will be great sin in you.
brenton_translation: Take heed to thyself that there be not a secret thing in thine heart, an iniquity, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, draws nigh; and thine eye shall be evil to thy brother that is in want, and thou shalt not give to him, and he shall cry against thee to the Lord, and there shall be great sin in thee.

fresh_translation: Giving, you shall give to him, and lending, you shall lend to him as much as he needs, and you shall not grieve in your heart while giving to him, because for this word the Lord your God will bless you in all your works and in everything to which you put your hand.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt surely give to him, and thou shalt lend him as much as he wants, according as he is in need; and thou shalt not grudge in thine heart as thou givest to him, because on this account the Lord thy God will bless thee in all thy works, and in all things on which thou shalt lay thine hand.

fresh_translation: For one in need shall certainly not fail from the land. Because of this I command you to do this word, saying, Opening, you shall open your hands to your brother, to the poor and the needy one on your land.
brenton_translation: For the poor shall not fail off thy land, therefore I charge thee to do this thing, saying, Thou shalt surely open thine hands to thy poor brother, and to him that is distressed upon thy land.

fresh_translation: And if your Hebrew brother or Hebrew sister is sold to you, he shall serve you six years, and in the seventh you shall send him away from you free.
brenton_translation: And if thy brother or sister, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, be sold to thee, he shall serve thee six years, and in the seventh year thou shalt send him out free from thee.

fresh_translation: And when you send him away from you free, you shall not send him away empty.
brenton_translation: And when thou shalt send him out free from thee, thou shalt not send him out empty.

fresh_translation: Furnishing, you shall furnish him from your sheep and from your grain and from your winepress. In the way the Lord your God blessed you, you shall give to him.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt give him provision for the way from thy flock, and from thy corn, and from thy wine; as the Lord thy God has blessed thee, thou shalt give to him.

fresh_translation: And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you from there. Because of this I command you to do this word.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord thy God redeemed thee from thence; therefore I charge thee to do this thing.

fresh_translation: And if he says to you, I will not go out from you, because he loved you and your household, because it is well for him with you,
brenton_translation: And if he should say to thee, I will not go out from thee, because he continues to love thee and thy house, because he is well with thee;

fresh_translation: then you shall take the awl and pierce his ear to the door, and he shall be your household servant forever. And you shall do likewise to your female servant.
brenton_translation: then thou shalt take an awl, and bore his ear through to the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever; and in like manner shalt thou do to thy maid-servant.

fresh_translation: It shall not be hard before you when you send them away free from you, because he served you six years for a yearly wage doubled from the hired worker, and the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do.
brenton_translation: It shall not seem hard to thee when they are sent out free from thee, because thy servant has served thee six years according to the annual hire of a hireling; so the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all things whatsoever thou mayest do.

fresh_translation: Every firstborn, whatever is born among your cattle and your sheep, the males, you shall consecrate to the Lord your God. You shall not work with your firstborn calf, nor shall you shear the firstborn of your sheep.
brenton_translation: Every first-born that shall be born among thy kine and thy sheep, thou shalt sanctify the males to the Lord thy God; thou shalt not work with thy first-born calf, and thou shalt not shear the first-born of thy sheep.

fresh_translation: Before the Lord your God you shall eat it, year by year, in the place that the Lord your God chooses, you and your household.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt eat it before the Lord year by year in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, thou and thy house.

fresh_translation: And if there is a blemish in it, lame or blind or any evil blemish, you shall not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And if there be in it a blemish, if it be lame or blind, an evil blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: In your cities you shall eat it. The unclean among you and the clean alike shall eat it, as the gazelle or the deer.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt eat it in thy cities; the unclean in thee and the clean shall eat it in like manner, as the doe or the stag.

fresh_translation: Except the blood, you shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
brenton_translation: Only ye shall not eat the blood; thou shalt pour it out on the earth as water.

fresh_translation: Keep the month of new grain, and you shall make the Passover to the Lord your God, because in the month of new grain you came out from Egypt by night.
brenton_translation: Observe the month of new corn, and thou shalt sacrifice the passover to the Lord thy God; because in the month of new corn thou camest out of Egypt by night.

fresh_translation: And you shall sacrifice the Passover to the Lord your God, sheep and cattle, in the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt sacrifice the passover to the Lord thy God, sheep and oxen in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to have his name called upon it.

fresh_translation: You shall not eat leaven on it. Seven days you shall eat on it unleavened bread, bread of affliction, because in haste you came out from Egypt, so that you may remember the day of your departure from the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not eat leaven with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread with it, bread of affliction, because ye came forth out of Egypt in haste; that ye may remember the day of your coming forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

fresh_translation: No leaven shall be seen to you in all your boundaries seven days, and none of the meat that you sacrifice in the evening on the first day shall remain overnight until morning.
brenton_translation: Leaven shall not be seen with thee in all thy borders for seven days, and there shall not be left of the flesh which thou shalt sacrifice at even on the first day until the morning.

fresh_translation: You shall not be able to sacrifice the Passover in any of your cities that the Lord your God gives you,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not have power to sacrifice the passover in any of the cities, which the Lord thy God gives thee.

fresh_translation: but only at the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there, there you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening, at the setting of the sun, at the time when you came out from Egypt.
brenton_translation: But in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, to have his name called there, thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even at the setting of the sun, at the time when thou camest out of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And you shall cook and roast and eat it in the place that the Lord your God chooses, that one, and in the morning you shall turn and go away to your houses.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt boil and roast and eat it in the place, which the Lord thy God shall choose; and thou shalt return in the morning, and go to thy house.

fresh_translation: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day, departure feast to the Lord your God. You shall do no work in it except what shall be done for a life.
brenton_translation: Six days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day is a holiday, a feast to the Lord thy God: thou shalt not do in it any work, save what must be done by any one.

fresh_translation: Seven full weeks you shall count for yourself. From when you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.
brenton_translation: Seven weeks shalt thou number to thyself; when thou hast begun to put the sickle to the corn, thou shalt begin to number seven weeks.

fresh_translation: And you shall make the Feast of Weeks to the Lord your God according to the strength of your hand, whatever you may give, in the way the Lord your God blessed you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks to the Lord thy God, accordingly as thy hand has power in as many things as the Lord thy God shall give thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite in your cities and the proselyte and the orphan and the widow among you, in the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God, thou and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant and thy maid-servant, and the Levite, and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow which dwells among you, in whatsoever place the Lord thy God shall choose, that his name should be called there.

fresh_translation: And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and you shall keep and do these commands.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and thou shalt observe and do these commands.

fresh_translation: You shall make the Feast of Booths for yourself seven days, when you gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt keep for thyself the feast of tabernacles seven days, when thou gatherest in thy produce from thy corn-floor and thy wine-press.

fresh_translation: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite and the proselyte and the orphan and the widow who are in your cities.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite, and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow that is in thy cities.

fresh_translation: Seven days you shall feast to the Lord your God in the place that the Lord your God chooses for himself, because if the Lord your God blesses you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, then you shall be rejoicing.
brenton_translation: Seven days shalt thou keep a feast to the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself; and if the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all thy fruits, and in every work of thy hands, then thou shalt rejoice.

fresh_translation: Three times in the year every male among you shall appear before the Lord your God in the place that the Lord chooses: in the Feast of Unleavened Bread and in the Feast of Weeks and in the Feast of Tabernacle-making. You shall not appear before the Lord your God empty,
brenton_translation: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord shall choose in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: thou shalt not appear before the Lord thy God empty.

fresh_translation: each according to the ability of your hands, according to the blessing of the Lord your God that he gave you.
brenton_translation: Each one according to his ability, according to the blessing of the Lord thy God which he has given thee.

fresh_translation: You shall appoint judges and scribes for yourself in all your cities that the Lord your God gives you, according to tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt make for thyself judges and officers in thy cities, which the Lord thy God gives thee in thy tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment:

fresh_translation: They shall not turn aside judgment. They shall not recognize a face, nor take a gift, because gifts blind the eyes of the wise and remove the words of the righteous.
brenton_translation: they shall not wrest judgment, nor favour persons, nor receive a gift; for gifts blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

fresh_translation: Justly pursue what is just, so that you may live and, entering in, inherit the land that the Lord your God gives you.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt justly pursue justice, that ye may live, and go in and inherit the land which the Lord thy God gives thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not plant for yourself a grove, any tree, beside the altar of the Lord your God that you make for yourself.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not plant for thyself a grove; thou shalt not plant for thyself any tree near the altar of thy God.

fresh_translation: You shall not set up for yourself a pillar, which the Lord your God hated.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not set up for thyself a pillar, which the Lord thy God hates.

fresh_translation: You shall not sacrifice to the Lord your God a calf or a sheep in which there is a blemish, any evil thing, because it is an abomination to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not sacrifice to the Lord thy God a calf or a sheep, in which there is a blemish, or any evil thing; for it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And if there is found among you in one of your cities that the Lord your God gives you, a man or a woman who does evil before the Lord your God by transgressing his covenant,
brenton_translation: And if there should be found in any one of thy cities, which the Lord thy God gives thee, a man or a woman who shall do that which is evil before the Lord thy God, so as to transgress his covenant,

fresh_translation: and they go and serve other gods and bow to them, to the sun or to the moon or to anything from the order of heaven, which he did not command,
brenton_translation: and they should go and serve other gods, and worship them, the sun, or the moon, or any of the host of heaven, which he commanded thee not to do,

fresh_translation: and it is reported to you, and you search it out very carefully, and behold, the matter has truly happened, this abomination has occurred in Israel,
brenton_translation: and it be told thee, and thou shalt have enquired diligently, and, behold, the thing really took place, this abomination has been done in Israel;

fresh_translation: then you shall bring out that man or that woman, and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou bring out that man, or that woman, and ye shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.

fresh_translation: On two witnesses or on three witnesses the one dying shall die. He shall not die on one witness.
brenton_translation: He shall die on the testimony of two or three witnesses; a man who is put to death shall not be put to death for one witness.

fresh_translation: And the hand of the witnesses shall be upon him first to put him to death, and the hand of all the people last. And you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the witnesses shall be upon him among the first to put him to death, and the hand of the people at the last; so shalt thou remove the evil one from among yourselves.

fresh_translation: And if a matter in judgment is too hard for you, between blood and blood, and between judgment and judgment, and between wound and wound, words of judgment in your cities, then, rising, you shall go up to the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there.
brenton_translation: And if a matter shall be too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, and between cause and cause, and between stroke and stroke, and between contradiction and contradiction, matters of judgment in your cities;

fresh_translation: And you shall come to the Levitical priests and to the judge who may be in those days, and, after seeking, they shall report the judgment to you.
brenton_translation: then thou shalt arise and go up to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, and thou shalt come to the priests the Levites, and to the judge who shall be in those days, and they shall search out the matter and report the judgment to thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall act according to the matter that they report to you from the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there, and you shall keep very carefully to do according to everything that may be legislated to you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt act according to the thing which they shall report to thee out of the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, and thou shalt observe to do all whatsoever shall have been by law appointed to thee.

fresh_translation: According to the law and according to the judgment that they tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn aside from the word that they report to you, right or left.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt do according to the law and to the judgment which they shall declare to thee: thou shalt not swerve to the right hand or to the left from any sentence which they shall report to thee.

fresh_translation: And the man who may act in pride by not listening to the priest who stands there ministering on the name of the Lord your God, or to the judge who may be in those days, that man shall die, and you shall destroy the evil one from Israel.
brenton_translation: And the man whosoever shall act in haughtiness, so as not to hearken to the priest who stands to minister in the name of the Lord thy God, or the judge who shall preside in those days, that man shall die, and thou shalt remove the evil one out of Israel.

fresh_translation: And all the people, hearing, shall fear and no longer act ungodly.
brenton_translation: And all the people shall hear and fear, and shall no more commit impiety.

fresh_translation: And if you enter into the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance and inherit it and dwell on it and say, I will set a ruler over myself, just as also the rest of the nations around me,
brenton_translation: And when thou shalt enter into the land which the Lord thy God gives thee, and shalt inherit it and dwell in it, and shalt say, I will set a ruler over me, as also the other nations round about me;

fresh_translation: appointing, you shall appoint over yourself a ruler whom the Lord your God chooses. From your brothers you shall appoint a ruler over yourself. You shall not be able to appoint over yourself a foreign man, because he is not your brother.
brenton_translation: thou shalt surely set over thee the ruler whom the Lord God shall choose: of thy brethren thou shalt set over thee a ruler; thou shalt not have power to set over thee a stranger, because he is not thy brother.

fresh_translation: Only he shall not multiply horses for himself, nor indeed turn the people back to Egypt so as to multiply horses for himself, because the Lord said, You shall not add to return by this road any longer.
brenton_translation: For he shall not multiply to himself horses, and he shall by no means turn the people back to Egypt, lest he should multiply to himself horses; for the Lord said, Ye shall not any more turn back by that way.

fresh_translation: And he shall not multiply wives for himself, nor shall his heart turn away, and silver and gold he shall not multiply for himself greatly.
brenton_translation: And he shall not multiply to himself wives, lest his heart turn away; and he shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when he sits on his rule, he shall write for himself this second law in a book from the priests, the Levites.
brenton_translation: And when he shall be established in his government, then shall he write for himself this repetition of the law into a book by the hands of the priests the Levites;

fresh_translation: And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the Lord his God, keeping all these commands and these ordinances, to do them,
brenton_translation: and it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the Lord thy God, and to keep all these commandments, and to observe these ordinances:

fresh_translation: so that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, so that he may not transgress the commands right or left, so that he may be long-lived in his rule, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: that his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, that he depart not from the commandments on the right hand or on the left; that he and his sons may reign long in his dominion among the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: There shall not be for the priests, the Levites, the whole tribe of Levi, a portion or inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the Lord's offerings, which are their inheritance.
brenton_translation: The priests, the Levites, even the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel; the burnt-offerings of the Lord are their inheritance, they shall eat them.

fresh_translation: And inheritance shall not be for them among their brothers. The Lord himself is his inheritance, just as he said to him.
brenton_translation: And they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the Lord himself is his portion, as he said to him.

fresh_translation: And this is the due of the priests from the people, from those sacrificing the sacrifices, whether calf or sheep: he shall give to the priest the arm and the jaws and the stomach.
brenton_translation: And this is the due of the priests in the things coming from the people from those who offer sacrifices, whether it be a calf or a sheep; and thou shalt give the shoulder to the priest, and the cheeks, and the great intestine:

fresh_translation: And the firstfruits of your grain and your wine and your oil, and the firstfruits of the shearings of your sheep, you shall give to him,
brenton_translation: and the first-fruits of thy corn, and of thy wine, and of thine oil; and thou shalt give to him the first-fruits of the fleeces of thy sheep:

fresh_translation: because the Lord your God chose him from all your tribes to stand before the Lord your God to minister and bless in his name, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: because the Lord has chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand before the Lord thy God, to minister and bless in his name, himself and his sons among the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And if the Levite comes from one of your cities, from all the sons of Israel where he is residing as a stranger, because his soul desires the place that the Lord chooses,
brenton_translation: And if a Levite come from one of the cities of all the children of Israel, where he himself dwells, accordingly as his mind desires, to the place which he shall have chosen,

fresh_translation: then he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, just as all his brothers the Levites who stand there before the Lord.
brenton_translation: he shall minister to the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites, who stand there present before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: He shall eat an equal portion, besides the sale according to patrimony.
brenton_translation: He shall eat an allotted portion, besides the sale of his hereditary property.

fresh_translation: And if you enter into the land that the Lord your God gives you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.
brenton_translation: And when thou shalt have entered into the land which the Lord thy God gives thee, thou shalt not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.

fresh_translation: There shall not be found among you one purifying his son or his daughter through fire, one divining divination, one practicing omens, one reading signs, a sorcerer,
brenton_translation: There shall not be found in thee one who purges his son or his daughter with fire, one who uses divination, who deals with omens, and augury,

fresh_translation: one chanting a chant, a ventriloquist, one observing signs, one consulting the dead,
brenton_translation: a sorcerer employing incantation, one who has in him a divining spirit, an observer of signs, questioning the dead.

fresh_translation: because everyone doing these things is an abomination to the Lord your God, for because of these abominations the Lord will utterly destroy them from before your face.
brenton_translation: For every one that does these things is an abomination to the Lord thy God; for because of these abominations the Lord will destroy them from before thy face.

fresh_translation: You shall be complete before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt be perfect before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: For these nations that you inherit, these will listen to omen-readers and diviners. But for you the Lord your God did not give thus.
brenton_translation: For all these nations whose land thou shalt inherit, they will listen to omens and divinations; but the Lord thy God has not permitted thee so to do.

fresh_translation: A prophet from your brothers like me the Lord your God will raise up for you. To him you shall listen,
brenton_translation: The Lord thy God shall raise up to thee a prophet of thy brethren, like me; him shall ye hear:

fresh_translation: according to all that you asked from the Lord your God in Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, We shall not add to hear the voice of the Lord our God, and we shall not see this great fire any more, nor indeed die.
brenton_translation: according to all things which thou didst desire of the Lord thy God in Choreb in the day of the assembly, saying, We will not again hear the voice of the Lord thy God, and we will not any more see this great fire, and so we shall not die.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, They spoke rightly all that they spoke.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, They have spoken rightly all that they have said to thee.

fresh_translation: I will raise up for them a prophet from their brothers like you, and I will put my word in his mouth, and he shall speak to them according to whatever I command him.
brenton_translation: I will raise up to them a prophet of their brethren, like thee; and I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them as I shall command him.

fresh_translation: And the man who does not hear whatever the prophet speaks in my name, I will exact it from him.
brenton_translation: And whatever man shall not hearken to whatsoever words that prophet shall speak in my name, I will take vengeance on him.

fresh_translation: But the prophet who may act ungodly by speaking in my name a word that I did not command him to speak, and who may speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.
brenton_translation: But the prophet whosoever shall impiously speak in my name a word which I have not commanded him to speak, and whosoever shall speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.

fresh_translation: And if you say in your heart, How shall we know the word that the Lord did not speak?
brenton_translation: But if thou shalt say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?

fresh_translation: Whatever the prophet speaks in the name of the Lord and the matter does not happen and does not come to pass, this is the word that the Lord did not speak. In ungodliness that prophet spoke it. You shall not spare him.
brenton_translation: Whatsoever words that prophet shall speak in the name of the Lord, and they shall not come true, and not come to pass, this is the thing which the Lord has not spoken; that prophet has spoken wickedly: ye shall not spare him.

fresh_translation: And if the Lord your God utterly destroys the nations whose land your God gives you, and you fully inherit them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,
brenton_translation: And when the Lord thy God shall have destroyed the nations, which God gives thee, even the land, and ye shall inherit them, and dwell in their cities, and in their houses,

fresh_translation: you shall set apart for yourself three cities in the midst of your land that the Lord your God gives you.
brenton_translation: thou shalt separate for thyself three cities in the midst of thy land, which the Lord thy God gives thee.

fresh_translation: Prepare the road for yourself, and divide the boundaries of your land into three parts, the land that the Lord your God distributes to you, and there shall be refuge there for every killer.
brenton_translation: Take a survey of thy way, and thou shalt divide the coasts of thy land, which the Lord thy God apportions to thee, into three parts, and there shall be there a refuge for every manslayer.

fresh_translation: And this shall be the ordinance of the killer who flees there and lives: whoever strikes his neighbor unintentionally, this one not hating him before yesterday or the third day,
brenton_translation: And this shall be the ordinance of the manslayer, who shall flee thither, and shall live, whosoever shall have smitten his neighbour ignorantly, whereas he hated him not in times past.

fresh_translation: and whoever enters with his neighbor into the forest to gather wood, and his hand swings with the axe while cutting the wood, and the iron flies from the wood and meets his neighbor and he dies, this one shall flee to one of these cities and live,
brenton_translation: And whosoever shall enter with his neighbour into the thicket, to gather wood, if the hand of him that cuts wood with the axe should be violently shaken, and the axe head falling off from the handle should light on his neighbour, and he should die, he shall flee to one of these cities, and live.

fresh_translation: lest the avenger of blood, pursuing behind the one who killed, because his heart was heated, overtake him if the road is longer, and strike his life and he die, though for this one there is no judgment of death, because he was not hating him before yesterday or the third day.
brenton_translation: Lest the avenger of blood pursue after the slayer, because his heart is hot, and overtake him, if the way be too long, and slay him, though there is to this man no sentence of death, because he hated him not in time past.

fresh_translation: Because of this I command you this word, saying, You shall set apart for yourself three cities.
brenton_translation: Therefore I charge thee, saying, Thou shalt separate for thyself three cities.

fresh_translation: And if the Lord your God enlarges your boundaries in the way he swore to your fathers and the Lord gives you all the land that he said to give to your fathers,
brenton_translation: And if the Lord shall enlarge thy borders, as he sware to thy fathers, and the Lord shall give to thee all the land which he said he would give to thy fathers;

fresh_translation: if you listen to do all these commands that I command you today, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways all the days, then you shall add for yourself three more cities to these three,
brenton_translation: if thou shalt hearken to do all these commands, which I charge thee this day, to love the Lord thy God, to walk in all his ways continually; thou shalt add for thyself yet three cities to these three.

fresh_translation: and innocent blood shall not be shed in your land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance, and bloodguilt shall not be in you.
brenton_translation: So innocent blood shall not be spilt in the land, which the Lord thy God gives thee to inherit, and there shall not be in thee one guilty of blood.

fresh_translation: And if there is a man hating his neighbor, and he lies in wait for him and rises against him and strikes his life and he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,
brenton_translation: But if there should be in thee a man hating his neighbour, and he should lay wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him, that he die, and he should flee to one of these cities,

fresh_translation: then the elders of his city shall send and take him from there and deliver him into the hands of the avenger of blood, and he shall die.
brenton_translation: then shall the elders of his city send, and take him thence, and they shall deliver him into the hands of the avengers of blood, and he shall die.

fresh_translation: Your eye shall not spare him, and you shall cleanse innocent blood from Israel, and it shall be well with you.
brenton_translation: Thine eye shall not spare him; so shalt thou purge innocent blood from Israel, and it shall be well with thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not move your neighbor's boundaries that your fathers set in your inheritance that you inherited in the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not move the landmarks of thy neighbour, which thy fathers set in the inheritance, in which thou hast obtained a share in the land, which the Lord thy God gives thee to inherit.

fresh_translation: A witness shall not remain to testify against a man for every injustice and for every sin and for every sin that he may sin. By the mouth of two witnesses and by the mouth of three witnesses every word shall stand.
brenton_translation: One witness shall not stand to testify against a man for any iniquity, or for any fault, or for any sin which he may commit; by the mouth of two witnesses, or by the mouth of three witnesses, shall every word be established.

fresh_translation: And if an unjust witness stands against a man, charging him with ungodliness,
brenton_translation: And if an unjust witness rise up against a man, alleging iniquity against him;

fresh_translation: then the two men who have the dispute shall stand before the Lord and before the priests and before the judges who may be in those days.
brenton_translation: then shall the two men between whom the controversy is, stand before the Lord, and before the priests, and before the judges, who may be in those days.

fresh_translation: And the judges shall investigate exactly, and behold, if the witness is unjust and he has testified unjust things, standing against his brother,
brenton_translation: And the judges shall make diligent inquiry, and, behold, if an unjust witness has borne unjust testimony; and has stood up against his brother;

fresh_translation: then you shall do to him in the way he wickedly intended to do against his brother, and you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: then shall ye do to him as he wickedly devised to do against his brother, and thou shalt remove the evil from yourselves.

fresh_translation: And the rest, hearing, shall fear and no longer add to do according to this evil word among you.
brenton_translation: And the rest shall hear and fear, and do no more according to this evil thing in the midst of you.

fresh_translation: Your eye shall not spare him: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
brenton_translation: Thine eye shall not spare him: thou shalt exact life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

fresh_translation: And if you go out to war against your enemies and see horse and rider and a people more numerous than you, you shall not fear before them, because the Lord your God is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest go forth to war against thine enemies, and shouldest see horse, and rider, and a people more numerous than thyself; thou shalt not be afraid of them, for the Lord thy God is with thee, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when you draw near to the war, then the priest, drawing near, shall speak to the people,
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass whenever thou shalt draw nigh to battle, that the priest shall draw nigh and speak to the people, and shall say to them,

fresh_translation: and he shall say to them, Hear, Israel: you draw near today to war against your enemies. Do not let your heart grow weak. Do not fear, nor be broken, nor turn aside from before their face,
brenton_translation: Hear, O Israel; ye are going this day to battle against your enemies: let not your heart faint, fear not, neither be confounded, neither turn aside from their face.

fresh_translation: because the Lord your God, the one going before with you, will fight together with you against your enemies, to save you.
brenton_translation: For it is the Lord your God who advances with you, to fight with you against your enemies, and to save you.

fresh_translation: And the scribes shall speak to the people, saying, Who is the man who built a new house and did not dedicate it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the war and another man dedicate it.
brenton_translation: And the scribes shall speak to the people, saying, What man is he that has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the war, and another man dedicate it.

fresh_translation: And who is the man who planted a vineyard and did not rejoice from it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the war and another man rejoice from it.
brenton_translation: And what man is he that has planted a vineyard, and not been made merry with it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man be made merry with it.

fresh_translation: And who is the man who is betrothed to a woman and did not take her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the war and another man take her.
brenton_translation: And what man is he that has betrothed a wife, and has not taken her? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.

fresh_translation: And the scribes shall add to speak to the people and say, Who is the man who is fearful and cowardly in heart? Let him go and return to his house, lest he make his brother's heart cowardly like his own.
brenton_translation: And the scribes shall speak further to the people, and say, What man is he that fears and is cowardly in his heart? Let him go and return to his house, lest he make the heart of his brother fail, as his own.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when the scribes finish speaking to the people, then they shall appoint leaders of the army to go before the people.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when the scribes shall have ceased speaking to the people, that they shall appoint generals of the army to be leaders of the people.

fresh_translation: And if you draw near to a city to fight against it, then you shall call them with peace.
brenton_translation: And if thou shalt draw nigh to a city to overcome them by war, then call them out peaceably.

fresh_translation: And if they answer you peaceably and open to you, then all the people found in it shall be tributary and subject to you.
brenton_translation: If then they should answer peaceably to thee, and open to thee, it shall be that all the people found in it shall be tributary and subject to thee.

fresh_translation: And if they do not obey you and make war against you, then you shall besiege it.
brenton_translation: But if they will not hearken to thee, but wage war against thee, thou shalt invest it;

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will give it into your hands, and you shall strike every male in it with the slaughter of the sword.
brenton_translation: until the Lord thy God shall deliver it into thy hands, and thou shalt smite every male of it with the edge of the sword:

fresh_translation: Except the women and the supplies and all the cattle and whatever is in the city and all its provisions, you shall plunder for yourself, and you shall eat all the spoil of your enemies that the Lord your God gives you.
brenton_translation: except the women and the stuff: and all the cattle, and whatsoever shall be in the city, and all the plunder thou shalt take as spoil for thyself, and shalt eat all the plunder of thine enemies whom the Lord thy God gives thee.

fresh_translation: Thus you shall do to all the cities that are very far from you, which are not from the cities of these nations.
brenton_translation: Thus shalt thou do to all the cities that are very far off from thee, not being of the cities of these nations which the Lord thy God gives thee to inherit their land.

fresh_translation: But from the cities of these nations whose land the Lord your God gives you to inherit, you shall not keep alive from them anything breathing.
brenton_translation: Of these ye shall not take any thing alive;

fresh_translation: But with a devoted thing you shall devote them, the Hittite and Amorite and Canaanite and Pherezite and Hivite and Jebusite and Gergesite, in the way the Lord your God commanded you,
brenton_translation: but ye shall surely curse them, the Chettite, and the Amorite, and the Chananite, and the Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Jebusite, and the Gergesite; as the Lord thy God commanded thee:

fresh_translation: so that they may not teach you to do all their abominations that they did to their gods, and you would sin before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: that they may not teach you to do all their abominations, which they did to their gods, and so ye should sin before the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And if you besiege a city many days to fight against it for its capture, you shall not utterly destroy its trees by putting iron to them. Rather, you may eat from it, but you shall not cut it down, because the tree in the field is not a human to enter before your face into siegeworks.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest besiege a city many days to prevail against it by war to take it, thou shalt not destroy its trees, by applying an iron tool to them, but thou shalt eat of it, and shalt not cut it down: Is the tree that is in the field a man, to enter before thee into the work of the siege?

fresh_translation: But a tree that you know is not for eating fruit, this you shall destroy and cut down, and you shall build siegeworks against the city that makes war against you until it is given up.
brenton_translation: But the tree which thou knowest to be not fruit-bearing, this thou shalt destroy and cut down; and thou shalt construct a mound against the city, which makes war against thee, until it be delivered up.

fresh_translation: And if a wounded man is found in the land that the Lord your God gives you to inherit, fallen in the field, and they do not know the one who struck him,
brenton_translation: And if one be found slain with the sword in the land, which the Lord thy God gives thee to inherit, having fallen in the field, and they do not know who has smitten him;

fresh_translation: then your elders and your judges shall come out and measure to the cities around the wounded man.
brenton_translation: thine elders and thy judges shall come forth, and shall measure the distances of the cities round about the slain man:

fresh_translation: And it shall be, the city nearest to the wounded man, the elders of that city shall take a heifer from the herd that has not been worked and has not drawn a yoke,
brenton_translation: and it shall be that the city which is nearest to the slain man the elders of that city shall take a heifer of the herd, which has not laboured, and which has not borne a yoke.

fresh_translation: and the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer into a rough ravine that has not been worked nor sown, and they shall hamstring the heifer in the ravine.
brenton_translation: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer into a rough valley, which has not been tilled and is not sown, and they shall slay the heifer in the valley.

fresh_translation: And the priests, the Levites, shall come near, because the Lord your God chose them to stand by him and bless in his name, and by their mouth shall be every dispute and every wound.
brenton_translation: And the priests the Levites shall come, because the Lord God has chosen them to stand by him, and to bless in his name, and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be decided.

fresh_translation: And all the elders of that city nearest to the wounded man shall wash their hands over the head of the heifer that was hamstrung in the ravine,
brenton_translation: And all the elders of that city who draw nigh to the slain man shall wash their hands over the head of the heifer which was slain in the valley;

fresh_translation: and answering they shall say, Our hands did not pour out this blood, and our eyes did not see.
brenton_translation: and they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, and our eyes have not seen it.

fresh_translation: Be merciful to your people Israel, whom you redeemed, O Lord, from the land of Egypt, so that innocent blood may not be among your people Israel, and the blood shall be atoned for them.
brenton_translation: Be merciful to thy people Israel, whom thou hast redeemed, O Lord, that innocent blood may not be charged on thy people Israel: and the blood shall be atoned for to them.

fresh_translation: And you shall remove innocent blood from among you if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take away innocent blood from among you, if thou shouldest do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And if, going out to war against your enemies, the Lord your God gives them into your hands, and you plunder their spoil,
brenton_translation: And if when thou goest out to war against thine enemies, the Lord thy God should deliver them into thine hands, and thou shouldest take their spoil,

fresh_translation: and you see in the spoil a woman beautiful in appearance and desire her and take her for yourself as a wife,
brenton_translation: and shouldest see among the spoil a woman beautiful in countenance, and shouldest desire her, and take her to thyself for a wife,

fresh_translation: then you shall bring her inside your house, and she shall shave her head and pare her nails,
brenton_translation: and shouldest bring her within thine house: then shalt thou shave her head, and pare her nails;

fresh_translation: and she shall remove the garments of her captivity from herself and sit in your house and mourn her father and her mother a full month, and after these things you shall go in to her and live with her, and she shall be your wife.
brenton_translation: and shalt take away her garments of captivity from off her, and she shall abide in thine house, and shall bewail her father and mother the days of a month; and afterwards thou shalt go in to her and dwell with her, and she shall be thy wife.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, if you do not want her, you shall send her away free, and she shall certainly not be sold for silver. You shall not treat her as nothing, because you humbled her.
brenton_translation: And it shall be if thou do not delight in her, thou shalt send her out free; and she shall not by any means be sold for money, thou shalt not treat her contemptuously, because thou hast humbled her.

fresh_translation: And if a man has two wives, one loved and one hated, and the loved and the hated bear children to him, and the firstborn son belongs to the hated one,
brenton_translation: And if a man have two wives, the one loved and the other hated, and both the loved and the hated should have born him children, and the son of the hated should be first-born;

fresh_translation: then it shall be, on the day he distributes his possessions to his sons, he shall not be able to give firstborn rights to the son of the loved one, overlooking the son of the hated one, the firstborn.
brenton_translation: then it shall be that whensoever he shall divide by inheritance his goods to his sons, he shall not be able to give the right of the first-born to the son of the loved one, having overlooked the son of the hated, which is the first-born.

fresh_translation: But he shall acknowledge the firstborn son of the hated one, to give him a double share from everything found with him, because this one is the beginning of his children, and to him belong the rights of the firstborn.
brenton_translation: But he shall acknowledge the first-born of the hated one to give to him double of all things which shall be found by him, because he is the first of his children, and to him belongs the birthright.

fresh_translation: And if a man has a disobedient and provoking son, not obeying the voice of his father and the voice of his mother, and they discipline him and he does not listen to them,
brenton_translation: And if any man has a disobedient and contentious son, who hearkens not to the voice of his father and the voice of his mother, and they should correct him, and he should not hearken to them;

fresh_translation: then his father and his mother, seizing him, shall bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place,
brenton_translation: then shall his father and his mother take hold of him, and bring him forth to the elders of his city, and to the gate of the place:

fresh_translation: and they shall say to the men of their city, This son of ours disobeys and provokes, he does not listen to our voice, he is a glutton and a drunkard.
brenton_translation: and they shall say to the men of their city, This our son is disobedient and contentious, he hearkens not to our voice, he is a reveller and a drunkard.

fresh_translation: And the men of his city shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, and you shall destroy the evil one from among you. And the rest, hearing, shall fear.
brenton_translation: And the men of his city shall stone him with stones, and he shall die; and thou shalt remove the evil one from yourselves, and the rest shall hear and fear.

fresh_translation: And if in someone there is a sin, a judgment of death, and he dies, and you hang him on a tree,
brenton_translation: And if there be sin in any one, and the judgment of death be upon him, and he be put to death, and ye hang him on a tree:

fresh_translation: his body shall not remain overnight on the tree, but burying you shall bury him on that day, because everyone hanging on a tree is cursed by God, and you shall not defile the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: his body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but ye shall by all means bury it in that day; for every one that is hanged on a tree is cursed of God; and ye shall by no means defile the land which the Lord thy God gives thee for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: Not seeing your brother's calf or his sheep wandering on the road shall you overlook them. Returning, you shall return them to your brother, and you shall give them back to him.
brenton_translation: When thou seest the calf of thy brother or his sheep wandering in the way, thou shalt not overlook them; thou shalt by all means turn them back to thy brother, and thou shalt restore them to him.

fresh_translation: And if your brother is not near you, nor do you know him, you shall gather them into your house, and they shall be with you until your brother seeks them, and you shall give them back to him.
brenton_translation: And if thy brother do not come nigh thee, and thou dost not know him, thou shalt bring it into thy house within; and it shall be with thee until thy brother shall seek them, and thou shalt restore them to him.

fresh_translation: Thus you shall do with his donkey, and thus you shall do with his garment, and thus you shall do with every loss of your brother, whatever may be lost from him and you find. You shall not be able to overlook it.
brenton_translation: Thus shalt thou do to his ass, and thus shalt thou do to his garment, and thus shalt thou do to every thing that thy brother has lost; whatsoever shall have been lost by him, and thou shalt have found, thou shalt not have power to overlook.

fresh_translation: You shall not see your brother's donkey or his calf fallen on the road and overlook them. Raising, you shall raise them with him.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not see the ass of thy brother, or his calf, fallen in the way: thou shalt not overlook them, thou shalt surely help him to raise them up.

fresh_translation: There shall not be a man's gear on a woman, nor shall a man put on a woman's clothing, because everyone doing these things is an abomination to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: The apparel of a man shall not be on a woman, neither shall a man put on a woman's dress; for every one that does these things is an abomination to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And if a brood of birds meets you on the road, or on any tree or on the ground, with chicks or eggs and the mother warming over the chicks or over the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the children.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest come upon a brood of birds before thy face in the way or upon any tree, or upon the earth, young or eggs, and the mother be brooding on the young or the eggs, thou shalt not take the dam with the young ones.

fresh_translation: Sending, you shall send away the mother, but the young you shall take for yourself, so that it may be well with you and you may be long-lived.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt by all means let the mother go, but thou shalt take the young to thyself; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest live long.

fresh_translation: And if you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof, and you shall not make bloodguilt in your house if the one falling falls from it.
brenton_translation: If thou shouldest build a new house, then shalt thou make a parapet to thy house; so thou shalt not bring blood-guiltiness upon thy house, if one should in any wise fall from it.

fresh_translation: You shall not sow your vineyard with diversity, lest the produce and the seed that you sow with the produce of your vineyard be made holy.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with diverse seed, lest the fruit be devoted, and whatsoever seed thou mayest sow, with the fruit of thy vineyard.

fresh_translation: You shall not plow with calf and donkey together.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not plough with an ox and an ass together.

fresh_translation: You shall not wear mixed fabric, wool and linen together.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not wear a mingled garment, woollen and linen together.

fresh_translation: You shall make twisted threads for yourself on the four corners of your cloaks with which you clothe yourself.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt make fringes on the four borders of thy garments, with which soever thou mayest be clothed.

fresh_translation: And if a man takes a wife and lives with her and then hates her,
brenton_translation: And if any one should take a wife, and dwell with her, and hate her,

fresh_translation: and places pretextual words against her and brings an evil name upon her and says, I took this woman, and after going in to her I did not find her virginity,
brenton_translation: and attach to her reproachful words, and bring against her an evil name, and say, I took this woman, and when I came to her I found not her tokens of virginity:

fresh_translation: then, taking the tokens of the girl's virginity, the father of the girl and the mother shall bring them out to the elders at the gate,
brenton_translation: then the father and the mother of the damsel shall take and bring out the damsel's tokens of virginity to the elders of the city to the gate.

fresh_translation: and the father of the girl shall say to the elders, I gave this daughter of mine to this man as a wife, and, having hated her,
brenton_translation: And the father of the damsel shall say to the elders, I gave this my daughter to this man for a wife;

fresh_translation: he now places pretextual words against her, saying, I did not find virginity for your daughter. And these are the girl's virginity. And they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city.
brenton_translation: and now he has hated her, and attaches reproachful words to her, saying, I have not found tokens of virginity with thy daughter; and these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall unfold the garment before the elders of the city.

fresh_translation: And the elders of that city shall take that man and discipline him,
brenton_translation: And the elders of that city shall take that man, and shall chastise him,

fresh_translation: and they shall fine him one hundred shekels and give them to the father of the young woman, because he brought an evil name upon a virgin of Israel, and she shall be his wife. He shall not be able to send her away all his time.
brenton_translation: and shall fine him a hundred shekels, and shall give them to the father of the damsel, because he has brought forth an evil name against a virgin of Israel; and she shall be his wife: he shall never be able to put her away.

fresh_translation: But if this matter truly happened and virginity was not found for the young woman,
brenton_translation: But if this report be true, and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel;

fresh_translation: then they shall bring the young woman out to the doors of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones, and she shall die, because she did folly among the sons of Israel, prostituting herself in her father's house. And you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: then shall they bring out the damsel to the doors of her father's house, and shall stone her with stones, and she shall die; because she has wrought folly among the children of Israel, to defile the house of her father by whoring: so thou shalt remove the evil one from among you.

fresh_translation: And if a man is found lying with a woman living with a husband, you shall kill them both, the man lying with the woman and the woman, and you shall destroy the evil one from Israel.
brenton_translation: And if a man be found lying with a woman married to a man, ye shall kill them both, the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou remove the wicked one out of Israel.

fresh_translation: And if there is a virgin girl betrothed to a man, and a man finding her in the city lies with her,
brenton_translation: And if there be a young damsel espoused to a man, and a man should have found her in the city and have lain with her;

fresh_translation: you shall bring them both out to the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones and die, the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he humbled his neighbor's wife. And you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: ye shall bring them both out to the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones, and they shall die; the damsel, because she cried not in the city; and the man, because he humbled his neighbour's spouse: so shalt thou remove the evil one from yourselves.

fresh_translation: But if a man finds the betrothed girl in the field and, forcing her, lies with her, you shall kill only the man lying with her.
brenton_translation: But if a man find in the field a damsel that is betrothed, and he should force her and lie with her, ye shall slay the man that lay with her only.

fresh_translation: And to the young woman you shall do nothing. The young woman has no sin worthy of death, because as when a man rises against his neighbor and murders his life, so is this matter,
brenton_translation: And the damsel has not committed a sin worthy of death; as if a man should rise up against his neighbour, and slay him, so is this thing;

fresh_translation: because he found her in the field. The betrothed young woman cried out, and there was no one to help her.
brenton_translation: because he found her in the field; the betrothed damsel cried, and there was none to help her.

fresh_translation: And if a man finds the virgin girl who is not betrothed and, forcing her, lies with her and they are found,
brenton_translation: And if any one should find a young virgin who has not been betrothed, and should force her and lie with her, and be found,

fresh_translation: then the man lying with her shall give the father of the young woman fifty silver didrachmas, and she shall be his wife, because he humbled her. He shall not be able to send her away all his time.
brenton_translation: the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the damsel fifty silver didrachms, and she shall be his wife, because he has humbled her; he shall never be able to put her away.

fresh_translation: A man shall not take his father's wife, and he shall not uncover his father's covering.
brenton_translation: A man shall not take his father's wife, and shall not uncover his father's skirt.

fresh_translation: One crushed in the testicles and one cut off shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.
brenton_translation: He that is fractured or mutilated in his private parts shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.

fresh_translation: One from a prostitute shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.
brenton_translation: One born of a harlot shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.

fresh_translation: An Ammonite and a Moabite shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, and even to the tenth generation he shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, even forever,
brenton_translation: The Ammanite and Moabite shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, even until the tenth generation he shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, even for ever:

fresh_translation: because they did not meet you with bread and water on the road when you came out from Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam son of Beor from Mesopotamia to curse you.
brenton_translation: because they met you not with bread and water by the way, when ye went out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Mesopotamia to curse thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God was not willing to listen to Balaam, and the Lord your God turned the curses into blessing, because the Lord your God loved you.
brenton_translation: But the Lord thy God would not hearken to Balaam; and the Lord thy God changed the curses into blessings, because the Lord thy God loved thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not greet them with peace, nor seek what benefits them, all your days forever.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not speak peaceably or profitably to them all thy days for ever.

fresh_translation: You shall not abhor an Idumean, because he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you became a resident in his land.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite, because he is thy brother; thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian, because thou wast a stranger in his land.

fresh_translation: If sons are born to them, the third generation shall enter into the assembly of the Lord.
brenton_translation: If sons be born to them, in the third generation they shall enter into the assembly of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if you go out to encamp against your enemies, you shall keep yourself from every evil word.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest go forth to engage with thine enemies, then thou shalt keep thee from every wicked thing.

fresh_translation: And if there is in you a man who is not clean from his night-flow, then he shall go outside the camp and shall not enter into the camp.
brenton_translation: If there should be in thee a man who is not clean by reason of his issue by night, then he shall go forth out of the camp, and he shall not enter into the camp.

fresh_translation: And it shall be toward evening, he shall wash his body with water, and when the sun has set he shall enter into the camp.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass toward evening he shall wash his body with water, and when the sun has gone down, he shall go into the camp.

fresh_translation: And a place shall be for you outside the camp, and you shall go out there,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt have a place outside of the camp, and thou shalt go out thither,

fresh_translation: and a peg shall be for you on your belt, and it shall be, when you sit outside, then you shall dig with it and, turning back, you shall cover your indecency with it.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt have a trowel on thy girdle; and it shall come to pass when thou wouldest relieve thyself abroad, that thou shalt dig with it, and shalt bring back the earth and cover thy nuisance.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord your God walks about in your camp to deliver you and hand over your enemy before your face, and your camp shall be holy, and indecency of a matter shall not be seen in you, and he shall turn away from you.
brenton_translation: Because the Lord thy God walks in thy camp to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemy before thy face; and thy camp shall be holy, and there shall not appear in thee a disgraceful thing, and so he shall turn away from thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not hand over a servant to his master who has been added to you from his master.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not deliver a servant to his master, who coming from his master attaches himself to thee.

fresh_translation: With you he shall dwell, among you he shall dwell, in every place that pleases him. You shall not afflict him.
brenton_translation: He shall dwell with thee, he shall dwell among you where he shall please; thou shalt not afflict him.
