fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Rise. Why have you fallen like this on your face?
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Rise up; why hast thou fallen upon thy face?

fresh_translation: The people have sinned and transgressed the covenant that I covenanted with them, and, stealing from the devoted thing, they put it into their vessels.
brenton_translation: The people has sinned, and transgressed the covenant which I made with them; they have stolen from the cursed thing, and put it into their store.

fresh_translation: The sons of Israel will certainly not be able to stand against the face of their enemies. They will turn neck before their enemies, because they have become a devoted thing. I will not add to be with you any longer unless you remove the devoted thing from among you.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel will not be able to stand before their enemies; they will turn their back before their enemies, for they have become an accursed thing: I will not any longer be with you, unless ye remove the cursed thing from yourselves.

fresh_translation: Rise, sanctify the people and tell them to sanctify themselves for tomorrow. These things says the Lord God of Israel: The devoted thing is among you. You will not be able to stand before your enemies until you remove the devoted thing from among you.
brenton_translation: Rise, sanctify the people and tell them to sanctify themselves for the morrow: thus says the Lord God of Israel, The accursed thing is among you; ye shall not be able to stand before your enemies, until ye shall have removed the cursed thing from among you.

fresh_translation: And you shall be gathered in the morning by tribes, and it shall be, the tribe that the Lord points out, you shall bring by clans, and the clan that the Lord points out, you shall bring by house, and the house that the Lord points out, you shall bring by man.
brenton_translation: And ye shall all be gathered together by your tribes in the morning, and it shall come to pass that the tribe which the Lord shall shew, ye shall bring by families; and the family which the Lord shall shew, ye shall bring by households; and the household which the Lord shall shew, ye shall bring man by man.

fresh_translation: And whoever is pointed out shall be burned with fire, he and everything that belongs to him, because he transgressed the covenant of the Lord and did lawless deed in Israel.
brenton_translation: And the man who shall be pointed out, shall be burnt with fire, and all that he has; because he has transgressed the covenant of the Lord, and has wrought wickedness in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Joshua rose early and brought the people by tribes, and the tribe of Judah was pointed out.
brenton_translation: And Joshua rose up early, and brought the people by their tribes; and the tribe of Juda was pointed out.

fresh_translation: And it was brought by clans, and the clan of Zara was pointed out and brought by man.
brenton_translation: And it was brought by their families, and the family of the Zaraites was pointed out.

fresh_translation: And Achar son of Zambri son of Zara was pointed out.
brenton_translation: And it was brought man by man, and Achar the son of Zambri the son of Zara was pointed out.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to Achar, Give glory today to the Lord God of Israel and give confession, and report to me what you did, and do not hide it from me.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to Achar, Give glory this day to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession; and tell me what thou hast done, and hide it not from me.

fresh_translation: And Achar answered Joshua and said, Truly I sinned before the Lord God of Israel. Thus and thus I did.
brenton_translation: And Achar answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel: thus and thus have I done:

fresh_translation: I saw in the spoil a fine variegated cloak and two hundred silver didrachmas and one golden tongue of fifty didrachmas, and desiring them I took them. And behold, they are hidden in the ground in my tent, and the silver is hidden underneath them.
brenton_translation: I saw in the spoil an embroidered mantle, and two hundred didrachms of silver, and one golden wedge of fifty didrachms, and I desired them and took them; and, behold, they are hid in my tent, and the silver is hid under them.

fresh_translation: And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran into the tent in the camp, and these things were hidden in the tent, and the silver underneath them.
brenton_translation: And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent into the camp; and these things were hidden in his tent, and the silver under them.

fresh_translation: And they brought them out from the tent and carried them to Joshua and the elders of Israel and placed them before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they brought them out of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and the elders of Israel, and they laid them before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Joshua took Achar son of Zara and brought him up to the Valley of Achor, and his sons and his daughters and his calves and his beasts of burden and all his sheep and his tent and all his possessions, and all the people with him, and they brought them up to Emekachor.
brenton_translation: And Joshua took Achar the son of Zara, and brought him to the valley of Achor, and his sons, and his daughters, and his calves, and his asses, and all his sheep, and his tent, and all his property, and all the people were with him; and he brought them to Emec Achor.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to Achar, Why did you destroy us? May the Lord destroy you, just as also today. And all Israel stoned him with stones.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to Achar, Why hast thou destroyed us? the Lord destroy thee as at this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones.

fresh_translation: And they raised over him a great heap of stones, and the Lord ceased from the wrath of anger. Because of this he named it Emekachor until this day.
brenton_translation: And they set up over him a great heap of stones; and the Lord ceased from his fierce anger. Therefore he called the place Emecachor until this day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Do not fear, nor be cowardly. Take with you all the warriors, and rising, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hands the king of Ai and his land.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Fear not, nor be timorous: take with thee all the men of war, and arise, go up to Gai; behold, I have given into thy hands the king of Gai, and his land.

fresh_translation: And you shall do to Ai in the way you did to Jericho and its king, except its spoil and cattle you shall plunder for yourself. But set for yourself an ambush behind the city.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt do to Gai, as thou didst to Jericho and its king; and thou shalt take to thyself the spoil of its cattle; set now for thyself an ambush for the city behind.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all the warrior people rose to go up to Ai, and Joshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty in strength, and sent them by night.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all the men of war rose to go up to Gai; and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men, and he sent them away by night.

fresh_translation: And he commanded them, saying, You lie in ambush behind the city. Do not be far from the city, and all of you be ready.
brenton_translation: And he charged them, saying, Do ye lie in ambush behind the city: do not go far from the city, and ye shall all be ready.

fresh_translation: And I and all those with me will come near the city, and it shall be, when those dwelling in Ai come out to meet us, just as also before, then we shall flee from before their face.
brenton_translation: And I and all with me will draw near to the city: and it shall come to pass when the inhabitants of Gai shall come forth to meet us, as before, that we will flee from before them.

fresh_translation: And when they come out behind us, we will draw them away from the city, and they will say, These flee from before us, just as also before.
brenton_translation: And when they shall come out after us, we will draw them away from the city; and they will say, These men flee from before us, as also before.

fresh_translation: But you shall rise from the ambush and go into the city.
brenton_translation: And ye shall rise up out of the ambuscade, and go into the city.

fresh_translation: According to this word you shall do. Behold, I have commanded you.
brenton_translation: Ye shall do according to this word, lo! I have commanded you.

fresh_translation: And Joshua sent them, and they went into the ambush and sat between Bethel and Ai, west of Ai.
brenton_translation: And Joshua sent them, and they went to lie in ambush; and they lay between Bæthel and Gai, westward of Gai.

fresh_translation: And Joshua rose early in the morning and inspected the people, and he and the elders went up before the face of the people toward Ai.
brenton_translation: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people; and he went up, he and the elders before the people to Gai.

fresh_translation: And all the warrior people with him went up, and going they came opposite the city from the east.
brenton_translation: And all the men of war went up with him, and they went forward and came over against the city eastward.

fresh_translation: And the ambush of the city was from the west.
brenton_translation: And the ambuscade was on the west side of the city.

fresh_translation: And it happened, when the king of Ai saw, he hurried and went out to meet them straight for battle, he and all the people with him, and he did not know that there was an ambush behind the city against him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the king of Gai saw it, he hasted and went out to meet them direct to the battle, he and all the people that were with him: and he knew not that there was an ambuscade formed against him behind the city.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and Israel saw and withdrew from before their face.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and Israel saw, and retreated from before them.

fresh_translation: And they pursued behind the sons of Israel, and they were drawn away from the city.
brenton_translation: And they pursued after the children of Israel, and they themselves went to a distance from the city.

fresh_translation: No one was left in Ai who did not pursue behind Israel, and they left the city open and pursued behind Israel.
brenton_translation: There was no one left in Gai who did not pursue after Israel; and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Stretch out your hand with the spear that is in your hand toward the city, because I have delivered it into your hands. And the ambush will rise up quickly from its place. And Joshua stretched out his hand, the spear, toward the city.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Stretch forth thy hand with the spear that is in thy hand toward the city, for I have delivered it into thy hands; and the liers in wait shall rise up quickly out of their place.

fresh_translation: And the ambush rose up quickly from its place and came out when he stretched out his hand, and they came against the city and seized it, and hurrying they burned the city with fire.
brenton_translation: And Joshua stretched out his hand and his spear toward the city, and the ambuscade rose up quickly out of their place; and they came forth when he stretched out his hand; and they entered into the city, and took it; and they hasted and burnt the city with fire.

fresh_translation: And the inhabitants of Ai, looking around behind them, were seeing smoke going up from the city into heaven, and they no longer had where to flee here or there.
brenton_translation: And when the inhabitants of Gai looked round behind them, then they saw the smoke going up out of the city to heaven, and they were no longer able to flee this way or that way.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that the smoke of the city had gone up into heaven, and turning around they struck the men of Ai.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambuscade had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city went up to heaven; and they turned and smote the men of Gai.

fresh_translation: And these came out from the city to meet them, and they came to be in the midst of the camp, these from here and those from there, and they struck until none of them was left saved or escaped.
brenton_translation: And these came forth out of the city to meet them; and they were in the midst of the army, some being on this side, and some on that; and they smote them until there was not left of them one who survived and escaped.

fresh_translation: And they seized the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
brenton_translation: And they took the king of Gai alive, and brought him to Joshua.

fresh_translation: And when the sons of Israel stopped killing all those in Ai, those in the plains and in the mountain on the descent, where they pursued them from it to the end, then Joshua returned to Ai and struck it by the mouth of the sword.
brenton_translation: And when the children of Israel had ceased slaying all that were in Gai, and in the fields, and in the mountain on the descent, from whence they pursued them even to the end, then Joshua returned to Gai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

fresh_translation: And those who fell on that day, from man to woman, were twelve thousand, all those dwelling in Ai.
brenton_translation: And they that fell in that day, men and women, were twelve thousand: they slew all the inhabitants of Gai.

fresh_translation: Except the cattle and the spoils in the city, everything that the sons of Israel plundered according to the command of the Lord, in the way the Lord ordered Joshua.
brenton_translation: Beside the spoils that were in the city, all things which the children of Israel took as spoil for themselves according to the command of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Joshua.

fresh_translation: And Joshua burned the city with fire and made it an uninhabited mound forever, until this day.
brenton_translation: And Joshua burnt the city with fire: he made it an uninhabited heap for ever, even to this day.

fresh_translation: And the king of Ai he hung on a forked tree, and he was on the tree until evening, and when the sun set Joshua ordered and they took his body down from the tree and threw it into the pit and raised over him a heap of stones until this day.
brenton_translation: And he hanged the king of Gai on a gallows; and he remained on the tree till evening: and when the sun went down, Joshua gave charge, and they took down his body from the tree, and cast it into a pit, and they set over him a heap of stones until this day.

fresh_translation: And as the kings of the Amorites in the beyond of the Jordan heard, those in the hill country and those in the plain and those on all the coast of the great sea and those by Anti-Lebanon, the Hittites and Canaanites and Pherezites and Hivites and Amorites and Gergesites and Jebusites,
brenton_translation: And when the kings of the Amorites on the other side of Jordan, who were in the mountain country, and in the plain, and in all the coast of the great sea, and those who were near Antilibanus, and the Chettites, and the Chananites, and the Pherezites, and the Evites, and the Amorites, and the Gergesites, and the Jebusites, heard of it,

fresh_translation: they came all together at the same time to make war against Joshua and Israel.
brenton_translation: they came all together at the same time to make war against Joshua and Israel.

fresh_translation: And those dwelling in Gibeon heard everything that the Lord did to Jericho and Ai,
brenton_translation: And the inhabitants of Gabaon heard of all that the Lord did to Jericho and Gai.

fresh_translation: and they themselves also acted with cunning, and going they prepared provisions and made ready, and taking old sacks on their donkeys and old wine skins, torn and tied up,
brenton_translation: And they also wrought craftily, and they went and made provision and prepared themselves; and having taken old sacks on their shoulders, and old and rent and patched bottles of wine,

fresh_translation: and their sandals were old and worn through in their feet, and their garments were worn out on them, and the bread of their provisions was dry and moldy and eaten.
brenton_translation: and the upper part of their shoes and their sandals old and clouted on their feet, and their garments old upon them—and the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy and corrupt.

fresh_translation: And they came to Joshua at the camp of Israel in Galgala and said to Joshua and Israel, We have come from a land far away, and now make a covenant with us.
brenton_translation: And they came to Joshua into the camp of Israel to Galgala, and said to Joshua and Israel, We are come from a far land: now then make a covenant with us.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel said to the Horite, See, perhaps you dwell among me, and how shall I make a covenant with you?
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel said to the Chorrhæan, Peradventure thou dwellest amongst us; and how should I make a covenant with thee?

fresh_translation: And they said to Joshua, We are your servants. And Joshua said to them, Who are you, and from where have you come?
brenton_translation: And they said to Joshua, We are thy servants: and Joshua said to them, Whence are ye, and whence have ye come?

fresh_translation: And they said, Your servants have come from a very distant land in the name of the Lord your God, for we heard his name and everything that he did in Egypt,
brenton_translation: And they said, Thy servants are come from a very far country in the name of the Lord thy God: for we have heard his name, and all that he did in Egypt,

fresh_translation: and everything that he did to the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who dwelt in Astaroth and in Edrain.
brenton_translation: and all that he did to the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond Jordan, to Seon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Basan, who dwelt in Astaroth and in Edrain.

fresh_translation: And hearing, our elders and all those dwelling in our land said to us, saying, Take provisions for yourselves for the road and go to meet them and say to them, We are your servants, and now make a covenant with us.
brenton_translation: And our elders and all that inhabit our land when they heard spoke to us, saying, Take to yourselves provision for the way, and go to meet them; and ye shall say to them, We are thy servants, and now make a covenant with us.

fresh_translation: These breads, hot, we provisioned them on the day when we went out to come to you, but now they are dried out and have become eaten.
brenton_translation: These are the loaves—we took them hot for our journey on the day on which we came out to come to you; and now they are dried and become mouldy.

fresh_translation: And these wine skins that we filled new, these have burst, and our garments and our sandals have worn out because of the very long road.
brenton_translation: And these are the skins of wine which we filled when new, and they are rent; and our garments and our shoes are worn out because of the very long journey.

fresh_translation: And the leaders took from their provisions and did not ask the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the chiefs took of their provision, and asked not counsel of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Joshua made peace with them and covenanted with them to keep them alive, and the leaders of the assembly swore to them.
brenton_translation: And Joshua made peace with them, and they made a covenant with them to preserve them; and the princes of the congregation sware to them.

fresh_translation: And it happened after three days after making covenant with them that they heard that they are near them and dwell among them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were near neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel set out and came to their cities, and their cities were Gibeon and Kephira and Beeroth and City of Jarin.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel departed and came to their cities; and their cities were Gabaon, and Kephira, and Berot, and the cities of Jarin.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did not fight them, because all the leaders swore to them by the Lord God of Israel, and all the assembly grumbled against the leaders.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel fought not with them, because all the princes sware to them by the Lord God of Israel; and all the congregation murmured at the princes.

fresh_translation: And the leaders said to all the assembly, We swore to them by the Lord God of Israel, and now we cannot touch them.
brenton_translation: And the princes said to all the congregation: We have sworn to them by the Lord God of Israel, and now we shall not be able to touch them.

fresh_translation: This we will do: keep them alive and preserve them, and wrath shall not be against us because of the oath that we swore to them.
brenton_translation: This we will do; take them alive, and we will preserve them: so there shall not be wrath against us by reason of the oath which we swore to them.

fresh_translation: They shall live and shall be woodcutters and water carriers for all the assembly, just as the leaders said to them.
brenton_translation: They shall live, and shall be hewers of wood and drawers of water to all the congregation, as the princes said to them.

fresh_translation: And Joshua summoned them and said to them, Why did you deceive me, saying, We are very far from you, while you are locals from those dwelling among us?
brenton_translation: And Joshua called them together and said to them, Why have ye deceived me, saying, We live very far from you; whereas ye are fellow-countrymen of those who dwell among us?

fresh_translation: And now cursed are you. From you servant shall certainly not fail, nor woodcutter for me and for my God.
brenton_translation: And now ye are cursed: there shall not fail of you a slave, or a hewer of wood, or a drawer of water to me and my God.

fresh_translation: And they answered Joshua, saying, It was reported to us what the Lord your God ordered Moses his servant, to give you this land and utterly destroy us and all those dwelling on it from before your face, and we feared greatly for our lives from before you and did this thing.
brenton_translation: And they answered Joshua, saying, It was reported to us what the Lord thy God charged his servant Moses, to give you this land, and to destroy us and all that dwelt on it from before you; and we feared very much for our lives because of you, and therefore we did this thing.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, we are under your hand. As it pleases you and as it seems good to you, do to us.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, we are in your power; do to us as it is pleasing to you, and as it seems good to you.

fresh_translation: And they did thus to them, and Joshua rescued them on that day from the hands of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them.
brenton_translation: And they did so to them; and Joshua rescued them in that day out of the hands of the children of Israel, and they did not slay them.

fresh_translation: And Joshua made them on that day woodcutters and water carriers for all the assembly and for the altar of God. Because of this those dwelling in Gibeon became woodcutters and water carriers for the altar of God until this day and for the place that the Lord may choose.
brenton_translation: And Joshua made them in that day hewers of wood and drawers of water to the whole congregation, and for the altar of God: therefore the inhabitants of Gabaon became hewers of wood and drawers of water for the altar of God until this day, even for the place which the Lord should choose.

fresh_translation: And when Adonibezek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua took Ai and utterly destroyed it, in the way they did Jericho and its king, thus they did Ai and its king, and that those dwelling in Gibeon defected to Joshua and to Israel,
brenton_translation: And when Adoni-bezec king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Gai, and had destroyed it, as he did to Jericho and its king, even so they did to Gai and its king, and that the inhabitants of Gabaon had gone over to Joshua and Israel;

fresh_translation: then they feared greatly among them, for they knew that Gibeon is a great city, like one of the metropolises, and all its men are strong.
brenton_translation: then they were greatly terrified by them, for the king knew that Gabaon was a great city, as one of the chief cities, and all its men were mighty.

fresh_translation: And Adonibezek king of Jerusalem sent to Ailam king of Hebron and to Phidon king of Jerimoth and to Jeptha king of Lachish and to Dabir king of Odollam, saying,
brenton_translation: So Adoni-bezec king of Jerusalem sent to Elam king of Hebron, and to Phidon king of Jerimuth, and to Jephtha king of Lachis, and to Dabin king of Odollam, saying,

fresh_translation: Come up to me and help me, and let us war against Gibeon, because they defected to Joshua and to the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: Come up hither to me, and help me, and let us take Gabaon; for the Gabaonites have gone over to Joshua and to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the five kings of the Jebusites went up, king of Jerusalem and king of Hebron and king of Jerimoth and king of Lachish and king of Odollam, they and all their people, and they besieged Gibeon and were besieging it.
brenton_translation: And the five kings of the Jebusites went up, the king of Jerusalem, and the king of Chebron, and the king of Jerimuth, and the king of Lachis, and the king of Odollam, they and all their people; and encamped around Gabaon, and besieged it.

fresh_translation: And those dwelling in Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp of Israel in Galgala, saying, Do not let your hands grow weak from your servants. Come up to us quickly and rescue us and help us, because all the kings of the Amorites dwelling in the hill country are gathered against us.
brenton_translation: And the inhabitants of Gabaon sent to Joshua into the camp to Galgala, saying, Slack not thy hands from thy servants: come up quickly to us, and help us, and rescue us; for all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the hill country are gathered together against us.

fresh_translation: And Joshua went up from Galgala, he and all the warrior people with him, every strong one in might.
brenton_translation: And Joshua went up from Galgala, he and all the people of war with him, every one mighty in strength.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Do not fear them, because I have delivered them into your hands. None of them shall be left before you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Fear them not, for I have delivered them into thy hands; there shall not one of them be left before you.

fresh_translation: And Joshua came upon them suddenly; all the night he marched in from Galgala.
brenton_translation: And when Joshua came suddenly upon them, he had advanced all the night out of Galgala.

fresh_translation: And the Lord amazed them from before the sons of Israel and crushed them with a great crushing in Gibeon, and they pursued them on the road of the ascent of Horonin and were cutting them down as far as Azeka and as far as Makkeda.
brenton_translation: And the Lord struck them with terror before the children of Israel; and the Lord destroyed them with a great slaughter at Gabaon; and they pursued them by the way of the going up of Oronin, and they smote them to Azeca and to Makeda.

fresh_translation: And as they fled from before the sons of Israel on the descent of Horonin, the Lord threw on them hailstones from heaven as far as Azeka, and those who died through the hailstones became more than those whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword in the war.
brenton_translation: And when they fled from the face of the children of Israel at the descent of Oronin, then the Lord cast upon them hailstones from heaven to Azeca; and they were more that died by the hailstones, than those whom the children of Israel slew with the sword in the battle.

fresh_translation: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord on the day when God delivered the Amorite under the hands of Israel, when he crushed them in Gibeon and they were crushed from before the sons of Israel, and Joshua said, Let the sun stand over Gibeon, and the moon over the valley of Ailon.
brenton_translation: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord, in the day in which the Lord delivered the Amorite into the power of Israel, when he destroyed them in Gabaon, and they were destroyed from before the children of Israel: and Joshua said, Let the sun stand over against Gabaon, and the moon over against the valley of Ælon.

fresh_translation: And the sun stood, and the moon stood in place, until God defended their enemies. And the sun stood in the midst of heaven; it did not go forward to the setting, to the end of one day.
brenton_translation: And the sun and the moon stood still, until God executed vengeance on their enemies; and the sun stood still in the midst of heaven; it did not proceed to set till the end of one day.

fresh_translation: And there was no day like this, neither before nor after, for God to hear a human, because the Lord fought together with Israel.
brenton_translation: And there was not such a day either before or after, so that God should hearken to a man, because the Lord fought on the side of Israel.

fresh_translation: And these five kings fled and hid in the cave in Makkeda.
brenton_translation: And these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave that is in Makeda.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Joshua, saying, The five kings have been found hidden in the cave in Makkeda.
brenton_translation: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings have been found hid in the cave that is in Makeda.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said, Roll stones onto the mouth of the cave and appoint men to guard over them.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said, Roll stones to the mouth of the cave, and set men to watch over them.

fresh_translation: But you, do not stand still; pursue behind your enemies and seize their rear, and do not let them enter into their cities, because the Lord our God has delivered them into our hands.
brenton_translation: But do not ye stand, but pursue after your enemies, and attack the rear of them, and do not suffer them to enter into their cities; for the Lord our God has delivered them into our hands.

fresh_translation: And it happened, when Joshua and every son of Israel stopped cutting them down with a very great slaughter to the end, and those being saved were saved into the fortified cities,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Joshua and all Israel ceased destroying them utterly with a very great slaughter, that they that escaped took refuge in the strong cities.

fresh_translation: then all the people returned to Joshua at Makkeda unharmed, and none of the sons of Israel so much as growled with his tongue.
brenton_translation: And all the people returned safe to Joshua to Makeda; and no one of the children of Israel murmured with his tongue.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said, Open the cave and bring out these five kings to me from the cave.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said, Open the cave, and bring out these five kings out of the cave.

fresh_translation: And they brought out the five kings from the cave, the king of Jerusalem and the king of Hebron and the king of Jerimoth and the king of Lachish and the king of Odollam.
brenton_translation: And they brought out the five kings out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, and the king of Chebron, and the king of Jerimuth, and the king of Lachis, and the king of Odollam.

fresh_translation: And when they brought them out to Joshua, Joshua called all Israel and the leaders of the war who went with him, saying to them, Come forward and put your feet on their necks. And coming forward, they put their feet on their necks.
brenton_translation: And when they brought them out to Joshua, then Joshua called together all Israel, and the chiefs of the army that went with him, saying to them, Come forward and set your feet on their necks; and they came and set their feet on their necks.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to them, Do not fear them, nor be cowardly. Act like men and be strong, because thus the Lord will do to all your enemies against whom you make war.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to them, Do not fear them, neither be cowardly; be courageous and strong, for thus the Lord will do to all your enemies, against whom ye fight.

fresh_translation: And Joshua killed them and hanged them on five trees, and they were hanging on the trees until evening.
brenton_translation: And Joshua slew them, and hanged them on five trees; and they hung upon the trees until the evening.

fresh_translation: And it happened toward sunset that Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave into which they fled there, and rolled stones onto the cave until this day.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass toward the setting of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees, and cast them into the cave into which they had fled for refuge, and rolled stones to the cave, which remain till this day.

fresh_translation: And they took Makkeda on that day and killed it with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed every breathing thing in it, and no one was left in it who was saved and escaped, and they did to the king of Makkeda in the way they did to the king of Jericho.
brenton_translation: And they took Makeda on that day, and slew the inhabitants with the edge of the sword, and they utterly destroyed every living thing that was in it; and there was none left in it that was preserved and had escaped; and they did to the king of Makeda, as they did to the king of Jericho.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him went from Makkeda to Lebna and besieged Lebna.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him departed out of Makeda to Lebna, and besieged Lebna.

fresh_translation: And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel, and they took it and its king and killed it with the edge of the sword and every breathing thing in it, and no one was left in it, not one saved and escaped, and they did to its king in the way they did to the king of Jericho.
brenton_translation: And the Lord delivered it into the hands of Israel: and they took it, and its king, and slew the inhabitants with the edge of the sword, and every thing breathing in it; and there was not left in it any that survived and escaped; and they did to its king, as they did to the king of Jericho.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him went from Lebna to Lachish and besieged it and were besieging it.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him departed from Lebna to Lachis, and he encamped about it, and besieged it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel, and he took it on the second day and killed it with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed it in the way they did to Lebna.
brenton_translation: And the Lord delivered Lachis into the hands of Israel; and they took it on the second day, and they put the inhabitants to death with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed it, as they had done to Lebna.

fresh_translation: Then Ailam king of Gazer went up to help Lachish, and Joshua struck him with the edge of the sword, him and his people, until none of them were left saved and escaped.
brenton_translation: Then Elam the king of Gazer went up to help Lachis; and Joshua smote him and his people with the edge of the sword, until there was not left to him one that was preserved and escaped.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him went from Lachish to Odollam and besieged it and were besieging it.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him departed from Lachis to Odollam, and he besieged it and took it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel, and he took it on that day and killed it with the edge of the sword, and every breathing thing in it they killed in the way they did to Lachish.
brenton_translation: And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel; and he took it on that day, and slew the inhabitants with the edge of the sword, and slew every thing breathing in it, as they did to Lachis.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him went to Hebron and besieged it.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all Israel with him departed to Chebron, and encamped about it.

fresh_translation: And he struck it with the edge of the sword and every breathing thing that was in it; there was no one saved, in the way they did to Odollam. They utterly destroyed it and everything that was in it.
brenton_translation: And he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the living creatures that were in it; there was no one preserved: they destroyed it and all things in it, as they did to Odollam.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all Israel turned back to Dabir and besieged it,
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all Israel returned to Dabir; and they encamped about it;

fresh_translation: and they took it and its king and its villages and struck it with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed it and every breathing thing in it, and they did not leave in it any saved one, in the way they did to Hebron and its king, so they did to Dabir and its king.
brenton_translation: and they took it, and its king, and its villages: and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and they destroyed it, and every thing breathing in it; and they did not leave in it any one that was preserved: as they did to Chebron and her king, so they did to Dabir and her king.

fresh_translation: And Joshua struck all the land, the hill country and the Negeb and the plain and the Asedoth and their kings. He left no saved one among them, and every breathing life he utterly destroyed, in the way the Lord God of Israel commanded.
brenton_translation: And Joshua smote all the land of the hill country, and Nageb and the plain country, and Asedoth, and her kings, they did not leave of them one that was saved: and they utterly destroyed every thing that had the breath of life, as the Lord God of Israel commanded,

fresh_translation: From Kadesh-Barnea as far as Gaza, all Gosom as far as Gibeon.
brenton_translation: from Cades Barne to Gaza, all Gosom, as far as Gabaon.

fresh_translation: And all their kings and their land Joshua struck at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought together with Israel.
brenton_translation: And Joshua smote, once for all, all their kings, and their land, because the Lord God of Israel fought on the side of Israel.

fresh_translation: And when Jabin king of Hasor heard, he sent to Jobab king of Marron and to the king of Symoon and to king Aziph,
brenton_translation: And when Jabis the king of Asor heard, he sent to Jobab king of Maron, and to the king of Symoön, and to the king of Aziph,

fresh_translation: and to the kings near great Sidon in the hill country and in the Raba opposite Keneroth and in the plain and in Napheddor,
brenton_translation: and to the kings who were by the great Sidon, to the hill country and to Araba opposite Keneroth, and to the plain, and to Phenaeddor,

fresh_translation: and to the coastal Canaanites from the east and to the coastal Amorites and Hivites and Jebusites and Pherezites in the mountain and the Hittites under Hermon in the land of Massipha.
brenton_translation: and to the Chananites on the coast eastward, and to the Amorites on the coast, and the Chettites, and the Pherezites, and the Jebusites in the mountain, and the Evites, and those dwelling under mount Aermon in the land Massyma.

fresh_translation: And they went out, they and their kings with them, like the sand of the sea in multitude, and horses and very many chariots.
brenton_translation: And they and their kings with them went forth, as the sand of the sea in multitude, and horses, and very many chariots.

fresh_translation: And all these kings gathered and came together and camped by the water of Marron to make war against Israel.
brenton_translation: And all the kings assembled in person, and came to the same place, and encamped at the waters of Maron to war with Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Do not fear from before them, because tomorrow at this hour I am delivering them routed before Israel. Their horses you shall hamstring, and their chariots you shall burn with fire.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Be not afraid of them, for to-morrow at this time I will put them to flight before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

fresh_translation: And Joshua and all the warrior people came upon them at the water of Marron suddenly and fell upon them in the hill country.
brenton_translation: And Joshua and all the men of war came upon them at the water of Maron suddenly; and they attacked them in the hill country.

fresh_translation: And the Lord delivered them under the hands of Israel, and as they struck them they pursued them as far as great Sidon and as far as Maserom and as far as the plains of Massoch toward the east, and they cut them down until none of them was left saved.
brenton_translation: And the Lord delivered them into the power of Israel; and they smote them and pursued them to great Sidon, and to Maseron, and to the plains of Massoch eastward; and they destroyed them till there was not one of them left that survived.

fresh_translation: And Joshua did to them in the way the Lord commanded him: their horses he hamstrung, and their chariots he burned with fire.
brenton_translation: And Joshua did to them, as the Lord commanded him: he houghed their horses, and burned their chariots with fire.

fresh_translation: And Joshua turned back at that time and took Hasor, and its king, for Hasor was formerly ruling all these kingdoms.
brenton_translation: And Joshua returned at that time, and took Asor and her king; now Asor in former time was the chief of these kingdoms.

fresh_translation: And they killed every breathing thing in it with the sword and utterly destroyed all, and no breathing thing was left in it, and they burned Hasor with fire.
brenton_translation: And they slew with the sword all that breathed in it, and utterly destroyed them all, and there was no living thing left in it; and they burnt Asor with fire.

fresh_translation: And Joshua took all the cities of the kings and their kings, and killed them with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed them in the way Moses servant of the Lord commanded.
brenton_translation: And Joshua took all the cities of the kingdoms, and their kings, and slew them with the edge of the sword; and utterly slew them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.

fresh_translation: But all the cities that had been mounded up Israel did not burn, except Hasor alone Joshua burned.
brenton_translation: But all the walled cities Israel burnt not; but Israel burnt Asor only.

fresh_translation: And all their spoil the sons of Israel plundered for themselves, but them all they utterly destroyed with the edge of the sword until he destroyed them; they left none of them, not one breathing thing.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel took all its spoils to themselves; and they slew all the men with the edge of the sword, until he destroyed them; they left not one of them breathing.

fresh_translation: In the way the Lord ordered Moses his servant, and Moses likewise commanded Joshua, so Joshua did. He did not transgress anything from all that Moses ordered him.
brenton_translation: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, even so Moses commanded Joshua; and so Joshua did, he transgressed no precept of all that Moses commanded him.

fresh_translation: And Joshua took all the land, the hill country and all the Negeb and all the land of Gosom and the plain and the western region and the mountain of Israel and its lowlands,
brenton_translation: And Joshua took all the hill country, and all the land of Nageb, and all the land of Gosom, and the plain country, and that toward the west, and the mountain of Israel and the low country by the mountain;

fresh_translation: from near Mount Achel and what rises to Seir and as far as Baalgad and the plains of Lebanon under Mount Hermon, and he took all their kings and killed them.
brenton_translation: from the mountain of Chelcha, and that which goes up to Seir, and as far as Balagad, and the plains of Libanus, under mount Aermon; and he took all their kings, and destroyed, and slew them.

fresh_translation: And Joshua made war with these kings many days.
brenton_translation: And for many days Joshua waged war with these kings.

fresh_translation: And there was no city that Israel did not take; they took all in war.
brenton_translation: And there was no city which Israel took not; they took all in war.

fresh_translation: Because from the Lord it came to strengthen their heart to meet in war against Israel, so that they might be utterly destroyed, so that no mercy might be given to them, but so that they might be utterly destroyed in the way the Lord said to Moses.
brenton_translation: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts to go forth to war against Israel, that they might be utterly destroyed, that mercy should not be granted to them, but that they should be utterly destroyed, as the Lord said to Moses.

fresh_translation: And Joshua came at that time and utterly destroyed the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron and from Dabir and from Anaboth and from all the race of Israel and from all the mountain of Judah; Joshua utterly destroyed them together with their cities.
brenton_translation: And Joshua came at that time, and utterly destroyed the Enakim out of the hill country, from Chebron and from Dabir, and from Anaboth, and from all the race of Israel, and from all the mountain of Juda with their cities; and Joshua utterly destroyed them.

fresh_translation: None of the Anakim were left among the sons of Israel, except in Gaza and in Geth and in Asedoth they were left.
brenton_translation: There was not any one left of the Enakim by the children of Israel, only there was left of them in Gaza, and in Gath, and in Aseldo.

fresh_translation: And Joshua took all the land, just as the Lord commanded Moses, and Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel in division according to their tribes, and the land rested from war.
brenton_translation: And Joshua took all the land, as the Lord commanded Moses; and Joshua gave them for an inheritance to Israel by division according to their tribes; and the land ceased from war.

fresh_translation: And these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel killed, and they inherited their land beyond the Jordan from the sunrise, from the ravine of Arnon as far as Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah from the east:
brenton_translation: And these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel slew, and inherited their land beyond Jordan from the east, from the valley of Arnon to the mount of Aermon, and all the land of Araba on the east.

fresh_translation: Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, ruling from Aroer which is in the ravine, from the middle part of the ravine, and half of Gilead as far as Jabbok, boundary of the sons of Ammon,
brenton_translation: Seon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Esebon, ruling from Arnon, which is in the valley, on the side of the valley, and half of Galaad as far as Jaboc, the borders of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: and Arabah as far as the sea of Chenereth to the east and as far as the sea of Arabah, the Salt Sea, from the east, road by Asimoth, from the south under Asedoth Phasga;
brenton_translation: And Araba as far as the sea of Chenereth eastward, and as far as the sea of Araba; the salt sea eastward by the way to Asimoth, from Thæman under Asedoth Phasga.

fresh_translation: and Og king of Bashan, left over from the giants, dwelling in Astaroth and in Edrain,
brenton_translation: And Og king of Basan, who dwelt in Astaroth and in Edrain, was left of the giants

fresh_translation: ruling from Mount Hermon and from Selcha and all Bashan to the borders of Gesouri and Machaathi and half of Gilead, boundaries of Sihon king of Heshbon.
brenton_translation: ruling from mount Aermon and from Secchai, and over all the land of Basan to the borders of Gergesi, and Machi, and the half of Galaad of the borders of Seon king of Esebon.

fresh_translation: Moses servant of the Lord and the sons of Israel struck them, and Moses gave it as an inheritance to Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
brenton_translation: Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel smote them; and Moses gave them by way of inheritance to Ruben, and Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And these are the kings of the Amorites whom Joshua and the sons of Israel killed in the beyond of the Jordan toward the sea, from Baalgad in the plain of Lebanon and as far as Mount Chelcha rising to Seir, and Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel to inherit according to their lots,
brenton_translation: And these are the kings of the Amorites, whom Joshua and the children of Israel slew beyond Jordan by the sea of Balagad in the plain of Libanus, and as far as the mountain of Chelcha, as men go up to Seir: and Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel to inherit according to their portion;

fresh_translation: in the mountain and in the plain and in Arabah and in Asedoth and in the wilderness and in Negeb, the Hittite and the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Pherezite and the Hivite and the Jebusite:
brenton_translation: in the mountain, and in the plain, and in Araba, and in Asedoth, and in the wilderness, and Nageb; the Chettite, and the Amorite, and the Chananite, and the Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: the king of Jericho, and the king of Ai which is near Bethel,
brenton_translation: The king of Jericho, and the king of Gai, which is near Bæthel;

fresh_translation: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron,
brenton_translation: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Chebron,

fresh_translation: the king of Jerimoth, the king of Lachish,
brenton_translation: the king of Jerimuth, the king of Lachis;

fresh_translation: the king of Ailam, the king of Gazer,
brenton_translation: the king of Ælam, the king of Gazer;

fresh_translation: the king of Dabir, the king of Gader,
brenton_translation: the king of Dabir, the king of Gader:

fresh_translation: the king of Hermath, the king of Arath,
brenton_translation: the king of Hermath, the king of Ader;

fresh_translation: the king of Lebna, the king of Odollam,
brenton_translation: the king of Lebna, the king of Odollam,

fresh_translation: the king of Makkeda,
brenton_translation: the king of Elath,

fresh_translation: the king of Taphoug, the king of Opher,
brenton_translation: the king of Taphut, the king of Opher,

fresh_translation: the king of Aphek of Sharon,
brenton_translation: the king of Ophec of Aroc,

fresh_translation: the king of Hasor,
brenton_translation: the king of Asom,

fresh_translation: the king of Symoon, the king of Marron, the king of Aziph,
brenton_translation: the king of Symoön, the king of Mambroth, the king of Aziph,

fresh_translation: the king of Kadesh, the king of Tanach,
brenton_translation: the king of Cades, the king of Zachac,

fresh_translation: the king of Mageddon, the king of Jeconam of Chermel,
brenton_translation: the king of Maredoth, the king of Jecom of Chermel,

fresh_translation: the king of Dor of Napheddor, the king of Goiim of Galilee,
brenton_translation: the king of Odollam belonging to Phennealdor, the king of Gei of Galilee:

fresh_translation: the king of Tharsa. All these kings, twenty-nine.
brenton_translation: the king of Thersa: all these were twenty-nine kings.

fresh_translation: And Joshua was old, advanced in days, and the Lord said to Joshua, You have advanced in days, and much land remains for inheritance.
brenton_translation: And Joshua was old and very advanced in years; and the Lord said to Joshua, Thou art advanced in years, and there is much land left to inherit.

fresh_translation: And this is the remaining land: the boundaries of the Philistines, the Gesirite, and the Canaanite,
brenton_translation: And this is the land that is left: the borders of the Phylistines, the Gesirite, and the Chananite,

fresh_translation: from the uninhabited region opposite Egypt as far as the boundaries of Ekron on the left of the Canaanites; it is reckoned to the five satrapies of the Philistines, to the Gazite and the Azotian and the Ascalonite and the Gittite and the Ekronite and the Hivite,
brenton_translation: from the wilderness before Egypt, as far as the borders of Accaron on the left of the Chananites the land is reckoned to the five principalities of the Phylistines, to the inhabitant of Gaza, and of Azotus, and of Ascalon, and of Geth, and of Accaron, and to the Evite;

fresh_translation: from the south and all the land of Canaan opposite Gaza and the Sidonians as far as Aphek, as far as the boundaries of the Amorites,
brenton_translation: from Thæman even to all the land of Chanaan before Gaza, and the Sidonians as far as Aphec, as far as the borders of the Amorites.

fresh_translation: and all the land of Gabli of the Philistines and all Lebanon from the sunrise, from Galgala under Mount Hermon as far as the entrance of Emath,
brenton_translation: And all the land of Galiath of the Phylistines, and all Libanus eastward from Galgal, under the mountain Aermon as far as the entering in of Emath;

fresh_translation: all those dwelling in the hill country from Lebanon as far as Maseremphothmaim, all the Sidonians. I will utterly destroy them from before Israel. But divide it as an inheritance to Israel in the way I commanded you.
brenton_translation: every one that inhabits the hill country from Libanus as far as Masereth Memphomaim. All the Sidonians, I will destroy them from before Israel; but do thou give them by inheritance to Israel, as I charged thee.

fresh_translation: And now divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe of Manasseh. From the Jordan as far as the great sea toward the setting of the sun you shall give it; the great sea shall define it.
brenton_translation: And now divide this land by lot to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe of Manasse.

fresh_translation: But to the two tribes and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to Reuben and to Gad, Moses gave in the beyond of the Jordan toward the sunrise; Moses servant of the Lord gave it,
brenton_translation: From Jordan to the great sea westward thou shalt give it them: the great sea shall be the boundary. But to the two tribes and to the half tribe of Manasse, to Ruben and to Gad Moses gave an inheritance beyond Jordan: Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them eastward,

fresh_translation: from Aroer which is on the lip of the ravine of Arnon, and the city in the ravine of Arnon, and all Misor from Maidaba as far as Daibon,
brenton_translation: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook of Arnon, and the city in the midst of the valley, and all Misor from Mædaban.

fresh_translation: all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon as far as the boundaries of the sons of Ammon,
brenton_translation: All the cities of Seon king of the Amorites, who reigned from Esebon to the coasts of the children of Ammon;

fresh_translation: and Gileaditis and the boundaries of Gesiri and the Maachathi, all Mount Hermon and all Bashanitis as far as Selcha,
brenton_translation: and the region of Galaad, and the borders of the Gesirites and the Machatites, the whole mount of Aermon, and all the land of Basan to Acha.

fresh_translation: all the kingdom of Og in Bashanitis, who reigned in Astaroth and in Edrain. This one was left from the giants, and Moses struck him and utterly destroyed him.
brenton_translation: All the kingdom of Og in the region of Basan, who reigned in Astaroth and in Edrain: he was left of the giants; and Moses smote him, and destroyed him.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did not utterly destroy the Gesirite and the Maachathi and the Canaanite, and the king of Gesiri and the Maachathi dwelt among the sons of Israel until this day.
brenton_translation: But the children of Israel destroyed not the Gesirite and the Machatite and the Chananite; and the king of the Gesiri and the Machatite dwelt among the children of Israel until this day.

fresh_translation: Except to the tribe of Levi no inheritance was given. The Lord God of Israel, this one is their inheritance, just as the Lord said to them. And this is the division that Moses divided to the sons of Israel in Araboth of Moab, beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho.
brenton_translation: Only no inheritance was given to the tribe of Levi: the Lord God of Israel, he is their inheritance, as the Lord said to them; and this is the division which Moses made to the children of Israel in Araboth Moab, on the other side of Jordan, by Jericho.

fresh_translation: And Moses gave to the tribe of Reuben according to their clans.
brenton_translation: And Moses gave the land to the tribe of Ruben according to their families.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came from Aroer, which is opposite the ravine of Arnon, and the city in the ravine of Arnon, and all Misor,
brenton_translation: And their borders were from Aroer, which is opposite the brook of Arnon, and theirs is the city that is in the valley of Arnon; and all Misor,

fresh_translation: as far as Heshbon and all the cities in Misor, and Daibon and Bamothbaal and House of Beelmon,
brenton_translation: to Esebon, and all the cities in Misor, and Dæbon, and Bæmon-Baal, and the house of Meelboth;

fresh_translation: and Jassa and Kedemoth and Mephaath,
brenton_translation: and Basan, and Bakedmoth, and Mæphaad,

fresh_translation: and Kariathaim and Sebama and Serada and Sior in Mount Emak,
brenton_translation: and Kariathaim, and Sebama, and Serada, and Sion in mount Enab;

fresh_translation: and Baithphogor and Asedoth Phasga and Baithasimoth,
brenton_translation: and Bæthphogor, and Asedoth Phasga, and Bætthasinoth,

fresh_translation: and all the cities of Misor and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, whom Moses struck, also the leaders of Midian and Eui and Rokom and Sour and Our and Robe, rulers beside Sihon and those dwelling in the land.
brenton_translation: and all the cities of Misor, and all the kingdom of Seon king of the Amorites, whom Moses smote, even him and the princes of Madian, and Evi, and Roboc, and Sur, and Ur, and Robe prince of the spoils of Sion, and the inhabitants of Sion.

fresh_translation: And Balaam son of Beor, the diviner, they killed in the rush.
brenton_translation: And Balaam the son of Bæor the prophet they slew in the battle.

fresh_translation: And the Jordan became the boundary of Reuben, the boundary. This is the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their clans, their cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: And the borders of Ruben were—even Jordan was the boundary; this is the inheritance of the children of Ruben according to their families, these were their cities and their villages.

fresh_translation: And Moses gave to the sons of Gad according to their clans.
brenton_translation: And Moses gave inheritance to the sons of Gad according to their families.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came to be Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon as far as Aroer, opposite Rabba,
brenton_translation: And their borders were Jazer, all the cities of Galaad, and half the land of the children of Ammon to Araba, which is before Arad.

fresh_translation: and from Heshbon as far as Ramoth according to Massipha and Botanin and Maanaim as far as the boundaries of Dabir,
brenton_translation: And from Esebon to Araboth by Massepha, and Botanim, and Maan to the borders of Dæbon,

fresh_translation: and in Emek, Baitharam and Baithanabra and Sokchotha and Saphan, and the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, and the Jordan marking the boundary as far as the part of the Sea of Chenereth beyond the Jordan from the east.
brenton_translation: and Enadom, and Othargai, and Bænthanabra, and Soccotha, and Saphan, and the rest of the kingdom of Seon king of Esebon: and Jordan shall be the boundary as far as part of the sea of Chenereth beyond Jordan eastward.

fresh_translation: This is the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their clans, their cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families and according to their cities: according to their families they will turn their backs before their enemies, because their cities and their villages were according to their families.

fresh_translation: And Moses gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh according to their clans.
brenton_translation: And Moses gave to half the tribe of Manasse according to their families.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came to be from Maanaim and all the kingdom of Bashan and all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan and all the villages of Jair that are in Bashanitis, sixty cities,
brenton_translation: And their borders were from Maan, and all the kingdom of Basan, and all the kingdom of Og king of Basan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in the region of Basan, sixty cities:

fresh_translation: and half of Gilead, and in Astaroth and in Edrain, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashanitis. These were given to the sons of Machir son of Manasseh, to the half of the sons of Machir son of Manasseh, according to their clans.
brenton_translation: and the half of Galaad, and in Astaroth, and in Edrain, royal cities of Og in the land of Basan, Moses gave to the sons of Machir the sons of Manasse, even to the half-tribe sons of Machir the sons of Manasse, according to their families.

fresh_translation: These are those whom Moses gave as inheritance beyond the Jordan in Araboth of Moab, beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho from the east.
brenton_translation: These are they whom Moses caused to inherit beyond Jordan in Araboth Moab, beyond Jordan by Jericho eastward.

fresh_translation: And these are those whom the sons of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, whom Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and the leaders of the ancestral tribes of the sons of Israel allotted to them as inheritance,
brenton_translation: And these are they of the children of Israel that received their inheritance in the land of Chanaan, to whom Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Naue, and the heads of the families of the tribes of the children of Israel, gave inheritance.

fresh_translation: by lots they inherited, in the way the Lord commanded by the hand of Joshua, to the nine tribes and the half-tribe,
brenton_translation: They inherited according to their lots, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Joshua to the nine tribes and the half tribe, on the other side of Jordan.

fresh_translation: from the beyond of the Jordan; and to the Levites he gave no lot among them,
brenton_translation: But to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

fresh_translation: because the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, and no portion in the land was given to the Levites except cities to dwell in and their set-apart lands for their cattle and livestock.
brenton_translation: For the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasse and Ephraim; and there was none inheritance in the land given to the Levites, only cities to dwell in, and their suburbs separated for the cattle, and their cattle.

fresh_translation: In the way the Lord commanded Moses, thus the sons of Israel did, and they divided the land.
brenton_translation: As the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel; and they divided the land.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Judah came near to Joshua in Galgala, and Caleb the son of Jephonne the Kenezite said to him, You know the word that the Lord spoke to Moses, man of God, concerning me and you in Kadesh-Barnea.
brenton_translation: And the children of Juda came to Joshua in Galgal, and Chaleb the son of Jephone the Kenezite said to him, Thou knowest the word that the Lord spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Cades Barne.

fresh_translation: For I was forty years old when Moses servant of God sent me out from Kadesh-Barnea to spy out the land, and I answered him word according to his mind.
brenton_translation: For I was forty years old when Moses the servant of God sent me out of Cades Barne to spy out the land; and I returned him an answer according to his mind.

fresh_translation: But my brothers who went up with me turned aside the heart of the people; but I attached myself to follow after the Lord my God.
brenton_translation: My brethren that went up with me turned away the heart of the people, but I applied myself to follow the Lord my God.

fresh_translation: And Moses swore on that day, saying, The land on which you stepped shall be for you as an inheritance and for your children forever, because you attached yourself to follow after the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: And Moses sware on that day, saying, The land on which thou art gone up, it shall be thy inheritance and thy children's for ever, because thou hast applied thyself to follow the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: And now the Lord has nourished me in the way he said; this is the forty-fifth year since the Lord spoke this word to Moses, while Israel traveled in the wilderness, and now behold I am today eighty-five years old.
brenton_translation: And now the Lord has kept me alive as he said: this is the forty-fifth year since the Lord spoke that word to Moses; and Israel journeyed in the wilderness; and now, behold, I am this day eighty-five years old.

fresh_translation: I am still today strong just as when Moses sent me out; just so I am strong now to go out and to go in for war.
brenton_translation: I am still strong this day, as when the Lord sent me: just so strong am I now to go out and to come in for war.

fresh_translation: And now I ask you for this mountain, just as the Lord said on that day, because you heard this word on that day. And now the Anakim are there, fortified and great cities. If therefore the Lord is with me, then I will utterly destroy them in the way the Lord said to me.
brenton_translation: And now I ask of thee this mountain, as the Lord said in that day; for thou heardest this word on that day; and now the Enakim are there, cities great and strong: if then the Lord should be with me, I will utterly destroy them, as the Lord said to me.

fresh_translation: And Joshua blessed him and gave Hebron to Caleb son of Jephonne son of Kenez as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Chebron to Chaleb the son of Jephone the son of Kenez for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: Because of this Hebron became to Caleb son of Jephonne the Kenezite as an inheritance until this day, because he followed the command of the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: Therefore Chebron became the inheritance of Chaleb the son of Jephone the Kenezite until this day, because he followed the commandment of the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the former name of Hebron was City of Arbok, metropolis of the Anakim. And the land ceased from war.
brenton_translation: And the name of Chebron before was the city Argob, it is the metropolis of the Enakim: and the land rested from war.

fresh_translation: And the boundaries of the tribe of Judah came to be according to their clans, from the boundaries of Idumea, from the wilderness of Sin as far as Kadesh toward the south.
brenton_translation: And the borders of the tribe of Juda according to their families were from the borders of Idumea from the wilderness of Sin, as far as Cades southward.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came from the south as far as the part of the Salt Sea, from the ridge bearing toward the south,
brenton_translation: And their borders were from the south as far as a part of the salt sea from the high country that extends southward.

fresh_translation: and pass through opposite the ascent of Akrabin and go around Senna and ascend from the south onto Kadesh-Barnea and go out to Asoron and go up to Addara and circle westward Kadesh,
brenton_translation: And they proceed before the ascent of Acrabin, and go out round Sena, and go up from the south to Cades Barne; and go out to Asoron, and proceed up to Sarada, and go out by the way that is west of Cades.

fresh_translation: and go to Asemona and come out to the ravine of Egypt, and the boundary's outlet shall be to the sea. This is their southern boundary.
brenton_translation: And they go out to Selmona, and issue at the valley of Egypt; and the termination of its boundaries shall be at the sea: these are their boundaries southward.

fresh_translation: And the boundary from the east is the whole Salt Sea up to the Jordan, and their boundaries from the north are from the ridge of the sea and from the part of the Jordan,
brenton_translation: And their boundaries eastward are all the salt sea as far as Jordan; and their borders from the north, and from the border of the sea, and from part of Jordan—

fresh_translation: the boundary goes up to Bethagla and passes by the north to Baitharaba and goes up to the stone of Baion son of Reuben,
brenton_translation: the borders go up to Bæthaglaam, and they go along from the north to Bætharaba, and the borders go on up to the stone of Bæon the son of Ruben.

fresh_translation: and the boundary goes up to the fourth part of the Valley of Achor and goes down to Galgala, which is opposite the ascent of Addamin, which is south by the valley, and comes out to the water of the spring of the sun, and its outlet shall be at the spring Rogel.
brenton_translation: And the borders continue on to the fourth part of the valley of Achor, and go down to Galgal, which is before the approach of Adammin, which is southward in the valley, and terminate at the water of the fountain of the sun; and their going forth shall be the fountain of Rogel.

fresh_translation: And the boundary goes up into the valley of Onom on the south shoulder of Jebus; this is Jerusalem, and the boundary comes out to the top of the mountain that is opposite the valley of Onom toward the west, which is from the part of the land of Raphain toward the north.
brenton_translation: And the borders go up to the valley of Ennom, behind Jebus southward; this is Jerusalem: and the borders terminate at the top of the mountain, which is before the valley of Ennom toward the sea, which is by the side of the land of Raphain northward.

fresh_translation: And the boundary comes out from the top of the mountain to the spring of the water of Naphtho and comes out to the mountain of Ephron and the boundary goes out to Baal; this is City of Jarin.
brenton_translation: And the border going forth from the top of the mountain terminates at the fountain of the water of Naphtho, and terminates at mount Ephron; and the border will lead to Baal; this is the city of Jarim.

fresh_translation: And the boundary will circle from Baal westward and pass to Mount Assares on the south of City of Jarin on the north; this is Chaslon, and it will go down to City of the Sun and pass to the south.
brenton_translation: And the border will go round from Baal to the sea, and will go on to the mount of Assar behind the city of Jarin northwards; this is Chaslon: and it will come down to the city of the Sun, and will go on to the south.

fresh_translation: And the boundary will come out down the shoulder of Ekron to the north and go out to Sakkarona and pass Mount Bala and come out to Jabnel, and the boundary's outlet shall be to the sea.
brenton_translation: And the border terminates behind Accaron northward, and the borders will terminate at Socchoth, and the borders will go on to the south, and will terminate at Lebna, and the issue of the borders will be at the sea; and their borders shall be toward the sea, the great sea shall be the boundary.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries from the sea are marked by the great sea. These are the boundaries of the sons of Judah all around according to their clans.
brenton_translation: These are the borders of the children of Juda round about according to their families.

fresh_translation: And to Caleb son of Jephonne he gave a portion in the midst of the sons of Judah by the command of God, and Joshua gave him the city of Arbok, metropolis of Anak; this is Hebron.
brenton_translation: And to Chaleb the son of Jephone he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Juda by the command of God; and Joshua gave him the city of Arboc the metropolis of Enac; this is Chebron.

fresh_translation: And Caleb son of Jephonne utterly destroyed from there the three sons of Anak, Sousi and Tholmi and Achima.
brenton_translation: And Chaleb the son of Jephone destroyed thence the three sons of Enac, Susi, and Tholami, and Achima.

fresh_translation: And Caleb went up from there against those dwelling in Dabir; now the former name of Dabir was City of Letters.
brenton_translation: And Chaleb went up thence to the inhabitants of Dabir; and the name of Dabir before was the city of Letters.

fresh_translation: And Caleb said, Whoever takes and cuts down the City of Letters and rules it, I will give him Achsa my daughter as a wife.
brenton_translation: And Chaleb said, Whosoever shall take and destroy the city of Letters, and master it, to him will I give my daughter Ascha to wife.

fresh_translation: And Gothoniiel son of Kenez, younger brother of Caleb, took it, and he gave him Achsa his daughter to him as a wife.
brenton_translation: And Gothoniel the son of Chenez the brother of Chaleb took it; and he gave him Ascha his daughter to wife.

fresh_translation: And it happened, when she entered in, she advised him, saying, I will ask my father for a field. And she cried out from the donkey, and Caleb said to her, What is with you?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as she went out that she counselled him, saying, I will ask of my father a field; and she cried from off her ass; and Chaleb said to her, What is it?

fresh_translation: And she said to him, Give me a blessing, because you have given me into the land of Negeb; give me the Golathmain. And Caleb gave her the upper Golathmain and the lower Golathmain.
brenton_translation: And she said to him, Give me a blessing, for thou hast set me in the land of Nageb; give me Botthanis: and he gave her Gonæthla the upper, and Gonæthla the lower.

fresh_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah.
brenton_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Juda.

fresh_translation: And the cities of the sons of Judah came to be: first city of the tribe of the sons of Judah on the boundaries of Edom by the wilderness, Kaibaseleel and Ara and Asor,
brenton_translation: And their cities were cities belonging to the tribe of the children of Juda on the borders of Edom by the wilderness, and Bæseleel, and Ara, and Asor,

fresh_translation: and Ikam and Regma and Arouel,
brenton_translation: and Icam, and Regma, and Aruel,

fresh_translation: and Kadesh and Asorionain,
brenton_translation: and Cades, and Asorionain, and Mænam,

fresh_translation: and Mainam and Balmainan and their villages,
brenton_translation: and Balmænan, and their villages,

fresh_translation: and the cities of Aseron; this is Asor,
brenton_translation: and the cities of Aseron, this is Asor,

fresh_translation: and Sen and Salmaa and Molada,
brenton_translation: and Sen, and Salmaa, and Molada,

fresh_translation: and Seri and Baiphalad,
brenton_translation: and Seri, and Bæphalath,

fresh_translation: and Cholaseola and Bairsabee and their villages and their hamlets,
brenton_translation: and Cholaseola, and Beersabee; and their villages, and their hamlets,

fresh_translation: Bala and Bakok and Asom,
brenton_translation: Bala and Bacoc, and Asom,

fresh_translation: and Elboudad and Baith-el and Erma,
brenton_translation: and Elboüdad, and Bæthel, and Herma,

fresh_translation: and Sekelak and Macharim and Sethennak,
brenton_translation: and Sekelac, and Macharim, and Sethennac,

fresh_translation: and Labos and Sale and Eromoth, twenty-nine cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: and Labos, and Sale, and Eromoth; twenty-nine cities, and their villages.

fresh_translation: In the plain, Astaol and Raa and Assa,
brenton_translation: In the plain country Astaol, and Raa, and Assa,

fresh_translation: and Ramen and Tano and Ilouthoth and Maiani,
brenton_translation: and Ramen, and Tano, and Iluthoth, and Mæani,

fresh_translation: and Jermouth and Odollam and Membra and Saocho and Azeka,
brenton_translation: and Jermuth, and Odollam, and Membra, and Saocho, and Jazeca.

fresh_translation: and Sakarim and Gadera and its hamlets, fourteen cities and their villages,
brenton_translation: And Sacarim and Gadera, and its villages; fourteen cities, and their villages;

fresh_translation: Senna and Adasan and Magadagad,
brenton_translation: Senna, and Adasan, and Magadalgad,

fresh_translation: and Dalal and Maspha and Iakareel,
brenton_translation: and Dalad, and Maspha, and Jachareel,

fresh_translation: and Laches and Basedoth and Ideadalea,
brenton_translation: and Basedoth, and Ideadalea;

fresh_translation: and Chabra and Maches and Maachos,
brenton_translation: and Chabra, and Maches, and Maachos,

fresh_translation: and Geddor and Bagadiel and Noman and Makedan, sixteen cities and their villages,
brenton_translation: and Geddor, and Bagadiel, and Noman, and Machedan: sixteen cities, and their villages;

fresh_translation: Lemna and Ithak,
brenton_translation: Lebna, and Ithac, and Anoch,

fresh_translation: and Anoch and Jana and Nasib,
brenton_translation: and Jana, and Nasib,

fresh_translation: and Keilam and Akiezi and Kezib and Bathesar and Ailon, ten cities and their villages,
brenton_translation: and Keilam, and Akiezi, and Kezib, and Bathesar, and Ælom: ten cities, and their villages;

fresh_translation: Ekron and its villages and their hamlets,
brenton_translation: Accaron and her villages, and their hamlets:

fresh_translation: from Ekron, Gemna and all that is near Asedoth and their villages,
brenton_translation: from Accaron, Gemna, and all the cities that are near Asedoth; and their villages.

fresh_translation: Asiedoth and its villages and its hamlets, Gaza and its villages and its hamlets, as far as the ravine of Egypt, and the great sea marks the boundary.
