brenton_translation: Asiedoth, and her villages, and her hamlets; Gaza, and its villages and its hamlets as far as the river of Egypt, and the great sea is the boundary.

fresh_translation: And in the hill country, Samir and Jether and Socha,
brenton_translation: And in the hill country Samir, and Jether, and Socha,

fresh_translation: and Renna and City of Letters, this is Dabir,
brenton_translation: and Renna and the city of Letters, this is Dabir;

fresh_translation: and Anon and Eskaiman and Aisam,
brenton_translation: and Anon, and Es, and Man, and Æsam,

fresh_translation: and Gosom and Chalon and Channa, eleven cities and their villages,
brenton_translation: and Gosom, and Chalu, and Channa, and Gelom: eleven cities, and their villages;

fresh_translation: Airem and Remna and Soma,
brenton_translation: Ærem, and Remna, and Soma,

fresh_translation: and Jemain and Baithachou and Phakoua,
brenton_translation: and Jemain, and Bæthachu, and Phacua,

fresh_translation: and Euma and City of Arbok, this is Hebron, and Sorth, nine cities and their hamlets,
brenton_translation: and Euma, and the city Arboc, this is Chebron, and Soraith: nine cities, and their villages:

fresh_translation: Maor and Chermel and Ozib and Itan,
brenton_translation: Maor, and Chermel, and Ozib, and Itan,

fresh_translation: and Jariel and Jarikam and Zakanaim,
brenton_translation: and Jariel, and Aricam, and Zacanaim,

fresh_translation: and Gabaa and Thamnatha, nine cities and their villages,
brenton_translation: and Gabaa, and Thamnatha; nine cities, and their villages;

fresh_translation: Aloua and Baithsour and Geddon,
brenton_translation: Ælua, and Bethsur, and Geddon,

fresh_translation: and Magaroth and Baithanam and Thekoum, six cities and their villages. Thekoa and Ephratha, this is Bethlehem, and Phagor and Aitan and Koulon and Tatam and Eobes and Karem and Galem and Thether and Manocho, eleven cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: and Magaroth, and Bæthanam, and Thecum; six cities, and their villages;

fresh_translation: Kariathbaal, this is City of Jarin, and Sothiba, two cities and their hamlets.
brenton_translation: Cariathbaal, this is the city of Jarim, and Sotheba: two cities, and their villages:

fresh_translation: And Baddargis and Tharabaam and Ainon and Aichioza,
brenton_translation: and Baddargeis, and Tharabaam, and Ænon;

fresh_translation: and Naphlazon and the cities of Sodom and Ankades, seven cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: and Æochioza, and Naphlazon, and the cities of Sadon, and Ancades; seven cities, and their villages.

fresh_translation: And the Jebusite dwelt in Jerusalem, and the sons of Judah were not able to destroy them, and the Jebusites dwelt in Jerusalem until that day.
brenton_translation: And the Jebusite dwelt in Jerusalem, and the children of Juda could not destroy them; and the Jebusites dwelt in Jerusalem to this day.

fresh_translation: And the boundaries of the sons of Joseph came to be from the Jordan by Jericho from the east, and it will go up from Jericho into the hill-country wilderness to Bethel Louza,
brenton_translation: And the borders of the children of Joseph were from Jordan by Jericho eastward; and they will go up from Jericho to the hill country, to the wilderness, to Bæthel Luza.

fresh_translation: and it will go out to Bethel and pass to the boundaries of Chatarothi,
brenton_translation: And they will go out to Bæthel, and will proceed to the borders of Achatarothi.

fresh_translation: and pass through westward to the boundaries of Aptalim as far as the boundaries of Baithoron the lower and Gazara, and their outlet shall be to the sea.
brenton_translation: And they will go across to the sea to the borders of Aptalim, as far as the borders of Bæthoron the lower, and the going forth of them shall be to the sea.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Joseph inherited, Ephraim and Manasseh.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Joseph, Ephraim and Manasse, took their inheritance.

fresh_translation: And the boundaries of the sons of Ephraim came to be according to their clans, and the boundaries of their inheritance came to be from the east, Ataroth and Erok as far as Baithoron the upper and Gazara.
brenton_translation: And the borders of the children of Ephraim were according to their families, and the borders of their inheritance were eastward to Ataroth, and Eroc as far as Bæthoron the upper, and Gazara.

fresh_translation: And the boundaries will pass to the sea into Ikasmona from the north; it will circle eastward to Thenasa and Sellesa and pass from the east to Janoka,
brenton_translation: And the borders will proceed to the sea to Icasmon north of Therma; they will go round eastward to Thenasa, and Selles, and will pass on eastward to Janoca,

fresh_translation: and to Macho and Ataroth and their villages, and it will come to Jericho and come out to the Jordan.
brenton_translation: and to Macho, and Ataroth, and these are their villages; and they will come to Jericho, and will issue at Jordan.

fresh_translation: And from Taphou the boundary will go to the sea at Chelkana, and its outlet shall be to the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim according to their clans.
brenton_translation: And the borders will proceed from Tapho to the sea to Chelcana; and their termination will be at the sea; this is the inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim according to their families.

fresh_translation: And the cities set apart to the sons of Ephraim among the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: And the cities separated to the sons of Ephraim were in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Manasse, all the cities and their villages.

fresh_translation: And Ephraim did not destroy the Canaanite dwelling in Gazer, and the Canaanite dwelt in Ephraim until this day, until Pharaoh king of Egypt went up and took it and burned it with fire, and he pierced through the Canaanites and the Pherezites and those dwelling in Gazer, and Pharaoh gave it as a gift to his daughter.
brenton_translation: And Ephraim did not destroy the Chananite who dwelt in Gazer; and the Chananite dwelt in Ephraim until this day, until Pharao the king of Egypt went up and took it, and burnt it with fire; and the Chananites, and Pherezites, and the dwellers in Gaza they destroyed, and Pharao gave them for a dowry to his daughter.

fresh_translation: And the boundaries of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh came to be, because he was firstborn to Joseph, to Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, father of Gilead, for he was a warrior in Gileaditis and in Bashanitis.
brenton_translation: And the borders of the tribe of the children of Manasse, (for he was the first-born of Joseph,) assigned to Machir the first-born of Manasse the father of Galaad, for he was a warrior, were in the land of Galaad and of Basan.

fresh_translation: And it came to be for the remaining sons of Manasseh according to their clans, for the sons of Jezer and the sons of Chelez and the sons of Jeziel and the sons of Sychem and the sons of Symarim and the sons of Opher. These are the males according to their clans.
brenton_translation: And there was land assigned to the other sons of Manasse according to their families; to the sons of Jezi, and to the sons of Kelez, and to the sons of Jeziel, and to the sons of Sychem, and to the sons of Symarim, and to the sons of Opher: these are the males according to their families.

fresh_translation: And to Salpaad son of Opher there were no sons but daughters, and these are the names of the daughters of Salpaad: Maala and Noua and Egla and Melcha and Thersa.
brenton_translation: And Salpaad the son of Opher had no sons but daughters: and these are the names of the daughters of Salpaad; Maala, and Nua, and Egla, and Melcha, and Thersa.

fresh_translation: And they stood before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua and before the leaders, saying, God commanded by the hand of Moses to give us an inheritance in the midst of our brothers. And by the command of the Lord an inheritance was given to them among the brothers of their father.
brenton_translation: And they stood before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua, and before the rulers, saying, God gave a charge by the hand of Moses, to give us an inheritance in the midst of our brethren: so there was given to them by the command of the Lord an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

fresh_translation: And their line fell from Anassa and the plain of Labek from Gilead, which is beyond the Jordan,
brenton_translation: And their lot fell to them from Anassa, and to the plain of Labec of the land of Galaad, which is beyond Jordan.

fresh_translation: because daughters of the sons of Manasseh inherited a lot in the midst of their brothers, and the land of Gilead came to be for the sons of Manasseh who were left over.
brenton_translation: For the daughters of the sons of Manasse inherited a portion in the midst of their brethren, and the land of Galaad was assigned to the remainder of the sons of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And the boundary of the sons of Manasseh came to be Delanath, which is opposite the sons of Anath, and the boundary goes to Jamin and Jassib to the spring of Thaphthoth.
brenton_translation: And the borders of the sons of Manasse were Delanath, which is before the sons of Anath, and it proceeds to the borders even to Jamin and Jassib to the fountain of Thaphthoth.

fresh_translation: Thapheth shall belong to Manasseh; on the boundaries of Manasseh, to the sons of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: It shall belong to Manasse, and Thapheth on the borders of Manasse shall belong to the sons of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And the boundaries will go down to the ravine of Karana to the south by the ravine of Jariel, terebinth, to Ephraim in the midst of the city of Manasseh, and the boundary of Manasseh is to the north by the torrent, and its outlet shall be the sea.
brenton_translation: And the borders shall go down to the valley of Carana southward by the valley of Jariel, (there is a turpentine tree belonging to Ephraim between that and the city of Manasse:) and the borders of Manasse are northward to the brook; and the sea shall be its termination.

fresh_translation: From the south to Ephraim and to the north Manasseh, and the sea shall be their boundary, and by Asher they shall join on the north and by Issachar on the east.
brenton_translation: Southward the land belongs to Ephraim, and northward to Manasse; and the sea shall be their coast; and northward they shall border upon Aseb, and eastward upon Issachar.

fresh_translation: And Manasseh shall have in Issachar and in Asher Bethsan and its villages and those dwelling in Dor and its villages and those dwelling in Mageddo and its villages and the third of Napheta and its villages.
brenton_translation: And Manasses shall have in the portion of Issachar and Aser Bæthsan and their villages, and the inhabitants of Dor, and its villages, and the inhabitants of Mageddo, and its villages, and the third part of Mapheta, and its villages.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Manasseh were not able to destroy these cities, and the Canaanite began to dwell in that land.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Manasse were not able to destroy these cities; and the Chananite began to dwell in that land.

fresh_translation: And it happened when the sons of Israel grew strong, they made the Canaanites subject, but did not utterly destroy them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass that when the children of Israel were strong, they made the Chananites subject, but they did not utterly destroy them.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Joseph spoke back to Joshua, saying, Why did you give us one lot and one measuring line as an inheritance, while I am a numerous people and God blessed me?
brenton_translation: And the sons of Joseph answered Joshua, saying, Wherefore hast thou caused us to inherit one inheritance, and one line? whereas I am a great people, and God has blessed me.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to them, If you are a numerous people, go up into the forest and clear a place for yourself, if the hill-country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to them, If thou be a great people, go up to the forest, and clear the land for thyself, if mount Ephraim be too little for thee.

fresh_translation: And they said, The hill-country of Ephraim will not suffice for us, and the Canaanite dwelling in it has chosen iron horse and chariot, in Bethsan and in its villages, in the valley of Jezrael.
brenton_translation: And they said, The mount of Ephraim does not please us, and the Chananite dwelling in it in Bæthsan, and in its villages, and in the valley of Jezrael, has choice cavalry and iron.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the sons of Joseph, If you are a numerous people and have great strength, there shall not be for you one lot,
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the sons of Joseph, If thou art a great people, and hast great strength, thou shalt not have only one inheritance.

fresh_translation: because the forest shall be yours, for it is forest, and you shall clear it, and it shall be yours, and when you destroy the Canaanite, because he has chosen iron horse and chariot, for you prevail over him.
brenton_translation: For thou shalt have the wood, for there is a wood, and thou shalt clear it, and the land shall be thine; even when thou shalt have utterly destroyed the Chananite, for he has chosen cavalry; yet thou art stronger than he.

fresh_translation: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh, and they pitched there the tent of testimony, and the land was subdued by them.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation of the children of Israel were assembled at Selo, and there they pitched the tabernacle of witness; and the land was subdued by them.

fresh_translation: And there were left among the sons of Israel seven tribes that had not inherited.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Israel remained, even those who had not received their inheritance, seven tribes.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, How long will you grow slack to inherit the land that the Lord our God gave?
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, How long will ye be slack to inherit the land, which the Lord our God has given you?

fresh_translation: Give from among you three men from each tribe, and let them arise and pass through the land and map it out before me according to how it should be divided, and let them come to me.
brenton_translation: Appoint of yourselves three men of each tribe, and let them rise up and go through the land, and let them describe it before me, as it will be proper to divide it.

fresh_translation: And he divided it for them into seven portions: Judah shall stand for them on the boundary from the south, and the sons of Joseph shall stand for them from the north.
brenton_translation: And they came to him: and he divided to them seven portions, saying, Juda shall stand to them a border southward, and the sons of Joseph shall stand to them northward.

fresh_translation: And you shall divide the land into seven portions and bring it to me here, and I will cast for you a lot before the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: And do ye divide the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, and I will give you a lot before the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: For there is no portion for the sons of Levi among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is his portion. And Gad and Reuben and the half tribe of Manasseh took their inheritance beyond the Jordan toward the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
brenton_translation: For the sons of Levi have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is his portion; and Gad, and Ruben, and the half tribe of Manasse, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave to them.

fresh_translation: And the men arose and went, and Joshua commanded the men going to survey the land, saying, Go and survey the land and come back to me, and here I will cast for you a lot before the Lord in Shiloh.
brenton_translation: And the men rose up and went; and Joshua charged the men who went to explore the land, saying, Go and explore the land, and come to me, and I will bring you forth a lot here before the Lord in Selo.

fresh_translation: And the men went and surveyed the land, and they viewed it and wrote it down by its cities in seven portions in a book, and they brought it to Joshua.
brenton_translation: And they went, and explored the land: and they viewed it, and described it according to the cities, seven parts in a book, and brought the book to Joshua.

fresh_translation: And Joshua cast for them a lot in Shiloh before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Joshua cast the lot for them in Selo before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the lot of the tribe of Benjamin came out first according to their clans, and the boundaries of their lot came out between Judah and between the sons of Joseph.
brenton_translation: And the lot of the tribe of Benjamin came forth first according to their families: and the borders of their lot came forth between the children of Juda and the children of Joseph.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came to be from the north from the Jordan, and the boundary shall go up along the shoulder of Jericho on the north and shall go up to the mountain westward, and its outlet shall be the wilderness of Baithon.
brenton_translation: And their borders were northward: the borders shall go up from Jordan behind Jericho northward, and shall go up to the mountain westward, and the issue of it shall be Bæthon of Mabdara.

fresh_translation: And the boundary shall pass from there to Louza, on the south of Louza, from the south, this is Baethel, and the boundary shall go down to Maatarothorech, to the hill-country that is south of lower Baithoron.
brenton_translation: And the borders will go forth thence to Luz, behind Luz, from the south of it; this is Bæthel: and the borders shall go down to Maatarob Orech, to the hill country, which is southward of Bæthoron the lower.

fresh_translation: And the boundary shall pass through and go around on the side facing the sea from the south, from the mountain opposite Baithoron to the south, and its outlet shall be at Kariathbaal, this is Kariathiarin, a city of the sons of Judah. This is the side toward the sea.
brenton_translation: And the borders shall pass through and proceed to the part that looks toward the sea, on the south, from the mountain in front of Bæthoron southward, and its termination shall be at Cariath-Baal, this is Cariath-Jarin, a city of the children of Juda; this is the part toward the west.

fresh_translation: And the side toward the south is from the side of Kariathbaal, and the boundary shall pass to Gasein, to the spring of the water of Naphtho.
brenton_translation: And the south side on the part of Cariath-Baal; and the borders shall go across to Gasin, to the fountain of the water of Naphtho.

fresh_translation: And the boundary shall go down to the side of the mountain that is opposite the valley of Onnam, which is on the side of Emekraphain to the north, and it shall go down to Gaienna on the south of Jebousai from the south, and it shall go down to the spring of Rogel.
brenton_translation: And the borders shall extend down on one side, this is in front of the forest of Sonnam, which is on the side of Emec Raphain northward, and it shall come down to Gæenna behind Jebusai southward: it shall come down to the fountain of Rogel.

fresh_translation: And it shall pass to the spring of Baithsamyis and pass to Galiloth, which is opposite the ascent of Aithamin, and shall go down to the stone of Baion of the sons of Reuben.
brenton_translation: And the borders shall go across to the fountain of Bæthsamys:

fresh_translation: And it shall pass along the shoulder of Baitharaba on the north and shall go down.
brenton_translation: and shall proceed to Galiloth, which is in front by the going up of Æthamin; and they shall come down to the stone of Bæon of the sons of Ruben; and shall pass over behind Bætharaba northward, and shall go down to the borders behind the sea northward.

fresh_translation: to the boundary on the south of Baithagla on the north, and the outlet of the boundary shall be at the ridge of the Salt Sea on the north, by the part of the Jordan on the south. These are the boundaries from the south.
brenton_translation: And the termination of the borders shall be at the creek of the salt sea northward to the side of Jordan southward: these are their southern borders.

fresh_translation: And the Jordan shall bound it on the eastern side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, its boundaries all around according to their clans.
brenton_translation: And Jordan shall be their boundary on the east: this is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, these are their borders round about according to their families.

fresh_translation: And the cities of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans came to be Jericho and Baitheglio and Amekasis,
brenton_translation: And the cities of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethegæo, and Amecasis,

fresh_translation: and Baithabara and Sara and Besana,
brenton_translation: and Bæthabara, and Sara, and Besana,

fresh_translation: and Aiin and Phara and Ephratha,
brenton_translation: and Æein, and Phara, and Ephratha,

fresh_translation: and Karapha and Kephira and Moni and Gabaa, twelve cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: and Carapha, and Cephira, and Moni, and Gabaa, twelve cities and their villages:

fresh_translation: Gabaon and Rama and Beerotha,
brenton_translation: Gabaon, and Rama, and Beerotha;

fresh_translation: and Massema and Miron and Amoke,
brenton_translation: and Massema, and Miron, and Amoke;

fresh_translation: and Phira and Kaphan and Nakan and Selakan and Thareela,
brenton_translation: and Phira, and Caphan, and Nacan, and Selecan, and Thareela,

fresh_translation: and Jebous, this is Jerusalem, and Gabbaothiariim, thirteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans.
brenton_translation: and Jebus (this is Jerusalem); and Gabaoth, Jarim, thirteen cities, and their villages; this is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families.

fresh_translation: And the second lot came out for the sons of Simeon, and their inheritance came to be in the midst of the allotments of the sons of Judah.
brenton_translation: And the second lot came out for the children of Symeon; and their inheritance was in the midst of the lots of the children of Juda.

fresh_translation: And their lot came to be Bersabee and Samaa and Koladam,
brenton_translation: And their lot was Beersabee, and Samaa, and Caladam,

fresh_translation: and Arsola and Bola and Asom,
brenton_translation: and Arsola, and Bola, and Jason,

fresh_translation: and Elthoula and Boula and Herma,
brenton_translation: and Erthula, and Bula, and Herma,

fresh_translation: and Sikelak and Baithmachereb and Sarsousin,
brenton_translation: and Sikelac, and Bæthmachereb, and Sarsusin,

fresh_translation: and Batharoth and their fields, thirteen cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: and Batharoth, and their fields, thirteen cities, and their villages.

fresh_translation: Eremmon and Thalcha and Ether and Asan, four cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: Eremmon, and Thalcha, and Jether, and Asan; four cities and their villages,

fresh_translation: all around their cities as far as Barek, going toward Bameth to the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their clans.
brenton_translation: round about their cities as far as Balec as men go to Bameth southward: this is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Symeon according to their families.

fresh_translation: From the allotment of Judah came the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, because the share of the sons of Judah became greater than theirs, and the sons of Simeon inherited in the midst of their allotment.
brenton_translation: The inheritance of the tribe of the children of Symeon was a part of the lot of Juda, for the portion of the children of Juda was greater than theirs; and the children of Symeon inherited in the midst of their lot.

fresh_translation: And the third lot came out for Zebulun according to their clans. The boundaries of their inheritance shall be Esedek.
brenton_translation: And the third lot came out to Zabulon according to their families: the bounds of their inheritance shall be—Esedekgola shall be their border,

fresh_translation: Gola, their boundary, the sea and Maragella, and it shall join to Baitharaba at the ravine that is opposite Jekman.
brenton_translation: the sea and Magelda, and it shall reach to Bætharaba in the valley, which is opposite Jekman.

fresh_translation: And it turned back from Seddouk opposite the east to Baithsamyis, to the boundaries of Chaselothaith, and it shall pass to Dabiroth and go up to Phaggai.
brenton_translation: And the border returned from Sedduc in a contrary direction eastward from Bæthsamys, to the borders of Chaselothaith, and shall pass on to Dabiroth, and shall proceed upward to Phangai.

fresh_translation: And from there it shall go around opposite eastward to Gebere, to the city Katasem, and shall pass to Remmona Amathar Aouza.
brenton_translation: And thence it shall come round in the opposite direction eastward to Gebere to the city of Catasem, and shall go on to Remmonaa Matharaoza.

fresh_translation: And the boundary shall go around to the north at Amoth, and its outlet shall be at Gaiphael,
brenton_translation: And the borders shall come round northward to Amoth, and their going out shall be at Gæphael,

fresh_translation: and Katanath and Nabaal and Symoon and Jericho and Baithman.
brenton_translation: and Catanath, and Nabaal, and Symoön, and Jericho, and Bæthman.

fresh_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zabulon according to their families, these cities and their villages.

fresh_translation: And for Issachar the fourth lot came out.
brenton_translation: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came to be Iezel and Chasaloth and Sounan,
brenton_translation: And their borders were Jazel, and Chasaloth, and Sunam,

fresh_translation: and Agin and Siona and Reeiroth and Anachereth,
brenton_translation: and Agin, and Siona, and Reeroth,

fresh_translation: and Dabiron and Kison and Rebes,
brenton_translation: and Anachereth, and Dabiron, and Kison, and Rebes,

fresh_translation: and Remmas and Jeon and Tomman and Aimarek and Bersaphes,
brenton_translation: and Remmas, and Jeon, and Tomman, and Æmarec, and Bersaphes.

fresh_translation: and the boundary shall join to Gaithbor and to Salim by the sea and Baithsamyis, and the outlet of its boundaries shall be the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And the boundaries shall border upon Gæthbor, and upon Salim westward, and Bæthsamys; and the extremity of his bounds shall be Jordan.

fresh_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

fresh_translation: And the fifth lot came out for Asher.
brenton_translation: And the fifth lot came out to Aser according to their families.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came to be Exeleketh and Aleph and Baithok and Keaph,
brenton_translation: And their borders were Exeleketh, and Aleph, and Bæthok, and Keaph,

fresh_translation: and Elimelech and Amiiel and Maasa, and it shall join to Carmel by the sea and to Sion and Labanath.
brenton_translation: and Elimelech, and Amiel, and Maasa, and the lot will border on Carmel westward, and on Sion, and Labanath.

fresh_translation: And it shall turn back from the rising of the sun to Baithegenech and join to Zebulun, and from Gai to Phthaiel northward, and the boundary shall enter Saphtbaithme and Inael and pass to Choba Masomel,
brenton_translation: And it will return westward from Bæthegeneth, and will join Zabulon and Ekgai, and Phthæel northwards, and the borders will come to Saphthæbæthme, and Inael, and will go on to Chobamasomel,

fresh_translation: and Elbon and Raab and Ememaon and Kanthan, as far as great Sidon.
brenton_translation: and Elbon, and Raab, and Ememaon, and Canthan to great Sidon.

fresh_translation: And the boundary shall turn to Rama and as far as the spring of Masphassat and the Tyrians, and the boundary shall turn to Iasiph, and its outlet shall be the sea, and from Leb and Echozob,
brenton_translation: And the borders shall turn back to Rama, and to the fountain of Masphassat, and the Tyrians; and the borders shall return to Jasiph, and their going forth shall be the sea, and Apoleb, and Echozob,

fresh_translation: and Archob and Aphek and Raau,
brenton_translation: and Archob, and Aphec, and Raau.

fresh_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
brenton_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Aser according to their families, the cities and their villages.

fresh_translation: And for Naphtali the sixth lot came out.
brenton_translation: And the sixth lot came out to Nephthali.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came to be Moolam and Mola and Besemiin and Arme and Nabok and Jephthamai, as far as Dodam, and its outlets came to be the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And their borders were Moolam, and Mola, and Besemiin, and Arme, and Naboc, and Jephthamai, as far as Dodam; and their goings out were Jordan.

fresh_translation: And the boundary shall turn to the sea at Enath-thabor and pass from there to Jakana, and it shall join to Zebulun from the south and Asher shall join by the sea, and the Jordan from the rising of the sun.
brenton_translation: And the coasts will return westward by Athabor, and will go out thence to Jacana, and will border on Zabulon southward, and Aser will join it westward, and Jordan eastward.

fresh_translation: And the fortified cities of the Tyrians were Tyre and Omatha, Daketh and Kenereth,
brenton_translation: And the walled cities of the Tyrians, Tyre, and Omathadaketh, and Kenereth,

fresh_translation: and Armaith and Arael and Asor,
brenton_translation: and Armaith, and Arael, and Asor,

fresh_translation: and Kades and Assari and the spring of Asor,
brenton_translation: and Cades, and Assari, and the well of Asor;

fresh_translation: and Kerōe and Megala Arim and Baiththame and Thessamys.
brenton_translation: and Keroe, and Megalaarim, and Bætthame, and Thessamys.

fresh_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali.
brenton_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Nephthali.

fresh_translation: And for Dan the seventh lot came out.
brenton_translation: And the seventh lot came out to Dan.

fresh_translation: And their boundaries came to be Sarath and Asa, cities of Sammans,
brenton_translation: And their borders were Sarath, and Asa, and the cities of Sammaus,

fresh_translation: and Salabin and Ammon and Silatha,
brenton_translation: and Salamin, and Ammon, and Silatha,

fresh_translation: and Ailon and Thamnatha and Akkaron,
brenton_translation: and Elon, and Thamnatha, and Accaron;

fresh_translation: and Alkatha and Bege thon and Gebeelan,
brenton_translation: and Alcatha, and Begethon, and Gebeëlan,

fresh_translation: and Azor and Banaibakat and Gethremmon,
brenton_translation: and Azor, and Banæbacat, and Gethremmon.

fresh_translation: and from the sea Hierakon, the boundary near Joppa.
brenton_translation: And westward of Hieracon the border was near to Joppa.

fresh_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their clans, their cities and their villages. And the sons of Dan did not drive out the Amorite who hemmed them in on the mountain, and the Amorites did not allow them to go down into the valley, and they pressed the boundary of their portion away from them.
brenton_translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan, according to their families, these are their cities and their villages:

fresh_translation: And the sons of Judah went and fought Lachis and captured it and struck it with the edge of the sword and settled in it and called its name Lasendak. And the Amorite remained dwelling in Elom and in Salamin, and the hand of Ephraim weighed heavily on them, and they became tributary to them.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Dan went and fought against Lachis, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword; and they dwelt in it, and called the name of it Lasendan:

fresh_translation: And they went to take possession of the land according to their boundary, and the sons of Israel gave Joshua son of Naue an inheritance among them.
brenton_translation: And they proceeded to take possession of the land according to their borders, and the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Naue among them,

fresh_translation: By command of God they gave him the city he asked, Thamnasarach, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, and he built the city and lived in it.
brenton_translation: by the command of God, and they gave him the city which he asked for, Thamnasarach, which is in the mount of Ephraim; and he built the city, and dwelt in it.

fresh_translation: These are the divisions that Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Naue and the heads of the fathers among the tribes of Israel apportioned by lots in Shiloh before the Lord at the doors of the tent of testimony, and they went to take possession of the land.
brenton_translation: These are the divisions which Eleazar the priest divided by lot, and Joshua the son of Naue, and the heads of families among the tribes of Israel, according to the lots, in Selo before the Lord by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, and they went to take possession of the land.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, Appoint the cities of refuge of which I spoke to you through Moses,
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses.

fresh_translation: a refuge for the killer who struck down a life unintentionally, and the cities shall be for you as a refuge, and the killer shall not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
brenton_translation: Even a refuge to the slayer who has smitten a man unintentionally; and the cities shall be to you a refuge, and the slayer shall not be put to death by the avenger of blood, until he have stood before the congregation for judgment.

fresh_translation: And they set apart Kades in Galilee in the mountain of Naphtali, and Sychem in the mountain of Ephraim, and the city Arbok, this is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.
brenton_translation: And Joshua separated Cades in Galilee in the mount Nephthali, and Sychem in the mount Ephraim, and the city of Arboc; this is Chebron, in the mountain of Juda.

fresh_translation: And beyond the Jordan they gave Bosor in the wilderness in the plain from the tribe of Reuben, and Arēmōth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Gaulon in Bashanitis from the tribe of Manasseh.
brenton_translation: And beyond Jordan he appointed Bosor in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Ruben, and Aremoth in Galaad out of the tribe of Gad, and Gaulon in the country of Basan out of the tribe of Manasse.

fresh_translation: These are the appointed cities for the sons of Israel and for the resident foreigner staying among them, that everyone striking a life unintentionally might flee there, so that he may not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
brenton_translation: These were the cities selected for the sons of Israel, and for the stranger abiding among them, that every one who smites a soul unintentionally should flee thither, that he should not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he should stand before the congregation for judgment.

fresh_translation: And the heads of the fathers' houses of the sons of Levi approached Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Naue and the heads of the fathers' houses from the tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the heads of the families of the sons of Levi drew near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Naue, and to the heads of families of the tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: And they said to them in Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in and pasturelands for our cattle.
brenton_translation: And they spoke to them in Selo in the land of Chanaan, saying, The Lord gave commandment by Moses to give us cities to dwell in, and the country round about for our cattle.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites, in their inheriting, by command of the Lord, the cities and their pasturelands.
brenton_translation: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites in their inheritance by the command of the Lord the cities and the country round.

fresh_translation: And the lot came out for the clan of Kaath, and for the sons of Aaron the priests, the Levites, from the tribe of Judah and from the tribe of Simeon and from the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities by lot.
brenton_translation: And the lot came out for the children of Caath; and the sons of Aaron, the priests the Levites, had by lot thirteen cities out of the tribe of Juda, and out of the tribe of Symeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And for the sons of Kaath who were left, from the tribe of Ephraim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities by lot.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Caath that were left were given by lot ten cities, out of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And for the sons of Gedson, from the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Gedson had thirteen cities, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Aser, and out of the tribe of Nephthali, and out of the half tribe of Manasse in Basan.

fresh_translation: And for the sons of Merari according to their clans, from the tribe of Reuben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities by lot.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Merari according to their families had by lot twelve cities, out of the tribe of Ruben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zabulon.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their pasturelands, just as the Lord commanded Moses, by lot.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs, as the Lord commanded Moses, by lot.

fresh_translation: And the tribe of the sons of Judah and the tribe of the sons of Simeon and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin gave the cities that were called out
brenton_translation: And the tribe of the children of Juda, and the tribe of the children of Symeon, and part of the tribe of the children of Benjamin gave these cities, and they were assigned

fresh_translation: for the sons of Aaron from the clan of Kaath of the sons of Levi, because for these the lot came to be.
brenton_translation: to the sons of Aaron of the family of Caath of the sons of Levi, for the lot fell to these.

fresh_translation: And they gave them Kariatharbok, metropolis of the Anakim, this is Hebron, in the hill-country of Judah, and its pasturelands around it.
brenton_translation: And they gave to them Cariatharboc the metropolis of the sons of Enac; this is Chebron in the mountain country of Juda, and the suburbs round it.

fresh_translation: And Joshua gave the fields of the city and its villages to the sons of Caleb son of Jephonne in possession.
brenton_translation: But the lands of the city, and its villages Joshua gave to the sons of Chaleb the son of Jephonne for a possession.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Aaron they gave Hebron, city of refuge for the manslayer, and its set-apart lands with it, and Lemna and its set-apart lands toward it,
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Aaron he gave the city of refuge for the slayer, Chebron, and the suburbs belonging to it; and Lemna and the suburbs belonging to it;

fresh_translation: and Ailom and its set-apart lands, and Tema and its set-apart lands,
brenton_translation: and Ælom and its suburbs; and Tema and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Gella and its set-apart lands, and Dabir and its set-apart lands,
brenton_translation: and Gella and its suburbs; and Dabir and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Asa and its set-apart lands, and Tany and its set-apart lands, and Baithsamyis and its set-apart lands, nine cities from these two tribes.
brenton_translation: and Asa and its suburbs; and Tany and its suburbs; and Bæthsamys and its suburbs: nine cities from these two tribes.

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gabaon and its set-apart lands, and Gatheth and its set-apart lands,
brenton_translation: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gabaon and its suburbs; and Gatheth and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Anathoth and its set-apart lands, and Gamala and its set-apart lands, four cities.
brenton_translation: and Anathoth and its suburbs; and Gamala and its suburbs; four cities.

fresh_translation: All the cities of the sons of Aaron the priests were thirteen.
brenton_translation: All the cities of the sons of Aaron the priests, thirteen.

fresh_translation: And for the clans of the sons of Kaath, the Levites, who were left from the sons of Kaath, the cities of their boundaries came from the tribe of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And to the families, even the sons of Caath the Levites, that were left of the sons of Caath, there was given their priests' city,

fresh_translation: And they gave them the city of refuge for the manslayer, Sychem, and its set-apart lands, and Gazara and the lands toward it and its set-apart lands,
brenton_translation: out of the tribe of Ephraim; and they gave them the slayer's city of refuge, Sychem, and its suburbs, and Gazara and its appendages, and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Kabsaim and the set-apart lands toward it, and upper Baithoron and its set-apart lands, four cities.
brenton_translation: and Bæthoron and its suburbs: four cities:

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Dan, Elkothaim and its set-apart lands, and Gethedan and its set-apart lands,
brenton_translation: and of the tribe of Dan, Helcothaim and its suburbs; and Gethedan and its suburbs:

fresh_translation: and Ailon and its set-apart lands, and Getheremmon and its set-apart lands, four cities.
brenton_translation: and Ælon and its suburbs; and Getheremmon and its suburbs: four cities.

fresh_translation: And from the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach and its set-apart lands, and Iebatha and its set-apart lands, two cities.
brenton_translation: And out of the half tribe of Manasse, Tanach and its suburbs; and Jebatha and its suburbs; two cities.

fresh_translation: All the cities were ten, and the set-apart lands toward them, for the clans of the sons of Kaath who were left over.
brenton_translation: In all were given ten cities, and the suburbs of each belonging to them, to the families of the sons of Caath that remained.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Gedson, the Levites, from the half tribe of Manasseh, the cities set apart for the manslayers: Gaulon in Bashanitis and its set-apart lands, and Bosora and its set-apart lands, two cities.
brenton_translation: And Joshua gave to the sons of Gedson the Levites out of the other half tribe of Manasse cities set apart for the slayers, Gaulon in the country of Basan, and its suburbs; and Bosora and its suburbs; two cities.

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kison and its set-apart lands, and Debba and its set-apart lands,
brenton_translation: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kison and its suburbs; and Debba and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Remmath and its set-apart lands, and the spring of letters and its set-apart lands, four cities.
brenton_translation: and Remmath and its suburbs; and the well of Letters, and its suburbs; four cities.

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Asher, Basellan and its set-apart lands, and Dabbōn and its set-apart lands,
brenton_translation: And out of the tribe of Aser, Basella and its suburbs; and Dabbon and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Chelkath and its set-apart lands, and Raab and its set-apart lands, four cities.
brenton_translation: and Chelcat and its suburbs; and Raab and its suburbs; four cities.

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Naphtali, the city set apart for the manslayer, Kades in Galilee, and its set-apart lands, and Emmath and its set-apart lands, and Themmōn and its set-apart lands, three cities.
brenton_translation: And of the tribe of Nephthali, the city set apart for the slayer, Cades in Galilee, and its suburbs; and Nemmath, and its suburbs; and Themmon and its suburbs; three cities.

fresh_translation: All the cities of Gedson according to their clans were thirteen cities.
brenton_translation: All the cities of Gedson according to their families were thirteen cities.

fresh_translation: And to the clan of the sons of Merari, the Levites, the rest, from the tribe of the sons of Zebulun, Maan and its pasturelands, and Kades and its pasturelands,
brenton_translation: And to the family of the sons of Merari the Levites that remained, he gave out of the tribe of Zabulon, Maan and its suburbs; and Cades and its suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Demna and its pasturelands, and Sella and its pasturelands, four cities.
brenton_translation: and Sella and its suburbs: three cities.

fresh_translation: And beyond the Jordan by Jericho, from the tribe of Reuben, the city of refuge for the manslayer, Bosor in the wilderness in Misor, and its pasturelands, and Iazēr and its pasturelands,
brenton_translation: And beyond Jordan over against Jericho, out of the tribe of Ruben, the city of refuge for the slayer, Bosor in the wilderness; Miso and its suburbs; and Jazer and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Dekmōn and its pasturelands, and Mapha and its pasturelands, four cities.
brenton_translation: and Decmon and its suburbs; and Mapha and its suburbs; four cities.

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Gad, the city of refuge for the manslayer, Ramoth in Gilead and its pasturelands, and Kamin and its pasturelands,
brenton_translation: And out of the tribe of Gad the city of refuge for the slayer, both Ramoth in Galaad, and its suburbs; Camin and its suburbs;

fresh_translation: and Esebōn and its pasturelands, and Iazēr and its pasturelands, all four cities.
brenton_translation: and Esbon and its suburbs; and Jazer and its suburbs: the cities were four in all.

fresh_translation: All the cities for the sons of Merari according to their clans, the ones left over from the tribe of Levi, and their boundaries came to be twelve cities.
brenton_translation: All these cities were given to the sons of Merari according to the families of them that were left out of the tribe of Levi; and their limits were the twelve cities.

fresh_translation: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel were forty-eight cities and their pasturelands.
brenton_translation: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the children of Israel, were forty-eight cities,

fresh_translation: Around these cities each city had its pasturelands around the city, all these cities. And Joshua finished dividing the land within their boundaries. And the sons of Israel gave Joshua a share by command of the Lord; they gave him the city he asked, Thamnasarach, they gave it to him in the hill-country of Ephraim. And Joshua built the city and lived in it. And Joshua took the stone knives with which he circumcised the sons of Israel who were born on the way in the wilderness and placed them in Thamnasarach.
brenton_translation: and their suburbs round about these cities: a city and the suburbs round about the city to all these cities:

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave to Israel all the land that he swore to give to their fathers, and they inherited it and dwelt in it.
brenton_translation: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land which he sware to give to their fathers: and they inherited it, and dwelt in it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave them rest all around, just as he swore to their fathers. No one stood against them from all their enemies; the Lord gave all their enemies into their hands.
brenton_translation: And the Lord gave them rest round about, as he sware to their fathers: not one of all their enemies maintained his ground against them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hands.

fresh_translation: Not one word fell from all the good words that the Lord spoke to the sons of Israel; all came to pass.
brenton_translation: There failed not one of the good things which the Lord spoke to the children of Israel; all came to pass.

fresh_translation: Then Joshua called together the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh,
brenton_translation: Then Joshua called together the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse,

fresh_translation: and said to them, You have heard all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and you obeyed my voice according to all that I commanded you.
brenton_translation: and said to them, Ye have heard all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and ye have hearkened to my voice in all that he commanded you.

fresh_translation: You have not forsaken your brothers these many days until this day, and you have kept the commandment of the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Ye have not deserted your brethren these many days: until this day ye have kept the commandment of the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And now the Lord our God has given our brothers rest, as he told them. Now then, turn back and go to your houses and to the land of your possession that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And now the Lord our God has given our brethren rest, as he told them: now then return and depart to your homes, and to the land of your possession, which Moses gave you on the other side Jordan.

fresh_translation: Only take great care to do the commandments and the law that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded us to do: to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, and to cling to him and serve him with all your mind and with all your soul.
brenton_translation: But take great heed to do the commands and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you to do; to love the Lord our God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commands, and to cleave to him, and serve him with all your mind, and with all your soul.

fresh_translation: And Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their houses.
brenton_translation: And Joshua blessed them, and dismissed them; and they went to their homes.

fresh_translation: And to the half tribe of Manasseh Moses gave a share in Bashanitis, and to the other half Joshua gave a share with their brothers beyond the Jordan by the sea. And when Joshua sent them away to their houses, he blessed them,
brenton_translation: And to one half the tribe of Manasse Moses gave a portion in the land of Basan, and to the other half Joshua gave a portion with his brethren on the other side of Jordan westward: and when Joshua sent them away to their homes, then he blessed them.

fresh_translation: and they went away to their houses with much wealth and very much livestock and silver and gold and iron and much clothing, and they divided the plunder of their enemies with their brothers.
brenton_translation: And they departed with much wealth to their houses, and they divided the spoil of their enemies with their brethren; very much cattle, and silver, and gold, and iron, and much raiment.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of the sons of Manasseh went from the sons of Israel from Shiloh in the land of Canaan to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession which they inherited by command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
brenton_translation: So the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse, departed from the children of Israel in Selo in the land of Chanaan, to go away into Galaad, into the land of their possession, which they inherited by the command of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.

fresh_translation: And they came to Galgala of the Jordan, which is in the land of Canaan, and the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, a great altar to behold.
brenton_translation: And they came to Galaad of Jordan, which is in the land of Chanaan: and the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to look at.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel heard people saying, Behold, the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben and the half tribe of Manasseh built an altar on the borders of the land of Canaan, at Galaad of the Jordan, on the far side of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse have built an altar at the borders of the land of Chanaan at Galaad of Jordan, on the opposite side to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And all the sons of Israel gathered in Shiloh so as to go up to make war against them.
brenton_translation: And all the children of Israel gathered together to Selo, so as to go up and fight against them.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel sent to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the high priest,
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel sent to the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and to the sons of the half tribe of Manasse into the land of Galaad, both Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest,

fresh_translation: and ten leaders with him, one leader from each fathers' house from all the tribes of Israel; these were heads of fathers' houses, commanders of thousands in Israel.
brenton_translation: and ten of the chiefs with him; there was one chief of every household out of all the tribes of Israel; (the heads of families are the captains of thousands in Israel.)

fresh_translation: And they came to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben and to the half tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead and spoke to them, saying,
brenton_translation: And they came to the sons of Ruben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasse into the land of Galaad; and they spoke to them, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord, What is this trespass by which you have trespassed before the God of Israel, turning away today from the Lord by building for yourselves an altar, so that you become rebels against the Lord?
brenton_translation: Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord, What is this transgression that ye have transgressed before the God of Israel, to turn away today from the Lord, in that ye have built for yourselves an altar, so that ye should be apostates from the Lord?

fresh_translation: Is the sin of Phogor too little for us, from which we have not been cleansed until this day, and a plague came to be in the congregation of the Lord?
brenton_translation: Is the sin of Phogor too little for you, whereas we have not been cleansed from it until this day, though there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And will you turn away today from the Lord? And it shall be, if you revolt today from the Lord, then tomorrow wrath will be on all Israel.
brenton_translation: And ye have this day revolted from the Lord; and it shall come to pass if ye revolt this day from the Lord, that to-morrow there shall be wrath upon all Israel.

fresh_translation: And now, if the land of your possession is too little for you, cross over into the land of the possession of the Lord, where the tent of the Lord camps, and inherit among us. But do not become rebels against God, and do not turn away from the Lord by your building for yourselves an altar apart from the altar of the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: And now if the land of your possession be too little, cross over to the land of the possession of the Lord, where the tabernacle of the Lord dwells, and receive ye an inheritance among us; and do not become apostates from God, neither do ye apostatize from the Lord, because of your having built an altar apart from the altar of the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: Did not Achar son of Zara commit a trespass from the accursed thing, and wrath came upon all the congregation of Israel? Yet that one man did not die alone in his own sin.
brenton_translation: Lo! did not Achar the son of Zara commit a trespass taking of the accursed thing, and there was wrath on the whole congregation of Israel? and he himself died alone in his own sin.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered and spoke to the commanders of thousands of Israel, saying,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse answered, and spoke to the captains of the thousands of Israel, saying,

fresh_translation: God is God, the Lord, and God is God, the Lord. He himself knows, and Israel itself shall know. If in revolt we have trespassed before the Lord, may he not rescue us in this.
brenton_translation: God even God is the Lord, and God even God himself knows, and Israel he shall know; if we have transgressed before the Lord by apostasy, let him not deliver us this day.

fresh_translation: And if we built for ourselves an altar so as to turn away from the Lord our God, so as to offer on it sacrifices of whole burnt offerings or so as to make on it a sacrifice of salvation, the Lord himself shall require it.
brenton_translation: And if we have built to ourselves an altar, so as to apostatize from the Lord our God, so as to offer upon it a sacrifice of whole-burnt-offerings, so as to offer upon it a sacrifice of peace-offering,—the Lord shall require it.

fresh_translation: But because of caution over this matter we did this, saying, So that tomorrow your children may not say to our children, What have you to do with the Lord God of Israel?
brenton_translation: But we have done this for the sake of precaution concerning this thing, saying, Lest hereafter your sons should say to our sons, What have ye to do with the Lord God of Israel?

fresh_translation: For the Lord set the Jordan as a boundary between us and you, and you have no share of the Lord. And your children will estrange our children, so that they no longer worship the Lord.
brenton_translation: Whereas the Lord has set boundaries between us and you, even Jordan, and ye have no portion in the Lord: so your sons shall alienate our sons, that they should not worship the Lord.

fresh_translation: And we said to do this, to build this altar, not for offerings nor for sacrifices,
brenton_translation: And we gave orders to do thus, to build this altar, not for burnt-offerings, nor for meat-offerings;

fresh_translation: but so that this may be a witness between us and you and between our generations after us, to render service to the Lord before him in our offerings and in our sacrifices and in our sacrifices of salvation, and your children will not say to our children tomorrow, You have no share in the Lord.
brenton_translation: but that this may be a witness between you and us, and between our posterity after us, that we may do service to the Lord before him, with our burnt-offerings and our meat-offerings and our peace-offerings: so your sons shall not say to our sons, hereafter, Ye have no portion in the Lord.

fresh_translation: And we said, if ever it happens and they speak to us and to our generations tomorrow, then we shall say, See the likeness of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for offerings nor for sacrifices, but it is a witness between you and us and between our sons.
brenton_translation: And we said, If ever it should come to pass that they should speak so to us, or to our posterity hereafter; then shall they say, Behold the likeness of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for the sake of burnt-offerings, nor for the sake of meat-offerings, but it is a witness between you and us, and between our sons.

fresh_translation: May it never be for us to turn away from the Lord in these days, to revolt from the Lord, so as to build for ourselves an altar for offerings and sacrifices of well-being and the sacrifice of salvation besides the altar of the Lord that is before his tent.
brenton_translation: Far be it from us therefore that we should turn away from the Lord this day so as to apostatize from the Lord, so as that we should build an altar for burnt-offerings, and for peace-offerings, besides the altar of the Lord which is before his tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And when Phinehas the priest and all the leaders of the congregation of Israel who were with him heard the words that the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them.
brenton_translation: And Phinees the priest and all the chiefs of the congregation of Israel who were with him heard the words which the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse spoke; and it pleased them.

fresh_translation: And Phinehas the priest said to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half tribe of Manasseh, Today we know that the Lord is with us, because you did not trespass against the Lord in a trespass, and because you rescued the sons of Israel from the hand of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Phinees the priest said to the sons of Ruben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half of the tribe of Manasse, To-day we know that the Lord is with us, because ye have not trespassed grievously against the Lord, and because ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Phinehas the priest and the leaders returned from the sons of Reuben and from the sons of Gad and from the half tribe of Manasseh, from the land of Gilead to the land of Canaan to the sons of Israel, and they answered them with the words.
brenton_translation: So Phinees the priest and the princes departed from the children of Ruben, and from the children of Gad, and from the half tribe of Manasse out of Galaad into the land of Chanaan to the children of Israel; and reported the words to them.

fresh_translation: And it pleased the sons of Israel, and they spoke to the sons of Israel and blessed the God of the sons of Israel, and said that they would no longer go up against them in war to destroy the land of the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh, and they dwelt upon it.
brenton_translation: And it pleased the children of Israel; and they spoke to the children of Israel, and blessed the God of the children of Israel, and told them to go up no more to war against the others to destroy the land of the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse: so they dwelt upon it.

fresh_translation: And Joshua named the altar of the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half tribe of Manasseh, and said, It is a witness between them that the Lord is their God.
brenton_translation: And Joshua gave a name to the altar of the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and of the half tribe of Manasse; and said, It is a testimony in the midst of them, that the Lord is their God.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after many days, after the Lord gave Israel rest from all their enemies all around, and Joshua was old, advanced in days,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after many days after the Lord had given Israel rest from all his enemies round about, that Joshua was old and advanced in years.

fresh_translation: that Joshua called all the sons of Israel and their council and their leaders and their scribes and their judges, and said to them, I have grown old, I am advanced in days.
brenton_translation: And Joshua called together all the children of Israel, and their elders, and their chiefs, and their judges, and their officers; and said to them, I am old and advanced in years.

fresh_translation: And you have seen all that the Lord your God did to all these nations from before you, because the Lord your God is the one who fought for you.
brenton_translation: And ye have seen all that the Lord our God has done to all these nations before us; for it is the Lord our God who has fought for you.

fresh_translation: See, I have allotted to you these nations left over to you by lots for your tribes, from the Jordan and all the nations that I destroyed, and from the great sea it shall bound westward.
brenton_translation: See, that I have given to you these nations that are left to you by lots to your tribes, all the nations beginning at Jordan; and some I have destroyed; and the boundaries shall be at the great sea westward.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God himself will destroy them from before you until they perish, and he will send to them the wild beasts until he destroys them and their kings from before you, and you shall inherit their land just as the Lord your God spoke to you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord our God, he shall destroy them before us, until they utterly perish; and he shall send against them the wild beasts, until he shall have utterly destroyed them and their kings from before you; and ye shall inherit their land, as the Lord our God said to you.

fresh_translation: Therefore be very strong to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, so that you do not turn aside to the right or to the left,
brenton_translation: Do ye therefore strive diligently to observe and do all things written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not to the right hand or to the left;

fresh_translation: so that you do not enter among these nations that are left over, and the names of their gods shall not be named among you, and you shall certainly not bow down to them nor serve them.
brenton_translation: that ye go not in among these nations that are left; and the names of their gods shall not be named among you, neither shall ye serve them, neither shall ye bow down to them.

fresh_translation: But to the Lord your God you shall cling, just as you have done until this day.
brenton_translation: But ye shall cleave to the Lord our God, as ye have done until this day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord destroyed from before you great and strong nations, and no one stood against you until this day.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall destroy them before you, even great and strong nations; and no one has stood before us until this day.

fresh_translation: One of you chased a thousand, because the Lord your God was fighting for you, just as he said to you.
brenton_translation: One of you has chased a thousand, for the Lord our God, he fought for you, as he said to you.

fresh_translation: And take great care to love the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And take ye great heed to love the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: For if you turn back and attach yourselves to these nations left over with you and make marriages with them and mingle with them and they with you,
brenton_translation: For if ye shall turn aside and attach yourselves to these nations that are left with you, and make marriages with them, and become mingled with them and they with you,

fresh_translation: know that the Lord will certainly not continue to destroy these nations from before you, and they shall become snares for you and scandals and nails in your heels and darts in your eyes until you perish from this good land that the Lord your God gave you.
brenton_translation: know that the Lord will no more destroy these nations from before you; and they will be to you snares and stumbling-blocks, and nails in your heels, and darts in your eyes, until ye be destroyed from off this good land, which the Lord your God has given you.

fresh_translation: And behold, I am departing on the way, just as all on the earth, and you shall know in your heart and in your soul that not one word has failed from all the words that the Lord your God spoke concerning all that belongs to you; none of them has fallen away.
brenton_translation: But I hasten to go the way of death, as all that are upon the earth also do: and know ye in your heart and in your soul, that not one word has fallen to the ground of all the words which the Lord our God has spoken respecting all that concerns us; there has not one of them failed.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, just as all the good words that the Lord spoke to you have come upon you, so the Lord your God will bring upon you all the evil words until he destroys you from this good land that the Lord gave you.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, that as all the good things are come upon us which the Lord spoke concerning you, so the Lord God will bring upon you all the evil things, until he shall have destroyed you from off this good land, which the Lord has given you,

fresh_translation: when you transgress the covenant of the Lord your God that he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them.
brenton_translation: when ye transgress the covenant of the Lord our God, which he has charged us, and go and serve other gods, and bow down to them.

fresh_translation: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shiloh and called together their elders and their scribes and their judges, and he set them before God.
brenton_translation: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Selo, and convoked their elders, and their officers, and their judges, and set them before God.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: From the beginning your fathers lived beyond the river, Thara the father of Abraham and the father of Nachor, and they served other gods.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Your fathers at first sojourned beyond the river, even Thara, the father of Abraam and the father of Nachor; and they served other gods.

fresh_translation: And I took your father Abraham from beyond the river and led him through all the land, and I multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac.
brenton_translation: And I took your father Abraam from the other side of the river, and I guided him through all the land, and I multiplied his seed;

fresh_translation: And to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau, and to Esau I gave Mount Seir for his inheritance, and Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt and became there a great and numerous and strong nation.
brenton_translation: and I gave to him Isaac, and to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau mount Seir for him to inherit: and Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt, and became there a great and populous and mighty nation: and the Egyptians afflicted them.

fresh_translation: And the Egyptians afflicted them, and the Lord struck Egypt with the things he did among them, and after these things he brought you out.
brenton_translation: And I smote Egypt with the wonders that I wrought among them.

fresh_translation: Out of Egypt you came, and you entered the Red Sea, and the Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and horses to the Red Sea.
brenton_translation: And afterwards God brought out our fathers from Egypt, and ye entered into the Red Sea; and the Egyptians pursued after our fathers with chariots and horses into the Red Sea.

fresh_translation: And we cried out to the Lord, and he put cloud and gloom between us and between the Egyptians, and he brought the sea upon them and covered them, and your eyes saw what the Lord did in the land of Egypt, and you were in the wilderness many days.
brenton_translation: And we cried aloud to the Lord; and he put a cloud and darkness between us and the Egyptians, and he brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen all that the Lord did in the land of Egypt; and ye were in the wilderness many days.

fresh_translation: And he brought you into the land of the Amorites who dwell beyond the Jordan, and they arrayed themselves against you, and the Lord gave them into your hands, and you inherited their land and destroyed them from before you.
brenton_translation: And he brought us into the land of the Amorites that dwelt beyond Jordan, and the Lord delivered them into our hands; and ye inherited their land, and utterly destroyed them from before you.

fresh_translation: And Balak son of Sepphor, king of Moab, rose up and made war against Israel, and he sent and called Balaam to curse you.
brenton_translation: And Balac, king of Moab, son of Sepphor, rose up, and made war against Israel, and sent and called Balaam to curse us.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God was not willing to destroy you, and with blessing he blessed you and delivered you from their hands and gave them over.
brenton_translation: But the Lord thy God would not destroy thee; and he greatly blessed us, and rescued us out of their hands, and delivered them to us.

fresh_translation: And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho, and those dwelling in Jericho fought against you: the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite and the Hittite and the Girgashite, and the Lord gave them into your hands.
brenton_translation: And ye crossed over Jordan, and came to Jericho; and the inhabitants of Jericho fought against us, the Amorite, and the Chananite, and the Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Jebusite, and the Chettite, and the Gergesite, and the Lord delivered them into our hands.

fresh_translation: And he sent ahead of you the hornet, and it drove them out from before you, twelve kings of the Amorites, not by your sword nor by your bow.
brenton_translation: And he sent forth the hornet before you; and he drove them out from before you, even twelve kings of the Amorites, not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

fresh_translation: And he gave you a land on which you did not labor, and cities that you did not build, and you settled in them, and you eat vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.
brenton_translation: And he gave you a land on which ye did not labour, and cities which ye did not build, and ye were settled in them; and ye eat of vineyards and oliveyards which ye did not plant.

fresh_translation: And now fear the Lord and serve him in uprightness and in righteousness, and remove the foreign gods that your fathers served beyond the river and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.
brenton_translation: And now fear the Lord, and serve him in righteousness and justice; and remove the strange gods, which our fathers served beyond the river, and in Egypt; and serve the Lord.

fresh_translation: But if it does not please you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve, whether the gods of your fathers beyond the river or the gods of the Amorites among whom you dwell on their land. But I and my house will serve the Lord, because he is holy.
brenton_translation: But if it seem not good to you to serve the Lord, choose to yourselves this day whom ye will serve, whether the gods of your fathers that were on the other side of the river, or the gods of the Amorites, among whom ye dwell upon their land: but I and my house will serve the Lord, for he is holy.

fresh_translation: And the people answered and said, May it never be for us to forsake the Lord so as to serve other gods.
brenton_translation: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us to forsake the Lord, so as to serve other gods.

fresh_translation: The Lord our God, he is God; he brought up us and our fathers out of Egypt and preserved us in all the way in which we went and among all the nations through whom we passed.
brenton_translation: The Lord our God, he is God; he brought up us and our fathers from Egypt, and kept us in all the way wherein we walked, and among all the nations through whom we passed.

fresh_translation: And the Lord drove out the Amorite and all the nations dwelling in the land from before us. Therefore we also will serve the Lord, for he is our God.
brenton_translation: And the Lord cast out the Amorite, and all the nations that inhabited the land from before us: yea, we will serve the Lord, for he is our God.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the people, You will not be able to serve the Lord, because he is a holy and jealous God; he will not forgive your sins and your lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Indeed ye will not be able to serve the Lord, for God is holy; and he being jealous will not forgive your sins and your transgressions.

fresh_translation: Whenever you forsake the Lord and serve other gods, then coming upon you he will mistreat you and consume you in return for the good things he did for you.
brenton_translation: Whensoever ye shall forsake the Lord and serve other gods, then he shall come upon you and afflict you, and consume you, because he has done you good.

fresh_translation: And the people said to Joshua, No, but we will serve the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the people said to Joshua, Nay, but we will serve the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you chose the Lord, to serve him.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves, that ye have chosen the Lord to serve him.

fresh_translation: And now remove the foreign gods among you and direct your heart toward the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And now take away the strange gods that are among you, and set your heart right toward the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the Lord and we will listen to his voice.
brenton_translation: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the Lord, and we will hearken to his voice.

fresh_translation: And Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day and gave them law and judgment in Shiloh before the tent of the God of Israel.
