fresh_translation: And he said to the men of Sokchōth, Give now loaves to the people with me, because they are hungry, and I am pursuing after Zēbee and Salmana, kings of Midian.
brenton_translation: And he said to the men of Socchoth, Give, I pray you, bread to feed this people that follow me; because they are faint, and behold, I am following after Zebee and Salmana, kings of Madiam.

fresh_translation: And the leaders of Sokchōth said, Is the hand of Zēbee and Salmana now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?
brenton_translation: And the princes of Socchoth said, Are the hands of Zebee and Salmana now in thy hand, that we should give bread to thy host?

fresh_translation: And Gideon said, Not so. When the Lord gives Zēbee and Salmana into my hand, I will thresh your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with the barkonnim.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said, Therefore when the Lord gives Zebee and Salmana into my hand, then will I tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness, and the Barkenim.

fresh_translation: And he went up from there to Phanouēl and spoke to them in the same way, and the men of Phanouēl answered him just as the men of Sokchōth answered him.
brenton_translation: And he went up thence to Phanuel, and spoke to them likewise: and the men of Phanuel answered him as the men of Socchoth had answered him.

fresh_translation: And he said to the men of Phanouēl, saying, When I return in peace, I will dig down this tower.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to the men of Phanuel, When I return in peace, I will break down this tower.

fresh_translation: And Zēbee and Salmana were in Karkar, and their camp with them was about fifteen thousand, those left in all the camp of the sons of the east, and those fallen were one hundred twenty thousand men drawing sword.
brenton_translation: And Zebee and Salmana were in Carcar, and their host was with them, about fifteen thousand, all that were left of all the host of the aliens; and they that fell were a hundred and twenty thousand men that drew the sword.

fresh_translation: And Gideon went up by the way of those dwelling in tents east of Nabeth, opposite Zēbee, and struck the camp, and the camp was confident.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents, eastward of Nabai and Jegebal; and he smote the host, and the host was secure.

fresh_translation: And Zēbee and Salmana fled, and he pursued after them and seized the two kings of Midian, Zēbee and Salmana, and crushed all their camp.
brenton_translation: And Zebee and Salmana fled; and he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Madiam, Zebee and Salmana, and discomfited all the army.

fresh_translation: And Gideon son of Jōas returned from the war by the ascent of Ares.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon the son of Joas returned from the battle, down from the battle of Ares.

fresh_translation: And he captured a young servant from the men of Sokchōth and questioned him, and he wrote down for him the leaders of Sokchōth and its elders, seventy-seven men.
brenton_translation: And he took prisoner a young lad of the men of Socchoth, and questioned him; and he wrote to him the names of the princes of Socchoth and of their elders, seventy-seven men.

fresh_translation: And Gideon came to the leaders of Sokchōth and said to them, Behold, Zēbee and Salmana, about whom you reproached me, saying, Is the hand of Zēbee and Salmana now in your hand, that we should give loaves to your exhausted men?
brenton_translation: And Gedeon came to the princes of Socchoth, and said, Behold Zebee and Salmana, about whom ye reproached me, saying, Are the hands of Zebee and Salmana now in thy hand, that we should give bread to thy men that are faint?

fresh_translation: And he took the leaders and the elders of the city and threshed them with the thorns of the wilderness and the bramble bushes, and with them he threshed the men of Sokchōth.
brenton_translation: And he took the elders of the city with the thorns of the wilderness and the Barkenim, and with them he tore the men of the city.

fresh_translation: And he dug down the tower of Phanouēl and killed the men of the city.
brenton_translation: And he overthrew the tower of Phanuel, and slew the men of the city.

fresh_translation: And he said to Zēbee and Salmana, Where are the men whom you killed at Thabor? And they said, As you are, so were they, like the appearance, the form, of sons of kings.
brenton_translation: And he said to Zebee and Salmana, Where are the men whom ye slew in Thabor? and they said, As thou, so were they, according to the likeness of the son of a king.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said, They are my brothers and sons of my mother. As the Lord lives, if you had kept them alive, I would not kill you.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said, They were my brethren and the sons of my mother: as the Lord lives, if ye had preserved them alive, I would not have slain you.

fresh_translation: And he said to Jether his firstborn, Rise, kill them. But the young man did not draw his sword, because he was afraid, because he was younger.
brenton_translation: And he said to Jether his first-born, Rise and slay them; but the lad drew not his sword, for he was afraid, for he was yet very young.

fresh_translation: And Zēbee and Salmana said, Rise yourself and fall upon us, because as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon rose and killed Zēbee and Salmana and took the crescents that were on the necks of their camels.
brenton_translation: And Zebee and Salmana said, Rise thou and fall upon us, for thy power is as that of a man; and Gedeon arose, and slew Zebee and Salmana; and he took the round ornaments that were on the necks of their camels.

fresh_translation: And a man of Israel said to Gideon, Rule over us, you and your sons, because you saved us from the hand of Midian.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel said to Gedeon, Rule, my lord, over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son; for thou hast saved us out of the hand of Madiam.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said to them, I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the Lord will rule over you.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to them, I will not rule, and my son shall not rule among you; the Lord shall rule over you.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said to them, I will ask from you a request, and give me, each man, an earring from his spoil, because they had many gold earrings, for they were Ishmaelites.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to them, I will make a request of you, and do ye give me every man an earring out of his spoils: for they had golden earrings, for they were Ismaelites.

fresh_translation: And they said, Giving, we will give. And he spread out his garment, and there each man threw a gold earring from his spoil.
brenton_translation: And they said, We will certainly give them: and he opened his garment, and each man cast therein an earring of his spoils.

fresh_translation: And the weight of the gold earrings that he requested came to one thousand seven hundred shekels of gold, apart from the little moons and the necklaces and the purple garments that were upon the kings of Midian, and apart from the gold collars that were on the necks of their camels.
brenton_translation: And the weight of the golden earrings which he asked, was a thousand and seven hundred pieces of gold, besides the crescents, and the chains, and the garments, and the purple cloths that were on the kings of Madiam, and besides the chains that were on the necks of their camels.

fresh_translation: And Gideon made it into an ephod and set it in his city in Ephratha, and all Israel prostituted themselves after it there, and it became for Gideon and for his house as a snare.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon made an ephod of it, and set it in his city in Ephratha; and all Israel went thither a whoring after it, and it became a stumbling-block to Gedeon and his house.

fresh_translation: And Midian was put to shame before the sons of Israel, and they no longer lifted up their head, and the land was at rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
brenton_translation: And Madiam was straitened before the children of Israel, and they did not lift up their head any more; and the land had rest forty years in the days of Gedeon.

fresh_translation: And Jerobaal son of Jōas went and dwelt in his house.
brenton_translation: And Jerobaal the son of Joas went and sat in his house.

fresh_translation: And Gideon had seventy sons coming out from his loins, because he had many wives.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon had seventy sons begotten of his body, for he had many wives.

fresh_translation: And his concubine who was in Sikimois also bore him a son, and he set his name Abimelech.
brenton_translation: And his concubine was in Sychem, and she also bore him a son, and gave him the name Abimelech.

fresh_translation: And Gideon son of Jōas died in a good old age and was buried in the tomb of Jōas his father in Ephratha of the father of Abiezri.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon son of Joas died in his city, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joas his father in Ephratha of Abi-Esdri.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when Gideon died, the sons of Israel turned back and prostituted themselves after the Baals and made Baal-berith their covenant, for him to be a god to them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Gedeon was dead, that the children of Israel turned, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made for themselves a covenant with Baal that he should be their god.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did not remember the Lord their God, the one who delivered them from the hand of all their enemies all around.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel remembered not the Lord their God who had delivered them out of the hand of all that afflicted them round about.

fresh_translation: And they did not show mercy with the house of Jerobaal Gideon according to all the goodness that he did with Israel.
brenton_translation: And they did not deal mercifully with the house of Jerobaal, (the same is Gedeon) according to all the good which he did to Israel.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech son of Jerobaal went to Sikima to the brothers of his mother and spoke to them and to all the kin of his mother's house, saying,
brenton_translation: And Abimelech son of Jerobaal went to Sychem to his mother's brethren; and he spoke to them and to all the kindred of the house of his mother's father, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak now in the ears of the men of Sikima, Which is better, that seventy men, all the sons of Jerobaal, rule over you, or that one man rule over you? And remember that I am your flesh and your bone.
brenton_translation: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Sychem, saying, Which is better for you, that seventy men, even all the sons of Jerobaal, should reign over you, or that one man should reign over you? and remember that I am your bone and your flesh.

fresh_translation: And his mother's brothers spoke concerning him in the ears of all the men of Sikima all these words, and their heart inclined after Abimelech, because they said, He is our brother.
brenton_translation: And his mother's brethren spoke concerning him in the ears of all the men of Sychem all these words; and their heart turned after Abimelech, for they said, He is our brother.

fresh_translation: And they gave him seventy silver pieces from the house of Baal-covenant, and with them Abimelech hired empty and stunned men, and they went after him.
brenton_translation: And they gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith; and Abimelech hired for himself vain and cowardly men, and they went after him.

fresh_translation: And he entered into his father's house at Ephratha and killed his brothers, the sons of Jerobaal, seventy men, on one stone. And Jōatham, the youngest son of Jerobaal, was left, because he hid himself.
brenton_translation: And he went to the house of his father to Ephratha, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerobaal, seventy men upon one stone; but Joatham the youngest son of Jerobaal was left, for he hid himself.

fresh_translation: And all the men of Sikima and all the house of Maallōn were gathered together, and they went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the standing place in Sikimois.
brenton_translation: And all the men of Sicima, and all the house of Bethmaalo, were gathered together, and they went and made Abimelech king by the oak of Sedition, which was at Sicima.

fresh_translation: And they reported it to Jōatham, and he went and stood on the top of Mount Garizin and lifted up his voice and cried out and said to them, Hear me, men of Sikima, and may God hear you.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to Joatham, and he went and stood on the top of mount Garizin, and lifted up his voice, and wept, and said to them, Hear me, ye men of Sicima, and God shall hear you.

fresh_translation: Going, the trees went to anoint for themselves a king, and they said to the olive tree, Reign over us.
brenton_translation: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said to the olive, Reign over us.

fresh_translation: And the olive tree said to them, Shall I leave my fatness, by which God and men are glorified in me, and go to rule the trees?
brenton_translation: But the olive said to them, Shall I leave my fatness, with which men shall glorify God, and go to be promoted over the trees?

fresh_translation: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come, reign over us.
brenton_translation: And the trees said to the fig-tree, Come, reign over us.

fresh_translation: And the fig tree said to them, Shall I leave my sweetness and my good produce and go to rule over trees?
brenton_translation: But the fig-tree said to them, Shall I leave my sweetness and my good fruits, and go to be promoted over the trees?

fresh_translation: And the trees said to the vine, Come, reign over us.
brenton_translation: And the trees said to the vine, Come, reign over us.

fresh_translation: And the vine said to them, Shall I leave my wine, the gladness from God of men, and go to rule trees?
brenton_translation: And the vine said to them, Shall I leave my wine that cheers God and men, and go to be promoted over the trees?

fresh_translation: And the trees said to the thorn bush, Come, you reign over us.
brenton_translation: Then all the trees said to the bramble, Come thou and reign over us.

fresh_translation: And the thorn bush said to the trees, If in truth you anoint me as king over you, come and trust in my shade, but if not, let fire come out from the thorn bush and consume the cedars of Lebanon.
brenton_translation: And the bramble said to the trees, If ye in truth anoint me to reign over you, come, stand under my shadow; and if not, let fire come out from me and devour the cedars of Libanus.

fresh_translation: And now, if in truth and in perfection you acted and made Abimelech king, and if you acted well with Jerobaal and with his house, and if you acted toward him according to the repayment of his hand,
brenton_translation: And now, if ye have done it in truth and integrity, and have made Abimelech king, and if ye have wrought well with Jerobaal, and with his house, and if ye have done to him according to the reward of his hand,

fresh_translation: as my father fought for you and cast his life in front and delivered you from the hand of Midian,
brenton_translation: as my father fought for you, and put his life in jeopardy, and delivered you out of the hand of Madiam;

fresh_translation: but you rose up against my father's house today and killed his sons, seventy men, on one stone, and made Abimelech, son of his maidservant, king over the men of Sikima because he is your brother,
brenton_translation: and ye are risen up this day against the house of my father, and have slain his sons, being seventy men, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech the son of his bondwoman king over the men of Sicima, because he is your brother:

fresh_translation: then if in truth and perfection you acted with Jerobaal and with his house on this day, may you be blessed, and rejoice in Abimelech, and may he also rejoice in you.
brenton_translation: if then ye have done truly and faithfully with Jerobaal, and with his house this day, rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice over you:

fresh_translation: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and consume the men of Sikima and the house of Maallōn, and if not, let fire come out from the men of Sikima and from the house of Maallōn and consume Abimelech.
brenton_translation: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Sicima, and the house of Beth-maalo; and let fire come out from the men of Sicima and from the house of Beth-maalo, and devour Abimelech.

fresh_translation: And Jōatham ran away and went on the road and fled to Rara and dwelt there away from the face of Abimelech his brother.
brenton_translation: And Joatham fled, and ran away, and went as far as Bæer, and dwelt there out of the way of his brother Abimelech.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech ruled over Israel three years.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech reigned over Israel three years.

fresh_translation: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and between the men of Sikima, and the men of Sikima acted treacherously in the house of Abimelech,
brenton_translation: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Sicima; and the men of Sicima dealt treacherously with the house of Abimelech:

fresh_translation: to bring the injustice of the seventy sons of Jerobaal and to lay their blood upon Abimelech their brother who killed them, and upon the men of Sikima who strengthened his hands so as to kill his brothers.
brenton_translation: to bring the injury done to the seventy sons of Jerobaal, and to lay their blood upon their brother Abimelech, who slew them, and upon the men of Sicima, because they strengthened his hands to slay his brethren.

fresh_translation: And the men of Sikima set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who passed by them on the road, and it was reported to Abimelech.
brenton_translation: And the men of Sicima set liers in wait against him on the top of the mountains, and robbed every one who passed by them on the way; and it was reported to the king Abimelech.

fresh_translation: And Gaal son of Abed came, and his brothers, into Sikima, and the men of Sikima trusted in him.
brenton_translation: And Gaal son of Jobel came, and his brethren, and passed by Sicima, and the men of Sicima trusted in him.

fresh_translation: And they went out into the field and gathered the grapes of their vineyards and trod them and made dances and entered the house of their god and ate and drank and cursed Abimelech.
brenton_translation: And they went out into the field, and gathered their grapes, and trod them, and made merry; and they brought the grapes into the house of their god, and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

fresh_translation: And Gaal son of Abed said, What is Abimelech, and who is the son of Sychem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerobaal, and Zeboul his overseer, his servant with the men of Emmōr father of Sychem? And why should we serve him?
brenton_translation: And Gaal the son of Jobel said, Who is Abimelech, and who is the son of Sychem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerobaal, and is not Zebul his steward, his servant with the son of Emmor the father of Sychem? and why should we serve him?

fresh_translation: And if someone would give this people into my hand, then I would remove Abimelech, and I would say to Abimelech, Increase your force and come out.
brenton_translation: And would that this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech, and I would say to him, Multiply thy host, and come out.

fresh_translation: And Zeboul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Abed and his anger burned.
brenton_translation: And Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Jobel, and he was very angry.

fresh_translation: And he sent messengers to Abimelech with gifts, saying, Behold, Gaal son of Abed and his brothers have arrived in Sikima, and behold, they are besieging the city against you.
brenton_translation: And he sent messengers to Abimelech secretly, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Jobel and his brethren are come to Sychem; and behold, they have besieged the city against thee.

fresh_translation: And now rise by night, you and the people with you, and lie in ambush in the field.
brenton_translation: And now rise up by night, thou and the people with thee, and lay wait in the field.

fresh_translation: And it shall be in the morning, with the sun rising, you shall rise early and spread out against the city, and behold, he and the people with him are coming out to you, and you shall do to him just as your hand finds.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in the morning at sunrising, thou shalt rise up early and draw toward the city; and behold, he and the people with him will come forth against thee, and thou shalt do to him according to thy power.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech rose, and all the people with him, by night, and they lay in ambush against Sikima in four companies.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech and all the people with him rose up by night, and formed an ambuscade against Sychem in four companies.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the morning, Gaal son of Abed went out and stood at the doorway of the city gate, and Abimelech rose, and the people with him, out of the ambushes.
brenton_translation: And Gaal the son of Jobel went forth, and stood by the door of the gate of the city: and Abimelech and the people with him rose up from the ambuscade.

fresh_translation: And Gaal son of Abed saw the people and said to Zeboul, Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains. And Zeboul said to him, You are seeing the shadow of the mountains as men.
brenton_translation: And Gaal the son of Jobel saw the people, and said to Zebul, Behold, a people comes down from the top of the mountains: and Zebul said to him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as men.

fresh_translation: And Gaal continued yet to speak and said, Behold, people are coming down by the sea from near the navel of the land, and one company is coming by way of the oak of the lookouts.
brenton_translation: And Gaal continued to speak and said, Behold, a people comes down westward from the part bordering on the middle of the land, and another company comes by the way of Helon Maonenim.

fresh_translation: And Zeboul said to him, Where is your mouth now, the one saying, Who is Abimelech that we should serve him? Behold, this is the people whom you despised. Go out now and fight against him.
brenton_translation: And Zebul said to him, And where is thy mouth as thou spokest, Who is Abimelech that we should serve him? Is not this the people whom thou despisedst? go forth now, and set the battle in array against him.

fresh_translation: And Gaal went out before the men of Sikima and fought against Abimelech.
brenton_translation: And Gaal went forth before the men of Sychem, and set the battle in array against Abimelech.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech pursued him, and he fled from before him, and many wounded fell as far as the doors of the city.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech pursued him, and he fled from before him; and many fell down slain as far as the door of the gate.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech sat in Arima, and Zeboul drove out Gaal and his brothers from dwelling in Sikimois.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech entered into Arema, and Zebul cast out Gaal and his brethren, so that they should not dwell in Sychem.

fresh_translation: And it came to be the next day, the people went out into the plain, and it was reported to Abimelech.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the second day that the people went out into the field, and one brought word to Abimelech.

fresh_translation: And he took the people and divided it into three companies and lay in ambush in it, and he saw, and behold, the people were coming out of the city, and he rose up against them and struck them.
brenton_translation: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and formed an ambush in the field; and he looked, and, behold, the people went forth out of the city, and he rose up against them, and smote them.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech and the companies with him spread out and stood by the gate of the city, and the two companies rushed upon all who were in the field and struck them.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech and the chiefs of companies that were with him rushed forward, and stood by the door of the gate of the city; and the two other companies rushed forward upon all that were in the field, and smote them.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day and took the city, and he killed the people in it and tore down the city and sowed it with salt.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day, and took the city, and slew the people that were in it, and destroyed the city, and sowed it with salt.

fresh_translation: And all the men of the tower of Sikima heard, and they entered into the stronghold of the house of Baal-covenant.
brenton_translation: And all the men of the tower of Sychem heard, and came to the gathering of Bæthel-berith.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Sikima had gathered together.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Sychem were gathered together.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech went up to Mount Selmōn, he and all the people with him, and Abimelech took an axe in his hand and cut a load of wood and took it and put it on his shoulders and said to the people with him, What you saw me doing, quickly do as I also did.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech went up to the mount of Selmon, and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a branch of a tree, and took it, and laid it on his shoulders; and said to the people that were with him, What ye see me doing, do quickly as I.

fresh_translation: And they also each cut a load and took it and went after Abimelech and put it against the stronghold and burned the stronghold upon them with fire, and all the men of the tower of Sikima died, about a thousand men and women.
brenton_translation: And they cut down likewise even every man a branch, and went after Abimelech, and laid them against the place of gathering, and burnt the place of gathering over them with fire; and they died, even all the men of the tower of Sicima, about a thousand men and women.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech went to Thebes and encamped against it and seized it first.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech went out of Bæthel-berith, and encamped against Thebes, and took it.

fresh_translation: And there was a strong tower in the midst of the city, and all the men and women and all the leaders of the city fled there and shut themselves in and went up to the roof of the tower.
brenton_translation: And there was a strong tower in the midst of the city; and thither all the men and the women of the city fled, and shut the door without them, and went up on the roof of the tower.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech came as far as the tower and made war against it, and Abimelech came near the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
brenton_translation: And Abimelech drew near to the tower, and they besieged it; and Abimelech drew near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

fresh_translation: And one woman threw a fragment of millstone upon the head of Abimelech and shattered his skull.
brenton_translation: And a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon the head of Abimelech, and broke his skull.

fresh_translation: And he quickly called to the young man carrying his armor and said to him, Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say, A woman killed him. And his young man pierced him through, and Abimelech died.
brenton_translation: And he cried out quickly to the young man his armour-bearer, and said to him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, lest at any time they should say, A woman slew him: and his young man thrust him through and he died.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel saw that Abimelech had died, and each man went to his place.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead; and they went each to his place.

fresh_translation: And God returned the evil of Abimelech that he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers.
brenton_translation: So God requited the wickedness of Abimelech, which he wrought against his father, in slaying his seventy brethren.

fresh_translation: And all the evil of the men of Sikima God returned upon their head, and the curse of Jōatham son of Jerobaal came upon them.
brenton_translation: And all the wickedness of the men of Sychem God requited upon their head; and the curse of Joatham the son of Jerobaal came upon them.

fresh_translation: And after Abimelech there arose to save Israel Thōla son of Phoua, son of his father's brother, a man of Issachar, and he dwelt in Samaria in the hill-country of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And after Abimelech Thola the son of Phua rose up to save Israel, being the son of his father's brother, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Samir in mount Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And he judged Israel twenty-three years, and he died and was buried in Samaria.
brenton_translation: And he judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Samir.

fresh_translation: And after him arose Jair the Gileadite, and he judged Israel twenty-two years.
brenton_translation: And after him arose Jair of Galaad, and he judged Israel twenty-two years.

fresh_translation: And there were to him thirty-two sons riding on thirty-two foals, and thirty-two cities belonged to them, and he called them Villages of Jair until this day; they are in the land of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And he had thirty-two sons riding on thirty-two colts, and they had thirty-two cities; and they called them Jair's towns until this day in the land of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Jair died and was buried in Rammō.
brenton_translation: And Jair died, and was buried in Rhamnon.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel again added to do evil before the Lord, and they served the Baals and the Astarōths and the gods of Sidon and the gods of Moab and the gods of the sons of Ammon and the gods of the foreigners, and they forsook the Lord and did not serve him.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Astaroth, and the gods of Aram, and the gods of Sidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Phylistines; and they forsook the Lord, and did not serve him.

fresh_translation: And the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of foreigners and into the hand of the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and sold them into the hand of the Phylistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And they crushed and oppressed the sons of Israel in that year, eighteen years, all the sons of Israel beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorite in Gileaditis.
brenton_translation: And they afflicted and bruised the children of Israel at that time eighteen years, all the children of Israel beyond Jordan in the land of the Amorite in Galaad.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Ammon crossed the Jordan to make war also in Judah and Benjamin and in the house of Ephraim, and the sons of Israel were greatly oppressed.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon went over Jordan to fight with Juda, and Benjamin, and with Ephraim; and the children of Israel were greatly afflicted.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, saying, We sinned against you because we forsook our God and served the Baals.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord, saying, We have sinned against thee, because we have forsaken God, and served Baalim.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to the sons of Israel, Was it not the Egyptians and the Amorites and the sons of Ammon and Moab and the foreigners
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to the children of Israel, Did I not save you from Egypt and from the Amorite, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Phylistines,

fresh_translation: and Sidonians and Midian and Amalek who oppressed you? And you cried out to me, and I saved you from their hand.
brenton_translation: and from the Sidonians, and Amalec, and Madiam, who afflicted you? and ye cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand?

fresh_translation: Yet you forsook me and served other gods; therefore I will not continue to save you.
brenton_translation: Yet ye forsook me and served other gods; therefore I will not save you any more.

fresh_translation: Go and cry out to the gods you chose for yourselves, and let them save you in the time of your distress.
brenton_translation: Go, and cry to the gods whom ye have chosen to yourselves, and let them save you in the time of your affliction.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel said to the Lord, We sinned. Do to us according to all that is pleasing before you; only, Lord, deliver us in this day.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, We have sinned: do thou to us according to all that is good in thine eyes; only deliver us this day.

fresh_translation: And they removed the foreign gods from their midst and served the Lord. And it was not pleasing in the people, and he grew short of soul in the toil of Israel.
brenton_translation: And they put away the strange gods from the midst of them, and served the Lord only, and his soul was pained for the trouble of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Ammon went up and encamped in Gilead, and the sons of Israel went out and encamped in Massēpha.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon went up, and encamped in Galaad; and the children of Israel were gathered together and encamped on the hill.

fresh_translation: And the leaders of the people of Gilead said, each man to his neighbor, Who is the man that will begin to fight against the sons of Ammon? He shall be head over all dwelling in Gilead.
brenton_translation: And the people the princes of Galaad said every man to his neighbour, Who is he that shall begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall even be head over all that dwell in Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae the Gileadite was mighty in strength, and he was the son of a prostitute woman, and Gilead fathered Jephthae.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae the Galaadite was a mighty man; and he was the son of a harlot, who bore Jephthae to Galaad.

fresh_translation: And the wife of Gilead bore sons to him, and the sons of the wife grew up and cast out Jephthae and said to him, You shall not inherit in the house of our father, because you are the son of another woman.
brenton_translation: And the wife of Galaad bore him sons; and the sons of his wife grew up, and they cast out Jephthae, and said to him, Thou shalt not inherit in the house of our father, for thou art the son of a concubine.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae fled from before his brothers and dwelt in the land of Tōb, and idle men gathered to Jephthae and went out with him.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae fled from the face of his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob; and vain men gathered to Jephthae, and went out with him.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after days that the sons of Ammon made war with Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the children of Ammon prepared to fight with Israel,

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the sons of Ammon were making war with Israel, the elders of Gilead went to take Jephthae from the land of Tōb.
brenton_translation: that the elders of Galaad went to fetch Jephthae from the land of Tob.

fresh_translation: And they said to Jephthae, Come and be for us as leader, and let us fight against the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And they said to Jephthae, Come, and be our head, and we will fight with the sons of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae said to the elders of Gilead, Was it not you who hated me and cast me out from my father's house and sent me away from you? And why have you now come to me when you are in distress?
brenton_translation: And Jephthae said to the elders of Galaad, Did ye not hate me, and cast me out of my father's house, and banish me from you? and wherefore are ye come to me now when ye want me?

fresh_translation: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthae, Not so now; we have come to you, and you shall go with us, and we shall fight against the sons of Ammon, and you shall be for us as head over all dwelling in Gilead.
brenton_translation: And the elders of Galaad said to Jephthae, Therefore have we now turned to thee, that thou shouldest go with us, and fight against the sons of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae said to the elders of Gilead, If you turn me back to fight against the sons of Ammon, and the Lord delivers them before me, I will be head for you.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae said to the elders of Galaad, If ye turn me back to fight with the children of Ammon, and the Lord should deliver them before me, then will I be your head.

fresh_translation: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthae, The Lord shall be the one hearing between us if we do not do according to your word.
brenton_translation: And the elders of Galaad said to Jephthae, The Lord be witness between us, if we shall not do according to thy word.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae went with the elders of Gilead, and they placed him over them as head, as leader, and Jephthae spoke all his words before the Lord in Massēpha.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae went with the elders of Galaad, and the people made him head and ruler over them: and Jephthae spoke all his words before the Lord in Massepha.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae sent messengers to the king of the sons of Ammon, saying, What is to me and to you, that you came against me to fight me in my land?
brenton_translation: And Jephthae sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What have I to do with thee, that thou hast come against me to fight in my land?

fresh_translation: And the king of the sons of Ammon said to the messengers of Jephthae, Because Israel took my land in its going up out of Egypt, from Arnon to Jabbok and to the Jordan, and now return them in peace.
brenton_translation: And the king of the children of Ammon said to the messengers of Jephthae, Because Israel took my land when he went up out of Egypt, from Arnon to Jaboc, and to Jordan: now then return them peaceably and I will depart.

fresh_translation: And the messengers turned back to Jephthae, and Jephthae again sent messengers to the king of the sons of Ammon,
brenton_translation: And Jephthae again sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon,

fresh_translation: saying, Thus says Jephthae: Israel did not take the land of Moab and the land of the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: and said to him, Thus says Jephthae, Israel took not the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

fresh_translation: For in their going up from Egypt, Israel went in the wilderness as far as the Red Sea and came as far as Kades.
brenton_translation: for in their going up out of Egypt Israel went in the wilderness as far as the sea of Siph, and came to Cades.

fresh_translation: And Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, I will pass through your land, and the king of Edom did not listen. And indeed he sent also to the king of Moab, and he was not willing, and Israel stayed at Kades.
brenton_translation: And Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, I will pass, if it please thee, by thy land: and the king of Edom complied not: and Israel also sent to the king of Moab, and he did not consent; and Israel sojourned in Cades.

fresh_translation: And it passed through in the wilderness and went around the land of Edom and the land of Moab and came on the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped beyond the Arnon, and they did not enter the border of Moab, because Arnon was the border of Moab.
brenton_translation: And they journeyed in the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom and the land of Moab: and they came by the east of the land of Moab, and encamped in the country beyond Arnon, and came not within the borders of Moab, for Arnon is the border of Moab.

fresh_translation: And Israel sent messengers to Sēōn king of Hesebon the Amorite and said to him, Israel will pass through your land to my place.
brenton_translation: And Israel sent messengers to Seon king of the Amorite, king of Esebon, and Israel said to him, Let us pass, we pray thee, by thy land to our place.

fresh_translation: And Sēōn was not willing for Israel to pass through his borders, and Sēōn gathered all his people and encamped at Jassa and made war with Israel.
brenton_translation: And Seon did not trust Israel to pass by his coast; and Seon gathered all his people, and they encamped at Jasa; and he set the battle in array against Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God of Israel gave Sēōn and all his people into the hand of Israel, and he struck them. And Israel inherited all the land of the Amorite dwelling in the land.
brenton_translation: And the Lord God of Israel delivered Seon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote him; and Israel inherited all the land of the Amorite who dwelt in that land,

fresh_translation: And it inherited all the border of the Amorite from Arnon to Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
brenton_translation: from Arnon and to Jaboc, and from the wilderness to Jordan.

fresh_translation: And now the Lord God of Israel removed the Amorite from before his people Israel, and will you inherit it against him?
brenton_translation: And now the Lord God of Israel has removed the Amorite from before his people Israel, and shalt thou inherit his land?

fresh_translation: Will you not inherit whatever Chamos your god caused you to inherit? And all that the Lord our God inherited from before us, these things we will inherit.
brenton_translation: Wilt thou not inherit those possessions which Chamos thy god shall cause thee to inherit; and shall not we inherit the land of all those whom the Lord our God has removed from before you?

fresh_translation: And now are you at all better than Balak son of Sepphor, king of Moab? Did he by fighting fight with Israel, or by warring war against them?
brenton_translation: And now art thou any better than Balac son of Sepphor, king of Moab? Did he indeed fight with Israel, or indeed make war with him,

fresh_translation: While Israel dwelt in Hesebon and in its daughters and in Jazēr and in its daughters and in all the cities beside the Jordan three hundred years, why did they not rescue them at that time?
brenton_translation: when Israel dwelt in Esebon and in its coasts, and in the land of Aroer and in its coasts, and in all the cities by Jordan, three hundred years? and wherefore didst thou not recover them in that time?

fresh_translation: And I have not sinned against you, but you are doing evil with me by fighting against me. Let the Lord, the judge, judge today between the sons of Israel and between the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And now I have not sinned against thee, but thou wrongest me in preparing war against me: may the Lord the Judge judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And the king of the sons of Ammon did not listen to the words of Jephthae that he sent to him.
brenton_translation: But the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not to the words of Jephthae, which he sent to him.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthae, and he passed through the land of Gilead and Manasseh and passed through the watchtower of Gilead, and from the watchtower of Gilead to the far side of the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthae, and he passed over Galaad, and Manasse, and passed by the watch-tower of Galaad to the other side of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae vowed a vow to the Lord and said, If indeed you deliver the sons of Ammon into my hand,
brenton_translation: And Jephthae vowed a vow to the Lord, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,

fresh_translation: then it shall be that whoever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the sons of Ammon, that one shall be the Lord's, and I will offer him up as a whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: then it shall come to pass that whosoever shall first come out of the door of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, he shall be the Lord's: I will offer him up for a whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae crossed over to the sons of Ammon to fight against them, and the Lord gave them into his hand.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae advanced to meet the sons of Ammon to fight against them; and the Lord delivered them into his hand.

fresh_translation: And he struck them from Aroēr and until one comes to Semōith, twenty cities, and as far as Abel of vineyards, a very great blow, and the sons of Ammon were put to shame from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he smote them from Aroer till one comes to Arnon, in number twenty cities, and as far as Ebelcharmim, with a very great destruction: and the children of Ammon were straitened before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae came to Massēpha, to his house, and behold, his daughter was coming out to meet him with tambourines and dances, and she was his only child, beloved, and besides her he had neither son nor daughter.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae came to Massepha to his house; and behold, his daughter came forth to meet him with timbrels and dances; and she was his only child, he had not another son or daughter.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he saw her, he tore his garments and said, Alas, my daughter, by stumbling you have made me stumble; you have become as a pain in my eyes. And I opened my mouth concerning you to the Lord, and I cannot turn back.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he saw her, that he rent his garments, and said, Ah, ah, my daughter, thou hast indeed troubled me, and thou wast the cause of my trouble; and I have opened my mouth against thee to the Lord, and I shall not be able to return from it.

fresh_translation: And she said to him, Father, if in me you opened your mouth to the Lord, do to me according to what went out from your mouth, because the Lord made for you acts of vengeance from your enemies, from the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And she said to him, Father, hast thou opened thy mouth to the Lord? Do to me accordingly as the word went out of thy mouth, in that the Lord has wrought vengeance for thee on thine enemies of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And she said to her father, Do this word for me: let me alone two months, and I will go and go down upon the mountains and weep for my virginity, I and my companions.
brenton_translation: And she said to her father, Let my father now do this thing: let me alone for two months, and I will go up and down on the mountains, and I will bewail my virginity, I and my companions.

fresh_translation: And he said, Go, and he sent her away two months. And she went, she and her companions, and she wept for her virginity upon the mountains.
brenton_translation: And he said, Go: and he sent her away for two months; and she went, and her companions, and she bewailed her virginity on the mountains.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at the end of two months that she returned to her father, and Jephthae fulfilled his vow that he had vowed, and she had not known a man. And it became an ordinance in Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at the end of the two months that she returned to her father; and he performed upon her his vow which he vowed; and she knew no man:

fresh_translation: From days to days the daughters of Israel went to lament the daughter of Jephthae the Gileadite, four days in the year.
brenton_translation: and it was an ordinance in Israel, That the daughters of Israel went from year to year to bewail the daughter of Jephthae the Galaadite for four days in a year.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Ephraim were gathered, and they came to Sephina and said to Jephthae, Why did you go to fight against the sons of Ammon and not call us to go with you? We will burn your house upon you with fire.
brenton_translation: And the men of Ephraim assembled themselves, and passed on to the north, and said to Jephthae, Wherefore didst thou go over to fight with the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thy house over thee with fire.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae said to them, I and my people were men of contention, and the sons of Ammon were humbling me greatly, and I cried out to you, and you did not save me from their hand.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae said to them, I and my people and the children of Ammon were very much engaged in war; and I called for you, and ye did not save me out of their hand.

fresh_translation: And I saw that there was no savior, and I put my life in my own hand and crossed over to the sons of Ammon, and the Lord gave them into my hand. And why did you come up to me this day to fight against me?
brenton_translation: And I saw that thou wert no helper, and I put my life in my hand, and passed on to the sons of Ammon; and the Lord delivered them into my hand: and wherefore are ye come up against me this day to fight with me?

fresh_translation: And Jephthae gathered all the men of Gilead and fought Ephraim, and the men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, You, Gilead, are fugitives of Ephraim in the midst of Ephraim and in the midst of Manasseh.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae gathered all the men of Galaad, and fought with Ephraim; and the men of Galaad smote Ephraim, because they that were escaped of Ephraim said, Ye are of Galaad in the midst of Ephraim and in the midst of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And the men of Gilead seized the crossings of the Jordan of Ephraim, and it happened that the fugitives of Ephraim said, Let us cross over, and the men of Gilead said to them, Are you from Ephraim? And they said, We are not.
brenton_translation: And Galaad took the fords of Jordan before Ephraim; and they that escaped of Ephraim said to them, Let us go over: and the men of Galaad said, Art thou an Ephrathite? and he said, No.

fresh_translation: And they said to them, Speak now a watchword. And they did not direct themselves to speak thus, and they seized them and slaughtered them at the crossings of the Jordan. And there fell from Ephraim at that time forty-two thousand.
brenton_translation: Then they said to him, Say now Stachys; and he did not rightly pronounce it so: and they took him, and slew him at the fords of Jordan; and there fell at that time of Ephraim two and forty thousand.

fresh_translation: And Jephthae judged Israel six years, and Jephthae the Gileadite died and was buried in his city, Gilead.
brenton_translation: And Jephthae judged Israel six years; and Jephthae the Galaadite died, and was buried in his city Galaad.

fresh_translation: And after him Esebōn from Baithleem judged Israel.
brenton_translation: And after him Abaissan of Bethleem judged Israel.

fresh_translation: And there were to him thirty sons and thirty daughters sent outside, and he brought in thirty wives from outside for his sons, and he judged Israel seven years.
brenton_translation: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent forth; and he brought in thirty daughters for his sons from without; and he judged Israel seven years.

fresh_translation: And Esebōn died and was buried in Bēthleem.
brenton_translation: And Abaissan died, and was buried in Bethleem.

fresh_translation: And after him Ailōn the Zebulunite judged Israel, and he judged Israel ten years.
brenton_translation: And after him Ælom of Zabulon judged Israel ten years.

fresh_translation: And Ailōn the Zebulunite died in Ailim, and they buried him in the land of Zebulun.
brenton_translation: And Ælom of Zabulon died, and was buried in Ælom in the land of Zabulon.

fresh_translation: And after him Labdōn son of Sellēm the Phraathōnite judged Israel.
brenton_translation: And after him Abdon the son of Ellel, the Pharathonite, judged Israel.

fresh_translation: And there were to him forty sons and thirty sons of his sons, riding on seventy foals, and he judged Israel eight years.
brenton_translation: And he had forty sons, and thirty grandsons, that rode upon seventy colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

fresh_translation: And Labdōn son of Sellēm the Phraathōnite died and was buried in Phraathōn in the land of Ephraim, in the mountain of Lanak.
brenton_translation: And Abdon the son of Ellel, the Pharathonite, died, and was buried in Pharathon in the land of Ephraim in the mount of Amalec.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel again added to do evil before the Lord, and the Lord gave them into the hand of the foreigners forty years.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel yet again committed iniquity before the Lord; and the Lord delivered them into the hand of the Phylistines forty years.

fresh_translation: And there was a man from Saraa, from the tribe of Dan, and his name was Manōe, and his wife was barren and did not bear.
brenton_translation: And there was a man of Saraa, of the family of the kindred of Dan, and his name was Manoë, and his wife was barren, and bore not.

fresh_translation: And an angel of the Lord appeared to the woman and said to her, Behold now, you are barren and have not borne, yet you shall conceive and bear a son.
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord appeared to the woman, and said to her, Behold, thou art barren and hast not born; yet thou shalt conceive a son.

fresh_translation: And now take care and do not drink wine and strong drink and do not eat any unclean thing.
brenton_translation: And now be very cautious, and drink no wine nor strong drink, and eat no unclean thing;

fresh_translation: For behold, you shall conceive and bear a son, and iron shall not come upon his head, because the child shall be a consecrated Nazirite to God from the womb, and he will begin to save Israel from the hand of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: for behold, thou art with child, and shalt bring forth a son; and there shall come no razor upon his head, for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb; and he shall begin to save Israel from the hand of the Phylistines.

fresh_translation: And the woman came and said to her husband, saying, A man of God came to me, and his appearance was like the appearance of an angel of God, very awe-inspiring, and I asked where he was from, and he did not tell me his name.
brenton_translation: And the woman went in, and spoke to her husband, saying, A man of God came to me, and his appearance was as of an angel of God, very dreadful; and I did not ask him whence he was, and he did not tell me his name.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son, and now do not drink wine and strong drink and do not eat any uncleanness, because the child shall be a Nazirite of God from the womb until the day of his death.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bring forth a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, and eat no unclean thing; for the child shall be holy to God from the womb until the day of his death.

fresh_translation: And Manōe prayed to the Lord and said, I beg, Lord, may the man of God whom you sent to us please come to us again and instruct us what we should do for the child being born.
brenton_translation: And Manoë prayed to the Lord and said, I pray thee, O Lord my Lord, concerning the man of God whom thou sentest; let him now come to us once more, and teach us what we shall do to the child about to be born.

fresh_translation: And God listened to the voice of Manōe, and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was sitting in the field, and Manōe her husband was not with her.
brenton_translation: And the Lord heard the voice of Manoë, and the angel of God came yet again to the woman; and she sat in the field, and Manoë her husband was not with her.

fresh_translation: And the woman hurried and ran and reported to her husband and said to him, Behold, the man who came to me on that day has appeared to me.
brenton_translation: And the woman hasted, and ran, and brought word to her husband, and said to him, Behold the man who came in the other day to me has appeared to me.

fresh_translation: And Manōe rose and went after his wife to the man and said to him, Are you the man who spoke to the woman? And the angel said, I am.
brenton_translation: And Manoë arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, Art thou the man that spoke to the woman? and the angel said, I am.

fresh_translation: And Manōe said, Now then, when your word comes, what shall be the ordinance for the child and his deeds?
brenton_translation: And Manoë said, Now shall thy word come to pass: what shall be the ordering of the child, and our dealings with him?

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to Manōe, From all that I said to the woman, let her keep herself.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoë, Of all things concerning which I spoke to the woman, she shall beware.

fresh_translation: From everything that comes out of the vine she shall not eat, and wine and strong drink she shall not drink, and every unclean thing she shall not eat. Everything that I commanded her let her keep.
brenton_translation: She shall eat of nothing that comes of the vine yielding wine, and let her not drink wine or strong liquor, and let her not eat anything unclean: all things that I have charged her she shall observe.

fresh_translation: And Manōe said to the angel of the Lord, Let us constrain you now, and we will prepare before you a kid of the goats.
brenton_translation: And Manoë said to the angel of the Lord, Let us detain thee here, and prepare before thee a kid of the goats.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to Manōe, If you constrain me, I will not eat your bread, but if you make a whole burnt offering, you shall offer it to the Lord. For Manōe did not know that he was an angel of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoë, If thou shouldest detain me, I will not eat of thy bread; and if thou wouldest offer a whole-burnt-offering, to the Lord thou shalt offer it: for Manoë knew not that he was an angel of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Manōe said to the angel of the Lord, What is your name, so that when your word comes we may glorify you?
brenton_translation: And Manoë said to the angel of the Lord, What is thy name, that when thy word shall come to pass, we may glorify thee?

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to him, Why is this that you ask my name? It is wonderful.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to him, Why dost thou thus ask after my name; whereas it is wonderful?

fresh_translation: And Manōe took the kid of the goats and the sacrifice and offered it on the rock to the Lord, to the Lord who does wonders, while Manōe and his wife were watching.
brenton_translation: And Manoë took a kid of the goats and its meat-offering, and offered it on the rock to the Lord; and the angel wrought a distinct work, and Manoë and his wife were looking on.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the flame went up from the altar to heaven, the angel of the Lord went up in the flame, and Manōe and his wife were watching, and they fell on their faces to the ground.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the flame went up above the altar toward heaven, that the angel of the Lord went up in the flame; and Manoë and his wife were looking, and they fell upon their face to the earth.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord did not continue any longer to appear to Manōe and to his wife; then Manōe knew that he was an angel of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the angel appeared no more to Manoë and to his wife: then Manoë knew that this was an angel of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Manōe said to his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
brenton_translation: And Manoë said to his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

fresh_translation: And his wife said to him, If the Lord desired to kill us, he would not have received from our hands a whole burnt offering and sacrifice, and he would not have enlightened us with all these things and would not have made such things heard to us.
brenton_translation: But his wife said to him, If the Lord were pleased to slay us, he would not have received of our hand a whole-burnt-offering and a meat-offering; and he would not have shewn us all these things, neither would he have caused us to hear all these things as at this time.

fresh_translation: And the woman bore a son and called his name Sampsōn, and the Lord blessed him, and the child grew.
brenton_translation: And the woman brought forth a son, and she called his name Sampson; and the child grew, and the Lord blessed him.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord began to go with him in the camp of Dan, between Saraa and between Esthaol.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord began to go out with him in the camp of Dan, and between Saraa and Esthaol.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn went down to Thamnatha and saw a woman in Thamnatha from the daughters of the foreigners, and she was pleasing before him.
brenton_translation: And Sampson went down to Thamnatha, and saw a woman in Thamnatha of the daughters of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he went up and reported to his father and to his mother and said, I saw a woman in Thamnatha from the daughters of the foreigners, and now take her for me as wife.
brenton_translation: And he went up and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Thamnatha of the daughters of the Phylistines; and now take her to me for a wife.

fresh_translation: And his father and his mother said to him, Is there no woman from the daughters of your brothers and among all my people, that you are going to take a wife from the uncircumcised foreigners? And Sampsōn said to his father, Take this one for me, because she is pleasing in my eyes.
brenton_translation: And his father and his mother said to him, Are there no daughters of thy brethren, and is there not a woman of all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?

fresh_translation: And his father and his mother did not know that it was from the Lord, because he was seeking repayment from the foreigners, and at that time the foreigners ruled over the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And his father and his mother knew not that it was of the Lord, that he sought to be revenged on the Philistines: and at that time the Philistines lorded it over Israel.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn and his father and his mother went down to Thamnatha and turned aside into the vineyard of Thamnatha, and behold, a lion cub roaring to meet him.
brenton_translation: And Sampson and his father and his mother went down to Thamnatha, and he came to the vineyard of Thamnatha; and behold, a young lion roared in meeting him.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, and he tore it apart as one tears apart a kid of the goats, and there was nothing in his hand. And he did not report to his father or his mother what he had done.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him, and he crushed him as he would have crushed a kid of the goats, and there was nothing in his hands: and he told not his father and his mother what he had done.

fresh_translation: And they went down and spoke to the woman, and she was pleasing before Sampsōn.
brenton_translation: And they went down and spoke to the woman, and she was pleasing in the eyes of Sampson.

fresh_translation: And he returned after days to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcass of the lion, and behold, a swarm of bees was in the mouth of the lion, and there was honey.
brenton_translation: And after some time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion; and behold, a swarm of bees, and honey were in the mouth of the lion.

fresh_translation: And he took it out into his mouth, and he went on walking and eating, and he went to his father and to his mother and gave to them, and they ate. And he did not report to them that he took the honey from the carcass of the lion.
brenton_translation: And he took it into his hands, and went on eating, and he went to his father and his mother, and gave to them, and they did eat; but he told them not that he took the honey out of the mouth of the lion.

fresh_translation: And his father went down to the woman, and Sampsōn made there a drinking feast seven days, because so the young men used to do.
brenton_translation: And his father went down to the woman, and Sampson made there a banquet for seven days, for so the young men are used to do.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, in their fearing him, they appointed thirty companions for him, and they were with him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when they saw him, that they took thirty guests, and they were with him.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn said to them, I will now put forth a riddle to you, and if you tell me the riddle within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty linen cloths and thirty changes of garments.
brenton_translation: And Sampson said to them, I propound you a riddle: if ye will indeed tell it me, and discover it within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty sheets and thirty changes of raiment.

fresh_translation: But if you are not able to tell me, then you shall give me thirty linen cloths and thirty changes of clothing. And they said to him, Put forth your riddle, and we will hear it.
brenton_translation: And if ye cannot tell it me, ye shall give me thirty napkins and thirty changes of apparel: and they said to him, Propound thy riddle, and we will hear it.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Out of the eater came food, and out of the strong came sweetness. And they were not able to tell the riddle for three days.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Meat came forth of the eater, and sweetness out of the strong: and they could not tell the riddle for three days.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the fourth day they said to Sampsōn's wife, Deceive your husband, and let him tell you the riddle, lest we burn you and your father's house with fire. Did you call us to impoverish us?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the fourth day, that they said to the wife of Sampson, Deceive now thy husband, and let him tell thee the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: did ye invite us to do us violence?

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn's wife wept over him and said to him, You hate me and do not love me, because the riddle that you set forth to the sons of my people you have not told to me. And Sampsōn said to her, Behold, to my father and to my mother I have not told it, and shall I tell you?
brenton_translation: And Sampson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not; for the riddle which thou hast propounded to the children of my people, thou hast not told me: and Sampson said to her, If I have not told it to my father and my mother, shall I tell it to thee?

fresh_translation: And she wept over him during the seven days in which the feast was with them, and it came to be on the seventh day he told her, because she pressed him hard, and she told the sons of her people.
brenton_translation: And she wept before him the seven days, during which their banquet lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she troubled him; and she told it to the children of her people.

fresh_translation: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey, and what is stronger than a lion? And Sampsōn said to them, If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found my riddle.
brenton_translation: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day, before sunrise, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? and Sampson said to them, If ye had not ploughed with my heifer, ye would not have known my riddle.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, and he went down to Ascalon and struck from there thirty men and took their garments and gave them to those telling the riddle. And the anger of Sampsōn burned, and he went up to his father's house.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him powerfully, and he went down to Ascalon, and destroyed of the inhabitants thirty men, and took their garments, and gave the changes of raiment to them that told the riddle; and Sampson was very angry, and went up to the house of his father.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn's wife lived with his bridal companion, who had been his associate.
brenton_translation: And the wife of Sampson was given to one of his friends, with whom he was on terms of friendship.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after days, in the days of wheat harvest, Sampsōn visited his wife, bringing a kid of the goats, and said, I will go in to my wife in the bedroom. And her father did not allow him to go in to her.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after a time, in the days of wheat harvest, that Sampson visited his wife with a kid, and said, I will go in to my wife even into the chamber: but her father did not suffer him to go in.

fresh_translation: And her father said, Saying, I said that in hating you hated her, and I gave her to your companion. Is not her younger sister better than she? Let her be yours instead of her.
brenton_translation: And her father spoke, saying, I said that thou didst surely hate her, and I gave her to one of thy friends: is not her younger sister better than she? let her be to thee instead of her.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn said to him, This once I am innocent from the foreigners, because I am doing evil things with you.
brenton_translation: And Sampson said to them, Even for once am I guiltless with regard to the Philistines, in that I do mischief among them.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn went and caught three hundred foxes and took torches and tied tail to tail and put one torch between two tails in the middle.
brenton_translation: And Sampson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch between two tails, and fastened it.

fresh_translation: And he set fire in the torches and let them loose into the sheaves of the foreigners and burned up the ears of grain and the pre-harvested grain from the stack and to what was standing and to vineyard and olive tree.
brenton_translation: And he set fire to the torches, and sent the foxes into the corn of the Philistines; and every thing was burnt from the threshing floor to the standing corn, and even to the vineyard and olives.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners said, Who did this? And they said, Sampsōn, son-in-law of the Thamnathite, because he took his wife and gave her to his companion. And the foreigners went up and burned the house of her father and her and her father with fire.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines said, Who has done these things? and they said, Sampson the son-in-law of the Thamnite, because he has taken his wife, and given her to one of his friends; and the Philistines went up, and burnt her and her father's house with fire.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn said to them, If you do this, I will not be pleased until I make my vengeance on each one of you.
brenton_translation: And Sampson said to them, Though ye may have dealt thus with her, verily I will be avenged of you, and afterwards I will cease.

fresh_translation: And he struck them hip upon thigh, a great blow, and he went down and dwelt by the torrent in the cave of Etam.
brenton_translation: And he smote them leg on thigh with a great overthrow; and went down and dwelt in a cave of the rock Etam.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners went up and encamped against Judah and were spread out in Lechi.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines went up, and encamped in Juda, and spread themselves abroad in Lechi.

fresh_translation: And every man of Judah said to them, Why did you come up against us? And the foreigners said, We came up to bind Sampsōn and do to him as he did to us.
brenton_translation: And the men of Juda said, Why are ye come up against us? and the Philistines said, We are come up to bind Sampson, and to do to him as he has done to us.

fresh_translation: And three thousand men from Judah went down to the cleft of the rock Etam and said to Sampsōn, Do you not know that the foreigners rule over us? And why did you do these things to us? And Sampsōn said to them, Just as they did to me, so I did to them.
brenton_translation: And the three thousand men of Juda went down to the hole of the rock Etam, and they said to Sampson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines rule over us? and what is this that thou hast done to us? and Sampson said to them, As they did to me, so have I done to them.

fresh_translation: And they said to him, We came down to bind you and hand you over into the hands of the foreigners. And Sampsōn said to them, Swear to me that you yourselves will not kill me and hand me over to them, lest you yourselves fall upon me.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, We are come down to bind thee to deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines: and Sampson said to them, Swear to me that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

fresh_translation: And they swore to him, saying, No, but we will surely bind you and hand you over into their hands, but with death we will not kill you. And they bound him with two new cords and brought him up from the rock.
brenton_translation: And they spoke to him, saying, Nay, but we will only bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand, and will by no means slay thee: and they bound him with two new ropes, and brought him from that rock.

fresh_translation: And he came as far as the jawbone, and the foreigners shouted to meet him and ran to meet him. And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, and the cords on his arms became like tow when it smells fire, and his bonds were dissolved from his arms.
brenton_translation: And they came to Lechi: and the Philistines shouted, and ran to meet him: and the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and the ropes that were upon his arms became as tow which is burnt with fire; and his bonds were consumed from off his hands.

fresh_translation: And he found a jawbone of a donkey thrown on the road and stretched out his hand and took it and struck with it a thousand men.
brenton_translation: And he found the jaw-bone of an ass that had been cast away, and he put forth his hand and took it, and smote with it a thousand men.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn said, With the jawbone of a donkey, wiping out, I wiped them out, because with the jawbone of a donkey I struck a thousand men.
brenton_translation: And Sampson said, With the jaw-bone of an ass I have utterly destroyed them, for with the jaw-bone of an ass I have smitten a thousand men.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he finished speaking, he threw the jawbone from his hand and called that place Slaughter of Jawbone.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he ceased speaking, that he cast the jaw-bone out of his hand; and he called that place the Lifting of the jaw-bone.

fresh_translation: And he thirsted greatly and cried out to the Lord and said, You gave by the hand of your servant this great salvation, and now shall I die of thirst and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
brenton_translation: And he was very thirsty, and wept before the Lord, and said, Thou hast been well pleased to grant this great deliverance by the hand of thy servant, and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

fresh_translation: And God opened the wound of the jawbone, and waters came out of it, and he drank, and his spirit returned in him and he revived. Therefore the name of it was called Spring, called of Jawbone, until this day.
brenton_translation: And God broke open a hollow place in the jaw, and there came thence water, and he drank; and his spirit returned and he revived: therefore the name of the fountain was called ‘The well of the invoker,’ which is in Lechi, until this day.

fresh_translation: And he judged Israel in the days of the foreigners twenty years.
brenton_translation: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn went from there to Gaza and saw there a prostitute woman and went in to her.
brenton_translation: And Sampson went to Gaza, and saw there a harlot, and went in to her.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to the Gazites, saying, Sampsōn came here. And they surrounded and lay in ambush for him all night at the gate of the city and kept quiet all night, saying, Let us wait until morning light and kill him.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to the Gazites, saying, Sampson is come hither: and they compassed him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and they were quiet all the night, saying, Let us wait till the dawn appear, and we will slay him.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn slept until midnight and rose about midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city and the two posts and lifted them up with the bar and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is opposite Hebron and put them there.
brenton_translation: And Sampson slept till midnight, and rose up at midnight, and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city with the two posts, and lifted them up with the bar, and laid them on his shoulders, and he went up to the top of the mountain that is before Chebron, and laid them there.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things that he loved a woman by the torrent Sōrēch, and her name was Dalila.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this that he loved a woman in Alsorech, and her name was Dalida.

fresh_translation: And the satraps of the foreigners went up to her and said to her, Deceive him and see wherein his great strength lies and in what way we may prevail against him and bind him so as to humble him, and we will give you, each man, one thousand one hundred silver pieces.
