brenton_translation: And the princes of the Philistines came up to her, and said to her, Beguile him, and see wherein his great strength is, and wherewith we shall prevail against him, and bind him to humble him; and we will give thee each eleven hundred pieces of silver.

fresh_translation: And Dalila said to Sampsōn, Tell me wherein your great strength lies and in what way you may be bound for your humbling.
brenton_translation: And Dalida said to Sampson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein is thy great strength, and wherewith thou shalt be bound that thou mayest be humbled.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn said to her, If they bind me with seven fresh sinews not dried out, I will grow weak and become like one of the men.
brenton_translation: And Sampson said to her, If they bind me with seven moist cords that have not been spoiled, then shall I be weak and be as one of ordinary men.

fresh_translation: And the satraps of the foreigners brought up to her seven fresh sinews not dried out, and she bound him with them.
brenton_translation: And the princes of the Philistines brought to her seven moist cords that had not been spoiled, and she bound him with them.

fresh_translation: And the ambush was sitting in the inner room, and she said to him, Foreigners are upon you, Sampsōn. And he tore the sinews just as a strand of tow is torn when it smells fire, and his strength was not known.
brenton_translation: And the liers in wait remained with her in the chamber; and she said to him, The Philistines are upon thee, Sampson: and he broke the cords as if any one should break a thread of tow when it has touched the fire, and his strength was not known.

fresh_translation: And Dalila said to Sampsōn, Behold, you mocked me and spoke lies to me. Now then tell me in what you may be bound.
brenton_translation: And Dalida said to Sampson, Behold, thou hast cheated me, and told me lies; now then tell me wherewith thou shalt be bound.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, If they bind me with seven new cords in which no work has been done, I will grow weak and become like one of the men.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, If they should bind me fast with new ropes with which work has not been done, then shall I be weak, and shall be as another man.

fresh_translation: And Dalila took new cords for him and bound him with them and said to him, The foreigners are upon you, Sampsōn. And the ambush was sitting in the inner room. And he tore them from his arms like thread.
brenton_translation: And Dalida took new ropes, and bound him with them, and the liers in wait came out of the chamber, and she said, The Philistines are upon thee, Sampson: and he broke them off his arms like a thread.

fresh_translation: And Dalila said to Sampsōn, Until now you have mocked me and spoken lies to me. Tell me in what you may be bound. And he said to her, If you weave the seven locks of my head with the web and fasten it with the peg into the wall, I will become weak like one of the men.
brenton_translation: And Dalida said to Sampson, Behold, thou hast deceived me, and told me lies; tell me, I intreat thee, wherewith thou mayest be bound: and he said to her, If thou shouldest weave the seven locks of my head with the web, and shouldest fasten them with the pin into the wall, then shall I be weak as another man.

fresh_translation: And Dalila put him to sleep and wove the seven curls of his head with the web and fastened them with the pegs into the wall and said to him, The foreigners are upon you, Sampsōn. And he woke from his sleep and pulled out the pegs together with the woven cloth from the wall and the web, and his strength was not known.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he was asleep, that Dalida took the seven locks of his head, and wove them with the web, and fastened them with the pin into the wall, and she said, The Philistines are upon thee, Sampson: and he awoke out of his sleep, and carried away the pin of the web out of the wall.

fresh_translation: And Dalila said to him, How can you say, I loved you, and your heart is not with me? This third time you mocked me and did not tell me wherein your great strength lies.
brenton_translation: And Dalida said to Sampson, How sayest thou, I love thee, when thy heart is not with me? this third time thou hast deceived me, and hast not told me wherein is thy great strength.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when she wore him down with her words all night and troubled him, he grew short of soul unto death.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as she pressed him sore with her words continually, and straitened him, that his spirit failed almost to death.

fresh_translation: And he told her everything from his heart and said to her, A razor has not come upon my head, because I am a Nazirite of God from my mother's womb, and if I am shaved, my strength will depart from me, and I will grow weak and become like all men.
brenton_translation: Then he told her all his heart, and said to her, A razor has not come upon my head, because I have been a holy one of God from my mother's womb; if then I should be shaven, my strength will depart from me, and I shall be weak, and I shall be as all other men.

fresh_translation: And Dalila saw that he had told her everything from his heart, and she sent and called all the satraps of the foreigners, saying, Come up this once, because he told me all his heart. And all the satraps of the foreigners came up to her and brought the silver in their hands.
brenton_translation: And Dalida saw that he told her all his heart, and she sent and called the princes of the Philistines, saying, Come up yet this once; for he has told me all his heart. And the chiefs of the Philistines went up to her, and brought the money in their hands.

fresh_translation: And she put him to sleep between her knees and called the barber and shaved the seven curls of his head, and he began to be humbled, and his strength departed from him.
brenton_translation: And Dalida made Sampson sleep upon her knees; and she called a man, and he shaved the seven locks of his head, and she began to humble him, and his strength departed from him.

fresh_translation: And Dalila said to him, The foreigners are upon you, Sampsōn. And he woke from his sleep and said, I will go out and do as always and shake myself free. And he did not know that the Lord had departed from him.
brenton_translation: And Dalida said, The Philistines are upon thee, Sampson: and he awoke out of his sleep and said, I will go out as at former times, and shake myself; and he knew not that the Lord was departed from him.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners seized him and gouged out his eyes and brought him down to Gaza and bound him with bronze fetters, and he was grinding in the prison house.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he ground in the prison-house.

fresh_translation: And the hair of his head began to grow back when he was shaved.
brenton_translation: And the hair of his head began to grow as before it was shaven.

fresh_translation: And the satraps of the foreigners gathered to sacrifice a great sacrifice to Dagon their god and to rejoice, and they said, Our god gave Sampsōn our enemy into our hand.
brenton_translation: And the chiefs of the Philistines met to offer a great sacrifice to their god Dagon, and to make merry; and they said, God has given into our hand our enemy Sampson.

fresh_translation: And the people saw him and praised their gods and said, Our god gave our enemy into our hand, the one ravaging our land, who multiplied our wounded.
brenton_translation: And the people saw him, and sang praises to their god; for our god, said they, has delivered into our hand our enemy, who wasted our land, and who multiplied our slain.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when their heart grew good, they said, Call Sampsōn out of the prison house and let him play before us. And they called Sampsōn out of the prison house, and they mocked him, and they set him between the two pillars.
brenton_translation: And when their heart was merry, then they said, Call Sampson out of the prison-house, and let him play before us: and they called Sampson out of the prison-house, and he played before them; and they smote him with the palms of their hands, and set him between the pillars.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn said to the young servant guiding his hand, Let me rest now and let me feel the pillars upon which the house has been supported, and I will lean upon them. And the boy did so.
brenton_translation: And Sampson said to the young man that held his hand, Suffer me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, and I will stay myself upon them.

fresh_translation: And the house was full of men and women, and all the satraps of the foreigners were there, and on the roof were about three thousand men and women looking on as Sampsōn was mocked.
brenton_translation: And the house was full of men and women, and there were all the chiefs of the Philistines, and on the roof were about three thousand men and women looking at the sports of Sampson.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn cried out to the Lord and said, Lord, Lord, remember me and strengthen me now, only this once, and I will exact one vengeance for my two eyes from the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And Sampson wept before the Lord, and said, O Lord, my Lord, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, O God, yet this once, and I will requite one recompense to the Philistines for my two eyes.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house had been supported and leaned upon them, one with his right hand and one with his left.
brenton_translation: And Sampson took hold of the two pillars of the house on which the house stood, and leaned on them, and laid hold of one with his right hand, and the other with his left.

fresh_translation: And Sampsōn said, Let my soul die with the foreigners. And he bent in strength, and the house fell upon the satraps and upon all the people in it, and the dead whom Sampsōn killed in his death were more than those whom he killed in his life.
brenton_translation: And Sampson said, Let my life perish with the Philistines: and he bowed himself mightily; and the house fell upon the princes, and upon all the people that were in it: and the dead whom Sampson slew in his death were more than those whom he slew in his life.

fresh_translation: And his brothers and all the house of his father went down and took him and went up and buried him between Saraa and between Esthaol in the tomb of Manōe his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.
brenton_translation: And his brethren and his father's house went down, and they took him; and they went up and buried him between Saraa and Esthaol in the sepulchre of his father Manoë; and he judged Israel twenty years.

fresh_translation: And there was a man from the hill-country of Ephraim, and his name was Micha.
brenton_translation: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, and his name was Michaias.

fresh_translation: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred silver pieces taken from you, about which you pronounced an oath and spoke in my ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be my son to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred pieces of silver which thou tookest to thyself, and about which thou cursedst me, and spokest in my ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it: and his mother said, Blessed be my son of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he returned the eleven hundred silver pieces to his mother, and his mother said, With consecration I consecrated the silver to the Lord from my hand alone, to make a carved image and a molten image, and now I will return them to you and give it back to you.
brenton_translation: And he restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother; and his mother said, I had wholly consecrated the money to the Lord out of my hand for my son, to make a graven and a molten image, and now I will restore it to thee.

fresh_translation: And he returned the silver to his mother, and his mother took two hundred silver pieces and gave it to the metalworker, and he made it into a carved image and a molten image, and it came to be in the house of Micha.
brenton_translation: But he returned the silver to his mother, and his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, and he made it a graven and a molten image; and it was in the house of Michaias.

fresh_translation: And the man Micha had a house of God, and he made an ephod and teraphim and filled the hand of one of his sons, and he became priest for him.
brenton_translation: And the house of Michaias was to him the house of God, and he made an ephod and theraphin, and he consecrated one of his sons, and he became to him a priest.

fresh_translation: In those days there was no king in Israel; each man did what was good in his own eyes.
brenton_translation: And in those days there was no king in Israel; every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

fresh_translation: And there was a young man from Bethleem, clan of Judah, from the family of Judah, and he was a Levite, and he was staying there as a resident.
brenton_translation: And there was a young man in Bethleem of the tribe of Juda, and he was a Levite, and he was sojourning there.

fresh_translation: And the man went from the city of Judah, from Bethleem, to reside wherever he might find, and he came to the hill-country of Ephraim, as far as the house of Micha, to make his way.
brenton_translation: And the man departed from Bethleem the city of Juda to sojourn in whatever place he might find; and he came as far as mount Ephraim, and to the house of Michaias to accomplish his journey.

fresh_translation: And Micha said to him, From where do you come? And he said to him, I am a Levite from Bethleem of Judah, and I am going to reside wherever I may find.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said to him, Whence comest thou? and he said to him, I am a Levite of Bethleem Juda, and I go to sojourn in any place I may find.

fresh_translation: And Micha said to him, Stay with me and become to me as father and as priest, and I will give you ten silver pieces for days, and a pair of garments, and your living. And the Levite went.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said to him, Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest; and I will give thee ten pieces of silver by the year, and a change of raiment, and thy living.

fresh_translation: And he began to reside with the man, and the young man became to him like one of his sons.
brenton_translation: And the Levite went and began to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

fresh_translation: And Micha filled the hand of the Levite, and the young man became his priest and was in the house of Micha.
brenton_translation: And Michaias consecrated the Levite, and he became to him a priest, and he was in the house of Michaias.

fresh_translation: And Micha said, Now I know that the Lord has done me good, because the Levite has become my priest.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, Now I know that the Lord will do me good, because a Levite has become my priest.

fresh_translation: In those days there was no king in Israel, and in those days the tribe of Dan was seeking for itself an inheritance to dwell in, because until those days no inheritance had fallen to it in the midst of the tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: In those days there was no king in Israel; and in those days the tribe of Dan sought for itself an inheritance to inhabit, because no inheritance had fallen to it until that day in the midst of the tribes of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Dan sent from their families five men from among them, sons of strength, from Saraa and Esthaol, to inspect the land and to search it out, and they said to them, Go and search out the land. And they came to the hill-country of Ephraim as far as the house of Micha and rested there.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Dan sent from their families five men of valour, from Saraa and from Esthaol, to spy out the land and to search it; and they said to them, Go and search out the land. And they came as far as the mount of Ephraim to the house of Michaias and they lodged there,

fresh_translation: While they were by the house of Micha, they recognized the voice of the young Levite, and they turned aside there and said to him, Who brought you here, and what are you doing in this place, and what do you have here?
brenton_translation: in the house of Michaias, and they recognised the voice of the young man the Levite, and turned in thither; and said to him, Who brought thee in hither? and what doest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Thus and thus Micha did for me, and he hired me, and I became his priest.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Thus and thus did Michaias to me, and he hired me, and I became his priest.

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Inquire now of God, and we will know whether our way on which we are going will prosper.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, Enquire now of God, and we shall know whether our way will prosper, on which we are going.

fresh_translation: And the priest said to them, Go in peace. Before the Lord is your way in which you are going.
brenton_translation: And the priest said to them, Go in peace; your way in which ye go, is before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the five men went and came to Laisa and saw the people dwelling in it, sitting in confidence according to the judgment of the Sidonians, being quiet in confidence and unable to speak a word, because they are far from Sidon and have no dealings with Syria.
brenton_translation: And the five men went on, and came to Laisa; and they saw the people in the midst of it dwelling securely, at ease as is the manner of the Sidonians, and there is no one perverting or shaming a matter in the land, no heir extorting treasures; and they are far from the Sidonians, and they have no intercourse with any one.

fresh_translation: And the five men came to their brothers at Saraa and Esthaol, and their brothers said to them, Why are you sitting here?
brenton_translation: And the five men came to their brethren to Saraa and Esthaol, and said to their brethren, Why sit ye here idle?

fresh_translation: And they said, Rise and let us go up against them, because we entered and walked through the land as far as Laisa and saw the people dwelling in it in confidence according to the custom of the Sidonians, and they are far from Sidon and have no dealings with Syria. But rise and let us go up against them, because we found the land, and behold, it is very good, and you keep silent. Do not hesitate to go, to enter and inherit the land.
brenton_translation: And they said, Arise, and let us go up against them, for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good, yet ye are still: delay not to go, and to enter in to possess the land.

fresh_translation: When you enter, you will come to a trusting people, and the land is broad, because God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is in the land.
brenton_translation: And whensoever ye shall go, ye shall come in upon a people secure, and the land is extensive, for God has given it into your hand; a place where there is no want of anything that the earth affords.

fresh_translation: And from the family of Dan, from Saraa and Esthaol, six hundred men girded with weapons of war set out.
brenton_translation: And there departed thence of the families of Dan, from Saraa and from Esthaol, six hundred men, girded with weapons of war.

fresh_translation: And they went up and encamped in Kariathiarim in Judah. Therefore that place was called Camp of Dan until this day; behold, it is behind Kariathiarim.
brenton_translation: And they went up, and encamped in Cariathiarim in Juda; therefore it was called in that place the camp of Dan, until this day: behold, it is behind Cariathiarim.

fresh_translation: They passed on from there and came to the hill-country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micha.
brenton_translation: And they went on thence to the mount of Ephraim, and came to the house of Michaias.

fresh_translation: And the five men going to inspect the land answered and said to their brothers, Do you know that in these houses there are an ephod and teraphim and a carved image and a molten image? And now know what you will do.
brenton_translation: And the five men who went to spy out the land of Laisa answered, and said to their brethren, Ye know that there is in this place an ephod, and theraphin, and a graven and a molten image; and now consider what ye shall do.

fresh_translation: And they turned aside there and entered into the house of the young Levite, into the house of Micha, and greeted him.
brenton_translation: And they turned aside there, and went into the house of the young man, the Levite, even into the house of Michaias, and asked him how he was.

fresh_translation: And the six hundred men girded with weapons of war, from the sons of Dan, stood by the doorway of the gate.
brenton_translation: And the six hundred men of the sons of Dan who were girded with their weapons of war stood by the door of the gate.

fresh_translation: And the five men going to inspect the land went up there and took the carved image and the ephod and the teraphim and the molten image, while the priest stood by the doorway of the gate and the six hundred men girded with weapons of war.
brenton_translation: And the five men who went to spy out the land went up, and entered into the house of Michaias, and the priest stood.

fresh_translation: And these entered into the house of Micha and took the carved image and the ephod and the teraphim and the molten image. And the priest said to them, What are you doing?
brenton_translation: And they took the graven image, and the ephod, and the theraphin, and the molten image; and the priest said to them, What are ye doing?

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Be silent; put your hand upon your mouth and come with us, and you shall be to us as father and as priest. Is it not better for you to be priest to the house of one man than for you to become priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?
brenton_translation: And they said to him, Be silent, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and come with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be the priest of the house of one man, or to be the priest of a tribe and house for a family of Israel?

fresh_translation: And the heart of the priest was gladdened, and he took the ephod and the teraphim and the carved image and the molten image and entered into the midst of the people.
brenton_translation: And the heart of the priest was glad, and he took the ephod, and the theraphin, and the graven image, and the molten image, and went in the midst of the people.

fresh_translation: And they turned and went away, and they placed the household and the possessions and his glorious things before them.
brenton_translation: So they turned and departed, and put their children and their property and their baggage before them.

fresh_translation: And when they had gone a good distance from the house of Micha, behold, Micha and the men with the house with Micha cried out after the sons of Dan.
brenton_translation: They went some distance from the house of Michaias, and, behold, Michaias and the men in the houses near Michaias' house, cried out, and overtook the children of Dan.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Dan turned their faces and said to Micha, What is wrong with you, that you cried out?
brenton_translation: And the children of Dan turned their face, and said to Michaias, What is the matter with thee that thou hast cried out?

fresh_translation: And Micha said, My carved image that I made for myself you took, and the priest, and you went away. And what remains to me now? And why do you say to me, Why do you cry out?
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, Because ye have taken my graven image which I made, and my priest, and are gone; and what have I remaining? and what is this that ye say to me, Why criest thou?

fresh_translation: And the sons of Dan said to him, Let your voice not be heard with us, lest bitter-souled men fall upon you and you lose your life and the life of your household.
brenton_translation: And the children of Dan said to him, Let not thy voice be heard with us, lest angry men run upon thee, and take away thy life, and the lives of thy house.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Dan went on their way, and Micha saw that they were stronger than he, and he turned aside and returned to his house.
brenton_translation: And the children of Dan went their way; and Michaias saw that they were stronger than himself, and he returned to his house.

fresh_translation: And they took what Micha had made and the priest who was his, and they came to Laisa, to a people quiet and confident, and struck them with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.
brenton_translation: And the children of Dan took what Michaias had made, and the priest that he had, and they came to Laisa, to a people quiet and secure; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

fresh_translation: And there was no deliverer, because it is far from the Sidonians, and they have no dealings with men, and it is in the valley that belongs to the house of Roōb. And they built the city and dwelt in it.
brenton_translation: And there was no deliverer, because the city is far from the Sidonians, and they have no intercourse with men, and it is in the valley of the house of Raab; and they built the city, and dwelt in it.

fresh_translation: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of their father who was born to Israel, though the name of the city formerly was Lais.
brenton_translation: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; and the name of the city was Ulamais before.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Dan set up for themselves the carved image of Micha, and Jonathan son of Gērsōm, son of Moses, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
brenton_translation: And the children of Dan set up the graven image for themselves; and Jonathan son of Gerson son of Manasse, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan till the time of the carrying away of the nation.

fresh_translation: And they set up for themselves the carved image of Micha that he made all the days that the house of God was in Shiloh.
brenton_translation: And they set up for themselves the graven image which Michaias made, all the days that the house of God was in Selom; and it was so in those days that there was no king in Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in those days, and there was no king in Israel, and there was a Levite man residing in the flanks of the hill-country of Ephraim, and the man took for himself a concubine wife from Bethleem of Judah.
brenton_translation: And there was a Levite sojourning in the sides of mount Ephraim, and he took to himself a concubine from Bethleem Juda.

fresh_translation: And his concubine became angry with him and went away from him to the house of her father in Bethleem of Judah and was there four months.
brenton_translation: And his concubine departed from him, and went away from him to the house of her father to Bethleem Juda, and she was there four months.

fresh_translation: And her husband rose and went after her to speak to her heart, to reconcile her to himself and bring her back again to him, with his servant with him and a pair of pack animals. And he went to the house of her father, and the father of the young woman saw him and came joyfully to meet him.
brenton_translation: And her husband rose up, and went after her to speak kindly to her, to recover her to himself; and he had his young man with him, and a pair of asses; and she brought him into the house of her father; and the father of the damsel saw him, and was well pleased to meet him.

fresh_translation: And his father-in-law, the father of the young woman, brought him in and he stayed with him three days, and they ate and drank and slept there.
brenton_translation: And his father-in-law, the father of the damsel, constrained him, and he staid with him for three days; and they ate and drank, and lodged there.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the fourth day, they rose early in the morning, and he arose to depart, and the father of the young woman said to his son-in-law, Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and after this you may go.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the fourth day that they rose early, and he stood up to depart; and the father of the damsel said to his son-in-law, Strengthen thy heart with a morsel of bread, and afterwards ye shall go.

fresh_translation: And they sat and both of them ate together and drank, and the father of the young woman said to the man, Begin now, lodge overnight, and let your heart be glad.
brenton_translation: So they two sat down together and ate and drank: and the father of the damsel said to her husband, Tarry now the night, and let thy heart be merry.

fresh_translation: And the man rose to depart, and his father-in-law constrained him, and again he lodged there.
brenton_translation: And the man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law constrained him, and he staid and lodged there.

fresh_translation: And he rose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart, and the father of the young woman said, Strengthen your heart with bread and make camp until the day declines. And both of them ate and drank.
brenton_translation: And he rose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the father of the damsel said, Strengthen now thine heart, and quit thyself as a soldier till the day decline; and the two ate.

fresh_translation: And the man rose to depart, he and his concubine and his servant, and his father-in-law, the father of the young woman, said to him, Behold now, toward evening the day has declined; lodge here still today, and let your heart be glad, and rise early tomorrow for your journey, and you will go to your tent.
brenton_translation: And the man rose up to depart, he and his concubine, and his young man; but his father-in-law the father of the damsel said to him, Behold now, the day has declined toward evening; lodge here, and let thy heart rejoice; and ye shall rise early to-morrow for your journey, and thou shalt go to thy habitation.

fresh_translation: But the man was not willing to lodge, and he rose and went away and came opposite Jebous, this is Jerusalem, and with him was a pair of saddled pack animals, and his concubine was with him.
brenton_translation: But the man would not lodge there, but he arose and departed, and came to the part opposite Jebus, (this is Jerusalem,) and there was with him a pair of asses saddled, and his concubine was with him.

fresh_translation: While they were still near Jebous and the day had declined greatly, the servant said to his master, Come now and let us turn aside into this city of the Jebusite and lodge in it.
brenton_translation: And they came as far as Jebus: and the day had far advanced, and the young man said to his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn aside to this city of the Jebusites, and let us lodge in it.

fresh_translation: And his master said to him, I will certainly not turn aside into a city of foreigners who are not of the sons of Israel, but we will pass on as far as Gabaa.
brenton_translation: And his master said to him, We will not turn aside to a strange city, where there is not one of the children of Israel, but we will pass on as far as Gabaa.

fresh_translation: And he said to his servant, Come and let us enter one of the places and lodge in Gabaa or in Rama.
brenton_translation: And he said to his young man, Come, and let us draw nigh to one of the places, and we will lodge in Gabaa or in Rama.

fresh_translation: And they passed by and went on, for the sun set near Gabaa, which belongs to Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And they passed by and went on, and the sun went down upon them near to Gabaa, which is in Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And they turned aside there to enter to lodge in Gabaa, and they entered and sat in the square of the city, and there was no man bringing them into the house to lodge.
brenton_translation: And they turned aside thence to go in to lodge in Gabaa; and they went in, and sat down in the street of the city, and there was no one who conducted them into a house to lodge.

fresh_translation: And behold, an old man came in from his work out of the field at evening, and the man was from the hill-country of Ephraim and he resided in Gabaa, but the men of the place were sons of Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And behold, an old man came out of the field from his work in the evening; and the man was of mount Ephraim, and he sojourned in Gabaa, and the men of the place were sons of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And lifting up his eyes, he saw the traveling man in the square of the city, and the old man said, Where are you going and from where do you come?
brenton_translation: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw a traveller in the street of the city; and the old man said to him, Whither goest thou, and whence comest thou?

fresh_translation: And he said to him, We are passing through from Bethleem of Judah to the flanks of the hill-country of Ephraim; I am from there, and I went to Bethleem of Judah, and I am turning back to my house, and there is no man bringing me into the house.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, We are passing by from Bethleem Juda to the sides of mount Ephraim: I am from thence, and I went as far as Bethleem Juda, and I am going home, and there is no man to take me into his house.

fresh_translation: And indeed there is straw and fodder for our donkeys, and there is bread and wine for me and for your maidservant and for the servant with your servants; there is no lack of anything.
brenton_translation: Yet is there straw and food for our asses, and bread and wine for me and my handmaid and the young man with thy servants; there is no want of anything.

fresh_translation: And the old man said, Peace to you. Only let all your lack be upon me; only do not lodge in the square.
brenton_translation: And the old man said, Peace be to thee; only be every want of thine upon me, only do thou by no means lodge in the street.

fresh_translation: And he brought him into his house and fed his pack animals, and they washed their feet and ate and drank.
brenton_translation: And he brought him into his house, and made room for his asses; and they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

fresh_translation: And while their hearts were gladdened, behold, the men of the city, sons of lawlessness, surrounded the house and beat on the door and said to the man, the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring out the man who entered your house, so that we may know him.
brenton_translation: And they were comforting their heart, when, behold, the men of the city, sons of transgressors, compassed the house, knocking at the door: and they spoke to the old man the owner of the house, saying, Bring out the man who came into thy house, that we may know him.

fresh_translation: And the man, the master of the house, went out to them and said to them, No, brothers, do not do evil, after this man has entered my house do not do this folly.
brenton_translation: And the master of the house came out to them, and said, Nay, brethren, do not ye wrong, I pray you, after this man has come into my house; do not ye this folly.

fresh_translation: Behold, my virgin daughter and his concubine, I will bring them out now, and humble them and do to them what is good in your eyes, but to this man do not do this word of folly.
brenton_translation: Behold my daughter a virgin, and the man's concubine: I will bring them out, and humble ye them, and do to them that which is good in your eyes; but to this man do not this folly.

fresh_translation: And the men were not willing to listen to him, and the man took hold of his concubine and brought her out to them outside, and they knew her and abused her all night until morning and sent her away when dawn was rising.
brenton_translation: But the men would not consent to hearken to him; so the man laid hold of his concubine, and brought her out to them; and they knew her, and abused her all night till the morning, and let her go when the morning dawned.

fresh_translation: And the woman came toward morning and fell by the door of the gate of the man's house where her master was, until it became light.
brenton_translation: And the woman came toward morning, and fell down at the door of the house where her husband was, until it was light.

fresh_translation: And her master rose in the morning and opened the doors of the house and went out to go on his way, and behold, his concubine wife had fallen by the door, and her hands were on the threshold.
brenton_translation: And her husband rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went forth to go on his journey; and, behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down by the doors of the house, and her hands were on the threshold.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, Rise and let us go. And she did not answer him, but had died. And he lifted her onto the pack animal, and the man rose and went to his place.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, Rise, and let us go; and she answered not, for she was dead: and he took her upon his ass, and went to his place.

fresh_translation: And he entered into his house and took the sword and took hold of his concubine and cut her up according to her bones into twelve parts and sent them into all the tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he took his sword, and laid hold of his concubine, and divided her into twelve parts, and sent them to every coast of Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, everyone seeing said, Such a thing neither happened nor was seen from the day the sons of Israel came up from Egypt until this day. And he commanded the men to whom he sent them, saying, Thus you shall say to every man of Israel: Has this matter happened from the day the sons of Israel came up from Egypt until this day? Set counsel for yourselves about her and speak.
brenton_translation: And it was so, that every one who saw it said, Such a day as this has not happened nor has been seen from the day of the going up of the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt until this day: take ye counsel concerning it, and speak.

fresh_translation: And all the sons of Israel went out, and all the congregation was assembled as one man from Dan and as far as Bersabee and the land of Gilead, to the Lord at Massēpha.
brenton_translation: And all the children of Israel went out, and all the congregation was gathered as one man, from Dan even to Bersabee, and in the land of Galaad, to the Lord at Massepha.

fresh_translation: And the whole assembly of the people, all the tribes of Israel, stood in the gathering of the people of God, four hundred thousand foot men drawing sword.
brenton_translation: And all the tribes of Israel stood before the Lord in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin heard that the sons of Israel had gone up to the Lord at Massēpha. And the sons of Israel said, Speak, where did this evil happen?
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Massepha: and the children of Israel came and said, Tell us, where did this wickedness take place?

fresh_translation: And the Levite man, husband of the murdered woman, answered and said, I came to Gabaa of Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
brenton_translation: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I and my concubine went to Gabaa of Benjamin to lodge.

fresh_translation: And the men from Gabaa rose against me and surrounded the house against me by night, and they wanted to kill me, and they humbled my concubine and abused her, and she died.
brenton_translation: And the men of Gabaa rose up against me, and compassed the house by night against me; they wished to slay me, and they have humbled my concubine, and she is dead.

fresh_translation: And I took hold of my concubine and cut her up and sent her through every border of the inheritance of Israel, because they committed folly in Israel.
brenton_translation: And I laid hold of my concubine, and divided her in pieces, and sent the parts into every coast of the inheritance of the children of Israel; for they have wrought lewdness and abomination in Israel.

fresh_translation: Behold, all of you are sons of Israel; give to yourselves word and counsel.
brenton_translation: Behold, all ye are children of Israel; and consider and take counsel here among yourselves.

fresh_translation: And all the people rose as one man, saying, We will not go, man into his tent, and we will not turn aside, man to his house.
brenton_translation: And all the people rose up as one man, saying, No one of us shall return to his tent, and no one of us shall return to his house.

fresh_translation: And now this is the word that we will do to Gabaa: we will go up against it by lot.
brenton_translation: And now this is the thing which shall be done in Gabaa; we will go up against it by lot.

fresh_translation: And we will take ten men by the hundred and a hundred by the thousand and a thousand by the ten thousand, to take provisions for the people, for those entering to execute against Gabaa of Benjamin according to all the folly that they did in Israel.
brenton_translation: Moreover we will take ten men for a hundred for all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred for a thousand, and a thousand for ten thousand, to take provision, to cause them to come to Gabaa of Benjamin, to do to it according to all the abomination, which they wrought in Israel.

fresh_translation: And all Israel, man from the cities, was gathered as one man, coming together.
brenton_translation: And all the men of Israel were gathered to the city as one man.

fresh_translation: And the tribes of Israel sent men in every tribe of Benjamin, saying, What is this evil that happened among you?
brenton_translation: And the tribes of Israel sent men through the whole tribe of Benjamin, saying, What is this wickedness that has been wrought among you?

fresh_translation: And now give the men, the ungodly ones in Gabaa, the sons of Belial, and we will put them to death and remove evil from Israel. But the sons of Benjamin were not willing to listen to the voice of their brothers, the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: Now then give up the men the sons of transgressors that are in Gabaa, and we will put them to death, and purge out wickedness from Israel: but the children of Benjamin consented not to hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin were gathered from their cities to Gabaa to go out to fight with the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin were gathered from their cities to Gabaa, to go forth to fight with the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin were counted on that day from the cities, twenty-five thousand men drawing sword, besides the inhabitants of Gabaa; these were counted, seven hundred chosen young men.
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin from their cities were numbered in that day, twenty-three thousand, every man drawing a sword, besides the inhabitants of Gabaa, who were numbered seven hundred chosen men of all the people, able to use both hands alike;

fresh_translation: All these were ambidextrous slingers, throwing stones at a hair and not missing.
brenton_translation: all these could sling with stones at a hair, and not miss.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel was counted apart from the sons of Benjamin, four hundred thousand men drawing sword; all these were men of war.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel, exclusive of Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword; all these were men of war.

fresh_translation: And they arose and went up to Baethel and inquired of God, and the sons of Israel said, Who will go up for us, leading to fight with Benjamin? And the Lord said, Judah shall go up, leading.
brenton_translation: And they arose and went up to Bæthel, and enquired of God: and the children of Israel said, Who shall go up for us first to fight with the children of Benjamin? And the Lord said, Juda shall go up first as leader.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel rose and encamped against Gabaa.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gabaa.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel went out to war with Benjamin, and the men of Israel lined up with them for battle against Gabaa.
brenton_translation: And they went out, all the men of Israel, to fight with Benjamin, and engaged with them at Gabaa.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin went out from the city and destroyed from Israel on that day twenty-two thousand men to the ground.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Benjamin went forth from Gabaa, and they destroyed in Israel on that day two and twenty thousand men down to the ground.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel strengthened themselves and again lined up for battle in the place where they lined up on the first day.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel strengthened themselves, and again engaged in battle in the place where they had engaged on the first day.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel went up and wept before the Lord until evening and inquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I again draw near to battle with Benjamin my brother? And the Lord said, Go up against him.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel went up, and wept before the Lord till evening, and enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall we again draw nigh to battle with our brethren the children of Benjamin? and the Lord said, Go up against them.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel approached Benjamin on the second day.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel advanced against the children of Benjamin on the second day.

fresh_translation: And Benjamin went out from Gabaa to meet them on the second day and destroyed from the people eighteen thousand men to the ground, all these drawing sword.
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin went forth to meet them from Gabaa on the second day, and destroyed of the children of Israel yet further eighteen thousand men down to the ground: all these drew sword.

fresh_translation: And all the sons of Israel and all the people went up and came to Baethel and wept before the Lord and fasted on that day and offered whole burnt offerings of salvation before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bæthel; and they wept, and sat there before the Lord; and they fasted on that day until evening, and offered whole-burnt-offerings and perfect sacrifices, before the Lord,

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel inquired of the Lord, and there the ark of the covenant of the Lord was in those days,
brenton_translation: for the ark of the Lord God was there in those days,

fresh_translation: and Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron stood before it in those days, saying, Shall I again go out to war with the sons of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the Lord said, Go up, because tomorrow I will give him into your hand.
brenton_translation: and Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron stood before it in those days; and the children of Israel enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall we yet again go forth to fight with our brethren the sons of Benjamin? and the Lord said, Go up, to-morrow I will give them into your hands.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel set an ambush around Gabaa.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel set an ambush against Gabaa round about it.

fresh_translation: And Israel lined up against Benjamin on the third day and arrayed themselves against Gabaa as once and again.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and arrayed themselves against Gabaa as before.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin went out to meet the people and were drawn away from the city and began to strike from the people as once and again on the roads, one going up to Baethel and one going up to Gabaa in the field, about thirty men in Israel.
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin went out to meet the people, and were all drawn out of the city, and began to smite and slay the people as before in the roads, whereof one goes up to Bæthel, and one to Gabaa in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin said, They are stumbling before us as at first. But the sons of Israel said, Let us flee and draw them out from the city to the roads.
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin said, They fall before us as at the first: but the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them out from the city into the roads; and they did so.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel rose from his place and arrayed themselves at Baalthamar, and the ambush of Israel came out from its place from the west of Gabaa.
brenton_translation: And all the men rose up out of their places, and engaged in Baal Thamar; and the liers in wait of Israel advanced from their place from Maraagabe.

fresh_translation: And opposite Gabaa came ten thousand chosen men from all Israel, and the battle became heavy, and they did not know that evil was touching them.
brenton_translation: And there came over against Gabaa ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel; and the fight was severe; and they knew not that evil was coming upon them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord routed Benjamin before Israel, and the sons of Israel destroyed in Benjamin on that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men, all these drawing sword.
brenton_translation: And the Lord smote Benjamin before the children of Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin in that day a hundred and twenty-five thousand men: all these drew sword.

fresh_translation: And Benjamin saw that it had been routed. And the men of Israel gave place to Benjamin because they relied on the ambush that they had set against Gabaa.
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten; and the men of Israel gave place to Benjamin, because they trusted in the ambuscade which they had prepared against Gabaa.

fresh_translation: And the ambush rushed and spread out toward Gabaa, and the ambush went and struck the whole city with the edge of the sword.
brenton_translation: And when they retreated, then the liers in wait rose up, and they moved on toward Gabaa, and the whole ambush came forth, and they smote the city with the edge of the sword.

fresh_translation: And the signal between the men of Israel and the ambush was for them to bring up from the city a torch of smoke.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel had a signal of battle with the liers in wait, that they should send up a signal of smoke from the city.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin had begun striking down wounded men in Israel, about thirty men, because they said, Surely by defeat they are defeated before us as in the former battle.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel saw that the liers in wait had seized Gabaa, and they stood in line of battle; and Benjamin began to smite down wounded ones among the men of Israel about thirty men; for they said, Surely they fall again before us, as in the first battle.

fresh_translation: And the torch began to go up from the city, a pillar of smoke, and Benjamin looked behind him, and behold, the whole destruction of the city went up to heaven.
brenton_translation: And the signal went up increasingly over the city as a pillar of smoke; and Benjamin looked behind him, and behold the destruction of the city went up to heaven.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel turned back, and the man of Benjamin was terrified, and he saw that evil had touched him.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel turned back, and the men of Benjamin hasted, because they saw that evil had come upon them.

fresh_translation: And they turned before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, and the battle overtook him, and those from the cities destroyed him in their midst.
brenton_translation: And they turned to the way of the wilderness from before the children of Israel, and fled: but the battle overtook them, and they from the cities destroyed them in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And they cut down Benjamin, giving him no rest, and trampled him down as far as opposite Gabaa from the east of the sun.
brenton_translation: And they cut down Benjamin, and pursued him from Nua closely till they came opposite Gabaa on the east.

fresh_translation: And there fell from Benjamin eighteen thousand men; with all these were mighty men.
brenton_translation: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men: all these were men of might.

fresh_translation: And they turned aside and fled into the wilderness to the rock Rhemmon, and they gleaned five thousand men on the roads and clung after him as far as Gadaam and struck from them two thousand men.
brenton_translation: And the rest turned, and fled to the wilderness to the rock of Remmon; and the children of Israel picked off of them five thousand men; and the children of Israel went down after them as far as Gedan, and they smote of them two thousand men.

fresh_translation: And all those falling in Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men drawing sword on that day, with all these mighty men.
brenton_translation: And all that fell of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men that drew sword in that day: all these were men of might.

fresh_translation: And six hundred men turned aside and fled into the wilderness to the rock Rhemmon and sat at the rock Rhemmon four months.
brenton_translation: And the rest turned, and fled to the wilderness to the rock of Remmon, even six hundred men; and they sojourned four months in the rock of Remmon.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel shut in the sons of Benjamin and struck them with the edge of the sword from city onward to beast and to everything found; all the cities they found they sent out in fire.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel returned to the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword from the city of Methla, even to the cattle, and every thing that was found in all the cities: and they burnt with fire the cities they found.

fresh_translation: And a man of Israel swore at Massēpha, saying, No man from us will give his daughter to Benjamin as wife.
brenton_translation: Now the children of Israel swore in Massephath, saying, No man of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin for a wife.

fresh_translation: And all the people came to Massēpha and Baethel and sat there until evening before God and lifted up their voice and wept with great weeping.
brenton_translation: And the people came to Bæthel, and sat there until evening before God: and they lifted up their voice and wept with a great weeping;

fresh_translation: And they said, Why, Lord God of Israel, has this happened in Israel, that one tribe should be missing in Israel today?
brenton_translation: and said, Wherefore, O Lord God of Israel, has this come to pass, that to-day one tribe should be counted as missing from Israel?

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the next day, the people rose early and built there an altar and offered whole burnt offerings of salvation.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the morrow that the people rose up early, and built there an altar, and offered up whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel said, Who is there that did not go up in the assembly from all the tribes of Israel to the Lord? For a great oath had been made against whoever did not go up to the Lord at Massēpha, saying, He shall surely die.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel said, Who of all the tribes of Israel, went not up in the congregation to the Lord? for there was a great oath concerning those who went not up to the Lord to Massephath, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel were moved concerning Benjamin their brother and said, One tribe has been taken away from Israel today.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel relented toward Benjamin their brother, and said, To-day one tribe is cut off from Israel.

fresh_translation: What shall we do for those left for wives, since we swore by the Lord not to give them from our daughters as wives?
brenton_translation: What shall we do for wives for the rest that remain? whereas we have sworn by the Lord, not to give them of our daughters for wives.

fresh_translation: And they said, Which one from the tribes of Israel is it that did not go up to the Lord at Massēpha? And behold, no man had come from Jabis Gilead to the camp to the assembly.
brenton_translation: And they said, What one man is there of the tribes of Israel, who went not up to the Lord to Massephath? and, behold, no man came to the camp from Jabis Galaad to the assembly.

fresh_translation: And the people were counted, and behold, there was no man there from the inhabitants of Jabis Gilead.
brenton_translation: And the people were numbered, and there was not there a man from the inhabitants of Jabis Galaad.

fresh_translation: And the congregation sent there twelve thousand men from the sons of might and commanded them, saying, Go and strike all dwelling in Jabis Gilead with the edge of the sword, and the women and the people.
brenton_translation: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the strongest, and they charged them, saying, Go ye and smite the inhabitants of Jabis Galaad with the edge of the sword.

fresh_translation: And this is the word that you shall do: every male and every woman knowing the bed of a male you shall devote to destruction.
brenton_translation: And this shall ye do: every male and every woman that has known the lying with man ye shall devote to destruction, but the virgins ye shall save alive: and they did so.

fresh_translation: And they found from the inhabitants of Jabis Gilead four hundred young women, virgins who had not known man by the bed of a male, and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabis Galaad four hundred young virgins, who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to Selom in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And all the congregation sent and spoke to Benjamin at the rock Rhemmon and called them to peace.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin in the rock Remmon, and invited them to make peace.

fresh_translation: And Benjamin returned to the sons of Israel at that time, and they gave them the women who had been from the women of Jabis Gilead, and it pleased them thus.
brenton_translation: And Benjamin returned to the children of Israel at that time, and the children of Israel gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the daughters of Jabis Galaad; and they were content.

fresh_translation: And the people were moved for Benjamin because the Lord made a break in the tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the people relented for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the elders of the congregation said, What shall we do for the rest for wives, because woman has been wiped out from Benjamin?
brenton_translation: And the elders of the congregation said, What shall we do for wives for them that remain? for the women have been destroyed out of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And they said, A preserved inheritance belongs to Benjamin, and a tribe shall certainly not be blotted out from Israel.
brenton_translation: And they said, There must be an inheritance of them that are escaped of Benjamin; and so a tribe shall not be destroyed out of Israel.

fresh_translation: And we are not able to give them wives from our daughters, because the sons of Israel swore, saying, Cursed is the one giving a wife to Benjamin.
brenton_translation: For we shall not be able to give them wives of our daughters, because we swore among the children of Israel, saying, Cursed is he that gives a wife to Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And they said, Behold, a feast to the Lord at Shiloh from days to days, which is north of Baethel toward the rising of the sun, on the road going up from Baethel to Sikima, and south of Lebōna.
brenton_translation: And they said, Lo! now there is a feast of the Lord from year to year in Selom, which is on the north of Bæthel, eastward on the way that goes up from Bæthel to Sychem, and from the south of Lebona.

fresh_translation: And they commanded the sons of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in ambush in the vineyards.
brenton_translation: And they charged the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

fresh_translation: And you shall watch, and behold, when the daughters of those dwelling in Shiloh come out in Shiloh to dance in dances, then you shall come out from the vineyards and each man seize for himself a wife from the daughters of Shiloh and go away to the land of Benjamin.
brenton_translation: and ye shall see; and lo! if there come out the daughters of the inhabitants of Selom to dance in dances, then shall ye go out of the vineyards and seize for yourselves every man a wife of the daughters of Selom, and go ye into the land of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And it shall be when their fathers or their brothers come to contend with us, we will say to them, Show mercy to them, because not each man took his wife in the war. For you did not give to them at the proper time; otherwise you would have trespassed.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when their fathers or their brethren come to dispute with us, that we will say to them, Grant them freely to us, for we have not taken every man his wife in the battle: because ye did not give to them according to the occasion, ye transgressed.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin did so and took wives according to their number from the dancers whom they carried off, and they went away and returned to their inheritance and built for themselves cities and dwelt in them.
brenton_translation: And the children of Benjamin did so; and they took wives according to their number from the dancers whom they seized: and they went and returned to their inheritance, and built the cities, and dwelt in them.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel walked from there at that time, each man to his tribe and to his family, and each man went away from there to his inheritance.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel went thence at that time every man to his tribe and his kindred; and they went thence every man to his inheritance.

fresh_translation: In those days there was no king in Israel; each man did what was right in his own eyes.
brenton_translation: And in those days there was no king in Israel; every man did that which was right in his own sight.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the judging of the judges, and there was famine in the land, and a man from Bethleem of Judah went to reside in the field of Moab, he and his wife and his sons.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land: and a man went from Bethleem Juda to sojourn in the land of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

fresh_translation: And the name of the man was Abimelech, and the name of his wife Noemin, and the names of his two sons Maalōn and Chelaiōn, Ephrathites from Bethleem of Judah, and they came into the field of Moab and were there.
brenton_translation: And the man's name was Elimelech, and his wife's name Noemin, and the names of his two sons Maalon and Chelaion, Ephrathites of Bethleem of Juda: and they came to the land of Moab, and remained there.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech, husband of Noemin, died, and she was left, she and her two sons.
brenton_translation: And Elimelech the husband of Noemin died; and she was left, and her two sons.

fresh_translation: And they took for themselves Moabite women; the name of the one was Orpha and the name of the second Ruth, and they dwelt there about ten years.
brenton_translation: And they took to themselves wives, women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpha, and the name of the second Ruth; and they dwelt there about ten years.

fresh_translation: And both Maalōn and Chelaiōn also died, and the woman was left without her husband and without her two sons.
brenton_translation: And both Maalon and Chelaion died also; and the woman was left of her husband and her two sons.

fresh_translation: And she rose, she and her two daughters-in-law, and they returned from the field of Moab, because she heard in the field of Moab that the Lord had visited his people to give them bread.
brenton_translation: And she rose up and her two daughters-in-law, and they returned out of the country of Moab, for she heard in the country of Moab that the Lord had visited his people to give them bread.

fresh_translation: And she went out from the place where she had been there, and her two daughters-in-law with her, and they were going on the road to return to the land of Judah.
brenton_translation: And she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her: and they went by the way to return to the land of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Noemin said to her daughters-in-law, Go now, return each to her mother's house. May the Lord deal with you in mercy, as you dealt with the dead and with me.
brenton_translation: And Noemin said to her daughters-in-law, Go now, return each to the house of her mother: the Lord deal mercifully with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

fresh_translation: May the Lord give to you, and may each of you find rest in the house of her husband. And she kissed them, and they lifted up their voice and wept.
brenton_translation: The Lord grant you that ye may find rest each of you in the house of her husband: and she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

fresh_translation: And they said to her, With you we will return to your people.
brenton_translation: And they said to her, We will return with thee to thy people.

fresh_translation: And Noemin said, Return now, my daughters. Why are you going with me? Are there yet sons in my womb, and will they be husbands for you?
brenton_translation: And Noemin said, Return now, my daughters; and why do ye go with me? have I yet sons in my womb to be your husbands?

fresh_translation: Return now, my daughters, because I have grown old, not to belong to a husband. For if I said, There is hope for me to belong to a husband and bear sons,
brenton_translation: Turn now, my daughters, for I am too old to be married: for I said, Suppose I were married, and should bear sons;

fresh_translation: would you wait for them until they grow up? Or would you be restrained on account of them from belonging to a husband? No, my daughters, because it has become very bitter for me concerning you, because the hand of the Lord has gone out against me.
brenton_translation: would ye wait for them till they should be grown? or would ye refrain from being married for their sakes? Not so, my daughters; for I am grieved for you, that the hand of the Lord has gone forth against me.

fresh_translation: And they lifted up their voice and wept again, and Orpha kissed her mother-in-law and returned to her people, but Ruth followed her.
brenton_translation: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again; and Orpha kissed her mother-in-law and returned to her people; but Ruth followed her.

fresh_translation: And Noemin said to Ruth, Behold, your fellow daughter-in-law turned back to her people and to her gods. Turn back now, you also, after your fellow daughter-in-law.
brenton_translation: And Noemin said to Ruth, Behold, thy sister-in-law has returned to her people and to her gods; turn now thou also after thy sister-in-law.

fresh_translation: And Ruth said, Do not press me to leave you or to turn back from behind you, because wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you lodge, I will lodge. Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
brenton_translation: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following thee; for whithersoever thou goest, I will go, and wheresoever thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God.

fresh_translation: And wherever you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. Thus may the Lord do to me, and thus may he add, because only death will divide between me and you.
brenton_translation: And wherever thou diest, I will die, and there will I be buried: the Lord do so to me, and more also, if I leave thee, for death only shall divide between me and thee.

fresh_translation: And Noemin saw that she was strong in going with her, and she ceased speaking to her any more.
brenton_translation: And Noemin seeing that she was determined to go with her, ceased to speak to her any more.

fresh_translation: And both of them went until they came to Bethleem, and all the city sounded over them, and they said, Is this Noemin?
brenton_translation: And they went both of them until they came to Bethleem: and it came to pass, when they arrived at Bethleem, that all the city rang with them, and they said, Is this Noemin?

fresh_translation: And she said to them, Do not call me Noemin; call me Bitter, because the Mighty One has made things very bitter in me.
brenton_translation: And she said to them, Nay, do not call me Noemin; call me ‘Bitter,’ for the Mighty One has dealt very bitterly with me.

fresh_translation: I went away full, and the Lord brought me back empty. And why do you call me Noemin, when the Lord humbled me and the Mighty One afflicted me?
brenton_translation: I went out full, and the Lord has brought me back empty: and why call ye me Noemin, whereas the Lord has humbled me, and the Mighty One has afflicted me?

fresh_translation: And Noemin returned, and Ruth the Moabitess her daughter-in-law with her, returning from the field of Moab. And they came to Bethleem at the beginning of barley harvest.
brenton_translation: So Noemin and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, returned from the country of Moab; and they came to Bethleem in the beginning of barley harvest.

fresh_translation: And for Noemin there was a known man to her husband, and the man was mighty in strength from the kindred of Abimelech, and his name was Boos.
brenton_translation: And Noemin had a friend an acquaintance of her husband, and the man was a mighty man of the kindred of Elimelech, and his name was Booz.

fresh_translation: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Noemin, Let me now go to the field and glean among the ears behind whoever I find favor in his eyes. And she said to her, Go, daughter.
brenton_translation: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Noemin, Let me go now to the field, and I will glean among the ears behind the man with whomsoever I shall find favour: and she said to her, Go, daughter.

fresh_translation: And she went and gleaned in the field behind the reapers, and it happened by chance upon the portion of the field of Boos, who was from the kindred of Abimelech.
brenton_translation: And she went; and came and gleaned in the field behind the reapers; and she happened by chance to come on a portion of the land of Booz, of the kindred of Elimelech.

fresh_translation: And behold, Boos came from Bethleem and said to the reapers, The Lord be with you. And they said to him, May the Lord bless you.
brenton_translation: And, behold, Booz came from Bethleem, and said to the reapers, The Lord be with you: and they said to him, The Lord bless thee.

fresh_translation: And Boos said to his young servant set over the reapers, Whose young woman is this?
brenton_translation: And Booz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, Whose is this damsel?

fresh_translation: And the young servant set over the reapers answered and said, She is the Moabite girl who returned with Noemin from the field of Moab.
brenton_translation: And his servant who was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel who returned with Noemin out of the land of Moab.

fresh_translation: And she said, Let me now glean and gather among the sheaves behind the reapers. And she came and has stood from early morning until evening; she did not rest in the field except a little.
brenton_translation: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the reapers: and she came and stood from morning till evening, and rested not even a little in the field.

fresh_translation: And Boos said to Ruth, Have you not heard, daughter? Do not go to another field to glean, and do not go from here. Here stay close with my girls.
brenton_translation: And Booz said to Ruth, Hast thou not heard, my daughter? go not to glean in another field; and depart not thou hence, join thyself here with my damsels.

fresh_translation: Let your eyes be on the field where they reap, and go behind them. Behold, I commanded the young men not to touch you, and whenever you thirst, go to the vessels and drink from where the young men draw water.
brenton_translation: Let thine eyes be on the field where my men shall reap, and thou shalt go after them: behold, I have charged the young men not to touch thee: and when thou shalt thirst, then thou shalt go to the vessels, and drink of that which the young men shall have drawn.

fresh_translation: And she fell on her face and bowed to the ground and said to him, Why did I find favor in your eyes, that you should notice me, when I am a foreign woman?
brenton_translation: And she fell upon her face, and did reverence to the ground, and said to him, How is it that I have found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take notice of me, whereas I am a stranger?

fresh_translation: And Boos answered and said to her, It was fully reported to me all that you have done with your mother-in-law after the death of your husband, and how you left your father and your mother and the land of your birth and went to a people you did not know yesterday or the day before.
brenton_translation: And Booz answered and said to her, It has fully been told me how thou hast dealt with thy mother-in-law after the death of thy husband; and how thou didst leave thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy birth, and camest to a people whom thou knewest not before.

fresh_translation: May the Lord repay your work, and may your wage be full from the Lord God of Israel, under whose wings you came to trust.
brenton_translation: The Lord recompense thy work: may a full reward be given thee of the Lord God of Israel, to whom thou hast come to trust under his wings.

fresh_translation: And she said, May I find favor in your eyes, lord, because you comforted me and because you spoke to the heart of your servant, and behold, I shall be as one of your maidservants.
brenton_translation: And she said, Let me find grace in thy sight, my lord, because thou hast comforted me, and because thou hast spoken kindly to thy handmaid, and behold, I shall be as one of thy servants.

fresh_translation: And Boos said to her, Already it is time to eat; come here and eat of the bread and dip your morsel in the vinegar. And Ruth sat beside the reapers, and Boos heaped parched grain for her, and she ate and was filled and left some.
brenton_translation: And Booz said to her, Now it is time to eat; come hither, and thou shalt eat of the bread, and thou shalt dip thy morsel in the vinegar: and Ruth sat by the side of the reapers, and Booz handed her meal, and she ate, and was satisfied, and left.

fresh_translation: And she rose to glean, and Boos commanded his young men, saying, Indeed let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not shame her.
brenton_translation: And she rose up to glean; and Booz charged his young men, saying, Let her even glean among the sheaves, and reproach her not.

fresh_translation: And in carrying, carry for her; indeed in dropping, drop for her from the armfuls and leave them, and she will glean, and you shall not rebuke her.
brenton_translation: And do ye by all means carry it for her, and ye shall surely let fall for her some of that which is heaped up; and let her eat, and glean, and rebuke her not.

fresh_translation: And she gleaned in the field until evening and beat out what she had gleaned, and it came to be about an ephah of barley.
brenton_translation: So she gleaned in the field till evening, and beat out that she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.

fresh_translation: And she took it and went into the city, and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. And Ruth brought out and gave to her what she had left from what satisfied her.
brenton_translation: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned, and Ruth brought forth and gave to her the food which she had left from what she had been satisfied with.

fresh_translation: And her mother-in-law said to her, Where did you glean today, and where did you work? Blessed be the one noticing you. And Ruth reported to her mother-in-law where she worked and said, The name of the man with whom I worked today is Boos.
brenton_translation: And her mother-in-law said to her, Where hast thou gleaned to-day, and where hast thou wrought? blessed be he that took notice of thee. And Ruth told her mother-in-law where she had wrought, and said, The name of the man with whom I wrought to-day is Booz.

fresh_translation: And Noemin said to her daughter-in-law, Blessed is he by the Lord, because he did not forsake his mercy with the living and with the dead. And Noemin said to her, The man is near to us; he is from those redeeming us.
brenton_translation: And Noemin said to her daughter-in-law, Blessed is he of the Lord, because he has not failed in his mercy with the living and with the dead: and Noemin said to her, The man is near akin to us, he is one of our relations.

fresh_translation: And Ruth said to her mother-in-law, Indeed he also said to me, Stay close with my young men until they finish all the harvest that belongs to me.
brenton_translation: And Ruth said to her mother-in-law, Yea, he said also to me, Keep close to my damsels, until the men shall have finished all my reaping.

fresh_translation: And Noemin said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, It is good, daughter, that you went with his girls, and they will not meet you in another field.
