brenton_translation: And Noemin said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, It is well, daughter, that thou wentest out with his damsels; thus they shall not meet thee in another field.

fresh_translation: And Ruth stayed close to the girls of Boos, gleaning until the barley harvest and the wheat harvest were finished, and she lived with her mother-in-law.
brenton_translation: And Ruth joined herself to the damsels of Booz to glean until they had finished the barley-harvest and the wheat-harvest.

fresh_translation: And Noemin her mother-in-law said to her, Daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, so that it may be well with you?
brenton_translation: And she lodged with her mother-in-law: and Noemin her mother-in-law said to her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?

fresh_translation: And now, is not Boos our kinsman, with whose girls you were? Behold, he winnows the threshing floor of barley tonight.
brenton_translation: And now is not Booz our kinsman, with whose damsels thou wast? behold, he winnows barley this night in the floor.

fresh_translation: And you shall wash and anoint yourself and put your garment upon yourself and go up to the threshing floor. Do not make yourself known to the man until he finishes eating and drinking.
brenton_translation: But do thou wash, and anoint thyself, and put thy raiment upon thee, and go up to the threshing-floor: do not discover thyself to the man until he has done eating and drinking.

fresh_translation: And it shall be when he lies down, you will know the place where he lies there, and you will come and uncover the things at his feet and lie down, and he will tell you what you shall do.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when he lies down, that thou shalt mark the place where he lies down, and shalt come and lift up the covering of his feet, and shalt lie down; and he shall tell thee what thou shalt do.

fresh_translation: And Ruth said to her, Everything that you say I will do.
brenton_translation: And Ruth said to her, All that thou shalt say, I will do.

fresh_translation: And she went down to the threshing floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law commanded her.
brenton_translation: And she went down to the threshing-floor, and did according to all that her mother-in-law enjoined her.

fresh_translation: And Boos ate and his heart was made glad, and he came to lie down at the edge of the heap, and she came secretly and uncovered the things at his feet.
brenton_translation: And Booz ate and drank, and his heart was glad, and he came to lie down by the side of the heap of corn; and she came secretly, and lifted up the covering of his feet.

fresh_translation: And it happened at midnight, and the man was startled and disturbed, and behold, a woman lay at his feet.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at midnight that the man was amazed, and troubled, and behold, a woman lay at his feet.

fresh_translation: And he said, Who are you? And she said, I am Ruth your servant, and you shall spread your wing over your servant, because you are a redeemer.
brenton_translation: And he said, Who art thou? and she said, I am thine handmaid Ruth; spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid, for thou art a near relation.

fresh_translation: And he said, Blessed are you by the Lord God, daughter, because you made your latter mercy better than the first, by not going after young men, whether poor or rich.
brenton_translation: And Booz said, Blessed be thou of the Lord God, my daughter, for thou hast made thy latter kindness greater than the former, in that thou followest not after young men, whether any be poor or rich.

fresh_translation: And now, daughter, do not fear. Everything that you say I will do for you, for every tribe of my people knows that you are a woman of strength.
brenton_translation: And now fear not, my daughter, whatever thou shalt say I will do to thee; for all the tribe of my people knows that thou art a virtuous woman.

fresh_translation: And now, truly I am a redeemer, and yet there is a redeemer nearer than I.
brenton_translation: And now I am truly akin to thee; nevertheless there is a kinsman nearer than I.

fresh_translation: Lodge here tonight, and it shall be in the morning, if he redeems you, good, let him redeem; but if he does not want to redeem you, I will redeem you, as the Lord lives. Sleep until morning.
brenton_translation: Lodge here for the night, and it shall be in the morning, if he will do the part of a kinsman to thee, well—let him do it: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, I will do the kinsman's part to thee, as the Lord lives; lie down till the morning.

fresh_translation: And she slept at his feet until morning, and she rose before one man could recognize his neighbor. And Boos said, Let it not be known that a woman came to the threshing floor.
brenton_translation: And she lay at his feet until the morning; and she rose up before a man could know his neighbour; and Booz said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, Bring the mantle that is upon you. And she held it, and he measured six of barley and put it on her, and she went into the city.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, Bring the apron that is upon thee: and she held it, and he measured six measures of barley, and put them upon her, and she went into the city.

fresh_translation: And Ruth entered to her mother-in-law, and she said, Who are you, daughter? And she told her everything that the man did for her.
brenton_translation: And Ruth went in to her mother-in-law, and she said to her, My daughter! and Ruth told her all that the man had done to her.

fresh_translation: And she said to her, He gave me these six of barley, because he said to me, Do not enter empty to your mother-in-law.
brenton_translation: And she said to her, He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said to me, Go not empty to thy mother-in-law.

fresh_translation: And she said, Sit, daughter, until you know how the matter will fall, for the man will certainly not rest until he completes the matter today.
brenton_translation: And she said, Sit still, my daughter, until thou shalt know how the matter will fall out; for the man will not rest until the matter be accomplished this day.

fresh_translation: And Boos went up to the gate and sat there, and behold, the redeemer was passing by whom Boos had spoken of, and Boos said to him, Turn aside, sit here, hidden one. And he turned aside and sat.
brenton_translation: And Booz went up to the gate, and sat there; and behold, the relative passed by, of whom Booz spoke: and Booz said to him, Turn aside, sit down here, such a one: and he turned aside and sat down.

fresh_translation: And Boos took ten men from the elders of the city and said, Sit here. And they sat.
brenton_translation: And Booz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye here; and they sat down.

fresh_translation: And Boos said to the redeemer, The portion of the field that belongs to our brother Abimelech is being given to Noemin who returned from the field of Moab.
brenton_translation: And Booz said to the relative, The matter regards the portion of the field which was our brother Elimelech's which was given to Noemin, now returning out of the land of Moab;

fresh_translation: And I said, I will uncover your ear, saying, Buy it before those sitting here and before the elders of my people. If you redeem, redeem; but if you do not redeem, tell me, and I will know, because there is none besides you to redeem, and I am after you. And he said, I am; I will redeem.
brenton_translation: and I said, I will inform thee, saying, Buy it before those that sit, and before the elders of my people: if thou wilt redeem it, redeem it, but if thou wilt not redeem it, tell me, and I shall know; for there is no one beside thee to do the office of a kinsman, and I am after thee: and he said, I am here, I will redeem it.

fresh_translation: And Boos said, On the day of your acquiring the field from the hand of Noemin, and from Ruth the Moabitess, wife of the dead man, it is necessary for you also to acquire her for yourself, so as to raise up the name of the dead over his inheritance.
brenton_translation: And Booz said, In the day of thy buying the field of the hand of Noemin and of Ruth the Moabitess the wife of the deceased, thou must also buy her, so as to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

fresh_translation: And the redeemer said, I will not be able to redeem for myself, lest I ruin my own inheritance. Redeem my redemption-right for yourself, because I will not be able to redeem.
brenton_translation: And the kinsman said, I shall not be able to redeem it for myself, lest I mar my own inheritance; do thou redeem my right for thyself, for I shall not be able to redeem it.

fresh_translation: And this was the custom formerly in Israel concerning redemption and concerning exchange, to establish every word: a man would loosen his sandal and give it to his neighbor redeeming his right, and this was a witness in Israel.
brenton_translation: And this was in former time the ordinance in Israel for redemption, and for a bargain, to confirm every word: A man loosed his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour that redeemed his right; and this was a testimony in Israel.

fresh_translation: And the redeemer said to Boos, Acquire my redemption-right for yourself, and he loosened his sandal and gave it to him.
brenton_translation: And the kinsman said to Booz, Buy my right for thyself: and he took off his shoe and gave it to him.

fresh_translation: And Boos said to the elders and to all the people, You are witnesses today that I acquired everything of Abimelech and everything belonging to Chelaiōn and to Maalōn from the hand of Noemin.
brenton_translation: And Booz said to the elders and to all the people, Ye are this day witnesses, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that belonged to Chelaion and Maalon, of the hand of Noemin.

fresh_translation: And indeed Ruth the Moabitess, wife of Maalōn, I acquired for myself as wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, and the name of the dead shall not be blotted out from among his brothers and from the tribe of his people. You are witnesses today.
brenton_translation: Moreover I have bought for myself for a wife Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Maalon, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance; so the name of the dead shall not be destroyed from among his brethren, and from the tribe of his people: ye are this day witnesses.

fresh_translation: And all the people at the gate said, Witnesses. And the elders said, May the Lord make your wife entering into your house like Rachel and like Leia, who both built the house of Israel, and may they make strength in Ephratha, and may your name be in Bethleem.
brenton_translation: And all the people who were in the gate said, We are witnesses: and the elders said, The Lord make thy wife who goes into thy house, as Rachel and as Lia, who both together built the house of Israel, and wrought mightily in Ephratha, and there shall be a name to thee in Bethleem.

fresh_translation: And may your house become like the house of Phares, whom Thamar bore to Judah, from the seed that the Lord will give you from this servant girl.
brenton_translation: And let thy house be as the house of Phares, whom Thamar bore to Juda, of the seed which the Lord shall give thee of this handmaid.

fresh_translation: And Boos took Ruth, and she became his wife, and he went in to her, and the Lord gave her conception, and she bore a son.
brenton_translation: And Booz took Ruth, and she became his wife, and he went in to her; and the Lord gave her conception, and she bore a son.

fresh_translation: And the women said to Noemin, Blessed be the Lord, who did not leave you without a redeemer today, and may your name be called in Israel.
brenton_translation: And the women said to Noemin, Blessed is the Lord, who has not suffered a redeemer to fail thee this day, even to make thy name famous in Israel.

fresh_translation: And he shall be for you a restoring of soul and to nourish your old age, because your daughter-in-law who loved you bore him, she who is good to you beyond seven sons.
brenton_translation: And he shall be to thee a restorer of thy soul, and one to cherish thy old age; for thy daughter-in-law which has loved thee, who is better to thee than seven sons, has born him.

fresh_translation: And Noemin took the child and placed him in her bosom, and she became nurse to him.
brenton_translation: And Noemin took the child and laid it in her bosom, and became a nurse to it.

fresh_translation: And the neighboring women called his name, saying, A son has been born to Noemin, and they called his name Ōbēd; he is father of Jessai, father of David.
brenton_translation: And the neighbours gave it a name, saying, A son has been born to Noemin; and they called his name Obed; this is the father of Jessæ the father of David.

fresh_translation: And these are the generations of Phares: Phares fathered Esrōn,
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Phares: Phares begot Esrom:

fresh_translation: and Esrōn fathered Arran, and Arran fathered Aminadab,
brenton_translation: Esrom begot Aram; and Aram begot Aminadab.

fresh_translation: and Aminadab fathered Naassōn, and Naassōn fathered Salman,
brenton_translation: And Aminadab begot Naasson; and Naasson begot Salmon.

fresh_translation: and Salman fathered Boos, and Boos fathered Ōbēd,
brenton_translation: And Salmon begot Booz; and Booz begot Obed.

fresh_translation: and Ōbēd fathered Jessai, and Jessai fathered David.
brenton_translation: And Obed begot Jessæ; and Jessæ begot David.

fresh_translation: There was a man from Armathaim Siphā, from the hill-country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkana, son of Ieremeēl, son of Eliou, son of Thoke, in Nasib Ephraim.
brenton_translation: There was a man of Armathaim Sipha, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Helkana, a son of Jeremeel the son of Elias the son of Thoke, in Nasib Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And to him were two wives; the name of the one was Anna and the name of the second Phennana, and Phennana had children, but Anna had no child.
brenton_translation: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Anna, and the name of the second Phennana. And Phennana had children, but Anna had no child.

fresh_translation: And the man went up from days to days from his city, from Armathaim, to bow down and sacrifice to the Lord God Sabaōth at Shilō, and there were Heli and his two sons, Ophni and Phinees, priests of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the man went up from year to year from his city, from Armathaim, to worship and sacrifice to the Lord God of Sabaoth at Selom: and there were Heli and his two sons Ophni and Phinees, the priests of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the day Elkana sacrificed, that he gave to Phennana his wife and to her sons and her daughters portions,
brenton_translation: And the day came, and Helkana sacrificed, and gave portions to his wife Phennana and her children.

fresh_translation: but to Anna he gave one portion, because she had no child; yet Elkana loved Anna beyond this one, and the Lord had closed the things of her womb.
brenton_translation: And to Anna he gave a prime portion, because she had no child, only Helkana loved Anna more than the other; but the Lord had closed her womb.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord had not given her a child, according to her affliction and according to the discouragement of her affliction, and because of this she was disheartened, because the Lord had shut the things of her womb from giving her a child.
brenton_translation: For the Lord gave her no child in her affliction, and according to the despondency of her affliction; and she was dispirited on this account, that the Lord shut up her womb so as not to give her a child.

fresh_translation: Thus he did year by year, when she went up to the house of the Lord, and she was disheartened and wept and did not eat.
brenton_translation: So she did year by year, in going up to the house of the Lord; and she was dispirited, and wept, and did not eat.

fresh_translation: And Elkana her husband said to her, Anna. And she said to him, Behold, here I am, lord. And he said to her, What is wrong with you, that you weep, and why do you not eat, and why does your heart strike you? Am I not good to you beyond ten children?
brenton_translation: And Helkana her husband said to her, Anna: and she said to him, Here am I, my lord: and he said to her, What ails thee that thou weepest? and why dost thou not eat? and why does thy heart smite thee? am I not better to thee than ten children?

fresh_translation: And Anna rose after they ate in Shilō and stood before the Lord, and Heli the priest was sitting upon the seat by the posts of the temple of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Anna rose up after they had eaten in Selom, and stood before the Lord: and Heli the priest was on a seat by the threshold of the temple of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And she was bitter in soul and prayed to the Lord, and weeping she wept.
brenton_translation: And she was very much grieved in spirit, and prayed to the Lord, and wept abundantly.

fresh_translation: And she vowed a vow to the Lord, saying, Adōnai, Lord Elōai Sabaōth, if in looking you look upon the humiliation of your servant and remember me and give to your servant seed of men, then I will give him before you as a given thing until the day of his death, and wine and intoxicating drink he shall not drink, and iron shall not come upon his head.
brenton_translation: And she vowed a vow to the Lord, saying, O Lord God of Sabaoth, if thou wilt indeed look upon the humiliation of thine handmaid, and remember me, and give to thine handmaid a man-child, then will I indeed dedicate him to thee till the day of his death; and he shall drink no wine nor strong drink, and no razor shall come upon his head.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, while she multiplied in praying before the Lord, Heli the priest watched her mouth.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, while she was long praying before the Lord, that Heli the priest marked her mouth.

fresh_translation: And she was speaking in her heart, and her lips were moving, but her voice was not heard, and Heli counted her as a drunken woman.
brenton_translation: And she was speaking in her heart, and her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: and Heli accounted her a drunken woman.

fresh_translation: And the servant Heli said to her, How long will you be drunk? Put away your wine and go from the presence of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the servant of Heli said to her, How long wilt thou be drunken? take away thy wine from thee, and go out from the presence of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Anna answered and said, No, lord. I am a woman of hard day, and I have not drunk wine or intoxicating drink, but I pour out my soul before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Anna answered and said, Nay, my lord, I live in a hard day, and I have not drunk wine or strong drink, and I pour out my soul before the Lord.

fresh_translation: Do not give your servant as a daughter of pestilence, because out of the abundance of my musing I have stretched on until now.
brenton_translation: Count not thy handmaid for a pestilent woman, for by reason of the abundance of my importunity I have continued my prayer until now.

fresh_translation: And Heli answered and said to her, Go in peace. The God of Israel give you every request of yours that you asked from him.
brenton_translation: And Heli answered and said to her, Go in peace: the God of Israel give thee all thy petition, which thou hast asked of him.

fresh_translation: And she said, Your servant found favor in your eyes. And the woman went on her way and entered into her lodging and ate with her husband and drank, and her face did not fall any more.
brenton_translation: And she said, Thine handmaid has found favour in thine eyes: and the woman went her way, and entered into her lodging, and ate and drank with her husband, and her countenance was no more sad.

fresh_translation: And they rose early in the morning and bowed down to the Lord and went on their way, and Elkana entered into his house at Armathaim and knew Anna his wife, and the Lord remembered her.
brenton_translation: And they rise early in the morning, and worship the Lord, and they go their way: and Helkana went into his house at Armathaim, and knew his wife Anna; and the Lord remembered her, and she conceived.

fresh_translation: And she conceived, and it came to be at the turn of the days, that she bore a son and called his name Samouēl, and said, Because from the Lord God Sabaōth I asked him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the time was come, that she brought forth a son, and called his name Samuel, and said, Because I asked him of the Lord God of Sabaoth.

fresh_translation: And the man Elkana went up, and all his house, to sacrifice in Shilōm the sacrifice of the days and his vows and all the tithes of his land.
brenton_translation: And the man Helkana and all his house went up to offer in Selom the yearly sacrifice, and his vows, and all the tithes of his land.

fresh_translation: But Anna did not go up with him, because she said to her husband, Until the child goes up, when I wean him, then he will be seen before the face of the Lord and sit there forever.
brenton_translation: But Anna did not go up with him, for she said to her husband, I will not go up until the child goes up, when I have weaned him, and he shall be presented before the Lord, and he shall abide there continually.

fresh_translation: And Elkana her husband said to her, Do what is good in your eyes; sit until you wean him. Only may the Lord establish what went out from your mouth. And the woman sat and nursed her son until she weaned him.
brenton_translation: And Helkana her husband said to her, Do that which is good in thine eyes, abide still until thou shalt have weaned him; but may the Lord establish that which comes out of thy mouth: and the woman tarried, and suckled her son until she had weaned him.

fresh_translation: And she went up with him to Shilōm with a three-year-old calf and breads and an ephah of fine flour and a skin of wine, and she entered into the house of the Lord in Shilōm, and the child was with them.
brenton_translation: And she went up with him to Selom with a calf of three years old, and loaves, and an ephah of fine flour, and a bottle of wine: and she entered into the house of the Lord in Selom, and the child with them.

fresh_translation: And they brought him before the Lord, and his father slaughtered the sacrifice that he made from days to days to the Lord, and he brought the child and slaughtered the calf, and Anna, the mother of the child, brought him to Heli.
brenton_translation: And they brought him before the Lord; and his father slew his offering which he offered from year to year to the Lord; and he brought near the child, and slew the calf; and Anna the mother of the child brought him to Heli.

fresh_translation: And she said, In me, lord, your soul lives: I am the woman who stood before you in praying to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And she said, I pray thee, my lord, as thy soul liveth, I am the woman that stood in thy presence with thee while praying to the Lord.

fresh_translation: For this child I prayed, and the Lord gave me my request that I asked from him.
brenton_translation: For this child I prayed; and the Lord has given me my request that I asked of him.

fresh_translation: And I lend him to the Lord all the days that he lives, a use to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I lend him to the Lord all his days that he lives, a loan to the Lord: and she said,

fresh_translation: And she said, My heart was strengthened in the Lord, my horn was lifted up in my God, my mouth was widened against enemies, I rejoiced in your salvation.
brenton_translation: My heart is established in the Lord, my horn is exalted in my God; my mouth is enlarged over my enemies, I have rejoiced in thy salvation.

fresh_translation: Because there is no holy one like the Lord, and there is none righteous like our God; there is no holy one besides you.
brenton_translation: For there is none holy as the Lord, and there is none righteous as our God: there is none holy beside thee.

fresh_translation: Do not boast and do not speak lofty things; let no big speaking go out from your mouth, because the Lord is a God of knowings and a God preparing his practices.
brenton_translation: Boast not, and utter not high things; let not high-sounding words come out of your mouth, for the Lord is a God of knowledge, and God prepares his own designs.

fresh_translation: The bow of the mighty weakened, and the weak girded themselves with strength.
brenton_translation: The bow of the mighty has waxed feeble, and the weak have girded themselves with strength.

fresh_translation: Those full of breads were made less, and the hungry left the land, because the barren one bore seven, and the one many in children became weak.
brenton_translation: They that were full of bread are brought low; and the hungry have forsaken the land; for the barren has born seven, and she that abounded in children has waxed feeble.

fresh_translation: The Lord kills and makes alive; he brings down to Hades and brings up.
brenton_translation: The Lord kills and makes alive; he brings down to the grave, and brings up.

fresh_translation: The Lord makes poor and makes rich, humbles and lifts up.
brenton_translation: The Lord makes poor, and makes rich; he brings low, and lifts up.

fresh_translation: He raises the poor from the earth and lifts the needy from the dung heap, to seat him with rulers of peoples and to allot to them a throne of glory.
brenton_translation: He lifts up the poor from the earth, and raises the needy from the dunghill; to seat him with the princes of the people, and causing them to inherit the throne of glory:

fresh_translation: Giving prayer to the one praying, and he blessed the years of the righteous, because not by strength is a man mighty.
brenton_translation: granting his petition to him that prays; and he blesses the years of the righteous, for by strength cannot man prevail.

fresh_translation: The Lord will make his adversary weak; the Lord is holy. Let not the wise boast in his wisdom, and let not the strong boast in his strength, and let not the rich boast in his wealth, but in this let the boasting one boast: to understand and know the Lord and to do judgment and righteousness in the midst of the earth. The Lord went up into the heavens and thundered; he will judge the ends of the earth and gives strength to our kings and will lift up the horn of his anointed.
brenton_translation: The Lord will weaken his adversary; the Lord is holy. Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor let the mighty man boast in his strength, and let not the rich man boast in his wealth; but let him that boasts boast in this, to understand and know the Lord, and to execute judgment and justice in the midst of the earth. The Lord has gone up to the heavens, and has thundered: he will judge the extremities of the earth, and he gives strength to our kings, and will exalt the horn of his Christ.

fresh_translation: And they left him there before the Lord and went away to Armathaim, and the child was ministering before the face of the Lord before Heli the priest.
brenton_translation: and departed to Armathaim: and the child ministered in the presence of the Lord before Heli the priest.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Heli the priest were sons of pestilence, not knowing the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Heli the priest were evil sons, not knowing the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the ordinance of the priest from the people, everyone sacrificing, was this: the servant of the priest came while the meat was boiling, and a three-pronged flesh-hook was in his hand,
brenton_translation: And the priest's claim from every one of the people that sacrificed was this: the servant of the priest came when the flesh was in seething, and a flesh-hook of three teeth was in his hand.

fresh_translation: and he struck it into the great cauldron or into the bronze pot or into the cooking pot. Everything that came up with the flesh-hook the priest took for himself. According to these things they were doing to all Israel who came to sacrifice to the Lord in Shilōm.
brenton_translation: And he struck it into the great caldron, or into the brazen vessel, or into the pot, and whatever came up with the flesh-hook, the priest took for himself: so they did to all Israel that came to sacrifice to the Lord in Selom.

fresh_translation: And before the fat was burned, the servant of the priest came and said to the man sacrificing, Give meat for roasting to the priest, and I will certainly not take boiled meat from you out of the cauldron.
brenton_translation: And before the fat was burnt for a sweet savour, the servant of the priest would come, and say to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest, and I will by no means take of thee sodden flesh out of the caldron.

fresh_translation: And the sacrificing man said, Let the fat first be burned as is proper, and take for yourself from everything your soul desires. And he said, No, because you shall give now, and if not, I will take by force.
brenton_translation: And if the man that sacrificed said, First let the fat be burned, as it is fit, and take for thyself of all things which thy soul desires: then he would say, Nay, for thou shalt give it me now; and if not, I will take it by force.

fresh_translation: And the sin of the young servants before the Lord was very great, because they were despising the sacrifice of the Lord.
brenton_translation: So the sin of the young men was very great before the Lord, for they set at nought the offering of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl was ministering before the Lord, a child girded with a linen ephod.
brenton_translation: And Samuel ministered before the Lord, a child girt with a linen ephod.

fresh_translation: And his mother made for him a small doublet and brought it up to him from days to days when she went up with her husband to sacrifice the sacrifice of the days.
brenton_translation: And his mother made him a little doublet, and brought it to him from year to year, in her going up in company with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And Heli blessed Elkana and his wife, saying, May the Lord repay you seed from this woman in place of the loan that you loaned to the Lord. And the man went to his place.
brenton_translation: And Heli blessed Helcana and his wife, saying, The Lord recompense to thee seed of this woman, in return for the loan which thou hast lent to the Lord: and the man returned to his place.

fresh_translation: And the Lord visited Anna, and she bore yet three sons and two daughters, and the child Samouēl was magnified before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the Lord visited Anna, and she bore yet three sons, and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Heli was very old and heard what his sons were doing to the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Heli was very old, and he heard what his sons did to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Why are you doing according to this word that I hear from the mouth of all the people of the Lord?
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Why do ye according to this thing, which I hear from the mouth of all the people of the Lord?

fresh_translation: No, children, because the report that I hear is not good. Do not do so, because the reports that I hear are not good, of the people not serving God.
brenton_translation: Nay my sons, for the report which I hear is not good; do not so, for the reports which I hear are not good, so that the people do not serve God.

fresh_translation: If a man sins by sinning against a man, then they will pray concerning him to the Lord, but if someone sins against the Lord, who will pray concerning him? And they were not listening to the voice of their father, because the Lord deliberately desired to destroy them.
brenton_translation: If a man should at all sin against another, then shall they pray for him to the Lord; but if a man sin against the Lord, who shall intreat for him? But they hearkened not to the voice of their father, because the Lord would by all means destroy them.

fresh_translation: And the child Samouēl was going on and growing and good both with the Lord and with men.
brenton_translation: And the child Samuel advanced, and was in favour with God and with men.

fresh_translation: And a man of God came to Heli and said, Thus says the Lord: In revealing did I reveal myself to the house of your father while they were in the land of Egypt, servants to the house of Pharaoh?
brenton_translation: And a man of God came to Heli, and said, Thus says the Lord, I plainly revealed myself to the house of thy father, when they were servants in Egypt to the house of Pharao.

fresh_translation: And I chose the house of your father from all the scepters of Israel for myself, to serve as priest and to go up upon my altar and to burn incense and to lift the ephod, and I gave to the house of your father all the fire-offerings of the sons of Israel for food.
brenton_translation: And I chose the house of thy father out of all the tribes of Israel to minister to me in the priest's office, to go up to my altar, and to burn incense, and to wear an ephod. And I gave to the house of thy father all the offerings by fire of the children of Israel for food.

fresh_translation: And why did you look upon my incense and upon my sacrifice with shameless eye, and glorify your sons beyond me, to bless yourselves from the firstfruits of every sacrifice of Israel before me?
brenton_translation: And wherefore hast thou looked upon my incense-offering and my meat-offering with a shameless eye, and hast honoured thy sons above me, so that they should bless themselves with the first-fruits of every sacrifice of Israel before me?

fresh_translation: Because of this thus said the Lord God of Israel: I said, Your house and the house of your father will pass before me forever. And now, says the Lord, let it not be to me; rather those glorifying me I will glorify, and the one despising me will be dishonored.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel, I said, Thy house and the house of thy father shall pass before me for ever: but now the Lord says, That be far from me; for I will only honour them that honour me, and he that sets me at nought shall be despised.

fresh_translation: Behold, days are coming, and I will destroy your seed and the seed of your father's house.
brenton_translation: Behold, the days come when I will destroy thy seed and the seed of thy father's house.

fresh_translation: And there shall not be an old man of yours in my house all the days.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not have an old man in my house for ever.

fresh_translation: And a man I will not destroy for you from my altar, to fail his eyes and make his soul melt away, and everyone remaining of your house shall fall by the sword of men.
brenton_translation: And if I do not destroy a man of thine from my altar, it shall be that his eyes may fail and his soul may perish; and every one that remains in thy house shall fall by the sword of men.

fresh_translation: And this will be the sign to you that will come upon these your two sons, Ophni and Phinees: in one day both will die.
brenton_translation: And this which shall come upon thy two sons Ophni and Phinees shall be a sign to thee; in one day they shall both die.

fresh_translation: And I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who will do all the things in my heart and the things in my soul, and I will build for him a faithful house, and he will pass before my anointed all the days.
brenton_translation: And I will raise up to myself a faithful priest, who shall do all that is in my heart and in my soul; and I will build him a sure house, and he shall walk before my Christ for ever.

fresh_translation: And it shall be that the one left over in your house will come to bow down to him for an obol of silver, saying, Cast me beside one of your priesthoods that I may eat bread.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass that he that survives in thy house, shall come to do obeisance before him for a little piece of silver, saying, Put me into one of thy priests' offices to eat bread.

fresh_translation: And the child Samouēl was ministering to the Lord before Heli the priest, and the word of the Lord was precious in those days; there was no vision making distinction.
brenton_translation: And the child Samuel ministered to the Lord before Heli the priest: and the word of the Lord was precious in those days, there was no distinct vision.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on that day, and Heli was sleeping in his place, and his eyes began to grow heavy and he was not able to see.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at that time that Heli was sleeping in his place; and his eyes began to fail, and could not see.

fresh_translation: And the lamp of God was before being set in order, and Samouēl was sleeping in the temple where the ark of God was.
brenton_translation: And the lamp of God was burning before it was trimmed, and Samuel slept in the temple, where was the ark of God.

fresh_translation: And the Lord called, Samouēl, Samouēl. And he said, Behold, here I am.
brenton_translation: And the Lord called, Samuel, Samuel; and he said, Behold, here am I.

fresh_translation: And he ran to Heli and said, Behold, here I am, because you called me. And he said, I did not call you; go back, sleep. And he went back and slept.
brenton_translation: And he ran to Heli, and said, Here am I, for thou didst call me: and he said, I did not call thee; return, go to sleep; and he returned and went to sleep.

fresh_translation: And the Lord added and called, Samouēl, Samouēl. And he went to Heli a second time and said, Behold, here I am, because you called me. And he said, I did not call you; go back, sleep.
brenton_translation: And the Lord called again, Samuel, Samuel: and he went to Heli the second time, and said, Behold here am I, for thou didst call me: and he said, I called thee not; return, go to sleep.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl was before knowing God and before the word of the Lord was revealed to him.
brenton_translation: And it was before Samuel knew the Lord, and before the word of the Lord was revealed to him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord added to call Samouēl a third time, and he rose and went to Heli and said, Behold, here I am, because you called me. And Heli understood that the Lord had called the child.
brenton_translation: And the Lord called Samuel again for the third time: and he arose and went to Heli, and said, Behold, I am here, for thou didst call me: and Heli perceived that the Lord had called the child.

fresh_translation: And he said, Go back, sleep, child, and it shall be if he calls you, then you shall say, Speak, Lord, because your servant hears. And Samouēl went and lay down in his place.
brenton_translation: And he said, Return, child, go to sleep; and it shall come to pass if he shall call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, for thy servant hears: and Samuel went and lay down in his place.

fresh_translation: And the Lord came and stood and called him as once and again, and Samouēl said, Speak, because your servant hears.
brenton_translation: And the Lord came, and stood, and called him as before: and Samuel said, Speak, for thy servant hears.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Samouēl, Behold, I am doing my words in Israel, so that whoever hears them, both his ears will ring.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Behold, I execute my words in Israel; whoever hears them, both his ears shall tingle.

fresh_translation: In that day I will raise upon Heli all that I spoke against his house; I will begin and I will complete.
brenton_translation: In that day I will raise up against Heli all things that I have said against his house; I will begin, and I will make an end.

fresh_translation: And I have announced to him that I am avenging his house forever for the injustices of his sons, because his sons were blaspheming God and he was not warning them, not even so.
brenton_translation: And I have told him that I will be avenged on his house perpetually for the iniquities of his sons, because his sons spoke evil against God, and he did not admonish them.

fresh_translation: I swore to the house of Heli whether the injustice of the house of Heli will be propitiated by incense and by sacrifices forever.
brenton_translation: And it shall not go on so; I have sworn to the house of Eli, the iniquity of the house of Eli shall not be atoned for with incense or sacrifices for ever.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl slept until morning and rose early in the morning and opened the doors of the house of the Lord, and Samouēl feared to report the vision to Heli.
brenton_translation: And Samuel slept till morning, and rose early in the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the Lord; and Samuel feared to tell Heli the vision.

fresh_translation: And Heli said to Samouēl, Samouēl, child. And he said, Behold, here I am.
brenton_translation: And Heli said to Samuel, Samuel, my son; and he said, Behold, here am I.

fresh_translation: And he said, What is the word spoken to you? Do not hide it from me. Thus may God do to you and thus may he add, if you hide from me a word of all the words spoken to you in your ears.
brenton_translation: And he said, What was the word that was spoken to thee? I pray thee hide it not from me: may God do these things to thee, and more also, if thou hide from me any thing of all the words that were spoken to thee in thine ears.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl reported all the words and did not hide from him, and Heli said, He is the Lord; what is good before him he will do.
brenton_translation: And Samuel reported all the words, and hid them not from him. And Heli said, He is the Lord, he shall do that which is good in his sight.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl grew great, and the Lord was with him, and not one of all his words fell to the ground.
brenton_translation: And Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him, and there did not fall one of his words to the ground.

fresh_translation: And all Israel knew, from Dan and as far as Bersabee, that Samouēl was faithful as prophet to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And all Israel knew from Dan even to Bersabee, that Samuel was faithful as a prophet to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord again made himself known in Shilōm, because the Lord was revealed to Samouēl, and Samouēl was entrusted to become prophet to the Lord for all Israel from end of the land to end. And Heli was very old, and his sons were going on and their way was evil before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the Lord manifested himself again in Selom, for the Lord revealed himself to Samuel; and Samuel was accredited to all Israel as a prophet to the Lord from one end of the land to the other: and Heli was very old, and his sons kept advancing in wickedness, and their way was evil before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in those days, and foreigners were gathered for war against Israel, and Israel went out to meet them for war, and they camped by Abenezēr, and the foreigners camped in Aphek.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in those days that the Philistines gathered themselves together against Israel to war; and Israel went out to meet them and encamped at Aben-ezer, and the Philistines encamped in Aphec.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners lined up for battle against Israel, and the battle turned, and a man of Israel stumbled before the foreigners, and four thousand men were struck down in battle in the field.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines prepare to fight with Israel, and the battle was turned against them; and the men of Israel fell before the Philistines, and there were smitten in the battle in the field four thousand men.

fresh_translation: And the people came into the camp, and the elders of Israel said, Why did the Lord make us stumble today before the foreigners? Let us take the ark of our God from Shilōm, and let it come out in our midst and save us from the hand of our enemies.
brenton_translation: And the people came to the camp, and the elders of Israel said, Why has the Lord caused us to fall this day before the Philistines? let us take the ark of our God out of Selom, and let it proceed from the midst of us, and it shall save us from the hand of our enemies.

fresh_translation: And the people sent to Shilōm, and they took from there the ark of the Lord seated on cherubim, and both sons of Heli were with the ark, Ophni and Phinees.
brenton_translation: And the people sent to Selom, and they take thence the ark of the Lord who dwells between the cherubs: and both the sons of Heli, Ophni and Phinees, were with the ark.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the ark of the Lord came into the camp, all Israel cried out with a great voice, and the earth resounded.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the ark of the Lord entered into the camp, that all Israel cried out with a loud voice, and the earth resounded.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners heard the sound of the cry and said, What is this great cry in the camp of the Hebrews? And they knew that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines heard the cry, and the Philistines said, What is this great cry in the camp of the Hebrews: and they understood that the ark of the Lord was come into the camp.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners were afraid and said, These gods have come to them into the camp. Woe to us, Lord, rescue us today, because such a thing has not happened yesterday or the day before.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines feared, and said, These are the Gods that are come to them into the camp.

fresh_translation: Woe to us. Who will rescue us from the hand of these strong gods? These are the gods who struck Egypt with every plague and in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: Woe to us, O Lord, deliver us to-day, for such a thing has not happened aforetime: woe to us, who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these are the Gods that smote Egypt with every plague, and in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: Be strong and become men, foreigners, lest you serve the Hebrews as they served us. And become men and fight them.
brenton_translation: Strengthen yourselves and behave yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye may not serve the Hebrews as they have served us, but be ye men and fight with them.

fresh_translation: And they fought them, and a man of Israel stumbled, and each fled to his tent, and there was a very great blow, and thirty thousand ranks fell from Israel.
brenton_translation: And they fought with them; and the men of Israel fall, and they fled every man to his tent; and there was a very great slaughter; and there fell of Israel thirty thousand fighting men.

fresh_translation: And the ark of God was taken, and both sons of Heli died, Ophni and Phinees.
brenton_translation: And the ark of God was taken, and both the sons of Heli, Ophni and Phinees, died.

fresh_translation: And a Jeminite man ran from the battle line and came to Shilōm on that day, and his garments were torn and earth was on his head.
brenton_translation: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the battle, and he came to Selom on that day: and his clothes were rent, and earth was upon his head.

fresh_translation: And he came, and behold, Heli was sitting on the seat by the gate, watching the road, because his heart was beside itself concerning the ark of God. And the man entered into the city to report, and the city cried out.
brenton_translation: And he came, and behold, Heli was upon the seat by the gate looking along the way, for his heart was greatly alarmed for the ark of God: and the man entered into the city to bring tidings; and the city cried out.

fresh_translation: And Heli heard the sound of the outcry and said, What is this cry of this sound? And the man hurried and entered and reported to Heli.
brenton_translation: And Heli heard the sound of the cry, and said, What is the voice of this cry? and the man hasted and went in, and reported to Heli.

fresh_translation: And Heli was ninety years old, and his eyes had become fixed, and he did not see, and Heli said to the men standing around him, What is the voice of this sound?
brenton_translation: Now Heli was ninety years old, and his eyes were fixed, and he saw not.

fresh_translation: And the man hurried and came near to Heli and said to him, I am the one coming from the camp, and I fled from the battle line today. And he said, What is the matter, child?
brenton_translation: And Heli said to them that stood round about him, What is the voice of this sound? And the man hasted and advanced to Heli, and said to him, I am he that is come out of the camp, and I have fled from the battle to-day: and Heli said, What is the event, my son?

fresh_translation: And the young servant answered and said, A man of Israel fled from before the foreigners, and there was a great blow among the people, and both your sons have died, and the ark of God has been taken.
brenton_translation: And the young man answered and said, The men of Israel fled from the face of the Philistines, and there was a great slaughter among the people, and both thy sons are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when he mentioned the ark of God, he fell from the seat backward near the gate, and his back was broken and he died, because the man was old and heavy, and he judged Israel twenty years.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when he mentioned the ark of God, that he fell from the seat backward near the gate, and his back was broken, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy: and he judged Israel twenty years.

fresh_translation: And his daughter-in-law, wife of Phinees, had conceived to give birth, and she heard the news that the ark of God had been taken and that her father-in-law and her husband had died, and she crouched down and gave birth, because her labor pains turned upon her.
brenton_translation: And his daughter-in-law the wife of Phinees was with child, about to bring forth; and she heard the tidings, that the ark of God was taken, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead; and she wept and was delivered, for her pains came upon her.

fresh_translation: And at the time of her dying the women standing by her said to her, Do not fear, because you have borne a son. But she did not answer, and her heart did not understand.
brenton_translation: And in her time she was at the point of death; and the women that stood by her, said to her, Fear not, for thou hast born a son: but she answered not, and her heart did not regard it.

fresh_translation: And she called the child Ouai Barchabōth because of the ark of God and because of her father-in-law and because of her husband.
brenton_translation: And she called the child Uæbarchaboth, because of the ark of God, and because of her father-in-law, and because of her husband.

fresh_translation: And they said, Glory has departed from Israel in the taking of the ark of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they said, The glory of Israel is departed, forasmuch as the ark of the Lord is taken.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners took the ark of God and brought it in from Abennezēr to Azotus.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Abenezer to Azotus.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners took the ark of the Lord and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it beside Dagon.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines took the ark of the Lord, and brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it by Dagon.

fresh_translation: And the Azotians rose early and entered into the house of Dagon, and behold, Dagon had fallen on his face before the ark of God. And they raised up Dagon and set him in his place, and the hand of the Lord grew heavy upon the Azotians, and he tormented them and struck them in their seats, Azotus and its borders.
brenton_translation: And the people of Azotus rose early, and entered into the house of Dagon; and looked, and behold, Dagon had fallen on his face before the ark of the Lord: and they lifted up Dagon, and set him in his place. And the hand of the Lord was heavy upon the Azotians, and he plagued them, and he smote them in their secret parts, Azotus and her coasts.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when they rose early in the morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the head of Dagon and both the prints of his hands were removed upon the front threshold, each one, and both palms of his hands had fallen on the threshold; only the back of Dagon was left.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when they rose early in the morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face before the ark of the covenant of the Lord; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off each before the threshold, and both the wrists of his hands had fallen on the floor of the porch; only the stump of Dagon was left.

fresh_translation: Because of this the priests of Dagon and everyone entering the house of Dagon do not step upon the step of the house of Dagon in Azotus until this day, because in passing over they pass over it.
brenton_translation: Therefore the priests of Dagon, and every one that enters into the house of Dagon, do not tread upon the threshold of the house of Dagon in Azotus until this day, for they step over.

fresh_translation: And the hand of the Lord grew heavy upon Azotus and brought upon them and boiled out for them in their ships, and in the midst of its region mice sprang up, and there was a great confusion of death in the city.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the Lord was heavy upon Azotus, and he brought evil upon them, and it burst out upon them into the ships, and mice sprang up in the midst of their country, and there was a great and indiscriminate mortality in the city.

fresh_translation: And the men of Azotus saw that it was so and said, The ark of the God of Israel will not remain with us, because his hand is hard upon us and upon Dagon our god.
brenton_translation: And the men of Azotus saw that it was so, and they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us, for his hand is heavy upon us and upon Dagon our god.

fresh_translation: And they sent and gathered the satraps of the foreigners to them and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And the Gittites said, Let the ark of God come over to us. And the ark of God came over to Geththa.
brenton_translation: And they send and gather the lords of the Philistines to them, and say, What shall we do to the ark of the God of Israel? and the Gittites say, Let the ark of God come over to us; and the ark of the God of Israel came to Geth.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after it came over, the hand of the Lord was in the city, a very great disturbance, and he struck the men of the city from small to great and struck them in their seats, and the Gittites made seats for themselves.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after it went about to Geth, that the hand of the Lord comes upon the city, a very great confusion; and he smote the men of the city small and great, and smote them in their secret parts: and the Gittites made to themselves images of emerods.

fresh_translation: And they sent away the ark of God to Ascalon, and it came to be when the ark of God entered into Ascalon, the Ascalonites cried out, saying, Why did you return to us the ark of the God of Israel, to kill us and our people?
brenton_translation: And they send away the ark of God to Ascalon; and it came to pass when the ark of God went into Ascalon, that the men of Ascalon cried out, saying, Why have ye brought back the ark of the God of Israel to us, to kill us and our people?

fresh_translation: And they sent and gathered the satraps of the foreigners and said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it sit in its place, and it shall certainly not kill us and our people, because there was confusion of death in the whole city, very heavy, as the ark of the God of Israel entered there.
brenton_translation: And they send and gather the lords of the Philistines, and they said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it lodge in its place; and let it not slay us and our people.

fresh_translation: And the living who did not die were struck in their seats, and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
brenton_translation: For there was a very great confusion in all the city, when the ark of the God of Israel entered there; and those who lived and died not were smitten with emerods; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.

fresh_translation: And the ark was in the field of the foreigners seven months, and their land boiled out mice.
brenton_translation: And the ark was seven months in the country of the Philistines, and their land brought forth swarms of mice.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners call the priests and their diviners and enchanters, saying, What shall we do with the ark of the Lord? Make known to us in what way we shall send it to its place.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines call their priests, and their prophets, and their enchanters, saying, What shall we do to the ark of the Lord? teach us wherewith we shall send it away to its place.

fresh_translation: And they said, If you send away the ark of the covenant of the Lord God of Israel, by no means send it away empty, but in repaying repay it for the torment, and then you will be healed and it will be propitiated for you. Will not his hand depart from you?
brenton_translation: And they said, If ye send away the ark of the covenant of the Lord God of Israel, do not on any account send it away empty, but by all means render to it an offering for the plague; and then shall ye be healed, and an atonement shall be made for you: should not his hand be thus stayed from off you?

fresh_translation: And they say, What is the thing of torment that we shall repay to it? And they said, According to the number of the satraps of the foreigners, five golden seats, because the same fall is on you and on your rulers and on the people.
brenton_translation: And they say, What is the offering for the plague which we shall return to it? and they said,

fresh_translation: And golden mice, likeness of your mice destroying the land, and you shall give glory to the Lord, so that he may lighten his hand from you and from your gods and from your land.
brenton_translation: According to the number of the lords of the Philistines, five golden emerods, for the plague was on you, and on your rulers, and on the people; and golden mice, the likeness of the mice that destroy your land: and ye shall give glory to the Lord, that he may lighten his hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

fresh_translation: And why do you harden your hearts as Egypt and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? Was it not when he mocked them that they sent them away and they went?
brenton_translation: And why do ye harden your hearts, as Egypt and Pharao hardened their hearts? was it not so when he mocked them, that they let the people go, and they departed?

fresh_translation: And now take and make a new wagon and two first-calving cows apart from their calves, and yoke the cows to the wagon and lead away the calves from behind them into the house.
brenton_translation: And now take wood and make a new waggon, and take two cows, that have calved for the first time, without their calves; and do ye yoke the cows to the waggon, and lead away the calves from behind them home.

fresh_translation: And you will take the ark and put it on the wagon, and the gold objects that you repay to it for the torment you shall place in a chest beside it, and you shall send it away and drive it out, and it will go.
brenton_translation: And ye shall take the ark and put it on the waggon; and ye shall restore to it the golden articles for the trespass-offering in a coffer by the side of it: and ye shall let it go, and send it away, and ye shall depart.

fresh_translation: And you will see whether it goes on the road of its borders toward Baithsamyis; he did to us this great evil. But if not, then we shall know that it was not his hand that touched us, but this happened to us by chance.
brenton_translation: And ye shall see, if it shall go the way of its coasts along by Bæthsamys, he has brought upon us this great affliction; and if not, then shall we know that his hand has not touched us, but this is a chance which has happened to us.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners did so, and they took two first-calving cows and yoked them to the wagon, and they shut up their calves in the house.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines did so; and they took two cows that had calved for the first time, and yoked them to the waggon, and shut up their calves at home.

fresh_translation: And they set the ark upon the wagon and the chest Ergab and the gold mice.
brenton_translation: And they set the ark of the Lord, and the coffer, and the golden mice, on the waggon.

fresh_translation: And the cows went straight on the road, on the road to Baithsamyis, in one path they went, and they toiled and did not turn aside right or left, and the satraps of the foreigners went after it until the borders of Baithsamyis.
brenton_translation: And the cows went straight on the way to the way of Bæthsamys, they went along one track; and laboured, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left, and the lords of the Philistines went after it as far as the coasts of Bæthsamys.

fresh_translation: And those in Baithsamyis were reaping wheat harvest in the valley, and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark of the Lord and rejoiced to meet it.
brenton_translation: And the men of Bæthsamys were reaping the wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the ark of the Lord, and rejoiced to meet it.

fresh_translation: And the wagon came into the field of Ōsēe in Baithsamyis, and they stood there by a great stone, and they split the wood of the wagon and offered the cows as a whole burnt offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the waggon entered into the field of Osee, which was in Bæthsamys, and they set there by it a great stone; and they split the wood of the waggon, and offered up the cows for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Levites brought up the ark of the Lord and the chest Ergab with it and the gold items upon it and placed them on the great stone, and the men of Baithsamyis offered whole burnt offerings and sacrifices on that day to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the Levites brought up the ark of the Lord, and the coffer with it, and the golden articles upon it, and placed them on the great stone, and the men of Bæthsamys offered whole-burnt-offerings and meat-offerings on that day to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the five satraps of the foreigners saw and returned to Ascalon on that day.
brenton_translation: And the five lords of the Philistines saw, and returned to Ascalon in that day.

fresh_translation: And these are the golden seats that the foreigners repaid to the Lord for the torment: one for Azotus, one for Gaza, one for Ascalon, one for Geth, one for Akkaron,
brenton_translation: And these are the golden emerods which the lords of the Philistines gave as a trespass-offering to the Lord; for Azotus one, for Gaza one, for Ascalon one, for Geth one, for Accaron one.

fresh_translation: and the golden mice according to the number of all the cities of the foreigners of the five satraps, from fortified city and to village of the Perizzite, and to the great stone on which they placed the ark of the covenant of the Lord, the one in the field of Ōsēe the Baithsamyisite.
brenton_translation: And the golden mice according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines, belonging to the five lords, from the fenced city to the village of the Pherezite, and to the great stone, on which they placed the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that was in the field of Osee the Bæthsamysite.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Iechoniou were not pleased among the men of Baithsamyis because they saw the ark of the Lord, and he struck among them seventy men and fifty thousand men, and the people mourned because the Lord struck the people with a very great blow.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jechonias were not pleased with the men of Bæthsamys, because they saw the ark of the Lord; and the Lord smote among them seventy men, and fifty thousand men: and the people mourned, because the Lord had inflicted on the people a very great plague.

fresh_translation: And the men from Baithsamyis said, Who will be able to go through before this holy Lord, and to whom will the ark of the Lord go up from us?
brenton_translation: And the men of Bæthsamys said, Who shall be able to pass before this holy Lord God? and to whom shall the ark of the Lord go up from us?

fresh_translation: And they send messengers to those dwelling in Kariathiarim, saying, The foreigners have returned the ark of the Lord. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.
brenton_translation: And they send messengers to the inhabitants of Cariathiarim, saying, The Philistines have brought back the ark of the Lord, go down and take it home to yourselves.

fresh_translation: And the men of Kariathiarim come and bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and bring it into the house of Aminadab on the hill, and they consecrated Eleazar his son to guard the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the men of Cariathiarim come, and bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord: and they bring it into the house of Aminadab in the hill; and they sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it came to be from the day the ark was in Kariathiarim, the days multiplied and became twenty years, and all the house of Israel looked after the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass from the time that the ark was in Cariathiarim, the days were multiplied, and the time was twenty years; and all the house of Israel looked after the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl said to all the house of Israel, saying, If with your whole heart you are turning to the Lord, remove the foreign gods from your midst and the groves, and prepare your hearts toward the Lord and serve him alone, and he will deliver you from the hand of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do with all your heart return to the Lord, take away the strange gods from the midst of you, and the groves, and prepare your hearts to serve the Lord, and serve him only; and he shall deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel removed the Baals and the groves of Astarōth and served the Lord alone.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel took away Baalim and the groves of Astaroth, and served the Lord only.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl said, Gather all Israel to Massēphath, and I will pray concerning you to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Massephath, and I will pray for you to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they gathered to Massēphath and drew water and poured it out before the Lord upon the ground and fasted on that day and said, We sinned before the Lord. And Samouēl was judging the sons of Israel in Massēphath.
brenton_translation: And they were gathered together to Massephath, and they drew water, and poured it out upon the earth before the Lord. And they fasted on that day, and said, We have sinned before the Lord. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Massephath.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners heard that all the sons of Israel had gathered to Massēphath, and the satraps of the foreigners went up against Israel. And the sons of Israel heard and feared from before the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines heard that all the children of Israel were gathered together to Massephath: and the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel: and the children of Israel heard, and they feared before the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel said to Samouēl, Do not be silent away from us from crying to the Lord your God, and he will save us from the hand of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry to the Lord thy God for us, and he shall save us out of the hand of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl took one suckling lamb and offered it up whole with all the people to the Lord, and Samouēl cried out to the Lord concerning Israel, and the Lord listened to him.
brenton_translation: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered it up as a whole-burnt-offering with all the people to the Lord: and Samuel cried to the Lord for Israel, and the Lord heard him.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl was offering up the whole burnt offering, and the foreigners drew near for battle against Israel, and the Lord thundered with a great voice on that day against the foreigners and confused them, and they stumbled before Israel.
brenton_translation: And Samuel was offering the whole-burnt-offering; and the Philistines drew near to war against Israel; and the Lord thundered with a mighty sound in that day upon the Philistines, and they were confounded and overthrown before Israel.

fresh_translation: And men of Israel went out from Massēphath and pursued the foreigners and struck them as far as below Baithchor.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel went forth out of Massephath, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them to the parts under Bæthchor.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl took one stone and set it between Massēphath and between the old place and called its name Abenezēr, Stone of the Helper, and said, Until here the Lord has helped us.
brenton_translation: And Samuel took a stone, and set it up between Massephath and the old city; and he called the name of it Abenezer, stone of the helper; and he said, Hitherto has the Lord helped us.

fresh_translation: And the Lord humbled the foreigners, and they no longer continued to come into the border of Israel, and the hand of the Lord was upon the foreigners all the days of Samouēl.
brenton_translation: So the Lord humbled the Philistines, and they did not any more come into the border of Israel; and the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

fresh_translation: And the cities that the foreigners took from the sons of Israel were given back, and they restored them to Israel from Ascalon to Azob, and the border of Israel they removed from the hand of the foreigners. And there was peace between Israel and between the Amorite.
brenton_translation: And the cities which the Philistines took from the children of Israel were restored; and they restored them to Israel from Ascalon to Azob: and they took the coast of Israel out of the hand of the Philistines; and there was peace between Israel and the Amorite.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl judged Israel all the days of his life.
brenton_translation: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

fresh_translation: And he went year by year and made circuit of Baethel and Galgala and Massēphath and judged Israel in all these consecrated places.
brenton_translation: And he went year by year, and went round Bæthel, and Galgala, and Massephath; and he judged Israel in all these consecrated places.

fresh_translation: And his return was to Armathaim, because there was his house, and there he judged Israel, and he built there an altar to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And his return was to Armathaim, because there was his house; and there he judged Israel, and built there an altar to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Samouēl grew old that he appointed his sons as judges for Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of his sons: firstborn Jōēl, and the name of the second Abia, judges in Bersabee.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of his sons; Joel the first-born, and the name of the second Abia, judges in Bersabee.

fresh_translation: And his sons did not walk in his way, and they turned aside after gain and were taking gifts and turning aside judgments.
brenton_translation: And his sons did not walk in his way; and they turned aside after gain, and took gifts, and perverted judgments.

fresh_translation: And men of Israel gathered together and came to Armathaim to Samouēl.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel gather themselves together, and come to Armathaim to Samuel,

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Behold, you have grown old, and your sons do not walk in your way, and now appoint over us a king to judge us, as also the rest of the nations have.
brenton_translation: and they said to him, Behold, thou art grown old, and thy sons walk not in thy way; and now set over us a king to judge us, as also the other nations have.

fresh_translation: And the word was evil in the eyes of Samouēl as they said, Give us a king to judge us, and Samouēl prayed to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us: and Samuel prayed to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Samouēl, Hear the voice of the people according to whatever they say to you, because they have not despised you, but me they have despised, from reigning over them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Hear the voice of the people, in whatever they shall say to thee; for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me from reigning over them.

fresh_translation: According to all the deeds that they did to me from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, and they forsook me and served other gods, so they also are doing to you.
brenton_translation: According to all their doings which they have done to me, from the day that I brought them out of Egypt until this day, even as they have deserted me, and served other gods, so they do also to thee.

fresh_translation: And now hear their voice; only in protesting protest to them and declare to them the right of the king who will reign over them.
brenton_translation: And now hearken to their voice; only thou shalt solemnly testify to them, and thou shalt describe to them the manner of the king who shall reign over them.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl spoke every word of the Lord to the people asking from him a king.
brenton_translation: And Samuel spoke every word of the Lord to the people who asked of him a king.

fresh_translation: And he said, This will be the right of the king who will reign over you: he will take your sons and place them in his chariots and among his horsemen and as runners before his chariots,
brenton_translation: And he said, This shall be the manner of the king that shall rule over you: he shall take your sons, and put them in his chariots, and among his horsemen, and running before his chariots,

fresh_translation: and to appoint them for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and to reap his harvest and gather his vintage and make his implements of war and the implements of his chariots.
brenton_translation: and his manner shall be to make them to himself captains of hundreds and captains of thousands; and to reap his harvest, and gather his vintage, and prepare his instruments of war, and the implements of his chariots.

fresh_translation: And your daughters he will take as perfumers and cooks and bakers.
brenton_translation: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, and cooks, and bakers.

fresh_translation: And your fields and your vineyards and your good olive groves he will take and give to his servants.
brenton_translation: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your good oliveyards, and give them to his servants.

fresh_translation: And your seeds and your vineyards he will tithe and give to his eunuchs and to his servants.
brenton_translation: And he will take the tithe of your seeds and your vineyards, and give it to his eunuchs, and to his servants.

fresh_translation: And your male servants and your female servants and your good cattle and your donkeys he will take and tithe for his works.
brenton_translation: And he will take your servants, and your handmaids, and your good herds and your asses, and will take the tenth of them for his works.

fresh_translation: And your flocks he will tithe, and you will be his servants.
brenton_translation: And he will tithe your flocks; and ye shall be his servants.

fresh_translation: And you will cry out in that day because of your king whom you chose for yourselves, and the Lord will not listen to you in those days, because you chose a king for yourselves.
brenton_translation: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king whom ye have chosen to yourselves, and the Lord shall not hear you in those days, because ye have chosen to yourselves a king.

fresh_translation: And the people was not willing to hear Samouēl, and they said to him, No, but a king shall be over us.
brenton_translation: But the people would not hearken to Samuel; and they said to him, Nay, but there shall be a king over us.

fresh_translation: And we also will be like all the nations, and our king will judge us and go out before us and fight our war.
brenton_translation: And we also will be like all the nations; and our king shall judge us, and shall go out before us, and fight our battles.

fresh_translation: And Samouēl heard all the words of the people and spoke them into the ears of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and spoke them in the ears of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Samouēl, Hear their voice and make a king reign over them. And Samouēl said to the men of Israel, Let each man run back to his city.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Hearken to their voice, and appoint them a king. And Samuel said to the men of Israel, Let each man depart to his city.

fresh_translation: And there was a man from the sons of Benjamin, and his name was Kis, son of Abiēl, son of Sared, son of Bachir, son of Aphek, son of a Jeminaian man, a mighty man.
brenton_translation: And there was a man of the sons of Benjamin, and his name was Kis, the son of Abiel, the son of Jared, the son of Bachir, the son of Aphec, the son of a Benjamite, a man of might.

fresh_translation: And he had a son, and his name was Saoul, a well-grown good man, and there was not among the sons of Israel a better man than he; from his shoulders and above he was taller than all the people.
