brenton_translation: And David said, With a good will I will make with thee a covenant: only I demand one condition of thee, saying, Thou shalt not see my face, unless thou bring Melchol the daughter of Saul, when thou comest to see my face.

fresh_translation: And David sent messengers to Mephibosthe son of Saoul, saying, Give back to me my wife Melchol, whom I took for one hundred foreskins of foreigners.
brenton_translation: And David sent messengers to Jebosthe the son of Saul, saying, Restore me my wife Melchol, whom I took for a hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And Mephibosthe sent and took her from her husband, from Phaltiēl son of Sellēs.
brenton_translation: And Jebosthe sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Selle.

fresh_translation: And her husband went with her, weeping behind her until Barakim, and Abennēr said to him, Go, return. And he returned.
brenton_translation: And her husband went with her weeping behind her as far as Barakim. And Abenner said to him, Go, return; and he returned.

fresh_translation: And Abennēr spoke to the elders of Israel, saying, Yesterday and the third day you were seeking David to reign over you.
brenton_translation: And Abenner spoke to the elders of Israel, saying, In former days ye sought David to reign over you;

fresh_translation: And now do it, because the Lord spoke concerning David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save Israel from the hand of the foreigners and from the hand of all their enemies.
brenton_translation: and now perform it: for the Lord has spoken concerning David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save Israel out of the hand of all their enemies.

fresh_translation: And Abennēr spoke in the ears of Benjamin, and Abennēr went to speak in the ears of David in Chebrōn all that pleased in the eyes of Israel and in the eyes of all the house of Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And Abenner spoke in the ears of Benjamin: and Abenner went to speak in the ears of David at Chebron, all that seemed good in the eyes of Israel and in the eyes of the house of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And Abennēr came to David in Chebrōn, and with him were twenty men, and David made a feast for Abennēr and for the men with him.
brenton_translation: And Abenner came to David to Chebron, and with him twenty men: and David made for Abenner and his men with him a banquet of wine.

fresh_translation: And Abennēr said to David, I will rise now and go and gather to my lord the king all Israel, and I will make a covenant with you, and you will reign over all that your soul desires. And David sent Abennēr away, and he went in peace.
brenton_translation: And Abenner said to David, I will arise now, and go, and gather to my lord the king all Israel; and I will make with him a covenant, and thou shalt reign over all whom thy soul desires. And David sent away Abenner, and he departed in peace.

fresh_translation: And behold, the servants of David and Iōab were coming from the raid and bringing much spoil with them, and Abennēr was not with David in Chebrōn, because he had sent him away and he had gone in peace.
brenton_translation: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab arrived from their expedition, and they brought much spoil with them: and Abenner was not with David in Chebron, because he had sent him away, and he had departed in peace.

fresh_translation: And Iōab and all his army were brought in, and it was reported to Iōab, saying, Abennēr son of Nēr came to David, and he sent him away, and he went in peace.
brenton_translation: And Joab and all his army came, and it was reported to Joab, saying, Abenner the son of Ner is come to David, and David has let him go, and he has departed in peace.

fresh_translation: And Iōab came in to the king and said, What is this you have done? Behold, Abennēr came to you, and why did you send him away and he has gone in peace?
brenton_translation: And Joab went in to the king, and said, What is this that thou hast done? behold, Abenner came to thee; and why hast thou let him go, and he has departed in peace?

fresh_translation: Do you not know the evil of Abennēr son of Nēr, that he came to deceive you and to know your going out and your coming in and to know all that you do?
brenton_translation: Knowest thou not the mischief of Abenner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all things that thou doest?

fresh_translation: And Iōab turned back from David and sent messengers after Abennēr, and they brought him back from the well of Seiram, and David did not know.
brenton_translation: And Joab returned from David, and sent messengers to Abenner after him; and they bring him back from the well of Seïram: but David knew it not.

fresh_translation: And Abennēr returned to Chebrōn, and Iōab turned him aside by the side of the gate to speak with him in ambush, and struck him there in the belly, and he died for the blood of Asaēl brother of Iōab.
brenton_translation: And he brought back Abenner to Chebron, and Joab caused him to turn aside from the gate to speak to him, laying wait for him: and he smote him there in the loins, and he died for the blood of Asael the brother of Joab.

fresh_translation: And David heard after this and said, Innocent am I and my kingdom from the Lord forever from the bloods of Abennēr son of Nēr.
brenton_translation: And David heard of it afterwards, and said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the Lord even for ever of the blood of Abenner the son of Ner.

fresh_translation: Let them come down on the head of Iōab and on all the house of his father, and let there not fail from the house of Iōab one with discharge and leper and one holding a staff and one falling by the sword and one lacking breads.
brenton_translation: Let it fall upon the head of Joab, and upon all the house of his father; and let there not be wanting of the house of Joab one that has an issue, or a leper, or that leans on a staff, or that falls by the sword, or that wants bread.

fresh_translation: And Iōab and Abessa his brother were lying in wait for Abennēr, because he killed Asaēl their brother in Gabaōn in the battle.
brenton_translation: For Joab and Abessa his brother laid wait continually for Abenner, because he slew Asael their brother at Gabaon in the battle.

fresh_translation: And David said to Iōab and to all the people with him, Tear your garments and gird on sackcloth and mourn before Abennēr. And king David was going behind the bier.
brenton_translation: And David said to Joab and to all the people with him, Rend your garments, and gird yourselves with sackcloth, and lament before Abenner. And king David followed the bier.

fresh_translation: And they bury Abennēr in Chebrōn, and the king lifted up his voice and wept over his tomb, and all the people wept over Abennēr.
brenton_translation: And they bury Abenner in Chebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at his tomb, and all the people wept for Abenner.

fresh_translation: And the king lamented over Abennēr and said, Should Abennēr die according to the death of Nabal?
brenton_translation: And the king mourned over Abenner, and said, Shall Abenner die according to the death of Nabal?

fresh_translation: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not in fetters; you fell as Nabal falls before sons of wrongdoing. And all the people gathered to weep for him.
brenton_translation: Thy hands were not bound, and thy feet were not put in fetters: one brought thee not near as Nabal; thou didst fall before children of iniquity.

fresh_translation: And all the people came to make David dine with breads while it was still day, and David swore, saying, Thus may God do to me and thus may he add, if before the sun goes down I taste bread or anything whatever.
brenton_translation: And all the people assembled to weep for him. And all the people came to cause David to eat bread while it was yet day: and David swore, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if I eat bread or any thing else before the sun goes down.

fresh_translation: And all the people knew, and it was pleasing before them, all that the king did before the people.
brenton_translation: And all the people took notice, and all things that the king did before the people were pleasing in their sight.

fresh_translation: And all the people and all Israel knew on that day that it did not come from the king to put Abennēr son of Nēr to death.
brenton_translation: So all the people and all Israel perceived in that day, that it was not of the king to slay Abenner the son of Ner.

fresh_translation: And the king said to his servants, Do you not know that a great leader has fallen on this day in Israel?
brenton_translation: And the king said to his servants, Know ye not that a great prince is this day fallen in Israel?

fresh_translation: And I am today a relative and appointed by a king, but these men, sons of Sarouia, are harsher than I. The Lord will repay the one doing evil according to his evil.
brenton_translation: And that I am this day a mere kinsman of his, and as it were a subject; but these men the sons of Saruia are too hard for me: the Lord reward the evil-doer according to his wickedness.

fresh_translation: And Mephibosthe son of Saoul heard that Abennēr had died in Chebrōn, and his hands were loosed, and all the men of Israel were let down.
brenton_translation: And Jebosthe the son of Saul heard that Abenner the son of Ner had died in Chebron; and his hands were paralysed, and all the men of Israel grew faint.

fresh_translation: And there were two men, leaders of bands, belonging to Mephibosthe son of Saoul; the name of the one was Baana and the name of the second Rēchab, sons of Remmōn the Bērōthaite, from the sons of Benjamin, because Bērōth was reckoned to the sons of Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And Jebosthe the son of Saul had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baana, and the name of the other Rechab, sons of Remmon the Berothite of the children of Benjamin; for Beroth was reckoned to the children of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And the Bērōthaites fled into Geththaim and were sojourning there until this day.
brenton_translation: And the Berothites ran away to Gethaim, and were sojourners there until this day.

fresh_translation: And to Iōnathan son of Saoul there was a son, stricken in the feet, five years old. He was this age when the news came of Saoul and Iōnathan his son from Iezraēl, and his nurse took him up and fled. And it came to be as she hurried and withdrew, he fell and became lame, and his name was Mephibosthe.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan Saul's son had a son lame of his feet, five years old, and he was in the way when the news of Saul and Jonathan his son came from Jezrael, and his nurse took him up, and fled; and it came to pass as he hasted and retreated, that he fell, and was lamed. And his name was Memphibosthe.

fresh_translation: And sons of Remmōn the Bērōthaite, Rēchab and Baana, went and entered in the heat of the day into the house of Mephibosthe, and he was sleeping on the bed at noon.
brenton_translation: And Rechab and Baana the sons of Remmon the Berothite went, and they came in the heat of the day into the house of Jebosthe; and he was sleeping on a bed at noon.

fresh_translation: And behold, the doorkeeper of the house was cleaning wheat and became drowsy and slept, and Rēchab and Baana the brothers escaped notice.
brenton_translation: And, behold, the porter of the house winnowed wheat, and he slumbered and slept: and the brothers Rechab and Baana went privily into the house:

fresh_translation: And they entered into the house, and Mephibosthe was sleeping on his bed in his bedroom, and they strike him and kill him and remove his head, and they took his head and went the road westward all night.
brenton_translation: and Jebosthe was sleeping on his bed in his chamber: and they smite him, and slay him, and take off his head: and they took his head, and went all the night by the western road.

fresh_translation: And they brought the head of Mephibosthe to David in Chebrōn and said to the king, Behold, the head of Mephibosthe son of Saoul your enemy who sought your life, and the Lord has given to my lord the king vengeance from your enemies as this day, from Saoul your enemy and from his seed.
brenton_translation: And they brought the head of Jebosthe to David to Chebron, and they said to the king, Behold the head of Jebosthe the son of Saul thy enemy, who sought thy life; and the Lord has executed for my lord the king vengeance on his enemies, as it is this day: even on Saul thy enemy, and on his seed.

fresh_translation: And David answered Rēchab and Baana his brother, sons of Remmōn the Bērōthaite, and said to them, As the Lord lives, who redeemed my life from every affliction,
brenton_translation: And David answered Rechab and Baana his brother, the sons of Remmon the Berothite, and said to them, As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all affliction;

fresh_translation: when the one reporting to me that Saoul had died, and he was as one bringing good news before me, I seized him and killed him in Sekelak, to whom I should have given good-news payment.
brenton_translation: he that reported to me that Saul was dead, even he was as one bringing glad tidings before me: but I seized him and slew him in Sekelac, to whom I ought, as he thought, to have given a reward for his tidings.

fresh_translation: And now evil men have killed a righteous man in his house on his bed, and now I will seek out his blood from your hand and wipe you out from the earth.
brenton_translation: And now evil men have slain a righteous man in his house on his bed: now then I will require his blood of your hand, and I will destroy you from off the earth.

fresh_translation: And David commanded his young men, and they kill them and cut off their hands and their feet and hanged them by the pool in Chebrōn. And they buried the head of Mephibosthe in the tomb of Abennēr son of Nēr.
brenton_translation: And David commanded his young men, and they slay them, and cut off their hands and their feet; and they hung them up at the fountain in Chebron: and they buried the head of Jebosthe in the tomb of Abenner the son of Ner.

fresh_translation: And all the tribes of Israel come to David in Chebrōn and said to him, Behold, we are your bones and your flesh.
brenton_translation: And all the tribes of Israel come to David to Chebron, and they said to him, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

fresh_translation: And yesterday and the third day, while Saoul was king over us, you were the one bringing out and bringing in Israel, and the Lord said to you, You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will be leader over Israel.
brenton_translation: And heretofore Saul being king over us, thou wast he that didst lead out and bring in Israel: and the Lord said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be for a leader to my people Israel.

fresh_translation: And all the elders of Israel come to the king in Chebrōn, and king David made a covenant with them in Chebrōn before the Lord, and they anointed David as king over all Israel.
brenton_translation: And all the elders of Israel come to the king to Chebron; and king David made a covenant with them in Chebron before the Lord; and they anoint David king over all Israel.

fresh_translation: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
brenton_translation: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

fresh_translation: In Chebrōn he reigned over Iouda seven years and six months, and in Ierousalēm he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Iouda.
brenton_translation: Seven years and six months he reigned in Chebron over Juda, and thirty-three years he reigned over all Israel and Juda in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And David and his men went to Ierousalēm, to the Iebousaite inhabiting the land, and it was said to David, You will not enter here, because the blind and the lame withstood him, saying, David will not enter here.
brenton_translation: And David and his men departed to Jerusalem, to the Jebusite that inhabited the land: and it was said to David, Thou shalt not come in hither: for the blind and the lame withstood him, saying, David shall not come in hither.

fresh_translation: And David captured the stronghold of Siōn; this is the City of David.
brenton_translation: And David took first the hold of Sion: this is the city of David.

fresh_translation: And David said on that day, Everyone striking a Iebousaite, let him touch with the dagger both the lame and the blind and the ones hating the soul of David. Because of this they will say, Blind and lame will not enter into the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David said on that day, Every one that smites the Jebusite, let him attack with the dagger both the lame and the blind, and those that hate the soul of David. Therefore they say, The lame and the blind shall not enter into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David settled in the stronghold, and it was called the City of David, and he built the city round about from the citadel and his own house.
brenton_translation: And David dwelt in the hold, and it was called the city of David, and he built the city itself round about from the citadel, and he built his own house.

fresh_translation: And David kept going, going on and growing great, and the Lord Almighty was with him.
brenton_translation: And David advanced and became great, and the Lord Almighty was with him.

fresh_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David and cedar woods and carpenters of woods and carpenters of stones, and they built a house for David.
brenton_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar wood, and carpenters, and stone-masons: and they built a house for David.

fresh_translation: And David knew that the Lord had prepared him as king over Israel and that his kingdom was lifted up for his people Israel.
brenton_translation: And David knew that the Lord had prepared him to be king over Israel, and that his kingdom was exalted for the sake of his people Israel.

fresh_translation: And David took still more wives and concubines from Ierousalēm after he came from Chebrōn, and there came to be still more sons and daughters to David.
brenton_translation: And David took again wives and concubines out of Jerusalem, after he came from Chebron: and David had still more sons and daughters born to him.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of the ones born to him in Ierousalēm: Sammous and Sōbab and Nathan and Salōmōn,
brenton_translation: And these are the names of those that were born to him in Jerusalem; Sammus, and Sobab, and Nathan, and Solomon.

fresh_translation: and Ebear and Elisous and Naphek and Iephies,
brenton_translation: And Ebear, and Elisue, and Naphec, and Jephies.

fresh_translation: and Elisama and Elidae and Eliphalaeth, Samae, Iessibath, Nathan, Galamaan, Iebaar, Thēsous, Elphalat, Naged, Naphek, Ianatha, Leasamys, Baalimath, Eliphalaeth.
brenton_translation: And Elisama, and Elidae, and Eliphalath,

fresh_translation: And the foreigners heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, and all the foreigners went up to seek David, and David heard and went down into the stronghold.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over Israel; and all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the strong hold.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners come and fell in the Valley of the Titans.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines came, and assembled in the valley of the giants.

fresh_translation: And David inquired through the Lord, saying, Shall I go up against the foreigners, and will you deliver them into my hands? And the Lord said to David, Go up, because in delivering I will deliver the foreigners into your hands.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into my hands? and the Lord said to David, Go up, for I will surely deliver the Philistines into thine hands.

fresh_translation: And David came from the upper breaches and struck the foreigners there, and David said, The Lord has broken through my enemies, the foreigners, before me, as waters break through. Because of this the name of that place was called Upper Breaches.
brenton_translation: And David came from Upper Breaches, and smote the Philistines there: and David said, The Lord has destroyed the hostile Philistines before me, as water is dispersed; therefore the name of that place was called Over Breaches.

fresh_translation: And they leave their gods there, and David and the men with him took them.
brenton_translation: And they leave there their gods, and David and his men with him took them.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners again added to go up and fell in the Valley of the Titans.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines came up yet again, and assembled in the valley of Giants.

fresh_translation: And David inquired through the Lord, and the Lord said, You will not go up to meet them; turn away from them and come upon them near the grove of weeping.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of the Lord: and the Lord said, Thou shalt not go up to meet them: turn from them, and thou shalt meet them near the place of weeping.

fresh_translation: And it will be, when you hear the voice of the closing together of the grove of weeping, then you will go down to them, because then the Lord will go out before you to strike in the battle of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when thou hearest the sound of a clashing together from the grove of weeping, then thou shalt go down to them, for then the Lord shall go forth before thee to make havoc in the battle with the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And David did just as the Lord commanded him and struck the foreigners from Gabaōn to the land of Gazēra.
brenton_translation: And David did as the Lord commanded him, and smote the Philistines from Gabaon as far as the land of Gazera.

fresh_translation: And David gathered again every young man from Israel, about seventy thousand.
brenton_translation: And David again gathered all the young men of Israel, about seventy thousand.

fresh_translation: And David rose and all the people with him from the leaders of Iouda, in the ascent to bring up from there the ark of God, on which the name of the Lord of hosts seated upon the cherubim over it had been called.
brenton_translation: And David arose, and went, he and all the people that were with him, and some of the rulers of Juda, on an expedition to a distant place, to bring back thence the ark of God, on which the name of the Lord of Hosts who dwells between the cherubs upon it is called.

fresh_translation: And they set the ark of the Lord on a new wagon and took it up from the house of Aminadab on the hill, and Oza and his brothers, sons of Aminadab, were leading the wagon.
brenton_translation: And they put the ark of the Lord on a new waggon, and took it out of the house of Aminadab who lived on the hill: and Oza and his brethren the sons of Aminadab drove the waggon with the ark.

fresh_translation: With the ark, and his brothers were going before the ark.
brenton_translation: And his brethren went before the ark.

fresh_translation: And David and the sons of Israel were playing before the Lord with fitted instruments in strength and with songs and with lyres and with harps and with tambourines and with cymbals and with pipes.
brenton_translation: And David and the children of Israel were playing before the Lord on well-tuned instruments mightily, and with songs, and with harps, and with lutes, and with drums, and with cymbals, and with pipes.

fresh_translation: And they come as far as the threshing floor of Nōdab, and Oza stretched out his hand upon the ark of God to hold it and seized it, because the calf pulled it aside while holding it.
brenton_translation: And they come as far as the threshing floor of Nachor: and Oza reached forth his hand to the ark of God to keep it steady, and took hold of it; for the ox shook it out of its place.

fresh_translation: And the Lord became angry at Oza, and God struck him there, and he died there beside the ark of the Lord before God.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Oza; and God smote him there: and he died there by the ark of the Lord before God.

fresh_translation: And David was troubled because the Lord had made a breach with Oza, and that place was called Breach of Oza until this day.
brenton_translation: And David was dispirited because the Lord made a breach upon Oza; and that place was called the breach of Oza until this day.

fresh_translation: And David feared the Lord on that day, saying, How will the ark of the Lord enter to me?
brenton_translation: And David feared the Lord in that day, saying, How shall the ark of the Lord come in to me?

fresh_translation: And David was not willing to turn aside the ark of the covenant of the Lord to himself into the City of David, and David turned it aside into the house of Abeddara the Geththaite.
brenton_translation: And David would not bring in the ark of the covenant of the Lord to himself into the city of David: and David turned it aside into the house of Abeddara the Gethite.

fresh_translation: And the ark of the Lord sat in the house of Abeddara the Geththaite three months, and the Lord blessed the whole house of Abeddara and all his things.
brenton_translation: And the ark of the Lord lodged in the house of Abeddara the Gethite three months, and the Lord blessed all the house of Abeddara, and all his possessions.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to king David, saying, The Lord has blessed the house of Abeddara and all his things for the sake of the ark of God. And David went and brought up the ark of the Lord from the house of Abeddara into the City of David with gladness.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to king David, saying, The Lord has blessed the house of Abeddara, and all that he has, because of the ark of the Lord. And David went, and brought up the ark of the Lord from the house of Abeddara to the city of David with gladness.

fresh_translation: And with them were seven circles carrying the ark, and sacrifice: a calf and a lamb.
brenton_translation: And there were with him bearing the ark seven bands, and for a sacrifice a calf and lambs.

fresh_translation: And David was beating time with fitted instruments before the Lord, and David was clothed in an exquisite robe.
brenton_translation: And David sounded with well-tuned instruments before the Lord, and David was clothed with a fine long robe.

fresh_translation: And David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting and with the voice of trumpet.
brenton_translation: And David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of a trumpet.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, as the ark was coming as far as the City of David, Melchol daughter of Saoul was looking through the window, and she saw king David dancing and beating time before the Lord, and she counted him as nothing in her heart.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as the ark arrived at the city of David, that Melchol the daughter of Saul looked through the window, and saw king David dancing and playing before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart.

fresh_translation: And they bring the ark of the Lord and set it in its place in the midst of the tent that David pitched for it, and David offered whole burnt offerings before the Lord and peace offerings.
brenton_translation: And they bring the ark of the Lord, and set it in its place in the midst of the tabernacle which David pitched for it: and David offered whole-burnt-offerings before the Lord, and peace-offerings.

fresh_translation: And David finished offering the whole burnt offerings and the peace offerings and blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts.
brenton_translation: And David made an end of offering the whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and blessed the people in the name of the Lord of Hosts.

fresh_translation: And he distributed to all the people, to all the host of Israel, from Dan to Bērsabee, from man to woman, to each a cake of bread and a roasted cake and a pan-cake, and all the people went away, each to his house.
brenton_translation: And he distributed to all the people, even to all the host of Israel from Dan to Bersabee, both men and women, to every one a cake of bread, and a joint of meat, and a cake from the frying-pan: and all the people departed every one to his home.

fresh_translation: And David returned to bless his house, and Melchol daughter of Saoul came out to meet David and blessed him and said, How glorious today was the king of Israel, who was uncovered today in the eyes of the servant-girls of his servants, just as one of the dancers uncovers himself in being uncovered.
brenton_translation: And David returned to bless his house. And Melchol the daughter of Saul came out to meet David and saluted him, and said, How was the king of Israel glorified to-day, who was to-day uncovered in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the dancers wantonly uncovers himself!

fresh_translation: And David said to Melchol, I will dance before the Lord. Blessed be the Lord, who chose me over your father and over all his house, to appoint me as leader over his people, over Israel, and I will play and dance before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David said to Melchol, I will dance before the Lord. Blessed be the Lord who chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to make me head over his people, even over Israel: therefore I will play, and dance before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will uncover myself still more thus, and I will be worthless in your eyes, but with the servant-girls of whom you spoke, with them I will be glorified.
brenton_translation: And I will again uncover myself thus, and I will be vile in thine eyes, and with the maid-servants by whom thou saidst that I was not had in honour.

fresh_translation: And to Melchol daughter of Saoul there came to be no child until the day of her death.
brenton_translation: And Melchol the daughter of Saul had no child till the day of her death.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the king sat in his house, and the Lord gave him inheritance-rest all around from all his enemies around him,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the king sat in his house, and the Lord had given him an inheritance on every side free from all his enemies round about him;

fresh_translation: that the king said to Nathan the prophet, Behold now, I dwell in a cedar house, and the ark of God sits in the midst of the tent.
brenton_translation: that the king said to Nathan the prophet, Behold now, I live in a house of cedar, and the ark of the Lord dwells in the midst of a tent.

fresh_translation: And Nathan said to the king, All things whatever are in your heart, go and do, because the Lord is with you.
brenton_translation: And Nathan said to the king, Go and do all that is in thine heart, for the Lord is with thee.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on that night, the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in that night, that the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,

fresh_translation: Go and say to my servant David, Thus says the Lord: You will not build me a house for my dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: Go, and say to my servant David, Thus says the Lord, Thou shalt not build me a house for me to dwell in.

fresh_translation: Because I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought up the sons of Israel from Egypt until this day, but I was walking about in lodging and in tent.
brenton_translation: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt to this day, but I have been walking in a lodge and in a tent,

fresh_translation: In all the things through which I passed in all Israel, did I ever speak a word to one tribe of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, saying, Why have you not built me a cedar house?
brenton_translation: wheresoever I went with all Israel. Have I ever spoken to any of the tribes of Israel, which I commanded to tend my people Israel, saying, Why have ye not built me a house of cedar?

fresh_translation: And now thus you will say to my servant David: Thus says the Lord Almighty, I took you from the fold of the sheep, for you to be leader over my people, over Israel.
brenton_translation: And now thus shalt thou say to my servant David, Thus says the Lord Almighty, I took thee from the sheep-cote, that thou shouldest be a prince over my people, over Israel.

fresh_translation: And I was with you in all things wherever you went, and I destroyed all your enemies from before you and made you a name like the name of the great ones upon the earth.
brenton_translation: And I was with thee wheresoever thou wentest, and I destroyed all thine enemies before thee, and I made thee renowned according to the renown of the great ones on the earth.

fresh_translation: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and I will plant him, and he will tabernacle by himself and will no longer be anxious, and a son of wrongdoing will no longer add to humble him as from the beginning,
brenton_translation: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell by themselves, and shall be no more distressed; and the son of iniquity shall no more afflict them, as he has done from the beginning,

fresh_translation: from the days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I will give you rest from all your enemies, and the Lord reports to you that you will build a house for him.
brenton_translation: from the days when I appointed judges over my people Israel: and I will give thee rest from all thine enemies, and the Lord will tell thee that thou shalt build a house to him.

fresh_translation: And it will be, if your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who will be from your belly, and I will make his kingdom ready.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when thy days shall have been fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, even thine own issue, and I will establish his kingdom.

fresh_translation: He will build a house for my name, and I will set upright his throne forever.
brenton_translation: He shall build for me a house to my name, and I will set up his throne even for ever.

fresh_translation: I will be to him for a father, and he will be to me for a son, and if his wrongdoing comes, I will reprove him with the rod of men and with touches of the sons of men.
brenton_translation: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son. And when he happens to transgress, then will I chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the sons of men.

fresh_translation: But my mercy I will not remove from him, just as I removed it from those whom I removed from before my face.
brenton_translation: But my mercy I will not take from him, as I took it from those whom I removed from my presence.

fresh_translation: And his house and his kingdom will be made faithful forever before me, and his throne will be set upright forever.
brenton_translation: And his house shall be made sure, and his kingdom for ever before me, and his throne shall be set up for ever.

fresh_translation: According to all these words and according to all this vision, thus Nathan spoke to David.
brenton_translation: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

fresh_translation: And king David entered and sat before the Lord and said, Who am I, my Lord, O Lord, and what is my house, that you have loved me up to these things?
brenton_translation: And king David came in, and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord, my Lord, and what is my house, that thou hast loved me hitherto?

fresh_translation: And this was made a very small thing before you, my Lord, O Lord, and you spoke concerning the house of your servant for a long time to come. And this is the law of the human, my Lord, O Lord.
brenton_translation: Whereas I was very little before thee, O Lord, my Lord, yet thou spokest concerning the house of thy servant for a long time to come. And is this the law of man, O Lord, my Lord?

fresh_translation: And what will David add still to speak to you? And now you know your servant, my Lord, O Lord.
brenton_translation: And what shall David yet say to thee? and now thou knowest thy servant, O Lord, my Lord.

fresh_translation: For the sake of your word you have done and according to your heart you have done all this greatness to make it known to your servant.
brenton_translation: And thou hast wrought for thy servant's sake, and according to thy heart thou hast wrought all this greatness, to make it known to thy servant,

fresh_translation: Because of making you great, my Lord, O Lord, because there is none like you, and there is no God besides you, in all things that we heard in our ears.
brenton_translation: that he may magnify thee, O my Lord; for there is no one like thee, and there is no God but thou among all of whom we have heard with our ears.

fresh_translation: And who is like your people Israel, another nation on the earth, as God led him to redeem for himself a people, to set for yourself a name, to do greatness and splendor by driving out before your people whom you redeemed for yourself from Egypt nations and tents?
brenton_translation: And what other nation in the earth is as thy people Israel? whereas God was his guide, to redeem for himself a people to make thee a name, to do mightily and nobly, so that thou shouldest cast out nations and their tabernacles from the presence of thy people, whom thou didst redeem for thyself out of Egypt?

fresh_translation: And you prepared for yourself your people Israel as a people forever, and you, Lord, became for them as God.
brenton_translation: And thou hast prepared for thyself thy people Israel to be a people for ever, and thou, Lord, art become their God.

fresh_translation: And now, my Lord, O Lord, the word that you spoke concerning your servant and his house, establish forever, Lord Almighty, God of Israel, and now just as you spoke.
brenton_translation: And now, O my Lord, the Almighty Lord God of Israel, confirm the word for ever which thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and his house: and now as thou hast said,

fresh_translation: May your name be magnified forever.
brenton_translation: Let thy name be magnified for ever.

fresh_translation: Lord Almighty, God of Israel, you uncovered the ear of your servant, saying, I will build you a house. Because of this your servant found his heart to pray to you this prayer.
brenton_translation: Almighty Lord God of Israel, thou hast uncovered the ear of thy servant, saying, I will build thee a house: therefore thy servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to thee.

fresh_translation: And now, my Lord, O Lord, you are God, and your words will be true, and you spoke these good things concerning your servant.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord my Lord, thou art God; and thy words will be true, and thou hast spoken these good things concerning thy servant.

fresh_translation: And now begin and bless the house of your servant, for it to be forever before you, because you, my Lord, O Lord, have spoken, and from your blessing the house of your servant will be blessed forever.
brenton_translation: And now begin and bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee; for thou, O Lord, my Lord, hast spoken, and the house of thy servant shall be blessed with thy blessing so as to continue for ever.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things, David struck the foreigners and routed them, and David took the separated thing from the hand of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this, that David smote the Philistines, and put them to flight, and David took the tribute from out of the hand of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And David struck Mōab and measured them with lines, laying them on the ground, and there came to be the two line-measures for putting to death, and the two line-measures he kept alive, and Mōab became for David as servants bringing gifts.
brenton_translation: And David smote Moab, and measured them out with lines, having laid them down on the ground: and there were two lines for slaying, and two lines he kept alive: and Moab became servants to David, yielding tribute.

fresh_translation: And David struck Adraazar son of Raab king of Souba, as he was going to set up his hand on the river Euphrates.
brenton_translation: And David smote Adraazar the son of Raab king of Suba, as he went to extend his power to the river Euphrates.

fresh_translation: And David pre-took from his men one thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand footmen, and David lamed all the chariots, and from them one hundred chariots were left.
brenton_translation: And David took a thousand of his chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all his chariot horses, and he reserved to himself a hundred chariots.

fresh_translation: And Syria of Damascus comes to help Adraazar king of Souba, and David struck among the Syrians twenty-two thousand men.
brenton_translation: And Syria of Damascus comes to help Adraazar king of Suba, and David smote twenty-two thousand men belonging to the Syrian.

fresh_translation: And David placed a garrison in Syria by Damascus, and Syria became to David as servants bringing gifts, and the Lord saved David in all things wherever he went.
brenton_translation: And David placed a garrison in Syria near Damascus, and the Syrians became servants and tributaries to David: and the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

fresh_translation: And David took the golden bracelets that were upon the servants of Adraazar king of Souba and brought them to Ierousalēm. And Sousakim king of Egypt took them when he came up to Ierousalēm in the days of Roboam son of Solōmōn.
brenton_translation: And David took the golden bracelets which were on the servants of Adraazar king of Suba, and brought them to Jerusalem. And Susakim king of Egypt took them, when he went up to Jerusalem in the days of Roboam son of Solomon.

fresh_translation: And from Masbak, from the chosen cities of Adraazar, king David took very much bronze. In it Salōmōn made the bronze sea and the pillars and the basins and all the vessels.
brenton_translation: And king David took from Metebac, and from the choice cities of Adraazar, very much brass: with that Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the lavers, and all the furniture.

fresh_translation: And Thoou king of Emath heard that David struck all the force of Adraazar,
brenton_translation: And Thoü the king of Hemath heard that David had smitten all the host of Adraazar.

fresh_translation: and Thoou sent Ieddouran his son to king David to ask him the things of peace and to bless him, because he had fought Adraazar and struck him, because he was opposing Adraazar. And in his hands were silver vessels and gold vessels and bronze vessels.
brenton_translation: And Thoü sent Jedduram his son to king David, to ask him of his welfare, and to congratulate him on his fighting against Adraazar and smiting him, for he was an enemy to Adraazar: and in his hands were vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass.

fresh_translation: And king David consecrated these things to the Lord, along with the silver and along with the gold that he consecrated from all the cities that he subdued,
brenton_translation: And these king David consecrated to the Lord, with the silver and with the gold which he consecrated out of all the cities which he conquered,

fresh_translation: from Idoumaia and from the land of Mōab and from the sons of Ammon and from the foreigners and from Amalēk and from the spoils of Adraazar son of Raab king of Souba.
brenton_translation: out of Idumea, and out of Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalec, and from the spoils of Adraazar son of Raab king of Suba.

fresh_translation: And David made a name, and on his return he struck Idoumaia in Gaimel, eighteen thousand.
brenton_translation: And David made himself a name: and when he returned he smote Idumea in Gebelem to the number of eighteen thousand.

fresh_translation: And he placed a garrison in Idoumaia; in all Idoumaia he placed a garrison, and all the Idoumaians became servants to the king, and the Lord saved David in all things wherever he went.
brenton_translation: And he set garrisons in Idumea, even in all Idumea: and all the Idumeans were servants to the king. And the Lord preserved David wherever he went.

fresh_translation: And David reigned over Israel, and David was doing judgment and righteousness over all his people.
brenton_translation: And David reigned over all Israel: and David wrought judgment and justice over all his people.

fresh_translation: And Iōab son of Sarouia was over the army, and Iōsaphat son of Achia was over the records,
brenton_translation: And Joab the son of Saruia was over the host; and Josaphat the son of Achilud was keeper of the records.

fresh_translation: and Saddouk son of Achitōb and Achimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Asa the scribe,
brenton_translation: And Sadoc the son of Achitob, and Achimelech son of Abiathar, were priests; and Sasa was the scribe,

fresh_translation: and Banaias son of Iōdae was counselor, and the Cheletthi and the Pheletti, and sons of David were chiefs of the court.
brenton_translation: and Banæas son of Jodaë was councillor, and the Chelethite and the Phelethite, and the sons of David, were princes of the court.

fresh_translation: And David said, Is there still one left of the house of Saoul, that I may do mercy with him for the sake of Iōnathan?
brenton_translation: And David said, Is there yet any one left in the house of Saul, that I may deal kindly with him for Jonathan's sake?

fresh_translation: And from the house of Saoul there was a servant, and his name was Siba, and they call him to David, and the king said to him, Are you Siba? And he said, I am your servant.
brenton_translation: And there was a servant of the house of Saul, and his name was Siba: and they call him to David; and the king said to him, Art thou Siba? and he said, I am thy servant.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Is there still a man left from the house of Saoul, that I may do mercy of God with him? And Siba said to the king, There is still a son for Iōnathan, stricken in the feet.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Is there yet a man left of the house of Saul, that I may act towards him with the mercy of God? and Siba said to the king, There is yet a son of Jonathan, lame of his feet.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Where is he? And Siba said to the king, Behold, in the house of Machir son of Amiēl, from Ladabar.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Where is he? and Siba said to the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Amiel of Lodabar.

fresh_translation: And king David sent and took him from the house of Machir son of Amiēl, from Ladabar.
brenton_translation: And king David sent, and took him out of the house of Machir the son of Amiel of Lodabar.

fresh_translation: And Mephibosthe son of Iōnathan son of Saoul comes to king David and fell on his face and bowed down to him, and David said to him, Mephibosthe. And he said, Behold, your servant.
brenton_translation: And Memphibosthe the son of Jonathan the son of Saul comes to king David, and he fell upon his face and did obeisance to him: and David said to him, Memphibosthe: and he said, Behold thy servant.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, Do not fear, because in doing I will do mercy with you for the sake of Iōnathan your father, and I will restore to you all the field of Saoul father of your father, and you will eat bread at my table continually.
brenton_translation: And David said to him, Fear not, for I will surely deal mercifully with thee for the sake of Jonathan thy father, and I will restore to thee all the land of Saul the father of thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

fresh_translation: And Mephibosthe bowed down and said, What am I, your servant, that you looked upon the dead dog, one like me?
brenton_translation: And Memphibosthe did obeisance, and said, Who am I thy servant, that thou hast looked upon a dead dog like me?

fresh_translation: And the king called Siba, the young servant of Saoul, and said to him, All things whatever belong to Saoul and to all his house I have given to the son of your lord.
brenton_translation: And the king called Siba the servant of Saul, and said to him, All that belonged to Saul and to all his house have I given to the son of thy lord.

fresh_translation: And work the land for him, you and your sons and your servants, and you will bring breads to the son of your lord, and he will eat them. And Mephibosthe son of your lord will continually eat bread at my table. And Siba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
brenton_translation: And thou, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him; and thou shalt bring in bread to the son of thy lord, and he shall eat bread: and Memphibosthe the son of thy lord shall eat bread continually at my table. Now Siba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

fresh_translation: And Siba said to the king, According to all things whatever my lord the king has commanded his servant, thus your servant will do. And Mephibosthe was eating at David’s table as one of the sons of the king.
brenton_translation: And Siba said to the king, According to all that my lord the king has commanded his servant, so will thy servant do. And Memphibosthe did eat at the table of David, as one of the sons of the king.

fresh_translation: And to Mephibosthe there was a little son, and his name was Micha, and all the dwelling of the house of Siba were servants of Mephibosthe.
brenton_translation: And Memphibosthe had a little son, and his name was Micha: and all the household of Siba were servants to Memphibosthe.

fresh_translation: And Mephibosthe lived in Ierousalēm, because he continually was eating at the table of the king, and he was lame in both his feet.
brenton_translation: And Memphibosthe dwelt in Jerusalem, for he continually ate at the table of the king; and he was lame in both his feet.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things, the king of the sons of Ammon died, and Anōn his son reigned instead of him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Annon his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And David said, I will do mercy with Anōn son of Naas, in the way his father did mercy with me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants concerning his father, and the servants of David came into the land of the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And David said, I will shew mercy to Annon the son of Naas, as his father dealt mercifully with me. And David sent to comfort him concerning his father by the hand of his servants; and the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And the rulers of the sons of Ammon said to Anōn their lord, Is it to glorify your father before you that David sent comforters to you? Is it not to search the city and spy it out and inspect it that David sent his servants to you?
brenton_translation: And the princes of the children of Ammon said to Annon their lord, Is it to honour thy father before thee that David has sent comforters to thee? Has not David rather sent his servants to thee that they should search the city, and spy it out and examine it?

fresh_translation: And Anōn took the servants of David and shaved their beards and cut their cloaks in the middle up to their buttocks and sent them away.
brenton_translation: And Annon took the servants of David, and shaved their beards, and cut off their garments in the midst as far as their haunches, and sent them away.

fresh_translation: And they reported to David concerning the men, and he sent to meet them, because the men were very greatly dishonored. And the king said, Sit in Ierichō until your beards grow, and then you will return.
brenton_translation: And they brought David word concerning the men; and he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly dishonoured: and the king said, Remain in Jericho till your beards have grown, and then ye shall return.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Ammon saw that the people of David had been put to shame, and the sons of Ammon sent and hired Syria of Baithroōb, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacha, one thousand men, and Istōb, twelve thousand men.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon saw that the people of David were ashamed; and the children of Ammon sent, and hired the Syrians of Bæthraam, and the Syrians of Suba, and Roob, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Amalec with a thousand men, and Istob with twelve thousand men.

fresh_translation: And David heard and sent Iōab and all the force, the mighty men.
brenton_translation: And David heard, and sent Joab and all his host, even the mighty men.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Ammon went out and arrayed for war by the entrance of the gate, and Syria of Souba and Rōōb and Istōb and Maacha were alone in the field.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon went forth, and set the battle in array by the door of the gate: those of Syria, Suba, and Roob, and Istob, and Amalec, being by themselves in the field.

fresh_translation: And Iōab saw that the front of the battle had come to be against him from the front opposite and from the rear, and he chose from all the young men of Israel and arrayed them opposite Syria.
brenton_translation: And Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him from that which was opposed in front and from behind, and he chose out some of all the young men of Israel, and they set themselves in array against Syria.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of Abessa his brother, and they arrayed opposite the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of Abessa his brother, and they set the battle in array opposite to the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And he said, If Syria grows strong beyond me, you will be for salvation to me, and if the sons of Ammon grow strong beyond you, we will be to save you.
brenton_translation: And he said, If Syria be too strong for me, then shall ye help me: and if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then will we be ready to help thee.

fresh_translation: Be manly, and let us be strengthened for our people and for the cities of our God, and the Lord will do the good in his eyes.
brenton_translation: Be thou courageous, and let us be strong for our people, and for the sake of the cities of our God, and the Lord shall do that which is good in his eyes.

fresh_translation: And Iōab and the people with him came near to war against Syria, and they fled from before him.
brenton_translation: And Joab and his people with him advanced to battle against Syria, and they fled from before him.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Ammon saw that Syria fled, and they fled from before Abessa and entered into the city, and Iōab returned from the sons of Ammon and came into Ierousalēm.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, and they fled from before Abessa, and entered into the city: and Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Syria saw that it had stumbled before Israel, and they were gathered together.
brenton_translation: And the Syrians saw that they were worsted before Israel, and they gathered themselves together.

fresh_translation: And Adraazar sent and gathered Syria from beyond the river Chalamak, and they came to Ailam, and Sōbak, chief of the force of Adraazar, was before them.
brenton_translation: And Adraazar sent and gathered the Syrians from the other side of the river Chalamak, and they came to Ælam; and Sobac the captain of the host of Adraazar was at their head.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to David, and he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan and came to Ailam, and Syria arrayed opposite David and fought with him.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to David, and he gathered all Israel, and went over Jordan, and came to Ælam: and the Syrians set the battle in array against David, and fought with him.

fresh_translation: And Syria fled from before Israel, and David killed from Syria seven hundred chariots and forty thousand horsemen, and Sōbak the chief of his force he struck, and he died there.
brenton_translation: And Syria fled from before Israel, and David destroyed of Syria seven hundred chariots, and forty thousand horsemen, and he smote Sobac the captain of his host, and he died there.

fresh_translation: And all the kings, servants of Adraazar, saw that they had stumbled before Israel, and they defected with Israel and served them, and Syria feared to save the sons of Ammon still more.
brenton_translation: And all the kings the servants of Adraazar saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, and they went over to Israel, and served them: and Syria was afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at the turning of the year, at the season of the campaigns of kings, David sent Iōab and his servants with him and all Israel, and they ravaged the sons of Ammon and sat down against Rabbath, but David sat in Ierousalēm.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the time of the year for kings going out to battle had come round, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbath: but David remained at Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And it came to be toward evening, David rose from his bed and was walking on the roof of the king’s house, and from the roof he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful in appearance.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass toward evening, that David arose off his couch, and walked on the roof of the king's house, and saw from the roof a woman bathing; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

fresh_translation: And David sent and asked about the woman, and someone said, Is not this Bērsabee daughter of Eliab, wife of Ourias the Hittite?
brenton_translation: And David sent and enquired about the woman: and one said, Is not this Bersabee the daughter of Eliab, the wife of Urias the Chettite?

fresh_translation: And David sent messengers and took her, and he went in to her and lay with her, and she was sanctifying herself from her uncleanness, and she returned to her house.
brenton_translation: And David sent messengers, and took her, and went in to her, and he lay with her: and she was purified from her uncleanness, and returned to her house.

fresh_translation: And the woman conceived, and having sent, she reported to David and said, I am with child.
brenton_translation: And the woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

fresh_translation: And David sent to Iōab, saying, Send to me Ourias the Hittite, and Iōab sent Ourias to David.
brenton_translation: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Urias the Chettite; and Joab sent Urias to David.

fresh_translation: And Ourias comes and entered to him, and David asked concerning the peace of Iōab and concerning the peace of the people and concerning the peace of the war.
brenton_translation: And Urias arrived and went in to him, and David asked him how Joab was, and how the people were, and how the war went on.

fresh_translation: And David said to Ourias, Go down to your house and wash your feet. And Ourias went out from the king’s house, and the king’s carrying gift went out after him.
brenton_translation: And David said to Urias, Go to thy house, and wash thy feet: and Urias departed from the house of the king, and a portion of meat from the king followed him.

fresh_translation: And Ourias slept by the door of the king’s house with the servants of his lord, and he did not go down to his house.
brenton_translation: And Urias slept at the door of the king with the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

fresh_translation: And they reported to David, saying that Ourias did not go down to his house, and David said to Ourias, Do you not come from a road? Why is it that you did not go down to your house?
brenton_translation: And they brought David word, saying, Urias has not gone down to his house. And David said to Urias, Art thou not come from a journey? why hast thou not gone down to thy house?

fresh_translation: And Ourias said to David, The ark and Israel and Iouda dwell in tents, and my lord Iōab and the servants of my lord camp on the face of the field, and shall I enter into my house to eat and drink and to lie with my wife? As your life lives, if I do this thing.
brenton_translation: And Urias said to David, The ark, and Israel, and Juda dwell in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; and shall I go into my house to eat and drink, and lie with my wife? how should I do this? as thy soul lives, I will not do this thing.

fresh_translation: And David said to Ourias, Sit here today also, and tomorrow I will send you away. And Ourias sat in Ierousalēm on that day and the next day.
brenton_translation: And David said to Urias, Remain here to-day also, and to-morrow I will let thee go. So Urias remained in Jerusalem that day and the day following.

fresh_translation: And David called him, and he ate before him and drank, and he made him drunk, and he went out in the evening to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but to his own house he did not go down.
brenton_translation: And David called him, and he ate before him and drank, and he made him drunk: and he went out in the evening to lie upon his bed with the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the morning, David wrote a letter to Iōab and sent it by the hand of Ourias.
brenton_translation: And the morning came, and David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Urias.

fresh_translation: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Bring Ourias into the front of the hard battle and turn back from behind him, and he will be struck and die.
brenton_translation: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Station Urias in front of the severe part of the fight, and retreat from behind him, so shall he be wounded and die.

fresh_translation: And it came to be while Iōab was guarding the city, he put Ourias in the place where he knew men of strength were there.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass while Joab was watching against the city, that he set Urias in a place where he knew that valiant men were.

fresh_translation: And the men of the city came out and were fighting with Iōab, and some of the people from the servants of David fell, and also Ourias the Hittite died.
brenton_translation: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and some of the people of the servants of David fell, and Urias the Chettite died also.

fresh_translation: And Iōab sent and reported to the king all the words of the war,
brenton_translation: And Joab sent, and reported to David all the events of the war, so as to tell them to the king.

fresh_translation: and he commanded the messenger, saying, When you finish speaking all the words of the war to the king,
brenton_translation: And he charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast finished reporting all the events of the war to the king,

fresh_translation: it will be if the anger of the king rises and he says to you, Why did you go near the city to fight? Did you not know that they would shoot from above the wall?
brenton_translation: then it shall come to pass if the anger of the king shall arise, and he shall say to thee, Why did ye draw nigh to the city to fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from off the wall?

fresh_translation: Who struck Abimelech son of Ierobaal? Did not a woman throw a piece of millstone upon him from above the wall, and he died at Themas? Why did you go near the wall? Then you will say, And also your servant Ourias the Hittite died.
brenton_translation: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerobaal son of Ner? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from above the wall, and he died in Thamasi? why did ye draw near to the wall? then thou shalt say, Thy servant Urias the Chettite is also dead.

fresh_translation: And the messenger of Iōab went to the king in Ierousalēm and came and reported to David all that Iōab reported to him, all the words of the war. And David became angry at Iōab and said to the messenger, Why did you go near the city to fight? Did you not know that you would be struck from the wall? Who struck Abimelech son of Ierobaal? Did not a woman throw a piece of millstone on him from the wall, and he died in Themas? Why did you go near the wall?
brenton_translation: And the messenger of Joab went to the king to Jerusalem, and he came and reported to David all that Joab told him, all the affairs of the war. And David was very angry with Joab, and said to the messenger, Why did ye draw nigh to the wall to fight? knew ye not that ye would be wounded from off the wall? Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerobaal? did not a woman cast upon him a piece of millstone from the wall, and he died in Thamasi? why did ye draw near to the wall?

fresh_translation: And the messenger said to David, Because the men grew strong against us and came out against us into the field, and we came against them as far as the door of the gate,
brenton_translation: And the messenger said to David, The men prevailed against us, and they came out against us into the field, and we came upon them even to the door of the gate.

fresh_translation: and the archers shot at your servants from above the wall, and some of the servants of the king died, and also your servant Ourias the Hittite died.
brenton_translation: And the archers shot at thy servants from off the wall, and some of the king's servants died, and thy servant Urias the Chettite is dead also.

fresh_translation: And David said to the messenger, Thus you will say to Iōab: Let not this word be evil in your eyes, because once thus and once thus the sword will eat. Strengthen your battle against the city and tear it down, and strengthen him.
brenton_translation: And David said to the messenger, Thus shalt thou say to Joab, Let not the matter be grievous in thine eyes, for the sword devours one way at one time and another way at another: strengthen thine array against the city, and destroy it, and strengthen him.

fresh_translation: And the wife of Ourias heard that Ourias her husband had died, and she mourned for her husband.
brenton_translation: And the wife of Urias heard that Urias her husband was dead, and she mourned for her husband.

fresh_translation: And the mourning passed, and David sent and gathered her into his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the word that David had done appeared evil in the eyes of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the time of mourning expired, and David sent and took her into his house, and she became his wife, and bore him a son: but the thing which David did was evil in the eyes of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord sent Nathan the prophet to David, and he entered to him and said to him, There were two men in one city, one rich and one poor.
brenton_translation: And the Lord sent Nathan the prophet to David; and he went in to him, and said to him, There were two men in one city, one rich and the other poor.

fresh_translation: And the rich man had very many flocks and herds.
brenton_translation: And the rich man had very many flocks and herds.

fresh_translation: And to the poor man there was nothing except one little ewe lamb, which he acquired and kept alive and nourished, and it grew up with him and with his sons together. From his bread it would eat and from his cup it would drink and in his bosom it would sleep, and it was to him as a daughter.
brenton_translation: But the poor man had only one little ewe lamb, which he had purchased, and preserved, and reared; and it grew up with himself and his children in common; it ate of his bread and drank of his cup, and slept in his bosom, and was to him as a daughter.

fresh_translation: And a traveler came to the rich man, and he spared to take from his flocks and from his herds to prepare for the stranger traveler who came to him, and he took the ewe lamb of the poor man and prepared it for the man who came to him.
brenton_translation: And a traveller came to the rich man, and he spared to take of his flocks and of his herds, to dress for the traveller that came to him; and he took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that came to him.

fresh_translation: And the anger of David burned greatly against the man, and David said to Nathan, As the Lord lives, the man who did this is a son of death.
brenton_translation: And David was greatly moved with anger against the man; and David said to Nathan, As the Lord lives, the man that did this thing shall surely die.

fresh_translation: And he will repay the ewe lamb sevenfold, because he did this thing and because he did not spare.
brenton_translation: And he shall restore the lamb seven-fold, because he has not spared.

fresh_translation: And Nathan said to David, You are the man who did this. Thus says the Lord God of Israel: I am the one who anointed you as king over Israel, and I am the one who delivered you from the hand of Saoul,
brenton_translation: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man that has done this. Thus says the Lord God of Israel, I anointed thee to be king over Israel, and I rescued thee out of the hand of Saul;

fresh_translation: and I gave you the house of your lord and the wives of your lord into your bosom, and I gave you the house of Israel and Iouda, and if this is little, I will add to you according to these things.
brenton_translation: and I gave thee the house of thy lord, and the wives of thy lord into thy bosom, and I gave to thee the house of Israel and Juda; and if that had been little, I would have given thee yet more.

fresh_translation: Why did you count the word of the Lord as little, to do the evil in his eyes? Ourias the Hittite you struck with the sword, and his wife you took for yourself as wife, and him you killed with the sword of the sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: Why hast thou set at nought the word of the Lord, to do that which is evil in his eyes? thou hast slain Urias the Chettite with the sword, and thou hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and thou hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And now the sword will not depart from your house forever, because you counted me as nothing and took the wife of Ourias the Hittite to be your wife.
brenton_translation: Now therefore the sword shall not depart from thy house for ever, because thou hast set me at nought, and thou hast taken the wife of Urias the Chettite, to be thy wife.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am raising evils against you out of your own house, and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives before this sun.
brenton_translation: Thus says the Lord, Behold, I will raise up against thee evil out of thy house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and will give them to thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

fresh_translation: Because you did it in secret, but I will do this word in front of all Israel and before this sun.
brenton_translation: For thou didst it secretly, but I will do this thing in the sight of all Israel, and before this sun.

fresh_translation: And David said to Nathan, I have sinned against the Lord. And Nathan said to David, And the Lord has caused your sin to pass over; you certainly will not die.
brenton_translation: And David said to Nathan, I have sinned against the Lord. And Nathan said to David, And the Lord has put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

fresh_translation: Only because in provoking you provoked the enemies of the Lord by this word, indeed the son born to you will surely die.
brenton_translation: Only because thou hast given great occasion of provocation to the enemies of the Lord by this thing, thy son also that is born to thee shall surely die.

fresh_translation: And Nathan went to his house, and the Lord struck the child whom the wife of Ourias bore to David, and he became sick.
brenton_translation: And Nathan departed to his house. And the Lord smote the child, which the wife of Urias the Chettite bore to David, and it was ill.

fresh_translation: And David sought God concerning the little boy, and David fasted a fast and entered and lodged in sackcloth on the ground.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of God concerning the child, and David fasted, and went in and lay all night upon the ground.

fresh_translation: And the elders of his house stood over him to raise him up from the ground, and he was not willing, and he did not eat bread with them.
brenton_translation: And the elders of his house arose and went to him to raise him up from the ground, but he would not rise, nor did he eat bread with them.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the seventh day, the little boy died, and the servants of David feared to report to him that the little boy had died, because they said, Behold, while the little boy was still living we spoke to him, and he did not listen to our voice, and how shall we say to him that the little boy has died? He will do evil.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the seventh day that the child died: and the servants of David were afraid to tell him that the child was dead; for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive we spoke to him, and he hearkened not to our voice; and how should we tell him that the child is dead?—so would he do himself harm.

fresh_translation: And David understood that his servants were whispering, and David discerned that the little boy had died, and David said to his servants, Has the little boy died? And they said, He has died.
brenton_translation: And David understood that his servants were whispering, and David perceived that the child was dead: and David said to his servants, Is the child dead? and they said, He is dead.

fresh_translation: And David rose from the ground and washed and anointed himself and changed his garments and entered into the house of God and bowed down to him. And he entered into his house and asked for bread to eat, and they set bread before him, and he ate.
brenton_translation: Then David rose up from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his raiment, and went into the house of God, and worshipped him; and went into his own house, and called for bread to eat, and they set bread before him and he ate.

fresh_translation: And his servants said to him, What is this word that you have done? For the little boy, while he was still alive, you were fasting and weeping and keeping watch, and when the little boy died, you rose and ate bread and have drunk.
brenton_translation: And his servants said to him, What is this thing that thou hast done concerning the child? while it was yet living thou didst fast, and weep, and watch: and when the child was dead thou didst rise up, and didst eat bread, and drink.

fresh_translation: And David said, While the little boy was still living, I fasted and wept, because I said, Who knows whether the Lord will have mercy on me and the little boy will live?
brenton_translation: And David said, While the child yet lived, I fasted and wept; for I said, Who knows if the Lord will pity me, and the child live?

fresh_translation: And now he has died. Why now am I fasting? Shall I be able to bring him back still more? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.
brenton_translation: But now it is dead, why should I fast thus? shall I be able to bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

fresh_translation: And David comforted Bērsabee his wife and entered to her and lay with her, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Salōmōn, and the Lord loved him.
brenton_translation: And David comforted Bersabee his wife, and he went in to her, and lay with her; and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Solomon, and the Lord loved him.

fresh_translation: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he called his name Idedi because of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and called his name Jeddedi, for the Lord's sake.

fresh_translation: And Iōab fought at Rabbath of the sons of Ammon and captured the city of the kingdom.
brenton_translation: And Joab fought against Rabbath of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

fresh_translation: And Iōab sent messengers to David and said, I fought at Rabbath and captured the city of waters.
brenton_translation: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbath, and taken the city of waters.

fresh_translation: And now gather the rest of the people and camp against the city and capture it beforehand, lest I capture the city and my name be called upon it.
brenton_translation: And now gather the rest of the people, and encamp against the city, and take it beforehand; lest I take the city first, and my name be called upon it.

fresh_translation: And David gathered all the people and went to Rabbath and fought in it and captured it.
brenton_translation: And David gathered all the people, and went to Rabbath, and fought against it, and took it.

fresh_translation: And he took the crown of Melchol their king from his head, and its weight was a talent of gold and precious stone, and it was on David’s head, and he brought out the spoils of the city very greatly.
brenton_translation: And he took the crown of Molchom their king from off his head, and the weight of it was a talent of gold, with precious stones, and it was upon the head of David; and he carried forth very much spoil of the city.

fresh_translation: And the people in it he brought out and set with the saw and with the iron threshing sledges and made them pass through the brickworks. And thus he did to all the cities of the sons of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Ierousalēm.
brenton_translation: And he brought forth the people that were in it, and put them under the saw, and under iron harrows, and axes of iron, and made them pass through the brick-kiln: and thus he did to all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
