fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things, to Abessalōm son of David there was a sister very beautiful in appearance, and her name was Thēmar, and Amnōn son of David loved her.
brenton_translation: And it happened after this that Abessalom the son of David had a very beautiful sister, and her name was Themar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

fresh_translation: And Amnōn was distressed so as to become sick because of Thēmar his sister, because she was a virgin, and it was over-large in the eyes of Amnōn to do anything to her.
brenton_translation: And Amnon was distressed even to sickness, because of Themar his sister; for she was a virgin, and it seemed very difficult for Amnon to do anything to her.

fresh_translation: And to Amnōn there was a companion, and his name was Iōnadab son of Samaa, brother of David, and Iōnadab was a very wise man.
brenton_translation: And Amnon had a friend, and his name was Jonadab, the son of Samaa the brother of David: and Jonadab was a very cunning man.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Why are you thus weak, son of the king, morning by morning? Will you not report to me? And Amnōn said to him, I love Thēmar, sister of Abessalōm my brother.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, What ails thee that thou art thus weak, O son of the king, morning by morning? wilt thou not tell me? and Amnon said, I love Themar the sister of my brother Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Iōnadab said to him, Lie on your bed and make yourself weak, and your father will enter to see you, and you will say to him, Let Thēmar my sister now come to me and feed me morsels and prepare food before my eyes, so that I may see and eat from her hands.
brenton_translation: And Jonadab said to him, Lie upon thy bed, and make thyself sick, and thy father shall come in to see thee; and thou shalt say to him, Let, I pray thee, Themar my sister come, and feed me with morsels, and let her prepare food before my eyes, that I may see and eat at her hands.

fresh_translation: And Amnōn lay down and became sick, and the king entered to see him, and Amnōn said to the king, Let Thēmar my sister now come to me and make before my eyes two cakes, and I will eat from her hand.
brenton_translation: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick; and the king came in to see him: and Amnon said to the king, Let, I pray thee, my sister Themar come to me, and make a couple of cakes in my sight, and I will eat them at her hand.

fresh_translation: And David sent to Thēmar to the house, saying, Go now to the house of Amnōn your brother and make food for him.
brenton_translation: And David sent to Themar to the house, saying, Go now to thy brother's house, and dress him food.

fresh_translation: And Thēmar went to the house of Amnōn her brother, and he was lying down, and she took dough and kneaded it and made cakes before his eyes and baked the cakes.
brenton_translation: And Themar went to the house of her brother Amnon, and he was lying down: and she took the dough and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

fresh_translation: And she took the pan and emptied it out before him, and he was not willing to eat. And Amnōn said, Put out every man from me, and they put out every man from him.
brenton_translation: And she took the frying-pan and poured them out before him, but he would not eat. And Amnon said, Send out every man from about me. And they removed every man from about him.

fresh_translation: And Amnōn said to Thēmar, Bring the food into the inner room, and I will eat from your hand. And Thēmar took the cakes that she had made and brought them in to Amnōn her brother into the bedroom.
brenton_translation: And Amnon said to Themar, Bring in the food into the closet, and I will eat of thy hand. And Themar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them to her brother Amnon into the chamber.

fresh_translation: And she brought them near to him to eat, and he seized her and said to her, Come, lie with me, my sister.
brenton_translation: And she brought them to him to eat, and he caught hold of her, and said to her, Come, lie with me, my sister.

fresh_translation: And she said to him, No, my brother, do not humble me, because thus it will not be done in Israel. Do not do this folly.
brenton_translation: And she said to him, Nay, my brother, do not humble me, for it ought not to be so done in Israel; do not this folly.

fresh_translation: And I, where will I carry away my reproach? And you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. And now speak now to the king, because he certainly will not withhold me from you.
brenton_translation: And I, whither shall I remove my reproach? and thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. And now, speak, I pray thee, to the king, for surely he will not keep me from thee.

fresh_translation: And Amnōn was not willing to hear her voice, and he grew strong beyond her and humbled her and lay with her.
brenton_translation: But Amnon would not hearken to her voice; and he prevailed against her, and humbled her, and lay with her.

fresh_translation: And Amnōn hated her with a very great hatred, because the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he loved her. And Amnōn said to her, Rise and go.
brenton_translation: Then Amnon hated her with very great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her, for the last wickedness was greater than the first: and Amnon said to her, Rise, and begone.

fresh_translation: And Thēmar said to him, No, my brother, because this last evil is greater than the first, which you did with me, by sending me away. And Amnōn was not willing to hear her voice.
brenton_translation: And Themar spoke to him concerning this great mischief, greater, said she, than the other that thou didst me, to send me away: but Amnon would not hearken to her voice.

fresh_translation: And he called his young servant, the one standing over his house, and said to him, Send this one away from me outside, and bar the door behind her.
brenton_translation: And he called his servant who had charge of the house, and said to him, Put now this woman out from me, and shut the door after her.

fresh_translation: And upon her was a full-length tunic, because thus the king’s virgin daughters were clothed with their robes. And his attendant brought her out and barred the door behind her.
brenton_translation: And she had on her a variegated robe, for so were the king's daughters that were virgins attired in their apparel: and his servant led her forth, and shut the door after her.

fresh_translation: And Thēmar took ashes and put them upon her head, and the full-length tunic that was upon her she tore, and she put her hands on her head and went on, going and crying out.
brenton_translation: And Themar took ashes, and put them on her head; and she rent the variegated garment that was upon her: and she laid her hands on her head, and went crying continually.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm her brother said to her, Has Amnōn your brother been with you? And now, my sister, be deaf, because he is your brother; do not set your heart to speak concerning this word. And Thēmar sat desolate in the house of Abessalōm her brother.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom her brother said to her, Has thy brother Amnon been with thee? now then, my sister, be silent, for he is thy brother: be not careful to mention this matter. So Themar dwelt as a widow in the house of her brother Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And king David heard all these words and was greatly angered, and he did not grieve the spirit of Amnōn his son, because he loved him, because he was his firstborn.
brenton_translation: And king David heard of all these things, and was very angry; but he did not grieve the spirit of his son Amnon, because he loved him, for he was his first-born.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm did not speak with Amnōn from evil to good, because Abessalōm hated Amnōn over the matter in which he humbled Thēmar his sister.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom spoke not to Amnon, good or bad, because Abessalom hated Amnon, on account of his humbling his sister Themar.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at a two-year cycle of days, they were shearing for Abessalōm at Belasōr by Ephraim, and Abessalōm called all the sons of the king.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at the end of two whole years, that they were shearing sheep for Abessalom in Belasor near Ephraim: and Abessalom invited all the king's sons.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm came to the king and said, Behold now, they are shearing for your servant. Let the king and his servants now go with your servant.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom came to the king, and said, Behold, thy servant has a sheep-shearing; let now the king and his servants go with thy servant.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Abessalōm, No, my son, let us not all go, and we certainly will not weigh heavily upon you. And he pressed him, and he was not willing to go, and he blessed him.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Abessalom, Nay, my son, let us not all go, and let us not be burdensome to thee. And he pressed him; but he would not go, but blessed him.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm said, And if not, let Amnōn my brother now go with us. And the king said to him, Why should he go with you?
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said to him, And if not, let, I pray thee, my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said to him, Why should he go with thee?

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm pressed him, and he sent with him Amnōn and all the sons of the king, and Abessalōm made a feast like the feast of the king.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom pressed him, and he sent with him Amnon and all the king's sons; and Abessalom made a banquet like the banquet of the king.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm commanded his young men, saying, See when the heart of Amnōn is made good with wine, and I say to you, Strike Amnōn and kill him. Do not fear, because am not I the one commanding you? Be manly and become sons of strength.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom charged his servants, saying, Mark when the heart of Amnon shall be merry with wine, and I shall say to you, Smite Amnon, and slay him: fear not; for is it not I that command you? Be courageous, and be valiant.

fresh_translation: And the young men of Abessalōm did to Amnōn just as Abessalōm commanded them, and all the sons of the king rose and mounted, each on his mule, and fled.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Abessalom did to Amnon as Abessalom commanded them: and all the sons of the king rose up, and they mounted every man his mule, and fled.

fresh_translation: And it came to be while they were on the road, the report came to David, saying, Abessalōm struck all the sons of the king, and not one was left from them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when they were in the way, that a report came to David, saying, Abessalom has slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.

fresh_translation: And the king rose and tore his garments and lay on the ground, and all his servants standing around him tore their garments.
brenton_translation: Then the king arose, and rent his garments, and lay upon the ground: and all his servants that were standing round him rent their garments.

fresh_translation: And Iōnadab son of Samaa brother of David answered and said, Let not my lord the king say that he killed all the young men, the sons of the king, because only Amnōn has died, because by the mouth of Abessalōm it was laid from the day when he humbled Thēmar his sister.
brenton_translation: And Jonadab the son of Samaa brother of David, answered and said, Let not my lord the king say that he has slain all the young men the sons of the king, for Amnon only of them all is dead; for he was appointed to death by the mouth of Abessalom from the day that he humbled his sister Themar.

fresh_translation: And now let not my lord the king set on his heart a word, saying, All the sons of the king have died, because only Amnōn has died.
brenton_translation: And now let not my lord the king take the matter to heart, saying, All the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only of them all is dead.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm fled. And the young man, the watchman, lifted up his eyes and saw, and behold, many people were coming on the road behind him from the side of the mountain on the descent, and the watchman came and reported to the king and said, I have seen men from the road of Ōrōnēn from the side of the mountain.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom escaped: and the young man the watchman lifted up his eyes, and looked; and, behold, much people went in the way behind him from the side of the mountain in the descent: and the watchman came and told the king, and said, I have seen men by the way of Oronen, by the side of the mountain.

fresh_translation: And Iōnadab said to the king, Behold, the sons of the king are coming. According to the word of your servant, thus it came to be.
brenton_translation: And Jonadab said to the king, Behold, the king's sons are present: according to the word of thy servant, so has it happened.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he finished speaking, behold, the sons of the king came and lifted up their voice and wept, and also the king and all his servants wept with a very great weeping.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he had finished speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept with a very great weeping.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm fled and went to Tholmai son of Emioud, king of Gedsour, to the land of Machad, and king David mourned for his son all the days.
brenton_translation: But Abessalom fled, and went to Tholmi son of Emiud king of Gedsur to the land of Chamaachad: and king David mourned for his son continually.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm fled and went to Gedsour and was there three years.
brenton_translation: So Abessalom fled, and departed to Gedsur, and was there three years.

fresh_translation: And the spirit of the king ceased from going out after Abessalōm, because he was comforted over Amnōn, because he died.
brenton_translation: And king David ceased to go out after Abessalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, touching his death.

fresh_translation: And Iōab son of Sarouia knew that the heart of the king was upon Abessalōm.
brenton_translation: And Joab the son of Saruia knew that the heart of the king was toward Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Iōab sent to Thekōe and took from there a wise woman and said to her, Mourn now and put on mourning garments and do not anoint with oil, and you will be as a woman mourning over one dead for many days.
brenton_translation: And Joab sent to Thecoe, and took thence a cunning woman, and said to her, Mourn, I pray thee, and put on mourning apparel, and anoint thee not with oil, and thou shalt be as a woman mourning for one that is dead thus for many days.

fresh_translation: And you will come to the king and speak to him according to this word. And Iōab put the words in her mouth.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt go to the king, and speak to him according to this word. And Joab put the words in her mouth.

fresh_translation: And the Thekōite woman entered to the king and fell on her face to the ground and bowed down to him and said, Save, king, save.
brenton_translation: So the woman of Thecoe went in to the king and fell upon her face to the earth, and did him obeisance, and said, Help, O king, help.

fresh_translation: And the king said to her, What is with you? And she said, Truly I am a widow woman, and my husband died.
brenton_translation: And the king said to her, What is the matter with thee?

fresh_translation: And indeed your servant had two sons, and both fought in the field, and there was no one separating between them, and the one struck his brother and killed him.
brenton_translation: And moreover thy handmaid had two sons, and they fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them; and the one smote the other his brother, and slew him.

fresh_translation: And behold, the whole clan rose against your servant and said, Give the one striking his brother, and we will put him to death for the life of his brother whom he killed, and we will remove also your heir. And they will quench my coal left behind, so as not to set for my husband remnant and name on the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: And behold the whole family rose up against thine handmaid, and they said, Give up the one that smote his brother, and we will put him to death for the life of his brother, whom he slew, and we will take away even your heir: so they will quench my coal that is left, so as not to leave my husband remnant or name on the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Go to your house in health, and I myself will command concerning you.
brenton_translation: And the king said to the woman, Go in peace to thy house, and I will give commandment concerning thee.

fresh_translation: And the Thekōite woman said to the king, Upon me, my lord king, be the lawlessness, and upon my father’s house, and the king and his throne are innocent.
brenton_translation: And the woman of Thecoe said to the king, On me, my lord, O king, and on my father's house be the iniquity, and the king and his throne be guiltless.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Who is speaking to you? And you will bring him to me, and he will not add still to touch him.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Who was it that spoke to thee? thou shalt even bring him to me, and one shall not touch him any more.

fresh_translation: And she said, Let the king now remember the Lord his God, that the avenger of blood not multiply to destroy, and they certainly will not remove my son. And he said, As the Lord lives, if a hair of your son falls to the ground.
brenton_translation: And she said, Let now the king remember concerning his Lord God in that the avenger of blood is multiplied to destroy, and let them not take away my son. And he said, As the Lord lives, not a hair of thy son shall fall to the ground.

fresh_translation: And the woman said, Let your servant now speak a word to my lord the king. And he said, Speak.
brenton_translation: And the woman said, Let now thy servant speak a word to my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

fresh_translation: And the woman said, Why have you reckoned such a thing against the people of God? Even from the mouth of the king this word is like an offense, in that the king does not bring back his banished one.
brenton_translation: And the woman said, Why hast thou devised this thing against the people of God? or is this word out of the king's mouth as a transgression, so that the king should not bring back his banished?

fresh_translation: Because in death we will die, and like the water poured down upon the ground, which will not be gathered, and God will take a life, yet he devises ways for the banished one not to remain banished from him.
brenton_translation: For we shall surely die, and be as water poured upon the earth, which shall not be gathered up, and God shall take the life, even as he devises to thrust forth from him his outcast.

fresh_translation: And now that I came to speak this word to my lord the king is because the people will see me, and your servant will say, Let me now speak to the king, if perhaps the king will do the word of his servant.
brenton_translation: And now whereas I came to speak this word to my lord the king, the reason is that the people will see me, and thy handmaid will say, Let one now speak to my lord the king, if peradventure the king will perform the request of his handmaid;

fresh_translation: Because the king will listen to rescue his servant from the hand of the man seeking to remove me and my son from the inheritance of God.
brenton_translation: for the king will hear. Let him rescue his handmaid out of the hand of the man that seeks to cast out me and my son from the inheritance of God.

fresh_translation: And the woman said, Let the word of my lord the king now be as an offering, because as an angel of God so is my lord the king, to hear the good and the evil, and the Lord your God will be with you.
brenton_translation: And the woman said, If now the word of my lord the king be gracious,—well: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king, to hear good and evil: and the Lord thy God shall be with thee.

fresh_translation: And the king answered and said to the woman, Do not hide from me now a word which I ask you. And the woman said, Let my lord the king speak.
brenton_translation: And the king answered, and said to the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the matter which I ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king by all means speak.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Is the hand of Iōab with you in all this? And the woman said to the king, As your life lives, my lord king, there is not to the right or to the left from all that my lord the king spoke, because your servant Iōab, he himself commanded me, and he himself put in the mouth of your servant all these words.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab in all this matter with thee? and the woman said to the king, As thy soul lives, my lord, O king, there is no turning to the right hand or to the left from all that my lord the king has spoken; for thy servant Joab himself charged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid.

fresh_translation: For the sake of turning the face of this matter, your servant Iōab did this thing, and my lord is wise like the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all the things on the earth.
brenton_translation: In order that this form of speech might come about it was that thy servant Joab has framed this matter: and my lord is wise as is the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Iōab, Behold now, I have done for you according to this word of yours. Go, bring back the young man Abessalōm.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Joab, Behold now, I have done to thee according to this thy word: go, bring back the young man Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Iōab fell on his face to the ground and bowed down and blessed the king, and Iōab said, Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your eyes, my lord king, because my lord the king has done the word of his servant.
brenton_translation: And Joab fell on his face to the ground, and did obeisance, and blessed the king: and Joab said, To-day thy servant knows that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, for my lord the king has performed the request of his servant.

fresh_translation: And Iōab rose and went to Gedsour and brought Abessalōm into Ierousalēm.
brenton_translation: And Joab arose, and went to Gedsur, and brought Abessalom to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. And Abessalōm turned to his house, and he did not see the face of the king.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Let him return to his house, and not see my face. And Abessalom returned to his house, and saw not the king's face.

fresh_translation: And as for Abessalōm, there was no man in all Israel praised so greatly. From the sole of his foot to his crown there was no blemish in him.
brenton_translation: And there was not a man in Israel so very comely as Abessalom: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

fresh_translation: And when he cut his head, and it came to be from beginning of days to days as he would cut it because it weighed heavily upon him, cutting it he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels by the royal shekel.
brenton_translation: And when he polled his head, (and it was at the beginning of every year that he polled it, because it grew heavy upon him,) even when he polled it, he weighed the hair of his head, two hundred shekels according to the royal shekel.

fresh_translation: And there were born to Abessalōm three sons and one daughter, and her name was Thēmar. She was a very beautiful woman and became wife to Roboam son of Salōmōn and bore to him Abia.
brenton_translation: And there were born to Abessalom three sons and one daughter, and her name was Themar: she was a very beautiful woman, and she becomes the wife of Roboam son of Solomon, and she bears to him Abia.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm sat in Ierousalēm two years of days, and he did not see the face of the king.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom remained in Jerusalem two full years, and he saw not the king's face.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm sent to Iōab to send him to the king, and he was not willing to come to him, and he sent a second time to him, and he was not willing to come.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom sent to Joab to bring him in to the king, and he would not come to him: and he sent to him the second time, and he would not come.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm said to his servants, See, the portion in the field of Iōab lies next to mine, and barley is there. Go and burn it with fire. And the servants of Abessalōm burned them, and the servants of Iōab came to him with garments torn and said, The servants of Abessalōm burned the portion with fire.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said to his servants, Behold, Joab's portion in the field is next to mine, and he has in it barley; go and set it on fire. And the servants of Abessalom set the field on fire: and the servants of Joab come to him with their clothes rent, and they said to him, The servants of Abessalom have set the field on fire.

fresh_translation: And Iōab rose and came to Abessalōm at the house and said to him, Why did your servants burn my portion with fire?
brenton_translation: And Joab arose, and came to Abessalom into the house, and said to him, Why have thy servants set my field on fire?

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm said to Iōab, Behold, I sent to you, saying, Come here and I will send you to the king, saying, Why did I come from Gedsour? It was good for me still to be there. And now behold, I have not seen the face of the king, and if there is wrongdoing in me, then put me to death.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said to Joab, Behold, I sent to thee, saying, Come hither, and I will send thee to the king, saying, Why did I come out of Gedsur? it would have been better for me to have remained there: and now, behold, I have not seen the face of the king; but if there is iniquity in me, then put me to death.

fresh_translation: And Iōab entered to the king and reported to him, and he called Abessalōm, and he entered to the king and bowed down to him and fell on his face to the ground before the king, and the king kissed Abessalōm.
brenton_translation: And Joab went in to the king, and brought him word: and he called Abessalom, and he went in to the king, and did him obeisance, and fell upon his face to the ground, even in the presence of the king; and the king kissed Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things, Abessalōm made for himself chariots and horses and fifty men to run before him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this that Abessalom prepared for himself chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm rose early and stood by the side of the road of the gate, and it came to be every man who had a judgment came to the king for judgment, and Abessalōm would cry out to him and say to him, From what city are you? And the man would say, Your servant is from one of the tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom rose early, and stood by the side of the way of the gate: and it came to pass that every man who had a cause, came to the king for judgment, and Abessalom cried to him, and said to him, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm said to him, Behold, your words are good and easy, but there is no one hearing you from the king.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said to him, See, thy affairs are right and clear, yet thou hast no one appointed of the king to hear thee.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm said, Who will appoint me judge in the land? And to me every man with dispute and judgment will come, and I will justify him.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said, O that one would make me a judge in the land; then every man who had a dispute or a cause would come to me, and I would judge him!

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when a man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand and took hold of him and kissed him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when a man came near to do him obeisance, that he stretched out his hand, and took hold of him, and kissed him.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm did according to this word to all Israel who were coming for judgment to the king, and Abessalōm was stealing the heart of the men of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom did after this manner to all Israel that came to the king for judgment; and Abessalom gained the hearts of the men of Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at the end of forty years, Abessalōm said to his father, I will now go and pay my vows that I vowed to the Lord in Chebrōn.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after forty years, that Abessalom said to his father, I will go now, and pay my vows, which I vowed to the Lord in Chebron.

fresh_translation: Because your servant vowed a vow while I was dwelling in Gedsour in Syria, saying, If in returning the Lord returns me to Ierousalēm, I will serve the Lord.
brenton_translation: For thy servant vowed a vow when I dwelt at Gedsur in Syria, saying, If the Lord should indeed restore me to Jerusalem, then will I serve the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the king said to him, Go in peace. And rising, he went to Chebrōn.
brenton_translation: And the king said to him, Go in peace. And he arose and went to Chebron.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm sent spies into all the tribes of Israel, saying, When you hear the sound of the horn, then you will say, King Abessalōm has become king in Chebrōn.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, When ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then shall ye say, Abessalom is become king in Chebron.

fresh_translation: And with Abessalōm went two hundred men from Ierousalēm, invited and going in their simplicity, and they knew no word.
brenton_translation: And there went with Abessalom two hundred chosen men from Jerusalem; and they went in their simplicity, and knew not anything.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm sent and called Achitophel the Gelmōnaian, counselor of David, from his city, from Gōla, while he was sacrificing, and the conspiracy became strong, and the people going with Abessalōm were many.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom sent to Achitophel the Theconite, the counsellor of David, from his city, from Gola, where he was sacrificing: and there was a strong conspiracy; and the people with Abessalom were increasingly numerous.

fresh_translation: And the one reporting came to David, saying, The heart of the men of Israel has come to be behind Abessalōm.
brenton_translation: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The heart of the men of Israel is gone after Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And David said to all his servants with him in Ierousalēm, Rise, and let us flee, because there is no salvation for us from before Abessalōm. Hurry to go, lest he hurry and overtake us and drive evil upon us and strike the city with the mouth of the sword.
brenton_translation: And David said to all his servants who were with him in Jerusalem, Rise, and let us flee, for we have no refuge from Abessalom: make haste and go, lest he overtake us speedily, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

fresh_translation: And the servants of the king said to the king, According to all things whatever my lord the king chooses, behold, your servants.
brenton_translation: And the king's servants said to the king, In all things which our lord the king chooses, behold we are thy servants.

fresh_translation: And the king went out and all his house on their feet, and the king left ten women, his concubines, to guard the house.
brenton_translation: And the king and all his house went out on foot: and the king left ten women of his concubines to keep the house.

fresh_translation: And the king went out and all his servants on foot, and they stood at the far house.
brenton_translation: And the king and all his servants went out on foot; and abode in a distant house.

fresh_translation: And all his servants were passing by his side, and all the Chetti and all the Pheleththi stood by the olive tree in the wilderness, and all the people were passing on near him, and all those around him and all the Adroi and all the fighters, six hundred men, and all the Chereththi and all the Pheleththi and all the Geththaites, six hundred men who had come on their feet from Geth, were going before the king.
brenton_translation: And all his servants passed on by his side, and every Chelethite, and every Phelethite, and they stood by the olive tree in the wilderness: and all the people marched near him, and all his court, and all the men of might, and all the men of war, six hundred: and they were present at his side: and every Chelethite, and every Phelethite, and all the six hundred Gittites that came on foot out of Geth, and they went on before the king.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Eththi the Geththaite, Why are you also going with us? Return and dwell with the king, because you are a foreigner and because you have migrated from your place.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Ethi the Gittite, Why dost thou also go with us? return, and dwell with the king, for thou art a stranger, and thou hast come forth as a sojourner out of thy place.

fresh_translation: Yesterday you came, and today shall I move you with us? And indeed you will migrate your place? Yesterday your coming, and today shall I move you with us to go? And I will go wherever I go. Return and return your brothers with you, and the Lord will do mercy and truth with you.
brenton_translation: Whereas thou camest yesterday, shall I to-day cause thee to travel with us, and shalt thou thus change thy place? thou didst come forth yesterday, and to-day shall I set thee in motion to go along with us? I indeed will go whithersoever I may go: return then, and cause thy brethren to return with thee, and may the Lord deal mercifully and truly with thee.

fresh_translation: And Eththi answered the king and said, As the Lord lives and as my lord the king lives, in the place where my lord is, whether for death or for life, there your servant will be.
brenton_translation: And Ethi answered the king and said, As the Lord lives and as my lord the king lives, in the place wheresoever my lord shall be, whether it be for death or life, there shall thy servant be.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Eththi, Come and pass over with me. And Eththi the Geththaite passed over, and all his servants and all the crowd with him.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Ethi, Come and pass over with me. So Ethi the Gittite and the king passed over, and all his servants, and all the multitude with him.

fresh_translation: And all the land was weeping with a great voice, and all the people were passing in the wadi Kedrōn, and the king crossed the wadi Kedrōn, and all the people and the king were passing on toward the road of the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And all the country wept with a loud voice. And all the people passed by over the brook of Kedron; and the king crossed the brook Kedron: and all the people and the king passed on toward the way of the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And behold, also Saddōk and all the Levites with him carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Baithar, and they set the ark of God down, and Abiathar went up until all the people ceased passing out of the city.
brenton_translation: And behold also Sadoc, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Bæthar: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had passed out of the city.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Saddōk, Turn back the ark of God into the city. If I find favor in the eyes of the Lord, he will return me and show me it and its beauty.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Sadoc, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I should find favour in the eyes of the Lord, then will he bring me back, and he will shew me it and its beauty.

fresh_translation: And if he says thus, I have not delighted in you, behold, here I am; let him do to me according to the good in his eyes.
brenton_translation: But if he should say thus, I have no pleasure in thee; behold, here I am, let him do to me according to that which is good in his eyes.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Saddōk the priest, See, you are returning into the city in peace, and Achimaas your son and Iōnathan son of Abiathar, your two sons with you.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Sadoc the priest, Behold, thou shalt return to the city in peace, and Achimaas thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar, your two sons with you.

fresh_translation: See, I am encamping in the plains of the wilderness until a word comes from you to report to me.
brenton_translation: Behold, I continue in arms in Araboth of the desert, until there come tidings from you to report to me.

fresh_translation: And Saddōk and Abiathar turned the ark into Ierousalēm and sat there.
brenton_translation: So Sadoc and Abiathar brought back the ark of the Lord to Jerusalem, and it continued there.

fresh_translation: And David was going up in the ascent of the olives, going up and weeping, and his head covered, and he was going barefoot, and all the people with him covered each man his head, and they were going up, going up and weeping.
brenton_translation: And David went up by the ascent of the mount of Olives, ascending and weeping, and had his head covered, and went barefooted: and all the people that were with him covered every man his head; and they went up, ascending and weeping.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to David, saying, And Achitophel is among the conspirators with Abessalōm. And David said, Scatter now the counsel of Achitophel, Lord my God.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to David, saying, Achitophel also is among the conspirators with Abessalom. And David said, O Lord my God, disconcert, I pray thee, the counsel of Achitophel.

fresh_translation: And David was coming as far as the summit where he bowed there to God, and behold, to meet him was Chousi, chief companion of David, with his tunic torn and earth on his head.
brenton_translation: And David came as far as Ros, where he worshipped God: and behold, Chusi the chief friend of David came out to meet him, having rent his garment, and earth was upon his head.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, If you cross over with me, you will be a burden upon me.
brenton_translation: And David said to him, If thou shouldest go over with me, then wilt thou be a burden to me;

fresh_translation: But if you return to the city and say to Abessalōm, Your brothers have passed through, and the king behind me, your father, has passed through, and now I am your servant, king; then I was servant of your father and now again and now I am your servant, and you will scatter for me the counsel of Achitophel.
brenton_translation: but if thou shall return to the city, and shalt say to Abessalom, Thy brethren are passed over, and the king thy father is passed over after me: and now I am thy servant, O king, suffer me to live: at one time even of late I was the servant of thy father, and now I am thy humble servant—so shalt thou disconcert for me the counsel of Achitophel.

fresh_translation: And behold, with you there are Saddōk and Abiathar the priests, and every word whatever you hear from the house of the king, you will report to Saddōk and Abiathar the priests.
brenton_translation: And, behold, there are there with thee Sadoc and Abiathar the priests; and it shall be that every word that thou shalt hear of the house of the king, thou shalt report it to Sadoc and Abiathar the priests.

fresh_translation: Behold, there with them are their two sons, Achimaas to Saddōk and Iōnathan to Abiathar, and you will send by their hand to me every word whatever you hear.
brenton_translation: Behold, there are there with them their two sons, Achimaas the son of Sadoc, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar; and by them ye shall report to me every word which ye shall hear.

fresh_translation: And Chousi, companion of David, entered into the city, and Abessalōm was entering into Ierousalēm.
brenton_translation: So Chusi the friend of David went into the city, and Abessalom was lately gone into Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And David passed a little from the summit, and behold, Siba the servant of Mephibosthe came to meet him, and a pair of saddled donkeys, and on them two hundred loaves and one hundred raisins and one hundred dates and a skin of wine.
brenton_translation: And David passed on a little way from Ros; and, behold, Siba the servant of Memphibosthe came to meet him; and he had a couple of asses laden, and upon them two hundred loaves, and a hundred bunches of raisins, and a hundred cakes of dates, and a bottle of wine.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Siba, What are these to you? And Siba said, The pack animals are for the house of the king to sit on, and the loaves and the dates for food to the young men, and the wine for the ones faint in the wilderness to drink.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Siba, What meanest thou by these? and Siba said, The asses are for the household of the king to sit upon, and the loaves and the dates are for the young men to eat, and the wine is for them that are faint in the wilderness to drink.

fresh_translation: And the king said, And where is the son of your lord? And Siba said to the king, Behold, he sits in Ierousalēm, because he said, Today the house of Israel will return to me the kingdom of my father.
brenton_translation: And the king said, And where is the son of thy master? and Siba said to the king, Behold, he remains in Jerusalem; for he said, To-day shall the house of Israel restore to me the kingdom of my father.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Siba, Behold, yours are all the things that belong to Mephibosthe. And Siba said, Bowing down, May I find favor in your eyes, my lord king.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Siba, Behold, all Memphibosthe's property is thine. And Siba did obeisance and said, My lord, O king, let me find grace in thine eyes.

fresh_translation: And king David came as far as Baourim, and behold, from there a man was coming out from the kin of the house of Saoul, and his name was Semei son of Gēra. He came out going and cursing,
brenton_translation: And king David came to Baurim; and, behold, there came out from thence a man of the family of the house of Saul, and his name was Semei the son of Gera. He came forth and cursed as he went,

fresh_translation: and throwing stones at David and all the servants of king David, and all the people were there and all the mighty ones at the right and at the left of the king.
brenton_translation: and cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on the right and left hand of the king.

fresh_translation: And thus Semei was saying while cursing him: Go out, go out, man of bloods and lawless man.
brenton_translation: And thus Semei said when he cursed him, Go out, go out, thou bloody man, and man of sin.

fresh_translation: The Lord has returned upon you all the bloods of the house of Saoul, because you reigned instead of him, and the Lord has given the kingdom into the hand of Abessalōm your son, and behold, you are in your evil, because you are a man of bloods.
brenton_translation: The Lord has returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, because thou hast reigned in his stead; and the Lord has given the kingdom into the hand of Abessalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

fresh_translation: And Abessa son of Sarouia said to the king, Why is this dead dog cursing my lord the king? I will pass over now and remove his head.
brenton_translation: And Abessa the son of Saruia said to the king, Why does this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over now and take off his head.

fresh_translation: And the king said, What is to me and to you, sons of Sarouia? Leave him and thus let him curse, because the Lord told him to curse David, and who will say, Why did you do thus?
brenton_translation: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Saruia? even let him alone, and so let him curse, for the Lord has told him to curse David: and who shall say, Why hast thou done thus?

fresh_translation: And David said to Abessa and to all his servants, Behold, my son who came out of my belly seeks my life, and how much more now this son of the Jeminaian. Leave him to curse, because the Lord told him.
brenton_translation: And David said to Abessa and to all his servants, Behold, my son who came forth out of my bowels seeks my life; still more now may the son of Benjamin: let him curse, because the Lord has told him.

fresh_translation: If perhaps the Lord will look upon my humiliation and return to me good instead of his curse on this day.
brenton_translation: If by any means the Lord may look on my affliction, thus shall he return me good for his cursing this day.

fresh_translation: And David and his men were going on the road, and Semei was going on the side of the mountain next to him, going and cursing and throwing stones from his side and casting dust.
brenton_translation: And David and all the men with him went on the way: and Semei went by the side of the hill next to him, cursing as he went, and casting stones at him, and sprinkling him with dirt.

fresh_translation: And the king came and all his people faint, and they refreshed themselves there.
brenton_translation: And the king, and all the people with him, came away and refreshed themselves there.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm and every man of Israel entered into Ierousalēm, and Achitophel with him.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom and all the men of Israel went into Jerusalem, and Achitophel with him.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when Chousi, chief companion of David, came to Abessalōm, Chousi said to Abessalōm, Long live the king.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Chusi the chief friend of David came to Abessalom, that Chusi said to Abessalom, Let the king live.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm said to Chousi, Is this your mercy with your companion? Why did you not go with your companion?
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said to Chusi, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not forth with thy friend?

fresh_translation: And Chousi said to Abessalōm, No, but behind whom the Lord chose and this people and every man of Israel, to him I will belong and with him I will sit.
brenton_translation: And Chusi said to Abessalom, Nay, but following whom the Lord, and this people, and all Israel have chosen,—his will I be, and with him will I dwell.

fresh_translation: And the second thing: whom shall I serve? Shall it not be before his son? As I served before your father, so I will be before you.
brenton_translation: And again, whom shall I serve? should I not in the presence of his son? As I served in the sight of thy father, so will I be in thy presence.

fresh_translation: And Abessalōm said to Achitophel, Bring counsel for yourselves. What shall we do?
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said to Achitophel, Deliberate among yourselves concerning what we should do.

fresh_translation: And Achitophel said to Abessalōm, Go in to the concubines of your father whom he left to guard his house, and all Israel will hear that you have put your father to shame, and the hands of all those with you will be strengthened.
brenton_translation: And Achitophel said to Abessalom, Go in to thy father's concubines, whom he left to keep his house; and all Israel shall hear that thou hast dishonoured thy father; and the hands of all that are with thee shall be strengthened.

fresh_translation: And they pitched the tent for Abessalōm on the roof, and Abessalōm went in to the concubines of his father before the eyes of all Israel.
brenton_translation: And they pitched a tent for Abessalom on the roof, and Abessalom went in to his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

fresh_translation: And the counsel of Achitophel that he counseled in the former days was as if one inquired in the word of God. Thus was all the counsel of Achitophel, both to David and to Abessalōm.
brenton_translation: And the counsel of Achitophel, which he counselled in former days, was as if one should enquire of the word of God: so was all the counsel of Achitophel both to David and also to Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Achitophel said to Abessalom, Let me choose for myself twelve thousand men, and I will rise and pursue David by night.
brenton_translation: And Achitophel said to Abessalom, Let me now choose out for myself twelve thousand men, and I will arise and follow after David this night:

fresh_translation: And I will come upon him while he is weary and slack of hands, and I will throw him into panic, and all the people with him will flee, and I will strike the king alone.
brenton_translation: and I will come upon him when he is weary and weak-handed, and I will strike him with terror; and all the people with him shall flee, and I will smite the king only of all.

fresh_translation: And I will return all the people to you, just as a bride returns to her husband. It is only the life of one man you seek, and all the people will be at peace.
brenton_translation: And I will bring back all the people to thee, as a bride returns to her husband: only thou seekest the life of one man, and all the people shall have peace.

fresh_translation: And the word was right in the eyes of Abessalom and in the eyes of all the elders of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the saying was right in the eyes of Abessalom, and in the eyes of all the elders of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Abessalom said, Call now also Chousi the Arachite, and let us hear what too is in his mouth.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom said, Call now also Chusi the Arachite, and let us hear what is in his mouth, even in his also.

fresh_translation: And Chousi came to Abessalom, and Abessalom said to him, saying, Achitophel has spoken according to this word. Shall we do according to his word? But if not, you speak.
brenton_translation: And Chusi went in to Abessalom, and Abessalom spoke to him, saying, After this manner spoke Achitophel: shall we do according to his word? but if not, do thou speak.

fresh_translation: And Chousi said to Abessalom, This time the counsel that Achitophel has counseled is not good.
brenton_translation: And Chusi said to Abessalom, This counsel which Achitophel has counselled this one time is not good.

fresh_translation: And Chousi said, You know your father and his men, that they are very mighty and bitter in soul, like a bear robbed of cubs in the field, and like a wild boar in the open country. And your father is a man of war and will not lodge with the people.
brenton_translation: And Chusi said, Thou knowest thy father and his men, that they are very mighty, and bitter in their spirit, as a bereaved bear in the field, [and as a wild boar in the plain]: and thy father is a man of war, and will not give the people rest.

fresh_translation: For behold, even now he is hidden in one of the hills or in one of the places, and it will happen, when some fall among them at the first attack, that whoever hears will say, A slaughter has happened among the people following Abessalom.
brenton_translation: For, behold, he is now hidden in one of the hills or in some other place: and it shall come to pass when he falls upon them at the beginning, that some one will certainly hear, and say, There has been a slaughter among the people that follow after Abessalom.

fresh_translation: Then even a son of strength, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will utterly melt, because all Israel knows that your father is mighty and the men with him are sons of strength.
brenton_translation: Then even he that is strong, whose heart is as the heart of a lion,—it shall utterly melt: for all Israel knows that thy father is mighty, and they that are with him are mighty men.

fresh_translation: But this is the counsel I have counseled: let all Israel from Dan to Bersabee be gathered to you, like the sand by the sea in multitude, and let your own face go in their midst.
brenton_translation: For thus I have surely given counsel, that all Israel be generally gathered to thee from Dan even to Bersabee, as the sand that is upon the sea-shore for multitude: and that thy presence go in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And we will come upon him in one of the places where we find him there, and we will camp against him as the dew falls on the ground, and we will not leave among him and the men with him even one.
brenton_translation: And we will come upon him in one of the places where we shall find him, and we will encamp against him, as the dew falls upon the earth; and we will not leave of him and of his men so much as one.

fresh_translation: And if he withdraws into a city, all Israel will take ropes to that city, and we will drag it down into the torrent-bed until not even a stone is left there.
brenton_translation: And if he shall have taken refuge with his army in a city, then shall all Israel take ropes to that city, and we will draw it even into the river, that there may not be left there even a stone.

fresh_translation: And Abessalom and every man of Israel said, The counsel of Chousi the Arachite is better than the counsel of Achitophel. For the Lord commanded the good counsel of Achitophel to be scattered, so that the Lord might bring all these evils upon Abessalom.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom, and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Chusi the Arachite is better than the counsel of Achitophel. For the Lord ordained to disconcert the good counsel of Achitophel, that the Lord might bring all evil upon Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Chousi the Arachite said to Sadok and Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus Achitophel counseled Abessalom and the elders of Israel, and thus and thus I counseled.
brenton_translation: And Chusi the Arachite said to Sadoc and Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus Achitophel counselled Abessalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

fresh_translation: And now send quickly and report to David, saying, Do not lodge tonight at the crossings of the wilderness, but hurry and cross over, lest the king and all the people with him be swallowed up.
brenton_translation: And now send quickly and report to David, saying, Lodge not this night in Araboth of the wilderness: even go and make haste, lest one swallow up the king, and all the people with him.

fresh_translation: And Ionathan and Achimaas had been standing at the spring Rhogel, and the maidservant went and reported to them, and they were going to report to King David, because they could not be seen entering the city.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan and Achimaas stood by the well of Rogel, and a maid-servant went and reported to them, and they go and tell king David; for they might not be seen to enter into the city.

fresh_translation: But a young man saw them and reported it to Abessalom, and the two went quickly and entered the house of a man in Baourim, and he had a well in his court, and they went down there.
brenton_translation: But a young man saw them and told Abessalom: and the two went quickly, and entered into the house of a man in Baurim; and he had a well in his court, and they went down into it.

fresh_translation: And the woman took the covering and spread it over the face of the well, and she scattered crushed grain over it, and no matter was known.
brenton_translation: And a woman took a covering, and spread it over the mouth of the well, and spread out ground corn upon it to dry, and the thing was not known.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Abessalom came to the woman at the house and said, Where are Achimaas and Ionathan? And the woman said to them, They passed a little beyond the water. And they searched and did not find them and returned to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Abessalom came to the woman into the house, and said, Where are Achimaas and Jonathan? and the woman said to them, They are gone a little way beyond the water. And they sought and found them not, and returned to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after they left, that they came up out of the well and went and reported to King David, and they said to David, Rise and cross the water quickly, because thus Achitophel has counseled against you.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after they were gone, that they came up out of the pit, and went on their way; and reported to king David, and said to David, Arise ye and go quickly over the water, for thus has Achitophel counselled concerning you.

fresh_translation: And David rose, and all the people with him, and they crossed the Jordan until the morning light. Not one was missing who had not crossed the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And David rose up and all the people with him, and they passed over Jordan till the morning light; there was not one missing who did not pass over Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Achitophel saw that his counsel had not been done, and he saddled his donkey and rose and went to his home, to his own city, and he gave orders to his house and hanged himself, and he died and was buried in the tomb of his father.
brenton_translation: And Achitophel saw that his counsel was not followed, and he saddled his ass, and rose and departed to his house into his city; and he gave orders to his household, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

fresh_translation: And David crossed over to Manaim, and Abessalom crossed the Jordan, he and every man of Israel with him.
brenton_translation: And David passed over to Manaim: and Abessalom crossed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

fresh_translation: And Abessalom appointed Amessai in place of Ioab over the army. And Amessai was son of a man whose name was Iothor the Israelite, who went in to Abigaia daughter of Naas, sister of Sarouia the mother of Ioab.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom appointed Amessai in the room of Joab over the host. And Amessai was the son of a man whose name was Jether of Jezrael: he went in to Abigaia the daughter of Naas, the sister of Saruia the mother of Joab.

fresh_translation: And Israel and Abessalom camped in the land of Galaad.
brenton_translation: And all Israel and Abessalom encamped in the land of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when David came to Manaim, Ouesbi son of Naas from Rabbath of the sons of Ammon, and Machir son of Ammiel from Lodabar, and Berzelli the Galaadite from Rhogellim,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when David came to Manaim, that Uesbi the son of Naas of Rabbath of the sons of Ammon, and Machir son of Amiel of Lodabar, and Berzelli the Galaadite of Rogellim,

fresh_translation: brought ten beds and coverings and ten cauldrons and earthenware vessels and wheat and barley and flour and parched grain and beans and lentils,
brenton_translation: brought ten embroidered beds, (with double coverings,) and ten caldrons, and earthenware, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and meal, and beans, and pulse,

fresh_translation: and honey and butter and sheep and curds from cattle. And they brought them to David and to the people with him to eat, because they said, The people are hungry and faint and thirsty in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: and honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheeses of kine: and they brought them to David and to his people with him to eat; for one said, The people is faint and hungry and thirsty in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And David mustered the people with him and appointed over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
brenton_translation: And David numbered the people with him, and set over them captains of thousands and captains of hundreds.

fresh_translation: And David sent out the people, one third by the hand of Ioab, one third by the hand of Abessa son of Sarouia, brother of Ioab, and one third by the hand of Eththi the Gethite. And David said to the people, I myself will surely go out with you.
brenton_translation: And David sent away the people, the third part under the hand of Joab, and the third part under the hand of Abessa the son of Saruia, the brother of Joab, and the third part under the hand of Ethi the Gittite. And David said to the people, I also will surely go out with you.

fresh_translation: But they said, You must not go out, because if we flee they will not set their heart on us, and if half of us die they will not set their heart on us, because you are like ten thousand of us. And now it is better that you be for us help from the city by helping.
brenton_translation: And they said, Thou shalt not go out: for if we should indeed flee, they will not care for us; and if half of us should die, they will not mind us; for thou art as ten thousand of us: and now it is well that thou shalt be to us an aid to help us in the city.

fresh_translation: And the king said to them, Whatever is good in your eyes I will do. And the king stood by the side of the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
brenton_translation: And the king said to them, Whatsoever shall seem good in your eyes I will do. And the king stood by the side of the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.

fresh_translation: And the king commanded Ioab and Abessa and Eththi, saying, Spare for my sake the young man Abessalom. And all the people heard when the king gave orders to all the commanders concerning Abessalom.
brenton_translation: And the king commanded Joab and Abessa and Ethi, saying, Spare for my sake the young man Abessalom. And all the people heard the king charging all the commanders concerning Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And all the people went out into the forest opposite Israel, and the battle came to be in the forest of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And all the people went out into the wood against Israel; and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And the people of Israel stumbled there before the servants of David, and the great slaughter there on that day was twenty thousand men.
brenton_translation: And the people of Israel fell down there before the servants of David, and there was a great slaughter in that day, even twenty thousand men.

fresh_translation: And the battle there was spread over the face of all the land, and the forest multiplied to devour more of the people than the sword devoured of the people on that day.
brenton_translation: And the battle there was scattered over the face of all the land: and the wood consumed more of the people than the sword consumed among the people in that day.

fresh_translation: And Abessalom met the servants of David. And Abessalom was mounted on his mule, and the mule went under the thick branches of the great oak, and his head was caught in the oak, and he was suspended between heaven and earth, and the mule under him passed on.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom went to meet the servants of David: and Abessalom was mounted on his mule, and the mule came under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head was entangled in the oak, and he was suspended between heaven and earth; and the mule passed on from under him.

fresh_translation: And one man saw and reported to Ioab and said, Behold, I saw Abessalom hanging in the oak.
brenton_translation: And a man saw it, and reported to Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Abessalom hanging in an oak.

fresh_translation: And Ioab said to the man reporting to him, And behold, you saw him. Why then did you not strike him there to the ground? Then I would have given you ten silver pieces and one belt.
brenton_translation: And Joab said to the man who reported it to him, And, behold, thou didst see him: why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten pieces of silver, and a girdle.

fresh_translation: But the man said to Ioab, Even if a thousand silver shekels were weighed into my hands, I would never put my hand against the king's son. For in our hearing the king charged you and Abessa and Eththi, saying, Guard for my sake the young man Abessalom.
brenton_translation: And the man said to Joab, Were I even to receive a thousand shekels of silver, I would not lift my hand against the king's son; for in our ears the king charged thee and Abessa and Ethi, saying, Take care of the young man Abessalom for me,

fresh_translation: Otherwise, if I had done lawlessness against his life, no word would be hidden from the king, and you yourself would have stood opposite.
brenton_translation: so as to do no harm to his life: and nothing of the matter will be concealed from the king, and thou wilt set thyself against me.

fresh_translation: And Ioab said, I will not linger thus before you. And Ioab took three darts in his hand and drove them into the heart of Abessalom while he was still alive in the heart of the oak.
brenton_translation: And Joab said, I will begin this; I will not thus remain with thee. And Joab took three darts in his hand, and thrust them into the heart of Abessalom, while he was yet alive in the heart of the oak.

fresh_translation: And ten young men carrying the armor of Ioab surrounded Abessalom and struck him and put him to death.
brenton_translation: And ten young men that bore Joab's armour compassed Abessalom, and smote him and slew him.

fresh_translation: And Ioab sounded with the trumpet, and the people turned back from pursuing after Israel, because Ioab spared the people.
brenton_translation: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing Israel, for Joab spared the people.

fresh_translation: And they took Abessalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest and raised over him a very large heap of stones, and all Israel fled, a man to his tent.
brenton_translation: And he took Abessalom, and cast him into a great cavern in the wood, into a deep pit, and set up over him a very great heap of stones: and all Israel fled every man to his tent.

fresh_translation: And Abessalom had taken and set up for himself in his lifetime the pillar in the King's Valley, because he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance. And he called the pillar by his own name, and it is called Hand of Abessalom to this day.
brenton_translation: Now Abessalom while yet alive had taken and set up for himself the pillar near which he was taken, and set it up so as to have the pillar in the king's dale; for he said he had no son to keep his name in remembrance: and he called the pillar, Abessalom's hand, until this day.

fresh_translation: And Achimaas son of Sadok said, Let me run now and bring good news to the king, because the Lord has judged for him against the hand of his enemies.
brenton_translation: And Achimaas the son of Sadoc said, Let me run now and carry glad tidings to the king, for the Lord has delivered him from the hand of his enemies.

fresh_translation: And Ioab said to him, You are not a bearer of good news on this day, but you may bring good news on another day. On this day you shall not bring good news, because the king's son is dead.
brenton_translation: And Joab said to him, Thou shalt not be a messenger of glad tidings this day; thou shalt bear them another day; but on this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

fresh_translation: And Ioab said to Chousi, Go, report to the king what you have seen. And Chousi bowed to Ioab and ran.
brenton_translation: And Joab said to Chusi, Go, report to the king all that thou hast seen. And Chusi did obeisance to Joab, and went out.

fresh_translation: And Achimaas son of Sadok again added and said to Ioab, Whatever may happen, let me run too after Chousi. And Ioab said, Why would you run, my son, since no payment of good news is for you?
brenton_translation: And Achimaas the son of Sadoc said again to Joab, Nay, let me also run after Chusi. And Joab said, Why wouldest thou thus run, my son? attend, thou hast no tidings for profit if thou go.

fresh_translation: And he said, Whatever may happen, I will run. And he said to him, Run. And Achimaas ran by the way of the plain and passed Chousi.
brenton_translation: And he said, Why should I not run? and Joab said to him, Run. And Achimaas ran along the way of Kechar, and outran Chusi.

fresh_translation: And David was sitting between the two gates. And the watchman went up to the roof of the gate by the wall and lifted his eyes and saw, and behold, one man was running alone.
brenton_translation: And David was sitting between the two gates: and the watchman went up on the top of the gate of the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone before him.

fresh_translation: And the watchman called out and reported to the king. And the king said, If he is alone, good news is in his mouth. And he came, going and coming near.
brenton_translation: And the watchman cried out, and reported to the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there are good tidings in his mouth. And the man came and drew near.

fresh_translation: And the watchman saw another man running, and the watchman called out to the gatekeeper and said, Behold, another man runs alone. And the king said, This one too is bringing good news.
brenton_translation: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman cried at the gate, and said, And look, another man running alone. And the king said, He also brings glad tidings.

fresh_translation: And the watchman said, I see the running of the first like the running of Achimaas son of Sadok. And the king said, He is a good man and comes in good news.
brenton_translation: And the watchman said, I see the running of the first as the running of Achimaas the son of Sadoc. And the king said, He is a good man, and will come to report glad tidings.

fresh_translation: And Achimaas called out and said to the king, Peace. And he bowed before the king with his face to the ground and said, Blessed be the Lord your God, who shut up the men who lifted their hand against my lord the king.
brenton_translation: And Achimaas cried out and said to the king, Peace. And he did obeisance to the king with his face to the ground, and said, Blessed be the Lord thy God, who has delivered up the men that lifted up their hands against my lord the king.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Is it well with the young man Abessalom? And Achimaas said, I saw the great crowd when Ioab sent the servant of the king and your servant, and I did not know what was there.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Is the young man Abessalom safe? and Achimaas said, I saw a great multitude at the time of Joab's sending the king's servant and thy servant, and I knew not what was there.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Turn aside, stand here. And he turned aside and stood.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Turn aside, stand still here. And he turned aside, and stood.

fresh_translation: And behold, Chousi arrived and said to the king, Let my lord the king receive good news, because the Lord has judged for you today against the hand of all those rising against you.
brenton_translation: And, behold, Chusi came up, and said to the king, Let my lord the king hear glad tidings, for the Lord has avenged thee this day upon all them that rose up against thee.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Chousi, Is it well with the young man Abessalom? And Chousi said, May the enemies of my lord the king and all who have risen up against him for evil become like that young man.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Chusi, Is it well with the young man Abessalom? and Chusi said, Let the enemies of my lord the king, and all whosoever have risen up against him for evil, be as that young man.

fresh_translation: And the king was troubled and went up to the upper room of the gate and wept, and thus he said as he went, My son Abessalom, my son, my son Abessalom. Who will give my death in place of you? I, in place of you, Abessalom, my son, my son.
brenton_translation: And the king was troubled, and went to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and thus he said as he went, My son Abessalom, my son, my son Abessalom; would God I had died for thee, even I had died for thee, Abessalom, my son, my son!

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Ioab, saying, Behold, the king is weeping and mourning over Abessalom.
brenton_translation: And they brought Joab word, saying, Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And the victory on that day became mourning for all the people, because the people heard on that day, saying, The king grieves over his son.
brenton_translation: And the victory was turned that day into mourning to all the people, for the people heard say that day, The king grieves after his son.

fresh_translation: And the people were slipping into the city on that day, as the people slip in ashamed when they flee in battle.
brenton_translation: And the people stole away that day to go into the city, as people steal away when they are ashamed as they flee in the battle.

fresh_translation: And the king hid his face, and the king cried out with a loud voice, saying, My son Abessalom, Abessalom, my son, my son.
brenton_translation: And the king hid his face: and the king cried with a loud voice, My son Abessalom! Abessalom my son!

fresh_translation: And Ioab came to the king in the house and said, Today you have put to shame the face of all your servants, those who are rescuing you today and the lives of your sons and your daughters and the lives of your wives and your concubines,
brenton_translation: And Joab went in to the king, into the house, and said, Thou hast this day shamed the faces of all thy servants that have delivered thee this day, and have saved the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and of thy concubines,

fresh_translation: by loving those who hate you and hating those who love you. For you declared today that your commanders and servants are nothing, because I know today that if Abessalom were alive and all of us today dead, then it would have been right in your eyes.
brenton_translation: forasmuch as thou lovest them that hate thee, and hatest them that love thee; and thou hast this day declared, that thy princes and thy servants are nothing in thy sight: for I know this day, that if Abessalom were alive, and all of us dead to-day, then it would have been right in thy sight.

fresh_translation: And now rise, go out, and speak to the heart of your servants, because by the Lord I have sworn that if you do not go out, not a man will lodge with you tonight, and know for yourself that this will be worse for you than all the evil that has come upon you from your youth until now.
brenton_translation: And now arise, and go forth, and speak comfortably to thy servants; for I have sworn by the Lord, that unless thou wilt go forth to-day, there shall not a man remain with thee this night: and know for thyself, this thing will indeed be evil to thee beyond all the evil that has come upon thee from thy youth until now.

fresh_translation: And the king rose and sat in the gate, and all the people reported, saying, Behold, the king sits in the gate. And all the people came before the king. And Israel fled, a man to his tents.
brenton_translation: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate: and all the people reported, saying, Behold, the king sits in the gate. And all the people went in before the king to the gate; for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

fresh_translation: And all the people were disputing in all the tribes of Israel, saying, King David rescued us from all our enemies and himself delivered us from the hand of the foreigners, and now he has fled from the land and from his kingdom because of Abessalom.
brenton_translation: And all the people disputed among all the tribes of Israel, saying, King David delivered us from all our enemies, and he rescued us from the hand of the Philistines: and now he has fled from the land, and from his kingdom, and from Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Abessalom, whom we anointed over us, has died in battle. So now why are you silent about bringing back the king? And the word of all Israel came to the king.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle: and now why are ye silent about bringing back the king? And the word of all Israel came to the king.

fresh_translation: And King David sent to Sadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak to the elders of Iouda, saying, Why do you become the last to bring back the king to his house, since the word of all Israel has come to the king?
brenton_translation: And king David sent to Sadoc and Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak to the elders of Israel, saying, Why are ye the last to bring back the king to his house? whereas the word of all Israel is come to the king to his house.

fresh_translation: You are my brothers; you are my bones and my flesh. Why then do you become the last to bring back the king to his house?
brenton_translation: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: why are ye the last to bring back the king to his house?

fresh_translation: And you shall say to Amessai, Are you not my bone and my flesh? Thus may God do to me, and thus may he add, if you shall not be commander of the army before me all the days in place of Ioab.
brenton_translation: And ye shall say to Amessai, Art thou not my bone and my flesh? and now God do so to me, and more also, if thou shalt not be commander of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

fresh_translation: And he inclined the heart of every man of Iouda as one man, and they sent to the king, saying, Return, you and all your servants.
brenton_translation: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Juda as that of one man; and they sent to the king, saying, Return thou, and all thy servants.

fresh_translation: And the king returned and came as far as the Jordan, and the men of Iouda came to Galgala to go and meet the king, to bring the king across the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And the king returned, and came as far as Jordan. And the men of Juda came to Galgala on their way to meet the king, to cause the king to pass over Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Semei son of Gera son of the Jeminaian from Baourim hurried and came down with the men of Iouda to meet King David.
