fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said to Iosaphat, Will you come up with us to Remmath Galaad for war? And Iosaphat said, As I am, so are you; as my people, so your people; as my horses, so your horses.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, Wilt thou go up with us to Remmath Galaad to battle?

fresh_translation: And Iosaphat king of Iouda said to the king of Israel, Ask the Lord today.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat said, As I am, so art thou also; as my people, so is thy people; as my horses, so are thy horses.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel gathered all the prophets, about four hundred men, and the king said to them, Shall I go to Remmath Galaad for war, or shall I hold back? And they said, Go up, and in giving, the Lord will give into the hands of the king.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel gathered all the prophets together, about four hundred men; and the king said to them, Shall I go up to Remmath Galaad to battle, or shall I forbear? and they said, Go up, and the Lord will surely give it into the hands of the king.

fresh_translation: And Iosaphat said to the king of Israel, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, and shall we ask the Lord through him?
brenton_translation: And Josaphat said to the king of Israel, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, that we may enquire of the Lord by him?

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said to Iosaphat, There is still one man by whom we may ask the Lord, and I hate him because he does not speak good concerning me, only evil: Michaias son of Iemla. And Iosaphat king of Iouda said, Let not the king speak so.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, There is one man here for us to enquire of the Lord by; but I hate him, for he does not speak good of me, but only evil; Michaias son of Jemblaa. And Josaphat king of Juda said, Let not the king say so.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel called one eunuch and said, Quickly, Michaias son of Iemla.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel called a eunuch and said, Bring hither quickly Michaias son of Jemblaa.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel and Iosaphat king of Iouda were sitting, each upon his throne, armed, in the gates of Samaria, and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel and Josaphat king of Juda sat, each on his throne, armed in the gates of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

fresh_translation: And Sedekias son of Chanana made iron horns for himself and said, Thus says the Lord: With these you will gore Syria until it is finished.
brenton_translation: And Sedekias son of Chanaan made for himself iron horns, and said, Thus saith the Lord, With these thou shalt push Syria, until it be consumed.

fresh_translation: And all the prophets prophesied thus, saying, Go up to Remmath Galaad and prosper, and the Lord will give into your hands, and the king of Syria.
brenton_translation: And all the prophets prophesied in like manner, saying, Go up to Remmath Galaad, and the thing shall prosper, and the Lord shall deliver it and the king of Syria into thine hands.

fresh_translation: And the messenger who went to call Michaias spoke to him, saying, Behold now, all the prophets speak with one mouth good things concerning the king. Be now also in your words like the words of one of these and speak good things.
brenton_translation: And the messenger that went to call Michaias spoke to him, saying, Behold now, all the prophets speak with one mouth good concerning the king, let now thy words be like the words of one of them, and speak good things.

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, As the Lord lives, whatever the Lord says to me, these things I will speak.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, As the Lord lives, whatsoever the Lord shall say to me, that will I speak.

fresh_translation: And he came to the king, and the king said to him, Michaias, shall I go up to Remmath Galaad for war, or shall I hold back? And he said, Go up and prosper, and the Lord will give into the hand of the king.
brenton_translation: And he came to the king: and the king said to him, Michaias, shall I go up to Remmath Galaad to battle, or shall I forbear? and he said, Go up, and the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

fresh_translation: And the king said to him, How many times do I put you under oath, that you speak truth to me in the name of the Lord?
brenton_translation: And the king said to him, How often shall I adjure thee, that thou speak to me truth in the name of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, Not so. I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains like a flock that has no shepherd, and the Lord said, There is no lord for these. Let each return to his own house in peace.
brenton_translation: And he said, Not so. I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains as a flock without a shepherd: and the Lord said, Is not God lord of these? let each one return to his home in peace.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said to Iosaphat king of Iouda, Did I not tell you that this one does not prophesy good things to me, only evils?
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat king of Juda, Did I not say to thee that this man does not prophesy good to me, for he speaks nothing but evil?

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, Not so. Hear the word of the Lord. I saw the Lord God of Israel sitting upon his throne, and all the army of heaven stood around him, at his right hand and at his left.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, Not so, it is not I: hear the word of the Lord; it is not so. I saw the God of Israel sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven stood about him on his right hand and on his left.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, Who will deceive Achaab king of Israel, and he will go up and fall in Remmath Galaad? And one said this and another said this.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, Who will deceive Achaab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall in Remmath Galaad? and one spoke one way, and another another way.

fresh_translation: And a spirit went out and stood before the Lord and said, I will deceive him. And the Lord said to him, By what?
brenton_translation: And there came forth a spirit and stood before the Lord, and said, I will deceive him.

fresh_translation: And he said, I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You will deceive and indeed you will prevail. Go out and do so.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to him, Whereby? And he said, I will go forth, and will be a false spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt deceive him, yea, and shalt prevail: go forth, and do so.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, the Lord has given a lying spirit in the mouth of all these prophets of yours, and the Lord has spoken evils against you.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, the Lord has put a false spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the Lord has spoken evil against thee.

fresh_translation: And Sedekiou son of Chanana came near and struck Michaias on the jaw and said, What spirit of the Lord was this that spoke in you?
brenton_translation: And Sedekias the son of Chanaan came near and smote Michaias on the cheek, and said, What sort of a spirit of the Lord has spoken in thee?

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, Behold, you will see on that day when you enter chamber within chamber to hide yourself.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an innermost chamber to hide thyself there.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said, Take Michaias and return him to Emēr the ruler of the city and to Iōas son of the king.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said, Take Michaias, and convey him away to Semer the keeper of the city;

fresh_translation: Say to put this one in prison and to feed him bread of affliction and water of affliction until I return in peace.
brenton_translation: and tell Joas the king's son to put this fellow in prison, and to feed him with bread of affliction and water of affliction until I return in peace.

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, If returning you return in peace, the Lord has not spoken in me.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, If thou return at all in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel and Iosaphat king of Iouda went up with him to Remmath Galaad.
brenton_translation: So the king of Israel went up, and Josaphat king of Juda with him to Remmath Galaad.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said to Iosaphat king of Iouda, I will disguise myself and enter into the battle, and you put on my clothing. And the king of Israel disguised himself and entered into the battle.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat king of Juda, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle, and do thou put on my raiment. So the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

fresh_translation: And the king of Syria commanded the rulers of his chariots, thirty-two, saying, Fight neither small nor great, only the king of Israel, utterly alone.
brenton_translation: And the king of Syria had charged the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, Fight not against small or great, but against the king of Israel only.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the rulers of the chariots saw Iosaphat king of Iouda, they said, This one appears to be the king of Israel, and they surrounded him to fight, and Iosaphat cried out.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Josaphat king of Juda, that they said, This seems to be the king of Israel. And they compassed him about to fight against him; and Josaphat cried out.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the rulers of the chariots saw that this one was not the king of Israel, they turned away from him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw that this was not the king of Israel, that they returned from him.

fresh_translation: And one stretched the bow accurately and struck the king of Israel between the lung and between the breastplate, and he said to his charioteer, Turn your hands and bring me out from the battle, because I am wounded.
brenton_translation: And one drew a bow with a good aim, and smote the king of Israel between the lungs and the breast-plate: and he said to his charioteer, Turn thine hands, and carry me away out of the battle, for I am wounded.

fresh_translation: And the battle turned in that day, and the king was standing on the chariot opposite Syria from morning until evening, and the blood from the wound kept pouring into the bosom of the chariot, and he died at evening, and the blood of the stroke kept going out as far as the bosom of the chariot.
brenton_translation: And the war was turned in that day, and the king was standing on the chariot against Syria from morning till evening; and he shed the blood out of his wound, into the bottom of the chariot, and died at even, and the blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

fresh_translation: And the herald stood at sunset, saying, Each to his own city and to his own land.
brenton_translation: And the herald of the army stood at sunset, saying, Let every man go to his own city and his own land,

fresh_translation: Because the king is dead. And they came to Samaria and buried the king in Samaria.
brenton_translation: for the king is dead. And they came to Samaria, and buried the king in Samaria.

fresh_translation: And they washed the chariot at the spring of Samaria, and the sows and the dogs licked the blood, and the prostitutes bathed in the blood, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke.
brenton_translation: And they washed the chariot at the fountain of Samaria; and the swine and the dogs licked up the blood, and the harlots washed themselves in the blood, according to the word of the Lord which he spoke.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Achaab and all that he did and the ivory house that he built and all the cities that he made, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Achaab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities which he built, behold, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Achaab slept with his fathers, and Ochozias his son reigned in place of him.
brenton_translation: And Achaab slept with his fathers, and Ochozias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Iosaphat son of Asa reigned over Iouda. In the fourth year of Achaab king of Israel he reigned.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat the son of Asa reigned over Juda: in the fourth year of Achaab king of Israel began Josaphat to reign.

fresh_translation: Iosaphat was a son of thirty-five years when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Ierousalem, and his mother's name was Azouba daughter of Selei.
brenton_translation: Thirty and five years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Azuba daughter of Salai.

fresh_translation: And he walked in every way of Asa his father, and he did not turn aside from it, doing what was right in the eyes of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he walked in all the way of Asa his father: he turned not from it, even from doing that which was right in the eyes of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Yet he did not remove the high places. The people were still sacrificing and burning incense on the high places.
brenton_translation: Only he took not away any of the high places: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places.

fresh_translation: And Iosaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat was at peace with the king of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Iosaphat and his acts of power, what he did, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Iouda?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Josaphat, and his mighty deeds, whatever he did, behold, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Iosaphat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father, and Iōram his son reigned in place of him.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried by his fathers in the city of David his father, and Joram his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Ochozias son of Achaab reigned over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Iosaphat king of Iouda, and he reigned over Israel two years.
brenton_translation: And Ochozias son of Achaab reigned over Israel in Samaria: in the seventeenth year of Josaphat king of Juda, Ochozias son of Achaab reigned over Israel in Samaria two years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord and walked in the way of Achaab his father and in the way of Iezabel his mother and in the sins of the house of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Achaab his father, and in the way of Jezabel his mother, and in the sins of the house of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who caused Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: And he served the Baals and bowed down to them and provoked the Lord God of Israel according to all the things that came before him.
brenton_translation: And he served Baalim, and worshipped them, and provoked the Lord God of Israel, according to all that had been done before him.

fresh_translation: And Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Achaab.
brenton_translation: And Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Achaab.

fresh_translation: And Ochozias fell through the lattice in his upper room in Samaria and became sick, and he sent messengers and said to them, Come and seek in Baal of flies, god of Akkarōn, whether I will live from this sickness. And they went to inquire through him.
brenton_translation: And Ochozias fell through the lattice that was in his upper chamber in Samaria, and was sick; and he sent messengers, and said to them, Go and enquire of Baal fly, the god of Accaron, whether I shall recover of this my sickness. And they went to enquire of him.

fresh_translation: And angel of the Lord spoke to Elijah the Thesbite, saying, Rise, come to meet the messengers of Ochozias king of Samaria, and you will speak to them, Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going to seek in Baal of flies, god of Akkarōn?
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord called Eliu the Thesbite, saying, Arise, and go to meet the messengers of Ochozias king of Samaria, and thou shalt say to them, Is it because there is no God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baal fly, the god of Accaron? but it shall not be so.

fresh_translation: And not so, because thus says the Lord: The bed on which you went up there, you shall not come down from it, because by death you will die. And Elijah went and spoke to them.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, The bed on which thou art gone up, thou shalt not come down from it, for thou shalt surely die. And Eliu went, and said so to them.

fresh_translation: And the messengers returned to him, and he said to them, Why is it that you returned?
brenton_translation: And the messengers returned to him, and he said to them, Why have ye returned?

fresh_translation: And they said to him, A man came up to meet us and said to us, Come, return to the king who sent you, and speak to him, Thus says the Lord: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going to seek in Baal of flies, god of Akkarōn? And not so, the bed on which you went up there, you shall not come down from it, because by death you will die.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, A man came up to meet us, and said to us, Go, return to the king that sent you, and say to him, Thus saith the Lord, Is it because there is no God in Israel, that thou goest to enquire of Baal fly, the god of Accaron? it shall not be so: the bed on which thou art gone up, thou shalt not come down from it, for thou shalt surely die.

fresh_translation: And he spoke to them, saying, What was the appearance of the man who came up to meet you and spoke to you these words?
brenton_translation: So they returned and reported to the king as Eliu said: and he said to them, What was the manner of the man who went up to meet you, and spoke to you these words?

fresh_translation: And they said to him, A hairy man, with a leather belt girded around his waist. And he said, This is Elijah the Thesbite.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, He was a hairy man, and girt with a leathern girdle about his loins. And he said, This is Eliu the Thesbite.

fresh_translation: And he sent to him a captain of fifty and his fifty, and he went up and came to him. And behold, Elijah was sitting on the top of the mountain, and the captain of fifty spoke to him and said, Man of God, the king has called you. Come down.
brenton_translation: And he sent to him a captain of fifty and his fifty; and he went up to him: and, behold, Eliu sat on the top of a mountain. And the captain of fifty spoke to him, and said, O man of God, the king has called thee, come down.

fresh_translation: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I am a man of God, fire will come down from heaven and eat you and your fifty. And fire came down from heaven and ate him and his fifty.
brenton_translation: And Eliu answered and said to the captain of fifty, And if I am a man of God, fire shall come down out of heaven, and devour thee and thy fifty. And fire came down out of heaven, and devoured him and his fifty.

fresh_translation: And the king added and sent to him another captain of fifty and his fifty, and he went up and the captain of fifty spoke to him and said, Man of God, thus says the king: Quickly, come down.
brenton_translation: And the king sent a second time to him another captain of fifty, and his fifty. And the captain of fifty spoke to him, and said, O man of God, thus says the king, Come down quickly.

fresh_translation: And Elijah answered and spoke to him and said, If I am a man of God, fire will come down from heaven and eat you and your fifty. And fire came down from heaven and ate him and his fifty.
brenton_translation: And Eliu answered and spoke to him, and said, If I am a man of God, fire shall come down out of heaven, and devour thee and thy fifty. And fire came down out of heaven, and devoured him and his fifty.

fresh_translation: And the king added yet to send a third captain of fifty and his fifty, and the third captain of fifty came to him and bent upon his knees before Elijah and begged him and spoke to him and said, Man of God, let my life now be precious, and the life of these fifty servants of yours, in your eyes.
brenton_translation: And the king sent yet again a captain and his fifty. And the third captain of fifty came, and knelt on his knees before Eliu, and entreated him, and spoke to him and said, O man of God, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thine eyes.

fresh_translation: Behold, fire came down from heaven and ate the first two captains of fifty and their fifties. And now let the life of your servants be precious in your eyes.
brenton_translation: Behold, fire came down from heaven, and devoured the two first captains of fifty: and now, I pray, let my life be precious in thine eyes.

fresh_translation: And angel of the Lord spoke to Elijah and said, Go down with him. Do not fear from before them. And Elijah rose and went down with him to the king.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord spoke to Eliu, and said, Go down with him, be not afraid of them. And Eliu rose up, and went down with him to the king.

fresh_translation: And Elijah spoke to him and said, Thus says the Lord: Why is it that you sent messengers to seek in Baal of flies, god of Akkarōn? And not so, the bed on which you went up there, you shall not come down from it, because by death you will die.
brenton_translation: And Eliu spoke to him, and said, Thus saith the Lord, Why hast thou sent messengers to enquire of Baal fly, the god of Accaron? it shall not be so: the bed on which thou art gone up, thou shalt not come down from it, for thou shalt surely die.

fresh_translation: And he died according to the word of the Lord that Elijah spoke.
brenton_translation: So he died according to the word of the Lord which Eliu had spoken.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Ochozias, what he did, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Israel? And Iōram son of Achaab reigned over Israel in Samaria twelve years, in the eighteenth year of Iosaphat king of Iouda. And he did evil before the Lord, yet not like his brothers nor like his mother. And he removed the pillars of Baal that his father made and shattered them. Yet in the sins of the house of Ieroboam, who made Israel sin, he clung and did not depart from them. And the anger of the Lord was enraged against the house of Achaab.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ochozias which he did, behold, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the Lord was taking Elijah up in a storm as into heaven, Elijah and Elisaie went from Galgala.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the Lord was going to take Eliu with a whirlwind as it were into heaven, that Eliu and Elisaie went out of Galgala.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to Elisaie, Stay here now, because the Lord has sent me as far as Baithēl. And Elisaie said, As the Lord lives and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And they went to Baithēl.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to Elisaie, Stay here, I pray thee; for God has sent me to Bæthel. And Elisaie said, As the Lord lives and thy soul lives, I will not leave thee; so they came to Bæthel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of the prophets in Baithēl came to Elisaie and said to him, Do you know that today the Lord is taking your lord away from over your head? And he said, I also know. Be silent.
brenton_translation: And the sons of the prophets who were in Bæthel came to Elisaie, and said to him, Dost thou know, that the Lord this day is going to take thy lord away from thy head? And he said, Yea, I know it; be silent.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to Elisaie, Stay here now, because the Lord has sent me to Ierichō. And Elisaie said, As the Lord lives and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And they came to Ierichō.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to Elisaie, Stay here, I pray thee; for the Lord has sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the Lord lives and thy soul lives, I will not leave thee. And they came to Jericho.

fresh_translation: And the sons of the prophets in Ierichō came near to Elisaie and said to him, Do you know that today the Lord is taking your lord away from over your head? And he said, I too know. Be silent.
brenton_translation: And the sons of the prophets who were in Jericho drew near to Elisaie, and said to him, Dost thou know that the Lord is about to take away thy master to-day from thy head? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold your peace.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to him, Stay here now, because the Lord has sent me as far as the Jordan. And Elisaie said, As the Lord lives and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And both went on.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to him, Stay here, I pray thee, for the Lord has sent me to Jordan. And Elisaie said, As the Lord lives and thy soul lives, I will not leave thee: and they both went on.

fresh_translation: And fifty men from the sons of the prophets stood opposite at a distance, and both stood by the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went also, and they stood opposite afar off: and both stood on the bank of Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Elijah took his sheepskin cloak and rolled it up and struck the water, and the water divided here and there, and both crossed in dry land.
brenton_translation: And Eliu took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the water: and the water was divided on this side and on that side, and they both went over on dry ground.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when they crossed over, Elijah said to Elisaie, Ask what I should do for you before I am taken up from you. And Elisaie said, Let a double share of your spirit now be upon me.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass while they were crossing over, that Eliu said to Elisaie, Ask what I shall do for thee before I am taken up from thee. And Elisaie said, Let there be, I pray thee, a double portion of thy spirit upon me.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said, You made the asking hard. If you see me being taken up from you, it shall be so for you; but if not, it shall certainly not happen.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: if thou shalt see me when I am taken up from thee, then shall it be so to thee; and if not, it shall not be so.

fresh_translation: And it came to be as they were going on and talking, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire, and they separated between the two of them, and Elijah was taken up in a storm as into heaven.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as they were going, they went on talking; and, behold, a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and it separated between them both; and Eliu was taken up in a whirlwind as it were into heaven.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie was watching and crying out, Father, father, chariot of Israel and its horseman. And he did not see him anymore, and he seized his garments and tore them into two tearings.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie saw, and cried, Father, father, the chariot of Israel, and the horseman thereof! And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his garments, and rent them into two pieces.

fresh_translation: And he lifted up Elijah's sheepskin cloak that fell from above upon Elisaie, and Elisaie returned and stood on the lip of the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie took up the mantle of Eliu, which fell from off him upon Elisaie; and Elisaie returned, and stood upon the brink of Jordan;

fresh_translation: And he took Elijah's sheepskin cloak that fell from above him and struck the water, and it did not divide, and he said, Where is the God of Elijah, indeed? And he struck the waters, and they split here and there, and Elisaie crossed over.
brenton_translation: and he took the mantle of Eliu, which fell from off him, and smote the water, and said, Where is the Lord God of Eliu? and he smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither; and Elisaie went over.

fresh_translation: And the sons of the prophets in Ierichō saw him from opposite them and said, The spirit of Elijah has come to rest upon Elisaie. And they came to meet him and bowed to him to the ground.
brenton_translation: And the sons of the prophets who were in Jericho on the opposite side saw him, and said, The spirit of Eliu has rested upon Elisaie. And they came to meet him, and did obeisance to him to the ground.

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Behold now, with your servants are fifty men, sons of strength. Let them go now and seek your lord, lest the Spirit of the Lord lifted him and cast him into the Jordan or onto one of the mountains or onto one of the hills. And Elisaie said, You shall not send.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, Behold now, there are with thy servants fifty men of strength: let them go now, and seek thy lord: peradventure the Spirit of the Lord has taken him up, and cast him into Jordan, or on one of the mountains, or on one of the hills. And Elisaie said, Ye shall not send.

fresh_translation: And they pressed him until he was ashamed, and he said, Send them. And they sent fifty men, and they sought three days and did not find him.
brenton_translation: And they pressed him until he was ashamed; and he said, Send. And they sent fifty men, and sought three days, and found him not.

fresh_translation: And they returned to him, and he was sitting in Ierichō, and Elisaie said, Did I not tell you, Do not go?
brenton_translation: And they returned to him, for he dwelt in Jericho: and Elisaie said, Did I not say to you, Go not?

fresh_translation: And the men of the city said to Elisaie, Behold, the dwelling of the city is good, as my lord sees, but the waters are bad and the land barren.
brenton_translation: And the men of the city said to Elisaie, Behold, the situation of the city is good, as our lord sees; but the waters are bad, and the ground barren.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said, Take for me a new little jar and put salt there. And they brought it to him.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said, Bring me a new pitcher, and put salt in it. And they took one, and brought it to him.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie went out to the outflow of the waters and threw salt there and said, Thus says the Lord: I have healed these waters. There shall no longer be from there death and barrenness.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie went out to the spring of the waters, and cast salt therein, and says, Thus saith the Lord, I have healed these waters; there shall not be any longer death thence or barren land.

fresh_translation: And the waters were healed until this day, according to the word Elisaie spoke.
brenton_translation: And the waters were healed until this day, according to the word of Elisaie which he spoke.

fresh_translation: And he went up from there to Baithēl, and as he was going up on the road, little boys came out from the city and mocked him and said to him, Go up, baldhead, go up.
brenton_translation: And he went up thence to Bæthel: and as he was going up by the way there came up also little children from the city, and mocked him, and said to him, Go up, baldhead, go up.

fresh_translation: And he turned after them and saw them and cursed them in the name of the Lord, and behold, two bears came out of the woodland and tore apart forty-two boys from among them.
brenton_translation: And he turned after them, and saw them, and cursed them in the name of the Lord. And, behold, there came out two bears out of the wood, and they tore forty and two children of them.

fresh_translation: And he went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
brenton_translation: And he went thence to mount Carmel, and returned thence to Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Iōram son of Achaab reigned in Israel in the eighteenth year of Iosaphat king of Iouda, and he reigned twelve years.
brenton_translation: And Joram the son of Achaab began to reign in Israel in the eighteenth year of Josaphat king of Juda, and he reigned twelve years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, yet not like his father and not like his mother, and he removed the pillars of Baal that his father made.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, only not as his father, nor as his mother: and he removed the pillars of Baal which his father had made.

fresh_translation: Yet he clung to the sin of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin. He did not depart from it.
brenton_translation: Only he adhered to the sin of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin; he departed not from it.

fresh_translation: And Mosa king of Moab was a sheep-breeder, and in the revolt he paid back to the king of Israel one hundred thousand lambs and one hundred thousand rams in wool.
brenton_translation: And Mosa king of Moab was a sheep-master, and he rendered to the king of Israel in the beginning of the year, a hundred thousand lambs, and a hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after Achaab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the kingdom of Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, after the death of Achaab, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

fresh_translation: And King Iōram went out on that day from Samaria and reviewed Israel.
brenton_translation: And king Joram went forth in that day out of Samaria, and numbered Israel.

fresh_translation: And he went and sent to Iosaphat king of Iouda, saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to Moab for war? And he said, I will go up. As I am, so you; as my people, so your people; as my horses, so your horses.
brenton_translation: And he went and sent to Josaphat king of Juda, saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to war? And he said, I will go up: thou art as I, I am as thou; as my people, so is thy people, as my horses, so are thy horses.

fresh_translation: And he said, By what road shall I go up? And he said, By the wilderness road of Edom.
brenton_translation: And he said, What way shall I go up? and he said, The way of the wilderness of Edom.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel and the king of Iouda and the king of Edom went, and they went around by a seven-days road, and there was no water for the camp and for the cattle at their feet.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel went, and the king of Juda, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey; and there was no water for the army, and for the cattle that went with them.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said, Alas, because the Lord has called these three passing kings to give them into the hand of Moab.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the Lord should have called the three kings on their way, to give them into the hand of Moab.

fresh_translation: And Iosaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, and shall we seek the Lord from him? And one of the servants of the king of Israel answered and said, Elisaie son of Saphat is here, who poured water on the hands of Elijah.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, that we may enquire of the Lord by him? And one of the servants of the king of Israel answered and said, There is here Elisaie son of Saphat, who poured water on the hands of Eliu.

fresh_translation: And Iosaphat said, Word of the Lord is with him. And the king of Israel and Iosaphat king of Iouda and the king of Edom went down to him.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat said, He has the word of the Lord. And the king of Israel, and Josaphat king of Juda, and the king of Edom, went down to him.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to the king of Israel, What is to me and to you? Go to the prophets of your father. And the king of Israel said to him, No, because the Lord has called these three kings to hand them over into the hands of Moab.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said to the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? go to the prophets of thy father, and the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said to him, Has the Lord called the three kings to deliver them into the hands of Moab?

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said, As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, unless I regarded the face of Iosaphat king of Iouda, I would not look toward you or see you.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said, As the Lord of hosts before whom I stand lives, unless I regarded the presence of Josaphat the king of Juda, I would not have looked on thee, nor seen thee.

fresh_translation: And now bring me a musician. And it came to be, as the musician played, the hand of the Lord came upon him.
brenton_translation: And now fetch me a harper. And it came to pass, as the harper harped, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.

fresh_translation: And he said, Thus says the Lord: Make this wadi pits, pits.
brenton_translation: And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Make this valley full of trenches.

fresh_translation: For thus says the Lord: You will not see wind and you will not see rain, and this wadi will be filled with water, and you will drink, you and your possessions and your cattle.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain, yet this valley shall be filled with water, and ye, and your flocks, and your cattle shall drink.

fresh_translation: And this is light in the eyes of the Lord, and I will hand Moab over into your hand.
brenton_translation: And this is a light thing in the eyes of the Lord: I will also deliver Moab into your hand.

fresh_translation: And you will strike every fortified city, and you will bring down every good tree, and you will stop up all springs of water, and every good tract you will spoil with stones.
brenton_translation: And ye shall smite every strong city, and ye shall cut down every good tree, and ye shall stop all wells of water, and spoil every good piece of land with stones.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the morning, as the sacrifice was going up, behold, waters were coming by the road of Edom, and the land was filled with water.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the morning, when the sacrifice was offered, that, behold! waters came from the way of Edom, and the land was filled with water.

fresh_translation: And all Moab heard that the kings had gone up to fight them, and they cried out from everyone girding on a belt and upward, and they stood at the border.
brenton_translation: And all Moab heard that the three kings were come up to fight against them; and they cried out on every side, even all that were girt with a girdle, and they said, Ho! and stood upon the border.

fresh_translation: And they rose early in the morning, and the sun rose upon the waters, and Moab saw opposite them the waters red like blood.
brenton_translation: And they rose early in the morning, and the sun rose upon the waters, and Moab saw the waters on the opposite side red as blood.

fresh_translation: And they said, This is blood of the sword. The kings fought and struck each man his neighbor. And now, Moab, to the spoils!
brenton_translation: And they said, This is the blood of the sword; and the kings have fought, and each man has smitten his neighbour; now then to the spoils, Moab.

fresh_translation: And they entered into the camp of Israel, and Israel rose and struck Moab, and they fled from before them, and they entered, going in and striking Moab.
brenton_translation: And they entered into the camp of Israel; and Israel arose and smote Moab, and they fled from before them; and they went on and smote Moab as they went.

fresh_translation: And they tore down the cities, and on every good tract each man threw his stone and filled it, and they stopped up every spring of water and brought down every good tree until they left only the wall-stones of Kir-hareseth torn down. And the slingers encircled it and struck it.
brenton_translation: And they razed the cities, and cast every man his stone on every good piece of land and filled it; and they stopped every well, and cut down every good tree, until they left only the stones of the wall cast down; and the slingers compassed the land, and smote it.

fresh_translation: And the king of Moab saw that the battle had grown too strong against him, and he took with himself seven hundred men drawing sword to break through to the king of Edom, and they were not able.
brenton_translation: And the king of Moab saw that the battle prevailed against him; and he took with him seven hundred men that drew sword, to cut through to the king of Edom: and they could not.

fresh_translation: And he took his firstborn son, who would reign in place of him, and offered him as a whole burnt offering upon the wall, and great regret came upon Israel, and they withdrew from him and returned to the land.
brenton_translation: And he took his eldest son whom he had designed to reign in his stead, and offered him up for a whole-burnt-offering on the walls. And there was a great indignation against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their land.

fresh_translation: And one woman from the sons of the prophets cried to Elisaie, saying, Your servant, my husband, has died, and you knew that your servant was fearing the Lord, and the creditor has come to take my two sons for himself as slaves.
brenton_translation: And one of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried to Elisaie, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant feared the Lord: and the creditor is come to take my two sons to be his servants.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said, What shall I do for you? Tell me what there is for you in the house. And she said, There is nothing for your servant in the house except oil for anointing.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said, What shall I do for thee? tell me what thou hast in the house. And she said, Thy servant has nothing in the house, except oil wherewith I anoint myself.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, Go, ask for yourself vessels from outside, from all your neighbors, empty vessels. Do not make them few.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, Go, borrow for thyself vessels without of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

fresh_translation: And you will go in and shut the door on yourself and on your sons, and you will pour into these vessels, and the filled one you will lift away.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt go in and shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and thou shalt pour forth into these vessels, and remove that which is filled.

fresh_translation: And she went from him and did so, and she shut the door on herself and on her sons. They kept bringing the vessels near to her, and she kept pouring.
brenton_translation: And she departed from him, and shut the door upon herself and upon her sons: they brought the vessels near to her, and she poured in until the vessels were filled.

fresh_translation: Until the vessels were filled, and she said to her sons, Bring another vessel near to me. And they said to her, There is no more vessel. And the oil stood still.
brenton_translation: And she said to her sons, Bring me yet a vessel. And they said to her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

fresh_translation: And she came and reported to the man of God, and Elisaie said, Go and sell the oil and pay your interest, and you and your sons will live on the remaining oil.
brenton_translation: And she came and told the man of God: and Elisaie said, Go, and sell the oil, and thou shalt pay thy debts, and thou and thy sons shall live of the remaining oil.

fresh_translation: And it came to be one day Elisaie passed through to Sōman, and there was a great woman there, and she constrained him to eat bread. And it came to be, as often as he went in, he turned aside there to eat.
brenton_translation: And a day came, when Elisaie passed over to Soman, and there was a great lady there, and she constrained him to eat bread: and it came to pass as often as he went into the city, that he turned aside to eat there.

fresh_translation: And the woman said to her husband, Behold now, I know that this one who continually passes over us is a holy man of God.
brenton_translation: And the woman said to her husband, See now, I know that this is a holy man of God who comes over continually to us.

fresh_translation: Let us make for him a little upper-room place, and let us put there for him a bed and a table and a chair and a lampstand, and it shall be, when he comes in to us, he will turn in there.
brenton_translation: Let us now make for him an upper chamber, a small place; and let us put there for him a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall come to pass that when he comes in to us, he shall turn in thither.

fresh_translation: And it came to be one day, he went in there and turned in to the upper room and slept there.
brenton_translation: And a day came, and he went in thither, and turned aside into the upper chamber, and lay there.

fresh_translation: And he said to Giezi his servant-boy, Call this Sōmanite for me. And he called her, and she stood before him.
brenton_translation: And he said to Giezi his servant, Call me this Somanite. And he called her, and she stood before him.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Say now to her, Behold, you have stirred up for us all this concern. What needs to be done for you? Is there a word for you to the king or to the commander of the force? And she said, I dwell in the midst of my people.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Say now to her, Behold, thou hast taken all this trouble for us; what should I do for thee? Hast thou any request to make to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she said, I dwell in the midst of my people.

fresh_translation: And he said, What needs to be done for her? And Giezi his servant-boy said, Truly she has no son, and her husband is old.
brenton_translation: And he said to Giezi, What must we do for her? and Giezi his servant said, Indeed she has no son, and her husband is old.

fresh_translation: And he called her, and she stood by the door.
brenton_translation: And he called her, and she stood by the door.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to her, At this time, as the living season returns, you will be embracing a son. And she said, No, my lord, do not lie to your servant.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said to her, At this time next year, as the season is, thou shalt be alive, and embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, do not lie to thy servant.

fresh_translation: And the woman conceived and bore a son at this time, as the living season returned, just as Elisaie spoke to her.
brenton_translation: And the woman conceived, and bore a son at the very time, as the season was, being alive, as Elisaie said to her.

fresh_translation: And the boy grew strong, and it came to be when the boy went out to his father, to the reapers.
brenton_translation: And the child grew: and it came to pass when he went out to his father to the reapers,

fresh_translation: And he said to his father, My head, my head. And he said to the servant-boy, Carry him to his mother.
brenton_translation: that he said to his father, My head, my head. And his father said to a servant, Carry him to his mother.

fresh_translation: And he carried him to his mother, and he lay on her knees until midday and died.
brenton_translation: And he carried him to his mother, and he lay upon her knees till noon, and died.

fresh_translation: And she brought him up and laid him on the bed of the man of God and shut the door upon him and went out.
brenton_translation: And she carried him up and laid him on the bed of the man of God; and she shut the door upon him, and went out.

fresh_translation: And she called her husband and said, Send me now one of the servant-boys and one of the donkeys, and I will run as far as the man of God and return.
brenton_translation: And she called her husband, and said, Send now for me one of the young men, and one of the asses, and I will ride quickly to the man of God, and return.

fresh_translation: And he said, Why are you going to him today? It is neither new moon nor Sabbath. And she said, Peace.
brenton_translation: And he said, Why art thou going to him to-day? It is neither new moon, nor the sabbath. And she said, It is well.

fresh_translation: And she saddled the donkey and said to her servant-boy, Lead on. Do not slow my riding unless I tell you.
brenton_translation: And she saddled the ass, and said to her servant, Be quick, proceed: spare not on my account to ride, unless I shall tell thee. Go, and thou shalt proceed, and come to the man of God to mount Carmel.

fresh_translation: So she went and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. And it came to be when Elisaie saw her coming, he said to Giezi his servant-boy, Behold now, that Sōmanite.
brenton_translation: And she rode and came to the man of God to the mountain: and it came to pass when Elisaie saw her coming, that he said to Giezi his servant, See now, that Somanite comes.

fresh_translation: Now run to meet her and say, Is there peace for you? Is there peace for your husband? Is there peace for the boy? And she said, Peace.
brenton_translation: Now run to meet her, and thou shalt say, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? and she said, It is well.

fresh_translation: And she came to Elisaie at the mountain and seized his feet, and Giezi came near to push her away, and Elisaie said, Leave her, because her soul is bitter within her, and the Lord hid it from me and did not tell me.
brenton_translation: And she came to Elisaie to the mountain, and laid hold of his feet; and Giezi drew near to thrust her away. And Elisaie said, Let her alone, for her soul is much grieved in her, and the Lord has hidden it from me, and has not told it me.

fresh_translation: And she said, Did I ask for a son from my lord? Did I not say, Do not mislead me?
brenton_translation: And she said, Did I ask a son of my lord? For did I not say, Do not deal deceitfully with me?

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to Giezi, Gird your waist and take my staff in your hand and go, because if you meet a man you shall not bless him, and if a man blesses you, you shall not answer him, and you shall put my staff on the face of the boy.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said to Giezi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thy hand, and go: if thou meet any man, thou shalt not salute him, and if a man salute thee thou shalt not answer him: and thou shalt lay my staff on the child's face.

fresh_translation: And the mother of the boy said, As the Lord lives and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And Elisaie rose and went after her.
brenton_translation: And the mother of the child said, As the Lord lives and as thy soul lives, I will not leave thee. And Elisaie arose, and went after her.

fresh_translation: And Giezi passed before her and placed the staff on the face of the boy, but there was no voice and there was no hearing, and he returned to meet him and reported to him, saying, The boy did not wake up.
brenton_translation: And Giezi went on before her, and laid his staff on the child's face: but there was neither voice nor any hearing. So he returned to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie entered into the house, and behold, the boy was dead, laid on his bed.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie went into the house, and, behold, the dead child was laid upon his bed.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie went into the house and shut the door upon the two of them and prayed to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie went into the house, and shut the door upon themselves, the two, and prayed to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he went up and lay upon the boy and put his mouth on his mouth and his eyes on his eyes and his hands on his hands and bent himself over him, and the flesh of the boy grew warm.
brenton_translation: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands; and bowed himself upon him, and the flesh of the child grew warm.

fresh_translation: And he turned and walked in the house here and there and went up and bent himself over the boy until seven times, and the boy opened his eyes.
brenton_translation: And he returned, and walked up and down in the house: and he went up, and bowed himself on the child seven times; and the child opened his eyes.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie cried out to Giezi and said, Call this Sōmanite. And he called her, and she came in to him, and Elisaie said, Take your son.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie cried out to Giezi, and said, Call this Somanite. So he called her, and she came in to him: and Elisaie said, Take thy son.

fresh_translation: And the woman came in and fell at his feet and bowed to the ground, and she took her son and went out.
brenton_translation: And the woman went in, and fell at his feet, and did obeisance bowing to the ground; and she took her son, and went out.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie returned to Galgala, and famine was in the land, and the sons of the prophets sat before him, and Elisaie said to his servant-boy, Set on the great pot and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie returned to Galgala: and a famine was in the land; and the sons of the prophets sat before him: and Elisaie said to his servant, Set on the great pot, and boil pottage for the sons of the prophets.

fresh_translation: And one went out into the field to gather herbs and found a vine in the field and gathered from it wild gourds, his garment full, and put them into the pot of stew, because they did not know them.
brenton_translation: And he went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a vine in the field, and gathered of it wild gourds, his garment full; and he cast it into the caldron of pottage, for they knew them not.

fresh_translation: And they poured it out for the men to eat, and it came to be while they were eating from the stew, behold, they cried out and said, Death in the pot, man of God, and they were not able to eat.
brenton_translation: And he poured it out for the men to eat: and it came to pass, when they were eating of the pottage, that lo! they cried out, and said, There is death in the pot, O man of God. And they could not eat.

fresh_translation: And he said, Take flour and throw it into the pot. And Elisaie said to Giezi the servant-boy, Pour out to the people and let them eat. And there was no longer any evil thing in the pot.
brenton_translation: And he said, Take meal, and cast it into the pot. And Elisaie said to his servant Giezi, Pour out for the people, and let them eat. And there was no longer there any hurtful thing in the pot.

fresh_translation: And a man came from Baithsarisa and brought to the man of God firstfruits, twenty barley loaves and fresh ears in a sack, and he said, Give to the people and let them eat.
brenton_translation: And there came a man over from Bætharisa, and brought to the man of God twenty barley loaves and cakes of figs, of the first-fruits. And he said, Give to the people, and let them eat.

fresh_translation: And his attendant said, What shall I give this before one hundred men? And he said, Give to the people and let them eat, because thus says the Lord: They will eat and leave some.
brenton_translation: And his servant said, Why should I set this before a hundred men? and he said, Give to the people, and let them eat; for thus saith the Lord, They shall eat and leave.

fresh_translation: And they ate and left some, according to the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they ate and left, according to the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Naiman, commander of the force of Syria, was a great man before his lord and honored in face, because through him the Lord gave salvation to Syria; and the man was mighty in strength, afflicted with skin-disease.
brenton_translation: Now Naiman, the captain of the host of Syria, was a great man before his master, and highly respected, because by him the Lord had given deliverance to Syria, and the man was mighty in strength, but a leper.

fresh_translation: And Syria had gone out in raiding bands and taken captive from the land of Israel a small young girl, and she was before the wife of Naiman.
brenton_translation: And the Syrians went forth in small bands, and took captive out of the land of Israel a little maid: and she waited on Naiman's wife.

fresh_translation: And she said to her mistress, If only my lord were before the prophet of God in Samaria. Then he would remove him from his skin-disease.
brenton_translation: And she said to her mistress, O that my lord were before the prophet of God in Samaria; then he would recover him from his leprosy.

fresh_translation: And he went in and reported to his lord, saying, Thus and thus spoke the young girl from the land of Israel.
brenton_translation: And she went in and told her lord, and said, Thus and thus spoke the maid from the land of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the king of Syria said to Naiman, Come, go in, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel. And he went and took in his hand ten talents of silver and six thousand pieces of gold and ten changes of garments.
brenton_translation: And the king of Syria said to Naiman, Go to, go, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel. And he went, and took in his hand ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

fresh_translation: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, And now, when this letter comes to you, behold, I have sent to you Naiman my servant, and you shall remove him from his skin-disease.
brenton_translation: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now then, as soon as this letter shall reach thee, behold, I have sent to thee my servant Naiman, and thou shalt recover him from his leprosy.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his garments and said, Am I God, to kill and make alive, that this man sends to me to remove a man from his skin-disease? Only recognize now and see that he is seeking a pretext against me.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel read the letter, that he rent his garments, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to recover a man of his leprosy? consider, however, I pray you, and see that this man seeks an occasion against me.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when Elisaie heard that the king of Israel tore his garments, he sent to the king of Israel, saying, Why have you torn your garments? Let Naiman now come to me, and let him know that there is a prophet in Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when Elisaie heard that the king of Israel had rent his garments, that he sent to the king of Israel, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy garments? Let Naiman, I pray thee, come to me, and let him know that there is a prophet in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Naiman came with horse and chariot and stood at the door of the house of Elisaie.
brenton_translation: So Naiman came with horse and chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisaie.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie sent a messenger to him, saying, Go, wash seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will return to you, and you will be cleansed.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie sent a messenger to him, saying, Go and wash seven times in Jordan, and thy flesh shall return to thee, and thou shalt be cleansed.

fresh_translation: And Naiman grew angry and went away and said, Behold, I said to myself that he would surely come out to me and stand and call on the name of his God and put his hand on the place and remove the skin-diseased part.
brenton_translation: And Naiman was angry, and departed, and said, Behold, I said, He will by all means come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of his God, and lay his hand upon the place, and recover the leper.

fresh_translation: Are not Abana and Pharphar, rivers of Damascus, better than the Jordan and all the waters of Israel? If I go and wash in them, will I not be cleansed? And he turned aside and went away in anger.
brenton_translation: Are not Abana and Pharphar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not go and wash in them, and be cleansed? and he turned and went away in a rage.

fresh_translation: And his servants came near and spoke to him, saying, Father, if the prophet had spoken a great word to you, would you not do it? How much more when he said to you, Wash and be cleansed.
brenton_translation: And his servants came near and said to him, Suppose the prophet had spoken a great thing to thee, wouldest thou not perform it? yet he has but said to thee, Wash, and be cleansed.

fresh_translation: And Naiman went down and immersed himself in the Jordan seven times according to the word of Elisaie, and his flesh returned like the flesh of a small boy, and he was cleansed.
brenton_translation: So Naiman went down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the word of Elisaie: and his flesh returned to him as the flesh of a little child, and he was cleansed.

fresh_translation: And he returned to Elisaie, he and all his camp, and came and stood and said, Behold now, I know that there is no God in all the earth except in Israel. And now take a blessing from your servant.
brenton_translation: And he and all his company returned to Elisaie, and he came and stood before him, and said, Behold, I know that there is no God in all the earth, save only in Israel: and now receive a blessing of thy servant.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said, As the Lord lives, before whom I stand, I will not take it. And he pressed him to take it, but he refused.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said, As the Lord lives, before whom I stand, I will not take one. And he pressed him to take one: but he would not.

fresh_translation: And Naiman said, If not, then let there be given to your servant a load of red earth, as much as a pair of mules can carry, for your servant will no longer make whole-burnt-offering or sacrifice to other gods, but only to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Naiman said, Well then, if not, let there be given to thy servant, I pray thee, the load of a yoke of mules; and thou shalt give me of the red earth: for henceforth thy servant will not offer whole-burnt-offering or sacrifice to other gods, but only to the Lord by reason of this thing.

fresh_translation: In this matter may the Lord be merciful to your servant: when my lord enters the house of Remman to bow there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow in the house of Remman, when I bow in the house of Remman, may the Lord be merciful to your servant in this matter.
brenton_translation: And let the Lord be propitious to thy servant when my master goes into the house of Remman to worship there, and he shall lean on my hand, and I shall bow down in the house of Remman when he bows down in the house of Remman; even let the Lord, I pray, be merciful to thy servant in this matter.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to Naiman, Go in peace. And he went away from him a short stretch of land.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said to Naiman, Go in peace. And he departed from him a little way.

fresh_translation: And Giezi, the servant-boy of Elisaie, said, Behold, my lord spared this Naiman the Syrian by not taking from his hand what he brought. As the Lord lives, unless I run after him and take something from him.
brenton_translation: And Giezi the servant of Elisaie said, Behold, my Lord has spared this Syrian Naiman, so as not to take of his hand what he has brought: as the Lord lives, I will surely run after him, and take somewhat of him.

fresh_translation: And Giezi pursued after Naiman, and Naiman saw him running after him and turned back from the chariot to meet him.
brenton_translation: So Giezi followed after Naiman: and Naiman saw him running after him, and turned back from his chariot to meet him.

fresh_translation: And he said, Peace. My lord has sent me, saying, Behold, now two servant-boys have come to me from the hill-country of Ephraim, from the sons of the prophets. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of garments.
brenton_translation: And Giezi said, All is well: my master has sent me, saying, Behold, now are there come to me two young men of the sons of the prophets from mount Ephraim; give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of raiment.

fresh_translation: And Naiman said, Take two talents of silver. And he bound them in two bags, with two changes of garments, and gave them to two of his servant-boys, and they carried them before him.
brenton_translation: And Naiman said, Take two talents of silver. And he took two talents of silver in two bags, and two changes of raiment, and put them upon two of his servants, and they bore them before him.

fresh_translation: And they came to the hidden place, and he took them from their hands and stored them in the house and sent the men away.
brenton_translation: And he came to a secret place, and took them from their hands, and laid them up in the house, and dismissed the men.

fresh_translation: And he himself went in and stood by his lord. And Elisaie said to him, Where have you come from, Giezi? And Giezi said, Your servant did not go here or there.
brenton_translation: And he went in himself and stood before his master; and Elisaie said to him,

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to him, Did not my heart go with you when the man turned back from his chariot to meet you? Is now the time to take silver and to take garments and olive-groves and vineyards and sheep and cattle and male servants and female servants?
brenton_translation: Whence comest thou, Giezi? and Giezi said, Thy servant has not been hither or thither. And Elisaie said to him, Went not my heart with thee, when the man returned from his chariot to meet thee? and now thou hast received silver, and now thou hast received raiment, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants.

fresh_translation: And the skin-disease of Naiman will cling to you and to your seed forever. And he went out from before him afflicted with skin-disease like snow.
brenton_translation: The leprosy also of Naiman shall cleave to thee, and to thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence leprous, like snow.

fresh_translation: And the sons of the prophets said to Elisaie, Behold now, the place where we dwell before you is too narrow for us.
brenton_translation: And the sons of the prophets said to Elisaie, Behold now, the place wherein we dwell before thee is too narrow for us.

fresh_translation: Let us go now as far as the Jordan, and let each man take from there one beam, and let us make for ourselves there a place to dwell there. And he said, Go.
brenton_translation: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and make for ourselves a habitation there.

fresh_translation: And one said, Please come with your servants. And he said, I will go.
brenton_translation: And he said, Go. And one of them said gently, Come with thy servants. And he said, I will go.

fresh_translation: And he went with them. And they came to the Jordan and were cutting the wood.
brenton_translation: And he went with them, and they came to Jordan, and began to cut down wood.

fresh_translation: And behold, one was felling the beam, and the iron fell into the water, and he cried out, Alas, master, and it was borrowed.
brenton_translation: And behold, one was cutting down a beam, and the axe head fell into the water: and he cried out, Alas! master: and it was hidden.

fresh_translation: And the man of God said, Where did it fall? And he showed him the place, and he cut off a stick and threw it there, and the iron floated.
brenton_translation: And the man of God said, Where did it fall? and he shewed him the place: and he broke off a stick, and threw it in there, and the iron came to the surface.

fresh_translation: And he said, Lift it up for yourself. And he stretched out his hand and took it.
brenton_translation: And he said, Take it up to thyself. And he stretched out his hand, and took it.

fresh_translation: And the king of Syria was warring against Israel and consulted with his servants, saying, At such and such a place I will encamp.
brenton_translation: And the king of Syria was at war with Israel: and he consulted with his servants, saying, I will encamp in such a place.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie sent to the king of Israel, saying, Beware of passing by this place, because Syria is hidden there.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie sent to the king of Israel, saying, Take heed that thou pass not by that place, for the Syrians are hidden there.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel sent to the place of which Elisaie spoke to him and was on guard there, not once nor twice.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel sent to the place which Elisaie mentioned to him, and saved himself thence not once or twice.

fresh_translation: And the soul of the king of Syria was thrown into confusion over this matter, and he called his servants and said to them, Will you not tell me who is betraying me to the king of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the mind of the king of Syria was very much disturbed concerning this thing; and he called his servants, and said to them, Will ye not tell me who betrays me to the king of Israel?

fresh_translation: And one of his servants said, No, my lord king. Rather Elisaie the prophet in Israel tells the king of Israel all the words that you speak in the chamber of your bed.
brenton_translation: And one of his servants said, Nay, my Lord, O king, for Elisaie the prophet that is in Israel reports to the king of Israel all the words whatsoever thou mayest say in thy bedchamber.

fresh_translation: And he said, Come, see where this man is, and I will send and take him. And they reported to him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothaim.
brenton_translation: And he said, Go, see where this man is, and I will send and take him. And they sent word to him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothaim.

fresh_translation: And he sent there horse and chariot and a heavy force, and they came by night and surrounded the city.
brenton_translation: And he sent thither horses, and chariots, and a mighty host: and they came by night, and compassed about the city.

fresh_translation: And the servant of Elisaie rose early and went out, and behold, a force was surrounding the city, with horse and chariot. And the servant-boy said to him, Alas, master, what shall we do?
brenton_translation: And the servant of Elisaie rose up early and went out; and, behold, a host compassed the city, and horses and chariots: and the servant said to him, O master, what shall we do?

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said, Do not fear, because those with us are more than those with them.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said, Fear not, for they who are with us are more than they that are with them.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie prayed and said, Lord, open the eyes of the servant-boy and let him see. And the Lord opened his eyes, and he saw, and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisaie.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie prayed, and said, Lord, open, I pray thee, the eyes of the servant, and let him see. And the Lord opened his eyes, and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses, and there were chariots of fire round about Elisaie.

fresh_translation: And they came down toward him, and Elisaie prayed to the Lord and said, Strike this nation with blindness now. And he struck them with blindness according to the word of Elisaie.
brenton_translation: And they came down to him; and he prayed to the Lord, and said, Smite, I pray thee, this people with blindness. And he smote them with blindness, according to the word of Elisaie.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to them, This is not the city, and this is not the way. Come after me, and I will lead you to the man whom you seek. And he led them into Samaria.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said to them, This is not the city, and this is not the way: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. And he led them away to Samaria.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when they entered Samaria, Elisaie said, Lord, open now their eyes and let them see. And the Lord opened their eyes and they saw, and behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when they entered into Samaria, that Elisaie said, Open, I pray thee, O Lord, their eyes, and let them see. And the Lord opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said, when he saw them, Shall I strike them down, father? Shall I strike them down?
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Elisaie, when he saw them, Shall I not verily smite them, my father?

fresh_translation: And he said, You shall not strike them down. Would you strike down those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, and let them eat and drink and go to their lord.
brenton_translation: And he said, Thou shalt not smite them, unless thou wouldest smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow: set bread and water before them, and let them eat and drink, and depart to their master.

fresh_translation: And he set before them a great feast, and they ate and drank, and he sent them away, and they went to their lord. And raiding bands of Syria did not continue to come into the land of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he set before them a great feast, and they ate and drank: and he dismissed them, and they departed to their master. And the bands of Syria came no longer into the land of Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after this that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his camp and went up and besieged Samaria.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this, that the son of Ader king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

fresh_translation: And there was a great famine in Samaria, and behold, they besieged it until a donkey's head was fifty shekels of silver and a quarter of a kab of dove's dung was five shekels of silver.
brenton_translation: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was valued at fifty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung at five pieces of silver.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel was passing over the wall, and a woman cried to him, saying, Save, my lord king.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, and a woman cried to him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, If the Lord does not save you, from where shall I save you? From the threshing floor or from the winepress?
brenton_translation: And he said to her, Unless the Lord help thee, whence shall I help thee? from the corn-floor, or from the wine-press?

fresh_translation: And the king said to her, What troubles you? And the woman said, This woman said to me, Give your son, and let us eat him today, and my son we will eat tomorrow.
brenton_translation: And the king said to her, What is the matter with thee? And the woman said to him, This woman said to me, Give thy son, and we will eat him to-day, and we will eat my son to-morrow.

fresh_translation: And we boiled my son and ate him, and I said to her on the second day, Give your son and let us eat him, and she hid her son.
brenton_translation: So we boiled my son, and ate him; and I said to her on the second day, Give thy son, and let us eat him: and she has hidden her son.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his garments. And he was passing over the wall, and the people saw the sackcloth on his flesh within.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel heard the words of the woman, that he rent his garments; and he passed by on the wall, and the people saw sackcloth within upon his flesh.

fresh_translation: And he said, Thus may God do to me and thus may he add, if the head of Elisaie son of Shaphat remains on him today.
brenton_translation: And he said, God do so to me and more also, if the head of Elisaie shall stand upon him this day.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him, and the king sent a man from before him. Before the messenger came to him, Elisaie said to the elders, Do you see that this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? See, when the messenger comes, shut the door and press him at the door. Is not the sound of the feet of his lord behind him?
brenton_translation: And Elisaie was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him; and the king sent a man before him: before the messenger came to him, he also said to the elders, Do ye see that this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? See, as soon as the messenger shall have come, shut the door, and forcibly detain him at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?

fresh_translation: While he was still speaking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him and said, Behold, this evil is from the Lord. Why should I wait for the Lord any longer?
brenton_translation: While he was yet speaking with them, behold, a messenger came to him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the Lord; why should I wait for the Lord any longer?

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said, Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord: At this time tomorrow a measure of fine flour will be a shekel, and two measures of barley a shekel, at the gates of Samaria.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said, Hear thou the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord, As at this time, to-morrow a measure of fine flour shall be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gates of Samaria.
