fresh_translation: And the officer on whose hand the king leaned answered Elisaie and said, Behold, if the Lord makes floodgates in heaven, can this thing be? And Elisaie said, Behold, you will see with your eyes, but from there you will not eat.
brenton_translation: And the officer on whose hand the king rested, answered Elisaie, and said, Behold, if the Lord shall make flood-gates in heaven, might this thing be? and Elisaie said, Behold, thou shalt see with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

fresh_translation: And four men afflicted with skin-disease were beside the gate of the city. And one man said to his neighbor, Why do we sit here until we die?
brenton_translation: And there were four leprous men by the gate of the city: and one said to his neighbour, Why sit we here until we die?

fresh_translation: If we say, Let us enter the city, the famine is in the city, and we will die there. And if we sit here, we will die. And now come, let us fall into the camp of Syria. If they keep us alive, we will live; and if they put us to death, we will die.
brenton_translation: If we should say, Let us go into the city, then there is famine in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit here, then we shall die. Now then come, and let us fall upon the camp of the Syrians: if they should take us alive, then we shall live; and if they should put us to death, then we shall only die.

fresh_translation: And they rose in the dark to enter the camp of Syria and came to the edge of the camp of Syria, and behold, no man was there.
brenton_translation: And they rose up while it was yet night, to go into the camp of Syria; and they came into a part of the camp of Syria, and behold, there was no man there.

fresh_translation: For the Lord had made the camp of Syria hear a sound of chariot and a sound of horse and a sound of great force, and one man said to his brother, Behold now, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Egypt to come against us.
brenton_translation: For the Lord had made the army of Syria to hear a sound of chariots, and a sound of horses, even the sound of a great host: and each man said to his fellow, Now has the king of Israel hired against us the kings of the Chettites, and the kings of Egypt, to come against us.

fresh_translation: And they rose and fled in the dark and abandoned their tents and their horses and their donkeys, the camp just as it was, and fled for their own life.
brenton_translation: And they arose and fled while it was yet dark, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses in the camp, as they were, and fled for their lives.

fresh_translation: And these men afflicted with skin-disease came to the edge of the camp and entered one tent and ate and drank and took from there silver and gold and clothing and went and hid them. And they returned and entered another tent and took from there and went and hid them.
brenton_translation: And these lepers entered a little way into the camp, and went into one tent, and ate and drank, and took thence silver, and gold, and raiment; and they went and returned thence, and entered into another tent, and took thence, and went and hid the spoil.

fresh_translation: And one man said to his neighbor, We are not doing right. This day is a day of good news, and we are keeping silent. If we wait until the morning light, lawlessness will find us. And now come, let us go in and report to the house of the king.
brenton_translation: And one man said to his neighbour, We are not doing well thus: this day is a day of glad tidings, and we hold our peace, and are waiting till the morning light, and shall find mischief: now then come, and let us go into the city, and report to the house of the king.

fresh_translation: And they went in and cried out to the gate of the city and reported to them, saying, We entered the camp of Syria, and behold, no man was there and no human voice, only horses tied and donkeys and the tents just as they were.
brenton_translation: So they went and cried toward the gate of the city, and reported to them, saying, We went into the camp of Syria, and, behold, there is not there a man, nor voice of man, only horses tied and asses, and their tents as they were.

fresh_translation: And the gatekeepers cried out and reported it inside the house of the king.
brenton_translation: And the porters cried aloud, and reported to the house of the king within.

fresh_translation: And the king rose by night and said to his servants, Let me now tell you what Syria has done to us. They know that we are hungry, and they went out from the camp and hid themselves in the field, saying, When they come out from the city, we will seize them alive and enter the city.
brenton_translation: And the king rose up by night, and said to his servants, I will now tell you what the Syrians have done to us. They knew that we are hungry; and they have gone forth from the camp and hidden themselves in the field, saying, They will come out of the city, and we shall catch them alive, and go into the city.

fresh_translation: And one of his servants answered and said, Let them take now five of the horses left, which were left here. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel that has come to an end. Let us send and see.
brenton_translation: And one of his servants answered and said, Let them now take five of the horses that were left, which were left here; behold, they are the number left to all the multitude of Israel; and we will send thither and see.

fresh_translation: And they took two mounted horsemen, and the king of Israel sent them after the king of Syria, saying, Go and see.
brenton_translation: So they took two horsemen; and the king of Israel sent after the king of Syria, saying, Go, and see.

fresh_translation: And they went after them as far as the Jordan, and behold, all the road was full of garments and vessels which Syria threw away in their panic. And the messengers returned and reported to the king.
brenton_translation: And they went after them even to Jordan: and, behold, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their panic. And the messengers returned, and brought word to the king.

fresh_translation: And the people went out and plundered the camp of Syria. And a measure of fine flour became a shekel, and two measures of barley a shekel, according to the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the people went out, and plundered the camp of Syria: and a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, according to the word of the Lord, and two measures of barley for a shekel.

fresh_translation: And the king had appointed the officer on whose hand he leaned over the gate, and the people trampled him in the gate, and he died, just as the man of God spoke when the king came down to him.
brenton_translation: And the king appointed the officer on whose hand the king leaned to have charge over the gate: and the people trampled on him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spoke when the messenger came down to him.

fresh_translation: And it came to be just as Elisaie had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley a shekel and a measure of fine flour a shekel will be at this time tomorrow in the gate of Samaria.
brenton_translation: So it came to pass as Elisaie had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley shall be sold for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel; and it shall be as at this time to-morrow in the gate of Samaria.

fresh_translation: And the officer answered Elisaie and said, Behold, if the Lord makes floodgates in heaven, can this thing be? And Elisaie said, Behold, you will see with your eyes, but from there you will not eat.
brenton_translation: And the officer answered Elisaie, and said, Behold, if the Lord makes flood-gates in heaven, shall this thing be? and Elisaie said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not eat thereof.

fresh_translation: And so it happened to him, and the people trampled him in the gate, and he died.
brenton_translation: And it was so: for the people trampled on him in the gate, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie spoke to the woman whose son he restored to life, saying, Rise and go, you and your house, and sojourn where you may sojourn, because the Lord has called for famine upon the land, and it has come upon the land seven years.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie spoke to the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thy house, and sojourn wherever thou mayest sojourn: for the Lord has called for a famine upon the land; indeed it is come upon the land for seven years.

fresh_translation: And the woman rose and did according to the word of Elisaie, and she and her house went and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
brenton_translation: And the woman arose, and did according to the word of Elisaie, both she and her house; and they sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at the end of seven years that the woman returned from the land of the Philistines to the city, and she came to cry to the king concerning her house and concerning her fields.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the expiration of the seven years, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines to the city; and came to cry to the king for her house and for her lands.

fresh_translation: And the king was speaking to Giezi the servant-boy of Elisaie, the man of God, saying, Tell me now all the great things Elisaie did.
brenton_translation: And the king spoke to Giezi the servant of Elisaie the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things which Elisaie has done.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, while he was recounting to the king how Elisaie restored a dead son to life, behold, the woman whose son Elisaie restored to life cried to the king concerning her house and her fields. And Giezi said, My lord king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisaie restored to life.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored to life the dead son, behold, the woman whose son Elisaie restored to life came crying to the king for her house and for her lands. And Giezi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisaie restored to life.

fresh_translation: And the king asked the woman, and she recounted it to him. And the king gave her one eunuch, saying, Restore all that was hers and all the produce of her field from the day she left the land until now.
brenton_translation: And the king asked the woman, and she told him: and the king appointed her a eunuch, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field from the day that she left the land until now.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie came to Damascus, and Ben-hadad king of Syria was sick. And they reported to him, saying, The man of God has come here.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie came to Damascus; and the king of Syria the son of Ader was ill, and they brought him word, saying, The man of God is come hither.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Hazael, Take in your hand a gift, and go to meet the man of God, and inquire of the Lord through him, saying, Shall I live from this sickness of mine?
brenton_translation: And the king said to Azael, Take in thine hand a present, and go to meet the man of God, and enquire of the Lord by him, saying, Shall I recover of this my disease?

fresh_translation: And Hazael went to meet him and took in his hand a gift, even every good thing of Damascus, a load of forty camels, and came and stood before him and said to Elisaie, Your son Ben-hadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, Shall I live from this sickness?
brenton_translation: And Azael went to meet him, and he took a present in his hand, and all the good things of Damascus, forty camels' load, and came and stood before him, and said to Elisaie, Thy son the son of Ader, the king of Syria, has sent me to thee to enquire, saying, Shall I recover of this my disease?

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said, Go, say to him, You will surely live, yet the Lord has shown me that he will surely die.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said, Go, say, Thou shalt certainly live; yet the Lord has shewed me that thou shalt surely die.

fresh_translation: And he fixed his face and held it until shame, and the man of God wept.
brenton_translation: And he stood before him, and fixed his countenance till he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

fresh_translation: And Hazael said, Why does my lord weep? And he said, Because I know what evils you will do to the sons of Israel. You will send their strongholds into fire, and their chosen men you will kill with the sword, and their infants you will dash, and their pregnant women you will rip open.
brenton_translation: And Azael said, Why does my lord weep? And he said, Because I know all the evil that thou wilt do to the children of Israel: thou wilt utterly destroy their strong holds with fire, and thou wilt slay their choice men with the sword, and thou wilt dash their infants against the ground, and their women with child thou wilt rip up.

fresh_translation: And Hazael said, What is your servant, this dead dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisaie said, The Lord has shown me you as king over Syria.
brenton_translation: And Azael said, Who is thy servant? a dead dog, that he should do this thing? And Elisaie said, The Lord has shewn me thee ruling over Syria.

fresh_translation: And he went from Elisaie and entered to his lord, and he said to him, What did Elisaie say to you? And he said, He said to me, You will surely live.
brenton_translation: And he departed from Elisaie, and went in to his lord; and he said to him, What said Elisaie to thee? and he said, He said to me, Thou shalt surely live.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the next day that he took a coverlet and dipped it in water and spread it over his face, and he died. And Hazael reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the next day that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and put it on his face, and he died: and Azael reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the fifth year of Joram son of Achaab, king of Israel, Jehoram son of Josaphat became king, king of Judah.
brenton_translation: In the fifth year of Joram son of Achaab king of Israel, and while Josaphat was king of Juda, Joram the son of Josaphat king of Juda began to reign.

fresh_translation: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as the house of Achaab had done, because the daughter of Achaab was his wife, and he did evil before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Achaab; for the daughter of Achaab was his wife: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Yet the Lord did not wish to destroy Judah because of Dauid his servant, as he said to give him a lamp and to his sons all the days.
brenton_translation: But the Lord would not destroy Juda for David his servant's sake, as he said he would give a light to him and to his sons continually.

fresh_translation: In his days Edom rebelled from under the hand of Judah and made a king reign over themselves.
brenton_translation: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Juda, and they made a king over themselves.

fresh_translation: And Joram went over to Sior, and all the chariots with him. And it came to be, when he rose by night, he struck Edom that had encircled him and the commanders of the chariots, and the people fled to their tents.
brenton_translation: And Joram went up to Sior, and all the chariots that were with him: and it came to pass after he had arisen, that he smote Edom who compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

fresh_translation: And Edom rebelled from under the hand of Judah until this day. Then Lobena rebelled at that time.
brenton_translation: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Juda till this day. Then Lobna revolted at that time.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Joram and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Joram slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dauid his father, and Ochozias his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: So Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David: and Ochozias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the twelfth year of Joram son of Achaab king of Israel, Ochozias son of Joram became king.
brenton_translation: In the twelfth year of Joram son of Achaab king of Israel, Ochozias son of Joram began to reign.

fresh_translation: Ochozias was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Gotholia, daughter of Ambrie king of Israel.
brenton_translation: Twenty and two years old was Ochozias when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem: and the name of his mother was Gotholia, daughter of Ambri king of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he walked in the way of the house of Achaab and did evil before the Lord, like the house of Achaab.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the way of the house of Achaab, and did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as did the house of Achaab.

fresh_translation: And he went with Joram son of Achaab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Remmoth Galaad, and the Syrians struck Joram.
brenton_translation: And he went with Joram the son of Achaab to war against Azael king of the Syrians in Remmoth Galaad; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

fresh_translation: And king Joram returned to be healed in Jezrael from the wounds which they struck him at Remmoth when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ochozias son of Joram went down to see Joram son of Achaab in Jezrael, because he was ill.
brenton_translation: And king Joram returned to be healed in Jezrael of the wounds with which they wounded him in Remmoth, when he fought with Azael king of Syria. And Ochozias son of Joram went down to see Joram the son of Achaab in Jezrael, because he was sick.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets and said to him, Gird your loins and take this flask of oil in your hand and go to Remmoth Galaad.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, Gird up thy loins, and take this cruse of oil in thy hand, and go to Remmoth Galaad.

fresh_translation: And you will enter there and see there Iou son of Iosaphat son of Namessi, and you will go in and raise him up from the midst of his brothers and bring him into an inner room within a room.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt enter there, and shalt see there Ju the son of Josaphat son of Namessi, and shalt go in and make him rise up from among his brethren, and shalt bring him into a secret chamber.

fresh_translation: Then take the flask of oil and pour it on his head and say, Thus says the Lord, I have anointed you as king over Israel. And you will open the door and flee and not stay.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take the cruse of oil, and pour it on his head, and say thou, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel: and thou shalt open the door, and flee, and not tarry.

fresh_translation: And the servant-boy, the prophet, went to Remmoth Galaad.
brenton_translation: And the young man the prophet went to Remmoth Galaad.

fresh_translation: And he entered, and behold, the commanders of the force were sitting, and he said, I have a word for you, commander. And Iou said, For which one among all of us? And he said, For you, commander.
brenton_translation: And he went in, and, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have a message to thee, O captain. And Ju said, To which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.

fresh_translation: And he rose and entered the house, and he poured the oil on his head and said to him, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, I have anointed you as king over the people of the Lord, over Israel.
brenton_translation: And he arose, and went into the house: and he poured the oil upon his head, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I have anointed thee to be king over the people of the Lord, even over Israel.

fresh_translation: And you shall destroy the house of Achaab your lord, and I will avenge the blood of my servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of the Lord from the hand of Jezabel.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt utterly destroy the house of Achaab thy master from before me, and shalt avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezabel,

fresh_translation: And I will cut off from the house of Achaab everyone who urinates against a wall, and one held fast and left behind in Israel.
brenton_translation: and at the hand of the whole house of Achaab: and thou shalt utterly cut off from the house of Achaab every male, and him that is shut up and left in Israel.

fresh_translation: And I will make the house of Achaab like the house of Ieroboam son of Nabat and like the house of Baasa son of Achia.
brenton_translation: And I will make the house of Achaab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and as the house of Baasa the son of Achia.

fresh_translation: And the dogs shall eat Jezabel in the portion of Jezrael, and there is none who buries. And he opened the door and fled.
brenton_translation: And the dogs shall eat Jezabel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.

fresh_translation: And Iou went out to the servants of his lord, and they said to him, Is all well? Why did this madman come to you? And he said to them, You know the man and his rambling.
brenton_translation: And Ju went forth to the servants of his lord, and they said to him, Is all well? Why came this mad fellow in to thee? And he said to them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

fresh_translation: And they said, It is false. Tell us now. And he said to them, Thus and thus he spoke to me, saying, Thus says the Lord, I have anointed you as king over Israel.
brenton_translation: And they said, It is wrong: tell us now. And Ju said to them, Thus and thus spoke he to me, saying,—and he said, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee to be king over Israel.

fresh_translation: And hearing, they hurried, and each took his garment and put it under him on the bare steps, and they blew on a horn and said, Iou reigns.
brenton_translation: And when they heard it, they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with the trumpet, and said, Ju is king.

fresh_translation: And Iou son of Iosaphat son of Namessi conspired against Ioram. And Ioram himself had been guarding Remmoth Galaad, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
brenton_translation: So Ju the son of Josaphat the son of Namessi conspired against Joram, and Joram was defending Remmoth Galaad, he and all Israel, because of Azael king of Syria.

fresh_translation: And Ioram the king returned to be healed in Jezrael from the wounds with which the Syrians struck him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Iou said, If your soul is with me, let none escape from the city to go and report in Jezrael.
brenton_translation: And king Joram had returned to be healed in Jezrael of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, in his war with Azael king of Syria.

fresh_translation: And Iou mounted and went to Jezrael, because Ioram was being healed there, and Ochozias king of Judah had gone down to see Ioram.
brenton_translation: And Ju rode and advanced, and came down to Jezrael; for Joram king of Israel was getting healed in Jezrael of the arrow-wounds wherewith the Syrians had wounded him in Rammath in the war with Azael king of Syria; for he was strong and a mighty man: and Ochozias king of Juda was come down to see Joram.

fresh_translation: And the watchman stood on the tower in Jezrael and saw the dust of Iou as he came and said, I see dust. And Ioram said, Take a rider and send him before them, and let him say, Is it peace?
brenton_translation: And there went up a watchman upon the tower of Jezrael, and saw the dust made by Ju as he approached; and he said, I see dust. And Joram said, Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Peace.

fresh_translation: And a horseman went to meet them and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? And Iou said, What is peace to you? Turn behind me. And the watchman reported, saying, The messenger came to them and did not return.
brenton_translation: And there went a horseman to meet them, and said, Thus says the king, Peace. And Ju said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn behind me. And the watchman reported, saying, The messenger came up to them, and has not returned.

fresh_translation: And he sent a second horseman, and he came to him and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? And Iou said, What is peace to you? Turn behind me.
brenton_translation: And he sent another horseman, and he came to him, and said, Thus says the king, Peace. And Ju said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn behind me.

fresh_translation: And the watchman reported, saying, He came to them and did not return, and the driving is like the driving of Iou son of Namessi, because he drives furiously.
brenton_translation: And the watchman reported, saying, He came up to them, and has not returned: and the driver drives Ju the son of Namessi, for it is with furious haste.

fresh_translation: And Ioram said, Harness. And they harnessed his chariot, and Ioram king of Israel and Ochozias king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, to meet Iou, and they found him in the portion of Nabouthai the Jezraelite.
brenton_translation: And Joram said, Make ready. And one made ready the chariot: and Joram the king of Israel went forth, and Ochozias king of Juda, each in his chariot, and they went to meet Ju, and found him in the portion of Nabuthai the Jezraelite.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when Ioram saw Iou, he said, Is it peace, Iou? And Iou said, What peace, while the whoredoms of Jezabel your mother and her many sorceries remain?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Joram saw Ju, that he said, Is it peace, Ju? And Ju said, How can it be peace? as yet there are the whoredoms of thy mother Jezabel, and her abundant witchcrafts.

fresh_translation: And Ioram turned his hands to flee and said to Ochozias, Treachery, Ochozias!
brenton_translation: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ochozias, Treachery, Ochozias.

fresh_translation: And Iou filled his hand with the bow and struck Ioram between his arms, and the arrow went out through his heart, and he bent upon his knees.
brenton_translation: And Ju bent his bow with his full strength, and smote Joram between his arms, and his arrow went out at his heart, and he bowed upon his knees.

fresh_translation: And Iou said to Badekar his officer, Lift him and throw him into the portion of the field of Nabouthai the Jezraelite, because I remember, I and you riding on pairs behind Achaab his father, and the Lord took up this burden against him, saying,
brenton_translation: And Ju said to Badecar his chief officer, Cast him into the portion of ground of Nabuthai the Jezraelite, for I and thou remember, riding as we were on chariots after Achaab his father, that the Lord took up this burden against him, saying,

fresh_translation: Surely the blood of Nabouthai and the blood of his sons I saw yesterday, says the Lord, and I will repay him in this portion, says the Lord. And now lift him and throw him into the portion according to the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Surely, I have seen yesterday the blood of Nabuthai, and the blood of his sons, saith the Lord; and I will recompense him in this portion, saith the Lord. Now then, I pray thee, take him up and cast him into the portion, according to the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Ochozias king of Judah saw and fled by way of Baithaggan, and Iou pursued after him and said, Strike him too. And they struck him in the chariot at the ascent of Gai, which is Ieblaam, and he fled to Mageddo and died there.
brenton_translation: And Ochozias king of Juda saw it, and fled by the way of Bæthgan. And Ju pursued after him, and said, Slay him also. And one smote him in the chariot at the going up of Gai, which is Jeblaam: and he fled to Mageddo, and died there.

fresh_translation: And his servants set him on the chariot and brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his tomb in the city of Dauid.
brenton_translation: And his servants put him on a chariot, and brought him to Jerusalem, and they buried him in his sepulchre in the city of David.

fresh_translation: And in the eleventh year of Ioram king of Israel, Ochozias reigned over Judah.
brenton_translation: And in the eleventh year of Joram king of Israel, Ochozias began to reign over Juda.

fresh_translation: And Iou came to Jezrael, and Jezabel heard and painted her eyes and adorned her head and looked out through the window.
brenton_translation: And Ju came to Jezrael; and Jezabel heard of it, and coloured her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked through the window.

fresh_translation: And as Iou was entering the city, she said, Is it peace, Zamri, murderer of his lord?
brenton_translation: And Ju entered into the city; and she said, Had Zambri, the murderer of his master, peace?

fresh_translation: And he lifted his face to the window and saw her and said, Who are you? Come down with me. And two eunuchs looked down toward him.
brenton_translation: And he lifted up his face toward the window, and saw her, and said, Who art thou? Come down with me. And two eunuchs looked down towards him.

fresh_translation: And he said, Roll her down. And they rolled her down, and some of her blood was spattered on the wall and on the horses, and they trampled her.
brenton_translation: And he said, Throw her down. And they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and they trampled on her.

fresh_translation: And he entered and ate and drank and said, See now to this cursed woman and bury her, because she is a king's daughter.
brenton_translation: And Ju went in and ate and drank, and said, Look now, after this cursed woman, and bury her, for she is a king's daughter.

fresh_translation: And they went to bury her and found nothing of her except the skull and the feet and the palms of the hands.
brenton_translation: And they went to bury her; but they found nothing of her but the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

fresh_translation: And they returned and reported to him, and he said, This is the word of the Lord which he spoke by the hand of his servant Elijah the Thesbite, saying, In the portion of Jezrael the dogs will eat the flesh of Jezabel.
brenton_translation: And they returned and told him. And he said, It is the word of the Lord, which he spoke by the hand of Eliu the Thesbite, saying, In the portion of Jezrael shall the dogs eat the flesh of Jezabel.

fresh_translation: And corpse of Jezabel will be like dung on the face of the field in the portion of Jezrael, so that they cannot say, This is Jezabel.
brenton_translation: And the carcase of Jezabel shall be as dung on the face of the field in the portion of Jezrael, so that they shall not say, This is Jezabel.

fresh_translation: And Achaab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Iou wrote a letter and sent it into Samaria to the rulers of Samaria and to the elders and to the guardians of the sons of Achaab, saying,
brenton_translation: And Achaab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Ju wrote a letter, and sent it into Samaria to the rulers of Samaria, and to the elders, and to the guardians of the children of Achaab, saying,

fresh_translation: And now when this letter comes to you, with you are the sons of your lord, and with you are the chariot and horses and fortified cities and weapons.
brenton_translation: Now then, as soon as this letter shall have reached you, whereas there are with you the sons of your master, and with you chariots and horses, and strong cities, and arms,

fresh_translation: And you will look for the good and upright among the sons of your lord and set him on the throne of his father, and fight for the house of your lord.
brenton_translation: do ye accordingly look out the best and fittest among your master's sons, and set him on the throne of his father, and fight for the house of your master.

fresh_translation: And they feared greatly and said, Behold, the two kings did not stand before him, and how shall we stand?
brenton_translation: And they feared greatly, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: and how shall we stand?

fresh_translation: And those over the house and those over the city and the elders and the guardians sent to Iou, saying, We are your servants, and whatever you say to us we will do. We will not make any man king. Do what is good in your eyes.
brenton_translation: So they that were over the house, and they that were over the city, and the elders and the guardians, sent to Ju, saying, We also are thy servants, and whatsoever thou shalt say to us we will do; we will not make any man king: we will do that which is right in thine eyes.

fresh_translation: And he wrote to them a second letter, saying, If you are for me and obey my voice, take the heads of the men, the sons of your lord, and bring them to me at this time tomorrow in Jezrael. And the sons of the king, seventy men, were with the great men of the city, those rearing them.
brenton_translation: And Ju wrote them a second letter, saying, If ye are for me, and hearken to my voice, take the heads of the men your master's sons, and bring them to me at this time to-morrow in Jezrael. Now the sons of the king were seventy men; these great men of the city brought them up.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the letter came to them, they took the sons of the king and slaughtered them, seventy men, and put their heads in baskets and sent them to him in Jezrael.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew them, even seventy men, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him at Jezrael.

fresh_translation: And the messenger came and reported, saying, They brought the heads of the sons of the king. And he said, Put them in two heaps by the doorway of the gate until morning.
brenton_translation: And a messenger came and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay them in two heaps by the door of the gate until the morning.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the morning, he went out and stood in the gate of the city and said to all the people, You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my lord and killed him, but who struck all these?
brenton_translation: And the morning came, and he went forth, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye are righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

fresh_translation: Know now that not one thing from the word of the Lord will fall to the ground, which the Lord spoke against the house of Achaab. And the Lord has done what he spoke by the hand of his servant Elijah.
brenton_translation: See now that there shall not fall to the ground anything of the word of the Lord which the Lord spoke against the house of Achaab: for the Lord has performed all that he spoke of by the hand of his servant Eliu.

fresh_translation: And Iou struck all those left of the house of Achaab in Jezrael and all his great men and his acquaintances and his priests until he left him no remnant.
brenton_translation: And Ju smote all that were left of the house of Achaab in Jezrael, and all his great men, and his acquaintance, and his priests, so as not to leave him any remnant.

fresh_translation: And he rose and went to Samaria, he at Baithakad of the shepherds on the way.
brenton_translation: And he arose and went to Samaria, and he was in the house of sheep-shearing in the way.

fresh_translation: And Iou found the brothers of Ochozias king of Judah and said, Who are you? And they said, We are brothers of Ochozias, and we came down to greet the sons of the king and the sons of the ruling lady.
brenton_translation: And Ju found the brethren of Ochozias king of Juda, and said, Who are ye? And they said, We are the brethren of Ochozias, and we have come down to salute the sons of the king, and the sons of the queen.

fresh_translation: And he said, Seize them alive. And they seized them alive and slaughtered them at Baithakad, forty-two men. He left not a man from among them.
brenton_translation: And he said, Take them alive. And they slew them at the shearing-house, forty and two men: he left not a man of them.

fresh_translation: And he went from there and found Ionadab son of Rechab on the way to meet him and blessed him and said to him, Is your heart straight with my heart, as my heart is with your heart? And Ionadab said, It is. And Iou said, If it is, give your hand. And he gave his hand, and he took him up to himself into the chariot.
brenton_translation: And he went thence and found Jonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him; and he saluted him, and Ju said to him, Is thy heart right with my heart, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jonadab said, It is. And Ju said, If it is then, give me thy hand. And he gave him his hand, and he took him up to him into the chariot.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Come with me and see in my zeal for the Lord Sabaoth. And he seated him in his chariot.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Come with me, and see me zealous for the Lord. And he caused him to sit in his chariot.

fresh_translation: And he entered Samaria and struck all those left to Achaab in Samaria until destroying him, according to the word of the Lord which he spoke to Elijah.
brenton_translation: And he entered into Samaria, and smote all that were left of Achaab in Samaria, until he had utterly destroyed him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spoke to Eliu.

fresh_translation: And Iou gathered all the people and said to them, Achaab served Baal a little; Iou will serve him much.
brenton_translation: And Ju gathered all the people, and said to them, Achaab served Baal a little; Ju shall serve him much.

fresh_translation: And now call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. Let not a man be overlooked, because I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Everyone who is overlooked will not live. And Iou did it in deception, in order to destroy the servants of Baal.
brenton_translation: Now then do all ye the prophets of Baal call all his servants and his priests to me; let not a man be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to offer to Baal; every one who shall be missing shall die. But Ju did it in subtilty, that he might destroy the servants of Baal.

fresh_translation: And Iou said, Sanctify a festival for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
brenton_translation: And Ju said, Sanctify a solemn festival to Baal, and they made a proclamation.

fresh_translation: And Iou sent through all Israel, and all the servants of Baal and all his priests and all his prophets came. No one was left out who did not come. And they entered the house of Baal, and the house of Baal was filled from mouth to mouth.
brenton_translation: And Ju sent throughout all Israel, saying, Now then let all Baal's servants, and all his priests, and all his prophets come, let none be lacking: for I am going to offer a great sacrifice; whosoever shall be missing, shall not live. So all the servants of Baal came, and all his priests, and all his prophets: there was not one left who came not. And they entered into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to the other.

fresh_translation: And Iou said to the one over the wardrobe, Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal. And the dresser brought out garments for them.
brenton_translation: And he said to the man who was over the house of the wardrobe, Bring forth a robe for all the servants of Baal. And the keeper of the robes brought forth to them.

fresh_translation: And Iou and Ionadab son of Rechab entered the house of Baal and said to the servants of Baal, Search and see whether there is with you any of the servants of the Lord, because only the servants of Baal are here.
brenton_translation: And Ju and Jonadab the son of Rechab entered into the house of Baal, and said to the servants of Baal, Search, and see whether there is among you any of the servants of the Lord, or only the servants of Baal, by themselves.

fresh_translation: And they went in to offer the sacrifices and whole-burnt-offerings. And Iou stationed for himself outside eighty men and said, The man who lets escape any from the men whom I bring into your hands, his life will be for that man's life.
brenton_translation: And he went in to offer sacrifices and whole-burnt-offerings; and Ju set for himself eighty men without, and said, Every man who shall escape of the men whom I bring into your hand, the life of him that spares him shall go for his life.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when he finished offering the whole-burnt-offering, Iou said to the runners and to the officers, Go in and strike them down. Let not a man come out. And they struck them with the edge of the sword, and the runners and the officers cast them out and went into the inner city of the house of Baal.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when he had finished offering the whole-burnt-offering, that Ju said to the footmen and the officers, Go ye in and slay them; let not a man of them escape. So they smote them with the edge of the sword, and the footmen and the officers cast the bodies forth, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

fresh_translation: And they brought out the pillar of Baal and burned it.
brenton_translation: And they brought out the pillar of Baal, and burnt it.

fresh_translation: And they tore down the pillars of Baal and demolished the house of Baal and made it latrines to this day.
brenton_translation: And they tore down the pillars of Baal, and made his house a draught-house until this day.

fresh_translation: And Iou destroyed Baal from Israel.
brenton_translation: So Ju abolished Baal out of Israel.

fresh_translation: Only, from the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin, Iou did not turn away from after them, the golden calves in Baithēl and in Dan.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless Ju departed not from following the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin: these were the golden heifers in Bæthel and in Dan.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Iou, Because you did well in doing what was right in my eyes and did to the house of Achaab all that was in my heart, fourth sons will sit for you on the throne of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Ju, Because of all thy deeds wherein thou hast acted well in doing that which was right in my eyes, according to all things which thou hast done to the house of Achaab as they were in my heart, thy sons to the fourth generation shall sit upon the throne of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Iou was not careful to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart. He did not turn from the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: But Ju took no heed to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart: he departed not from following the sins of Jeroboam, who made Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: In those days the Lord began to cut away in Israel, and Hazael struck them in every border of Israel,
brenton_translation: In those days the Lord began to cut Israel short; and Azael smote them in every coast of Israel;

fresh_translation: from the Jordan toward sunrise, all the land of Galaad, of Gad and of Rouben and of Manasse, from Aroēr, which is on the lip of the wadi Arnon, even Galaad and Basan.
brenton_translation: from Jordan eastward all the land of Galaad belonging to the Gadites, of Gaddi and that of Ruben, and of Manasses, from Aroer, which is on the brink of the brook of Arnon, and Galaad and Basan.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Iou and all that he did and all his might, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ju, and all that he did, and all his might, and the wars wherein he engaged, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Iou slept with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria, and Ioachas his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ju slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joachaz his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And the days which Iou reigned over Israel were twenty-eight years in Samaria.
brenton_translation: And the days which Ju reigned over Israel were twenty-eight years in Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Gotholia, the mother of Ochozias, saw that her sons were dead, and she destroyed all the royal seed.
brenton_translation: And Gotholia the mother of Ochozias saw that her son was dead, and she destroyed all the seed royal.

fresh_translation: And Iosabee daughter of king Ioram, sister of Ochozias, took Ioas son of her brother and stole him from the midst of the sons of the king being put to death, him and his nurse, into the bedchamber, and hid him from Gotholia, and he was not put to death.
brenton_translation: And Josabee daughter of king Joram, sister of Ochozias, took Joas the son of her brother, and stole him from among the king's sons that were put to death, secreting him and his nurse in the bedchamber, and hid him from the face of Gotholia, and he was not slain.

fresh_translation: And he was with her hidden in the house of the Lord six years, while Gotholia was reigning over the land.
brenton_translation: And he remained with her hid in the house of the Lord six years: and Gotholia reigned over the land.

fresh_translation: And in the seventh year Iōdae the priest sent and took the centurions, the Chorrhi and the Rasim, and brought them to himself into the house of the Lord and made a covenant with them before the Lord and made them swear and showed them the king's son.
brenton_translation: And in the seventh year Jodae sent and took the captains of hundreds of the Chorri and of the Rhasim, and brought them to him into the house of the Lord, and made a covenant of the Lord with them, and adjured them, and Jodae shewed them the king's son.

fresh_translation: And he commanded them, saying, This is the word that you shall do: a third of you, those entering on the Sabbath, shall keep watch of the king's house at the gate.
brenton_translation: And charged them, saying, This is the thing which ye shall do.

fresh_translation: And a third at the gate of the roads and a third at the gate behind the runners, and you shall keep the watch of the house.
brenton_translation: Let a third part of you go in on the sabbath-day, and keep ye the watch of the king's house in the porch; and another third in the gate of the high way, and a third at the gate behind the footmen; and keep ye the guard of the house.

fresh_translation: And two divisions among you, all going out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of the house of the Lord for the king.
brenton_translation: And there shall be two parties among you, even every one that goes out on the sabbath, and they shall keep the guard of the Lord's house before the king.

fresh_translation: And surround the king all around, each man with his weapon in his hand, and the one entering within the ranks shall die. And be with the king in his going out and in his coming in.
brenton_translation: And do ye compass the king about every man with his weapon in his hand, and he that goes into the ranges shall die: and they shall be with the king in his going out and in his coming in.

fresh_translation: And the centurions did all that Iōdae the priest commanded, and each man took his men, those entering on the Sabbath along with those going out on the Sabbath, and came to Iōdae the priest.
brenton_translation: And the captains of hundreds did all things that the wise Jodae commanded; and they took each his men, both those that went in on the sabbath-day, and those that went out on the sabbath-day, and went in to Jodae the priest.

fresh_translation: And the priest gave to the centurions the king Dauid's spears and shields, those in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priest gave to the captains of hundreds the swords and spears of king David that were in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the runners stood, each man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, by the altar and the house, around the king.
brenton_translation: And the footmen stood each with his weapon in his hand from the right corner of the house to the left corner of the house, by the altar and the house round about the king.

fresh_translation: And he brought out the king's son and put on him the crown and the testimony and made him king and anointed him, and they clapped with the hand and said, Let the king live.
brenton_translation: And he brought forth the king's son, and put upon him the crown and gave him the testimony; and he made him king, and anointed him: and they clapped their hands, and said, Long live the king.

fresh_translation: And Gotholia heard the sound of the runners of the people and entered to the people in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Gotholia heard the sound of the people running, and she went in to the people to the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And she saw, and behold, the king was standing by the pillar according to the custom, and the singers and the trumpets were by the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing with trumpets. And Gotholia tore her garments and cried, Conspiracy, conspiracy!
brenton_translation: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood near a pillar according to the manner; and the singers and the trumpeters were before the king and all the people of the land even rejoicing and sounding with trumpets: and Gotholia rent her garments, and cried, A conspiracy, a conspiracy.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae the priest commanded the centurions, the officers of the force, and said to them, Bring her out from within the ranks, and whoever enters after her shall certainly be put to death by the sword, because the priest said, Let her not die in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jodae the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were over the host, and said to them, Bring her forth without the ranges, and he that goes in after her shall certainly die by the sword. For the priest said, Let her not however be slain in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they laid hands on her, and she went by way of the horse entrance of the king's house, and she died there.
brenton_translation: And they laid hands upon her, and went in by the way of the horses' entrance into the house of the Lord, and she was slain there.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae made a covenant between the Lord and the king and the people, that they should be a people to the Lord, and between the king and the people.
brenton_translation: And Jodae made a covenant between the Lord and the king and the people, that they should be the Lord's people; also between the king and the people.

fresh_translation: And all the people of the land entered the house of Baal and tore it down, and his altars and his images they broke well, and Matthan priest of Baal they killed before the altars. And the priest set overseers over the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and tore it down, and completely broke in pieces his altars and his images, and they slew Mathan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed overseers over the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he took the centurions and the Chorrhi and the Rasim and all the people of the land and brought the king down from the house of the Lord and entered by way of the gate of the runners to the king's house, and they seated him on the throne of the kings.
brenton_translation: And he took the captains of the hundreds, and the Chorri, and the Rhasim, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king out of the house of the Lord; and they went in by the way of the gate of the footmen of the king's house, and seated him there on the throne of the kings.

fresh_translation: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet, and they put Gotholia to death by the sword in the king's house.
brenton_translation: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was at rest: and they slew Gotholia with the sword in the house of the king.

fresh_translation: Ioas was seven years old when he became king.
brenton_translation: Joas was seven years old when he began to reign.

fresh_translation: In the seventh year of Iou, Ioas became king, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Abia from Bērsabee.
brenton_translation: Joas began to reign in the seventh year of Ju, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Sabia of Bersabee.

fresh_translation: And Ioas did what was right before the Lord all the days in which Iōdae the priest instructed him.
brenton_translation: And Joas did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all the days that Jodae the priest instructed him.

fresh_translation: Only, the high places were not removed, and there the people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.
brenton_translation: Only there were not any of the high places removed, and the people still sacrificed there, and burned incense on the high places.

fresh_translation: And Ioas said to the priests, All the silver of the holy things brought into the house of the Lord, silver of assessment, a man's silver from assessed value, every silver that comes up upon a man's heart to bring into the house of the Lord,
brenton_translation: And Joas said to the priests, As for all the money of the holy things that is brought into the house of the Lord, the money of valuation, as each man brings the money of valuation, all the money which any man may feel disposed to bring into the house of the Lord,

fresh_translation: let the priests take it for themselves, each from his collection, and they themselves shall repair the breach of the house wherever any breach is found there.
brenton_translation: let the priests take it to themselves, every man from the proceeds of his sale: and they shall repair the breaches of the house in all places wheresoever a breach shall be found.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the twenty-third year of king Ioas, the priests had not repaired the breach of the house.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the twenty-third year of king Joas the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

fresh_translation: And king Ioas called Iōdae the priest and the priests and said to them, Why is it that you do not repair the breach of the house? And now do not take silver from your collections, because you will give it for the breach of the house.
brenton_translation: And king Joas called Jodae the priest, and the other priests, and said to them, Why have ye not repaired the breaches of the house? now then receive no more money from your sales, for ye shall give it to repair the breaches of the house.

fresh_translation: And the priests agreed not to take silver from the people and not to repair the breach of the house.
brenton_translation: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, and not to repair the breaches of the house.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae the priest took one chest and bored a hole in its lid and set it beside the altar, at the right side as a man enters the house of the Lord. And the priests keeping the threshold put there all the silver found in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jodae the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it by the altar in the house of a man belonging to the house of the Lord, and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was found in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when they saw that there was much silver in the chest, the king's scribe and the high priest went up and tied and counted the silver found in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest went up, and they tied up and counted the money that was found in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they gave the silver, weighed out, into the hands of those doing the works, the overseers of the house of the Lord, and they spent it on the carpenters of wood and on the builders doing work in the house of the Lord,
brenton_translation: And they gave the money that had been collected into the hands of them that wrought the works, the overseers of the house of the Lord; and they gave it out to the carpenters and to the builders that wrought in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: and on the masons and on the stonecutters to buy timber and quarried stones to hold together the breach of the house of the Lord, for everything laid out on the house to strengthen it.
brenton_translation: And to the masons, and to the hewers of stone, to purchase timber and hewn stone to repair the breaches of the house of the Lord, for all that was spent on the house of the Lord to repair it.

fresh_translation: Only, there were not made for the house of the Lord silver bowls, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessel of gold or vessel of silver, from the silver brought into the house of the Lord,
brenton_translation: Only there were not to be made for the house of the Lord silver plates, studs, bowls, or trumpets, any vessel of gold or vessel of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the Lord:

fresh_translation: because they would give it to those doing the works, and they strengthened with it the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: for they were to give it to the workmen, and they repaired therewith the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they did not reckon with the men into whose hands they gave the silver to give to those doing the works, because they acted in faithfulness.
brenton_translation: Also they took no account of the men into whose hands they gave the money to give to the workmen, for they acted faithfully.

fresh_translation: Silver for sin and silver for trespass, whatever was brought into the house of the Lord, became the priests'.
brenton_translation: Money for a sin-offering, and money for a trespass-offering, whatever happened to be brought into the house of the Lord, went to the priests.

fresh_translation: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Geth and took it, and Hazael set his face to go up against Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Then went up Azael king of Syria, and fought against Geth, and took it: and Azael set his face to go against Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Ioas king of Judah took all the holy things that Iosaphat and Ioram and Ochozias his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things and all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and of the king's house, and sent them to Hazael king of Syria, and he went up away from Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Joas king of Juda took all the holy things which Josaphat, and Joram, Ochozias, his fathers, and kings of Juda had consecrated, and what he had himself dedicated, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the Lord's house and the king's house, and he sent them to Azael king of Syria; and he went up from Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Ioas and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joas, and all that he did, behold, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And his servants rose and bound a conspiracy and struck Ioas at the house Mallo in Gaalla.
brenton_translation: And his servants rose up and made a conspiracy, and smote Joas in the house of Mallo that is in Sela.

fresh_translation: And Iezichar son of Iemouath and Iezebouth his servant, son of Sōmēr, struck him, and he died. And they buried him with his fathers in the city of Dauid, and Amessias his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Jezirchar the son of Jemuath, and Jezabuth Somer's son, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amessias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the twenty-third year of Ioas son of Ochozias, king of Judah, Ioachas son of Iou reigned in Samaria seventeen years.
brenton_translation: In the twenty-third year of Joas son of Ochozias king of Juda began Joachaz the son of Ju to reign in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord and went after the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin. He did not depart from them.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked after the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin; he departed not from them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord grew angry in wrath against Israel and gave them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria and into the hand of son of Ader son of Hazael all the days.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and delivered them into the hand of Azael king of Syria, and into the hand of the son of Ader son of Azael, all their days.

fresh_translation: And Ioachas entreated the face of the Lord, and the Lord listened to him, because he saw the oppression of Israel, that the king of Syria oppressed them.
brenton_translation: And Joachaz besought the Lord, and the Lord hearkened to him, for he saw the affliction of Israel, because the king of Syria afflicted them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave salvation to Israel, and he went out from under the hand of Syria, and the sons of Israel sat in their tents as formerly.
brenton_translation: And the Lord gave deliverance to Israel, and they escaped from under the hand of Syria: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents as heretofore.

fresh_translation: Only, they did not depart from the sins of the house of Ieroboam, who made Israel sin. In them they walked, and even the grove stood in Samaria.
brenton_translation: Only they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who led Israel to sin: they walked in them—moreover the grove also remained in Samaria.

fresh_translation: Because there was not left to Ioachas a people except fifty horsemen and ten chariots and ten thousand footmen, because the king of Syria destroyed them and set them like dust for trampling.
brenton_translation: Whereas there was not left any army to Joachaz, except fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand infantry: for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and they made them as dust for trampling.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Ioachas and all that he did and his acts of power, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joachaz, and all that he did, and his mighty acts are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Ioachas slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in Samaria, and Ioas his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Joachaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria: and Joas his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the thirty-seventh year of Ioas king of Judah, Ioas son of Ioachas reigned over Israel in Samaria sixteen years.
brenton_translation: In the thirty-seventh year of Joas king of Juda, Joas the son of Joachaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria sixteen years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord. He did not depart from all the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin. In them he walked.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord; he departed not from all the sin of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin: he walked in it.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Ioas and all that he did and his acts of power with which he fought with Amessias king of Judah, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joas, and all that he did, and his mighty acts which he performed together with Amessias king of Juda, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Ioas slept with his fathers, and Ieroboam sat upon his throne in Samaria among the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Joas slept with his fathers, and Jeroboam sat upon his throne, and he was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie became sick with the sickness by which he died, and Ioas king of Israel came down to him and wept over his face and said, My father, my father, chariot of Israel and its horseman.
brenton_translation: Now Elisaie was sick of his sickness, whereof he died: and Joas king of Israel went down to him, and wept over his face, and said, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horseman thereof!

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to him, Take a bow and arrows. And he took for himself a bow and arrows.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said to him, Take bow and arrows. And he took to himself a bow and arrows.

fresh_translation: And he said to the king, Lay your hand upon the bow. And Ioas laid his hand upon the bow, and Elisaie placed his hands upon the hands of the king.
brenton_translation: And he said to the king, Put thy hand on the bow. And Joas put his hand upon it: and Elisaie put his hands upon the king's hands.

fresh_translation: And he said, Open the window toward the east. And he opened it. And Elisaie said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, An arrow of salvation for the Lord and an arrow of salvation against Syria, and you will strike Syria at Aphek until completion.
brenton_translation: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. And Elisaie said, Shoot. And he shot. And Elisaie said, The arrow of the Lord's deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria; and thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphec until thou have consumed them.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie said to him, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said to the king of Israel, Strike into the ground. And the king struck three times and stopped.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie said to him, Take bow and arrows. And he took them. And he said to the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And the king smote three times, and stayed.

fresh_translation: And the man of God was grieved over him and said, If you had struck five or six times, then you would have struck Syria until completion. But now three times you will strike Syria.
brenton_translation: And the man of God was grieved at him, and said, If thou hadst smitten five or six times, then thou shouldest have smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed them; but now thou shalt smite Syria only thrice.

fresh_translation: And Elisaie died, and they buried him. And raiding bands of Moab came into the land at the coming of the year.
brenton_translation: And Elisaie died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites came into the land, at the beginning of the year.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, while they were burying a man, behold, they saw the raiding band, and they threw the man into the tomb of Elisaie. And he went and touched the bones of Elisaie and lived and stood on his feet.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as they were burying a man, that behold, they saw a band of men, and they cast the man into the grave of Elisaie: and as soon as he touched the bones of Elisaie, he revived and stood up on his feet.

fresh_translation: And Hazael oppressed Israel all the days of Ioachas.
brenton_translation: And Azael greatly afflicted Israel all the days of Joachaz.

fresh_translation: And the Lord had mercy on them and pitied them and looked toward them because of his covenant with Abraam and Isaak and Iakob, and the Lord did not wish to destroy them and did not cast them from before his face until now.
brenton_translation: And the Lord had mercy and compassion upon them, and had respect to them because of his covenant with Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob; and the Lord would not destroy them, and did not cast them out from his presence.

fresh_translation: And Hazael king of Syria died, and son of Ader his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Azael king of Syria died, and the son of Ader his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Ioas son of Ioachas returned and took the cities from the hand of son of Ader son of Hazael, which he took from the hand of Ioachas his father in war. Three times Ioas struck him and recovered the cities of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Joas the son of Joachaz returned, and took the cities out of the hand of the son of Ader the son of Azael, which he had taken out of the hand of Joachaz his father in the war: thrice did Joas smite him, and he recovered the cities of Israel.

fresh_translation: In the second year of Ioas son of Ioachas, king of Israel, Amessias son of Ioas king of Judah reigned.
brenton_translation: In the second year of Joas the son of Joachaz king of Israel, did Amessias also the son of Joas the king of Juda begin to reign.

fresh_translation: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Ioadin from Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Joadim of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, but not like Dauid his father. According to all that Ioas his father did, he did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, but not as David his father: he did according to all things that his father Joas did.

fresh_translation: Only, the high places he did not remove. The people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.
brenton_translation: Only he removed not the high places: as yet the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the kingdom grew strong in his hand, he struck his servants who struck his father.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the kingdom was established in his hand, that he slew his servants that had slain the king his father.

fresh_translation: But the sons of those who struck him he did not put to death, just as it is written in the book of the laws of Moses, as the Lord commanded, saying, Fathers shall not die for sons, and sons shall not die for fathers, because each will die in his own sins.
brenton_translation: But he slew not the sons of those that had slain him; according as it is written in the book of the laws of Moses, as the Lord gave commandment, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, and the children shall not be put to death for the fathers; but every one shall die for his own sins.

fresh_translation: He struck Edom in Gai-melē, ten thousand, and captured Petra in war and called its name Kathoēl to this day.
brenton_translation: He smote of Edom ten thousand in the valley of salt, and took the Rock in the war, and called its name Jethoel until this day.

fresh_translation: Then Amessias sent messengers to Ioas son of Ioachas son of Iou, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
brenton_translation: Then Amessias sent messengers to Joas son of Joachaz son of Ju king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

fresh_translation: And Ioas king of Israel sent to Amessias king of Judah, saying, The thornbush in Lebanon sent to the cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for a wife. And the beasts of the field passed by, those in Lebanon, and trampled the thornbush.
brenton_translation: And Joas the king of Israel sent to Amessias king of Juda, saying, The thistle that was in Libanus sent to the cedar that was in Libanus, saying, Give my daughter to thy son to wife: and the wild beasts of the field that were in Libanus passed by and trod down the thistle.

fresh_translation: Striking, you struck Edom, and your heart lifted you up. Be glorified by sitting in your house. Why do you provoke evil against yourself, so that you fall, you and Judah with you?
brenton_translation: Thou hast smitten and wounded Edom, and thy heart has lifted thee up: stay at home and glorify thyself; for wherefore art thou quarrelsome to thy hurt? So both thou wilt fall and Juda with thee.

fresh_translation: And Amessias did not listen, and the king of Israel went up, and he and Amessias king of Judah looked one another in the face at Baithsamis of Judah.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless Amessias hearkened not: so Joas king of Israel went up, and he and Amessias king of Juda looked one another in the face in Bæthsamys of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Judah stumbled before Israel, and each man fled to his tent.
brenton_translation: And Juda was overthrown before Israel, and every man fled to his tent.

fresh_translation: And Ioas son of Ioachas king of Israel captured Amessias son of Ioas son of Ochozias, king of Judah, at Baithsamis, and he came to Jerusalem and tore down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.
brenton_translation: And Joas king of Israel took Amessias the son of Joas the son of Ochozias, in Bæthsamys; and he came to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, beginning at the gate of Ephraim as far as the gate of the corner, four hundred cubits.

fresh_translation: And he took the gold and the silver and all the vessels found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king's house and the hostages, and he returned to Samaria.
brenton_translation: And he took the gold, and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Ioas, what he did in his might, how he fought with Amessias king of Judah, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joas, even all that he did in his might, how he warred with Amessias king of Juda, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Ioas slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel, and Ieroboam his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Joas slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Amessias son of Ioas king of Judah lived fifteen years after the death of Ioas son of Ioachas king of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Amessias the son of Joas king of Juda lived after the death of Joas son of Joachaz king of Israel fifteen years.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Amessias and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Amessias, and all that he did, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And they conspired a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachis. And they sent after him to Lachis and killed him there.
brenton_translation: And they formed a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachis: and they sent after him to Lachis, and slew him there.

fresh_translation: And they carried him on horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of Dauid.
brenton_translation: And they brought him upon horses; and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

fresh_translation: And all the people of Judah took Azarias, and he was sixteen years old, and they made him king instead of his father Amessias.
brenton_translation: And all the people of Juda took Azarias, and he was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amessias.

fresh_translation: He built Ailoth and restored it to Judah after the king slept with his fathers.
brenton_translation: He built Æloth, and restored it to Juda, after the king slept with his fathers.

fresh_translation: In the fifteenth year of Amessias son of Ioas king of Judah, Ieroboam son of Ioas reigned over Israel in Samaria forty-one years.
brenton_translation: In the fifteenth year of Amessias son of Joas king of Juda began Jeroboam son of Joas to reign over Israel in Samaria forty and one years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord. He did not depart from all the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Aimath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spoke by the hand of his servant Iōnas son of Amathi, the prophet from Gethchober.
brenton_translation: He recovered the coast of Israel from the entering in of Æmath to the sea of Araba, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spoke by his servant Jonas the son of Amathi, the prophet of Gethchopher.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter, and those held in and those diminished and those abandoned were few, and there was none helping Israel.
brenton_translation: For the Lord saw that the affliction of Israel was very bitter, and that they were few in number, straitened and in want, and destitute, and Israel had no helper.
