fresh_translation: And the Lord did not speak to blot out the seed of Israel from under heaven, and he saved them by the hand of Ieroboam son of Ioas.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said that he would not blot out the seed of Israel from under heaven; so he delivered them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joas.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Ieroboam and all that he did and his acts of power, how he fought and how he restored Damascus and Aimath to Judah in Israel, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his mighty deeds, which he achieved in war, and how he recovered Damascus and Æmath to Juda in Israel, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Ieroboam slept with his fathers, with the kings of Israel, and Azarias son of Amessias reigned in place of his father.
brenton_translation: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zacharias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the twenty-seventh year of Ieroboam king of Israel, Azarias son of Amessias king of Judah reigned.
brenton_translation: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel Azarias the son of Amessias king of Juda began to reign.

fresh_translation: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Chalia from Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jechelia of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, according to all that Amessias his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, according to all things that Amessias his father did.

fresh_translation: Only, the high places he did not remove. The people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.
brenton_translation: Only he took not away any of the high places: as yet the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places.

fresh_translation: And the Lord touched the king, and he was afflicted with skin-disease until the day of his death, and he reigned in a separate house, and Iōatham son of the king was over the house, judging the people of the land.
brenton_translation: And the Lord plagued the king, and he was leprous till the day of his death; and he reigned in a separate house. And Joatham the king's son was over the household, judging the people of the land.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Azarias and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Azarias, and all that he did, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Azarias slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the city of Dauid, and Iōatham his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Azarias slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Joatham his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the thirty-eighth year of Azarias king of Judah, Zacharias son of Ieroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
brenton_translation: In the thirty and eighth year of Azarias king of Juda Zacharias the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his fathers did. He did not depart from the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his fathers had done: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: And Selloum son of Iabis conspired against him and struck him at Keblaam and killed him, and Selloum reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Sellum the son of Jabis and others conspired against him, and they smote him in Keblaam, and slew him, and he reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Zacharias, behold, they are written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Zacharias, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

fresh_translation: This was the word of the Lord which he spoke to Iou, saying, Fourth sons will sit for you on the throne of Israel. And it came to be so.
brenton_translation: This was the word of the Lord which he spoke to Ju, saying, Thy sons of the fourth generation shall sit upon the throne of Israel: and it was so.

fresh_translation: And Selloum son of Iabis reigned, and in the thirty-ninth year of Azarias king of Judah, Selloum reigned in Samaria a month of days.
brenton_translation: And Sellum the son of Jabis reigned: and in the thirty and ninth year of Azarias king of Juda began Sellum to reign a full month in Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Manaēm son of Gaddi went up from Tharsila and came to Samaria and struck Selloum son of Iabis in Samaria and killed him.
brenton_translation: And Manaem the son of Gaddi went up out of Tharsila, and came to Samaria, and smote Sellum the son of Jabis in Samaria, and slew him.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Selloum and his conspiracy which he conspired, behold, they are written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Sellum, and his conspiracy wherein he was engaged, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

fresh_translation: Then Manaēm struck Thersa and all that was in it and its borders from Thersa, because they did not open to him, and he struck it, and the pregnant women he ripped open.
brenton_translation: Then Manaem smote both Thersa and all that was in it, and its borders extending beyond Thersa, because they opened not to him: and he smote it, and ripped up the women with child.

fresh_translation: In the thirty-ninth year of Azarias king of Judah, Manaēm son of Gaddi reigned over Israel ten years in Samaria.
brenton_translation: In the thirty and ninth year of Azarias king of Juda began Manaem the son of Gaddi to reign over Israel in Samaria ten years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord. He did not depart from all the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: In his days Phoul king of the Assyrians came up against the land, and Manaēm gave to Phoul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him.
brenton_translation: In his days went up Phua king of the Assyrians against the land: and Manaem gave to Phua a thousand talents of silver to aid him with his power.

fresh_translation: And Manaēm brought out the silver upon Israel, upon every mighty man of strength, to give to the king of the Assyrians fifty shekels to one man. And the king of the Assyrians turned back and did not remain there in the land.
brenton_translation: And Manaem raised the silver by a tax upon Israel, even on every mighty man in wealth, to give to the king of the Assyrians, fifty shekels levied on each man; and the king of the Assyrians departed, and remained not there in the land.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Manaēm and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Manaem, and all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Manaēm slept with his fathers, and Phakeias his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Manaem slept with his fathers; and Phakesias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the fiftieth year of Azarias king of Judah, Phakeias son of Manaēm reigned over Israel in Samaria two years.
brenton_translation: In the fiftieth year of Azarias king of Juda, began Phakesias the son of Manaem to reign over Israel in Samaria two years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord. He did not depart from the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: And Phakee son of Romeliou, his officer, conspired against him and struck him in Samaria opposite the king's house with Argob and with Aria, and with him were fifty men from the four hundred, and he killed him and reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Phakee the son of Romelias, his officer, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria in the front of the king's house, with Argob and Aria, and with him there were fifty men of the four hundred: and he slew him, and reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Phakeias and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Phakesias, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

fresh_translation: In the fifty-second year of Azarias king of Judah, Phakee son of Romeliou reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty years.
brenton_translation: In the fifty-second year of Azarias king of Juda began Phakee the son of Romelias to reign over Israel in Samaria twenty years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord. He did not depart from all the sins of Ieroboam son of Nabat, who made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: In the days of Phakee king of Israel, Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians came and took Aiin and Abelbaithmaacha and Ianōch and Kenez and Asōr and Galaad and Galilaia, all the land of Nephthali, and deported them to the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: In the days of Phakee king of Israel came Thalgath-phellasar king of the Assyrians, and took Ain, and Abel, and Thamaacha, and Anioch, and Kenez, and Asor, and Galaa, and Galilee, even all the land of Nephthali, and carried them away to the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: And Ōsēe son of Ela made a conspiracy against Phakee son of Romeliou and struck him and killed him and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Iōatham son of Azarias.
brenton_translation: And Osee son of Ela formed a conspiracy against Phakee the son of Romelias, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Joatham the son of Azarias.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Phakee and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Phakee, and all that he did, behold, these are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

fresh_translation: In the second year of Phakee son of Romeliou king of Israel, Iōatham son of Azarias king of Judah reigned.
brenton_translation: In the second year of Phakee son of Romelias king of Israel began Joatham the son of Azarias king of Juda to reign.

fresh_translation: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Ierousa daughter of Sadōk.
brenton_translation: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jerusa daughter of Sadoc.

fresh_translation: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord. According to all that Ozias his father did, he did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all things that his father Azarias did.

fresh_translation: Only, the high places he did not remove. The people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places. He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless he took not away the high places: as yet the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places. He built the upper gate of the Lord's house.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Iōatham and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joatham, and all that he did, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: In those days the Lord began to send into Judah Raassōn king of Syria and Phakee son of Romeliou.
brenton_translation: In those days the Lord began to send forth against Juda Raasson king of Syria, and Phakee son of Romelias.

fresh_translation: And Iōatham slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dauid his father, and Achaz his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Joatham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Achaz his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the seventeenth year of Phakee son of Romeliou, Achaz son of Iōatham king of Judah reigned.
brenton_translation: In the seventeenth year of Phakee son of Romelias began Achaz the son of Joatham king of Juda to reign.

fresh_translation: Achaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God faithfully, as Dauid his father.
brenton_translation: Twenty years old was Achaz when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not that which was right in the eyes of the Lord his God faithfully, as David his father had done.

fresh_translation: And he walked in the way of Ieroboam son of Nabat king of Israel, and even his son he caused to pass through fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord drove out from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, he made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he sacrificed and burned incense at the high places and on the hills and under every leafy tree.
brenton_translation: And he sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places, and upon the hills, and under every shady tree.

fresh_translation: Then Raassōn king of Syria and Phakee son of Romeliou king of Israel went up against Jerusalem for war and besieged Achaz, and they could not fight against him.
brenton_translation: Then went up Raasson king of Syria and Phakee son of Romelias king of Israel against Jerusalem to war, and besieged Achaz, but could not prevail against him.

fresh_translation: At that time Raassōn king of Syria restored Ailath to Syria and drove the Judeans from Ailath, and Idumeans came to Ailath and dwelt there until this day.
brenton_translation: At that time Raasson king of Syria recovered Ælath to Syria, and drove out the Jews from Ælath, and the Idumeans came to Ælath, and dwelt there until this day.

fresh_translation: And Achaz sent messengers to Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians, saying, I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hand of the king of Syria and from the hand of the king of Israel, those rising against me.
brenton_translation: And Achaz sent messengers to Thalgath-phellasar king of the Assyrians, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, deliver me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who are rising up against me.

fresh_translation: And Achaz took the silver and the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and of the king's house and sent gifts to the king.
brenton_translation: And Achaz took the silver and the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and of the king's house, and sent gifts to the king.

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians listened to him, and the king of the Assyrians went up to Damascus and captured it and deported it, and Raassōn he killed.
brenton_translation: And the king of the Assyrians hearkened to him: and the king of the Assyrians went up to Damascus and took it, and removed the inhabitants, and slew king Raasson.

fresh_translation: And king Achaz went to meet Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians in Damascus and saw the altar in Damascus, and king Achaz sent to Ourias the priest the likeness of the altar and its pattern according to all its workmanship.
brenton_translation: And king Achaz went to Damascus to meet Thalgath-phellasar king of the Assyrians at Damascus; and he saw an altar at Damascus. And king Achaz sent to Urias the priest the pattern of the altar, and its proportions, and all its workmanship.

fresh_translation: And Ourias the priest built the altar according to all that king Achaz sent from Damascus.
brenton_translation: And Urias the priest built the altar, according to all the directions which king Achaz sent from Damascus.

fresh_translation: And the king saw the altar and went up upon it.
brenton_translation: And the king saw the altar, and went up to it,

fresh_translation: And he burned his whole-burnt-offering and his sacrifice and his drink-offering and poured out the blood of his peace-offerings upon the altar.
brenton_translation: and offered his whole-burnt-offering, and his meat-offering, and his drink-offering, and poured out the blood of his peace-offerings on the brazen altar that was before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the bronze altar, the one before the Lord, he brought near from before the house of the Lord, from between the altar and from between the house of the Lord, and set it on the side of the altar toward the north.
brenton_translation: And he brought forward the one before the house of the Lord from between the altar and the house of the Lord, and he set it openly by the side of the altar northwards.

fresh_translation: And king Achaz commanded Ourias the priest, saying, Upon the great altar offer the morning whole-burnt-offering and the evening sacrifice and the whole-burnt-offering of the king and his sacrifice and the whole-burnt-offerings of all the people of the land and their sacrifices and their drink-offerings, and pour on it all the blood of the whole-burnt-offering and all the blood of the sacrifice, but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.
brenton_translation: And king Achaz charged Urias the priest, saying, Offer upon the great altar the whole-burnt-offering in the morning and the meat-offering in the evening, and the whole-burnt-offering of the king, and his meat-offering, and the whole-burnt-offering of all the people, and their meat-offering, and their drink-offering; and thou shalt pour all the blood of the whole-burnt-offering, and all the blood of any other sacrifice upon it: and the brazen altar shall be for me in the morning.

fresh_translation: And Ourias the priest did according to all that king Achaz commanded him.
brenton_translation: And Urias the priest did according to all that king Achaz commanded him.

fresh_translation: And king Achaz cut down the frames of the bases and removed the laver from them, and he brought down the sea from the bronze oxen under it and set it on a stone base.
brenton_translation: And king Achaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them, and took down the sea from the brazen oxen that were under it, and set it upon a base of stone.

fresh_translation: And the foundation of the seat he built in the house of the Lord, and the outer entrance of the king he turned within the house of the Lord because of the king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: And he made a base for the throne in the house of the Lord, and he turned the king's entrance without in the house of the Lord because of the king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Achaz, what he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Achaz, even all that he did, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Achaz slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of Dauid, and Ezekias his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Achaz slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Ezekias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the twelfth year of Achaz king of Judah, Ōsēe son of Ela reigned in Samaria over Israel nine years.
brenton_translation: In the twelfth year of Achaz king of Juda began Osee the son of Ela to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, yet not like the kings of Israel who were before him.
brenton_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, only not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

fresh_translation: Against him came up Salamanassar king of the Assyrians, and Ōsēe became his servant and brought tribute back to him.
brenton_translation: Against him came up Salamanassar king of the Assyrians; and Osee became his servant, and rendered him tribute.

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians found wrongdoing in Ōsēe, because he sent messengers to Sēgōr king of Egypt and did not bring tribute to the king of the Assyrians in that year. And the king of the Assyrians besieged him and bound him in prison.
brenton_translation: And the king of the Assyrians found iniquity in Osee, in that he sent messengers to Segor king of Egypt, and brought not a tribute to the king of the Assyrians in that year: and the king of the Assyrians besieged him, and bound him in the prison-house.

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians came up in all the land and came up to Samaria and besieged it three years.
brenton_translation: And the king of the Assyrians went up against all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it for three years.

fresh_translation: In the ninth year of Ōsēe, the king of the Assyrians captured Samaria and deported Israel to the Assyrians and settled them in Alae and in Abōr, rivers of Gōzan, and mountains of the Medes.
brenton_translation: In the ninth year of Osee the king of the Assyrians took Samaria, and carried Israel away to the Assyrians, and settled them in Alae, and in Abor, near the rivers of Gozan, and in the mountains of the Medes.

fresh_translation: And it came to be because the sons of Israel sinned against the Lord their God who brought them up from the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and they feared other gods.
brenton_translation: For it came to pass that the children of Israel had transgressed against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharao king of Egypt, and they feared other gods,

fresh_translation: And they walked in the statutes of the nations whom the Lord drove out from before the sons of Israel, and in those of the kings of Israel, as many as they made.
brenton_translation: and walked in the statutes of the nations which the Lord cast out before the face of the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel as many as did such things,

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel secretly did matters not so against the Lord their God, and they built for themselves high places in all their cities, from tower of watchmen to fortified city.
brenton_translation: and in those of the children of Israel as many as secretly practised customs, not as they should have done, against the Lord their God:

fresh_translation: And they set up for themselves pillars and groves on every high hill and under every leafy tree.
brenton_translation: and they built for themselves high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city. And they made for themselves pillars and groves on every high hill, and under every shady tree.

fresh_translation: And there they burned incense on all the high places, as the nations whom the Lord deported from before them, and they made companions and engraved things to provoke the Lord.
brenton_translation: And burned incense there on all high places, as the nations did whom the Lord removed from before them, and dealt with familiar spirits, and they carved images to provoke the Lord to anger.

fresh_translation: And they served idols, of which the Lord said to them, You shall not do this thing to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they served the idols, of which the Lord said to them, Ye shall not do this thing against the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord testified in Israel and in Judah by the hand of all his prophets, every seer, saying, Turn from your evil ways and keep my commandments and my ordinances and all the law.
brenton_translation: And the Lord testified against Israel and against Juda, even by the hand of all his prophets, and of every seer, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my ordinances, and all the law which I commanded your fathers, and all that I sent to them by the hand of my servants the prophets.

fresh_translation: And they did not listen and hardened their neck beyond the neck of their fathers.
brenton_translation: But they hearkened not, and made their neck harder than the neck of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And his testimonies, which he testified to them, they did not keep, and they went after vanities and became vain, and after the nations around them, concerning whom he commanded them not to do according to these.
brenton_translation: And they kept not any of his testimonies which he charged them; and they walked after vanities, and became vain, and after the nations round about them, concerning which the Lord had charged them not to do accordingly.

fresh_translation: They abandoned the commandments of the Lord their God and made for themselves cast images, two calves, and made groves and bowed down to all the force of heaven and served Baal.
brenton_translation: They forsook the commandments of the Lord their God, and made themselves graven images, even two heifers, and they made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

fresh_translation: And they made their sons and their daughters pass through fire and practiced divinations and omens and sold themselves to do evil in the eyes of the Lord, to provoke him.
brenton_translation: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divinations and auspices, and sold themselves to work wickedness in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them from before his face, and none was left except the tribe of Judah alone.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight; and there was only left the tribe of Juda quite alone.

fresh_translation: Yet Judah also did not keep the commandments of the Lord their God, and they walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
brenton_translation: Nay even Juda kept not the commandments of the Lord their God, but they walked according to the customs of Israel which they practised, and rejected the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord rejected all the seed of Israel and shook them and gave them into the hand of those plundering them until he cast them from before his face.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was angry with the whole seed of Israel, and troubled them, and gave them into the hand of them that spoiled them, until he cast them out of his presence.

fresh_translation: Because he tore Israel away from the house of Dauid, and they made Ieroboam son of Nabat king, and Ieroboam thrust Israel away from following the Lord and made them sin a great sin.
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as Israel revolted from the house of David, and they made Jeroboam the son of Nabat king: and Jeroboam drew off Israel from following the Lord, and led them to sin a great sin.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel walked in every sin of Ieroboam which he did. They did not depart from it,
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel walked in all the sin of Jeroboam which he committed; they departed not from it,

fresh_translation: until the Lord removed Israel from before his face, as the Lord spoke by the hand of all his servants the prophets, and Israel was deported from its land to the Assyrians until this day.
brenton_translation: until the Lord removed Israel from his presence, as the Lord spoke by all his servants the prophets; and Israel was removed from off their land to the Assyrians until this day.

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians brought from Babylon and from Choutha and from Aia and from Aimath and Seppharouain and settled them in the cities of Samaria instead of the sons of Israel. And they inherited Samaria and dwelt in its cities.
brenton_translation: And the king of Assyria brought from Babylon the men of Chutha, and men from Aia, and from Æmath, and Seppharvaim, and they were settled in the cities of Samaria in the place of the children of Israel: and they inherited Samaria, and were settled in its cities.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at the beginning of their dwelling there, they did not fear the Lord, and the Lord sent lions among them, and they were killing among them.
brenton_translation: And it was so at the beginning of their establishment there that they feared not the Lord, and the Lord sent lions among them, and they slew some of them.

fresh_translation: And they said to the king of the Assyrians, The nations whom you deported and settled in the cities of Samaria did not know the judgment of the god of the land, and he sent the lions among them, and behold, they are putting them to death because they do not know the judgment of the god of the land.
brenton_translation: And they spoke to the king of the Assyrians, saying, The nations whom thou hast removed and substituted in the cities of Samaria for the Israelites, know not the manner of the God of the land: and he has sent the lions against them, and, behold, they are slaying them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians commanded, saying, Take there one of the priests whom you deported from there, and let him go and dwell there and enlighten them about the judgment of the god of the land.
brenton_translation: And the king of the Assyrians commanded, saying, Bring some Israelites thence, and let them go and dwell there, and they shall teach them the manner of the God of the land.

fresh_translation: And they brought one of the priests whom they deported from Samaria, and he dwelt in Baithēl and was enlightening them how they should fear the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they brought one of the priests whom they had removed from Samaria, and he settled in Bæthel, and taught them how they should fear the Lord.

fresh_translation: And nation by nation was making its own gods and putting them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans made, nation in the cities in which they were dwelling.
brenton_translation: But the nations made each their own gods, and put them in the house of the high places which the Samaritans had made, each nation in the cities in which they dwelt.

fresh_translation: And the men of Babylon made Sokkōthbainith, and the men of Chouth made Nērigel, and the men of Aimath made Asimath,
brenton_translation: And the men of Babylon made Socchoth Benith, and the men of Chuth made Ergel, and the men of Hæmath made Asimath.

fresh_translation: and the Evaites made Eblazer and Tharthak, and the Seppharouaites were burning their sons in fire to Adramelech and Anamelech, gods of Seppharouain.
brenton_translation: And the Evites made Eblazer and Tharthac, and the inhabitant of Seppharvaim did evil when they burnt their sons in the fire to Adramelech and Anemelech, the gods of Seppharvaim.

fresh_translation: And they were fearing the Lord and appointing for themselves priests of the high places from among themselves, and they were making for them in the houses of the high places.
brenton_translation: And they feared the Lord, yet they established their abominations in the houses of the high places which they made in Samaria, each nation in the city in which they dwelt: and they feared the Lord, and they made for themselves priests of the high places, and sacrificed for themselves in the house of the high places.

fresh_translation: They feared the Lord and served their gods according to the custom of the nations from which he deported them there.
brenton_translation: And they feared the Lord, and served their gods according to the manner of the nations, whence their lords brought them.

fresh_translation: Until this day they act according to their custom. They fear, and they act according to their ordinances and according to their judgment and according to the law and according to the commandment which the Lord commanded the sons of Iakōb, whom he named Israel.
brenton_translation: Until this day they did according to their manner: they fear the Lord, and they do according to their customs, and according to their manner, and according to the law, and according to the commandment which the Lord commanded the sons of Jacob, whose name he made Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord made a covenant with them and commanded them, saying, You shall not fear other gods, and you shall not bow down to them, and you shall not serve them, and you shall not sacrifice to them,
brenton_translation: And the Lord made a covenant with them, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, neither shall ye worship them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

fresh_translation: but only the Lord who brought you up from the land of Egypt with great strength and with uplifted arm, him you shall fear and to him you shall bow and to him you shall sacrifice.
brenton_translation: but only to the Lord, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great strength and with a high arm: him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship; to him shall ye sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And the ordinances and the judgments and the law and the commandments which he wrote for you, you shall keep to do all the days, and you shall not fear other gods.
brenton_translation: Ye shall observe continually the ordinances, and the judgments, and the law, and the commandments which he wrote for you to do; and ye shall not fear other gods.

fresh_translation: And the covenant which he made with you, you shall not forget, and you shall not fear other gods,
brenton_translation: Neither shall ye forget the covenant which he made with you: and ye shall not fear other gods.

fresh_translation: but the Lord your God you shall fear, and he will deliver you from all your enemies.
brenton_translation: But ye shall fear the Lord your God, and he shall deliver you from all your enemies.

fresh_translation: And you will not listen according to their judgment, which they do.
brenton_translation: Neither shall ye comply with their practice, which they follow.

fresh_translation: And these nations were fearing the Lord and were serving their carved images, and indeed their sons and the sons of their sons, just as their fathers did, they do until this day.
brenton_translation: So these nations feared the Lord, and served their graven images: yea, their sons and their sons' sons do until this day even as their fathers did.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the third year of Ōsēe son of Ela, king of Israel, Ezekias son of Achaz king of Judah reigned.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the third year of Osee son of Ela king of Israel that Ezekias son of Achaz king of Juda began to reign.

fresh_translation: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Abou daughter of Zachariou.
brenton_translation: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Abu, daughter of Zacharias.

fresh_translation: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, according to all that Dauid his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David did.

fresh_translation: He removed the high places and crushed all the pillars and destroyed the groves and the bronze serpent which Moses made, because until those days the sons of Israel were burning incense to it, and he called it Neesthan.
brenton_translation: He removed the high places, and broke in pieces the pillars, and utterly destroyed the groves, and the brazen serpent which Moses made: because until those days the children of Israel burnt incense to it: and he called it Neesthan.

fresh_translation: He hoped in the Lord God of Israel, and after him there was none like him among the kings of Judah and among those before him.
brenton_translation: He trusted in the Lord God of Israel; and after him there was not any like him among the kings of Juda, nor among those that were before him.

fresh_translation: And he clung to the Lord and did not depart from behind him and kept his commandments which he commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he clave to the Lord, he departed not from following him; and he kept his commandments, as many as he commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was with him. In all that he did, he prospered. And he rebelled against the king of the Assyrians and did not serve him.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was with him; and he was wise in all that he undertook: and he revolted from the king of the Assyrians, and served him not.

fresh_translation: He struck the Philistines as far as Gaza and as far as its border, from tower of watchmen to fortified city.
brenton_translation: He smote the Philistines even to Gaza, and to the border of it, from the tower of the watchmen even to the strong city.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the fourth year of king Ezekias, which was the seventh year of Ōsēe son of Ela king of Israel, Salamanassar king of the Assyrians came up against Samaria and was besieging it.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Ezekias (this is the seventh year of Osee son of Ela king of Israel,) that Salamanassar king of the Assyrians came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

fresh_translation: And he captured it at the end of three years, in the sixth year of Ezekias, which was the ninth year of Ōsēe king of Israel, and Samaria was captured.
brenton_translation: And he took it at the end of three years, in the sixth year of Ezekias, (this is the ninth year of Osee king of Israel, when Samaria was taken.)

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians deported Samaria to the Assyrians and set them in Alae and in Abōr, river of Gōzan, and mountains of the Medes,
brenton_translation: And the king of the Assyrians carried away the Samaritans to Assyria, and put them in Alaë and in Abor, by the river Gozan, and in the mountains of the Medes;

fresh_translation: because they did not listen to the voice of the Lord their God and transgressed his covenant, all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and they did not listen and did not do it.
brenton_translation: because they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord their God, and transgressed his covenant, even in all things that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and hearkened not to them, nor did them.

fresh_translation: And in the fourteenth year of king Ezekias, Sennachērim king of the Assyrians came up against the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
brenton_translation: And in the fourteenth year of king Ezekias came up Sennacherim king of the Assyrians against the strong cities of Juda, and took them.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias king of Judah sent messengers to the king of the Assyrians to Lachis, saying, I have sinned. Turn away from me. Whatever you impose on me I will bear. And the king of the Assyrians imposed on Ezekias king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias king of Juda sent messengers to the king of the Assyrians to Lachis, saying, I have offended; depart from me: whatsoever thou shalt lay upon me, I will bear. And the king of Assyria laid upon Ezekias king of Juda a tribute of three hundred talents of silver, and thirty talents of gold.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias gave all the silver found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king's house.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias gave all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house.

fresh_translation: At that time Ezekias cut off the doors of the temple of the Lord and the supports which Ezekias king of Judah overlaid, and he gave them to the king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: At that time Ezekias cut off the gold from the doors of the temple, and from the pillars which Ezekias king of Juda had overlaid with gold, and gave it to the king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians sent Tharthan and Raphis and Rapsakēs from Lachis to king Ezekias with a heavy force against Jerusalem, and they came up and came to Jerusalem and stood by the conduit of the upper pool on the way of the fuller's field.
brenton_translation: And the king of the Assyrians sent Tharthan and Raphis and Rapsakes from Lachis to king Ezekias with a strong force against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem, and stood by the aqueduct of the upper pool, which is by the way of the fuller's field.

fresh_translation: And they called to Ezekias, and Eliakim son of Chelkias the steward and Somnas the scribe and Iōas son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.
brenton_translation: And they cried to Ezekias: and there came to him Heliakim the son of Chelcias the steward, and Somnas the scribe, and Joas the son of Saphat the recorder.

fresh_translation: And Rapsakēs said to them, Say now to Ezekias, Thus says the great king, king of the Assyrians: What is this confidence in which you have trusted?
brenton_translation: And Rapsakes said to them, Say now to Ezekias, Thus says the king, the great king of the Assyrians, What is this confidence wherein thou trustest?

fresh_translation: You said, Only words of lips are counsel and strength for war. Now then, in whom have you trusted that you rebelled against me?
brenton_translation: Thou hast said, (but they are mere words,) I have counsel and strength for war. Now then in whom dost thou trust, that thou hast revolted from me?

fresh_translation: Now behold, you have trusted for yourself on this broken reed staff, on Egypt, on which if a man leans it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
brenton_translation: See now, art thou trusting for thyself on this broken staff of reed, even upon Egypt? whosoever shall stay himself upon it, it shall even go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharao king of Egypt to all that trust on him.

fresh_translation: And if you say to me, We have trusted in the Lord our God, is not this the one whose high places and altars Ezekias removed and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Before this altar in Jerusalem you shall bow?
brenton_translation: And whereas thou hast said to me, We trust on the Lord God: is not this he, whose high places and altars Ezekias has removed, and has said to Juda and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

fresh_translation: And now make a bargain now with my lord king of the Assyrians, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able to give riders for them.
brenton_translation: And now, I pray you, make an agreement with my lord the king of the Assyrians, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou shalt be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

fresh_translation: And how will you turn away the face of one governor from the least of the servants of my lord? And you trusted for yourself in Egypt for chariots and horsemen.
brenton_translation: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one petty governor from among the least of my lord's servants? whereas thou trustest for thyself on Egypt for chariots and horsemen.

fresh_translation: And now, was it without the Lord that we came up against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land and destroy it.
brenton_translation: And now have we come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

fresh_translation: And Eliakim son of Chelkias and Somnas and Iōas said to Rapsakēs, Speak now to your servants in Syrian, because we understand, and do not speak with us in Judean. Why do you speak in the ears of the people upon the wall?
brenton_translation: And Heliakim the son of Chelkias, and Somnas, and Joas, said to Rapsakes, Speak now to thy servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it; and speak not with us in the Jewish language: and why dost thou speak in the ears of the people that are on the wall?

fresh_translation: And Rapsakēs said to them, Was it to your lord and to you that my lord sent me to speak these words? Was it not to the men sitting on the wall, to eat their dung and drink their urine with you?
brenton_translation: And Rapsakes said to them, Has my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? has he not sent me to the men who sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own water together with you?

fresh_translation: And Rapsakēs stood and cried with a great voice in Judean and spoke and said, Hear the words of the great king, king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: And Rapsakes stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jewish language, and spoke, and said, Hear the words of the great king of the Assyrians:

fresh_translation: Thus says the king: Let not Ezekias lift you up with words, because he will not be able to deliver you from my hand.
brenton_translation: thus says the king, Let not Ezekias encourage you with words: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand.

fresh_translation: And let not Ezekias make you hope in the Lord, saying, In delivering the Lord will deliver us. This city will not be given into the hand of the king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: And let not Ezekias cause you to trust on the Lord, saying, The Lord will certainly deliver us; this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of the Assyrians: hearken not to Ezekias:

fresh_translation: Do not listen to Ezekias, because thus says the king of the Assyrians: Make a blessing with me and come out to me, and each man will eat of his vine and each man will eat of his fig tree and each man will drink water from his cistern,
brenton_translation: for thus says the king of the Assyrians, Gain my favour, and come forth to me, and every man shall drink of the wine of his own vine, and every man shall eat of his own fig-tree, and shall drink water out of his own cistern;

fresh_translation: until I come and take you to a land like your land, a land of grain and wine and bread and vineyards, a land of olive oil and honey, and you will live and not die. And do not listen to Ezekias, because he deceives you, saying, The Lord will rescue us.
brenton_translation: until I come and remove you to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, and bread and vineyards, a land of olive oil, and honey, and ye shall live and not die: and do not ye hearken to Ezekias, for he deceives you, saying, The Lord shall deliver you.

fresh_translation: Have the gods of the nations, in delivering, delivered each his own land from the hand of the king of the Assyrians?
brenton_translation: Have the gods of the nations at all delivered each their own land out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians?

fresh_translation: Where is the god of Aimath and Arphad? Where is the god of Seppharouain? And have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
brenton_translation: Where is the god of Hæmath, and of Arphad? where is the god of Seppharvaim, Ana, and Aba? for have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

fresh_translation: Who among all the gods of the lands delivered their lands from my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem from my hand?
brenton_translation: Who is there among all the gods of the countries, who have delivered their countries out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

fresh_translation: And they kept silent and did not answer him a word, because it was the king's command, saying, You shall not answer him.
brenton_translation: But the men were silent, and answered him not a word: for there was a commandment of the king, saying, Ye shall not answer him.

fresh_translation: And Eliakim son of Chelkias the steward and Somnas the scribe and Iōas son of Asaph the recorder came to Ezekias with torn garments and reported to him the words of Rapsakēs.
brenton_translation: And Heliakim the son of Chelcias, the steward, and Somnas the scribe, and Joas the son of Saphat the recorder came in to Ezekias, having rent their garments; and they reported to him the words of Rapsakes.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when king Ezekias heard, he tore his garments and wrapped himself in sackcloth and entered into the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when king Ezekias heard it, that he rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he sent Eliakim the steward and Somnas the scribe and the elders of the priests clothed in sackcloth to Esaias the prophet son of Amōs.
brenton_translation: And he sent Heliakim the steward, and Somnas the scribe, and the elders of the priests, clothed with sackcloth, to Esaias the prophet the son of Amos.

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Thus says Ezekias: This day is a day of affliction and rebuke and provocation, because sons came as far as birth pains and there is no strength for the woman giving birth.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, Thus says Ezekias, This day is a day of tribulation, and rebuke, and provocation: for the children are come to the travail-pangs, but the mother has no strength.

fresh_translation: If perhaps the Lord your God will hear all the words of Rapsakēs, whom the king of the Assyrians his lord sent to reproach the living God and to blaspheme in words which the Lord your God heard, then you shall take up prayer for the remnant that is found.
brenton_translation: Peradventure the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rapsakes, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living God and to revile him with the words which the Lord thy God has heard: and thou shalt offer thy prayer for the remnant that is found.

fresh_translation: And the servants of king Ezekias came to Esaias.
brenton_translation: So the servants of king Ezekias came to Esaias.

fresh_translation: And Esaias said to them, Thus you shall say to your lord: Thus says the Lord, Do not fear from the words which you heard, with which the servant-boys of the king of the Assyrians blasphemed.
brenton_translation: And Esaias said to them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of the Assyrians have blasphemed.

fresh_translation: Behold, I am putting a spirit in him, and he will hear a report and return to his land, and I will bring him down by the sword in his land.
brenton_translation: Behold, I send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a report, and shall return to his own land; and I will overthrow him with the sword in his own land.

fresh_translation: And Rapsakēs returned and found the king of the Assyrians warring against Lobna, because he heard that he departed from Lachis.
brenton_translation: So Rapsakes returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Lobna: for he heard that he had departed from Lachis.

fresh_translation: And he heard concerning Tharaka king of the Ethiopians, saying, Behold, he came out to war with you. And he turned and sent messengers to Ezekias, saying,
brenton_translation: And he heard concerning Tharaca king of the Ethiopians, saying, Behold, he is come forth to fight with thee: and he returned, and sent messengers to Ezekias, saying,

fresh_translation: Let not your God on whom you trust lift you up, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: Let not thy God on whom thou trustest encourage thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hands of the king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: Behold, you heard all that the kings of the Assyrians did to all lands, to devote them. And will you be rescued?
brenton_translation: Behold, thou hast heard all that the kings of the Assyrians have done in all the lands, to waste them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

fresh_translation: Did the gods of the nations rescue them, those whom my fathers destroyed, both Gōzan and Charran and Raphes and sons of Edem in Thaesthen?
brenton_translation: Have the gods of the nations at all delivered them, whom my fathers destroyed; both Gozan, and Charran, and Raphis, and the sons of Edem who were in Thaesthen?

fresh_translation: Where is the king of Aimath and the king of Arphad, and where is Seppharouain, Ana, and Aua?
brenton_translation: Where is the king of Hæmath, and the king of Arphad? and where is the king of the city of Seppharvaim, of Ana, and Aba?

fresh_translation: And Ezekias took the letters from the hand of the messengers and read them, and he went up to the house of the Lord, and Ezekias spread them out before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias took the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and he went up to the house of the Lord, and Ezekias spread it before the Lord,

fresh_translation: And he said, Lord God of Israel, the one sitting upon the cherubim, you are God alone in all the kingdoms of the earth. You made heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: and said, O Lord God of Israel, that dwellest over the cherubs, thou art the only God in all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

fresh_translation: Incline, Lord, your ear and hear. Open, Lord, your eyes and see. And hear the words of Sennachērim which he sent to reproach the living God.
brenton_translation: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear: open, Lord, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherim, which he has sent to reproach the living God.

fresh_translation: Because truly, Lord, the kings of the Assyrians laid waste the nations
brenton_translation: For truly, Lord, the kings of Assyria have wasted the nations,

fresh_translation: and gave their gods into the fire, because they are not gods but works of human hands, wood and stone, and they destroyed them.
brenton_translation: and have cast their gods into the fire: because they are no gods, but the works of men's hands, wood and stone; and they have destroyed them.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord our God, save us from his hand, and all the kingdoms of the earth will know that you alone, Lord, are God.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord our God, deliver us out of his hand, and all the kingdoms of the earth shall know that thou alone art the Lord God.

fresh_translation: And Esaias son of Amōs sent to Ezekias, saying, Thus says the Lord God of the forces, the God of Israel: I heard what you prayed to me concerning Sennachērim king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: And Esaias the son of Amos sent to Ezekias, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, I have heard thy prayer to me concerning Sennacherim king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: This is the word which the Lord spoke against him: Virgin daughter of Siōn despised you and mocked you. Daughter Jerusalem shook her head over you.
brenton_translation: This is the word which the Lord has spoken against him; The virgin daughter of Sion has made light of thee, and mocked thee; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at thee.

fresh_translation: Whom did you reproach and blaspheme? Against whom did you raise your voice and lift your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: Whom hast thou reproached, and whom hast thou reviled? and against whom hast thou lifted up thy voice, and raised thine eyes on high? Is it against the Holy One of Israel?

fresh_translation: By the hand of your messengers you reproached the Lord and said, By the multitude of my chariots I will go up to the heights of mountains, the sides of Lebanon, and I cut down the greatness of its cedar, its choice cypresses, and I came to the farthest part of its border, the forest of its Carmel.
brenton_translation: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, I will go up with the multitude of my chariots, to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Libanus, and I have cut down the height of his cedar, and his choice cypresses; and I have come into the midst of the forest and of Carmel.

fresh_translation: I cooled and drank foreign waters, and with the sole of my foot I laid waste all rivers of a besieged land.
brenton_translation: I have refreshed myself, and have drunk strange waters, and I have dried up with the sole of my foot all the rivers of fortified places.

fresh_translation: I formed it. Now I brought it, and it came to be for elevations of desolated settlements, fortified cities.
brenton_translation: I have brought about the matter, I have brought it to a conclusion; and it is come to the destruction of the bands of warlike prisoners, even of strong cities.

fresh_translation: And those dwelling in them were weak of hand. They were dismayed and put to shame. They became grass of field and green herb, grass of rooftops and trampling before standing grain.
brenton_translation: And they that dwelt in them were weak in hand, they quaked and were confounded, they became as grass of the field, or as the green herb, the grass growing on houses, and that which is trodden down by him that stands upon it.

fresh_translation: And your sitting and your going out and your going in I knew, and your rage against me.
brenton_translation: But I know thy down-sitting, and thy going forth, and thy rage against me.

fresh_translation: Because you raged against me and your insolence went up in my ears, I will put my hooks in your nostrils and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back on the way by which you came.
brenton_translation: Because thou wast angry against me, and thy fierceness is come up into my ears, therefore will I put my hooks in thy nostrils, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

fresh_translation: And this to you is the sign: Eat this year what grows of itself, and in the second year the springing growth, and in the third sow and reap and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
brenton_translation: And this shall be a sign to thee; eat this year the things that grow of themselves, and in the second year the things which spring up: and in the third year let there be sowing, and reaping, and planting of vineyards, and eat ye the fruit of them.

fresh_translation: And the remnant of the house of Judah that escaped and was left will again take root downward and make fruit upward.
brenton_translation: And he shall increase him that has escaped of the house of Juda: and the remnant shall strike root beneath, and it shall produce fruit above.

fresh_translation: Because from Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and one preserved from Mount Siōn. The zeal of the Lord of forces will do this.
brenton_translation: For from Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and he that escapes from the mountain of Sion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.

fresh_translation: Not so. Thus says the Lord to the king of the Assyrians: He will not enter into this city and will not shoot there an arrow and will not come before it with shield and will certainly not cast up against it a mound.
brenton_translation: Is it not so?

fresh_translation: By the way that he came, by it he will return, and into this city he will not enter, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: By the way by which he comes, by it shall he return, and he shall not enter into this city, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will shield this city for my own sake and for Dauid my servant.
brenton_translation: And I will defend this city as with a shield, for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

fresh_translation: And it came to be by night, and an angel of the Lord went out and struck in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred eighty-five thousand. And they rose early in the morning, and behold, all were dead bodies.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at night that the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand: and they rose early in the morning, and, behold, these were all dead corpses.

fresh_translation: And Sennachērim king of the Assyrians departed and went and returned and dwelt in Nineuē.
brenton_translation: And Sennacherim king of the Assyrians departed, and went and returned, and dwelt in Nineve.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, while he was bowing in the house of Neserach his god, Adramelech and Sarasar his sons struck him with the sword, and they escaped into the land of Ararat, and Asordan his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, while he was worshipping in the house of Meserach his god, that Adramelech and Sarasar his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Ararath; and Asordan his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In those days Ezekias became sick unto death, and Esaias son of Amōs the prophet entered to him and said to him, Thus says the Lord: Give command to your house, because you are dying and will not live.
brenton_translation: In those days was Ezekias sick even to death. And the prophet Esaias the son of Amos came in to him, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord, Give charge to thy household; for thou shalt die, and not live.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord, saying,
brenton_translation: And Ezekias turned to the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: O Lord, remember now how I walked before you in truth and with a full heart and did what was good in your eyes. And Ezekias wept with great weeping.
brenton_translation: Lord, remember, I pray thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thine eyes. And Ezekias wept with a great weeping.

fresh_translation: And Esaias was in the middle court, and word of the Lord came to him, saying,
brenton_translation: And Esaias was in the middle court, and the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

fresh_translation: Turn back and say to Ezekias the leader of my people, Thus says the Lord God of Dauid your father: I heard your prayer, I saw your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day you will go up into the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Turn back, and thou shalt say to Ezekias the ruler of my people, Thus saith the Lord God of thy father David, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up to the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will add fifteen years to your days, and from the hand of the king of the Assyrians I will save you and this city, and I will shield this city for my own sake and for Dauid my servant.
brenton_translation: And I will add to thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians, and I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

fresh_translation: And he said, Let them take a cake of figs and let them put it upon the sore, and he will recover.
brenton_translation: And he said, Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it upon the ulcer, and he shall be well.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias said to Esaias, What is the sign that the Lord will heal me and I will go up into the house of the Lord on the third day?
brenton_translation: And Ezekias said to Esaias, What is the sign that the Lord will heal me, and I shall go up to the house of the Lord on the third day?

fresh_translation: And Esaias said, This is the sign from the Lord that the Lord will do the word which he spoke. Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it turn back ten steps?
brenton_translation: And Esaias said, This is the sign from the Lord, that the Lord will perform the word which he has spoken, the shadow of the dial shall advance ten degrees: or if it should go back ten degrees this would also be the sign.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias said, It is a light thing for the shadow to slope ten steps. No, but let the shadow turn back ten steps.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias said, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return ten degrees backward on the dial.

fresh_translation: And Esaias the prophet cried to the Lord, and the shadow turned back on the steps ten steps backward.
brenton_translation: And Esaias the prophet cried to the Lord: and the shadow returned back ten degrees on the dial.

fresh_translation: At that time Marōdachbaladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Ezekias, because he heard that Ezekias was sick.
brenton_translation: At that time Marodach Baladan, son of Baladan king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Ezekias, because he had heard that Ezekias was sick.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias rejoiced over them and showed them his whole treasure-house, the silver and the gold, the spices and the good oil and the house of the vessels and all that was found in his treasuries. There was not a thing which Ezekias did not show them in his house and in all his dominion.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias rejoiced at them, and shewed all the house of his spices, the silver and the gold, the spices, and the fine oil, and the armoury, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing which Ezekias did not shew them in his house, and in all his dominion.

fresh_translation: And Esaias the prophet entered to king Ezekias and said to him, What did these men say, and from where did they come to you? And Ezekias said, They came to me from a far land, from Babylon.
brenton_translation: And Esaias the prophet went in to king Ezekias, and said to him, What said these men? and whence came they to thee? And Ezekias said, They came to me from a distant land, even from Babylon.

fresh_translation: And he said, What did they see in your house? And he said, They saw all that is in my house. There was not a thing in my house or in my treasuries that I did not show them.
brenton_translation: And he said, What saw they in thy house? And he said, They saw all things that are in my house: there was nothing in my house which I shewed not to them; yea, all that was in my treasures also.

fresh_translation: And Esaias said to Ezekias, Hear word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Esaias said to Ezekias, Hear the word of the Lord:

fresh_translation: Behold, days are coming, and everything in your house and whatever your fathers stored up to this day will be taken to Babylon, and not a thing will be left, which the Lord said.
brenton_translation: Behold, the days come, that all things that are in thy house shall be taken, and all that thy fathers have treasured up until this day, to Babylon; and there shall not fail a word which the Lord has spoken.

fresh_translation: And from your sons who will come out from you, whom you will beget, they will take, and they will be eunuchs in the house of the king of Babylon.
brenton_translation: And as for thy sons which shall come forth of thee, which thou shalt beget, the enemy shall take them, and they shall be eunuchs in the house of the king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias said to Esaias, Good is the word of the Lord which you spoke. Let there be peace in my days.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias said to Esaias, Good is the word of the Lord which he has spoken: only let there be peace in my days.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Ezekias and all his might and what he did, the spring and the conduit, and how he brought the water into the city, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ezekias, and all his might, and all that he made, the fountain and the aqueduct, and how he brought water into the city, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Ezekias slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of Dauid, and Manassēs his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias slept with his fathers: and Manasses his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Manassēs was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Opsiaba.
brenton_translation: Manasses was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Apsiba.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord drove out from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, according to the abominations of the nations which the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he turned back and rebuilt the high places which Ezekias his father tore down and raised up an altar to Baal and made groves, as Achaab king of Israel did, and bowed down to all the host of heaven and served them.
brenton_translation: And he built again the high places, which Ezekias his father had demolished; and set up an altar to Baal, and made groves as Achaab king of Israel made them; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

fresh_translation: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which he said, In Jerusalem I will put my name.
brenton_translation: And he built an altar in the house of the Lord, whereas he had said, In Jerusalem I will place my name.

fresh_translation: And he built altars to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he built an altar to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he made his sons pass through fire and practiced divination and omens and made spirit-mediums and knowers. He multiplied to do evil in the eyes of the Lord, to provoke him.
brenton_translation: And he caused his sons to pass through the fire, and used divination and auspices, and made groves, and multiplied wizards, so as to do that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

fresh_translation: And he set the carved image of the grove in the house, of which the Lord said to Dauid and to Salōmōn his son, In this house and in Jerusalem, which I chose from all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name there forever.
brenton_translation: And he set up the graven image of the grove in the house of which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I even place my name for ever.

fresh_translation: And I will not again add to shake the foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, if only they keep all that I commanded, according to all the commandment which my servant Moses commanded them.
brenton_translation: And I will not again remove the foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, even of those who shall keep all that I commanded, according to all the commandments which my servant Moses commanded them.

fresh_translation: And they did not listen, and Manassēs led them astray to do evil in the eyes of the Lord beyond the nations which the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: But they hearkened not; and Manasses led them astray to do evil in the sight of the Lord, beyond the nations whom the Lord utterly destroyed from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke by the hand of his servants the prophets, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

fresh_translation: Because Manassēs king of Judah did these evil abominations, beyond all that the Amorrite who was before him did, and even caused Judah to sin with their idols,
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as Manasses the king of Juda has wrought all these evil abominations, beyond all that the Amorite did, who lived before him, and has led Juda also into sin by their idols,

fresh_translation: not so. Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing evils on Jerusalem and on Judah, so that whoever hears, both his ears will ring.
brenton_translation: it shall not be so. Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I bring calamities upon Jerusalem and Juda, so that both the ears of every one that hears shall tingle.

fresh_translation: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the measure of Samaria and the plummet of the house of Achaab, and I will wipe Jerusalem as an alabaster vessel is wiped, being wiped and turned on its face.
brenton_translation: And I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measure of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Achaab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a jar is wiped, and turned upside down in the wiping.

fresh_translation: And I will push away the remnant of my inheritance and give them into the hands of their enemies, and they will become plunder and spoil to all their enemies,
brenton_translation: And I will reject the remnant of my inheritance, and will deliver them into the hands of their enemies; and they shall be for a plunder and for a spoil to all their enemies:

fresh_translation: because they did evil in my eyes and were provoking me from the day I brought out their fathers from Egypt until this day.
brenton_translation: forasmuch as they have done wickedly in my sight, and have provoked me from the day that I brought out their fathers out of Egypt, even until this day.

fresh_translation: And Manassēs also poured out very much innocent blood until he filled Jerusalem from mouth to mouth, besides his sins with which he made Judah sin by doing evil in the eyes of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Moreover Manasses shed very much innocent blood, until he filled Jerusalem with it from one end to the other, beside his sins with which he caused Juda to sin, in doing evil in the eyes of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Manassēs and all that he did and the sin which he sinned, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Manasses, and all that he did, and his sin which he sinned, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Manassēs slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of his house, in the garden of Oza, and Amōn his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Manasses slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his house, even in the garden of Oza: and Amos his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Amōn was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Mesollam daughter of Arōs from Ieteba.
brenton_translation: Twenty and two years old was Amos when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Mesollam, daughter of Arus of Jeteba.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Manassēs his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as Manasses his father did.

fresh_translation: And he walked in every way in which his father walked and served the idols which his father served and bowed down to them.
brenton_translation: And he walked in all the way in which his father walked, and served the idols which his father served, and worshipped them.

fresh_translation: And he abandoned the Lord God of his fathers and did not walk in the way of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Amōn conspired against him and put the king to death in his house.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Amos conspired against him, and slew the king in his house.

fresh_translation: And all the people of the land struck down all those conspiring against king Amōn, and the people of the land made Iōsias his son king in his place.
brenton_translation: And the people of the land slew all that had conspired against king Amos; and the people of the land made Josias his son king in his room.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Amōn, what he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Amos, even all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And they buried him in his tomb in the garden of Oza, and Iōsias his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And they buried him in his tomb in the garden of Oza: and Josias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Iōsias was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Iedida daughter of Edeia from Basourōth.
brenton_translation: Josias was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jedia, daughter of Edeia of Basuroth.

fresh_translation: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and walked in every way of Dauid his father. He did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the way of David his father; he turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the eighteenth year of king Iōsias, in the eighth month, the king sent Saphphan son of Eseliou son of Mesollam, the scribe of the house of the Lord, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josias, in the eighth month, the king sent Sapphan the son of Ezelias the son of Mesollam, the scribe of the house of the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: Go up to Chelkias the high priest and seal the silver brought into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the threshold gathered from the people.
