brenton_translation: and they prevailed against them: and the Agaræans were given into their hands, they and all their tents: for they cried to God in the battle, and he hearkened to them, because they trusted on him.

fresh_translation: And they took captive their goods: five thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep, two thousand donkeys, and one hundred thousand human lives.
brenton_translation: And they took captive their store; five thousand camels, and two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, two thousand asses, and a hundred thousand men.

fresh_translation: Because many wounded fell, because the war was from God. And they dwelt in their place until the exile.
brenton_translation: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their place until the captivity.

fresh_translation: And the half tribe of Manassē dwelt in the land from Basan to Baalermon and Sanir and Mount Aermon and in Lebanon. They multiplied.
brenton_translation: And the half-tribe of Manasse dwelt from Basan to Baal, Ermon, and Sanir, and to the mount Aërmon: and they increased in Libanus.

fresh_translation: And these were chiefs of houses of their fathers: Opher and Isei and Eliēl and Esdriēl and Iermia and Odouia and Iediēl, mighty men of power, men of name, chiefs of houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And these were the heads of the houses of their families; Opher, and Sei, and Eliel, and Jeremia, and Oduia, and Jediel, mighty men of valour, men of renown, heads of the houses of their families.

fresh_translation: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers and whored after gods of the peoples of the land, whom God drove out from before them.
brenton_translation: But they rebelled against the God of their fathers, and went a-whoring after the gods of the nations of the land, whom God cast out from before them.

fresh_translation: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Phaloch king of Assour and the spirit of Thaglathphalnasar king of Assour, and he deported Rouben and the Gaddi and the half tribe of Manassē, and brought them to Chalach and Chabor and Hara and to river Gozan, until this day.
brenton_translation: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Phaloch king of Assyria, and the spirit of Thagla-phallasar king of Assyria, and carried away Ruben and Gaddi, and the half-tribe of Manasse, and brought them to Chaach, and Chabor, and to the river Gozan, until this day.

fresh_translation: Sons of Levi: Gedson, Kaath, and Merari.
brenton_translation: The sons of Levi: Gedson, Caath, and Merari.

fresh_translation: And sons of Kaath: Ambram, Issaar, Chebron, and Oziēl.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Caath; Ambram, and Issaar, Chebron, and Oziel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ambram: Aaron, Moses, and Mariam. And sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abioud, Eleazar and Ithamar.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ambram; Aaron, and Moses, and Mariam: and the sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abiud, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

fresh_translation: Eleazar begot Phinees, Phinees begot Abisou,
brenton_translation: Eleazar begot Phinees, Phinees begot Abisu;

fresh_translation: Abisou begot Bokkai, Bokkai begot Ozi,
brenton_translation: Abisu begot Bokki, and Bokki begot Ozi;

fresh_translation: Ozi begot Zaraia, Zaraia begot Mariel,
brenton_translation: Ozi begot Zaraia, Zaraia begot Mariel;

fresh_translation: and Mariel begot Amaria, and Amaria begot Achitob,
brenton_translation: and Mariel begot Amaria, and Amaria begot Achitob;

fresh_translation: and Achitob begot Sadok, and Sadok begot Achimaas,
brenton_translation: and Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Achimaas;

fresh_translation: and Achimaas begot Azaria, and Azarias begot Ioanan,
brenton_translation: and Achimaas begot Azarias, and Azarias begot Joanan;

fresh_translation: and Ioanas begot Azarian. This one served as priest in the house which Salomon built in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: and Joanan begot Azarias: he ministered as priest in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Azaria begot Amaria, and Amaria begot Achitob,
brenton_translation: And Azarias begot Amaria, and Amaria begot Achitob;

fresh_translation: and Achitob begot Sadok, and Sadok begot Salom,
brenton_translation: and Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Salom;

fresh_translation: and Salom begot Chelkian, and Chelkias begot Azaria,
brenton_translation: and Salom begot Chelcias, and Chelcias begot Azarias;

fresh_translation: and Azarias begot Saraia, and Saraias begot Iōsadak.
brenton_translation: and Azarias begot Saraia, and Saraias begot Josadac.

fresh_translation: And Iōsadak went away in the exile with Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nabouchodonosor.
brenton_translation: And Josadac went into captivity with Juda and Jerusalem under Nabuchodonosor.

fresh_translation: Sons of Levi: Gedson, Kaath, and Merari.
brenton_translation: The sons of Levi: Gedson, Caath, and Merari.

fresh_translation: And these are names of the sons of Gedson: Lobeni and Semei.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the sons of Gedson; Lobeni, and Semei.

fresh_translation: Sons of Kaath: Ambram, Issaar, Chebron, and Oziēl.
brenton_translation: The sons of Caath; Ambram, and Issaar, Chebron, and Oziel.

fresh_translation: Sons of Merari: Mooli and Omousi. And these are families of Levi according to their families.
brenton_translation: The sons of Merari; Mooli and Musi: and these are the families of Levi, according to their families.

fresh_translation: To Gedson: Lobeni his son, Ieeeth his son, Zemma his son,
brenton_translation: To Gedson—to Lobeni his son—were born Jeth his son, Zammath his son,

fresh_translation: Ioach his son, Addi his son, Zara his son, Iethri his son.
brenton_translation: Joab his son, Addi his son, Zara his son, Jethri his son.

fresh_translation: Sons of Kaath: Aminadab his son, Kore his son, Asir his son,
brenton_translation: The sons of Caath; Aminadab his son, Core his son, Aser his son;

fresh_translation: Elkana his son, and Abiasaph his son, Asir his son,
brenton_translation: Helcana his son, Abisaph his son, Aser his son:

fresh_translation: Thaath his son, Ouriel his son, Ozia his son, Saul his son.
brenton_translation: Thaath his son, Uriel his son, Ozia his son, Saul his son.

fresh_translation: And sons of Elkana: Amasi and Achimoth.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Helcana; Amessi, and Achimoth.

fresh_translation: Elkana his son, Souphi his son, and Naath his son,
brenton_translation: Helcana his son, Suphi his son, Cainaath his son;

fresh_translation: Eliab his son, Idaer his son, Elkana his son.
brenton_translation: Eliab his son, Jeroboam his son, Helcana his son.

fresh_translation: Sons of Samuel: the firstborn Sani and Abia.
brenton_translation: The sons of Samuel; the first-born Sani, and Abia.

fresh_translation: Sons of Merari: Mooli, Lobeni his son, Semei his son, Oza his son,
brenton_translation: The sons of Merari; Mooli, Lobeni his son, Semei his son, Oza his son;

fresh_translation: Somea his son, Aggia his son, Asaia his son.
brenton_translation: Samaa his son, Angia his son, Asaias his son.

fresh_translation: And these are whom Dauid appointed by hands of singers in the house of the Lord, when the ark came to rest.
brenton_translation: And these were the men whom David set over the service of the singers in the house of the Lord when the ark was at rest.

fresh_translation: And they were ministering before the tent of the house of testimony with instruments until Salomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they stood according to their judgment over their services.
brenton_translation: And they ministered in front of the tabernacle of witness playing on instruments, until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they stood according to their order for their services.

fresh_translation: And these are those standing, and their sons. From sons of Kaath: Aiman the singer, son of Ioel son of Samuel,
brenton_translation: And these were the men that stood, and their sons, of the sons of Caath: Æman the psalm singer, son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

fresh_translation: son of Elkana son of Edad son of Eliēl son of Thie,
brenton_translation: the son of Helcana, the son of Jeroboam, the son of Eliel, the son of Thoas,

fresh_translation: son of Souph son of Elkana son of Meth son of Amasiou,
brenton_translation: the son of Suph, the son of Helcana, the son of Maath, the son of Amathi,

fresh_translation: son of Elkana son of Ioel son of Azaria son of Saphania,
brenton_translation: the son of Helcana, the son of Joel, the son of Azarias, the son of Japhanias,

fresh_translation: son of Thaath son of Asir son of Abiasaph son of Kore,
brenton_translation: the son of Thaath, the son of Aser, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core,

fresh_translation: son of Issaar son of Kaath son of Levi son of Israel.
brenton_translation: the son of Isaar, the son of Caath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

fresh_translation: And his brother Asaph stood at his right hand: Asaph son of Barachia son of Samaa,
brenton_translation: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand; Asaph the son of Barachias, the son of Samaa,

fresh_translation: son of Michaēl son of Maasia son of Melchia,
brenton_translation: the son of Michael, the son of Baasia, the son of Melchia,

fresh_translation: son of Athani son of Zarai son of Adia,
brenton_translation: the son of Athani, the son of Zaarai,

fresh_translation: son of Aithan son of Zamma son of Semei,
brenton_translation: the son of Adai, the son of Ætham, the son of Zammam, the son of Semei,

fresh_translation: son of Echa son of Gedson son of Levi.
brenton_translation: the son of Jeeth, the son of Gedson, the son of Levi.

fresh_translation: And sons of Merari their brother at the left hand: Aithan son of Kisai son of Abdi son of Maloch,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Merari their brethren on the left hand: Ætham the son of Kisa, the son of Abai, the son of Maloch,

fresh_translation: son of Asebi son of Amessia son of Chelkiou,
brenton_translation: the son of Asebi,

fresh_translation: son of Amasai son of Bani son of Semmer,
brenton_translation: the son of Amessias, the son of Bani, the son of Semer,

fresh_translation: son of Mooli son of Mousi son of Merari son of Levi.
brenton_translation: the son of Mooli, the son of Musi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

fresh_translation: And their brothers according to houses of their fathers, the Levites, were given for every work of service of the tent of the house of God.
brenton_translation: And their brethren according to the houses of their fathers, were the Levites who were appointed to all the work of ministration of the tabernacle of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And Aaron and his sons were burning incense upon the altar of the whole-burnt-offerings and upon the altar of incense for every work of the holy of holies and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses child of God commanded.
brenton_translation: And Aaron and his sons were to burn incense on the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, and on the altar of incense, for all the ministry in the holy of holies, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all things that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.

fresh_translation: And these are sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinees his son, Abisou his son,
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinees his son, Abisu his son,

fresh_translation: Bokkai his son, Ozi his son, Zaraia his son,
brenton_translation: Bokki his son, Ozi his son, Saraia his son,

fresh_translation: Mariel his son, Amaria his son, Achitob his son,
brenton_translation: Mariel his son, Amaria his son, Achitob his son,

fresh_translation: Sadok his son, Achimaas his son.
brenton_translation: Sadoc his son, Achimaas his son.

fresh_translation: And these are their dwellings in their villages, in their borders, for the sons of Aaron, the family of the Kaathite, because to them came the lot.
brenton_translation: And these are their residences in their villages, in their coasts, to the sons of Aaron, to their family the Caathites: for they had the lot.

fresh_translation: And they gave them Chebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
brenton_translation: And they gave them Chebron in the land of Juda, and its suburbs round about it.

fresh_translation: And the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Chaleb son of Iephonne.
brenton_translation: But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Chaleb the son of Jephonne.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Chebron and Lobna and its surrounding lands, and Selna and its surrounding lands, and Esthamo and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, even Chebron, and Lobna and her suburbs round about, and Selna and her suburbs, and Esthamo and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Ieththar and its surrounding lands, and Dabir and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Jethar and her suburbs, and Dabir and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Asan and its surrounding lands, and Attan and its surrounding lands, and Basamys and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Asan and her suburbs, and Bæthsamys and her suburbs:

fresh_translation: and from tribe of Beniamin, Gabee and its surrounding lands, and Galemeth and its surrounding lands, and Angoch and its surrounding lands. All their cities were thirteen cities according to their families.
brenton_translation: and of the tribe of Benjamin Gabai and her suburbs, and Galemath and her suburbs, and Anathoth and her suburbs: all their cities were thirteen cities according to their families.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Kaath, the rest, from the families, from the tribe, from half tribe of Manasse, by lot, ten cities.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Caath that were left of their families, there were given out of the tribe, namely, out of the half-tribe of Manasse, by lot, ten cities.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Gedson according to their families, from tribe of Issachar, from tribe of Aser, from tribe of Nephthali, from tribe of Manasse in Basan, thirteen cities.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Gedson according to their families there were given thirteen cities of the tribe of Issachar, of the tribe of Aser, of the tribe of Nephthali, of the tribe of Manasse in Basan.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Merari according to their families, from tribe of Rouben, from tribe of Gad, from tribe of Zabulon, by lot, twelve cities.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Merari according to their families there were given, by lot, twelve cities of the tribe of Ruben, of the tribe of Gad, and of the tribe of Zabulon.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs.

fresh_translation: And they gave by lot from tribe of sons of Judah and from tribe of sons of Symeon these cities which he called by name.
brenton_translation: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Juda, and out of the tribe of the children of Symeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which they call by name.

fresh_translation: And from the families of sons of Kaath were their border cities from tribe of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And to the members of the families of the sons of Caath there were also given the cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And they gave to him the cities of refuge, Sychem and its surrounding lands in hill Ephraim, and Gazer and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And they gave them the cities of refuge, Sychem and her suburbs in mount Ephraim, and Gazer and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Iekmaam and its surrounding lands, and Baithoron and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Jecmaan and her suburbs, and Bæthoron and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Eglaim and its surrounding lands, and Gethremmon and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Ælon and her suburbs, and Gethremmon and her suburbs:

fresh_translation: and from the half tribe of Manasse, Anar and its surrounding lands, and Ieblaam and its surrounding lands, according to family, to the rest of the sons of Kaath.
brenton_translation: and of the half-tribe of Manasse Anar and her suburbs, and Jemblaan and her suburbs, to the sons of Caath that were left, according to each several family.

fresh_translation: To the sons of Gedson, from families of the half tribe of Manasse, Golan from Basan and its surrounding lands, and Aseroth and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: To the sons of Gedson from the families of the half-tribe of Manasse they gave Golan of Basan and her suburbs, and Aseroth and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: And from tribe of Issachar, Kedes and its surrounding lands, and Deberi and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedes and her suburbs, and Deberi and her suburbs, and Dabor and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Dabor and its surrounding lands, and Anam and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Ramoth, and Ænan and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: and from tribe of Aser, Masal and its surrounding lands, and Abaran and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And of the tribe of Aser; Maasal and her suburbs, and Abdon and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Ikak and its surrounding lands, and Roob and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: and Acac and her suburbs, and Roob and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: And from tribe of Nephthali, Kedes in Galilaia and its surrounding lands, and Chamoth and its surrounding lands, and Kariathaim and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: And of the tribe of Nephthali; Kedes in Galilee and her suburbs, and Chamoth and her suburbs, and Kariathaim and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: To the sons of Merari, the rest, from tribe of Zabulon, Remmon and its surrounding lands, and Thachchia and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: To the sons of Merari that were left, they gave out of the tribe of Zabulon Remmon and her suburbs, and Thabor and her suburbs:

fresh_translation: And from beyond Jordan of Iericho, west of Jordan, from tribe of Rouben, Bosor in the wilderness and its surrounding lands, and Iasa and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: out of the country beyond Jordan; Jericho westward of Jordan: out of the tribe of Ruben; Bosor in the wilderness and her suburbs, and Jasa and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Kademoth and its surrounding lands, and Mophaath and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Kadmoth and her suburbs, and Maephla and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: and from tribe of Gad, Ramoth Galaad and its surrounding lands, and Maanaim and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: Out of the tribe of Gad; Rammoth Galaad and her suburbs, and Maanaim and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Esebon and its surrounding lands, and Iazer and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: and Esebon and her suburbs, and Jazer and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Issachar: Thola and Phoua and Iasoub and Semeron, four.
brenton_translation: And as to the sons of Issachar, they were Thola, and Phua, and Jasub, and Semeron, four.

fresh_translation: And sons of Thola: Ozi and Raphaia and Ieriēl and Iemou and Iebasam and Samouēl, chiefs of houses of their fathers, to Thola, mighty men of power according to their generations. Their number in the days of Dauid was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Thola; Ozi, Raphaia, and Jeriel, and Jamai, and Jemasan, and Samuel, chiefs of their fathers' houses belonging to Thola, men of might according to their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty and two thousand and six hundred.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ozi: Iezria. And sons of Iezria: Michael and Obdia and Ioēl and Iesia, five, all chiefs.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ozi; Jezraia: and the sons of Jezraia; Michael, Abdiu, and Joel, and Jesia, five, all rulers.

fresh_translation: And with them by their generations, by houses of their fathers, mighty men to draw up for war, thirty-six thousand, because they multiplied wives and sons.
brenton_translation: And with them, according to their generations, according to the houses of their families, were men mighty to set armies in array for war, thirty and six thousand, for they had multiplied their wives and children.

fresh_translation: And their brothers in all families of Issachar, mighty in power, were eighty-seven thousand, the full number of them.
brenton_translation: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, also mighty men, were eighty-seven thousand—this was the number of them all.

fresh_translation: Beniamin: Bale and Bachir and Iadiēl, three.
brenton_translation: The sons of Benjamin; Bale, and Bachir, and Jediel, three.

fresh_translation: And sons of Bale: Asebon and Ozi and Oziēl and Ierimoth and Ouri, five, chiefs of houses of fathers, mighty men of power, and their number was twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Bale; Esebon, and Ozi, and Oziel, and Jerimuth, and Uri, five; heads of houses of families, mighty men; and their number was twenty and two thousand and thirty-four.

fresh_translation: And sons of Bachir: Zamarias and Ioas and Eliezer and Elithenan and Amaria and Ierimoth and Abiou and Anathoth and Gemeeth. All these were sons of Bachir.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Bachir; Zemira, and Joas, and Eliezer, and Elithenan, and Amaria, and Jerimuth, and Abiud, and Anathoth, and Eleemeth: all these were the sons of Bachir.

fresh_translation: And their number by their generations, chiefs of houses of their fathers, mighty men of power, was twenty thousand two hundred.
brenton_translation: And their number according to their generations, (they were chiefs of their fathers' houses, men of might), was twenty thousand and two hundred.

fresh_translation: And sons of Iadiēl: Balaan. And sons of Balaan: Iaous and Beniamin and Aoth and Chanana and Zaithan and Ramessai and Achisaar.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jediel; Balaan: and the sons of Balaan; Jaüs, and Benjamin, and Aoth, and Chanana, and Zæthan, and Tharsi, and Achisaar.

fresh_translation: All these sons of Iadiēl, chiefs of fathers, mighty in power, were seventeen thousand two hundred, going out in force to make war.
brenton_translation: All these were the sons of Jediel, chiefs of their families, men of might, seventeen thousand and two hundred, going forth to war with might.

fresh_translation: And Sapphin and Apphin and sons of Raōm: his son Aēr.
brenton_translation: And Sapphin, and Apphin, and the sons of Or, Asom, whose son was Aor.

fresh_translation: Sons of Nephthali: Iasiēl and Gōni and Issiēr and Salom, sons of Balaa.
brenton_translation: The sons of Nephthali; Jasiel, Goni, and Aser, and Sellum, his sons, Balam his son.

fresh_translation: Sons of Manassē: Aseriēl, whom his Syrian concubine bore. She bore Machir father of Galaad.
brenton_translation: The sons of Manasse; Esriel, whom his Syrian concubine bore; and she bore to him also Machir the father of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Machir took a wife for Amphin and Maphin, and name of his sister was Moocha, and name of the second was Salpaad, and daughters were born to Salpaad.
brenton_translation: And Machir took a wife for Apphin and Sapphin, and his sister's name was Moöcha; and the name of the second son was Sapphaad; and to Sapphaad were born daughters.

fresh_translation: And Moocha wife of Machir bore a son and called his name Phares, and name of his brother was Soros. His son was Oulam.
brenton_translation: And Moöcha the wife of Machir bore a son, and called his name Phares; and his brother's name was Surus; his sons were Ulam, and Rocom.

fresh_translation: And sons of Oulam: Badan. These were sons of Galaad son of Machir son of Manassē.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ulam; Badam. These were the sons of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And his sister Malecheth bore Isadek and Abiezer and Maela.
brenton_translation: And his sister Malecheth bore Isud, and Abiezer, and Maela.

fresh_translation: And sons of Semira were Iaaim and Sychem and Lakei and Aniam.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Semira were, Aim, and Sychem, and Lakim, and Anian.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ephraim: Sothala and Barad his son, and Thaath his son, Eleada his son, Nomee his son,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ephraim; Sothalath, and Barad his son, and Thaath his son, Elada his son, Saath his son,

fresh_translation: Zabed his son, Sothele his son, and Ezer and Elead. And men of Geth, those born in the land, killed them, because they went down to take their cattle.
brenton_translation: and Zabad his son, Sothele his son, and Azer, and Elead: and the men of Geth who were born in the land slew them, because they went down to take their cattle.

fresh_translation: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
brenton_translation: And their father Ephraim mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

fresh_translation: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Baraga, because he came in evils to my house.
brenton_translation: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beria, because, said he, He was afflicted in my house.

fresh_translation: And his daughter Seera built lower Baithoron and upper Baithoron and Ozan-seera.
brenton_translation: And his daughter was Saraa, and he was among them that were left, and he built Bæthoron the upper and the lower. And the descendants of Ozan were Seera,

fresh_translation: And Raphe his son, Raseph, and Thale his son, Thaen his son,
brenton_translation: and Raphe his son, Saraph and Thalees his sons, Thaen his son.

fresh_translation: Laadan his son, Amioud his son, Elisama his son,
brenton_translation: To Laadan his son was born his son Amiud, his son Helisamai, his son

fresh_translation: Noum his son, Iēsoue his son.
brenton_translation: Nun, his son Jesue, these were his sons.

fresh_translation: And their possession and their dwelling were Baithēl and its villages, eastward Naaran, westward Gazer and its villages, and Sychem and its villages as far as Gaian and its villages.
brenton_translation: And their possession and their dwelling were Bæthel and her towns, to the east Noaran, westward Gazer and her towns, and Sychem and her towns, as far as Gaza and her towns.

fresh_translation: And to borders of sons of Manassē: Baithsaan and its villages, Thaanach and its villages, Balad and its villages, Mageddo and its villages, Dor and its villages. In these dwelt the sons of Ioseph son of Israel.
brenton_translation: And as far as the borders of the sons of Manasse, Bæthsaan and her towns, Thanach and her towns, Mageddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In this the children of Joseph the son of Israel dwelt.

fresh_translation: Sons of Aser: Iemna and Isoua and Isoui and Beriga and Sore their sister.
brenton_translation: The sons of Aser; Jemna, and Suia, and Isui, and Beria, and Sore their sister.

fresh_translation: And sons of Beriga: Chaber and Melchiēl, this one father of Berzaith.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Beria; Chaber, and Melchiel; he was the father of Berthaith.

fresh_translation: And Chaber begot Iaphalet and Samer and Chotham and Sola their sister.
brenton_translation: And Chaber begot Japhlet, and Samer, and Chothan, and Sola their sister.

fresh_translation: And sons of Iaphalet: Phesechi, Bamaēl, and Asith. These were sons of Iaphalet.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Japhlet; Phasec, and Bamael, and Asith: these are the sons of Japhlet.

fresh_translation: And sons of Semmēr: Achiouraoga and Oba and Aram.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Semmer; Achir, and Rooga, and Jaba, and Aram.

fresh_translation: And sons of Baniēlam his brother: Sopha and Imana and Selles and Amal.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Elam his brother; Sopha, and Imana, and Selles, and Amal.

fresh_translation: Sons of Sopha: Chouchi, Arnaphar, Soual, Bari, and Imarē,
brenton_translation: The sons of Sopha; Sue, and Arnaphar, and Suda, and Barin, and Imran,

fresh_translation: Sobal and Od and Semma and Salisa and Iethran and Beēra.
brenton_translation: and Basan, and Oa, and Sama, and Salisa, and Jethra, and Beëra.

fresh_translation: And sons of Iether: Iphina and Phaspha and Ara.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jether, Jephina, and Phaspha, and Ara.

fresh_translation: And sons of Oula: Orech, Aniēl, and Rasia.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ola; Orech, Aniel, and Rasia.

fresh_translation: All these were sons of Aser, all chiefs of fathers, chosen mighty men of power, leading chiefs. Their number for drawing up battle was twenty-six thousand men.
brenton_translation: All these were the sons of Aser, all heads of families, choice, mighty men, chief leaders: their number for battle array—their number was twenty-six thousand men.

fresh_translation: And Beniamin begot Bale his firstborn, Asbel the second, Aara the third,
brenton_translation: Now Benjamin begot Bale his first-born, and Asbel his second son, Aara the third, Noa the fourth,

fresh_translation: Noa the fourth, and Raphe the fifth.
brenton_translation: and Rapha the fifth.

fresh_translation: And there were sons to Bale: Ader and Gera and Abioud,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Bale were, Adir, and Gera, and Abiud,

fresh_translation: and Abisoue and Nooma and Achia,
brenton_translation: and Abessue, and Noama, and Achia,

fresh_translation: and Gera and Sōpharphak and Oim.
brenton_translation: and Gera, and Sephupham, and Uram.

fresh_translation: These are sons of Aod. These are chiefs of fathers for those dwelling in Gabee, and they deported them to Manachathi,
brenton_translation: These were the sons of Aod: these are the heads of families to them that dwell in Gabee, and they removed them to Machanathi:

fresh_translation: and Nooma and Achia and Gera. This one begot Naana and Achichod.
brenton_translation: and Nooma, and Achia and Gera, he removed them, and he begot Aza, and Jachicho.

fresh_translation: And Saarim begot in the plain of Moab after sending away Ousim and Baada his wives.
brenton_translation: And Saarin begot children in the plain of Moab, after that he had sent away Osin and Baada his wives.

fresh_translation: And by Ada his wife he begot Iobab and Sebia and Misa and Melcham,
brenton_translation: And he begot of his wife Ada, Jolab, and Sebia, and Misa, and Melchas,

fresh_translation: and Iaos and Sabia and Marma. These were chiefs of fathers.
brenton_translation: and Jebus, and Zabia, and Marma: these were heads of families.

fresh_translation: And from Ousim he begot Abitob and Alphaal.
brenton_translation: And of Osin he begot Abitol, and Alphaal.

fresh_translation: And sons of Alphaal: Obed, Messaam, Semmer. This one built Ono and Lod and its villages.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Alphaal; Obed, Misaal, Semmer: he built Ona, and Lod, and its towns:

fresh_translation: And Beriga and Sama, these were chiefs of fathers for those dwelling in Ailam, and these drove out those dwelling in Geth.
brenton_translation: and Beria, and Sama; these were heads of families among the dwellers in Elam, and they drove out the inhabitants of Geth.

fresh_translation: And his brother Sosek and Iarimoth,
brenton_translation: And his brethren were Sosec, and Arimoth,

fresh_translation: and Zabadia and Orer and Oded,
brenton_translation: and Zabadia, and Ored, and Eder,

fresh_translation: and Michael and Iespha and Iocha, sons of Bariga,
brenton_translation: and Michael, and Jespha, and Joda, the sons of Beria:

fresh_translation: and Zabadia and Mosollam and Azaki and Abar,
brenton_translation: and Zabadia, and Mosollam, and Azaki, and Abar,

fresh_translation: and Isamari and Iezlia and Iobab, sons of Elphaal,
brenton_translation: and Isamari, and Jexlias, and Jobab, the sons of Elphaal:

fresh_translation: and Iakim and Zechri and Zabdi,
brenton_translation: and Jakim, and Zachri, and Zabdi,

fresh_translation: and Elioēnai and Salthi and Eliēli,
brenton_translation: and Elionai, and Salathi,

fresh_translation: and Adaia and Baraia and Samarath, sons of Samai,
brenton_translation: and Elieli, and Adaia, and Baraia, and Samarath, sons of Samaith:

fresh_translation: and Isphan and Obed and Eleēl,
brenton_translation: and Jesphan, and Obed, and Eliel,

fresh_translation: and Abadōn and Zechri and Anan,
brenton_translation: and Abdon, and Zechri, and Anan,

fresh_translation: and Anania and Ambri and Ailam and Anathōthia,
brenton_translation: and Anania, and Ambri, and Ælam, and Anathoth,

fresh_translation: and Athin and Iepheria and Pheliēl, sons of Sosek,
brenton_translation: and Jathin, and Jephadias, and Phanuel, the sons of Sosec:

fresh_translation: and Samsaria and Saaria and Ogotholia,
brenton_translation: and Samsari, and Saarias, and Gotholia,

fresh_translation: and Iaarasia and Elia and Zechri, sons of Ieraam.
brenton_translation: and Jarasia, and Eria, and Zechri, son of Iroam.

fresh_translation: These were chiefs of fathers according to their generations, chiefs. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: These were heads of families, chiefs according to their generations: these dwelt in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And in Gabaon dwelt father of Gabaon, and name of his wife was Maacha.
brenton_translation: And the father of Gabaon dwelt in Gabaon; and his wife's name was Moacha.

fresh_translation: And her firstborn son was Abadōn, and Sour and Kis and Baal and Nēr and Nadab,
brenton_translation: And her first-born son was Abdon, and Sur, and Kis, and Baal, and Nadab, and Ner,

fresh_translation: and Gedour and his brother and Zachour and Makalōth.
brenton_translation: and Gedur and his brother, and Zacchur, and Makeloth.

fresh_translation: And Makalōth begot Semaa, and these also dwelt opposite their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.
brenton_translation: And Makeloth begot Samaa: for these dwelt in Jerusalem in the presence of their brethren with their brethren.

fresh_translation: And Nēr begot Kis, and Kis begot Saul, and Saul begot Ionathan and Melchisoue and Aminadab and Asabal.
brenton_translation: And Ner begot Kis, and Kis begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, and Melchisue, and Aminadab, and Asabal.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ionathan: Meribaal. And Meribaal begot Michia.
brenton_translation: And the son of Jonathan was Meribaal; and Meribaal begot Micha.

fresh_translation: And sons of Michia: Phithon and Melchiēl and Theree and Achaz.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Micha; Phithon, and Melach, and Tharach, and Achaz.

fresh_translation: And Achaz begot Iōiada, and Iōiada begot Galemath and Asmoth and Zambri, and Zambri begot Maisa.
brenton_translation: And Achaz begot Jada, and Jada begot Salæmath, and Asmoth, and Zambri; and Zambri begot Mæsa;

fresh_translation: And Maisa begot Baana, Raphaia his son, Elasa his son, Esel his son.
brenton_translation: and Mæsa begot Baana: Rhaphæa, was his son, Elasa his son, Esel his son.

fresh_translation: And Esel had six sons, and these are their names: Ezrikam his firstborn, and Ismaēl and Saraias and Abdia and Anan. All these were sons of Esel.
brenton_translation: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names; Ezricam his first-born, and Ismael, and Saraia, and Abdia, and Anan, and Asa: all these were the sons of Esel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Asel his brother: Ailam his firstborn, Iais the second, Eliphaleit the third.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Asel his brother; Ælam his first-born, and Jas the second, and Eliphalet the third.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ailam were mighty men of power, drawing bow, multiplying sons and sons of sons, a hundred fifty. All these were from sons of Beniamin.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ælam were mighty men, bending the bow, and multiplying sons and grandsons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And all Israel, their enrollment, and these are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, with those deported to Babylon in their lawlessness.
brenton_translation: And this is all Israel, even their enrolment: and these are written down in the book of the kings of Israel and Juda, with the names of them that were carried away to Babylon for their transgressions.

fresh_translation: And those dwelling first in their possessions in the cities of Israel were the priests, the Levites, and the given ones.
brenton_translation: And they that dwelt before in their possessions in the cities of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the appointed ones.

fresh_translation: And in Jerusalem dwelt from sons of Judah and from sons of Beniamin and from sons of Ephraim and Manassē,
brenton_translation: And there dwelt in Jerusalem some of the children of Juda, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasse.

fresh_translation: Gouthi son of Ammioud son of Amri, of the sons of Phares son of Iouda.
brenton_translation: And Gnothi, and the son of Samiud, the son of Amri, the son of Ambraim, the son of Buni, son of the sons of Phares, the son of Juda.

fresh_translation: And from the Seloni: Asaia his firstborn and his sons.
brenton_translation: And of the Selonites; Asaia his first-born, and his sons.

fresh_translation: From the sons of Zara: Iiēl and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Zara; Jeel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Beniamin: Salō son of Mosollam son of Odouia son of Sanaa,
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Benjamin; Salom, son of Mosollam, son of Odouia, son of Asinu.

fresh_translation: and Ibanaa son of Iraam, and these sons of Ozi son of Machir, and Massalēm son of Saphatia son of Ragouēl son of Banaia,
brenton_translation: And Jemnaa son of Jeroboam, and Elo: these are the sons of Ozi the son of Machir: and Mosollam, son of Saphatia, son of Raguel, son of Jemnai;

fresh_translation: and their brothers by their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All the men were chiefs of fathers by houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: and their brethren according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six, all the men were heads of families according to the houses of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And from the priests: Iōdae and Iōarim and Iachin,
brenton_translation: And of the priests; Jodaë, and Joarim, and Jachin,

fresh_translation: and Azaria son of Chelkias son of Mosollam son of Sadok son of Maraioth son of Achitob, ruler of house of God,
brenton_translation: and Azaria the son of Chelcias, the son of Mosollam, the son of Sadoc, the son of Maraïoth, the son of Achitob, the ruler of the house of God;

fresh_translation: and Adaia son of Iraam son of Paskor son of Malchia, and Maasia son of Adiēl son of Iediou son of Mosollam son of Maselmoth son of Emmēr,
brenton_translation: and Adaia son of Iraam, son of Phascor, son of Melchia, and Maasaia son of Adiel, son of Ezira, son of Mosollam, son of Maselmoth, son of Emmer;

fresh_translation: and their brothers, chiefs of houses of fathers, one thousand seven hundred sixty, mighty in strength for work of service of house of God.
brenton_translation: and their brethren, chiefs of their families, a thousand seven hundred and sixty, mighty men for the work of the ministration of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And from the Levites: Samaias son of Asob son of Esrikam son of Asabia, from the sons of Merari,
brenton_translation: And of the Levites; Samaia son of Asob, son of Ezricam, son of Asabia, of the sons of Merari.

fresh_translation: and Bakbakar and Ares and Galal and Manthanias son of Micha son of Zechri son of Asaph,
brenton_translation: And Bacbacar, and Ares, and Galaal, and Matthanias son of Micha, son of Zechri, son of Asaph;

fresh_translation: and Abdia son of Samia son of Galal son of Idithon, and Barachia son of Ossa son of Elkana, the one dwelling in the villages of the Netophathi.
brenton_translation: and Abdia, son of Samia, son of Galaal, son of Idithun, and Barachia son of Ossa, son of Helcana—who dwelt in the villages of the Notephatites.

fresh_translation: The gatekeepers: Salom and Akoub and Talman and Aiman and their brothers. Salom the chief.
brenton_translation: The door-keepers; Salom, Acum, Telmon, and Diman, and their brethren; Salom was the chief;

fresh_translation: And until this day at the king's gate eastward, these were the gates of the encampments of the sons of Levi.
brenton_translation: and he waited hitherto in the king's gate eastward: these are the gates of the companies of the sons of Levi.

fresh_translation: And Salom son of Kore son of Abiasaph son of Kore, and his brothers to house of his father, the Korites, were over works of the service, guarding the guards of the tent, and their fathers were over the encampment of the Lord, guarding the entrance.
brenton_translation: And Sellum the son of Core, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core, and his brethren belonging to the house of his father, the Corites were over the works of the service, keeping the watches of the tabernacle, and their fathers over the camp of the Lord, keeping the entrance.

fresh_translation: And Phinees son of Eleazar was ruler over them before, and these were with him.
brenton_translation: And Phinees son of Eleazar was head over them before the Lord, and these were with him.

fresh_translation: Zacharias son of Masalami was gatekeeper of the door of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: Zacharias the son of Mosollami was keeper of the door of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: All the chosen ones at the gates in the gates were two hundred twelve. These in their courts: their enrollment. Dauid and Samuel the seer established them in their faithfulness.
brenton_translation: All the chosen porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve, these were in their courts, this was their distribution: these David and Samuel the seer established in their charge.

fresh_translation: And these and their sons were over the gates in the house of the Lord, in the house of the tent, to guard.
brenton_translation: And these and their sons were over the gates in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the tabernacle, to keep watch.

fresh_translation: To the four winds were the gates: east, west, north, south.
brenton_translation: The gates were toward the four winds, eastward, westward, northward, southward.

fresh_translation: And their brothers in their courts were to enter every seven days from time to time with them.
brenton_translation: And their brethren were in their courts, to enter in weekly from time to time with these.

fresh_translation: Because in faithfulness there were four mighty gatekeepers. The Levites were over the storerooms and over the treasuries of the house of God.
brenton_translation: For four strong men have the charge of the gates; and the Levites were over the chambers, and they keep watch over the treasures of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And around the house of God they encamped, because the guard was upon them, and they were over the keys, to open the doors of the sanctuary morning by morning.
brenton_translation: For the charge was upon them, and these were charged with the keys to open the doors of the temple every morning.

fresh_translation: And from them some were over the vessels of the service, because by number they bring them in and by number they bring them out.
brenton_translation: And some of them were appointed over the vessels of service, that they should carry them in by number, and carry them out by number.

fresh_translation: And from them some were appointed over the vessels and over all the holy vessels and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the frankincense and the spices.
brenton_translation: And some of them were appointed over the furniture, and over all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of the priests were mixers of the ointment and of the spices.
brenton_translation: And some of the priests were makers of the ointment, and appointed to prepare the spices.

fresh_translation: And Matthathias from the Levites, this one firstborn to Salom the Korite, in faithfulness over the works of the pan of the great priest.
brenton_translation: And Matthathias of the Levites, (he was the first-born of Salom the Corite,) was set in charge over the sacrifices of meat-offering of the pan belonging to the high priest.

fresh_translation: And Banaias the Kaathite, from their brothers, was over the bread of presentation, to prepare it Sabbath by Sabbath.
brenton_translation: And Banaias the Caathite, from among their brethren, was set over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

fresh_translation: And these were singers, chiefs of fathers of the Levites, appointed by courses, because day and night the works were upon them.
brenton_translation: And these were the singers, heads of families of the Levites, to whom were established daily courses, for they were employed in the services day and night.

fresh_translation: These were chiefs of fathers of the Levites according to their generations, chiefs. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: These were the heads of the families of the Levites according to their generations; these chiefs dwelt in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And in Gabaon dwelt father of Gabaon, Iiiēl, and name of his wife was Moocha.
brenton_translation: And Jeël the father of Gabaon dwelt in Gabaon; and his wife's name was Moöcha.

fresh_translation: And her firstborn son was Abadōn, and Sir and Kis and Baal and Nēr and Nadab,
brenton_translation: And his first-born son was Abdon, and he had Sur, and Kis, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

fresh_translation: and Gedour and his brother and Zacharia and Makelloth.
brenton_translation: and Gedur and his brother, and Zacchur, and Makeloth.

fresh_translation: And Makelloth begot Samaa. And these also dwelt in Jerusalem in midst of their brothers with their brothers.
brenton_translation: And Makeloth begot Samaa: and these dwelt in the midst of their brethren in Jerusalem, even in the midst of their brethren.

fresh_translation: And Nēr begot Kis, and Kis begot Saul, and Saul begot Ionathan and Melchisoue and Aminadab and Isbaal.
brenton_translation: And Ner begot Kis, and Kis begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, and Melchisue, and Aminadab, and Asabal.

fresh_translation: And son of Ionathan was Maribaal, and Maribaal begot Micha.
brenton_translation: And the son of Jonathan was Meribaal: and Meribaal begot Micha.

fresh_translation: And sons of Micha: Phaithon and Malach and Tharach.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Micha were Phithon and Malach, and Tharach.

fresh_translation: And Achaz begot Iada, and Iada begot Galemeth and Gazmoth and Zambri, and Zambri begot Masa.
brenton_translation: And Achaz begot Jada: and Jada begot Galemeth, and Gazmoth, and Zambri; and Zambri begot Massa.

fresh_translation: And Masa begot Baana, Raphaia his son, Eleasa his son, Esel his son.
brenton_translation: And Massa begot Baana, and Rhaphaïa was his son, Elasa his son, Esel his son.

fresh_translation: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names: Esdrikam his firstborn, Ismaēl and Saria and Abdia and Anan. These were sons of Esel.
brenton_translation: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names; Esricam his first-born, and Ismael, and Saraia, and Abdia, and Anan, and Asa: these were the sons of Esel.

fresh_translation: And Philistines fought against Israel, and Israel fled from before Philistines, and wounded men fell on Mount Gelboue.
brenton_translation: Now the Philistines warred against Israel; and they fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And Philistines pursued after Saul and after his sons, and Philistines struck Ionathan and Aminadab and Melchisoue, sons of Saul.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines pursued after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines smote Jonathan, and Aminadab, and Melchisue, sons of Saul.

fresh_translation: And battle grew heavy against Saul, and archers found him with bows, and he was pained from arrows.
brenton_translation: And the battle prevailed against Saul, and the archers hit him with bows and arrows, and they were wounded of the bows.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to one carrying his weapons, Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised come and mock me. But one carrying his weapons would not, because he feared greatly. And Saul took sword and fell upon it.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his armour-bearer, Draw thy sword, and pierce me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and mock me. But his armour-bearer would not, for he was greatly afraid: so Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

fresh_translation: And one carrying his weapons saw that Saul had died, and he too fell upon his sword and died.
brenton_translation: And his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, and he also fell upon his sword.

fresh_translation: And Saul died, and his three sons died on that day, and all his house died together.
brenton_translation: So Saul died, and his three sons on that day, and all his family died at the same time.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel in valley saw that Israel fled and that Saul and his sons had died, and they left their cities and fled, and Philistines came and lived in them.
brenton_translation: And all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, and they left their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass on next day, and Philistines came to strip slain men, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gelboue.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the next day that the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on mount Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And they stripped him and took his head and his weapons, and sent into land of Philistines all around to proclaim good news to their idols and to people.
brenton_translation: And they stripped him, and took his head, and his armour, and sent them into the land of the Philistines round about, to proclaim the glad tidings to their idols, and to the people.

fresh_translation: And they put his weapons in house of their god, and they put his head in house of Dagon.
brenton_translation: And they put their armour in the house of their god, and they put his head in the house of Dagon.

fresh_translation: And all dwelling in Galaad heard all that Philistines had done to Saul and to Israel.
brenton_translation: And all the dwellers in Galaad heard of all that the Philistines had done to Saul and to Israel.

fresh_translation: And every mighty man from Galaad rose and took body of Saul and bodies of his sons and brought them to Iabis, and they buried their bones under oak in Iabis and fasted seven days.
brenton_translation: And all the mighty men rose up from Galaad, and they took the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabis, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabis, and fasted seven days.

fresh_translation: And Saul died in his lawless deeds which he committed lawlessly against Lord, against word of Lord, because he did not keep it, because Saul inquired through ventriloquist to seek, and Samuel prophet answered him.
brenton_translation: So Saul died for his transgressions, wherein he transgressed against God, against the word of the Lord, forasmuch as he kept it not, because Saul enquired of a wizard to seek counsel, and Samuel the prophet answered him:

fresh_translation: And he did not seek Lord, and he put him to death and turned kingdom to Dauid son of Iessai.
brenton_translation: and he sought not the Lord: so he slew him, and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.

fresh_translation: And all Israel came to Dauid in Chebron, saying, Behold, we are your bones and your flesh.
brenton_translation: And all Israel came to David in Chebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bones and thy flesh.

fresh_translation: Even yesterday and third day, when Saul was king, you were one bringing Israel out and bringing it in, and Lord your God said to you, You shall shepherd my people Israel, and you shall be ruler over Israel.
brenton_translation: And heretofore when Saul was king, thou wast he that led Israel in and out, and the Lord of Israel said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be for a ruler over Israel.

fresh_translation: And all elders of Israel came to king in Chebron, and king Dauid made covenant with them in Chebron before Lord, and they anointed Dauid king over Israel according to word of Lord by hand of Samuel.
brenton_translation: And all the elders of Israel came to the king to Chebron; and king David made a covenant with them in Chebron before the Lord: and they anointed David to be king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.

fresh_translation: And king and men of Israel went to Ierousalem, this is Iebous, and there were Iebousites dwelling in land.
brenton_translation: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem, this is Jebus; and there the Jebusites the inhabitants of the land said to David,

fresh_translation: And those dwelling in Iebous said to Dauid, You shall not enter here. But he captured stronghold of Sion; this is City of Dauid.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not enter in hither. But he took the strong hold of Sion: this is the city of David.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said, Whoever strikes Iebousite first shall become ruler and commander. And Ioab son of Sarouia went up first and became ruler.
brenton_translation: And David said, Whoever first smites the Jebusite, even he shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Saruia went up first, and became chief.

fresh_translation: And Dauid settled in stronghold; therefore he called it City of Dauid.
brenton_translation: And David dwelt in the strong hold; therefore he called it the city of David.

fresh_translation: And he built city all around and fought and took city.
brenton_translation: And he fortified the city round about.

fresh_translation: And Dauid kept going, going and growing great, and Lord Almighty was with him.
brenton_translation: And David continued to increase, and the Lord Almighty was with him.

fresh_translation: And these were chiefs of mighty men who belonged to Dauid, those prevailing with him in his kingdom with all Israel to make him king according to word of Lord over Israel.
brenton_translation: And these are the chiefs of the mighty men, whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

fresh_translation: And this was number of mighty men of Dauid: Iesebaal son of Achamani, first of thirty; he drew his sword once against three hundred wounded men at one time.
brenton_translation: And this is the list of the mighty men of David; Jesebada, son of Achaman, first of the thirty: he drew his sword once against three hundred whom he slew at one time.

fresh_translation: And after him Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite; he was among three mighty men.
brenton_translation: And after him Eleazar son of Dodai, the Achochite: he was among the three mighty men.

fresh_translation: He was with Dauid in Phasodomin, and Philistines gathered there for battle, and there was a portion of field full of barley, and people fled from before Philistines.
brenton_translation: He was with David in Phasodamin, and the Philistines were gathered there to battle, and there was a portion of the field full of barley; and the people fled before the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he stood in middle of portion and saved it and struck Philistines, and Lord made great deliverance.
brenton_translation: And he stood in the midst of the portion, and rescued it, and smote the Philistines; and the Lord wrought a great deliverance.

fresh_translation: And three from thirty chiefs went down to rock, to Dauid, into cave of Odollam, and camp of Philistines had camped in valley of giants.
brenton_translation: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, to the cave of Odollam, and the camp of the Philistines was in the giants' valley.

fresh_translation: And Dauid was then in stronghold, and garrison of Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
brenton_translation: And David was then in the hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethleem.

fresh_translation: And Dauid desired and said, Who will give me water to drink from cistern of Bethlehem, one by gate?
brenton_translation: And David longed, and said, Who will give me water to drink of the well of Bethleem, that is in the gate?

fresh_translation: And three broke through camp of Philistines and drew water from cistern in Bethlehem, which was by gate, and took it and came to Dauid. But Dauid would not drink it, and he poured it out to Lord.
brenton_translation: And the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, and they drew water out of the well that was in Bethleem, which was in the gate, and they took it, and came to David: but David would not drink it, and poured it out to the Lord, and said,

fresh_translation: And he said, God be merciful to me from doing this thing. Shall I drink blood of these men with their lives? For with their lives they brought it. And he would not drink it. These things three mighty men did.
brenton_translation: God forbid that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men with their lives? for with the peril of their lives they brought it. So he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

fresh_translation: And Abessa brother of Ioab, he was chief of three. He drew his sword against three hundred wounded men at one time, and he was named among three.
brenton_translation: And Abisa the brother of Joab, he was chief of three: he drew his sword against three hundred slain at one time, and he had a name among the second three.

fresh_translation: Of three he was more glorious than two, and he was their ruler, but he did not attain to three.
brenton_translation: He was more famous than the two others of the three, and he was chief over them; yet he reached not to the first three.

fresh_translation: And Banaias son of Iodae, son of mighty man, his deeds were many, above Kabasael. He struck two sons of Ariel of Moab, and he went down and struck lion in pit on snowy day.
brenton_translation: And Banaia the son of Jodae was the son of a mighty man: many were his acts for Cabasael: he smote two lion-like men of Moab, and he went down and smote a lion in a pit on a snowy day.

fresh_translation: And he struck Egyptian man, visible man, five cubits tall, and in hand of Egyptian was spear like beam of weavers, and Banaias went down against him with staff and took spear from hand of Egyptian and killed him with his own spear.
brenton_translation: And he smote an Egyptian, a wonderful man five cubits high; and in the hand of the Egyptian there was a spear like a weavers' beam; and Banaia went down to him with a staff, and took the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

fresh_translation: These things Banaias son of Iodae did, and to him was name among three mighty men.
brenton_translation: These things did Banaia son of Jodae, and his name was among the three mighties.

fresh_translation: He was glorious above thirty, but he did not attain to three, and Dauid set him over his family.
brenton_translation: He was distinguished beyond the thirty, yet he reached not to the first three: and David set him over his family.

fresh_translation: And mighty men of forces: Asael brother of Ioab, Eleanan son of Dodo from Baithlaem,
brenton_translation: And the mighty men of the forces were, Asael the brother of Joab, Eleanan the son of Dodoe of Bethleem,

fresh_translation: Sammoth the Adi, Chelles the Pheloni,
brenton_translation: Samaoth the Arorite, Chelles the Phelonite,

fresh_translation: Orai son of Ekkes the Thekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
brenton_translation: Ora the son of Ekkis the Thecoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

fresh_translation: Sobochai the Asothite, Eli the Ahohite,
brenton_translation: Sobochai the Usathite, Eli the Achonite,

fresh_translation: Moorai the Netophathite, Cholod son of Nooza the Netophathite,
brenton_translation: Marai the Netophathite, Chthaod the son of Nooza the Netophathite,

fresh_translation: Aithi son of Ribai from hill of Beniamin, Banaias the Pharathonite,
brenton_translation: Airi the son of Rebie of the hill of Benjamin, Banaias the Pharathonite,

fresh_translation: Ouri from Nachaligaas, Abiel the Garabeththite,
brenton_translation: Uri of Nachali Gaas, Abiel the Garabæthite,

fresh_translation: Azmoth the Beermi, Eliaba the Salabonite,
brenton_translation: Azbon the Baromite, Eliaba the Salabonite,

fresh_translation: Bennaias, Hosom the Gennounite, Ionathan son of Sola the Hararite,
brenton_translation: the son of Asam the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Sola the Ararite,

fresh_translation: Achim son of Sachar the Hararite, Elphal son of Our,
brenton_translation: Achim the son of Achar the Ararite, Elphat the son of Thyrophar

fresh_translation: Ophar the Mechorathite, Achia the Phelonite,
brenton_translation: the Mechorathrite, Achia the Phellonite,

fresh_translation: Heserai the Charmalite, Naarai son of Azobai,
brenton_translation: Esere the Charmadaite, Naarai the son of Azobai,

fresh_translation: Ioel brother of Nathan, Mebaar son of Agari,
brenton_translation: Joel the son of Nathan, Mebaal son of Agari,

fresh_translation: Selek the Ammonite, Nachor the Berthite, carrier of weapons of Ioab son of Sarouia,
brenton_translation: Sele the son of Ammoni, Nachor the Berothite, armour-bearer to the son of Saruia,

fresh_translation: Ira the Iethrite, Gareb the Iethrite,
brenton_translation: Ira the Jethrite, Gaber the Jethrite,

fresh_translation: Ourias the Chettite, Zabet son of Achlia,
brenton_translation: Uria the Chettite, Zabet son of Achaia,

fresh_translation: Adina son of Saiza the Reubenite, ruler, and with him thirty,
brenton_translation: Adina son of Sæza, a chief of Ruben, and thirty with him,

fresh_translation: Anan son of Moocha, and Iosaphat the Baithanite,
brenton_translation: Anan the son of Moöcha, and Josaphat the Matthanite,

fresh_translation: Ozia the Astarothite, Samma and Iiēl sons of Chothan the Hararite,
brenton_translation: Ozia the Astarothite, Samatha and Jeiel sons of Chotham the Ararite,

fresh_translation: Iediēl son of Sameri and Ioazae his brother the Ieasite,
brenton_translation: Jediel the son of Sameri, and Jozae his brother the Thosaite,

fresh_translation: Eliēl the Mii, and Iaribi, and Iosia son of Elnaam, and Iethemas the Moabite,
brenton_translation: Eliel the Maoite, and Jaribi, and Josia his son, Ellaam, and Jethama the Moabite,

fresh_translation: Aliēl and Obed and Iesiēl the Misabian.
brenton_translation: Daliel, and Obeth, and Jessiel of Mesobia.

fresh_translation: And these were those who came to Dauid in Sekelag, while he was still shut in away from before Saul son of Kis, and these were among mighty men helping in war,
brenton_translation: And these are they that came to Sikelag, when he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kis; and these were among the mighty, aiding him in war,

fresh_translation: with bow in right hand and in left hand, slingers with stones and arrows, from brothers of Saul, from Beniamin.
brenton_translation: and using the bow with the right hand and with the left, and slingers with stones, and shooters with bows. Of the brethren of Saul of Benjamin,

fresh_translation: Chief was Achiezer and Ioas son of Asma the Gebothite, and Ioel and Iophalet sons of Asmoth, and Berchia, and Iēoul the Anathothite,
brenton_translation: the chief was Achiezer, and Joas son of Asma the Gabathite, and Joel and Jophalet, sons of Asmoth, and Berchia, and Jeul of Anathoth,

fresh_translation: and Samaias the Gabaonite, mighty among thirty and over thirty,
brenton_translation: and Samaias the Gabaonite a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty;

fresh_translation: Ieremias and Ieziēl and Ioanan and Iozabad the Gadarathite,
brenton_translation: and Jeremia, and Jeziel, and Joanan, and Jozabath of Gadarathiim,

fresh_translation: Eliazai and Iarimouth and Baalia and Samaria and Saphatia the Chariphite,
brenton_translation: Azai and Arimuth, and Baalia, and Samaraia, and Saphatias of Charæphiel,

fresh_translation: Elkana and Iēsouni and Ozriēl and Iōazar and Iesboam the Korites,
brenton_translation: Helcana, and Jesuni, and Ozriel, and Jozara, and Sobocam, and the Corites,

fresh_translation: and Elia and Zabadia sons of Ieraam, sons of Gedor.
brenton_translation: and Jelia and Zabadia, sons of Iroam, and the men of Gedor.

fresh_translation: And from Gadites men separated themselves to Dauid from wilderness, mighty men, men of battle line for war, carrying shields and spears, and their faces were lion faces, and they were swift as gazelles on mountains.
brenton_translation: And from Gad these separated themselves to David from the wilderness, strong mighty men of war, bearing shields and spears, and their faces were as the face of a lion, and they were nimble as roes upon the mountains in speed.

fresh_translation: Azer chief, Abdias second, Eliab third,
brenton_translation: Aza the chief, Abdia the second, Eliab the third,

fresh_translation: Masemannē fourth, Ieremia fifth,
brenton_translation: Masmana the fourth, Jeremias the fifth,

fresh_translation: Eththi sixth, Eliab seventh,
brenton_translation: Jethi the sixth, Eliab the seventh,

fresh_translation: Ioanan eighth, Eliazer ninth,
brenton_translation: Joanan the eighth, Eleazer the ninth,

fresh_translation: Ieremia tenth, Machabannai eleventh.
brenton_translation: Jeremia the tenth, Melchabanai the eleventh.

fresh_translation: These from sons of Gad were chiefs of army; least one was over hundred, and greatest over thousand.
brenton_translation: These were chiefs of the army of the sons of Gad, the least one commander of a hundred, and the greatest one of a thousand.

fresh_translation: These crossed Jordan in first month, when it was filled over all its banks, and they drove out all dwelling in valleys from east to west.
brenton_translation: These are the men that crossed over Jordan in the first month, and it had overflowed all its banks; and they drove out all the inhabitants of the valleys, from the east to the west.

fresh_translation: And some from sons of Beniamin and Iouda came for help to Dauid.
brenton_translation: And there came some of the sons of Benjamin and Juda to the assistance of David.

fresh_translation: And Dauid went out to meet them and said to them, If you have come to me in peace, let my heart be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, though no truth of hand is against me, may God of our fathers see and rebuke.
brenton_translation: And David went out to meet them, and said to them, If ye are come peaceably to me, let my heart be at peace with you: but if ye are come to betray me to my enemies unfaithfully, the God of your fathers look upon it, and reprove it.

fresh_translation: And spirit clothed Amasai, chief of thirty, and he said, Go, and your people, Dauid son of Iessai. Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, because your God has helped you. And Dauid received them and set them as chiefs of forces.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit came upon Amasai, a captain of the thirty, and he said, Go, David, son of Jesse, thou and thy people, peace, peace be to thee, and peace to thy helpers, for thy God has helped thee. And David received them, and made them captains of the forces.

fresh_translation: And from Manasse some joined Dauid when Philistines came against Saul for battle, and he did not help them, because by counsel commanders of Philistines sent him away, saying, At cost of heads of those men he will return to his lord Saul.
brenton_translation: And some came to David from Manasse, when the Philistines came against Saul to war: and he helped them not, because the captains of the Philistines took counsel, saying, With the heads of those men will he return to his master Saul.

fresh_translation: When he went to Sekelag, there joined him from Manasse: Edna and Iozabath and Iodiēl and Michaēl and Iosabeth and Elimouth and Selathi, heads of thousands of Manasse.
brenton_translation: When David was going to Sikelag, there came to him of Manasse, Edna and Jozabath, and Rodiel, and Michael, and Josabaith, and Elimuth, and Semathi: these are the captains of thousands of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And they fought alongside Dauid against raiding band, because all were mighty of strength, and they became leaders in army, in force.
brenton_translation: And they fought on the side of David against a troop, for they were all men of might; and they were commanders in the army, because of their might.

fresh_translation: Because day by day they kept coming to Dauid, into great force, like force of God.
brenton_translation: For daily men came to David, till they amounted to a great force, as the force of God.

fresh_translation: And these were names of chiefs of army who came to Dauid in Chebron to turn kingdom of Saul to him according to word of Lord.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the commanders of the army, who came to David to Chebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him according to the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Sons of Iouda, shield-bearers and spear-bearers, six thousand eight hundred, mighty for battle line.
brenton_translation: The sons of Juda, bearing shields and spears, six thousand and eight hundred mighty in war.

fresh_translation: From sons of Symeon, mighty in strength for battle line, seven thousand one hundred.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Symeon mighty for battle, seven thousand and a hundred.

fresh_translation: From sons of Leui, four thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Levi, four thousand and six hundred.

fresh_translation: And Iōadae leader for Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred.
brenton_translation: And Joadas the chief of the family of Aaron, and with him three thousand and seven hundred.

fresh_translation: And Sadok, young man mighty in strength, and from his father’s house, twenty-two chiefs.
brenton_translation: And Sadoc, a young man mighty in strength, and there were twenty-two leaders of his father's house.

fresh_translation: And from sons of Beniamin, brothers of Saul, three thousand, and still most of them were keeping watch of house of Saul.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand: and still the greater part of them kept the guard of the house of Saul.

fresh_translation: And from sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty in strength, men of name by houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand and eight hundred mighty men, famous in the houses of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And from half tribe of Manasse, eighteen thousand who were named by name to come make Dauid king.
brenton_translation: And of the half-tribe of Manasse, eighteen thousand, even those who were named by name, to make David king.

fresh_translation: And from sons of Issachar, knowing understanding for times, knowing what Israel should do, their chiefs were two hundred, and all their brothers with them.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Issachar having wisdom with regard to the times, knowing what Israel should do, two hundred; and all their brethren with them.

fresh_translation: And from Zabulon, going out for battle line with every weapon of war, fifty thousand to help Dauid, not double-hearted.
brenton_translation: And of Zabulon they that went out to battle, with all weapons of war, were fifty thousand to help David, not weak-handed.

fresh_translation: And from Nephthali, one thousand chiefs, and with them with shields and spears, thirty-seven thousand.
brenton_translation: And of Nephthali a thousand captains, and with them men with shields and spears, thirty-seven thousand.

fresh_translation: And from Danites, drawing up for battle, twenty-eight thousand eight hundred.
brenton_translation: And of the Danites men ready for war twenty-eight thousand and eight hundred.

fresh_translation: And from Aser, going out to help in war, forty thousand.
brenton_translation: And of Aser, they that went out to give aid in war, forty thousand.

fresh_translation: And from beyond Jordan, from Reuben and Gad and from half tribe of Manasse, with every weapon of war, one hundred twenty thousand.
brenton_translation: And from the country beyond Jordan, from Ruben, and the Gadites, and from the half-tribe of Manasse, a hundred and twenty thousand, with all weapons of war.

fresh_translation: All these were men of war, drawing up battle line with peaceful soul, and they came to Chebron to make Dauid king over all Israel, and remnant of Israel were one soul to make Dauid king.
brenton_translation: All these were men of war, setting the army in battle array, with a peaceful mind towards him, and they came to Chebron to make David king over all Israel: and the rest of Israel were of one mind to make David king.

fresh_translation: And they were there three days, eating and drinking, because their brothers had prepared for them.
brenton_translation: And they were there three days eating and drinking, for their brethren had made preparations.

fresh_translation: And those bordering them, even as far as Issachar and Zabulon and Nephthali, were bringing to them on camels and donkeys and mules and on calves provisions, meal, fig cakes, raisins, wine and oil, calves and sheep in abundance, because gladness was in Israel.
brenton_translation: And their neighbours, as far as Issachar and Zabulon and Nephthali, brought to them upon camels, and asses, and mules, and upon calves, victuals, meal, cakes of figs, raisins, wine, and oil, calves and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Dauid took counsel with commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every leader.
brenton_translation: And David took counsel with the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even with every commander.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to all assembly of Israel, If this seems good to you, and if it has been prospered from Lord our God, let us send to our brothers left behind in all land of Israel, and with them to priests and Levites in cities of their possession, and let them gather to us.
brenton_translation: And David said to the whole congregation of Israel, If it seem good to you, and it should be prospered by the Lord our God, let us send to our brethren that are left in all the land of Israel, and let the priests the Levites who are with them in the cities of their possession come, and let them be gathered to us.

fresh_translation: And let us bring ark of our God to us, because from days of Saul they did not seek it.
brenton_translation: And let us bring over to us the ark of our God; for men have not enquired at it since the days of Saul.

fresh_translation: And all assembly said to do so, because word was upright in eyes of all people.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation said that they would do thus; for the saying was right in the eyes of all the people.

fresh_translation: And Dauid assembled all Israel from borders of Egypt and as far as entrance of Hamath, to bring ark of God from city of Iarim.
brenton_translation: So David assembled all Israel, from the borders of Egypt even to the entering in of Hemath, to bring in the ark of God from the city of Jarim.

fresh_translation: And Dauid brought it up, and all Israel went up to City of Dauid, which belonged to Iouda, to bring up from there ark of God, Lord seated upon cheroubim, where his name was called upon it.
brenton_translation: And David brought it up: and all Israel went up to the city of David, which belonged to Juda, to bring up thence the ark of the Lord God who sits between the cherubim, whose name is called on it.

fresh_translation: And they placed ark of God on new wagon from house of Aminadab, and Oza and his brothers were leading wagon.
brenton_translation: And they set the ark of God on a new waggon brought out of the house of Aminadab: and Oza and his brethren drove the waggon.

fresh_translation: And Dauid and all Israel were playing before God with all strength, and with songs and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets.
brenton_translation: And David and all Israel were playing before the Lord with all their might, and that together with singers, and with harps, and with lutes, with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

fresh_translation: And they came as far as threshing floor, and Oza stretched out his hand to grasp ark, because calf turned it aside.
brenton_translation: And they came as far as the threshing-floor: and Oza put forth his hand to hold the ark, because the bullock moved it from its place.

fresh_translation: And Lord’s anger grew hot against Oza, and he struck him there because he stretched out his hand upon ark, and he died there before God.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Oza, and smote him there, because of his stretching forth his hand upon the ark: and he died there before God.

fresh_translation: And Dauid was troubled because Lord had broken out with breach against Oza, and he called that place Breach-of-Oza until this day.
brenton_translation: And David was dispirited, because the Lord had made a breach on Oza: and he called that place the Breach of Oza until this day.

fresh_translation: And Dauid feared God on that day, saying, How shall I bring ark of God to myself?
brenton_translation: And David feared God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God in to myself?

fresh_translation: And Dauid did not bring back ark to himself into City of Dauid, but turned it aside into house of Abeddara the Geththite.
brenton_translation: So David brought not the ark home to himself into the city of David, but he turned it aside into the house of Abeddara the Gethite.

fresh_translation: And ark of God stayed in house of Abeddara three months, and God blessed Abeddaram and all his things.
brenton_translation: And the ark of God abode in the house of Abeddara three months: and God blessed Abeddara and all that he had.

fresh_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre sent messengers to Dauid, and cedar woods and builders of walls and carpenters of wood to build him house.
brenton_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar timbers, and masons, and carpenters, to build a house for him.

fresh_translation: And Dauid knew that Lord had established him over Israel, because his kingdom was exalted on high for sake of his people Israel.
