brenton_translation: And David knew that the Lord had designed him to be king over Israel; because his kingdom was highly exalted, on account of his people Israel.

fresh_translation: And Dauid took yet more wives in Ierousalem, and more sons and daughters were born to Dauid.
brenton_translation: And David took more wives in Jerusalem: and there were born to David more sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And these were names of children born to him in Ierousalem: Samaa, Isobaam, Nathan, Salomon,
brenton_translation: And these are the names of those that were born, who were born to him in Jerusalem; Samaa, Sobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

fresh_translation: and Ibaar and Elisae and Eliphalet,
brenton_translation: and Baar, and Elisa, and Eliphaleth,

fresh_translation: and Nage and Naphag and Ianouou,
brenton_translation: and Nageth, and Naphath, and Japhie,

fresh_translation: and Elisamae and Balegdae and Eliphalet.
brenton_translation: and Elisamae, and Eliade, and Eliphala.

fresh_translation: And Philistines heard that Dauid had been anointed king over all Israel, and all Philistines went up to seek Dauid, and Dauid heard and went out to meet them.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel: and all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard it, and went out to meet them.

fresh_translation: And Philistines came and fell upon valley of giants.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines came and assembled together in the giants' valley.

fresh_translation: And Dauid inquired through God, saying, Shall I go up against Philistines, and will you give them into my hands? And Lord said to him, Go up, and I will give them into your hands.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into my hand? And the Lord said to him, Go up, and I will deliver them into thy hands.

fresh_translation: And he went up to Baalpharasin, and Dauid struck them there. And Dauid said, God broke through my enemies by my hand like breaking of waters. Therefore name of that place was called Breach-of-Pharasin.
brenton_translation: And he went up to Baal Pharasin, and David smote them there; and David said, God has broken through enemies by my hand like a breach of water: therefore he called the name of that place, the Breach of Pharasin.

fresh_translation: And they left their gods there, and Dauid said to burn them with fire.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines left their gods there; and David gave orders to burn them with fire.

fresh_translation: And Philistines added yet again and again fell upon valley of giants.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines once more assembled themselves in the giants' valley.

fresh_translation: And Dauid again inquired of God, and God said to him, You shall not go after them; turn away from them and come upon them near pear trees.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of God again; and God said to him, Thou shalt not go after them; turn away from them, and thou shalt come upon them near the pear trees.

fresh_translation: And when you hear sound of shaking in tops of pear trees, then you shall go out into battle, because God has gone out before you to strike camp of Philistines.
brenton_translation: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear the sound of their tumult in the tops of the pear trees, then thou shalt go into the battle: for God has gone out before thee to smite the army of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he did as God commanded him, and he struck camp of Philistines from Gabaon as far as Gazara.
brenton_translation: And he did as God commanded him: and he smote the army of the Philistines from Gabaon to Gazera.

fresh_translation: And name of Dauid became in all land, and Lord put his fear upon all nations.
brenton_translation: And the name of David was famous in all the land; and the Lord put the terror of him on all the nations.

fresh_translation: And he made houses for himself in City of Dauid, and he prepared place for ark of God and made tent for it.
brenton_translation: And David made for himself houses in the city of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and made a tent for it.

fresh_translation: Then Dauid said, It is not for any to carry ark of God except Levites, because Lord chose them to carry ark of Lord and to minister to him forever.
brenton_translation: Then said David, It is not lawful for any to bear the ark of God, but the Levites; for the Lord has chosen them to bear the ark of the Lord, and to minister to him for ever.

fresh_translation: And Dauid assembled all Israel in Ierousalem to bring up ark of Lord to place which he prepared for it.
brenton_translation: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place which he had prepared for it.

fresh_translation: And Dauid gathered sons of Aaron and Levites:
brenton_translation: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron the Levites.

fresh_translation: from sons of Kaath, Ouriēl chief, and his brothers, one hundred twenty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Caath; there was Uriel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and twenty.

fresh_translation: from sons of Merari, Asaia chief, and his brothers, two hundred fifty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Merari; Asaia the chief, and his brethren, two hundred and twenty.

fresh_translation: from sons of Gērsam, Ioēl chief, and his brothers, one hundred fifty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Gedson; Joel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and thirty.

fresh_translation: from sons of Elisaphan, Samaias chief, and his brothers, two hundred;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Elisaphat; Semei the chief, and his brethren, two hundred.

fresh_translation: from sons of Chebron, Eliēl chief, and his brothers, eighty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Chebrom; Eliel the chief, and his brethren eighty.

fresh_translation: from sons of Oziēl, Aminadab chief, and his brothers, one hundred twelve.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Oziel; Aminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.

fresh_translation: And Dauid called Sadok and Abiathar the priests, and Levites Ouriēl, Asaia, Ioēl, Samaian, Eliēl, Aminadab,
brenton_translation: And David called Sadoc and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites, Uriel, Asaia, and Joel, and Semaia, and Eliel, and Aminadab,

fresh_translation: and he said to them, You are chiefs of fathers of Levites. Sanctify yourselves, you and your brothers, and bring up ark of God of Israel, which I prepared for it.
brenton_translation: and said to them, Ye are the heads of the families of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, and ye shall carry up the ark of the God of Israel, to the place which I have prepared for it.

fresh_translation: Because when you were not there at first, our God made breach among us, because we did not seek him according to ordinance.
brenton_translation: For because ye were not ready at the first, our God made a breach upon us, because we sought him not according to the ordinance.

fresh_translation: And priests and Levites sanctified themselves to bring up ark of God of Israel.
brenton_translation: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves, to bring up the ark of the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Levites took ark of God as Moyses commanded by word of God, according to writing, with carrying-poles upon them.
brenton_translation: And the sons of the Levites took the ark of God, (as Moses commanded by the word of God according to the scripture) upon their shoulders with staves.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to chiefs of Levites, Station their brothers, singers with instruments of songs, lyres and harps and cymbals, to raise sound with voice of gladness.
brenton_translation: And David said to the chiefs of the Levites, Set your brethren the singers with musical instruments, lutes, harps, and cymbals, to sound aloud with a voice of joy.

fresh_translation: And Levites stationed Haiman son of Ioēl, and from his brothers Asaph son of Barachia, and from sons of Merari, their brothers, Aithan son of Kisaiou,
brenton_translation: So the Levites appointed Æman the son of Joel; Asaph the son of Barachias was one of his brethren; and Æthan the son of Kisæus was of the sons of Merari their brethren;

fresh_translation: and with them their brothers of second rank: Zacharias and Oziēl and Semiramoth and Iiēl and Ouni and Eliab and Banaia and Maasaia and Mattathia and Eliphalia and Makenia and Abdedom and Iiēl and Ozias, gatekeepers.
brenton_translation: and with them their brethren of the second rank, Zacharias, and Oziel, and Semiramoth, and Jeiel, and Elioel, and Eliab, and Banaia, and Maasaia, and Matthathia, and Eliphena, and Makellia, and Abdedom, and Jeiel, and Ozias, the porters.

fresh_translation: And singers Haiman, Asaph, and Aithan had bronze cymbals to make sound heard.
brenton_translation: And the singers, Æman, Asaph, and Æthan, with brazen cymbals to make a sound to be heard.

fresh_translation: Zacharias and Oziēl, Semiramoth, Iiēl, Ouni, Eliab, Masaias, Banaias, with harps on alamoth.
brenton_translation: Zacharias, and Oziel, Semiramoth, Jeiel, Oni, Eliab, Maasæas, Banæas, with lutes, on alæmoth.

fresh_translation: And Mattathias and Eliphalias and Makenias and Abdedom and Iiēl and Ozias with lyres on the eighth, to lead strongly.
brenton_translation: And Mattathias, and Eliphalu, and Makenia, and Abdedom, and Jeiel, and Ozias, with harps of Amasenith, to make a loud noise.

fresh_translation: And Chonenia, chief of Levites, was chief over songs, because he was understanding.
brenton_translation: And Chonenia chief of the Levites was master of the bands, because he was skilful.

fresh_translation: And Barachia and Ēlkana were gatekeepers of ark.
brenton_translation: And Barachia and Elcana were door-keepers of the ark.

fresh_translation: And Sobnia and Iosaphat and Nathanaēl and Amasai and Zacharia and Banai and Eliezer, the priests, were blowing trumpets before ark of God, and Abdedom and Iia were gatekeepers of ark of God.
brenton_translation: And Somnia, and Josaphat, and Nathanael, and Amasai, and Zacharia, and Banæa, and Eliezer, the priests, were sounding with trumpets before the ark of God: and Abdedom and Jeia were door-keepers of the ark of God.

fresh_translation: And Dauid and elders of Israel and commanders of thousands were going to bring up ark of covenant of Lord from house of Abdedom with gladness.
brenton_translation: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains of thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant from the house of Abdedom with gladness.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, when God strengthened Levites carrying ark of covenant of Lord, they sacrificed seven calves and seven rams.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when God strengthened the Levites bearing the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they sacrificed seven calves and seven rams.

fresh_translation: And Dauid was girded with linen robe, and all Levites carrying ark of covenant of Lord, and singers, and Chonenia chief of songs of singers; and upon Dauid was linen robe.
brenton_translation: And David was girt with a fine linen robe, and all the Levites who were bearing the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the singers, and Chonenias the master of the band of singers; also upon David there was a robe of fine linen.

fresh_translation: And all Israel were bringing up ark of covenant of Lord with signal and sound of shophar and with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.
brenton_translation: And all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of a horn, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, playing loudly on lutes and harps.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, ark of covenant of Lord came as far as City of Dauid, and Melchol daughter of Saul looked through window and saw king Dauid dancing and playing, and she despised him in her soul.
brenton_translation: And the ark of the covenant of the Lord arrived, and came to the city of David; and Melchol the daughter of Saul looked down through the window, and saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

fresh_translation: And they brought in ark of God and set it in middle of tent which Dauid pitched for it, and they offered whole burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
brenton_translation: So they brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tabernacle which David pitched for it; and they offered whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God.

fresh_translation: And Dauid finished offering whole burnt offerings and peace offerings and blessed people in name of Lord.
brenton_translation: And David finished offering up whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he distributed to every man of Israel, from man to woman, to each man one loaf of bread, one bakery-cake, and one raisin-cake.
brenton_translation: And he divided to every man of Israel (both men and women), to every man one baker's loaf, and a cake.

fresh_translation: And he appointed before ark of covenant of Lord from Levites, ministers proclaiming aloud and giving thanks and praising Lord God of Israel:
brenton_translation: And he appointed before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, Levites to minister and lift up the voice, and to give thanks and praise the Lord God of Israel:

fresh_translation: Asaph leader, and second to him Zacharias, Iiēl, Semiramoth, Iiēl, Mattathias, Eliab, and Banaias and Abdedom and Iiēl with instruments, harps and lyres, and Asaph sounding aloud with cymbals,
brenton_translation: Asaph was the chief, and next to him Zacharias, Jeiel, Semiramoth, and Jeiel, Mattathias, Eliab, and Banæas, and Abdedom: and Jeiel sounding with musical instruments, lutes and harps, and Asaph with cymbals:

fresh_translation: and Banaias and Oziēl the priests with trumpets continually before ark of covenant of God.
brenton_translation: and Banæas and Oziel the priests sounding continually with trumpets before the ark of the covenant of God in that day.

fresh_translation: On that day then Dauid first appointed by hand of Asaph and his brothers to praise Lord.
brenton_translation: Then David first gave orders to praise the Lord by the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

fresh_translation: Give thanks to Lord; call upon him in his name; make known among peoples his practices.
brenton_translation: Song. Give thanks to the Lord, call upon him by his name, make known his designs among the people.

fresh_translation: Sing to him and hymn to him; tell all his wonders, those things Lord did.
brenton_translation: Sing songs to him, and sing hymns to him, relate to all people his wonderful deeds, which the Lord has wrought.

fresh_translation: Praise in his holy name; heart seeking his good pleasure shall rejoice.
brenton_translation: Praise his holy name, the heart that seeks his pleasure shall rejoice.

fresh_translation: Seek Lord and grow strong; seek his face continually.
brenton_translation: Seek the Lord and be strong, seek his face continually.

fresh_translation: Remember his wonders which he did, his marvels and judgments of his mouth,
brenton_translation: Remember his wonderful works which he has wrought, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

fresh_translation: seed of Israel, his servants, sons of Iakob, his chosen ones.
brenton_translation: ye seed of Israel his servants, ye seed of Jacob his chosen ones.

fresh_translation: He is Lord our God; in all earth are his judgments.
brenton_translation: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

fresh_translation: Remembering forever his covenant, his word which he commanded for thousand generations,
brenton_translation: Let us remember his covenant for ever, his word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

fresh_translation: which he covenanted with Abraam, and his oath to Isaak,
brenton_translation: which he covenanted with Abraham, and his oath sworn to Isaac.

fresh_translation: and he set it for Iakob as ordinance, for Israel as everlasting covenant,
brenton_translation: He confirmed it to Jacob for an ordinance, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,

fresh_translation: saying, To you I will give land of Chanaan, measuring-line of your inheritance.
brenton_translation: saying, To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, the line of your inheritance:

fresh_translation: When they were few in number, as they were diminished and sojourned in it,
brenton_translation: when they were few in number, when they were but little, and dwelt as strangers in it;

fresh_translation: and they went from nation to nation and from kingdom to another people,
brenton_translation: and went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.

fresh_translation: he did not let man oppress them, and he rebuked kings concerning them:
brenton_translation: He suffered not a man to oppress them, and he reproved kings for their sakes,

fresh_translation: Do not touch my anointed ones, and do not do evil among my prophets.
brenton_translation: saying, Touch not my anointed ones, and deal not wrongfully with my prophets.

fresh_translation: Sing to Lord, all earth; announce his salvation from day to day.
brenton_translation: Sing ye to the Lord, all the earth; proclaim his salvation from day to day.

fresh_translation: For Lord is great and greatly praised; he is fearful above all gods.
brenton_translation: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

fresh_translation: For all gods of nations are idols, but our God made heaven.
brenton_translation: For all the gods of the nations are idols; but our God made the heavens.

fresh_translation: Glory and praise are before him; strength and boasting are in his place.
brenton_translation: Glory and praise are in his presence; strength and rejoicing are in his place.

fresh_translation: Give to Lord, families of nations; give to Lord glory and strength.
brenton_translation: Give to the Lord, ye families of the nations, give to the Lord glory and strength.

fresh_translation: Give to Lord glory of his name; take gifts and bring them before him, and worship Lord in his holy courts.
brenton_translation: Give to the Lord the glory belonging to his name: take gifts and offer them before him; and worship the Lord in his holy courts.

fresh_translation: Let all earth fear from before him; let earth be set right and not be shaken.
brenton_translation: Let the whole earth fear before him; let the earth be established, and not be moved.

fresh_translation: Let heaven rejoice and earth exult, and let them say among nations, Lord reigns.
brenton_translation: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth exult; and let them say among the nations, The Lord reigns.

fresh_translation: Sea shall thunder with its fullness, and tree of field and all things in it.
brenton_translation: The sea with its fulness shall resound and the tree of the field, and all things in it.

fresh_translation: Then trees of forest shall rejoice from before Lord, because he came to judge earth.
brenton_translation: Then shall the trees of the wood rejoice before the Lord, for he is come to judge the earth.

fresh_translation: Give thanks to Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.
brenton_translation: Give thanks to the Lord, for it is good, for his mercy is for ever.

fresh_translation: And say, Save us, God of our salvation, and deliver us from nations, to praise your holy name and to boast in your praises.
brenton_translation: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us, and rescue us from among the heathen, that we may praise thy holy name, and glory in thy praises.

fresh_translation: Blessed Lord God of Israel from age and unto age. And all people shall say, Amen, and they praised Lord.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting and to everlasting:

fresh_translation: And they left there before ark of covenant of Lord Asaph and his brothers to minister before ark continually, each day’s matter for its day,
brenton_translation: And they left there Asaph and his brethren before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to minister before the ark continually, according to the service of each day: from day to day.

fresh_translation: and Abdedom and his brothers, sixty-eight, and Abdedom son of Idithon and Ossa as gatekeepers,
brenton_translation: And Abdedom and his brethren were sixty and eight; and Abdedom the son of Idithun, and Osa, were to be door-keepers.

fresh_translation: and Sadok the priest and his brothers the priests before tent of Lord at high place in Gabaon,
brenton_translation: And they appointed Sadoc the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place in Gabaon,

fresh_translation: to offer whole burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of whole burnt offerings continually, morning and evening, and according to all things written in the law of the Lord, whatever he commanded for the sons of Israel by the hand of Moyses servant of God,
brenton_translation: to offer up whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord on the altar of whole-burnt-offerings continually morning and evening, and according to all things written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded the children of Israel by Moses the servant of God.

fresh_translation: and with him Haiman and Idithon and rest of chosen ones named by name to praise Lord, because his mercy is forever,
brenton_translation: And with him were Æman and Idithun, and the rest chosen out by name to praise the Lord, for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: and with them trumpets and cymbals for sounding aloud, and instruments of songs of God; sons of Idithon were at gate.
brenton_translation: And with them there were trumpets and cymbals to sound aloud, and musical instruments for the songs of God: and the sons of Idithun were at the gate.

fresh_translation: And all people went each to his house, and Dauid returned to bless his house.
brenton_translation: And all the people went every one to his home: and David returned to bless his house.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, as Dauid settled in his house, Dauid said to Nathan prophet, Behold, I dwell in cedar house, but ark of covenant of Lord is under curtains.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under curtains of skins.

fresh_translation: And Nathan said to Dauid, Do all that is in your soul, because God is with you.
brenton_translation: And Nathan said to David, Do all that is in thy heart; for God is with thee.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass in that night, word of Lord came to Nathan, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in that night, that the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,

fresh_translation: Go and speak to Dauid my servant, Thus says Lord, You shall not build me house for me to dwell in it.
brenton_translation: Go and say to David my servant, Thus said the Lord, Thou shalt not build me a house for me to dwell in it.

fresh_translation: Because I have not dwelt in house from day when I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been in tent and in dwelling-place.
brenton_translation: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been in a tabernacle and a tent,

fresh_translation: In all places where I went through among all Israel, did I ever speak to one tribe of Israel, to shepherd my people, saying, Why have you not built me cedar house?
brenton_translation: in all places through which I have gone with all Israel: did I ever speak to any one tribe of Israel whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why is it that ye have not built me a house of cedar?

fresh_translation: And now thus you shall say to my servant Dauid, Thus says Lord Almighty, I took you from fold, from behind sheep, to be ruler over my people Israel.
brenton_translation: And now thus shalt thou say to my servant David, Thus saith the Lord Almighty, I took thee from the sheepfold, from following the flocks, to be a ruler over my people Israel:

fresh_translation: And I was with you in all places where you went, and I destroyed all your enemies from before you, and I made for you name like name of great ones on earth.
brenton_translation: and I was with thee in all places whither thou wentest, and I destroyed all thine enemies from before thee, and I made for thee a name according to the name of the great ones that are upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And I will appoint place for my people Israel and plant him, and he shall dwell by himself and not be anxious anymore, and unrighteousness shall not again afflict him as from beginning,
brenton_translation: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and I will plant him, and he shall dwell by himself, and shall no longer be anxious; and the son of iniquity shall no longer afflict him, as at the beginning,

fresh_translation: and from days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I humbled all your enemies, and I will increase you, and Lord will build house for you.
brenton_translation: and from the days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. Also I have humbled all thine enemies, and I will increase thee, and the Lord will build thee a house.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who shall be from your belly, and I will prepare his kingdom.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when thy days shall be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

fresh_translation: He shall build me house, and I will set upright his throne forever.
brenton_translation: He shall build me a house, and I will set up his throne for ever.

fresh_translation: I will be to him for father, and he shall be to me for son, and I will not remove my mercy from him, as I removed it from those before you.
brenton_translation: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son: and my mercy will I not withdraw from him, as I withdrew it from them that were before thee.

fresh_translation: And I will make him faithful in my house and in his kingdom forever, and his throne shall stand upright forever.
brenton_translation: And I will establish him in my house and in his kingdom for ever; and his throne shall be set up for ever.

fresh_translation: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to Dauid.
brenton_translation: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so spoke Nathan to David.

fresh_translation: And king Dauid came and sat before Lord and said, Who am I, Lord God, and what is my house, that you loved me unto forever?
brenton_translation: And king David came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God? and what is my house, that thou hast loved me for ever?

fresh_translation: And these things were made small before you, O God, and you spoke concerning house of your servant for long distance, and you looked upon me as vision of man, and you exalted me, Lord God.
brenton_translation: And these things were little in thy sight, O God: thou hast also spoken concerning the house of thy servant for a long time to come, and thou hast looked upon me as a man looks upon his fellow, and hast exalted me, O Lord God.

fresh_translation: What more shall Dauid add to you to glorify? And you know your servant.
brenton_translation: What shall David do more toward thee to glorify thee? and thou knowest thy servant.

fresh_translation: And according to your heart you did all this greatness.
brenton_translation: And thou hast wrought all this greatness according to thine heart.

fresh_translation: Lord, there is none like you, and there is none besides you, according to all things we heard with our ears.
brenton_translation: O Lord, there is none like thee, and there is no God beside thee, according to all things which we have heard with our ears.

fresh_translation: And there is no nation on earth like your people Israel, whom God led to redeem for himself as people, to make for himself great and manifest name, to drive out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt.
brenton_translation: Neither is there another nation upon the earth such as thy people Israel, whereas God led him in the way, to redeem a people for himself, to make for himself a great and glorious name, to cast out nations from before thy people, whom thou redeemedst out of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And you gave your people Israel to yourself as people forever, and you, Lord, became God to them.
brenton_translation: And thou hast appointed thy people Israel as a people to thyself for ever; and thou, Lord, didst become a God to them.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord, let your word which you spoke concerning your servant and concerning his house be made faithful forever.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord, let the word which thou spokest to thy servant, and concerning his house, be confirmed for ever, and do thou as thou hast spoken.

fresh_translation: Let them say, Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel, and let house of Dauid your servant be established before you.
brenton_translation: And let thy name be established and magnified for ever, men saying, Lord, Lord, Almighty God of Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

fresh_translation: Because you, Lord, opened ear of your servant to build him house. Therefore your servant found courage to pray before you.
brenton_translation: For thou, O Lord my God, hast revealed to the ear of thy servant that thou wilt build him a house; therefore thy servant has found a willingness to pray before thee.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord, you are that God, and you spoke these good things concerning your servant.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord, thou thyself art God, and thou hast spoken these good things concerning thy servant.

fresh_translation: And now you began to bless house of your servant, that it may be forever before you, because you, Lord, blessed; bless forever.
brenton_translation: And now thou hast begun to bless the house of thy servant, so that it should continue for ever before thee: for thou, Lord, hast blessed it, and do thou bless it for ever.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after these things, Dauid struck Philistines and routed them, and he took Geth and its villages from hand of Philistines.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterwards, that David smote the Philistines, and routed them, and took Geth and its villages out of the hand of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he struck Moab, and Moab became servants to Dauid, bringing gifts.
brenton_translation: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and tributaries.

fresh_translation: And Dauid struck Adraazar king of Souba Hamath, as he was going to set his hand upon river Euphrates.
brenton_translation: And David smote Adraazar king of Suba of Emath, as he was going to establish power toward the river Euphrates.

fresh_translation: And Dauid captured from them one thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand footmen, and Dauid hamstrung all chariots, but left of them one hundred chariots.
brenton_translation: And David took of them a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand infantry: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but there were reserved of them a hundred chariots.

fresh_translation: And Syrian from Damascus came to help Adraazar king of Souba, and Dauid struck among Syrians twenty-two thousand men.
brenton_translation: And the Syrian came from Damascus to help Adraazar king of Suba; and David smote of the Syrian army twenty and two thousand men.

fresh_translation: And Dauid put garrison in Syria by Damascus, and they became servants to Dauid, bringing gifts, and Lord kept saving Dauid in all places he went.
brenton_translation: And David put a garrison in Syria near Damascus; and they became tributary servants to David: and the Lord delivered David wherever he went.

fresh_translation: And Dauid took golden armlets which were on servants of Adraazar and brought them to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And David took the golden collars that were on the servants of Adraazar, and brought them to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And from Metabēchas and from chosen cities of Adraazar, Dauid took very much bronze. From it Salomon made bronze sea and pillars and bronze vessels.
brenton_translation: And David took out of Matabeth, and out of the chief cities of Adraazar very much brass: of this Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the brazen vessels.

fresh_translation: And Thōa king of Hamath heard that Dauid struck all force of Adraazar king of Souba.
brenton_translation: And Thoa king of Emath heard that David had smitten the whole force of Adraazar king of Suba.

fresh_translation: And he sent Idouram his son to king Dauid to ask about peace and to bless him because he fought Adraazar and struck him, because Adraazar was man of war against Thōa, with every silver and gold vessel.
brenton_translation: And he sent Aduram his son to king David to ask how he was, and to congratulate him because he had fought against Adraazar, and smitten him; for Thoa was the enemy of Adraazar.

fresh_translation: These also king Dauid consecrated to Lord, with silver and gold which he took from all nations, from Idoumaia and Moab and sons of Ammon and Philistines and Amalek.
brenton_translation: And all the golden and silver and brazen vessels, even these king David consecrated to the Lord, with the silver and the gold which he took from all the nations; from Idumæa, and Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalec.

fresh_translation: And Abessa son of Sarouia struck Idoumaia in valley of salt pits, eighteen thousand.
brenton_translation: And Abesa son of Saruia smote the Idumeans in the valley of Salt, eighteen thousand.

fresh_translation: And he put garrisons in valley, and all Idoumaians became servants of Dauid, and Lord kept saving Dauid in all places he went.
brenton_translation: And he put garrisons in the valley; and all the Idumæans became David's servants: and the Lord delivered David wherever he went.

fresh_translation: And Dauid reigned over all Israel, and he was doing judgment and righteousness for all his people.
brenton_translation: So David reigned over all Israel; and he executed judgment and justice to all his people.

fresh_translation: And Ioab son of Sarouia was over army, and Iosaphat son of Achiloud was recorder,
brenton_translation: And Joab the son of Saruia was over the army, and Josaphat the son of Achilud was recorder.

fresh_translation: and Sadok son of Achitob and Achimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Sousa was scribe,
brenton_translation: And Sadoc son of Achitob, and Achimelech son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Susa was the scribe;

fresh_translation: and Banaias son of Iodae was over Chereththite and Pheleththite, and sons of Dauid were first successors of king.
brenton_translation: and Banæas the son of Jodae was over the Cherethite and the Phelethite, and the sons of David were the chief deputies of the king.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after these things, Naas king of sons of Ammon died, and Anan his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this, that Naas the king of the children of Ammon died, and Anan his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said, I will do mercy with Anan son of Naas, as his father did mercy with me. And Dauid sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And servants of Dauid came into land of sons of Ammon to comfort him.
brenton_translation: And David said, I will act kindly toward Anan the son of Naas, as his father acted kindly towards me. And David sent messengers to condole with him on the death of his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Anan, to comfort him.

fresh_translation: And rulers of Ammon said to Anan, Does Dauid honor your father before you because he sent comforters to you? Did not his servants come to you to search city and spy out land?
brenton_translation: And the chiefs of the children of Ammon said to Anan, Is it to honour thy father before thee, that David has sent comforters to thee? Have not his servants come to thee that they might search the city, and to spy out the land?

fresh_translation: And Anan took servants of Dauid and shaved them and cut away half their cloaks as far as garment and sent them away.
brenton_translation: And Anan took the servants of David, and shaved them, and cut off the half of their garments as far as their tunic, and sent them away.

fresh_translation: And men came to report to Dauid concerning men, and he sent to meet them, because men had been greatly dishonored. And king said, Sit in Iericho until your beards grow, and then return.
brenton_translation: And there came men to report to David concerning the men: and he sent to meet them, for they were greatly disgraced: and the king said, Dwell in Jericho until your beards have grown, and return.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon saw that people of Dauid had been shamed, and Anan and sons of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Syria of Mesopotamia and from Syria of Moocha and from Souba.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon saw that the people of David were ashamed, and Anan and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen out of Syria of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria Maacha, and from Sobal.

fresh_translation: And they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots and king of Moocha and his people, and they came and camped opposite Maidaba. And sons of Ammon gathered from their cities and came to battle.
brenton_translation: And they hired for themselves two and thirty thousand chariots, and the king of Maacha and his people; and they came and encamped before Medaba: and the children of Ammon assembled out of their cities, and came to fight.

fresh_translation: And Dauid heard and sent Ioab and all army of mighty men.
brenton_translation: And David heard, and sent Joab and all the host of mighty men.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon came out and drew up for battle by gate of city, and kings who came camped by themselves in plain.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon came forth, and set themselves in array for battle by the gate of the city: and the kings that were come forth encamped by themselves in the plain.

fresh_translation: And Ioab saw that front of battle had come against him before and behind, and he chose from every young man of Israel, and they drew up against Syrians.
brenton_translation: And Joab saw that they were fronting him to fight against him before and behind, and he chose some out of all the young men of Israel, and they set themselves in array against the Syrian.

fresh_translation: And rest of people he gave into hand of Abessa his brother, and they drew up opposite sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of his brother Abesai, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And he said, If Syrians prevail over me, you shall be for salvation to me, and if sons of Ammon prevail over you, I will save you.
brenton_translation: And he said, If the Syrian should prevail against me, then shalt thou deliver me: and if the children of Ammon should prevail against thee, then will I deliver thee.

fresh_translation: Act like man, and let us strengthen ourselves for our people and for cities of our God, and Lord will do what is good in his eyes.
brenton_translation: Be of good courage, and let us be strong, for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the Lord shall do what is good in his eyes.

fresh_translation: And Ioab drew up, and people with him, opposite Syrians for battle, and they fled from him.
brenton_translation: So Joab and the people that were with him set themselves in battle array against the Syrians, and they fled from them.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon saw that Syrians fled, and they too fled from before Ioab and from before Abessa his brother and came into city. And Ioab came to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians fled, and they also fled from before Abesai, and from before Joab his brother, and they came to the city: and Joab came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Syria saw that Israel routed him, and they sent messengers and brought out Syrians from beyond river, with Sophach commander of force of Adraazar before them.
brenton_translation: And the Syrian saw that Israel had defeated him, and he sent messengers, and they brought out the Syrians from beyond the river; and Sophath the commander-in-chief of the forces of Adraazar was before them.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Dauid, and he gathered all Israel and crossed Jordan and came against them and drew up against them. And Syria drew up opposite Dauid and fought him.
brenton_translation: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and crossed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So David set his army in array to fight against the Syrians, and they fought against him.

fresh_translation: And Syria fled from before Dauid, and Dauid killed from Syria seven thousand chariots and forty thousand footmen, and he killed Sophach commander of force.
brenton_translation: And the Syrians fled from before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand riders in chariots, and forty thousand infantry, and he slew Sophath the commander-in-chief of the forces.

fresh_translation: And servants of Adraazar saw that they had fallen before Israel, and they made covenant with Dauid and served him. And Syria did not want to help sons of Ammon anymore.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Adraazar saw that they were defeated before Israel, and they made peace with David and served him: and the Syrians would not any more help the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass in following year, at time when kings go out, Ioab led all force of army and ruined land of sons of Ammon and came and besieged Rabbah, while Dauid stayed in Ierousalem. And Ioab struck Rabbah and tore it down.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at the return of the year, at the time of the going forth of kings to war, that Joab gathered the whole force of the army, and they ravaged the land of the children of Ammon; and he came and besieged Rabba. But David abode in Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabba and destroyed it.

fresh_translation: And Dauid took crown of Molchol their king from his head, and its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and in it was precious stone, and it was upon head of Dauid. And he brought out spoils of city very many.
brenton_translation: And David took the crown of Molchom their king off his head, and the weight of it was found to be a talent of gold, and on it were precious stones; and it was placed on the head of David: and he brought out the spoils of the city which were very great.

fresh_translation: And people in it he brought out and cut with saws and with iron picks, and thus Dauid did to all sons of Ammon. And Dauid and all his people returned to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And he brought out the people that were in it, and sawed them asunder with saws, and cut them with iron axes, and with harrows: and thus David did to all the children of Ammon. And David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after these things, there was still war in Gazer with Philistines. Then Sobochai the Ousathite struck Saphou from sons of giants, and he humbled him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterward that there was again war with the Philistines in Gazer: then Sobochai the Sosathite smote Saphut of the sons of the giants, and laid him low.

fresh_translation: And there was yet war with Philistines, and Ellanan son of Iair struck Leemi brother of Goliath the Geththite, and wood of his spear was like beam of weavers.
brenton_translation: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Eleanan the son of Jair smote Lachmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, and the wood of his spear was as a weavers' beam.

fresh_translation: And there was still war in Geth, and there was oversized man, and his fingers were six and six, twenty-four, and he was descendant of giants.
brenton_translation: And there was again war in Geth, and there was a man of extraordinary size, and his fingers and toes were six on each hand and foot, four and twenty; and he was descended from the giants.

fresh_translation: And he reproached Israel, and Ionathan son of Samaa brother of Dauid struck him.
brenton_translation: And he defied Israel, and Jonathan the son of Samaa the brother of David slew him.

fresh_translation: These were born to Rapha in Geth; all were four giants, and they fell by hand of Dauid and by hand of his servants.
brenton_translation: These were born to Rapha in Geth; all four were giants, and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

fresh_translation: And slanderer stood up against Israel and stirred Dauid to number Israel.
brenton_translation: And the devil stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.

fresh_translation: And king Dauid said to Ioab and to chiefs of force, Go, number Israel from Bersabee to Dan, and bring to me, and I shall know their number.
brenton_translation: And king David said to Joab and to the captains of the forces, Go, number Israel from Bersabee even to Dan, and bring me the account, and I shall know their number.

fresh_translation: And Ioab said, May Lord add to his people a hundredfold as they are, and are not eyes of my lord the king seeing that all are servants to my lord? Why does my lord seek this, so that it should not become sin for Israel?
brenton_translation: And Joab said, May the Lord add to his people, a hundred-fold as many as they are, and let the eyes of my lord the king see it: all are the servants of my lord. Why does my lord seek this thing? do it not, lest it become a sin to Israel.

fresh_translation: But word of king prevailed over Ioab. And Ioab went out and passed through all border of Israel and came to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab; and Joab went out and passed through all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Ioab gave number of mustering of people to Dauid, and all Israel was one million one hundred thousand men drawing sword, and Iouda was four hundred eighty thousand men drawing sword.
brenton_translation: And Joab gave the number of the mustering of the people to David: and all Israel was a million and a hundred thousand men that drew sword: and the sons of Juda were four hundred and seventy thousand men that drew sword.

fresh_translation: But Levi and Beniamin he did not count among them, because word of king overpowered Ioab.
brenton_translation: But he numbered not Levi and Benjamin among them; for the word of the king was painful to Joab.

fresh_translation: And thing appeared evil before God concerning this matter, and he struck Israel.
brenton_translation: And there was evil in the sight of the Lord respecting this thing; and he smote Israel.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to God, I sinned greatly because I did this thing, and now please take away evil of your servant, because I acted very foolishly.
brenton_translation: And David said to God, I have sinned exceedingly, in that I have done this thing: and now, I pray thee, remove the sin of thy servant; for I have been exceedingly foolish.

fresh_translation: And Lord spoke to Gad, seer of Dauid, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Gad the seer, saying,

fresh_translation: Go and speak to Dauid, saying, Thus says Lord, I lift three things upon you; choose one of them for yourself, and I will do it to you.
brenton_translation: Go and speak to David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I bring three things upon thee: choose one of them for thyself, and I will do it to thee.

fresh_translation: And Gad came to Dauid and said to him, Thus says Lord, Choose for yourself:
brenton_translation: And Gad came to David, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose for thyself,

fresh_translation: either three years of famine, or three months for you to flee from before your enemies while sword of your enemies destroys, or three days sword of Lord and death in land, and angel of Lord destroying in all inheritance of Israel. And now see what word I should answer to one who sent me.
brenton_translation: either three years of famine, or that thou shouldest flee three months from the face of thine enemies, and the sword of thine enemies shall be employed to destroy thee, or that the sword of the Lord and pestilence should be three days in the land, and the angel of the Lord shall be destroying in all the inheritance of Israel. And now consider what I shall answer to him that sent the message.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to Gad, All three press me very hard. Let me now fall into hands of Lord, because his mercies are very many; but into hands of men I shall not fall.
brenton_translation: And David said to Gad, They are very hard for me, even all the three: let me fall now into the hands of the Lord, for his mercies are very abundant, and let me not fall by any means into the hands of man.

fresh_translation: And Lord gave death in Israel, and seventy thousand men fell from Israel.
brenton_translation: So the Lord brought pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

fresh_translation: And God sent angel into Ierousalem to destroy it, and as he destroyed, Lord saw and relented over evil and said to angel destroying, It is enough for you; let go your hand. And angel of Lord was standing at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite.
brenton_translation: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord saw, and repented for the evil, and said to the angel that was destroying, Let it suffice thee; withhold thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: And Dauid lifted his eyes and saw angel of Lord standing between earth and between heaven, with his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Ierousalem. And Dauid and elders clothed in sackcloth fell on their faces.
brenton_translation: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord, standing between the earth and the heaven, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem: and David and the elders clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to God, Was it not I who said to number among people? And I am one who sinned; I acted evilly with evil. But these sheep, what did they do? Lord God, let your hand be on me and on house of my father, and not on your people for destruction, Lord.
brenton_translation: And David said to God, Was it not I that gave orders to number the people? and I am the guilty one; I have greatly sinned: but these sheep, what have they done? O Lord God, let thy hand be upon me, and upon my father's house, and not on thy people for destruction, O Lord!

fresh_translation: And angel of Lord said to Gad to tell Dauid to go up and set altar to Lord at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord told Gad to tell David, that he should go up to erect an altar to the Lord, in the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: And Dauid went up according to word of Gad, which he spoke in name of Lord.
brenton_translation: And David went up according to the word of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Orna turned and saw king, and his four sons with him were hiding themselves, and Orna was threshing wheat.
brenton_translation: And Orna turned and saw the king; and he hid himself and his four sons with him. Now Orna was threshing wheat.

fresh_translation: And Dauid came to Orna, and Orna came out from threshing floor and bowed to Dauid with face to ground.
brenton_translation: And David came to Orna; and Orna came forth from the threshing-floor, and did obeisance to David with his face to the ground.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to Orna, Give me place of your threshing floor, and I will build on it altar to Lord. For silver at full worth give it to me, and plague will stop from people.
brenton_translation: And David said to Orna, Give me thy place of the threshing-floor, and I will build upon it an altar to the Lord: give it me for its worth in money, and the plague shall cease from among the people.

fresh_translation: And Orna said to Dauid, Take for yourself, and let my lord the king do good in his sight. Behold, I have given calves for whole burnt offering, and plow and wagons for wood, and wheat for sacrifice; I have given all.
brenton_translation: And Orna said to David, Take it to thyself, and let my lord the king do what is right in his eyes: see, I have given the calves for a whole-burnt-offering, and the plough for wood, and the corn for a meat-offering; I have given all.

fresh_translation: And king Dauid said to Orna, No, because by buying I will buy for full worth in silver, because I shall not take what is yours for Lord, to offer free whole burnt offering to Lord.
brenton_translation: And king David said to Orna, Nay; for I will surely buy it for its worth in money: for I will not take thy property for the Lord, to offer a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord without cost to myself.

fresh_translation: And Dauid gave to Orna in his place six hundred shekels of weight in gold.
brenton_translation: And David gave to Orna for his place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

fresh_translation: And Dauid built there altar to Lord and offered whole burnt offerings and peace offerings, and cried out to Lord, and he answered him with fire from heaven upon altar of whole burnt offering and consumed whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered up whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings: and he cried to the Lord, and he answered him by fire out of heaven on the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, and it consumed the whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And Lord spoke to angel, and he put sword into sheath.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to the angel; and he put up the sword into its sheath.

fresh_translation: At that time, when Dauid saw that Lord answered him at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite, he sacrificed there.
brenton_translation: At that time when David saw that the Lord answered him in the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite, he also sacrificed there.

fresh_translation: And tent of Lord which Moyses made in wilderness, and altar of whole burnt offerings, were at that time at high place in Gabaon.
brenton_translation: And the tabernacle of the Lord which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, were at that time in the high place at Gabaon.

fresh_translation: And Dauid was not able to go before it to seek God, because he hurried in fear from before sword of angel of Lord.
brenton_translation: And David could not go before it to enquire of God; for he hasted not because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said, This is house of Lord God, and this is altar for whole burnt offering for Israel.
brenton_translation: And David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for whole-burnt-offering for Israel.

fresh_translation: And Dauid told them to gather all sojourners in land of Israel, and he appointed stonecutters to cut dressed stones to build house for God.
brenton_translation: And David gave orders to gather all the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he appointed stone-hewers to hew polished stones to build the house to God.

fresh_translation: And Dauid prepared much iron for nails of doors and gates and hinges, and bronze in abundance without weight,
brenton_translation: And David prepared much iron for the nails of the doors and the gates; the hinges also and brass in abundance, there was no weighing of it.

fresh_translation: and cedar woods without number, because Sidonians and Tyrians brought cedar woods in abundance to Dauid.
brenton_translation: And cedar trees without number: for the Sidonians and the Tyrians brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said, Salomon my son is tender youth, and house to build for Lord must be for greatness beyond, for name and for glory in all earth; I will prepare for him. And Dauid prepared in abundance before his death.
brenton_translation: And David said, My son Solomon is a tender child, and the house for me to build to the Lord is for superior magnificence for a name and for a glory through all the earth: I will make preparation for it. And David prepared abundantly before his death.

fresh_translation: And he called Salomon his son and charged him to build house to Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he called Solomon his son, and commanded him to build the house for the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said, Salomon, my child, it was upon my heart to build a house for name of Lord God,
brenton_translation: And David said to Solomon, My child, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the Lord God.

fresh_translation: but word of Lord came upon me, saying, You poured out blood in abundance and made great wars; you shall not build house to my name, because you poured out much blood on earth before me.
brenton_translation: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast carried on great wars: thou shalt not build a house to my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth before me.

fresh_translation: Behold, son is born to you. He shall be man of rest, and I will give him rest from all enemies around, because Salomon shall be his name, and peace and quietness I will give upon Israel in his days.
brenton_translation: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, he shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

fresh_translation: He shall build house to my name, and he shall be to me for son, and I to him for father, and I will set upright throne of his kingdom in Israel forever.
brenton_translation: He shall build a house to my name; and he shall be a son to me, and I will be a father to him; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom in Israel for ever.

fresh_translation: And now, my son, Lord shall be with you and prosper you, and you shall build house to Lord your God as he spoke concerning you.
brenton_translation: And now, my son, the Lord shall be with thee, and prosper thee; and thou shalt build a house to the Lord thy God, as he spoke concerning thee.

fresh_translation: Only may Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and strengthen you over Israel, to keep and to do law of Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Only may the Lord give thee wisdom and prudence, and strengthen thee over Israel, both to keep and to do the law of the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: Then you shall prosper if you keep doing ordinances and judgments which Lord commanded Moyses for Israel. Act like man and be strong; do not fear and do not be dismayed.
brenton_translation: Then will he prosper thee, if thou take heed to do the commandments and judgments which the Lord commanded Moses for Israel: be courageous and strong; fear not, nor be terrified.

fresh_translation: And behold, in my poverty I prepared for house of Lord one hundred thousand talents of gold and one thousand thousand talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight, because it is in abundance, and wood and stones I prepared, and to these add more.
brenton_translation: And, behold, I according to my poverty have prepared for the house of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a million talents of silver, and brass and iron without measure; for it is abundant; and I have prepared timber and stones; and do thou add to these.

fresh_translation: And with you are workers in abundance, craftsmen and builders of stone and carpenters of wood and every wise man in every work,
brenton_translation: And of them that are with thee do thou add to the multitude of workmen; let there be artificers and masons, and carpenters, and every skilful workman in every work;

fresh_translation: in gold, in silver, in bronze, and in iron there is no number. Rise and do, and Lord be with you.
brenton_translation: in gold and silver, brass and iron, of which there is no number. Arise and do, and the Lord be with thee.

fresh_translation: And Dauid commanded all rulers of Israel to help Salomon his son:
brenton_translation: And David charged all the chief men of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

fresh_translation: Is not Lord with you and has he not given you rest all around? Because he gave inhabitants of land into hands, and land is subdued before Lord and before his people.
brenton_translation: Is not the Lord with you? and he has given you rest round about, for he has given into your hands the inhabitants of the land; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.

fresh_translation: Now set your hearts and your souls to seek the Lord your God, and rise and build a sanctuary to the Lord your God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy vessels of God into the house being built for the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Now set your hearts and souls to seek after the Lord your God: and rise, and build a sanctuary to your God to carry in the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Dauid was old and full of days, and he made Salomon his son king in his place over Israel.
brenton_translation: And David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel in his stead.

fresh_translation: And he gathered all rulers of Israel and priests and Levites.
brenton_translation: And he assembled all the chief men of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites.

fresh_translation: And Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward, and their number by heads, men, was thirty-eight thousand.
brenton_translation: And the Levites numbered themselves from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls amounted to thirty and eight thousand men.

fresh_translation: From these, overseers over works of house of Lord were twenty-four thousand, and scribes and judges six thousand,
brenton_translation: Of the overseers over the works of the house of the Lord there were twenty-four thousand, and there were six thousand scribes and judges;

fresh_translation: and four thousand gatekeepers, and four thousand praising Lord with instruments which he made for praising Lord.
brenton_translation: and four thousand door-keepers, and four thousand to praise the Lord with instruments which he made to praise the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Dauid divided them into courses for sons of Levi: to Gedsōn, Kaath, Merari.
brenton_translation: And David divided them into daily courses, for the sons of Levi, for Gedson, Caath, and Merari.

fresh_translation: And to Parosōm, to Edan and to Semei.
brenton_translation: And for the family of Gedson, Edan, and Semei.

fresh_translation: Sons of Edan: chief Iiēl, and Zethom, and Ioēl, three.
brenton_translation: The sons of Edan were Jeiel, the chief, and Zethan, and Joel, three.

fresh_translation: Sons of Semei: Salōmith and Iiēl and Aidan, three. These were chiefs of fathers for Edan.
brenton_translation: The sons of Semei; Salomith, Jeiel, and Dan, three: these were the chiefs of the families of Edan.

fresh_translation: And to sons of Semei: Ieth and Ziza and Ioas and Beria; these were four sons of Semei.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Semei, Jeth, and Ziza, and Joas, and Beria: these were the four sons of Semei.

fresh_translation: And Ieth was chief and Ziza second; Ioas and Beria did not multiply sons, and they became one father-house in one reckoning.
brenton_translation: And Jeth was the chief, and Ziza the second: and Joas and Beria did not multiply sons, and they became only one reckoning according to the house of their father.

fresh_translation: Sons of Kaath: Ambram, Issaar, Chebrōn, Oziēl, four.
brenton_translation: The sons of Caath; Ambram, Isaar, Chebron, Oziel, four.

fresh_translation: Sons of Ambram: Aaron and Moyses. And Aaron was set apart to be sanctified as holy of holies, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Lord, to minister, and to bless upon his name forever.
brenton_translation: The sons of Ambram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was appointed for the consecration of the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister and bless in his name for ever.

fresh_translation: And Moyses, man of God, his sons were called into tribe of Levi.
brenton_translation: And as for Moses the man of God, his sons were reckoned to the tribe of Levi.

fresh_translation: Sons of Moyses: Gērsam and Eliezer.
brenton_translation: The sons of Moses; Gersam, and Eliezer.

fresh_translation: Sons of Gērsam: Soubaēl chief.
brenton_translation: The sons of Gersam; Subael the chief.

fresh_translation: And sons of Eliezer: Raabia chief. And Eliezer had no other sons, but sons of Raabia increased greatly.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rabia the chief: and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rabia were very greatly multiplied.

fresh_translation: Sons of Issaar: Salōmōth chief.
brenton_translation: The sons of Isaar; Salomoth the chief.

fresh_translation: Sons of Chebrōn: Idoud chief, Amadia second, Oziēl third, Ikemias fourth.
brenton_translation: The sons of Chebron; Jeria the chief, Amaria the second, Jeziel the third, Jekemias the fourth.

fresh_translation: Sons of Oziēl: Michas chief, and Isia second.
brenton_translation: The sons of Oziel; Micha the chief, and Isia the second.

fresh_translation: Sons of Merari: Mooli and Mousi. Sons of Mooli: Eleazar and Kis.
brenton_translation: The sons of Merari; Mooli, and Musi: the sons of Mooli; Eleazar, and Kis.

fresh_translation: And Eleazar died, and he had no sons but daughters, and sons of Kis their brothers took them.
brenton_translation: And Eleazar died, and he had no sons, but daughters: and the sons of Kis, their brethren, took them.

fresh_translation: Sons of Mousi: Mooli and Eder and Iarimōth, three.
brenton_translation: The sons of Musi; Mooli, and Eder, and Jarimoth, three.

fresh_translation: These were sons of Levi according to houses of their fathers, chiefs of fathers according to their mustering, by number of their names, by head, doing works of service of house of Lord from twenty years old and upward.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Levi according to the houses of their fathers; chiefs of their families according to their numbering, according to the number of their names, according to their polls, doing the works of service of the house of the Lord, from twenty years old and upward.

fresh_translation: Because Dauid said, Lord God of Israel gave rest to his people, and he dwelt in Ierousalem forever.
brenton_translation: For David said, The Lord God of Israel has given rest to his people, and has taken up his abode in Jerusalem for ever.

fresh_translation: And Levites were no longer carrying tent and all its vessels for its service.
brenton_translation: And the Levites bore not the tabernacle, and all the vessels of it for its service.

fresh_translation: For in last words of Dauid is number of sons of Levi from twenty years old and upward.
brenton_translation: For by the last words of David was the number of the Levites taken from twenty years old and upward.

fresh_translation: Because he set them by hand of Aaron to minister in house of Lord, over courts and over storerooms and over cleansing of all holy things and over works of service of house of God,
brenton_translation: For he appointed them to wait on Aaron, to minister in the house of the Lord, over the courts, and over the chambers, and over the purification of all the holy things, and over the works of the service of the house of God;

fresh_translation: for bread of presentation and for fine flour of offering and for unleavened wafers and for griddle and for mixed dough and for every measure,
brenton_translation: and for the shew-bread, and for the fine flour of the meat-offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for the fried cake, and for the dough, and for every measure;

fresh_translation: and to stand morning by morning to praise and give thanks to Lord, and likewise at evening,
brenton_translation: and to stand in the morning to praise and give thanks to the Lord, and so in the evening;

fresh_translation: and over all whole burnt offerings offered to Lord on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts, by number according to ordinance upon them continually before Lord,
brenton_translation: and to be over all the whole-burnt-offerings that were offered up to the Lord on the sabbaths, and at the new moons, and at the feasts, by number, according to the order given to them, continually before the Lord.

fresh_translation: and they shall keep charges of tent of testimony and charges of sons of Aaron their brothers, to minister in house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And they are to keep the charge of the tabernacle of witness, and the charge of the holy place, and the charges of the sons of Aaron their brethren, to minister in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And for sons of Aaron, divisions: sons of Aaron were Nadab and Abioud, Eleazar and Ithamar.
brenton_translation: And they number the sons of Aaron in their division, Nadab, and Abiud, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.

fresh_translation: And Nadab and Abioud died before their father, and they had no sons, and Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron, served as priests.
brenton_translation: And Nadab and Abiud died before their father, and they had no sons: so Eleazar and Ithamar the sons of Aaron ministered as priests.

fresh_translation: And Dauid divided them, and Sadok from sons of Eleazar and Achimelech from sons of Ithamar, according to their mustering for their service by houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And David distributed them, even Sadoc of the sons of Eleazar, and Achimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their numbering, according to their service, according to the houses of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And more sons of Eleazar were found as chiefs of mighty men than sons of Ithamar, and he divided them: for sons of Eleazar, sixteen chiefs by father-houses, and for sons of Ithamar, eight by father-houses.
brenton_translation: And there were found among the sons of Eleazar more chiefs of the mighty ones, than of the sons of Ithamar: and he divided them, sixteen heads of families to the sons of Eleazar, eight according to their families to the sons of Ithamar.

fresh_translation: And he divided them by lots, these with those, because they were chiefs of holy things and chiefs of God among sons of Eleazar and among sons of Ithamar.
brenton_translation: And he divided them according to their lots, one with the other; for there were those who had charge of the holy things, and those who had charge of the house of the Lord among the sons of Eleazar, and among the sons of Ithamar.

fresh_translation: And Samaias son of Nathanaēl, scribe from Levi, wrote them before king and rulers and Sadok priest and Achimelech son of Abiathar and chiefs of father-houses of priests and Levites, one father-house taken for Eleazar and one taken for Ithamar.
brenton_translation: And Samaias the son of Nathanael, the scribe, of the family of Levi, wrote them down before the king, and the princes, and Sadoc the priest, and Achimelech the son of Abiathar were present; and the heads of the families of the priests and the Levites, each of a household were assigned one to Eleazar, and one to Ithamar.

fresh_translation: And first lot came out to Iarib, to Ideia second,
brenton_translation: And the first lot came out to Joarim, the second to Jedia,

fresh_translation: to Charēm third, to Seōrim fourth,
brenton_translation: the third to Charib, the fourth to Seorim,

fresh_translation: to Melchia fifth, to Miamin sixth,
brenton_translation: the fifth to Melchias, the sixth to Meiamin,

fresh_translation: to Kōs seventh, to Abia eighth,
brenton_translation: the seventh to Cos, the eighth to Abia,

fresh_translation: to Iēsou ninth, to Sechenia tenth,
brenton_translation: the ninth to Jesus, the tenth to Sechenias,

fresh_translation: to Eliasib eleventh, to Iakim twelfth,
brenton_translation: the eleventh to Eliabi, the twelfth to Jacim,

fresh_translation: to Ochchoppha thirteenth, to Isbaal fourteenth,
brenton_translation: the thirteenth to Oppha, the fourteenth to Jesbaal,

fresh_translation: to Belga fifteenth, to Emmēr sixteenth,
brenton_translation: the fifteenth to Belga, the sixteenth to Emmer,

fresh_translation: to Chēzir seventeenth, to Aphesse eighteenth,
brenton_translation: the seventeenth to Chezin, the eighteenth to Aphese,

fresh_translation: to Phetaia nineteenth, to Ezekēl twentieth,
brenton_translation: the nineteenth to Phetæa, the twentieth to Ezekel,

fresh_translation: to Iachin twenty-first, to Gamoul twenty-second,
brenton_translation: the twenty-first to Achim, the twenty-second to Gamul,

fresh_translation: to Dalaia twenty-third, to Maasai twenty-fourth.
brenton_translation: the twenty-third to Adallai, the twenty-fourth to Maasai.

fresh_translation: This was their mustering for their service to enter house of Lord according to their ordinance by hand of Aaron their father, as Lord God of Israel commanded him.
brenton_translation: This is their numbering according to their service to go into the house of the Lord, according to their appointment by the hand of Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.

fresh_translation: And for remaining sons of Levi: for sons of Ambram, Soubaēl; for sons of Soubaēl, Iadia.
brenton_translation: And for the sons of Levi that were left, even for the sons of Ambram, Sobael: for the sons of Sobael, Jedia.

fresh_translation: For Raabia, chief was Iesias.
brenton_translation: For Raabia, the chief was Isaari,

fresh_translation: And for Issari, Salōmōth; for sons of Salōmōth, Iath.
brenton_translation: and for Isaari, Salomoth: for the sons of Salomoth, Jath.

fresh_translation: Sons of Iediou: Amadia second, Iaziēl third, Iokom fourth.
brenton_translation: The sons of Ecdiu; Amadia the second, Jaziel the third, Jecmoam the fourth.

fresh_translation: Sons of Oziēl: Micha; sons of Micha: Samēr.
brenton_translation: For the sons of Oziel, Micha: the sons of Micha; Samer.

fresh_translation: Brother of Micha: Isia; sons of Isia: Zacharia.
brenton_translation: The brother of Micha; Isia, the son of Isia; Zacharia.

fresh_translation: Sons of Merari: Mooli and Mousi; sons of Ozia: sons of Bonni.
brenton_translation: The sons of Merari, Mooli, and Musi: the sons of Ozia,

fresh_translation: Sons of Merari for Ozia: his sons Isoam and Zakkhour and Abdi.
brenton_translation: That is, the sons of Merari by Ozia,—his sons were Isoam, and Sacchur, and Abai.

fresh_translation: For Mooli: Eleazar and Ithamar; and Eleazar died and had no sons.
brenton_translation: To Mooli were born Eleazar, and Ithamar; and Eleazar died, and had no sons.

fresh_translation: For Kis: sons of Kis, Iramaēl.
brenton_translation: For Kis; the sons of Kis; Jerameel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Mousi: Mooli and Eder and Iarimōth. These were sons of Levites by houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Musi; Mooli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to the houses of their families.

fresh_translation: And they too received lots, like their brothers sons of Aaron, before king and Sadok and Achimelech and chiefs of father-houses of priests and Levites, elder fathers like their younger brothers.
brenton_translation: And they also received lots as their brethren the sons of Aaron before the king; Sadoc also, and Achimelech, and the chiefs of the families of the priests and of the Levites, principal heads of families, even as their younger brethren.

fresh_translation: And king Dauid and rulers of force appointed for works sons of Asaph and Haiman and Idithon, those prophesying with lyres and harps and cymbals, and their number by head was according to their works.
brenton_translation: And king David and the captains of the host appointed to their services the sons of Asaph, and of Æman, and of Idithun, prophesiers with harps, and lutes, and cymbals: and their number was according to their polls serving in their ministrations.

fresh_translation: Sons of Asaph: Zakkhour and Iōsēph and Nathanias and Eraēl, sons of Asaph, under Asaph the prophet, under king.
brenton_translation: The sons of Asaph; Sacchur, Joseph, and Nathanias, and Erael: the sons of Asaph were next the king.

fresh_translation: For Idithon: sons of Idithon, Godolias and Souri and Isaia and Semei and Asabias and Mattathias, six, after their father Idithon, with lyre, sounding thanksgiving and praise to Lord.
brenton_translation: To Idithun were reckoned the sons of Idithun, Godolias, and Suri, and Iseas, and Asabias, and Matthathias, six after their father Idithun, sounding loudly on the harp thanksgiving and praise to the Lord.

fresh_translation: For Haiman: sons of Haiman, Boukias and Manthanias and Azaraēl and Soubaēl and Ierimōth and Ananias and Anani and Ēliatha and Godollathi and Rōmemthi-ōd and Iesbakasa and Mallēthi and Ōthēri and Meazōth.
brenton_translation: To Æman were reckoned the sons of Æman, Bukias, and Matthanias, and Oziel, and Subael, and Jerimoth, and Ananias, and Anan, and Heliatha, and Godollathi, and Rometthiezer, and Jesbasaca, and Mallithi, and Otheri, and Meazoth.

fresh_translation: All these were sons of Haiman, one sounding to king in words of God, to raise horn, and God gave to Haiman fourteen sons and three daughters.
brenton_translation: All these were the sons of Æman the king's chief player in the praises of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Æman fourteen sons, and three daughters.

fresh_translation: All these, with their father, were singing hymns in house of Lord with cymbals and harps and lyres, under king, and Asaph and Idithon and Haiman.
brenton_translation: All these sang hymns with their father in the house of God, with cymbals, and lutes, and harps, for the service of the house of God, near the king, and Asaph, and Idithun, and Æman.
