fresh_translation: And their number with their brothers, taught to sing to Lord, every one understanding, was two hundred eighty-eight.
brenton_translation: And the number of them after their brethren, those instructed to sing to God, every one that understood singing was two hundred and eighty-eight.

fresh_translation: And they also cast lots for courses, small like great, perfect like learners.
brenton_translation: And they also cast lots for the daily courses, for the great and the small of them, of the perfect ones and the learners.

fresh_translation: And first lot came out for sons of him and brothers of Asaph, to Iōsēph; Godolias second, he and his brothers and sons, twelve.
brenton_translation: And the first lot of his sons and of his brethren came forth to Asaph the son of Joseph, namely, Godolias: the second Heneia, his sons and his brethren being twelve.

fresh_translation: Third, Zakkhour, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: The third Zacchur, his sons and his brethren were twelve:

fresh_translation: Fourth, Iesdri, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the fourth Jesri, his sons and his brethren were twelve:

fresh_translation: Fifth, Nathanias, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the fifth Nathan, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Sixth, Boukias, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the sixth Bukias, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Seventh, Iseriēl, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the seventh Iseriel, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Eighth, Iōsia, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the eighth Josia, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Ninth, Manthanias, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the ninth Matthanias, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Tenth, Semei, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the tenth Semeia, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Eleventh, Azaria, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the eleventh Asriel, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Twelfth, Asabia, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the twelfth Asabia, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Thirteenth, Soubaēl, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the thirteenth Subael, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Fourteenth, Mattathias, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the fourteenth Matthathias, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Fifteenth, Ierimōth, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the fifteenth Jerimoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Sixteenth, Ananias, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the sixteenth Anania, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Seventeenth, Iesbakasa, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the seventeenth Jesbasaca, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Eighteenth, Anani, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the eighteenth Ananias, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Nineteenth, Mellēthi, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the nineteenth Mallithi, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Twentieth, Eliatha, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the twentieth Heliatha, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Twenty-first, Ēthir, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the twenty-first Otheri, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Twenty-second, Godollathi, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the twenty-second Godollathi, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Twenty-third, Meazōth, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the twenty-third Meazoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

fresh_translation: Twenty-fourth, Rōmemthi-ōd, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
brenton_translation: the twenty-fourth Rometthiezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.

fresh_translation: For divisions of gates: for sons of Korēim, Mosollamia son of Korē from sons of Abiasaph.
brenton_translation: And for the divisions of the gates: the sons of the Corites were Mosellemia, of the sons of Asaph.

fresh_translation: And to Mosollamia, sons: Zacharias firstborn, Idiēl second, Zabadias third, Iethnouēl fourth,
brenton_translation: And Mosellemia's first-born son was Zacharias, the second Jadiel, the third Zabadia, the fourth Jenuel,

fresh_translation: Ōlam fifth, Iōanan sixth, Eliōēnai seventh.
brenton_translation: the fifth Jolam, the sixth Jonathan, the seventh Elionai, the eighth Abdedom.

fresh_translation: And to Abdedom, sons: Samaias firstborn, Iōzabad second, Iōaa third, Sōchar fourth, Nathanaēl fifth,
brenton_translation: And to Abdedom there were born sons, Samaias the first-born, Jozabath the second, Joath the third, Sachar the fourth, Nathanael the fifth,

fresh_translation: Amiēl sixth, Issachar seventh, Phollathi eighth, because God blessed him.
brenton_translation: Amiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Phelathi the eighth: for God blessed him.

fresh_translation: And to Samaia his son were born sons, rulers of his firstborn house, because they were mighty men.
brenton_translation: And to Samaias his son were born the sons of his first-born, chiefs over the house of their father, for they were mighty.

fresh_translation: Sons of Samaia: Gothni and Raphaēl and Ōbēd and Elzabad and his strong brothers, Eliou and Sabchia and Isbakōm.
brenton_translation: The sons of Samai; Othni, and Raphael, and Obed, and Elzabath, and Achiud, mighty men, Heliu, and Sabachia, and Isbacom.

fresh_translation: All these were from sons of Abdedom, they and their brothers and their sons, working strongly in service, all sixty-two for Abdedom.
brenton_translation: All these were of the sons of Abdedom, they and their sons and their brethren, doing mightily in service: in all sixty-two born to Abdedom.

fresh_translation: And to Mosollamia, sons and brothers, eighteen mighty men.
brenton_translation: And Mosellemia had eighteen sons and brethren, mighty men.

fresh_translation: And to Ōsa from sons of Merari, sons keeping the rule, because he was not firstborn, yet his father made him chief.
brenton_translation: And to Osa of the sons of Merari there were born sons, keeping the dominion; though he was not the first-born, yet his father made him chief of the second division.

fresh_translation: Tablai second, Zacharia third, fourth; all these were sons and brothers for Ōsa, thirteen.
brenton_translation: Chelcias the second, Tablai the third, Zacharias the fourth: all these were the sons and brethren of Osa, thirteen.

fresh_translation: To these divisions of gates, to chiefs of mighty men, were courses like their brothers, to minister in house of Lord.
brenton_translation: To these were assigned the divisions of the gates, to the chiefs of the mighty men the daily courses, even their brethren, to minister in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they cast lots, small like great, by houses of their fathers, for gate and gate.
brenton_translation: And they cast lots for the small as well as for the great, for the several gates, according to their families.

fresh_translation: And lot toward east fell to Salamia, and to Zacharia son of Iōas, to Melchia, they cast lots, and his lot came out north.
brenton_translation: And the lot of the east gates fell to Selemias, and Zacharias: the sons of Soaz cast lots for Melchias, and the lot came out northward.

fresh_translation: To Abdedom, south, opposite house of Esephin.
brenton_translation: To Abdedom they gave by lot the south, opposite the house of Esephim.

fresh_translation: For second, to Ōsa toward west, by gate of storeroom of ascent, guard opposite guard.
brenton_translation: They gave the lot for the second to Osa westward, after the gate of the chamber by the ascent, watch against watch.

fresh_translation: Toward east six for day, north for day four, south for day four, and for Esephin two.
brenton_translation: Eastward were six watchmen in the day; northward four by the day; southward four by the day; and two at the Esephim,

fresh_translation: At the annexes toward west, four, and at roadway two annexes.
brenton_translation: to relieve guard, also for Osa westward after the chamber-gate, three. There was a ward over against the ward of the ascent eastward, six men in a day, and four for the north, and four for the south, and at the Esephim two to relieve guard, and four by the west, and two to relieve guard at the pathway.

fresh_translation: These were divisions of gatekeepers for sons of Korē and for sons of Merari.
brenton_translation: These are the divisions of the porters for the sons of Core, and to the sons of Merari.

fresh_translation: And Levites their brothers were over treasuries of house of Lord and over treasuries of dedicated things.
brenton_translation: And the Levites their brethren were over the treasures of the house of the Lord, and over the treasures of the hallowed things.

fresh_translation: Sons of Ladan, sons of Gērsōni for Ladan, chiefs of fathers for Ladan the Gērsōnite: Iiēl.
brenton_translation: These were the sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gersonite: to Ladan belonged the heads of the families: the son of Ladan the Gersonite was Jeiel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Iiēl, Zethom and Ioēl his brother, were over treasuries of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: The sons of Jeiel were Zethom, and Joel; brethren who were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: For Ambram and Issaar, Chebrōn and Oziēl.
brenton_translation: To Ambram and Issaar belonged Chebron, and Oziel.

fresh_translation: And Soubaēl, from Gērsam son of Moyses, was chief over treasuries.
brenton_translation: And Subael the son of Gersam, the son of Moses, was over the treasures.

fresh_translation: And for his brother Eliezer: Raabias his son, and Iōsaias and Iōram and Zechri and Salōmōth.
brenton_translation: And Rabias was son to his brother Eliezer, and so was Josias, and Joram, and Zechri, and Salomoth.

fresh_translation: This Salōmōth and his brothers were over all treasuries of holy things which king Dauid and chiefs of father-houses and commanders of thousands and hundreds and chiefs of force dedicated,
brenton_translation: This Salomoth and his brethren were over all the sacred treasures, which David the king and the heads of families consecrated, and the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and princes of the host,

fresh_translation: which he took from wars and from spoils, and from them he dedicated, to avoid delaying building of house of God.
brenton_translation: things which he took out of cities and from the spoils, and consecrated some of them, so that the building of the house of God should not want supplies;

fresh_translation: And over all holy things which Samuel prophet and Saul son of Kis and Abennēr son of Nēr and Ioab son of Sarouia dedicated, all dedicated things by hand of Salōmōth and his brothers.
brenton_translation: and over all the holy things of God dedicated by Samuel the prophet, and Saul the son of Kis, and Abenner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Saruia, whatsoever they sanctified was by the hand of Salomoth and his brethren.

fresh_translation: For Issari, Chōnenia and his sons were for outside work over Israel, for scribal work and for judging.
brenton_translation: For the Issaarites, Chonenia, and his sons were over the outward ministration over Israel, to record and to judge.

fresh_translation: For Chebrōnite, Asabias and his brothers, sons of strength, one thousand seven hundred, over oversight of Israel beyond Jordan westward, for every service of Lord and work of king.
brenton_translation: For the Chebronites, Asabias and his brethren, a thousand and seven hundred mighty men, were over the charge of Israel beyond Jordan westward, for all the service of the Lord and work of the king.

fresh_translation: For Chebrōnite, Ioudias was chief of Chebrōnite by their generations, by fathers. In fortieth year of his reign they were sought out, and mighty man was found among them in Iazēr of Galaaditis.
brenton_translation: Of the family of Chebron Urias was chief, even of the Chebronites according to their generations, according to their families. In the fortieth year of his reign they were numbered, and there were found mighty men among them in Jazer of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And his brothers, sons of strength, were two thousand seven hundred chiefs of fathers, and king Dauid appointed them over Reubenite and Gaddite and half tribe of Manasse for every ordinance of Lord and matter of king.
brenton_translation: And his brethren were two thousand seven hundred mighty men, chiefs of their families, and king David set them over the Rubenites, and the Gaddites, and the half-tribe of Manasse, for every ordinance of the Lord, and business of the king.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel according to their number, chiefs of fathers and commanders of thousands and of hundreds and scribes, those ministering to people and for every matter of king according to divisions, for every matter of what came in and went out month by month through all months of year, each division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: Now the sons of Israel according to their number, heads of families, captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and scribes ministering to the king, and for every affair of the king according to their divisions, for every ordinance of coming in and going out monthly, for all the months of the year, one division of them was twenty-four thousand.

fresh_translation: And over first division for first month was Iesboam son of Zabdiēl, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: And over the first division of the first month was Isboaz the son of Zabdiel: in his division were twenty-four thousand.

fresh_translation: From sons of Phares, chief of all commanders of force for first month.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Tharez one was chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

fresh_translation: And over division of second month was Dōdia the Echōchi, and over his division twenty-four thousand, commanders of force.
brenton_translation: And over the division of the second month was Dodia the son of Ecchoc, and over his division was Makelloth also chief: and in his division were twenty and four thousand, chief men of the host.

fresh_translation: Third for third month was Banaias son of Iōdae the priest, chief, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The third for the third month was Banaias the son of Jodae the chief priest: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: This Banaias was mightier than thirty and over thirty, and over his division was Amizabad his son.
brenton_translation: This Banæas was more mighty than the thirty, and over the thirty: and Zabad his son was over his division.

fresh_translation: Fourth for fourth month was Asaēl brother of Ioab and Zabadias his son and brothers, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The fourth for the fourth month was Asael the brother of Joab, and Zabadias his son, and his brethren: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Fifth for fifth month, leader Samaōth the Iesrae, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The fifth chief for the fifth month was Samaoth the Jezraite: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Sixth for sixth month, Odouias son of Ekkēs the Thekoite, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The sixth for the sixth month was Hoduias the son of Ekkes the Thecoite: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Seventh for seventh month, Chellēs from Phallous, from sons of Ephraim, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The seventh for the seventh month was Chelles of Phallus of the children of Ephraim: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Eighth for eighth month, Sobochai the Isathi for Zarai, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The eighth for the eighth month was Sobochai the Usathite, belonging to Zarai: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Ninth for ninth month, Abiezer from Anathōth, from land of Beniamin, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer of Anathoth, of the land of Benjamin: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Tenth for tenth month, Mēēra from Netoupha for Zarai, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The tenth for the tenth month was Meera the Netophathite, belonging to Zarai: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Eleventh for eleventh month, Banaias from Pharathōn, of sons of Ephraim, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The eleventh for the eleventh month was Banaias of Pharathon, of the sons of Ephraim: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: Twelfth for twelfth month, Choldai the Netouphathi for Gothoniēl, and over his division twenty-four thousand.
brenton_translation: The twelfth for the twelfth month was Choldia the Netophathite, belonging to Gothoniel: and in his division were twenty and four thousand.

fresh_translation: And over tribes of Israel: for Reuben, leader Eliezer son of Zechri; for Symeon, Saphatias son of Maacha;
brenton_translation: And over the tribes of Israel, the chief for Ruben was Eliezer the son of Zechri: for Symeon, Saphatias the son of Maacha:

fresh_translation: for Levi, Asabias son of Kamouēl; for Aaron, Sadok;
brenton_translation: for Levi, Asabias the son of Camuel: for Aaron, Sadoc:

fresh_translation: for Iouda, Eliab from brothers of Dauid; for Issachar, Ambri son of Michaēl;
brenton_translation: for Juda, Eliab of the brethren of David: for Issachar, Ambri the son of Michael:

fresh_translation: for Zabulon, Samaias son of Abdiou; for Nephthali, Ierimōth son of Esriēl;
brenton_translation: for Zabulon, Samæas the son of Abdiu: for Nephthali, Jerimoth the son of Oziel:

fresh_translation: for Ephraim, Ōsē son of Oziou; for half tribe of Manasse, Ioēl son of Phadaia;
brenton_translation: for Ephraim, Ose the son of Ozia: for the half-tribe of Manasse, Joel the son of Phadæa:

fresh_translation: for half tribe of Manasse in Galaad, Iaddai son of Zabdiou; for sons of Beniamin, Asiēl son of Abennēr;
brenton_translation: for the half-tribe of Manasse in the land of Galaad, Jadai the son of Zadæas, for the sons of Benjamin, Jasiel the son of Abenner:

fresh_translation: for Dan, Azaraiēl son of Iōram. These were patriarchs of tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: for Dan, Azariel the son of Iroab: these are the chiefs of the tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Dauid did not take their number from twenty years and under, because Lord said to multiply Israel like stars of heaven.
brenton_translation: But David took not their number from twenty years old and under: because the Lord said that he would multiply Israel as the stars of the heaven.

fresh_translation: And Ioab son of Sarouia began numbering among people and did not finish, and because of these things wrath came upon Israel, and number was not entered in book of matters of days of king Dauid.
brenton_translation: And Joab the son of Saruia began to number the people, and did not finish the work, for there was hereupon wrath on Israel; and the number was not recorded in the book of the chronicles of king David.

fresh_translation: And over king’s treasuries was Asmōth son of Ōdiēl, and over treasuries in field and in villages and in settlements and in towers was Ionathan son of Oziou.
brenton_translation: And over the king's treasures was Asmoth the son of Odiel; and over the treasures in the country, and in the towns, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Jonathan the son of Ozia.

fresh_translation: And over those farming ground, those working soil, was Esdri son of Choloub.
brenton_translation: And over the husbandmen who tilled the ground was Esdri the son of Chelub.

fresh_translation: And over vineyards was Semei from Rama, and over treasuries in vineyards of wine was Zachri son of Sephni.
brenton_translation: And over the fields was Semei of Rael; and over the treasures of wine in the fields was Zabdi the son of Sephni.

fresh_translation: And over olive groves and sycamines in lowland was Balanas the Gedōrite, and over treasuries of oil was Iōas.
brenton_translation: And over the oliveyards, and over the sycamores in the plain country was Ballanan the Gedorite; and over the stores of oil was Joas.

fresh_translation: And over cattle feeding in Asidōn was Satrais the Sarōnite, and over cattle in farmyards was Sōphat son of Adli.
brenton_translation: And over the oxen pasturing in Saron was Satrai the Saronite; and over the oxen in the valleys was Sophat the son of Adli.

fresh_translation: And over camels was Ōbil the Ismaēlite, and over donkeys was Iadias from Merathōn.
brenton_translation: And over the camels was Abias the Ismaelite; and over the asses was Jadias of Merathon.

fresh_translation: And over sheep was Iaziz the Hagarite. All these were stewards of possessions of king Dauid.
brenton_translation: And over the sheep was Jaziz the Agarite. All these were superintendents of the substance of king David.

fresh_translation: And Ionathan, Dauid’s uncle, was counselor, understanding man and scribe, and Iiēl son of Achamani was with sons of king.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan, David's uncle by the father's side, was a counsellor, a wise man: and Jeel the son of Achami was with the king's sons.

fresh_translation: And Achitophel was counselor of king, and Chousi was first friend of king.
brenton_translation: Achitophel was the king's counsellor: and Chusi the chief friend of the king.

fresh_translation: And after him: Achitophel, then Iōdae son of Banaiou and Abiathar, and Ioab commander-in-chief of king.
brenton_translation: And after this Achitophel Jodae the son of Banæas came next, and Abiathar: and Joab was the king's commander-in-chief.

fresh_translation: And Dauid assembled all rulers of Israel, rulers of judges and rulers of courses around body of king and rulers of thousands and of hundreds and treasurers and those over his possessions and mighty lords and fighters of army, in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And David assembled all the chief men of Israel, the chief of the judges, and all the chief men of the courses of attendance on the person of the king, and the captains of thousands and hundreds, and the treasurers, and the lords of his substance, and of all the king's property, and of his sons, together with the eunuchs, and the mighty men, and the warriors of the army, at Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Dauid stood in midst of assembly and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. It came upon my heart to build house of rest for ark of covenant of Lord and footstool of our Lord, and I prepared fitting things for dwelling.
brenton_translation: And David stood in the midst of the assembly, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and a place for the feet of our Lord, and I prepared materials suitable for the building:

fresh_translation: But God said, You shall not build me a house to have my name called upon it, because you are man of war and have poured out blood.
brenton_translation: but God said, Thou shalt not build me a house to call my name upon it, for thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.

fresh_translation: And Lord God of Israel chose me from all house of my father to be king over Israel forever, and in Iouda he chose kingdom, and from house of Iouda house of my father, and among sons of my father he desired in me to make me king over all Israel.
brenton_translation: Yet the Lord God of Israel chose me out of the whole house of my father to be king over Israel for ever; and he chose Juda as the kingly house, and out of the house of Juda he chose the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he preferred me, that I should be king over all Israel.

fresh_translation: And from all my sons, because Lord gave me many sons, he chose in Salomon my son to seat him upon throne of kingdom of Lord over Israel.
brenton_translation: And of all my sons, (for the Lord has given me many sons,) he has chosen Solomon my son, to set him on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

fresh_translation: And God said to me, Salomon your son shall build my house and my court, because I chose him to be son to me, and I will be father to him.
brenton_translation: And God said to me, Solomon thy son shall build my house and my court: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be to him a father.

fresh_translation: And I will set his kingdom right forever, if he is strong to keep my commandments and my judgments, as this day.
brenton_translation: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he continue to keep my commandments, and my judgments, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And now, before all assembly of Lord and in ears of our God, keep and seek all commandments of Lord our God, so that you may inherit good land and leave inheritance to your sons after you forever.
brenton_translation: And now I charge you before the whole assembly of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek all the commandments of the Lord our God, that ye may inherit the good land, and leave it for your sons to inherit after you for ever.

fresh_translation: And now, Salomon my son, know God of your fathers and serve him with complete heart and willing soul, because Lord examines all hearts and knows every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; and if you forsake him, he will forsake you to end.
brenton_translation: And now, my son Solomon, know the God of thy fathers, and serve him with a perfect heart and willing soul: for the Lord searches all hearts, and knows every thought: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou shouldest forsake him, he will forsake thee for ever.

fresh_translation: See now, because Lord chose you to build him house for sanctuary. Be strong and do.
brenton_translation: See now, for the Lord has chosen thee to build him a house for a sanctuary, be strong and do it.

fresh_translation: And Dauid gave to Salomon his son pattern of temple and of its houses and its treasuries and upper rooms and inner storehouses and house of propitiation,
brenton_translation: And David gave Solomon his son the plan of the temple, and its buildings, and its treasuries, and its upper chambers, and the inner store-rooms, and the place of the atonement,

fresh_translation: and pattern which he had in his spirit of courts of house of Lord and all storerooms around, for treasuries of house of Lord and treasuries of holy things,
brenton_translation: and the plan which he had in his mind of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, designed for the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the holy things, and of the chambers for resting:

fresh_translation: and of chambers of courses of priests and Levites, for every work of service of house of Lord and of storehouses of vessels of service of worship of house of Lord,
brenton_translation: and the plan of the courses of the priests and Levites, for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and of the stores of vessels for ministration of the service of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: and weight of their weighing, both of gold and silver things,
brenton_translation: And he gave him the account of their weight, both of gold and silver vessels.

fresh_translation: weight of lampstands and of lamps he gave him,
brenton_translation: He gave him the weight of the candlesticks, and of the lamps.

fresh_translation: he likewise gave him weight of tables of presentation, each golden table, and likewise silver ones,
brenton_translation: He gave him likewise the weight of the tables of shewbread, of each table of gold, and likewise of the tables of silver:

fresh_translation: and for flesh-hooks and bowls and golden cups, and weight of gold and of silver for each kefphoure according to weight,
brenton_translation: also of the flesh-hooks, and vessels for drink-offering, and golden bowls: and the weight of the gold and silver articles, and censers, and bowls, according to the weight of each.

fresh_translation: and for altar of incense, weight from refined gold he showed him, and pattern of chariot of cheroubim spreading wings and overshadowing ark of covenant of Lord.
brenton_translation: And he shewed him the weight of the utensils of the altar of incense, which was of pure gold, and the plan of the chariot of the cherubs that spread out their wings, and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

fresh_translation: All in writing of hand of Lord, Dauid gave to Salomon according to understanding given to him for working of pattern.
brenton_translation: David gave all to Solomon in the Lord's handwriting, according to the knowledge given him of the work of the pattern.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to Salomon his son, Be strong and act like man and do. Do not fear and do not be dismayed, because Lord my God is with you. He will not let go of you and will not forsake you until you finish every work of service of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong, and play the man, and do: fear not, neither be terrified; for the Lord my God is with thee; he will not forsake thee, and will not fail thee, until thou hast finished all the work of the service of the house of the Lord. And behold the pattern of the temple, even his house, and its treasury, and the upper chambers, and the inner store-rooms, and the place of propitiation, and the plan of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And behold, courses of priests and Levites for every service of house of God are with you, and with you in every work are all willing men in wisdom for every craft, and rulers and all people for all your words.
brenton_translation: And see, here are the courses of the priests and Levites for all the service of the house of the Lord, and there shall be with thee men for every workmanship, and every one of ready skill in every art: also the chief men and all the people, ready for all thy commands.

fresh_translation: And king Dauid said to all assembly, Salomon my son, in whom alone Lord chose, is young and tender, and work is great, because building not for man but for Lord God.
brenton_translation: And David the king said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom the Lord has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great; for it is not for man, but for the Lord God.

fresh_translation: With all my strength I prepared for house of my God gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, shoham stones and filling stones and precious stones and varied stones and every precious stone and much Parian stone.
brenton_translation: I have prepared according to all my might for the house of my God gold, silver, brass, iron, wood, onyx stones, and costly and variegated stones for setting, and every precious stone, and much Parian marble.

fresh_translation: And still, because I delighted in house of my God, I have gold and silver which I kept for myself, and behold, I gave it for house of my God in addition to what I prepared for house of holy things,
brenton_translation: And still farther, because I took pleasure in the house of my God, I have gold and silver which I have procured for myself, and, behold, I have given them to the house of my God over and above, beyond what I have prepared for the holy house.

fresh_translation: three thousand talents of gold from Souphir and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay walls of sanctuary with them,
brenton_translation: Three thousand talents of gold of Suphir, and seven thousand talents of fine silver, for the overlaying of the walls of the sanctuary:

fresh_translation: by hand of craftsmen. And who is willing to fill his hands for Lord today?
brenton_translation: for thee to use the gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for every work by the hand of the artificers. And who is willing to dedicate himself in work this day for the Lord?

fresh_translation: And chiefs of fathers and rulers of sons of Israel and commanders of thousands and of hundreds and leaders of works and stewards of king were made willing.
brenton_translation: Then the heads of families, and the princes of the children of Israel, and the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and the overseers of the works, and the king's builders, offered willingly.

fresh_translation: And they gave for works of house of Lord five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand gold pieces, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
brenton_translation: And they gave for the works of the house of the Lord five thousand talents of gold, and ten thousand gold pieces, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of brass, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.

fresh_translation: And those with whom stone was found gave it to treasuries of house of Lord by hand of Iiēl the Gērsōnite.
brenton_translation: And they who had precious stone, gave it into the treasuries of the house of the Lord by the hand of Jeiel the Gedsonite.

fresh_translation: And people rejoiced over their willingness, because with full heart they were made willing to Lord, and king Dauid rejoiced greatly.
brenton_translation: And the people rejoiced because of the willingness, for they offered willingly to the Lord with a full heart: and king David rejoiced greatly.

fresh_translation: And king Dauid blessed Lord before assembly, saying, Blessed are you, Lord God of Israel our father, from age and unto age.
brenton_translation: And king David blessed the Lord before the congregation, saying,

fresh_translation: Yours, Lord, are greatness and power and boasting and victory and strength, because you rule all things in heaven and on earth; before your face every king and nation is troubled.
brenton_translation: Thine, O Lord, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the might: for thou art Lord of all things that are in heaven and upon the earth: before thy face every king and nation is troubled.

fresh_translation: From you are riches and glory; you rule all things, Lord, ruler of every beginning, and in your hand are strength and lordship, and in your hand, Almighty One, to magnify and strengthen all things.
brenton_translation: From thee come wealth and glory: thou, O Lord, rulest over all, the Lord of all dominion, and in thy hand is strength and rule; and thou art almighty with thy hand to increase and establish all things.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord, we give thanks to you and praise name of your boasting.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord, we give thanks to thee, and praise thy glorious name.

fresh_translation: And who am I, and who are my people, that we grew strong to be willing to you in this way? Because all things are yours, and from your things we gave to you.
brenton_translation: But who am I, and what is my people, that we have been able to be thus forward in offering to thee? for all things are thine, and of thine own have we given thee,

fresh_translation: Because we are sojourners before you and temporary residents, as all our fathers were. Our days on earth are like shadow, and there is no staying.
brenton_translation: for we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days upon the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

fresh_translation: Lord our God, all this abundance which I prepared to build house for your holy name is from your hand, and all things are yours.
brenton_translation: O Lord our God, as for all this abundance which I have prepared that a house should be built to thy holy name, it is of thy hand, and all is thine.

fresh_translation: And I knew, Lord, that you examine hearts and love righteousness. In simplicity of heart I was willing for all these things, and now I saw your people found here willingly giving to you with gladness.
brenton_translation: And I know, Lord, that thou art he that searches the hearts, and thou lovest righteousness. I have willingly offered all these things in simplicity of heart; and now I have seen with joy thy people here present, willingly offering to thee.

fresh_translation: Lord God of Abraam and Isaak and Israel our fathers, keep these things in thought of heart of your people forever, and direct their hearts toward you.
brenton_translation: O Lord God of Abraham, and Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, preserve these things in the thought of the heart of thy people for ever, and direct their hearts to thee.

fresh_translation: And to Salomon my son give good heart to do your commandments and your testimonies and your ordinances, and to bring building of your house to completion.
brenton_translation: And to Solomon my son give a good heart, to perform thy commandments, and to observe thy testimonies, and thine ordinances, and to accomplish the building of thy house.

fresh_translation: And Dauid said to all assembly, Bless Lord your God. And all assembly blessed Lord God of their fathers, and bowing knees they worshiped Lord and king.
brenton_translation: And David said to the whole congregation, Bless ye the Lord our God. And all the congregation blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and they bowed the knee and worshipped the Lord, and did obeisance to the king.

fresh_translation: And Dauid sacrificed sacrifices to Lord and offered whole burnt offerings to God on next day after first day: one thousand calves, one thousand rams, one thousand lambs, and their libations, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
brenton_translation: And David sacrificed to the Lord, and offered up whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord on the morrow after the first day, a thousand calves, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, and their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

fresh_translation: And they ate and drank before Lord on that day with joy, and they made Salomon son of Dauid king a second time, and anointed him to Lord as king and Sadok to priesthood.
brenton_translation: And they ate and drank joyfully that day before the Lord: and they made Solomon the son of David king a second time, and anointed him king before the Lord, and Sadoc to the priesthood.

fresh_translation: And Salomon sat on throne of Dauid his father and prospered, and all Israel listened to him.
brenton_translation: And Solomon sat upon the throne of his father David, and was highly honoured; and all Israel obeyed him.

fresh_translation: Rulers and mighty lords and all sons of king Dauid his father submitted to him.
brenton_translation: The princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons of king David his father, were subject to him.

fresh_translation: And Lord magnified Salomon exceedingly before all Israel and gave him royal glory such as did not happen on any king before him.
brenton_translation: And the Lord magnified Solomon over all Israel, and gave him royal glory, such as was not upon any king before him.

fresh_translation: And Dauid son of Iessai reigned over Israel.
brenton_translation: And David the son of Jessæ reigned over Israel forty years;

fresh_translation: Forty years: in Chebron seven years and in Ierousalem thirty-three years.
brenton_translation: seven years in Chebron, and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he died in good old age, full of days, riches, and glory, and Salomon his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And he died in a good old age, full of days, in wealth, and glory: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And rest of matters of king Dauid, first and last, are written in words of Samuel seer and in words of Nathan prophet and in words of Gad seer,
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of David, the former and the latter, are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

fresh_translation: concerning all his kingdom and his mighty rule and times which came upon him and upon Israel and upon all kingdoms of earth.
brenton_translation: concerning all his reign, and his power, and the times which went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the earth.

fresh_translation: And Salomon son of Dauid was strengthened over his kingdom, and Lord his God was with him and magnified him on high.
brenton_translation: And Solomon the son of David was established over his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and increased him exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And Salomon spoke to all Israel, to commanders of thousands and of hundreds and to judges and to all rulers before Israel, to chiefs of fathers.
brenton_translation: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands, and to the captains of hundreds, and to the judges, and to all the rulers over Israel, even the heads of the families;

fresh_translation: And Salomon and all assembly with him went to high place in Gabaon, because there was tent of testimony of God which Moyses servant of Lord made in wilderness.
brenton_translation: and Solomon and all the congregation went to the high place that was in Gabaon, where was God's tabernacle of witness, which Moses the servant of the Lord made in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: But Dauid brought up ark of God from city Kariathiarim, because he prepared tent for it in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: But David had brought up the ark of God out of the city of Cariathiarim; for David had prepared a place for it, for he had pitched a tabernacle for it in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And bronze altar which Beseleēl son of Ourios son of Ōr made was there before tent of Lord, and Salomon and assembly sought it.
brenton_translation: And the brazen altar which Beseleel the son of Urias, the son of Or, had made, was there before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and the congregation enquired at it.

fresh_translation: And there Salomon brought up upon bronze altar before Lord, the one in tent, and brought up upon it one thousand whole burnt offerings.
brenton_translation: And Solomon brought victims thither to the brazen altar that was before the Lord in the tabernacle, and offered upon it a thousand whole-burnt-offerings.

fresh_translation: In that night God appeared to Salomon and said to him, Ask what I should give you.
brenton_translation: In that night God appeared to Solomon, and said to him, Ask what I shall give thee.

fresh_translation: And Salomon said to God, You did great mercy with Dauid my father and made me king in his place.
brenton_translation: And Solomon said to God, Thou hast dealt very mercifully with my father David, and hast made me king in his stead.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord God, let your name be made faithful upon Dauid my father, because you made me king over numerous people like dust of earth.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord God, let, I pray thee, thy name be established upon David my father; for thou hast made me king over a people numerous as the dust of the earth.

fresh_translation: Now give me wisdom and understanding, and I shall go out before this people and come in, because who can judge this great people of yours?
brenton_translation: Now give me wisdom and understanding, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who shall judge this thy great people?

fresh_translation: And God said to Salomon, Because this came to be in your heart, and you did not ask wealth, riches, or glory, nor life of your adversaries, nor many days, but asked wisdom and understanding for yourself so that you may judge my people over whom I made you king,
brenton_translation: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thy heart, and thou hast not asked great wealth, nor glory, nor the life of thine enemies, and thou hast not asked long life; but hast asked for thyself wisdom and understanding, that thou mightest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

fresh_translation: wisdom and understanding I give to you, and wealth and riches and glory I will give to you such as none among kings before you had, and after you there shall not be thus.
brenton_translation: I give thee this wisdom and understanding; and I will give thee wealth, and riches, and glory, so that there shall not have been any like thee among the kings before thee, neither shall there be such after thee.

fresh_translation: And Salomon came from high place in Gabaon to Ierousalem, from before tent of testimony, and reigned over Israel.
brenton_translation: And Solomon came from the high place that was in Gabaon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of witness, and reigned over Israel.

fresh_translation: And Salomon gathered chariots and horsemen, and he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he placed them in cities of chariots, and people were with king in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And Solomon collected chariots and horsemen: and he had fourteen hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen: and he set them in the cities of chariots, and the people were with the king in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And king made gold and silver in Ierousalem like stones, and cedars in Iouda like sycamines in lowland in abundance.
brenton_translation: And the king made silver and gold in Jerusalem to be as stones, and cedars in Judea as sycamores in the plain for multitude.

fresh_translation: And export of horses for Salomon was from Egypt, and merchants of king were trading and buying at price.
brenton_translation: And Solomon imported horses from Egypt, and the charge of the king's merchants for going was as follows, and they traded,

fresh_translation: And they were bringing up and bringing out from Egypt chariot for six hundred silver and horse for one hundred fifty, and thus for all kings of Chettites and kings of Syria they brought by their hands.
brenton_translation: and went and brought out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty pieces of silver: and so they brought for all the kings of the Chettites, and for the kings of Syria by their means.

fresh_translation: And Salomon spoke of building house to name of Lord and house for his kingdom.
brenton_translation: And Solomon said that he would build a house to the name of the Lord, and a house for his kingdom.

fresh_translation: And Salomon gathered seventy thousand men and eighty thousand stonecutters in mountain and three thousand six hundred overseers over them.
brenton_translation: And Solomon gathered seventy thousand men that bore burdens, and eighty thousand hewers of stone in the mountain, and there were three thousand six hundred superintendents over them.

fresh_translation: And Salomon sent to Chiram king of Tyre, saying, As you did with Dauid my father and sent him cedars to build house for himself to dwell in it,
brenton_translation: And Solomon sent to Chiram king of Tyre, saying, Whereas thou didst deal favourably with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build for himself a house to dwell in,

fresh_translation: behold, I his son am building house to name of Lord my God, to sanctify it to him, to burn incense of spices before him and perpetual presentation and to offer whole burnt offerings continually morning and evening and on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts of Lord our God. This is forever upon Israel.
brenton_translation: behold, I also his son am building a house to the name of the Lord my God, to consecrate it to him, to burn incense before him, and to offer shewbread continually, and to offer up whole-burnt-offerings continually morning and evening, and on the sabbaths, and at the new moons, and at the feasts of the Lord our God: this is a perpetual statute for Israel.

fresh_translation: And house which I am building is great, because our God is great above all gods.
brenton_translation: And the house which I am building is to be great: for the Lord our God is great beyond all gods.

fresh_translation: And who will have strength to build him house? Because heaven and heaven of heavens do not bear his glory. And who am I building him house, except to burn incense before him?
brenton_translation: And who will be able to build him a house? for the heaven and heaven of heavens do not bear his glory: and who am I, that I should build him a house, save only to burn incense before him?

fresh_translation: And now send me wise man, one knowing how to work in gold and silver and bronze and iron and purple and scarlet and blue, and knowing how to carve carving, together with wise men with me in Iouda and in Ierousalem, whom Dauid my father prepared.
brenton_translation: And now send me a man wise and skilled to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in blue, and one that knows how to grave together with the craftsmen who are with me in Juda and in Jerusalem, which materials my father David prepared.

fresh_translation: And send me cedar woods and juniper woods and pine woods from Lebanon, because I know your servants know how to cut woods from Lebanon, and behold, your servants are with my servants,
brenton_translation: And send me from Libanus cedar wood, and wood of juniper, and pine; for I know that thy servants are skilled in cutting timber in Libanus: and, behold, thy servants shall go with my servants,

fresh_translation: to prepare woods for me in abundance, because house which I am building is great and glorious.
brenton_translation: to prepare timber for me in abundance: for the house which I am building must be great and glorious.

fresh_translation: And behold, for workers, those cutting woods for food, I gave grain to your servants, twenty thousand kors, and barley, twenty thousand kors, and wine, twenty thousand measures, and oil, twenty thousand measures.
brenton_translation: And, behold, I have given freely to thy servants that work and cut the wood, corn for food, even twenty thousand measures of wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand measures of wine, and twenty thousand measures of oil.

fresh_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre answered in writing and sent to Salomon, Because Lord loved his people, he gave you king over them.
brenton_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre answered in writing, and sent to Solomon, saying, Because the Lord loved his people, he made thee king over them.

fresh_translation: And Chiram said, Blessed Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth, who gave to king Dauid wise son, knowing understanding and knowledge, who will build house to Lord and house for his kingdom.
brenton_translation: And Chiram said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to king David a wise son, and one endowed with knowledge and understanding, who shall build a house for the Lord, and a house for his kingdom.

fresh_translation: And now I have sent to you wise man, knowing understanding, Chiram my father,
brenton_translation: And now I have sent thee a wise and understanding man who belonged to Chiram my father

fresh_translation: whose mother was from daughters of Dan and whose father was Tyrian man, knowing how to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron, in stones and woods, and to weave in purple and in blue and in fine linen and in scarlet, and to carve carvings and devise every design whatever you give him, together with your wise men and wise men of Dauid my lord your father.
brenton_translation: (his mother was of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a Tyrian), skilled to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in stones and wood; and to weave with purple, and blue, and fine linen, and scarlet; and to engrave, and to understand every device, whatsoever thou shalt give him to do with thy craftsmen, and the craftsmen of my lord David thy father.

fresh_translation: And now let my lord send to his servants grain and barley and oil and wine which my lord spoke of.
brenton_translation: And now, the wheat, and the barley, and the oil, and the wine which my lord mentioned, let him send to his servants.

fresh_translation: And we shall cut woods from Lebanon according to all your need, and we shall bring them on rafts by sea to Ioppē, and you shall bring them up to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And we will cut timber out of Libanus according to all thy need, and we will bring it on rafts to the sea of Joppa, and thou shalt bring it to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Salomon gathered all sojourning men in land of Israel, after number by which Dauid his father numbered them, and they were found to be one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: And Solomon gathered all the foreigners that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering with which David his father numbered them; and there were found a hundred and fifty-three thousand six hundred.

fresh_translation: And he made from them seventy thousand carriers of burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters and three thousand six hundred overseers over people.
brenton_translation: And he made of them seventy thousand burden-bearers, and eighty thousand hewers of stone, and three thousand six hundred taskmasters over the people.

fresh_translation: And Salomon began building house of Lord in Ierousalem on mountain of Amoria, where Lord appeared to Dauid his father, in place which Dauid prepared at threshing floor of Orna the Iebousite.
brenton_translation: And Solomon began to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem in the mount of Amoria, where the Lord appeared to his father David, in the place which David had prepared in the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: And he began building in second month, in fourth year of his reign.
brenton_translation: And he began to build in the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

fresh_translation: And these are foundations which Salomon laid for building house of God: length by first measure, sixty cubits, and width twenty cubits.
brenton_translation: And thus Solomon began to build the house of God: the length in cubits—even the first measurement from end to end, was sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

fresh_translation: And vestibule before house, length according to breadth of house, twenty cubits, and height one hundred twenty cubits, and he overlaid it inside with pure gold.
brenton_translation: And the portico in front of the house, its length in front of the breadth of the house was twenty cubits, and its height a hundred and twenty cubits: and he gilded it within with pure gold.

fresh_translation: And great house he paneled with cedar woods and overlaid it with pure gold and carved upon it palms and chains.
brenton_translation: And he lined the great house with cedar wood, and gilded it with pure gold, and carved upon it palm-trees and chains.

fresh_translation: And he adorned house with precious stones for glory, and with gold, gold from Pharouaim.
brenton_translation: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty; and he gilded it with gold of the gold from Pharuim.

fresh_translation: And he gilded house and walls and doorposts and ceilings and doors with gold, and carved cheroubim on walls.
brenton_translation: And he gilded the house, and its inner walls, and the door-posts, and the roofs, and the doors with gold; and he carved cherubs on the walls.

fresh_translation: And he made house of holy of holies, its length according to breadth, twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits, and he overlaid it with pure gold, for cheroubim, six hundred talents.
brenton_translation: And he built the holy of holies, its length was according to the front of the other house, the breadth of the house was twenty cubits, and the length twenty cubits: and he gilded it with pure gold for cherubs, to the amount of six hundred talents.

fresh_translation: And weight of nails, weight of one, fifty shekels of gold, and upper rooms he gilded with gold.
brenton_translation: And the weight of the nails, even the weight of each was fifty shekels of gold: and he gilded the upper chamber with gold.

fresh_translation: And he made in house of holy of holies two cheroubim, work from woods, and gilded them with gold.
brenton_translation: And he made two cherubs in the most holy house, wood-work, and he gilded them with gold.

fresh_translation: And wings of cheroubim were twenty cubits in length; one wing five cubits touching wall of house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.
brenton_translation: And the wings of the cherubs were twenty cubits in length: and one wing of five cubits touched the wall of the house: and the other wing of five cubits touched the wing of the other cherub.

fresh_translation: And wing of one cheroub was five cubits touching wall of house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.
And wings of cheroubim spread out were twenty cubits, and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward house.
brenton_translation: And the wings of these cherubs expanded were of the length of twenty cubits: and they stood upon their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

fresh_translation: And he made veil of blue and purple and scarlet and fine linen, and wove cheroubim in it.
brenton_translation: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and wove cherubs in it.

fresh_translation: And he made before house two pillars, thirty-five cubits high, and their capitals five cubits.
brenton_translation: Also he made in front of the house two pillars, in height thirty-five cubits, and their chapiters of five cubits.

fresh_translation: And he made chains in debir and put them on heads of pillars, and he made one hundred pomegranates and put them on chains.
brenton_translation: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

fresh_translation: And he set pillars before temple, one at right and one at left, and he called name of right one Uprightness and name of left one Strength.
brenton_translation: And he set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left: and he called the name of the one on the right hand ‘Stability,’ and the name of the one on the left ‘Strength.’

fresh_translation: And he made bronze altar, twenty cubits long and twenty cubits broad and ten cubits high.
brenton_translation: And he made a brazen altar, the length of it twenty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits, and the height ten cubits.

fresh_translation: And he made cast sea, ten cubits across, round all around, and its height five cubits, and its circuit thirty cubits.
brenton_translation: And he made the molten sea, in diameter ten cubits, entirely round, and the height of it five cubits, and the circumference thirty cubits.

fresh_translation: And likeness of calves under it around encircled it, ten cubits surrounding laver all around, two kinds having cast calves in their casting.
brenton_translation: And beneath it the likeness of calves, they compass it round about: ten cubits compass the laver round about, they cast the calves two rows in their casting,

fresh_translation: Which they made: twelve calves, three facing north and three facing west and three facing south and three facing east, and sea was above them, and their hind parts were inward.
brenton_translation: wherein they made them twelve calves,—three looking northwards, and three westwards, and three southwards, and three eastwards: and the sea was upon them above, and their hinder parts were inward.

fresh_translation: And its thickness was a handbreadth, and its rim like rim of cup, carved lily blossoms, holding three thousand measures, and it was finished.
brenton_translation: And its thickness was a hand-breadth, and its brim as the brim of a cup, graven with flowers of lilies, holding three thousand measures: and he finished it.

fresh_translation: And he made ten lavers and set five on right and five on left, to wash in them works of whole burnt offerings and rinse in them, and sea was for priests to wash in it.
brenton_translation: And he made ten lavers, and set five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them the instruments of the whole-burnt-offerings, and to rinse the vessels in them; and the sea was for the priests to wash in.

fresh_translation: And he made ten gold lampstands according to their ordinance and set them in temple, five on right and five on left.
brenton_translation: And he made the ten golden candlesticks according to their pattern, and he put them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

fresh_translation: And he made ten tables and set them in temple, five on right and five on left, and he made one hundred golden bowls.
brenton_translation: And he made ten tables, and put them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left: and he made a hundred golden bowls.

fresh_translation: And he made court of priests and great court and doors for court, and their door-panels plated with bronze.
brenton_translation: Also he made the priests' court, and the great court, and doors to the court, and their panels were overlaid with brass.

fresh_translation: And he set sea from corner of house on right, toward east, opposite.
brenton_translation: And he set the sea at the corner of the house on the right, as it were fronting the east.

fresh_translation: And Chiram made flesh-hooks and firepans and grate of altar and all its vessels, and Chiram finished making all work which Salomon the king made in house of God:
brenton_translation: And Chiram made the fleshhooks, and the fire-pans, and the grate of the altar, and all its instruments: and Chiram finished doing all the work which he wrought for king Solomon in the house of God:

fresh_translation: two pillars, and upon them bowl-capitals on heads of pillars, two, and two nets to cover two bowl-capitals which were on heads of pillars,
brenton_translation: two pillars, and upon them an embossed work for the chapiters on the heads of the two pillars, and two nets to cover the heads of the chapiters which are on the heads of the pillars;

fresh_translation: and four hundred golden pomegranates for two nets, two sets of pomegranates on one net to cover two bowl-capitals which were above pillars,
brenton_translation: and four hundred golden bells for the two nets, and two rows of pomegranates in each net, to cover the two embossed rims of the chapiters which are upon the pillars.

fresh_translation: and he made ten stands and made lavers upon stands,
brenton_translation: And he made the ten bases, and he made the lavers upon the bases;

fresh_translation: and one sea and twelve calves under it,
brenton_translation: and the one sea, and the twelve calves under it;

fresh_translation: and footstools and forks and cauldrons and flesh-hooks and all their vessels, which Chiram made and brought to king Salomon for house of Lord, of pure bronze.
brenton_translation: and the foot-baths, and the buckets, and the caldrons, and the flesh-hooks, and all their furniture (which Chiram made, and brought to king Solomon in the house of the Lord) of pure brass.

fresh_translation: In region of Jordan king cast them in thickness of earth, in house of Sokchōth and between Sirdatha.
brenton_translation: In the country round about Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground in the house of Socchoth, and between that and Saredatha.

fresh_translation: And Salomon made all these vessels in very great abundance, because weight of bronze did not fail.
brenton_translation: So Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, for the quantity of brass failed not.

fresh_translation: And Salomon made all vessels of house of Lord, and golden altar and tables, and on them breads of presentation,
brenton_translation: And Solomon made all the vessels of the house of the Lord, and the golden altar, and the tables, and upon them were to be the loaves of shewbread;

fresh_translation: and lampstands and lamps for light according to ordinance and before debir, of pure gold,
brenton_translation: also the candlesticks, and the lamps to give light according to the pattern, and in front of the oracle, of pure gold.

fresh_translation: and their tongs and their lamps and bowls and censers and firepans of pure gold,
brenton_translation: And their snuffers, and their lamps were made, and he made the bowls, and the censers, and the fire-pans, of pure gold.

fresh_translation: and inner door of house into holy of holies, and doors of house of temple, golden.
brenton_translation: And there was the inner door of the house opening into the holy of holies, and he made the inner doors of the temple of gold. So all the work which Solomon wrought for the house of the Lord was finished.

fresh_translation: And all work which Salomon made in house of Lord was finished, and Salomon brought in holy things of Dauid his father, silver and gold and vessels, and gave them into treasure of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And Solomon brought in the holy things of his father David, the silver, and the gold, and the other vessels, and put them in the treasury of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Then Salomon assembled elders of Israel and all rulers of tribes, leaders of fathers of sons of Israel, in Ierousalem, to bring up ark of covenant of Lord from City of Dauid, this is Sion.
brenton_translation: Then Solomon assembled all the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, even the leaders of the families of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David,—this is Sion.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel was assembled to king at feast, this seventh month.
brenton_translation: And all Israel were assembled unto the king in the feast, this is the seventh month.

fresh_translation: And all elders of Israel came, and all Levites took ark.
brenton_translation: And all the elders of Israel came; and all the Levites took up the ark,

fresh_translation: And they brought up ark and tent of testimony and all holy vessels in tent; priests and Levites brought them up.
brenton_translation: and the tabernacle of witness, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle; and the priests and the Levites brought it up.

fresh_translation: And king Salomon and all congregation of Israel, those fearing and gathered with him before ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep which cannot be numbered and cannot be reckoned from multitude.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon, and all the elders of Israel, and the religious of them, and they of them that were gathered before the ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep, which could not be numbered or reckoned for multitude.

fresh_translation: And priests brought in ark of covenant of Lord to its place, into debir of house, into holy of holies, under wings of cheroubim.
brenton_translation: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord into its place, into the oracle of the house, even into the holy of holies, under the wings of the cherubs.

fresh_translation: And cheroubim were spreading out their wings over place of ark, and cheroubim were covering ark and its carrying-poles above.
brenton_translation: And the cherubs stretched out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubs covered the ark, and its staves above.

fresh_translation: And carrying-poles projected, and heads of poles were seen from holy place before debir, but were not seen outside, and they were there until this day.
brenton_translation: And the staves projected, and the heads of the staves were seen from the holy place in front of the oracle, they were not seen without: and there they were to this day.

fresh_translation: There was nothing in ark except two tablets which Moyses put in Chōrēb, when Lord made covenant with sons of Israel as they came out from land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: There was nothing in the ark except the two tables which Moses placed there in Choreb, which God gave in covenant with the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when priests came out from holy place, because all priests found there had sanctified themselves; they were not arranged by courses.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the priests went out of the holy place, (for all the priests that were found were sanctified, they were not then arranged according to their daily course,)

fresh_translation: And Levites, singers, all sons of Asaph, Haiman, Idithoun, and their sons and their brothers, clothed in linen robes with cymbals and harps and lyres, were standing opposite altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests blowing trumpets.
brenton_translation: that all the singing Levites assigned to the sons of Asaph, to Æman, to Idithun, and to his sons, and to his brethren, of them that were clothed in linen garments, with cymbals and lutes and harps, were standing before the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests, blowing trumpets.

fresh_translation: And one sound came to be in blowing trumpets and in singing psalms and in sounding one voice, to give thanks and praise to Lord. And as they raised voice with trumpets and cymbals and instruments of songs and said, Give thanks to Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever, house was filled with cloud of glory of Lord.
brenton_translation: And there was one voice in the trumpeting and in the psalm-singing, and in the loud utterance with one voice to give thanks and praise the Lord; and when they raised their voice together with trumpets and cymbals, and instruments of music, and said, Give thanks to the Lord, for it is good, for his mercy endures for ever:—then the house was filled with the cloud of the glory of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And priests were not able to stand to minister from presence of cloud, because glory of Lord filled house of God.
brenton_translation: And the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord filled the house of God.

fresh_translation: Then Salomon said, Lord said he would dwell in thick darkness.
brenton_translation: Then said Solomon, The Lord said that he would dwell in thick darkness.

fresh_translation: And I built holy house to your name for you, ready for dwelling forever.
brenton_translation: But I have built a house to thy name, holy to thee, and prepared for thee to dwell in for ever.

fresh_translation: And king turned his face and blessed all assembly of Israel, and all assembly of Israel stood there.
brenton_translation: And the king turned his face, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood by.

fresh_translation: And he said, Blessed Lord God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to Dauid my father and with his hands fulfilled it, saying,
brenton_translation: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel: he has even fulfilled with his hands as he spoke with his mouth to my father David, saying,

fresh_translation: From day when I brought my people out of land of Egypt, I did not choose city from all tribes of Israel to build house for my name to be there, and I did not choose man to be ruler over my people Israel,
brenton_translation: From the day when I brought up my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city of all the tribes of Israel, to build a house that my name should be there; neither did I choose a man to be a leader over my people Israel.

fresh_translation: but I chose Ierousalem for my name to be there, and I chose Dauid to be over my people Israel.
brenton_translation: But I chose Jerusalem that my name should be there; and I chose David to be over my people Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came upon heart of Dauid my father to build house to name of Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came into the heart of David my father, to build a house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Lord said to Dauid my father, Because it came upon your heart to build house to my name, you did well that it came upon your heart.
brenton_translation: But the Lord said to my father David, Whereas it came into thy heart to build a house for my name, thou didst well that it came into thy heart.

fresh_translation: Nevertheless, you shall not build house, but your son who shall come out from your loins, he shall build house to my name.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; for thy son who shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

fresh_translation: And Lord raised up his word which he spoke, and I came to be in place of Dauid my father and sat upon throne of Israel, as Lord spoke, and I built house to name of Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the Lord has confirmed this word, which he spoke; and I am raised up in the room of my father David, and I sit upon the throne of Israel as the Lord said, and I have built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel:

fresh_translation: And there I put ark, in which is covenant of Lord which he made with Israel.
brenton_translation: and I have set there the ark in which is the covenant of the Lord, which he made with Israel.

fresh_translation: And he stood before altar of Lord in presence of all assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.
brenton_translation: And he stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread out his hands.

fresh_translation: For Salomon made bronze platform and set it in midst of court of sanctuary, its length five cubits and breadth five cubits and height three cubits, and he stood upon it and fell on his knees before all assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.
brenton_translation: For Solomon had made a brazen scaffold, and set it in the midst of the court of the sanctuary; the length of it was five cubits, and the breadth of it five cubits, and the height of it three cubits: and he stood upon it, and fell upon his knees before the whole congregation of Israel, and spread abroad his hands to heaven,

fresh_translation: And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven and on earth, keeping covenant and mercy for your servants walking before you with whole heart,
brenton_translation: and said,

fresh_translation: what you kept for your servant Dauid my father, what you spoke to him saying, and you spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, as this day.
brenton_translation: Even as thou hast kept them with thy servant David my father, as thou hast spoken to him in words:—thou hast both spoken with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thy hands, as it is this day.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for your servant Dauid my father what you spoke to him, saying, Man shall not fail for you from before me sitting on throne of Israel, if only your sons keep their way to walk in my law as you walked before me.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father the things which thou spokest to him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man before me sitting on the throne of Israel, if only thy sons will take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou didst walk before me.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, let your word be made faithful, which you spoke to your servant Dauid.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, let, I pray thee, thy word be confirmed, which thou hast spoken to thy servant David.

fresh_translation: For will God truly dwell with men upon earth? If heaven and heaven of heaven are not sufficient for you, then what is this house which I built?
brenton_translation: For will God indeed dwell with men upon the earth? if the heaven and the heaven of heavens will not suffice thee, what then is this house which I have built?

fresh_translation: And you shall look upon prayer of your servant and upon my petition, Lord God, to hear petition and prayer which your servant prays before you today,
brenton_translation: Yet thou shalt have respect to the prayer of thy servant, and to my petition, O Lord God, so as to hearken to the petition and the prayer which thy servant prays before thee this day:

fresh_translation: that your eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon this place where you said your name would be called there, to hear prayer which your servant prays toward this place.
brenton_translation: so that thine eyes should be open over this house by day and by night, towards this place, whereon thou saidst thy name should be called, so as to hear the prayer which thy servant prays towards this house.

fresh_translation: And you shall hear petition of your servant and your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place, and you shall hear from place of your dwelling, from heaven, and you shall hear and be merciful.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt hear the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, whatsoever prayers they shall make towards this place: and thou shalt hearken in thy dwelling-place out of heaven, yea thou shalt hear, and be merciful.

fresh_translation: If man sins against his neighbor and takes oath upon him to swear him, and comes and swears before altar in this house,
brenton_translation: If a man sin against his neighbour, and he bring an oath upon him so as to make him swear, and he come and swear before the altar in this house;

fresh_translation: then you shall hear from heaven and do and judge your servants, repaying lawless one, to return his ways upon his head, and justifying righteous one, to give to him according to his righteousness.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hearken out of heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, to recompense the transgressor, and to return his ways upon his head: and to justify the righteous, to recompense him according to his righteousness.

fresh_translation: And if your people Israel are crushed before enemy when they sin against you, and they turn and give thanks to your name and pray and entreat before you in this house,
brenton_translation: And if thy people Israel should be put to the worse before the enemy, if they should sin against thee, and then turn and confess to thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

fresh_translation: then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to sins of your people Israel and return them to land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
