fresh_translation: And king of Israel said to Iōsaphat, There is still one man through whom to seek Lord, and I hated him, because he is not prophesying good concerning me, but all his days evil. This is Michaias son of Iemla. And Iōsaphat said, Let not king speak thus.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, There is yet one man by whom to enquire of the Lord; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy concerning me for good, for all his days are for evil: this is Michaias the son of Jembla. And Josaphat said, Let not the king say so.

fresh_translation: And king of Israel called one eunuch and said, Quickly, Michaias son of Iemla.
brenton_translation: And the king called an eunuch, and said, Fetch quickly Michaias the son of Jembla.

fresh_translation: And king of Israel and Iōsaphat king of Iouda were sitting each on his throne, clothed in robes, sitting in broad place of gate of Samareia, and all prophets were prophesying before them.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel and Josaphat king of Juda were sitting each on his throne, and clothed in their robes, sitting in the open space at the entrance of the gate of Samaria: and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

fresh_translation: And Sedekias son of Chanaana made for himself iron horns and said, Thus says Lord: With these you shall gore Syria until it is finished.
brenton_translation: And Sedekias son of Chanaan made for himself iron horns, and said, Thus saith the Lord, With these thou shalt thrust Syria until it be consumed.

fresh_translation: And all prophets were prophesying thus, saying, Go up to Ramōth Galaad and prosper, and Lord will give into hands of king.
brenton_translation: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth Galaad, and thou shalt prosper; and the Lord shall deliver it into the hands of the king.

fresh_translation: And messenger who went to call Michaias spoke to him, saying, Behold, prophets spoke with one mouth good things about king. Let your words now be like one of them, and you shall speak good things.
brenton_translation: And the messenger that went to call Michaias spoke to him, saying, Behold, the prophets have spoken favourably concerning the king with one mouth; let now, I pray thee, thy words be as the words of one of them, and do thou speak good things.

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, Lord lives, whatever God says to me, this I will speak.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, As the Lord lives, whatever God shall say to me, that will I speak.

fresh_translation: And he came to king, and king said to him, Michaias, shall I go to Ramōth Galaad for battle, or shall I hold back? And he said, Go up, and you will prosper, and they shall be given into your hands.
brenton_translation: And he came to the king, and the king said to him, Michaias, shall I go up to Ramoth Galaad to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go up, and thou shalt prosper, and they shall be given into your hands.

fresh_translation: And king said to him, How many times shall I make you swear that you speak to me nothing except truth in name of Lord?
brenton_translation: And the king said to him, How often shall I solemnly charge thee that thou speak to me nothing but truth in the name of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And he said, I saw Israel scattered on mountains like sheep which have no shepherd, and Lord said, These have no ruler; let each return to his house in peace.
brenton_translation: And he said, I saw Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep without a shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no commander; let each return to his home in peace.

fresh_translation: And king of Israel said to Iōsaphat, Did I not say to you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, Said I not to thee, that he would not prophesy concerning me good, but evil?

fresh_translation: And he said, Not so. Hear word of Lord: I saw Lord sitting on his throne, and all force of heaven stood at his right and at his left.
brenton_translation: But he said, Not so. Hear ye the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven stood by on his right hand and on his left.

fresh_translation: And Lord said, Who will deceive Achaab king of Israel, and he will go up and fall in Ramōth Galaad? And one said thus and another said thus.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, Who will deceive Achaab king of Israel, that he may go up, and fall in Ramoth Galaad? And one spoke this way, and another spoke that way.

fresh_translation: And spirit came out and stood before Lord and said, I will deceive him. And Lord said, In what way?
brenton_translation: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will deceive him. And the Lord said, Whereby?

fresh_translation: And he said, I will go out and be lying spirit in mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You shall deceive and you shall be able; go out and do so.
brenton_translation: And he said, I will go forth, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the Lord said, Thou shalt deceive him, and shalt prevail: go forth, and do so.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, Lord has put lying spirit in mouth of all these prophets of yours, and Lord spoke evil against you.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, the Lord has put a false spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the Lord has spoken evil against thee.

fresh_translation: And Sedekias son of Chanaana came near and struck Michaias on jaw and said to him, By what way did spirit of Lord pass from me to speak to you?
brenton_translation: Then Sedekias the son of Chanaan drew near, and smote Michaias on the cheek, and said to him, By what way passed the Spirit of the Lord from me to speak to thee?

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, Behold, you will see in that day when you enter chamber from chamber to hide yourself.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go from chamber to chamber to hide thyself.

fresh_translation: And king of Israel said, Take Michaias and return him to Emēr ruler of city and to Iōas ruler, son of king,
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said, Take Michaias, and carry him back to Emer the governor of the city, and to Joas the captain, the king's son;

fresh_translation: and say, Thus says king: Put this one into house of prison, and let him eat bread of affliction and water of affliction until I return in peace.
brenton_translation: and ye shall say, Thus said the king, Put this fellow into the prison-house, and let him eat the bread of affliction, and drink the water of affliction, until I return in peace.

fresh_translation: And Michaias said, If you indeed return in peace, Lord did not speak in me. Hear, all peoples.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, If thou do at all return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me. And he said, Hear, all ye people.

fresh_translation: And king of Israel and Iōsaphat king of Iouda went up to Ramōth Galaad.
brenton_translation: So the king of Israel, and Josaphat king of Juda, went up to Ramoth Galaad.

fresh_translation: And king of Israel said to Iōsaphat, I will disguise myself and enter into battle, and you put on my clothing. And king of Israel disguised himself and entered into battle.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, Disguise me, and I will enter into the battle: and do thou put on my raiment. So the king of Israel disguised himself, and entered into the battle.

fresh_translation: And king of Syria commanded chiefs of chariots with him, saying, Do not fight small and great, except king of Israel only.
brenton_translation: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight neither against small nor great, but only against the king of Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when chiefs of chariots saw Iōsaphat, they said, It is king of Israel. And they surrounded him to fight, and Iōsaphat cried out, and Lord saved him, and God turned them away from him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Josaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel: and they compassed him about to fight against him: and Josaphat cried out, and the Lord delivered him; and God turned them away from him.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when chiefs of chariots saw that he was not king of Israel, they turned away from him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned away from him.

fresh_translation: And a man bent bow by good aim and struck king of Israel between lung and between chest, and he said to driver, Turn your hand and bring me out of battle, because I am in pain.
brenton_translation: And a man drew a bow with a good aim, and smote the king of Israel between the lungs and the breastplate: and he said to the charioteer, Turn thine hand, drive me out of the battle, for I am wounded.

fresh_translation: And battle turned in that day, and king of Israel was standing on chariot until evening against Syria, and he died at setting of sun.
brenton_translation: And the battle turned in that day; and the king of Israel remained on the chariot against Syria until evening, and died at sunset.

fresh_translation: And Iōsaphat king of Iouda returned to his house in peace, to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat king of Juda returned to his house at Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Iou son of Anani the prophet went out to meet him and said to him, King Iōsaphat, do you help sinner, or make friendship with one hated by Lord? Because of this wrath came upon you from Lord.
brenton_translation: And there went out to meet him Jeu the prophet the son of Anani, and said to him, King Josaphat, dost thou help a sinner, or act friendly towards one hated of the Lord? Therefore has wrath come upon thee from the Lord.

fresh_translation: Yet good matters were found in you, because you removed groves from land of Iouda and directed your heart to seek Lord.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless some good things have been found in thee, forasmuch as thou didst remove the groves from the land of Juda, and didst direct thine heart to seek after the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Iōsaphat dwelt in Ierousalem and again went out to people from Bersabee to mountain of Ephraim and turned them back to Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat dwelt in Jerusalem: and he again went out among the people from Bersabee to the mount of Ephraim, and turned them back to the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And he appointed judges in all fortified cities of Iouda, city by city.
brenton_translation: And he appointed judges in all the strong cities of Juda, city by city.

fresh_translation: And he said to judges, See what you do, because you do not judge for man, but for Lord, and matters of judgment are with you.
brenton_translation: And he said to the judges, Take good heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the Lord, and with you are matters of judgment.

fresh_translation: And now let fear of Lord be upon you, and keep and do, because with Lord our God there is no injustice, nor regard of face, nor taking of gifts.
brenton_translation: And now let the fear of the Lord be upon you, and be wary, and do your duty: for there is no unrighteousness with the Lord our God, neither is it for him to respect persons, nor to take bribes.

fresh_translation: And also in Ierousalem Iōsaphat appointed from priests and Levites and patriarchs of Israel for judgment of Lord and to judge those dwelling in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: Moreover Josaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the priests, and Levites, and heads of houses of Israel, for the judgment of the Lord, and to judge the dwellers in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he commanded them, saying, Thus you shall do in fear of Lord, in truth and with full heart.
brenton_translation: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the Lord, in truth and with a perfect heart.

fresh_translation: Every case that comes upon you from your brothers dwelling in their cities, between blood and blood and between ordinance and commandment and statutes and judgments, you shall make distinction for them, and they shall not sin against Lord, and wrath shall not be on you and on your brothers. Thus you shall do and you shall not sin.
brenton_translation: Whatsoever man of your brethren that dwell in their cities shall bring the cause that comes before you, between blood and blood, and between precept and commandment, and ordinances and judgments, ye shall even decide for them; so they shall not sin against the Lord, and there shall not be wrath upon you, and upon your brethren: thus ye shall do, and ye shall not sin.

fresh_translation: And behold, Amarias the priest is leader over you for every matter of Lord, and Zabdias son of Ismaēl is leader for house of Iouda for every matter of king, and scribes and Levites are before you. Be strong and do, and Lord shall be with good man.
brenton_translation: And, behold, Amarias the priest is head over you in every matter of the Lord; and Zabdias the son of Ismael is head over the house of Juda in every matter of the king; and the scribes and Levites are before you: be strong and active, and the Lord shall be with the good.

fresh_translation: And after these things sons of Moab and sons of Ammon and with them from Minaeans came against Iōsaphat for battle.
brenton_translation: And after this came the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Minæans, against Josaphat to battle.

fresh_translation: And they came and reported to Iōsaphat, saying, Great multitude has come against you from beyond sea, from Syria, and behold, they are in Asasanthamar, this is Engaddi.
brenton_translation: And they came and told Josaphat, saying, There is come against thee a great multitude from Syria, from beyond the sea; and, behold, they are in Asasan Thamar, this is Engadi.

fresh_translation: And he feared, and Iōsaphat set his face to seek Lord and proclaimed fast in all Iouda.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat was alarmed, and set his face to seek the Lord earnestly, and he proclaimed a fast in all Juda.

fresh_translation: And Iouda gathered to seek Lord, and from all cities of Iouda they came to seek Lord.
brenton_translation: And Juda gathered themselves together to seek after the Lord: even from all the cities of Juda they came to seek the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Iōsaphat stood in assembly of Iouda in Ierousalem, in house of Lord, before new court,
brenton_translation: And Josaphat stood up in the assembly of Juda in Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord, in front of the new court.

fresh_translation: and said, Lord God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven, and do you not rule over all kingdoms of nations? And in your hand are strength and power, and none can stand against you.
brenton_translation: And he said, O Lord God of my fathers, art not thou God in heaven above, and art not thou Lord of all the kingdoms of the nations? and is there not in thy hand the might of dominion, and there is no one who can resist thee?

fresh_translation: Are you not Lord who destroyed inhabitants of this land from before your people Israel and gave it to seed of Abraam your beloved forever?
brenton_translation: Art not thou the Lord that didst destroy the inhabitants of this land before the face of thy people Israel, and didst give it to thy beloved seed of Abraham for ever?

fresh_translation: And they dwelt in it and built in it sanctuary to your name, saying,
brenton_translation: And they dwelt in it, and built in it a sanctuary to thy name, saying,

fresh_translation: If evils come upon us, sword, judgment, death, famine, we shall stand before this house and before you, because your name is upon this house, and we shall cry to you from affliction, and you will hear and save.
brenton_translation: If there should come upon us evils, sword, judgment, pestilence, famine, we will stand before this house, and before thee, (for thy name is upon this house,) and we will cry to thee because of the affliction, and thou shalt hear, and deliver.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, sons of Ammon and Moab and mount Sēir, through whom you did not allow Israel to pass when they came out from land of Egypt, because they turned away from them and did not destroy them,
brenton_translation: And now, behold, the children of Ammon, and Moab, and mount Seir, with regard to whom thou didst not permit Israel to pass through their border, when they had come out of the land of Egypt, (for they turned away from them, and did not destroy them;)—

fresh_translation: and now, behold, they attempt against us, to come cast us out from our inheritance which you gave us.
brenton_translation: yet now, behold, they make attempts against us, to come forth to cast us out from our inheritance which thou gavest us.

fresh_translation: Lord our God, will you not judge among them? Because there is no strength in us to stand against this great multitude that came upon us, and we do not know what we should do, but our eyes are upon you.
brenton_translation: O Lord our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no strength to resist this great multitude that is come against us; and we know not what we shall do to them: but our eyes are toward thee.

fresh_translation: And all Iouda stood before Lord, and their little children and wives.
brenton_translation: And all Juda was standing before the Lord, and their children, and their wives.

fresh_translation: And upon Oziēl son of Zachariou, from sons of Banaiou, from sons of Elēēl, from Mathaniou the Levite, from sons of Asaph, spirit of Lord came in assembly,
brenton_translation: And Oziel the son of Zacharias, of the children of Banaias, of the sons of Eleïel the sons of Matthanias the Levite, of the sons of Asaph,—upon him came the Spirit of the Lord in the assembly:

fresh_translation: and he said, Hear, all Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem and king Iōsaphat. Thus says Lord to you: Do not fear and do not be dismayed before this great multitude, because battle is not yours but God’s.
brenton_translation: and he said, Hear ye, all Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem, and king Josaphat: Thus saith the Lord to you, even you, Fear not, neither be alarmed, before all this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.

fresh_translation: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they are going up by ascent of Asas, and you will find them at end of river of wilderness Ieriiēl.
brenton_translation: To-morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the ascent of Assis, and ye shall find them at the extremity of the river of the wilderness of Jeriel.

fresh_translation: It is not for you to fight in this. Stand and see salvation of Lord with you, Iouda and Ierousalem. Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Tomorrow go out to meet them, and Lord is with you.
brenton_translation: It is not for you to fight: understand these things, and see the deliverance of the Lord with you, Juda and Jerusalem: fear not, neither be afraid to go forth to-morrow to meet them; and the Lord shall be with you.

fresh_translation: And Iōsaphat bowed with face to ground, and all Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem fell before Lord to worship Lord.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat bowed with his face to the ground with all Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem, and they fell before the Lord to worship the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Levites from sons of Kaath and from sons of Korē rose to praise Lord God of Israel with very great loud voice.
brenton_translation: And the Levites of the children of Caath, and they of the sons of Core, rose up to praise the Lord God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

fresh_translation: And they rose early in morning and went out into wilderness of Thekōe, and as they went out, Iōsaphat stood and cried, saying, Hear me, Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem. Trust in Lord your God and you shall be trusted; trust in his prophet and you shall prosper.
brenton_translation: And they rose early in the morning and went out to the wilderness of Thecoe: and as they went out, Josaphat stood and cried, and said, Hear me, Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem; put your trust in the Lord God, and your trust shall be honoured; trust in his prophet, and ye shall prosper.

fresh_translation: And he took counsel with people and set singers and praisers to give thanks and praise holy things as they went out before force, and they said, Give thanks to Lord, because his mercy is forever.
brenton_translation: And he took counsel with the people, and set appointed men to sing psalms and praises, to give thanks, and sing the holy songs of praise in going forth before the host: and they said, Give thanks to the Lord, for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: And when he began praise of thanksgiving, Lord made sons of Ammon fight against Moab and mount Sēir, those coming out against Iouda, and they were routed.
brenton_translation: And when they began the praise and thanksgiving, the Lord caused the children of Ammon to fight against Moab, and the inhabitants of mount Seir that came out against Juda; and they were routed.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon and Moab rose against inhabitants of mount Sēir to destroy and wipe out, and when they finished inhabitants of Sēir, they rose against one another for destruction.
brenton_translation: Then the children of Ammon and Moab rose up against the dwellers in mount Seir, to destroy and consume them; and when they had made an end of destroying the inhabitants of Seir, they rose up against one another so that they were utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: And Iouda came to watchtower of wilderness and looked, and saw multitude, and behold, all were dead, fallen on ground; there was none being saved.
brenton_translation: And Juda came to the watch-tower of the wilderness, and looked, and saw the multitude, and, behold, they were all fallen dead upon the earth, not one escaped.

fresh_translation: And Iōsaphat and his people came to plunder their spoils and found many cattle and baggage and spoils and desirable vessels, and they plundered for themselves, and it was three days they plundered spoils, because it was much.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat and his people went out to spoil them, and they found much cattle, and furniture, and spoils, and precious things: and they spoiled them, and they were three days gathering the spoil, for it was abundant.

fresh_translation: And on fourth day they were gathered to valley of blessing, because there they blessed Lord. Therefore name of that place was called Valley of Blessing until this day.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the fourth day they were gathered to the Valley of Blessing; for there they blessed the Lord: therefore they called the name of that place the Valley of Blessing, until this day.

fresh_translation: And every man of Iouda returned to Ierousalem, and Iōsaphat leading them, with great gladness, because Lord gladdened them from their enemies.
brenton_translation: And all the men of Juda returned to Jerusalem, and Josaphat led them with great joy; for the Lord gave them joy over their enemies.

fresh_translation: And they entered into Ierousalem with harps and lyres and trumpets to house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And they entered into Jerusalem with lutes and harps and trumpets, going into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And terror of Lord came upon all kingdoms of earth when they heard that Lord fought against adversaries of Israel.
brenton_translation: And there was a terror of the Lord upon all the kingdoms of the land, when they heard that the Lord fought against the enemies of Israel.

fresh_translation: And kingdom of Iōsaphat was at peace, and his God gave him rest all around.
brenton_translation: And the kingdom of Josaphat was at peace; and his God gave him rest round about.

fresh_translation: And Iōsaphat reigned over Iouda, being thirty-five years old when he reigned, and he reigned twenty-five years in Ierousalem, and his mother’s name was Azouba daughter of Sali.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat reigned over Juda, being thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Azuba, daughter of Sali.

fresh_translation: And he walked in ways of Asa his father and did not turn aside from doing upright in sight of Lord.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the ways of his father Asa, and turned not aside from doing that which was right in the sight of the Lord.

fresh_translation: But high places still existed, and people still did not direct heart toward Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the high places yet remained; and as yet the people did not direct their heart to the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And rest of matters of Iōsaphat, first and last, behold, written in words of Iou son of Anani, who wrote book of kings of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Josaphat, the first and the last, behold, they are written in the history of Jeu the son of Anani, who wrote the book of the kings of Israel.

fresh_translation: And after these things Iōsaphat king of Iouda joined himself with Ochozias king of Israel, and he acted lawlessly.
brenton_translation: And afterwards Josaphat king of Juda entered into an alliance with Ochozias king of Israel, (now this was an unrighteous man,)

fresh_translation: In making and going with him to make ships to go to Tharsis, he made ships in Gasiōngaber.
brenton_translation: by acting with and going to him, to build ships to go to Tharsis: and he built ships in Gasion Gaber.

fresh_translation: And Eliezer son of Dōdia from Marisa prophesied against Iōsaphat, saying, Because you made friendship with Ochozias, Lord broke your work, and your ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tharsis.
brenton_translation: And Eliezer the son of Dodia of Marisa prophesied against Josaphat, saying, Forasmuch as thou hast allied thyself with Ochozias, the Lord has broken thy work, and thy vessels have been wrecked. And they could not go to Tharsis.

fresh_translation: And Iōsaphat slept with his fathers and was buried beside his fathers in City of Dauid, and Iōram his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Joran his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And he had brothers, sons of Iōsaphat: Azarias and Iiēl and Zacharias and Azarias and Michaēl and Saphatias; all these were sons of Iōsaphat king of Iouda.
brenton_translation: And he had brothers, the six sons of Josaphat, Azarias, and Jeiel, and Zacharias, and Azarias, and Michael, and Zaphatias: all these were the sons of Josaphat king of Juda.

fresh_translation: And their father gave them many gifts, silver and gold and weapons, with fortified cities in Iouda, but kingdom he gave to Iōram, because he was firstborn.
brenton_translation: And their father gave them many gifts, silver, and gold, and arms, together with fortified cities in Juda: but he gave the kingdom to Joram, for he was the first-born.

fresh_translation: And Iōram rose over his kingdom and grew strong and killed all his brothers with sword, and also from rulers of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Joram entered upon his kingdom, and strengthened himself, and slew all his brothers with the sword, and some of the princes of Israel.

fresh_translation: Iōram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and eight years he reigned in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: When he was thirty and two years old, Joram succeeded to his kingdom, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he walked in way of kings of Israel, as house of Achaab did, because daughter of Achaab was his wife, and he did evil before Lord.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Achaab; for a daughter of Achaab was his wife: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord:

fresh_translation: And Lord did not want to destroy house of Dauid because of covenant which he made with Dauid and as he said to give to him lamp and to his sons all days.
brenton_translation: nevertheless the Lord would not utterly destroy the house of David, because of the covenant which he made with David, and as he said to him that he would give a light to him and his sons for ever.

fresh_translation: In those days Edōm rebelled from Iouda and made king over themselves.
brenton_translation: In those days Edom revolted from Juda, and they made a king over themselves.

fresh_translation: And Iōram went with rulers and all cavalry with him, and it came to pass, he rose by night and struck Edōm encircling him and commanders of chariots, and people fled to their tents.
brenton_translation: And Joram went with the princes, and all the cavalry with him: and it came to pass that he arose by night, and smote Edom that compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots, and the people fled to their tents.

fresh_translation: And Edōm rebelled from Iouda until this day. Then Lobna rebelled at that time from his hand, because he forsook Lord God of his fathers.
brenton_translation: And Edom revolted from Juda until this day. Then Lomna at that time revolted from under his hand, because he forsook the Lord God of his fathers.

fresh_translation: And he too made high places in cities of Iouda and prostituted inhabitants of Ierousalem and led Iouda astray.
brenton_translation: For he built high places in the cities of Juda, and caused the dwellers in Jerusalem to go a-whoring, and led Juda astray.

fresh_translation: And writing came to him from Ēlias the prophet, saying, Thus says Lord God of Dauid your father: Because you did not walk in way of Iōsaphat your father and in ways of Asa king of Iouda,
brenton_translation: And there came to him a message in writing from Eliu the prophet, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of thy father David, Because thou hast not walked in the way of thy father Josaphat, nor in the ways of Asa king of Juda,

fresh_translation: but walked in ways of kings of Israel and prostituted Iouda and inhabitants of Ierousalem as house of Achaab prostituted, and you killed your brothers, sons of your father, those better than you,
brenton_translation: but hast walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and hast caused Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem to go a-whoring, as the house of Achaab caused Israel to go a-whoring, and thou hast slain thy brethren, the sons of thy father, who were better than thyself;

fresh_translation: behold, Lord will strike you with great plague among your people and among your sons and among your wives and among all your baggage.
brenton_translation: behold, the Lord shall smite thee with a great plague among thy people, and thy sons, and thy wives, and all thy store:

fresh_translation: And you with evil weakness, in disease of belly, until your belly comes out with sickness from day to day.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt be afflicted with a grievous disease, with a disease of the bowels, until thy bowels shall fall out day by day with the sickness.

fresh_translation: And Lord stirred up against Iōram Philistines and Arabs and neighbors of Aithiopians.
brenton_translation: So the Lord stirred up the Philistines against Joram, and the Arabians, and those who bordered on the Æthiopians:

fresh_translation: And they went up against Iouda and overpowered and carried away all baggage they found in house of king and his sons and his daughters, and no son was left to him except Ochozias, youngest of his sons.
brenton_translation: and they went up against Juda, and prevailed against them, and took away all the store which they found in the house of the king, and his sons, and his daughters; and there was no son left to him but Ochozias the youngest of his sons.

fresh_translation: And after all these things Lord struck him in belly with weakness that had no healing.
brenton_translation: And after all these things the Lord smote him in the bowels with an incurable disease.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass from days to days, and as time of days came, two days, his belly came out with disease, and he died in evil weakness, and his people did not make funeral for him like funeral of his fathers.
brenton_translation: And it continued from day to day: and when the time of the days came to two years, his bowels fell out with the disease, and he died by a grievous distemper: and his people performed no funeral, like the funeral of his fathers.

fresh_translation: He was thirty-two years old when he reigned, and eight years he reigned in Ierousalem, and he went away without praise and was buried in City of Dauid, but not in tombs of kings.
brenton_translation: He was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. And he departed without honour, and was buried in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

fresh_translation: And inhabitants of Ierousalem made Ochozias his son, youngest, king in his place, because raiding band that came upon them, Arabs and Alimazones, killed all elders. And Ochozias son of Iōram king of Iouda reigned.
brenton_translation: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ochozias his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of robbers that came against them, even the Arabians and the Alimazonians, had slain all the elder ones. So Ochozias son of Joram king of Juda reigned.

fresh_translation: Ochozias was twenty years old when he reigned, and one year he reigned in Ierousalem, and his mother’s name was Gotholia daughter of Ambri.
brenton_translation: Ochozias began to reign when he was twenty years old, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Gotholia, the daughter of Ambri.

fresh_translation: And he walked in way of house of Achaab, because his mother was counselor to him in sinning.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the way of the house of Achaab; for his mother was his counsellor to do evil.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before Lord like house of Achaab, because they were counselors to him after death of his father, to destroy him.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord as the house of Achaab had done: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

fresh_translation: And in their counsels he walked and went with Iōram son of Achaab to war against Azaēl king of Syria at Rama Galaad, and archers struck Iōram.
brenton_translation: And he walked in their counsels, and he went with Joram son of Achaab king of Israel to war against Azael king of Syria to Ramoth Galaad: and the archers smote Joram.

fresh_translation: And Iōram returned to be healed in Iezrael from wounds which Syrians gave him in Rama when he fought Azaēl king of Syria, and Ochozias son of Iōram king of Iouda came down to visit Iōram son of Achaab in Iezrael, because he was sick.
brenton_translation: And Joram returned to Jezrael to be healed of the wounds wherewith the Syrians smote him in Ramoth, when he fought against Azael king of Syria.

fresh_translation: And from God came destruction of Ochozias by coming to Iōram. And when he came, Iōram went out with him toward Iou son of Namessi, anointed of Lord, against house of Achaab.
brenton_translation: And destruction from God came upon Ochozias in his coming to Joram; for when he had come, Joram went out with him against Jeu the son of Namessei, the anointed of the Lord against the house of Achaab.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when Iou avenged house of Achaab and found rulers of Iouda and brothers of Ochozias ministering to Ochozias, he killed them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when Jeu was taking vengeance on the house of Achaab, that he found the princes of Juda and the brethren of Ochozias ministering to Ochozias, and he slew them.

fresh_translation: And he told them to seek Ochozias, and they seized him while he was being healed in Samareia and brought him to Iou, and he killed him and buried him, because they said, He is son of Iōsaphat who sought Lord with whole heart. And there was none in house of Ochozias strong enough for kingdom.
brenton_translation: And he gave orders to seek Ochozias: and they took him while he was healing his wounds in Samaria, and they brought him to Jeu, and he slew him; and they buried him, for they said, He is the son of Josaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart.

fresh_translation: And Gotholia mother of Ochozias saw that her son was dead, and she rose and destroyed all royal seed in house of Iouda.
brenton_translation: And Gotholia the mother of Ochozias saw that her son was dead, and she arose and destroyed all the seed royal in the house of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Iōsabeath daughter of king took Iōas son of Ochozias and stole him from midst of king’s sons who were being put to death and put him and his nurse in chamber of beds. And Iōsabeath daughter of king Iōram, sister of Ochozias, wife of Iōdae the priest, hid him from before Gotholia, and she did not kill him.
brenton_translation: But Josabeeth, the daughter of the king, took Joas the son of Ochozias and rescued him secretly out of the midst of the sons of the king that were put to death, and she placed him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Josabeeth daughter of king Joram, sister of Ochozias, wife of Jodae the priest, hid him, and she even hid him from Gotholia, and she did not slay him.

fresh_translation: And he was with her in house of God, hidden six years, and Gotholia reigned over land.
brenton_translation: And he was with him hid in the house of God six years; and Gotholia reigned over the land.

fresh_translation: And in seventh year Iōdae strengthened himself and took the centurions, Azarian son of Iōram and Ismaēl son of Iōanan and Azarian son of Ōbēd and Maasaias son of Adaia and Elisaphan son of Zacharia, with him into house.
brenton_translation: And in the eighth year Jodae strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azarias the son of Joram, and Ismael the son of Joanan, and Azarias the son of Obed, and Maasæas the son of Adia, and Elisaphan the son of Zacharias, with him into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they went around Iouda and gathered Levites from all cities of Iouda and chiefs of fathers of Israel and came to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And they went round about Juda, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Juda, and heads of the families of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And all assembly of Iouda made covenant in house of God with king, and he showed them son of king and said to them, Behold, son of king, let him reign, as Lord spoke concerning house of Dauid.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation of Juda made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he shewed them the king's son, and said to them, Lo, let the king's son reign, as the Lord said concerning the house of David.

fresh_translation: Now this is thing which you shall do: one-third of you entering on Sabbath, of priests and Levites, shall be at gates of entries,
brenton_translation: Now this is the thing which ye shall do. Let a third part of you, even of the priests and of the Levites, enter in on the sabbath, even into the gates of the entrances;

fresh_translation: and one-third in house of king, and one-third at middle gate, and all people in courts of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: and let a third part be in the house of the king; and another third at the middle gate: and all the people in the courts of the Lord's house.

fresh_translation: And no one shall enter house of Lord except priests and Levites and ministers of Levites. They shall enter because they are holy, and all people shall keep charges of Lord.
brenton_translation: And let not any one enter into the house of the Lord, except the priests and the Levites, and the servants of the Levites; they shall enter in, because they are holy: and let all the people keep the watch of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Levites shall surround king all around, each man with weapon in his hand, and one entering house shall die, and they shall be with king when he enters and goes out.
brenton_translation: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man's weapon in his hand; and whoever else goes into the house shall die: but they shall be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.

fresh_translation: And Levites and all Iouda did according to all things which Iōdae the priest commanded, and each took his men from beginning of Sabbath to end of Sabbath, because Iōdae did not dismiss courses.
brenton_translation: And the Levites and all Juda did according to all that the priest Jodae commanded them, and they took each his men from the beginning of the sabbath to the end of the sabbath, for Jodae the priest did not dismiss the courses.

fresh_translation: And he gave swords and shields and weapons which belonged to king Dauid in house of God.
brenton_translation: And Jodae gave to the men the swords, and the shields, and the arms, which had belonged to king David, in the house of God.

fresh_translation: And he set all people, each with his weapons, from shoulder of house on right to shoulder on left, by altar and by house, around king.
brenton_translation: And he set the whole people, every man with his arms, from the right side of the house to the left side of the altar and the house, over against the king round about.

fresh_translation: And they brought out son of king and put kingdom and testimonies upon him, and they made him king and anointed him, Iōdae and his sons, and said, Let king live.
brenton_translation: And he brought out the king's son, and put on him the crown and the testimony, and Jodae the priest and his sons proclaimed him king, and anointed him, and said, Long live the king!

fresh_translation: And Gotholia heard sound of people running and giving thanks and praising king and entered to king in house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And Gotholia heard the sound of the people running, and acknowledging and praising the king: and she went in to the king into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And she saw, and behold, king stood at his station and at entrance, rulers and trumpets around king, and all people of land rejoiced, and they sounded with trumpets, and singers with instruments of songs and hymning praise. And Gotholia tore her robe and cried, Conspiracy, conspire!
brenton_translation: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood in his place, and the princes and trumpets were at the entrance, and the princes were round the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded the trumpets, and there were the singers singing with instruments, and singing hymns of praise. And Gotholia rent her robe, and cried, Ye surely are plotting against me.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae the priest went out and commanded centurions and leaders of force and said to them, Throw her out beyond house, and whoever enters after her, let him die by sword, because priest said, Let her not die in house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jodae the priest went forth, and Jodae the priest charged the captains of hundreds, even the captains of the host, and said to them, Thrust her forth outside the house, and follow her, and let her be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Let her not be slain in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they gave her free passage, and she went through horse gate of house of king, and they killed her there.
brenton_translation: So they let her go out; and she went through the horsemen's gate of the house of the king, and they slew her there.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae made covenant between himself and people and king, that they should be people to Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jodae made a covenant between himself, and the people, and the king, that the people should be the Lord's.

fresh_translation: And all people of land entered house of Baal and pulled it down, and his altars and idols they crushed small, and Matthan priest of Baal they killed before his altars.
brenton_translation: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and tore down it and its altars, and they ground his images to powder, and they slew Matthan the priest of Baal before his altars.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae the priest entrusted works of house of Lord by hand of priests and Levites and restored courses of priests and Levites which Dauid appointed over house of Lord, to offer whole burnt offerings to Lord as written in law of Moyses, with gladness and with songs by hand of Dauid.
brenton_translation: And Jodae the priest committed the works of the house of the Lord into the hand of the priests and Levites, and he re-established the courses of the priests and Levites which David appointed over the house of the Lord, and he appointed them to offer whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord, as it is written in the law of Moses, with gladness, and with songs by the hand of David.

fresh_translation: And they stationed gatekeepers at gates of house of Lord, and no unclean person in any matter shall enter.
brenton_translation: And the porters stood at the gates of the house of the Lord, that no one unclean in any respect should enter in.

fresh_translation: And he took patriarchs and mighty men and rulers of people and all people of land, and brought up king to house of Lord, and entered by inner gate into house of king and seated king upon throne of kingdom.
brenton_translation: And he took the heads of families, and the mighty men, and the chiefs of the people, and all the people of the land, and they conducted the king into the house of the Lord; and he went through the inner gate into the king's house, and they seated the king on the throne of the kingdom.

fresh_translation: And all people of land rejoiced, and city was quiet, and they killed Gotholia with sword.
brenton_translation: And all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was quiet: and they slew Gotholia.

fresh_translation: Iōas was seven years old when he reigned, and forty years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Sabia from Bersabee.
brenton_translation: Joas was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Sabia of Beersabee.

fresh_translation: And Iōas did upright in sight of Lord all days of Iōdae the priest.
brenton_translation: And Joas did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all the days of Jodae the priest.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae took for him two wives, and he fathered sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Jodae took to himself two wives, and they bore sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And after these things it came upon heart of Iōas to repair house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterward that it came into the heart of Joas to repair the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he gathered priests and Levites and said to them, Go out into cities of Iouda and gather from all Israel silver to strengthen house of Lord year by year, and hurry to speak. And Levites did not hurry.
brenton_translation: And he gathered the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out into the cities of Juda, and collect money of all Israel to repair the house of the Lord from year to year, and make haste to speak of it. But the Levites hasted not.

fresh_translation: And king Iōas called Iōdae the chief and said to him, Why did you not see about Levites to bring from Iouda and Ierousalem what was ordained by Moyses man of God when he assembled Israel for tent of testimony?
brenton_translation: And king Joas called Jodae the chief, and said to him, Why hast thou not looked after the Levites, so that they should bring from Juda and Jerusalem that which was prescribed by Moses the man of God, when he assembled Israel at the tabernacle of witness?

fresh_translation: Because Gotholia was lawless, and her sons pulled down house of God, and indeed holy things of house of Lord they made for Baals.
brenton_translation: For Gotholia was a transgressor, and her sons tore down the house of God; for they offered the holy things of the house of the Lord to Baalim.

fresh_translation: And king said, Let a chest be made and placed at gate of house of Lord outside.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Let a box be made, and let it be put at the gate of the house of the Lord without.

fresh_translation: And let them proclaim in Iouda and in Ierousalem to bring to Lord as Moyses servant of God spoke upon Israel in wilderness.
brenton_translation: And let men proclaim in Juda and in Jerusalem, that the people should bring to the Lord, as Moses the servant of God spoke concerning Israel in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And all rulers and all people gave and brought and put into chest until it was full.
brenton_translation: And all the princes and all the people gave, and brought in, and cast into the box until it was filled.

fresh_translation: And whenever chest was brought to king’s officers by hand of Levites, and when they saw silver had multiplied, then king’s scribe came and officer of high priest and emptied chest and restored it to its place. Thus they did day by day and gathered much silver.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when they brought in the box to the officers of the king by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that the money was more than sufficient, then came the king's scribe, and the officer of the high priest, and emptied the box, and restored it to its place. Thus they did day by day, and collected much money.

fresh_translation: And king and Iōdae the priest gave it to those doing works for work of house of Lord, and they hired stonecutters and carpenters to repair house of Lord, and workers in iron and bronze to repair house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king and Jodae the priest gave it to the workmen employed in the service of the house of the Lord, and they hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, also smiths and braziers to repair the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And workers did work, and length of works went up in their hands, and they restored house of Lord to its standing and strengthened it.
brenton_translation: And the workmen wrought, and the works prospered in their hands, and they established the house of the Lord on its foundation, and strengthened it.

fresh_translation: And when they finished, they brought remaining silver to king and to Iōdae, and they made vessels for house of Lord, ministering vessels for whole burnt offerings and censers of gold and silver, and they offered whole burnt offerings in house of Lord continually all days of Iōdae.
brenton_translation: And when they had finished it, they brought to the king and to Jodae the remainder of the money, and they made vessels for the house of the Lord, vessels of service for whole-burnt-offerings, and gold and silver censers: and they offered up whole-burnt-offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jodae.

fresh_translation: And Iōdae grew old, full of days, and died, being one hundred thirty years old at his death.
brenton_translation: And Jodae grew old, being full of days, and he died, being a hundred and thirty years old at his death.

fresh_translation: And they buried him in City of Dauid with kings, because he did goodness with Israel and with God and his house.
brenton_translation: And they buried him with the kings in the city of David, because he had dealt well with Israel, and with God and his house.

fresh_translation: And after death of Iōdae, rulers of Iouda came and bowed to king; then king listened to them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the death of Jodae, that the princes of Juda went in, and did obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened to them.

fresh_translation: And they forsook Lord God of their fathers and served Astartes and idols, and wrath came upon Iouda and Ierousalem in this day.
brenton_translation: And they forsook the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served the Astartes and idols: and there was wrath upon Juda and Jerusalem in that day.

fresh_translation: And he sent prophets to them to return to Lord, and they did not listen, and they testified to them and they did not listen.
brenton_translation: Yet he sent prophets to them, to turn them to the Lord; but they hearkened not: and he testified to them, but they obeyed not.

fresh_translation: And spirit of God clothed Azarian son of Iōdae the priest, and he stood above people and said, Thus says Lord: Why do you transgress commandments of Lord and not prosper? Because you forsake Lord, he will forsake you.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of God came upon Azarias the son of Jodae the priest, and he stood up above the people, and said, Thus saith the Lord, Why do ye transgress the commandments of the Lord? so shall ye not prosper; for ye have forsaken the Lord, and he will forsake you.

fresh_translation: And they conspired against him and stoned him by command of king Iōas in court of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And they conspired against him, and stoned him by command of king Joas in the court of the Lord's house.

fresh_translation: And Iōas did not remember mercy which Iōdae his father did with him and killed his son. And as he was dying, he said, Let Lord see and judge.
brenton_translation: So Joas remembered not the kindness which his father Jodae had exercised towards him, but slew his son. And as he died, he said, The Lord look upon it, and judge.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after completion of year, force of Syria came up against him and came upon Iouda and Ierousalem and destroyed all rulers of people among people, and all their spoils they sent to king of Damascus.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the end of the year, that the host of Syria went up against him, and came against Juda and Jerusalem: and they slew all the chiefs of the people among the people, and all their spoils they sent to the king of Damascus.

fresh_translation: Because with few men force of Syria came, and God gave into their hands very great force, because they forsook Lord God of their fathers, and against Iōas he made judgments.
brenton_translation: For the army of Syria came with few men, yet God gave into their hands a very large army, because they had forsaken the God of their fathers; and he brought judgments on Joas.

fresh_translation: And after they departed from him, leaving him in great weaknesses, his servants conspired against him over bloods of son of Iōdae the priest and killed him on his bed, and he died. And they buried him in City of Dauid, but they did not bury him in tomb of kings.
brenton_translation: And after they had departed from him, when they had left him in sore diseases, then his servants conspired against him because of the blood of the son of Jodae the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died, and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchre of the kings.

fresh_translation: And those conspiring against him were Zabed son of Samath the Ammonite and Iōzabed son of Sōmarōth the Moabite.
brenton_translation: And they that conspired against him were Zabed the son of Samaath the Ammanite, and Jozabed the son of Samareth the Moabite.

fresh_translation: And all his sons and the five things brought upon him and the rest, behold, written on commentary of kings, and Amasias his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And all his sons, and the five came to him: and the other matters, behold, they are written in the book of the kings. And Amasias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Amasias was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Iōaden from Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: Amasias began to reign when he was twenty and five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Joadaen of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in sight of Lord, but not with full heart.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a perfect heart.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who killed king his father.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the kingdom was established in his hand, that he slew his servants who had slain the king his father.

fresh_translation: But their sons he did not kill, according to covenant of law of Lord, as written, as Lord commanded, saying, Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers, but each shall die for his own sin.
brenton_translation: But he slew not their sons, according to the covenant of the law of the Lord, as it is written, and as the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, and the sons shall not die for the fathers, but they shall die each for his own sin.

fresh_translation: And Amasias gathered house of Iouda and set them by houses of their fathers over thousands and hundreds in all Iouda and Ierousalem, and counted them from twenty years old and upward and found them three hundred thousand able to go out to battle, holding spear and shield.
brenton_translation: And Amasias assembled the house of Juda, and appointed them according to the houses of their families for captains of thousands and captains of hundreds in all Juda and Jerusalem: and he numbered them from twenty years old and upwards, and found them three hundred thousand able to go out to war, holding spear and shield.

fresh_translation: And he hired from Israel one hundred thousand mighty men of strength for one hundred talents of silver.
brenton_translation: Also he hired of Israel a hundred thousand mighty men for a hundred talents of silver.

fresh_translation: And man of God came to him, saying, King, force of Israel shall not go with you, because Lord is not with Israel, with all sons of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the host of Israel go with thee; for the Lord is not with Israel, even all the sons of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: Because if you suppose to prevail by these, Lord will rout you before enemies, because with Lord there is power both to strengthen and to route.
brenton_translation: For if thou shalt undertake to strengthen thyself with these, then the Lord shall put thee to flight before the enemies: for it is of the Lord both to strengthen and to put to flight.

fresh_translation: And Amasias said to man of God, And what shall I do with hundred talents which I gave to force of Israel? And man of God said, Lord is able to give you many more than these.
brenton_translation: And Amasias said to the man of God, But what shall I do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God said, The Lord can give thee much more than these.

fresh_translation: And Amasias separated force that came to him from Ephraim to go to their place, and they were very angry against Iouda and returned to their place in heat of anger.
brenton_translation: And Amasias separated from the army that came to him from Ephraim, that they might go away to their place; and they were very angry with Juda, and they returned to their place with great wrath.

fresh_translation: And Amasias strengthened himself and took his people and went to valley of salt pits and struck there ten thousand sons of Sēir.
brenton_translation: And Amasias strengthened himself, and took his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote there the children of Seir ten thousand.

fresh_translation: And ten thousand sons of Iouda took captive alive and brought them to top of cliff and threw them down from top of cliff, and all were broken apart.
brenton_translation: And the children of Juda took ten thousand prisoners, and they carried them to the top of the precipice, and cast them headlong from the top of the precipice, and they were all dashed to pieces.

fresh_translation: And sons of force whom Amasias sent back from not going with him to war attacked cities of Iouda from Samareia to Baithōrōn and struck among them three thousand and plundered much spoil.
brenton_translation: And the men of the host whom Amasias sent back so that they should not go with him to battle, went and attacked the cities of Juda, from Samaria to Bæthoron; and they smote three thousand among them, and took much spoil.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after Amasias came from striking Idoumaia, he brought to them gods of sons of Sēir and set them up for himself as gods, and bowed before them and burned sacrifice to them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, after Amasias had returned from smiting Idumea, that he brought home the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up for himself as gods, and bowed down before them, and he sacrificed to them.

fresh_translation: And anger of Lord came upon Amasias and he sent prophets to him and said to him, Why did you seek gods of people who did not rescue their own people from your hand?
brenton_translation: And the anger of the Lord came upon Amasias, and he sent him a prophet, and he said to him, Why hast thou sought the gods of the people, which have not rescued their own people out of thine hand?

fresh_translation: And it came to pass as he spoke to him, he said to him, Have I made you counselor of king? Take heed lest you be whipped. And prophet was silent and said, I know that this was intended against you to destroy you, because you did this and did not listen to my counsel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the prophet was speaking to him, that he said to him, Have I made thee king's counsellor? take heed lest thou be scourged: and the prophet forebore, and said, I know that God is disposed against thee to destroy thee, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not hearkened to my counsel.

fresh_translation: And Amasias took counsel and sent to Iōas son of Iōachaz son of Iou king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in face.
brenton_translation: And Amasias king of Juda took counsel, and sent to Joas, son of Joachaz, son of Jeu, king of Israel, saying, Come, and let us look one another in the face.

fresh_translation: And Iōas king of Israel sent to Amasias king of Iouda, saying, Thornbush in Lebanon sent to cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for wife. And behold, beasts of field in Lebanon came and trampled thornbush.
brenton_translation: And Joas king of Israel sent to Amasias king of Juda, saying, The thistle that was in Libanus sent to the cedar that was in Libanus, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife; but, behold, the wild beasts of the field that are in Libanus shall come: and the wild beasts did come, and trod down the thistle.

fresh_translation: You said, Behold, you struck Idoumaia, and your heavy heart lifts you up. Now sit in your house. Why provoke evil and fall, you and Iouda with you?
brenton_translation: Thou hast said, Behold, I have smitten Idumea, and thy stout heart exalts thee: now stay at home; for why dost thou implicate thyself in mischief, that thou shouldest fall, and Juda with thee?

fresh_translation: And Amasias did not listen, because it came from Lord to hand him over, because he sought gods of Idoumaians.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless Amasias hearkened not, for it was of the Lord to deliver him into the enemy's hands, because he sought after the gods of the Idumeans.

fresh_translation: And Iōas king of Israel went up, and they looked one another in face, he and Amasias king of Iouda, at Baithsamys, which belongs to Iouda.
brenton_translation: So Joas king of Israel went up; and they saw one another, he and Amasias king of Juda, in Bæthsamys, which is of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Iouda was routed before Israel, and each fled to his tent.
brenton_translation: And Juda was put to flight before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

fresh_translation: And Iōas king of Israel seized Amasias king of Iouda, son of Iōas, at Baithsamys and brought him to Ierousalem and pulled down from wall of Ierousalem, from gate of Ephraim to corner gate, four hundred cubits.
brenton_translation: And Joas king of Israel took prisoner Amasias king of Juda, son of Joas, son of Joachaz, in Bæthsamys, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he pulled down part of the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

fresh_translation: And all gold and silver and all vessels found in house of Lord and with Abdedom and treasures of house of king and sons of mixtures, and he returned to Samareia.
brenton_translation: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord and with Abdedom, and the treasures of the king's house, and the hostages, and he returned to Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Amasias son of Iōas king of Iouda lived after death of Iōas son of Iōachaz king of Israel fifteen years.
brenton_translation: And Amasias the son of Joas king of Juda lived after the death of Joas the son of Joachaz king of Israel fifteen years.

fresh_translation: And rest of matters of Amasiou, first and last, behold, written upon book of kings of Iouda and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Amasias, the first and the last, lo! are they not written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel?

fresh_translation: And at time when Amasias rebelled from Lord they conspired against him, and he fled from Ierousalem to Lachis, and they sent after him to Lachis and killed him there.
brenton_translation: And at the time when Amasias departed from the Lord, then they formed a conspiracy against him; and he fled from Jerusalem to Lachis: and they sent after him to Lachis, and slew him there.

fresh_translation: And they carried him upon horses and buried him with his fathers in City of Dauid.
brenton_translation: And they took him up on horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of David.

fresh_translation: And all people of land took Ozia, and he was sixteen years old, and they made him king in place of his father Amasiou.
brenton_translation: Then all the people of the land took Ozias, and he was sixteen years old, and they made him king in the room of his father Amasias.

fresh_translation: He built Ailath; he restored it to Iouda after king slept with his fathers.
brenton_translation: He built Ælath, he recovered it to Juda, after the king slept with his fathers.

fresh_translation: Ozias was sixteen years old when he reigned, and fifty-two years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Chalia from Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: Ozias began to reign at the age of sixteen years, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jechelia of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in sight of Lord according to all things Amasias his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Amasias his father did.

fresh_translation: And he was seeking Lord in days of Zachariou, one understanding in fear of Lord, and in his days he sought Lord and Lord prospered him.
brenton_translation: And he sought the Lord in the days of Zacharias, who understood the fear of the Lord; and in his days he sought the Lord, and the Lord prospered him.

fresh_translation: And he went out and fought against Philistines and pulled down walls of Geth and walls of Iabnē and walls of Azōtos and built cities of Azōtos and among Philistines.
brenton_translation: And he went out and fought against the Philistines, and pulled down the walls of Geth, and the walls of Jabner, and the walls of Azotus, and he built cities near Azotus, and among the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And Lord strengthened him against Philistines and against Arabs dwelling upon rock and against Minaeans.
brenton_translation: And the Lord strengthened him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt on the rock, and against the Minæans.

fresh_translation: And Minaeans gave gifts to Ozia, and his name was until entrance of Egypt, because he grew strong exceedingly.
brenton_translation: And the Minæans gave gifts to Ozias; and his fame spread as far as the entering in of Egypt, for he strengthened himself exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And Ozias built towers in Ierousalem, at corner gate and at valley gate and at corners, and strengthened them.
brenton_translation: And Ozias built towers in Jerusalem, both at the gate of the corner and at the valley gate, and at the corners, and he fortified them.

fresh_translation: And he built towers in wilderness and cut many pits, because much cattle belonged to him in lowland and in plain, and vine-workers in hill-country and in Carmel, because he loved farming.
brenton_translation: And he built towers in the wilderness, and dug many wells, for he had many cattle in the low country and in the plain; and vinedressers in the mountain country and in Carmel: for he was a husbandman.

fresh_translation: And Ozias had forces making war and going out for battle in number, and their number by hand of Iiēl the scribe and Maasaiou the judge, by hand of Ananiou, successor of king.
brenton_translation: And Ozias had a host of warriors, and that went out orderly to war, and returned orderly in number; and their number was made by the hand of Jeiel the scribe, and Maasias the judge, by the hand of Ananias the king's deputy.

fresh_translation: Whole number of patriarchs of mighty men for war was two thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: The whole number of the chiefs of families of the mighty men of war was two thousand six hundred;

fresh_translation: And with them military force was three hundred seven thousand five hundred, those doing war with strength of power to help king against adversaries.
brenton_translation: and with them was a warrior force, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred: these waged war mightily to help the king against his enemies.

fresh_translation: And Ozias prepared for them, for all force, shields and spears and helmets and breastplates and bows and sling-stones.
brenton_translation: And Ozias prepared for them, even for all the host, shields, and spears, and helmets, and breastplates, and bows, and slings for stones.

fresh_translation: And he made in Ierousalem machines, invented by designer, to be on towers and corners, to cast arrows and large stones, and sound of their making was heard far away, because he was marvelously helped until he became strong.
brenton_translation: And he made in Jerusalem machines invented by a wise contriver, to be upon the towers and upon the corners, to cast darts and great stones: and the fame of their preparation was heard at a distance; for he was wonderfully helped, till he was strong.

fresh_translation: And when he became strong, his heart was lifted up to ruin, and he acted unjustly against Lord his God and entered into temple of Lord to burn incense on altar of incense.
brenton_translation: And when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction; and he transgressed against the Lord his God, and went into the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.

fresh_translation: And Azarias the priest entered after him and with him eighty priests of Lord, mighty sons.
brenton_translation: And there went in after him Azarias the priest, and with him eighty priests of the Lord, mighty men.

fresh_translation: And they stood against Ozia the king and said to him, Not for you, Ozia, to burn incense to Lord, but for priests, sons of Aaron, those sanctified to burn incense. Go out from sanctuary, because you rebelled from Lord, and this shall not be for glory to you from Lord God.
brenton_translation: And they withstood Ozias the king, and said to him, It is not for thee, Ozias, to burn incense to the Lord, but only for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to sacrifice: go forth of the sanctuary, for thou hast departed from the Lord; and this shall not be for glory to thee from the Lord God.

fresh_translation: And Ozias was angry, and in his hand was censer to burn incense in temple, and when he was angry with priests, leprosy rose in his forehead before priests in house of Lord above altar of incense.
brenton_translation: And Ozias was angry, and in his hand was the censer to burn incense in the temple: and when he was angry with the priests, then the leprosy rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the Lord, over the altar of incense.

fresh_translation: And chief priest and priests turned to him, and behold, he was leprous in forehead, and they hurried him out from there, and indeed he himself hurried to go out because Lord rebuked him.
brenton_translation: And Azarias the chief priest, and the other priests, turned to look at him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they got him hastily out thence, for he also hasted to go out, because the Lord had rebuked him.

fresh_translation: And Ozias the king was leprous until day of his death, and as leper he sat in house Aphphousōth, because he was cut off from house of Lord, and Iōatham his son was over kingdom, judging people of land.
brenton_translation: And Ozias the king was a leper to the day of his death, and he dwelt as a leper in a separate house; for he was cut off from the house of the Lord: and Joathan his son was set over his kingdom, judging the people of the land.

fresh_translation: And rest of matters of Oziou, first and last, were written by Iēssiou the prophet.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ozias, the first and the last, are written by Jessias the prophet.

fresh_translation: And Ozias slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in field of burial of kings, because they said he is leprous, and Iōatham his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ozias slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial place of the kings, for they said, He is a leper; and Joatham his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Iōatham was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Ierousa daughter of Sadok.
brenton_translation: Joatham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jerusa, daughter of Sadoc.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in sight of Lord according to all things which Oziou his father did, but he did not enter into temple of Lord, and still people were being corrupted.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Ozias did: but he went not into the temple of the Lord. And still the people corrupted themselves.

fresh_translation: He built high gate of house of Lord, and in wall of Ophal he built much.
brenton_translation: He built the high gate of the house of the Lord, and he built much in the wall of Opel.

fresh_translation: And he built cities in mountain of Iouda, and in forests dwellings and towers.
brenton_translation: In the mountain of Juda, and in the woods, he built both dwelling-places and towers.

fresh_translation: He fought against king of sons of Ammon and prevailed over him, and sons of Ammon gave him year by year one hundred talents of silver and ten thousand kors of wheat and ten thousand of barley. These king of Ammon brought him in first year and second and third.
brenton_translation: He fought against the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against him: and the children of Ammon gave him even annually a hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. These the king of the children of Ammon brought to him annually in the first and second and third years.

fresh_translation: And Iōatham grew strong, because he prepared his ways before Lord his God.
brenton_translation: Joatham grew strong, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And rest of matters of Iōatham and war and deeds of him, behold, written in book of kings of Iouda and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joatham, and his war, and his deeds, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

fresh_translation: And Iōatham slept with his fathers and was buried in City of Dauid, and Achaz his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Joatham slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Achaz his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Achaz was twenty years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Ierousalem, and he did not do upright in sight of Lord like Dauid his father.
brenton_translation: Achaz was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and he did not that which was right in the sight of the Lord, as David his father.

fresh_translation: And he walked according to ways of kings of Israel, and indeed he made carved things for their idols.
brenton_translation: But he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, for he made graven images.

fresh_translation: And he sacrificed in Gaibennom and brought his children through fire according to abominations of nations which Lord destroyed from before sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he sacrificed to their idols in the valley of Benennom, and passed his children through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he burned incense on high places and on roofs and under every grove tree.
brenton_translation: And he burnt incense upon the high places, and upon the roofs, and under every shady tree.

fresh_translation: And Lord his God gave him into hand of king of Syria, and he struck him and took from them many captives and brought them to Damascus. And indeed into hands of king of Israel he gave him, and he struck him with great blow.
brenton_translation: And the Lord his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and he smote him, and took captive of them a great band of prisoners, and carried him to Damascus. Also God delivered him into the hands of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

fresh_translation: And Phakee son of Romelia king of Israel killed in Iouda in one day one hundred twenty thousand mighty men of strength, because they forsook Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And Phakee the son of Romelias king of Israel, slew in Juda in one day a hundred and twenty thousand mighty men; because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And Ezechri, mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maasaias son of king and Esdrikam ruler of his house and Elkana successor of king.
brenton_translation: And Zechri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maasias the king's son, and Ezrican the chief of his house, and Elcana the king's deputy.
