fresh_translation: And sons of Israel took captive from their brothers three hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and they plundered much spoil from them and brought spoil to Samareia.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel took captive of their brethren three hundred thousand, women, and sons, and daughters, and they spoiled them of much property, and brought the spoils to Samaria.

fresh_translation: And there was prophet of Lord there, Odēd his name, and he went out to meet force coming to Samareia and said to them, Behold, wrath of Lord God of your fathers came upon Iouda and he gave them into your hands, and you killed among them in wrath reaching to heavens.
brenton_translation: And there was there a prophet of the Lord, his name was Oded: and he went out to meet the host that were coming to Samaria, and said to them, Behold, the wrath of the Lord God of your fathers is upon Juda, and he has delivered them into your hands, and ye have slain them in wrath, and it has reached even to heaven.

fresh_translation: And now sons of Iouda and Ierousalem you say to acquire as male and female servants. Behold, am I not with you to testify to Lord your God?
brenton_translation: And now ye talk of keeping the children of Juda and Jerusalem for servants and handmaidens. Lo, am I not with you to testify for the Lord your God?

fresh_translation: And now hear me and return captivity which you took captive from your brothers, because wrath of heat of Lord is upon you.
brenton_translation: And now hearken to me, and restore the prisoners of your brethren whom ye have taken: for the fierce anger of the Lord is upon you.

fresh_translation: And rulers from sons of Ephraim rose up: Oudia son of Iōanou and Barachias son of Mosolamōth and Ezechias son of Sellēm and Amasias son of Chodli, against those coming from war.
brenton_translation: And the chiefs of the sons of Ephraim rose up, Udias the son of Joanas, and Barachias the son of Mosolamoth, and Ezekias the son of Sellem, and Amasias the son of Eldai, against those that came from the war,

fresh_translation: And they said to them, You shall not bring captivity here to us, because you say to add upon our sins and upon our ignorance in sinning to Lord, because our sin is great, and heat of wrath of Lord is upon Israel.
brenton_translation: and said to them, Ye shall not bring in hither the prisoners to us, for whereas sin against the Lord is upon us, ye mean to add to our sins, and to our trespass: for our sin is great, and the fierce anger of the Lord is upon Israel.

fresh_translation: And warriors left captivity and spoils before rulers and all assembly.
brenton_translation: So the warriors left the prisoners and the spoils before the princes and all the congregation.

fresh_translation: And men called by name rose and took hold of captivity, and all naked they clothed from spoils and dressed them and shod them and gave them to eat and to be anointed, and took hold of every weak one on beasts of burden and set them in Iericho, city of palms, by their brothers, and returned to Samareia.
brenton_translation: And the men who were called by name rose up, and took hold of the prisoners, and clothed all the naked from the spoils, and gave them garments and shoes, and gave them food to eat, and oil to anoint themselves with, and they helped also every one that was weak with asses, and placed them in Jericho, the city of palm-trees, with their brethren; and they returned to Samaria.

fresh_translation: At that time Achaz sent to king of Assour to help him.
brenton_translation: At that time king Achaz sent to the king of Assyria to help him, and on this occasion,

fresh_translation: And also because Idoumaians attacked and struck in Iouda and took captivity.
brenton_translation: because the Idumæans had attacked him, and smitten Juda, and taken a number of prisoners.

fresh_translation: And Philistines attacked cities of plain and of south of Iouda and took Baithsamys and Ailōn and Gadērōth and Sokchō and its villages and Thamna and its villages and Gamzō and its villages, and they dwelt there.
brenton_translation: Also the Philistines had made an attack on the cities of the plain country, and the cities of the south of Juda, and taken Bæthsamys, and [the things in the house of the Lord, and the things in the house of the king, and of the princes: and they gave to the king] Ælon, and Galero, and Socho and her villages, and Thamna and her villages, and Gamzo and her villages: and they dwelt there.

fresh_translation: Because Lord humbled Iouda through Achaz king of Iouda, because he rebelled in rebellion from Lord.
brenton_translation: For the Lord humbled Juda because of Achaz king of Juda, because he grievously departed from the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Thaglathfellasar king of Assour came upon him and struck him.
brenton_translation: And there came against him Thalgaphellasar king of Assyria, and he afflicted him.

fresh_translation: And Achaz took what was in house of Lord and in house of king and of rulers and gave to king of Assour, and it was not for help to him.
brenton_translation: And Achaz took the things that were in the house of the Lord, and the things in the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave them to the king of Assyria: but he was no help to him,

fresh_translation: But when he was afflicted he added to rebel further from Lord, and king said,
brenton_translation: but only troubled him in his affliction: and he departed yet more from the Lord, and king Achaz said,

fresh_translation: I will seek gods of Damascus who strike me. And he said, Because gods of king of Syria strengthened them, therefore I will sacrifice to them and they will help me. But they became to him as stumbling-block and to all Israel.
brenton_translation: I will seek after the gods of Damascus that smite me. And he said, Forasmuch as the gods of the king of Syria themselves strengthen them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, and they will help me. But they became a stumbling-block to him, and to all Israel.

fresh_translation: And Achaz removed vessels of house of Lord and cut them up and shut doors of house of Lord and made for himself altars in every corner in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And Achaz removed the vessels of the house of the Lord, and cut them in pieces, and shut the doors of the house of the Lord, and made to himself altars in every corner in Jerusalem:

fresh_translation: And in every city of Iouda he made high places to burn incense to foreign gods, and they provoked Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: and in each several city in Juda he made high places to burn incense to strange gods: and they provoked the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And rest of his matters and his deeds, first and last, behold, written upon book of kings of Iouda and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of his acts, and his deeds, the first and the last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

fresh_translation: And Achaz slept with his fathers and was buried in City of Dauid, because they did not bring him into tombs of kings of Israel, and Ezekias his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Achaz slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David; for they did not bring him into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Ezekias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias reigned, being twenty-five years old, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Ierousalem, and name of his mother was Abba daughter of Zacharia.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias began to reign at the age of twenty-five years, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Abia, daughter of Zacharias.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in sight of Lord according to all things Dauid his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when he stood over his kingdom, in first month, he opened doors of house of Lord and repaired them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when he was established over his kingdom, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord, and repaired them.

fresh_translation: And he brought in priests and Levites and stationed them in east court.
brenton_translation: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and put them on the east side,

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Hear, Levites. Now sanctify yourselves and sanctify house of Lord God of your fathers and throw out uncleanness from holy place.
brenton_translation: and said to them, Hear, ye Levites: now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and cast out the impurity from the holy places.

fresh_translation: Because our fathers rebelled and did evil before Lord and forsook him and turned face away from tent of Lord and gave neck.
brenton_translation: For our fathers have revolted, and done that which was evil before the Lord our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their face from the tabernacle of the Lord, and have turned their back.

fresh_translation: And they shut doors of temple and quenched lamps and did not burn incense and did not offer whole burnt offerings in holy place to God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And they have shut up the doors of the temple, and put out the lamps, and have not burnt incense, and have not offered whole-burnt-offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And wrath of Lord was against Iouda and Ierousalem, and he gave them to terror and to desolation and to hissing, as you see with your eyes.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Juda and Jerusalem, and made them an astonishment, and a desolation, and a hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

fresh_translation: And behold, your fathers have fallen by sword and your sons and daughters and wives are in captivity in land not theirs, which even now is so.
brenton_translation: And, behold, your fathers have been smitten with the sword, and your sons and your daughters and your wives are in captivity in a land not their own, as it is even now.

fresh_translation: Upon these things now it is in my heart to make covenant of Lord God of Israel, and he will turn away heat of his wrath from us.
brenton_translation: Therefore it is now in my heart to make a covenant, a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that he may turn away his fierce wrath from us.

fresh_translation: And now do not fail, because Lord chose in you to stand before him to minister and to be ministers and burners of incense.
brenton_translation: And now be not wanting to your duty, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him to minister, and to be ministers and burners of incense to him.

fresh_translation: And Levites rose: Maath son of Amasi and Ioēl son of Azariou from sons of Kaath, and from sons of Merari, Kis son of Abdi and Azarias son of Iallēl, and from sons of Gedsōni, Iōa son of Zemmath and Iōdan son of Iōacha,
brenton_translation: Then the Levites rose up, Maath the son of Amasi, and Joel the son of Azarias, of the sons of Caath: and of the sons of Merari, Kis the son of Abdi, and Azarias the son of Ilaelel: and of the sons of Gedsoni, Jodaad the son of Zemmath, and Joadam: these were the sons of Joacha.

fresh_translation: and from sons of Elisaphan, Sambri and Iiēl, and from sons of Asaph, Zacharias and Maththanias,
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Elisaphan; Zambri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zacharias, and Matthanias:

fresh_translation: and from sons of Haiman, Iiēl and Semei, and from sons of Idithōn, Samaias and Oziēl.
brenton_translation: and of the sons of Æman; Jeiel, and Semei: and of the sons of Idithun; Samaias, and Oziel.

fresh_translation: And they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves according to command of king by ordinance of Lord to cleanse house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And they gathered their brethren, and they purified themselves according to the king's command by the order of the Lord, to purify the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And priests entered inside house of Lord to sanctify it and threw out every uncleanness found in house of Lord into court of house of Lord, and Levites received it to throw outside into torrent of Kedrōn.
brenton_translation: And the priests entered into the house of the Lord, to purify it, and they cast out all the uncleanness that was found in the house of the Lord, even into the court of the house of the Lord: and the Levites received it to cast into the brook of Kedron without.

fresh_translation: And they began on first day of new moon of first month to sanctify, and on eighth day of month they entered temple of Lord, and they sanctified house of Lord in eight days, and on sixteenth day of first month they finished.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias began on the first day, even on the new moon of the first month, to purify, and on the eighth day of the month they entered into the temple of the Lord: and they purified the house of the Lord in eight days; and on the thirteenth day of the first month they finished the work.

fresh_translation: And they went inside to Ezekias the king and said, We sanctified all things in house of Lord, altar of whole burnt offering and its vessels and table of presentation and its vessels.
brenton_translation: And they went in to king Ezekias, and said, We have purified all the things in the house of the Lord, the altar of whole-burnt-offering, and its vessels, and the table of shew-bread, and its vessels;

fresh_translation: And all vessels which king Achaz defiled in his kingdom in his rebellion we prepared and sanctified. Behold, they are before altar of Lord.
brenton_translation: and all the vessels which king Achaz polluted in his reign, in his apostacy, we have prepared and purified: behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias the king rose early and gathered rulers of city and went up to house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And king Ezekias rose early in the morning, and gathered the chief men of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they brought seven calves, seven rams, seven lambs, seven male goats of goats for sin, for kingdom and for holy things and for Israel, and he told sons of Aaron the priests to go up upon altar of Lord.
brenton_translation: And he brought seven calves, seven rams, seven lambs, seven kids of goats for a sin-offering, for the kingdom, and for the holy things, and for Israel: and he told the priests the sons of Aaron to go up to the altar of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they slaughtered calves, and priests received blood and poured it upon altar, and they slaughtered rams and poured blood upon altar, and they slaughtered lambs and poured blood to altar.
brenton_translation: And they slew the calves, and the priests received the blood, and poured it on the altar: and they slew the rams, and poured the blood upon the altar: also they slew the lambs, and poured the blood round the altar.

fresh_translation: And they brought male goats for sin before king and assembly, and they put hands upon them.
brenton_translation: And they brought the goats for a sin-offering before the king and the congregation; and laid their hands upon them.

fresh_translation: And priests slaughtered them and made atonement with their blood toward altar and made atonement for all Israel, because king said whole burnt offering and sin offerings were for all Israel.
brenton_translation: And the priests slew them, and offered their blood as a propitiation on the altar; and they made atonement for all Israel: for the king said, The whole-burnt-offering, and the sin-offerings are for all Israel.

fresh_translation: And he stationed Levites in house of Lord with cymbals and harps and lyres according to command of Dauid king and Gad the seer for king and Nathan the prophet, because ordinance was from Lord by hand of prophets.
brenton_translation: And he stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, and lutes, and harps, according to the commandment of king David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for by the commandment of the Lord the order was in the hand of the prophets.

fresh_translation: And Levites stood with instruments of Dauid, and priests with trumpets.
brenton_translation: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias said to offer whole burnt offering upon altar, and when they began to offer whole burnt offering, they began to sing to Lord, and trumpets with instruments of Dauid king of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias told them to offer up the whole-burnt-offering on the altar: and when they began to offer the whole-burnt-offering, they began to sing to the Lord, and the trumpets accompanied the instruments of David king of Israel.

fresh_translation: And all assembly worshiped, and singers were singing and trumpets sounding, until whole burnt offering was finished.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation worshipped, and the psalm-singers were singing, and the trumpets sounding, until the whole-burnt-sacrifice had been completely offered.

fresh_translation: And as they finished offering, king bent knee and all those found with him and worshiped.
brenton_translation: And when they had done offering it, the king and all that were present bowed, and worshipped.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias the king and rulers told Levites to hymn Lord in words of Dauid and Asaph the prophet, and they hymned with gladness and fell and worshiped.
brenton_translation: And king Ezekias and the princes told the Levites to sing hymns to the Lord in the words of David, and of Asaph the prophet: and they sang hymns with gladness, and fell down and worshipped.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias answered and said, Now you have filled your hands to Lord; come near and bring sacrifices and praises into house of Lord. And assembly brought sacrifices and praises into house of Lord, and everyone willing in heart brought whole burnt offerings.
brenton_translation: Then Ezekias answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves to the Lord, bring near and offer sacrifices of praise in the house of the Lord. And the congregation brought sacrifices and thank-offerings into the house of the Lord; and every one who was ready in his heart brought whole-burnt-offerings.

fresh_translation: And number of whole burnt offerings which assembly brought was seventy calves, one hundred rams, two hundred lambs. All these for whole burnt offering to Lord.
brenton_translation: And the number of the whole-burnt-offerings which the congregation brought, was seventy calves, a hundred rams, two hundred lambs: all these were for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And holy things were six hundred calves and three thousand sheep.
brenton_translation: And the consecrated calves were six hundred, and the sheep three thousand.

fresh_translation: But priests were few and were not able to flay whole burnt offerings, and their brothers Levites took hold with them until work was finished and until priests were sanctified, because Levites were more willing to sanctify than priests.
brenton_translation: But the priests were few, and could not flay the whole-burnt-offering, so their brethren the Levites helped them, until the work was finished, and until the priests had purified themselves: for the Levites more zealously purified themselves than the priests.

fresh_translation: And whole burnt offering was much, with fats of perfection of peace offering and libations of whole burnt offering, and work in house of Lord was set right.
brenton_translation: And the whole-burnt-offering was abundant, with the fat of the complete peace-offering, and the drink-offerings of the whole-burnt-sacrifice. So the service was established in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias and all people rejoiced because God prepared for people, because word came suddenly.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias and all the people rejoiced, because God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias sent over all Israel and Iouda and wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasse to come to house of Lord in Ierousalem to do passover to Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias sent to all Israel and Juda, and wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasse, that they should come into the house of the Lord to Jerusalem, to keep the passover to the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And king and rulers and all assembly in Ierousalem took counsel to do passover in second month.
brenton_translation: For the king, and the princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, designed to keep the passover in the second month.

fresh_translation: For they were not able to do it at that time, because priests had not sanctified themselves enough and people had not been gathered into Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: For they could not keep it at that time, because a sufficient number of priests had not purified themselves, and the people was not gathered to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And word pleased king and assembly.
brenton_translation: And the proposal pleased the king and the congregation.

fresh_translation: And they established word to make proclamation pass through all Israel from Bersabee to Dan, that they should come do passover to Lord God of Israel in Ierousalem, because multitude did not do it according to writing.
brenton_translation: And they established a decree that a proclamation should go through all Israel, from Bersabee to Dan, that they should come and keep the passover to the Lord God of Israel at Jerusalem: for the multitude had not done it lately according to the scripture.

fresh_translation: And runners went with letters from king and rulers through all Israel and Iouda according to command of king, saying, Sons of Israel, return to God of Abraam and Isaak and Israel, and he will return remnant, those left from hand of king of Assour.
brenton_translation: And the posts went with the letters from the king and the princes to all Israel and Juda, according to the command of the king, saying, Children of Israel, return to the Lord God of Abraam, and Isaac, and Israel, and bring back them that have escaped even those that were left of the hand of the king of Assyria.

fresh_translation: And do not become like your fathers and your brothers who rebelled from Lord God of their fathers, and he gave them to desolation, as you see.
brenton_translation: And be not as your fathers, and your brethren, who revolted from the Lord God of their fathers, and he gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

fresh_translation: And now do not harden your necks; give glory to Lord God, and enter into his sanctuary which he sanctified forever, and serve Lord your God, and he will turn away fury of wrath from you.
brenton_translation: And now harden not your hearts, as your fathers did: give glory to the Lord God, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified for ever: and serve the Lord your God, and he shall turn away his fierce anger from you.

fresh_translation: Because when you return to Lord, your brothers and your children shall be in mercies before all who took them captive and he will return to this land, because Lord our God is merciful and compassionate and will not turn away his face from us if we return to him.
brenton_translation: For when ye turn to the Lord, your brethren and your children shall be pitied before all that have carried them captives, and he will restore you to this land: for the Lord our God is merciful and pitiful, and will not turn away his face from you, if we return to him.

fresh_translation: And runners were passing through city from city in hill-country of Ephraim and Manasse and as far as Zabulon, and they became as laughingstock and mockery to them.
brenton_translation: So the posts went through from city to city in mount Ephraim, and Manasse, and as far as Zabulon: and they as it were laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

fresh_translation: But men from Aser and from Manasse and from Zabulon were put to shame and came to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: But the men of Aser, and some of Manasses and of Zabulon, were ashamed, and came to Jerusalem and Juda.

fresh_translation: And in Iouda hand of Lord came to give them one heart, to come do according to command of king and rulers in word of Lord.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the Lord was present to give them one heart to come, to do according to the commands of the king and of the princes, by the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And much people gathered into Ierousalem to do feast of unleavened bread in second month, very great assembly.
brenton_translation: And a great multitude were gathered to Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

fresh_translation: And they rose and took down altars in Ierousalem, and all things in which they burned incense to false gods they pulled down and threw into torrent of Kedrōn.
brenton_translation: And they arose, and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all on which they burnt incense to false gods they tore down and cast into the brook Kedron.

fresh_translation: And they sacrificed passover on fourteenth of second month, and priests and Levites were put to shame and sanctified themselves and brought whole burnt offerings into house of Lord.
brenton_translation: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites repented, and purified themselves, and brought whole-burnt-offerings into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they stood at their station according to their ordinance, according to command of Moyses man of God, and priests received blood from hand of Levites.
brenton_translation: And they stood at their post, according to their ordinance, according to the commandment of Moses the man of God: and the priests received the blood from the hand of the Levites.

fresh_translation: Because many of assembly had not sanctified themselves, and Levites were to sacrifice passover for everyone not able to sanctify to Lord.
brenton_translation: For a great part of the congregation was not sanctified; and the Levites were ready to kill the passover for every one who could not sanctify himself to the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because most of people from Ephraim and Manasse and Issachar and Zabulon had not sanctified themselves, but they ate passover contrary to writing, and Ezekias prayed for them, saying, Lord the good one make atonement concerning
brenton_translation: For the greatest part of the people of Ephraim, and Manasse, and Issachar, and Zabulon, had not purified themselves, but ate the passover contrary to the scripture. On this account also Ezekias prayed concerning them, saying,

fresh_translation: every heart directing itself to seek Lord God of their fathers and not according to purity of holy things.
brenton_translation: The good Lord be merciful with regard to every heart that sincerely seeks the Lord God of their fathers, and is not purified according to the purification of the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: And Lord listened to Ezekias and healed people.
brenton_translation: And the Lord hearkened to Ezekias, and healed the people.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel found in Ierousalem kept feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness, and priests and Levites hymning to Lord day by day with instruments to Lord.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel who were present in Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great joy; and they continued to sing hymns to the Lord daily, and the priests and the Levites played on instruments to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias spoke to every heart of Levites, those understanding good understanding for Lord, and they completed feast of unleavened bread seven days, sacrificing sacrifices of peace offering and giving thanks to Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias encouraged all the Levites, and those that had good understanding of the Lord: and they completely kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, offering peace-offerings, and confessing to the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And assembly took counsel together to do another seven days, and they did seven days with gladness.
brenton_translation: And the congregation purposed together to keep other seven days: and they kept seven days with gladness.

fresh_translation: Because Ezekias contributed to Iouda for assembly one thousand calves and seven thousand sheep, and rulers contributed to people one thousand calves and ten thousand sheep, and many holy things for priests.
brenton_translation: For Ezekias set apart for Juda, even for the congregation, a thousand calves and seven thousand sheep; and the princes set apart for the people a thousand calves and ten thousand sheep: and the holy things of the priests abundantly.

fresh_translation: And all assembly rejoiced, priests and Levites and all assembly from Iouda and those found from Israel and sojourners who came from land of Israel and those dwelling in Iouda.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation, the priests and the Levites, rejoiced, and all the congregation of Juda, and they that were present of Jerusalem, and the strangers that came from the land of Israel, and the dwellers in Juda.

fresh_translation: And there was great gladness in Ierousalem; from days of Salomon son of Dauid king of Israel there had not been such feast in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And there was great joy in Jerusalem: from the days of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not such a feast in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And priests the Levites rose and blessed people, and their voice was heard and their prayer came to his holy dwelling, to heaven.
brenton_translation: Then the priests the Levites rose up and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came into his holy dwelling-place, even into heaven.

fresh_translation: And when all these things were finished, all Israel found in cities of Iouda went out and broke pillars and cut down groves and pulled down high places and altars from all Iouda and Beniamin and from Ephraim and from Manasse until end, and all Israel returned each to his inheritance and to their cities.
brenton_translation: And when all these things were finished, all Israel that were found in the cities of Juda went out, and broke in pieces the pillars, and cut down the groves, and tore down the high places and the altars out of all Judea and Benjamin, also of Ephraim and Manasse, till they made an end: and all Israel returned, every one to his inheritance, and to their cities.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias appointed courses of priests and Levites, each course according to its own service, priests and Levites for whole burnt offering and peace offering and to praise and give thanks and minister at gates in courts of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites, and the courses of each one according to his ministry, to the priests and to the Levites, for the whole-burnt-offering, and for the peace-offering, and to praise, and to give thanks, and to minister in the gates and in the courts of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And portion of king from his possessions was for whole burnt offerings, morning and evening, and whole burnt offerings for Sabbaths and new moons and feasts written in law of Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king's proportion out of his substance was appointed for the whole-burnt-offerings, the morning and the evening one, and the whole-burnt-offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the feasts that were ordered in the law of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he told people dwelling in Ierousalem to give portion of priests and Levites so that they might grow strong in service of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And they told the people who dwelt in Jerusalem, to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be strong in the ministry of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And as word was commanded, sons of Israel increased firstfruits of grain and wine and oil and honey and every produce of field, and tithes of all things they brought in abundance.
brenton_translation: And as he gave the command, Israel brought abundantly first-fruits of corn, and wine, and oil, and honey, and every fruit of the field: and the children of Israel and Juda brought tithes of everything abundantly.

fresh_translation: Sons of Israel and Iouda and those dwelling in cities of Iouda also brought tithes of calves and sheep and tithes of goats and sanctified to Lord their God and brought in and set in heaps, heaps.
brenton_translation: And they that dwelt in the cities of Juda themselves also brought tithes of calves and sheep, and tithes of goats, and consecrated them to the Lord their God, and they brought them and laid them in heaps.

fresh_translation: In third month they began to lay foundation of heaps, and in seventh month they finished.
brenton_translation: In the third month the heaps began to be piled, and in the seventh month they were finished.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias and rulers came and saw heaps and blessed Lord and his people Israel.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias and the princes came and saw the heaps, and blessed the Lord, and his people Israel.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias inquired of priests and Levites concerning heaps.
brenton_translation: Then Ezekias enquired of the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

fresh_translation: And Azarias the chief priest for house of Sadok said to him, From when firstfruits began to be brought into house of Lord, we ate and drank and left over, because Lord blessed his people, and we still left over this great abundance.
brenton_translation: And Azarias the priest, the chief over the house of Sadoc, spoke to him, and said, From the time that the first-fruits began to be brought into the house of the Lord, we have eaten and drunk, and left even abundantly; for the Lord has blessed his people, and we have left to this amount.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias said to prepare storerooms in house of Lord, and they prepared them.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias told them yet farther to prepare chambers for the house of the Lord; and they prepared them,

fresh_translation: And they brought there firstfruits and tithes in faithfulness, and over them overseer was Chōnenias the Levite and Semei his brother second.
brenton_translation: and they brought thither the first-fruits and the tithes faithfully: and Chonenias the Levite was superintendent over them, and Semei his brother was next.

fresh_translation: And Iiēl and Ozazias and Naeth and Asaēl and Ierimōth and Iōzabath and Eliēl and Samachia and Maath and Banaias and his sons were set under Chōneniou and Semei his brother, as king Ezekias and Azarias leader of house of Lord commanded.
brenton_translation: And Jeiel, and Ozias, and Naeth, and Asael, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Samachia, and Maath, and Banaias, and his sons, were appointed by Chonenias and Semei his brother, as Ezekias the king, and Azarias who was over the house of the Lord commanded.

fresh_translation: And Korē son of Iemna the Levite, gatekeeper eastward, was over freewill gifts to give firstfruits to Lord and holy of holies.
brenton_translation: And Core, the son of Jemna the Levite, the porter eastward, was over the gifts, to distribute the first-fruits of the Lord, and the most holy things,

fresh_translation: By hand of Odom and Beniamin and Iēsous and Semei and Amarias and Sechonias, by hand of priests in faithfulness, to give to their brothers according to courses, to great and small.
brenton_translation: by the hand of Odom, and Benjamin, and Jesus, and Semei, and Amarias, and Sechonias, by the hand of the priests faithfully, to give to their brethren according to the courses, as well to great as small;

fresh_translation: Besides genealogy of males from three years and upward, to everyone entering house of Lord for matter of days day by day, for service in courses of their ordinance.
brenton_translation: besides the increase of males from three years old and upward, to every one entering into the house of the Lord, a portion according to a daily rate, for service in the daily courses of their order.

fresh_translation: This is reckoning of priests by houses of fathers, and Levites in their courses from twenty years and upward in their arrangement.
brenton_translation: This is the distribution of the priests according to the houses of their families; and the Levites in their daily courses from twenty years old and upward were in their order,

fresh_translation: In genealogies among all their offspring, their sons and daughters, for all multitude, because in faithfulness they sanctified holy thing.
brenton_translation: to assign stations for all the increase of their sons and their daughters, for the whole number: for they faithfully sanctified the holy place.

fresh_translation: For sons of Aaron, those serving as priests, and those from their cities in every city and city, men named by name to give portion to every male among priests and to every one counted among Levites.
brenton_translation: As for the sons of Aaron that executed the priests' office,—even those from their cities, the men in each several city who were named expressly,—were appointed to give a portion to every male among the priests, and to every one reckoned among the Levites.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias did thus in all Iouda and did good and upright before Lord his God.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias did so through all Juda, and did that which was good and right before the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And in every work which he began in service in house of Lord and in law and in ordinances, he sought his God with all his soul and did it, and he prospered.
brenton_translation: And in every work which he began in service in the house of the Lord, and in the law, and in the ordinances, he sought his God with all his soul, and wrought, and prospered.

fresh_translation: And after these words and this faithfulness, Sennachērim king of Assyrians came, and he came against Iouda and encamped against fortified cities and said to seize them.
brenton_translation: And after these things and this faithful dealing, came Sennacherim king of the Assyrians, and he came to Juda, and encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to take them for himself.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias saw that Sennachērim had come and that his face was set to fight against Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias saw that Sennacherim was come, and that his face was set to fight against Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he took counsel with his elders and his mighty men to stop up waters of springs which were outside city, and they strengthened him.
brenton_translation: And he took counsel with his elders and his mighty men to stop the wells of water which were without the city: and they helped him.

fresh_translation: And he gathered much people and stopped up waters of springs and river dividing through city, saying, Lest king of Assour come and find much water and prevail.
brenton_translation: And he collected many people, and stopped the wells of water, and the river that flowed through the city, saying, Lest the king of Assyria come, and find much water, and strengthen himself.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias grew strong and built all wall that had been pulled down, and towers, and another outer wall, and strengthened supporting-wall of City of Dauid, and prepared many weapons.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias strengthened himself, and built all the wall that had been pulled down, and the towers, and another wall in front without, and fortified the strong place of the city of David, and prepared arms in abundance.

fresh_translation: And he set war-captains over people, and they were gathered to him in broad place of gate of valley, and he spoke to their heart, saying,
brenton_translation: And he appointed captains of war over the people, and they were gathered to meet him to the open place of the gate of the valley, and he encouraged them, saying,

fresh_translation: Be strong and act like men. Do not fear from face of king of Assour and from face of all nation with him, because more are with us than with him.
brenton_translation: Be strong and courageous, and fear not, neither be dismayed before the king of Assyria, and before all the nation that is with him: for there are more with us than with him.

fresh_translation: With him fleshly arms, but with us Lord our God, to save and to fight our battle. And people grew bold upon words of Ezekias king of Iouda.
brenton_translation: With him are arms of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God to save us, and to fight our battle. And the people were encouraged at the words of Ezekias king of Juda.

fresh_translation: And after these things Sennachērim king of Assyrians sent his servants to Ierousalem, while he himself was at Lachis and all force with him, and he sent to Ezekias king of Iouda and to all Iouda in Ierousalem, saying,
brenton_translation: And afterward Sennacherim king of the Assyrians sent his servants to Jerusalem; and he went himself against Lachis, and all his army with him, and sent to Ezekias king of Juda, and to all Juda that was in Jerusalem, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus says Sennachērim king of Assyrians: Upon what do you trust and remain in siege in Ierousalem?
brenton_translation: Thus says Sennacherim king of the Assyrians, On what do ye trust, that ye will remain in the siege in Jerusalem?

fresh_translation: Does not Ezekias deceive you, to give you over to death and to famine and to thirst, saying, Lord our God will save us from hand of king of Assour?
brenton_translation: Does not Ezekias deceive you, to deliver you to death and famine and thirst, saying, The Lord our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

fresh_translation: Is not this Ezekias himself the one who removed his altars and his high places and said to Iouda and to those dwelling in Ierousalem, saying, Before this altar you shall bow down, and upon it you shall burn incense?
brenton_translation: Is not this Ezekias who has taken down his altars and his high places, and has spoken to Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before this altar, and burn incense upon it?

fresh_translation: Will you not know what I and my fathers did to all peoples of lands? Were gods of nations of all earth at all able to save their people from my hand?
brenton_translation: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done to all the nations of the countries? Could the gods of the nations of all the earth at all rescue their people out of my hand?

fresh_translation: Who among all gods of these nations whom my fathers destroyed was unable to save their people from my hand, that your God will be able to save you from my hand?
brenton_translation: Who is there among all the gods of those nations whom my fathers utterly destroyed, worthy of trust? Could they deliver their people out of my hand, that your God should deliver you out of my hand?

fresh_translation: Now let not Ezekias deceive you, and let him not make you trust according to these things, and do not believe him, because no god of any nation and kingdom was able to save his people from my hand and from hand of my fathers. So your God will certainly not save you from my hand.
brenton_translation: Now then, let not Ezekias deceive you, and let him not make you thus confident, and believe him not: for no god of any kingdom or nation is at all able to deliver his people out of my hand, or the hand of my fathers: therefore your God shall not deliver you out of my hand.

fresh_translation: And still his servants spoke against Lord God and against Ezekias his servant.
brenton_translation: And his servants continued to speak against the Lord God, and against his servant Ezekias.

fresh_translation: And he wrote letter to reproach Lord God of Israel and spoke concerning him, saying, As gods of nations of earth did not deliver their peoples from my hand, so God of Ezekias will certainly not deliver his people from my hand.
brenton_translation: And he wrote a letter to reproach the Lord God of Israel, and spoke concerning him, saying, As the gods of the nations of the earth have not delivered their people out of my hand, so the God of Ezekias shall by no means deliver his people out of my hand.

fresh_translation: And he cried with loud voice in Ioudaisti over people of Ierousalem on wall, to frighten them and throw them down, so that they might seize city.
brenton_translation: And he cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language to the people of Jerusalem on the wall, calling them to assist them, and pull down the walls, that they might take the city.

fresh_translation: And he spoke against God of Ierousalem as also against gods of peoples of earth, works of hands of men.
brenton_translation: And he spoke against the God of Jerusalem, even as against the gods of the nations of the earth, the works of the hands of men.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias king and Esaias son of Amōs prophet prayed about these things and cried out to heaven.
brenton_translation: And king Ezekias and Esaias the prophet the son of Amos prayed concerning these things, and they cried to heaven.

fresh_translation: And Lord sent angel and crushed every mighty warrior and ruler and commander in camp of king of Assour, and he returned with shame of face to his land, and he came into house of his god, and those coming from his own belly struck him down there with sword.
brenton_translation: And the Lord sent an angel, and he destroyed every mighty man and warrior, and leader and captain in the camp of the king of Assyria: and he returned with shame of face to his own land and came into the house of his god: and some of them that came out of his bowels slew him with the sword.

fresh_translation: And Lord saved Ezekias and those dwelling in Ierousalem from hand of Sennachērim king of Assour and from hand of all, and gave them rest round about.
brenton_translation: So the Lord delivered Ezekias and the dwellers in Jerusalem out of the hand of Sennacherim king of Assyria, and out of the hand of all his enemies, and gave them rest round about.

fresh_translation: And many brought gifts to Lord in Ierousalem, and offerings to Ezekias king of Iouda, and he was lifted up in eyes of all nations after these things.
brenton_translation: And many brought gifts to the Lord to Jerusalem, and presents to Ezekias king of Juda; and he was exalted in the eyes of all the nations after these things.

fresh_translation: In those days Ezekias became sick to point of death, and he prayed to Lord, and he heard him and gave him sign.
brenton_translation: In those days Ezekias was sick even to death, and prayed to the Lord: and he hearkened to him, and gave him a sign.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias did not repay according to recompense given him, but his heart was lifted up, and wrath came upon him and upon Iouda and Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: But Ezekias did not recompense the Lord according to the return which he made him, but his heart was lifted up: and wrath came upon him, and upon Juda and Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias was humbled from height of his heart, he and those dwelling in Ierousalem, and wrath of Lord did not come upon them in days of Ezekias.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias humbled himself after the exaltation of his heart, he and the dwellers in Jerusalem; and the wrath of the Lord did not come upon them in the days of Ezekias.

fresh_translation: And there came to Ezekias very much wealth and glory, and he made for himself treasuries of silver and gold and precious stone and for spices and armories and for desirable vessels,
brenton_translation: And Ezekias had wealth and very great glory: and he made for himself treasuries of gold, and silver, and precious stones, also for spices, and stores for arms, and for precious vessels;

fresh_translation: and store-cities for produce of grain and oil and wine, and stalls for every beast and folds for flocks.
brenton_translation: and cities for the produce of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls and mangers for every kind of cattle, and folds for flocks;

fresh_translation: And he built cities for himself, and possession of sheep and cattle in abundance, because Lord gave him very much possession.
brenton_translation: and cities which he built for himself, and store of sheep and oxen in abundance, for the Lord gave him a very great store.

fresh_translation: This Ezekias stopped up upper outlet of water of Giōn and directed them down toward south of City of Dauid, and Ezekias prospered in all his works.
brenton_translation: The same Ezekias stopped up the course of the water of Gion above, and brought the water down straight south of the city of David. And Ezekias prospered in all his works.

fresh_translation: And so, with ambassadors of rulers from Babylōnos who had been sent to him to inquire from him about wonder that happened upon earth, Lord left him to test him, to know things in his heart.
brenton_translation: Notwithstanding, in regard to the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who were sent to him to enquire of him concerning the prodigy which came upon the land, the Lord left him, to try him, to know what was in his heart.

fresh_translation: And rest of words of Ezekias and his mercy, behold, written in prophecy of Esaias son of Amōs the prophet and in book of kings of Iouda and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ezekias, and his kindness, behold, they are written in the prophecy of Esaias the son of Amos the prophet, and in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

fresh_translation: And Ezekias slept with his fathers, and they buried him in ascent of tombs of sons of Dauid, and all Iouda and those dwelling in Ierousalem gave him glory and honor in his death, and Manassēs his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias slept with his fathers, and they buried him in a high place among the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem gave him glory and honour at his death. And Manasses his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Manassēs was twelve years old when he reigned, and fifty-five years he reigned in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: Manasses was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before Lord, from all abominations of nations whom Lord destroyed from before sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord destroyed from before the face of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he turned again and rebuilt high places which Ezekias his father pulled down, and set up pillars to Baalim and made groves and bowed down to all army of heaven and served them.
brenton_translation: And he returned and built the high places, which his father Ezekias had pulled down, and set up images to Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

fresh_translation: And he built altars in house of Lord, of which Lord said, In Ierousalem my name will be forever.
brenton_translation: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, concerning which the Lord said, In Jerusalem shall be my name for ever.

fresh_translation: And he built altars to all army of heaven in two courts of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And he built altars to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he himself brought his children through fire in Gai-Banai-Ennom, and practiced divination and omens and sorcery, and made ventriloquists and enchanters. He multiplied doing evil before Lord, to provoke him.
brenton_translation: He also passed his children through the fire in the valley of Benennom; and he divined, and used auspices, and sorceries, and appointed those who had divining spirits, and enchanters, and wrought abundant wickedness before the Lord, to provoke him.

fresh_translation: And he set carved and molten image which he made in house of God, of which God said to Dauid and to Salōmōn his son, In this house and Ierousalem, which I chose from all tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.
brenton_translation: And he set the graven image, the molten statue, the idol which he made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name for ever;

fresh_translation: And I will not again add to move foot of Israel from land which I gave to their fathers, only if they keep to do all things which I commanded them, according to all law and ordinances and judgments by hand of Mōusēs.
brenton_translation: and I will not again remove the foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, if only they will take heed to do all things which I have commanded them, according to all the law and the ordinances and the judgments given by the hand of Moses.

fresh_translation: And Manassēs led Iouda and those dwelling in Ierousalem astray, to do evil beyond all nations which Lord removed from before sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: So Manasses led astray Juda and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to do evil beyond all the nations which the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Lord spoke against Manassēs and against his people, and they did not listen.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Manasses, and to his people: but they hearkened not.

fresh_translation: And Lord brought upon them commanders of force of king of Assour, and they seized Manassēs in bonds and bound him in fetters and brought him to Babylōn.
brenton_translation: And the Lord brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, and they took Manasses in bonds, and bound him in fetters, and brought him to Babylon.

fresh_translation: And when he was afflicted, he sought face of Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before God of his fathers.
brenton_translation: And when he was afflicted, he sought the face of the Lord his God, and was greatly humbled before the face of the God of his fathers;

fresh_translation: And he prayed to him, and he heard him and heard his cry and restored him to Ierousalem, to his kingdom. And Manassēs knew that Lord, he is God.
brenton_translation: and he prayed to him: and he hearkened to him, and listened to his cry, and brought him back to Jerusalem to his kingdom: and Manasses knew that the Lord he is God.

fresh_translation: And after these things he built wall outside City of Dauid from west toward Giōn in ravine and at those going out of gate round about and to Ophal, and he raised it very high, and set commanders of force in all fortified cities in Iouda.
brenton_translation: And afterward he built a wall without the city of David, from the southwest southward in the valleys and at the entrance through the fish-gate, as men go out by the gate round about, even as far as Opel; and he raised it much, and set captains of the host in all the fortified cities in Juda.

fresh_translation: And he removed foreign gods and carved thing from house of Lord, and all altars which he built on mountain of house of Lord and in Ierousalem, and he threw them outside city.
brenton_translation: And he removed the strange gods and the graven image out of the house of the Lord, and all the altars which he had built in the mount of the house of the Lord, and in Jerusalem, and without the city.

fresh_translation: And he restored the altar of the Lord and sacrificed upon it a sacrifice of salvation and of praise, and told Iouda to serve the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he repaired the altar of the Lord, and offered upon it a sacrifice of peace-offering and thank-offering, and he told Juda to serve the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: Except that people still sacrificed on high places, only to Lord their God.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed on the high places, only to the Lord their God.

fresh_translation: And rest of words of Manassēs and his prayer to God and words of seers speaking to him in name of Lord God of Israel, behold, upon records.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Manasses, and his prayer to God, and the words of the seers that spoke to him in the name of the God of Israel,

fresh_translation: And his prayer and how he was heard, and all his sins and his rebellions and places on which he built high places and set up groves and carved things before he turned back, behold, written upon words of seers.
brenton_translation: behold, they are in the account of his prayer; and God hearkened to him. And all his sins, and his backslidings, and the spots on which he built the high places, and set there groves and graven images, before he repented, behold, they are written in the books of the seers.

fresh_translation: And Manassēs slept with his fathers, and they buried him in garden of his house, and Amōn his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Manasses slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the garden of his house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Amōn was twenty-two years old when he reigned, and two years he reigned in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before Lord as Manassēs his father did, and to all idols which Manassēs his father made Amōn sacrificed and served them.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasses did: and Amon sacrificed to all the idols which his father Manasses had made, and served them.

fresh_translation: And he did not humble himself before Lord as Manassēs his father humbled himself, because this Amōn multiplied trespass.
brenton_translation: And he was not humbled before the Lord as his father Manasses was humbled; for his son Amon abounded in transgression.

fresh_translation: And his servants attacked him and struck him in his house.
brenton_translation: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his house.

fresh_translation: And people of land struck those attacking king Amōn, and people of land made Iōsias his son king in his place.
brenton_translation: And the people of the land slew the men who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josias his son king in his stead.

fresh_translation: Iōsias was eight years old when he reigned, and thirty-one years he reigned in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: Josias was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did upright before Lord and walked in ways of Dauid his father and did not turn aside right or left.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of his father David, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

fresh_translation: And in eighth year of his kingdom, while he was still a young boy, he began to seek Lord God of Dauid his father. And in twelfth year of his kingdom he began to cleanse Iouda and Ierousalem from high places and groves and molten things.
brenton_translation: And in the eighth year of his reign, and he being yet a youth, he began to seek the Lord God of his father David: and in the twelfth year of his reign he began to purge Juda and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the ornaments for the altars, and the molten images.

fresh_translation: And they pulled down before his face altars of Baalim, and high places above them, and he cut down groves, and carved and molten things he crushed and ground small and threw on tombs of those sacrificing to them.
brenton_translation: And he pulled down the altars of Baalim that were before his face, and the high places that were above them; and he cut down the groves, and the graven images, and broke in pieces the molten images, and reduced them to powder, and cast it upon the surface of the tombs of those who had sacrificed to them.

fresh_translation: And bones of priests he burned upon altars, and he cleansed Iouda and Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon the altars, and purged Juda and Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And in cities of Ephraim and Manassē and Symeōn and Nephthali and in their places round about.
brenton_translation: And he did so in the cities of Manasse, and Ephraim, and Symeon, and Nephthali, and the places round about them.

fresh_translation: And he pulled down groves and altars, and idols he cut small, and all high places he cut down from all land of Israel, and he returned to Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And he pulled down the altars and the groves, and he cut the idols in small pieces, and cut off all the high places from all the land of Israel, and returned to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And in eighteenth year of his kingdom, after cleansing land and house, he sent Saphan son of Eselia and Maasian ruler of city and Iōach son of Iōachaz his recorder to strengthen house of Lord his God.
brenton_translation: And in the eighteenth year of his reign, after having cleansed the land, and the house, he sent Saphan the son of Ezelias, and Maasa prefect of the city, and Juach son of Joachaz his recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And they came to Chelkias the high priest and gave money brought into house of God, which Levites keeping gate gathered from hand of Manassē and Ephraim and of rulers and from all remnant in Israel and sons of Iouda and Beniamin and those dwelling in Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And they came to Chelcias the high priest, and gave the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites who kept the gate collected of the hand of Manasse and Ephraim, and of the princes, and of every one that was left in Israel, and of the children of Juda and Benjamin, and of the dwellers in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And they gave it into hand of workers, those appointed in house of Lord, and they gave it to those doing works, who were working in house of Lord, to repair and strengthen house.
brenton_translation: And they gave it into the hand of the workmen, who were appointed in the house of the Lord, and they gave it to the workmen who wrought in the house of the Lord, to repair and strengthen the house.

fresh_translation: And they gave to carpenters and builders to buy squared stones and timber for beams, to roof houses which kings of Iouda destroyed.
brenton_translation: They gave it also to the carpenters and builders, to buy squared stones, and timber for beams to cover the houses which the kings of Juda had destroyed.

fresh_translation: And men were faithfully upon works, and overseers over them were Ieth and Abdias the Levites from sons of Merari, and Zacharias and Mosollam from sons of Kaath, to oversee. And every Levite skilled in instruments of songs,
brenton_translation: And the men were faithfully engaged in the works: and over them were superintendents, Jeth and Abdias, Levites of the sons of Merari, and Zacharias and Mosollam, of the sons of Caath, appointed to oversee; and every Levite, and every one that understood how to play on musical instruments.

fresh_translation: and over burden bearers and over all those doing works, work by work. And from Levites were scribes and judges and gatekeepers.
brenton_translation: And overseers were over the burden-bearers, and over all the workmen in the respective works; and of the Levites were appointed scribes, and judges, and porters.

fresh_translation: And when they were bringing out money brought into house of Lord, Chelkias the priest found book of law of Lord by hand of Mōusēs.
brenton_translation: And when they brought forth the money that had been brought into the house of the Lord, Chelcias the priest found a book of the law of the Lord given by the hand of Moses.

fresh_translation: And Chelkias answered and said to Saphan the scribe, I found book of law in house of Lord. And Chelkias gave book to Saphan.
brenton_translation: And Chelcias answered and said to Saphan the scribe, I have found a book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Chelcias gave the book to Saphan.

fresh_translation: And Saphan brought book to king and further brought word back to king: All money placed in hand of your servants doing work,
brenton_translation: And Saphan brought in the book to the king, and moreover gave an account to the king, saying, This is all the money given into the hand of thy servants that work.

fresh_translation: they melted down money found in house of Lord and gave it into hand of overseers and into hand of those doing work.
brenton_translation: And they have collected the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and given it into the hand of the overseers, and into the hand of them that do the work.

fresh_translation: And Saphan the scribe reported to king, saying, Chelkias the priest gave me book. And Saphan read it before king.
brenton_translation: And Saphan the scribe brought word to the king, saying, Chelcias the priest has given me a book. And Saphan read it before the king.

fresh_translation: And it happened, when king heard words of law, he tore his garments.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the law, that he rent his garments.

fresh_translation: And king commanded Chelkias and Achikam son of Saphan and Abdōn son of Michaia and Saphan the scribe and Asaia servant of king, saying,
brenton_translation: And the king commanded Chelcias, and Achicam the son of Saphan, and Abdom the son of Michaias, and Saphan the scribe, and Asaia the servant of the king, saying,

fresh_translation: Go, seek Lord concerning me and concerning everyone left in Israel and in Iouda, concerning words of book found, because great wrath of Lord is kindled among us, because our fathers did not listen to words of Lord, to do according to all things written in this book.
brenton_translation: Go, enquire of the Lord for me, and for every one that is left in Israel and Juda, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord which has been kindled amongst us, because our fathers have not hearkened to the words of the Lord, to do according to all the things written in this book.

fresh_translation: And Chelkias and those whom king told went to Olda the prophetess, wife of Sellēm son of Thakouath son of Chelles, keeper of robes, and she dwelt in Ierousalem in Masena, and they spoke to her according to these things.
brenton_translation: And Chelcias went, and the others whom the king told, to Olda the prophetess, the wife of Sellem son of Thecoe, son of Aras, who kept the commandments; and she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter: and they spoke to her accordingly.

fresh_translation: And she said to them, Thus said Lord God of Israel: Say to man who sent you to me,
brenton_translation: And she said to them, Thus has the Lord God of Israel said, Tell the man who sent you to me,

fresh_translation: Thus says Lord: Behold, I bring evils upon this place, all words written in book read before king of Iouda,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I bring evil upon this place, even all the words that are written in the book that was read before the king of Juda:

fresh_translation: because they forsook me and burned incense to foreign gods, so that they might provoke me in all works of their hands. And my wrath has been kindled in this place and will not be quenched.
brenton_translation: because they have forsaken me, and burnt incense to strange gods, that they might provoke me by all the works of their hands; and my wrath is kindled against this place, and it shall not be quenched.

fresh_translation: And to king of Iouda who sent you to seek Lord, thus you shall say to him: Thus says Lord God of Israel, concerning words which you heard,
brenton_translation: And concerning the king of Juda, who sent you to seek the Lord,—thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, As for the words which thou hast heard,

fresh_translation: because your heart was turned, and you humbled yourself before me when you heard my words against this place and against those dwelling in it, and you humbled yourself before me and tore your garments and wept before me, I also heard, says Lord.
brenton_translation: forasmuch as thy heart was ashamed, and thou wast humbled before me when thou heardest my words against this place, and against the inhabitants of it, and thou wast humbled before me, and didst rend thy garments, and didst weep before me; I also have heard, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, I will add you to your fathers, and you shall be added to your tombs in peace, and your eyes will not see all evils which I am bringing upon this place and upon those dwelling in it. And they brought word back to king.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, and thine eyes shall not look upon all the evils which I am bringing upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of it. And they brought back word to the king.

fresh_translation: And king sent and gathered elders of Iouda and Ierousalem.
brenton_translation: And the king sent and gathered the elders of Juda and Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And king went up to house of Lord, and all Iouda and those dwelling in Ierousalem and priests and Levites and all people, from great to small, and he read in their ears all words of book of covenant found in house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, he and all Juda, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that were found in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And king stood upon pillar and made covenant before Lord, to walk before Lord, to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his ordinances with all heart and with all soul, words of covenant written upon this book.
brenton_translation: And the king stood at a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk before the Lord, to keep his commandments and testimonies, and his ordinances, with all his heart and with all his soul, so as to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

fresh_translation: And he made all found in Ierousalem and Beniamin stand to it, and those dwelling in Ierousalem made covenant in house of Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And he caused all that were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand; and the inhabitants of Jerusalem made a covenant in the house of the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And Iōsias removed all abominations from all land that belonged to sons of Israel and made all found in Ierousalem and in Israel serve Lord their God. All his days they did not turn away from behind Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And Josias removed all the abominations out of the whole land which belonged to the children of Israel, and caused all that were found in Jerusalem and in Israel, to serve the Lord their God all his days: he departed not from following the Lord God of his fathers.

fresh_translation: And Iōsias kept Passover to Lord his God, and they sacrificed Passover on fourteenth of first month.
brenton_translation: And Josias kept a passover to the Lord his God; and sacrificed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

fresh_translation: And he set priests in their charges and strengthened them for works of house of Lord.
brenton_translation: And he appointed the priests at their charges, and encouraged them for the services of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he said to Levites, mighty in all Israel, when they had sanctified themselves to Lord and placed holy ark in house which Salōmōn son of Dauid king of Israel built, King said, It is not for you to carry anything on shoulders. Now then minister to Lord your God and to his people Israel.
brenton_translation: And he told the Levites that were able to act in all Israel, that they should consecrate themselves to the Lord: and they put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built: and the king said, Ye must not carry anything on your shoulders: now then minister to the Lord your God, and to his people Israel.

fresh_translation: And prepare yourselves by houses of your fathers and by your courses, according to writing of Dauid king of Israel and by hand of Salōmōn his son.
brenton_translation: And prepare yourselves according to the houses of your families, and according to your daily courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and the order by the hand of his son Solomon.

fresh_translation: And stand in house according to divisions of houses of your fathers, for your brothers, sons of people, and share of father-house for Levites.
brenton_translation: And stand ye in the house according to the divisions of the houses of your families for your brethren the sons of the people; so also let there be for the Levites a division of the house of their family.

fresh_translation: And sacrifice Passover and prepare holy things for your brothers, to do according to word of Lord by hand of Mōusēs.
brenton_translation: And kill ye the passover, and prepare it for your brethren, to do according to the word of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.

fresh_translation: And Iōsias contributed to sons of people sheep and lambs and kids of goats, all for Passover, to all found, to number of thirty thousand, and three thousand calves; these were from king's possessions.
brenton_translation: And Josias gave as an offering to the children of the people, sheep, and lambs, and kids of the young of the goats, all for the passover, even for all that were found, in number amounting to thirty thousand, and three thousand calves, these were of the substance of the king.

fresh_translation: And his rulers contributed to people and to priests and Levites. Chelkias and Zacharias and Iiēl, rulers of house of God, gave to priests for Passover sheep and lambs and kids, two thousand six hundred, and calves three hundred.
brenton_translation: And his princes gave an offering to the people, and to the priests, and to the Levites: and Chelcias and Zacharias and Jeiel the chief men gave to the priests of the house of God, they even gave for the passover sheep, and lambs, and kids, two thousand six hundred, and three hundred calves.

fresh_translation: And Chōnenias and Banaias and Samaias and Nathanaēl his brother and Asabias and Iiēl and Iōzabad, rulers of Levites, contributed to Levites for Passover five thousand sheep and five hundred calves.
brenton_translation: And Chonenias, and Banæas, and Samæas, and Nathanael his brother, and Asabias, and Jeiel, and Jozabad, heads of the Levites, gave an offering to the Levites for the passover, of five thousand sheep and five hundred calves.

fresh_translation: And service was set right, and priests stood in their station and Levites in their divisions according to command of king.
brenton_translation: And the service was duly ordered, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their divisions, according to the command of the king.

fresh_translation: And they sacrificed Passover, and priests poured out blood from their hand, and Levites flayed them.
brenton_translation: And they slew the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hand, and the Levites flayed the victims.

fresh_translation: And they prepared whole burnt offering to give to them according to division by houses of fathers for sons of people, to bring to Lord, as written in book of Mōusēs, and thus till morning.
brenton_translation: And they prepared the whole-burnt-offering to give to them, according to the division by the houses of families, even to the sons of the people, to offer to the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses.

fresh_translation: And they roasted Passover in fire according to ordinance, and holy things they boiled in bronze pots and cauldrons, and it went well, and they ran to all sons of people.
brenton_translation: And thus they did till the morning. And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance; and boiled the holy pieces in copper vessels and caldrons, and the feast went on well, and they quickly served all the children of the people.

fresh_translation: And after preparing for themselves and for priests, because priests were in offering fats and whole burnt offerings until night, Levites prepared for themselves and for their brothers, sons of Aarōn.
brenton_translation: And after they had prepared for themselves and for the priests, for the priests were engaged in offering the whole-burnt-offerings and the fat until night, then the Levites prepared for themselves, and for their brethren the sons of Aaron.

fresh_translation: And singers sons of Asaph were at their station according to commands of Dauid and Asaph and Haiman and Idithōn prophets of king, and rulers and gatekeepers at gate and gate. There was no need for them to move from service of holy things, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Asaph the psalm-singers were at their post according to the commands of David, and Asaph, and Æman, and Idithom, the prophets of the king: also the chiefs and the porters of the several gates;—it was not for them to stir from the service of the holy things, for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

fresh_translation: And all service of Lord was set right and prepared on that day, to keep Passover and to offer whole burnt offerings upon altar of Lord according to command of king Iōsias.
brenton_translation: So all the service of the Lord was duly ordered and prepared in that day, for keeping the passover, and offering the whole-burnt-sacrifices on the altar of the Lord, according to the command of king Josias.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel found there kept Passover at that time and feast of unleavened bread seven days.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

fresh_translation: And no Passover like it came to be in Israel from days of Samouēl the prophet, and all kings of Israel did not keep such Passover as Iōsias kept, and priests and Levites and all Iouda and Israel found there and those dwelling in Ierousalem, to Lord.
