Appoint lawgiver over them, Lord; let nations know that they are men. Interlude.
Why, Lord, have you stood far off, overlooking in opportunities, in affliction?
When ungodly man acts proudly, poor man is set on fire; they are caught in schemes which they devise.
Because sinner is praised in desires of his soul, and unjust man is blessed.
Sinner provoked Lord; according to multitude of his anger he will not seek him. God is not before him.
His ways are profaned in every season; your judgments are taken away from before him. He will dominate all his enemies.
For he said in his heart, I will not be shaken from generation to generation, without evil.
His mouth is full of curse and bitterness and deceit; under his tongue are toil and pain.
He sits in ambush with rich men in hidden places to kill innocent man; his eyes look toward poor man.
He lies in ambush in hidden place like lion in its den, lying in ambush to seize poor man, to seize poor man by dragging him away.
In his snare he will humble him; he will crouch and fall when he dominates poor men.
For he said in his heart, God has forgotten; he turned away his face so as never to see.
Rise up, Lord God; let your hand be lifted high. Do not forget poor men.
For what reason did ungodly man provoke God? For he said in his heart, He will not seek out.
You see, because you observe toil and wrath, to hand them over into your hands. To you poor man is left; you were helper to orphan.
Break arm of sinner and evil man; his sin will be sought and by no means found because of it.
Lord will reign into age and into age of age; nations, you will perish from his land.
Desire of poor men Lord heard; to preparation of their heart your ear attended,
to judge orphan and lowly man, so that man upon earth may no longer add to acting great.
For end. Psalm of David. In Lord I trusted. How will you say to my soul, Migrate to mountains like sparrow?
Because behold, sinners stretched bow, prepared arrows in quiver, to shoot in darkness at upright ones in heart.
Because what you fitted together they tore down; but righteous man, what did he do?
Lord in his holy temple; Lord, his throne in heaven. His eyes look toward poor man; his eyelids examine sons of men.
Lord examines righteous man and ungodly man, but one loving injustice hates his own soul.
He will rain snares upon sinners, fire and sulfur and blast of storm, portion of their cup.
Because Lord is righteous and loved righteousnesses; his face saw uprightness.
For end. Concerning eighth. Psalm of David.
Save me, Lord, because holy man failed, because truths were diminished from sons of men.
Each spoke vain things to his neighbor; with deceitful lips, with heart and heart they spoke.
May Lord utterly destroy all deceitful lips and tongue speaking great things,
those saying, We will magnify our tongue; our lips are with us; who is lord over us?
Because of misery of poor men and groaning of needy men, now I will rise up, says Lord; I will set him in salvation; I will speak boldly in him.
Words of Lord are pure words, silver refined by fire, tested in earth, purified sevenfold.
You, Lord, will guard us and preserve us from this generation and into age.
Ungodly men walk around in circle; according to your height you made sons of men much observed.
For end. Psalm of David.
Until when, Lord, will you forget me to end? Until when will you turn your face from me?
Until when will I place counsels in my soul, pains in my heart by day? Until when will my enemy be lifted up over me?
Look, hear me, Lord my God. Enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep into death,
lest my enemy say, I prevailed against him. Those afflicting me will rejoice if I am shaken.
But I hoped in your mercy; my heart will rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to Lord who did good to me, and sing praise to name of Lord Most High.
For end. Psalm of David. Fool said in his heart, There is no God. They were corrupted and became abominable in pursuits; there is none doing kindness, there is not even one.
Lord looked down from heaven upon sons of men to see if there is one understanding or seeking God.

All turned aside; together they became useless. There is none doing kindness, there is not even one. Their throat open grave; with their tongues they dealt deceitfully; venom of asps under their lips; whose mouth is full of curse and bitterness; their feet sharp to pour out blood.
Will not all workers of lawlessness know, those eating my people as food of bread? They did not call upon Lord.
There they feared with fear where there was no fear, because God is in righteous generation.
You shamed counsel of poor man, because Lord is his hope.
Who will give from Sion salvation of Israel? When Lord turns back captivity of his people, let Iakōb rejoice and Israel be glad.
Psalm of David. Lord, who will sojourn in your tent, and who will camp on your holy mountain?
One walking blamelessly and working righteousness, speaking truth in his heart,
who did not deal deceitfully with his tongue, nor do evil to his neighbor, and did not take reproach against those near him.
Evildoer is despised before him, but those fearing Lord he glorifies; one swearing to his neighbor and not setting it aside,
his silver he did not give at interest, and did not take gifts against innocent men. One doing these things will not be shaken into age.
Inscription of David. Guard me, Lord, because upon you I hoped.
I said to Lord, You are my Lord, because you have no need of my good things.
To holy ones in his land he made all his wills wondrous in them.
Their weaknesses were multiplied; after these things they hastened. I will by no means gather their gatherings from bloods, nor by any means remember their names with my lips.
Lord, portion of my inheritance and of my cup, you are one restoring my inheritance to me.
Measuring lines fell to me among best things, and indeed my inheritance is best to me.
I will bless Lord who gave me understanding; and still, until night, my kidneys disciplined me.
I foresaw Lord before me through all things, because he is at my right hand so that I may not be shaken.
Because of this my heart was gladdened and my tongue rejoiced; and still my flesh will camp in hope,
because you will not forsake my soul to Hades, nor will you give your holy one to see corruption.
You made known to me ways of life; you will fill me with gladness with your face; delights at your right hand to end.
Prayer of David. Hear, Lord, my righteousness; attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer, not with deceitful lips.
Let my judgment come out from your face; let my eyes see straight things.
You tested my heart, visited by night, refined me, and injustice was not found in me.
So that my mouth might not speak works of men, because of words of your lips I kept hard ways.
Set right my steps in your tracks, so that my steps may not be shaken.
I cried out because you heard me, God. Incline your ear to me and hear my words.
Make your mercies wondrous, you saving those hoping upon you from those standing against your right hand.
Guard me as apple of eye; in shelter of your wings you will cover me
from face of ungodly men who distressed me. My enemies enclosed my soul.
Their fat they shut up; their mouth spoke arrogance.
Casting me out, now they encircled me; their eyes they set to turn aside into earth.
They took me up like lion ready for hunt and like lion-cub dwelling in hidden places.
Rise up, Lord; get before them and trip them up. Rescue my soul from ungodly men, your sword, from enemies of your hand,
Lord, from few men of earth divide them in their life; and with your hidden things their belly was filled. They were satisfied with sons and left remainders to their little ones.
But I in righteousness will appear before your face; I will be satisfied when your glory appears.
For end. To servant of Lord, David, what he spoke to Lord, words of this song, in day when Lord rescued him from hand of all his enemies and from hand of Saoul.
And he said, I will love you, Lord, my strength.
Lord my firm place and my refuge and my rescuer, my God my helper, and I will hope upon him, my defender and horn of my salvation, my supporter.
Praising, I will call upon Lord, and from my enemies I will be saved.
Pangs of death enclosed me, and torrents of lawlessness troubled me.
Pangs of Hades surrounded me; snares of death came before me.
And in my affliction I called upon Lord, and to my God I cried out. He heard my voice from his holy temple, and my cry before him will enter into his ears.
And earth was shaken and became trembling; foundations of mountains were troubled and shaken, because God was angered with them.
Smoke went up in his anger, and fire from his face flamed up; coals were kindled from him.
And he bent heaven and came down, and gloom under his feet.
And he mounted cheroub and flew; he flew upon wings of winds.
And he made darkness his hiding place; around him his tent, dark water in clouds of air.
From brightness before him clouds passed through, hail and coals of fire.
And Lord thundered from heaven, and Most High gave his voice.
And he sent out arrows and scattered them; he multiplied lightnings and threw them into confusion.
And fountains of waters were seen, and foundations of inhabited world were uncovered from your rebuke, Lord, from breath of spirit of your wrath.
He sent from on high and took me; he received me out of many waters.
He will rescue me from my strong enemies and from those hating me, because they were stronger than I.
They came before me in day of my affliction, and Lord became my support.
And he brought me out into broad place; he will rescue me because he desired me.
And Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, and according to purity of my hands he will repay me,
because I kept ways of Lord and did not act ungodly from my God.
Because all his judgments were before me, and his ordinances I did not turn away from me.
And I will be blameless with him, and guard myself from my lawlessness.
And Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to purity of my hands before his eyes.
With holy one you will be holy, and with innocent man you will be innocent.
And with chosen one you will be chosen, and with crooked one you will twist.
Because you will save humble people and humble eyes of proud men.
Because you will light my lamp, Lord; my God, you will light my darkness.
Because in you I will be rescued from trap, and in my God I will leap over wall.
My God, his way blameless; words of Lord refined by fire. He is defender of all hoping upon him.
Because who is God besides Lord, and who is God besides our God?
God who girds me with strength and set my way blameless,
fitting my feet like deer and setting me upon heights,
teaching my hands for war, and you made my arms bronze bow.
And you gave me defense of my salvation, and your right hand held me up, and your discipline set me straight to end, and this discipline of yours will teach me.
You widened my steps under me, and my tracks did not weaken.
I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until they fail.
I will crush them and they will not be able to stand; they will fall under my feet.
And you girded me with strength for war; you shackled under me all rising against me.
And my enemies you gave to me back, and those hating me you destroyed.
They cried out, and there was none saving, to Lord, and he did not hear them.
And I will pulverize them like dust before wind; like mud of streets I will smooth them down.
Rescue me from contradictions of people; you will set me as head of nations. People whom I did not know served me.
At hearing of ear they obeyed me; foreign sons lied to me.
Foreign sons grew old and limped from their paths.
Lord lives, and blessed my God, and let God of my salvation be exalted,
God giving vengeance to me and subjecting peoples under me,
my rescuer from angry enemies. From those rising against me you will lift me up; from unjust man you will rescue me.
Because of this I will confess to you among nations, Lord, and to your name I will sing praise,
magnifying salvations of his king and doing mercy to his Anointed, to David and to his seed into age.
For end. Psalm of David.
Heavens recount glory of God, and firmament announces making of his hands.
Day to day gushes word, and night to night announces knowledge.
There are no speeches nor words where their voices are not heard.
Into all earth their sound went out, and to ends of inhabited world their words. In sun he set his tent.
And he as bridegroom coming out of bridal chamber will rejoice like giant to run his course.
From edge of heaven is his going out, and his return to edge of heaven, and there is none who will hide from his heat.
Law of Lord blameless, turning souls back; testimony of Lord faithful, making little ones wise.
Ordinances of Lord straight, gladdening heart; command of Lord radiant, enlightening eyes.
Fear of Lord pure, remaining into age of age; judgments of Lord true, justified together.
More to be desired than gold and much precious stone, and sweeter than honey and honeycomb.
And indeed your servant guards them; in guarding them, much repayment.
Who will understand trespasses? From my hidden ones cleanse me,
and from strangers spare your servant. If they do not dominate me, then I will be blameless, and I will be cleansed from great sin.
And words of my mouth and meditation of my heart will be for favor before you through all things, Lord, my helper and my redeemer.
For end. Psalm of David.
May Lord hear you in day of affliction; may name of God of Iakōb defend you.
May he send you help from holy place, and from Sion may he support you.
May he remember all your sacrifice and let your whole burnt offering be fat. Interlude.
May he give you according to your heart and fulfill all your counsel.
We will rejoice in your salvation, and in name of our God we will be magnified. May Lord fulfill all your requests.
Now I knew that Lord saved his Anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven. Salvation of his right hand is in acts of power.
These in chariots and these in horses, but we in name of Lord our God will be magnified.
They were shackled and fell, but we rose and were set upright.
Lord, save your king, and hear us in whatever day we call upon you.
For end. Psalm of David.
Lord, in your strength king will be gladdened, and in your salvation he will greatly rejoice.
Desire of his soul you gave to him, and longing of his lips you did not deprive him of. Interlude.
Because you got before him with blessings of goodness; you set upon his head crown from precious stone.
He asked life from you, and you gave it to him, length of days into age of age.
Great his glory in your salvation; glory and magnificence you will place upon him.
Because you will give him blessing into age of age; you will gladden him with joy with your face.
Because king hopes upon Lord, and in mercy of Most High he will by no means be shaken.
May your hand be found by all your enemies; may your right hand find all hating you.
You will set them like furnace of fire in time of your face; Lord in his anger will trouble them, and fire will devour them.
Their fruit from earth you will destroy, and their seed from sons of men,
because they bent evils toward you; they devised counsel which they will not be able to establish.
Because you will set them as back in your remnants; you will prepare their face.
Be exalted, Lord, in your strength; we will sing and praise your mighty acts.
For end. Concerning morning help. Psalm of David.
God, my God, attend to me. Why did you forsake me? Far from my salvation are words of my trespasses.
My God, I will cry by day and you will not hear, and by night, and it is not folly to me.
But you dwell among holy ones, praise of Israel.
Upon you our fathers hoped; they hoped and you rescued them.
To you they cried and were saved; upon you they hoped and were not ashamed.
But I am worm and not man, reproach of man and despising of people.
All seeing me mocked me; they spoke with lips, they shook head,
He hoped upon Lord; let him rescue him, let him save him, because he wants him.
Because you are one drawing me out from womb, my hope from breasts of my mother.
Upon you I was cast from womb; from belly of my mother you are my God.
Do not stand far from me, because affliction is near, because there is no helper.
Many calves encircled me; fat bulls surrounded me.
They opened their mouth upon me like lion seizing and roaring.
Like water I was poured out, and all my bones were scattered; my heart became like wax melting in midst of my belly.
My strength dried up like potsherd, and my tongue was glued to my throat, and you brought me down into dust of death.
Because many dogs encircled me; gathering of evildoers surrounded me; they dug my hands and feet.
I counted all my bones, and they observed and looked on me.
They divided my garments among themselves, and cast lot upon my clothing.
But you, Lord, do not put my help far away; attend to my support.
Rescue my soul from sword, and my only one from hand of dog.
Save me from mouth of lion, and my humiliation from horns of unicorns.
I will recount your name to my brothers; in midst of assembly I will hymn you.
You fearing Lord, praise him; all seed of Iakōb, glorify him; let all seed of Israel fear him,
because he did not despise nor loathe petition of poor man, nor turn his face from me, and when I cried to him he heard me.
From you my praise in great assembly; my vows I will repay before those fearing him.
Poor men will eat and be filled, and those seeking him will praise Lord; their hearts will live into age of age.
All ends of earth will remember and turn to Lord, and all families of nations will worship before you.
Because kingdom belongs to Lord, and he rules nations.
All fat ones of earth ate and worshiped; before him all going down into earth will fall down, and my soul lives to him.
And my seed will serve him; coming generation will be announced to Lord.
And they will announce his righteousness to people being born, because Lord did it.
Psalm of David. Lord shepherds me, and nothing will fail me.
Into place of grass there he camped me; beside water of rest he nourished me.
He turned my soul back; he led me upon tracks of righteousness for sake of his name.
For even if I walk in midst of shadow of death, I will not fear evils, because you are with me; your rod and your staff, these comforted me.
You prepared table before me opposite those afflicting me; you anointed my head with oil, and your cup intoxicating like strongest wine.
And your mercy will pursue me all days of my life, and my dwelling in house of Lord to length of days.
Psalm of David. Of first of Sabbaths. Earth belongs to Lord and its fullness, inhabited world and all dwelling in it.
He founded it upon seas and prepared it upon rivers.
Who will go up to mountain of Lord, and who will stand in his holy place?
Innocent in hands and clean in heart, who did not take his soul upon vanity and did not swear in deceit to his neighbor.
This one will receive blessing from Lord and mercy from God his savior.
This is generation of those seeking him, seeking face of God of Iakōb. Interlude.
Lift up gates, your rulers, and be lifted up, everlasting gates, and king of glory will enter.
Who is this king of glory? Lord strong and mighty, Lord mighty in war.
Lift up gates, your rulers, and be lifted up, everlasting gates, and king of glory will enter.
Who is this king of glory? Lord of hosts, he is king of glory.
Psalm of David. To you, Lord, I lifted my soul, O my God.
Upon you I trusted; may I not be ashamed, nor let my enemies mock me.
For indeed all enduring you will by no means be ashamed; let all acting lawlessly for nothing be ashamed.
Your ways, Lord, make known to me, and your paths teach me.
Lead me upon your truth and teach me, because you are God my savior, and I endured you all day.
Remember your compassions, Lord, and your mercies, because they are from age.
Sins of my youth and my ignorances do not remember; according to your mercy remember me, because of your goodness, Lord.
Good and upright is Lord; because of this he will give law to sinners in way.
He will guide meek ones in judgment; he will teach meek ones his ways.
All ways of Lord are mercy and truth to those seeking out his covenant and his testimonies.
For sake of your name, Lord, you will be propitious to my sin, because it is great.
Who is man fearing Lord? He will give law to him in way which he chose.
His soul will lodge among good things, and his seed will inherit earth.
Lord is stronghold of those fearing him, and name of Lord belongs to those fearing him, and his covenant to show it to them.
My eyes are always toward Lord, because he will draw my feet out of snare.
Look upon me and have mercy on me, because I am only one and poor.
Afflictions of my heart were widened; out of my necessities bring me out.
See my humiliation and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
See my enemies, because they were multiplied and hated me with unjust hatred.
Guard my soul and rescue me; may I not be ashamed, because I hoped upon you.
Blameless and upright men clung to me, because I endured you, Lord.
Redeem, O God, Israel from all his afflictions.
Of David. Judge me, Lord, because I walked in my innocence, and hoping upon Lord I will by no means weaken.
Test me, Lord, and try me; refine my kidneys and my heart.
Because your mercy is before my eyes, and I was well-pleasing in your truth.
I did not sit with assembly of vanity, and with lawless men I will by no means enter.
I hated assembly of evildoers, and with ungodly men I will by no means sit.
I will wash my hands among innocent ones, and circle your altar, Lord,
to hear voice of praise and recount all your wondrous deeds.
Lord, I loved beauty of your house and place of tent of your glory.
Do not destroy my soul together with ungodly men, nor my life with men of bloods,
in whose hands are lawless acts, and their right hand was filled with gifts.
But I walked in my innocence; redeem me and have mercy on me.
For my foot stood in uprightness; in assemblies I will bless you, Lord.
Of David, before being anointed. The Lord is my illumination and my savior; whom shall I fear? The Lord is defender of my life; from whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers draw near upon me to eat my flesh, those afflicting me and my enemies, they weakened and fell.
If camp should line up against me, my heart will not fear. If war rise up against me, in this I hope.
One thing I asked from Lord; this I will seek out: to dwell me in house of Lord all days of my life, to behold delight of Lord and visit his temple.
Because he hid me in tent in day of my evils; he sheltered me in hidden place of his tent; on rock he lifted me up.
And now behold, he lifted my head over enemies around me. I went around and sacrificed in his tent sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and praise Lord.
Hear, Lord, my voice with which I cried out; have mercy on me and hear me.
To you my heart said, My face sought your face; your face, Lord, I will seek.
Do not turn your face from me, nor turn away in anger from your servant. Become my helper; do not cast me off and do not forsake me, God my savior.
Because my father and my mother forsook me, but Lord took me in.
Give me law, Lord, in your way, and lead me in straight path because of my enemies.
Do not hand me over to souls of those afflicting me, because unjust witnesses rose against me and injustice lied to itself.
I believe to see good things of Lord in land of living ones.
Endure Lord; act like man, and let your heart be strengthened, and endure Lord.
Of David. To you, Lord, I cried out. My God, do not be silent from me, lest if you be silent from me, I become like those going down into pit.
Hear voice of my petition when I beg to you, when I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
Do not drag my soul away with sinners, and do not destroy me together with those working injustice, those speaking peace with their neighbors while evils are in their hearts.
Give to them according to their works and according to evil of their pursuits; according to works of their hands give to them; repay to them their repayment.
Because they did not understand works of Lord and works of his hands, you will pull them down and by no means build them up.
Blessed Lord, because he heard voice of my petition.
Lord my helper and my defender; upon him my heart hoped and I was helped, and my flesh bloomed again, and by my will I will confess to him.
Lord is strength of his people, and defender of salvations of his Anointed is he.
Save your people and bless your inheritance, and shepherd them and lift them up until age.
Psalm of David. Of exiting tent. Bring to Lord, sons of God; bring to Lord sons of rams; bring to Lord glory and honor.
Bring to Lord glory to his name; worship Lord in his holy court.
Voice of Lord upon waters; God of glory thundered; Lord upon many waters.
Voice of Lord in strength; voice of Lord in magnificence.
Voice of Lord shattering cedars, and Lord will shatter cedars of Lebanon.
And he will pulverize them like calf, Lebanon, and the beloved one like son of unicorns.
Voice of Lord cutting through flame of fire.
Voice of Lord shaking wilderness, and Lord will shake wilderness of Kadēs.
Voice of Lord fitting deer and uncovering forests; and in his temple every one says, Glory.
Lord will dwell over flood, and Lord will sit king into age.
Lord will give strength to his people; Lord will bless his people in peace.
For end. Psalm, song of dedication of house, of David.
I will exalt you, Lord, because you took me up and did not gladden my enemies over me.
Lord my God, I cried to you and you healed me.
Lord, you brought up my soul from Hades; you saved me from those going down into pit.
Sing praise to Lord, his holy ones, and confess to remembrance of his holiness.
Because anger in his wrath and life in his will. At evening weeping will lodge, and by morning glad shouting.
But I said in my prosperity, I will by no means be shaken into age.
Lord, in your will you supplied strength to my beauty; but you turned your face away and I became troubled.
To you, Lord, I will cry, and to my God I will beg.
What profit in my blood, in my going down into corruption? Will dust confess to you or announce your truth?
Lord heard and had mercy on me; Lord became my helper.
You turned my mourning into dance for me; you tore my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
so that my glory might sing to you and by no means be pierced through. Lord my God, into age I will confess to you.
For end. Psalm of David, of ecstasy.
Upon you, Lord, I hoped; may I not be ashamed into age. In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me.
Incline your ear to me; hurry to deliver me. Become to me God defender and house of refuge to save me.
Because you are my strength and my refuge, and for sake of your name you will lead me and nourish me.
You will bring me out from this snare which they hid for me, because you are my defender.
Into your hands I will entrust my spirit. You redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.
You hated those keeping worthless vanities for nothing, but I hoped upon Lord.
I will rejoice and be glad in your mercy, because you looked upon my humiliation; you saved my soul from necessities.
And you did not shut me up into enemy hands; you set my feet in broad place.
Have mercy on me, Lord, because I am afflicted; my eye was troubled in anger, my soul and my belly.
Because my life failed in pain and my years in groanings; my strength weakened in poverty and my bones were troubled.
Beyond all my enemies I became reproach, and greatly to my neighbors, and fear to those known to me; those seeing me outside fled from me.
I was forgotten like dead man from heart; I became like ruined vessel.
Because I heard blame of many dwelling around, when they gathered together against me, they planned to take my soul.
But I hoped upon you, Lord; I said, You are my God.
My times in your hands. Rescue me from hand of my enemies and from those pursuing me.
Shine your face upon your servant; save me in your mercy.
Lord, may I not be ashamed, because I called upon you. Let ungodly men be ashamed and brought down into Hades.
Let deceitful lips become dumb, those speaking lawlessness against righteous man in pride and contempt.
How much the multitude of your goodness, Lord, which you hid for those fearing you; you worked it out for those hoping upon you before sons of men.
You will hide them in hidden place of your face from disturbance of men; you will shelter them in tent from contradiction of tongues.
Blessed Lord, because he made his mercy wondrous in city of enclosure.
But I said in my ecstasy, So then I am cast away from face of your eyes. Because of this you heard voice of my petition when I cried out to you.
Love Lord, all his holy ones, because Lord seeks truths and repays those doing pride beyond measure.
Act like men and let your heart be strengthened, all hoping upon Lord.
Of David. Of understanding. Blessed those whose lawless acts were forgiven and whose sins were covered.
Blessed man to whom Lord will by no means count sin, nor is deceit in his mouth.
Because I was silent, my bones grew old from my crying all day.
Because day and night your hand grew heavy upon me; I was turned into misery when thorn was fixed in. Interlude.
My sin I made known, and my lawlessness I did not cover. I said, I will confess against myself my lawlessness to Lord, and you forgave ungodliness of my sin. Interlude.
Because of this every holy one will pray to you in fitting season. Yet in flood of many waters they will not come near him.
You are my refuge from affliction surrounding me, my joy. Redeem me from those encircling me. Interlude.
I will make you understand and instruct you in this way which you will go; I will fix my eyes upon you.
Do not become like horse and mule, which have no understanding, in bridle and bit to clamp their jaws, of those not drawing near to you.
Many scourges belong to sinner, but mercy will encircle one hoping upon Lord.
Be glad in Lord and rejoice, righteous ones, and boast, all upright in heart.
Of David. Rejoice in Lord, righteous ones; praise is fitting for upright ones.
Confess to Lord with harp; with ten-stringed psaltery sing to him.
Sing to him new song; play well with shouting.
Because word of Lord straight, and all his works in faithfulness.
He loves mercy and judgment; earth full of mercy of Lord.
By word of Lord heavens were made firm, and by spirit of his mouth all their power.
Gathering waters of sea like wineskin, putting deeps in treasuries.
Let all earth fear Lord, and from him let all dwelling inhabited world be shaken,
because he said and they came to be; he commanded and they were created.
Lord scatters counsels of nations, sets aside reasonings of peoples, and sets aside counsels of rulers.
But counsel of Lord remains into age, reasonings of his heart from generation to generation.
Blessed nation whose God is Lord, people whom he chose for inheritance to himself.
From heaven Lord looked down; he saw all sons of men.
From his prepared dwelling he looked upon all dwelling earth,
he who formed their hearts one by one, he who understands all their works.
King is not saved by much power, and giant will not be saved by multitude of his strength.
Horse false thing for salvation, and in multitude of its power it will not be saved.
Behold, eyes of Lord upon those fearing him, those hoping upon his mercy,
to rescue their souls from death and nourish them in famine.
Our soul endures for Lord, because he is our helper and defender.
Because in him our heart will be gladdened, and in his holy name we hoped.
Let your mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we hoped upon you.
Of David, when he altered his face before Abimelech, and he released him and he went away.
I will bless Lord in every season; continually his praise in my mouth.
In Lord my soul will be praised; let meek hear and be glad.
Magnify Lord with me, and let us lift up his name together.
I sought out Lord, and he heard me, and rescued me from all my sojournings.
Draw near to him and be enlightened, and your faces will by no means be ashamed.
This poor man cried out, and Lord heard him and saved him from all his afflictions.
Angel of Lord will encamp around those fearing him and will rescue them.
Taste and see that Lord good; blessed man who hopes upon him.
Fear Lord, his holy ones, because there is no lack to those fearing him.
Rich men became poor and hungry, but those seeking Lord will not be diminished of any good thing. Interlude.
Come, children, hear me; fear of Lord I will teach you.
Who is man wanting life, loving days to see good things?
Stop your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
Eyes of Lord upon righteous ones and his ears toward their petition.
But face of Lord against those doing evils, to destroy their memorial from earth.
Righteous ones cried out and Lord heard them, and rescued them from all their afflictions.
Lord near to those crushed in heart, and he will save humble in spirit.
Many afflictions of righteous ones, and from all of them he will rescue them.
Lord guards all their bones; not one of them will be broken.
Death of sinners evil, and those hating righteous man will go astray.
Lord will redeem souls of his servants, and all hoping upon him will by no means go astray.
Of David. Judge, Lord, those doing me injustice; war against those warring against me.
Take hold of weapon and shield, and rise up for my help.
Pour out sword and shut off those opposite my pursuers; say to my soul, I am your salvation.
Let those seeking my soul be ashamed and put to shame; let those devising evils for me turn backward and be ashamed.
Let them become like chaff before wind, and angel of Lord afflicting them.
Let their way become darkness and slipperiness, and angel of Lord pursuing them.
Because without cause they hid for me destruction of their snare; in vain they reproached my soul.
Let snare come upon them which they do not know, and hunt which they hid catch them, and in that snare let them fall.
But my soul will rejoice in Lord, delighting in his salvation.
All my bones will say, Lord, who like you, rescuing poor man from hand of those stronger than he, and poor and needy from those plundering him?
Unjust witnesses rising up asked me things I did not know.
They repaid me evils for good things and childlessness to my soul.
But when they troubled me, I clothed myself in sackcloth and humbled my soul in fasting, and my prayer will return into my bosom.
Like neighbor, like our brother, so I was pleasing; like mourning and glooming, so I humbled myself.
And against me they rejoiced and gathered together; scourges gathered upon me and I did not know; they were torn apart and were not pierced through.
They tested me, mocked me with mocking, gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, when will you look? Restore my soul from their villainies, my only one from lions.
I will confess to you, Lord, in great assembly; among heavy people I will praise you.
Let those hating me unjustly not rejoice over me, those hating me without cause and winking with eyes,
because to me they spoke peaceful things, and in anger they devised deceits.
And they opened wide their mouth upon me; they said, Good, good, our eyes saw.
You saw, Lord; do not be silent. Lord, do not stand far from me.
Wake up, Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my case.
Judge me according to your righteousness, Lord my God, and let them not rejoice over me.
Let them not say in their hearts, Good, good, to our soul, nor say, We swallowed him up.
Let those rejoicing at my evils be ashamed and put to shame together; let those speaking great things against me be clothed with shame and embarrassment.
Let those wanting my righteousness rejoice and be glad, and let them always say, Let Lord be magnified, those wanting peace of his servant.
And my tongue will meditate your righteousness, all day your praise.
For end. To servant of Lord, David.
Lawless man says of sinning within himself, There is no fear of God before his eyes.
Because he dealt deceitfully before him, to find his lawlessness and hate it.
Words of his mouth lawlessness and deceit; he did not wish to understand so as to do good.
He devised lawlessness upon his bed; he stood upon every way not good, and he did not loathe evil.
Lord, in heaven your mercy and your truth up to clouds.
Your righteousness like mountains of God; your judgments great deep. Men and cattle you will save, Lord.
How you multiplied your mercy, God; but sons of men will hope in shelter of your wings.
They will be intoxicated from richness of your house, and you will give them drink from torrent of your delight.
Because with you spring of life; in your light we will see light.
Stretch out your mercy to those knowing you and your righteousness to upright in heart.
Let foot of pride not come to me, and hand of sinners not shake me.
There workers of lawlessness fell; they were thrust out and will not be able to stand.
Of David. Do not be jealous among evildoers, nor envy those doing lawlessness,
because like grass they will quickly dry up, and like green herbs they will quickly fall away.
Hope upon Lord and do kindness, and dwell in earth, and you will be shepherded upon its wealth.
Take delight in Lord, and he will give you requests of your heart.
Reveal your way to Lord and hope upon him, and he will do it.
And he will bring out your righteousness like light and your judgment like noonday.
Be subjected to Lord and entreat him. Do not be jealous in one prospering in his way, in man doing lawless things.
Cease from anger and leave wrath behind; do not be jealous so as to do evil.
Because evildoers will be utterly destroyed, but those enduring Lord, they will inherit earth.
And still a little, and sinner will by no means exist; and you will seek his place and by no means find it.
But meek ones will inherit earth and take delight in abundance of peace.
Sinner will watch righteous man and gnash his teeth upon him.
But Lord will laugh at him, because he foresees that his day will come.
Sinners drew sword and stretched their bow, to cast down poor and needy, to slaughter upright in heart.
Their sword may enter into their heart, and their bows may be broken.
Better little thing to righteous man than much wealth of sinners,
because arms of sinners will be broken, but Lord supports righteous ones.
Lord knows ways of blameless ones, and their inheritance will be into age.
They will not be ashamed in evil season, and in days of famine they will be filled.
Because sinners will perish, and enemies of Lord, when they are glorified and lifted up, failing away like smoke they failed away.
Sinner borrows and will not repay, but righteous man has compassion and gives.
Because those blessing him will inherit earth, but those cursing him will be utterly destroyed.
From Lord steps of man are directed straight, and he will desire his way.
When he falls, he will not be dashed down, because Lord supports his hand.
I became younger and indeed I grew old, and I did not see righteous man forsaken, nor his seed seeking breads.
All day he has mercy and lends, and his seed will be into blessing.
Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell into age of age,
because Lord loves judgment and will not forsake his holy ones. Into age they will be guarded, but lawless men will be driven out, and seed of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.
But righteous ones will inherit earth and dwell upon it into age of age.
Mouth of righteous man will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment.
Law of his God in his heart, and his steps will not be tripped up.
Sinner watches righteous man and seeks to put him to death.
But Lord will by no means forsake him into his hands, nor by any means condemn him when judgment comes to him.
Endure Lord and keep his way, and he will lift you up to inherit earth; when sinners are utterly destroyed you will see.
I saw ungodly man highly exalted and lifted up like cedars of Lebanon.
And I passed by, and behold, he was not; and I sought him, and his place was not found.
Guard innocence and see uprightness, because there is remnant for peaceful man.
But lawless men will be utterly destroyed together; remnants of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.
But salvation of righteous ones from Lord, and he is their defender in time of affliction.
And Lord will help them and rescue them and deliver them from sinners and save them, because they hoped upon him.
Psalm of David, for remembrance concerning Sabbath.
Lord, do not reprove me in your fury, nor discipline me in your anger,
because your arrows were fixed in me and you set your hand firmly upon me.
There is no healing in my flesh from face of your wrath; no peace to my bones from face of my sins.
Because my lawless acts rose above my head; like heavy burden they weighed heavily upon me.
My wounds stank and rotted from face of my foolishness.
I was miserable and bent down to end; all day mourning-faced I went about.
Because my loins were filled with mockings, and there is no healing in my flesh.
I was afflicted and humbled beyond measure; I roared from groaning of my heart.
Lord, all my desire before you, and my groaning was not hidden from you.
My heart was troubled; my strength forsook me, and light of my eyes, even this not with me.
My friends and my neighbors drew near opposite me and stood, and my near ones stood far off.
And those seeking my soul used violence, and those seeking my evils spoke vanities and meditated deceits all day.
But I like deaf man was not hearing, and like mute not opening his mouth.
And I became like man not hearing and not having reproofs in his mouth.
Because upon you, Lord, I hoped; you will hear, Lord my God.
Because I said, Lest my enemies rejoice over me, and when my feet are shaken they spoke great things against me.
Because I am ready for scourges, and my pain before me always.
Because my lawlessness I will announce, and I will be anxious concerning my sin.
But my enemies live and are stronger than I, and those hating me unjustly were multiplied.
Those repaying evil for good slandered me because I pursued righteousness and cast me away, beloved one, like dead man abhorred.
Do not forsake me, Lord my God; do not stand far from me.
Attend to my help, Lord of my salvation.
For end. To Idithoun. Song of David.
I said, I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue; I set guard for my mouth when sinner stood opposite me.
I became mute and humbled and was silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.
My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation fire will blaze; I spoke with my tongue,
Make known to me, Lord, my end and number of my days, what it is, that I may know what I lack.
Behold, you made my days old-span lengths, and my existence like nothing before you. Yet all things vanity, every living man. Interlude.
Surely man passes by in image; yet in vain they are troubled; he stores up and does not know for whom he will gather them.
And now what is my endurance? Is it not Lord? And my substance is from you.
From all my lawless acts rescue me; you gave me as reproach to fool.
I became mute and did not open my mouth, because you are one who made me.
Remove your scourges from me; from strength of your hand I failed away.
With reproofs over lawlessness you disciplined man and melted his soul like spider. Yet in vain every man is troubled. Interlude.
Hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my petition. Do not be silent at my tears, because I am sojourner with you and passing resident, like all my fathers.
Leave me, that I may be refreshed before I depart and no longer exist.
For end. Psalm of David.
Waiting, I waited for Lord, and he attended to me and heard my petition.
And he brought me up from pit of misery and from mud of mire and set my feet upon rock and straightened my steps.
And he threw into my mouth new song, hymn to our God. Many will see and fear and hope upon Lord.
Blessed man whose hope is name of Lord, and did not look toward vanities and false frenzies.
Many things you did, Lord my God, your wonders; and in your reasonings there is none who will be likened to you. I declared and spoke; they were multiplied beyond number.
Sacrifice and offering you did not want, but ears you fitted for me; whole burnt offering and concerning sin you did not ask.
Then I said, Behold, I came. In head-roll of book it is written concerning me.
To do your will, O my God, I wanted, and your law in midst of my belly.
I proclaimed righteousness in great assembly; behold, my lips I will by no means restrain. Lord, you knew.
Your righteousness I did not hide in my heart; your truth and your salvation I spoke; I did not hide your mercy and your truth from great gathering.
But you, Lord, do not keep your compassions far from me; your mercy and your truth always supported me.
Because evils without number enclosed me; my lawless acts overtook me and I was not able to look. They were multiplied beyond hairs of my head, and my heart forsook me.
Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, attend to help me.
Let those seeking my soul to take it away be ashamed and put to shame together; let those wanting evils for me turn backward and be put to shame.
Let those saying to me, Good, good, carry away at once their shame.
Let all seeking you rejoice and be glad upon you, Lord, and let those loving your salvation always say, Let Lord be magnified.
But I am poor and needy; Lord will care for me. My helper and my defender are you; my God, do not delay.
For end. Psalm of David.
Blessed one understanding concerning poor and needy man; in evil day Lord will rescue him.
Lord guard him and make him live and bless him in earth and not hand him over into hands of his enemy.
Lord help him upon bed of his pain; you turned all his bed in his sickness.
I said, Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, because I sinned against you.
My enemies spoke evils to me: When will he die and his name perish?
And if he entered to see, he spoke vain things; his heart gathered lawlessness to itself; he went outside and spoke.
Together all my enemies whispered against me; against me they reasoned evils for me:
They set lawless word against me: Will not one lying down add to rise again?
And indeed man of my peace, upon whom I hoped, one eating my breads, magnified heel-tripping against me.
But you, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.
In this I knew that you wanted me, because my enemy will by no means rejoice over me.
But of me, because of my innocence, you took hold and established me before you into age.
Blessed Lord God of Israel from age and into age. Let it be, let it be.
For end, for understanding, for sons of Korah.
As deer longs for springs of waters, so my soul longs for you, O God.
My soul thirsted for living God; when will I come and appear before face of God?
My tears became bread to me day and night, while they say to me each day, Where is your God?

These things I remembered, and I poured out my soul upon me, because I will pass through into place of wondrous tent, as far as house of God, with voice of exultation and confession, sound of festival-keepers.
Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.
Toward myself my soul was troubled; therefore I will remember you from land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from little mountain.
Abyss calls abyss at sound of your cataracts; all your surges and your waves passed over me.
By day Lord will command his mercy, and by night his song with me, prayer to God of my life.
I will say to God, my supporter, Why did you forget me? Why do I go gloomy when enemy afflicts me?
When my bones were crushed, those afflicting me reproached me, while they say to me each day, Where is your God?
Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.
Psalm of David. Judge me, O God, and judge my case from nation not holy; from unjust and deceitful man rescue me.
Because you are God, my strength. Why did you reject me? Why do I go gloomy when enemy afflicts me?
Send out your light and your truth; they guided me and brought me to your holy mountain and to your tabernacles.
And I will go in to altar of God, to God gladdening my youth; I will confess to you with harp, O God, my God.
Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.
For end, for sons of Korah, for understanding, psalm.
O God, with our ears we heard; our fathers told us work you worked in their days, in ancient days.
Your hand destroyed nations, and you planted them; you afflicted peoples and cast them out.
Because not by their sword did they inherit land, and their arm did not save them, but your right hand and your arm and light of your face, because you took pleasure in them.
You are same my king and my God, one commanding salvations of Jacob.
In you we will gore our enemies, and in your name we will despise those rising against us.
Because not in my bow will I hope, and my sword will not save me.
Because you saved us from those afflicting us, and those hating us you shamed.
In God we will boast whole day, and in your name we will confess forever. Interlude.
But now you rejected and shamed us, and you will not go out with our powers.
You turned us back before our enemies, and those hating us plundered for themselves.
You gave us like sheep for food, and among nations you scattered us.
You sold your people without price, and there was no multitude in their exchanges.
You made us reproach to our neighbors, mockery and derision to those around us.
You made us proverb among nations, shaking of head among peoples.
Whole day my shame before me, and shame of my face covered me,
from voice of reproacher and slanderer, from face of enemy and pursuer.
All these things came upon us, and we did not forget you, and we did not act unjustly in your covenant.
And our heart did not turn back, and you turned our paths aside from your way,
because you humbled us in place of affliction, and shadow of death covered us.
If we forgot name of our God and stretched out our hands to strange god,
will not God seek these things out? For he knows hidden things of heart.
Because for your sake we are put to death whole day; we were counted as sheep of slaughter.
Awake. Why do you sleep, Lord? Rise up and do not reject to end.
Why do you turn away your face, forgetting our poverty and our affliction?
Because our soul was humbled into dust; our belly clung to earth.
Rise up, Lord, help us, and redeem us for sake of your name.
For end, concerning those to be changed, for sons of Korah, for understanding, song concerning beloved.
My heart poured forth good word; I speak my works to king; my tongue reed of swift-writing scribe.
Beautiful in form beyond sons of men; grace was poured upon your lips; therefore God blessed you forever.
Gird your sword upon thigh, mighty one, in your beauty and your loveliness.
And draw, and prosper, and reign, because of truth and meekness and righteousness, and your right hand will guide you wondrously.
Your arrows sharpened, mighty one; peoples will fall under you, in heart of enemies of king.
Your throne, O God, forever and ever; rod of uprightness rod of your kingdom.
You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with oil of exultation beyond your companions.
Myrrh and stacte and cassia from your garments, from ivory palaces from which they gladdened you.
Daughters of kings in your honor; queen stood at your right hand, clothed in gold-woven garments, adorned with many colors.
Hear, daughter, and see, and incline your ear, and forget your people and house of your father,
because king desired your beauty, because he is your lord.
And daughters of Tyre will worship him with gifts; rich ones of people will entreat your face.
All glory of daughter of king within, clothed in golden fringes, adorned with many colors.
Virgins after her will be brought to king; her companions will be brought to you.
They will be brought in gladness and exultation; they will be led into temple of king.
In place of your fathers sons were born to you; you will appoint them rulers over all earth.
They will remember your name in every generation and generation; therefore peoples will confess to you forever, even forever and ever.
For end, for sons of Korah, concerning hidden things, psalm.
God ours refuge and strength, helper in afflictions that found us greatly.
Therefore we will not fear when earth is shaken and mountains are shifted into hearts of seas.
Their waters roared and were troubled; mountains were troubled by his might. Interlude.
Rushings of river gladden city of God; Most High sanctified his dwelling.
God in midst of her; she will not be shaken. God will help her toward morning.
Nations were troubled, kingdoms bowed; he gave his voice, earth was shaken.
Lord of hosts with us; our supporter God of Jacob. Interlude.
Come, see works of Lord, what wonders he set upon earth,
doing away wars to ends of earth. He will break bow and shatter weapon and burn shields in fire.
Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among nations, I will be exalted in earth.
Lord of hosts with us; our supporter God of Jacob.
For end, for sons of Korah, psalm.
All nations, clap hands; shout to God with voice of exultation.
Because Lord Most High fearful, great king over all earth.
He subjected peoples to us and nations under our feet.
He chose for us his inheritance, beauty of Jacob which he loved. Interlude.
God went up in shout, Lord in voice of trumpet.
Sing to our God, sing; sing to our king, sing.
Because God king of all earth, sing with understanding.
God reigned over nations; God sits upon his holy throne.
Rulers of peoples gathered with God of Abraham, because mighty ones of earth belong to God; they were greatly exalted.
Psalm of song for sons of Korah, second of Sabbath.
Great Lord and greatly praised in city of our God, his holy mountain,
well-rooted, joy of all earth. Mounts of Zion, sides of north, city of great king.
God in her citadels is known when he takes hold of her.
Because behold, kings gathered; they came together.
They, seeing thus, were astonished, were troubled, were shaken.
Trembling seized them there, pangs as of woman giving birth.
With violent wind you will shatter ships of Tarshish.
As we heard, so we saw in city of Lord of hosts, in city of our God; God founded her forever. Interlude.
We received, O God, your mercy in midst of your temple.
According to your name, O God, so also your praise to ends of earth; your right hand full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice; let daughters of Judah exult because of your judgments, Lord.
Encircle Zion and surround her; tell in her towers.
Set your hearts on her power and pass through her citadels, so that you may tell to another generation.
Because this is God, our God forever and ever; he will shepherd us forever.
For end, for sons of Korah, psalm.
Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all inhabiting world,
both earthborn and sons of men together, rich and poor.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and meditation of my heart understanding.
I will incline my ear into parable; I will open my riddle on harp.
Why do I fear in evil day? Lawlessness of my heel will surround me,
those trusting in their strength and boasting in abundance of their wealth.
Brother is not redeemed; will man redeem? He will not give to God his atonement,
even price of redemption of his soul,
and he labored forever, and he will live to end. He will not see corruption when he sees wise men dying.
Together fool and senseless will perish and leave their wealth to strangers.
And their graves their houses forever, their dwellings from generation to generation; they called their names upon their lands.
But man in honor did not understand; he was compared with mindless cattle and was made like them.
This way of theirs stumbling-block to them, and after these things they will delight in their mouth. Interlude.
Like sheep they were set in Hades; death will shepherd them, and upright ones will lord over them in morning, and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.
But God will redeem my soul from hand of Hades when he receives me. Interlude.
Do not fear when man becomes rich and glory of his house is multiplied,
because when he dies he will take nothing; his glory will not go down with him.
Because his soul in his life will be blessed; he will confess to you when you do good to him.
He will go in as far as generation of his fathers; forever he will not see light.
Man in honor did not understand; he was compared with mindless cattle and was made like them.
Psalm of Asaph. God of gods, Lord, spoke and called earth from rising of sun to its setting.
Out of Zion comeliness of his beauty; God will come openly.
Our God will come and will not keep silent; fire before him will burn, and around him storm exceedingly.
He will call heaven above and earth to judge his people.
Gather to him his holy ones, those making his covenant upon sacrifices.
And heavens will declare his righteousness, because God is judge. Interlude.
Hear, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, and I will testify to you: God, your God, am I.
Not concerning your sacrifices will I rebuke you, and your whole burnt offerings are before me continually.
I will not receive calves from your house, nor he-goats from your flocks,
because all wild animals of forest are mine, cattle on mountains and oxen.
I knew all birds of heaven, and beauty of field with me.
If I hunger, I will not tell you, because inhabited world is mine and its fullness.
Will I eat flesh of bulls, or drink blood of goats?
Sacrifice to God sacrifice of praise, and pay to Most High your vows.
And call upon me in day of affliction, and I will deliver you, and you will glorify me. Interlude.
But to sinner God said, Why do you recount my righteous acts and take up my covenant in your mouth,
but you hated instruction and cast my words behind you?
If you saw thief, you ran with him, and with adulterers you set your share.
Your mouth abounded in evil, and your tongue wove deceit.
Sitting, you spoke against your brother, and against son of your mother you set stumbling-block.
These things you did, and I kept silent. You supposed lawlessness, that I would be like you. I will rebuke you and set them before your face.
Understand these things, you forgetting God, lest he seize, and there be none rescuing.
Sacrifice of praise will glorify me, and there is way by which I will show him salvation of God.
For end. Psalm of David.
When Nathan the prophet came to him, when he went in to Bersabee.
Have mercy on me, O God, according to your great mercy, and according to multitude of your compassions blot out my lawlessness.
Wash me more and more from my lawlessness and cleanse me from my sin,
because I know my lawlessness, and my sin before me continually.
Against you only I sinned and did evil before you, so that you may be justified in your words and prevail when you are judged.
For behold, in lawlessnesses I was conceived, and in sins my mother conceived me.
For behold, you loved truth; hidden and secret things of your wisdom you showed me.
You will sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed; you will wash me, and beyond snow I will be whitened.
You will make me hear exultation and gladness; humbled bones will exult.
Turn your face away from my sins, and blot out all my lawlessnesses.
Create in me clean heart, O God, and renew right spirit in my inward parts.
Do not cast me away from your face, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
Restore to me exultation of your salvation, and strengthen me with guiding spirit.
I will teach lawless ones your ways, and ungodly ones will turn back to you.
Rescue me from bloodguilt, O God, God of my salvation; my tongue will exult in your righteousness.
Lord, you will open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
Because if you wanted sacrifice, I would give it; in whole burnt offerings you will not delight.
Sacrifice to God crushed spirit; crushed and humbled heart God will not despise.
Do good, Lord, in your good pleasure to Zion, and let walls of Jerusalem be built.
Then you will delight in sacrifice of righteousness, offering and whole burnt offerings; then they will offer calves upon your altar.
For end. For understanding. Of David.
When Doeg the Idumean came and told Saul and said to him, David came into house of Abimelech.
Why do you boast in evil, mighty one, in lawlessness whole day?
Your tongue devised injustice; like sharpened razor you worked deceit.
You loved evil beyond goodness, injustice beyond speaking righteousness. Interlude.
You loved all words of engulfing, deceitful tongue.
Therefore God will tear you down to end; may he pluck you out and remove you from tent, and your root from land of living. Interlude.
And righteous ones will see and fear, and over him they will laugh and say,
Behold man who did not make God his helper, but hoped in multitude of his wealth and was strengthened in his vanity.
But I like fruitful olive tree in house of God; I hoped in mercy of God forever and forever of forever.
I will confess to you forever, because you did it, and I will wait for your name, because good before your holy ones.
For end, concerning Maeleth. For understanding. Of David.
Fool said in his heart, There is no God. They were corrupted and became abominable in lawlessnesses; there is none doing good.
God looked down from heaven upon sons of men to see whether there is one understanding or seeking God.
All turned aside; together they became worthless; there is none doing good, there is not even one.
Will not all workers of lawlessness know, those eating my people as eating bread? They did not call upon God.
There they feared fear where fear was not, because God scattered bones of men-pleasers. They were shamed, because God despised them.
Who will give out of Zion salvation of Israel? When Lord turns back captivity of his people, Jacob will exult and Israel will rejoice.
For end, in hymns. For understanding. Of David.
When Ziphites came and said to Saul, Is not David hidden among us?
O God, in your name save me, and in your power judge me.
O God, hear my prayer; give ear to words of my mouth.
Because strangers rose up against me, and strong men sought my soul; they did not set God before them. Interlude.
For behold, God helps me, and Lord supporter of my soul.
He will turn evils back on my enemies; in your truth destroy them.
Willingly I will sacrifice to you; I will confess your name, Lord, because good,
because from every affliction he rescued me, and among my enemies my eye looked down.
For end, in hymns. For understanding. Of David.
Give ear, O God, to my prayer, and do not overlook my supplication.
Attend to me and hear me; I was grieved in my musing and was troubled
from voice of enemy and from affliction of sinner, because they bent lawlessness upon me and in wrath were enraged against me.
My heart was troubled in me, and dread of death fell upon me.
Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.
And I said, Who will give me wings like dove, and I will fly away and be at rest?
Behold, I went far away in fleeing and lodged in wilderness. Interlude.
I waited for one saving me from faintheartedness and storm.
Drown them, Lord, and divide their tongues, because I saw lawlessness and contradiction in city.
Day and night it will encircle her upon her walls; lawlessness and labor in midst of her,
and injustice. And usury and deceit did not fail from her squares.
Because if enemy reproached me, I would bear it; and if one hating me spoke great words against me, I would hide from him.
But you, man equal-souled, my guide and my acquaintance,
who together with me sweetened foods; in house of God we walked in concord.
Let death come upon them, and let them go down living to Hades, because evils in their dwellings, in midst of them.
But I cried to God, and Lord heard me.
Evening and morning and midday I will tell and declare, and he will hear my voice.
He will redeem my soul in peace from those drawing near to me, because among many they were with me.
God will hear and humble them, he who exists before ages. Interlude. Because there is no change for them, and they did not fear God.
He stretched out his hand in repaying; they profaned his covenant.
They were divided by wrath of his face, and his heart drew near. His words were softened beyond oil, and they are darts.
Cast your care upon Lord, and he will sustain you; he will not give shaking to righteous one forever.
But you, O God, will bring them down into pit of corruption; men of bloods and deceit will not halve their days, but I will hope upon you, Lord.
For end, concerning people removed far from holy places. Of David, for inscription, when Philistines seized him in Gath.
Have mercy on me, Lord, because man trampled me; whole day, warring, he afflicted me.
My enemies trampled me whole day, because many warring against me from height.
In day I fear, I will hope upon you.
In God I will praise my words; whole day in God I hoped; I will not fear what flesh will do to me.
Whole day they were abhorring my words; all their thoughts against me for evil.
They will dwell as strangers and hide themselves; they will watch my heel, just as they waited for my soul.
For sake of nothing will you save them? In wrath you will bring down peoples, O God.
My life I told to you; set my tears before you, as also in your promise.
My enemies will turn back in whatever day I call on you; behold, I knew that you are my God.
In God I will praise word; in Lord I will praise saying.
In God I hoped; I will not fear what man will do to me.
In me, O God, are vows; I will repay praises to you,
because you rescued my soul from death and my feet from slipping, so that I may be well-pleasing before God in light of living ones.
For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when he fled from face of Saul into cave.
Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, because my soul has trusted in you, and in shadow of your wings I will hope until lawlessness passes by.
I will cry to God Most High, to God who benefited me.
He sent from heaven and saved me; he gave reproach to those trampling me. Interlude. God sent his mercy and his truth.
And he rescued my soul from midst of lion-cubs. I slept troubled. Sons of men: their teeth weapon and arrows, and their tongue sharp sword.
Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all earth your glory.
They prepared snare for my feet and bent down my soul; they dug pit before my face and fell into it. Interlude.
Ready my heart, O God, ready my heart; I will sing and make melody.
Awake, my glory; awake, harp and lyre; I will awake at dawn.
I will confess to you among peoples, Lord; I will sing to you among nations.
Because your mercy was magnified unto heavens and your truth unto clouds.
Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all earth your glory.
For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription.
If truly indeed you speak righteousness, judge straight things, sons of men.
For even in heart you work lawlessnesses; in earth your hands weave together injustice.
Sinners were estranged from womb, they went astray from belly, they spoke lies.
Their fury according to likeness of serpent, like deaf asp stopping its ears,
which will not hear voice of charmers, of drug mixed by wise enchanter.
God shattered their teeth in their mouth; Lord crushed fangs of lions.
They will be despised like water passing by; he will bend his bow until they grow weak.
Like wax melting they will be done away; fire fell, and they did not see sun.
Before your thorns understand bramble, as living ones, as in wrath, he will swallow you up.
Righteous one will rejoice when he sees vengeance of ungodly; he will wash his hands in blood of sinner.
And man will say, Then there is fruit for righteous one; then there is God judging them in earth.
For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when Saul sent and watched his house to kill him.
Rescue me from my enemies, O God, and redeem me from those rising against me.
Deliver me from those working lawlessness, and save me from men of bloods.
Because behold, they hunted my soul; strong men attacked me, neither my lawlessness nor my sin, Lord.
Without lawlessness I ran and went straight; awake to meet me and see.
And you, Lord God of hosts, God of Israel, attend to visit all nations; do not pity all workers of lawlessness. Interlude.
They will return at evening and hunger like dog and encircle city.
Behold, they will utter with their mouth, and sword on their lips, because who heard?
But you, Lord, will laugh at them; you will despise all nations.
My strength, toward you I will keep watch, because God my supporter.
My God, his mercy will go before me; God will show me among my enemies.
Do not kill them, lest they forget my people. Scatter them in your power and bring them down, my defender, Lord.
Sin of their mouth, word of their lips. Let them be caught in their pride, and from curse and lie they will be proclaimed in endings.
In wrath of ending, and they will be no more; and they will know that God rules Jacob to ends of earth. Interlude.
They will return at evening and hunger like dog and encircle city.
They will be scattered to eat; if they are not filled, they will also grumble.
But I will sing of your power and exult in morning in your mercy, because you became my supporter and refuge in day of my affliction.
My helper, to you I will sing, because God my supporter, my God, my mercy.
For end, concerning those to be changed, yet for inscription, of David, for teaching.
When he burned Mesopotamia of Syria and Syria Soba, and Joab returned and struck valley of salt, twelve thousand.
O God, you rejected us and pulled us down; you were angry and had compassion on us.
You shook earth and troubled it; heal its fractures, because it was shaken.
You showed your people hard things; you made us drink wine of staggering.
You gave signal to those fearing you, to flee from face of bow. Interlude.
So that your beloved ones may be rescued, save with your right hand and hear me.
God spoke in his holy place: I will exult and divide Shechem, and valley of tents I will measure out.
Gilead mine and Manasseh mine, and Ephraim strength of my head, Judah my king.
Moab cauldron of my hope; upon Idumea I will stretch out my sandal; foreigners were subjected to me.
Who will bring me into fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Idumea?
Is it not you, O God, who rejected us? And God will not go out in our powers.
Give us help out of affliction, because salvation of man vain.
In God we will do mighty deed, and he will despise those afflicting us.
For end, in hymns. Of David.
Hear, O God, my supplication; attend to my prayer.
From ends of earth I cried to you when my heart grew faint; on rock you lifted me up.
You guided me, because you became my hope, tower of strength from face of enemy.
I will sojourn in your tent forever; I will be sheltered in cover of your wings. Interlude.
Because you, God, heard my vows; you gave inheritance to those fearing your name.
Days upon days of king you will add; his years until days of generation and generation.
He remains forever before God; his mercy and truth, who will seek out?
Thus I will sing to your name forever and forever, to pay my vows day from day.
For end, concerning Jeduthun. Psalm of David.
Will not my soul be subjected to God? For from him my salvation.
For he my God and my savior, my supporter; I will not be shaken much.
How long do you attack man? You all murder, like leaning wall and thrust fence.
Only my honor they planned to cast away; they ran in lie. With their mouth they blessed and with their heart they cursed. Interlude.
Only be subjected to God, my soul, because from him my endurance.
Because he my God and savior, my supporter; I will not be moved away.
Upon God my salvation and my glory, God of my help and my hope upon God.
Hope upon him, every assembly of people; pour out your hearts before him; God our helper. Interlude.
But vain sons of men, false sons of men, in balances to do injustice; they together from vanity.
Do not hope in injustice, and do not desire plunder; if wealth flows, do not set heart on it.
Once God spoke; these two things I heard:
because strength belongs to God, and to you, Lord, mercy, because you will repay each one according to his works.
Psalm of David, when he was in wilderness of Judea.
O God, my God, to you I rise early. My soul thirsted for you; how much my flesh also for you, in land desert and trackless and waterless.
Thus in holy place I appeared to you, to see your power and your glory.
Because your mercy better than lives; my lips will praise you.
Thus I will bless you in my life; in your name I will lift my hands.
Let my soul be filled as with fat and richness, and with lips of exultation my mouth will praise you.
If I remembered you upon my bed, at dawns I meditated on you.
Because you became my helper, and in shelter of your wings I will exult.
My soul clung after you; your right hand took hold of me.
But they in vain sought my soul; they will enter into lowest parts of earth.
They will be handed over into hands of sword; they will be portions of foxes.
But king will rejoice in God; everyone swearing by him will be praised, because mouth of those speaking unjust things was stopped.
For end. Psalm of David.
Hear, O God, my voice in my supplication; from fear of enemy rescue my soul.
You sheltered me from conspiracy of evil-doers, from multitude of workers of lawlessness,
who sharpened their tongues like sword, bent their bow, bitter thing,
to shoot blameless one in secret places. Suddenly they will shoot him and will not fear.
They strengthened for themselves evil word; they told of hiding snares. They said, Who will see them?
They searched out lawlessnesses; they failed, searching out searchings. Man will come near, and heart deep.
And God will be exalted; arrows of infants were their wounds.
And their tongues grew weak against them; all seeing them were troubled.
And every man feared, and they declared works of God and understood his deeds.
Righteous one will rejoice in Lord and hope upon him, and all straight in heart will be praised.
For end. Psalm of David. Song of Jeremiah and Ezekiel from word of the sojourning when they were about to go out.
Hymn fits you, O God, in Zion, and vow will be paid to you in Jerusalem.
Hear my prayer; to you all flesh will come.
Words of lawless men overpowered us, and our ungodlinesses you will propitiate.
Blessed one whom you chose and took to yourself; he will dwell in your courts. We will be filled with good things of your house; holy your temple, wondrous in righteousness.
Hear us, God our savior, hope of all ends of earth and of those far off in sea,
preparing mountains in his strength, girded about in dominion,
troubling depth of sea, sound of its waves. Nations will be troubled.
And those inhabiting ends will fear at your signs; goings out of morning and evening you will gladden.
You visited earth and made it drunk; you multiplied to enrich it. River of God was filled with waters; you prepared their food, because thus your preparation.
Make her furrows drunk; multiply her produce; in its drops that springing thing will rejoice.
You will bless crown of year of your goodness, and your plains will be filled with richness.
Beauties of wilderness will grow fat, and hills will gird themselves with exultation.
Rams of sheep clothed themselves, and valleys will multiply grain; they will cry out, yes, they will sing hymns.
For end. Song of psalm of resurrection. Shout to God, all earth.
Sing indeed to his name; give glory to his praise.
Say to God, How fearful your works. In multitude of your power your enemies will lie to you.
Let all earth worship you and sing to you; let them sing to your name. Interlude.
Come and see works of God, fearful in counsels beyond sons of men,
who turns sea into dry land; in river they will pass through on foot; there we will rejoice in him,
the one ruling in his dominion forever. His eyes look upon nations; those provoking must not exalt themselves. Interlude.
Bless our God, nations, and make voice of his praise heard,
who set my soul into life and did not give my feet to shaking.
Because you tested us, O God; you purified us as silver is purified.
You brought us into snare; you laid afflictions upon our back.
You made men ride upon our heads; we went through fire and water, and you brought us out into refreshment.
I will enter into your house with whole burnt offerings; I will pay you my vows,
which my lips uttered and my mouth spoke in my affliction.
Fattened whole burnt offerings I will offer to you with incense and rams; I will offer oxen with he-goats. Interlude.
Come, hear, and I will tell, all fearing God, whatever he did for my soul.
To him with my mouth I cried, and I exalted under my tongue.
If I saw injustice in my heart, let not Lord hear me.
Therefore God heard me; he attended to voice of my supplication.
Blessed God, who did not turn away my prayer and his mercy from me.
For end, in hymns. Psalm of song.
May God have compassion on us and bless us; may he make his face shine upon us. Interlude.
So as to know your way in earth, your salvation among all nations.
Let peoples confess to you, O God; let all peoples confess to you.
Let nations rejoice and exult, because you judge peoples in uprightness and will guide nations upon earth. Interlude.
Let peoples confess to you, O God; let all peoples confess to you.
Earth gave her fruit; may God, our God, bless us.
May God bless us, and let all ends of earth fear him.
For end. Of David. Psalm of song.
Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered, and let those hating him flee from before him.
As smoke fails, let them fail; as wax melts from face of fire, so let sinners perish from face of God.
But let righteous ones rejoice; let them exult before God; let them delight in gladness.
Sing to God, make melody to his name; make way for one riding upon westlands. Lord his name, and exult before him; they will be troubled from before his face,
father of orphans and judge of widows, God in his holy place.
God settles solitary ones in house, bringing out chained ones in manliness, likewise those provoking, those dwelling in tombs.
O God, when you go out before your people, when you pass through wilderness. Interlude.
Earth was shaken, for even heavens dripped from face of God, this Sinai, from face of God of Israel.
You will set apart willing rain, O God, for your inheritance; and it grew weak, but you restored it.
Your living creatures dwell in it; in your goodness you prepared for poor one, O God.
Lord will give word to those bringing good news with much power.
King of forces of beloved one, and in beauty of house to divide spoils.
If you sleep between the lots, wings of dove silvered, and her back parts in green sheen of gold. Interlude.
When heavenly one scatters kings upon her, they will be snow-white in Zalmon.
Mountain of God, rich mountain; curdled mountain, rich mountain.
Why do you suppose, curdled mountains, mountain in which God delighted to dwell? And indeed Lord will tabernacle to end.
Chariot of God ten-thousandfold, thousands prospering; Lord among them in Sinai, in holy place.
You went up on high, you led captivity captive; you received gifts in man, for even disobedient ones, for Lord God to dwell. Blessed.
Blessed Lord day by day; God of our salvations will make straight way for us. Interlude.
