Our God God of saving, and to Lord, Lord, exits of death.
But God will crush heads of his enemies, hairy crown of those going on in their trespasses.
Lord said, From Bashan I will turn back, I will turn back in depths of sea,
so that your foot may be dipped in blood, tongue of your dogs from enemies, from him.
Your goings were seen, O God, goings of my God, my king, in holy place.
Princes went before, close behind singers, in midst of young women beating tambourines.
In assemblies bless God, Lord, from springs of Israel.
There Benjamin, younger one, in ecstasy, princes of Judah, their leaders, princes of Zebulun, princes of Naphtali.
Command, O God, your strength; strengthen, O God, this which you worked for us.
From your temple over Jerusalem kings will bring gifts to you.
Rebuke beasts of reed, gathering of bulls among calves of peoples, so as not to shut out those tested by silver. Scatter nations wanting wars.
Envoys will come from Egypt; Ethiopia will hasten her hand to God.
Kingdoms of earth, sing to God; make melody to Lord. Interlude.
Sing to God, to one riding on heaven of heaven toward east; behold, he will give to his voice voice of power.
Give glory to God; over Israel his magnificence and his power in clouds.
Wonderful God in his holy ones; God of Israel, he will give power and strengthening to his people. Blessed God.
For end, concerning those to be changed. Of David.
Save me, O God, because waters came in as far as my soul.
I was stuck in mud of deep, and no standing-place; I came into depths of sea, and storm sank me.
I grew weary crying; my throat grew hoarse; my eyes failed from hoping upon my God.
Those hating me without cause multiplied beyond hairs of my head; my enemies, unjustly pursuing me, were strengthened. What I did not seize, then I was repaying.
O God, you knew my foolishness, and my trespasses were not hidden from you.
Let not those waiting for you be shamed because of me, Lord, Lord of hosts; let not those seeking you be disgraced because of me, God of Israel.
Because for your sake I bore reproach; shame covered my face.
I became estranged to my brothers and foreign to sons of my mother,
because zeal of your house consumed me, and reproaches of those reproaching you fell upon me.
And I bent my soul in fasting, and it became reproach to me.
And I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became proverb to them.
Those sitting in gate were talking against me, and those drinking wine were singing about me.
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Lord, at a time of good pleasure. O God, in the multitude of your mercy hear me in the truth of your salvation.
Save me from mire so that I may not be stuck; let me be delivered from those hating me and from depth of waters.
Let not storm of water sink me, nor let deep swallow me, nor let pit close its mouth over me.
Hear me, Lord, because your mercy kind; according to multitude of your compassions look upon me.
Do not turn your face away from your servant, because I am afflicted; quickly hear me.
Draw near to my soul and redeem it; because of my enemies rescue me.
For you know my reproach and my shame and my dishonor; before you all afflicting me.
My soul expected reproach and misery, and I waited for one grieving with me, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.
And they gave gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
Let their table become snare before them, and retribution and stumbling-block.
Let their eyes be darkened so as not to see, and bend down their back continually.
Pour out your wrath upon them, and let fury of your anger overtake them.
Let their homestead become desolate, and in their tents let there be none dwelling.
Because one you struck, they themselves pursued, and to pain of your wounded ones they added.
Add lawlessness upon their lawlessness, and let them not enter into your righteousness.
Let them be blotted out from book of living, and with righteous let them not be written.
But I poor and pained; salvation of your face, O God, took hold of me.
I will praise name of God with song; I will magnify him with praise.
And it will please God beyond young bull bringing forth horns and hoofs.
Let poor see and rejoice; seek God, and your soul will live.
Because Lord heard poor ones and did not despise his chained ones.
Let heavens and earth praise him, sea and all creeping things in them,
because God will save Zion and cities of Judah will be built, and they will dwell there and inherit her.
And seed of his servants will possess her, and those loving his name will dwell in her.
For end. Of David, for remembrance.
For Lord to save me. O God, attend to my help.
Let those seeking my soul be shamed and disgraced; let those wanting evils for me be turned back and shamed.
Let those saying to me, Good, good, be turned back immediately, being shamed.
Let all seeking you exult and rejoice in you, and let those loving your salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
But I poor and needy; O God, help me. My helper and deliverer you are, Lord; do not delay.
Of David, of sons of Jonadab, and of first captives. O God, on you I hoped; let me not be shamed forever.
In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me; incline your ear to me and save me.
Become to me God defender and fortified place to save me, because you my firm place and refuge.
My God, rescue me from hand of sinner, from hand of law-breaking and unjust man.
Because you my endurance, Lord, Lord, my hope from my youth.
On you I was supported from womb; from belly of my mother you my protector; in you my hymn continually.
I became like wonder to many, and you strong helper.
Let my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may hymn your glory, all day your magnificence.
Do not cast me away in time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
Because my enemies spoke against me, and those watching my soul took counsel together,
saying, God forsook him; pursue and seize him, because there is no rescuer.
O God, do not be far from me; my God, attend to my help.
Let those slandering my soul be shamed and fail; let those seeking evils for me be clothed with shame and dishonor.
But I will hope continually and will add upon all your praise.
My mouth will declare your righteousness, all day your salvation, because I did not know writings.
I will go in by dominion of Lord, Lord; I will remember your righteousness, yours alone.
You taught me, O God, from my youth, and until now I declare your wonders.
And until old age and gray hair, O God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to every coming generation, your dominion and your righteousness,
O God, unto heights, what great things you did; O God, who like you?
How many afflictions, many and evil, you showed me; and turning back, you made me live, and from depths of earth again you brought me up.
You multiplied your greatness, and turning back you comforted me, and from depths of earth again you brought me up.
And indeed I will confess to you with instrument of psalm your truth, O God; I will sing to you with lyre, Holy One of Israel.
My lips will exult when I sing to you, and my soul which you redeemed.
And still my tongue all day will meditate on your righteousness, when those seeking evils for me are shamed and disgraced.
Of Solomon. O God, give your judgment to king and your righteousness to son of king,
to judge your people in righteousness and your poor ones in judgment.
Let mountains take up peace for your people, and hills in righteousness.
He will judge poor ones of people and save sons of needy ones and humble slanderer.
And he will continue along with sun and before moon for generations of generations.
And he will come down like rain upon fleece and like drops dripping upon earth.
Righteousness will rise in his days and abundance of peace until moon is removed.
And he will rule from sea to sea and from river to ends of inhabited world.
Before him Ethiopians will fall, and his enemies will lick dust.
Kings of Tarshish and islands will bring gifts; kings of Arabians and Saba will bring presents.
And all kings will worship him; all nations will serve him.
Because he rescued poor man from hand of ruler and needy one to whom no helper existed.
He will spare poor and needy and save souls of needy ones.
From usury and from injustice he will redeem their souls, and their name precious before him.
And he will live, and from gold of Arabia it will be given to him, and they will pray concerning him continually; all day they will bless him.
There will be support in earth on tops of mountains; his fruit will be lifted above Lebanon, and they will flower from city like grass of earth.
Let his name be blessed forever; before sun his name remains, and in him all tribes of earth will be blessed; all nations will count him blessed.
Blessed Lord God, God of Israel, who alone does wonders.
And blessed name of his glory forever and forever of forever, and all earth will be filled with his glory. Amen, amen.
Hymns of David son of Jesse came to end.
Psalm of Asaph. How good God to Israel, to those straight in heart.
But as for me, my feet were almost shaken; my steps all but poured out.
Because I was jealous over lawless ones, seeing peace of sinners.
Because there is no relenting in their death and firmness in their scourge.
In labors of men they are not, and with men they will not be scourged.
Therefore pride took hold of them; they clothed themselves with their injustice and ungodliness.
Their injustice will go out as from fatness; they passed into purpose of heart.
They thought and spoke in evil, they spoke injustice on high.
They set their mouth into heaven, and their tongue passed through earth.
Therefore my people will return here, and full days will be found for them.
And they said, How did God know? And is there knowledge in Most High?
Behold, these sinners prosper forever and possessed wealth.
And I said, Then in vain I made my heart righteous and washed my hands among innocent ones.
And I became scourged whole day, and my reproof unto mornings.
If I said, I will tell thus, behold, against generation of your sons I acted treacherously.
And I undertook to know this; it is trouble before me,
until I enter into sanctuary of God and understand their last things.
Surely because of their deceits you set things for them; you cast them down in their being lifted up.
How they came to desolation suddenly; they failed, they perished because of their lawlessness.
Like dream of one waking, Lord, in your city you will despise their image.
Because my heart burned and my kidneys were altered,
and I, being despised, did not know; I became beastlike beside you.
And I continually with you; you held my right hand.
In your counsel you guided me, and with glory you received me.
For what exists for me in heaven? And besides you what did I desire upon earth?
My heart and my flesh failed; God of my heart and my portion, God forever.
Because behold, those distancing themselves from you will perish; you destroyed everyone prostituting himself away from you.
But for me, clinging to God good; to place hope in Lord, to declare all your praises in gates of daughter of Zion.
For understanding. Of Asaph. Why, O God, did you reject to end? Your anger burned against sheep of your pasture.
Remember your congregation which you acquired from beginning; you redeemed rod of your inheritance, this Mount Zion in which you dwelt.
Lift up your hands against their pride to end, against all evil enemy did in your holy places.
And those hating you boasted in midst of your feast; they set their signs as signs and did not know,
as at entrance above.
As in forest of woods with axes they cut down her doors together; with hatchet and stone-cutter tool they broke her down.
They burned your sanctuary with fire; to ground they profaned tabernacle of your name.
They said in their heart, their whole kin together, Come, let us burn all feasts of God from earth.
Our signs we did not see; there is no longer prophet, and he will not know us any longer.
How long, O God, will enemy reproach? Will adversary provoke your name to end?
Why do you turn away your hand and your right hand from midst of your bosom to end?
But God our king before age worked salvation in midst of earth.
You strengthened sea in your power; you crushed heads of dragons upon water.
You crushed heads of dragon; you gave him as food to Ethiopian peoples.
You split open springs and torrents; you dried up rivers of Etham.
Yours day and yours night; you prepared light and sun.
You made all boundaries of earth; summer and spring you formed them.
Remember this: enemy reproached Lord, and foolish people provoked your name.
Do not hand over to beasts soul confessing to you; souls of your poor ones do not forget to end.
Look upon your covenant, because dark places of earth were filled with houses of lawlessness.
Let humbled one not turn back shamed; poor and needy will praise your name.
Rise up, O God, judge your case; remember your reproaches from fool all day.
Do not forget voice of your suppliants; pride of those hating you went up continually toward you.
For end, do not destroy. Psalm of Asaph. Song.
We will confess to you, O God, we will confess, and we will call on your name.
I will tell all your wonders when I receive appointed time; I will judge uprightnesses.
Earth melted, and all inhabiting it; I strengthened its pillars. Interlude.
I said to law-breakers, Do not break law, and to sinners, Do not lift horn.
Do not raise your horn on high; do not speak injustice against God.
Because neither from exits nor from wests nor from desert mountains,
because God is judge; this one he humbles and this one he exalts.
Because cup in hand of Lord, of unmixed wine full of mixture, and he tilted from this into that, but its dregs were not emptied; all sinners of earth will drink.
But I will exult forever; I will sing to God of Jacob.
And all horns of sinners I will shatter, and horns of righteous one will be exalted.
For end, in hymns. Psalm of Asaph. Song against Assyrian.
In Judea God known; in Israel great his name.
And his place came to be in peace, and his dwelling-place in Zion.
There he crushed strengths of bows, weapon and sword and war. Interlude.
You shine wondrously from everlasting mountains.
All senseless in heart were troubled; they slept their sleep and found nothing, all men of wealth, in their hands.
From your rebuke, God of Jacob, riders of horses grew drowsy.
You fearful, and who will stand against you from then on, from your anger?
From heaven you made judgment heard; earth feared and was still,
when God rose to judgment, to save all meek of earth. Interlude.
Because thought of man will confess to you, and remnant of thought will celebrate feast to you.
Vow and pay to Lord your God; all around him will bring gifts
to one fearful and removing spirits of rulers, fearful beyond kings of earth.
For end, concerning Jeduthun. Of Asaph. Psalm.
My voice cried to Lord, my voice to God, and he attended to me.
In day of my affliction I sought God; my hands by night before him, and I was not deceived. My soul refused to be comforted.
I remembered God and was gladdened; I mused and my spirit grew fainthearted. Interlude.
My eyes seized first watches; I was troubled and did not speak.
I considered ancient days, and years of old I remembered and meditated.
By night with my heart I mused, and my spirit searched out.
Will Lord reject forever and add no more to take pleasure still?
Or will he cut off his mercy to end, from generation to generation?
Will God forget to show compassion, or will he hold back his compassions in his anger? Interlude.
And I said, Now I began; this change belongs to right hand of Most High.
I remembered works of Lord, because I will remember from beginning your wonders.
And I will meditate on all your works and muse on your practices.
O God, your way in holy place; what god great as our God?
You are God doing wonders; you made known your power among peoples.
With your arm you redeemed your people, sons of Jacob and Joseph. Interlude.
Waters saw you, O God; waters saw you and feared, and deeps were troubled, multitude of sound of waters.
Clouds gave voice, for your arrows pass through.
Voice of your thunder in wheel; your lightnings appeared to inhabited world; earth was shaken and became trembling.
In sea your way and your paths in many waters, and your footprints will not be known.
You guided your people like sheep by hand of Moses and Aaron.
For understanding. Of Asaph. Attend, my people, to my law; incline your ear to words of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter riddles from beginning,
things we heard and knew, and our fathers told us.
It was not hidden from their children, to another generation declaring praises of Lord and his powers and his wonders which he did.
And he raised testimony in Jacob and set law in Israel, things he commanded our fathers to make known to their sons,
so that another generation might know, sons being born, and rise and tell them to their sons,
so that they might place their hope upon God and not forget works of God and seek out his commandments,
so that they may not become like their fathers, generation crooked and provoking, generation which did not set its heart straight and whose spirit was not faithful with God.
Sons of Ephraim, stringing and shooting bows, turned back in day of war.
They did not keep covenant of God and did not want to walk in his law.
And they forgot his good deeds and his wonders which he showed them,
things he did wondrously before their fathers in land of Egypt, in plain of Tanis.
He split sea and led them through; he made waters stand like wineskin.
And he guided them in cloud by day and all night in light of fire.
He split rock in wilderness and gave them drink as from great deep.
And he brought water out from rock and brought waters down like rivers.
And they added still to sin against him; they provoked Most High in waterless place.
And they tested God in their hearts by asking foods for their souls.
And they spoke against God and said, Will God be able to prepare table in wilderness?
Since he struck rock and waters flowed and torrents overflowed, can he also give bread or prepare table for his people?
Therefore Lord heard and deferred, and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath rose upon Israel,
because they did not believe in God nor hope on his salvation.
And he commanded clouds above and opened doors of heaven,
and rained manna on them to eat and gave them bread of heaven.
Man ate bread of angels; he sent them provision unto fullness.
He lifted south wind from heaven and brought in by his dominion southwest wind.
And he rained flesh upon them like dust and winged birds like sand of seas.
And they fell into midst of their camp, around their tents.
And they ate and were filled exceedingly, and he brought them their desire.
They were not deprived of their desire; while their food was still in their mouth,
wrath of God rose upon them and killed among their fat ones and hamstrung chosen ones of Israel.
In all these things they still sinned and did not believe in his wonders.
And their days failed in vanity and their years in haste.
When he killed them, they sought him, and returned and rose early toward God.
And they remembered that God is their helper and God Most High their redeemer.
And they deceived him with their mouth and lied to him with their tongue.
But their heart was not straight with him, nor were they faithful in his covenant.
But he compassionate and will propitiate their sins and not destroy, and he will multiply turning away his wrath and will not kindle all his anger.
And he remembered that they are flesh, spirit going and not returning.
How often they provoked him in wilderness, angered him in waterless land.
And they turned and tested God and provoked Holy One of Israel.
They did not remember his hand, day when he redeemed them from hand of afflicter,
how he set his signs in Egypt and his wonders in plain of Tanis,
and turned their rivers into blood and their rainfalls so they might not drink.
He sent upon them dog-fly and it devoured them, and frog and it ruined them.
And he gave their fruit to mildew and their labors to locust.
He killed their vine with hail and their sycamores with frost.
And he handed over their cattle to hail and their possessions to fire.
He sent upon them wrath of his anger, anger and fury and affliction, dispatch by evil angels.
He made way for his anger; he did not spare their souls from death and enclosed their cattle in death.
And he struck every firstborn in Egypt, first fruits of their labors in tents of Ham.
And he lifted up his people like sheep and led them like flock in wilderness.
And he guided them in hope and they did not fear, and sea covered their enemies.
And he brought them into boundary of his sanctuary, this mountain which his right hand acquired.
And he cast out nations from before them and gave them inheritance by measuring line and made tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.
And they tested and provoked God Most High, and his testimonies they did not keep.
And they turned back and broke covenant just as their fathers, and were twisted into crooked bow.
And they angered him with their hills and with their carved images stirred him to jealousy.
God heard and disregarded and greatly despised Israel.
And he rejected tent of Shilom, his tabernacle where he dwelt among men.
And he gave their strength into captivity and their beauty into hand of enemy.
And he enclosed his people to sword and disregarded his inheritance.
Fire devoured their young men, and their virgins were not mourned.
Their priests fell by sword, and their widows will not be wept.
And Lord awoke like one sleeping, like mighty man sobered from wine.
And he struck his enemies backward; everlasting reproach he gave them.
And he rejected tent of Joseph, and tribe of Ephraim he did not choose.
And he chose tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
And he built his sanctuary like unicorns; on earth he founded it forever.
And he chose David his servant and took him up from flocks of sheep.
From behind nursing ones he took him to shepherd Jacob his people and Israel his inheritance.
And he shepherded them in innocence of his heart and guided them in understandings of his hands.
Psalm of Asaph. O God, nations came into your inheritance; they defiled your holy temple; they made Jerusalem into orchard-watch hut.
They set dead bodies of your servants as food to birds of heaven, flesh of your holy ones to beasts of earth.
They poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there was none burying.
We became reproach to our neighbors, mocking and derision to those around us.
How long, Lord? Will you be angry to end? Will your zeal burn like fire?
Pour out your anger upon nations not knowing you and upon kingdoms which did not call upon your name,
because they devoured Jacob and laid waste his place.
Do not remember against us ancient lawlessnesses; let your compassions quickly go before us, because we became very poor.
Help us, God our savior, for sake of glory of your name. Lord, rescue us and propitiate our sins for sake of your name.
Lest nations say, Where is their God? Let vengeance of blood of your servants poured out be known among nations before our eyes.
Let groaning of chained ones enter before you; according to greatness of your arm preserve sons of those put to death.
Repay to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they reproached you, Lord.
But we your people and sheep of your pasture will confess to you forever; from generation to generation we will declare your praise.
For end, concerning those to be changed, testimony of Asaph, psalm concerning Assyrian.
You shepherding Israel, attend; you leading Joseph like sheep, you sitting upon cherubim, show yourself.
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up your dominion and come to save us.
O God, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved.
Lord God of hosts, how long are you angry over prayer of your servant?
You feed us bread of tears and give us tears to drink in measure.
You set us for contradiction to our neighbors, and our enemies mocked us.
Lord God of hosts, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved. Interlude.
You transplanted vine out of Egypt; you cast out nations and planted her.
You made way before her and planted her roots, and land was filled.
Her shadow covered mountains, and her branches the cedars of God.
She stretched out her shoots unto sea and her offshoots unto river.
Why did you pull down her fence, and all passing by road gather from her?
Boar from forest ravaged her, and solitary wild beast fed on her.
God of hosts, turn now; look from heaven and see and visit this vine,
and restore what your right hand planted, and upon son of man whom you strengthened for yourself.
Burned with fire and dug up, they will perish from rebuke of your face.
Let your hand be upon man of your right hand and upon son of man whom you strengthened for yourself.
And we will never depart from you; you will make us live, and we will call upon your name.
Lord God of hosts, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved.
For end, concerning winepresses. Of Asaph. Psalm.
Exult in God our helper; shout to God of Jacob.
Take psalm and give tambourine, pleasant psaltery with lyre.
Blow trumpet at new moon, on notable day of our feast,
because ordinance for Israel it is and judgment for God of Jacob.
He set it as testimony in Joseph when he went out from land of Egypt; he heard language he did not know.
He removed his back from burdens; his hands served in basket.
In affliction you called on me, and I rescued you; I heard you in hidden place of storm; I tested you at water of contradiction. Interlude.
Hear, my people, and I will testify to you; Israel, if you would hear me,
there will not be in you recent god, nor will you worship strange god.
For I am Lord your God, who brought you up from land of Egypt; widen your mouth, and I will fill it.
And my people did not hear my voice, and Israel did not attend to me.
And I sent them according to practices of their hearts; they will walk in their practices.
If my people heard me, if Israel walked in my ways,
in nothing I would humble their enemies and against those afflicting them I would lay my hand.
Enemies of Lord lied to him, and their time will be forever.
And he fed them from fat of wheat, and from rock he satisfied them with honey.
Psalm of Asaph. God stood in gathering of gods, and in midst he judges gods.
How long will you judge injustice and take faces of sinners? Interlude.
Judge orphan and poor one; justify humble one and needy one.
Rescue needy one and poor one; deliver from hand of sinner.
They did not know nor understand; they walk in darkness; all foundations of earth will be shaken.
I said, You are gods, and all sons of Most High.
But you die like men and fall like one of rulers.
Rise up, O God, judge earth, because you will inherit among all nations.
Song of psalm of Asaph.
O God, who will be likened to you? Do not be silent nor be made gentle, O God.
Because behold, your enemies sounded out, and those hating you raised head.
Against your people they worked crafty counsel and took counsel against your holy ones.
They said, Come, and let us destroy them from nation, and name of Israel will not be remembered any longer.
Because they took counsel with one accord together; against you they arranged covenant:
tents of Idumeans and Ishmaelites, Moab and Hagarenes,
Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, foreigners with those dwelling in Tyre.
For Asshur also came along with them; they became support to sons of Lot. Interlude.
Do to them as to Midian and to Sisera, as to Jabin at torrent Kishon.
They were destroyed at Endor; they became like dung for earth.
Make their rulers like Oreb and Zeeb and Zebee and Salmana, all their rulers,
who said, Let us inherit sanctuary of God for ourselves.
My God, make them like wheel, like stubble before wind,
as fire kindles forest, as flame burns mountains,
so you will pursue them in your storm, and in your anger you will trouble them.
Fill their faces with dishonor, and they will seek your name, Lord.
Let them be shamed and troubled forever and ever, and let them be disgraced and perish.
And let them know that your name Lord, you alone Most High over all earth.
For end, concerning winepresses, for sons of Korah, psalm.
How beloved your tabernacles, Lord of hosts.
My soul longs and fails for courts of Lord; my heart and my flesh exulted in living God.
For even sparrow found house for itself, and turtledove nest for herself where she may place her nestlings: your altars, Lord of hosts, my king and my God.
Blessed those dwelling in your house; forever and ever they will praise you. Interlude.
Blessed man whose support is from you, Lord; ascents in his heart he arranged,
in valley of weeping, into place he appointed; for lawgiver will also give blessings.
They will go from strength to strength; God of gods will be seen in Zion.
Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Interlude.
Our defender, see, O God, and look upon face of your anointed.
Because one day in your courts better than thousands; I chose to be cast aside in house of God rather than dwell in tents of sinners.
Because the Lord God loves mercy and truth; the Lord will give grace and glory; he will not withhold good things from those walking in innocence.
Lord of hosts, blessed man hoping on you.
For end, for sons of Korah, psalm.
You took pleasure, Lord, in your land; you turned back captivity of Jacob.
You forgave lawlessnesses of your people; you covered all their sins. Interlude.
You stopped all your anger; you turned back from wrath of your anger.
Turn us back, God of our salvations, and turn your anger away from us.
Will you be angry with us forever, or stretch your anger from generation to generation?
O God, you, turning back, will make us live, and your people will rejoice in you.
Show us, Lord, your mercy, and give us your salvation.
I will hear what Lord God will speak in me, because he will speak peace upon his people and upon his holy ones and upon those turning heart toward him.
Surely his salvation near those fearing him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
Mercy and truth met together; righteousness and peace kissed.
Truth rose from earth, and righteousness looked down from heaven.
For Lord will give goodness, and our land will give its fruit.
Righteousness will go before him and set his footsteps in way.
Prayer of David. Incline your ear, Lord, and hear me, because I poor and needy.
Guard my soul, because I holy; save your servant, my God, hoping on you.
Have mercy on me, Lord, because to you I will cry whole day.
Gladden soul of your servant, because to you, Lord, I lifted my soul.
Because you, Lord, kind and gentle and rich in mercy to all calling on you.
Give ear, Lord, to my prayer and attend to voice of my supplication.
In day of my affliction I cried to you, because you heard me.
There is none like you among gods, Lord, and none according to your works.
All nations, as many as you made, will come and worship before you, Lord, and will glorify your name.
Because you great and doing wonders; you alone the great God.
Guide me, Lord, in your way, and I will walk in your truth; let my heart rejoice to fear your name.
I will confess to you, Lord my God, with whole heart, and I will glorify your name forever.
Because your mercy great upon me, and you rescued my soul from lowest Hades.
O God, lawless men rose against me, and gathering of strong men sought my soul, and they did not set you before them.
But you, Lord God, compassionate and merciful, long-suffering and rich in mercy and true.
Look upon me and have mercy on me; give your strength to your child and save son of your handmaid.
Do with me sign for good, and let those hating me see and be shamed, because you, Lord, helped me and comforted me.
For sons of Korah. Psalm of song. His foundations in holy mountains.
Lord loves gates of Zion above all tabernacles of Jacob.
Glorious things were spoken concerning you, city of God. Interlude.
I will remember Rahab and Babylon to those knowing me; behold, foreigners and Tyre and people of Ethiopians, these were born there.
Mother Zion, man will say, and man was born in her, and Most High himself founded her.
Lord will recount in writing of peoples and rulers, these who were born in her. Interlude.
As of all rejoicing ones, dwelling in you.
Song of psalm for sons of Korah, for end, concerning Maeleth, for answering, for understanding, of Heman the Israelite.
Lord God of my salvation, by day I cried and by night before you.
Let my prayer enter before you; incline your ear to my supplication, Lord.
Because my soul was filled with evils, and my life drew near to Hades.
I was counted with those going down into pit; I became like helpless man among dead, free,
like wounded ones cast down, sleeping in tomb, whom you no longer remembered and they were thrust away from your hand.
They set me in lowest pit, in dark places and in shadow of death.
Your wrath was fixed upon me, and all your surges you brought upon me. Interlude.
You removed my acquaintances from me; they made me abomination to themselves. I was handed over and did not go out.
My eyes grew weak from poverty; I cried to you, Lord, whole day; I spread out my hands to you.
Will you do wonders for dead, or will physicians raise them and confess to you?
Will anyone recount your mercy in tomb, and your truth in destruction?
Will your wonders be known in darkness and your righteousness in forgotten land?
But I cried to you, Lord, and in morning my prayer will go before you.
Why, Lord, do you reject my soul? You turn your face away from me.
I poor and in labors from my youth; having been exalted, I was humbled and came to despair.
Your angers passed over me, and your terrors troubled me.
They encircled me like water whole day; together they surrounded me.
You removed friend and neighbor from me and my acquaintances from misery.
For understanding. Of Ethan the Israelite.
Your mercies, Lord, forever I will sing; from generation to generation I will declare your truth with my mouth.
Because you said, Mercy will be built forever; in heavens your truth will be prepared.
I arranged covenant with my chosen ones; I swore to David my servant,
Until age I will prepare your seed and build your throne to generation and generation. Interlude.
Heavens will confess your wonders, Lord, and your truth in assembly of holy ones.
Because who in clouds will be made equal to Lord, and who will be likened to Lord among sons of God?
God glorified in council of holy ones, great and fearful above all around him.
Lord God of hosts, who like you? Mighty are you, Lord, and your truth around you.
You rule power of sea, and disturbance of its waves you calm.
You humbled proud one like wounded man, and with arm of your power you scattered your enemies.
Yours the heavens and yours the earth; inhabited world and its fullness, you founded them.
North and seas you created; Tabor and Hermon will exult in your name.
Yours the arm with dominion; let your hand be strengthened; let your right hand be exalted.
Righteousness and judgment preparation of your throne; mercy and truth will go before your face.
Blessed people knowing shout; Lord, in light of your face they will walk.
And in your name they will exult whole day, and in your righteousness they will be exalted.
Because you boast of their power, and in your good pleasure our horn will be exalted.
Because support belongs to Lord, and to Holy One of Israel, our king.
Then you spoke in vision to your holy ones and said, I set help upon mighty one; I exalted chosen one from my people.
I found David my servant; with my holy oil I anointed him.
For my hand will support him, and my arm will strengthen him.
Enemy will not profit in him, and son of lawlessness will not add to harm him.
And I will cut down his enemies from before him, and those hating him I will rout.
And my truth and my mercy with him, and in my name his horn will be exalted.
And I will set his hand in sea and his right hand in rivers.
He will call upon me, You are my father, my God and supporter of my salvation.
And I will set him firstborn, high above kings of earth.
Forever I will keep my mercy for him, and my covenant faithful to him.
And I will set his seed forever and ever and his throne as days of heaven.
If his sons forsake my law and do not walk in my judgments,
if they profane my ordinances and do not keep my commandments,
I will visit their lawlessnesses with rod and their sins with whips.
But my mercy I will certainly not scatter from him, nor will I act unjustly in my truth.
Nor will I profane my covenant, and what goes out through my lips I will certainly not set aside.
Once I swore in my holy place: will I lie to David?
His seed remains forever, and his throne as sun before me,
and as moon established forever, and witness in heaven faithful. Interlude.
But you rejected and despised; you deferred your anointed.
You overturned covenant of your servant; you profaned his sanctuary to earth.
You pulled down all his fences; you made his strongholds fear.
All passing by road plundered him; he became reproach to his neighbors.
You exalted right hand of his enemies; you gladdened all his enemies.
You turned back help of his sword and did not support him in war.
You dissolved him from cleansing; his throne you shattered to earth.
You shortened days of his time; you poured out shame upon him. Interlude.
How long, Lord? Will you turn away to end? Will your anger burn like fire?
Remember what my substance is; for not in vain did you create all sons of men.
Who is man who will live and not see death? Will he rescue his soul from hand of Hades? Interlude.
Where are your former mercies, Lord, which you swore to David in your truth?
Remember, Lord, reproach of your servants, which I bore in my bosom from many nations,
with which your enemies reproached, Lord, with which they reproached exchange of your anointed.
Blessed Lord forever. Amen, amen.
Prayer of Moses, man of God. Lord, you became refuge to us in generation and generation.
Before mountains were born and earth and inhabited world were formed, from age until age you are.
Do not turn man away into humiliation; and you said, Return, sons of men.
Because thousand years in your eyes like yesterday day that passed and like watch in night.
Their despised things will be years; in morning like grass let it pass away.
In morning let it flower and pass away; in evening let it fall, grow hard, and dry up.
Because we failed in your anger and in your fury we were troubled.
You set our lawlessnesses before you, our age in light of your face.
Because all our days failed, and in your anger we failed; our years I kept meditating like spider.
Days of our years, in them seventy years; and if in dominions, eighty years; and more of them labor and pain, because meekness came upon us and we will be disciplined.
Who knows strength of your anger and from your fear your fury?
To number your right hand, thus make known, and those bound in heart in wisdom.
Turn back, Lord, how long, and be comforted over your servants.
We were filled in morning with your mercy, and we exulted and rejoiced in all our days.
We rejoiced for days in which you humbled us, years in which we saw evils.
And look upon your servants and your works and guide their sons.
And let brightness of Lord our God be upon us, and works of our hands direct upon us.
Praise, song of David. One dwelling in help of Most High will lodge in shelter of God of heaven.
He will say to Lord, You are my supporter and my refuge, my God; I will hope on him.
Because he will rescue me from snare of hunters and from troubled word.
With his shoulders he will overshadow you, and under his wings you will hope; his truth will encircle you with shield.
You will not fear from night fear, from arrow flying by day,
from thing passing in darkness, from mishap and midday demon.
A thousand will fall from your side and ten thousand from your right, but it will not come near you.
Only with your eyes you will observe and see repayment of sinners.
Because you, Lord, my hope; you made Most High your refuge.
Evils will not come near you, and scourge will not draw near your tent.
Because he will command his angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.
On hands they will carry you, lest you strike your foot against stone.
You will step on asp and basilisk and trample lion and dragon.
Because he hoped on me, and I will rescue him; I will shelter him, because he knew my name.
He will call upon me, and I will hear him; I am with him in affliction, and I will deliver and glorify him.
With length of days I will fill him and show him my salvation.
Psalm, song for day of Sabbath.
Good thing to confess to Lord and sing to your name, Most High,
to proclaim in morning your mercy and your truth by night,
on ten-stringed psaltery, with song on lyre.
Because you gladdened me, Lord, in your workmanship, and in works of your hands I will exult.
How your works were magnified, Lord; your thoughts were made very deep.
Foolish man will not know, and senseless man will not understand these things:
when sinners spring up like grass and all workers of lawlessness peered out, so that they might be destroyed forever and ever.
But you, Most High forever, Lord.
Because behold, your enemies will perish, and all workers of lawlessness will be scattered.
And my horn will be exalted like unicorn, and my old age in rich oil.
And my eye looked upon my enemies, and on those rising against me doing evil my ear will hear.
Righteous one will flower like palm tree; like cedar in Lebanon he will multiply.
Planted in house of Lord, in courts of our God they will flower.
They will still multiply in rich old age and be prospering,
to declare that Lord my God upright, and there is no injustice in him.

For day before Sabbath, when earth was settled. Praise, song of David. Lord reigned; he clothed himself with beauty, Lord clothed himself with power and girded himself; for he also made firm inhabited world which will not be shaken.
Your throne ready from then; from age you are.
Rivers lifted up, Lord, rivers lifted up their voices.
From voices of many waters, wondrous the surges of sea; wondrous in heights Lord.
Your testimonies were made very faithful; holiness fits your house, Lord, for length of days.
Psalm of David, fourth of Sabbaths. God of vengeances, Lord; God of vengeances spoke openly.
Be exalted, judge of earth; repay recompense to proud ones.
How long, sinners, Lord, how long will sinners boast?
They will utter and speak injustice; all workers of lawlessness will speak.
Your people, Lord, they humbled, and your inheritance they afflicted.
Widow and sojourner they killed, and orphans they murdered.
And they said, Lord will not see, nor will God of Jacob understand.
Understand now, foolish ones among people, and senseless ones, when will you understand?
One planting ear, does he not hear? One forming eye, does he not perceive?
One disciplining nations, will he not reprove? One teaching man knowledge?
Lord knows thoughts of men, that they are vain.
Blessed man whom you discipline, Lord, and teach from your law,
to make him gentle away from evil days until pit be dug for sinner.
Because Lord will not reject his people and will not forsake his inheritance,
until righteousness returns to judgment, and all straight in heart close behind it. Interlude.
Who will rise for me against evil-doers, or who will stand with me against workers of lawlessness?
If not that Lord helped me, my soul would almost have dwelt in Hades.
If I said, My foot was shaken, your mercy, Lord, was helping me.
Lord, according to multitude of my pains in my heart, your comforts loved my soul.
Will throne of lawlessness join itself with you, one fashioning labor by ordinance?
They will hunt against soul of righteous man and condemn innocent blood.
And Lord became refuge to me, and my God helper of my hope.
And he will repay them their lawlessness and in their evil he will destroy them, Lord our God.
Praise, song of David. Come, let us exult in Lord; let us shout to God our savior.
Let us come before his face in confession, and in psalms let us shout to him.
Because great God Lord and great king over all gods,
because ends of earth in his hand and heights of mountains his.
Because sea his and he made it, and dry land his hands formed.
Come, let us worship and fall down before him and weep before Lord who made us,
because he our God and we people of his pasture and sheep of his hand. Today, if you hear his voice,
do not harden your hearts as in provocation, according to day of testing in wilderness,
where your fathers tested me, tried me, and saw my works.
Forty years I felt loathing toward that generation and said, They always go astray in heart, and they did not know my ways,
as I swore in my anger, They will not enter into my rest.
When house was being built after captivity. Song of David. Sing to Lord new song; sing to Lord, all earth.
Sing to Lord; bless his name; bring good news day from day of his salvation.
Declare among nations his glory, among all peoples his wonders.
Because great Lord and greatly praised; fearful he over all gods.
Because all gods of nations demons, but Lord made heavens.
Confession and beauty before him, holiness and magnificence in his sanctuary.
Bring to Lord, families of nations, bring to Lord glory and honor.
Bring to Lord glory to his name; take sacrifices and enter into his courts.
Worship Lord in his holy court; let all earth be shaken from before him.
Say among nations, Lord reigned, for he also set inhabited world straight, which will not be shaken; he will judge peoples in uprightness.
Let heavens rejoice and earth exult; let sea be shaken and its fullness.
Fields will be glad and all things in them; then all trees of forest will exult
before Lord, because he comes, because he comes to judge earth; he will judge inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in his truth.
Of David, when his land is established. Lord reigned; let earth exult; let many islands rejoice.
Cloud and gloom around him; righteousness and judgment correction of his throne.
Fire will go before him and flame around his enemies.
His lightnings shone to inhabited world; earth saw and was shaken.
Mountains melted like wax from face of Lord, from face of Lord of all earth.
Heavens declared his righteousness, and all peoples saw his glory.
Let all worshiping carved images be shamed, those boasting in their idols; worship him, all his angels.
Zion heard and rejoiced, and daughters of Judea exulted because of your judgments, Lord.
Because you are Lord, Most High over all earth; you were greatly exalted above all gods.
You loving Lord, hate evil; Lord guards souls of his holy ones; from hand of sinners he will rescue them.
Light arose for righteous one, and for straight in heart gladness.
Rejoice, righteous ones, in Lord, and confess to memory of his holiness.
Psalm of David. Sing to Lord new song, because Lord did wondrous things; his right hand saved for him, and his holy arm.
Lord made known his salvation; before nations he revealed his righteousness.
He remembered his mercy to Jacob and his truth to house of Israel; all ends of earth saw salvation of our God.
Shout to God, all earth; sing and exult and make melody.
Make melody to Lord with lyre, with lyre and voice of psalm,
with hammered trumpets and voice of horn trumpet; shout before king, Lord.
Let sea be shaken and its fullness, inhabited world and those dwelling in it.
Rivers will clap with hand; together mountains will exult,
because he comes to judge earth; he will judge inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in uprightness.
Psalm of David. Lord reigned; let peoples be angry; one sitting upon cherubim, let earth be shaken.
Lord great in Zion and high over all peoples.
Let them confess to your name, the great one, because it fearful and holy.
And honor of king loves judgment. You prepared uprightnesses; judgment and righteousness in Jacob you did.
Exalt Lord our God and worship at footstool of his feet, because holy he is.
Moses and Aaron among his priests and Samuel among those calling on his name; they called on Lord, and he heard them.
In pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and ordinances he gave them.
Lord our God, you heard them; O God, you became propitious to them and avenging over all their practices.
Exalt Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, because holy Lord our God.
Psalm for confession. Shout to Lord, all earth.
Serve Lord with gladness; enter before him with exultation.
Know that Lord, he is God; he made us, and not we ourselves, his people and sheep of his pasture.
Enter his gates in confession, his courts in hymns; confess to him, praise his name.
Because Lord kind; forever his mercy, and unto generation and generation his truth.
Of David. Psalm. Mercy and judgment I will sing to you, Lord.
I will sing and understand in blameless way. When will you come to me? I walked in innocence of my heart in midst of my house.
I did not set before my eyes lawless thing; those doing transgressions I hated.
Crooked heart did not cling to me; when evil one turned away from me, I did not know him.
One slandering his neighbor secretly, this one I drove out; one with proud eye and insatiable heart, with this one I did not eat.
My eyes upon faithful ones of earth, so that they may sit with me; one walking in blameless way, this one served me.
One doing pride did not dwell in midst of my house; one speaking unjust things did not go straight before my eyes.
In mornings I killed all sinners of earth, to destroy from city of Lord all workers of lawlessness.
Prayer for poor man, when he grows faint and pours out his supplication before Lord.
Hear, Lord, my prayer, and let my cry come to you.
Do not turn your face from me in whatever day I am afflicted; incline your ear to me; in whatever day I call on you, quickly hear me.
Because my days failed like smoke, and my bones were scorched like brushwood.
My heart was struck like grass and dried up, because I forgot to eat my bread.
From voice of my groaning, my bone clung to my flesh.
I became like desert pelican; I became like night-raven in ruined place.
I kept watch and became like sparrow solitary on housetop.
Whole day my enemies reproached me, and those praising me swore against me.
Because I ate ash like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,
from face of your anger and your fury, because lifting me up you dashed me down.
My days declined like shadow, and I dried up like grass.
But you, Lord, remain forever, and your memorial to generation and generation.
You, rising up, will have compassion on Zion, because time to pity her, because time came.
Because your servants took pleasure in her stones and will pity her dust.
And nations will fear name of Lord, and all kings of earth your glory.
Because Lord will build Zion and will be seen in his glory.
He looked upon prayer of humble ones and did not despise their supplication.
Let this be written for another generation, and people being created will praise Lord,
because he looked down from height of his holy place; Lord from heaven looked upon earth,
to hear groaning of chained ones, to loose sons of those put to death,
to declare in Zion name of Lord and his praise in Jerusalem,
when peoples are gathered together and kingdoms to serve Lord.
He answered him in way of his strength, Tell me fewness of my days.
Do not bring me up in half of my days; your years through generations of generations.
At beginnings, you, Lord, founded earth, and heavens works of your hands.
They will perish, but you remain; and all will grow old like garment, and like cloak you will change them, and they will be changed.
But you same, and your years will not fail.
Sons of your servants will dwell, and their seed will be directed forever.
Of David. Bless Lord, my soul, and all within me, his holy name.
Bless Lord, my soul, and do not forget all his repayments,
the one propitiating all your lawlessnesses, the one healing all your diseases,
the one redeeming your life from corruption, the one crowning you in mercy and compassions,
the one filling your desire with good things; your youth will be renewed like eagle.
Lord doing mercies and judgment for all suffering injustice.
He made known his ways to Moses, to sons of Israel his wills.
Compassionate and merciful Lord, long-suffering and rich in mercy.
He will not be angry to end, nor rage forever.
Not according to our sins did he do to us, nor according to our lawlessnesses did he repay us.
Because according to height of heaven from earth, Lord strengthened his mercy upon those fearing him.
As far as east from west, he removed our lawlessnesses from us.
As father has compassion on sons, Lord had compassion on those fearing him.
Because he knew our formation; remember that we are dust.
Man, his days like grass; like flower of field, so he will flower.
Because wind passed in him and he will not exist, and he will no longer know his place.
But mercy of Lord from age and until age upon those fearing him, and his righteousness upon sons of sons,
to those keeping his covenant and remembering his commandments to do them.
Lord prepared his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules all.
Bless Lord, all his angels, mighty in strength, doing his word, to hear voice of his words.
Bless Lord, all his powers, his ministers doing his will.
Bless Lord, all his works, in every place of his lordship; bless Lord, my soul.
Of David. Bless Lord, my soul. Lord my God, you were made exceedingly great; confession and beauty you clothed yourself with,
wrapping yourself in light like garment, stretching out heaven like skin,
roofing his upper rooms in waters, setting clouds as his ascent, walking on wings of winds,
making his angels spirits and his ministers flaming fire,
who founded earth on its security; it will not be inclined forever and ever.
Deep like garment its covering; on mountains waters will stand.
From your rebuke they will flee; from voice of your thunder they will fear.
Mountains go up and plains go down to place which you founded for them.
You set boundary they will not pass, nor return to cover earth.
One sending out springs in valleys; among mountains waters will pass.
They give drink to all beasts of field; wild donkeys will receive for their thirst.
Upon them birds of heaven will dwell; from midst of rocks they will give voice.
One watering mountains from his upper rooms; from fruit of your works earth will be satisfied.
One causing grass to spring up for cattle and green plant for service of men, to bring bread out of earth,
and wine gladdens heart of man, to brighten face with oil, and bread strengthens heart of man.
Trees of plain will be filled, cedars of Lebanon which he planted.
There sparrows will nest; house of stork leads them.
High mountains for deer, rock refuge for rock-badgers.
He made moon for seasons; sun knew its setting.
You set darkness, and night came; in it all beasts of forest will pass through.
Lion-cubs roaring to seize and to seek food for themselves from God.
Sun rose, and they were gathered, and in their dens they will lie down.
Man will go out to his work and to his labor until evening.
How your works were magnified, Lord; in wisdom you made all. Earth was filled with your creation.
This sea, great and broad-spaced: there creeping things without number, small animals with great.
There ships pass through; this dragon you formed to play in it.
All look to you to give food to them in due season.
When you give to them, they will gather; when you open your hand, all things will be filled with goodness.
When you turn away your face, they will be troubled; you will take away their spirit, and they will fail and return to their dust.
You send out your spirit, and they will be created, and you renew face of earth.
Let glory of Lord be forever; Lord will rejoice in his works,
one looking upon earth and making it tremble, one touching mountains and they smoke.
I will sing to Lord in my life; I will make melody to my God while I exist.
Let my discourse be sweet to him; and I will rejoice in Lord.
Let sinners fail from earth, and lawless ones so as not to exist. Bless Lord, my soul.
Alleluia. Confess to Lord and call on his name; declare among nations his works.
Sing to him and make melody to him; recount all his wonders.
Praise in his holy name; let heart of those seeking Lord rejoice.
Seek Lord and be strengthened; seek his face continually.
Remember his wonders which he did, his portents and judgments of his mouth,
seed of Abraham, his servants, sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He Lord our God; in all earth his judgments.
He remembered his covenant forever, word which he commanded for thousand generations,
which he arranged with Abraham and his oath to Isaac.
And he set it to Jacob for ordinance and to Israel everlasting covenant,
saying, To you I will give land of Canaan, line-measure of your inheritance,
when they were few in number, very few and sojourners in it,
and they passed from nation to nation, from kingdom to another people.
He did not allow man to do them injustice, and he reproved kings for their sake:
Do not touch my anointed ones, and in my prophets do not do evil.
And he called famine upon earth; he crushed every support of bread.
He sent before them man; Joseph was sold for slave.
They humbled his feet in shackles; iron went through his soul,
until his word came; saying of Lord refined him.
King sent and loosed him, ruler of peoples and released him.
He made him lord of his house and ruler of all his possession,
to discipline his rulers like himself and make his elders wise.
And Israel entered into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in land of Ham.
And he increased his people exceedingly and strengthened it beyond its enemies.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal deceitfully with his servants.
He sent Moses his servant, Aaron whom he chose,
he set among them words of his signs and portents in land of Ham.
He sent darkness and darkened, and they provoked his words.
He turned their waters to blood and killed their fish.
Their land teemed with frogs in chambers of their kings.
He spoke, and dog-fly came, and gnats in all their borders.
He made their rains hail, burning fire in their land.
And he struck their vines and their fig trees and shattered every tree of their border.
He spoke, and locust came, and young locust without number,
and devoured all grass in their land and devoured fruit of their earth.
And he struck every firstborn in their land, firstfruits of all their labor.
And he led them out with silver and gold, and there was none weak in their tribes.
Egypt rejoiced in their departure, because fear of them fell upon them.
He spread out cloud for covering to them and fire to give them light by night.
They asked, and quail came, and bread of heaven filled them.
He split rock and waters flowed; rivers went in waterless places.
Because he remembered his holy word to Abraham his servant.
And he led out his people with exultation and his chosen ones with gladness.
And he gave them lands of nations, and they inherited labors of peoples,
so that they might keep his ordinances and seek out his law.
Alleluia. Confess to Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.
Who will speak powers of Lord, make all his praises heard?
Blessed those keeping judgment and doing righteousness in every time.
Remember us, Lord, in good pleasure of your people; visit us in your salvation,
to see in goodness of your chosen ones, to rejoice in gladness of your nation, to be praised with your inheritance.
We sinned with our fathers, we acted lawlessly, we did injustice.
Our fathers in Egypt did not understand your wonders; they did not remember multitude of your mercy and provoked while going up at Red Sea.
And he saved them for sake of his name, to make known his dominion.
And he rebuked Red Sea and it dried up, and he guided them in deep as in wilderness.
And he saved them from hand of those hating and redeemed them from hand of enemy.
And water covered those afflicting them; not one of them was left.
And they believed in his words and sang his praise.
They hurried, they forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.
And they desired desire in wilderness and tested God in waterless place.
And he gave them their request and sent fullness into their souls.
And they angered Moses in camp, and Aaron, holy one of Lord.
Earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered over assembly of Abiron.
And fire burned in their assembly; flame consumed sinners.
And they made calf in Horeb and worshiped carved image.
And they exchanged their glory for likeness of calf eating grass.
They forgot God saving them, one doing great things in Egypt,
wondrous things in land of Ham, fearful things by Red Sea.
And he said to destroy them, if not Moses, his chosen one, stood in breaking before him to turn back his anger, so as not to destroy.
And they despised desirable land; they did not believe his word.
And they grumbled in their tents; they did not hear voice of Lord.
And he raised his hand against them, to cast them down in wilderness,
and to cast down their seed among nations and scatter them in lands.
And they were joined to Beelphegor and ate sacrifices of dead ones.
And they provoked him in their practices, and falling was multiplied among them.
And Phinehas stood and propitiated, and breaking ceased.
And it was counted to him as righteousness from generation to generation forever.
And they angered him at water of contradiction, and Moses was harmed because of them,
because they provoked his spirit, and he distinguished with his lips.
They did not destroy nations which Lord told them,
and they mixed among nations and learned their works.
And they served their carved images, and it became to them stumbling-block.
And they sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons,
and poured out innocent blood, blood of their sons and daughters whom they sacrificed to carved images of Canaan, and land was stained with bloods.
And they were defiled in their works and prostituted in their practices.
And Lord was angered in fury against his people and abhorred his inheritance.
And he handed them into hands of nations, and those hating them ruled over them.
And their enemies afflicted them, and they were humbled under their hands.
Many times he rescued them, but they provoked him in their counsel and were humbled in their lawlessnesses.
And he saw when they were afflicted, when he heard their supplication.
And he remembered his covenant and relented according to multitude of his mercy.
And he gave them into compassions before all who had taken them captive.
Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from nations, to confess to your holy name, to boast in your praise.
Blessed Lord God of Israel from age and until age, and let all the people say, Amen, amen.
Alleluia. Confess to Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.
Let those redeemed by Lord say so, whom he redeemed from hand of enemy
and gathered them from lands, from east and west and north and sea.
They wandered in wilderness, in waterless place; they did not find way of city of dwelling.
Hungry and thirsty, their soul in them failed.
And they cried to Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he rescued them.
And he guided them in straight way to go into city of dwelling.
Let them confess to Lord his mercies and his wonders to sons of men,
because he satisfied empty soul, and hungry soul he filled with good things.
Those sitting in darkness and shadow of death, chained in poverty and iron,
because they provoked words of God and angered counsel of Most High.
And their heart was humbled in labors; they grew weak, and there was none helping.
And they cried to Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he saved them.
And he led them out from darkness and shadow of death and tore apart their bonds.
Let them confess to Lord his mercies and his wonders to sons of men,
because he shattered bronze gates and broke iron bars.
He took hold of them out of way of their lawlessnesses, for because of their lawlessnesses they were humbled.
Their soul abhorred all food, and they drew near to gates of death.
And they cried to Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he saved them.
He sent his word and healed them and rescued them from their corruptions.
Let them confess to Lord his mercies and his wonders to sons of men,
and let them sacrifice sacrifice of praise and declare his works in exultation.
Those going down into sea in ships, doing business in many waters,
they saw works of Lord and his wonders in deep.
He spoke, and storm wind stood, and its waves were lifted up.
They go up to heavens and go down to deeps; their soul in evils was melting.
They were troubled, they were shaken like drunkard, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
And they cried to Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he brought them out.
And he commanded storm, and it stood to breeze, and its waves were silent.
And they rejoiced because they were quiet, and he guided them to harbor of their will.
Let them confess to Lord his mercies and his wonders to sons of men,
let them exalt him in assembly of people, and in seat of elders let them praise him.
He made rivers into desert and outgoings of waters into thirst,
fruitful land into salt-flat because of evil of those dwelling in it.
He made desert into pools of waters and waterless land into outgoings of waters.
And he settled there hungry ones, and they established city of dwelling.
And they sowed fields and planted vineyards and made fruit of produce.
And he blessed them, and they multiplied exceedingly, and their cattle he did not lessen.
And they were few and afflicted from affliction of evils and pain.
Contempt was poured out upon rulers, and he made them wander in trackless place and not way.
And he helped poor man out of poverty and made families like sheep.
Straight ones will see and rejoice, and all lawlessness will shut its mouth.
Who wise and will keep these things? And they will understand mercies of Lord.
Song of psalm of David.
Ready my heart, O God, ready my heart; I will sing and make melody in my glory.
Awake, psaltery and lyre; I will awake at dawn.
I will confess to you among peoples, Lord, and sing to you among nations,
because great above heavens your mercy and unto clouds your truth.
Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all earth your glory.
So that your beloved ones may be rescued, save with your right hand and hear me.
God spoke in his holy place: I will be exalted and divide Shechem and valley of tents I will measure out.
Mine Gilead and mine Manasseh, and Ephraim support of my head, Judah my king.
Moab cauldron of my hope; upon Idumea I will stretch out my sandal; foreigners were subjected to me.
Who will bring me into fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Idumea?
Is it not you, O God, who rejected us? And God will not go out with our powers.
Give us help from affliction, and salvation of man vain.
In God we will do mighty deed, and he will despise our enemies.
For end, of David, psalm. O God, my praise, do not pass over in silence,
because mouth of sinner and mouth of deceitful one opened against me; they spoke against me with deceitful tongue.
And with words of hatred they surrounded me and fought me without cause.
Instead of loving me they slandered me, but I was praying.
And they set against me evils for good things and hatred for my love.
Appoint sinner over him, and let devil stand at his right hand.
When he is judged, let him go out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
Let his days become few, and let another take his oversight.
Let his sons become orphans and his wife widow.
Trembling, let his sons wander and beg; let them be cast out from their homesteads.
Let lender search out all things he has; let strangers plunder his labors.
Let there be no supporter for him, nor let there be one compassionate to his orphans.
Let his children be for destruction; in one generation let his name be blotted out.
Let lawlessness of his fathers be remembered before Lord, and sin of his mother let it not be blotted out.
Let them be before Lord continually, and let their memory be destroyed from earth,
because he did not remember to do mercy and pursued poor and needy man and one pierced in heart to kill.
And he loved curse, and it will come to him; and he did not want blessing, and it will be far from him.
And he clothed himself with curse like garment, and it entered like water into his inward parts and like oil into his bones.
Let it become to him like garment he wraps around and like belt which he girds continually.
This work of those slandering me from Lord and of those speaking evil against my soul.
But you, Lord, Lord, deal mercifully with me for sake of your name, because your mercy kind.
Rescue me, because I poor and needy, and my heart troubled within me.
Like shadow in its decline I was taken away; I was shaken out like locusts.
My knees grew weak from fasting, and my flesh was changed away from oil.
And I became reproach to them; they saw me and shook their heads.
Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your mercy.
And let them know that this your hand, and you, Lord, did it.
They will curse, but you will bless; those rising against me let them be shamed, but your servant will rejoice.
Let those slandering me be clothed in shame and wrap their shame around themselves like double-cloak.
I will confess to Lord exceedingly with my mouth, and in midst of many I will praise him,
because he stood at right hand of poor man to save from those pursuing my soul.
Of David. Psalm. Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand until I place your enemies footstool of your feet.
Lord will send rod of your power from Zion, and rule in midst of your enemies.
With you beginning in day of your power, in splendors of holy ones; from womb before morning-star I begot you.
Lord swore and will not regret, You priest forever according to order of Melchizedek.
Lord at your right hand crushed kings in day of his anger.
He will judge among nations, he will fill corpses, he will crush heads over land of many.
From torrent in way he will drink; therefore he will lift up head.
Alleluia. I will confess to you, Lord, with whole heart, in council of straight ones and gathering.
Great works of Lord, sought out for all his wills.
Confession and magnificence his work, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.
He made remembrance of his wonders; merciful and compassionate Lord.
He gave food to those fearing him; he will remember his covenant forever.
He declared strength of his works to his people, to give them inheritance of nations.
Works of his hands truth and judgment; all his commandments faithful,
established forever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.
He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant forever; holy and fearful his name.
Beginning of wisdom fear of Lord; good understanding to all doing it; his praise remains forever and ever.
Alleluia. Blessed man fearing Lord; in his commandments he will desire greatly.
His seed will be mighty in earth; generation of straight ones will be blessed.
Glory and wealth in his house, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.
Light rose in darkness for straight ones, merciful and compassionate and righteous.
Good man, one showing compassion and lending, will manage his matters in judgment,
because forever he will not be shaken; righteous one will be in everlasting remembrance.
From evil report he will not fear; his heart ready to hope upon Lord.
His heart is established; he will not fear until he looks upon his enemies.
He scattered, he gave to poor ones; his righteousness remains forever and ever; his horn will be exalted in glory.
Sinner will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; desire of sinners will perish.
Alleluia. Praise, servants, Lord; praise name of Lord.
Let name of Lord be blessed from now and until age.
From risings of sun until settings, praise name of Lord.
High over all nations Lord, above heavens his glory.
Who like Lord our God, one dwelling in heights,
and watching low things in heaven and on earth,
one raising poor from earth and lifting needy from dung-heap,
to make him sit with rulers, with rulers of his people,
one settling barren woman in house, joyful mother of children.
Alleluia. In Israel going out from Egypt, house of Jacob from barbarous people,
Judea became his sanctuary, Israel his authority.
Sea saw and fled; Jordan turned backward.
Mountains skipped like rams, and hills like lambs of sheep.
What is with you, sea, that you fled, and you, Jordan, that you turned back?
Mountains, why did you skip like rams, and hills like lambs of sheep?
From face of Lord earth was shaken, from face of God of Jacob,
who turned rock into pools of waters and flint into springs of waters.
Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, upon your mercy and your truth.
Lest nations say, Where is their God?
But our God above in heaven, in heavens and on earth, all things whatever he wanted he did.
Idols of nations silver and gold, works of hands of men.
They have mouth and will not speak, eyes and will not see,
they have ears and will not hear, noses and will not smell,
they have hands and will not feel, feet and will not walk; they will not make sound in their throat.
Let those making them become like them, and all trusting on them.
House of Israel hoped on Lord; he their helper and defender.
House of Aaron hoped on Lord; he their helper and defender.
Those fearing Lord hoped on Lord; he their helper and defender.
Lord remembered us and blessed us; he blessed house of Israel, he blessed house of Aaron.
He blessed those fearing Lord, small with great.
May Lord add upon you, upon you and upon your sons.
Blessed you by Lord, who made heaven and earth.
Heaven of heaven belongs to Lord, but earth he gave to sons of men.
Dead ones will not praise you, Lord, nor all going down into Hades.
But we living ones will bless Lord from now and until age.
Alleluia. I loved because Lord will hear voice of my supplication,
because he inclined his ear to me, and in my days I will call upon him.
Pangs of death surrounded me, dangers of Hades found me; affliction and pain I found.
And name of Lord I called upon: O Lord, rescue my soul.
Merciful Lord and righteous, and our God shows mercy.
Lord guarding little ones; I was humbled, and he saved me.
Return, my soul, into your rest, because Lord benefited you.
Because he delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
I will be well-pleasing before Lord in land of living ones.
Alleluia. I believed, therefore I spoke; but I was humbled greatly.
I said in my ecstasy, Every man liar.
What will I repay to Lord for all things he repaid me?
Cup of salvation I will take, and name of Lord I will call upon.
Precious before Lord death of his holy ones.
O Lord, I your servant, I your servant and son of your handmaid; you tore apart my bonds.
To you I will sacrifice sacrifice of praise.
My vows to Lord I will pay before all his people,
in courts of house of Lord, in your midst, Jerusalem.
Alleluia. Praise Lord, all nations; praise him, all peoples,
because his mercy was strengthened upon us, and truth of Lord remains forever.
Alleluia. Confess to Lord, because good, because his mercy forever.
Let house of Israel say now that he good, because his mercy forever.
Let house of Aaron say now that he good, because his mercy forever.
Let all fearing Lord say now that he good, because his mercy forever.
In affliction I called on Lord, and he heard me into broad place.
Lord helper to me; I will not fear what man will do to me.
Lord helper to me, and I will look upon my enemies.
Better to trust upon Lord than to trust upon man.
Better to hope upon Lord than to hope upon rulers.
All nations surrounded me, and in name of Lord I drove them off.
Surrounding, they surrounded me, and in name of Lord I drove them off.
They surrounded me like bees round honeycomb and were burned like fire in thorns, and in name of Lord I drove them off.
Pushed, I was overturned to fall, and Lord took hold of me.
My strength and my hymn Lord, and he became to me for salvation.
Voice of exultation and salvation in tents of righteous ones; right hand of Lord did mighty deed.
Right hand of Lord lifted me up; right hand of Lord did mighty deed.
I will not die, but live, and recount works of Lord.
Disciplining, Lord disciplined me, and to death he did not hand me over.
Open to me gates of righteousness; entering through them I will confess to Lord.
This gate of Lord; righteous ones will enter through it.
I will confess to you because you heard me and became to me for salvation.
Stone which builders rejected, this became head of corner.
From Lord this came to be, and it wondrous in our eyes.
This day which Lord made; let us exult and rejoice in it.
O Lord, save indeed; O Lord, prosper indeed.
Blessed one coming in name of Lord; we blessed you from house of Lord.
God Lord and he appeared to us; arrange feast with dense branches, up to horns of altar.
You my God, and I will confess to you; you my God, and I will exalt you; I will confess to you because you heard me and became to me for salvation.
Confess to Lord, because good, because his mercy forever.
Alleluia. Aleph. Blessed blameless ones in way, those walking in law of Lord.
Blessed those searching out his testimonies; with whole heart they will seek him.
For those working lawlessness did not walk in his ways.
You commanded your commandments to be kept exceedingly.
Would that my ways be directed to keep your ordinances.
Then I will certainly not be ashamed when I look upon all your commandments.
I will confess to you, Lord, in uprightness of heart when I learn judgments of your righteousness.
Your ordinances I will keep; do not forsake me exceedingly.
Beth. In what will young man set straight his way? In keeping your words.
With whole heart I sought you; do not push me away from your commandments.
In my heart I hid your sayings so that I might not sin against you.
Blessed are you, Lord; teach me your ordinances.
With my lips I declared all judgments of your mouth.
In way of your testimonies I delighted as over all wealth.
In your commandments I will muse and perceive your ways.
In your ordinances I will meditate; I will not forget your words.
Gimel. Repay your servant; I will live and keep your words.
Uncover my eyes, and I will perceive wonders from your law.
I am sojourner in earth; do not hide your commandments from me.
My soul longed to desire your judgments at every time.
You rebuked proud ones; cursed those turning away from your commandments.
Take away from me reproach and contempt, because I searched out your testimonies.
For rulers also sat and spoke against me, but your servant mused in your ordinances.
For indeed your testimonies my meditation and your ordinances my counselors.
Daleth. My soul clung to ground; make me live according to your word.
I declared my ways, and you heard me; teach me your ordinances.
Make me understand way of your ordinances, and I will muse in your wonders.
My soul dripped from faintheartedness; confirm me in your words.
Remove way of injustice from me, and in your law have mercy on me.
Way of truth I chose; your judgments I did not forget.
I clung to your testimonies, Lord; do not shame me.
Way of your commandments I ran when you widened my heart.
He. Give law to me, Lord, way of your ordinances, and I will seek it continually.
