Make me understand, and I will search out your law and keep it with whole heart.
Guide me in path of your commandments, because I wanted it.
Incline my heart to your testimonies and not to greed.
Turn away my eyes from seeing vanity; in your way make me live.
Establish for your servant your saying toward your fear.
Take away my reproach which I suspected, because your judgments kind.
Behold, I desired your commandments; in your righteousness make me live.
Waw. And let your mercy come upon me, Lord, your salvation according to your saying.
And I will answer a word to those reproaching me, because I hoped upon your words.
And do not take word of truth from my mouth exceedingly, because I hoped upon your judgments.
And I will keep your law continually, forever and forever of forever.
And I was walking in broad place, because I searched out your commandments.
And I was speaking in your testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed.
And I meditated on your commandments, which I loved exceedingly.
And I lifted my hands to your commandments, which I loved, and mused in your ordinances.
Zayin. Remember your word to your servant, by which you gave me hope.
This comforted me in my humiliation, because your saying made me live.
Proud ones were lawless exceedingly, but from your law I did not turn aside.
I remembered your judgments from age, Lord, and was comforted.
Faintheartedness seized me from sinners abandoning your law.
Your ordinances were songs to me in place of my sojourning.
I remembered your name in night, Lord, and kept your law.
This came to me because I searched out your ordinances.
Heth. My portion, Lord, I said, to keep your law.
I entreated your face with whole heart; have mercy on me according to your saying.
I considered your ways and turned my feet to your testimonies.
I made ready and was not troubled to keep your commandments.
Ropes of sinners entangled me, and your law I did not forget.
At midnight I rose to confess to you upon judgments of your righteousness.
I companion of all fearing you and of those keeping your commandments.
Of your mercy, Lord, earth full; teach me your ordinances.
Teth. You did goodness with your servant, Lord, according to your word.
Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge, because I believed your commandments.
Before I was humbled, I went astray; therefore I kept your saying.
You good, Lord, and in your goodness teach me your ordinances.
Injustice of proud ones multiplied upon me; but I with whole heart will search out your commandments.
Their heart curdled like milk, but I meditated on your law.
Good for me that you humbled me, so that I might learn your ordinances.
Good for me law of your mouth beyond thousands of gold and silver.
Yod. Your hands made me and formed me; make me understand, and I will learn your commandments.
Those fearing you will see me and rejoice, because I hoped in your words.
I knew, Lord, that your judgments righteousness, and in truth you humbled me.
Let your mercy become indeed to comfort me according to your saying to your servant.
Let your compassions come to me and I will live, because your law my meditation.
Let proud ones be shamed, because unjustly they acted lawlessly against me; but I will muse in your commandments.
Let those fearing you turn to me, even those knowing your testimonies.
Let my heart become blameless in your ordinances, so that I may not be shamed.
Kaph. My soul fails for your salvation, and upon your word I hoped.
My eyes failed for your saying, saying, When will you comfort me?
Because I became like wineskin in frost; your ordinances I did not forget.
How many are days of your servant? When will you make judgment for me from those persecuting me?
Lawless men told me idle talk, but not according to your law, Lord.
All your commandments truth; unjustly they persecuted me; help me.
They almost ended me in earth, but I did not forsake your commandments.
According to your mercy make me live, and I will keep testimonies of your mouth.
Lamed. Forever, Lord, your word remains in heaven.
To generation and generation your truth; you founded earth, and it remains.
By your ordinance the day remains, because all things your servants.
If not that your law my meditation, then I would have perished in my humiliation.
Forever I will certainly not forget your ordinances, because in them you made me live, Lord.
Yours I am; save me, because I searched out your ordinances.
Sinners waited for me to destroy me; your testimonies I understood.
Of every completion I saw end; your commandment very broad.
Mem. How I loved your law, Lord; whole day it my meditation.
Beyond my enemies you made me wise by your commandment, because forever it mine.
Beyond all teaching me I understood, because your testimonies my meditation.
Beyond elders I understood, because I searched out your commandments.
From every evil way I kept back my feet, so that I might keep your words.
From your judgments I did not turn aside, because you gave law to me.
How sweet to my throat your sayings, beyond honey and honeycomb to my mouth.
From your commandments I understood; therefore I hated every way of injustice, because you gave law to me.
Nun. Your word lamp to my feet and light to my paths.
I swore and established it, to keep judgments of your righteousness.
I was humbled exceedingly; Lord, make me live according to your word.
Freewill offerings of my mouth accept indeed, Lord, and teach me your judgments.
My soul in my hands continually, and your law I did not forget.
Sinners set snare for me, and from your commandments I did not wander.
I inherited your testimonies forever, because they joy of my heart.
I inclined my heart to do your ordinances forever, for recompense.
Samekh. Lawless men I hated, but your law I loved.
You my helper and supporter; upon your word I hoped.
Turn away from me, evil-doers, and I will search out commandments of my God.
Take hold of me according to your saying, and I will live, and do not shame me from my expectation.
Help me, and I will be saved, and I will meditate on your ordinances continually.
You despised all departing from your ordinances, because unjust their thought.
I considered all sinners of earth as transgressors; therefore I loved your testimonies continually.
Nail down my flesh from your fear, because I feared your judgments.
Ayin. I did judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those doing me injustice.
Receive your servant for good; let proud ones not slander me.
My eyes failed for your salvation and for saying of your righteousness.
Do with your servant according to your mercy and teach me your ordinances.
I your servant; make me understand, and I will know your testimonies.
Time for Lord to act; they scattered your law.
Therefore I loved your commandments beyond gold and topaz.
Therefore toward all your commandments I was set straight; every unjust way I hated.
Pe. Wondrous your testimonies; therefore my soul searched them out.
Disclosure of your words gives light and makes little ones understand.
My mouth I opened and drew in breath, because I longed for your commandments.
Look upon me and have mercy on me according to judgment of those loving your name.
Direct my steps according to your saying, and let no lawlessness rule over me.
Redeem me from slander of men, and I will keep your commandments.
Make your face shine upon your servant and teach me your ordinances.
Streams of waters came down from my eyes because they did not keep your law.
Tsade. Righteous are you, Lord, and straight your judgment.
You commanded your testimonies in righteousness and truth exceedingly.
Zeal of your house melted me away, because my enemies forgot your words.
Your saying very refined, and your servant loved it.
Younger I am and despised; your ordinances I did not forget.
Your righteousness righteousness forever, and your law truth.
Affliction and necessity found me; your commandments my meditation.
Your testimonies righteousness forever; make me understand and I will live.
Qoph. I cried with whole heart; hear me, Lord; I will seek out your statutes.
I cried to you; save me, and I will keep your testimonies.
I came before dawn and cried; in your words I hoped.
My eyes came before daybreak to meditate on your sayings.
Hear my voice, Lord, according to your mercy; according to your judgment make me live.
Those pursuing me in lawlessness drew near; from your law they grew far.
You near, Lord, and all your commandments truth.
From beginning I knew from your testimonies that forever you founded them.
Resh. See my humiliation and rescue me, because I did not forget your law.
Judge my case and redeem me; by your word make me live.
Salvation far from sinners, because your statutes they did not seek out.
Your compassions many, Lord; according to your judgment make me live.
Many driving me out and afflicting me; from your testimonies I did not turn aside.
I saw those breaking faith and wasted away, because they did not keep your words.
See that I loved your commandments, Lord; in your mercy make me live.
Beginning of your words truth, and forever all judgments of your righteousness.
Princes pursued me for nothing, and from your words my heart stood in awe.
I rejoice over your words like one finding much spoil.
Injustice I hated and abhorred, but your law I loved.
Seven times in day I praised you for judgments of your righteousness.
Much peace to those loving your law, and no stumbling for them.
I kept expecting your salvation, Lord, and your commandments I loved.
My soul kept your testimonies and loved them greatly.
I kept your commandments and your testimonies, because all my ways before you, Lord.
Tau. Let my petition come near before you, Lord; according to your word make me understand.
Let my request enter before you; according to your word rescue me.
Let my lips pour forth hymn when you teach me your statutes.
Let my tongue speak your saying, because all your commandments righteousness.
Let your hand come to save me, because I chose your commandments.
I longed for your salvation, Lord, and your law my meditation.
My soul will live and praise you, and your judgments will help me.
I wandered like sheep lost; seek your servant, because your commandments I did not forget.
Song of ascents. To Lord, in my being afflicted, I cried, and he heard me.
Lord, rescue my soul from unjust lips and from deceitful tongue.
What should be given to you, and what should be added to you, against deceitful tongue?
Sharpened arrows of mighty one, with desert coals.
Alas me, because my sojourning lengthened; I camped with tents of Kedar.
My soul long sojourned.
With those hating peace, I was peaceable; when I spoke to them, they warred against me for nothing.
Song of ascents. I lifted my eyes to mountains; from where will my help come?
My help from Lord, maker of heaven and earth.
Do not let your foot be shaken; may one guarding you not slumber.
Behold, keeper of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
Lord will guard you; Lord your shelter at right hand.
By day sun will not burn you, nor moon by night.
Lord will guard you from every evil; he will guard your soul.
Lord will guard your going in and your going out, from now and until age.
Song of ascents. I rejoiced over those saying to me, "To house of Lord we will go."
Our feet stood in your courts, Jerusalem.
Jerusalem, being built as city whose fellowship together one and same.
For there tribes went up, tribes of Lord, testimony for Israel, to give thanks to name of Lord.
Because there thrones sat for judgment, thrones over house of David.
Ask now things for peace of Jerusalem, and prosperity to those loving you.
Let peace now be in your strength, and prosperity in your towers.
For sake of my brothers and neighbors, I kept speaking peace concerning you.
For sake of house of Lord our God, I sought good things for you.
Song of ascents. To you I lifted my eyes, one dwelling in heaven.
Behold, as eyes of servants toward hands of their masters, as eyes of maidservant toward hands of her mistress, so our eyes toward Lord our God until he shows us mercy.
Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, because greatly we were filled with contempt.
Still more our soul filled with reproach from prosperous ones and contempt from proud ones.
Song of ascents. If not that Lord was among us, let Israel say now.
If not that Lord was among us when men rose against us,
then alive they would have swallowed us when their anger blazed against us.
Then water would have drowned us; torrent passed over our soul.
Then our soul passed over water unendurable.
Blessed Lord, who did not give us for prey to their teeth.
Our soul like sparrow rescued from snare of hunters; snare crushed, and we rescued.
Our help in name of Lord, maker of heaven and earth.
Song of ascents. Those trusting in Lord like Mount Zion, not shaken forever.
Mountains around her, and Lord around his people, from now and until age.
Because Lord will not leave rod of sinners upon lot of righteous, lest righteous stretch out their hands in lawlessness.
Do good, Lord, to good ones and to upright in heart.
But those turning aside into crooked ways Lord will lead away with workers of lawlessness. Peace on Israel.
Song of ascents. When Lord turned back captivity of Zion, we became like comforted ones.
Then our mouth filled with joy and our tongue with exultation; then they will say among nations, "Lord magnified doing with them."
Lord magnified doing with us; we became rejoicing.
Turn back, Lord, our captivity, like torrents in south.
Those sowing in tears will reap in exultation.
Going they went and wept, carrying their seeds; coming they will come in exultation, carrying their sheaves.
Song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless Lord build house, in vain builders labored; unless Lord guard city, in vain guard kept awake.
In vain for you to rise early, to rise after sitting down, you eating bread of pain, when he gives sleep to his beloved.
Behold, sons inheritance of Lord, reward of fruit of womb.
Like arrows in hand of mighty one, so sons of those thrust out.
Blessed man who will fill his desire from them; they will not be shamed when they speak with their enemies in gate.
Song of ascents. Blessed all fearing Lord, those walking in his ways.
Labors of your fruits you will eat; blessed you, and well for you.
Your wife like vine flourishing in recesses of your house; your sons like olive shoots around your table.
Behold, thus man fearing Lord will be blessed.
May Lord bless you from Zion, and may you see good things of Jerusalem all days of your life.
And may you see sons of your sons. Peace upon Israel.
Song of ascents. Many times they warred against me from my youth; let Israel say now.
Many times they warred against me from my youth, yet indeed they were not able against me.
On my back sinners built; they lengthened their lawlessness.
Lord righteous cut necks of sinners.
Let all hating Zion be shamed and turned backward.
Let them become like grass of housetops, which before being pulled up dried up.
With which reaper did not fill his hand, nor gatherer of sheaves his bosom.
And passersby did not say, "Blessing of Lord upon you; we blessed you in name of Lord."
Song of ascents. Out of depths I cried to you, Lord.
Lord, hear my voice; let your ears attend to voice of my supplication.
If you should watch lawless deeds, Lord, Lord, who will stand?
Because with you propitiation.
For sake of your law I waited for you, Lord; my soul waited for your word.
My soul hoped in Lord from morning watch until night; from morning watch let Israel hope in Lord.
Because with Lord mercy, and much redemption with him.
And he will redeem Israel from all his lawless deeds.
Song of ascents. Of David. Lord, my heart not exalted, nor my eyes raised high, nor I walked in great things nor in marvels beyond me.
If not, I was humble-minded, but I lifted my soul like child weaned against its mother, like recompense upon my soul.
Let Israel hope in Lord from now and until age.
Song of ascents. Remember, Lord, David and all his gentleness.
How he swore to Lord, vowed to God of Jacob.
If I enter tent of my house, if I go up upon bed of my couch,
if I give sleep to my eyes and slumber to my eyelids and rest to my temples,
until I find place for Lord, tabernacle for God of Jacob.
Behold, we heard of it in Ephratha; we found it in fields of the wood.
We will enter his tabernacles; we will worship at place where his feet stood.
Rise, Lord, into your rest, you and ark of your holiness.
Your priests will clothe themselves with righteousness, and your holy ones will exult.
For sake of David your servant, do not turn away face of your anointed.
Lord swore truth to David, and he will not set it aside: from fruit of your belly I will set upon your throne.
If your sons keep my covenant and these testimonies that I will teach them, their sons also forever will sit upon your throne.
Because Lord chose Zion; he chose her for dwelling to himself.
This my resting-place forever and ever; here I will dwell, because I chose her.
Her provision blessing I will bless; her poor I will satisfy with breads.
Her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her holy ones with exultation will exult.
There I will cause horn to spring up for David; I prepared lamp for my anointed.
His enemies I will clothe with shame, but upon him my holiness will flower.
Song of ascents. Of David. Behold now, what good or what pleasant, but brothers dwelling together.
Like oil upon head, descending upon beard, beard of Aaron, descending upon hem of his garment.
Like dew of Hermon descending upon mountains of Zion, because there Lord commanded blessing and life until age.
Song of ascents. Behold now, bless Lord, all servants of Lord, standing in house of Lord, in courts of house of our God.
In nights lift your hands to holy things and bless Lord.
Lord bless you from Zion, maker of heaven and earth.
Hallelujah. Praise name of Lord; praise Lord, servants.
Those standing in house of Lord, in courts of house of our God.
Praise Lord, because Lord good; sing psalms to his name, because good.
Because Lord chose Jacob for himself, Israel for his special possession.
Because I knew Lord great, and our Lord beyond all gods.
All that Lord wanted he did in heaven and on earth, in seas and in all deeps.
Raising clouds from ends of earth, he made lightnings for rain, bringing winds from his treasuries.
Who struck firstborn of Egypt, from man to beast.
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
Who struck many nations and killed mighty kings.
Sihon king of Amorites and Og king of Bashan and all kingdoms of Canaan.
And gave their land inheritance, inheritance to Israel his people.
Lord, your name forever; Lord, your memorial from generation to generation.
Because Lord will judge his people and over his servants he will be comforted.
Idols of nations silver and gold, works of hands of men.
Mouths they have and will not speak; eyes they have and will not see.
Ears they have and will not hear; noses they have and will not smell; hands they have and will not feel; feet they have and will not walk; no sound in their throat, for no spirit in their mouth.
Like them may those making them become, and all trusting in them.
House of Israel, bless Lord; house of Aaron, bless Lord.
House of Levi, bless Lord; those fearing Lord, bless Lord.
Blessed Lord from Zion, one dwelling in Jerusalem.
Hallelujah. Give thanks to Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.
Give thanks to God of gods, because his mercy forever.
Give thanks to Lord of lords, because his mercy forever.
To one doing great wonders alone, because his mercy forever.
To one making heavens in understanding, because his mercy forever.
To one establishing earth upon waters, because his mercy forever.
To one making great lights alone, because his mercy forever.
Sun for authority of day, because his mercy forever.
Moon and stars for authority of night, because his mercy forever.
To one striking Egypt with their firstborn, because his mercy forever.
And bringing Israel out from their midst, because his mercy forever.
With strong hand and with high arm, because his mercy forever.
To one cutting Red Sea into divisions, because his mercy forever.
And leading Israel through its midst, because his mercy forever.
And shaking off Pharaoh and his force into Red Sea, because his mercy forever.
To one leading his people through wilderness, because his mercy forever; to one bringing water from sheer rock, because his mercy forever.
To one striking great kings, because his mercy forever.
And killing mighty kings, because his mercy forever.
Sihon king of Amorites, because his mercy forever.
And Og king of Bashan, because his mercy forever.
And giving their land inheritance, because his mercy forever.
Inheritance to Israel his servant, because his mercy forever.
Because in our humiliation Lord remembered us, because his mercy forever.
And redeemed us from our enemies, because his mercy forever.
One giving food to all flesh, because his mercy forever.
Give thanks to God of heaven, because his mercy forever. Give thanks to Lord of lords, because his mercy forever.
Of David. By rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept when remembering Zion.
On willows in midst of it we hung our instruments.
Because there those taking us captive asked us for words of songs, and those carrying us away asked hymn: "Sing us from songs of Zion."
How should we sing song of Lord on foreign land?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand be forgotten.
Let my tongue cling to my throat if I do not remember you, if I do not set Jerusalem first at beginning of my gladness.
Remember, Lord, sons of Edom in day of Jerusalem, those saying, "Empty it, empty it, down to its foundation."
Daughter of Babylon, wretched one, blessed who will repay you repayment that you repaid to us.
Blessed who will seize and dash your infants against rock.
Of David. I will give thanks to you, Lord, with whole heart, because you heard sayings of my mouth; before angels I will sing psalms to you.
I will worship toward your holy temple and give thanks to your name for your mercy and your truth, because you magnified your saying above every name.
In whatever day I call on you, quickly hear me; with power in my soul you will greatly strengthen me.
Let all kings of earth give thanks to you, Lord, because they heard all sayings of your mouth.
And let them sing in ways of Lord, because great glory of Lord.
Because Lord high and looks upon humble things, and high things he knows from far away.
If I walk in midst of affliction, you will make me live; against anger of my enemies you stretched out your hand, and your right hand saved me.
Lord will repay on my behalf; Lord, your mercy forever. Works of your hands do not disregard.
For end. Psalm of David. Lord, you tested me and knew me.
You knew my sitting down and my rising up; you understood my thoughts from far away.
My path and my measuring line you traced out, and all my ways you foresaw.
Because no word on my tongue—
behold, Lord, you knew all last things and first things; you formed me and laid your hand upon me.
Your knowledge made wondrous beyond me; it grew strong; I will not be able toward it.
Where should I go from your spirit, and where should I flee from your face?
If I go up into heaven, you there; if I go down into Hades, present.
If I take up my wings at dawn and dwell in uttermost parts of sea,
even there your hand will guide me and your right hand will hold me fast.
And I said, "Then darkness will trample me," yet night illumination in my delight.
Because darkness will not be darkened from you, and night will be lit as day; as its darkness, so also its light.
Because you acquired my inward parts, Lord; you took hold of me from my mother's womb.
I will give thanks to you because fearfully I was made wondrous; wondrous your works, and my soul knows very much.
My bone not hidden from you, which you made in secret, and my substance in lowest parts of earth.
Your eyes saw my unformed thing, and in your book all will be written; days will be formed, and no one among them.
To me your friends, God, were greatly honored; their chief ones grew very strong.
I will number them, and beyond sand they will multiply; I awoke, and still I am with you.
If only you would kill sinners, God; men of blood, turn aside from me.
Because they speak of you for scheming; they will take your cities in vain.
Did I not hate those hating you, Lord, and waste away over your enemies?
With perfect hatred I hated them; they became enemies to me.
Test me, God, and know my heart; examine me and know my paths.
And see if way of lawlessness in me, and guide me in age-lasting way.
For end. Psalm of David.
Rescue me, Lord, from evil man; from unjust man deliver me.
Who devised injustices in heart; whole day they arrayed wars.
They sharpened their tongue like serpent; venom of asps under their lips. Selah.
Guard me, Lord, from hand of sinner; from unjust men deliver me, who devised to trip my steps.
Proud ones hid snare for me and stretched ropes; traps for my feet, beside path they set stumbling block for me. Selah.
I said to Lord, "My God you." Give ear, Lord, to voice of my supplication.
Lord, Lord, strength of my salvation, you overshadowed over my head in day of war.
Do not give me over, Lord, from my desire to sinner; they schemed against me; do not abandon me, lest they be exalted. Selah.
Head of their encirclement—labor of their lips will cover them.
Coals will fall upon them; in fire you will cast them down, in miseries they will not withstand.
Tongue-man will not be directed on earth; evil will hunt unjust man into destruction.
I knew Lord will do judgment of poor one and justice of needy.
Yet righteous will give thanks to your name, and upright will dwell with your face.
Psalm of David. Lord, I cried to you; hear me. Attend to voice of my supplication when I cry to you.
Let my prayer be set straight as incense before you, lifting up of my hands evening sacrifice.
Set guard, Lord, for my mouth, and door of enclosure around my lips.
Do not incline my heart to words of evil, to make excuses of excuses in sins with men working lawlessness, and I will not join with their chosen ones.
Righteous will instruct me in mercy and reprove me, but oil of sinner may it not fatten my head; because still my prayer against their pleasures.
Their judges were swallowed up beside rock; they will hear my words because they were pleasant.
Like thickness of earth broken up upon ground, our bones were scattered beside Hades.
Because toward you, Lord, Lord, my eyes; in you I hoped; do not take away my soul.
Guard me from snare they set together for me and from stumbling blocks of workers of lawlessness.
Sinners will fall in his net; alone I am until I pass by.
Of understanding. Of David, when he was in cave. Prayer.
With my voice to Lord I cried; with my voice to Lord I made supplication.
I pour out before him my supplication; my affliction before him I declare.
When my spirit was failing from me, then you knew my paths. In this way where I walked, they hid snare for me.
I was looking to right and watching, and there was none knowing me; flight perished from me, and none seeking my soul.
I cried to you, Lord; I said, "You my hope, my portion in land of living."
Attend to my supplication, because I was greatly humbled; rescue me from those pursuing me, because they grew stronger than I.
Bring my soul out from prison to give thanks to your name, Lord. Righteous will wait for me until you repay me.
Psalm of David, when son pursued him. Lord, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplication in your truth; hear me in your righteousness.
And do not enter into judgment with your servant, because no living one will be justified before you.
Because enemy pursued my soul; he humbled my life to earth; he seated me in dark places like dead of age.
And my spirit grew weary upon me; within me my heart troubled.
I remembered ancient days and meditated on all your works; in works of your hands I kept meditating.
I spread out my hands to you; my soul as waterless land to you. Selah.
Quickly hear me, Lord; my spirit failed. Do not turn away your face from me, and I will be likened to those going down into pit.
Make your mercy heard to me in morning, because on you I hoped. Make known to me, Lord, way in which I should walk, because to you I lifted my soul.
Rescue me from my enemies, Lord, because to you I fled.
Teach me to do your will, because you my God. Your good spirit will guide me in straight land.
For sake of your name, Lord, you will make me live; in your righteousness you will bring my soul out from affliction.
And in your mercy you will utterly destroy my enemies and destroy all afflicting my soul, because I your servant.
Of David, against Goliath. Blessed Lord my God, teaching my hands for battle, my fingers for war.
My mercy and my refuge, my helper and my deliverer, my protector, and on him I hoped, one subduing my people under me.
Lord, what man that you became known to him, or son of man that you count him?
Man was likened to vanity; his days like passing shadow.
Lord, bend your heavens and come down; touch mountains and they will smoke.
Flash lightning and you will scatter them; send out your arrows and you will throw them into confusion.
Send out your hand from height; rescue me and deliver me from many waters, from hand of foreign sons,
whose mouth spoke vanity and their right hand right hand of injustice.
God, I will sing new song to you; on ten-stringed psaltery I will sing psalms to you.
To one giving salvation to kings, to one redeeming David his servant from evil sword.
Rescue me and deliver me from hand of foreign sons, whose mouth spoke vanity and their right hand right hand of injustice.
Whose sons like young shoots established in their youth; their daughters beautified, adorned like likeness of temple.
Their storehouses full, pouring out from this into that; their sheep many-bearing, multiplying in their outings.
Their oxen fat; no breach of wall, no passing out, no outcry in their squares.
They called blessed people to whom these things belong; blessed people whose Lord their God.
Praise of David. I will exalt you, my God, my king, and bless your name forever and forever of age.
Each day I will bless you and praise your name forever and forever of age.
Great Lord and greatly praiseworthy, and of his greatness no end.
Generation and generation will praise your works, and they will declare your power.
They will speak of magnificence of glory of your holiness, and they will relate your wonders.
They will speak of power of your fearful deeds, and they will recount your greatness.
They will pour forth memory of abundance of your kindness, and exult in your righteousness.
Compassionate and merciful Lord, long-suffering and very merciful.
Lord kind to all, and his compassions over all his works.
Let all your works give thanks to you, Lord, and let your holy ones bless you.
They will speak glory of your kingdom and tell of your dominion,
to make known to sons of men your dominion and glory of magnificence of your kingdom.
Your kingdom kingdom of all ages, and your lordship in every generation and generation. Faithful Lord in his words and holy in all his works.
Lord supports all falling and straightens all crushed down.
Eyes of all hope in you, and you give their food in season.
You open your hand and fill every living thing with favor.
Lord righteous in all his ways and holy in all his works.
Lord near to all calling upon him, to all calling upon him in truth.
He will do desire of those fearing him, and he will hear their supplication and save them.
Lord guards all loving him, and all sinners he will destroy.
Praise of Lord my mouth will speak, and let all flesh bless his holy name forever and forever of age.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise Lord, my soul.
I will praise Lord in my life; I will sing psalms to my God while I exist.
Do not trust in rulers and in sons of men, in whom no salvation.
His spirit will go out and he will return to his earth; in that day all their plans will perish.
Blessed whose helper God of Jacob, his hope upon Lord his God.
Who made heaven and earth, sea and all in them, one keeping truth forever.
Doing judgment for wronged ones, giving food to hungry; Lord frees chained ones.
Lord straightens crushed ones; Lord makes blind ones wise; Lord loves righteous.
Lord guards sojourners; orphan and widow he will take up, and way of sinners he will destroy.
Lord will reign forever, your God, Zion, to generation and generation.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise Lord, because psalm to our God good; let praise be sweet.
Lord building Jerusalem and gathering dispersions of Israel.
Healing crushed in heart and binding up their fractures.
Numbering multitudes of stars and calling all them by names.
Great our Lord and great his strength, and of his understanding no number.
Lord lifting up meek ones and humbling sinners to ground.
Begin with thanksgiving to Lord; sing psalms to our God on lyre.
To one clothing heaven with clouds, preparing rain for earth, making grass spring up on mountains and green growth for service of men.
Giving beasts their food and young ravens calling on him.
Not in strength of horse will he desire, nor in legs of man does he delight.
Lord delights in those fearing him and hoping upon his mercy.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise, Jerusalem, Lord; praise your God, Zion.
Because he strengthened bars of your gates; he blessed your sons in you.
One making your borders peace and filling you with fat of wheat.
One sending his saying to earth; with speed his word will run.
One giving snow like wool, scattering mist like ashes.
Throwing his ice like morsels; before his cold who will stand?
He will send his word and melt them; his spirit will blow and waters will flow.
Declaring his word to Jacob, his statutes and judgments to Israel.
He did not do thus to every nation, and his judgments he did not show to them.
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise Lord from heavens; praise him in highest places.
Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his powers.
Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all stars and light.
Praise him, heavens of heavens, and water above heavens.
Let them praise name of Lord, because he spoke and they came to be; he commanded and they were created.
He established them forever and forever of age; ordinance he set, and it will not pass away.
Praise Lord from earth, dragons and all deeps.
Fire, hail, snow, ice, spirit of storm, things doing his word.
Mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars.
Wild beasts and all cattle, creeping things and winged birds.
Kings of earth and all peoples, rulers and all judges of earth.
Young men and virgins, elders with younger ones.
Let them praise name of Lord, because his name alone was exalted; his praise upon earth and heaven.
And he will exalt horn of his people, hymn for all his holy ones, sons of Israel, people drawing near to him.
Hallelujah. Sing to Lord new song; his praise in assembly of holy ones.
Let Israel rejoice over one making him, and sons of Zion exult over their king.
Let them praise his name in dance; with tambourine and psaltery let them sing psalms to him.
Because Lord delights in his people and will exalt meek ones in salvation.
Holy ones will boast in glory and exult on their beds.
Exaltations of God in their throat and two-edged swords in their hands,
to do vengeance among nations, reproofs among peoples,
to bind their kings in fetters and their glorious ones in iron handcuffs,
to do among them judgment written. This glory for all his holy ones.
Hallelujah. Praise God in his holy ones; praise him in firmament of his power.
Praise him for his dominions; praise him according to multitude of his greatness.
Praise him in sound of trumpet; praise him in psaltery and lyre.
Praise him in tambourine and dance; praise him in strings and instrument.
Praise him in clear-sounding cymbals; praise him in cymbals of shout.
Every breath let it praise Lord. Hallelujah.
Proverbs of Solomon son of David, who reigned in Israel.
To know wisdom and discipline, and to understand words of insight.
To receive turnings of words, and to understand true righteousness and judgment, and to direct judgment.
So that I may give shrewdness to innocent ones, and to child, young perception and understanding.
For hearing these, wise will become wiser, and understanding man will acquire guidance.
And he will understand proverb and dark saying, sayings of wise and riddles.
Beginning of wisdom fear of God; good understanding for all doing it; piety toward God beginning of perception, but wisdom and discipline ungodly will despise.
Hear, son, discipline of your father, and do not reject decrees of your mother.
For you will receive crown of graces for your head and golden chain around your neck.
Son, let ungodly men not lead you astray, nor be willing if they urge you, saying,
"Come with us, share blood; let us hide in earth righteous man unjustly.
Let us swallow him alive like Hades, and lift his memory from earth.
Let us seize his costly possession and fill our houses with spoils.
Throw your lot in among us; let us all get common purse, and let one pouch be among us."
Do not go in way with them; turn your foot away from their tracks.
For their feet run to evil and swift to pour out blood.
For not for nothing are nets spread for winged creatures.
For these sharing in murder store up evils for themselves, and destruction of lawless men evil.
These ways of all carrying out lawless things, for by ungodliness they take away their own soul.
Wisdom hymns in exits, and in broad places she leads boldness.
Upon heights of walls she is proclaimed, and beside gates of rulers she sits, and beside gates of city, speaking boldly, says,
"As long as innocent ones hold to righteousness, they will not be shamed; but fools, being desirers of insolence, becoming ungodly, hated perception.
And they became liable to rebukes. Behold, I will bring forth for you utterance of my spirit, and teach you my word.
Since I called and you did not heed, and I stretched out words and you did not attend,
but you kept making my counsels invalid, and to my rebukes disobeyed,
therefore I too will laugh at your ruin and rejoice when destruction comes to you,
and when sudden turmoil comes upon you, and downfall comes like storm, and when affliction and siege or destruction comes upon you.
For it will be when you call on me, I will not hear you; evil men will seek me and not find.
For they hated wisdom, and fear of Lord they did not choose.
Nor were they willing to heed my counsels, and they sneered at my rebukes.
Therefore they will eat fruits of their own way and be filled from their own ungodliness.
For because they wronged simple ones, they will be killed, and scrutiny destroys ungodly.
But one hearing me will settle in hope and rest fearless from every evil."
Son, if receiving saying of my command you hide it with yourself,
your ear will obey wisdom, and you will apply your heart to understanding; yes, apply it as admonition for your son.
For if you call on wisdom and give your voice to understanding, and seek perception with loud voice,
and if you seek it like silver and search it out like treasures,
then you will understand fear of Lord and find knowledge of God.
Because Lord gives wisdom, and from his face knowledge and understanding.
And he treasures up salvation for those walking straight; he will shield their journey,
to guard ways of ordinances, and he will preserve way of those revering him.
Then you will understand righteousness and judgment, and you will straighten all good tracks.
For if wisdom comes into your mind and perception seems good to your soul,
good counsel will guard you, and holy thought will keep you,
to rescue you from evil way and from man speaking nothing trustworthy,
those abandoning straight ways to walk in ways of darkness,
those rejoicing over evils and delighting in evil perversity,
whose tracks crooked and their paths bent,
to make you far from straight way and alien to righteous judgment.
Son, let evil counsel not overtake you, that which leaves teaching of youth and has forgotten divine covenant.
For she set her house beside death, and her tracks beside Hades with earthborn men.
All going in to her will not return, nor ever catch straight paths, for they are not seized by years of life.
For if they had walked paths of good, they would have found smooth tracks of righteousness.
Good ones will be inhabitants of earth, and innocent ones remain in it, for straight ones will settle in earth and holy ones remain in it.
Ways of ungodly will perish from earth, and lawless men will be thrust out from it.
Son, do not forget my laws, and let your heart keep my sayings.
For length of life and years of life and peace they will add to you.
Acts of mercy and faithfulness let them not fail you; fasten them on your neck, and you will find favor.
And plan good things before Lord and men.
Be trusting with whole heart in God, and do not exalt yourself on your own wisdom.
In all your ways know her, so that she may cut straight your ways, and your foot will not stumble.
Do not be wise with yourself; fear God and turn from every evil.
Then healing to your body and care to your bones.
Honor Lord from your righteous labors and offer firstfruits to him from fruits of your righteousness.
So your storehouses may be filled with fullness of grain, and your wine vats gush wine.
Son, do not regard lightly discipline of Lord, nor faint when reproved by him.
For whom Lord loves he disciplines, and he scourges every son whom he receives.
Blessed man who found wisdom, and mortal who saw understanding.
For to trade in her better than treasures of gold and silver.
And she more valuable than precious stones; no evil thing will oppose her; she known by all drawing near to her, and every precious thing unworthy of her.
For length of life and years of life are in her right hand; in her left are riches and glory. From her mouth comes righteousness, and law and mercy she carries on her tongue.
Her ways good ways, and all her tracks in peace.
Tree of life to all holding fast to her, and to those leaning upon her as on Lord, secure.
God founded earth by wisdom and prepared heavens by understanding.
By perception deeps burst open, and clouds trickled dew.
Son, do not drift away; keep my counsel and thought,
so that your soul may live and grace be around your neck. And there will be healing for your flesh and care for your bones.
So that you may walk confidently in peace all your ways, and your foot will not stumble.
For if you sit, you will be fearless; if you sleep, you will sleep sweetly.
And you will not fear terror coming, nor assaults of ungodly when they come.
For Lord will be over all your ways and brace your foot so that it not be shaken.
Do not withhold doing good to needy when your hand has power to help.
Do not say, "Go, return, and tomorrow I will give," when you can do good, for you do not know what next day will bring forth.
Do not contrive evils against your friend living nearby and trusting in you.
Do not love strife with man for nothing, lest he work some evil against you.
Do not gain reproaches of evil men, nor envy their ways.
For every lawless man unclean before Lord, and among righteous he does not sit in council.
Curse of God in houses of ungodly, but dwellings of righteous are blessed.
Lord opposes proud, but to humble he gives grace.
Wise will inherit glory, but ungodly exalt dishonor.
Hear, children, discipline of father, and pay attention to know understanding.
For I give you good gift; do not forsake my law.
For I also became son to my father, obedient and loved before my mother.
They were saying and teaching me, "Let our word rest in your heart.
Keep commandments, do not forget, nor disregard sayings of my mouth.
Do not abandon her, and she will hold you; love her and she will keep you.
Enclose her round about, and she will exalt you; honor her, so that she may embrace you.
So that she may give your head crown of graces, and with crown of delight defend you.
Hear, son, and receive my words, and years of your life will multiply, so that many ways of life may belong to you.
For I teach you ways of wisdom and set you on straight tracks.
For when you walk, your steps will not be confined; and if you run, you will not grow weary.
Take hold of my discipline; do not let go, but guard it for yourself as your life.
Do not go upon ways of ungodly, nor envy ways of lawless men.
Wherever they camp, do not go there; turn aside from them and pass on.
For they will not sleep unless they do evil; sleep is taken from them, and they do not lie down.
For these feed on breads of ungodliness and get drunk on lawless wine.
Ways of righteous like shining light; they go before and give light until day is fully set right.
But ways of ungodly dark; they do not know how they stumble.
Son, pay attention to my saying; incline your ear to my words,
so that your springs may not fail you; guard them in your heart.
For they are life to those finding them and healing to all flesh.
With every guarding keep your heart, for out of these are goings-out of life.
Remove crooked mouth from yourself, and put unjust lips far from you.
Let your eyes look straight, and your eyelids nod what is right.
Make straight tracks for your feet and direct your ways.
Do not turn right or left, but turn your foot away from evil way. For God knows ways on right, but those on left twisted; he will make your tracks straight and advance your journeys in peace.
Son, pay attention to my wisdom, and incline your ear to my words,
so that you may guard good thought; and perception of my lips I command you.
Do not pay attention to base woman, for honey drips from lips of prostitute, who for a time fattens your throat.
Yet afterward you will find her more bitter than gall and sharper than two-edged sword.
For feet of folly bring those using her down with death into Hades, and her steps do not stand firm.
For she does not go upon ways of life, and her tracks slippery and not well known.
Now then, son, hear me and do not make my words invalid.
Make your way far from her; do not come near doors of her houses,
lest you give your life to others and your livelihood to unmerciful men,
lest strangers be filled with your strength and your labors enter houses of strangers,
and you will regret at end when flesh of your body is worn away.
And you will say, "How I hated discipline, and my heart turned away from reproofs.
I was not hearing voice of one disciplining me and teaching me, nor inclining my ear.
I almost came into every evil in midst of assembly and congregation."
Drink waters from your vessels and from wells of your spring.
Let not waters overflow for you from your spring; let your waters pass through your broad places.
Let them be yours alone, and let no stranger share with you.
Let fountain of your water be your own, and rejoice with wife of your youth.
Doe of love and colt of your graces, let her converse with you; let your own lead you and be with you at all times, for in companionship with her love you will be much.
Do not be much with strange woman, nor be held in arms of one not your own.
For ways of man before eyes of God, and he watches all his tracks.
Lawless deeds hunt man down, and each is bound with cords of his own sins.
This one dies with undisciplined men, and from abundance of his own livelihood is cast out and lost through folly.
Son, if you guarantee your friend, you hand your hand over to enemy.
For own lips strong snare for man, and he is caught by lips of his own mouth.
Do, son, what I command you, and save yourself, for you came into hands of evil men through your friend. Go, do not grow slack, but press your friend whom you guaranteed.
Do not give sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids,
that you may save yourself like gazelle from snares and like bird from trap.
Go to ant, sluggard, and watch his ways and become wiser than he.
For since he has no farming, no one forcing him, nor being under master,

he prepares in summer much food and in harvest makes provision. Or go to bee and learn how worker she is and how dignified she makes her work, whose labors kings and private men use for health. She desired by all and renowned. Though weak in strength, by honoring wisdom she advanced.
How long, sluggard, will you lie down? When will you rise from sleep?
Little you sleep, little you sit, little you slumber, little you fold your hands over your chest,
then poverty comes to you like bad traveler and want like good runner. But if you are tireless, your harvest will come like fountain, and want will flee like bad runner.
Foolish and lawless man walks in ways not good.
He winks with eye, signals with foot, and teaches with nods of fingers.
Perverse heart devises evils at every time; such man stirs up disturbances for city.
Because of this his ruin comes suddenly, cutting and crushing incurably.
For he rejoices in all things Lord hates, and he is crushed because of uncleanness of soul.
Haughty eye, unjust tongue, hands pouring out blood of righteous,
and heart forging evil thoughts, and feet hurrying to do evil,
unjust false witness kindling lies and sending judgments among brothers.
Son, keep laws of your father and do not reject decrees of your mother.
Fasten them to your soul always and put them as chain on your neck.
Whenever you walk, bring her on, and let her be with you; when you sleep, let her guard you, so that waking she may speak with you.
For command of law lamp and light, and way of life reproof and discipline,
to guard you from married woman and from slanderous tongue of stranger.
Let not beauty conquer you in desire, nor be caught by your eyes, nor be seized by her eyelids.
For price of prostitute as much as one loaf, but wife of honored men hunts precious souls.
Will anyone bind fire in bosom and not burn clothes?
Or will anyone walk on coals of fire and not burn feet?
So one going in to married woman will not be acquitted, nor anyone touching her.
Not astonishing if one is caught stealing, for he steals to fill soul when hungry.
But if caught, he will pay sevenfold, and by giving all his possessions he will rescue himself.
But adulterer, through lack of sense, works destruction for his soul.
Pains and dishonor he bears, and his reproach will not be wiped out forever.
For jealousy fills wrath of her husband; he will not spare in day of judgment.
He will not accept any ransom against enmity, nor be reconciled by many gifts.
Son, keep my words, and hide my commands with yourself. Son, honor Lord and you will grow strong; besides him fear no other.
Keep my commands and live, and my words like apple of eyes.
Bind them on your fingers, and write them on breadth of your heart.
Say wisdom your sister, and make understanding your close acquaintance,
that she may keep you from strange and evil woman if she throw herself at you with winning words.
For from little window of her house, peering into streets,
whomever she sees among foolish children, young man lacking sense,
passing near corner, in passages of her house,
and speaking in evening darkness, when nightly quiet or murky gloom,
woman meets him, having appearance of prostitute, who makes hearts of young men fly away.
She winged and profligate, and in house her feet do not keep quiet.
For a time she wanders outside, and a time in squares; beside every corner she lurks.
Then seizing him she kissed him, and with shameless face said to him,
"Peace-sacrifice mine; today I pay my vows.
Because of this I came out to meet you, desiring your face; I found you.
With coverings I decked my bed, and with Egyptian tapestries I spread it.
I sprinkled my couch with saffron, and my house with cinnamon.
Come, let us enjoy love until dawn; come, let us roll in desire.
For my husband not home, but he has gone long way.
Taking bundle of silver in his hand; after many days he will return to his house."
She led him astray with much talk, and with snares from lips she pushed him over.
He followed her dumbfounded, as ox led to slaughter and as dog to bonds,
or as deer struck in liver by arrow. He hurries like bird into snare, not knowing he runs for soul.
Now then, son, hear me and pay attention to sayings of my mouth.
Let your heart not turn aside to her ways.
For having wounded many, she cast them down, and innumerable those she killed.
Ways of Hades her house, leading down to chambers of death.
You will proclaim wisdom, so that understanding may obey you.
For she is on high heights, and among paths she stands.
For beside gates of rulers she sits, and in entrances she sings hymns.
To you, men, I call, and I send out my voice to sons of men.
Understand shrewdness, innocent ones; and untrained ones, take heart.
Hear me, for I will speak noble things, and I will open upright things from my lips.
For my throat will meditate truth, and lying lips abominable before me.
All sayings of my mouth with righteousness; nothing in them crooked or twisted.
All plain to those understanding and right to those finding knowledge.
Take discipline and not silver, and choose knowledge above proven gold; and choose perception above pure gold.
For wisdom better than precious stones, and every valuable thing not worthy of her.
I, wisdom, settled counsel, and knowledge and understanding I called.
Fear of Lord hates injustice and insolence and pride and evil ways; and twisted ways of evil I hated.
Mine counsel and security, mine understanding, and mine strength.
Through me kings reign and rulers write righteousness.
Through me nobles grow great, and tyrants through me rule earth.
I love those loving me, and those seeking me will find me.
Riches and glory belong to me, and abundance of possessions and righteousness.
Better to bear fruit from me than gold and precious stone, and my produce better than chosen silver.
In ways of righteousness I walk, and among tracks of judgment I turn about,
so that I may apportion substance to those loving me and fill their treasuries with good things. If I tell you things happening day by day, I will remember things from age to number them.
Lord created me beginning of his ways, for his works.
Before age he founded me, in beginning,
before making earth and before making deeps, before springs of waters came forth.
Before mountains were settled, and before all hills, he begets me.
Lord made lands and uninhabited places and inhabited heights under heaven.
When he prepared heaven, I was alongside him, and when he marked out his throne upon winds,
when he made strong upper clouds and set secure springs under heaven,
and made strong foundations of earth,
I was beside him, fitting together. I was one in whom he delighted, and day by day I rejoiced before him at every time,
when he rejoiced, having completed inhabited world, and rejoiced in sons of men.
Now then, son, hear me.
Blessed man who will hear me, and man who will keep my ways, staying awake at my doors daily, keeping posts of my entrances.
For my goings-out goings-out of life, and favor is prepared from Lord.
But those sinning against me act ungodly toward their own souls, and those hating me love death.
Wisdom built house for herself and set seven pillars under it.
She slaughtered her sacrifices, mixed her wine into bowl, and prepared her table.
She sent her servants, calling with high proclamation upon bowl, saying,
"Whoever foolish, let him turn aside to me." And to those lacking sense she said,
"Come, eat of my breads and drink wine I mixed for you.
Leave folly and live, and seek understanding so that you may live, and set straight by knowledge understanding.
One disciplining evil men will receive dishonor for himself, and rebuking ungodly will blame himself.
Do not rebuke evil men, lest they hate you; rebuke wise, and he will love you.
Give wise one opportunity, and he will become wiser; make righteous man know, and he will add to receiving.
Beginning of wisdom fear of Lord, and counsel of holy ones understanding. For knowing law belongs to good mind.
For by this way you will live long time, and years of your life will be added.

Son, if you become wise, for yourself you will be wise and for neighbors; but if you become evil, alone you will draw out evils. One leaning on lies pastures winds, and pursues flying birds. For he left ways of his own vineyard and wandered from tracks of his own field; he passes through waterless desert and land appointed in thirsty places, and gathers barrenness with hands.
Foolish and bold woman, lacking bread, becomes one who does not know shame.
She sat at doors of her house on chair openly in squares,
calling those passing by and going straight in their ways,
"Who among you most foolish? Let him turn aside to me." And to those lacking sense I exhort, saying,
"Touch hidden breads pleasantly and sweet water of theft."

But he does not know that earthborn men perish beside her, and he meets floor of Hades. But spring away; do not delay in place, nor set your eye toward her. For thus you will cross foreign water and pass over foreign river. Hold back from foreign water and do not drink from foreign spring, so that you may live long time and years of life be added.
Wise son gladdens father, but foolish son grief to mother.
Treasures will not benefit lawless men, but righteousness will rescue from death.
Lord will not starve righteous soul, but life of ungodly he will overthrow.
Poverty humbles man, but hands of brave men make rich. Disciplined son will be wise, but to foolish servant he will make use.
Understanding son saved from heat, but lawless son becomes wind-blasted in harvest.
Blessing of Lord upon head of righteous, but mouth of ungodly will cover untimely grief.
Memory of righteous with praises, but name of ungodly is quenched.
Wise in heart will receive commands, but roofless one twisting with lips will be tripped up.
One walking simply walks confidently, but one twisting his ways will be known.
One winking eyes with deceit gathers griefs for men, but one rebuking with boldness makes peace.
Fountain of life in hand of righteous, but mouth of ungodly will cover destruction.
Hatred stirs strife, but friendship covers all not loving strife.
One bringing forth wisdom from lips strikes heartless man with rod.
Wise hide perception, but mouth of rash approaches ruin.
Possession of rich strong city, but ruin of ungodly poverty.
Works of righteous produce life, but fruits of ungodly sins.
Discipline guards ways of righteous life, but discipline without correction leads astray.
Righteous lips cover enmity, but those bringing out slanders are very foolish.
In much speech you will not escape sin, but sparing lips you will be understanding.
Refined silver tongue of righteous, but heart of ungodly will fail.
Lips of righteous know high things, but fools die in want.
Blessing of Lord upon head of righteous, it makes rich, and grief in heart will not be added to it.
In laughter fool practices evil things, but wisdom bears understanding for man.
Ungodly is carried about in destruction, but desire of righteous acceptable.
When storm passes by, ungodly vanishes, but righteous turning aside is saved forever.
Like sour grape to teeth and smoke to eyes, so lawlessness to those using it.
Fear of Lord adds days, but years of ungodly will be shortened.
Joy lingers for righteous, but hope of ungodly perishes.
Fear of Lord fortress of holy one, but ruin to workers of evil.
Righteous forever will not give way, but ungodly will not inhabit earth.
Mouth of righteous drips wisdom, but tongue of unjust will perish.
Lips of righteous men drip graces, but mouth of ungodly turns aside.
Deceitful scales abomination before Lord, but just weight acceptable to him.
Wherever insolence enters, there also dishonor; but mouth of humble meditates wisdom.
When righteous dies, he leaves regret, but destruction of ungodly comes readily and gladly.
Righteousness of blameless cuts straight ways; but ungodliness falls by injustice.
Righteousness of upright rescues them, but lawless are caught by their own destruction.
When righteous man dies, hope does not perish, but boast of ungodly perishes.
Righteous escapes from trap, and ungodly is handed over in his place.
In mouth of ungodly snare to citizens, but perception of righteous good way.
In good things of righteous city prospered.
But by mouths of ungodly it was torn down.
One lacking sense sneers at citizens, but prudent man leads quietness.
Double-tongued man reveals counsels in council, but faithful breath hides matters.
Those without guidance fall like leaves, but salvation exists in much counsel.
Evil man does evil when he joins himself to righteous, but hates sound of security.
Pleasant woman raises glory for husband, but woman hating righteousness throne of dishonor. Sluggards become needy, but brave men are supported by wealth.
Merciful man does good to his own soul, but pitiless man destroys his own body.
Ungodly one does unjust works, but for seed of righteous ones there is reward of truth.
Righteous son is born for life, but pursuit of ungodly for death.
Crooked ways abomination to Lord, but blameless in their ways acceptable to him.
Hand joining hands unjustly will not go unpunished, but one sowing righteousness will receive faithful reward.
Like earring in nose of swine, so beauty in evil-minded woman.
Desire of righteous altogether good, but hope of ungodly will perish.
There are those sowing their own things and making them more; there are also those gathering yet becoming less.
Blessed soul, every simple one; but hot-tempered man unseemly.
One withholding grain, may peoples leave him behind, but blessing upon head of one sharing.
One devising good seeks good favor, but one seeking evils will be overtaken by them.
One trusting in wealth will fall, but one helping righteous will spring up.
One not living well with his own house will inherit wind, and fool will serve wise.
From fruit of righteousness grows tree of life, but untimely souls of lawless are taken away.
If righteous scarcely saved, ungodly and sinner where will appear?
One loving discipline loves perception, but one hating rebukes fool.
Better man finding favor from Lord, but lawless man will be silenced.
Man will not prosper from lawless thing, but roots of righteous will not be pulled up.
Brave wife crown to her husband, but evil-working wife like worm in wood destroys man.
Thoughts of righteous judgments, but ungodly govern deceits.
Words of ungodly deceitful, but mouth of upright will rescue them.
Whenever ungodly turn, they vanish, but houses of righteous remain.
Mouth of understanding praised by man, but slack-hearted mocked.
Better man in dishonor serving himself than one putting honor round himself and lacking bread.
Righteous pities souls of his cattle, but inward parts of ungodly pitiless.
One working his own land will be filled with breads, but those pursuing empty things lack sense. One sweet in wine-parties will leave dishonor in his strongholds.
Desires of ungodly evil, but roots of pious in strongholds.
Through sin of lips a sinner falls into a snare, but a righteous one escapes from them. One whose looks are gentle will receive mercy, but one contending in the gates will afflict souls.
From fruits of mouth soul of man will be filled with goods, and reward of his lips will be given him.
Ways of fools right before themselves, but wise listens to counsels.
Fool same day announces his anger, but shrewd hides his own shame.
Righteous openly displays faith, but witness of injustices deceitful.
There are speakers wounding like sword, but tongues of wise heal.
Truthful lips set straight witness, but hasty witness has unjust tongue.
Deceit in heart of one devising evils, but those willing peace will rejoice.
Nothing unjust will please righteous, but ungodly will be filled with evils.
Lying lips abomination to Lord, but one doing faithfulness acceptable to him.
Understanding man throne of perception, but heart of fools will meet curses.
Hand of choice ones will rule easily, but deceitful will be for plunder.
Fearful word troubles heart of righteous man, but good message gladdens him.
Knowing righteous will be his own friend, but counsels of ungodly harsh. Evil will pursue sinners, but way of ungodly will mislead them.
Deceitful man will not obtain game, but precious possession pure man.
In ways of righteousness life, but ways of the resentful to death.
Shrewd son obedient to father, but disobedient son in destruction.
From fruits of righteousness good man will eat, but souls of lawless perish untimely.
One guarding own mouth keeps own soul, but rash in lips will terrify himself.
Every idle man lives in desires, but hands of brave in diligence.
Righteous hates unjust word, but ungodly will be shamed and have no boldness.
Righteousness guards innocent, but sin makes ungodly base.
There are those making themselves rich while having nothing, and there are those humbling themselves in much wealth.
Ransom of man's soul his own wealth, but poor does not endure threat.
Light for righteous always, but light of ungodly is quenched. Deceitful souls wander in sins, but righteous show compassion and mercy.
Evil man with insolence works evils, but those knowing themselves wise.
Possession hurried with lawlessness becomes less, but one gathering for himself with piety will be multiplied. Righteous pities and lends.
Better one beginning to help from heart than one promising and leading into hope, for good desire tree of life.

One despising matter will be despised by it, but one fearing command will be made sound. Deceitful son will have nothing good, but to wise servant actions will prosper and his way will be made straight.
Law of wise fountain of life, but senseless man will die from snare.
Good understanding gives favor, and knowing law belongs to good mind, but ways of despisers in destruction.
Every shrewd man acts with knowledge, but fool spreads out his own evil.
Bold king will fall into evils, but faithful messenger will deliver him.
Discipline removes poverty and dishonor, but one keeping reproofs will be glorified.
Desires of godly sweeten soul, but works of ungodly far from knowledge.
One walking with wise will be wise, but one walking with fools will be known.
Evil will pursue sinners, but goods will overtake righteous.
Good man will inherit sons of sons, but wealth of ungodly stored up for righteous.
Righteous will make many years in wealth, but unjust will be destroyed quickly.
One sparing rod hates his son, but one loving disciplines diligently.
Righteous eating fills his soul, but souls of ungodly needy.
Wise women built houses, but foolish woman tore hers down with her own hands.
One walking upright fears Lord, but one twisting his ways will be dishonored.
From mouth of fools rod of insolence, but lips of wise will guard them.
Where no oxen, stalls clean, but much produce manifest in strength of ox.
Faithful witness does not lie, but unjust witness kindles lies.
You will seek wisdom among evil men and not find it, but perception easy with prudent.
All things contrary to foolish man, but lips of wise weapons of perception.
Wisdom of shrewd will know their ways, but folly of fools in wandering.
Houses of lawless will owe cleansing, but houses of righteous acceptable.
Heart of perceptive man knows grief of its own soul, and when it rejoices it does not mix with insolence.
Houses of ungodly will vanish, but tents of those setting straight will stand.
There is way seeming right before men, but its ends come to floor of Hades.
In merriments sorrow not mixed in, but end of joy comes into grief.
Bold-hearted will be filled from his own ways, but good man from his thoughts.
Innocent believes every word, but shrewd comes to second thoughts.
Wise man, fearing, turned away from evil, but fool, trusting himself, mixes with lawless man.
Sharp-tempered man acts without counsel, but prudent man endures much.
Fools inherit evil, but shrewd will hold fast perception.
Evil men will slip before good ones, and ungodly will serve doors of righteous.
Friends will hate poor friend, but friends of rich many.
One dishonoring poor sins, but one showing mercy to poor blessed.
Those wandering devise evils, but mercy and truth devise good. Those devising evils do not know mercy and faithfulness, but acts of mercy and faithfulness belong with devisers of good.
In every careful person there is abundance, but one pleasant and insensitive will be in want.
Crown of wise shrewdness, but occupation of fools evil.
Faithful witness rescues soul from evils, but deceitful one kindles lies.
In fear of Lord hope of strength, and for his children he leaves support.
Command of Lord fountain of life, and it makes one turn aside from snares of death.
In multitude of nation glory of king, but in lack of people crushing of ruler.
Longsuffering man abundant in understanding, but short-souled man strongly foolish.
Gentle man physician of heart, but sensitive heart rottenness of bones.
One slandering poor provokes his Maker, but one honoring him has mercy on poor.
In his evil ungodly will be driven away, but righteous trusting in his own holiness.
In good heart of man wisdom rests, but in heart of fools it is not discerned.
Righteousness exalts nation, but sins diminish tribes.
Understanding servant acceptable to king, and by his good turning he removes dishonor.
Anger destroys even prudent ones, but yielding answer turns away wrath, and grievous word stirs angers.
Tongue of wise knows good things, but mouth of fools will announce evils.
In every place eyes of Lord watch evil ones and good ones.
Healing tongue tree of life, but one sustaining it will be filled with spirit.
Fool sneers discipline of father, but one keeping commands more shrewd.
In abundant righteousness much strength, but ungodly root and branch perish from earth. In houses of righteous much strength, but fruits of ungodly perish.
Lips of wise bound to perception, but hearts of fools unsafe.
Sacrifices of ungodly abomination to Lord, but prayers of those setting straight acceptable to him.
Ways of ungodly abomination to Lord, but one pursuing righteousness he loves.
Discipline of innocent known by passersby, but those hating reproofs die shamefully.
Hades and destruction visible before Lord; how much more hearts of men.
Untrained man will not love those reproving him, nor will he converse with wise.
Of rejoicing heart face blooms, but being in grief it grows downcast.
Upright heart seeks perception, but mouth of untrained will know evils.
All the time eyes of evil ones expect evils, but good ones are at rest continually.
Better little portion with fear of Lord than great treasures with fearlessness.
Better hospitality of vegetables with love and favor than serving of calves with hatred.
Angry man prepares fights, but longsuffering man calms even what is coming. Longsuffering man extinguishes judgments, but ungodly stirs them up more.
Ways of idle paved with thorns, but those of brave made smooth.
Wise son gladdens father, but foolish son sneers at mother.
Ways of mindless man lacking sense, but prudent man walks directing straight.
They postpone plans who do not honor council, but counsel remains in hearts of counselors.
Evil man will not listen to it, nor will he say anything timely and good for public.
Ways of life thoughts of understanding, so that turning aside from Hades he may be saved.
Lord tears down houses of insolent, but he set firm boundary of widow.
Unjust thought abomination to Lord, but sayings of pure ones noble.
Gift-taker destroys himself, but one hating taking of gifts is saved. By acts of mercy and faithfulness sins are cleansed, and by fear of Lord everyone turns from evil.
Hearts of righteous meditate faithfulness, but mouth of ungodly answers evils. Ways of righteous men acceptable to Lord, and through them even enemies become friends.

God far from ungodly, but prayers of righteous he hears. Better little taking with righteousness than much produce with injustice. Let heart of man reckon righteous things, so that his steps may be corrected by God.
Eye seeing good things gladdens heart, and good report fattens bones.
One rejecting discipline hates himself, but one keeping reproofs loves his soul.
Fear of God discipline and wisdom, and beginning of glory will answer to it.
All works of humble plain before God, but ungodly in evil day will perish.
Every proud in heart unclean before God; joining hand to hand unjustly, he will not go unpunished.
Beginning of good way = doing righteous things, and more acceptable before God than sacrificing sacrifices.
One seeking Lord will find knowledge with righteousness, and those seeking him rightly will find peace.
All works of Lord kept with righteousness, but ungodly kept for evil day.
Oracle upon lips of king; in judgment his mouth will not go astray.
Balance and scale of righteousness from Lord, and all weights his righteous works.
Abomination to king = one doing evil, for throne of rule prepared with righteousness.
Righteous lips acceptable to king, and he loves upright words.
Wrath of king messenger of death, but wise man will appease him.
In light of king's life is son, and those acceptable to him like late cloud.
Nests of wisdom more choice than gold, and nests of understanding more choice than silver.

Paths of life turn away from evils, and ways of righteousness length of life. One receiving discipline will be among good things, and one keeping reproofs will grow wise. One guarding his own ways keeps his own soul, and one loving his life will spare his mouth.
Before crushing goes insolence, and before fall evil-mindedness.
Better gentle with humility than one dividing spoils with insolent men.
Understanding in matters finds good things, and one trusting in God blessed.
Wise and understanding men they call evil, but sweet in speech will hear more.
Thought fountain of life to those having it, but discipline of fools evil.
Heart of wise will understand things from its own mouth, and upon lips it will carry discernment.
Honeycombs = good words, sweetness of them = healing of soul.
There are ways seeming straight to man, yet their ends look into floor of Hades.
Man in pains labors for himself and forces his own destruction, but crooked man carries destruction on his own mouth.
Foolish man digs evils for himself, and on his own lips stores fire.
Crooked man sends around evils, and lamp of deceit kindles among evil men and separates friends.
Lawless man tests friends and leads them on ways not good.
One fixing his eyes plots twisted things and marks out all evils with his lips; this man furnace of evil.
Crown of boasting = old age, and in ways of righteousness it is found.
Better longsuffering man than strong man, and one mastering anger better than one taking city.
Into laps comes everything for unjust men, but all righteous things from Lord.
Better morsel with pleasure in peace than house full of many goods and unjust sacrifices with battle.
Understanding servant will rule foolish masters, and among brothers he will divide portions.
As silver and gold tested in furnace, so hearts chosen by Lord.
Evil man listens to lawless tongue, but righteous man does not heed lying lips.
One mocking poor provokes his Maker, and one rejoicing over one perishing will not go unpunished; but compassionate one will receive mercy.
Crown of old men = children's children, and glory of children = their fathers. Of faithful man whole world wealth; of faithless not even small coin.
Faithful lips do not suit fool, nor lying lips righteous man.
Reward of graces = discipline; wherever it turns, it will prosper.
One hiding wrongs seeks friendship, but one hating to hide separates friends and kin.
Threat shatters heart of prudent, but fool when whipped does not perceive.
Every evil man stirs contradictions, but Lord will send pitiless angel against him.
Anxiety will fall upon understanding man, but fools plot evils.
One repaying evils for good: evils will not be moved from his house.
Authority gives beginning to words of righteousness, but before want comes faction and battle.
One justifying unjust and condemning righteous = unclean and abominable before God.
Why did money come to fool? Heartless man cannot acquire wisdom. One making his house high seeks crushing, and one twisting to learn will fall into evils.
At every time let friend be yours, and brothers useful in necessities; for this reason they are born.
Foolish man claps and rejoices in himself, like one guaranteeing his own friend.
Sin-lover rejoices in fights.
Hard-hearted man will not meet good things; man of shifting tongue will fall into evils.
Heart of fool = pain to one possessing it; father does not rejoice over undisciplined son, but wise son gladdens mother.
Rejoicing heart does good healing, but sorrowful man dries bones.
When taking gifts in bosom unjustly, ways do not prosper; ungodly turns aside ways of righteousness.
Face of understanding man belongs to wise one, but eyes of fool to ends of earth.
Foolish son = anger to father and pain to one bearing him.
To fine righteous man not good, nor holy to plot against righteous rulers.
One sparing to utter hard word = discerning; and longsuffering man = prudent.
When senseless man questioned about wisdom, wisdom will be reckoned to him; and one making himself mute will seem prudent.
Man wanting to separate from friends seeks excuses; at every time he will be worthy of reproach.
One lacking sense has no need of wisdom, for rather he is led by folly.
When ungodly comes into depth of evils, he despises; and dishonor and reproach come upon him.
Deep water = word in heart of man, and river springing up = fountain of life.
To admire face of ungodly not good, nor holy to bend aside righteous in judgment.
Lips of fool lead him into evils, and his bold mouth calls death upon him.
Mouth of fool = ruin to him, and his lips snare to his soul.
Fear casts down sluggards, and souls of unmanned men will hunger.
One not healing himself in his works = brother of one ruining himself.
From greatness of strength, name of Lord; to it righteous running are exalted.
Wealth of rich man = strong city, and its glory overshadows greatly.
Before crushing heart of man is lifted up, and before glory it is humbled.
One answering word before hearing: folly to him and reproach.
Wise servant calms anger of man, but short-souled man who can bear?
Heart of prudent acquires perception, and ears of wise seek understanding.
Gift of man broadens him and seats him beside rulers.
Righteous man accuses himself in first speech, but when opponent comes he is reproved.
Lot stops contradictions and marks bounds among rulers.
Brother helped by brother = strong and high city, and it is strong like founded kingdom.
From fruits of mouth man will fill his belly, and from fruits of his lips he will be filled.
Death and life in hand of tongue, and those mastering it will eat its fruits.
One finding good wife found graces and received cheerfulness from God; one casting out good wife casts out good things, but one keeping adulteress = foolish and ungodly.
Folly of man ruins his ways, yet in his heart he blames God.
Wealth adds many friends, but poor man is deserted even by friend he has.
False witness will not go unpunished, and one accusing unjustly will not escape.
Many court faces of kings, and every evil man becomes reproach to man.

Everyone hating poor brother, even friendships will be far away. Good understanding draws near to those knowing it, and prudent man will find it. One doing much evil accomplishes evil, and one provoking words will not be saved.
One acquiring understanding loves himself, and one keeping understanding will find good things.
