Now I will sing to my beloved song of my beloved concerning my vineyard. Vineyard came to my beloved on hilltop in fertile place.
I put fence around and staked it and planted chosen vine and built tower in midst of it and dug wine-vat in it, and I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.
And now, man of Judah and dwellers in Jerusalem, judge between me and my vineyard.
What shall I still do to my vineyard that I did not do to it? Because I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.
And now I will announce to you what I will do to my vineyard: I will remove its fence and it will be for plundering, and I will pull down its wall and it will be for trampling.
And I will leave my vineyard, and it shall certainly not be pruned nor dug, and thorns will come up upon it as upon wasteland, and I will command clouds not to rain rain on it.
For vineyard of Lord Sabaoth = house of Israel, and man of Judah beloved new planting. I waited for judgment, but it produced lawlessness, and not righteousness but cry.
Woe those joining house to house and bringing field near to field, to take something from neighbor away; will you not dwell alone on land?
For these things were heard in ears of Lord Sabaoth: if many houses shall become, they will be desolate, great and beautiful, and there will not be ones dwelling in them.
For ten yoke of oxen working will produce one jar, and one sowing six artabas will produce three measures.
Woe those rising early and pursuing strong drink, those remaining till late, for wine will burn them together.
For with lyre and psaltery and drums and flutes they drink wine, but works of Lord they do not look on, and works of his hands they do not understand.
Therefore my people became captive because they did not know Lord, and multitude became dead from famine and thirst of water.
And Hades widened its soul and opened its mouth without ceasing, and her glorious ones and great ones and rich ones and her plague-struck ones will go down.
And man will be humbled and male will be dishonored, and lofty eyes will be humbled.
And the Lord Sabaoth will be exalted in judgment, and the Holy God will be glorified in righteousness.
And plundered ones will be grazed as bulls, and lambs will eat deserted places of those taken away.
Woe those drawing sins with long rope and lawlessness as with strap of heifer's yoke,
those saying, Let what he will do come quickly and draw near, that we may see; and let counsel of Holy One of Israel come, that we may know.
Woe those saying evil good and good evil, those putting darkness light and light darkness, those putting bitter sweet and sweet bitter.
Woe those understanding in themselves and knowledgeable before themselves.
Woe your mighty men, drinkers of wine, and rulers mixing strong drink,
those justifying ungodly for gifts and taking away right of righteous.

Therefore as stubble will be burned under coal of fire and be consumed under loose flame, their root will be as down and their blossom will go up as dust, because they did not want law of Lord Sabaoth but provoked oracle of Holy One of Israel.

And Lord Sabaoth was enraged in anger against his people, and he laid his hand on them and struck them and mountains were provoked, and their corpses became as dung in midst of road. In all these his anger did not turn away, but hand still high.
Therefore he will raise signal among nations far off and whistle to them from end of earth, and look, swiftly lightly they come.
They will neither hunger nor grow weary nor grow drowsy nor sleep, nor loosen their belts from their waist, nor will straps of their sandals break.
Whose arrows are sharp and their bows bent; feet of their horses were reckoned as solid rock, wheels of their chariots as storm.
They will rush as lions and stand by as lion's whelp, and will seize and roar as beast and cast out, and there will not be one rescuing.
And it will roar because of them in that day as sound of surging sea, and they will look to land, and look, hard darkness in their distress.
And it happened in year king Uzziah died, I saw Lord sitting on high and lifted throne, and house full of his glory.
And seraphim stood around him; six wings to one and six wings to one; with two they covered face, and with two they covered feet, and with two they flew.
And one cried to another and said, Holy, holy, holy, Lord Sabaoth; whole earth full of his glory.
And lintel was raised from voice with which they cried, and house was filled with smoke.
And I said, O wretched me, because I am pierced to heart, because being man and having unclean lips and dwelling in midst of people having unclean lips, I saw king Lord Sabaoth with my eyes.
And one of seraphim was sent to me, and in hand he had coal which he took with tongs from altar.
And he touched my mouth and said, Behold, this touched your lips, and it will take away your lawlessness and cleanse your sins.
And I heard voice of Lord saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, I am here; send me.
And he said, Go and say to this people: hearing you will hear and certainly not understand, and looking you will look and certainly not see.
For heart of this people grew fat, and with their ears they heard heavily, and their eyes they closed, lest they see with eyes and hear with ears and understand with heart and turn, and I heal them.
And I said, Until when, Lord? And he said, Until cities are made desolate from not being inhabited, and houses from not having men, and land will be left desolate.
And after these things God will send men far away, and those left behind will multiply on earth.
And yet upon it still = the tenth, and again it will be for plundering, like terebinth and like oak whenever it falls from its casing.

And it happened in days of Ahaz son of Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah, Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel went up against Jerusalem to war against it, and they were not able to besiege it.
And it was reported to house of David, saying, Aram agreed with Ephraim, and his soul and soul of his people were stirred as when tree in forest is shaken by wind.
And Lord said to Isaiah, Go out to meet Ahaz, you and Shear-jashub your son, to pool of upper road of fuller's field.
And you will say to him, Take care to be quiet and do not fear, nor let your soul weaken from these two pieces of smoking firebrands, for whenever anger of my wrath comes, again I will heal.
And son of Aram and son of Remaliah, because they counseled evil counsel about you, saying,
We will go up into Judah and by speaking with them turn them toward us, and we will make son of Tabeel king of it.
Thus says Lord Sabaoth: This counsel will certainly not remain, nor shall it be.
But head of Aram = Damascus; and yet within sixty-five years kingdom of Ephraim will cease from people.
And head of Ephraim = Samaria, and head of Samaria = son of Remaliah. If you do not believe, neither will you understand.
And Lord added again to speak to Ahaz, saying,
Ask for yourself sign from Lord your God, in depth or in height.
And Ahaz said, I will certainly not ask, nor certainly will I test Lord.
And he said, Hear now, house of David. Is it small thing for you to furnish struggle to men, and how do you furnish struggle to Lord?
Therefore Lord himself will give you sign: Behold, virgin in womb will have and bear son, and you will call his name Immanuel.
Butter and honey he will eat; before he knows or chooses evil, he will choose good.
Because before child knows good or evil, he rejects evil to choose good, and land which you fear from face of two kings will be forsaken.
But God will bring upon you and upon your people and upon house of your father days not yet come since day Ephraim was taken away from Judah = king of Assyrians.
And it will be in that day, Lord will whistle for flies that rule part of river of Egypt and for bee that is in land of Assyrians.
And they will all come and rest in ravines of land and holes of rocks and caves and every cleft and every tree.
In that day Lord will shave with razor, great and drunken, which is beyond river, by king of Assyrians, the head and hairs of feet, and beard he will remove.
And it will be in that day, man will nourish heifer of cattle and two sheep.
And it will be, from abundance of milk, everyone left on land will eat butter and honey.
And it will be in that day every place where there are thousand vines for thousand shekels will become wasteland and thorn.
With arrow and bow they will enter there, because whole land will be wasteland and thorn.
And every mountain being plowed will be plowed, and fear will certainly not come there, for from wasteland and thorn it will be for grazing of sheep and trampling of ox.
And Lord said to me, Take for yourself new large scroll and write on it with human stylus: Swiftly spoil, quickly plunder, for it is near.
And make for me faithful human witnesses, Uriah and Zechariah son of Barachiah.
And I approached prophetess, and she conceived and bore son, and Lord said to me, Call his name, Swiftly Spoil, Quickly Plunder.
Because before child knows to call father or mother, he will take power of Damascus and spoils of Samaria before king of Assyrians.
And Lord added to speak to me still,
Because this people did not want water of Shiloam going quietly, but wanted to have Rezin and son of Remaliah as king over you,
because of this behold Lord brings up upon you water of river, strong and much, king of Assyrians and his glory, and it will go up over all your valleys and walk over all your walls.
And it will take away from Judah man who can lift head or be able to accomplish anything, and his camp will be so as to fill width of your land, God-with-us.
Know, nations, and be defeated; hear, to end of earth. Having grown strong, be defeated. If again you grow strong, again you will be defeated.
And whatever counsel you counsel, Lord will scatter; and word whatever you speak will certainly not remain for you, because with us = Lord God.
Thus says Lord with strong hand; they disobey in walking way of this people, saying,
Never say hard whatever this people says is hard. Their fear you certainly shall not fear, nor certainly be troubled.
Sanctify Lord himself, and he himself will be your fear.

And if you are trusting in him, he will be for you into holiness, and not as stumbling stone will you meet him, nor as rock of falling; but house of Jacob in snare and in hollow, sitting in Jerusalem.
Because of this many among them will be weak and fall and be crushed, and they will draw near and be captured, men being in safety.
Then clear will be those sealing law so as not to learn.
And he will say, I will wait for God who turned his face from house of Jacob, and I will trust in him.
Behold, I and children whom God gave me, and they will be for signs and wonders in house of Israel from Lord Sabaoth who dwells on Mount Zion.

And if they say to you, Seek those from earth who call and ventriloquists who speak emptiness, who speak from belly, does not nation seek to its God? Why do they seek dead ones concerning living ones?
For he gave law for help, so that they may say, not according to this word, concerning which there is no gift to give.
And hard famine will come upon you, and it will be, whenever you hunger, you will be distressed, and you will speak evil of ruler and ancestral things and will look upward to heaven.
And down to earth they will look, and look, affliction and tightness and darkness, distress narrow and darkness so as not to see.

And one being in distress will not be without escape until time. This first he does quickly: land of Zebulun, land of Naphtali, way of sea, and the rest who dwell by coast and beyond Jordan, Galilee of nations, regions of Judah.
People walking in darkness, see great light; you dwelling in land and shadow of death, light will shine on you.
Most of people whom you brought down, in your gladness they will rejoice before you as those rejoicing in harvest and as those dividing spoils.
Because yoke lying on them and rod on their neck, for rod of those exacting scattered Lord as in day on Midian.
Because every garment gathered by deceit and garment from confiscation they will repay, and they will wish it had become burned with fire.
Because child was born to us, son was given to us, whose rule became upon his shoulder, and his name is called Angel of Great Counsel, for I will bring peace upon rulers, peace and health to him.

Great his rule, and his peace has no boundary, upon throne of David and his kingdom, to make it prosper and uphold it in righteousness and judgment from now and forever. Zeal of Lord Sabaoth will do these things.
Lord sent death upon Jacob, and it came upon Israel.
And all people of Ephraim and dwellers in Samaria will know, in insolence and lofty heart saying,
Bricks have fallen, but come, let us hew stones, and cut down sycamores and cedars, and build tower for ourselves.
And God will dash down those rising on Mount Zion against them, and their enemies he will scatter.
Syria from east of sun and Greeks from west of sun, devouring Israel with whole mouth. In all these his anger did not turn away, but hand still high.
And people did not turn until it was struck, and Lord they did not seek.
And Lord took away from Israel head and tail, great and small, in one day.
Elder and those admiring faces = head, and prophet teaching lawless things = tail.
And those blessing this people will mislead, and they mislead so as to swallow them.

Because of this God will not rejoice over their young men, and their orphans and widows he will not pity, because all lawless and evil, and every mouth speaks unjust things. In all these his anger did not turn away, but hand still high.
And lawlessness will burn as fire, and dry grass will be eaten by fire, and it will burn in thickets of forest and consume everything around hills.
By wrath of anger of Lord whole land has been burned together, and people will be as ones burned by fire; man will not pity his brother.
He will turn aside to right because he will hunger, and he will eat from left and certainly not be filled; each man eating flesh of his own arm.
For Manasseh will eat Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh, because together they will besiege Judah. In all these his anger did not turn away, but hand still high.
Woe those writing evil things, for writing they write evil,
turning aside judgment of poor, stealing right of needy of my people, so that widow becomes for them plunder and orphan spoil.
And what will they do in day of visitation? For affliction will come to you from far off, and to whom will you flee to be helped, and where will you leave your glory?
So as not to fall into captivity? In all these his anger did not turn away, but hand still high.
Woe to Assyrians; rod of my anger, and wrath is in their hands.
I will send my wrath against lawless nation, and I will command against my people to make spoil and plunder and trample cities and make them dust.
But he did not think thus, and in soul he did not reckon thus; but his mind will cast off, to destroy nations not a few.
And if they say to him, You alone are ruler?
And he will say, Did I not take region above Babylon and Calneh where tower was built, and take Arabia and Damascus and Samaria?
As I took these into my hand, so I will take all the realms. Howl, carved things in Jerusalem and in Samaria.
For as I did to Samaria and to her handmade things, so I will do to Jerusalem and her idols.
And it will be, when Lord finishes doing all things on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, he will bring upon great mind of ruler of Assyrians and upon loftiness of glory of his eyes.
For he said, By strength I will do it, and by wisdom of understanding. I will remove boundaries of nations and plunder their strength, and shake inhabited cities.
And whole world I will seize with hand as nest, and as eggs left behind I will take, and there is none who will escape me or speak against me.
Will axe be glorified without one chopping with it, or saw be lifted up without one pulling it? Likewise if someone lifts rod or wood.
And not thus, but Lord Sabaoth will send dishonor into your honor, and under your glory burning fire will be burned.
And light of Israel will be for fire, and it will sanctify him in burning fire, and it will devour forest as grass in that day.
Mountains and hills and forests will be extinguished, and it will be devoured from soul to flesh, and fugitive will be as one fleeing from burning flame.
And those left from them will be a number, and child will write them.

And it will be in that day, remnant of Israel will no longer continue, and those saved of Jacob will no longer keep trusting in those who wronged them, but they will be trusting in God, Holy One of Israel, in truth.
And remnant of Jacob will be upon mighty God.
And even if people Israel become as sand of sea, remnant of them will be saved, for word finishing and cutting short in righteousness.
Because God will make cut-short word in whole inhabited world.
Therefore thus says Lord Sabaoth, Do not fear, my people dwelling in Zion, from Assyrians, because with rod he will strike you, for I bring stripe upon you to see way of Egypt.
For still a little, and wrath will cease, but my anger upon their counsel.
And God will stir against them according to blow of Midian in place of affliction, and his anger in way by sea, in way toward Egypt.
And it will be in that day his fear will be removed from you and his yoke from your shoulder, and yoke will be destroyed from your shoulders.
For he will come to city Aggai and pass to Mageddo and at Michmash place his gear.
He will pass ravine and come to Aggai; fear will seize Ramah; city of Saul will flee.
Daughter Gallim will hear; Laish will hear; Anathoth.
Madmena staggered, and dwellers of Gebim, comfort yourselves.
Today on road to remain, with hand he calls to mountain, daughter of Zion, and hills in Jerusalem.
For look, Master Lord Sabaoth shakes glorious ones with might, and lofty in insolence will be crushed, and high ones will be humbled.
And high ones will fall by sword, and Lebanon with high ones will fall.
And rod will come out from root of Jesse, and flower from root will go up.
And Spirit of God will rest upon him, spirit of wisdom and understanding, spirit of counsel and strength, spirit of knowledge and piety.
Spirit of fear of God will fill him; not according to glory will he judge, nor according to speech will he reprove.
But he will judge humble in judgment and reprove humble of earth, and strike earth with word of his mouth, and by spirit through lips he will kill ungodly.
And righteousness will be girded about his loins and truth wrapped round his sides.
And wolf will graze together with lamb, and leopard will rest together with kid, and calf and bull and lion together will graze, and little child will lead them.
And ox and bear will graze together, and together their young will be, and lion and ox together will eat straw.
And infant child over hole of asps, and over bed of offspring of asps will lay hand.
And they will certainly not do evil nor be able to destroy anyone upon my holy mountain, because whole world was filled to know Lord, as much water covers seas.
And it will be in that day, root of Jesse and one rising to rule nations; on him nations will hope, and his rest will be honor.

And it will be in that day, Lord will add to show his hand, to be zealous for remnant left of his people which might be left from Assyrians and Egypt and Babylonia and Ethiopia and from Elamites and from east of sun and from Arabia.
And he will raise sign to nations and gather lost of Israel, and dispersed of Judah he will gather from four wings of earth.
And zeal of Ephraim will be removed and enemies of Judah will perish; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah and Judah will not oppress Ephraim.
And they will fly in ships of foreigners, sea together they will plunder, and easterners and Idumea, and upon Moab first they will lay hands, and sons of Ammon will obey first.
And Lord will make sea of Egypt desolate and lay his hand upon river with violent spirit and strike seven ravines, so as to pass through it in sandals.
And there will be passage for my people left in Egypt, and it will be for Israel as day when he came out from land of Egypt.
And you will say in that day, I will bless you, Lord, because you were angry with me and turned your wrath away and pitied me.
Behold, my God is my savior. I will trust in the Lord and be saved in him, and I will not fear, because the Lord is my glory and my praise, and he became salvation to me.
And you will draw water with gladness from springs of salvation.
And you will say in that day, sing hymn to Lord, cry his name, announce among nations his glorious things, remember that his name was exalted.
Sing hymn to name of Lord, because he did high things; announce these in all earth.
Exult and rejoice, dwellers of Zion, because Holy One of Israel was exalted in midst of her.
Vision which Isaiah son of Amoz saw against Babylon.
Lift signal on plain mountain, raise voice to them, do not fear, encourage with hand, open, rulers.
I command, and I bring them; they are sanctified, and I bring them. Giants come to fill my wrath, rejoicing together and insulting.
Voice of many nations on mountains, like many nations; voice of kings and nations gathered together. Lord Sabaoth has commanded warlike nation
to come from far land, from edge of foundation of heaven, Lord and his warriors, to destroy whole inhabited world.
Howl, for day of Lord is near, and crushing from God will come.
Because of this every hand will grow weak and every soul of man will lose courage.
And envoys will be troubled, and pains will seize them as woman giving birth, and they will be confounded one at another, and will be amazed, and their faces will change as flame.
For look, day of Lord comes, incurable, of fury and anger, to make whole inhabited world desolate and destroy sinners out of it.
For stars of heaven and Orion and all ornament of heaven will not give light, and sun rising will be darkened, and moon will not give its light.
And I will command evils upon whole inhabited world and their sins upon ungodly, and I will destroy insolence of lawless and humble insolence of proud.
And those left behind will be more precious than untried gold, and man will be more precious than stone from Suphir.
For heaven will be enraged, and earth will be shaken from its foundations, because of wrath of anger of Lord Sabaoth in day when his anger comes.
And those left will be as fleeing gazelle and as wandering sheep, and there will be no one gathering, so that man turn back to his people and man pursue to his land.
For whoever is caught will be defeated, and those gathered together will fall by sword.
And their children before them they will dash down, and their houses they will plunder, and their women they will have.
Look, I stir up Medes against you, who do not value silver nor have need of gold.
Their bows will crush young men, and your children they will certainly not pity, nor will their eyes spare children.
And Babylon, called glorious by king of Chaldeans, will be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
It will not be inhabited forever, nor shall they enter into it for many generations, nor shall Arabs pass through it, nor shepherds rest in it.
And beasts will rest there, and houses will be filled with sound, and sirens will rest there and demons will dance there.
And donkey-centaurs will dwell there, and hedgehogs will make nests in their houses. Quickly it comes and will not delay.
And Lord will have mercy on Jacob and will still choose Israel, and they will rest upon their land, and resident alien will be added to them and added to house of Jacob.

And nations will take them and bring them into their place, and they will inherit and multiply on land of God as male slaves and female slaves, and they will capture those who captured them and rule those who ruled them.
And it will be in that day God will give you rest from your pain and your anger and your hard service with which you served them.
And you will take up this lament over king of Babylon and say in that day: How exactor has rested, and how zealot has rested.
God shattered yoke of sinners, yoke of rulers,
striking nation in wrath with incurable blow, striking nation with stroke of anger from which he did not spare.
All earth rested confidently; it cries out with gladness.
And trees of Lebanon rejoiced over you, and cedar of Lebanon: Since you have fallen asleep, one cutting us down did not come up.
Hades below was embittered to meet you; all giants who ruled earth were raised up for you, who roused from their thrones all kings of nations.
All will answer and say to you, You too were taken as we were; among us you were reckoned.
And your glory came down into Hades, your much gladness; decay they will spread under you, and worm your covering.
How morning-star fell from heaven, one rising in morning; one sent out toward all nations was crushed to earth.
And you said in your mind, I will go up into heaven, above stars of heaven I will place my throne; I will sit on high mountain, on high mountains toward north.
I will go up above clouds; I will be like Most High.
But now you will go down into Hades and into foundations of earth.
Those seeing you will marvel over you and say, This man provoking earth, shaking kings,
placing whole inhabited world desolate and pulling down cities, did not release those in captivity.
All kings of nations slept in honor, each man in his own house.
But you will be cast on mountains as loathed corpse with many dead pierced by swords, going down into Hades, as garment soaked in blood will not be clean.
So neither will you be clean, because you destroyed my land and killed my people; evil seed will certainly not remain forever.
Prepare your children to be slaughtered for sins of your father, so that they do not rise up and inherit land and fill land with cities.
And I will rise against them, says Lord Sabaoth, and I will destroy from them name and remnant and seed, thus says Lord.
And I will make Babylonia desolate for hedgehogs to dwell and it will be for nothing, and I will make it muddy pit for destruction.
Thus says Lord Sabaoth: As I have spoken, so it will be, and as I have counseled, so it remains,
to destroy Assyrians from my land, and from my mountains, and they will be for trampling, and their yoke will be removed from them and their glory removed from shoulders.
This counsel which Lord has counseled over whole inhabited world, and this uplifted hand over all nations of inhabited world.
For what Holy God has counseled, who will scatter? And uplifted hand, who will turn back?
In year king Ahaz died this word came.
Do not rejoice, all you foreigners; for yoke of one striking you was broken, for from seed of snakes offspring of asps will come out, and their offspring will come out as flying serpents.
And poor will be grazed through him, and poor men will rest in peace, but he will kill your seed with famine, and your remnant he will kill.
Howl, gates of cities; let cities cry out, all foreigners disturbed, because smoke from north comes, and there is no one to be.
And what will kings of nations answer? That Lord founded Zion, and through him humble of people will be saved.
Word against Moabite land. By night Moabite land is destroyed; by night wall of Moabite land is destroyed.
Grieve over yourselves, for Dibon is destroyed, where your altar is. There you will go up to weep over Nabo of Moab. Howl; on every head baldness, all arms cut.
In her streets gird yourselves with sackcloths and lament on her housetops, and in her lanes all howl with weeping.
Because Heshbon cried out and Elealeh, as far as Jassa their voice was heard; therefore loins of Moab cry out; her soul will know.
Heart of Moab cries within her, as far as Segor, for heifer is three years old. Upon ascent of Luith they will go up to you weeping; on way of Horonaim they cry out, destruction and earthquake.
Water of Nemrim will be desolate, and its grass will fail, for green grass will not exist.
Will it thus be saved? For I will bring upon valley of Arabs, and they will take it.
For cry joined border of Moabite land, its howl as far as well of Elim.
Water of Remmon will be filled with blood, for I will bring Arabs upon Remmon, and I will take seed of Moab and Ariel and remnant of Adama.
I will send as reptiles upon land. Is not rock desert, mountain of Zion?
For you will be as flying bird, chick taken away, daughters of Moab, and then lambs.
Counsel more; make shelter of mourning for her always in noonday darkness. Fugitives are driven out; do not be taken away.
Fugitives of Moab will dwell with you; they will be shelter to you from face of pursuer, because your alliance was removed and ruler perished, one trampling on earth.
And throne will be set right with mercy, and one will sit upon it with truth in tent of David, judging and seeking judgment and hastening righteousness.
We heard insolence of Moab, very insolent, his pride was dried up; not thus your oracle.
Not thus will Moab howl; for in Moabite land all will howl. For dwellers of Deseth you will meditate, and you will not be ashamed.

Fields of Heshbon will mourn, vine of Sebama. Swallowing nations, you trampled its vines as far as Jazer; do not join yourselves, wander in wilderness. Those sent were abandoned, for they crossed wilderness.
Because of this I will weep as weeping of Jazer for vine of Sebama. Your trees Heshbon and Elealeh cast down, because over your harvest and your vintage I will trample, and all things will fall.
And gladness and rejoicing will be lifted from your vineyards, and in your vineyards they will certainly not rejoice, and they will certainly not tread wine into vats, for it has ceased.
Because of this my inward parts for Moab will sound like lyre, and my insides like wall which you renewed.
And it will be, when you are shamed, because Moab toiled upon altars and enters into her handmade things to pray, he certainly will not be able to rescue himself.
This word which Lord spoke against Moab whenever he spoke.
And now I say: in three years, years of hired worker, glory of Moab will be dishonored in all much wealth, and remnant will be few and not honored.
Word against Damascus: Behold, Damascus will be removed from cities and will be for falling.
Left forever for bed of flocks and rest, and there will not be one pursuing.

And there will no longer be fortress for Ephraim to flee into, and no longer kingdom in Damascus, and remnant of Syrians will perish. For you are no better than sons of Israel and their glory, thus says Lord Sabaoth.
It will be in that day, eclipse of glory of Jacob, and fat things of his glory will be shaken.
And it will be as if someone gathers standing harvest and reaps ears of grain with his arm, and it will be as if someone gathers ear in solid ravine.
And stubble will be left in it, or as berries of olive tree, two or three on high tip, or four or five on their branches, thus says Lord God of Israel.
In that day man will be trusting in one making him, and his eyes will look to Holy One of Israel.
And they certainly will not be trusting in altars, nor in works of their hands which their fingers made, and they will not see their trees nor their abominations.
In that day your cities will be abandoned as Amorites and Hivites abandoned from face of sons of Israel, and they will be desolate.
Because you abandoned God your savior and did not remember Lord your helper. Therefore you will plant faithless planting and faithless seed.
And in day when you plant, you will go astray, and in morning if you sow, it will blossom for harvest; in day he gives lot, and as father of man gives lot to your sons.
Woe multitude of many nations; as sea surging, so you will be troubled, and rush of many nations will sound as water.
As much water, many nations, as force of much water rushing down, and he will scare him away and chase him far, as dust of chaff of threshers before wind and as dust of wheel storm carrying.
Toward evening there will be grief; before morning and it will not be. This portion of those plundering you and inheritance of those inheriting you.
Woe, land of winged ships beyond rivers of Ethiopia,

sending hostages by sea and papyrus letters on water. For light messengers will go to nation lofty and strange, people difficult. What is theirs beyond? Nation without hope and trampled, whose land rivers now divide.
All as inhabited land will inhabit; their land will be inhabited as signal lifted from mountain, and as trumpet voice it will be heard.
Because thus Lord said to me: Safety will be in my city as light of noonday heat and as cloud of dew in day of harvest.
Before harvest, when blossom is finished and sour grape blossoms into budding flower, he will remove little clusters with sickles, and he will remove and cut down branches.
And he will leave them together to birds of heaven and beasts of earth, and birds of heaven will gather on them and all beasts of earth will come upon him.

At that time gifts will be brought to Lord Sabaoth from people afflicted and plucked, and from great people from now and forever, nation hoping and trampled, which is in region of river of its land, to place where name of Lord Sabaoth was invoked, Mount Zion.
Vision of Egypt: Behold, Lord sits on swift cloud and will come into Egypt, and handmade things of Egypt will be shaken from before him and their heart will be defeated within them.
And Egyptians will rise against Egyptians, and man will war with his brother and man with his neighbor, city against city and law against law.
And spirit of Egyptians will be troubled within them, and I will scatter their counsel, and they will ask their gods and their carved images and those speaking from earth and ventriloquists.
And I will hand over Egypt into hands of harsh lords, and harsh kings will rule them, thus says Lord Sabaoth.
And Egyptians will drink water from sea, and river will fail and dry up.
And rivers will fail, and channels of river, and every collection of water will dry up, and in every marsh reed and papyrus.
And green rush, all around river, and everything sown by river will dry up, wind-blasted.
And fishermen will groan, and all casting hook into river will groan, and those throwing drag-nets and casting nets will mourn.
And shame will seize those working split flax and those working fine linen.
And those weaving them will be in pain, and all making beer will grieve and pain their souls.
And princes of Tanis will be fools, wise counselors of king; their counsel will be made foolish. How will you say to king, We are sons of wise men, sons of ancient kings?
Where now are your wise men? Let them announce to you and tell what Lord Sabaoth has counseled against Egypt.
Princes of Tanis failed, and princes of Memphis were exalted, and they will lead Egypt astray by tribes.
For Lord mixed in them spirit of wandering, and they led Egypt astray in all their works, as drunk man and vomiting man wander together.
And there will not be for Egyptians work which head and tail, beginning and end, will do.
In that day Egyptians will be as women, in fear and trembling from face of hand of Lord Sabaoth which he himself lays upon them.
And land of Jews will be terror to Egyptians; whoever names it to them, they will fear because of counsel which Lord has counseled against it.
In that day there will be five cities in Egypt speaking language of Canaan and swearing by name of Lord; one city will be called City of Righteousness.
In that day there will be altar to Lord in land of Egyptians and pillar to Lord by its border.
And it will be for sign forever to Lord in land of Egypt, because they will cry to Lord because of those afflicting them, and Lord will send them man who will save them; by judging he will save them.
And Lord will be known to Egyptians, and Egyptians will know Lord in that day, and they will make sacrifices and vow vows to Lord and pay them.
And Lord will strike Egyptians with great blow and heal them; he will heal, and they will turn to Lord, and he will hear them and heal them.
In that day there will be way from Egypt to Assyrians, and Assyrians will enter Egypt and Egyptians will go to Assyrians, and Egyptians will serve Assyrians.
In that day Israel will be third among Assyrians and Egyptians, blessed in land
which Lord Sabaoth blessed, saying, Blessed my people in Egypt, and in Assyrians, and my inheritance Israel.
In year Tartan entered into Ashdod, when sent by Arna king of Assyrians, and he warred against Ashdod and captured it,
then Lord spoke to Isaiah, saying, Go and take sackcloth off your waist and loosen sandals from your feet. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
And Lord said, As Isaiah my servant has walked naked and barefoot three years, so signs and wonders will be to Egyptians and Ethiopians.
Because thus king of Assyrians will lead captivity of Egypt and Ethiopians, young men and elders, naked and barefoot, with shame of Egypt uncovered.
And Egyptians will be ashamed, defeated because of Ethiopians on whom they were trusting; for Egyptians were their glory.
And dwellers in this island will say, Look, we were trusting to flee to them for help, who were not able to be saved from king of Assyrians; and how shall we be saved?
Vision of wilderness: as storm through wilderness would pass through, coming from fearful land.
Hard vision was reported to me: lawless one acts lawlessly, and outlaw acts as outlaw. Against me Elamites and envoys of Persians come upon me. Now I will groan and comfort myself.
Because of this my loins were filled with weakness, and pains seized me as one giving birth. I did wrong not to hear; I hurried not to see.
My heart wanders and lawlessness baptizes me; my soul has stood into fear.
Prepare table; drink, eat. Rise up, rulers; prepare shields.
Because thus Lord said to me: Having gone, set watchman for yourself, and what you see, report.
And I saw riders, two horsemen, rider of donkey and rider of camel. Listen, great listening.
And call Uriah to lookout of Lord. And he said, I stood continually by day, and on camp I stood whole night.
And look, he comes, rider of pair. And answering he said, Babylon has fallen, and all her carved images and handmade things have been shattered to ground.
Hear, you left behind and you being pained; hear what Lord Sabaoth, God of Israel, announced to us.
Vision of Idumea: To me one calls from Seir, Guard ramparts.
I guard morning and night. If you seek, seek, and dwell with me.
In forest at evening you will sleep, on road, Dedan.
Bring water to one thirsty; you dwelling in land of Tema, meet fugitives with bread,
because of multitude of fugitives and multitude of wanderers and multitude of sword and multitude of stretched bows and multitude of fallen in war.
Because thus Lord said to me: Yet one year, as year of hired worker, glory of sons of Kedar will fail.
And remnant of arrows of mighty sons of Kedar will be few, because Lord God of Israel spoke.
Word of valley of Zion: What happened to you now that all of you went up to housetops?
City full of shouting, vanity; your wounded not wounded by sword, nor your dead dead of war.
All your rulers have fled, and those captured are harshly bound, and mighty ones among you have fled far off.
Because of this I said, Leave me; I will weep bitterly. Do not insist to comfort me over crushing of daughter of my kin.
Because day of trouble and destruction and trampling and wandering from Lord Sabaoth in valley of Zion; they wander from small to great, they wander on mountains.
And Elamites took quivers, riders, men on horses, and gathering of battle-line.
And your choice valleys will be filled with chariots, and horsemen will shut your gates.
And they will uncover gates of Judah, and in that day they will look to choice houses of city.
And they will uncover hidden things of houses of citadel of David, and saw that they are many, and that they turned water of old pool into city.
And that they pulled down houses of Jerusalem into fortification for wall of city.
And you made water for yourselves between two walls inside old pool, and you did not look to one who made it from beginning, and one who built it you did not see.
And Lord Sabaoth called in that day for weeping and mourning and shaving and girding of sackcloth.
But they made gladness and rejoicing, slaughtering calves and sacrificing sheep, so as to eat meat and drink wine, saying, Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.
And these things are uncovered in ears of Lord Sabaoth: this sin will certainly not be forgiven you until you die.
Thus says Lord Sabaoth: Go into chamber to Sobna the steward and say to him,
What do you have here, and what is here to you, that you cut out for yourself here tomb and made for yourself memorial in high place and carved for yourself dwelling in rock?
Look now, Lord Sabaoth will throw out and pulverize man and remove your robe.
And your glorious crown, and he will throw you into great and immeasurable land, and there you will die, and he will make your beautiful chariot dishonor and your ruler's house into trampling.
And you will be removed from your stewardship and from your station.
And it will be in that day, I will call my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

And I will clothe him with your robe and give your crown to him, and your authority and your stewardship I will give into his hands, and he will be as father to dwellers in Jerusalem and dwellers in Judah.
And I will give glory of David to him, and he will rule, and there will not be one contradicting.
And I will set him ruler in trustworthy place, and he will be for throne of glory of house of his father.
And whole glorious thing in house of his father will be trusting on him, from small to great, and they will be hanging from him.
In that day, thus says Lord Sabaoth, man supported in trustworthy place will be shaken, and he will fall, and glory upon him will be removed, because Lord spoke.
Vision of Tyre: Howl, ships of Carthage, because it was destroyed and they no longer come from land of Kittim; it was led captive.
To what have dwellers on island become like, traders of Phoenicia crossing sea?
In much water, seed of traders as harvest brought in, traders of nations.
Be ashamed, Sidon, said sea. And strength of sea said, I did not travail nor bear, nor nourish young men, nor raise virgins.
And whenever it becomes heard in Egypt, pain will seize them concerning Tyre.
Go away to Carthage; howl, dwellers on this island.
Was this your insolence from beginning before it was handed over?
Who planned these things against Tyre? Is she not lesser, or does she not prevail? Her merchants are glorious, rulers of earth.
Lord Sabaoth counseled to paralyze all insolence of glorious ones and dishonor every glorious thing on earth.
Work your land, for ship no longer comes from Carthage.
And your hand no longer strong over sea, the one provoking kings. Lord Sabaoth commanded concerning Canaan to destroy her strength.
And they will say, You will no longer continue to act insolently and do wrong, daughter of Sidon; and if you go to Kittim, even there rest will not be to you.
And into land of Chaldeans, and this has been desolated by Assyrians; even there rest will not be to you, because its wall has fallen.
Howl, ships of Carthage, because your stronghold was destroyed.
And it will be in that day, Tyre will be left seventy years, as time of king, as time of man. And after seventy years Tyre will be as song of prostitute.
Take lyre, wander cities, forgotten prostitute; play lyre well, sing much, so that memory of you may happen.
And it will be after seventy years, God will make visitation on Tyre, and again she will be restored to the ancient state and will be marketplace for all kingdoms of inhabited world.
And her trade and wage will be holy to Lord; it will not be gathered for them, but all her trade for those dwelling before Lord, to eat and drink and be filled, into token, memorial before Lord.
Behold, Lord destroys inhabited world and will make it desolate and uncover its face and scatter those dwelling in it.
And people will be as priest, and servant as master, and maid as mistress; buyer will be as seller, lender as borrower, and debtor as one to whom debt is owed.
Land with ruin will be ruined and with plunder will be plundered, for mouth of Lord spoke these things.
Land mourned and inhabited world was destroyed; high ones of earth mourned.
And land acted lawlessly because of those dwelling in it, because they transgressed law and changed ordinances, everlasting covenant.
Because of this curse will eat land, because those dwelling in it sinned; because of this dwellers in land will be poor and few men will be left.
Wine will mourn, vine will mourn, all rejoicing in soul will groan.
Gladness of drums ceased, insolence and wealth of ungodly ceased, voice of lyre ceased.
They were put to shame; they did not drink wine; strong drink became bitter to drinkers.
Every city was made desolate; they will shut house so as not to enter.
Howl concerning wine everywhere; all gladness of land ceased.
And cities will be left desolate, and abandoned houses will perish.
All these will be in land in midst of nations, as whenever one gleans olive tree, thus they will glean them, and when vintage ceases.
These will cry out with voice, and those left on land will rejoice together in glory of Lord; water of sea will be troubled.
Because of this glory of Lord will be in islands of sea; name of Lord will be glorious, Lord God of Israel.
From wings of earth we heard wonders, hope to godly one. And they will say, Woe to those rejecting, those rejecting law.
Fear and pit and snare upon you, dwellers on earth.
And it will be, one fleeing fear will fall into pit, and one coming up from pit will be caught by snare, because windows from heaven were opened and foundations of earth will be shaken.
With turmoil earth will be troubled and with perplexity earth will be perplexed.
Earth bent and will be shaken like fruit-watch hut, as drunken and hungover man, and it will fall and certainly not be able to rise, for lawlessness prevailed upon it.
And God will bring his hand upon host of heaven and upon kings of earth.
And they will gather and shut them into stronghold and prison, and after many generations there will be visitation on them.
And brick will melt and wall will fall, because Lord will reign in Zion and in Jerusalem and before elders be glorified.
Lord my God, I will glorify you, I will hymn your name, because you did wondrous things, ancient counsel, true; let it be, Lord.
Because you made cities into mound, strong cities so that their foundations fall; city of ungodly certainly will not be built forever.
Because of this poor people will bless you, and cities of men being wronged will bless you.
For you became helper to every humble city and shelter to those losing heart through want; from evil men you will rescue them, shelter for thirsty ones and spirit of men being wronged.
They will bless you as faint-hearted thirsty men in Zion, from ungodly men to whom you handed us over.
And Lord Sabaoth will make for all nations on this mountain; they will drink gladness, they will drink wine, they will anoint themselves with perfume.
On this mountain hand over all these things to nations, for this counsel upon all nations.
Death swallowed after growing strong, and again God took away every tear from every face; reproach of people he took away from all earth, for mouth of Lord spoke.
And they will say in that day, Behold our God on whom we hoped, and we rejoiced and will be glad over our salvation.
Because God will give rest on this mountain, and Moabite land will be trampled as they tread threshing floor with wagons.
And he will let down his hands, as he himself humbled to destroy, and he will humble his insolence over what he laid hands on.
And height of refuge of your wall he will humble, and it will come down to ground.
In that day they will sing this song in land of Judah, saying, Behold, strong city, and he will set salvation for us as wall and outer wall.
Open gates; let people enter, keeping righteousness and keeping truth,
upholding truth and keeping peace because upon you
they hoped, Lord, forever, great eternal God.
Who humbled and brought down those dwelling on heights, strong cities; you will throw down and bring to ground,
and feet of gentle and humble will tread them.
Way of godly became straight, and way of godly prepared.
For way of Lord = judgment; we hoped in your name and in remembrance.
Our soul desires you by night; my spirit rises early toward you, O God, because your ordinances are light upon earth. Learn righteousness, dwellers on earth.
For ungodly ceased; he certainly will not learn righteousness on earth, he certainly will not do truth. Let ungodly be taken away so that he not see glory of Lord.
Lord, your arm is high and they did not know; but knowing they will be ashamed. Zeal will seize untrained people, and now fire will eat opponents.
Lord our God, give us peace, for you gave all things to us.
Lord our God, acquire us; Lord, apart from you we know no other; we name your name.
But dead certainly will not see life, nor physicians certainly raise them; because of this you brought and destroyed and took away every male of them.
Add evils to them, Lord; add evils to all glorious ones of earth.
Lord, in affliction we remembered you; in affliction your discipline small to us.
And as woman in labor comes near to bearing and in her pain cried out, so we became to your beloved because of your fear, Lord.
In womb we conceived and were in labor and gave birth to spirit of your salvation. We worked on earth, but dwellers on earth will fall.
Dead will rise and those in tombs will be raised, and those in earth will rejoice, for dew from you is healing to them, but land of ungodly will fall.
Go, my people, enter your chambers, shut your door, hide yourself a little, as much as little, until anger of Lord passes.
For behold, Lord from holy place brings wrath upon dwellers on earth, and earth will uncover its blood and will not cover those killed.
In that day God will bring holy and great and strong sword upon dragon, fleeing serpent, upon dragon, twisted serpent, and he will kill dragon.
In that day, beautiful vineyard, desire to begin against her.
I, strong city, city under siege, water her in vain; for by night she will be captured, and by day wall will fall.
There is none who did not seize it. Who will set me to guard stubble in field? For this war I rejected it; therefore Lord God did all things he ordered. I have been burned up.
Those dwelling in it will cry, Let us make peace to him, let us make peace.
Those coming, sons of Jacob; Israel will sprout and blossom, and inhabited world will be filled with his fruit.
Was he struck as he struck? And thus will he be struck? And as he killed, thus will he be killed?
Warring and reproaching he will send them out. Were not you one plotting with harsh spirit to kill them with spirit of anger?

Because of this lawlessness of Jacob will be removed, and this is his blessing whenever I take away his sin, whenever they set all stones of altars crushed like fine dust, and their trees and idols certainly will not remain, cut down like distant forest.
The inhabited flock will be left loose as abandoned flock, and for much time it will be for pasture, and there they will rest.

And after time there will be no green thing in it because it dried up. Women coming from spectacle, come. For it is not people having understanding; because of this one making them certainly will not pity, nor one forming them show mercy.
And it will be in that day, Lord will fence off from channel of river as far as Rhinocolura, and you gather sons of Israel one by one.
And it will be in that day, they will trumpet with great trumpet, and those lost in land of Assyrians and those lost in Egypt will come and bow to Lord on holy mountain in Jerusalem.
Woe to crown of insolence, hired drinkers of Ephraim, flower fallen from glory on top of fat mountain, drunken without wine.
Behold, strong and hard = wrath of Lord, as hail rushing down without shelter, force rushing down as much water dragging land; with hand he will make rest to earth.
And with feet will be trampled crown of insolence, hired drinkers of Ephraim.
And fallen flower of hope of glory on top of high mountain will be like early fig, one seeing it before taking it in hand will want to swallow it.
In that day Lord Sabaoth will be crown of hope, woven thing of glory, to remnant of my people.
They will be left upon spirit of judgment for judgment and strength preventing slaughter.
For these are misled with wine, they wandered because of strong drink; priest and prophet were astonished because of wine, shaken from drunkenness of strong drink, wandered. This = vision.
Will this one eat this counsel? For this counsel because of greed.
To whom did we announce evils, and to whom did we announce message? Those weaned from milk, those pulled from breast.
Expect affliction upon affliction, hope upon hope, yet a little, yet a little.
By contempt of lips, by another tongue, because they will speak to this people,
saying to it, This rest to hungry one, and this crushing; and they did not want to hear.
And oracle of Lord God will be to them, affliction upon affliction, hope upon hope, yet a little, yet a little, so that they may go and fall backward and be in danger and be crushed and captured.
Therefore hear word of Lord, afflicted men and rulers of this people in Jerusalem,

because you said, We made covenant with Hades and agreements with death. Storm carried along, if it passes, certainly will not come upon us. We set falsehood as our hope, and by lie we will be covered.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I cast into foundations of Zion costly stone, chosen, precious cornerstone into her foundations, and one believing on him certainly will not be put to shame.
And I will set judgment into hope, and my mercy into scales, and those trusting vainly in falsehood, storm certainly will not pass you by.
Will it not remove from you covenant of death, and your hope toward Hades certainly will not remain? If storm carried along comes upon, you will be for trampling to it.
Whenever it passes, it will take you; morning by morning it will pass, by day and by night. Hope will be evil; learn to hear.
Being cramped, we cannot fight; and they are weak for us to gather ourselves.
As mountain of ungodly he will rise, and he will be in valley of Gibeon with wrath. He will do his works, works of bitterness; but his wrath will use strange way, and his bitterness alien.
And you, do not rejoice, nor let your bonds grow strong, because completed and cut-short things I heard from Lord Sabaoth, what he will do upon whole earth.
Give ear and hear my voice; pay attention and hear my words.
Will plowman plow whole day, or prepare seed before working ground?
Is it not whenever he levels its surface, then he sows little black cumin and cumin, and again sows wheat and barley and spelt within your borders?
And you will be disciplined with judgment of your God and rejoice.
For black cumin is not threshed with harshness, nor wheel of wagon brought around on cumin, but with rod black cumin is shaken out, and the cumin.
With bread it will be eaten; for not forever will I be angry with you, nor voice of my bitterness trample you.
And these things came out from Lord Sabaoth: counsel wonders; lift vain comfort high.
Woe, city Ariel, which David warred against. Gather produce, year upon year, for you will eat with Moab.
For I will afflict Ariel, and its strength and wealth will be mine.
And I will circle around you as David and throw palisade around you and set towers around you.
And your words will be humbled to earth, and your words will sink into earth, and your voice will be as those calling from earth, and to ground your voice will grow weak.
And wealth of ungodly will be as dust from wheel and as carried chaff, and it will be as a moment suddenly.
For from Lord Sabaoth there will be visitation with thunder and earthquake and great voice, storm carried along and consuming flame of fire.
And wealth of all nations who campaigned against Ariel and all campaigning against Jerusalem and all gathered against her and afflicting her will be as one dreaming in sleep.

And they will be as those in sleep drinking and eating, and when they rise, their dream vain; and as thirsty man dreams as if drinking, and rising still thirsts, and his soul hoped for emptiness. Thus wealth of all nations who campaigned against Mount Zion will be.
Grow weak and be stunned and carouse, not from strong drink nor from wine.
Because Lord has given you drink by spirit of stupor and will shut their eyes, and their prophets and their rulers, those seeing hidden things.
And all these words will be to you as words of this sealed book. If they give it to man knowing letters, saying, Read these things, he will say, I cannot read, for it is sealed.
And this book will be given into hands of man not knowing letters, and they will say to him, Read this, and he will say, I do not know letters.
And Lord said, This people draws near to me with lips; with their lips they honor me, but their heart holds far from me. In vain they revere me, teaching commandments and teachings of men.
Because of this, behold, I will add to move this people and will move them, and wisdom of wise I will destroy, and understanding of understanding ones I will hide.
Woe those making counsel deep, and not through Lord. Woe those making counsel in secret, and their works will be in darkness, and they will say, Who has seen us, and who will know us or what we do?
Will you not be reckoned as clay of potter? Will thing formed say to one forming, You did not form me? Or work to one making, You did not make me intelligently?
Yet a little, and Lebanon will be changed as mountain of Carmel, and mountain of Carmel will be reckoned as forest.
And in that day deaf will hear words of book, and eyes of blind in darkness and gloom will see.
And poor will exult through Lord with gladness, and hopeless among men will be filled with gladness.
Lawless one failed and proud one perished and those lawless unto evil were utterly destroyed,
and those making men sin in word and setting stumbling block for all reproving in gates and turning righteous aside among unjust ones.
Therefore thus says Lord upon house of Jacob, whom he set apart from Abraham: Now Jacob will not be ashamed, nor now will Israel change face.
But when they see their children, my works because of me, they will sanctify my name and sanctify Holy One of Jacob and fear God of Israel.
And those led astray in spirit will know understanding, and grumblers will learn to obey, and stammering tongues will learn to speak peace.
Woe, apostate children, thus says Lord. You made counsel not through me and agreements not through my Spirit, to add sins upon sins,
those going down into Egypt, but they did not ask me, to be helped under Pharaoh and sheltered under Egyptians.
For shelter of Pharaoh will be to you into shame, and to those trusting in Egypt = reproach.
Because there are leaders in Tanis, evil messengers; in vain they will toil.
Toward people who will not benefit them, neither for help nor profit, but for shame and reproach.

Vision of four-footed beasts in wilderness, in affliction and tightness: lion and lion's cub from there, and asps and offspring of flying asps, who carried on donkeys and camels their wealth to nation that will not benefit them for help but for shame and reproach.
Egyptians will help you vainly and emptyly. Report to them that your comfort = vanity.
Now then sit down and write these things on boxwood and in book, because these will be for days of times and forever.
Because this people disobedient, lying sons, who did not want to hear law of God,
who say to prophets, Do not announce to us, and to those seeing visions, Do not speak to us, but speak to us and announce to us another wandering.
And turn us from this way, remove from us this path, and remove from us Holy One of Israel.
Because of this thus says Lord, Holy One of Israel: Because you disobeyed these words and hoped on falsehood and because you grumbled and became trusting on this word,
because of this this sin will be to you as wall falling suddenly of strong city captured, whose collapse is instantly near.
And its fall will be as shattering of earthen vessel from pottery, crushed fine, so that not find shard in them in which you may lift fire and in which draw a little water.

Thus says Lord, Holy One of Israel: When you turn and groan, then you will be saved and know where you were whenever you trusted in vanities. Your strength became vanity, and you did not want to hear.
But you said, We will flee on horses. Because of this you will flee. And you said, We will be riders on swift ones. Because of this those pursuing you will be swift.
At voice of one, thousand will flee, and at voice of five, many will flee until you are left as mast on mountain and as standard-bearer on hill.
And again God waits to pity you, and because of this he will be exalted to have mercy on you, because Lord our God is judge. And where will you leave your glory? Blessed those staying in him.
Because holy people will dwell in Zion and Jerusalem. With weeping he wept, Have mercy on me. He will pity you; at voice of your cry, whenever he saw, he heard you.
And Lord will give you bread of affliction and narrow water, and those leading you astray will certainly no longer come near you, because your eyes will see those leading you astray.
And your ears will hear words of those behind you who led you astray, saying, This way, let us walk in it, whether right or left.
And you will cast away silver-covered idols and gold-plated idols. You will make them small and winnow them like polluted water, and thrust them away as dung.
Then there will be rain for seed of your land, and bread from produce of your land will be abundant and rich, and your cattle will be grazed in that day in rich and spacious place.
Your bulls and oxen working land will eat prepared straw mixed in barley.
And on every high mountain and lofty hill there will be passing water in that day when many perish and towers fall.
And light of moon will be as light of sun, and light of sun will be sevenfold in day when Lord heals crushing of his people and will heal pain of your blow.
Behold, name of Lord comes after much time, burning = wrath with glory. Oracle of his lips full of wrath, and anger of wrath as fire will eat.
And his spirit will come as water in ravine dragging along up to neck, and it will be divided to trouble nations with vain wandering, and wandering will pursue them and seize them before face.
Must you not rejoice continually and go into my holy things continually, as those keeping feast and as those rejoicing to enter with flute into mountain of Lord, to God of Israel?
And God will make glory of his voice heard and show wrath of his arm with fury and anger and devouring flame, he will thunder violently, and as water and hail rushing down by force.
For by voice of Lord Assyrians will be defeated by blow with which he strikes them.
And around him there will be where was hope of help for him, on which he trusted. With flutes and lyres they will war against him by change of turns.
For beforehand you will be demanded, lest perhaps deep ravine was prepared also for you to reign, wood laid, fire and much wood; wrath of Lord as ravine burning with sulfur.

Woe those going down to Egypt for help, those trusting in horses and chariots, for they are many, and in horses = very great multitude, and were not trusting in Holy One of Israel and did not seek God.
And he himself, being wise, brought evils upon them, and his word certainly will not be nullified, and he will rise against houses of evil men and against their vain hope.
Egyptian = man and not God, flesh of horses and there is no help. But Lord will bring his hand upon them, and helpers will tire and together all will perish.

Because thus Lord said to me: As lion or lion's cub roars over prey it took and cries over it until mountains are filled with its voice and they are defeated and multitude of wrath terrified, thus Lord Sabaoth will come down to campaign against Mount Zion and her mountains.
As birds flying, thus Lord will shield over Jerusalem and rescue and preserve and save.
Turn back, you counseling deep and lawless counsel.
Because in that day men will reject their silver and gold handmade things which their hands made.
And Asshur will fall, not by sword of man, nor sword of human devour him; and he will flee, not from face of sword, and young men will be for defeat.
For they will be seized as by trench around rock and be defeated; but one fleeing will be caught. Thus says Lord: Blessed one having seed in Zion and household in Jerusalem.
For behold, righteous king will reign, and rulers will rule with judgment.
And man will be hiding his words and will be hidden as from carried water, and will appear in Zion as glorious flowing river in thirsty land.
And they will no longer be trusting in men, but will give ears to hear.
And heart of weak ones will attend to hear, and stammering tongues will quickly learn to speak peace.
And they will certainly no longer say to fool, Rule; and they will certainly no longer say, Your servants, be silent.
For fool will speak foolish things, and his heart will think vain things, to finish lawless things and speak wandering against Lord, to scatter hungry souls and make thirsty souls empty.
For counsel of evil men will counsel lawless things, to destroy humble with unjust words and scatter words of humble in judgment.
But godly men counseled understanding things, and this counsel remains.
Rich women, rise and hear my voice; daughters in hope, hear my words.
Make remembrance days of year in pain with hope; vintage is spent, seed ceased and will certainly no longer come.
Be stunned, grieve, you trusting ones; strip, become naked, gird loins with sackcloths.
And beat yourselves on breasts for desired field and fruit-bearing vine.
Thorn and grass will come up on land of my people, and from every house gladness will be taken away, rich city.
Abandoned houses will leave wealth of city and desirable houses, and villages will be caves forever, joy of wild donkeys, pastures of shepherds,
until spirit from on high comes upon you, and Carmel will be wilderness and Carmel reckoned as forest.
And judgment will rest in wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in Carmel.
And works of righteousness will be peace, and righteousness will hold rest and trust forever.
And his people will dwell in city of peace and settle trusting and rest with wealth.
And if hail comes down, it will not come upon you, and those dwelling in forests will be trusting as those in plain.
Blessed those sowing over every water, where ox and donkey do not tread.

Woe to those making you miserable, but no one makes you miserable; and one rejecting you does not reject. Those rejecting will be captured and handed over, and as moth on garment, thus they will be defeated.
Lord, have mercy on us, for on you we have trusted. Seed of disobedient became for destruction, but our salvation in time of affliction.
At voice of your fear peoples were astonished; from your fear nations were scattered.
But now your spoils will be gathered, small and great; as if someone gathers locusts, thus they will mock you.
Holy = God dwelling in heights; Zion was filled with judgment and righteousness.
By law they will be handed over; in treasures = our salvation. There wisdom and knowledge and piety toward Lord; these are treasures of righteousness.
Look now, in your fear they themselves will fear; those you feared will fear from you, for messengers will be sent asking peace, weeping bitterly, imploring peace.
For their roads will be made desolate, fear of nations ceased, and covenant with these is removed, and you shall certainly not reckon them as men.
Land mourned, Lebanon was shamed, Sharon became marsh; Galilee and Carmel will become visible.
Now I will rise, says Lord; now I will be glorified; now I will be exalted.
Now you will see, now you will perceive. Strength of your spirit will be vanity; fire will devour you.
And nations will be burned as thorn in field thrown aside and burned.
Those far away will hear what I did; those near will know my strength.
Lawless in Zion departed; trembling will seize ungodly. Who will report to you that fire burns? Who will report to you the eternal place?
One walking in righteousness, speaking straight way, hating lawlessness and injustice, shaking hands from gifts, stopping ears not to hear judgment of blood, shutting eyes not to see injustice.
This one will dwell on high in cave of strong rock; bread will be given to him and his water faithful.
You will see king with glory, and your eyes will see land from far away.
Your soul will meditate fear: Where are scribes? Where are counselors? Where is one counting those being fed?
Small and great people to whom they did not counsel, nor knew deep-voiced speech so as not to hear; people despised, and there is no understanding to listener.
Behold Zion, city of our salvation. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, rich city; tents that certainly will not be shaken, nor will pegs of her tent move forever, nor will her ropes be torn.
Because name of Lord great to you; place to you will be rivers and broad and spacious channels. This way a ship under oars will not travel, nor will vessel go through.
For my God is great; he will not pass me by. Lord our judge, Lord our ruler, Lord our king, Lord himself will save us.
Your ropes were torn, because your mast was not strengthened; it bent, will not loosen sails, will not lift signal until it is handed over for plunder. Therefore many lame will make plunder.
And people dwelling in them will certainly not say, I am weary, for their sin has been forgiven them.
Come near, nations, and hear; rulers, hear. Let earth and those in it hear, inhabited world and people in it.
Because wrath of Lord upon all nations and anger upon their number, to destroy them and hand them over into slaughter.
And their wounded will be thrown out, and their dead, and their smell will go up, and mountains will be soaked from their blood.
And heaven will be rolled like book, and all stars will fall as leaves from vine and as leaf falls from fig tree.
My sword became drunk in heaven; behold, upon Idumea it will come down and upon people of destruction with judgment.
Sword of Lord was filled with blood, fattened from fat of lambs and from fat of goats and rams, because sacrifice to Lord in Bosor and great slaughter in Idumea.
And mighty ones will fall with them, and rams and bulls, and land will be drunk from blood, and from their fat it will be filled.
For day of judgment of Lord and year of repayment of judgment of Zion.
And its ravines will be turned into pitch and its land into sulfur, and its land will be burning as pitch.
Night and day it will not be quenched forever, and its smoke will go up forever; for generations it will be desolated and for much time.
And birds and hedgehogs and ibises and ravens will dwell in it, and measuring cord of desert will be cast upon it, and donkey-centaurs will dwell in it.
Its rulers will not exist, for its kings and its rulers and its grandees will be for destruction.
And thorny trees will spring up in their cities and in its fortresses, and it will be camp of sirens and courtyard of ostriches.
And demons will meet donkey-centaurs, and one will cry to another. There donkey-centaurs will rest, for they found rest for themselves.
There hedgehog nested and earth kept her children in safety. There deer met and saw each other's faces.
By number they passed, and one of them did not perish; one did not seek the other, because Lord commanded them and his spirit gathered them.
And he himself will cast lots to them, and his hand divided to them to graze forever; you will inherit forever; through generations of generations they will rest upon it.
Rejoice, thirsty wilderness; let wilderness exult and bloom as lily.
And deserts of Jordan will blossom and exult, and glory of Lebanon was given to it, and honor of Carmel, and my people will see glory of Lord and height of God.
Strengthen loosened hands and disabled knees.
Comfort the faint-hearted in mind; be strong, do not fear. Behold, our God repays judgment and will himself repay; he will come and save us.
Then eyes of blind will be opened and ears of deaf will hear.
Then lame one will leap as deer and tongue of stammerers will be clear, because water burst in wilderness and ravine in thirsty land.
And dry place will be marshes, and in thirsty land there will be spring of water. There joy of birds, camp of reed and marsh.

There will be pure way, and it will be called holy way, and unclean one certainly will not pass there, nor will there be unclean way there; but scattered ones will walk on it and certainly will not wander.
And lion will not be there, nor any evil beasts come up upon it, nor certainly be found there, but redeemed ones will walk in it.

And those gathered for Lord will return and come into Zion with gladness, and eternal gladness over their heads, for praise and exultation and gladness will seize them; pain and grief and groaning fled.
And it happened in fourteenth year of reigning Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyrians went up against fortified cities of Judah and took them.
And king of Assyrians sent Rabshakeh from Lachish into Jerusalem to king Hezekiah with much force, and he stood by conduit of upper pool on road of fuller's field.
And Eliakim son of Hilkiah the steward went out to him, and Somnas the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder.
And Rabshakeh said to them, Say to Hezekiah, Thus says great king, king of Assyrians, In what are you trusting?
Is battle-line made by counsel or words of lips? And now in what do you trust, that you disobey me?
Behold, you trust in this broken reed-rod, in Egypt. Whoever leans on it, it will enter his hand. Thus is Pharaoh king of Egypt and all trusting on him.
But if you say, We have trusted in Lord our God—
now make bargain with my lord king of Assyrians, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you can give riders upon them.
And how can you turn away face of one governor? Slaves are those trusting in Egyptians for horse and rider.
And now did we go up against this land without Lord to war against it?
And Eliakim and Somnas and Joah said to him, Speak to your servants in Syrian, for we hear, and do not speak to us in Judean. Why do you speak into ears of men on wall?
And Rabshakeh said to them, Was my lord not sent to speak these words to your lord or to you? Was it not rather to men sitting on wall, so that they may eat dung and drink urine with you together?
And Rabshakeh stood and cried with great voice in Judean and said, Hear words of great king, king of Assyrians.
Thus says king: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you with words that will not be able to rescue you.
And do not let Hezekiah say to you that God will rescue you and this city certainly will not be handed into hand of king of Assyrians.
Do not hear Hezekiah. Thus says king of Assyrians: If you want to be blessed, come out to me and eat each his vine and figs and drink water of your cisterns,
until I come and take you into land like your land, land of grain and wine and breads and vineyards.
Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, saying, Your God will rescue you. Did gods of nations each rescue its own land from hand of king of Assyrians?
Where is god of Hamath and Arphad, and where god of city of Sepharvaim? Were they able to rescue Samaria from my hand?
Who of all gods of these nations rescued its land from my hand, that God will rescue Jerusalem from my hand?
And they were silent, and no one answered him word, because king commanded no one to answer.
And Eliakim son of Hilkiah the steward and Somnas scribe of force and Joah son of Asaph the recorder came to Hezekiah, tearing tunics, and reported to him words of Rabshakeh.
And it happened when king Hezekiah heard, he tore garments and put on sackcloth and went up into house of Lord.
And he sent Eliakim the steward and Somnas the scribe and elders of priests clothed with sackcloths to Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet.
And they said to him, Thus says Hezekiah: Day of affliction and reproach and rebuke and anger = today, because labor came to one giving birth, but she has no strength to bear.

May Lord your God hear words of Rabshakeh, whom king of Assyrians sent to reproach living God and to reproach words which Lord your God heard, and you will pray to Lord your God concerning these remnants.
And servants of king came to Isaiah.
And Isaiah said to them, Thus you will say to your lord: Thus says Lord, Do not fear from words which you heard, with which envoys of king of Assyrians reproached me.
Behold, I cast spirit into him, and hearing report he will turn back to his own land and fall by sword in his own land.
And Rabshakeh turned back and found king besieging Lobna, and king of Assyrians heard that
Tharaka king of Ethiopians went out to besiege him. And hearing, he turned back and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
Thus you will say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let your God, on whom you trust, deceive you, saying, Jerusalem certainly will not be handed into hands of king of Assyrians.
Did you not hear what kings of Assyrians did to whole earth, how they destroyed?
Did gods of nations rescue them, whom my fathers destroyed, Gozan and Haran and Raphes which are in land of Thaimad?
Where are kings of Hamath and Arphad and city of Sepharvaim, Anag, Ougaua?
And Hezekiah took book from messengers and opened it before Lord.
And Hezekiah prayed to Lord, saying,
Lord Sabaoth, God of Israel, one sitting upon cherubim, you alone are God of every kingdom of inhabited world; you made heaven and earth.
Hear, Lord; look, Lord; and see words which Sennacherib sent to reproach living God.
For truly kings of Assyrians made whole inhabited world and their land desolate
and threw their idols into fire, for they were not gods but works of hands of men, wood and stones, and they destroyed them.
But you, Lord our God, save us from their hand so that every kingdom of earth may know that you alone are God.
And Isaiah son of Amoz was sent to Hezekiah and said to him, Thus says Lord God of Israel: I heard what you prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyrians.
This word God spoke concerning him: Virgin daughter Zion despised you and mocked you; after you daughter Jerusalem shook head.
Whom did you reproach and provoke? Against whom did you raise your voice and did not lift your eyes to height? Against Holy One of Israel.

Because through envoys you reproached Lord. For you said, In multitude of my chariots I went up into height of mountains and into far parts of Lebanon, and I cut down height of its cedar and beauty of cypress and entered height of region of forest.
And I set bridge and made waters desolate and every gathering of waters.
Did you not hear long ago what I did? From ancient days I arranged them. But now I displayed to lay nations waste in strongholds and dwellers in fortified cities.
I let go hands and they dried up and became as dry grass upon housetops and as field-grass.
And now your resting and your going out and your coming in I know.
And your anger, with which you raged, and your bitterness came up to me, and I will put hook into your nose and bridle on your lips and turn you back by way in which you came.
