And this to you = sign: Eat this year what you sowed, and in second year remnant, and in third year sow and reap and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
And those left in Judah will put forth root down and make seed upward.
Because from Jerusalem those left will go out and those being saved from Mount Zion. Zeal of Lord Sabaoth will do these things.

Because of this thus says Lord concerning king of Assyrians: He certainly will not enter this city, nor certainly cast arrow on it, nor certainly bring shield against it, nor certainly circle palisade around it.
But by way he came, by it he will turn back, thus says Lord.
I will shield over this city to save it for my sake and for David my servant.
And angel of Lord went out and killed from camp of Assyrians one hundred eighty-five thousand, and rising early in morning they found all bodies dead.
And king of Assyrians turned back and departed and dwelt in Nineveh.
And while he was bowing in house of Nasarach his ancestral god, Adramelech and Sarasar his sons struck him with swords, but they escaped into Armenia, and Asordan his son reigned in place of him.

And it happened in that time Hezekiah grew weak unto death, and Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet came to him and said to him, Thus says Lord: Arrange concerning your house, for you die and will not live.
And Hezekiah turned his face toward wall and prayed to Lord,
saying, Remember, Lord, how I walked before you with truth in true heart, and I did pleasing things before you. And Hezekiah wept with great weeping.
And word of Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
Go and say to Hezekiah, Thus says Lord God of David your father: I heard voice of your prayer and saw your tears. Behold, I add fifteen years to your time,
and from hand of king of Assyrians I will save you and shield over this city.
And this to you = sign from Lord that God will do this word:
shadow of stair-steps which sun went down, ten steps of house of your father, I will turn back the sun ten steps. And sun went up ten steps which shadow had gone down.
Prayer of Hezekiah king of Judah when he grew weak and rose from his weakness.
I said, In height of my days, in gates of Hades I will leave remaining years.
I said, I will certainly no longer see salvation of God on earth; I will certainly no longer see man.
From my kin I left remnant of my life; it went out and departed from me as one striking tent. My spirit by me became as weaver's web coming near to cut off; in that day I was handed over.
Until morning, as lion, thus he crushed my bones. For from day until night I was handed over.
As swallow thus I will cry, and as dove thus I will meditate, for my eyes failed from looking into height of heaven, toward Lord who delivered me.
And he took away pain of my soul.
Lord, for concerning this it was announced to you, and you roused my breath, and having comforted, I lived.
For you chose my soul so it might not perish, and you threw all my sins behind me.
For those in Hades will not praise you, nor will dead bless you, nor will those in Hades hope in your mercy.
Living ones will bless you, as also I; for from today I will make children who will announce your righteousness.
Lord of my salvation, and I will not stop blessing you with psaltery all days of my life before house of God.
And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Take cake of figs and rub and apply as poultice, and you will be healthy.
And Hezekiah said, This = sign that I will go up into house of Lord God.
At that time Marodach son of Laadan, king of Babylonia, sent letters and envoys and gifts to Hezekiah, for he heard he grew weak unto death and rose.

And Hezekiah rejoiced greatly over them and showed them house of perfumes and myrrh and incenses and ointment and silver and gold and all houses of vessels of treasury and all that was in his treasures, and there was nothing that Hezekiah did not show in his house.
And Isaiah the prophet came to king Hezekiah and said to him, What do these men say, and from where did they come to you? And Hezekiah said, From far land they came to me, from Babylon.
And Isaiah said, What did they see in your house? And Hezekiah said, They saw all things in my house, and there is nothing in my house which they did not see, and also things in my treasures.
And Isaiah said to him, Hear word of Lord Sabaoth.
Behold, days come, says Lord, and they will take all things in your house and whatever your fathers gathered until this day into Babylon, and they certainly will not leave anything, but God said,
and from your children whom you begot they will take and make eunuchs in house of king of Babylonians.
And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, Good word of Lord which he spoke. Let there be peace and righteousness in my days.
Comfort, comfort my people, says God.
Priests, speak to heart of Jerusalem; comfort her, because her humiliation is filled, her sin is loosed, because she received from hand of Lord double her sins.
Voice of one crying in wilderness, Prepare way of Lord, make straight paths of our God.
Every ravine will be filled, and every mountain and hill humbled, and all crooked things will be into straightness, and rough things into plains.
And glory of Lord will be seen, and all flesh will see salvation of God, because Lord spoke.
Voice of one saying, Cry out. And I said, What shall I cry? All flesh = grass, and all glory of man as flower of grass.
Grass dried up and flower fell,
but word of our God remains forever.
On high mountain go up, one bringing good news to Zion. Lift your voice with strength, one bringing good news to Jerusalem. Lift up, do not fear; say to cities of Judah, Behold your God.
Behold, Lord comes with strength, and arm with lordship; behold, his wage with him and work before him.
As shepherd he will shepherd his flock, and with his arm gather lambs and comfort those carrying in womb.
Who measured water with hand and heaven with span, and who set all earth by handful? Who set mountains with scale and glens with balance?
Who knew mind of Lord, and who became his counselor, who instructs him?
Or with whom did he take counsel and who instructed him? Or who showed him judgment? Or who showed him way of understanding?
If all nations as drop from bucket and as tilt of scales were reckoned, and as spit they will be reckoned.
Lebanon not enough for burning, and all four-footed animals not enough for whole burnt offering.
And all nations are as nothing and were reckoned into nothing.
To whom did you liken Lord, and to what likeness did you liken him?
Did not craftsman make image, or goldsmith having melted gold gilded it and construct likeness?
For incorrupt wood is chosen; craftsman wisely seeks how to set his image so it not be shaken.
Will you not know? Will you not hear? Was it not announced to you from beginning? Did you not know foundations of earth?
One holding circuit of earth, and those dwelling in it as locusts, one setting heaven as vault and stretching it as tent to dwell in,
one giving rulers to rule into nothing, and made earth as nothing.
For they certainly will not sow, nor plant, nor their root certainly take root into earth; he breathed upon them and they dried up, and storm will take them up as brushwood.
Now then to whom did you liken me, that I shall be exalted, said Holy One.
Lift eyes on high and see who showed all these, one bringing out his array by number; he will call all by name. From much glory and strength of power nothing escaped you.
So do not say, Jacob, and what did you speak, Israel? My way was hidden from God, and my God took away judgment and departed.
And now did you not know? Did you not hear? Eternal God, God who prepared ends of earth, will not hunger nor grow weary, nor is there finding out of his wisdom.
Giving strength to hungry ones and grief to those not pained.
For young men will hunger and grow weary, and chosen youths will be weak.
But those enduring for God will change strength, they will grow wings as eagles, they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not hunger.
Renew yourselves to me, islands, for rulers will change strength. Let them come near and speak together; then let them announce judgment.
Who raised from east righteousness? He called it to his feet and it will go. He will give nations before him and astonish kings and give their swords into earth and their bows as driven brushwood.
And he will pursue them and pass through in peace, way of his feet.
Who worked and did these things? He called it from generations of beginning. I = God, first, and in things coming I am.
Nations saw and feared; ends of earth drew near and came together.
Each judging for neighbor and saying to brother, Help.
Craftsman strengthened, and bronze-smith striking hammer while driving. At one time he says, Joint is good; they strengthened them with nails and they will not be moved.
But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I chose, seed of Abraham whom I loved,
whom I took hold from edges of earth and called from its watchpoints, and I said to you, You are my servant; I chose you and did not abandon you.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not wander, for I am your God, one strengthening you and helping you, and I secured you by my right righteous hand.
Behold, all opposing you will be ashamed and put to shame, for they will be as not existing, and all your adversaries will perish.
You will seek them and certainly not find men who rage against you, for those fighting against you will be as not existing and will not be.
For I am your God, holding your right hand, saying to you, Do not fear.
Jacob, little one; Israel, I helped you, says God, one redeeming you, Israel.
Behold, I made you as new threshing wheels of wagon, saw-toothed, and you will thresh mountains and make hills fine and make them as dust.
And you will winnow them, and wind will take them and storm scatter them. But you will rejoice in holy things of Israel, and they will exult.
For poor and needy will seek water and there will not be; their tongue dried up from thirst. I, Lord God, will hear; God of Israel, I will not abandon them.
But I will open rivers on mountains and make springs in midst of plains. I will make wilderness into marshes and thirsty land into aqueducts.
I will put in dry land cedar and box tree and myrtle and cypress and white poplar,
so that they may see and know and understand and know together that hand of Lord did all these things and Holy One of Israel displayed them.
Your judgment draws near, says Lord God; your counsels drew near, says king of Jacob.
Let them come near and announce to you what will happen, or what former things were; speak, and we will set our mind and know what last things are, and tell us things coming.
Tell us things coming at end, and we will know that you are gods; do good and do evil, and we will marvel and see together.
Because from where are you, and from where your work? They chose you from land, abomination.
But I raised one from north and one from east of sun; they will be called by my name. Let rulers come, and as potter's clay and as potter treading clay, thus you will be trampled.
For who will announce from beginning so that we may know, and things before, and we will say they are true? There is no one foretelling, nor one hearing your words.
I will give beginning to Zion and comfort Jerusalem for way.
For from nations, behold, no one, and from their idols there was not one announcing; and if I ask them from where are you, they certainly will not answer me.
For those making you and leading you astray are vain.
Jacob my servant, I will help him; Israel my chosen one, my soul accepted him. I gave my Spirit upon him; he will bring judgment to nations.
He will not cry out nor raise up, nor will his voice be heard outside.
Crushed reed he will not break, and smoking flax he will not quench, but into truth he will bring judgment.
He will shine out and will not be broken until he sets judgment upon earth, and nations will hope on his name.
Thus says Lord God, one making heaven and stretching it, one establishing earth and things in it, and giving breath to people on it and spirit to those walking on it.
I, Lord God, called you in righteousness and will hold your hand and strengthen you, and I gave you into covenant of race, into light of nations,
to open eyes of blind, bring bound ones out of bonds and those sitting in darkness out of prison house.
I, Lord God, this my name. My glory I will not give to another, nor my virtues to carved things.
Behold, former things came, and new things which I announce; before they spring up, they were made clear to you.
Sing to Lord new hymn, his beginning; glorify his name from end of earth, those going down into sea and sailing it, islands and those dwelling in them.
Rejoice, wilderness and its villages, camps and dwellers in Kedar. Dwellers of rock will rejoice; from tops of mountains they will cry out.
They will give glory to God, and in islands announce his virtues.
Lord God of powers will go out and crush war, stir up zeal and shout against his enemies with strength.
I was silent; will I also always be silent and endure? I held firm. As woman giving birth I will be amazed and dry up together.
And I will make rivers into islands and marshes I will dry up.

And I will lead blind in way they did not know and paths they did not know to tread I will make for them. I will make darkness to them into light and crooked things into straight. These words I will do and not abandon them.
But they turned backward. Be ashamed with shame, those trusting in carved things, those saying to molten images, You are our gods.
Deaf ones, hear; blind ones, look up to see.
And who blind except my servants, and deaf except those ruling them? And servants of God were blinded.
You saw many times and did not keep watch; ears were opened and you did not hear.
Lord God wanted that he should be justified and magnify praise, and I saw.

And people became plundered and pillaged, for snare in storerooms everywhere and in houses together where they hid them. They became for plunder and there was none rescuing, spoil and none saying, Give back.
Who among you will give ear to these things, will hear for things coming?
Who gave Jacob for plunder and Israel to those spoiling him? Was it not God against whom they sinned, and they did not want to walk in his ways nor hear his law?
And he brought upon them anger of his wrath and war prevailed over them, and those burning them around, each did not know nor set it on soul.
And now thus says Lord God, one making you, Jacob, one forming you, Israel: Do not fear, because I redeemed you; I called you by your name; you are mine.
And if you pass through water, I am with you, and rivers will not flood you, and if you pass through fire, you certainly will not be burned; flame will not burn you.
Because I = Lord your God, Holy One of Israel, one saving you. I made Egypt and Ethiopia and Syene your exchange.
Since you became precious before me, you were glorified and I loved you, and I will give many men for you and rulers over your head.
Do not fear, because I am with you. From east I will bring your seed, and from west I will gather you.
I will say to north, Bring, and to south, Do not hinder; bring my sons from far land and my daughters from ends of earth,
all as many as are called by my name, for in my glory I prepared him and formed and made him.
And I brought out blind people, and eyes exist yet equally blind, and deaf having ears.

All nations were gathered together, and rulers will gather. Who among them announces these things, or who from beginning will announce to you? Let them bring their witnesses and be justified and say truth.

Become witnesses to me, and I witness, says Lord God, and servant whom I chose, so that you may know and believe and understand that I am. Before me no other god came to be, and after me there will not be.
I am God, and apart from me there is no one saving.
I announced and saved; I reproached, and there was no foreigner among you. You = my witnesses, and I = witness, says Lord God.
Still from beginning, and there is none rescuing from my hands. I will do, and who will turn it back?
Thus says Lord God, one redeeming you, Holy One of Israel: Because of you I will send into Babylon and stir up all fugitives, and Chaldeans will be bound in ships.
I = Lord God, your Holy One, one showing Israel your king.
Thus says Lord, one giving way in sea and path in strong water,
one bringing out chariot and horse and strong crowd. But they slept and will not rise; they were quenched as extinguished flax.
Do not remember former things and do not consider ancient things.
Behold, I make new things which now will spring up, and you will know them, and I will make in wilderness a way and in dry land rivers.
Beasts of field, sirens and daughters of ostriches, will bless me, because I gave water in wilderness and rivers in dry land to give drink to my chosen race,
my people whom I acquired to recount my virtues.
Not now did I call you, Jacob, nor did I make you weary, Israel.
You did not bring me sheep of your burnt offerings, nor glorify me in your sacrifices, nor make me toil with frankincense.
Nor did you buy me incense with silver, nor did I desire fat of your sacrifices, but in your sins and injustices I stood before you.
I am, I am, one wiping out your lawlessnesses, and certainly I will not remember.
But you remember, and let us judge together; speak you your lawlessnesses first, so that you may be justified.
Your first fathers and their rulers acted lawlessly against me.
And rulers defiled my holy things, and I gave Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.
Now hear, my servant Jacob, and Israel whom I chose.
Thus says Lord God, one making you and shaping you from womb: You will still be helped. Do not fear, my servant Jacob, beloved Israel whom I chose.
Because I will give water in thirst to those going in dry land; I will put my Spirit on your seed and my blessings on your children.
And they will spring up like grass among waters, and like willows by flowing water.
This one will say, I belong to God; and this one will cry out in name of Jacob; and another will write, I belong to God, in name of Israel.
Thus says God, king of Israel, one rescuing him, God Sabaoth: I first, and I after these things; besides me no god exists.
Who like me? Let him stand, call out, and prepare it before me, from time I made humankind for age; and things coming before they come, let them declare to you.
Do not hide yourselves. Have you not heard from beginning? I told you. You are my witnesses whether there is god besides me; there were none then.
Those shaping and carving all vain, making their cherished things, which will not profit them; instead they will be put to shame.
All who shape god and carve useless things.
And all from whom they came were dried up, and mute from among men. Let them all gather and stand together; let them together be shamed and disgraced.
For craftsman sharpened iron, worked it with axe, pierced it with drill, worked it with strength of his arm; then he will hunger and grow weak, and by not drinking water, become faint.
Carpenter with wood set it by measure and shaped it by line. He made it as form of man and as beauty of human, to set it in house.
One cut wood from forest, which Lord planted, and rain made grow.
So it might be for humans as fuel; taking from it he warmed himself, and burning it they baked breads; with what remained they worked gods and worship them.
Half of it they burned in fire, and baking breads on it, and roasting meat on it, he ate and was filled; and being warmed he said, Pleasant to me, because I am warmed and saw fire.
But remainder he made into carved god and worships it and prays, saying, Deliver me, because you are my god.
They did not know to understand, because they were darkened from seeing with their eyes and from perceiving with their heart.

And he did not consider in his heart, nor reckon in his soul, nor know with understanding that he burned half of it in fire and baked breads on its coals and roasted meat and ate, and its remainder he made into abomination and they worship it.
Know that their heart = ashes; they wander, and no one can rescue his soul. See, will you not say, Lie in my right hand?
Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, because you are my servant. I formed you my servant, and you, Israel, do not forget me.
For see, I wiped away your lawless deeds like cloud and your sins like gloom. Turn to me, and I will redeem you.

Be glad, heavens, because God showed mercy to Israel. Trumpet, foundations of earth. Cry out, mountains, with gladness, hills and all trees in them, because God redeemed Jacob, and in Israel will be glorified.
Thus says Lord, one redeeming you and shaping you from womb: I Lord completing all, stretched out heaven alone and founded earth. Who else?
He scatters signs of ventriloquists and divinations from heart, turning wise men backward and making their counsel foolish,
confirming words of his servant and making true counsel of his messengers, saying, Jerusalem, You will be inhabited, and to cities of Judah, You will be built, and her desolate places will spring up.
saying to abyss, Be made desolate, and I will dry up your rivers.
saying Cyrus will think rightly and do all my will, saying, Jerusalem, You will be built, and my holy house, I will lay foundation.
Thus says Lord God to my anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I grasped, to make nations submit before him. I will tear apart strength of kings, open doors before him, and cities will not be shut.
I will go before you and level mountains; bronze doors I will crush and iron bars I will break.
And I will give you dark treasures, hidden unseen ones I will open for you, so you may know that I, Lord God, one calling your name, am God of Israel.
For sake of Jacob my servant and Israel my chosen, I will call you by your name and accept you; but you did not know me.
Because I am Lord God, and there is no other; besides me no god, and you did not know me.
So those from sunrise and those from west may know that none exists besides me. I am Lord God, and there is no other.
I one preparing light and making darkness, making peace and creating evils; I am Lord God, doing all these things.
Let heaven above rejoice, and clouds rain righteousness. Let earth bring forth mercy, and let righteousness spring up together. I am Lord who created you.
What better thing did I make than clay of potter? Will plowman plow whole earth all day? Will clay say to potter, What are you doing, since you do not work, nor have hands?
Woe to one saying to father, What will you father? and to mother, What are you laboring to bear?
Because thus says Lord God, Holy One of Israel, one making things coming: Ask me concerning my sons and daughters, and command me concerning works of my hands.
I made earth and humankind on it. I with my hand fixed heaven; I commanded all stars.
I raised him up with righteousness as king, and all his ways straight. He will build my city and turn back captivity of my people, not with ransom nor with gifts, says Lord Sabaoth.

Thus says Lord Sabaoth: Egypt labored, and trade of Ethiopians, and Sabeans, tall men, will pass over to you and be your slaves, and behind you they will follow, bound with handcuffs, and they will worship you and pray in you, because God is in you; and they will say, No god exists besides you.
For you are God, and we did not know it, God of Israel, savior.
All opposing him will be shamed and disgraced, and go in shame. Renew yourselves to me, islands.
Israel is saved by Lord with everlasting salvation; they will not be ashamed nor disgraced forever.
Thus says Lord, one making heaven, this God showing earth and making it, he marked it out; not in vain he made it, but to be inhabited. I am, and there is no other.
Not in secret I have spoken, nor in dark place of earth. I did not say to seed of Jacob, Seek me in vain. I am, I am Lord, speaking righteousness and declaring truth.
Gather and come; take counsel together, you being saved from nations. They did not know, those carrying wood of their carved image and praying as to gods who do not save.

If they declare, let them come near so they may know together. Who made these things heard from beginning? Then I declared them to you. I am God, and no other besides me; righteous and savior, none besides me.
Turn to me and be saved, those from end of earth. I am God and there is no other.
By myself I swear: surely righteousness will go out from my mouth; my words will not turn back, because to me every knee will bend and every tongue confess to God.
saying, Righteousness and glory will come to him, and all separating themselves will be shamed.
From Lord all seed of sons of Israel will be justified, and in God be glorified.
Bel fell, Dagon shattered. Their carved images became for animals and cattle. Carry them tied up as burden for weary one.
And for hungry and weakened one, not strong together, they will not be able to save themselves from war, but they themselves were led away captive.
Hear me, house of Jacob, and all remnant of Israel, carried from womb and instructed from childhood.
Until old age I am, and until you grow old I am. I bear you; I made, and I will release; I will take up and save you.
To whom did you compare me? See. Scheme it out, you wanderers.
Those pouring gold from purse and silver in balance will set it by weight, and hiring goldsmith made handmade things, and bowing down they worship them.
They lift it on shoulders and go. If they set it in its place, it stays; it will not move. Whoever cries to it, it will not hear; from evils it will not save him.
Remember these things and groan. Repent, you who have wandered; turn back in heart.
And remember former things from age, because I am God and there is no other besides me.
Declaring last things beforehand before they happen, and together they were accomplished. And I said, All my counsel will stand, and all I have planned I will do.
Calling bird from east and from far land man of my purposes. I spoke and brought it; I created and did it; I brought him and prospered his way.
Hear me, you ruined in heart, you far from righteousness.
I brought near my righteousness and salvation from me. I do not delay. I gave salvation in Zion to Israel for glory.
Come down. Sit on ground, virgin daughter of Babylon. Enter darkness, daughter of Chaldeans, because no longer will you be called tender and delicate.
Take millstone. Grind flour. Uncover your veil, uncover your hair, pull up your skirts, bare your legs, cross rivers.
Your shame will be uncovered, your reproaches seen. From you I will take justice; I will no longer give you to people.
Said your rescuer, Lord Sabaoth, Holy One of Israel his name.
Sit pierced through. Enter darkness, daughter of Chaldeans, because no longer will you be called strength of kingdom.
I was provoked against my people. I defiled my inheritance. I gave them into your hand, but you gave them no mercy; on old man you made yoke very heavy.
And you said, For age I will be ruler. You did not consider these things in your heart, nor remember end things.
Now hear these things, delicate one, sitting secure, saying in her heart, I am, and there is no other. I will not sit widow, nor know childlessness.
But now these two things will come on you suddenly in one day: widowhood and childlessness. Suddenly they will come on you, in your sorcery, in great strength of your spells.

In hope of your evil, for you said, I am, and there is no other. Know that understanding of these things and your prostitution will be shame to you, and you said in your heart, I am, and there is no other.

And ruin will come on you, and you will not know pit, and you will fall into it. Misery will come on you, and you will not be able to become clean. Sudden ruin will come on you, and you will not know it.
Stand now with your spells and your much sorcery, which you learned from youth, if perhaps you can be helped.
You are wearied in your counsels. Let astrologers of heaven stand and save you, those looking at stars; let them announce to you what is coming on you.
See, all as brushwood in fire will be burned, and they will not rescue their soul from flame, because you have coals of fire to sit on them.
Such will be your help. You labored in your trafficking from youth. Each man wandered by himself. For you there will be no salvation.
Hear these things, house of Jacob, those called by name of Israel and come out of Judah, swearing by name of Lord God of Israel, remembering not with truth nor with righteousness.
And holding fast to name of holy city and leaning on God of Israel; Lord Sabaoth his name.
Former things I declared long ago, and from my mouth they went out and became heard. Suddenly I did them, and they came.
I know that you are hard, your neck iron sinew, and your forehead bronze.
And I declared to you of old, before it came on you I made it heard to you, lest you say, My idols did them, and my carved and cast things commanded me.
You heard all, and you did not know. But I also made new things heard to you from now, things about to happen, and you did not say it.
Now they come to be and not long ago, and before today you did not hear them, lest you say, Yes, I know them.
You neither knew nor understood, nor from beginning did I open your ears, for I knew that in rejecting you would reject, and lawless from womb you would be called.
For sake of my name I will show you my wrath, and I will bring my glorious acts on you, so I do not destroy you.
See, I sold you, not for silver, but chose you out of furnace of poverty.
For my own sake I will do for you, because my name is profaned, and my glory I will not give to another.
Hear me, Jacob, and Israel whom I call. I am first, and I am forever.
My hand founded earth and my right hand fixed heaven. I will call them, and they will stand together.
And all will gather and hear. Who among them declared these things? Because I loved you, I did your will against Babylon, to remove seed of Chaldeans.
I spoke, I called, I brought him, and I prospered his way.
Come near to me and hear these things. Not from beginning did I speak in secret, nor in dark place of earth. When it happened, I was there. And now Lord sent me and his Spirit.
Thus says Lord, one rescuing you, Holy One of Israel: I am your God. I showed you to find way in which you should walk.
If you had heard my commandments, then your peace would have become like river and your righteousness like wave of sea.
And your seed would have become like sand, and offspring of your womb like dust of earth; nor now would you be destroyed, nor your name perish before me.
Go out from Babylon, fleeing from Chaldeans. Declare with voice of gladness and let this be heard. Proclaim it to end of earth. Say, Lord rescued his servant Jacob.
And if they thirst, through wilderness he will lead them; he will bring out water for them from rock. Rock will be split, water will flow, and my people will drink.
No rejoicing for ungodly, says Lord.
Hear me, islands, and pay attention, nations, after long time. Lord says, From my mother's womb he called my name.
And he made my mouth like sharp sword and hid me under shelter of his hand. He made me as chosen arrow and covered me in his quiver.
And he said to me, You are my servant, Israel, and in you I will be glorified.
But I said, In vain I labored, and for emptiness and nothing I gave my strength. Therefore my judgment from Lord and my toil before my God.
And now thus says Lord, one shaping me from womb as servant to himself, to gather Jacob and Israel to him. I will be gathered and glorified before Lord, and my God will be my strength.

And he said to me, Great thing for you it is to be called my servant, to set up tribes of Jacob and turn back dispersion of Israel. See, I made you covenant of race, light of nations, that you may be for salvation to end of earth.

Thus says Lord, the one rescuing you, the God of Israel: to the one despised in soul, to the one abhorred by nations, to servant of rulers: Kings will see and rise, rulers also, and will worship, because of Lord, because Holy One of Israel is faithful, and he chose you.
Thus says Lord: In acceptable time I heard you, and in day of salvation I helped you, and I gave you covenant of nations, to establish earth and inherit deserted inheritances.
saying to those in bonds, Come out, and to those in darkness, Be revealed. On all their ways they will be pastured, and on all their paths their grazing.
They will not hunger nor thirst, nor will heat strike them, nor sun, but one having mercy on them will comfort them and lead them by springs of waters.
And I will make every mountain into road and every path into pasture for them.
See, these come from far away; these from north, and these from sea; and others from land of Persians.
Rejoice, heavens, and let earth exult. Let mountains break out in gladness, and hills in righteousness, because God had mercy on his people and comforted humble ones of his people.
But Zion said, Lord abandoned me, and Lord forgot me.
Will woman forget her child, so as not to have mercy on offspring of her womb? But even if woman forgets these, I will not forget you, said Lord.
See, on my hands I have painted your walls, and you are always before me.
And quickly you will be built by those by whom you were torn down, and those making you desolate will go out from you.
Lift your eyes around and see. See, all were gathered and came to you. As I live, says Lord, you will clothe yourself with them all and put them on as ornament of bride.
Because your desolate places and ruined and fallen ones will now be made too narrow from inhabitants, and those swallowing you will be far from you.
For your sons whom you lost will say in your ears, Place too narrow for me; make room for me that I may dwell.
And you will say in your heart, Who bore these for me? I was childless and widow; who raised these for me? I was left alone; where were these for me?
Thus says Lord: See, I lift my hand to nations and raise my signal to islands, and they will bring your sons in bosom, and your daughters they will carry on shoulders.
And kings will be your foster fathers and rulers your nurses. They will worship you with face to ground and lick dust of your feet, and you will know that I am Lord, and you will not be ashamed.
Will anyone take spoils from giant? And if someone takes captive unjustly, will he be saved?
Thus says Lord: If anyone takes captive giant, he will take spoils; but one taking from strong man will be saved. I will judge your judgment, and I will rescue your sons.
And those afflicting you will eat their own flesh and drink their own blood like new wine and be drunk. And all flesh will know that I am Lord, one rescuing you and upholding strength of Jacob.

Thus says Lord: What book of divorce of your mother, with which I sent her away? Or to which creditor did I sell you? See, by your sins you were sold, and by your lawless deeds I sent away your mother.

Why, because I came and no man was there? I called and no one obeyed. Is my hand not strong to rescue, or am I not strong to deliver? See, by my threat I will desolate sea and make rivers dry; their fish will dry up from lack of water and die in thirst.
And I will clothe heaven with darkness and make sackcloth its covering.
Lord gives me tongue of instruction, to know when it is necessary to speak word. He set it in morning; he added to me ear to hear.
And discipline of Lord opens my ears, and I do not disobey nor speak against.
I gave my back to whips and my cheeks to slaps. My face I did not turn away from shame of spit.
And Lord became my helper. Therefore I was not ashamed, but set my face as solid rock and knew I will not be shamed.
Because one justifying me comes near. Who is judging with me? Let him stand against me together. And who is my accuser? Let him come near me.
See, Lord helps me. Who will harm me? See, all you will grow old like garment, and moth will eat you.
Who among you fears Lord? Let him hear voice of his servant. Those going in darkness have no light; trust in name of Lord and lean on God.
See, all you kindle fire and strengthen flame. Walk by light of your fire and by flame you kindled. Because of me these things came to you; in grief you will lie down.
Hear me, you pursuing righteousness and seeking Lord. Look to solid rock which you cut and to pit of well which you dug.
Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who labored to bear you, because he was one, and I called him and blessed him and loved him and multiplied him.

And now I will comfort Zion and have comforted all her desolate places, and I will make her desolations as paradise of Lord. Gladness and exultation they will find in her, thanksgiving and sound of praise.
Hear me, hear me, my people, and kings give ear to me, because law will go out from me and my judgment as light of nations.
My righteousness draws near quickly, my salvation will go out as light, and nations will hope in my arm. Islands wait for me and hope in my arm.

Lift your eyes to heaven and look at earth below, because heaven was fixed like smoke and earth will grow old like garment, and those dwelling earth will die like these. But my salvation will be forever and my righteousness will not fail.
Hear me, you knowing judgment, my people whose law is in your heart. Do not fear reproach of men and do not be defeated by their contempt.
For as garment it will be eaten by time and as wool it will be eaten by moth. But my righteousness will be forever and my salvation to generations of generations.
Awake, awake, Jerusalem, and put on strength of your arm. Awake as in beginning of days, as generation of age. Are you not
one laying waste sea, water of abyss, making abundance, one making depths of sea way of passage for delivered ones?
For redeemed by Lord will return and come to Zion with gladness, and everlasting exultation on their head. Praise and gladness and joy will seize them. Pain and grief and groaning fled.
I am, I am one comforting you. Know whom you feared, dreading mortal man and son of man who dried up like grass.

And you forgot God who made you, who made heaven and founded earth, and you feared always all days face of wrath of one afflicting you, because he planned to remove you. And now where is wrath of one afflicting you?
For in being saved you will not stand still nor delay.
Because I am your God, stirring sea and sounding its waves. Lord Sabaoth my name.
I will put my words into your mouth, and under shadow of my hand I will shelter you, by which I set heaven and founded earth and will say to Zion, You are my people.
Awake, awake. Rise, Jerusalem, you who drank cup of wrath from hand of Lord, because cup of falling, bowl of wrath, you drank and drained it.
And there was no one comforting you from all your children whom you bore, and no one taking your hand from all your sons whom you raised.
These two things stand against you. Who will grieve with you? Ruin and crushing, famine and sword. Who will comfort you?
Your sons in distress, sleeping at edge of every street, like half-cooked beet, full of wrath of Lord, weakened by Lord God.
Therefore hear this, humbled one and drunken one, not from wine.
Thus says Lord God, one judging his people: See, I have taken from your hand cup of falling, bowl of wrath, and you will no longer drink it.
And I will put it into hands of those wronging you and humbling you, who said to your soul, Bend down so we may pass by. And you made your back level with earth outside for those passing by.
Awake, awake, Zion. Put on your strength, Zion, and put on your glory, Jerusalem, holy city, because uncircumcised and unclean will no longer pass through you.
Shake off dust and rise. Sit, Jerusalem. Strip off bond of your neck, captive daughter of Zion.
Because thus says Lord: For nothing you were sold, and not with silver will you be redeemed.
Thus says Lord: My people first went down to Egypt to dwell there, and to Assyrians they were led by force.
And now why are you here? says Lord, because my people was taken for nothing. Be amazed and howl, says Lord. Because of you continually my name is blasphemed among nations.
Therefore my people will know my name in that day, because I am one speaking; I am present.
How beautiful upon mountains are feet of one bringing good news, report of peace, one bringing good things as good news, because I will make your salvation heard, saying to Zion, Your God will reign.
Because voice of your watchmen was lifted up, and with voice together they will rejoice, because eye to eye they will see when Lord shows mercy to Zion.
Let desolations of Jerusalem break out together in gladness, because Lord had mercy on her and rescued Jerusalem.
Lord will uncover his holy arm before all nations, and all ends of earth will see salvation from God.
Depart, depart. Go out from there, and touch nothing unclean. Go out from midst of her. Be set apart, you carrying vessels of Lord.
Because not with turmoil will you go out, nor will you go as fleeing, for Lord will go before you, and Lord God of Israel will gather you.
See, my servant will understand and be exalted and glorified greatly.
As many will be astonished at you, so your appearance will be without glory from men and your glory from people.
So many nations will marvel at him, and kings will shut their mouth, because those to whom nothing was told concerning him will see, and those who did not hear will understand.
Lord, who believed our report? And to whom was arm of Lord revealed?
We announced before him as child, as root in thirsty land. He has no form nor glory, and we saw him, and he had no form nor beauty.
But his form dishonored, failing beyond all men, man in wound and knowing how to bear sickness, because his face is turned away; he was dishonored and not counted.
This one bears our sins and suffers pain for us, and we counted him to be in pain and in wound and in affliction.
But he was wounded because of our lawless deeds and weakened because of our sins. Discipline of our peace on him; by his bruise we were healed.
All we as sheep wandered. Man wandered in his own way, and Lord gave him over for our sins.
And he, because he was afflicted, does not open his mouth. As sheep led to slaughter and as lamb silent before one shearing it, so he does not open his mouth.
In his humiliation his judgment was taken away. Who will tell his generation? Because his life is taken from earth; because of lawless deeds of my people he was led to death.
And I will give wicked ones for his burial and rich ones for his death, because he did no lawlessness, nor was deceit found in his mouth.
And Lord desires to cleanse him from wound. If you give your soul concerning sin, he will see long-lived seed, and Lord desires to remove pain.
From pain of his soul, to show him light and form with understanding, to justify righteous one serving many well, and he will bear their sins.

Therefore he will inherit many and divide spoils of strong, because his soul was given over to death and he was counted among lawless ones, and he bore sins of many and was given over because of their sins.
Rejoice, barren one who does not bear. Break out and cry, you not laboring, because children of desolate one more than of her having husband, said Lord.
Enlarge place of your tent, and fix your curtains. Do not spare. Lengthen your cords and strengthen your pegs.
Still to right and to left spread out, and your seed will inherit nations and inhabit desolated cities.
Do not fear, because you were put to shame; do not be disgraced, because you were reproached, because you will forget everlasting shame and no longer remember reproach of your widowhood.
Because Lord making you, Lord Sabaoth his name, and one rescuing you, he God of Israel, will be called God of all earth.
Not as woman forsaken and fainthearted has Lord called you, nor as woman hated from youth, said your God.
For small time I left you, and with great mercy I will have mercy on you.
In little wrath I turned my face from you, and with everlasting mercy I will have mercy on you, said Lord, one rescuing you.
This to me from water of Noah, just as I swore to him in that time not to be angry with earth. So neither will I be angry with you anymore nor threaten you.
Mountains may be moved and your hills shaken, but my mercy for you will not fail, and the covenant of your peace will not be moved, says the Lord, being gracious to you.
Afflicted and unstable one, you were not comforted. See, I prepare your stone with charcoal and your foundations with sapphire.
And I will make your battlements jasper and your gates stones of crystal and your wall chosen stones.
And all your sons taught of God, and your children in much peace.
And in righteousness you will be built. Keep far from injustice and you will not fear, and terror will not come near you.
See, strangers will come to you through me and will flee for refuge to you.
See, I created you not as smith blowing coals and bringing out vessel for work; I created you not for destruction to ruin.

Every harmful weapon against you I will not prosper, and every voice rising against you in judgment you will defeat them all. But your accusers will be guilty in it. This inheritance for those serving Lord, and you will be righteous to me, says Lord.
You thirsty ones, go to water. And those not having silver, go, buy, and drink. Without silver and price, wine and fat.
Why are you valued with silver and your labor not for fullness? Hear me and eat good things, and your soul will delight in good things.
Pay attention with your ears and follow my ways. Hear me, and your soul will live in good things, and I will make everlasting covenant with you, faithful holy things of David.
See, I have given him as witness among nations, ruler and commander to nations.
Nations that did not know you will call you, and peoples that do not understand you will flee for refuge to you, because of your God, Holy One of Israel, because he glorified you.
Seek God, and when you find him call on him when he draws near you.
Let ungodly man leave his ways and lawless man his counsels, and let him turn to Lord, and he will receive mercy, because he will abundantly forgive your sins.
For my counsels are not like your counsels, nor are my ways like your ways, says Lord.
But as heaven far from earth, so my way far from your ways and your thoughts from my mind.
For as rain and snow comes down from heaven and will not return until it drenches earth and it brings forth and sprouts and gives seed to sower and bread for food,
so my word that goes out from my mouth will not return until all I desired is accomplished, and I will prosper your ways and my commandments.
For in gladness you will go out and in joy be taught. Mountains and hills will leap, awaiting you with joy, and all trees of field will clap with branches.
And instead of stubble cypress will come up, and instead of nettle myrtle will come up, and Lord will be for name and everlasting sign and will not fail.
Thus says Lord: Keep judgment. Do righteousness, because my salvation draws near to come and my mercy to be revealed.
Blessed man doing these things and person holding them fast, keeping Sabbaths not profaning them and keeping his hands from doing wrongdoing.
Let not foreigner joined to Lord say, Lord will surely separate me from his people. And let not eunuch say, I am dry tree.
Thus says Lord to eunuchs: As many as keep my Sabbaths and choose what I want and hold fast my covenant,
I will give them in my house and within my wall notable place, better than sons and daughters. I will give them everlasting name and it will not fail.
And to foreigners joined to Lord to serve him and love name of Lord, so as to be his male and female servants, and all keeping my Sabbaths not profaning them and holding fast my covenant,

I will bring them to my holy mountain and gladden them in house of my prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on my altar, for my house will be called house of prayer for all nations.
Lord who gathers scattered Israel says, I will gather to him assembly.
All wild beasts, come eat, all beasts of forest.
See, all are blinded; they did not know to understand. All dogs mute, unable to bark, dreaming, loving sleepiness.
And dogs shameless in soul, not knowing fullness, and evil, not knowing understanding. All followed their own ways, each according to himself.
See how righteous man perished and no one takes it to heart, and righteous men are taken away and no one understands, because from face of injustice righteous man is taken away.
His burial will be in peace; he is taken from midst.
But you, come here, sons of lawless one, seed of adulterers and prostitute.
In whom did you delight yourselves? Against whom did you open your mouth and let loose your tongue? Are you not children of destruction, lawless seed,
inflamed over idols under leafy trees, slaughtering your children in ravines between rocks?
That is your portion. This is your lot. To them you poured drink offerings; to them you brought sacrifices. Shall I not be angry over these things?
On high and lofty mountain, there your bed; there you brought up sacrifices.
And behind doorposts of your door you set your memorials. You thought that if you depart from me you will have something more. You loved those sleeping with you.
And you multiplied your prostitution with them and made many far from you, and sent messengers beyond your borders and turned away and were humbled unto Hades.
In your many ways you labored and did not say, I will stop. Because you kept strengthening yourself, therefore you did not ask of me.
Whom did you respect and fear and lie against me, and not remember me, nor take me into your mind or heart? And I, seeing you, overlooked it, and you did not fear me.
But I will declare my righteousness and your evils, which will not profit you.
When you cry out, let them deliver you in your distress; for wind will take them all and storm carry them away. But those holding to me will possess land and inherit my holy mountain.
And they will say, Clear roads before him and lift obstacles from way of my people.

Thus says Lord Most High, dwelling in heights forever, Holy among holy ones his name, Lord Most High, resting among holy ones and giving patience to fainthearted ones and giving life to crushed in heart.
Not forever will I avenge you, nor be angry with you always, for spirit from me will go out, and I made every breath.
Because of sin I grieved him a little and struck him and turned my face away from him, and he was grieved and went gloomy in his ways.
His ways I saw and healed him and comforted him and gave him true comfort.
Peace upon peace to those far and to those near, and Lord said, I will heal them.
But unrighteous ones will be shaken like sea and cannot rest.
No rejoicing for ungodly, said Lord God.
Cry out with strength and do not spare. Lift your voice like trumpet and announce to my people their sins and to house of Jacob their lawless deeds.
They seek me day after day and want to know my ways, as people doing righteousness and not forsaking judgment of their God. They ask me now for righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God.
saying, Why did we fast and you did not see? We humbled our souls and you did not know. For in days of your fasts you find your own desires and prick all under your hand.
If you fast for judgments and fights and strike humble one with fists, why fast to me as today, so your voice may be heard in cry?
I did not choose such fast, nor day for man to humble his soul, nor if you bend your neck like ring and spread sackcloth and ashes. You will not call this acceptable fast.
Is not this the fast I chose, says Lord? Loose every bond of injustice, untie knots of violent agreements, send broken ones away in release, and tear up every unjust writing.
Break your bread to hungry and bring poor homeless into your house. If you see naked one, clothe him. And from your own seed do not turn away.
Then your light will burst forth early and your healings quickly rise, and your righteousness will go before you and glory of God will surround you.
Then you will cry, and God will hear you. While you are still speaking he will say, See, I am here. If you remove from you bond and pointing of hand and word of grumbling,
and give bread from your soul to hungry one and fill humbled soul, then your light will rise in darkness and your darkness as midday.

And your God will be with you always, and you will be filled as your soul desires, and your bones will grow fat, and you will be like well-watered garden and like spring whose water did not fail, and your bones like grass will spring up and grow fat, and they will inherit generations of generations.
And your everlasting desolations will be built, and your foundations everlasting to generations of generations. And you will be called builder of fences, and you will stop the paths between.
If you turn your foot from Sabbaths, not doing your wishes on holy day, and call Sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, you will not lift your foot for work nor speak word in anger from your mouth.
And you will be confident in Lord, and he will bring you up on good things of earth and feed you inheritance of Jacob your father, for mouth of Lord spoke these things.
Surely hand of Lord not too weak to save, nor his ear made heavy so as not to hear.
But your sins separate between you and God, and because of your sins he turned his face away from you so as not to have mercy.
For your hands polluted with blood and your fingers with sins. Your lips spoke lawlessness and your tongue studies injustice.
No one speaks righteous things, nor is there true judgment. They trust in vanities and speak empty things, because they conceive pain and bear lawlessness.
They hatch eggs of asps and weave spider's web, and one about to eat their eggs, breaking one, finds a viper in it.
Their web will not become garment, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works = works of lawlessness.
Their feet run to evil, quick to pour out blood, and their thoughts thoughts of fools. Crushing and misery in their ways.
They do not know way of peace, and no judgment in their ways, for their paths twisted, which they travel, and they do not know peace.
Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not overtake them. Though they waited for light, darkness came to them. Remaining for brightness, they walked in gloom.
They will grope wall like blind men and as having no eyes they will grope, and fall at noon as at midnight. As dying men they will groan.
Like bear and like dove together they will go. We waited for judgment, and there is none; salvation stood far from us.
For our lawlessness great before you, and our sins stood against us. Our lawless deeds in us, and our injustices we know:
we acted ungodly and lied and turned away from behind our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed. We conceived and studied from our heart unjust words.
And we turned judgment backward and righteousness stood far off, because truth was consumed in their ways and they could not pass by straight paths.
And truth was taken away and they removed understanding from mind. And Lord saw, and it did not please him, because there was no judgment.
And he saw, and there was no man, and he understood, and there was no one to help. So he defended them with his arm and established himself with mercy.
And he put on righteousness as breastplate and placed helmet of salvation on head and put on garment of vengeance as clothing.
As one giving repayment, reproach to opponents.
And those from west will fear name of Lord, and those from sunrise his glorious name. For wrath from Lord will come like violent river, coming with fury.
And rescuer will come for sake of Zion and turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
And this covenant from me with them, said Lord: My Spirit which is on you and words I put in your mouth will not fail from your mouth nor from mouth of your seed, said Lord, from now and forever.
Shine, shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come and glory of Lord has risen on you.
See, darkness and gloom will cover earth over nations; but on you Lord will appear and his glory will be seen on you.
And kings will walk by your light and nations by your brightness.
Lift your eyes around and see. Your children gathered; see, all your sons came from far away and your daughters will be carried on shoulders.
Then you will see and fear and your heart will be amazed, because wealth of sea and of nations and peoples will turn to you and come to you.
Herds of camels will cover you, camels of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come, carrying gold and incense, and proclaiming salvation of Lord.
And all sheep of Kedar will be gathered to you and rams of Nebaioth will come to you and be brought up acceptable on my altar, and my house of prayer will be glorified.
Who are these flying like clouds and like doves with young?
Islands waited for me and ships of Tarshish first, to bring your children from far away, and their silver and gold with them, because of holy name of Lord and because Holy One of Israel is glorified.
Foreigners will build your walls and their kings stand beside you, because in my wrath I struck you and in mercy I loved you.
Your gates will be opened continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring to you strength of nations and kings being led.
For nations and kings that will not serve you will perish, and nations will be made utterly desolate.
Glory of Lebanon will come to you with cypress and pine and cedar together, to glorify place of my holy one.
Sons of those humbling you and provoking you will come to you in fear, and you will be called city of Lord, Zion of Holy One of Israel.
Because you became forsaken and hated and there was none to help, I will make you everlasting exultation, joy of generation to generation.
You will suck milk of nations and eat wealth of kings, and you will know that I Lord am one saving you and delivering you, God of Israel.

Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and instead of iron I will bring you silver, and instead of wood bronze, and instead of stones iron. And I will give your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness.
Injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor crushing nor misery in your borders, but your walls will be called Salvation and your gates Praise.
Sun will not be for you light by day, nor rising of moon light your night, but Lord will be everlasting light for you and God your glory.
Your sun will not set and your moon will not fail, for Lord will be everlasting light for you and days of your mourning will be fulfilled.
All your people righteous, and forever they will inherit land, keeping the plant, work of his hands, for glory.
Least one will become into thousands and smallest into great nation. I Lord in due time will gather them.
Spirit of Lord on me, because he anointed me to bring good news to poor. He sent me to heal crushed in heart, proclaim release to captives and sight to blind.
Call year of Lord acceptable and day of repayment, to comfort all mourning ones.

Give to mourning ones of Zion glory instead of ashes, oil of gladness to mourning ones, garment of glory instead of spirit of weariness, and they will be called generations of righteousness, planting of Lord for glory.
And they will build everlasting desolations, raise up places formerly deserted, and renew desolate cities, desolated through generations.
Foreigners will come, shepherding your sheep, and aliens plowmen and vine-dressers.
But you will be called priests of Lord, ministers of God. You will eat strength of nations and be marveled at in their wealth.
So they will inherit land second time and everlasting joy above their head.
For I am Lord loving righteousness and hating robberies from injustice, and I will give their toil to righteous ones and make everlasting covenant with them.
Their seed will be known among nations and their offspring in midst of peoples. Everyone seeing them will know them, because these are seed blessed by God.

They will rejoice with joy in Lord; let my soul exult in Lord, for he clothed me with garment of salvation and tunic of gladness. As bridegroom he put turban on me, and as bride adorned me with ornament.
As earth increases its flower and as garden its seeds, so Lord will make righteousness and exultation spring up before all nations.
For Zion I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem I will not relent until my righteousness goes out as light and my salvation burns as torch.
Nations will see your righteousness and kings your glory, and your new name Lord will call it.
You will be crown of beauty in hand of Lord and diadem of kingdom in hand of your God.
No longer will you be called Forsaken, and your land will no longer be called Desert, for you will be called My Will, and your land Inhabited.
And as young man dwelling with virgin, so your sons will dwell with you, and as bridegroom rejoices over bride, so Lord will rejoice over you.
On your walls, Jerusalem, I appointed watchmen all day and all night; through all end they will not be silent, remembering Lord.
For no one like you when he restores and makes Jerusalem boast upon earth.
Lord swore by his right hand and by strength of his arm: If I again give your grain and your foods to your enemies, and if sons of foreigners again drink your wine for which you labored—
rather those gathering will eat them and praise Lord, and those gathering will drink them in my holy courts.
Go through my gates and make way for my people, and scatter stones from road. Lift standard to nations.
For see, Lord made it heard to end of earth: Say to daughter of Zion, See, your savior comes, holding his wage and his work before his face.
And he will call him Holy People, Redeemed by Lord. But you will be called Sought Out City and Not Forsaken.
Who is this coming from Edom, redness of garments from Bosor, so beautiful in robe, force with strength? I speak righteousness and judgment of salvation.
Why are your garments red and your clothes like from trodden winepress?
Full of trampled grapes, and from nations no man with me; I trampled them in wrath and crushed them like earth and brought their blood down to earth.
For day of repayment came on them, and year of redemption is present.
I looked and none was helper; I considered and no one was taking hold. So my arm rescued them and my wrath came upon them.
And I trampled them in my anger and brought their blood down to earth.
I remembered mercy of Lord, virtues of Lord in all things Lord repays us—Lord good judge to house of Israel. He brings upon us according to his mercy and according to abundance of his righteousness.
And he said, Are they not my people, children who will not reject? And he became salvation to them.
In all their affliction not elder nor angel, but Lord himself saved them. Because he loved them and spared them, he redeemed them and took them up and lifted them all days of age.
But they disobeyed and provoked his Holy Spirit, and he turned to them as enemy and himself fought them.
And he remembered days of old, one bringing up from land shepherd of sheep. Where is one placing Holy Spirit in them,
one leading Moses at right hand? Arm of his glory strengthened water before him, to make everlasting name for himself.
He led them through abyss like horse through wilderness, and they did not tire.
And as cattle through plain Spirit from Lord came down and guided them. So you led your people to make for yourself name of glory.
Turn from heaven and look from house of your holiness and glory. Where is your zeal and strength? Where is multitude of your mercy and compassions, because you held back from us?
For you are our father, because Abraham did not know us and Israel did not acknowledge us; but you, Lord, our father, rescue us. From beginning your name is upon us.
Why did you make us wander, Lord, from your way? You hardened our hearts so as not to fear you. Turn back for sake of your servants, tribes of your inheritance.
So we may inherit little of your holy mountain. Our opponents trampled your sanctuary.
We became as from beginning when you did not rule us nor your name was called on us. If you open heaven, mountains will take trembling from you and melt.
As wax melts from fire, and fire will burn opponents, and name of Lord will be evident among opponents; from your face nations will be shaken.
When you do glorious things, mountains will take trembling from you.
From age we did not hear, nor did our eyes see god besides you and your works which you will do for those waiting mercy.
For he will meet those doing righteousness, and they will remember your ways. See, you were angry and we sinned; because of this we wandered.
And we all became as unclean, and all our righteousness as cloth of menstruation, and we fell away as leaves. Because of our lawless deeds thus wind will carry us away.
And there is no one calling on your name and remembering to take hold of you, because you turned your face from us and gave us over because of our sins.
And now, Lord, our father, you; but we clay, all work of your hands.
Do not be very angry with us and do not remember our sins in season. And now look, because we all your people.
City of your holy one became desolate. Zion became like desert; Jerusalem into curse.
Our holy house and glory, which our fathers blessed, became burned with fire, and all glorious things fell.
And over all these you held back, Lord, and kept silent and humbled us greatly.
I became manifest to those not seeking me; I was found by those not asking after me. I said, Here I am, to nation not calling my name.
I stretched out my hands all day to disobedient and contradicting people, who did not walk true way but after their sins.
This people provoking me continually to my face, sacrificing in gardens and burning incense on bricks to demons that do not exist.
And in tombs and caves they sleep because of dreams, eating pig flesh and broth of polluted sacrifices, all their vessels polluted.
saying, Keep far from me; do not come near me, because I am clean. This smoke of my wrath, fire burning in it all days.
See, it is written before me. I will not keep silent until I repay into their bosom
their sins and sins of their fathers, says Lord, who burned incense on mountains and reproached me on hills. I will repay their works into their bosom.
Thus says Lord: As juice is found in cluster and they say, Do not destroy it, because blessing of Lord is in it, so I will do for sake of one serving me. For his sake I will not destroy them all.
And I will bring out from Jacob seed and from Judah, and it will inherit my holy mountain, and my chosen will inherit it and my servants dwell there.
And in forest there will be folds of flocks and valley of Achor for rest of herds, for my people who sought me.
But you who abandon me and forget my holy mountain and prepare table for demon and fill mixed drink for Fortune,
I will hand you over to sword. All you will fall in slaughter, because I called you and you did not obey; I spoke and you refused, and you did evil before me and chose what I did not want.
Therefore thus says Lord: See, those serving me will eat, but you will hunger. See, those serving me will drink, but you will thirst. See, those serving me will rejoice, but you will be shamed.
See, those serving me will exult in gladness, but you will cry out from pain of your heart and howl from crushing of spirit.
For you will leave your name for fullness to my chosen; Lord will kill you, but to those serving him new name will be called,
by which one blessed on earth will bless true God, and those swearing on earth will swear by true God, because they will forget their former affliction and it will not come up on their heart.
For there will be new heaven and new earth, and former things will not be remembered nor come upon heart.
But they will find gladness and exultation in it, because see, I make Jerusalem exultation and my people gladness.
And I will exult over Jerusalem and be glad over my people, and voice of weeping and voice of cry will no longer be heard in her.
And there will no longer be there untimely child nor old man who does not fill his time, for young one will be hundred years old, but sinner dying at hundred years will be accursed.
They will build houses and themselves dwell, and plant vineyards and themselves eat their produce.
They will not build and others dwell, nor plant and others eat, for days of my people will be as days of tree of life, and works of their labors will grow old.
My chosen will not labor in vain nor bear children for curse, because seed blessed by God is with them and their offspring with them.
And before they cry out, I will hear them. While they are still speaking, I will say, What is it?
Then wolves and lambs will graze together, and lion like ox will eat straw, and serpent earth as bread. They will not do injustice nor destroy on my holy mountain, says Lord.
Thus says Lord: Heaven my throne, and earth footstool of my feet. What house will you build for me, or what place of my rest?
For all these my hand made, and all these are mine, says Lord. And to whom will I look, except to humble and quiet one and one trembling at my words?

But lawless one sacrificing calf to me as one killing dog; one offering fine flour as blood of pig; one giving incense for memorial as blasphemer. These chose their own ways, and their soul desired their abominations.

So I will choose their mockeries and repay their sins to them, because I called them and they did not obey me. I spoke and they did not hear, and they did evil before me and chose what I did not want.
Hear word of Lord, you trembling at his word: Your brothers hating you and abhorring you said, Let name of Lord be glorified so we may see your gladness; but they will be shamed.
Voice of cry from city, voice from temple, voice of Lord repaying repayment to opponents.
Before one in labor gave birth, before pain of birth-pangs came, she escaped and bore male.
Who heard such thing and who saw thus? Did earth labor in one day, or nation bear at once? Because Zion labored and bore her children.
But I gave this expectation and you did not remember me, said Lord. See, did I make one bearing and then make her barren? said God.
Be glad, Jerusalem, and celebrate in her, all loving her. Rejoice with joy, all mourning over her,
so you may nurse and be filled from breast of her comfort, so that having sucked you may delight from entrance of her glory.
Because thus says Lord: See, I turn to them like river of peace and like torrent flooding glory of nations. Their children will be carried on shoulders and comforted on knees.
As if mother will comfort someone, so I will comfort you, and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.
And you will see and your heart will rejoice and your bones spring up like grass, and hand of Lord will be known to those revering him and he will threaten disobedient ones.
For see, Lord will come as fire and his chariots as storm, to render vengeance in wrath and rebuke in flame of fire.
For by fire of Lord all earth will be judged and by his sword all flesh; many wounded will be by Lord.
Those purifying and cleansing themselves in gardens and in porches, eating pig flesh and abominations and the mouse, together they will be consumed, said Lord.
I know their works and their thought. I am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see my glory.

And I will leave signs on them and send from them saved ones to nations—to Tarshish and Phud and Lud and Mosoch and Thobel and to Greece and to distant islands, who have not heard my name nor seen my glory—and they will declare my glory among nations.

And they will bring your brothers from all nations as gift to Lord, with horses and chariots, in litters, mules, and with parasols, into holy city Jerusalem, says Lord, as sons of Israel bring me their sacrifices with psalms into house of Lord.
And from them I will take for myself priests and Levites, said Lord.
For as new heaven and new earth which I make remain before me, says Lord, so your seed and your name will stand.
And it will be from month to month and Sabbath to Sabbath; all flesh will come before me to worship in Jerusalem, says Lord.
And they will go out and see limbs of men who transgressed against me, for their worm will not end and their fire will not be quenched, and they will be spectacle to all flesh.
Word of God that came upon Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, from priests dwelling in Anathoth in land of Benjamin,
to whom word of God came in days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, in thirteenth year of his reign,
and it came in days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until captivity of Jerusalem in fifth month.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Before I formed you in womb I knew you, and before you came out from womb I sanctified you; I set you as prophet to nations.
And I said, O Master Lord, see, I do not know to speak, because I am younger one.
And Lord said to me, Do not say, I am younger one, because to all to whom I send you, you will go, and all whatever I command you, you will speak.
Do not fear before their face, because I am with you to deliver you, says Lord.
And Lord stretched out his hand toward me and touched my mouth, and Lord said to me, See, I have given my words into your mouth.
See, I have set you today over nations and kingdoms, to root up and dig down and destroy and build and plant.
And word of Lord came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Staff of almond tree.
And Lord said to me, You saw well, because I keep watch over my words to do them.
And word of Lord came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? And I said, Boiling cauldron, and its face from face of north.
And Lord said to me, From face of north evils will burn out upon all dwelling in land.

Because see, I call all kingdoms from north of earth, says Lord, and they will come and each place his throne at entrances of gates of Jerusalem and against all her surrounding walls and against all cities of Judah.
And I will speak judgment with them concerning all their wickedness, because they abandoned me and sacrificed to foreign gods and worshiped works of their hands.
And you, gird your waist and rise and say to them all whatever I command you. Do not fear before them nor be broken before them, because I am with you to deliver you, says Lord.
See, I have made you this day as fortified city and as strong bronze wall against all kings of Judah and its rulers and people of land.
And they will fight you and will not prevail against you, because I am with you to deliver you, said Lord.
And he said, Thus says Lord: I remembered mercy of your youth and love of your completion, your following Holy One of Israel, says Lord.
Israel holy to Lord, firstfruits of his produce. All eating him will offend; evils will come on them, says Lord.
Hear word of Lord, house of Jacob and every family of house of Israel.
Thus says Lord: What fault did your fathers find in me, that they stood far from me and went after vanities and became vain?

And they did not say, Where is Lord who brought us up from land of Egypt, who guided us in wilderness, in boundless and untrodden land, in waterless and fruitless land, in land through which no one traveled and no son of man dwelt there?
And I brought you into Carmel, for you to eat its fruits and its good things. And you entered and defiled my land and made my inheritance abomination.
Priests did not say, Where is Lord? Those holding law did not know me, shepherds acted ungodly toward me, and prophets prophesied by Baal and went after useless things.
Therefore I will still enter judgment with you, says Lord, and with sons of your sons I will enter judgment.
For pass to islands of Kittim and see, and send to Kedar and understand greatly and see whether such things happened.
If nations will change their gods, though those are not gods, yet my people changed its glory for what will not profit.
Heaven was amazed at this and shuddered exceedingly greatly, says Lord.
Because my people did two evils: they abandoned me, fountain of living water, and dug for themselves broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
Is Israel slave or household-born? Why has he become plunder?
Lions roared over him and gave their voice, those who made his land a desert, and his cities were torn down so that none dwell.
And sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and mocked you.
Did not these things do this to you, your abandoning me? says Lord your God.
And now what to you and way of Egypt, to drink water of Gihon? And what to you and way of Assyrians, to drink water of rivers?
Your apostasy will discipline you and your evil will expose you. Know and see that bitter to you your abandoning me, says Lord your God, and I took no pleasure in you, says Lord your God.
Because from age you broke your yoke and tore your bonds and said, I will not serve. Rather on every high hill and under every shady tree there I will sprawl in my prostitution.
But I planted you fruitful vine, wholly true. How did you turn into bitterness, foreign vine?
If you wash with niter and multiply soap for yourself, you are stained in your injustices before me, says Lord.
How will you say, I was not defiled and I did not go after Baal? See your ways in burial valley and know what you did. Last evening her voice wailed in her ways.
She spread out over waters of wilderness; in desires of her soul she was wind-borne, given over. Who will turn her back? All seeking her will not grow weary; in her humiliation they will find her.
Turn your foot from rough way and your throat from thirst. But she said, I will be strong, because she loved foreigners and went after them.
As shame of thief when caught, so sons of Israel will be shamed, they and their kings and their rulers and their priests and their prophets.
To tree they said, You are my father, and to stone, You birthed me. And they turned to me backs and not faces, and at time of their evils they will say, Rise and save us.

And where are your gods which you made for yourself? Let them rise if they will save you at time of your affliction, because according to number of your cities were your gods, Judah, and according to number of streets of Jerusalem they sacrificed to Baal.
Why do you all speak against me? You all acted ungodly and lawlessly against me, says Lord.
In vain I struck your children; they did not accept correction. Sword devoured your prophets like destroying lion, and you did not fear.
Hear word of Lord. Thus says Lord: Did I become wilderness to Israel or land laid waste? Why did my people say, We will not be ruled and will not come to you anymore?
Will bride forget her ornament and virgin her breast-band? But my people forgot me days without number.
Why still do you make your ways look good to seek love? Not so, but you also did evil to defile your ways.
And in your hands were found bloods of innocent souls. I did not find them in tunnels, but under every oak.
And you said, I am innocent; let his wrath turn from me. See, I enter judgment with you in your saying, I did not sin.
Why did you despise greatly, repeating your ways? From Egypt you will be put to shame just as you were put to shame by Assyria.
Because also from there you will go out and your hands upon your head, because Lord rejected your hope and you will not prosper by it.
