If husband sends away his wife and she departs from him and becomes another man's, by returning will she return to him again? Will not that woman be utterly defiled? Yet you prostituted yourself with many shepherds and kept returning to me, says Lord.
Lift your eyes to straight places and see where you were not defiled. By roads you sat for them like crow in desolation, and you defiled land with your prostitutions and your evils.
And you had many shepherds for stumbling to yourself. Face of prostitute became yours; you became shameless toward all.
Did you not call me as house and father and leader of your virginity?
Will he remain forever or be kept into hostility? See, you spoke and did these evil things and prevailed.
And Lord said to me in days of King Josiah, Did you see what dwelling of Israel did to me? They went on every high mountain and under every leafy tree and prostituted themselves there.
And I said after her doing all these prostitutions, Return to me. And she did not return. And faithless Judah saw her faithlessness.

And I saw that concerning all things in which dwelling of Israel was caught, with which she committed adultery, I sent her away and gave her bill of divorce into her hands. Yet faithless Judah did not fear, but she also went and prostituted herself.
And her prostitution became as nothing, and she committed adultery with wood and stone.
And in all these things faithless Judah did not return to me with whole heart, but in falsehood.
And Lord said to me, Israel justified her own soul more than faithless Judah.

Go and read these words toward north and say, Return to me, dwelling of Israel, says Lord, and I will not set my face against you, because I am merciful, says Lord, and I will not be angry with you forever.
Only know your injustice, that against Lord your God you acted ungodly and poured out your ways to foreigners under every leafy tree, and you did not obey my voice, says Lord.
Return, turning-away sons, says Lord, because I will rule over you and take you, one from city and two from family, and bring you into Zion.
And I will give you shepherds according to my heart, and they will shepherd you with knowledge.

And it will be, if you multiply and increase on earth in those days, says Lord, they will no longer say, Ark of covenant of Holy One of Israel. It will not come up on heart, nor be named nor visited, nor be made again.
In those days and at that time they will call Jerusalem throne of Lord, and all nations will gather into it, and they will no longer walk after thoughts of their evil heart.
In those days house of Judah will come together upon house of Israel, and they will come together from land of north and from all regions upon land which I caused their fathers to inherit.

And I said, So be it, Lord, that I will place you among children and give you chosen land, inheritance of God Almighty of nations. And I said, You will call me Father, and from me you will not turn away.
But as woman proves faithless to one living with her, so house of Israel proved faithless to me, says Lord.
Voice from lips was heard, weeping and supplication of sons of Israel, because they did wrong in their ways and forgot their Holy God.
Return, returning sons, and I will heal your crushings. Behold, we will be your servants, because you are Lord our God.
Truly hills and might of mountains were for falsehood, but through Lord our God salvation of Israel.
And shame consumed labors of our fathers from our youth, their sheep and their calves and their sons and their daughters.
We lay down in our shame, and our dishonor covered us, because before our God we sinned, we and our fathers, from our youth until this day, and did not obey voice of Lord our God.
If Israel returns, says Lord, he will return to me. If he removes his abominations from his mouth and fears from before my face,
and one swears, As the Lord lives, with truth and in judgment and in righteousness, then nations will bless in him, and in him they will praise God in Jerusalem.
Because thus says Lord to men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Break up fresh ground for yourselves and do not sow among thorns.

Be circumcised to your God and circumcise your hardheartedness, men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, lest my wrath go out like fire and burn and none quench it because of evil of your practices.
Declare in Judah and let it be heard in Jerusalem. Say, Sound trumpet upon land, and cry greatly, saying, Gather together and let us enter fortified cities.
Take up fleeing to Zion. Hurry, do not stand, because I bring evils from north and great crushing.
Lion came up from his lair, destroyer of nations rose and went out from his place to make land desolation, and cities will be demolished so as not to be inhabited.
For these things gird yourselves with sackcloth and beat yourselves and howl, because anger of Lord has not turned away from you.
And it will be in that day, says Lord, heart of king will perish and heart of rulers, and priests will be amazed and prophets will wonder.
And I said, Ah, Master Lord, surely by deception you deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Peace will be to you. And see, the sword touched even to their soul.
At that time they will say to this people and to Jerusalem: Spirit of wandering in wilderness, way of daughter of my people, not for cleansing nor for holy thing.
Spirit of fullness will come to me. Now I myself speak judgments to them.
See, like cloud he will come up, and his chariots like storm, his horses lighter than eagles. Woe to us, because we are made miserable.
Wash your heart from wickedness, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will thoughts of your labors remain in you?
Because voice of one declaring will come from Dan, and pain will be heard from mountain of Ephraim.
Remind nations. See, they have come. Declare in Jerusalem: Crowds come from far land, and they gave their voice against cities of Judah.
Like keepers of field they became against her all around, because you neglected me, says Lord.
Your ways and your practices made these things for you. This your evil, because bitter, because it touched to your heart.
My belly, my belly, I am in pain, and feelings of my heart rage. My soul writhes. My heart torn. I will not be silent, because my soul heard voice of trumpet, cry of war.
Affliction calls crushing, because whole land has been afflicted. Suddenly my tent was afflicted, my skins torn apart.
How long will I see fugitives, hearing sound of trumpets?
Because leaders of my people did not know me. They are foolish sons and not understanding, wise to do evil, but to do good they did not know.
I looked upon earth, and behold, nothing, and to heaven, and its lights were not.
I saw mountains, and they were trembling, and all hills shaken.
I looked, and behold, there was no man, and all birds of heaven were terrified.
I looked, and behold, Carmel a desert, and all cities burned with fire. From face of Lord and from face of anger of his wrath they vanished.
Thus says Lord: Whole land will be desolation, yet full end I will not make.
For these things let earth mourn and heaven above be dark, because I spoke and will not change my mind, I rushed in and will not turn back from it.
From sound of horseman and bent bow every region withdrew. They entered caves and hid in groves and climbed rocks. Every city abandoned; man does not dwell in them.
And you, what will you do if you dress in scarlet and adorn yourself with gold ornaments and paint your eyes with antimony? In vain your beautifying. Lovers rejected you; they seek your soul.

Because voice as of woman in labor I heard, your groaning as of one giving birth first time. Voice of daughter of Zion will grow weak and let down her hands: Woe to me, because my soul fails because of slain ones.
Run about in streets of Jerusalem and see and know and seek in her broad places whether you find man doing judgment and seeking faithfulness, and I will be gracious to them, says Lord.
They say, As Lord lives, yet because of this they swear by lies.

Lord, are not your eyes for faithfulness? You struck them and they did not hurt. You finished them and they did not want to receive discipline. They made their faces harder than rock and did not want to turn back.
And I said, Perhaps they are poor, because they were not able, because they did not know way of Lord and judgment of God.
I will go to great men and speak with them, because they knew way of Lord and judgment of God. And behold, together they broke yoke and tore bonds.

Therefore lion from forest struck them, and wolf up to houses destroyed them, and leopard kept watch over their cities. All going out from them will be hunted, because they multiplied their ungodliness and grew strong in their turnings away.
For which of these shall I be gracious to you? Your sons abandoned me and swore by those that are not gods. And I fed them, and they committed adultery, and in houses of prostitutes they lodged.
They became lustful horses, each neighing after wife of his neighbor.
Shall I not visit for these things? says Lord. Shall not my soul avenge on such nation?
Go up on her battlements and tear down, but make no full end. Leave her supports, because they are Lord's.
Because in faithlessness house of Israel and house of Judah acted faithlessly toward me, says Lord.
They lied to their Lord and said, He is not, and evils will not come upon us, and sword and famine we will not see.
Our prophets were wind, and word of Lord was not in them. So it will be to them.
Therefore thus says Lord Almighty: Because you spoke this word, behold, I have made my words in your mouth fire and this people wood, and it will devour them.
Behold, I bring on you nation from far away, house of Israel, says Lord, nation whose language voice you will not hear.
All are mighty men.

And they will eat your harvest and your breads, and they will eat your sons and your daughters, and they will eat your sheep and your calves, and they will eat your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive groves, and thresh your fortified cities in which you trust with sword.
And it will be in those days, says Lord your God, I will not make you into full end.

And it will be when you say, For what reason did Lord our God do all these things to us? you will say to them, Because you served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in land not yours.
Declare these things to house of Jacob and let it be heard in Judah.
Hear now these things, foolish and heartless people: eyes to them and they do not see, ears to them and they do not hear.

Will you not fear me? says Lord. Will you not tremble before my face? I set sand as boundary to sea, everlasting command, and it will not pass it. It will be disturbed and not be able, and its waves will roar and not pass it.
But for this people there came disobedient and rebellious heart, and they turned aside and went away.
And they did not say in their heart, Let us now fear Lord our God, one giving us early and late rain in due season, fullness of harvest command, and he kept it for us.
Your lawless deeds turned these things away, and your sins removed good things from you.
Because among my people ungodly men were found, and they set traps to destroy men and captured them.
As snare set up full of birds, so their houses full of deceit. Because of this they grew great and rich.
And they passed over judgment. They did not judge cause of orphan, and cause of widow they did not judge.
Shall I not visit for these things? says Lord. Shall not my soul avenge on such nation?
Astonishment and horrors came on earth:
Prophets prophesy unjust things, and priests clapped with their hands, and my people loved it so. And what will you do afterward?

Strengthen yourselves, sons of Benjamin, from midst of Jerusalem, and in Tekoa sound trumpet, and over Beth-haccherem lift signal, because evils have leaned out from north and great crushing is coming.
Your height will be taken away, daughter of Zion.
To her shepherds and their flocks will come, and they will pitch tents against her all around, and each will shepherd by his own hand.
Prepare against her for war. Rise, and let us go up against her at noon. Woe to us, because day has declined, because shadows of evening fail.
Rise, and let us go up in night and destroy her foundations.
Because thus says Lord: Cut down her trees, pour out strength against Jerusalem. O false city, all oppression in her.
As cistern cools its water, so her evil cools. Ungodliness and misery will be heard in her; before her face continually pain and scourge.
Be disciplined, Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from you, lest I make you pathless land not inhabited.
Because thus says Lord: Glean, glean as vine the remnant of Israel. Return as grape-gatherer to his basket.
To whom shall I speak and testify, and he will hear? Behold, their ears uncircumcised and they cannot hear. Behold, word of Lord became reproach to them. They will not want to hear it.

And I was filled with my wrath and held back and did not finish them. I will pour it on infants outside and on gathering of young men together, because man and woman will be taken, elder with fullness of days.
And their houses will be turned to others, fields and their wives together, because I will stretch out my hand upon those inhabiting this land, says Lord.
Because from their small one even to great one all together complete lawlessness; from priest even to false prophet all practiced lies.
And they healed crushing of my people by treating it lightly and saying, Peace, peace, and where is peace?

They were ashamed because they failed, yet not even as ashamed were they ashamed, and they did not know their dishonor. Therefore they will fall in their falling, and in time of their visitation they will perish, said Lord.
Thus says Lord: Stand on roads and see and ask for everlasting paths of Lord, and see what good way is, and walk in it, and you will find cleansing for your souls. And they said, We will not walk.
I set watchmen over you: Hear sound of trumpet. And they said, We will not hear.
Therefore nations heard, and those shepherding their flocks.
Hear, earth. Behold, I bring on this people evils, fruit of their turning away, because they paid no attention to my words and rejected my law.
Why do you bring me frankincense from Sheba and cinnamon from far land? Your whole burnt offerings not acceptable and your sacrifices did not please me.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I give this people weakness, and fathers and sons together will be weakened by it; neighbor and his near one will perish.
Thus says Lord: Behold, people comes from north, and nation will be stirred from ends of earth.
They will grasp bow and javelin. He is harsh and will not show mercy. His voice as sea waving. On horses and chariots he will line up like fire for war against you, daughter of Zion.
We heard their report; our hands were paralyzed. Affliction seized us, birth-pangs as of woman giving birth.
Do not go out into field, and in roads do not walk, because sword of enemies lives all around.
Daughter of my people, gird sackcloth, roll in ashes, make for yourself mourning of beloved one, bitter lament, because suddenly misery will come upon you.
I have given you tester among tested peoples, and you will know me when I test their way.
All disobedient, walking crookedly, bronze and iron, all are corrupted.
Bellows failed from fire, lead failed; in vain silversmith works silver, their evil was not melted.
Call them rejected silver, because Lord rejected them.
Hear word of Lord, all Judah.
Thus says Lord God of Israel: Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.
Do not trust in yourselves upon false words that will surely not profit you, saying, Temple of Lord, temple of Lord it is.
Because if in correcting you truly correct your ways and your practices, and in doing you do judgment between man and his neighbor,
and do not oppress sojourner and orphan and widow, and do not pour out innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after foreign gods for your harm,
then I will settle you in this place, in land I gave to your fathers from age and to age.
But if you trust in false words, from which you will not profit,
and murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unrighteously and burn incense to Baal and walk after foreign gods whom you do not know, for your harm,
and you came and stood before me in house over which my name has been called and said, We have held back from doing all these abominations—
has my house over which my name has been called become den of robbers there before you? And I, behold, have seen, says Lord.
Because go to my place in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell before, and see what I did to it because of evil of my people Israel.
And now because you did all these works and I spoke to you and you did not hear me, and I called you and you did not answer,
I will do to this house over which my name has been called, on which you trust, and to place I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
And I will cast you out from my face, just as I cast out your brothers, all seed of Ephraim.
And you, do not pray concerning this people, and do not ask that they be shown mercy, and do not vow, and do not come to me concerning them, because I will not hear.
Do you not see what they do in cities of Judah and in streets of Jerusalem?
Their sons gather wood, and their fathers kindle fire, and their women knead dough to make cakes for army of heaven, and they poured drink offerings to foreign gods so as to provoke me.
Do they provoke me? says Lord. Is it not themselves, so that their faces be ashamed?

Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, my anger and wrath pours out on this place and on men and on cattle and on every tree of their field and on all produce of earth, and it will burn and not be quenched.
Thus says Lord: Gather your whole burnt offerings with your sacrifices and eat flesh.
Because I did not speak to your fathers and did not command them in day I brought them up from land of Egypt concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifice.
But this word I commanded them, saying, Hear my voice and I will be to you as God and you will be to me as people, and walk in all my ways that I command you, so that it may be well for you.
And they did not hear me and did not incline their ear, but walked in thoughts of their evil heart and became backward and not forward.
From day their fathers came out from land of Egypt until this day, I sent to you all my servants the prophets, day and early morning I sent.
And they did not hear me and did not incline their ear and hardened their neck more than their fathers.
And you will say to them this word: This is nation that did not hear voice of Lord and did not receive discipline. Faithfulness perished from their mouth.
Faithfulness perished from their mouth.
Shear your head and cast away, and raise lament on lips, because Lord rejected and thrust away generation doing these things.
Because sons of Judah did evil before me, says Lord. They set their abominations in house over which my name has been called, to defile it.
And they built altar of Topheth, which is in valley of son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in fire, which I did not command them, nor did I conceive in my heart.
Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and they will no longer say altar of Topheth and valley of son of Hinnom, but valley of slaughtered, and they will bury in Topheth because no place remains.
And dead bodies of this people will be for food to birds of heaven and beasts of earth, and none will frighten them away.
And I will destroy from cities of Judah and from streets of Jerusalem voice of rejoicing and voice of gladness, voice of bridegroom and voice of bride, because whole land will become desolation.
At that time, says Lord, they will bring out bones of kings of Judah and bones of their rulers and bones of priests and bones of prophets and bones of inhabitants of Jerusalem from their tombs.

And they will spread them out to sun and moon and all stars and all army of heaven, which they loved and served and went after and held fast and worshiped. They will not be mourned nor buried, and they will be example upon face of earth.
Because they chose death rather than life, for all remnant left from that generation in every place where I drive them out there.
Because thus says Lord: Will one falling not rise? Or one turning away not turn back?
Why did this people turn away with shameless turning away? They held fast in their own choice and did not want to return.
Give ear now and hear: They will not speak thus. There is no man repenting from his evil, saying, What have I done? One running from his course ceased, like sweating horse in its neighing.
And stork in heaven knew its season; turtledove and swallow of field and sparrows kept times of their comings. But my people did not know judgments of Lord.
How will you say, We are wise, and law of Lord is with us? In vain false reed of scribes came to be.
Wise men were ashamed and terrified and caught, because they rejected word of Lord. What wisdom is in them?
Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to heirs.
And they will gather their produce, says Lord. There is no grape on vines, and no figs on fig trees, and leaves have fallen.
Why do we sit? Gather and let us enter fortified cities and be cast away, because God cast us away and gave us water of gall to drink, because we sinned against him.
We gathered for peace and there were no good things, for time of healing and behold, hurry.
From Dan we will hear sound of sharpness of his horses. From sound of neighing of his cavalry all land shook, and he will come and devour land and its fullness, city and those dwelling in it.
Because behold, I send to you deadly serpents for which there is no charming, and they will bite you.
Incurable with pain, your heart in distress.
Behold, voice of cry of daughter of my people from far land: Is Lord not in Zion? Is her king not there? Why did they provoke me with their carved images and foreign vanities?
Summer passed, harvest ended, and we were not saved.
Over crushing of daughter of my people I was darkened. Distress seized me, pangs as of woman giving birth.
Is there no resin in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why did healing of daughter of my people not rise?
Who will give my head water and my eyes spring of tears? And I will weep for this people day and night, for wounded ones of daughter of my people.
Who will give me in wilderness last lodging-place, that I may leave my people and go away from them? Because all commit adultery, company of faithless ones.
And they bent their tongue like bow: falsehood, and not faithfulness, grew strong on land, because from evils to evils they went out, and me they did not know.
Each guard yourselves from your neighbor, and do not trust in your brothers, because every brother will utterly trip by heel and every friend will walk deceitfully.
Each will mock his friend; truth they will not speak. Their tongue learned to speak lies. They did wrong and did not cease from turning back.
Usury upon usury, deceit upon deceit; they did not want to know me.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I will refine them and test them, because what shall I do because of evil of daughter of my people?
Their tongue = wounding arrow; words of their mouth deceitful. To his neighbor he speaks peaceful things, but in himself he holds enmity.
Shall I not visit for these things? says Lord. Shall not my soul avenge on such people?

Take up mourning over mountains and lament over paths of wilderness, because they failed so that there are no men, and they did not hear sound of existence; from birds of heaven even to cattle they were astonished and went away.
And I will give Jerusalem into migration and dwelling-place of dragons, and cities of Judah I will make to vanish, so as not to be inhabited.
Who is wise man and let him understand this, and to whom word of mouth of Lord came, let him declare to you: Why did land perish, burned like wilderness, so as not to be passed through?
And Lord said to me: Because they abandoned my law which I gave before them and did not hear my voice,
but went after pleasures of their evil heart and after idols which their fathers taught them,
therefore thus says Lord God of Israel: Behold, I will feed them with hardships and give them water of gall to drink.
And I will scatter them among nations which neither they nor their fathers knew, and I will send sword after them until I consume them by it.
Thus says Lord: Call mourning women and let them come, and send to wise women and let them speak,
and let them take up lament over you, and let your eyes bring down tears and your eyelids run water.
Because voice of pity was heard in Zion: How we were made miserable! We were greatly ashamed, because we abandoned land and threw away our tents.
Hear now, women, word of God, and let your ears receive words of his mouth. Teach your daughters lament and each woman her neighbor mourning.
Because death came up through your windows, entered your land, to destroy infants outside and young men from broad places.
And dead bodies of men will be example upon face of field of your land, and like grass behind reaper, and none will gather.
Thus says Lord: Let not wise man boast in his wisdom, and let not strong man boast in his strength, and let not rich man boast in his riches,
but in this let the one boasting boast: to understand and know that I am the Lord, doing mercy and judgment and righteousness on the earth, because in these is my will, says the Lord.
Behold, days come, says Lord, and I will visit all circumcised in their foreskin:

upon Egypt and upon Judah and upon Edom and upon sons of Ammon and upon sons of Moab and upon all clipping what is before his face, those dwelling in wilderness, because all nations uncircumcised in flesh and all house of Israel uncircumcised in their hearts.
Hear word of Lord which he spoke upon you, house of Israel.
Thus says Lord: Do not learn according to ways of nations, and do not fear signs of heaven, because they fear them before their faces.
Because customs of nations are vain. It is tree cut out of forest, work of carpenter and casting.
They are adorned with silver and gold. With hammers and nails they fastened them and they will not move.
Being carried they will be carried, because they will not step. Do not fear them, because they surely will not do evil, and no good is in them.
Beaten silver is there; they will not walk. Refined silver will come from Tarshish, gold from Uphaz, handwork of goldsmiths, works of craftsmen. They will clothe them in blue and purple.
Thus you will say to them: Gods who did not make heaven and earth, let them perish from earth and from under this heaven.
Lord, one making earth by his strength, one setting upright inhabited world by his wisdom, by his understanding stretched out heaven.
And there is abundance of water in heaven, and he brought up clouds from end of earth, made lightning for rain, and brought out light from his treasuries.
Every man was made foolish from knowledge. Every goldsmith was ashamed over his carved things, because what they cast were lies; no breath in them.
They are vanities, mocked works. In time of their visitation they will perish.
Not like these is portion of Jacob, because one shaping all things is his inheritance. Lord his name.
Gather from outside your substance, you dwelling among chosen things.
Because thus says Lord: Behold, I sling out inhabitants of this land in affliction, so that your wound may be found.
Woe over your crushing; your wound painful. And I said, Truly this my blow, and it seized me.
My tent was made miserable, perished, and all my skins were torn apart. My sons and my sheep are not. There is no more place of my tent, place of my skins.
Because shepherds acted foolishly and did not seek Lord. Therefore all pasture did not understand, and they were scattered.
Voice of report, behold, comes, and great shaking from land of north, to make cities of Judah vanish and lodging-place of sparrows.
I know, Lord, that way of man not his own, nor will man walk and direct his path.
Discipline us, Lord, yet in judgment and not in wrath, lest you make us few.
Pour out your wrath on nations not knowing you and on families who did not call your name, because they devoured Jacob and consumed him and made his pasture desolate.
Word that came from Lord to Jeremiah, saying,
Hear words of this covenant and speak to men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem,
and you will say to them, Thus says Lord God of Israel: Cursed man who will not hear words of this covenant,

which I commanded your fathers in day I brought them up from land of Egypt, from iron furnace, saying, Hear my voice and do all whatever I command you, and you will be my people and I will be your God,
so that I may establish my oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them land flowing with milk and honey, as this day. And I answered and said, So be it, Lord.
And Lord said to me, Read these words in cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, saying, Hear words of this covenant and do them.
And they did not do them.
And Lord said to me, A conspiracy was found among men of Judah and among inhabitants of Jerusalem.

They turned back to injustices of their former fathers, who did not want to hear my words, and behold, they walk after foreign gods to serve them. House of Israel and house of Judah broke my covenant which I made with their fathers.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I bring on this people evils from which they will not be able to go out, and they will cry to me and I will not hear them.
And cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to gods to whom they burn incense; they surely will not save them in time of their evils.
Because according to number of your cities were your gods, Judah, and according to number of streets of Jerusalem you set up altars to burn incense to Baal.
And you, do not pray concerning this people and do not ask concerning them in supplication and prayer, because I will not hear when they call on me in time of their affliction.
What did my beloved do in my house? She did abomination. Will vows and holy flesh remove your evils from you, or by these will you escape?
Lord called your name Beautiful olive tree, fair in appearance. At sound of its pruning fire was kindled on it. Great affliction came on you; its branches were made useless.
And Lord who planted you spoke evils against you because of evil of house of Israel and house of Judah, because they did for themselves things to provoke me by their burning incense to Baal.
Lord, make it known to me and I will know; then I saw their practices.

And I was like innocent lamb led to be sacrificed. I did not know they reasoned evil thought against me, saying, Come and let us cast wood into his bread and wipe him out from land of living, and his name shall no longer be remembered.
Lord, judging righteous things, testing kidneys and heart, let me see your vengeance from them, because to you I revealed my case.
Therefore thus says Lord against men of Anathoth seeking my life, saying, You shall not prophesy in name of Lord, and if not, you will die in our hands.
Behold, I will visit upon them. Their young men will die by sword, and their sons and daughters will die by famine.
And remnant of them will not exist, because I will bring evils upon inhabitants of Anathoth in year of their visitation.
Righteous are you, Lord, because I will speak in defense to you; yet I will speak judgments to you: Why does way of ungodly prosper? All dealing faithlessly in acts of faithlessness flourished.
You planted them and they took root. They bore children and made fruit. Near are you in their mouth and far from their kidneys.
And you, Lord, know me. You tested my heart before you. Purify them for day of their slaughter.
How long will land mourn and every grass of field dry up? Because of evil of those dwelling in it, cattle and birds vanished, because they said, God will not see our ways.
Your feet run and wear you out; how will you prepare to mount horses? And in land of peace you trusted; how will you do in thicket of Jordan?
Because even your brothers and house of your father, they also dealt faithlessly with you, and they cried out after you from behind. Do not believe them when they speak good things to you.
I have abandoned my house, left my inheritance, given beloved of my soul into hands of her enemies.
My inheritance became to me like lion in forest; it gave its voice against me; therefore I hated it.
Is my inheritance cave of hyena to me, a cave around her? Go, gather all beasts of field, and let them come to devour her.
Many shepherds ruined my vineyard, defiled my portion, gave my desirable portion into pathless desert.
It was made into destruction; for me in destruction whole land was made desolate, because no man lays it to heart.
Over every opening in wilderness came destroyers, because sword of Lord will devour from one end of earth to other end; there is no peace for any flesh.
You sowed wheat and reaped thorns. Their allotments will not profit them. Be ashamed of your boastings, because of reproach before Lord.
Because thus says Lord concerning all evil neighbors touching my inheritance which I portioned to my people Israel: Behold, I pull them away from their land and cast Judah out from their midst.
And it will be after I cast them out, I will return and have mercy on them and settle each in his inheritance and each in his land.
And it will be if in learning they learn way of my people, to swear by my name, As Lord lives, just as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built in midst of my people.
But if they do not return, then I will uproot that nation with uprooting and destruction.
Thus says Lord: Go and buy for yourself linen belt and put it around your waist, and it will not pass through water.
And I bought belt according to word of Lord and put it around my waist.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Take belt around your waist and rise and go to Euphrates and hide it there in hole of rock.
And I went and hid it by Euphrates, just as Lord commanded me.
And it happened after many days, and Lord said to me, Rise, go to Euphrates and take from there belt which I commanded you to hide there.
And I went to Euphrates river and dug and took belt from place where I buried it there, and behold, it was ruined, fit for nothing.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Thus says Lord: So I ruin pride of Judah and pride of Jerusalem,
this great pride of those not wanting to hear my words and going after foreign gods to serve them and worship them. And they will become like this belt which is fit for nothing.
Because just as belt clings to waist of man, so I made whole house of Israel and whole house of Judah cling to me, to become to me notable people and praise and glory, and they did not hear me.
And you will say to this people, Every wineskin will be filled with wine. And it will be if they say to you, Not knowing shall we not know that every wineskin will be filled with wine?

And you will say to them, Thus says Lord: Behold, I fill inhabitants of this land and their kings seated, sons of David, upon his throne, and priests and prophets and all Judah and all inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
And I will scatter them, man and his brother and their fathers and their sons together. I will not pity, says Lord, and I will not spare and I will not show mercy from their destruction.
Hear and give ear and do not exalt yourselves, because Lord spoke.
Give to Lord your God glory before he brings darkness, and before your feet stumble on dark mountains, and you wait for light and there shadow of death and they be set into darkness.
And if you do not hear, your soul will weep secretly because of pride, and your eyes will bring down tears because flock of Lord was crushed.
Say to king and to rulers, Be humbled and sit down, because from your head fell crown of your glory.
Cities toward south were shut, and there was no one opening. Judah was carried away, a complete exile.
Lift up your eyes, Jerusalem, and see those coming from north. Where is flock given to you, sheep of your glory?
What will you say when they visit you, and you taught them lessons against yourself for rule? Will not birth-pangs seize you like woman giving birth?
And if you say in your heart, Why did these things meet me? Because of multitude of your injustice your hind parts were uncovered, your heels exposed as example.
If Ethiopian will change his skin and leopard her spots, then you also will be able to do good, being taught evil things.
And I scattered them like brushwood carried by wind into wilderness.
This your lot and portion of your disobeying me, says Lord, because you forgot me and hoped in lies.
And I also will uncover your back parts upon your face, and your dishonor will be seen.
Your adultery and your neighing and alienation of your prostitution on hills and in fields—I saw your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem, because you were not cleansed after me. How long yet?
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah concerning drought.
Judah mourned, and her gates were emptied and darkened upon earth, and cry of Jerusalem went up.
And her nobles sent their younger ones for water. They came to wells and found no water and returned their vessels empty.
And works of earth failed because there was no rain. Farmers were ashamed; they covered their heads.
And does in field gave birth and abandoned because there was no grass.
Wild donkeys stood on hilltops and drew in wind. Their eyes failed because there was no grass because of injustice of people.
If our sins stood against us, Lord, do for us for your sake, because many our sins before you, because against you we sinned.
Hope of Israel, Lord, and saving in time of evils, why did you become like resident alien upon land and like native one turning aside into lodging?
Do not be like sleeping man or like man unable to save. And you are in us, Lord, and your name is called upon us; do not forget us.
Thus says Lord to this people: They loved moving their feet and did not spare, and God took no pleasure in them. Now he will remember their injustices.
And Lord said to me, Do not pray concerning this people for good things.

Because if they fast, I will not hear their supplication, and if they offer whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not take pleasure in them, because by sword and by famine and by death I will consume them.
And I said, O Lord, behold, their prophets prophesy and say, You will not see sword nor will there be famine among you, because I will give truth and peace on earth and in this place.

And Lord said to me, Lies are what prophets prophesy in my name. I did not send them and did not command them and did not speak to them. False visions and divinations and omens and choices of their own hearts they prophesy to you.

Therefore thus says Lord concerning prophets prophesying lies in my name whom I did not send, those saying, Sword and famine will not be on this land: By diseased death they will die and by famine prophets will be finished.

And people to whom they prophesy will lie thrown in streets of Jerusalem from face of sword and famine, and there will be none burying them and their wives and their sons and their daughters, and I will pour out on them their evils.
And you will say to them this word: Let your eyes bring down tears day and night and let them not cease, because daughter of my people was crushed with crushing, very grievous wound.
If I go out into field, behold, wounded of sword, and if I enter city, behold, pain of famine, because priest and prophet went into land which they did not know.

Did you utterly reject Judah, and did your soul depart from Zion? Why did you strike us and there is no healing for us? We waited for peace and there were no good things, for time of healing and behold, disturbance.
We knew, Lord, our sins and injustices of our fathers, because we sinned against you.
Stop for your name's sake; do not destroy throne of your glory. Remember; do not break your covenant with us.
Is there among idols of nations one raining? Or will heaven give its fullness? Are not you yourself? And we will wait for you, because you made all these things.
And Lord said to me, If Moses and Samuel stand before my face, my soul is not toward them. Send out this people and let them go out.

And it will be if they say to you, Where will we go out? Then you will say to them, Thus says Lord: Those for death, to death; and those for sword, to sword; and those for famine, to famine; and those for captivity, to captivity.
And I will avenge on them with four kinds, says Lord: sword for slaughter and dogs for tearing and beasts of earth and birds of heaven for food and ruin.
And I will hand them over to troubles for all kingdoms of earth, because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah, because of all he did in Jerusalem.
Who will spare you, Jerusalem? And who will be timid over you? Or who will turn back for your peace?
You turned me away, says Lord; backward you will go. And I will stretch out my hand and destroy you, and I will no longer let them rest.
And I will scatter them in dispersion in gates of my people. They were made childless; they destroyed my people because of their evils.
Their widows multiplied beyond sand of sea. I brought against mother of young man misery at noon. I cast on her sudden terror and haste.
She who bore seven was emptied; her soul grew faint. Her sun set while still middle of day. She was ashamed and reproached. Their remnant I will give to sword before their enemies.
Woe to me, mother, that you bore me, man being judged and contending with whole land. I neither profited nor did anyone profit me. My strength failed among those cursing me.
Let it be, Master, as you straighten their way. Did I not stand before you in time of their evils and in time of their affliction for good things toward enemy?
Will iron and bronze armor be known?
Your strength and your treasures I will give for plunder, as payment for all your sins and in all your borders.
And I will enslave you round about to your enemies in land you did not know, because fire has been kindled from my wrath; upon you it will burn.
Lord, remember me and visit me and vindicate me from those persecuting me. In your long-suffering know that I took reproach for your sake.
By those rejecting your words, consume them. And your word will be to me joy and gladness of my heart, because your name is called upon me, Lord Almighty.
I did not sit in their gathering as they played, but I feared before your hand. I sat alone, because I was filled with bitterness.
Why do those grieving me prevail over me? My wound severe—from where will I be healed? It became to me like false water, having no faithfulness.

Therefore thus says Lord: If you return, I will restore you and you will stand before my face. And if you bring out precious from worthless, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.
And I will make you to this people as fortified bronze wall, and they will fight against you and surely not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you
and to deliver you from hand of evil ones, and I will redeem you from hand of pestilent men.
And you, do not take wife, says Lord God of Israel.
And son or daughter will not be born to you in this place.
Because thus says Lord concerning sons and daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them and their fathers who fathered them in this land:

By diseased death they will die. They will not be mourned and not buried. For example upon face of earth they will be. By sword they will fall and by famine be finished, and to beasts of earth and birds of heaven.
Thus says Lord: Do not enter into their drinking feast, and do not go to cut yourself and do not mourn them, because I removed my peace from this people.
They will not cut themselves for them, nor make gashes, nor shave themselves.
And bread will surely not be broken in their mourning for comfort over dead one, and he will not be given cup for comfort over his father and mother.
Into house of drinking you will not enter to sit with them to eat and drink.
Because thus says Lord God of Israel: Behold, I destroy from this place before your eyes and in your days voice of joy and voice of gladness, voice of bridegroom and voice of bride.

And it will be when you announce to this people all these words and they say to you, Why did Lord speak on us all these evils? What our injustice and what our sin which we sinned against Lord our God?
Then you will say to them, Because your fathers abandoned me, says Lord, and went after foreign gods and served them and worshiped them, and me they abandoned, and my law they did not keep.
And you acted more evilly than your fathers, and behold, you each walk after pleasures of your evil heart, so as not to obey me.
And I will cast you away from this land into land which you and your fathers did not know, and there you will serve other gods who will not give you mercy.
Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and they will no longer say, As Lord lives who brought up sons of Israel from land of Egypt,
but, As Lord lives who brought up house of Israel from land of north and from all regions where they were driven there, and I will restore them to their land which I gave to their fathers.
Behold, I send many fishers, says Lord, and they will fish them, and after these I will send many hunters, and they will hunt them on every mountain and hill and from clefts of rocks.
Because my eyes are on all their ways, and their injustices were not hidden from before my eyes.
And I will repay double their injustices and their sins, by which they profaned my land with corpses of their abominations and by their lawless deeds in which they offended my inheritance.
Lord, my strength and my help and my refuge in day of evils, to you nations will come from end of earth and say, Our fathers truly possessed lies, idols, and there is no profit in them.
Will man make gods for himself, and these are not gods?
Therefore behold, I will show them in this time my hand and make my power known to them, and they will know that my name is Lord.
Cursed man who has hope on man and will make flesh of his arm his support upon him, and his heart departs from Lord.
And he will be like tamarisk in wilderness and will not see when good things come, and will dwell in barren places and in wilderness, in salty land not inhabited.
And blessed man who trusts in Lord, and Lord will be his hope.

And he will be like flourishing tree by waters and upon moisture it will cast its roots, and will not fear when heat comes, and on it will be woodland shoots. In year of drought it will not fear and will not cease making fruit.
Deep is heart beyond all things, and it is man, and who will know him?
I Lord search hearts and test kidneys, to give to each according to his ways and according to fruits of his practices.
Partridge cried out, gathering what she did not bear. One making his wealth not with judgment, in middle of his days they will leave him, and at his end he will be fool.
Throne of glory exalted, our sanctuary.
Hope of Israel, Lord, let all abandoning you be ashamed. Those departing be written upon earth, because they abandoned fountain of life, Lord.
Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved, because you are my boasting.
Behold, they say to me, Where is word of Lord? Let it come.
But I did not grow weary following after you, and day of man I did not desire. You know what goes out through my lips; it is before your face.
Do not become alienation to me, sparing me in evil day.
Let those persecuting me be ashamed, and let me not be ashamed. Let them be terrified, and let me not be terrified. Bring on them evil day; crush them with double crushing.
Thus says Lord: Go and stand in gates of sons of your people, in which kings of Judah enter and go out, and in all gates of Jerusalem,
and say to them, Hear word of Lord, kings of Judah and all Judah and all Jerusalem, entering in these gates.
Thus says Lord: Guard your souls and do not carry burdens on day of Sabbaths and do not go out by gates of Jerusalem.
And do not bring burdens out of your houses on day of Sabbaths, and do no work. Sanctify day of Sabbaths, just as I commanded your fathers, and they did not hear and did not incline their ear.
And they hardened their neck beyond their fathers, not to hear me and not to receive discipline.
And it will be if in hearing you hear me, says Lord, not bringing burdens through gates of this city on day of Sabbaths and sanctifying day of Sabbaths, so as not to do any work,

then kings and rulers seated on throne of David will enter through gates of this city and mounted on their chariots and horses, they and their rulers, men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.

And they will come from cities of Judah and from around Jerusalem and from land of Benjamin and from lowland and from mountain and from south, bringing whole burnt offerings and sacrifice and incense and manna and frankincense, bringing praise into house of Lord.

And it will be if you do not hear me, to sanctify day of Sabbaths, not to carry burdens and not to enter by gates of Jerusalem on day of Sabbaths, then I will kindle fire in her gates and it will devour streets of Jerusalem and will not be quenched.
Word that came from Lord to Jeremiah, saying,
Rise and go down into house of potter, and there you will hear my words.
And I went down into house of potter, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.
And vessel which he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, just as it pleased him to make.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
If as this potter I will not be able to make you, house of Israel? Behold, as clay of potter, you are in my hands.
At one moment I will speak concerning nation or kingdom, to root them up and destroy.
And if that nation turns from all its evils, then I will repent concerning evils which I planned to do to them.
And at another moment I will speak concerning nation and kingdom, that it be built and planted.
And if they do evil before me, not hearing my voice, then I will repent concerning good things which I spoke to do for them.
And now speak to men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Behold, I form evils against you and think thought against you. Let each turn from his evil way, and you will make your practices better.
And they said, We will be strong, because after our turnings away we will go, and each will do pleasures of his own evil heart.
Therefore thus says Lord: Ask now among nations who heard such fearful things as virgin Israel did greatly.
Will breasts fail from rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water carried violently by wind turn aside?
Because my people forgot me. In vain they burned incense and will be weakened in their ways, eternal paths, to step on paths having no road for walking,
to set their land into destruction and everlasting hissing. All passing through it will be astonished and shake their heads.
As wind of heat I will scatter them before face of their enemies. I will show them day of their destruction.

And they said, Come, let us think thought against Jeremiah, because law will not perish from priest and counsel from wise man and word from prophet. Come, let us strike him with tongue and hear all his words.
Hear me, Lord, and hear voice of my plea.

Is evil repaid in place of good? Because they spoke words against my soul, and hid their punishment for me. Remember my standing before your face to speak good things for them, to turn your wrath away from them.
Therefore give their sons to famine and gather them into hands of sword. Let their wives become childless and widows, and their men become killed by death, and their young men fallen by sword in war.
Let cry come in their houses, because you will bring robbers on them suddenly, because they laid word for my capture and hid snares against me.

And you, Lord, knew all their counsel against me for death. Do not acquit their injustices, and do not wipe away their sins from before your face. Let their weakness be before you; in time of your wrath do in them.
Then Lord said to me, Go and buy shaped earthen jar and bring from elders of people and from elders of priests,
and you will go out to burial place of sons of their children, which is by entrances of gate of potsherd, and there read all words which I speak to you,

and say to them, Hear word of Lord, kings of Judah and men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem and those entering these gates. Thus says Lord God of Israel: Behold, I bring on this place evils so that ears of everyone hearing them will ring.

Because they abandoned me and estranged this place and burned incense in it to foreign gods whom they and their fathers and kings of Judah did not know, and they filled this place with innocent bloods,
and built high places to Baal to burn their sons in fire, which I did not command nor speak nor conceive in my heart.
Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and this place will no longer be called Falling Away and burial place of son of Hinnom, but burial place of slaughter.

And I will slaughter counsel of Judah and counsel of Jerusalem in this place, and I will cast them down by sword before their enemies and in hands of those seeking their souls, and I will give their dead bodies for food to birds of heaven and beasts of earth.
And I will set this city into destruction and hissing. Everyone passing by upon it will look gloomy and hiss over every plague of it.
And they will eat flesh of their sons and flesh of their daughters, and each will eat flesh of his neighbor in siege and straitness with which their enemies will besiege them.
And you will crush the jar before eyes of men going out with you,
and say, Thus says Lord: So I will crush this people and this city just as earthen vessel is crushed which cannot still be healed.
Thus I will do, says Lord, to this place and those dwelling in it, to make this city like the fallen place.

And houses of Jerusalem and houses of kings of Judah will be as place of falling away of uncleannesses, in all houses in which they burned incense on their roofs to all army of heaven and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.
And Jeremiah came from the place of falling away where Lord sent him there to prophesy, and he stood in court of house of Lord and said to all the people,
Thus says Lord: Behold, I bring on this city and on all her cities and on her villages all evils which I spoke against her, because they hardened their neck so as not to hear my words.
And Pashhur son of Immer the priest, and he was appointed ruler of house of Lord, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
And he struck him and threw him into stocks, which were at gate of house appointed of upper place, which was in house of Lord.
And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out from the stocks, and Jeremiah said to him, Lord did not call your name Pashhur, but Exile.

Because thus says Lord: Behold, I give you into exile with all your friends, and they will fall by sword of their enemies and your eyes will see, and I will give you and all Judah into hands of king of Babylon, and they will carry them away and cut them down with swords.
And I will give all strength of this city and all its toils and all treasures of king of Judah into hands of his enemies, and they will carry them into Babylon.
And you and all dwelling in your house will go into captivity, and in Babylon you will die, and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you prophesied lies.
You deceived me, Lord, and I was deceived. You overpowered me and prevailed. I became for laughter all day. I was spent being mocked.
Because with bitter word I will laugh. Lawlessness and misery I will call out, because word of Lord became to me for reproach and for mockery all my days.
And I said, I will not name name of Lord and I will not speak any longer in his name. And it became like burning fire flaming in my bones, and I am weakened from every side and cannot bear it.

Because I heard blame of many gathering around: Assemble, and let us assemble against him. All men his friends, watch his thought, if he will be deceived and we will prevail against him and take our vengeance from him.

And Lord with me as mighty warrior. Because of this they persecuted me and could not prevail. They were greatly ashamed, because they did not understand. Their eternal dishonors will not be forgotten.
Lord, testing righteous and understanding kidneys and heart, let me see from you vengeance on them, because to you I revealed my defense.
Sing to Lord. Praise him, because he rescued soul of poor man from hand of evildoers.
Cursed day in which I was born. Let not day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
Cursed man who brought good news to my father, saying, A male was born to you, rejoicing with joy.
Let that man be like cities which Lord overthrew in anger and did not relent. Let him hear cry in morning and battle-shout at midday,
because he did not kill me in womb of mother, and my mother became my tomb and womb of eternal conception.
Why was this? I came out from womb to see toils and pains, and my days passed in shame.
Word coming from Lord to Jeremiah when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Melchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
Ask Lord concerning us, because king of Babylon has risen against us, if Lord will act according to all his wonders and go away from us.
And Jeremiah said to them, Thus you will say to Zedekiah king of Judah,
Thus says Lord: Behold, I turn back war-weapons with which you fight against Chaldeans besieging you outside wall, into midst of this city.
And I myself will fight you with outstretched hand and strong arm, with wrath and anger and great provocation.
And I will strike all dwelling in this city, men and cattle, with great death, and they will die.

And after these things, thus says Lord, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and people left in this city from death and from famine and from sword into hands of their enemies seeking their lives, and they will cut them down with edge of sword. I will not spare them and I will not pity them.
And to this people you will say, Thus says Lord: Behold, I have given before your face way of life and way of death.
One dwelling in this city will die by sword and by famine, but one going out to join the Chaldeans besieging you will live, and his soul will be for spoil and he will live.
Because I have set my face against this city for evils and not for good. It will be handed over into hands of king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.
House of king of Judah, hear word of Lord.

House of David, thus says Lord: Judge judgment in morning, and set right, and rescue plundered one from hand of one wronging him, so that my wrath not blaze like fire and burn, and there not be one quenching it.
Behold, I am against you, one dwelling in valley of Sor, the plain one, those saying, Who will terrify us, and who will enter into our dwelling?
And I will kindle fire in her forest, and it will devour all around her.
Thus says Lord: Go and go down into house of king of Judah, and there you will speak this word,
and say, Hear word of Lord, king of Judah seated on throne of David, you and your house and your people and those entering by these gates.

Thus says Lord: Do judgment and righteousness, and rescue plundered one from hand of one wronging him, and do not oppress foreigner and orphan and widow, and do not act impiously, and do not pour out innocent blood in this place.
Because if in doing you do this word, kings seated on throne of David will enter through gates of this house and mounted on chariots and horses, they and their servants and their people.
But if you will not do these words, by myself I swore, says Lord, that this house will become for desolation.
Because thus says Lord against house of king of Judah: Gilead, you are to me, head of Lebanon. If I do not set you into wilderness, cities not to be inhabited.
And I will bring against you man destroying, and his axe, and they will cut down your choice cedars and throw them into fire.
And nations will pass through this city, and each will say to his neighbor, Why did Lord do thus to this great city?
And they will say, Because they abandoned covenant of Lord their God and bowed to foreign gods and served them.
Do not weep dead one and do not lament him. Weep with weeping for one going out, because he will not return again and will not see land of his homeland.
Because thus says Lord concerning Shallum son of Josiah, reigning instead of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: He will not return there any longer.
But in place where I carried him away, there he will die, and this land he will not see again.
Woe one building his house not with righteousness and his upper rooms not in judgment, with his neighbor working for nothing, and he will never pay him his wages.
You built for yourself well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms opened with windows and paneled with cedar and painted with red pigment.
Will you reign because you are inflamed against Ahaz your father? They will not eat and will not drink. Better it was for you to do judgment and good righteousness.
They did not know, they did not judge case of lowly nor case of poor. Is not this the same as not knowing me? says Lord.
Behold, your eyes and your heart are not good, but only for your greed and for pouring out innocent blood and for doing injustice and murder.
Therefore thus says Lord concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: Woe for this man. They will not lament him, saying, Ah brother, and they will not weep him, saying, Alas Lord.
With burial of donkey he will be buried, dragged away and thrown beyond gate of Jerusalem.
Go up to Lebanon and cry out, and in Bashan give your voice, and cry from across sea, because all your lovers were shattered.
I spoke to you in your falling away, and you said, I will not hear. This was your way from your youth: you did not hear my voice.
Wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go out into captivity, because then you will be ashamed and dishonored from all loving you.
You dwelling in Lebanon, nesting in cedars, you will groan when birth-pains come on you, like woman giving birth.
As I live, says Lord, if Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah becomes signet on my right hand, even from there I will pull you away.
And I will hand you over into hands of those seeking your life, whom you fear before their face, into hands of Chaldeans.
And I will throw you and your mother who bore you into land where you were not born, and there you will die.
But to land which they long for with their souls, they will never return.
Jeconiah was dishonored like vessel of no use, because he was thrown out and cast into land which he did not know.
Land, land, hear word of Lord.
Write this man as rejected, because no man from his seed will grow, sitting on throne of David and ruling any longer in Judah.
Woe, shepherds scattering and destroying sheep of my pasture.
Therefore thus says Lord against ones shepherding my people: You scattered my sheep and drove them out and did not visit them. Behold, I punish you according to your evil practices.
And I will gather remnant of my people from every land where I drove them there and restore them to their pasture, and they will increase and multiply.
And I will raise up for them shepherds who will shepherd them, and they will not fear any longer and will not be terrified, says Lord.
Behold, days come, says Lord, and I will raise up for David a righteous dawning, and a king will reign and understand and do judgment and righteousness upon earth.
In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will camp in confidence, and this is his name which Lord will call him: Josedek.
Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and they will no longer say, Lord lives, who brought up house of Israel from land of Egypt,
but, Lord lives, who gathered all seed of Israel from land of north and from all lands where he drove them there and restored them to their land.
In prophets my heart was crushed within me. All my bones were shaken. I became like broken man and like man overcome by wine, before face of Lord and before face of glory of his splendor.
Because from these things land mourned. Pastures of wilderness dried up, and their way became evil, and their strength not so.
Because priest and prophet were polluted, and in my house I saw their evils.
Therefore let their way become for them slipping-place in gloom, and they will stumble and fall in it, because I will bring evils on them in year of their visitation, says Lord.
And in prophets of Samaria I saw lawless things. They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.

And in prophets of Jerusalem I saw horrible things: committing adultery and walking in lies and strengthening hands of evildoers, so that each not turn back from his evil way. They all became to me like Sodom, and those dwelling in it like Gomorrah.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I feed them pain and give them bitter water to drink, because from prophets of Jerusalem pollution went out into all land.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Do not hear words of prophets. They make vain things for themselves. They speak vision from their own heart and not from mouth of Lord.
They say to ones rejecting word of Lord, Peace will be to you, and to all walking after their own desires, to everyone walking in wandering of his heart, they said, Evils will not come on you.
Because who stood in Lord's standing-place and saw his word? Who gave ear and heard?
Behold, shaking from Lord, and wrath goes out into turmoil twisting itself. It will come upon ungodly.
And anger of Lord will not turn back until he does it and until he raises it up from undertaking of his heart. At last of days they will understand these things.
I did not send prophets, and they ran. I did not speak to them, and they prophesied.
And if they had stood in my standing-place and heard my words, they would have turned my people away from their evil practices.
Am I God near at hand, says Lord, and not God from far away?
If man hides himself in hidden places, will I not see him? Do I not fill heaven and earth? says Lord.
I heard what prophets say, those prophesying lies in my name, saying, I dreamed dream.
How long will this be in heart of prophets prophesying lies and prophesying desires of their own heart?
They plan to make my law forgotten in their dreams which each recounts to his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot my name in Baal.
Prophet in whom dream is, let him recount his dream, and one with whom my word is, let him recount my word in truth. What has straw toward wheat? So are my words, says Lord.
Are not my words like flaming fire, says Lord, and like hammer breaking rock?
Therefore behold, I am against prophets, says Lord God, those stealing my words, each from his neighbor.
Behold, I am against prophets throwing out prophecies of tongue and dozing their own drowsiness.

Behold, I am against prophets prophesying lying dreams, and they recounted them and led my people astray in their lies and in their wanderings. And I did not send them and did not command them, and they will not benefit this people with benefit.
And if this people or priest or prophet asks you, saying, What burden of Lord? then you will say to them, You are burden, and I will dash you down, says Lord.
And prophet and priest and people, whoever says, Burden of Lord, I will punish that man and his house.
Because thus each will say to his neighbor and each to his brother, What did Lord answer, and what did Lord speak?
And burden of Lord do not name any longer, because burden will be each man's own word.
And why did Lord our God speak?
Therefore thus says Lord God: Because you said this word, Burden of Lord, though I sent to you saying, You shall not say, Burden of Lord,
therefore behold, I will take and dash you and city which I gave to you and to your fathers.
And I will give on you eternal reproach and eternal dishonor which will not be forgotten.

Lord showed me two baskets of figs set before face of temple of Lord, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and rulers and craftsmen and prisoners and rich men from Jerusalem and brought them into Babylon.
One basket held very good figs, like first-ripe figs, and other basket held very bad figs, which will not be eaten because of their badness.
And Lord said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs, very good ones very good, and very bad ones very bad, which will not be eaten because of their badness.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Thus says Lord God of Israel: As these good figs, so I will recognize exiles of Judah whom I sent away from this place into land of Chaldeans for good.
And I will set my eyes on them for good and restore them into this land for good, and I will rebuild them and not tear down, and I will plant them and not pull up.
And I will give them heart to know me, that I am Lord, and they will be to me for people and I will be to them for God, because they will turn back to me with all their heart.

And like bad figs, which will not be eaten because of their badness, thus says Lord, so I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah and his nobles and remnant of Jerusalem left in this land and those dwelling in Egypt.
And I will give them for dispersion into all kingdoms of earth, and they will be for reproach and for proverb and for hatred and for curse in every place where I drove them there.
And I will send on them famine and death and sword until they fail from land which I gave them.
Word coming to Jeremiah concerning all people of Judah in fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah,
which he spoke to all people of Judah and to ones dwelling in Jerusalem, saying,
In thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amos king of Judah and until this day, twenty-three years, I spoke to you, rising early and speaking.
And I sent to you my servants the prophets, rising early and sending, and you did not listen and did not pay attention with your ears,
saying, Let each turn back from his evil way and from your evil practices, and you will dwell upon land which I gave to you and to your fathers from age to age.
Do not go after foreign gods, to serve them and bow to them, so that you not provoke me by works of your hands, to harm you.
And you did not hear me.
Therefore thus says Lord: Because you did not believe my words,

behold, I send and will take family from north and bring them upon this land and upon those dwelling in it and upon all nations around it, and I will make them desolate and give them for disappearance and for hissing and for eternal reproach.
And I will destroy from them voice of joy and voice of gladness, voice of bridegroom and voice of bride, smell of perfume and light of lamp.
And all land will be for disappearance, and they will serve among nations seventy years.
And when seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish that nation, says Lord, and I will set them for eternal disappearance.
And I will bring upon that land all my words which I spoke against it, all things written in this book.
What Jeremiah prophesied against nations, against Elam.
Thus says Lord: Let bow of Elam be shattered, beginning of their power.
And I will bring upon Elam four winds from four ends of heaven and will scatter them in all these winds, and there will not be nation where outcasts of Elam will not come.
And I will terrify them before their enemies seeking their lives, and I will bring on them evils according to anger of my wrath, and I will send my sword after them until I consume them.
And I will set my throne in Elam and send away from there king and nobles.
And it will be at last of days, I will turn captivity of Elam, says Lord.
At beginning of Zedekiah king reigning, this word came concerning Elam.
Concerning Egypt, against force of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, which was by river Euphrates at Carchemish, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in fourth year of Jehoiakim king of Judah.
Take up weapons and shields and come near for war.
Harness horses, mount up, riders, and stand in your helmets. Advance spears and put on your breastplates.
Why? Because they are terrified and withdraw backward, because their mighty ones are cut down. In flight they fled and did not turn back, hemmed in all around, says Lord.
Let not swift one flee, and let not mighty one be saved. In north, by Euphrates, they weakened and fell.
Who is this who will rise like river, and whose waters surge like rivers?
Waters of Egypt will rise like river, and he said, I will go up and cover earth and destroy those dwelling in it.
Mount the horses. Prepare chariots. Go out, warriors, Ethiopians and Libyans armed with weapons, and Lydians, go up, bend bow.

And that day belongs to Lord our God, day of vengeance to avenge his enemies, and sword of Lord will devour and be filled and become drunk with their blood, because sacrifice belongs to Lord Sabaoth from land of north by river Euphrates.
Go up to Gilead and take resin, virgin daughter of Egypt. In vain you multiplied your healings. No benefit is for you.
Nations heard your voice, and earth was filled with your cry, because warrior weakened against warrior. Together both fell.
What Lord spoke by hand of Jeremiah, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to come to strike land of Egypt.
Announce in Migdol and proclaim in Memphis. Say, Stand ready and prepare, because sword devoured your smilax.
Why did Apis, your chosen calf, flee? He did not stand, because Lord weakened him.
And your multitude weakened and fell, and each said to his neighbor, Let us rise and return to our people and to our homeland from face of Greek sword.
Call name of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt: Saon-esbi-emoed.
As I live, says Lord God, as Tabor among mountains and as Carmel in sea, so he will come.
Make for yourself gear of exile, dwelling daughter of Egypt, because Memphis will become for disappearance and will be called Woe, because none dwell in her.
Egypt, beautified heifer. From north cutting-off came upon her.

And her hired men in her are like fattened calves raised in her, because they too turned back and fled together. They did not stand, because day of their destruction came upon them and time of their vengeance.
Her voice will hiss like serpent's, because they will go in sand, and with axes they will come upon her like woodcutters.
They will cut down her forest, says Lord God, because it will never be searched out. They multiplied beyond locusts, and there is no number for them.
Daughter of Egypt was put to shame. She was handed into hands of people from north.
Behold, I punish Amon her son, upon Pharaoh and upon ones trusting in him.

But do not fear, my servant Jacob, and do not be terrified, Israel, because behold, I save you from far away, and your seed from land of their captivity, and Jacob will return and be quiet and sleep, and there will not be one harassing him.

Do not fear, my child Jacob, says Lord, because I am with you. Because I will make end in every nation where I drove you there, but you I will not make fail, and I will discipline you in judgment, and by acquitting I will not acquit you.
Word of Lord which he spoke concerning Babylon.
Announce among nations and make heard, and do not hide. Say, Babylon was taken. Bel was put to shame. Merodach was handed over, fearless one and delicate one.
Because nation came up upon her from north. This one will make her land for disappearance, and there will be none dwelling in her, from man even to cattle.
In those days and in that time, sons of Israel will come, they and sons of Judah together. Walking and weeping, they will go seeking Lord their God.
They will ask way to Zion, because there they will set their faces, and they will come and flee for refuge to Lord their God, because everlasting covenant will not be forgotten.
My people became lost sheep. Their shepherds drove them away upon mountains. They led them astray from mountain onto hill. They went away and forgot their resting-place.
All finding them consumed them, and their enemies said, Let us not leave them guiltless, because they sinned against Lord, pasture of righteousness, the one gathering their fathers.
Become estranged from midst of Babylon, and go out from land of Chaldeans, and become like dragons before flocks.

Because behold, I raise up against Babylon gatherings of nations from land of north, and they will array against her. From there she will be taken, like arrow of wise warrior that will not return empty.
And Chaldea will become for plunder. All plundering her will be filled.
Because you rejoiced and boasted while plundering my inheritance, because you leaped like little cattle in grass and gored like bulls.
Your mother was greatly ashamed, mother of your good things, last of nations, wilderness.
From anger of Lord she will not be inhabited, and all will become for disappearance. Everyone passing through Babylon will darken and hiss over all her plague.
Array yourselves against Babylon all around, all stretching bow. Shoot at her. Do not spare your arrows.
Raise shout against her. Her hands were weakened. Her battlements fell, and her wall was torn down, because vengeance from God it is. Avenge against her. As she did, do to her.
Destroy seed from Babylon and one holding sickle in time of harvest. From face of Greek sword each will turn to his people, and each will flee into his land.
Israel, wandering sheep. Lions drove him out. First king of Assyria devoured him, and later king of Babylon broke his bones.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I punish king of Babylon and his land just as I punished king of Assyria.
And I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and on hill-country of Ephraim and on Gilead, and his soul will be filled.
In those days and in that time they will seek injustice of Israel and it will not exist, and sins of Judah and they will never be found, because I will be merciful to remnant upon land, says Lord.
Bitterly go up against her and against ones dwelling on her. Avenge with sword and destroy, says Lord, and do according to all I command you.
Sound of war and great crushing in land of Chaldeans.
How hammer of all earth was broken and shattered. How Babylon became for disappearance among nations.
They will set trap for you and you will be taken, Babylon, and you will not know. You were found and taken, because you stood against Lord.
Lord opened his treasury and brought out vessels of his wrath, because work belongs to Lord God in land of Chaldeans.
Because her times have come. Open her storehouses. Search her as cave and utterly destroy her. Let no remnant come to be from her.
Dry up all her fruits and let them go down to slaughter. Woe to them, because their day came and time of their vengeance.
Voice of ones fleeing and escaping from land of Babylon, to announce in Zion vengeance from Lord our God.

Command many against Babylon, every one stretching bow. Encamp against her all around. Let there not be one escaping from her. Pay back to her according to her works. According to all she did, do to her, because against Lord, Holy God of Israel, she stood.
Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all her war-men will be cast down, says Lord.
