Behold, I am against you, arrogant one, says Lord, because your day came and time of your vengeance.
And your arrogance will weaken and fall, and there will not be one raising her up. And I will kindle fire in her forest, and it will devour all around her.
Thus says Lord: Sons of Israel and sons of Judah together are oppressed, and all taking them captive oppressed them, because they were not willing to send them away.
But the one redeeming them is strong. Lord Almighty his name. He will judge judgment against his adversaries so that he may lift up the land and provoke those dwelling in Babylon.
Sword upon Chaldeans and upon those dwelling in Babylon and upon her nobles and upon her wise men.
Sword upon her warriors, and they will be paralyzed.
Sword upon their horses and upon their chariots, sword upon mixed people in her midst, and they will become like women. Sword upon her treasures, and they will be scattered.
Upon her water they trusted, and they will be put to shame, because it is land of carved images, and in islands they boasted.
Therefore phantoms will dwell in the islands, and daughters of sirens will dwell in her. She will no longer be inhabited forever.
As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and those neighboring them, says Lord, so man will not dwell there, and son of man will not sojourn there.
Behold, people comes from north, and great nation and many kings will be roused from end of earth.
Holding bow and short-sword, cruel he is and he will not pity. Their voice will sound like sea. Upon horses they will ride, prepared like fire for war against you, daughter of Babylon.
King of Babylon heard their report, and his hands were weakened. Distress seized him, birth-pains like one giving birth.

Behold, like lion he will go up from Jordan into Ethan place, because quickly I will drive them from her, and every young man I will appoint over her. Because who is like me, and who will oppose me, and who is this shepherd who will stand before my face?

Therefore hear counsel of Lord which he counseled against Babylon and his thoughts which he thought against those dwelling in Chaldea: Unless lambs of their sheep are destroyed, unless pasture is destroyed from them.
Because from voice of Babylon's capture earth will be shaken and cry will be heard among nations.
Thus says Lord: Behold, I raise against Babylon and against those dwelling in Chaldea hot destroying wind.
And I will send revilers into Babylon, and they will revile her and ruin her land. Woe upon Babylon all around in day of her affliction.
Against her let one stretching his bow stretch it, and let one with armor gird himself, and do not spare her young men, and destroy all her power.
And slain ones will fall in land of Chaldeans, and stabbed ones outside her.
Because Israel and Judah were not widowed from their God, from Lord Almighty, because their land was filled with injustice from Holy One of Israel.
Flee from midst of Babylon and save each his soul, and do not be cast away in her injustice, because time of her vengeance is from Lord. He repays repayment to her.
Babylon, golden cup in hand of Lord, making all earth drunk. Nations drank from her wine. Because of this they were shaken.
And suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered. Lament her. Take resin for her ruin, if perhaps she will be healed.
We healed Babylon and she was not healed. Let us abandon her, and let each go away into his own land, because her judgment drew near to heaven and rose as far as stars.
Lord brought out his judgment. Come, and let us announce in Zion works of Lord our God.
Prepare arrows. Fill quivers. Lord stirred spirit of king of Medes, because his wrath is against Babylon, to destroy her, because vengeance of Lord it is, vengeance of his people it is.
Upon walls of Babylon raise signal. Set quivers. Stir up guards. Prepare weapons, because Lord undertook and will do what he spoke against those dwelling in Babylon.
You dwelling upon many waters and abundance of treasures, your end came, truly into your inward parts.
Because Lord swore by his arm that I will fill you with men like locusts, and those coming down will shout over you.
He made earth in his strength, preparing world in his wisdom. In his understanding he stretched out heaven.
At his voice he set sound of waters in heaven and brought up clouds from end of earth. He made lightnings for rain and brought out light from his treasuries.
Every man became foolish from knowledge. Every goldsmith was put to shame by his carved images, because what they cast were lies and there is no breath in them.
They are vain works, mocked things. In time of their visitation they will perish.
Not such is portion for Jacob, because one forming all things, he is his inheritance. Lord his name.
You are to me war-vessels, and I will scatter nations in you, and I will remove kings from you.
And I will scatter in you horse and its rider, and I will scatter in you chariots and their riders.
And I will scatter in you young man and virgin, and I will scatter in you man and woman.
And I will scatter in you shepherd and his flock, and I will scatter in you farmer and his farm, and I will scatter in you your rulers and generals.
And I will repay Babylon and all dwelling in Chaldea all their evils which they did against Zion before your eyes, says Lord.
Behold, I am against you, corrupt mountain destroying all earth, and I will stretch out my hand upon you and roll you down from rocks and give you as mountain set on fire.
And they will never take from you stone for corner nor stone for foundation, because for disappearance forever you will be, says Lord.

Raise signal upon earth. Trumpet with trumpet among nations. Sanctify nations against her. Command against her kingdoms of Ararat and Ashkenaz. Set missile-stations against her. Bring up horse against her like swarm of locusts.
Sanctify nations against her, king of Medes and leaders of all his land and all his generals.
Earth shook and was in pain, because plan of Lord rose against Babylon, to make land of Babylon for disappearance and not inhabited.
Warrior of Babylon failed from fighting. They will sit there in enclosure. Their power was broken. They became like women. Her dwellings were burned with fire. Her bars were shattered.
Runner will run to meet runner, and announcer to meet announcer, to announce to king of Babylon that his city was taken.
From end of its crossings they were seized, and their gathering-places were burned with fire, and their war-men go out.
Because thus says Lord, house of king of Babylon is like ripe threshing-floor. Yet little, and her harvest will come.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon devoured me, portioned me, took me as delicate vessel, swallowed me like dragon, filled his belly from my luxury, and drove me out.
My labors and my hardships are upon Babylon, says one dwelling in Zion, and my blood upon those dwelling in Chaldea, says Jerusalem.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I judge your case and will avenge your vengeance, and I will desolate her sea and dry up her spring.
And Babylon will become for disappearance and will not be inhabited.
Together they were roused like lions and like lion-cubs.
In their heat I will give them drink and make them drunk so that they become numb and sleep eternal sleep and not wake up, says Lord.
I will bring them down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with goats.
How praise of all earth was taken and trapped. How Babylon became for disappearance among nations.
Sea rose over Babylon. With sound of its waves she was covered.
Her cities became waterless and impassable land. No one will dwell in her, and son of man will certainly not lodge in her.
And I will punish upon Babylon and bring out what she swallowed from her mouth, and nations will no longer be gathered to her.
And in Babylon slain ones of all earth will fall.
You saved ones from land, go and do not stand still. You far-off ones, remember Lord, and let Jerusalem rise upon your heart.
We were ashamed because we heard our reproach. Dishonor covered our face. Foreigners entered into our holy places, into house of Lord.
Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and I will punish her carved images, and in all her land slain ones will fall.
Because if Babylon goes up like heaven, and if she fortifies height of her strength, destroyers of her will come from me, says Lord.
Voice of cry in Babylon and great crushing in land of Chaldeans.
Because Lord destroyed Babylon and destroyed from her great voice sounding like many waters. He gave her voice for destruction.
Because affliction came upon Babylon. Her warriors were taken. Their bow was terrified, because God repays them. Lord repays her repayment.
And he will make her rulers drunk with drunkenness and her wise men and her generals, says the King, Lord Almighty his name.

Thus says Lord: Wall of Babylon, broadened out, being dug down, will be torn down, and her high gates were burned with fire, and peoples will not labor for emptiness, and nations at their beginning will fail.

Word which Lord commanded Jeremiah the prophet to tell Seraiah son of Neriah son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah king of Judah into Babylon in fourth year of his reign, and Seraiah ruler of gifts.
And Jeremiah wrote in one scroll all evils which will come upon Babylon, all these words written against Babylon.
And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come into Babylon and see and read all these words,
then you will say, Lord, Lord, you spoke against this place, to destroy it and for there not to be in it one dwelling, from man to cattle, because it will be disappearance forever.
And it will be when you finish reading this scroll, you will tie stone upon it and throw it into midst of Euphrates,
and you will say, Thus Babylon will sink and will never rise from face of evils which I bring upon her.
Against the foreigners.

Thus says Lord: Behold, waters rise from north, and they will become flooding torrent and cover land and its fullness, city and those dwelling in it, and men will cry out and all dwelling in land will howl.
From sound of his rush, from weapons of his feet and from shaking of his chariots, sound of his wheels, fathers did not turn back toward their sons from slackening of their hands.
In day coming to destroy all foreigners and to wipe out Tyre and Sidon and all remnant of their help, because Lord will destroy remnant of the islands.
Baldness came upon Gaza. Ashkelon was cast away, and remnant of Enakim. How long will you keep cutting yourself?
Sword of Lord, how long will you not rest? Return into your sheath. Rest and be lifted up.
How will it rest? Lord commanded it against Ashkelon and against the seacoasts, against the remnant, to be stirred up.
To Idumea thus says Lord: Is there no wisdom any longer in Thaiman? Counsel perished from prudent ones. Their wisdom went away.
Their place was deceived. Go deep into sitting, you dwelling in Daidan, because I made hard things against him. I brought them on him in time when I visited him.
Because grape-gatherers came to you, they will not leave gleanings to you. Like thieves in night they will lay hand on them.
Because I stripped Esau bare. I uncovered their hidden things. They will certainly not be able to hide. They were destroyed by hand of his brother and his neighbor, and he is no more.
Leave your orphan behind so that he may live, and I will keep him alive, and widows trusted in me.
Because thus said Lord: Those for whom it was not law to drink cup drank, and you by acquitting will not be acquitted, because drinking you will drink.
Because by myself I swore, says Lord, that you will become for trackless waste and for reproach and for curse in midst of her, and all her cities will become deserts forever.
I heard report from Lord, and he sent messengers to nations: Gather yourselves and come against her. Rise for war.
I made you small among nations, despised among men.
Your plaything deceived you, insolence of your heart, destroying holes of rocks, seizing strength of high hill. Because he raised his nest like eagle, from there I will bring you down.
And Idumea will become for trackless waste. Everyone passing by her will hiss.
As Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring places were overthrown, says Lord Almighty, so man will never sit there, and son of man will not dwell there.

Behold, like lion he will go up from midst of Jordan into Ethan place, because quickly I will drive them from her, and appoint young men over her. Because who is like me, and who will oppose me, and who is this shepherd who will stand before my face?

Therefore hear counsel of Lord which he counseled against Idumea and his thought which he thought against those dwelling in Thaiman: Unless least ones of flock are consumed, unless their resting-place is made desolate upon her.
Because from sound of their fall earth was shaken, and your cry was heard in sea.
Behold, like eagle he will appear and stretch his wings over her strongholds, and heart of mighty men of Idumea in that day will be like heart of woman in labor.
To sons of Ammon thus said Lord: Are there no sons in Israel, or is there no heir for them? Why did Melchom inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and I will sound in Rabbath tumults of wars, and they will become trackless waste and destruction, and her altars will be burned in fire, and Israel will inherit his beginning.
Howl, Heshbon, because Gai was destroyed. Cry out, daughters of Rabbath. Gird on sackcloth and mourn and cut yourselves for Melchom, because he will go in exile, his priests and his rulers together.
Why do you rejoice in plains, daughter of insolence, trusting in her treasures, saying, Who will enter against me?
Behold, I bring fear upon you, says Lord, from all around you, and you will each be scattered before his face, and there will not be one gathering.
To Kedar, royal court, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, thus said Lord: Rise and go up against Kedar and fill yourselves with sons of Kedem.
They will take their tents and their sheep, their garments and all their vessels, and their camels they will take for themselves, and call destruction around upon them.
Flee greatly. Go deep into sitting, you sitting in court, because king of Babylon counseled counsel against you and thought thought against you.
Rise and go up against nation at ease, dwelling in refreshment, for whom there are no doors, no bars, no bolts. They dwell alone.

And their camels will become for plunder and multitude of their cattle for destruction, and I will winnow them to every wind, clipped around the face, and from every side I will bring their downfall, says Lord.
And the court will become dwelling-place of sparrows and trackless waste forever. Man will not sit there, and son of man will not dwell there.
To Damascus: Hamath and Arphad were put to shame, because they heard evil report. They were confounded and troubled, and are not able to rest.
Damascus melted away. She turned to flight. Terror seized her.
How was my city not abandoned, town they loved?
Therefore your young men will fall in your squares, and all your war-men will fall, says Lord.
And I will kindle fire in wall of Damascus, and it will devour streets of son of Hader.
To Moab thus said Lord: Woe to Nabau, because it was destroyed. Kariathaim was taken. Amath was put to shame and defeated.
There is no longer healing for Moab, boasting in Heshbon. They planned evils against her: We cut her off from nation. Stop, a stopping-place. Behind you sword will go.
Because voice of criers from Horonaim, destruction and great crushing.
Moab was crushed. Announce it in Zoar.
Because on ascent of Alauth one will go up with weeping, weeping. On road of Horonaim they heard cry of crushing.
Flee and save your souls, and you will be like wild donkey in desert.
Because you trusted in your strongholds, you too will be taken, and Chemosh will go out into exile, his priests and his rulers together.
And destroyer will come upon every city, and city will not be saved, and valley will perish and plain will be destroyed, just as Lord said.
Give signs to Moab, because in flight she will fly out, and all her cities will become for trackless waste. From where will there be one dwelling in her?
Cursed one doing works of Lord negligently, withholding his sword from blood.

Moab was at rest from childhood and was confident on his glory. He was not poured from vessel into vessel, and into exile he did not go. Because of this his taste stood in him and his smell did not leave.
Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and I will send him tippers, and they will tip him, and they will thin his vessels and break his horns.
And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their hope, trusting on them.
How will you say, We are strong and mighty man for wars?
Moab was destroyed, his city, and his chosen young men went down to slaughter.
Near is day of Moab to come, and his evil very swift.
Shake for him, all around him, all knowing his name. Say, How glorious staff was broken, rod of greatness.
Come down from glory and sit in dampness, you dwelling in Daibon, worn out, because destroyer of Moab came up against you. He destroyed your stronghold.
Stand by road and watch, you dwelling in Aroer, and ask one fleeing and being saved, and say, What happened?
Moab was put to shame because he was broken. Howl and cry. Announce in Arnon that Moab was destroyed.
And judgment comes upon land of Misor, upon Chailon and upon Iassa and upon Mophaath,
and upon Daibon and Nabau and upon house of Deblathaim,
and upon Kariathaim and upon house of Gamol and upon house of Maon,
and upon Karioth and upon Bosor and upon all cities of Moab, far and near.
Horn of Moab was broken, and his arm was shattered.
Make him drunk, because he magnified himself against Lord, and Moab will clap with his hand, and he too will become for laughter.
And if Israel was not for mockery to you, was he found in your thefts, because you were fighting against him?
They left the cities and dwelt in rocks, those dwelling in Moab. They became like doves nesting in rocks at mouth of pit.
I heard pride of Moab. He was very proud, his insult and his arrogance, and his heart was raised high.
But I knew his works, not enough for him. Not so he did.
Therefore over Moab howl everywhere. Cry over men of Kiradas of drought.
Like weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sebema. Your branches passed through sea. They touched Jazer. Destroyer fell upon your fruit and upon your vintage.
Joy and gladness were consumed from Moabitis, and wine was upon your vats. Morning they did not tread, nor evening. They did not make shouting.
From cry of Heshbon as far as Elealeh their cities gave their voice, from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Aglath-salisia, because waters of Nebrim will become for burning.
And I will destroy from Moab, says Lord, one going up upon altar and burning incense to his gods.
Therefore my heart for Moab will sound like flutes, and my heart over men of Kiradas will sound like flute, because what he prepared perished from man.
Every head in every place will be shaved, and every beard will be shaved, and all hands will be cut, and upon every waist sackcloth.
And upon all roofs of Moab and in her squares, because I shattered Moab, says Lord, like vessel for which there is no use.
How it changed. How Moab turned back. He was ashamed and became for laughter and vexation to all around him.
Because thus said Lord,
Akkarioth was taken and strongholds were seized.
And Moab will perish from multitude, because against Lord he magnified himself.
Snare and fear and pit are upon you, one dwelling in Moab.
One fleeing from face of fear will fall into pit, and one coming up from pit will be caught in snare, because I will bring these things upon Moab in year of her visitation.
What Jeremiah prophesied against all nations.
Thus said Lord God of Israel: Take this cup of unmixed wine from my hand, and you will make all nations drink, to whom I send you to them.
And they will drink and vomit and go mad from face of sword which I send among them.
And I took cup from hand of Lord and made nations drink, to whom Lord sent me against them:
Jerusalem and cities of Judah and kings of Judah and his rulers, to set them for desolation and for trackless waste and for hissing,
and Pharaoh king of Egypt and his servants and his nobles and all his people,
and all his mixed peoples and all kings of foreigners, Ashkelon and Gaza and Ekron and remnant of Ashdod,
and Idumea and Moab and sons of Ammon,
and all kings of Tyre and kings of Sidon and kings beyond sea,
and Daidan and Thaiman and Ros and every one shaved around his face,
and all mixed peoples dwelling in wilderness,
and all kings of Elam and all kings of Persians,
and all kings from east, far and near, each toward his brother, and all kingdoms upon face of earth.
And you will say to them, Thus said Lord Almighty: Drink and get drunk and vomit and fall and not rise from face of sword which I send among you.
And it will be, when they do not want to receive cup from your hand to drink, then you will say, Thus said Lord: Drinking you will drink.
Because in city upon which my name was called, I begin to do evil, and by cleansing you will not be cleansed, because I call sword upon those dwelling on earth.

And you will prophesy against them these words and say: Lord from on high will answer, and from his holy place will give his voice. Word he will answer against his place, and shouting like grape-treaders they will answer against those dwelling on earth.
Destruction comes upon part of earth, because judgment belongs to Lord among nations. He himself is judged toward all flesh, but ungodly were given to sword, says Lord.
Thus said Lord: Behold, evils come from nation upon nation, and great storm goes out from ends of earth.
And slain by Lord in day of Lord will be from one end of earth even to other end of earth. They will never be buried. They will be like dung upon face of earth.
Howl, shepherds, and cry out, and cut yourselves, rams of sheep, because your days were filled up for slaughter, and you will fall like choice rams.
And flight will perish from shepherds and salvation from rams of sheep.
Voice of cry of shepherds and howl of sheep and rams, because Lord destroyed their pastures.
And remnants of peace will cease from face of my burning anger.
He abandoned his lodging like lion, because their land became trackless waste from face of great sword.
At beginning of king Jehoiakim son of Josiah this word came from Lord.
Thus said Lord: Stand in court of house of Lord and answer all Judeans and all coming to worship in house of Lord all words which I ordered you to answer them. Do not leave out word.
Perhaps they will hear and each turn from his evil way, and I will stop from evils which I plan to do to them because of their evil practices.
And you will say, Thus said Lord: If you do not hear me, to walk in my statutes which I gave before your face,
to listen to words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you early, and I sent, and you did not hear me,
then I will give this house like Shilom, and this city I will give for curse to all nations of all earth.
And priests and false prophets and all people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in house of Lord.
And it happened when Jeremiah ceased speaking all that Lord ordered him to speak to all people, priests and false prophets and all people seized him, saying, Death you will die.
Because you prophesied in name of Lord, saying, Like Shilom this house will be, and this city will be made desolate from dwellers. And all people were gathered against Jeremiah in house of Lord.
And rulers of Judah heard this word and went up from house of king into house of Lord and sat in entrance of new gate of Lord.
And priests and false prophets said to rulers and to all people, Judgment of death to this man, because he prophesied against this city as you heard in your ears.
And Jeremiah said to rulers and to all people, saying, Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all these words which you heard.
And now make your ways and your works better and hear voice of Lord, and Lord will stop from evils which he spoke against you.
And behold, I am in your hands. Do to me as helps and as seems better to you.

Only knowing you will know that if you kill me, you place innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and upon those dwelling in it, because in truth Lord sent me to you to speak all these words into your ears.
And rulers and all people said to priests and to false prophets, There is no judgment of death for this man, because in name of Lord our God he spoke to us.
And men from elders of land stood up and said to all assembly of people,

Micah the Morasthite was in days of Hezekiah king of Judah and said to all people of Judah, Thus said Lord: Zion will be plowed like field and Jerusalem will be for trackless waste and mountain of house for grove of forest.

Did Hezekiah and all Judah kill him by killing? Was it not because they feared Lord and sought face of Lord, and Lord stopped from evils which he spoke against them? And we have done great evils against our souls.
And there was man prophesying in name of Lord, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kariathiarim, and he prophesied concerning this land according to all words of Jeremiah.
And king Jehoiakim and all rulers heard all his words, and they sought to kill him, and Uriah heard and entered Egypt.
And king sent men into Egypt,
and they brought him out from there and led him to king, and he struck him with sword and threw him into tomb of sons of his people.
But hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so as not to hand him into hands of people, so that they not kill him.
Thus said Lord: Make bonds and yokes and put them around your neck.

And you will send them to king of Idumea and to king of Moab and to king of sons of Ammon and to king of Tyre and to king of Sidon by hand of their messengers coming to meet them in Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
And you will command them for their lords, saying, Thus said Lord God of Israel. Thus you will say to your lords:
I made earth in my great strength and in my high arm, and I will give it to whomever seems right in my eyes.
I gave land to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to serve him, and beasts of field to work for him.
And nation and kingdom, as many as do not put their neck under yoke of king of Babylon, with sword and famine I will visit them, said Lord, until they fail by his hand.
And do not hear your false prophets and those divining to you and those dreaming to you and your omen-readings and your sorceries, those saying, You will not serve king of Babylon.
Because they prophesy lies to you, to remove you far from your land.
And nation which puts its neck under yoke of king of Babylon and serves him, I will leave upon its land, and it will work it and dwell in it.
And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke according to all these words, saying, Bring in your neck,
and serve king of Babylon, because they prophesy unjust things to you.
Because I did not send them, says Lord, and they prophesy in my name for injustice, to destroy you, and you will perish, you and your prophets prophesying lies to you for injustice.

To you and to all this people and to priests I spoke, saying, Thus said Lord: Do not hear words of prophets prophesying to you, saying, Behold, vessels of house of Lord will return from Babylon, because they prophesy unjust things to you. I did not send them.
If they are prophets and if word of Lord is in them, let them answer me.
Because thus said Lord, even concerning remaining vessels
which king of Babylon did not take when he carried away Jeconiah from Jerusalem,
into Babylon it will enter, says Lord.

And it happened in fourth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in fifth month, Hananiah son of Azor, the false prophet from Gibeon, said to me in house of Lord before eyes of priests and all people, saying,
Thus said Lord: I have broken yoke of king of Babylon.
Still two years of days, and I will restore into this place vessels of house of Lord,
and Jeconiah and exile of Judah, because I will break yoke of king of Babylon.
And Jeremiah said to Hananiah before eyes of all people and before eyes of priests standing in house of Lord,
and Jeremiah said, Truly, may Lord do so. May Lord establish your word which you prophesy, to return vessels of house of Lord and all exile from Babylon into this place.
Only hear word of Lord which I speak into your ears and into ears of all people.
Prophets who were before me and before you from ancient time prophesied against much land and against great kingdoms for war.
Prophet prophesying for peace, when his word comes, they will know prophet whom Lord sent in faithfulness.
And Hananiah took before eyes of all people the yokes from Jeremiah’s neck and broke them.
And Hananiah said before eyes of all people, saying, Thus said Lord: Thus I will break yoke of king of Babylon from necks of all nations. And Jeremiah went on his way.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah after Hananiah broke yokes from his neck, saying,
Go and say to Hananiah, Thus said Lord: You broke wooden yokes, and I will make in place of them iron yokes.
Because thus said Lord: I have set iron yoke upon neck of all nations, to serve king of Babylon.
And Jeremiah said to Hananiah, Lord did not send you, and you made this people trust upon unjust thing.
Therefore thus said Lord: Behold, I send you away from face of earth. In this year you will die.
And he died in seventh month.
And these are words of scroll which Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to elders of exile and to priests and to false prophets, letter into Babylon to exile and to all people,
after Jeconiah the king and queen and eunuchs and every freeman and prisoner and craftsman went out from Jerusalem,
by hand of Eleasa son of Shaphan and Gamariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to king of Babylon in Babylon, saying,
Thus said Lord God of Israel concerning exile which I exiled from Jerusalem:
Build houses and dwell, and plant gardens and eat their fruits.
And take wives and beget sons and daughters, and take wives for your sons and give your daughters to husbands, and multiply and do not become few.
And seek peace of land into which I exiled you there, and pray concerning them to Lord, because in its peace there will be peace for you.
Because thus said Lord: Let not false prophets among you persuade you, and let not your diviners persuade you, and do not listen to your dreams which you yourselves dream,
because they prophesy unjust things to you in my name, and I did not send them.
Because thus said Lord: When Babylon is about to complete seventy years, I will visit you and establish my words upon you, to restore this people into this place.
And I think upon you thought of peace and not evils, to give you these things.
And pray to me, and I will hear you.
And seek me, and you will find me, because you will seek me with all your heart.
And I will appear to you.
Because you said, Lord appointed prophets for us in Babylon.
Thus said Lord concerning Ahab and concerning Zedekiah: Behold, I give them into hands of king of Babylon, and he will strike them before your eyes.
And from them they will take curse in all exile of Judah in Babylon, saying, May Lord make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom king of Babylon roasted in fire,
because they did lawlessness in Israel and committed adultery with wives of their fellow citizens and spoke word in my name which I did not command them, and I am witness, says Lord.
And to Shemaiah the Nehelamite you will say,
I did not send you in my name, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest he said,
Lord gave you priest in place of Joiada the priest, to become overseer in house of Lord over every man prophesying and every madman, and you will put him into confinement and into stocks.
And now why did you revile Jeremiah from Anathoth, the one prophesying to you?
Was it not for this he sent to you into Babylon, saying, It is long. Build houses and dwell, and plant gardens and eat their fruit?
And Zephaniah read the scroll into ears of Jeremiah.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
Send to exile, saying, Thus said Lord concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah prophesied to you and I did not send him, and he made you trust upon unjust things,
therefore thus said Lord: Behold, I will visit Shemaiah and his seed, and there will not be from them a man in your midst to see good things which I will do for you. They will not see.
Word coming to Jeremiah from Lord, saying,
Thus said Lord God of Israel, saying, Write all words which I answered to you in scroll,
because behold, days come, says Lord, and I will restore exile of my people Israel and Judah, says Lord, and I will restore them into land which I gave to their fathers, and they will rule it.
And these are words which Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah.
Thus said Lord: Voice of fear you will hear, fear and there is no peace.
Ask and see whether male gives birth, and from fear every man will hold his loin and salvation. Because I saw every man and his hands upon his loins. Faces were turned into jaundice.
It happened because that day is great, and there is none like it, and it is narrow time for Jacob, and from this he will be saved.
In that day, said Lord, I will break yoke from their neck and tear apart their bonds, and they will no longer serve foreigners.
And they will serve Lord their God, and David their king I will raise up for them.
Thus said Lord: Painful your fracture rose up, your wound.
There is none judging your judgment for painful thing. You were healed. No benefit for you.
All your friends forgot you. They will never ask for you, because with wound of enemy I struck you, stern discipline. Upon all your injustice your sins were multiplied.

Therefore all eating you will be eaten, and all your enemies, their flesh all will eat. Because your injustices multiplied, your sins multiplied, they did these things to you, and those carrying you off will be for carrying off, and all plundering you I will give for plunder.
Because I will bring up your healing. From painful wound I will heal you, says Lord, because scattered one they called you: It is your prey, because no seeker for her exists.
Thus said Lord: Behold, I will restore exile of Jacob and his captivity I will pity, and city will be built on its height, and temple will sit according to its judgment.
And from them singers and voice of ones playing will come out, and I will multiply them and they will not be diminished.
And their sons will enter as before, and their testimonies before my face will be set upright, and I will visit those afflicting them.
And their strong ones will be over them, and their ruler will come out from them, and I will gather them and they will return to me. Because who is this who gave his heart to return to me? says Lord.
Because wrath of Lord went out furious. Wrath twisting itself will come upon ungodly.
Wrath of anger of Lord will not turn back until he does and until he establishes undertaking of his heart. At last of days you will know these things.
In that time Lord said, I will be God to family of Israel, and they will be people to me.
Thus said Lord: I found warmth in wilderness with ones destroyed by sword. Go, and do not destroy Israel.
Lord appeared to him from far away: With eternal love I loved you, therefore I drew you into compassion.
Still I will build you and you will be built, virgin Israel. Still you will take your tambourine and go out with assembly of ones playing.
Still plant vineyards in mountains of Samaria. Plant and praise.
Because there is day of calling of defenders in mountain of Ephraim: Rise and go up to Zion, to Lord our God.
Because thus said Lord to Jacob: Rejoice and neigh over head of nations. Make it heard and praise. Say, Lord saved his people, remnant of Israel.
Behold, I bring them from north and gather them from ends of earth in feast of Phasce, and they will beget great crowd and return here.

With weeping they went out, and with comfort I will lead them, causing them to camp by channels of waters, in straight way, and they will not wander in it, because I became father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
Hear word of Lord, nations, and announce to islands far away. Say, One winnowing Israel will gather him and guard him like shepherd his flock.
Because Lord ransomed Jacob, delivered him from hand of ones stronger than he.

And they will come and rejoice in mountain Zion, and come upon good things of Lord, upon land of grain and wine and fruits and cattle and sheep. And their soul will be like fruitful tree, and they will hunger no longer.
Then virgins will rejoice in gathering of young men, and elders will rejoice, and I will turn their mourning into joy and make them glad.
I magnify and make drunk soul of priests, sons of Levi, and my people will be filled with my good things.
Thus said Lord: Voice was heard in Ramah, lament and weeping and mourning, Rachel weeping for her sons. She was not willing to stop because they are not.
Thus said Lord: Let your voice cease from weeping and your eyes from your tears, because there is wage for your works, and they will return from land of enemies.
Permanence for your children.
Hearing I heard Ephraim lamenting: You disciplined me and I was disciplined, like calf not taught. Turn me back and I will return, because you are Lord my God.
Because after my captivity I repented, and after my knowing I groaned in day of shame and showed you that I received reproach from my youth.
Ephraim beloved son to me, cherished child, because in return for my words in him I will surely remember him. Therefore I hurried over him. In mercy I will have mercy on him, says Lord.
Set up for yourself, Zion. Make chastisement. Give your heart to shoulders, to road on which you went. Turn back, virgin Israel. Turn back to your cities, mourning.
How long will you turn back, dishonored daughter? Because Lord created salvation for new planting. Men will go about in salvation.
Thus said Lord: Still they will speak this word in land of Judah and in its cities when I restore its captivity: Blessed Lord upon righteous mountain, his holy one.
And dwellers in cities of Judah and in all its land together with farmer and one lifted in flock.
Because I made every thirsty soul drunk and filled every hungry soul.
Therefore I woke up and saw, and my sleep became sweet to me.
Therefore behold, days come, says Lord, and I will sow Israel and Judah with seed of man and seed of cattle.
And it will be, just as I watched over them to tear down and to do evil, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, says Lord.
In those days they will no longer say, Fathers ate sour grape and teeth of children were set on edge.
But each will die in his own sin, and teeth of one eating sour grape will be set on edge.
Behold, days come, says Lord, and I will make with house of Israel and house of Judah new covenant,

not according to covenant which I made with their fathers in day when I took their hand to bring them out from land of Egypt, because they did not remain in my covenant and I neglected them, says Lord.

Because this is covenant which I will make with house of Israel after those days, says Lord: Giving, I will give my laws into their mind, and upon their hearts I will write them, and I will be God to them, and they will be people to me.

And they will certainly not teach each his fellow citizen and each his brother, saying, Know Lord, because all will know me from their little one to their great one, because I will be merciful to their injustices and I will no longer remember their sins.
If heaven is lifted up high, says Lord, and if foundation of earth is humbled below, I also will not reject seed of Israel, says Lord, concerning all they did.
Thus said Lord, who gave sun for light of day, moon and stars for light of night, and cry in sea, and its waves roared, Lord Almighty his name.
If these laws cease from before my face, says Lord, then seed of Israel will cease from being nation before my face all days.
Behold, days come, says Lord, and city will be built to Lord from tower of Hanameel to corner gate.
And its measuring-line will go out opposite them as far as hills of Gareb and will be encircled round about with chosen stones.
And all Asaeremoth as far as valley of Kedron, as far as corner of horse gate eastward, holy thing to Lord, and it will never fail or be torn down forever.
Word that came from Lord to Jeremiah in tenth year of reign of Zedekiah, this was eighteenth year of reign of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
And force of king of Babylon fenced against Jerusalem, and Jeremiah was guarded in court of prison, which is in house of king.
In which king Zedekiah shut him up, saying, Why do you prophesy, saying, Thus said Lord: Behold, I give this city into hands of king of Babylon, and he will take it.

And Zedekiah will certainly not be saved from hand of Chaldeans, because in handing over he will be handed into hands of king of Babylon, and his mouth will speak to his mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes.
And Zedekiah will enter Babylon, and there he will sit.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
Behold, Hanameel son of Shallum your father’s brother comes to you, saying, Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth, because judgment belongs to you to receive it for possession.

And Hanameel son of Shallum my father’s brother came to me into court of prison and said to me, Buy my field in land of Benjamin, in Anathoth, because judgment belongs to you to buy, and you are elder. And I knew that it is word of Lord.
And I bought field of Hanameel, son of my father’s brother, and weighed out to him seven shekels and ten of silver.
And I wrote in scroll and sealed and called witnesses and weighed silver in balance.
And I took scroll of purchase, sealed and read.

And I gave it to Baruch son of Neriah son of Maaseiah before eyes of Hanameel son of my father’s brother and before eyes of those standing and writing in scroll of purchase and before eyes of Judeans in court of prison.
And I commanded Baruch before their eyes, saying,
Thus said Lord Almighty: Take this scroll of purchase and scroll that was read and put it into earthen vessel, so that it may remain many days.
Because thus said Lord: Still fields and houses and vineyards will be bought in this land.
And I prayed to Lord after my giving scroll of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, saying,
Ah Lord, you made heaven and earth with your great strength and your high and lifted arm, and nothing will be hidden from you,
doing mercy to thousands and repaying sins of fathers into bosom of their children after them, God great and mighty,
Lord of great counsel and mighty in works, God great, Almighty, and great in name, Lord. Your eyes are upon ways of sons of men, to give to each according to his way,
who made signs and wonders in land of Egypt until this day, and in Israel and among natives, and made name for yourself as this day.
And you brought your people Israel out from land of Egypt with signs and with wonders and with strong hand and with high arm and with great visions.
And you gave them this land which you swore to their fathers, land flowing milk and honey.
And they entered and took it, and they did not hear your voice, and in your ordinances they did not walk. All that you commanded them they did not do, and you made all these evils happen to them.
Behold, crowd comes to this city to seize it, and city was given into hands of Chaldeans fighting against it from face of sword and famine. As you spoke, so it happened.
And you say to me, Buy field for yourself with silver, and I wrote scroll and sealed and brought witnesses, and city was given into hands of Chaldeans.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
I am Lord, God of all flesh. Will anything be hidden from me?
Therefore thus said Lord God of Israel: This city in being given over will be handed into hands of king of Babylon, and he will take it.
And Chaldeans fighting against this city will come and burn this city with fire and burn houses in which they burned incense on their roofs to Baal and poured libations to other gods to provoke me.
Because sons of Israel and sons of Judah alone were doing evil before my eyes from their youth.
Because this city has been for my anger and for my wrath from day they built it even until this day, to remove it from before my face,
because of all evils of sons of Israel and Judah which they did to provoke me, they and their kings and their rulers and their priests and their prophets, men of Judah and dwellers of Jerusalem.
And they turned to me back and not face, and I taught them rising early and teaching, and they did not hear to receive discipline.
And they set their defilements in house on which my name was called, by their uncleannesses.

And they built altars to Baal in valley of son of Hinnom, to offer up their sons and daughters to King Moloch, which I did not command them and it did not rise on my heart, to do this abomination, to make Judah sin.
And now thus said Lord God of Israel concerning this city which you say will be handed into hands of king of Babylon by sword and famine and by sending away:
Behold, I gather them from all lands where I scattered them there in my anger and in my wrath and in great provocation, and I will restore them to this place and settle them in confidence.
And they will be people to me, and I will be God to them.
And I will give them another way and another heart, to fear me all days, for good to them and to their children after them.
And I will make with them everlasting covenant, which I will certainly not turn away from behind them, and my fear I will give into their heart, so that they not depart from me.
And I will visit to do them good and plant them in this land in faithfulness and in all heart and in all soul.
Because thus said Lord: As I brought upon this people all these great evils, so I will bring upon them all good things which I spoke upon them.
And fields will still be bought in land which you say is trackless waste, from men and cattle, and they were handed into hands of Chaldeans.

And they will buy fields with silver and write scroll and seal and bring witnesses in land of Benjamin and around Jerusalem and in cities of Judah and in cities of hill country and in cities of lowland and in cities of Negeb, because I will restore their exiles.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah second time, and he was still bound in court of prison, saying,
Thus said Lord, making earth and forming it to set it upright, Lord his name,
Cry to me and I will answer you and announce to you great and mighty things which you did not know.
Because thus said Lord God of Israel concerning houses of this city and concerning houses of king of Judah, torn down into trenches and defenses,
to fight against Chaldeans and to fill it with dead men whom I struck in my anger and wrath, and I turned away my face from them because of all their evils.
Behold, I bring up healing and remedy to her and reveal to them hearing, and I will heal her and make for them peace and faithfulness.
And I will restore exile of Judah and exile of Israel and build them as before.
And I will cleanse them from all their injustices with which they sinned against me, and I will no longer remember sins with which they sinned against me and departed from me.

And it will be for joy and for praise and for greatness to every people of earth who hear all good things which I will do. And they will fear and be embittered concerning all good things and all peace which I will make for them.
Thus said Lord: Still in this place, which you say is desolate from men and cattle, in cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, laid waste because there is no man and no cattle, it will be heard

voice of gladness and voice of joy, voice of bridegroom and voice of bride, voice of those saying, Give thanks to Lord Almighty, because good is Lord, because his mercy is forever. And they will bring gifts into house of Lord, because I will restore all exile of that land as before, said Lord.
Thus said Lord of hosts: Still there will be in this place, this desolate one because there is no man and cattle, and in all its cities, dwellings of shepherds laying sheep down.

In cities of hill country and in cities of lowland and in cities of Negeb and in land of Benjamin and around Jerusalem and in cities of Judah, sheep will still pass under hand of one counting, said Lord.
Word that came to Jeremiah from Lord, while Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his camp and all land of his rule fought against Jerusalem and against all cities of Judah, saying,
Thus said Lord: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and say to him, Thus said Lord: This city in being handed over will be handed into hands of king of Babylon, and he will seize it and burn it with fire.

And you will certainly not be saved from his hand, because in seizing you will be seized and into his hands you will be given, and your eyes will see his eyes, and his mouth will speak with your mouth, and you will enter Babylon.
But hear word of Lord, Zedekiah king of Judah. Thus says Lord:
In peace you will die, and as they lamented your fathers, kings ruling before you, they will lament you also, and saying, Oh lord, they will beat themselves for you, because I spoke word, says Lord.
And Jeremiah spoke all these words to king Zedekiah in Jerusalem.
And force of king of Babylon fought against Jerusalem and against cities of Judah, against Lachish and against Azekah, because these were left among cities of Judah, fortified cities.
Word came to Jeremiah from Lord after king Zedekiah finished covenant with people, to proclaim release,
to send out each his male servant and each his female servant, the Hebrew and the Hebrew woman, free, so that no man from Judah should enslave them.
And all nobles and all people who entered covenant turned, to send out each his male servant and each his female servant.
And they drove them away into male servants and female servants.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
Thus said Lord God of Israel: I made covenant with your fathers in day when I brought them out from land of Egypt, out of house of slavery, saying,

When six years are completed, you will send out your Hebrew brother who was sold to you, and he will work for you six years, and you will send him out free. And they did not hear me and did not incline their ear.
And today you turned to do what is right before my eyes, to proclaim release each to his neighbor, and completed covenant before my face in house on which my name was called.

And you turned back and profaned my name, by turning back each his male servant and each his female servant whom you sent out free according to their soul, and you took them for yourselves as male servants and female servants.

Therefore thus said Lord: You did not hear me to proclaim release, each to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim release to you, to sword and to death and to famine, and I will give you for dispersion to all kingdoms of earth.
And I will give the men who passed over my covenant, those not keeping my covenant which they made before my face, like calf which they made to work for him,
the rulers of Judah and the mighty men and the priests and the people,
and I will give them to their enemies, and their dead bodies will be food to birds of heaven and beasts of earth.
And Zedekiah king of Judah and their rulers I will give into hands of their enemies and force of king of Babylon to those fleeing away from them.
Behold, I command, says Lord, and I will return them to this land, and they will fight against it and take it and burn it with fire, and cities of Judah I will give desolate, with no dwellers.
Word that came to Jeremiah from Lord in days of Jehoiakim king of Judah, saying,
Go into house of Rechab and bring them into house of Lord, into one of courts, and make them drink wine.
And I brought out Jezoniah son of Jeremin son of Chabasin and his brothers and his sons and all house of Rechab,
and I brought them into house of Lord, into chamber of sons of Hanan son of Godoliah, man of God, which is near house of rulers, above house of Maaseiah son of Shallum, keeper of court.
And I set before their face jar of wine and cups and said, Drink wine.
And they said, We will certainly not drink wine, because Jonadab son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You and your sons will certainly not drink wine forever.
And you will not build house, and seed you will not sow, and vineyard will not be yours, because in tents you will dwell all your days, so that you may live many days upon land on which you sojourn.
And we listened to voice of Jonadab our father, so as not to drink wine all our days, we and our wives and our sons and our daughters,
and so as not to build houses to dwell there, and vineyard and field and seed did not come to be for us.
And we dwelt in tents and listened and did according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
And it happened when Nebuchadnezzar came up against land, we said, Enter, and let us enter Jerusalem from face of force of Chaldeans and from face of force of Assyrians, and we dwelt there.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Thus says Lord: Go and say to man of Judah and to those dwelling in Jerusalem, Will you not receive discipline by hearing my words?
Words of sons of Jonadab son of Rechab stand, who commanded his children not to drink wine, and they did not drink, and I spoke to you early and spoke, and you did not hear.

And I sent to you my servants the prophets, saying, Each turn back from his evil way and make your practices better, and do not go after other gods to serve them, and you will dwell upon land which I gave to you and to your fathers, and you did not incline your ears and did not hear.
And sons of Jonadab son of Rechab kept command of their father, but this people did not hear me.
Therefore thus said Lord: Behold, I bring upon Judah and upon those dwelling in Jerusalem all evils which I spoke against them.
Therefore thus said Lord: Because sons of Jonadab son of Rechab heard command of their father, doing exactly as their father commanded them,
man from sons of Jonadab son of Rechab will certainly not fail, standing before my face all days of earth.
And in fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, word of Lord came to me, saying,

Take for yourself scroll-sheet and write on it all words which I answered to you concerning Jerusalem and Judah and all nations, from day when I spoke to you, from days of Josiah king of Judah until this day.
Perhaps house of Judah will hear all evils which I plan to do to them, so that they may turn back from their evil way, and I will be merciful to their injustices and their sins.
And Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote from mouth of Jeremiah all words of Lord which he answered to him into scroll-sheet.
And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am guarded. I cannot enter house of Lord.
And you will read from this sheet into ears of people in house of Lord in day of fasting, and in ears of all Judah coming from their cities you will read to them.
Perhaps their mercy will fall before face of Lord and they will turn back from their evil way, because great is anger and wrath of Lord which he spoke against this people.
And Baruch did according to all that Jeremiah commanded him, to read in scroll words of Lord in house of Lord.
And it happened in eighth year of reign of Jehoiakim, in ninth month, all people in Jerusalem and house of Judah proclaimed fast before Lord.
And Baruch read in scroll words of Jeremiah in house of Lord, in house of Gamariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in upper court, in entrance of new gate of house of Lord, in ears of all people.
And Micaiah son of Gamariah son of Shaphan heard all words of Lord from scroll,

and went down to house of king, to house of scribe, and behold there all rulers sat: Elishama the scribe and Delaiah son of Shelemiah and Elnathan son of Achobor and Gamariah son of Shaphan and Zedekiah son of Hananiah and all rulers.
And Micaiah announced to them all words which he heard while Baruch read into ears of people.

And all rulers sent to Baruch son of Neriah Jehudi son of Nethaniah son of Shelemiah son of Chusi, saying, Scroll in which you read in ears of people, take it in your hand and come. And Baruch took scroll and went down to them.
And they said to him, Read again into our ears. And Baruch read.
And it happened when they heard all words, each took counsel with his neighbor and said, Announcing, let us announce to king all these words.
And they asked Baruch, saying, From where did you write all these words?
And Baruch said, From his mouth Jeremiah announced to me all these words, and I wrote in scroll.
And they said to Baruch, Go hide, you and Jeremiah. Let no man know where you are.
And they entered to king into court, and scroll they gave to keep in house of Elishama, and they announced to king all words.
And king sent Jehudi to take scroll, and he took it from house of Elishama and read it into ears of king and into ears of all rulers standing around king.
And king sat in winter house, and hearth of fire before his face.
And it happened while Jehudi read three pages and four, he cut them off with scribe’s knife and threw into fire on hearth until whole sheet was gone into fire on hearth.
And king and his servants hearing all these words did not seek and did not tear their garments.
And Elnathan and Godoliah and Gamariah urged king not to burn scroll.
And king commanded Jeremeeel son of king and Seraiah son of Esriel to seize Baruch and Jeremiah, and they hid themselves.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah after king burned scroll, all words which Baruch wrote from mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
Again take for yourself another sheet and write all words that were on former sheet which king Jehoiakim burned.
And you will say, Thus said Lord: You burned this sheet, saying, Why did you write on it, saying, In entering king of Babylon will enter and destroy this land and man and cattle will fail from it?
Therefore thus said Lord concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: There will not be for him one sitting on throne of David, and his corpse will be thrown out in heat of day and frost of night.

And I will visit upon him and upon his seed and upon his servants, and I will bring upon them and upon those dwelling in Jerusalem and upon land of Judah all evils which I spoke to them and they did not hear.
And Baruch took another sheet and wrote on it from mouth of Jeremiah all words of scroll which Jehoiakim burned, and still more words like these were added to it.
And Zedekiah son of Josiah reigned instead of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made reign over Judah.
And he and his servants and people of land did not hear words of Lord which he spoke by hand of Jeremiah.
And king Zedekiah sent Jucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest to Jeremiah, saying, Pray now concerning us to Lord.
And Jeremiah came and passed through midst of city, and they had not given him into house of prison.
And force of Pharaoh went out from Egypt, and Chaldeans heard their report and went up from Jerusalem.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
Thus said Lord: Thus you will say to king of Judah who sent to you to seek me: Behold, force of Pharaoh which came out to help you will return into land of Egypt.
And these Chaldeans will return and fight against this city and seize it and burn it with fire.
Because thus said Lord: Do not assume in your souls, saying, In fleeing away Chaldeans will go away from us, because they will certainly not go away.
And if you strike all force of Chaldeans fighting you and some remain pierced, each in his place, these will rise up and burn this city with fire.
And it happened when force of Chaldeans went up from Jerusalem from face of force of Pharaoh,
Jeremiah went out from Jerusalem to go into land of Benjamin to buy from there in midst of people.
And it happened he was at gate of Benjamin, and there man with whom Seraiah son of Shelemiah son of Hananiah lodged, and he seized Jeremiah, saying, You flee to Chaldeans.
And he said, False. I do not flee to Chaldeans. And he did not hear him, and Seraiah seized Jeremiah and brought him to rulers.
And rulers were embittered against Jeremiah and struck him and sent him into house of Jonathan the scribe, because they made this into house of prison.
And Jeremiah came into house of pit and into cells and sat there many days.
And Zedekiah sent and called him, and king asked him secretly, to say whether there is word from Lord. And he said, There is. Into hands of king of Babylon you will be handed over.
And Jeremiah said to king, What wrong did I do to you and your servants and this people, that you give me into house of prison?
And where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying that king of Babylon will certainly not come against this land?
And now, lord king, let my mercy fall before your face, and why do you turn me back into house of Jonathan the scribe, so that I not die there?
And king commanded, and they put him into house of prison, and gave him one loaf of bread each day from outside where loaves fall, until breads failed from city. And Jeremiah sat in court of prison.
And Shephatiah son of Mattan and Gedoliah son of Pashhur and Jucal son of Shelemiah heard words which Jeremiah spoke to people, saying,
Thus said Lord: One dwelling in this city will die by sword and by famine, and one going out to Chaldeans will live, and his soul will be for gain and he will live.
Because thus said Lord: This city in being handed over will be handed into hands of force of king of Babylon, and he will seize it.

And they said to king, Let that man be killed, because he weakens hands of men fighting, remaining in city, and hands of all people, speaking to them according to these words, because this man does not seek peace for this people but evil.
And king said, Behold, he is in your hands, because king was not able against them.
And they threw him into pit of Malchiah son of king, which was in court of prison, and lowered him into pit, and in pit there was no water but mire, and he was in mire.
And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian heard, and he was in house of king, that they put Jeremiah into pit, and king was in gate of Benjamin.
And he went out to him and spoke to king and said,
You did evil, what you did, to kill this man from face of famine, because there are no longer breads in city.
And king commanded Ebed-melech, saying, Take thirty men in your hands from here and bring him up out of pit so that he not die.
And Ebed-melech took the men and entered into lower chamber of house of king and took from there old rags and old ropes and threw them to Jeremiah into pit.
And he said, Put these under ropes. And Jeremiah did so.
And they pulled him with ropes and brought him up from pit, and Jeremiah sat in court of prison.
And king sent and called him to himself into third house in house of Lord, and king said to him, I will ask you word, and do not hide thing from me.
And Jeremiah said to king, If I tell you, will you not surely kill me? And if I advise you, you will certainly not hear me.
And king swore to him, saying, As Lord lives, who made this soul for us, if I kill you and if I give you into hands of these men.

And Jeremiah said to him, Thus said Lord: If in going out you go out to rulers of king of Babylon, your soul will live and this city will certainly not be burned with fire, and you and your house will live.
And if you do not go out, this city will be given into hands of Chaldeans, and they will burn it with fire, and you will certainly not be saved.
And king said to Jeremiah, I have concern because of Judeans who fled to Chaldeans, lest they give me into their hands and they mock me.
And Jeremiah said, They will certainly not hand you over. Hear word of Lord which I speak to you, and it will be better for you and your soul will live.
And if you do not want to go out, this is word which Lord showed me:

Behold, all women left in house of king of Judah were being brought out to rulers of king of Babylon, and they said, Your peace-men deceived you and will prevail against you. They lodged your feet in slipping-places and turned away from you.
And your wives and your children they will bring out to Chaldeans, and you will certainly not be saved, because by hand of king of Babylon you will be seized, and this city will be burned.
And king said to him, Let no man know of these words, and you will certainly not die.
And if rulers hear that I spoke to you and come to you and say, Announce to us what king spoke to you, do not hide from us and we will certainly not kill you, and what king spoke to you,
then you will say to them, I cast my mercy before eyes of king, so as not to turn me back to house of Jonathan to die there.
And all rulers came to Jeremiah and questioned him, and he announced to them according to all these words which king commanded him, and they were silent, because word of Lord was not heard.
And Jeremiah sat in court of prison until time when Jerusalem was taken.
And it happened in ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came and all his force against Jerusalem and besieged it.
And in eleventh year of Zedekiah, in fourth month, ninth of month, city was breached.
And all rulers of king of Babylon entered and sat in middle gate: Nergal-sareser and Samagoth and Nebusachar and Nebusaris and Nagargasnaser, Rabmag, and rest of rulers of king of Babylon.
And they sent and took Jeremiah from court of prison and gave him to Gedoliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, and they brought him out and he sat in midst of people.
And to Jeremiah word of Lord came in court of prison, saying,
Go and say to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, Thus said Lord God of Israel: Behold, I bring my words upon this city for evils and not for good.
And I will save you in that day, and I will certainly not give you into hands of men whose face you fear from before them.
Because saving I will save you, and by sword you will certainly not fall, and your soul will be for gain, because you trusted on me, says Lord.
Word that came from Lord to Jeremiah later, after Nebuzaradan chief cook sent him away from Ramah, when he took him in handcuffs in midst of exile of Judah being led to Babylon.
And chief cook took him and said to him, Lord your God spoke these evils against this place.
And Lord did it because you sinned against him and did not hear his voice.
Behold, I loosed you from handcuffs on your hands. If it is good before you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will set my eyes on you.

And if not, run back and return to Gedoliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, whom king of Babylon appointed in land of Judah, and dwell with him in midst of people in land of Judah. Go wherever it is good in your eyes to go. And chief cook gave him provisions and gifts and sent him away.
And he came to Gedoliah at Mizpah and sat in midst of people left in land.
And all leaders of force in field, they and their men, heard that king of Babylon appointed Gedoliah in land and entrusted to him men and women, those not exiled to Babylon.
And Ishmael son of Nethaniah and Johanan son of Kareah and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth and sons of Ophi the Netophathite and Jezoniah son of Mochathi came to Gedoliah at Mizpah, they and their men.
And Gedoliah swore to them and to their men, saying, Do not fear from face of servants of Chaldeans. Dwell in land and serve king of Babylon, and it will be better for you.
And behold, I sit before you in Mizpah to stand before face of Chaldeans who may come upon you. And you gather wine and fruit and oil and put into your vessels and dwell in cities which you seized.
And all Judeans in land of Moab and among sons of Ammon and in Idumea and in all land heard that king of Babylon gave remnant to Judah and appointed over them Gedoliah son of Ahikam.
And they came to Gedoliah into land of Judah, to Mizpah, and gathered wine and very much fruit and oil.
And Johanan son of Kareah and all leaders of force in fields came to Gedoliah at Mizpah
and said to him, In knowing do you know that Baalis king of sons of Ammon sent Ishmael to strike your soul? And Gedoliah did not believe them.

And Johanan said to Gedoliah secretly in Mizpah, I will go now and strike Ishmael and let no one know. Why should he strike your soul and all Judah gathered to you be scattered and remnant of Judah perish?
And Gedoliah said to Johanan, Do not do this thing, because you speak lies concerning Ishmael.
And it happened in seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elasa, from seed of king, and ten men with him came to Gedoliah at Mizpah, and they ate bread there together.
And Ishmael rose up, and the ten men with him, and struck Gedoliah whom king of Babylon had appointed over land.
And all Judeans who were with him in Mizpah, and all Chaldeans found there.
And it happened on second day after he struck Gedoliah, and no man knew,

that men came from Sychem and from Shalem and from Samaria, eighty men with beards shaved and garments torn and cutting themselves, and manna and frankincense in their hands to bring into house of Lord.
And Ishmael went out to meet them. They went and wept, and he said to them, Enter to Gedoliah.
And it happened when they entered into midst of city, he slaughtered them into pit.

And ten men were found there, and they said to Ishmael, Do not kill us, because treasures are ours in field: wheat and barley, honey and oil. And he passed by and did not kill them in midst of their brothers.
And pit into which Ishmael threw all whom he struck, this great pit is that which king Asa made against Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael filled it with wounded men.
And Ishmael carried off all people left in Mizpah, and daughters of king whom chief cook entrusted to Gedoliah son of Ahikam, and he went to beyond sons of Ammon.
And Johanan son of Kareah and all leaders of force with him heard all evils which Ishmael did.
And they took all their army and went to fight him and found him by much water in Gibeon.
And it happened when all people with Ishmael saw Johanan and leaders of force with him,
they turned back to Johanan.
And Ishmael escaped with eight men and went to sons of Ammon.
And Johanan and all leaders of force with him took all remnant of people whom he turned back from Ishmael, mighty men in war and women and rest and eunuchs whom he turned back from Gibeon.
And they went and sat in Gaberoth-chamaam near Bethlehem, to go and enter Egypt
from face of Chaldeans, because they feared from face of them, because Ishmael struck Gedoliah whom king of Babylon appointed in land.
And all leaders of force approached, and Johanan and Azariah son of Maaseiah and all people from small to great,
to Jeremiah the prophet, and said to him, Let now our mercy fall before your face, and pray to Lord your God concerning these remnants, because we were left few from many, as your eyes see us.
And let Lord your God announce to us way in which we will go and word which we will do.
And Jeremiah said to them, I heard. Behold, I will pray to Lord our God according to your words, and word which Lord answers I will announce to you. I will not hide word from you.
And they said to Jeremiah, Let Lord be in us as righteous and faithful witness if according to all word which Lord sends you to us we do not do so.
Whether good or evil, voice of Lord our God, whom we send you to him, we will hear, so that it may be better for us because we will hear voice of Lord our God.
And it happened after ten days, word of Lord came to Jeremiah.
And he called Johanan and leaders of force and all people from small to great,
and said to them, Thus said Lord:
If in settling you settle in this land, I will build you and never tear down, and plant you and never pull up, because I have rested from evils which I did to you.
Do not fear from face of king of Babylon, whom you fear from face of him. Do not fear, says Lord, because I am with you to rescue you and save you from his hand.
And I will give you mercy and have mercy on you and restore you to your land.
And if you say, We will certainly not settle in this land, so as not to hear voice of Lord,
because we will enter land of Egypt and will certainly not see war and will certainly not hear sound of trumpet and will certainly not hunger for bread, and there we will dwell,
therefore hear word of Lord. Thus said Lord: If you set your face toward Egypt and enter there to dwell,
then sword which you fear from face of it will find you in land of Egypt, and famine about which you have concern will overtake you behind you in Egypt, and there you will die.
And all men and all foreigners who set their face toward land of Egypt to dwell there will fail by sword and by famine. There will not be among them one saved from evils which I bring on them.

Because thus said Lord: As my wrath dripped upon dwellers of Jerusalem, so my wrath will drip on you when you enter Egypt, and you will be for trackless waste and underhand and for curse and for reproach, and you will not see this place again.
What Lord spoke against you, remnants of Judah: Do not enter Egypt, and now in knowing you will know,
because you did evil in your souls, sending me, saying, Pray concerning us to Lord, and according to all Lord says to you we will do.
And you did not hear voice of Lord, by which he sent me to you.
And now by sword and by famine you will fail in place where you want to enter to dwell there.
And it happened as Jeremiah ceased speaking to people all words of Lord, which Lord sent him to them, all these words,
Azariah son of Maaseiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all men said to Jeremiah, saying, Lies. Lord did not send you to us, saying, Do not enter Egypt to dwell there.
But Baruch son of Neriah conspires against us, so as to give us into hands of Chaldeans, to kill us and exile us to Babylon.
And Johanan and all leaders of force and all people did not hear voice of Lord, to dwell in land of Judah.
And Johanan and all leaders of force took all remnants of Judah who returned to dwell in land,
mighty men and women and infants and daughters of king and souls whom Nebuzaradan left with Gedoliah son of Ahikam, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah,
and they entered Egypt because they did not hear voice of Lord, and they entered Taphnas.
And word of Lord came to Jeremiah in Taphnas, saying,
Take for yourself great stones and hide them in entrance by gate of house of Pharaoh in Taphnas, before eyes of men of Judah.
And you will say, Thus said Lord: Behold, I send and will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and he will set his throne upon these stones which you hid, and will lift his weapons over them.
And he will enter and strike land of Egypt: those for death to death, and those for exile to exile, and those for sword to sword.
And he will burn fire in houses of their gods and burn them and carry them away, and destroy land of Egypt as shepherd destroys his garment, and he will go out in peace.
And he will shatter pillars of Heliopolis which are in On, and their houses he will burn with fire.
Word that came to Jeremiah to all Judeans dwelling in land of Egypt and to those sitting in Migdol and in Taphnas and in land of Pathures, saying,
Thus said Lord God of Israel: You saw all evils which I brought upon Jerusalem and upon cities of Judah, and behold, they are desolate from dwellers,
because of their evils which they did to provoke me, going to burn incense to other gods whom you did not know.
And I sent to you my servants the prophets early and sent, saying, Do not do deed of this pollution which I hated.
And they did not hear me and did not incline ear to turn back from their evils, so as not to burn incense to other gods.
And my wrath and my anger dripped and burned in cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, and they became for desolation and for trackless waste as this day.
And now thus said Lord Almighty: Why do you do great evils against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, infant and nursing child from midst of Judah, so that none be left to you,

provoking me by works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in land of Egypt into which you entered to dwell there, so that you may be cut off and become for curse and reproach among all nations of earth?
Have you not forgotten evils of your fathers and evils of kings of Judah and evils of your rulers and evils of your women, which they did in land of Judah and outside Jerusalem?
And they did not cease until this day and did not endure my ordinances which I gave before face of their fathers.
Therefore thus said Lord: Behold, I set my face
to destroy all remnants in Egypt, and they will fall by sword and by famine. They will fail from small to great, and they will be for reproach and destruction and curse.
And I will visit upon those dwelling in land of Egypt as I visited upon Jerusalem with sword and with famine and with death.

And there will not be anyone saved of remnants of Judah sojourning in land of Egypt to return into land of Judah, upon which they hope in their souls to return there. They will certainly not return, except rescued ones.
And all men knowing that their wives burn incense to other gods answered Jeremiah, and all women, great assembly, and all people dwelling in land of Egypt in Pathures, saying,
Word which you spoke to us in name of Lord, we will not hear from you.

Because in doing we will do every word which goes out from our mouth, to burn incense to queen of heaven and pour libations to her, just as we and our fathers and our kings and our rulers did in cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, and we were filled with bread and became good and saw no evils.
And when we stopped burning incense to queen of heaven, we were all diminished and failed by sword and famine.
And because we burn incense to queen of heaven and pour libations to her, did we make cakes for her and pour libations to her without our husbands?
And Jeremiah said to all people and to men and to women and to all people answering him words, saying,
Was it not incense which you burned in cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, you and your fathers and your kings and your rulers and people of land, that Lord remembered and it rose upon his heart?
And Lord was no longer able to bear from face of evil of your deeds, from abominations which you did, and your land became for desolation and for trackless waste and for curse as in this day,
because you burned incense and sinned against Lord and did not hear voice of Lord and did not walk in his ordinances and in his law and in his testimonies, and these evils seized you.
And Jeremiah said to people and to women, Hear word of Lord.

Thus said Lord God of Israel: You women spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, saying, In doing we will do our vows which we vowed, to burn incense to queen of heaven and pour libations to her. In abiding you abided in your vows and in doing you did them.

Therefore hear word of Lord, all Judah dwelling in land of Egypt. Behold, I swore by my great name, said Lord, if my name still becomes in mouth of any Judah to say, As Lord lives, Lord, in all land of Egypt.
Because behold, I watched over them to do them evil and not good, and all Judah dwelling in land of Egypt will fail by sword and famine until they disappear.
