And I also gave them ordinances not good and judgments in which they will not live.
And I defiled them in their gifts, in my causing every opener of womb to pass through, so that I might destroy them.
Therefore speak to house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, Thus says Lord: Up to this point your fathers provoked me in their trespasses by which they trespassed against me.

And I brought them into land about which I lifted my hand to give it to them, and they saw every high hill and every shady tree and there they sacrificed to their gods and set there fragrant smell and poured out there their drink offerings.
And I said to them, What is Abama, that you enter there? And its name was called Abama until this day.
Therefore say to house of Israel, Thus says Lord: Are you defiling yourselves in lawless deeds of your fathers, and after their abominations are you whoring?

And in firstfruits of your gifts, in your separations, you are defiling yourselves in all your thoughts until this day, and shall I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says Lord, I will not answer you, and this that rises on your spirit.
And it will not be in way that you say, We will be like nations and like tribes of earth, serving wood and stone.
Therefore as I live, says Lord, with strong hand and uplifted arm and wrath poured out I will reign over you.
And I will bring you out from peoples and welcome you from lands where you were scattered, with strong hand and uplifted arm and wrath poured out.
And I will bring you into wilderness of peoples and judge with you there face to face.
As I judged with your fathers in wilderness of land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says Lord.
And I will bring you under my rod and bring you in by number.
And I will pick out from you impious ones and rebels, because I will bring them out from their sojourning, but into land of Israel they will not enter, and you will know that I am Lord.

And you, house of Israel, thus says Lord God: Each one, cast away his practices, and after these things, if you do not listen to me, you will no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and with your practices.

Because on my holy mountain, on high mountain, says Lord God, there all house of Israel, to the end, will serve me, and there I will receive them, and there I will visit your firstfruits and firstfruits of your separations in all your holy things.
In fragrant aroma I will receive you, when I bring you out from peoples and welcome you from lands in which you were scattered, and I will be sanctified in you before eyes of nations.
And you will know that I am Lord when I bring you into land of Israel, into land concerning which I lifted my hand to give it to your fathers.
And there you will remember your ways and your practices by which you were defiled in them, and you will strike your faces over all your evils.
And you will know that I am Lord when I act thus with you, so that my name may not be profaned, not according to your evil ways and not according to your corrupt practices, says Lord.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Teman and look toward Darom and prophesy against leading forest of Negeb.

And say to forest of Negeb, Hear word of Lord. Thus says Lord God: Behold, I kindle fire in you, and it will devour in you every green tree and every dry tree. Flame kindled will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be burned in it.
And all flesh will know that I, Lord, kindled it, and it will not be quenched.
And I said, Not so, Lord, Lord. They say to me, Is not this thing spoken a parable?
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Therefore prophesy, son of man, and set your face toward Jerusalem and look toward their holy places, and you will prophesy against land of Israel.
And you will say to land of Israel, Behold, I am against you and will draw my dagger from its sheath and destroy from you righteous and lawless.
Because I will destroy from you righteous and lawless, so my dagger will go out from its sheath against all flesh from south to north.
And all flesh will know that I, Lord, drew my dagger from its sheath, and it will not return again.
And you, son of man, groan with breaking of your loins, and with pains you will groan before their eyes.

And it will be, if they say to you, Because of what do you groan? then you will say, Because of report, for it comes, and every heart will be broken and all hands paralyzed, and all flesh will faint and every spirit, and all thighs will be defiled with wetness. Behold, it comes and will happen, says Lord God.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says Lord. Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and be enraged.
So that you may slaughter victims, be sharpened; so that it may be ready for gleaming, ready for paralysis. Slaughter. Despise; push away every tree.
And he gave it ready for his hand to seize. Sword has been honed; it is ready to be given into hand of one striking through.
Cry out and howl, son of man, because it came upon my people, upon all leaders of Israel. They will sojourn under sword; it came upon my people. Therefore clap upon your hand.
Because it has been justified. And what if tribe is rejected? It will not be, says Lord God.
And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand to hand and double sword, a third sword. It is sword of slain, the great sword of the slain, and it will throw them into panic.
So that heart may be crushed and weak ones multiplied, at all their gates they are handed over to slaughter of sword. Well made for slaughter, well made for gleaming.
Pass through. Be sharpened to right and to left, wherever your face is raised.
And I too will clap my hand to my hand and let my wrath rest. I, Lord, have spoken.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
And you, son of man, appoint for yourself two ways for sword of king of Babylon to enter. From one land both will come out, and hand at beginning of road, at beginning of city’s road.
You will set road for sword to enter upon Rabbath of sons of Ammon and upon Judea and upon Jerusalem in her midst.
Because king of Babylon will stand on old road, at beginning of two roads, to divine divination, to shake rod, and inquire by carved things and inspect liver. On his right
the oracle came to Jerusalem, to cast up trench, to open mouth with shout, to raise voice with cry, to cast up trench against her gates and heap up earth and build missile-stations.
And he will be to them like one divining divination before them, and he himself reminding them of his injustices, to be remembered.

Therefore thus says Lord: Because you brought your injustices to remembrance, when your impieties were uncovered, so that your sins were seen in all your impieties and in your practices, because you were remembered in these things, in them you will be captured.
And you, profane lawless leader of Israel, whose day has come in time of injustice of the end,
thus says Lord: Remove turban and take off crown. This will not stay this way. You humbled high thing and exalted low thing.
Injustice, injustice, I will make it. Even this will not be until one comes whose right it is, and I will give it to him.

And you, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says Lord concerning sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach. And you will say, Sword, sword, drawn for slaughter and drawn for complete destruction. Rise up so that you may flash,
while in your vain vision and your false divination, to hand you over on necks of slain lawless ones whose day has come in time of injustice of the end.
Turn back. Do not camp here. In place where you were born, in your own land, I will judge you.
And I will pour out my anger upon you; in fire of my wrath I will blow upon you and hand you over into hands of barbarous men, crafting destruction.
In fire you will be food for devouring; your blood will be in midst of your land. There will be no remembrance of you, because I, Lord, have spoken.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
And you, son of man, if you judge city of bloods, then show her all her lawless deeds,
and say, Thus says Lord God: O city pouring out blood in her midst, so that her time may come, and making thoughts against herself so as to defile herself,

in your bloods which you poured out you have trespassed, and in your thoughts which you made you were defiled, and you drew near your days and brought on time of your years. Because of this I gave you for reproach to nations and for mockery to all lands,
those near you and those far from you. They will mock you, unclean, well known, and great in lawless deeds.
Behold, leaders of house of Israel, each with his kin, were mixed up in you so as to pour out blood.
Father and mother they reviled in you, and toward sojourner they behaved unjustly. In you orphan and widow they oppressed.
And my holy things they despised, and my Sabbaths they profaned in you.
Robber-men were in you so as to pour out blood in you, and on mountains they ate in you; impious things they did in your midst.
Shame of father they uncovered in you, and woman set apart in uncleanness they humbled in you.
Each one acted lawlessly with wife of his neighbor, and each one defiled his daughter-in-law in impiety, and each one humbled his sister, daughter of his father, in you.
Gifts they took in you so as to pour out blood; interest and excess they took in you, and I completed your evils by oppression, but me you forgot, says Lord.
And if I strike hand to hand over what you completed, what you did, and over your bloods that came to be in your midst,
will your heart stand? Will your hands hold strong in days when I act in you? I, Lord, have spoken and will do it.
And I will scatter you among nations and disperse you through lands, and your uncleanness will cease from you.
And I will inherit in you before eyes of nations, and you will know that I am Lord.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, behold, house of Israel became to me mixed metal, all of them bronze and iron and tin and lead in midst of silver; it is mixed metal.
Therefore thus says Lord: Because you all became one mixture, therefore I gather you into midst of Jerusalem.
As silver and bronze and iron and tin and lead are gathered into midst of furnace, to blow fire into it so as to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and draw you together and melt you.
And I will blow upon you in fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in her midst.
As silver is melted in midst of furnace, so you will be melted in her midst, and you will know that I, Lord, poured out my wrath upon you.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, say to her, You are land not rained on, nor did rain come upon you in day of wrath.
Whose rulers in her midst are like roaring lions seizing plunder, eating souls in oppression, taking honors in injustice, and your widows were multiplied in your midst.

And her priests rejected my law and profaned my holy things; between holy and profane they did not distinguish, and between unclean and clean they did not distinguish, and from my Sabbaths they covered their eyes, and I was profaned in their midst.
Her rulers in her midst are like wolves seizing plunder, to pour out blood, so that greedily they may gain greed.
And her prophets smearing them over will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, Thus says Lord, and Lord has not spoken.
People of land, oppressing with injustice and plundering plunder, oppressing poor and needy, and toward sojourner not behaving with judgment.
And I sought from them a man walking uprightly and standing wholly before me in time for land, so as not to wipe it out completely, and I did not find one.
And I poured out my wrath upon it; in fire of my anger, to complete, I have put their ways on their heads, says Lord God.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
And they whored in Egypt, in their youth. There their breasts fell, there they were deflowered.
And their names were Oola the elder and Ooliba her sister, and they became mine and bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria was Oola and Jerusalem Ooliba.
And Oola whored away from me and set herself on her lovers, on Assyrians near her,
clothed in blue, leaders and generals, choice young men all, horsemen mounted on horses.
And she gave her whoring to them, all choice sons of Assyria, and with all on whom she set herself, with all her thoughts, she was defiled.
And her whoring from Egypt she did not leave, because with her they lay in her youth and they deflowered her and poured out their whoring on her.
Because of this I gave her into hands of her lovers, into hands of sons of Assyria on whom she set herself.
They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters, and killed her by sword, and she became a byword among women, and they did vengeance in her among the daughters.
And her sister Ooliba saw and corrupted her desire beyond her and her whoring beyond whoring of her sister.
She set herself on sons of Assyria, leaders and generals near her, clothed with fine border, horsemen riding on horses, choice young men all.
And I saw that they were defiled; one way belonged to both.
And she added to her whoring, and saw men painted on wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with stylus,
girded with patterned belts on their loins and dyed tiaras on their heads, all with princely appearance, likeness of sons of Chaldea, their native land.
And she set herself on them at sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them into land of Chaldeans.
And sons of Babylon came to her into bed of lying down and defiled her in her whoring, and she was defiled by them, and her soul turned away from them.
And she uncovered her whoring and uncovered her shame, and my soul turned away from her, as my soul turned away from her sister.
And you multiplied your whoring, to remember days of your youth in which you whored in Egypt.
And you desired Chaldeans, whose flesh was like flesh of donkeys and whose genitals were genitals of horses.
And you visited lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt, in your lodging, where breasts of your youth were.
Therefore, Ooliba, thus says Lord: Behold, I stir up your lovers against you, those from whom your soul turned away, and I will bring them upon you from all around,
sons of Babylon and all Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all sons of Assyria with them, choice young men, governors and generals, all nobles and men of name, riding on horses.

And all will come against you from north, chariots and wheels with crowd of peoples; shield and buckler and they will set guard against you around, and I will set judgment before them and they will avenge you by their judgments.

And I will set my jealousy in you, and they will act with you in fury of wrath. Your nose and your ears they will remove, and your remnant they will cast down by sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and your remnant fire will devour.
And they will strip you of your garments and take vessels of your boasting.
And I will turn your impieties away from you and your whoring from land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will remember no more.
Because thus says Lord God: Behold, I hand you over into hands of those you hate, from whom your soul turned away,
and they will deal with you in hatred and take all your gains and your toil, and you will be naked and unseemly, and shame of your whoring will be uncovered, and your impiety and your whoring.
These things were done to you because you whored after nations and were defiled in their thoughts.
In way of your sister you walked, and I will put her cup in your hands.
Thus says Lord: Cup of your sister you will drink, deep and broad, overflowing so as to destroy.
With drunkenness and collapse you will be filled, cup of desolation, cup of your sister Samaria.
And you will drink it, and her feasts and her new moons I will turn away, because I have spoken, says Lord.
Therefore thus says Lord: Because you forgot me and threw me behind your body, you also bear your impiety and your whoring.
And Lord said to me, Son of man, will you not judge Oola and Ooliba and announce to them their lawless deeds?
Because they committed adultery, and blood was in their hands. With their thoughts they committed adultery, and their children whom they bore to me they passed through fire for them.
And these things they did to me: my holy things they defiled and my Sabbaths they profaned.
And when they slaughtered their children to their idols, they entered into my holy places to profane them, and so they acted in midst of my house.
And they sent messengers to men coming from far away, and as soon as they came you washed and painted your eyes with stibium and adorned yourself with ornament.
And you sat on bed spread out, and table adorned before it, and my incense and my oil rejoiced among them.
And sound of harmony they struck up, and to men from multitude of people coming from wilderness they put bracelets on their hands and crown of boasting on their heads.
And I said, Are they committing adultery in these things? Works of prostitute, and she whored.
And they went in to her as they go in to prostitute woman; so they went in to Oola and to Ooliba, to do lawlessness.
And righteous men, they will avenge them with vengeance of adulteress and vengeance of blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is in their hands.
Thus says Lord God: Bring up against them crowd and give in them turmoil and plundering.
And stone them with stones of crowds and spear them with their swords. Their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.
And I will turn impiety away from land, and all women will be instructed and will not do according to their impieties.
And your impiety will be given upon you, and sins of your thoughts you will bear, and you will know that I am Lord.
And word of Lord came to me in ninth year, in tenth month, on tenth of month, saying,
Son of man, write for yourself this day, from this day from which king of Babylon pressed hard against Jerusalem, from this very day.
And speak to provoking house a parable, and say to them, Thus says Lord: Set on the cooking pot and pour water into it,
and put into it the pieces, every good piece, thigh and shoulder, stripped from bones.
Taken from choice cattle, and kindle the bones under them. It boiled, boiled, and its bones were cooked in its midst.
Therefore thus says Lord: O city of bloods, pot in which there is rust in it and its rust did not go out from it. Piece by piece it was brought out; lot did not fall on it.
Because her blood is in her midst. Upon bare rock I placed it; I did not pour it on ground to cover earth over it.
So that wrath might rise for vengeance, to be avenged, I gave her blood upon bare rock, so that it should not be covered.
Therefore thus says Lord: I too will magnify the pile.
And I will multiply the wood and kindle the fire so that the flesh may melt and the broth be diminished.
And set it upon the coals so that its bronze may burn and become hot and its uncleanness may melt within it and its rust fail away.
And her much rust will not go out from her; her rust will be put to shame.
Because you were defiling yourself, and if you will not be cleansed any longer until I fill up my wrath,

I, Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will do it. I will not delay, nor will I show mercy. According to your ways and according to your thoughts I judge you, says Lord. Therefore I judge you according to your bloods and according to your thoughts, you unclean one, well-known and much provoking.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, behold, I take from you desire of your eyes in ordered stroke. You must not mourn, nor must you weep.

Groaning of blood of your loins is mourning; it will not be. Your hair will not be braided upon you and your sandals will be on your feet. You will not be comforted by their lips, and bread of men you will not eat.
And I spoke to people in morning as it was commanded me, and my wife died at evening, and I did in morning as it was ordered me.
And people said to me, Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?
And I said to them, Word of Lord came to me, saying,

Say to house of Israel, Thus says Lord: Behold, I profane my holy things, arrogance of your strength, desire of your eyes and what your souls spare, and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by sword.
And you will do as I did. You will not be comforted from their mouth, and bread of men you will not eat.
And your hair will be on your head and your sandals on your feet. You will neither mourn nor weep, and you will melt away in your injustices and each will comfort his brother.
And Ezekiel will be for you a sign; according to all that he did you will do when these things come, and you will know that I am Lord.
And you, son of man, is it not on day when I take from them their strength, raising up of their boasting, desire of their eyes and raising up of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
on that day one escaping will come to you to announce it in your ears?
On that day your mouth will be opened toward one escaping, and you will speak and no longer be mute, and you will be to them for sign, and they will know that I am Lord.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,

and say to sons of Ammon, Hear word of Lord. Thus says Lord: Because you rejoiced over my holy things that they were profaned, and over land of Israel that it was destroyed, and over house of Judah that they went into captivity,
therefore behold, I give you to sons of Kedem for inheritance, and they will camp in their equipment in you and set their tents in you. They will eat your fruits, and they will drink your richness.
And I will give city of Ammon for pasture of camels and sons of Ammon for pasture of sheep, and you will know that I am Lord.
Because thus says Lord: Because you clapped your hand and stamped your foot and rejoiced with all your soul over land of Israel,
therefore I stretch out my hand against you and give you for plundering among nations and destroy you from peoples and make you perish from lands, destruction, and you will know that I am Lord.
Thus says Lord: Because Moab said, Behold, house of Israel and Judah is like all nations,
therefore behold, I weaken shoulder of Moab from cities, from its borders, the chosen land, house of Asimouth above spring of city by the sea,
to sons of Kedem over sons of Ammon I gave them for inheritance, so that remembrance of sons of Ammon might not be.
And in Moab I will do vengeance, and they will know that I am Lord.
Thus says Lord: Because Idumea acted in avenging vengeance against house of Judah and bore grudges and avenged a claim,
therefore thus says Lord: I will stretch out my hand against Idumea and destroy from it man and cattle and make it a wilderness, and from Teman those pursued will fall by sword.
And I will place my vengeance upon Idumea by hand of my people Israel, and they will act in Idumea according to my anger and according to my wrath, and they will know my vengeance, says Lord.
Therefore thus says Lord: Because foreigners acted in vengeance and stirred up vengeance, rejoicing in soul so as to wipe out forever,
therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I stretch out my hand against foreigners and destroy Cretans and wipe out remnant dwelling on the coast.
And I will do in them great acts of vengeance, and they will know that I am Lord when I give my vengeance upon them.
And it happened in eleventh year, on first of month, word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, because Tyre said over Jerusalem, Good, she was crushed, nations are destroyed, she turned back to me, the full one has been laid waste,
therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you as sea brings up its waves.
And they will throw down walls of Tyre and pull down your towers, and I will winnow her dust away from her and give her for bare rock.
Drying place of nets she will be in midst of sea, because I have spoken, says Lord, and she will be spoil for nations.
And her daughters in field will be killed by sword, and they will know that I am Lord.
Because thus says Lord: Behold, I bring against you, Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from north, king of kings, with horses and chariots and horsemen and gathering of very many nations.
He will kill your daughters in field by sword and set guard against you and build siege-works and make trench around you and set his spears against you.
Your walls and your towers he will throw down with his swords.
From multitude of his horses their dust will cover you, and from sound of his horsemen and wheels of his chariots your walls will shake when he enters your gates as one entering city from plain.
With hoofs of his horses they will trample all your streets; your people he will kill by sword, and your pillar of strength he will bring down to ground.
And he will plunder your power and spoil your possessions and throw down your walls and pull down your desirable houses, and your stones and your timber and your dust he will throw into midst of sea.
And I will end multitude of your musicians, and sound of your psalteries will never again be heard.
And I will give you for bare rock; drying place of nets you will be; you will never again be built, because I have spoken, says Lord.
Because thus says Lord God to Tyre: Will not the islands shake at sound of your fall, when wounded groan, when sword is broken in your midst?

And all rulers from nations of sea will come down from their thrones and take off their turbans from their heads and strip off their embroidered clothing; in astonishment they will be astonished, upon ground they will sit, and they will fear your destruction and groan over you.
And they will take up lament over you and say to you, How were you destroyed from sea, city praised, giving your fear to all dwelling in you?
And islands will fear from day of your fall.
Because thus says Lord God: When I make you city laid waste, like cities not inhabited, when I bring up deep over you and much water covers you,

then I will bring you down with those going down into pit, to people of old age, and make you dwell in depths of earth like everlasting desolation with those going down into pit, so that you will not be inhabited nor arise upon land of life.
I will give you destruction, and you will no longer exist forever, says Lord God.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, take up lamentation over Tyre,
and say to Tyre dwelling at entrance of sea, merchant of peoples from many islands, Thus says Lord to Tyre: You said, I have set my beauty around myself.
In heart of sea, in Beelim, your sons set your beauty.
With cedar from Sanir they built for you planks of cypress; from Lebanon they took to make you fir masts.
From Bashan they made your oars; your decking they made from ivory, forest houses from islands of Kittim.
Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt became your bedding, to put glory around you and clothe you; blue and purple from islands of Elishah became your garments.
And your rulers, those dwelling in Sidon and Arad, became your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, who were in you, these were your pilots.
Elders of Byblos and their wise men were in you; these strengthened your counsel, and all ships of sea and their rowers were for you toward far west.
Persians and Lydians and Libyans were in your force, your men of war; shields and helmets they hung in you; these gave your glory.
Sons of Arad and your force were on your walls; watchers were in your towers; their quivers they hung on your battlements all around; they completed your beauty.
Carthaginians were your merchants because of abundance of all your strength; silver and gold and iron and tin and lead they gave for your market.
Greece and all the whole land and those stretching out beside it traded with you in souls of men, and vessels of bronze they gave for your trade.
From house of Thergama horses and horsemen they gave for your market.
Sons of Rhodians, your merchants from islands, multiplied your trade; ivory teeth, and for imports you paid back your wages.
Men traded your merchandise from abundance of your mixed goods; myrrh and embroidered cloth from Tarshish and Ramoth and Chorchor they gave for your market.
Judah and sons of Israel, these were your merchants. In wheat of Minnith and perfumes and cassia and first honey and oil and resin they gave into your mixed trade.
Damascus was your merchant from abundance of all your power, wine from Chelbon and wool from Miletus.
And they gave wine for your market from Uzal; worked iron and wheel are in your mixed trade.
Daedan were your merchants with choice beasts for chariots.
Arabia and all rulers of Kedar, these were your merchants by your hand, camels and rams and lambs in which they trade you.
Merchants of Sheba and Raamah, these were your merchants; with chief spices and precious stones and gold they gave for your market.
Haran and Canneh, these were your merchants, Asshur and Charman your merchants,
bringing merchandise, blue cloth and selected treasures tied with cords and cypress goods.
Ships among them, Carthaginians, were your merchants in abundance in your mixed trade, and you were filled and became very heavy in heart of sea.
In much water your rowers led you; south wind shattered you in heart of sea.

Your powers and your wages and your traders and your rowers and your pilots and your counselors and your dealers from among your dealers and all your men of war who are in you and all your gathering in your midst will fall in heart of sea on day of your fall.
At sound of your cry your pilots will fear with fear.
And all your rowers and passengers and helmsmen of sea will come down from ships and stand on land.
And they will howl over you with their voice and cry bitterly and put earth on their heads and spread ashes beneath themselves.
And their sons will take up lament over you and lamentation for you:
What kind of wages did you find from sea? You filled nations from your abundance, and from your mixed trade you enriched all kings of earth.
Now you were shattered in sea, in depth of water; your mixed trade and all your gathering in your midst fell. All your rowers.
All dwelling on islands were appalled over you, and their kings stood in astonishment, and their face wept.
Merchants from nations hissed at you; you became destruction and will no longer exist forever.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,

And you, son of man, say to ruler of Tyre, Thus says Lord: Because your heart was exalted and you said, I am god, I have dwelt in dwelling of God in heart of sea, but you are man and not god, and you set your heart as heart of god,
Are you wiser than Daniel? Wise men did not instruct you in their knowledge.
Was it not by your knowledge or by your understanding that you made power for yourself, and gold and silver in your treasuries?
In your much knowledge and your trade you multiplied your power; your heart was exalted in your power.
Therefore thus says Lord: Since you set your heart as heart of god,

therefore behold, I bring against you foreigners, scourges from nations, and they will draw their swords against you and against beauty of your knowledge, and they will spread your beauty for destruction.
And they will bring you down, and you will die death of wounded in heart of sea.
Surely you will not say, I am god, before those killing you. You are man and not god in their multitude.
You will die deaths of uncircumcised by hands of foreigners, because I have spoken, says Lord.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, take lamentation over ruler of Tyre and say to him, Thus says Lord God: You are seal of likeness and crown of beauty.

In delight of paradise of God you came to be. Every precious stone you clothed yourself with: sardius and topaz and emerald and carbuncle and sapphire and jasper and silver and gold and ligurion and agate and amethyst and chrysolite and beryl and onyx; with gold you filled your treasures and your storehouses in you from day you were created.
With cherub I placed you on holy mountain of God; you came to be in midst of fiery stones.
You were blameless in your days from day you were created until injustices were found in you.
From abundance of your trade you filled your storehouses with lawlessness and sinned, and you were wounded from mountain of God, and cherub led you out from midst of fiery stones.
Your heart was exalted over your beauty; your knowledge was corrupted with your beauty. Because of multitude of your sins I cast you upon ground; before kings I gave you to be made example.

Because of multitude of your sins and injustices of your trade you profaned your holy things, and I will bring out fire from your midst; this will devour you, and I will give you for ashes on your land before all seeing you.
And all knowing you among nations will shudder over you; you became destruction and will no longer exist forever.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,
and say, Thus says Lord: Behold, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in you, and you will know that I am Lord when I do judgments in you and be sanctified in you.
Blood and death in your streets, and wounded will fall by swords in you, around you, and they will know that I am Lord.
And there will no longer be to house of Israel thorn of bitterness and pricking briar of pain from all around them, from those dishonoring them, and they will know that I am Lord.

Thus says Lord God: And I will gather Israel from nations where they were scattered there, and I will be sanctified in them before peoples and nations, and they will dwell on their land that I gave to my servant Jacob.

And they will dwell on it in hope and build houses and plant vineyards and dwell in hope, when I do judgment on all dishonoring them around them, and they will know that I am Lord their God and God of their fathers.
In tenth year, in tenth month, on first of month, word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,
and say, Thus says Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, great dragon sitting in midst of his rivers, saying, Rivers are mine, and I made them.
And I will put hooks in your jaws and fasten fish of your river to your fins and bring you up from midst of your river, and all fish of your river,
and I will cast you down quickly, and all fish of your river, upon face of plain. You will fall and not be gathered nor collected; to beasts of earth and birds of heaven I have given you for food.
And all inhabiting Egypt will know that I am Lord, because you became reed-staff to house of Israel.
When they took hold of you with their hand, you were crushed, and when every hand seized hold on them and when they leaned on you, you were shattered and broke all their loins.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I bring sword upon you and will destroy from you men and cattle.
And land of Egypt will be destruction and wilderness, and they will know that I am Lord, because you said, Rivers are mine, and I made them.
Therefore behold, I am against you and against all your rivers, and I will make land of Egypt for wilderness and sword and destruction from Migdol and Syene and as far as borders of Ethiopia.
Foot of man will not pass through it, and foot of beast will not pass through it, and it will not be inhabited forty years.
And I will make its land destruction in midst of desolated land, and its cities in midst of desolated cities will be forty years, and I will scatter Egypt among nations and winnow them into lands.
Thus says Lord: After forty years I will gather Egyptians from nations where they were scattered there,
and I will turn back captivity of Egyptians and settle them in land of Pathros, in land from which they were taken, and it will be humble dominion.
Beyond all dominions it will never again be exalted over nations, and I will make them few, so as not to be many among nations.
And they will no longer be to house of Israel hope recalling lawlessness, when they followed after them, and they will know that I am Lord.
And it happened in twenty-seventh year, on first of first month, word of Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his force serve great service against Tyre. Every head bald and every shoulder peeled raw, and wages did not come to him and to his force from Tyre for service that they served against her.
Thus says Lord: Behold, I give to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon land of Egypt, and he will plunder its plunder and spoil its spoils, and it will be wages for his force.
In return for his service with which he served against Tyre, I gave him land of Egypt, thus says Lord.
On that day horn will spring up for whole house of Israel, and to you I will give opened mouth in their midst, and they will know that I am Lord.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says Lord: Woe, woe to the day,
because day of Lord is near, day of end of nations it will be.
And sword will come upon Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in Ethiopia, and wounded will fall in Egypt, and her foundations will collapse.
Persians and Cretans and Lydians and Libyans and all mixed peoples and sons of my covenant will fall by sword in it.
And supports of Egypt will fall, and arrogance of her strength will go down. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by sword in her, says Lord.
And it will be made desolate in midst of desolated lands, and her cities will be in midst of desolated cities.
And they will know that I am Lord when I give fire upon Egypt and all helping her are crushed.
On that day messengers will go out hurrying to destroy Ethiopia, and turmoil will be among them on day of Egypt, because behold, it comes.
Thus says Lord God: And I will destroy multitude of Egyptians by hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
He and his people, scourges from nations sent to destroy the land, will all draw their swords against Egypt, and land will be filled with wounded.
And I will make their rivers dry and destroy the land and its fullness by hands of foreigners. I, Lord, have spoken.
Because thus says Lord God: And I will destroy great men from Memphis and rulers from land of Egypt, and they will no longer be.
And I will destroy land of Pathros and give fire on Tanis and do vengeance in Diospolis.
And I will pour out my wrath upon Sais, strength of Egypt, and destroy multitude of Memphis.
And I will give fire on Egypt, and turmoil will be in Syene, and in Diospolis there will be breaking open and waters will be poured out.
Young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by sword, and women will go into captivity.
And in Taphnae day will grow dark when I break there scepters of Egypt, and arrogance of her strength will perish there, and cloud will cover her, and her daughters will be led away captive.
And I will do judgment in Egypt, and they will know that I am Lord.
And it happened in eleventh year, in first month, on seventh of month, word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, I broke arms of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and behold, it was not bound up for healing, not given bandage, not given strength to seize sword.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt and will break his arms, the strong ones and the stretched out ones, and cast his sword from his hand.
And I will scatter Egypt into nations and winnow them into lands.
And I will strengthen arms of king of Babylon and give my sword into his hand, and he will bring it against Egypt and plunder her plunder and spoil her spoils.

And I will strengthen arms of king of Babylon, but arms of Pharaoh will fall, and they will know that I am Lord when I give my sword into hands of king of Babylon and he stretches it out over land of Egypt.
And I will scatter Egypt into nations and winnow them into lands, and all will know that I am Lord.
And it happened in eleventh year, in third month, on first of month, word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude, To whom did you liken yourself in your height?
Behold, Assyria, a cypress in Lebanon, beautiful in boughs and great in size; his top came to be in midst of clouds.
Water nourished him; the deep exalted him. Its rivers led around his plants, and its channels it sent out to all trees of field.
Because of this his size was exalted beyond all trees of field, and his branches grew broad from much water.
In his boughs all birds of heaven nested, and under his branches all beasts of field gave birth; in his shade dwelt every multitude of nations.
And he became beautiful in his height through multitude of his branches, because his roots came to much water.
No cypresses like these were in paradise of God, and pines were not like his boughs, and firs were not like his branches; no tree in paradise of God was likened to him in his beauty.
Because of multitude of his branches, trees of paradise of delight of God envied him.
Therefore thus says Lord: Because you became great in size and gave your top into midst of clouds and he was seen when he was exalted,
I delivered him into hands of ruler of nations, and he made his destruction.

And foreigners, scourges from nations, destroyed him and cast him down upon mountains; in all ravines his branches fell, and his stems were broken in every plain of earth, and all peoples of nations came down from his shelter and flattened him.
Upon his fall all birds of heaven rested, and on his stems all beasts of field came to be,

so that all trees in water might not be exalted in their size, and not give their top into midst of clouds, and not stand in their height toward them, all drinking water; all were given to death, to depth of earth, in midst of sons of men, to those going down into pit.
Thus says Lord God: On day he went down to Hades, the deep mourned for him, and I restrained its rivers and held back much water, and Lebanon grew dark over him; all trees of field fainted over him.

At sound of his fall nations shook, when I brought him down to Hades with those going down into pit, and all trees of delight, the choice things of Lebanon, all drinking water, comforted him in earth.
For they also went down with him to Hades, among those wounded by sword, and his seed, those dwelling under his shelter in midst of their life, perished.

To whom were you likened? Go down and be brought down with trees of delight into depth of earth. In midst of uncircumcised you will lie with wounded of sword. Thus is Pharaoh and all multitude of his strength, says Lord.
And it happened in eleventh year, in twelfth month, on first of month, word of Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, take lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him, You were likened to lion of nations, and you as dragon in sea, and you gored with your rivers and troubled water with your feet and trampled your rivers.
Thus says Lord: And I will spread over you nets of many peoples and bring you up in my hook.
And I will spread you on land; plains will be filled with you, and I will make all birds of heaven sit upon you and fill from you all beasts of whole earth.
And I will put your flesh on mountains and fill them from your blood.
And land will be watered from your dung, from your multitude, upon mountains; ravines I will fill from you.
And when you are extinguished I will cover heaven and darken its stars; sun I will cover with cloud, and moon will not show its light.
All shining lights in heaven I will darken over you and give darkness on your land, says Lord God.
And I will provoke heart of many peoples when I bring your captivity among nations to land you did not know.
And many nations will shudder over you, and their kings will stand astonished when I swing my sword before their faces, waiting for their fall from day of your fall.
Because thus says Lord: Sword of king of Babylon will come to you.
With swords of giants I will bring down your strength, scourges from nations, all of them, and they will destroy arrogance of Egypt and all her strength will be crushed.
And I will destroy all her cattle from beside much water, and foot of man will no longer trouble it, and track of cattle will no longer trample it.
Thus then their waters will become calm, and their rivers will go like oil, says Lord.
When I make Egypt destruction and land is desolated with its fullness, when I scatter all dwelling in it, then they will know that I am Lord.
It is lamentation, and they will lament it; daughters of nations will lament it over Egypt and over all her strength they will lament her, says Lord.
And it happened in twelfth year of first month, on fifteenth of month, word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, lament over strength of Egypt, and daughters of nations will bring her down, the dead, into depth of earth, to those going down into pit.
In midst of wounded of sword they will fall with him, and all his strength will lie down.
And giants in depth of pit will say to you, Of whom are you better? Go down and lie with uncircumcised in midst of wounded of sword.
There is Assyria and all his gathering; all wounded. There they were given, and their burial is in depth of pit, and his gathering was around his tomb, all wounded, those fallen by sword,
those who gave their fear upon land of life.

There is Elam and all his force around his tomb, all wounded, those fallen by sword and going down uncircumcised into depth of earth, those who gave their fear on land of life, and they bore their torment with those going down into pit.
In midst of wounded.
There were given Mosoch and Thobel and all their strength around his tomb, all his wounded, all uncircumcised, wounded by sword, those who gave their fear upon land of life.

And they lay with giants fallen from old age, who went down into Hades with weapons of war, and they placed their swords under their heads, and their lawless deeds came upon their bones, because they terrified giants in land of life.
And you will lie down in midst of uncircumcised with those wounded by sword.
There were given rulers of Assyria, those giving his strength to wound of sword; these slept with wounded, with those going down into pit.

There all rulers of north, all generals of Assyria, those going down wounded, with their fear and their strength they slept uncircumcised with wounded of sword, and they bore their torment with those going down into pit.
Those king Pharaoh will see and be comforted over all their strength, says Lord.
Because I gave his fear upon land of life, and Pharaoh and all his multitude will lie down in midst of uncircumcised with wounded of sword, says Lord.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, speak to sons of your people and say to them: Land upon which I bring sword, and people of land take one man from themselves and give him to themselves for watchman,
and he sees sword coming upon land and blows trumpet and signals to people,
and hearer hears sound of trumpet and does not guard himself, and sword comes and overtakes him, his blood will be on his own head.
Because hearing sound of trumpet he did not guard himself, his blood will be on him. But one who guarded himself rescued his own life.

And if watchman sees sword coming and does not signal with trumpet, and people do not guard themselves, and sword coming takes life from them, that one was taken in his own lawlessness, but his blood I will seek from hand of watchman.
And you, son of man, I have given you as watchman to house of Israel, and you will hear word from my mouth.
When I say to sinner, By death you will die, and you do not speak to guard lawless one from his way, that lawless one will die in his lawlessness, but his blood I will seek from your hand.
But if you warn lawless one about his way, to turn from it, and he does not turn from his way, he will die in his impiety, but you have rescued your own life.
And you, son of man, say to house of Israel, Thus you have spoken, saying, Our wanderings and our lawless deeds are upon us, and in them we melt away, and how shall we live?

Say to them, As I live, thus says Lord, I do not desire death of impious one as much as turning of impious one from his way and his living. Turn back, turn back from your way, and why are you dying, house of Israel?

Say to sons of your people, Righteousness of righteous one will not rescue him on day he wanders, and lawlessness of impious one will not hurt him on day he turns from his lawlessness, and righteous one will not be able to be saved.
When I say to righteous one, He surely lives, and he trusts in his righteousness and does lawlessness, all his righteous deeds will not be remembered; in injustice that he did, in it he will die.
And when I say to impious one, By death you will die, and he turns from his sin and does judgment and righteousness,
and returns a pledge and repays plunder and walks in ordinances of life, so as not to do injustice, living he will live and will not die.
All his sins that he sinned will not be remembered, because he did judgment and righteousness; in them he will live.
And sons of your people will say, Way of Lord is not straight, but this their way is not straight.
When righteous one turns from his righteousness and does lawlessness, he will die in them.
And when sinner turns from his lawlessness and does judgment and righteousness, in them he himself will live.
And this is what you said: Way of Lord is not straight. Each one in his ways I will judge you, house of Israel.
And it happened in twelfth year, in twelfth month, on fifth of month of our captivity, one escaping came to me from Jerusalem, saying, City has been taken.
And hand of Lord came upon me at evening before he came, and opened my mouth until he came to me in morning, and my mouth being opened was no longer restrained.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, those dwelling in desolated places on land of Israel say, Abraham was one and possessed land, and we are many; to us land was given for possession.
Therefore say to them, Thus says Lord God.
As I live, surely those in desolated places will fall by sword, and those on face of plain will be given to beasts of field for food, and those in fortified places and caves I will kill with death.
And I will make land desolation, and arrogance of its strength will perish, and mountains of Israel will be desolated because there is no passerby.
And they will know that I am Lord, when I make their land desolation and it will be desolated because of all their abominations that they did.
And you, son of man, sons of your people speaking about you by walls and in doorways of houses, and they speak, man to his brother, saying, Come, let us hear what goes out from Lord.
They come to you as people go together and sit before you and hear your words, but will not do them, because falsehood is in their mouth and behind their defilements is their heart.
And you become to them like voice of sweet-sounding psaltery, well harmonized, and they will hear your words and not do them.
And when it comes, they will say, Behold, it has come, and they will know that a prophet was in their midst.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy against shepherds of Israel, prophesy and say to shepherds, Thus says Lord: Woe, shepherds of Israel. Do shepherds not feed themselves? Do shepherds not feed sheep?
Behold, you eat the milk and clothe yourselves with wool and slaughter the fat one, but my sheep you do not feed.
Weak one you did not strengthen, sick one you did not heal, broken one you did not bind up, straying one you did not turn back, lost one you did not seek, and strong one you worked hard with toil.
And my sheep were scattered because there were no shepherds and became food for all beasts of field.
And my sheep were scattered on every mountain and on every high hill and over face of all earth, and there was no one seeking nor turning them back.
Therefore, shepherds, hear word of Lord.

As I live, says Lord, surely because my sheep became plunder and my sheep became food for all beasts of field because there were no shepherds, and shepherds did not seek my sheep, and shepherds fed themselves but did not feed my sheep,
because of this, shepherds,

thus says Lord: Behold, I am against shepherds and will require my sheep from their hands and turn them back from not shepherding my sheep, and shepherds will no longer feed them, and I will rescue my sheep from their mouth and they will no longer be food for them.
Because thus says Lord: Behold, I will seek out my sheep and visit them.

As shepherd seeks his flock on day when cloud and gloom are in midst of scattered sheep, so I will seek my sheep and drive them out from every place where they were scattered on day of cloud and gloom.
And I will bring them out from nations and gather them from lands and bring them into their land and feed them on mountains of Israel and in ravines and in every habitation of land.
In good pasture I will feed them, and on high mountain of Israel will be their folds; there they will lie down and rest in good delight, and in rich pasture they will be fed on mountains of Israel.
I myself will feed my sheep, and I myself will give them rest, and they will know that I am Lord, thus says Lord God.
Lost one I will seek, straying one I will turn back, broken one I will bind up, faint one I will strengthen, and strong one I will guard, and I will feed them with judgment.
And you, sheep, thus says Lord God: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, rams and he-goats.
And is it not enough for you that you grazed good pasture and trample the rest of your pasture with your feet, and drink settled water and trouble the rest with your feet?
And my sheep fed on tramplings of your feet and drank water troubled under your feet.
Therefore thus says Lord God: Behold, I judge between strong sheep and weak sheep.
With your sides and your shoulders you pushed, and with your horns you gored, and every faint one you pressed out.
And I will save my sheep, and they will no longer be plunder, and I will judge between ram and ram.
And I will raise up over them one shepherd, and he will shepherd them, my servant David, and he will be their shepherd.
And I, Lord, will be to them for God, and David in their midst ruler. I, Lord, have spoken.
And I will make with David covenant of peace and destroy evil beasts from land, and they will dwell in wilderness and sleep in forests.
And I will give them around my mountain and give you rain, rain of blessing.

And trees in field will give their fruit and land will give its strength, and they will dwell on their land in hope of peace and know that I am Lord when I break their yoke and rescue them from hand of those enslaving them.
And they will no longer be plunder to nations, and beasts of earth will never again eat them, and they will dwell in hope and there will be no one frightening them.
And I will raise up for them plant of peace, and they will no longer be destroyed by famine on earth and will no longer bear reproach of nations.
And they will know that I am Lord their God, and they are my people, house of Israel, says Lord.
You are my sheep, sheep of my flock, and I am Lord your God, says Lord God.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, turn your face upon Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
and say, Thus says Lord: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and give you for wilderness, and you will be desolated.
And I will make your cities desolation, and you will be a waste and know that I am Lord.
Because you became perpetual enemy and laid plots against house of Israel into hand of enemies, sword in time of injustice at the last,
therefore as I live, says Lord, surely you sinned unto blood, and blood will pursue you.
And I will make Mount Seir wilderness and desolation and destroy from it men and cattle.
And I will fill your hills with your wounded, and your ravines and all your plains. Wounded by sword will fall in you.
Everlasting desolation I will make you, and your cities will never again be inhabited, and you will know that I am Lord.
Because you said, These two nations and these two lands will be mine and I will inherit them, and Lord is there,
therefore as I live, says Lord, I will do to you according to your enmity and be made known to you when I judge you.
And you will know that I am Lord; I heard voice of your blasphemies, because you said, Mountains of Israel are desolate, given to us for food.
And you made great speeches against me with your mouth; I heard.
Thus says Lord: In joy of whole earth I will make you desolation.
You will be desolation, Mount Seir, and all Idumea will be utterly consumed, and you will know that I am Lord their God.
And you, son of man, prophesy over mountains of Israel and say to mountains of Israel, Hear word of Lord.
Thus says Lord God: Because enemy said against you, Good, everlasting desolations became ours for possession,

therefore prophesy and say, Thus says Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so as to be possession to remnant of nations, and you went up for talk of tongue and for reproach among nations,

therefore mountains of Israel hear word of Lord. Thus says Lord to mountains and hills and ravines and torrents and desolated and ruined places and abandoned cities, which became plunder and trampling to remaining nations around,

therefore thus says Lord: Surely in fire of my wrath I spoke against remaining nations and against all Idumea, because they gave my land to themselves for possession with joy, dishonoring souls, so as to destroy it for plunder.
Therefore prophesy over land of Israel and say to mountains and hills and ravines and valleys, Thus says Lord: Behold, in my zeal and in my wrath I spoke because you bore reproach of nations.
Therefore I lift up my hand over nations around you; they themselves will bear their dishonor.
But you, mountains of Israel, your grape and your fruit my people will eat, because they are drawing near to come.
Because behold, I am for you and will look upon you, and you will be worked and sown.
And I will multiply upon you men, all house of Israel to the end, and cities will be inhabited and the desolated thing will be built.
And I will multiply upon you men and cattle and settle you as at your beginning and do good to you like your former times, and you will know that I am Lord.
And I will cause men to be born upon you, my people Israel, and they will inherit you, and you will be to them for possession and will no longer again make them childless.
Thus says Lord God: Because they said to you, You are devouring men and became childless by your nation,
therefore you will no longer eat men, and your nation you will no longer make childless, says Lord God.
And reproach of nations will no longer be heard against you, and reproaches of peoples you will no longer bear, says Lord God.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, house of Israel dwelt on their land and defiled it in their way and in their idols and in their uncleannesses; like uncleanness of woman set apart, so their way became before me.
And I poured out my wrath upon them.
And I scattered them among nations and winnowed them into lands; according to their way and according to their sin I judged them.
And they entered into nations where they entered there and profaned my holy name, when it was said of them, These are people of Lord, and they came out of his land.
And I spared them because of my holy name, which house of Israel profaned among nations where they entered there.
Therefore say to house of Israel, Thus says Lord: Not for your sake do I act, house of Israel, but for sake of my holy name, which you profaned among nations where you entered there.
And I will sanctify my great name, profaned among nations, which you profaned in their midst, and nations will know that I am Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
And I will take you from nations and gather you from all lands and bring you into your land.
And I will sprinkle clean water upon you and you will be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and from all your idols, and I will cleanse you.
And I will give you new heart and new spirit I will give in you, and I will remove heart of stone from your flesh and give you heart of flesh.
And my Spirit I will give in you and make you walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them.
And you will dwell on land that I gave to your fathers, and you will be to me for people and I will be to you for God.
And I will save you from all your uncleannesses and call for the grain and multiply it and not give famine upon you.
And I will multiply fruit of tree and produce of field so that you no longer receive reproach of famine among nations.
And you will remember your evil ways and your practices not good and loathe yourselves before your faces for your lawless deeds and your abominations.
Not for your sake do I act, says Lord God; it will be made known to you. Be ashamed and be confounded from your ways, house of Israel.
Thus says Lord: On day I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds and settle the cities and the desolate places will be built,
and land that was desolated will be worked, because it had become desolated before eyes of every passerby.
And they will say, That land which was desolated became like garden of delight, and cities desolate and ruined and torn down now sat fortified.
And nations that are left around you will know that I, Lord, built torn-down things and planted desolated things. I, Lord, have spoken and will do it.
Thus says Lord: Still this I will be sought by house of Israel to do for them: I will multiply them like sheep, men.
As holy sheep, as sheep of Jerusalem in her feasts, so desolate cities will be filled with flocks of men, and they will know that I am Lord.
And hand of Lord came upon me, and Lord brought me out in Spirit and set me in midst of plain, and it was full of human bones.
And he led me around them, round about, and behold, very many on face of plain, very dry.
And he said to me, Son of man, will these bones live? And I said, Lord, you know these things.
And he said to me, Prophesy over these bones, and you will say to them, Dry bones, hear word of Lord.
Thus says Lord to these bones: Behold, I bring into you spirit of life.
And I will put sinews on you and bring up flesh upon you and stretch skin over you and give my Spirit into you, and you will live, and you will know that I am Lord.
And I prophesied as he commanded me, and it happened, in my prophesying, and behold, shaking, and each bone came to its fitting.
And I saw, and behold, upon them sinews and flesh were growing and skin was rising over them above, but spirit was not in them.
And he said to me, Prophesy, son of man, prophesy to the spirit, and say to the spirit, Thus says Lord: From the four winds come and breathe into these dead ones, and let them live.
And I prophesied as he commanded me, and spirit entered into them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, a very great gathering.
And Lord spoke to me, saying, Son of man, these bones are whole house of Israel, and they say, Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished, we are cut off.
Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says Lord: Behold, I open your tombs and bring you up from your tombs and bring you into land of Israel.
And you will know that I am Lord when I open your graves, when I bring my people up from the graves.
And I will give my Spirit into you and you will live, and I will place you on your land, and you will know that I, Lord, have spoken and will do it, says Lord.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, take for yourself a rod and write on it, Judah and sons of Israel attached to him, and take for yourself second rod and write on it, Joseph, rod of Ephraim, and all sons of Israel added to him.
And join them one to another for yourself into one rod, to bind them, and they will be in your hand.
And it will be when sons of your people say to you, Will you not tell us what these things are to you?

Then you will say to them, Thus says Lord: Behold, I take tribe of Joseph from hand of Ephraim and tribes of Israel attached to him, and I will place them upon tribe of Judah, and they will be one rod in hand of Judah.
And the rods on which you wrote will be in your hand before them.

And you will say to them, Thus says Lord God: Behold, I take whole house of Israel from midst of nations where they entered there, and I will gather them from all around and bring them into land of Israel.
And I will make them one nation in my land and on mountains of Israel, and one ruler will be over them, and they will no longer be two nations, nor be divided any longer into two kingdoms.

So that they no longer may defile themselves with their idols, and I will rescue them from all their lawless deeds in which they sinned, and I will cleanse them, and they will be to me for people, and I, Lord, will be to them for God.
And my servant David will be ruler in their midst, and one shepherd will be for all, because they will walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them.
And they will dwell on their land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where their fathers dwelt there, and they will dwell on it, they and David my servant their ruler, forever.
And I will make with them covenant of peace; everlasting covenant will be with them, and I will put my holy things in their midst forever.
And my dwelling will be among them, and I will be to them for God, and they will be to me for people.
And nations will know that I am Lord sanctifying them, when my holy things are in their midst forever.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Gog and land of Magog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch, and Thobel, and prophesy over him.
And say to him, Thus says Lord God: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch, and Thobel.
And I will gather you and all your force, horses and horsemen clothed in armor, all a great assembly, shields and helmets and swords,
Persians and Ethiopians and Libyans, all with helmets and shields,
Gomer and all around him, house of Thergama from farthest north and all around him, and many nations with you.
Be prepared; prepare yourself, you and all your assembly gathered with you, and you will be to me for guard.

After many days he will be prepared, and in latter years he will come and enter into land turned back from sword, gathered from many nations onto land of Israel, which became desolation through all time, and this people came out from nations and they all will dwell in peace.
And you will come up like rain and arrive like cloud to cover land, you and all around you, and many nations with you.
Thus says Lord God: And it will be on that day, words will come up into your heart, and you will reason evil plans,
and say, I will go up against land thrown open; I will come against those quiet in stillness and dwelling in peace, all dwelling on land where there is no wall, and bars and gates are not for them,
to plunder plunder and spoil spoils, to turn your hand against the desolated place that was resettled, and against nation gathered from many nations, making possessions, dwelling on navel of earth.

Sheba and Daedan and merchants of Carthage and all their villages will say to you, Is it for plunder that you come, and to spoil spoils? Did you gather your assembly to take silver and gold, to carry off possessions, to spoil spoils?
Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, Thus says Lord: Is it not on that day, when my people Israel are settled in peace, that you will rise up?
And you will come from your place, from farthest north, and many nations with you, all riding horses, great assembly and much force.

And you will come up against my people Israel like cloud covering land; in latter days it will be, and I will bring you upon my land so that all nations may know me when I am sanctified in you before them.
Thus says Lord God to Gog: Are you the one concerning whom I spoke in former days through hand of my servants, prophets of Israel, in those days and years, to bring you upon them?
And it will be on that day, on day when Gog comes upon land of Israel, says Lord God, my wrath will rise up.
And in my zeal, in fire of my anger, I spoke: Surely on that day there will be great earthquake upon land of Israel.

And from face of Lord fish of sea and birds of heaven and beasts of field and all creeping things creeping on earth and all men on face of earth will be shaken, and mountains will be split and ravines will fall and every wall will fall to ground.
And I will call against him every fear, says Lord; sword of each man will be against his brother.
And I will judge him with death and blood, and with flooding rain and hailstones and fire and sulfur I will rain on him and on all with him and on many nations with him.
And I will be magnified and sanctified and glorified and made known before many nations, and they will know that I am Lord.
And you, son of man, prophesy over Gog and say, Thus says Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch, and Thobel.
And I will gather you and lead you and bring you up from farthest north and bring you upon mountains of Israel.
And I will destroy your bow from your left hand and your arrows from your right hand and cast you down.
Upon mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all around you and nations with you. I have given you to flocks of birds, to every bird, and to all beasts of field to be devoured.
Upon face of plain you will fall, because I have spoken, says Lord.
And I will send fire upon Gog, and islands will be inhabited in peace, and they will know that I am Lord.
And my holy name will be made known in midst of my people Israel, and my holy name will no longer be profaned, and nations will know that I am Lord, holy in Israel.
Behold, it comes, and you will know that it will be, says Lord God. This is the day about which I spoke.
And inhabitants of cities of Israel will go out and burn weapons, shields and spears and bows and arrows and hand-staves and lances, and they will burn fire with them seven years.
And they will not take wood from field nor cut from forests, but rather they will burn the weapons with fire and plunder those who plundered them and spoil those who spoiled them, says Lord.

And it will be on that day I will give to Gog well-known place, a tomb in Israel, the burial place of those coming toward the sea, and they will wall up the mouth of the ravine and bury Gog there and all his multitude, and it will be called Valley, burial place of Gog.
And house of Israel will bury them so that land may be cleansed in seven months.
And all people of land will bury them, and it will be to them for renown on day I was glorified, says Lord.
And men will appoint for continual duty, going through the land to bury those left on face of land, to cleanse it; after seven months they will search.
And everyone passing through the land and seeing a human bone will build beside it a marker until buriers bury it in Valley, burial place of Gog.
And indeed name of the city is Burial Place, and land will be cleansed.

And you, son of man, say, Thus says Lord: Say to every bird and to all beasts of field, Gather and come; gather from all around to my sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you, great sacrifice on mountains of Israel, and eat flesh and drink blood.
Flesh of giants you will eat and blood of rulers of earth you will drink, rams and calves and goats, all fattened calves.
And you will eat fat to fullness and drink blood to drunkenness from my sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you.
And you will be filled at my table with horse and rider, giant and every man of war, says Lord.
And I will give my glory among you, and all nations will see my judgment that I did and my hand that I brought upon them.
And house of Israel will know that I am Lord their God from this day and onward.

And all nations will know that because of their sins house of Israel was taken captive, because they rejected me and I turned my face away from them and handed them over into hands of their enemies, and they all fell by sword.
According to their uncleannesses and according to their lawless deeds I dealt with them, and I turned my face away from them.
Therefore thus says Lord God: Now I will turn back captivity of Jacob and have mercy on house of Israel and be jealous for my holy name.
And they will bear their own dishonor and the injustice by which they acted unjustly when they dwell on their land in peace and there is no one frightening them.
When I turn them back from nations and gather them from lands of nations and am sanctified in them before nations,
then they will know that I am Lord their God, in my appearing to them among nations.
And I will no longer turn my face away from them, because I poured out my wrath upon house of Israel, says Lord God.
And it happened in twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in first month, on tenth of month, in fourteenth year after city was taken, on that day hand of Lord came upon me and led me.
In vision of God into land of Israel, and he set me on very high mountain, and on it as building of city opposite.
And he brought me there, and behold, a man, and his appearance was like appearance of gleaming bronze, and in his hand was builder’s cord and measuring reed, and he stood at gate.

And the man said to me, Have you seen, son of man? See with your eyes and hear with your ears and set in your heart all that I show you, because for this you entered here, to be shown. And you will show house of Israel all that you see.
And behold, wall outside house around it, and in man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits, each a cubit and a handbreadth, and he measured outer wall, breadth one reed, and its height one reed.
And he entered into gate facing east, by seven steps, and measured porch of gate, one reed.
And the chamber, one reed in length and one reed in width, and porch between the chambers, six cubits, and second chamber one reed in width and one reed in length, and porch five cubits.
And third chamber, one reed in width and one reed in length.
And porch of gateway next to porch of gate, eight cubits, and jambs two cubits, and porch of gate inward.
And chambers of gate, chambers opposite, three on one side and three on the other, and one measure in the three, and one measure in the porches, here and there.
And he measured width of doorway of gateway, ten cubits, and breadth of gateway, thirteen cubits.
And one cubit projection before the chambers, here and there, and the chamber six cubits on this side and six cubits on that side.
And he measured the gate from wall of one chamber to wall of the other chamber, breadth twenty-five cubits, doorway opposite doorway.
And court of porch of gate, sixty cubits, twenty chambers of gate around.
And from court of outer gate to court of inner porch of gate, fifty cubits.
And hidden windows on the chambers and on the porches inside gate of court all around, and likewise for the porches, windows all around inside, and on the porch palms here and there.
And he brought me into inner court, and behold, side rooms and colonnades around the court, thirty side rooms on the colonnades.
And the porticoes along back of the gates, according to length of the gates, the lower colonnade.
And he measured width of court from court of outer gate inward to court of gate facing out, one hundred cubits, facing east, and he brought me northward.
And behold, gate facing north to outer court, and he measured it, its length and its breadth.
And its chambers, three here and three there, and its porches and its palms, and it came to be according to measures of gate facing east, fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its breadth.
And its windows and its porches and its palms were like gate facing east, and by seven steps they went up to it, and its porches inward.
And gate of inner court faced gate of north, like gate facing east, and he measured court from gate to gate, one hundred cubits.
And he led me toward south, and behold, gate facing south, and he measured it and its chambers and its porches by these measures.
And its windows and its porches around, like windows of the porch, fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its breadth.
And seven steps to it, and its porches inward, and palms to it, one here and one there on the jambs.
And gate opposite gate of inner court southward, and he measured court from gate to gate, one hundred cubits breadth to south.
And he brought me into inner court by the south gate and measured the gate according to these measures.
And its chambers and its porches according to these measures, and windows to it and to its porches around, fifty cubits its length and breadth twenty-five cubits.
And its porches to the outer court, and palms on the jambs, and eight steps.
And he brought me to the gate facing east and measured it according to these measures.
And its chambers and its jambs and its porches according to these measures, and windows to it and to its porches around, fifty cubits its length and breadth twenty-five cubits.
And its porches to the inner court, and palms on the jambs here and there, and eight steps to it.
And he brought me to the north gate and measured according to these measures,
and its chambers and its jambs and its porches and windows around to it and to its porches, fifty cubits its length and breadth twenty-five cubits.
And its porches to the outer court, and palms on the jambs here and there, and eight steps to it.
Its side rooms and its doorways and its porches were by the gate.
Second pouring out, so that they may slaughter in it the offerings for sin and for ignorance.
And along back of the runnel of burnt offerings facing north, two tables to east, and along back of the second and of porch of gate, two tables to east.
Four on this side and four on that side, along side of gate; on them they will slaughter the sacrifices, opposite the eight tables of the sacrifices.

And four tables for burnt offerings, of cut stone, one and a half cubits broad and two and a half cubits long and one cubit high; upon them they will place the implements with which they slaughter there the burnt offerings and the sacrifices.
And a handbreadth border was carved inward around, and over the tables awnings for shelter from rain and from heat.
And he brought me into the inner court, and behold, two chambers in the inner court, one along back of gate facing north, looking south, and one along back of gate southward, looking north.
And he said to me, This chamber looking south is for priests keeping charge of the house.
And the chamber looking north is for priests keeping charge of the altar; these are sons of Zadok drawing near from Levi to Lord to minister to him.
And he measured the court, length one hundred cubits and breadth one hundred cubits on its four sides, and the altar opposite the house.

And he brought me to the porch of the house and measured jamb of porch, five cubits breadth here and five cubits there, and breadth of doorway fourteen cubits and shoulders of doorway three cubits here and three cubits there.
And length of porch twenty cubits and breadth twelve cubits, and by ten steps they went up to it, and pillars were on the porch, one here and one there.
And he brought me into the temple, where he measured the porch, six cubits breadth here and six cubits breadth of porch there.
