And he said to me, You are a man pitied. Do not fear. Be well. Be manly and strong. And when he spoke with me, I grew strong and said, Let my lord speak, because you strengthened me.
And he said to me, Do you know why I came to you? And now I will return to fight with commander of king of Persians, and as I was going out, behold, commander of Greeks was coming in.
But I will plainly show you first things in writing of truth, and no one was helping with me concerning these things except Michael the angel.
And in first year of Cyrus the king he told me to be strengthened and be manly.

And now I came to show you the truth. Behold, three kings have arisen in Persia, and the fourth will gain great wealth beyond all, and when he becomes strong in his wealth he will stir up all against kingdom of Greeks.
And a mighty king will arise and rule with great dominion and do as he wishes.

And when he arises, his kingdom will be shattered and divided to four winds of heaven, not according to his strength, nor according to his dominion that he ruled, because his kingdom will be removed and teach these things to others.
And kingdom of Egypt will grow strong, and one of the rulers will overpower him and exercise a great dominion, his dominion.

And at end of years king of Egypt will bring them in and enter into kingdom of north to make treaties, and he will not prevail, because his arm will not keep strength, and his arm will grow numb, and those going with him; and he remains for an hour.
And a shoot from his root will arise on his own, and king of north will come against his power with his own strength and make tumult and prevail.

And he will destroy their gods along with their molten images and their crowds, together with vessels of their desire, silver and gold; they will carry them away into captivity to Egypt, and there will be a year for king of north.
And he will enter into kingdom of Egypt for days and return to his own land.
And his son will be stirred up and gather assembly of great crowd and come sweeping through it, and he will return and be greatly provoked.
And king of Egypt will be angered and fight with king of north, and the assembly will be delivered into his hands.
And he will take the assembly, and his heart will be lifted up, and he will trouble many, and he will not fear.
And king of north will return and gather assembly of cities greater than first, and at completion of time of a year he will come against it with great crowd and much wealth.
And in those times thoughts will rise against king of Egypt, and he will rebuild fallen things of your nation and rise to establish the prophecy, and they will stumble.
And king of north will come and turn his spears and take the fortified city, and arms of king of Egypt will stand with his rulers, and he will have no strength to withstand him.
And one coming against him will do according to his will, and there will be none standing against him, and he will stand in the land, and all things will be completed in his hands.
And he will set his face to come in force with all his work, and he will make treaties with him and give him daughter of man to destroy her, and she will not obey and will not be.
And he will set his face toward the sea and take many, and he will turn back their reproachful wrath in an oath according to his reproach.
He will turn his face to overpower his own land, and he will stumble and fall and not be found.
And from his root a shoot of kingdom will arise, a man striking glory of king, and in last days he will be shattered, but not in anger nor in war.
And on his place a contemptible one will arise, and glory of kingdom will not be given to him, and he will come suddenly and seize kingship in his inheritance.
And he will shatter the arms that were shattered before him.
And after covenant and people are joined with him, he will act falsely, and against a strong nation with a small nation.

Suddenly he will desolate a city and do what neither his fathers nor fathers of his fathers did. He will give them spoil and plunder and wealth, and against the strong city he will devise, and his schemes are for nothing.

And his strength and his heart will be stirred against king of Egypt with great crowd, and king of Egypt will be stirred to war with very strong crowd, and he will not stand, because a scheme will be devised against him.
And his anxieties will consume him and turn him away, and he will pass through and sweep away, and many wounded will fall.
And two kings alone will dine together and eat at one table and lie, and they will not prosper, for completion is still for a time.
And he will return to his land with much wealth, and his heart will be against holy covenant, and he will act and return to his land.
At the appointed time he will enter into Egypt, and it will not be as the first and the last.

And Romans will come and drive him away and thunder against him, and he will return and be angered against holy covenant and act. He will return and think against those because they abandoned holy covenant.
And arms from him will arise and defile sanctuary of fear and remove the sacrifice and set abomination of desolation.
And with sins of covenant they will defile among hard people, and people knowing these things will prevail and act.
And those understanding of the nation will instruct many, and they will stumble by sword and grow worn by it, and in captivity and in plunder of days they will be stained.
And when they are being shattered they will gather a little strength, and many will be gathered to them by a city, and many as by inheritance.
And from those understanding they will ponder to purify themselves and to be chosen and to be cleansed until time of completion, for time is still for an hour.

And king will do according to his will, and he will be provoked and exalt himself over every god, and against God of gods he will speak strange things and prosper until wrath is completed, because completion is being made for him.
And for gods of his fathers he will show no concern, and for desire of a woman he will show no concern, because he will be exalted in everything, and strong nations will be subjected to him.
In his place he will set in motion and honor a god whom his fathers did not know with gold and silver and precious stone and choice things.
He will make cities and come into a strong fortress with a foreign god, whom if he recognizes he will increase in glory and rule over much and divide land for a gift.
And at time of completion king of Egypt will be butting against him, and king of north will be enraged against him with chariots and many horses and many ships and enter into land of Egypt.
And he will come against my land.
And in land of Egypt there will be no one escaping in it.
And he will seize place of gold and place of silver and every desirable thing of Egypt, and Libyans and Ethiopians will be in his crowd.
And report from east and north will trouble him, and he will go out in strong wrath and sword to destroy and kill many.
And then he will set his tent between the seas and mountain of desire of the holy place, and hour of his completion will come, and there will be no one helping him.

And at that time Michael will come, the great angel standing over sons of your people. That day will be a distress such as has not happened from time they came to be until that day, and in that day every people found written in the book will be exalted.
And many of those sleeping in breadth of the earth will rise, some to eternal life, some to reproach, some to scattering and eternal shame.
And those understanding will shine like lights of heaven, and those prevailing in my words like stars of heaven forever and ever.
And you, Daniel, conceal the commands and seal the book until time of completion, until many go mad and earth is filled with injustice.
And I, Daniel, saw, and behold, two others were standing, one on this side of river and one on that side.
And I said to the one clothed in fine linen above, When then is completion of these wonders you told me, and their cleansing?

And I heard the one clothed in fine linen, who was above water of the river, until time of completion, and he lifted right hand and left to heaven and swore by living God forever that for time and times and half a time is completion of release-hands of holy people, and all these things will be completed.
And I heard and did not understand from him the time, and I said, Lord, what is solution of this word, and whose are these parables?
And he said to me, Go away, Daniel, because the commands are hidden and sealed until...
Many will be tested and sanctified, and sinners will sin, and all sinners will not understand, but those understanding will pay attention.
From time sacrifice is removed continually and abomination of desolation is prepared to be given, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
Blessed is one remaining and gathering to one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
And you, go, rest, for there are still days and hours for completion of the end, and you will rest and rise to your glory at completion of days.
Word of Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri in days of Uzziah and Jotham and Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.
Beginning of word of Lord to Hosea. And Lord said to Hosea, Go, take for yourself wife of whoredom and children of whoredom, because land, prostituting itself, will prostitute itself away from Lord.
And he went and took Gomer daughter of Debelaiim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
And Lord said to him, Call his name Jezreel, because a little while longer and I will avenge blood of Jezreel upon house of Jehu and make kingdom of house of Israel cease.
And it will be in that day: I will shatter bow of Israel in valley of Jezreel.
And she conceived again and bore a daughter. And he said to him, Call her name Not-Shown-Mercy, because I will no longer continue to show mercy to house of Israel, but in opposing I will oppose them.
But sons of Judah I will show mercy to and save them in Lord their God, and I will not save them by bow nor by sword nor by war nor by chariots nor by horses nor by horsemen.
And she weaned Not-Shown-Mercy and conceived again and bore a son.
And he said, Call his name Not-My-People, because you are not my people and I am not yours.

And number of sons of Israel was like sand of sea, which will not be measured or numbered. And it will be in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people, there they will be called sons of living God.
And sons of Judah and sons of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one head, and they will come up from the land, because great is day of Jezreel.
Say to your brother, My-People, and to your sister, Shown-Mercy.
Contend with your mother, contend, because she is not my wife and I am not her husband; and I will remove her whoredom from my face and her adultery from between her breasts,
lest I strip her naked and restore her as on day of her birth and make her like wilderness and appoint her like waterless land and kill her with thirst.
And on her children I will show no mercy, because they are children of whoredom.

Because their mother prostituted herself; she that bore them was put to shame, for she said, I will go after my lovers, the ones giving me my breads and my water and my garments and my linens and my oil and all things fitting for me.
Therefore behold, I am fencing her way with thorns and I will rebuild her ways, and she will not find her path.

And she will pursue her lovers and will not catch them, and she will seek them and will not find them, and she will say, I will go and return to my former husband, because it was well for me then more than now.
And she did not know that I gave her grain and wine and oil, and I multiplied silver for her; but she made silver and gold for Baal.
Therefore I will return and recover my grain in its season and my wine in its time, and I will take away my garments and my linens from covering her shame.
And now I will uncover her uncleanness before her lovers, and no one will ever deliver her from my hand.
And I will turn away all her gladness, her feasts and her new moons and her Sabbaths and all her festivals.

And I will destroy her vine and her fig trees, of which she said, These are my wages that my lovers gave me, and I will turn them into a testimony, and beasts of the field and birds of heaven and reptiles of the earth will devour them.
And I will avenge on her days of the Baals in which she burned sacrifice to them and put on her earrings and her necklaces and went after her lovers, but forgot me, says Lord.
Therefore behold, I will lead her astray and appoint her to wilderness and speak to her heart.

And I will give her her possessions from there and valley of Achor to open her understanding, and she will be humbled there as in days of her childhood and as in days of her coming up from land of Egypt.
And it will be in that day, says Lord, she will call me My-Husband and will no longer call me Baalim.
And I will remove names of the Baals from her mouth, and their names will no longer be remembered.
And in that day I will make covenant for them with beasts of field and birds of heaven and reptiles of earth, and I will shatter bow and sword and war from the land and make you dwell in hope.
And I will betroth you to myself forever, and I will betroth you to myself in righteousness and in judgment and in mercy and in compassions.
And I will betroth you to myself in faithfulness, and you will know the Lord.
And it will be in that day, says Lord, I will hear the heaven, and heaven will hear the earth,
and earth will hear the grain and the wine and the oil, and these will hear Jezreel.
And I will sow her for myself upon the land, and I will show mercy to Not-Shown-Mercy, and I will say to Not-My-People, You are my people, and he himself will say, You are Lord my God.
And Lord said to me, Go again, love a woman loving evil things and adulterous, just as God loves sons of Israel, and they look to foreign gods and love raisin cakes.
And I hired her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer of barley and a jar of wine.
And I said to her, Many days you will sit with me, and you will not prostitute yourself, nor will you become another man's; and I will be toward you.
Because many days sons of Israel will sit without king and without ruler and without sacrifice and without altar and without priesthood and without disclosures.
And after these things sons of Israel will return and seek Lord their God and David their king and stand amazed at Lord and at his good things in last days.
Hear word of Lord, sons of Israel, because Lord has a case against inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth nor mercy nor knowledge of God upon the land.
Curse and lie and murder and theft and adultery have been poured out upon the land, and bloods mix with bloods.
Therefore the land will mourn and be diminished with all inhabiting it, with beasts of the field and with reptiles of the earth and with birds of heaven, and fish of sea will fail.
Let no one judge and let no one rebuke, for my people are like priest contradicted.
And you will grow weak by day, and prophet with you will also grow weak by night; I made your mother like you.
My people became like those having no knowledge. Because you rejected knowledge, I also will reject you from serving as priest to me. And you forgot law of your God; I also will forget your children.
According to their multitude, so they sinned against me; I will turn their glory into dishonor.
They will eat sins of my people, and in their injustices they will take their souls.
And it will be, like people so priest; and I will avenge on him his ways and repay him his counsels.
And they will eat and will not be filled; they prostituted themselves and will not be made straight, because they abandoned the Lord so as not to keep him.
Whoredom and wine and drunkenness took heart of my people.
They were asking by symbols, and by his rod it was reporting to him. They were led astray by spirit of whoredom and prostituted themselves away from their God.

On tops of mountains they were sacrificing, and on hills they were burning offerings under oak and white poplar and shady tree, because shelter is good. Therefore your daughters will prostitute themselves and your brides will commit adultery.

And I will not visit your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor your brides when they commit adultery, because they themselves mingled with prostitutes and were sacrificing with those initiated, and people with understanding were entwined with prostitute.
But you, Israel, do not be ignorant, and Judah, do not enter into Gilgal, and do not go up to house of On, and do not swear, As Lord lives.
Because like maddened heifer Israel maddened itself; now Lord will pasture them like lamb in open place.
Ephraim, partner of idols, set stumbling blocks for himself.
He raged with Canaanites; in prostituting they prostituted themselves; they loved dishonor from their own snorting.
A swirling of spirit you are in its wings, and they will be put to shame because of their altars.

Hear these things, priests, and pay attention, house of Israel, and house of king, listen closely, because the judgment is toward you, because you became a snare at the lookout and like a net spread out on Tabor.
And those hunting the prey drove it down deep, but I am your disciplinarian.
I knew Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me, because now Ephraim prostituted itself and Israel was defiled.
They have not set their counsels toward returning to their God, because a spirit of whoredom is in them, and they did not know the Lord.
And arrogance of Israel will be humbled before his face, and Israel and Ephraim will grow weak in their injustices, and Judah will grow weak with them.
With sheep and calves they will go to seek the Lord and will never find him, because he turned aside from them.
Because they abandoned the Lord, because foreign children were born to them; now mildew will devour them and their allotments.
Blow trumpet on the hills, sound on the heights, proclaim in house of On. Benjamin is beside himself.
Ephraim became for destruction in days of rebuke; among tribes of Israel I showed faithful things.
Rulers of Judah became like those moving boundaries; on them I will pour out my rushing force like water.
Ephraim oppressed his adversary and trampled judgment, because he began to go after empty things.
And I am like turmoil to Ephraim and like a sting to house of Judah.
And Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his pain, and Ephraim went to Assyrians and sent envoys to king Jarim, but he was not able to heal you, nor will pain depart from you.
Because I am like a panther to Ephraim and like a lion to house of Judah, and I will snatch and go away and take, and there will be no one delivering.
I will go and return to my place until they are destroyed and seek my face; in their affliction they will rise early toward me, saying,
Let us go and return to Lord our God, because he snatched and he will heal us; he will strike and bind us up.
He will heal us after two days; on third day we will rise and live before him.
And we will know; we will pursue knowing the Lord. As dawn, ready, we will find him, and he will come to us like early and latter rain to the earth.
What will I do to you, Ephraim? What will I do to you, Judah? Your mercy is like morning cloud and like early dew going away.
Because of this I cut down your prophets; I killed them by words of my mouth, and my judgment will come out like light.
Because I want mercy and not sacrifice, and knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
But they are like a man transgressing covenant; there he despised me.
Gilead is a city working vanity, stirring water.
And your strength is that of a pirate man; priests hid way of Lord; they murdered at Shechem, because they worked lawlessness.
In house of Israel I saw a horrible thing; there is whoredom of Ephraim; Israel and Judah were defiled.
Begin reaping for yourself when I turn back captivity of my people.
When I heal Israel, injustice of Ephraim and evil of Samaria will be uncovered, because they worked lies, and thief will enter to him, stripping robber on his road.
So that they may sing together as those agreeing in their heart all their evils; I remembered them now; their counsels surrounded them; they came to be before my face.
By their evils they gladdened kings, and by their lies rulers.
All adulterers, like an oven burning for baking of a heated loaf, from the flame, from kneading the fat until it is leavened.
Days of your kings began, and rulers grew angry from wine; he stretched out his hand with pestilent ones.
Because their hearts burned like oven when cursing them. All night Ephraim slept its fill; in morning it became blazing like a light of fire.
All grew hot like oven and devoured their judges; all their kings fell; there was none among them calling toward me.
Ephraim mingled itself with its peoples; Ephraim became a hidden cake not turned.
Foreigners devoured his strength, but he did not know, and gray hairs blossomed on him, and he did not know.
And arrogance of Israel will be humbled before his face, and they did not return to Lord their God, and they did not seek him in all these things.
And Ephraim was like foolish dove having no heart; they called on Egypt and went to Assyrians.
As they go, I will cast my net on them; like birds of heaven I will bring them down; I will discipline them by hearing of their affliction.
Woe to them, because they leaped away from me. They are cowardly because they acted impiously toward me. But I redeemed them, and they spoke lies against me.
And their hearts did not cry to me, but they howled on their beds; for grain and wine they cut themselves; they were trained in me.
And I strengthened their arms, but toward me they reckoned evil things.
They turned aside to nothing; they became like a bent bow. Their rulers will fall by sword because of undisciplined tongue. This is their scorn in land of Egypt.
Into their bosom, like land, like eagle against house of Lord, because they transgressed my covenant and acted impiously against my law.
They will cry to me, O God, we knew you.
Because Israel turned away from good things, enemies pursued him.
They made kings for themselves, and not through me. They ruled, and they did not make it known to me. Their silver and their gold they made into idols for themselves, so that they might be destroyed.
Cast away your calf, Samaria. My anger was provoked against them. How long will they be unable to be cleansed?
For in Israel a craftsman made it, and it is not God, because your calf, Samaria, was a thing causing wandering.
Because they sowed wind-blight, and destruction will receive them. A handful has no strength to make flour; and if it does make it, foreigners will devour it.
Israel was swallowed up; now it became among nations like a useless vessel.
Because they went up to Assyrians; Ephraim sprouted by itself; they loved gifts.
Therefore they will be handed over among the nations. Now I will receive them, and they will cease a little from anointing king and rulers.
Because Ephraim multiplied altars for sins; altars became beloved to him.
I will write for him multitude and his laws; they were reckoned as foreign things, beloved altars.

Because if they sacrifice sacrifice and eat meats, Lord will not accept them. Now he will remember their injustices and avenge their sins. They returned to Egypt, and in Assyria they will eat unclean things.
And Israel forgot the one who made him, and they built shrines, and Judah multiplied fortified cities. And I will send fire into his cities, and it will devour their foundations.
Do not rejoice, Israel, nor be glad like the peoples, because you prostituted yourself away from your God. You loved gifts on every threshing floor of grain.
Threshing floor and winepress did not know them, and the wine deceived them.
They did not dwell in land of Lord; Ephraim dwelt in Egypt, and in Assyria they will eat unclean things.

They did not pour out wine to Lord, and their sacrifices could not please him. To them they are like bread of mourning; all eating them will be defiled, because their breads are for their own souls; they will not enter into house of Lord.
What will you do in day of assembly and in day of feast of the Lord?
Therefore behold, they will go from misery. Egypt will receive them, and Memphis will bury them; Machmas, destruction will inherit their silver; thorns will be in their tents.

Days of vengeance have come; days of your repayment have come, and Israel will be afflicted like prophet out of his mind, man carried by spirit, because multitude of your injustices increased your madness.
Ephraim, a watchman with God, prophet, a crooked snare on all his ways; they drove madness deep in house of Lord.
They were corrupted as in days of the hill; he will remember their injustice; he will avenge their sins.
Like a grape in wilderness I found Israel, and like an early fig on a fig tree I saw their fathers. They entered to Baal-Peor and were estranged to shame, and beloved ones became like those abhorred.
Ephraim, like a bird, their glories flew away from births and birth-pangs and conceptions.
Because even if they rear their children, they will become childless from men, because woe is also to them; my flesh is from them.
As I saw Ephraim for hunting, they presented their children, and Ephraim to bring out his children for piercing.
Give to them, Lord. What will you give them? Give them barren womb and dry breasts.
All their evils are in Gilgal, because there I hated them. Because of evils of their practices I will cast them out of my house. I will not continue to love them; all their rulers are disobedient.
Ephraim suffered; its roots dried up; it will no longer bear fruit. Even if they bear children, I will kill desires of their womb.
God will reject them because they did not listen to him, and they will be wanderers among the nations.
Israel, a flourishing vine, its fruit prospered. According to multitude of its fruits he multiplied the altars; according to goodness of his land he built pillars.
They divided their hearts; now they will be destroyed. He himself will dig down their altars; their pillars will suffer.
Because now they will say, We have no king, because we did not fear the Lord. And the king, what will he do for us?
Speaking words, false excuses, they will make covenant; judgment springs up like weed on furrows of a field.

For calf of house of On, inhabitants of Samaria will dwell as strangers, because his people mourned over it, and as they embittered him they will rejoice over his glory, because it was removed from him.
And binding it they carried it away to Assyrians as a guest-gift to king Jarim. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed in his counsel.
Samaria threw away her king like twig on face of water.
And altars of On, sins of Israel, will be removed; thorns and thistles will come up on their altars, and they will say to mountains, Cover us, and to hills, Fall on us.
From time of the hills Israel sinned; there they stood. War on children of injustice will not overtake them on the hill.
He came to discipline them, and peoples will be gathered against them when they are disciplined in their two injustices.
Ephraim is a heifer taught to love victory, but I will come upon the beauty of her neck. I will mount Ephraim and silence Judah; Jacob will strengthen him.
Sow for yourselves into righteousness; reap into fruit of life. Give yourselves light of knowledge. Seek the Lord until fruits of righteousness come to you.
Why did you keep silence for impiety and reap its injustices? You ate fruit of lies, because you hoped in your chariots and in multitude of your strength.
And destruction will rise up among your people, and all your fortified things will go away, as ruler Salaman from house of Jerobaal, in day of war, leveled mother upon children.
Thus I will do to you, house of Israel, because of face of your evils. At dawn they threw away, king of Israel was thrown away.
Because Israel was an infant, and I loved him, and from Egypt I called his children.
As I called them, so they were being driven from my face. They were sacrificing to the Baals and burning incense to carved things.
And I bound Ephraim together; I took him on my arm, and they did not know that I heal them.
With ruin of men I stretched them out, in bonds of my love, and I will be to them like one striking a man on his jaws, and I will look upon him; I will prevail for him.
Ephraim dwelt in Egypt, and Assur is his king, because he did not want to return.
And sword grew weak in his cities and ceased in his hands, and they will eat from their counsels.
And his people hang suspended from his dwelling, and God will be angered over his honored things and will never exalt him.
How will I make you, Ephraim? Will I defend you, Israel? How will I make you like Adama? I will set you like Seboim. My heart was turned within me; my repentance was stirred together.
I will not act according to anger of my wrath; I will not abandon Ephraim to be wiped out, because I am God and not man, holy in you, and I will not enter into a city.
I will go after Lord; like a lion he will roar, because he himself will roar, and children of waters will stand amazed.
And they will stand amazed like bird from Egypt and like dove from land of Assyrians, and I will restore them to their houses, says Lord.
Ephraim surrounded me with lie and house of Israel with impieties, and now Judah knew them before God, and holy people will be called of God.
But Ephraim pursued evil wind, pursuing scorching heat all day. It multiplied emptiness and vanity, and made covenant with Assyrians, and was trading oil into Egypt.
And Lord has a case against Judah, to avenge Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his practices.
In womb he grabbed heel of his brother, and in his labors he grew strong toward God.
And he grew strong with an angel and prevailed; they wept and begged me. In house of On they found me, and there speech was made toward him.
And Lord God Almighty will be his memorial.
And you, in your God you will return; keep mercy and judgment and draw near to your God always.
Canaan, in his hand a scale of injustice; he loved to oppress.
And Ephraim said, Yet I became rich; I found relief for myself. All his labors will not be found for him in injustices by which he sinned.
But I am Lord your God who brought you up from land of Egypt. I will still make you dwell in tents as in days of feast.
And I will speak to prophets, and I multiplied visions, and by hands of prophets I was likened.
If Gilead is not, then were they false? In Gilgal rulers were sacrificing, and their altars were like turtles on furrows of field.
And Jacob withdrew into plain of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept watch.
And by a prophet Lord brought Israel up from Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept.
Ephraim enraged and provoked, and his blood will be poured upon him, and Lord will repay him his reproach.
According to word of Ephraim, he received ordinances in Israel, and he set them to Baal and died.

And now they sinned increasingly and made for themselves a molten image from their silver according to likeness of idols, works of craftsmen accomplished for them. They say, Sacrifice humans, for the calves have come to an end.
Therefore they will be like morning cloud and like early dew going away, like chaff blown from threshing floor and like vapor from locusts.

But I am Lord your God, establishing heaven and creating earth, whose hands created all army of heaven, and I did not show them to you for you to go after them. And I brought you up from land of Egypt, and besides me you will know no god, and there is no savior except me.
I was shepherding you in wilderness, in uninhabited land.
According to their pastures they were filled to fullness, and their hearts were exalted; because of this they forgot me.
And I will be to them like panther and like leopard on road of Assyrians.
I will meet them like bear in distress and tear open enclosure of their heart, and cubs of forest will devour them there; beasts of field will tear them apart.
At your destruction, Israel, who will help?
Where is this king of yours? Let him save you in all your cities. Let him judge you, the one of whom you said, Give me king and ruler.
And I gave you a king in my anger and held him in my wrath.
Ephraim's twisting of injustice, his sin, has been hidden.
Birth-pangs like those of a woman giving birth will come to him. This son is not wise, because he will not stand in breaking forth of children.
From hand of Hades I will rescue them, and from death I will ransom them. Where is your penalty, death? Where is your sting, Hades? Consolation is hidden from my eyes.

Because he himself will separate among brothers, Lord will bring east wind, scorching wind from wilderness, upon him, and it will dry up his veins and lay waste his springs. He himself will dry up his land and all his desirable vessels.
Samaria will be destroyed, because she opposed her God. By sword they will fall, their nursing infants will be dashed down, and their pregnant women ripped open.
Return, Israel, to Lord your God, because you grew weak in your injustices.
Take words with yourselves and return to Lord your God. Say to him that you may not take injustice and may take good things, and we will repay fruit of our lips.
Assur will never save us; we will not mount horse, and we will no longer say, Our gods, to works of our hands; in you orphan will find mercy.
I will heal their dwellings; I will love them openly, because my anger turned away from them.
I will be like dew to Israel; he will blossom like lily and cast his roots like Lebanon.
His branches will go out, and he will be like fruitful olive, and his smell like Lebanon.
They will return and sit under his shelter; they will live and be made drunk with grain and blossom like vine; his memorial like wine of Lebanon.
What further has Ephraim to do with idols? I humbled him and I will strengthen him. I am like thick-jutting juniper; from me your fruit is found.
Who is wise and will understand these things, or intelligent and will know them? Because ways of Lord are straight, and righteous ones will walk in them, but impious ones will grow weak in them.
Word of Lord that came to Joel son of Bathouel.
Hear these things, elders, and listen, all inhabiting the land. Have such things happened in your days or in days of your fathers?
Tell of these things to your children, and your children to their children, and their children to another generation.
What remained of the caterpillar the locust ate, and what remained of the locust the hopper ate, and what remained of the hopper the blight ate.
Wake up, drunkards, from your wine, and weep; lament, all drinking wine into drunkenness, because gladness and joy have been removed from your mouth.
Because a strong and numberless nation came up upon my land; its teeth are lion's teeth and its molars are those of a cub.
It made my vine into ruin and my fig trees into splintering; searching, it searched it out and threw it down; its branches turned white.
Lament to me like bride girded with sackcloth over her youthful husband.
Sacrifice and drink offering were removed from house of Lord. Mourn, priests serving at altar.
Because fields have suffered, let the land mourn, because grain has suffered, wine dried up, oil diminished.
Farmers dried up. Lament, fields, for wheat and barley, because harvest from field is lost.
Vine dried up and figs diminished, pomegranate and palm and apple and all trees of field dried up, because they put joy to shame, sons of men.

Gird yourselves and beat yourselves, priests; lament, those serving at altar. Enter, spend the night in sackcloth, those serving God, because sacrifice and drink offering have been kept back from house of your God.
Sanctify a fast, proclaim service, gather elders, all inhabiting the land, into house of your God, and cry out intensely to Lord.
Alas, alas, alas, for the day, because day of Lord is near, and like misery from misery it will come.
Before your eyes foods were destroyed, and from house of your God gladness and joy.
Heifers leaped at their mangers, storehouses vanished, vats were dug down, because grain dried up.
What will we store for ourselves? Herds of cattle wept, because pasture did not exist for them, and flocks of sheep vanished.
To you, Lord, I will cry, because fire consumed beauties of wilderness and flame kindled all trees of field.
And beasts of the plain looked up to you, because streams of waters dried up and fire devoured beauties of wilderness.
Blow trumpet in Zion, proclaim on my holy mountain, and let all inhabiting the land be shaken, because day of Lord is present, because it is near:

day of darkness and gloom, day of cloud and mist. Like dawn it will be poured out on the mountains, a great and strong people; none like it has happened from age, and after it none will be added for years of generations.
Before it fire consumes, and behind it kindled flame; before its face the land is a garden of delight, and behind it a plain of ruin, and there will be no one escaping it.
Its appearance is like appearance of horses, and like horsemen they will pursue.
Like sound of chariots on tops of mountains they will leap, and like sound of flame of fire devouring stubble, and like great and strong people arrayed for war.
Before its face peoples will be crushed; every face as scorching of a pot.
Like fighters they will run, and like men of war they will climb walls, and each will go in his own way, and they will never turn from their paths.
And each will not keep away from his brother; weighed down in their weapons they will go, and by their missiles they will fall and will never be finished off.
They will seize the city and run on the walls and climb into houses and enter through windows like thieves.
Before them earth will be shaken and heaven shaken; sun and moon will be darkened and stars will withdraw their light.

And Lord will give his voice before his force, because his camp is exceedingly great, because works of his words are strong; because great is day of Lord, very great and conspicuous, and who will be sufficient for it?
And now, says Lord your God, return to me with all your heart and with fasting and with weeping and with mourning.
And tear your hearts and not your garments, and return to the Lord your God, because he is merciful and compassionate, long-suffering and rich in mercy and relenting over calamities.
Who knows whether he will turn and repent and leave behind him blessing, sacrifice, and drink offering to the Lord our God?
Blow trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, proclaim service.
Gather people, sanctify assembly, choose elders, gather infants nursing breasts. Let bridegroom go out from his chamber and bride from her wedding-room.

Between base of altar the priests serving Lord will weep and say, Spare, Lord, your people, and do not give your inheritance to reproach for nations to rule them, so that they may not say among nations, Where is their God?
And Lord was jealous for his land and spared his people.
And Lord answered and said to his people, Behold, I am sending you grain and wine and oil, and you will be filled with them, and I will no longer give you to reproach among nations.

And the one from north I will drive away from you and thrust him into waterless and ruined land, his face into the former sea and his back into the last sea, and his rot will rise and his stench will rise, because he magnified his deeds.
Take courage, land; rejoice and be glad, because Lord magnified what he did.
Take courage, beasts of the field, because plains of wilderness have sprouted, because tree bore its fruit, vine and fig tree gave their strength.
And children of Zion, rejoice and be glad in Lord your God, because he gave you foods in righteousness, and he will rain on you early and latter rain as before.
And threshing floors will be filled with grain, and vats will overflow with wine and oil.
And I will repay you for years that locust and hopper and blight and caterpillar ate, my great force that I sent among you.
And eating you will eat and be filled and praise name of Lord your God, who did wonders with you, and my people will never be put to shame forever.
And you will know that I am in midst of Israel, and I am Lord your God and there is no other besides me, and all my people will no longer be put to shame forever.

And it will be after these things: I will pour out from my Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters will prophesy, and your elders will dream dreams, and your young men will see visions.
And even on the male servants and on the female servants in those days I will pour out from my Spirit.
And I will give wonders in heaven and on earth, blood and fire and vapor of smoke.
Sun will be turned into darkness and moon into blood before great and manifest day of Lord comes.
And it will be that everyone who calls on name of Lord will be saved, because on mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be survivors, as Lord said, and those bearing good news whom Lord has called.
Because behold, in those days and in that time, when I turn back captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

I will gather all nations and bring them down into valley of Jehoshaphat, and there I will judge with them concerning my people and my inheritance Israel, whom they scattered among nations and divided my land.
And over my people they cast lots and gave boys to prostitutes and sold girls for wine and drank.

And what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon and all Galilee of foreigners? Are you repaying me with repayment, or bearing resentment against me? Swiftly and quickly I will repay your repayment on your own heads.
Because you took my silver and my gold and carried my choice and good things into your temples.
And you sold sons of Judah and sons of Jerusalem to sons of Greeks so that you might drive them out from their borders.
Behold, I am raising them up from place where you sold them there, and I will repay your repayment on your own heads.
And I will sell your sons and your daughters into hands of sons of Judah, and they will sell them into captivity to a distant nation, because Lord spoke.
Proclaim these things among nations: sanctify war, rouse fighters, bring near and let all men of war go up.
Beat your plows into swords and your sickles into spears. Let weak one say, I am strong.
Gather yourselves and enter, all nations around, and assemble there. Let gentle one be a fighter.
Let all nations be roused and go up into valley of Jehoshaphat, because there I will sit to judge all nations around.
Send out sickles, because harvest stands ready. Enter, tread, because vat is full; troughs overflow, because their evils are multiplied.
Sounds resounded in valley of justice, because day of Lord is near in valley of justice.
Sun and moon will be darkened, and stars will withdraw their light.
And Lord will cry out from Zion and give his voice from Jerusalem, and heaven and earth will shake; but Lord will spare his people and strengthen sons of Israel.
And you will know that I am Lord your God dwelling in Zion, on my holy mountain, and Jerusalem will be a holy city, and foreigners will pass through her no longer.

And it will be in that day: mountains will drip sweetness and hills will flow with milk and all streams of Judah will flow with waters, and a spring from house of Lord will come out and water torrent of reeds.
Egypt will become ruin and Idumea a plain of ruin because of injustices against sons of Judah, because they poured out righteous blood in their land.
But Judea will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem for generations of generations.
And I will avenge their blood and will by no means leave them unpunished, and Lord will dwell in Zion.

Words of Amos, which came in Nakkarim from Tekoa, which he saw concerning Jerusalem in days of Uzziah king of Judah and in days of Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
And he said, Lord spoke out from Zion and gave his voice from Jerusalem, and pastures of shepherds mourned, and top of Carmel dried up.
And Lord said, For three impieties of Damascus and for four I will not turn him away, because they sawed open with iron saws those pregnant among the Gileadites.
And I will send fire into house of Hazael, and it will devour foundations of son of Ader.
And I will shatter bars of Damascus and destroy inhabitants from plain of On and cut off tribe from men of Harran, and people of Syria called by name will be led captive, says Lord.
Thus says Lord: For three impieties of Gaza and for four I will not turn them away, because they took captive captivity of Solomon to shut them up into Idumea.
And I will send fire on walls of Gaza, and it will devour her foundations.
And I will destroy inhabitants from Azotus, and tribe will be removed from Ascalon, and I will bring my hand upon Accaron, and remnant of the foreigners will perish, says Lord.
Thus says Lord: For three impieties of Tyre and for four I will not turn her away, because they shut up captivity of Solomon into Idumea and did not remember covenant of brothers.
And I will send fire on walls of Tyre, and it will devour her foundations.

Thus says Lord: For three impieties of Idumea and for four I will not turn them away, because they pursued their brother with sword and ruined womb upon earth, and seized their horror as witness, and kept their rushing force for strife.
And I will send fire into Thaiman, and it will devour foundations of her walls.
Thus says Lord: For three impieties of sons of Ammon and for four I will not turn him away, because they ripped open pregnant women of Gilead in order to widen their borders.
And I will kindle fire on walls of Rabbah, and it will devour her foundations with shouting in day of war, and it will be shaken in day of her completion.
And her kings will go into captivity, their priests and their rulers together, says Lord.
Thus says Lord: For three impieties of Moab and for four I will not turn him away, because they burned bones of king of Idumea to lime.
And I will send fire upon Moab, and it will devour foundations of her cities, and Moab will die in weakness with shouting and with sound of trumpet.
And I will destroy judge from her, and all her rulers I will kill with him, says Lord.

Thus says Lord: For three impieties of sons of Judah and for four I will not turn him away, because they rejected law of Lord and did not keep his commands, and their vanities that they made led them astray, which their fathers followed after them.
And I will send fire upon Judah, and it will devour foundations of Jerusalem.
Thus says Lord: For three impieties of Israel and for four I will not turn him away, because they sold righteous one for silver and poor one because of sandals.
Those trampling heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and turning aside way of humble, and son and father were going in to same servant-girl so as to profane name of their God.
And binding their garments with cords they were making curtains beside the altar, and they were drinking wine from extortions in house of their God.
But I dried up Amorrite from before them, whose height was like height of cedar, and he was strong like oak, and I dried up his fruit from above and his roots from below.
And I brought you up from land of Egypt and led you around in wilderness forty years, to inherit land of Amorrites.
And I took some of your sons for prophets and some of your young men for sanctification. Is this not so, sons of Israel? says Lord.
And you were giving wine to the sanctified ones, and to the prophets you commanded, saying, You must not prophesy.
Therefore behold, I am rolling beneath you just as cart full of stubble rolls.
And flight will perish from swift runner, and strong man will not hold his strength, and warrior will not save his soul.
And archer will not stand, and one swift in his feet will not escape, nor rider save his soul.
And naked man will find his heart among powers and flee in that day, says Lord.
Hear this word that Lord spoke against you, house of Israel, and against every tribe that I brought up from land of Egypt, saying,
Only you I knew from all tribes of the earth; therefore I will avenge upon you all your sins.
Will two walk together at all unless they make themselves known to each other?
Will lion roar from his forest having no prey? Will cub give his voice from his den at all unless he seizes something?
Will bird fall upon earth without a snare? Will trap spring from earth without catching something?
Will trumpet sound in a city and people not be frightened? Will there be evil in a city that Lord has not done?
Because Lord God will never do a thing unless he reveals his discipline to his servants the prophets.
Lion will roar, and who will not fear? Lord God has spoken, and who will not prophesy?
Report to lands in Assyria and to lands of Egypt and say, Gather on mountain of Samaria and see many wonders in midst of her and oppression in her.
And they did not know what will be before her, says Lord, those storing up injustice and misery in their lands.
Therefore thus says Lord God: Tyre, all around your land will be made desolate, and he will bring down your strength from you, and your lands will be plundered.
Thus says Lord: Just as shepherd snatches from lion's mouth two legs or tip of an ear, so sons of Israel dwelling in Samaria will be snatched away, opposite tribe and in Damascus priests.
Hear and testify to house of Jacob, says Lord God Almighty.
Because in day when I avenge impieties of Israel upon him, I will also avenge upon altars of Bethel, and horns of altar will be dug down and fall upon the earth.
I will pour together and strike winter house against summer house, and ivory houses will perish, and many other houses will be added, says Lord.
Hear this word, cows of Bashan, those on mountain of Samaria, oppressing poor and trampling needy, saying to their lords, Give to us so that we may drink.
Lord swears by his holy things: behold, days are coming upon you, and they will take you with weapons, and those with you they will throw into kindled cauldrons, fiery pestilences.
And you will be brought out naked, each opposite the other, and you will be thrown onto mount Remman, says Lord God.
Enter Bethel and act lawlessly, and in Gilgal multiply impiety, and bring your sacrifices in the morning, your tithes on the third day.
And they read out law outside and called for confessions. Declare that sons of Israel loved these things, says Lord God.
And I gave you gnashing of teeth in all your cities and lack of breads in all your places, and you did not return to me, says Lord.

And I withheld rain from you three months before the harvest, and I will rain on one city, but on one city I will not rain; one part will be rained on, and the part where I do not rain will be dried up.
And two and three cities will gather to one city to drink water and will never be filled, and you did not return to me, says Lord.

I struck you with burning and blight; you multiplied your gardens, your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees, but the caterpillar devoured them, and not even thus did you return to me, says Lord.

I sent death among you in way of Egypt and killed your young men by sword with captivity of your horses, and I brought up your camps in fire in my wrath, and not even thus did you return to me, says Lord.
I overthrew you as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you became like a brand snatched from fire, and not even thus did you return to me, says Lord.
Therefore thus I will do to you, Israel. Yet because I will do thus to you, prepare to call on your God, Israel.

For, behold, I am he that strengthens the thunder and creates the wind and proclaims to humans his anointed one, forming the morning and the darkness and mounting on the high places of the earth; the Lord God Almighty is his name.
Hear this word of Lord, this lament that I take up over you, house of Israel.
Virgin of Israel has fallen; she will no longer continue to rise. She slipped upon her own land; there is no one to raise her up.
Because thus says Lord God: The city from which a thousand went out will have a hundred left, and from which a hundred went out will have ten left for house of Israel.
Because thus says Lord to house of Israel: Seek me and live.
And do not seek Bethel, and do not enter Gilgal, and do not cross over to well of oath, because Gilgal, being led captive, will be led captive, and Bethel will be as though not existing.
Seek the Lord and live, lest house of Joseph blaze like fire and it devour him, and there will be no one to quench it for house of Israel.
Lord is the one making judgment into a height and setting righteousness upon the earth,

making all things and transforming, turning shadow of death into morning and darkening day into night, calling the water of the sea and pouring it on the face of the earth; Lord God Almighty is his name,
the one dividing destruction upon strength and bringing misery upon fortress.
They hated the one rebuking in gates, and they abhorred holy speech.
Therefore, because you beat down poor and received choice gifts from them, you built polished houses and will never dwell in them; you planted desirable vineyards and will never drink wine from them.
Because I knew your many impieties and your strong sins, trampling righteous one, taking exchanges, and turning poor aside in gates.
Therefore one understanding in that time will keep silent, because it is an evil time.
Seek good and not evil, so that you may live, and thus Lord God Almighty will be with you, as you said.
We hated evil things and loved good things, and restore judgment in gates, so that Lord God Almighty may show mercy to remnant of Joseph.
Therefore thus says Lord God Almighty: In all the squares mourning, and in all the roads it will be said, Alas, alas; farmer will be called into grief and mourning and into those knowing lament.
And in all roads mourning, because I will pass through your midst, says Lord.
Woe to those desiring day of Lord. Why is this day of Lord for you? It is darkness and not light,
just as when a man flees from lion and bear falls upon him, and he jumps into his house and presses his hands on the wall and serpent bites him.
Is not day of Lord darkness and not light, and gloom having no brightness?
I hated, I rejected your feasts, and I will by no means smell your festivals.
Because even if you bring me your burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not accept them, and I will not look upon your prominent peace offerings.
Remove from me sound of your songs, and I will not hear melody of your instruments.
And judgment will roll like water, and righteousness like an impassable torrent.
Did you bring me victims and sacrifices in wilderness forty years, house of Israel?
And you took up tent of Moloch and star of your god Rhaiphan, their images that you made for yourselves.
And I will resettle you beyond Damascus, says Lord God Almighty is his name.
Woe to those despising Zion and trusting in mountain of Samaria. They gathered firstfruits of nations, and house of Israel entered to them.
Pass through all and see, and go from there into Emath Rabbah and go down from there into Gath of foreigners, strongest out of all these kingdoms. Are their borders greater than your borders?
You coming into evil day, drawing near and touching false Sabbaths,
sleeping on ivory beds and living luxuriously on their couches and eating young goats from flocks and calves from midst of cattle-stalls, sucklings,
clapping to sound of instruments, they reckoned themselves as established and not as fleeing,
drinking strained wine and anointing with first perfumes, and they suffered nothing over crushing of Joseph.
Therefore now they will be captives from beginning of rulers, and neighing of horses from Ephraim will be removed.
Because Lord swore by himself: I abhor all arrogance of Jacob, and I hated his lands, and I will remove city with all inhabiting it.
And it will be if ten men are left in one house, they will die, and the rest left behind will remain.

And their household members will take them and force them to bring their bones out of house, and he will say to those presiding over the house, Is there still anyone with you? And he will say, No longer. And he will say, Be silent, because name of Lord must not be named.
Because behold, Lord commands and will strike the great house with ruins and the small house with cracks.
Will horses run upon rocks? Will they be silent among females? Because you turned judgment into wrath and fruit of righteousness into bitterness.
Those rejoicing over nothing, those saying, Did we not acquire horns by our own strength?
Because behold, I am raising against you, house of Israel, a nation, and they will afflict you from entering into Emath and as far as torrent of the west.
Thus Lord showed me, and behold, brood of locusts coming in the morning, and behold, one hopper, Gog the king.
And it will be, if it completes devouring grass of the land, then I said, Lord Lord, be merciful. Who will raise Jacob, because he is small?
Repent, Lord, over this, and this will not happen, says Lord.
Thus Lord showed me, and behold, Lord called judgment in fire, and it devoured the great abyss and devoured the portion.
And I said, Lord Lord, cease now. Who will raise Jacob, because he is small?
Repent, Lord, over this, and this will never happen, says Lord.
Thus Lord showed me, and behold, a man stood upon an adamant wall, and adamant was in his hand.
And Lord said to me, What do you see, Amos? And I said, Adamant. And Lord said to me, Behold, I am setting adamant in midst of my people Israel; I will no longer continue to pass over him.
And altars of laughter will be destroyed, and rites of Israel will be laid waste, and I will rise against house of Jeroboam with sword.
And Amaziah priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos is making conspiracies against you in midst of house of Israel; the land cannot bear all his words.
Because thus Amos says: Jeroboam will end by sword, and Israel will surely be led captive from his land.
And Amaziah said to Amos, O seer, go, withdraw into land of Judah, and live there, and there you will prophesy.
But in Bethel you must no longer continue to prophesy, because it is sanctuary of king and house of kingdom.
And Amos answered and said to Amaziah, I was not a prophet nor son of prophet, but I was a goatherd and one pricking sycamore figs.
And Lord took me from the sheep and said to me, Go, prophesy over my people Israel.
And now hear word of Lord. You say, Do not prophesy against Israel, and you must not raise tumult against house of Jacob.

Therefore thus says Lord: Your wife in the city will prostitute herself, and your sons and your daughters will fall by sword, and your land will be measured by line, and you will die in unclean land, and Israel will surely be led captive from his land.
Thus Lord showed me, and behold, a vessel of birdlime.
And he said, What do you see, Amos? And I said, A vessel of birdlime. And Lord said to me, The end has come upon my people Israel; I will no longer continue to pass over him.
And stalls of the temple will howl in that day, says Lord. Great is the fallen one in every place; I will cast silence.
Hear these things, you who crush poor into morning and oppress needy from the land,
saying, When will month pass and we will trade, and the Sabbaths and we will open treasuries, making the measure small and the weights large and making unjust scales,
to buy poor for silver and humble one for sandals, and we will trade from every crop.
Lord swears by arrogance of Jacob: Will he ever forget all your works for strife?
And because of these things will not the land be shaken, and every inhabitant in it mourn, and its whole end rise like a river and descend like river of Egypt?
And it will be in that day, says Lord God, sun will go down at noon and he will darken light upon earth in daytime.

And I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lament, and bring up sackcloth on every waist and baldness on every head and make it like mourning for beloved one and those with him like day of grief.
Behold, days are coming, says Lord, and I will send famine upon the land, not famine of bread nor thirst of water, but famine of hearing word of Lord.
And waters will be shaken to sea, and from north to east they will run around seeking word of Lord and will never find it.
In that day fair virgins and young men will fail in thirst.
Those swearing by propitiation of Samaria and saying, Your god lives, Dan, and your god lives, Beersheba, will fall and never rise again.

I saw the Lord standing upon the altar, and he said, Strike upon the mercy-seat, and the foregates will be shaken; cut through into heads of all, and the remnant of them I will kill with sword. No one fleeing from them will flee away, and no one being rescued from them will be saved.
If they dig down into Hades, from there my hand will pull them up, and if they go up into heaven, from there I will bring them down.
If they hide on top of Carmel, from there I will search out and take them, and if they sink from before my eyes into depths of sea, there I will command the dragon and it will bite them.
And if they go into captivity before face of their enemies, there I will command the sword and it will kill them, and I will set my eyes upon them for evils and not for good things.
And Lord, Lord God Almighty, touching the earth and shaking it, and all inhabiting it will mourn, and its whole end will rise like a river and descend like river of Egypt.
The one building his ascent into heaven and founding his promise on the earth, calling water of sea and pouring it on face of earth, Lord God Almighty is his name.
Are you not to me like sons of Ethiopians, sons of Israel? says Lord. Did I not bring Israel up from land of Egypt, and foreigners from Cappadocia, and Syrians from the pit?
Behold, eyes of Lord God are upon kingdom of sinners, and I will remove it from face of the earth, except that I will not entirely remove house of Jacob, says Lord.
Because behold, I command and will winnow house of Israel among all nations just as it is winnowed in a sieve, and not a fragment will fall on the earth.
All sinners of my people will end by sword, those saying, Evils will never come near us nor happen upon us.
In that day I will raise up tent of David that has fallen and rebuild its fallen things and raise up its dug-down things and rebuild it as days of the age,
so that remnant of men and all nations upon whom my name was called upon them may seek, says Lord God who does these things.
Behold, days are coming, says Lord, and plowman will overtake harvest, and grape will become dark in sowing, and mountains will drip sweetness and all hills will be thickly planted together.
And I will turn back captivity of my people Israel, and they will rebuild ruined cities and dwell in them and plant vineyards and drink their wine and plant gardens and eat their fruit.
And I will plant them upon their land, and they will never again be pulled up from their land that I gave them, says Lord God Almighty.
Vision of Obadiah. Thus says Lord God to Idumea: I heard a report from Lord, and he sent a message to nations: Rise, and let us rise against her for war.
Behold, I made you few among nations; you are greatly dishonored.
Arrogance of your heart lifted you up, you dwelling in holes of rocks, raising your dwelling high, saying in your heart, Who will bring me down to earth?
If you soar high like eagle and set your nest among stars, from there I will bring you down, says Lord.

If thieves entered to you, or robbers by night, where would you have been cast away? Would they not have stolen enough for themselves? And if grape-gatherers entered to you, would they not have left gleanings?
How Esau was searched out and his hidden things seized.
To your borders they sent you away, all men of your covenant. Your peaceful men opposed you and prevailed against you. They set ambush under you; there is no understanding in them.
In that day, says Lord, I will destroy wise men from Idumea and understanding from mount of Esau.
Your warriors from Teman will be terrified, so that a man may be cut off from mount of Esau.
Because of slaughter and impiety toward your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
From day when you stood opposite, on day when foreigners carried away his strength and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you also were as one of them.
Do not look on day of your brother in day of strangers, and do not rejoice over sons of Judah in day of their destruction, and do not speak proudly in day of distress.
Do not enter gates of my people in day of their pain, do not also look on their gathering in day of their ruin, and do not also join attack upon their strength in day of their destruction.
Do not stand at their outlets to destroy their survivors, and do not imprison their fugitives in day of distress.
Because day of Lord is near upon all nations. As you did, so it will be to you; your repayment will be returned on your head.
Because as you drank on my holy mountain, all nations will drink wine; they will drink and go down, and they will be as though not existing.
But on mount Zion there will be salvation, and it will be holy, and house of Jacob will inherit those who inherited them.
House of Jacob will be fire, house of Joseph flame, and house of Esau stubble; they will burn among them and devour them, and there will be no fire-bearer in house of Esau, because Lord spoke.
Those in Negeb will inherit mount of Esau, and those in Shephelah the foreigners; they will inherit mount of Ephraim and plain of Samaria, and Benjamin and Gilead.
This beginning of exile belongs to sons of Israel: land of Canaanites as far as Sarepta, and exile of Jerusalem as far as Ephratha; they will inherit cities of Negeb.
Rescued men will go up from mount Zion to avenge mount of Esau, and kingdom will belong to Lord.
Word of Lord came to Jonah son of Amathi, saying,
Rise, go to Nineveh, great city, and proclaim in it, because cry of its evil rose up to me.
Jonah rose to flee to Tarshish from face of Lord, went down to Joppa, found a ship going to Tarshish, paid its fare, and went into it to sail with them to Tarshish from face of Lord.
Lord stirred up a wind on sea, and a great surge happened on sea, and ship was in danger of being broken.
Sailors feared, and each cried to his god, and they threw ship's cargo into sea to lighten it from them. But Jonah had gone down into hold of ship and slept and snored.
Shipmaster came to him and said, Why are you snoring? Rise, call on your god, so God may save us and we not perish.
Each said to his neighbor, Come, let us cast lots and know for whose sake this evil is among us. They cast lots, and lot fell on Jonah.
They said to him, Tell us, for whose sake is this evil among us? What is your work? From where do you come? From what country and from what people are you?
He said to them, I am servant of Lord, and I worship Lord God of heaven, who made sea and dry land.
Men feared with great fear and said to him, What is this you have done? For men knew he was fleeing from face of Lord, because he told them.
They said to him, What should we do to you, so sea will quiet from us? Because sea kept going and stirred greater surge.
Jonah said to them, Lift me and throw me into sea, and sea will quiet from you, because I know this great surge is upon you because of me.
Men strained to turn back to land and were not able, because sea kept going and surging more against them.
They cried to the Lord and said, By no means, Lord, let us not perish on account of the life of this man, and do not put righteous blood on us, because you, Lord, have done as you wished.
They took Jonah and threw him into sea, and sea stood still from its tossing.
Men feared Lord with great fear, sacrificed sacrifice to Lord, and vowed vows.
Lord commanded a great sea-creature to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in belly of sea-creature three days and three nights.
Jonah prayed to Lord his God from belly of sea-creature.
He said, I cried in my distress to the Lord my God, and he heard me. From the belly of Hades you heard the voice of my cry.
You cast me into depths, into heart of sea, and rivers encircled me. All your billows and waves passed over me.
I said, I am thrust away from your eyes. Shall I again add to look toward your holy temple?
Water poured around me up to soul. Abyss encircled me utterly. My head went down into clefts of mountains.
I went down into land whose bars are everlasting holds, yet may my life come up from corruption, Lord my God.
When my soul was failing from me, I remembered Lord, and may my prayer come to you, into your holy temple.
Those keeping worthless and false things abandoned their mercy.
But I, with a voice of praise and confession, will sacrifice to you. Whatever I vowed I will repay to you. Salvation belongs to the Lord.
It was commanded to sea-creature, and it threw Jonah out on dry land.
Word of Lord came to Jonah second time, saying,
Rise, go to Nineveh, great city, and proclaim in it according to former proclamation that I spoke to you.
Jonah rose and went to Nineveh, just as Lord spoke. Nineveh was a great city to God, like journey of three days.
Jonah began to enter city, about journey of one day, and proclaimed and said, Yet three days and Nineveh will be overthrown.
Men of Nineveh believed God, proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth from greatest to least.
Word reached king of Nineveh, and he rose from his throne, removed his robe from himself, clothed himself in sackcloth, and sat on ashes.
It was proclaimed and said in Nineveh by king and his nobles: Let neither people nor cattle nor oxen nor sheep taste anything; let them not graze and let them not drink water.
People and cattle clothed themselves with sackcloth and cried intensely to God, and each turned from his evil way and from injustice in his hands, saying,
Who knows if God will repent and turn from fury of his anger, and we will certainly not perish?
God saw their works, that they turned from their evil ways, and God repented of evil he had spoken to do to them, and he did not do it.
Jonah was grieved with great grief and was confounded.

He prayed to Lord and said, O Lord, were not these my words while I was still in my land? Because of this I went ahead to flee to Tarshish, because I knew that you are merciful and compassionate, long-suffering and abundant in mercy, repenting over evils.
And now, Master Lord, take my life from me, because better for me to die than to live.
Lord said to Jonah, Are you greatly grieved?
Jonah went out of city and sat opposite city. He made a shelter for himself there and sat under it in shade until he might see what would happen to city.
Lord God commanded a bottle-gourd, and it grew over Jonah's head to be shade above his head, to shade him from his troubles. Jonah rejoiced over bottle-gourd with great joy.
God commanded a worm early next morning, and it struck bottle-gourd, and it dried up.
When sun rose, God commanded a scorching burning wind, and sun struck Jonah's head, and he grew fainthearted and gave up regarding his life and said, Better for me to die than to live.
God said to Jonah, Are you greatly grieved over bottle-gourd? He said, I am greatly grieved, even unto death.
Lord said, You spared bottle-gourd, over which you did not labor and did not raise, which came to be in a night and perished in a night.
But I, shall I not spare Nineveh, great city, in which dwell more than twelve myriads of human beings who do not know their right hand or their left, and many cattle?
And word of Lord came to Micah the Morasthite in days of Jotham and Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, concerning what he saw about Samaria and Jerusalem.
Hear words, peoples, and let earth and all in it pay attention, and Lord will be among you for witness, Lord from his holy house.
Because behold, Lord goes out from his place and will come down and step upon heights of earth.
And mountains will be shaken beneath him, and valleys will melt like wax before fire and like water carried down on slope.
All these because of impiety of Jacob and because of sin of house of Israel. What is impiety of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what is sin of house of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
And I will make Samaria into hut of field-watchman and planting of vineyard, and I will tear her stones down into chasm and uncover her foundations.

And all her carved things they will cut down, and all her wages they will burn in fire, and all her idols I will make disappear, because from wages of prostitution she gathered them and from wages of prostitution she turned them back.
Because of this she will be cut and mourn; she will go barefoot and naked; she will make lament like dragons and mourning like daughters of sirens.
Because her plague overpowered, because it came as far as Judah and touched gate of my people, as far as Jerusalem.
Those in Gath, do not magnify yourselves. Those in Akeim, do not rebuild. In house of laughter, sprinkle earth over your laughter.
She dwelling well in her cities did not come out, dwelling in Sennaan, to mourn. House adjoining her will receive from you wound of pain.
Who began for good things, while dwelling in pains? Because evils came down from Lord upon gates of Jerusalem.
Sound of chariots and riders, inhabitant of Lachish. She is beginning of sin to daughter of Zion, because impieties of Israel were found in you.
Therefore you will give those sent away as far as inheritance of Gath. Empty houses became emptiness to kings of Israel.
Until I bring heirs to you, inhabitant of Lachish. Glory of daughter of Israel will come as far as Odollam.
Shave and shear for your tender children; widen your widowhood like eagle, because they were taken captive from you.
They became ones devising troubles and working evils on their beds; at dawn they completed them, because they did not lift their hands to God.
And they coveted fields and plundered orphans and oppressed houses and plundered a man and his house, a man and his inheritance.
Therefore thus says Lord: Behold, I devise evils against this tribe, from which you will not remove your necks, and you will not walk upright suddenly, because time is evil.

In that day a parable will be taken up against you and lamented in song, saying, Misery, we were made miserable. Portion of my people was measured with line, and there was no one to hinder him from turning it back; our fields were divided.
Therefore there will not be for you one casting line by lot in assembly of Lord.
Do not weep with tears, and let them not weep over these things, because reproaches will not be put away.
O house of Jacob, saying, Has spirit of Lord been provoked? Are these his practices? Are not his words good with him, and have they walked uprightly?
But before, my people stood up as enemy against his peace; they stripped off his skin to remove shattered hope of war.
Therefore leaders of my people will be cast out from their houses of luxury; because of their evil practices they were driven out. Come near, everlasting mountains.
Rise and go, because this is not your rest. Because of uncleanness you were ruined with destruction.
You were pursued by no pursuer. Spirit set falsehood and dripped to you into wine and strong drink, and it will be from drop of this people.

Jacob will surely be gathered with all; I will surely receive remnant of Israel. I will set their turning together like sheep in distress, like flock in midst of their fold; they will spring out from humans.
By the breach before their face they breached and passed through gate and went out by it, and their king went out before their face, and Lord will lead them.
And he will say, Hear now these things, leaders of house of Jacob and remnant of house of Israel. Is it not for you to know judgment?
Hating good things and seeking evil things, snatching their skins from off them and their flesh from off their bones,
just as they ate flesh of my people and flayed their skin from off their bones and crushed their bones and cut them up like flesh for kettle and like meat for pot.
Thus they will cry to Lord and he will not hear them, and he will turn his face away from them in that time, because they made evil their practices against them.
Thus says Lord concerning prophets leading my people astray, biting with their teeth and proclaiming peace over him; if nothing was given into their mouth, they raised war against him.
Therefore night from vision will be for you, and darkness from divination will be for you, and sun will go down upon prophets and day will grow dark over them.
And seers of dreams will be put to shame and diviners laughed to scorn, and all will speak against them, because there will be no one hearing them.
But I am filled with strength by the Spirit of the Lord and with judgment and power, to declare to Jacob his impiety and to Israel his sins.
Hear now these things, leaders of house of Jacob and remnant of house of Israel, hating judgment and twisting all straight things,
building Zion in bloods and Jerusalem in injustices.
Her leaders judged with gifts, her priests answered for wages, her prophets divined for silver, and they relied on Lord saying, Is not Lord among us? Evils will certainly not come upon us.
Therefore because of you Zion will be plowed like field and Jerusalem will be as hut of field-watchman and mountain of house as grove of forest.
And it will be in last days, mountain of Lord will be manifest, prepared on tops of mountains and lifted above hills, and peoples will hasten to it.

And many nations will go and say, Come, let us go up to mountain of Lord and to house of God of Jacob, and they will show us his way and we will walk in his paths, because law will go out from Zion and word of Lord from Jerusalem.

And he will judge among many peoples and reprove strong nations as far as far land, and they will beat their swords into plows and their spears into sickles, and nation will no longer lift sword against nation, and they will no longer learn to make war.
And each will rest under his vine and each under his fig tree, and there will be no one frightening, because mouth of Lord Almighty spoke these things.
Because all peoples will walk, each in his own way, but we will walk in the name of the Lord our God forever and beyond.
In that day, says Lord, I will gather the crushed one and receive the driven-out and those whom I rejected.
And I will make the crushed one a remnant and the driven-out a strong nation, and Lord will reign over them in mount Zion from now and forever.
And you, tower of flock, dim daughter of Zion, upon you it will come and first rule will enter, kingdom from Babylon to daughter of Jerusalem.
And now why did you know evils? Was there no king for you, or has your counsel perished, because labor pains seized you like woman birthing?

Be in labor and act like man and draw near, daughter of Zion, like birthing woman, because now you will go out from city and camp in plain and reach to Babylon. There Lord your God will rescue you; there he will redeem you from hand of your enemies.
And now many nations were gathered against you, saying, We will rejoice, and our eyes will look upon Zion.
