But they did not know thought of Lord and did not understand his counsel, because he gathered them like sheaves of threshing floor.

Rise and thresh them, daughter of Zion, because I will make your horns iron and your hoofs bronze, and in them you will crush many nations and devote their multitude to Lord and their strength to Lord of all earth.
Now daughter of Ephraim will be fenced in with fence. He set pressure upon us; with rod they will strike tribes of Israel on jaw.
And you, Bethlehem, house of Ephratha, few are you to be among thousands of Judah; from you one will go out to me to be ruler in Israel, and his goings out are from beginning, from days of age.
Therefore he will give them until time when birthing woman births, and rest of their brothers will return upon sons of Israel.
And he will stand and see and shepherd his flock in strength of the Lord and in glory of the name of the Lord their God. They will remain, because now he will be made great to the ends of the earth.
And this will be peace when Assyrian comes upon your land and steps upon your country. And seven shepherds and eight bites of men will be raised up against him.
And they will shepherd Assyria with sword and land of Nimrod in its trench, and he will rescue from Assyria when he comes upon your land and steps upon your borders.
And remnant of Jacob among nations, in midst of many peoples, will be like dew from Lord falling and like lambs upon grass, so that no one might be gathered and no one stand among sons of men.

And remnant of Jacob among nations and in midst of many peoples will be like lion among beasts of forest and like lion-cub among flocks of sheep, which when he passes through and divides will seize and there is no rescuer.
Your hand will be lifted upon those distressing you, and all your enemies will be destroyed.
And it will be in that day, says Lord, I will destroy your horses from your midst and destroy your chariots.
And I will destroy cities of your land and remove all your strongholds.
And I will remove your sorceries from your hands, and there will be no omen-speakers in you.
And I will destroy your carved images and your pillars from your midst, and you will no longer worship works of your hands.
And I will cut down your groves from your midst and make your cities disappear.
And I will do vengeance in anger and wrath among nations because they did not hear.
Hear now word of Lord. Lord said, Rise, plead with mountains, and let hills hear your voice.
Hear, mountains, judgment of Lord, and ravines, foundations of earth, because Lord has judgment with his people, and with Israel he will dispute.
My people, what did I do to you? Or how did I grieve you? Or how did I trouble you? Answer me.
Because I brought you up from land of Egypt and redeemed you from house of slavery and sent before your face Moses and Aaron and Miriam.
My people, remember what Balak king of Moab planned against you and what Balaam son of Beor answered him, from the reed-ropes to Gilgal, so that righteousness of Lord may be known.
In what shall I overtake Lord? Shall I lay hold of my God Most High? Shall I lay hold of him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
Will Lord accept thousands of rams or tens of thousands of torrents of fat? Shall I give my firstborn for impiety, fruit of my womb for sin of my soul?
He told you, human, what is good, or what the Lord seeks from you: but to do judgment and love mercy and be ready to walk with the Lord your God.
Voice of Lord will be called to city and will save those fearing his name. Hear, tribe, and who will adorn city?
Is there not fire and house of lawless one treasuring unlawful treasures and injustice with arrogance?
Shall lawless one be justified with balance and with bag of deceitful weights?
From these they filled their wealth with impiety, and those inhabiting it spoke lies, and their tongue was exalted in their mouth.
And I will begin to strike you; I will make you disappear for your sins.
You will eat and certainly not be filled, and darkness will be in you, and you will move aside and certainly not be saved, and whoever are saved will be given to sword.
You will sow and certainly not reap; you will press olives and certainly not anoint with oil, and wine and certainly not drink. Statutes of my people will disappear.

And you kept ordinances of Zambri and all works of house of Ahab and walked in their counsels, so that I may give you to destruction and those inhabiting it to hissing, and you will receive reproaches of peoples.
Alas for me, because I became like one gathering stubble in harvest and like gleaning in vintage, with no cluster to eat. Alas, my soul longed for first-ripe fruit.
Because reverent one perished from earth and upright one among humans does not exist. All judge for bloods; each oppresses his neighbor with oppression.
For evil they prepare their hands. Ruler asks, and judge spoke peaceful words. Desire of his soul is there, and I will remove it.
Their best one is like moth devouring, and walking on measuring line. In day of your watch—woe, woe—your avengings came; now their weepings will be.
Do not trust in friends and do not hope in rulers. From woman lying in your bosom guard yourself from entrusting anything to her.
Because son dishonors father, daughter will rise against her mother, bride against her mother-in-law; enemies of a man are all men in his house.
But I will look to Lord; I will wait for God my savior; my God will hear me.
Do not rejoice over me, my enemy, because I fell and will rise. Because if I sit in darkness, Lord will give light to me.
I will bear wrath of Lord because I sinned against him, until he justifies my case and does my judgment, and he will bring me out to light; I will see his righteousness.
And my enemy will see and shame will clothe her, she saying to me, Where is Lord your God? My eyes will look upon her; now she will be for trampling like mud in roads.
Day of smearing brick, your wiping away—that day, and your statutes will be rubbed away.
That day and your cities will come to leveling and to partition of Assyrians, and your fortified cities to partition from Tyre to river of Syria, a day of water and turmoil.
And earth will be for destruction with those inhabiting it, because of fruits of their practices.
Shepherd your people with your rod, sheep of your inheritance, dwelling by themselves in forest in midst of Carmel; they will pasture Basan and Gilead as days of age.
According to days of your departure from Egypt, you will see wonders.
Nations will see and be ashamed from all their strength; they will put hands on mouth, and their ears will be deafened.
They will lick dust like snakes dragging earth; they will be confounded in their enclosure. At Lord our God they will be amazed and fear because of you.
Who is God like you, removing injustices and passing over impiety for remnant of his inheritance? He did not hold back his anger for witness, because he delights in mercy.
He will turn and pity us; he will sink our injustices, and all our sins will be cast into depths of sea.
You will give truth to Jacob and mercy to Abraham, just as you swore to our fathers in former days.
Oracle of Nineveh. Book of vision of Nahum the Elkesaite.
God is jealous and avenging; the Lord avenges with wrath. The Lord avenges his adversaries, and he removes his enemies.
The Lord is long-suffering, and great is his strength, and acquitting he will not acquit. The Lord's way is in destruction and in the whirlwind, and clouds are dust of his feet.
Threatening sea and drying it up, and making all rivers desolate. Basanitis and Carmel grew scant, and blossoms of Lebanon failed.
Mountains were shaken from before him, and hills were moved, and earth was pulled up from before him, the whole inhabited land and all dwelling in it.
From before his anger who will stand? And who will resist in anger of his wrath? His wrath melts rulers, and rocks were crushed from him.
Lord good to those waiting for him in day of distress, and knowing those revering him.
With overflowing flood he will make an end of those rising up, and darkness will pursue his enemies.
What do you plot against Lord? He himself will make an end; he will not take vengeance twice upon same thing in distress.
Because to their foundation they will be made desolate, and like tangled bindweed they will be devoured, like stubble full of dryness.
From you one thinking evil against Lord will come out, devising hostile things.
Thus says the Lord, who rules over many waters: Even thus they will be sent away, and your report will no longer be heard.
Now I will break his rod from upon you, and your bonds I will tear apart.
And the Lord will command concerning you: your name will no longer be sown. From house of your god I will destroy carved and cast images. I will make your grave, because you are vile.

Behold, on mountains feet of one bringing good news and announcing peace. Celebrate your feasts, Judah; pay your vows, because they will no longer continue to pass through you into decay. It has been completed; it has been removed.
Rise, one breathing in your face, rescuing from distress. Watch road, strengthen waist, arm yourself with great strength.
Because Lord turned back arrogance of Jacob, like arrogance of Israel, because those shaking them out shook them out, and ruined their branches.
Weapons of their rule are from men, mighty men mocking in fire. Reins of their chariots are in day of his preparation, and horsemen will be thrown into confusion.
In roads chariots will be thrown together and entangled in open places. Their appearance is like fiery torches and running like lightning.
Their nobles will remember and flee by day and grow weak in their march, and they will hurry to walls and prepare their watch-posts.
Gates of rivers were opened, and palace fell.
Foundation was laid bare, and she herself went up, and her slave-girls were led away like doves cooing in their hearts.
Nineveh was like a pool of water, her waters, yet they flee and did not stop, and there was no one looking back.
They kept plundering silver, plundering gold, and there was no end to her adornment. They were weighed down with all her desirable vessels.
Shaking-out and overturning and boiling-over, breaking of hearts and loosening of knees, pains upon every waist, and faces of all like scorching of a pot.
Where is dwelling of lions and pasture-place for cubs, where lion went to enter there, lion's cub, and no one frightening?
Lion snatched enough for his cubs and strangled for his lionesses and filled his lairs with prey and his dwelling with spoil.

Behold, I am against you, says Lord Almighty, and I will burn your multitude in smoke, and sword will devour your lions, and I will destroy your prey from earth, and your works will no longer be heard.
Woe, city of bloods, wholly false, full of injustice. Prey will not cease.
Sound of whips and sound of rattling wheels and pursuing horse and jolting chariot,
and charging horseman and gleaming sword and flashing weapons and multitude of wounded and heavy fall. There was no end to her nations, and they will grow weak in their bodies.
Because of multitude of prostitutions of prostitute, beautiful and pleasing, leading sorceries, selling nations by her prostitution and tribes by her sorceries.
Behold, I am against you, says Lord God Almighty, and I will uncover your backside to your face and show nations your shame and kingdoms your dishonor.
I will throw abomination on you according to your uncleanness and make you an example.
And everyone seeing you will spring away from you and say, Wretched Nineveh, who will groan for her? From where will I seek comfort for her?
Prepare your portion, fit the cord, prepare a portion for Ammon who dwells among rivers, with water around her, whose beginning was sea and water her walls.
Ethiopia was her strength, and Egypt, and there was no limit to her flight, and Libyans became her helpers.
Yet she will go into exile, captive, and her infants they will dash upon heads of all her roads, and over all her honored ones they will cast lots, and all her great men will be bound in fetters.
You also will be drunk and overlooked, and you also will seek for yourself a stand against enemies.
All your fortresses are fig trees with watchers; if they are shaken, they fall into mouth of eater.
Behold, your people are as women in you. To your enemies gates of your land will be opened wide; fire will devour your bars.
Draw water for siege for yourself and seize your fortresses. Step into clay and be trampled in chaff; strengthen brickwork.
There fire will devour you; sword will destroy you; it will devour you like locust. Become numerous like grasshopper.
You multiplied your trading more than stars of heaven. Grasshopper rushed on and flew away.
Your mixed multitude leaped like locust, like grasshopper settled on a fence in days of frost. Sun rose and it flew away, and it did not know its place. Woe to them.
Your shepherds slumbered, Assyrian king; your mighty men went to sleep. Your people departed on mountains, and there was no one gathering them.
There is no healing for your crushing; your wound blazed up. All hearing your report will clap hands over you, because upon whom has your evil not come continually?
Oracle that Habakkuk prophet saw.
How long, Lord, will I cry out and you not hear? I will shout to you while being wronged, and you will not save.
Why did you show me troubles and pains, to look upon misery and impiety? Judgment has come opposite me, and judge receives.
Because of this law has ceased, and judgment does not go forth to the end, because impious one overpowers righteous one; because of this judgment will go forth perverted.
Look, despisers, and watch and marvel wondrously and disappear, because I work a work in your days that you will certainly not believe if one tells it.
Because behold, I raise up against you Chaldeans, the fighting nation, bitter and swift, going over breadths of earth to inherit tents not theirs.
It is fearsome and prominent; its judgment will come from itself, and its burden will go out from itself.
Its horses will leap faster than leopards and keener than wolves of Arabia, and its horsemen will ride out and rush from far away and fly like eagle eager to eat.
An end will come for impious ones, opposing their faces from before, and it will gather captivity like sand.
And it will make sport of kings, and tyrants are its plaything, and it will mock every fortress and cast up earth and seize it.
Then spirit will change and pass through and make atonement. This strength belongs to my God.
Are you not from the beginning, Lord my God, my Holy One? And surely we shall not die. Lord, you appointed him for judgment, and he formed me to reprove his discipline.
Your eye is clean from seeing evils, and you cannot look on hardships. Why do you look on those despising and keep silent when impious one swallows righteous?
And you will make humans like fish of sea and like creeping things that have no leader.
He drew up an end with hook and dragged him in his net and gathered him in his seines. Because of this his heart will be glad and rejoice.
Because of this he will sacrifice to his seine and burn incense to his net, because in them his portion was fattened and his foods are choice.
Because of this he will cast his net, and continually to kill nations he will not spare.
I will stand on my guard-post and step upon rock and watch to see what he will speak in me and what I will answer concerning my reproof.
And Lord answered me and said, Write vision and make it clear on tablet, so that reader may run with it.
Because vision is still for time, and it will rise to end and not for emptiness. If it delays, wait for it, because coming it will come and certainly not tarry.
If he should draw back, my soul has no pleasure in him; but the righteous one will live by my faith.

But wine-drinker and contemptuous man, boaster, will certainly accomplish nothing. He widened his soul like Hades, and like death he is not filled, and he will gather to himself all nations and receive to himself all peoples.
Will not all these take up proverb against him and riddle for his tale and say, Woe to one multiplying what is not his, how long? and making his yoke heavy with thickness.
Because suddenly those biting him will rise, and your plotters will awake, and you will be plunder to them.
Because you plundered many nations, all remaining peoples will plunder you, because of blood of humans and impiety of land and city and all dwelling in it.
Woe to one grasping evil grasping for his house, to set his nest on high, to be torn away from hand of evils.
You planned shame for your house; you finished many peoples, and your soul sinned.
Because stone from wall will cry out, and beam from timber will speak these things.
Woe to one building city in bloods and preparing city in injustices.
Are not these things from Lord Almighty? Strong peoples failed in fire, and many nations grew fainthearted.
Because earth will be filled to know glory of Lord as water will cover them.
Woe to one giving drink to his neighbor, a muddy overthrow, and making him drunk so as to look on their caves.
You were filled with dishonor instead of glory. Drink, you too, and be shaken. Cup of Lord's right hand has gone around to you, and dishonor gathered upon your glory.
Because impiety of Lebanon will cover you, and misery of beasts will terrify you, because of blood of humans and impiety of land and city and all dwelling in it.
What profit is carved image, because they carved it? They made cast image, false imagination, because maker trusted in his creation to make dumb idols.
Woe to one saying to wood, Awake, rise up, and to stone, Be lifted. And this is imagination. It is plated with gold and silver, and no spirit is in it.
But Lord is in his holy temple; let all earth fear before him.
Prayer of Habakkuk prophet, with song.

Lord, I heard your report and feared. I considered your works and was astonished. You will be known between the two living creatures; you will be acknowledged when the years draw near; you will be manifested when the time is come. When my soul is troubled, in wrath you will remember mercy.
God will come from Teman, and Holy One from overshadowing wooded mountain. Pause. His excellence covered heavens, and earth was full of his praise.
And his brightness will be like light; horns in his hands, and there he set strong love of his might.
Before his face word will go, and his feet will go out in sandals.
He stood and earth was shaken; he looked and nations melted. Mountains were shattered by force; everlasting hills melted.
I saw tents of Ethiopians instead of hardships; tents of land of Midian will be terrified.
Were you angry at rivers, Lord? Or is your wrath in rivers? Or your charge in sea? Because you ride on your horses, and your riding is salvation.
Stretching you will stretch your bow upon scepters, says Lord. Pause. Earth will be split by rivers.
Peoples will see you and writhe; scattering waters in his march, abyss gave its voice, height of its form.
Sun was lifted up, moon stood in its order. To light your missiles will go, to brightness of lightning of your weapons.
In threat you will diminish earth, and in wrath break down nations.
You went out for salvation of your people, to save your anointed ones. You cast death upon heads of lawless ones and raised bonds to neck. Pause.
You cut through in astonishment heads of mighty ones; they will be shaken in it. They will open their bridles as one eating poor one secretly.
And you mounted your horses into sea, troubling much water.

I kept watch and my belly was terrified at sound of prayer of my lips, and trembling entered my bones, and under me my habit was disturbed. I will rest in day of distress, to go up among people of my sojourning.
Because fig tree will not bear fruit and produce will not be in vines; work of olive will fail and fields will make no food; sheep failed from fodder and there are no oxen at mangers.
But I will exult in Lord; I will rejoice in God my savior.
Lord God is my strength, and he will set my feet to completion. Upon heights set me, to conquer in his song.
Word of Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Godolias, son of Amarias, son of Hezekias, in days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah.
Let all things utterly fail from face of earth, says Lord.
Let human and cattle fail; let birds of heaven and fish of sea fail, and I will take humans away from face of earth, says Lord.
And I will stretch out my hand upon Judah and upon all inhabiting Jerusalem, and I will remove from this place names of Baal and names of the priests,
and those worshiping on housetops army of heaven and those swearing by Lord and those swearing by their king,
and those turning aside from Lord and those not seeking Lord and not clinging to Lord.
Stand in awe before the Lord God, because day of the Lord is near, because the Lord prepared his sacrifice; he consecrated his called ones.
And it will be in day of the Lord's sacrifice: I will take vengeance on the rulers and on the king's house and on all wearing foreign garments.
And I will avenge openly upon the porches in that day, those filling house of Lord their God with impiety and deceit.
And it will be in that day, says Lord, sound of cry from gate of attackers and wailing from the Second Quarter and great crushing from hills.
Lament, inhabitants of the Cut-place, because all people of Canaan have become like nothing; all lifted up with silver were destroyed.
And it will be in that day, I will search Jerusalem with lamp and avenge upon men despising on their watch-posts, those saying in their hearts, Lord will not do good, and he will not do harm.
And their strength will be for plunder and their houses for disappearance, and they will build houses and certainly not dwell in them and plant vineyards and certainly not drink their wine.
Because great day of Lord is near, near and very swift. Voice of Lord's day bitter and hard, appointed strong.
That day is day of wrath, day of distress and necessity, day of untimeliness and disappearance, day of darkness and gloom, day of cloud and mist,
day of trumpet and cry against fortified cities and against lofty corners.
And I will press humans, and they will walk as blind, because they sinned against Lord, and he will pour out their blood like dust and their flesh like dung.

And their silver and their gold will certainly not be able to rescue them in day of Lord's wrath, and in fire of his zeal all earth will be consumed, because he will make complete and hurried end upon all inhabiting earth.
Gather together and be bound together, undisciplined nation,
before you come to be like passing flower, before Lord's wrath comes upon you, before day of Lord's anger comes upon you.
Seek Lord, all humble of earth, who have done his judgment. Seek righteousness; seek humility. It may be that you will be sheltered in day of Lord's wrath.
Because Gaza will be plundered, and Ascalon will be for destruction, and Azotus will be cast out at noon, and Accaron uprooted.
Woe, inhabitants of tract of sea, resident Cretans. Word of Lord is upon you, Canaan, land of foreigners, and I will destroy you from habitation.
And Crete will be pasture of flocks and sheepfold.

And tract of sea will belong to remnant of house of Judah. Upon them they will pasture; in houses of Ascalon at evening they will lodge before sons of Judah, because Lord their God visited them and turned back their captivity.
I heard reproaches of Moab and taunts of sons of Ammon, with which they reproached my people and magnified themselves against my borders.

Therefore, as I live, says Lord of forces, God of Israel, Moab will be as Sodom and sons of Ammon as Gomorrah, and Damascus left behind like heap of threshing-floor and desolated forever; remnant of my people will plunder them, and remnant of my nation will inherit them.
This to them in return for their arrogance, because they reproached and magnified themselves against Lord Almighty.
Lord will appear against them and destroy all gods of nations of earth, and all islands of nations will worship him, each from his place.
And you Ethiopians are wounded by my sword.
And he will stretch out his hand against north and destroy Assyrian and make Nineveh into disappearance, waterless as desert.

And flocks will pasture in her midst and all beasts of earth, and chameleons and hedgehogs will lie in her carved places, and beasts will cry out in her ditches, ravens in her gates, because cedar is her height.

This is city that made light, dwelling in hope, saying in her heart, I am, and there is none besides me. How she became for destruction, pasture of beasts. Everyone passing through her will hiss and wave his hands.
O famous and redeemed city, the dove.
She did not listen to voice, did not accept correction, in Lord she did not trust, and to her God she did not draw near.
Her rulers within her are as roaring lions; her judges as wolves of Arabia, not leaving anything till morning.
Her prophets are spirit-borne men, contemptuous; her priests profane holy things and act impiously against law.
But the Lord is righteous in her midst and will certainly not do injustice. Morning by morning he gives his judgment to the light; it does not fail, but unjust one knows no shame.
In destruction I pulled down proud ones; their corners disappeared. I will make their roads desolate, utterly not traversed; their cities failed, with no one existing or dwelling.
I said, Yet fear me and receive correction, and you will certainly not be destroyed from before her, all that I avenged upon her. Prepare, rise early; all their gleaning is corrupted.

Therefore wait for me, says Lord, for day of my rising for witness, because my judgment is for gatherings of nations, to receive kings, to pour out upon them all anger of my wrath, because in fire of my zeal all earth will be consumed.
Because then I will turn toward peoples a tongue for its generation, for all to call on name of Lord, to serve him under one yoke.
From ends of rivers of Ethiopia they will bring sacrifices to me.

In that day you will certainly not be put to shame because of all practices by which you acted impiously against me, because then I will remove from you scornings of your arrogance, and you will no longer continue to boast on my holy mountain.
And I will leave in you a people gentle and humble, and they will fear name of Lord.

Remnant of Israel will not do injustice and will not speak vain things, and no deceitful tongue will be found in their mouth, because they will pasture and lie down and there will be no one frightening them.
Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion; proclaim, daughter Jerusalem; be glad and delight with all your heart, daughter Jerusalem.
Lord removed your injustices and redeemed you from hand of your enemies. Lord, king of Israel, is in your midst; you will no longer see evils.
In that time Lord will say to Jerusalem, Take courage, Zion; let not your hands grow slack.
Lord your God in you, mighty, will save you; he will bring joy upon you and renew you in his love and rejoice over you in delight as on feast day.
And I will gather the crushed ones. Woe, who took reproach upon her?
Behold, I act in you for your sake in that time, says Lord, and I will save the oppressed one and receive the driven-out one, and I will set them for boast and renowned in all earth.

And they will be put to shame in that time when I do well to you and when I receive you, because I will make you renowned and for boast among all peoples of earth, when I turn back your captivity before you, says Lord.

In second year of Darius king, in sixth month, on first day of month, word of Lord came by hand of Haggai prophet, saying: Speak now to Zerubbabel son of Salathiel from tribe of Judah, and to Jeshua son of Josedek, the great priest, saying,
Thus says Lord Almighty: This people says, Time has not yet come to build house of Lord.
Word of Lord came by hand of Haggai prophet, saying,
Is it time for you to dwell in your paneled houses while this house lies desolate?
Now thus says Lord Almighty: Set your hearts on your ways.

You sowed much and brought in little; you ate and not to fullness; you drank and not to drunkenness; you clothed yourselves and were not warmed in them; and one gathering wages gathered into a pierced purse.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Set your hearts on your ways.
Go up to mountain, cut wood, and build house, and I will take pleasure in it and be glorified, says Lord.

You looked for much, and it became little, and it was brought into house, and I blew it away. Because of what? says Lord Almighty. Because my house is desolate, while you each hurry to your own house.
Therefore sky will hold back from dew, and land will hold back its produce.
I will bring sword upon land and upon mountains and upon grain and upon wine and upon oil and upon what ground brings forth and upon people and cattle and upon all labors of their hands.

Zerubbabel son of Salathiel, from tribe of Judah, and Jeshua son of Josedek, the great priest, and all remnant of people, listened to voice of Lord their God and to words of Haggai prophet, because Lord their God sent him to them, and people feared before Lord.
Haggai, messenger of the Lord, said to the people, I am with you, says the Lord.

The Lord stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Salathiel from tribe of Judah, and the spirit of Jeshua son of Josedek the great priest, and the spirit of remnant of all the people, and they entered and were doing works in the house of the Lord Almighty their God,
on twenty-fourth day of sixth month, in second year of Darius king.
In seventh month, on twenty-first day of month, Lord spoke by hand of Haggai prophet, saying,
Speak now to Zerubbabel son of Salathiel from tribe of Judah, and to Jeshua son of Josedek the great priest, and to all remnant of people, saying,
Who among you saw this house in its former glory? And how do you see it now? Is it not as though not existing before you?
But now be strong, Zerubbabel, says Lord, and be strong, Jeshua son of Josedek, the great priest, and let all people of land be strong, says Lord, and act, because I am with you, says Lord Almighty.
And my spirit stands in midst of you; take courage.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Yet once I will shake heaven and earth and sea and dry land.
I will shake all nations, and chosen things of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Lord Almighty.
Silver is mine, and gold is mine, says Lord Almighty.

Latter glory of this house will be greater than first, says Lord Almighty, and in this place I will give peace, says Lord Almighty, and peace of soul for preservation to everyone building to raise this temple.
On twenty-fourth day of ninth month, in second year of Darius, word of Lord came to Haggai prophet, saying,
Thus says Lord Almighty: Ask priests about law, saying,
If a man takes holy flesh in fold of his garment and edge of garment touches bread or cooked food or wine or oil or any food, will it be made holy? Priests answered and said, No.
Haggai said, If one defiled by a corpse touches any of these, will it be defiled? Priests answered and said, It will be defiled.

Haggai answered and said, So is this people and so is this nation before me, says Lord, and so are all works of their hands, and whatever approaches there will be defiled. Because of their early spoil they will be pained before their labors, and you hated those rebuking in gates.
And now set this on your hearts from this day and upward, before stone was set upon stone in temple of Lord.
What were you when you put into heap twenty seahs of barley and it became ten, and you went into wine-vat to draw fifty measures and there became twenty?
I struck you with barrenness and blight and hail, all works of your hands, and you did not turn to me, says Lord.
Submit your hearts now from this day and onward, from twenty-fourth day of ninth month and from day when temple of Lord was founded; set it in your hearts.
Is seed still known on threshing-floor? And if vine and fig tree and pomegranate and olive trees that do not bear fruit, from this day I will bless.
Word of Lord came second time to Haggai prophet on twenty-fourth day of month, saying,
Speak to Zerubbabel son of Salathiel from tribe of Judah, saying: I shake heaven and earth and sea and dry land,
and I will overturn thrones of kings and destroy strength of kings of nations and overturn chariots and riders, and horses and riders will come down, each by sword of his brother.
In that day, says Lord Almighty, I will take you, Zerubbabel son of Salathiel, my servant, says Lord, and place you like a seal, because I chose you, says Lord Almighty.
In eighth month of second year of Darius, word of Lord came to Zechariah son of Barachias, son of Addo, the prophet, saying,
Lord was angry with your fathers with great anger.
And you will say to them, Thus says Lord Almighty: Return to me, and I will return to you, says Lord.

And do not become like your fathers, to whom former prophets called, saying, Thus says Lord Almighty: Turn from your evil ways and from your evil practices. But they did not pay attention to hear me, says Lord.
Where are your fathers? And will prophets live forever?

Yet receive my words and my statutes, whatever I command in my Spirit to my servants the prophets, which overtook your fathers. And they answered and said, Just as Lord Almighty was arrayed to do according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has done to us.
On twenty-fourth day of eleventh month, this is month Sabat, in second year of Darius, word of Lord came to Zechariah son of Barachias, son of Addo, the prophet, saying,
I saw by night, and behold, a man mounted on red horse, and he stood between two shadowed mountains, and behind him were red, dappled, varied, and white horses.
And I said, What are these, lord? And angel speaking in me said to me, I will show you what these are.
And man standing between mountains answered and said to me, These are ones Lord sent to patrol earth.
And they answered angel of Lord standing between mountains and said, We have patrolled all earth, and behold, all earth is inhabited and at rest.
And the angel of the Lord answered and said, Lord Almighty, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, which you overlooked this seventieth year?
And Lord Almighty answered angel speaking in me with good words and consoling sayings.
And angel speaking in me said to me, Cry out, saying, Thus says Lord Almighty: I have been jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with great jealousy,
and with great anger I am angry against nations joining attack, because I was angry a little, but they joined in for evils.
Therefore thus says Lord: I will return to Jerusalem with compassion, and my house will be rebuilt in her, says Lord Almighty, and measuring line will still be stretched over Jerusalem.
And angel speaking with me said to me, Cry out, saying, Thus says Lord Almighty: Cities will still overflow with good things, and Lord will still have mercy on Zion and still choose Jerusalem.
And I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.
And I said to angel speaking in me, What are these, lord? And he said to me, These are horns that scattered Judah and Israel.
And Lord showed me four craftsmen.

And I said, What are these coming to do? And he said to me, These are horns that scattered Judah and Israel; they broke them down, and no one lifted head among them. And these came to sharpen them in their hands, the four horns, the nations lifting horn against land of Lord to scatter it.
And I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, a man, and in his hand a measuring line.
And I said to him, Where are you going? And he said to me, To measure Jerusalem, to see how great its width is and how great its length.
And behold, angel speaking in me stood, and another angel went out to meet him,
and said to him, Run, and speak to that young man, saying: Jerusalem will be inhabited fruitfully because of multitude of humans and cattle in her midst.
And I will be to her, says Lord, a wall of fire all around, and I will be glory in her midst.
Ho, ho, flee from land of north, says Lord, because from four winds of heaven I will gather you, says Lord.
To Zion, be rescued, you dwelling with daughter Babylon.
Because thus says Lord Almighty: After glory he sent me against nations that plundered you, because one touching you is like one touching pupil of his eye.
Because behold, I bring my hand upon them, and they will be plunder to those serving them, and you will know that Lord Almighty sent me.
Delight and rejoice, daughter Zion, because behold, I come and will camp in your midst, says Lord.
And many nations will flee for refuge to Lord in that day and will be for him a people, and they will camp in your midst, and you will know that Lord Almighty sent me to you.
And Lord will inherit Judah, his portion, upon holy land, and he will still choose Jerusalem.
Let all flesh fear from face of Lord, because he has been roused from his holy clouds.
And he showed me Jeshua the great priest standing before angel of Lord, and slanderer stood at his right hand to oppose him.
And Lord said to slanderer, Lord rebuke you, slanderer; yes, Lord rebuke you, he who chose Jerusalem. Is not this like a firebrand pulled from fire?
And Jeshua was clothed in filthy garments and stood before angel.
And he answered and said to those standing before him, saying, Take away filthy garments from him. And he said to him, Behold, I took away your lawless deeds, and clothe him in full robe.
And put clean turban on his head. And they clothed him with garments and put clean turban on his head, and angel of Lord stood by.
And angel of Lord solemnly testified to Jeshua, saying,

Thus says Lord Almighty: If you walk in my ways and keep my commands, then you also will judge my house, and if you guard my court, I will give you those walking about in midst of these standing here.
Hear now, Jeshua the great priest, you and your companions sitting before your face, because they are men who observe signs. Because behold, I bring my servant Dawn.
Because stone that I gave before face of Jeshua—upon the one stone are seven eyes. Behold, I dig a pit, says Lord Almighty, and I will search out all injustice of that land in one day.
In that day, says Lord Almighty, each will call his neighbor under vine and under fig tree.
And angel speaking in me returned and woke me, like when a man is wakened from sleep.
And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, I saw, and behold, a lampstand, all golden, and lamp-bowl on top of it, and seven lamps upon it, and seven spouts for lamps upon it.
And two olive trees above it, one at right of lamp-bowl and one at left.
And I asked and said to angel speaking in me, What are these, lord?
And angel speaking in me answered and said to me, Do you not know what these are? And I said, No, lord.
And he answered and said to me: This is word of Lord to Zerubbabel, saying: Not by great power nor by might, but by my Spirit, says Lord Almighty.
Who are you, great mountain, before face of Zerubbabel to make things straight? And I will bring out stone of inheritance: equality of grace, grace to it.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Hands of Zerubbabel founded this house, and his hands will complete it, and you will know that Lord Almighty sent me to you.
Because who despised days of small things? They will rejoice and see tin-stone in hand of Zerubbabel. These seven are eyes of Lord, looking over all earth.
And I answered and said to him, What are these two olive trees at right of lampstand and at left?
And I asked a second time and said to him, What are two olive branches in hands of two golden nozzles that pour out and bring back golden spouts?
And he said to me, Do you not know what these are? And I said, No, lord.
And he said, These are two sons of richness, standing beside Lord of all earth.
And I turned and lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying sickle.
And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, I see a flying sickle, twenty cubits its length and ten cubits its width.
And he said to me, This is curse going out over face of all earth, because every thief will be avenged from this unto death, and every perjurer will be avenged from this unto death.

And I will bring it out, says Lord Almighty, and it will enter house of thief and house of one swearing falsely by my name, and it will lodge in midst of his house and consume it, its timbers and its stones.
And angel speaking in me went out and said to me, Lift up your eyes and see what this thing is that goes out.
And I said, What is it? And he said, This is measure that goes out. And he said, This is their injustice in all earth.
And behold, a talent of lead being lifted, and behold, one woman sat in midst of measure.
And he said, This is lawlessness. And he threw her into midst of measure and threw lead stone onto its mouth.
And I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, two women coming out, and wind in their wings, and they had wings like wings of hoopoe, and they lifted measure between earth and sky.
And I said to angel speaking in me, Where are they carrying measure?
And he said to me, To build a house for it in land of Babylon, and prepare it, and they will set it there on its prepared base.
And I turned and lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, four chariots going out from between two mountains, and mountains were bronze mountains.
In first chariot were red horses, and in second chariot black horses,
and in third chariot white horses, and in fourth chariot varied dappled horses.
And I answered and said to angel speaking in me, What are these, lord?
And angel speaking in me answered and said, These are four winds of heaven, going out to stand before Lord of all earth.
Where black horses were, they went out to land of north, and white went out behind them, and varied went out to land of south.
And dappled went out and looked to go, to patrol earth. And he said, Go, patrol earth. And they patrolled earth.
And he cried out and spoke to me, saying, Behold, those going out to land of north gave rest to my wrath in land of north.
And word of Lord came to me, saying,
Take from captivity, from its rulers and from its useful men and from those knowing it, and you shall enter on that day into house of Josiah son of Sophonias, who came from Babylon.
And you shall take silver and gold and make crowns and place them on head of Jeshua son of Josedek, the great priest.
And you shall say to him, Thus says Lord Almighty: Behold, a man—Dawn is his name—and from beneath him he will rise, and he will build house of Lord.
And he will receive excellence and sit and rule on his throne, and priest will be at his right, and peaceful counsel will be between both.
And crown will belong to those waiting and to its useful ones and to those knowing it and for favor to son of Sophonias and for memorial in house of Lord.
And those far from them will come and build in house of Lord, and you will know that Lord Almighty sent me to you. And it will be, if hearing you hear voice of Lord your God.
And it happened in fourth year of Darius king, word of Lord came to Zechariah on fourth day of ninth month, which is Chasleu.
And he sent to Bethel Sarasar and Arbeseer the king and his men to make atonement to Lord,
saying to priests in house of Lord Almighty and to prophets, saying, Has sanctification entered here in fifth month, as I have done already many years?
And word of Lord of forces came to me, saying,
Say to all people of land and to priests, saying: If you fasted or mourned in fifth month or in seventh month, behold, for seventy years, was it for me you fasted?
And if you eat and if you drink, are you not eating and drinking for yourselves?
Are not these words that Lord spoke by hand of former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and prospering, and her cities round about, and hill-country and lowland were inhabited?
And word of Lord came to Zechariah, saying,
Thus says Lord Almighty: Judge righteous judgment, and do mercy and compassion, each toward his brother.
And do not oppress widow and orphan and sojourner and poor, and let none remember evil of his brother in your hearts.
And they disobeyed paying attention and gave a rebellious back and made their ears heavy so as not to hear.
And they set their hearts in disobedience so as not to hear my law and the words that the Lord Almighty sent by his Spirit through the former prophets, and great wrath came from the Lord Almighty.
And it will be, just as he spoke and they did not hear, so they will cry out and I will not hear, says Lord Almighty.
And I will cast them out among all nations whom they did not know, and land behind them was made desolate from anyone passing through or returning, and they made delightful land into destruction.
And word of Lord Almighty came, saying,
Thus says Lord Almighty: I have been jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and in great wrath I was jealous for her.
Thus says Lord: I will return to Zion and dwell in midst of Jerusalem, and Jerusalem will be called city of truth and mountain of Lord Almighty, holy mountain.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Old men and old women will again dwell in streets of Jerusalem, each with staff in hand because of multitude of days.
And city's streets will be filled with boys and girls playing in its streets.
Thus says Lord Almighty: If this is impossible before remnant of this people in those days, will it also be impossible before me? says Lord Almighty.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Behold, I save my people from land of east and from land of setting sun,
and I will bring them in, and they will dwell in midst of Jerusalem, and they will be my people, and I will be their God in truth and righteousness.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Let your hands be strengthened, you hearing in these days these words from mouth of prophets, from days when house of Lord Almighty was founded and temple was for building.

Because before those days wages of humans were not for profit, and wages of cattle were not, and for one going out and coming in there was no peace from enemy, and I sent all humans, each against his neighbor.
And now I will not be to remnant of this people as in former days, says Lord Almighty.
Because I will show peace: vine will give its fruit, land will give its produce, and heaven will give its dew, and I will give all these things to remnant of my people to inherit.
And it will be, just as you were a curse among nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you and you will be a blessing. Take courage, and let your hands be strengthened.
Because thus says Lord Almighty: Just as I purposed to afflict you when your fathers provoked me, says Lord Almighty, and I did not repent,
so I have turned and purposed in these days to do good to Jerusalem and house of Judah. Take courage.
These are things you must do: Speak truth, each to his neighbor; judge truth and judgment of peace in your gates.
And let none remember evil of his neighbor in your hearts, and do not love false oath, because all these I hated, says Lord Almighty.
And word of Lord Almighty came to me, saying,
Thus says Lord Almighty: Fast of fourth and fast of fifth and fast of seventh and fast of tenth will be to house of Judah for joy and gladness and good feasts; and love truth and peace.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Peoples will still come, and inhabitants of many cities.
And inhabitants of five cities will come together to one city, saying, Let us go to make supplication before Lord and seek face of Lord Almighty; I too will go.
And many peoples and many nations will come to seek face of Lord Almighty in Jerusalem and to make supplication before Lord.
Thus says Lord Almighty: In those days ten men from every language of nations will seize hem of a Jewish man, saying, We will go with you, because we heard that God is with you.
Oracle of word of Lord in land of Sedrach and Damascus his sacrifice, because Lord looks upon humans and all tribes of Israel,
and Emath at its borders, Tyre and Sidon, because they were very wise.
And Tyre built strongholds for herself and stored silver like dust and gathered gold like mud of roads.
Therefore Lord will inherit her and strike her strength into sea, and she will be consumed in fire.
Ascalon will see and fear, and Gaza will suffer greatly, and Accaron, because she was shamed by her downfall, and king will perish from Gaza, and Ascalon will certainly not be inhabited.
And foreigners will dwell in Azotus, and I will pull down arrogance of foreigners.

And I will remove their blood from their mouth and their abominations from between their teeth, and he will be left also for our God, and they will be like chiliarch in Judah, and Accaron like Jebusite.
And I will stand by my house as guard, that no one may pass through or return, and oppressor will certainly not come upon them again, because now I have seen with my eyes.
Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion; proclaim, daughter Jerusalem: behold, your king comes to you, righteous and saving, he himself meek and mounted upon beast of burden, a young foal.
And he will destroy chariots from Ephraim and horse from Jerusalem, and war-bow will be destroyed, and abundance and peace from nations, and he will rule waters to sea and rivers to ends of earth.
And you, by blood of your covenant, sent out your prisoners from pit having no water.
You prisoners of congregation will sit in stronghold, and in place of one day of your sojourning I will repay you double.
Because I bent Judah for myself as bow, I filled Ephraim, and I will stir up your children, Zion, against children of Greeks, and handle you like sword of warrior.
And Lord will be over them, and his missile will go out like lightning, and Lord Almighty will blow trumpet and go in storm of his threat.
Lord Almighty will shield them, and they will consume them and overwhelm them with sling-stones, and they will drink them like wine and be filled like bowls of altar.
And Lord will save them in that day as sheep, his people, because holy stones roll upon his land.
Because if anything good is his and anything beautiful from him, grain for young men and fragrant wine for virgins.
Ask rain from Lord in season, early and late. Lord made apparitions and will give winter rain to them, to each growth in field.

Because omen-speakers spoke troubles, and diviners false visions, and dreams spoke false things, giving vain comfort. Therefore they were taken away like sheep and afflicted, because there was no healing.
Against shepherds my anger was provoked, and upon lambs I will visit, and Lord God Almighty will visit his flock, house of Judah, and set them like his splendid war horse.
From him he looked out, and from him he arranged, and from him bow in wrath; from him every driver will go out together.
And they will be like warriors trampling mud in roads in battle, and they will line up, because Lord is with them, and riders of horses will be put to shame.

And I will strengthen house of Judah, and house of Joseph I will save and settle them, because I loved them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them, because I am Lord their God and I will hear them.
And they will be like warrior of Ephraim, and their heart will rejoice as in wine, and their children will see and be glad, and their heart will rejoice in Lord.
I will signal to them and receive them, because I will redeem them, and they will be multiplied just as they were many.
And I will sow them among peoples, and those far away will remember me; they will rear their children and return.
And I will return them from land of Egypt, and from Assyrians I will receive them, and into Gilead and Lebanon I will bring them in, and not even one from them will be left behind.
And they will pass through narrow sea and strike waves in sea, and all depths of rivers will dry up, and all arrogance of Assyrians will be removed, and scepter of Egypt taken away.
And I will strengthen them in Lord their God, and in his name they will boast, says Lord.
Open your doors, Lebanon, and let fire devour your cedars.
Let pine howl, because cedar has fallen, because nobles suffered greatly. Howl, oaks of Basan, because dense forest was torn down.
Sound of shepherds mourning, because their greatness has suffered; sound of lions roaring, because Jordan's swelling has suffered.
Thus says Lord Almighty: Shepherd sheep of slaughter,
which their buyers slaughtered and felt no remorse, and those selling them said, Blessed be Lord, and we have grown rich, and their shepherds suffered nothing over them.

Therefore I will no longer spare inhabitants of earth, says Lord, and behold, I hand over humans, each into hand of his neighbor and into hand of his king, and they will cut down earth, and I will certainly not rescue from their hand.
And I will shepherd sheep of slaughter for Canaanitis, and I took for myself two staffs, one I named Beauty, the other I named Measure-line, and I shepherded sheep.
And I removed the three shepherds in one month, and my soul grew heavy upon them, for their souls kept roaring against me.
And I said, I will not shepherd you. What is dying, let it die; what is failing, let it fail; and those left, let each eat flesh of his neighbor.
And I took my staff, the beautiful one, and threw it away to scatter my covenant that I had arranged with all peoples.
And it will be scattered in that day, and Canaanite sheep being kept will know that it is word of Lord.
And I will say to them, If it is good before you, give, setting out my wages; or refuse. And they set my wages at thirty silver pieces.

And Lord said to me, Put them into smelting-place, and consider if it is approved, in manner that I was tested for them. And I took thirty silver pieces and threw them into house of Lord, into smelting-place.
And I threw away second staff, Measure-line, to scatter possession between Judah and Israel.
And Lord said to me, Still take for yourself shepherding gear of foolish shepherd,

because behold, I raise up a shepherd on earth: what is failing he will certainly not visit, what is scattered he will certainly not seek, what is broken he will certainly not heal, what is whole he will certainly not guide, and he will eat flesh of chosen ones and wrench out their ankles.
Woe, shepherding vanities and abandoning sheep. Sword upon his arms and upon his right eye. His arm, drying, will dry up, and his right eye, blinded, will be blinded.
Oracle of word of Lord upon Israel, says Lord, stretching out heaven and founding earth and forming spirit of human within him.
Behold, I make Jerusalem like shaken thresholds to all peoples round about, and in Judah there will be siege against Jerusalem.
And it will be in that day, I will make Jerusalem a trampled stone to all nations. Everyone trampling her will surely be mocked, and all nations of earth will be gathered against her.

In that day, says Lord Almighty, I will strike every horse with astonishment and its rider with madness, but upon house of Judah I will open my eyes, and every horse of peoples I will strike with blindness.
And chiliarchs of Judah will say in their hearts, We will find for ourselves those inhabiting Jerusalem in Lord Almighty their God.

In that day I will make chiliarchs of Judah like firebrand in wood and like torch of fire in stubble, and they will devour on right and left all peoples round about, and Jerusalem will still dwell by herself.
And Lord will save tents of Judah as from beginning, so that boast of house of David and uplift of inhabitants of Jerusalem may not magnify against Judah.
In that day Lord will shield inhabitants of Jerusalem, and weak one among them in that day will be like house of David, and house of David like house of God, like angel of Lord before them.
And it will be in that day, I will seek to remove all nations coming against Jerusalem.

And I will pour out upon house of David and upon inhabitants of Jerusalem spirit of grace and compassion, and they will look toward me because they mocked, and they will mourn for him with mourning as for beloved one and grieve over him as over firstborn.
In that day mourning in Jerusalem will be magnified, like mourning of pomegranate-grove in plain being cut down.

And land will mourn tribe by tribe, tribe by itself and their women by themselves: tribe of house of David by itself and their women by themselves, tribe of house of Nathan by itself and their women by themselves,
tribe of house of Levi by itself and their women by themselves, tribe of Symeon by itself and their women by themselves,
all tribes left behind, tribe by itself and their women by themselves.
In that day every place will be opened in house of David.
And it will be in that day, says Lord, I will destroy names of idols from land, and there will no longer be remembrance of them, and false prophets and unclean spirit I will remove from land.

And it will be, if a man still prophesies, his father and his mother who begot him will say to him, You will not live, because you spoke lies in name of Lord, and his father and mother who begot him will bind his feet together when he prophesies.
And it will be in that day, prophets will each be put to shame by his vision when he prophesies, and they will put on hairy skin because they lied.
And he will say, I am not prophet; I am man working land, because a man begot me from my youth.
And I will say to him, What are these wounds between your hands? And he will say, Those with which I was struck in house of my beloved.
Sword, awake against my shepherds and against man my fellow-citizen, says Lord Almighty. Strike shepherds, and draw out sheep, and I will bring my hand upon shepherds.
And it will be in all land, says Lord, two parts will be destroyed and fail, but third will be left in it.

And I will bring third through fire and refine them as silver is refined and test them as gold is tested. He will call on my name, and I will hear him, and I will say, This is my people, and he will say, Lord is my God.
Behold, days of Lord are coming, and your spoils will be divided in you.

And I will gather all nations against Jerusalem for war, and city will be taken and houses plundered and women defiled, and half of city will go out in captivity, but rest of my people will certainly not be destroyed from city.
And Lord will go out and line up against those nations, as day of his battle in day of war.

And his feet will stand in that day on Mount of Olives opposite Jerusalem from east, and Mount of Olives will be split in half, half eastward and half seaward, a very great chasm, and half of mountain will slope north and half south.

And ravine of my mountains will be blocked up, and ravine of mountains will cling together as far as Iasol, and it will be blocked as it was blocked in days of earthquake in days of Uzziah king of Judah, and Lord my God will come and all holy ones with him.
In that day there will not be light and cold and frost.
It will be one day, and that day known to Lord, and not day and not night, and toward evening there will be light.
And in that day living water will go out from Jerusalem, half of it to first sea and half of it to last sea, and in summer and in spring it will be so.
And Lord will be king over all earth; in that day Lord will be one, and his name one.

Encircling all land and wilderness from Gabe to Remmon south of Jerusalem—but Rama remains in its place—from gate of Benjamin to place of first gate to gate of corners and to tower of Ananeel to king's wine-vats.
And they will dwell in her, and there will no longer be curse, and Jerusalem will dwell in confidence.

And this will be downfall with which Lord will strike all peoples who campaigned against Jerusalem: their flesh will melt while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will flow from their sockets, and their tongue will melt in their mouth.
And it will be in that day, great astonishment of Lord upon them, and each will seize hand of his neighbor, and his hand will tangle against hand of his neighbor.
And Judah will line up in Jerusalem and gather strength of all peoples round about, gold and silver and clothing in very great abundance.
And this will be downfall of horses and mules and camels and donkeys and all cattle in those camps, according to this downfall.
And it will be, whoever are left from all nations coming against Jerusalem will go up year by year to worship King, Lord Almighty, and to celebrate feast of booths.
And it will be, whichever of all tribes of earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship King, Lord Almighty, these things will be added upon them.
And if tribe of Egypt does not go up nor come there, then upon them will be downfall with which Lord will strike all nations that do not go up to celebrate feast of booths.
This will be sin of Egypt and sin of all nations, whichever do not go up to celebrate feast of booths.
In that day, on horse's bridle will be: Holy to Lord Almighty. And pots in house of Lord will be like bowls before altar.

And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Lord Almighty, and all sacrificing will come and take from them and cook in them, and there will no longer be Canaanite in house of Lord Almighty in that day.
Oracle of word of Lord upon Israel by hand of his messenger. Put this now on your hearts.
I loved you, says Lord. And you said, In what way did you love us? Was not Esau brother of Jacob? says Lord. Yet I loved Jacob,
but Esau I hated, and I appointed his borders for destruction and his inheritance for dwellings of desert.

Because Idumea will say, It has been torn down, but let us return and rebuild wastes. Thus says Lord Almighty: They will build, but I will tear down, and they will be called border of lawlessness and people against whom Lord is arrayed forever.
Your eyes will see, and you will say, Lord has been magnified beyond borders of Israel.

A son honors father and a servant his master. If I am father, where is my honor? And if I am Lord, where is my fear? says Lord Almighty to you, priests despising my name. And you said, In what have we despised your name?
Bringing defiled breads to my altar. And you said, In what have we defiled them? In your saying, Lord's table is despised, and foods placed on it are despised.
If you bring blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? And if you bring lame or sick, is it not evil? Present it now to your ruler; will he accept it or receive your face? says Lord Almighty.
And now make atonement to face of your God and beg him. These things came by your hands. Shall I receive your faces? says Lord Almighty.
Even among you doors will be shut, and you will not kindle my altar for nothing. There is no delight of mine in you, says Lord Almighty, and sacrifice I will not accept from your hands.

Because from rising of sun to setting my name has been glorified among nations, and in every place incense is brought to my name and pure sacrifice, because my name is great among nations, says Lord Almighty.
But you profane it in your saying, Lord's table is defiled and foods placed there are despised.

And you said, These things are from hardship, and you snorted at them, says Lord Almighty. You brought plunder and the lame and the afflicted, and if you bring that as sacrifice, shall I accept them from your hands? says Lord Almighty.

Cursed is one who was able, and there was a male in his flock, and his vow was upon him, yet he sacrifices to the Lord a spoiled thing. Because I am a great King, says the Lord Almighty, and my name is manifest among the nations.
And now this command is for you, priests.

If you do not listen and do not set it on your hearts to give glory to my name, says Lord Almighty, I will send curse upon you and curse your blessing and scatter your blessing, and it will not be among you, because you do not set it on your hearts.
Behold, I separate for you the shoulder, and scatter stomach-content on your faces, stomach-content of your feasts, and I will take you with it.
And you will know that I sent this command to you, for my covenant to be with Levites, says Lord Almighty.
My covenant with him was of life and peace, and I gave it to him in fear, to fear me and to shrink before my name.
Law of truth was in his mouth, and injustice was not found on his lips. In peace he walked straight with me and turned many from injustice.
Because lips of priest will guard knowledge, and law they will seek from his mouth, because he is messenger of Lord Almighty.
But you turned aside from the way and made many falter in the law. You corrupted the covenant of Levi, says the Lord Almighty.
And I made you despised and cast aside among all nations, because you did not guard my ways but received faces in law.
Did not one God create you? Is not one father of all you? Why does each abandon his brother, to profane covenant of your fathers?
Judah was abandoned, and abomination happened in Israel and in Jerusalem, because Judah profaned holy things of Lord which he loved and busied himself with foreign gods.
Lord will destroy man doing these, until he is humbled from tents of Jacob and from those bringing sacrifice to Lord Almighty.

And this second thing you did: you covered the altar of the Lord with tears and with weeping and groaning from toil, so that it is no longer worthy to look upon sacrifice or receive what is acceptable from your hands.
And you said, For what reason? Because Lord testified between you and wife of your youth whom you abandoned, and she is your companion and wife of your covenant.
Did not one make, while remnant of spirit was his? And you said, What else does God seek but seed? Guard yourselves in your spirit, and do not abandon wife of your youth.
But if you hate and send away, says the Lord God of Israel, impiety will cover your thoughts, says the Lord Almighty. Guard yourselves in your spirit, and do not abandon.
You provoke God in your words, and you said, In what have we provoked him? In your saying, Everyone doing evil is good before Lord, and in them he took pleasure; and, Where is God of justice?

Behold, I send my messenger, and he will look on way before my face, and suddenly Lord whom you seek will come into his own temple, and messenger of covenant whom you want. Behold, he comes, says Lord Almighty.
And who will endure day of his coming? And who will stand in his appearance? Because he enters like fire of a smelter and like herb of washers.
And he will sit refining and cleansing like silver and gold and will cleanse sons of Levi and pour them out like gold and like silver, and they will be to Lord bringing sacrifice in righteousness.
Sacrifice of Judah and Jerusalem will please Lord as days of age and as former years.

And I will come near to you in judgment and be swift witness against sorceresses and adulteresses and those swearing falsely by my name and those withholding wage of hired worker and oppressing widow and striking orphan and turning aside judgment of sojourner and not fearing me, says Lord Almighty.
Because I am Lord your God and do not change, and you sons of Jacob have not ceased.
From injustices of your fathers you turned aside from my statutes and did not keep them. Return to me and I will return to you, says Lord Almighty. And you said, In what shall we return?
Will a human trick God? Yet you trick me. And you say, In what did we trick you? Because tenths and firstfruits are with you.
Looking, you keep looking away, and me you keep tricking. Nation has been brought to an end.

Bring all produce into storehouses, and in his house there will be provision. Test me in this, says Lord Almighty, if I will not open to you cataracts of heaven and pour out my blessing for you until enough.
And I will appoint one against devouring for you, and he will not destroy fruit of your land, and vine in field will not grow weak for you, says Lord Almighty.
And all nations will call you blessed, because you will be desired land, says Lord Almighty.
Your words were made heavy against me, says Lord. And you said, In what did we speak against you?
You said, Serving God is vain. And what more is it that we kept his charges and that we walked as suppliants before Lord Almighty?
And now we call strangers blessed, and all doing unlawful things are built up, and they stood against God and were saved.
These things those fearing Lord spoke, each to his neighbor, and Lord paid attention and heard, and he wrote book of remembrance before him for those fearing Lord and revering his name.
And they will be mine, says Lord Almighty, in day I make for possession, and I will choose them as man chooses his son serving him.
And you will turn and see between righteous and lawless, and between one serving God and one not serving.

Because behold, day of Lord comes, burning like furnace, and it will burn them, and all strangers and all doing unlawful things will be stubble, and coming day will kindle them, says Lord Almighty, and root and branch will not be left from them.
And for you fearing my name, sun of righteousness will rise, and healing in its wings, and you will go out and skip like calves let loose from bonds.
And you will trample lawless ones, because they will be ashes under your feet in day that I make, says Lord Almighty.
And behold, I send Elijah the Tishbite to you before great and manifest day of Lord comes,
who will restore heart of father to son and heart of man to his neighbor, lest I come and strike earth utterly.
Remember law of Moses my servant, as I commanded him in Horeb for all Israel, ordinances and judgments.
